events: 18日——22日 中国共产党第十一届三中全会在北京举行。出席会议的中央委员169人、候补中央委员112人。中共中央主席华国锋、副主席叶剑英、邓小平、李先念、陈云、汪东兴出席了会议。全会着重指出,毛泽东同志在长期革命斗争中立下的伟大功勋是不可磨灭的。全会高度评价了关于实践是检验真理的唯一标准问题的讨论,批判了“两个凡是”的错误方针,肯定了必须完整地、准确地掌握毛泽东思想的科学体系的提法,确定了解放思想,开动脑筋、实事求是、团结一致向前看的指导方针。同时,决定停止使用“以阶级斗争为纲”的口号,要求全党全面地、认真地纠正“文化大革命”中和以前的“左”倾错误。全会还作出了从 1979 年起,把全党工作重点转移到社会主义现代化建设上来的战略决策。全会提出了全党要注意解决好国民经济重大比例严重失调的要求,原则上通过了关于加快农业发展的两个文件。全会审查和解决了党的历史上一批重大冤假错案和一些重要领导人的功过是非问题,纠正了过去对彭德怀、陶铸、薄一波、杨尚昆等同志所作的错误结论,肯定了他们对党对人民的贡献。会议着重提出了健全党规党法和民主集中制,加强社会主义民主与法制的任务。
translated_text: From the 18th to the 22nd, the Third Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China was held in Beijing. 169 members of the Central Committee and 112 alternate members attended the meeting. Chairman Hua Guofeng, Vice Chairman Ye Jianying, Deng Xiaoping, Li Xiannian, Chen Yun, and Wang Dongxing of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China attended the meeting. The Plenary Session emphasized that the great contributions made by Comrade Mao Zedong in the long-term revolutionary struggle are indelible. The Plenary Session highly praised the discussion on the issue of practice as the only criterion for testing truth, criticized the erroneous policy of "two whatevers", affirmed the need to fully and accurately grasp the scientific system of Mao Zedong Thought, and determined the guiding principle of emancipating the mind, using brains, seeking truth from facts, and uniting as one to look forward. At the same time, it was decided to stop using the slogan of "taking class struggle as the key link" and required the whole party to comprehensively and seriously correct the "left" errors during and before the "Cultural Revolution". The Plenary Session also made a strategic decision to shift the focus of the work of the whole party to socialist modernization from 1979. The plenary session put forward the requirement that the whole party should pay attention to solving the serious imbalance of major proportions in the national economy, and in principle passed two documents on accelerating agricultural development. The plenary session reviewed and resolved a number of major unjust, false and wrong cases in the party's history and the merits and demerits of some important leaders, corrected the wrong conclusions made in the past about comrades such as Peng Dehuai, Tao Zhu, Bo Yibo and Yang Shangkun, and affirmed their contributions to the party and the people. The meeting emphasized the task of improving party rules and laws and democratic centralism, and strengthening socialist democracy and the legal system. The plenary session elected Chen Yun as vice chairman of the Party Central Committee, and Deng Yingchao, Hu Yaobang and Wang Zhen as members of the Central Political Bureau. The plenary session added Huang Kecheng, Song Renwu, Hu Qiaomu, Xi Zhongxun, Wang Renzhong, Huang Huoqing, Chen Zaidao, Han Guang and Zhou Hui as members of the Central Committee, and proposed that the 12th National Congress of the Communist Party of China be ratified. The plenary session elected the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, and elected Chen Yun as the first secretary, Deng Yingchao as the second secretary, Hu Yaobang as the third secretary, and Huang Kecheng as the executive secretary.

events: 1978年12月18日至22日,中国共产党第十一届中央委员会第三次全体会议在北京举行。会议作出了把工作重点转移到社会主义建设上来的战略决策,提出要对权力过分集中的体制进行认真的改革。会议公报指出,要认真解决党政企不分、以党代政､以政代企的现象,实行分级分工分人负责,加强管理机构和管理人员的权限和责任,减少会议公文,提高工作效率,认真实行考核、奖惩､升降等制度。
translated_text: From December 18 to 22, 1978, the Third Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China was held in Beijing. The meeting made a strategic decision to shift the focus of work to socialist construction and proposed to seriously reform the system of excessive concentration of power. The communiqué of the meeting pointed out that it is necessary to seriously solve the phenomenon of no distinction between the party, government and enterprise, the party replacing the government, and the government replacing the enterprise, implement hierarchical division of labor and individual responsibility, strengthen the authority and responsibility of management agencies and management personnel, reduce meeting documents, improve work efficiency, and earnestly implement the system of assessment, rewards and punishments, promotion and demotion.

产阶级革命家、党和国家的卓越领导人彭德怀、陶铸同志追悼大
会在北京隆重举行。中共中央副主席叶剑英主持追悼大会,中共
中央副主席邓小平、陈云分别致悼词。
translated_text: On the 24th, a memorial meeting for Comrades Peng Dehuai and Tao Zhu, two long-tested and loyal revolutionary fighters of the Communist Party of China, proletarian revolutionaries of the older generation, and outstanding leaders of the Party and the country, was held in Beijing. Vice Chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China Ye Jianying presided over the memorial meeting, and Vice Chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China Deng Xiaoping and Chen Yun delivered eulogies respectively.

分。贯彻落实党中央重视和关心老干部的政策,加强老干部工

治局面,恢复和发扬党的优良传统和作风,加快实现四个现代化
的步伐,都具有重大意义。要求各级党组织积极认真地把这项工
作抓紧抓好。
translated_text: On the 29th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued "Several Opinions on Strengthening the Work of Veteran Cadres". The "Opinions" pointed out that the work of veteran cadres is an important part of the party's cadre work. Implementing the Party Central Committee's policy of paying attention to and caring about veteran cadres, strengthening the work of veteran cadres, and giving full play to the positive role of veteran cadres are of great significance to consolidating and developing a stable and united political situation, restoring and carrying forward the party's fine traditions and style, and accelerating the pace of realizing the four modernizations. Party organizations at all levels are required to actively and conscientiously grasp this work.

上来》的社论,指出:把全党工作的重点转移到社会主义现代
化建设上来,是一个伟大的战略转变。全体干部、全体党员和全
国人民都要动员起来,跟上客观形势的发展,在思想上来一个大
解放。各级党、政、群、团的工作,都要服从社会主义现代化建

translated_text: On the 1st, the People's Daily published an editorial entitled "Focus on Production and Construction", pointing out that shifting the focus of the whole party's work to socialist modernization is a great strategic shift. All cadres, all party members and the people of the country must be mobilized to keep up with the development of the objective situation and have a great ideological liberation. The work of the party, government, mass organizations and leagues at all levels must obey the center of socialist modernization and cannot leave this center.

events: 中共中央转发上海市委《关于解决所谓“一月革命”问题的请示报告》。《报告》指出,所谓“一月革命”,是指从1967年1月4日张春桥、姚文元回到上海,到2月5日建立“上海人民公社”这一段时间内,他们从上海打开缺口,进行全面夺权的阴谋活动。在“一月革命”中被公开点名批判的陈丕显,曹荻秋、魏文伯、杨西光等同志,所有受迫害的赤卫队等群众组织和干部、群众,以及一切假案,错案、冤案,予以彻底平反,恢复名誉,切诬陷不实之词,统统予以推倒。
translated_text: On the 4th, the CPC Central Committee approved Peng Chong as the first secretary of the Shanghai Municipal Committee and agreed to him as the director of the Municipal Revolutionary Committee; Liang Buting as the second secretary of the Qinghai Provincial Committee; Zhao Lin and Qiang Xiaochu as the secretaries of the Shandong Provincial Committee and agreed to them as deputy directors of the Provincial Revolutionary Committee; agreed to Wang Kewen, Wu Guangtang and Guo Qinan as deputy directors of the Shanxi Provincial Revolutionary Committee; agreed to Wang Bingxiang and Gao Mianchun as deputy directors of the Gansu Provincial Revolutionary Committee; agreed to Zheng Shaowen as the vice president of the Supreme People's Court, approved Yang Jingren as the party secretary of the State Ethnic Affairs Commission, and approved Yang Dongsheng, Jiang Ping, Hu Jiabin, Xie He and others as deputy directors of the State Ethnic Affairs Commission; approved Timur Dawamat as the secretary of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region Party Committee and agreed to him as the deputy director of the Revolutionary Committee; agreed to Wu Jinghua, deputy director of the Sichuan Provincial Ethnic Affairs Commission, concurrently as deputy director of the State Ethnic Affairs Commission; Xu Shijie and Jia Qingli as deputy ministers of the Ministry of Chemical Industry. The CPC Central Committee forwarded the Shanghai Municipal Committee's "Request Report on Solving the So-called "January Revolution" Issue". The report pointed out that the so-called "January Revolution" refers to the period from January 4, 1967, when Zhang Chunqiao and Yao Wenyuan returned to Shanghai, to February 5, when they established the "Shanghai People's Commune". During this period, they opened a gap in Shanghai and carried out a conspiracy to seize power. Comrades Chen Pixian, Cao Diqiu, Wei Wenbo, Yang Xiguang and others who were publicly criticized in the "January Revolution", all persecuted mass organizations and cadres and masses such as the Red Guards, as well as all false cases, wrong cases and unjust cases, have been thoroughly rehabilitated and their reputations restored, and all false accusations have been completely overturned.

events:
4日——22日 中共中央纪律检查委员会第一次全体会议在
北京举行。中共中央副主席、中纪委第一书记陈云主持会议并讲
了话。他指出,中央纪律检查委员会的基本任务,就是维护党规
党法,整顿党风。会议着重研究了党规党法和搞好党风问题,讨
论并拟订了《关于党内政治生活的若干准则》,讨论并通过了
《中共中央纪律检查委员会关于工作任务、职权范围、机构设置
的规定》。
translated_text: From the 4th to the 22nd, the first plenary meeting of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China was held in Beijing. Chen Yun, Vice Chairman of the Communist Party of China and First Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, presided over the meeting and delivered a speech. He pointed out that the basic task of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection is to uphold the party rules and laws and rectify the party style. The meeting focused on studying the party rules and laws and improving the party style, discussed and drafted the "Several Principles on Political Life within the Party", and discussed and passed the "Regulations of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China on Work Tasks, Scope of Authority, and Organizational Setup".

events: 11日 中共中央作出《关于地主、富农分子摘帽问题和地、富子女成份问题的决定》。《决定》指出,除了极少数坚持反动立场的以外,凡是多年遵守政府法令,老实劳动,不做坏事的地主、富农分子以及反革命分子,经过群众评审,县革委会批准,一律摘掉帽子,给予农村人民公社社员待遇;地主、富农家庭出身的社员的子女,家庭出身应一律为社员,不再作为地主、富农家庭出身。
translated_text: On the 11th, the CPC Central Committee issued the "Decision on the Issue of Removing the Labels of Landlords and Rich Peasants and the Class Status of the Children of Landlords and Rich Peasants". The "Decision" pointed out that, except for a very small number of those who persisted in reactionary positions, all landlords, rich peasants and counter-revolutionaries who had obeyed government laws and regulations for many years, worked honestly and did not do bad things, after being evaluated by the masses and approved by the county revolutionary committee, would all be removed from their labels and given the treatment of rural people's commune members; the children of members from landlord and rich peasant families should all be members of the commune and no longer be regarded as being from landlord and rich peasant families. The CPC Central Committee approved Wang Yifu as the deputy secretary of the Tianjin Municipal Committee and agreed to him as the deputy director of the Municipal Revolutionary Committee; and agreed to Yan Jimin as the deputy director of the Henan Provincial Revolutionary Committee.

events: 17日 中共中央批转《关于落实对国民党起义投诚人员政策的请示报告的通知》。《通知》指出:认真落实对起义投诚人员的政策,不仅对恢复党的优良传统是必要的,而且对台湾回归祖国、完成祖国统一大业,有着重要的意义。

events:
21日——30日 中共中央组织部、中共中央宣传部、文化
部党组、全国文联筹备组联合召开全国文艺界落实党的知识分子
政策汇报座谈会。会议着重研究了如何进一步加快落实党的知识
分子政策的问题。中共中央政治局委员胡耀邦到会作了重要讲
话。4 月 18 日中组部等四单位联合发出《全国文艺界落实党的
知识分子政策汇报座谈会纪要》。《纪要》指出,落实党的政策,
解决好历史遗留问题,分清是非功过,就是为了调动一切积极因
素,加强团结,更好地为实现四个现代化而奋斗。总的原则是:
实事求是,有错必纠。凡是不实之词都要推倒,凡是不正确的结
论和处理都要予以纠正,做到全错的全平,部分错的部分平,不
错的不平。
translated_text: From the 21st to the 30th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Propaganda Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Party Group of the Ministry of Culture, and the Preparatory Group of the National Federation of Literary and Art Circles jointly held a symposium on the implementation of the Party's intellectual policy in the literary and art circles across the country. The meeting focused on how to further accelerate the implementation of the Party's intellectual policy. Hu Yaobang, a member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, attended the meeting and delivered an important speech. On April 18, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and other four units jointly issued the "Minutes of the Symposium on the Implementation of the Party's Intellectual Policy in the Literary and Art Circles across the Country". The "Minutes" pointed out that implementing the Party's policies, solving historical problems, and distinguishing right from wrong, merits and demerits are all for the purpose of mobilizing all positive factors, strengthening unity, and better striving for the realization of the four modernizations. The general principle is: seek truth from facts and correct mistakes. All untrue words must be overturned, and all incorrect conclusions and treatments must be corrected, so that all mistakes are corrected, some mistakes are corrected, and those that are correct are not corrected.

Tong Dizhou, an outstanding scientist and Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, died in Beijing at the age of 77.

events: 18日——7月1日 第五届全国人大常委会第二次会议在北京举行。叶剑英委员长致开幕词和闭幕词。会议通过的《政府工作报告》中说:在我国(除台湾外),作为阶级的地主阶级、富农阶级已经消灭。作为阶级的资本家阶级也已经不再存在。经过近三十年的斗争和教育,这些人绝大多数已经改造成为自食其力的劳动者。当然,我国还有反革命分子和敌特分子,还有各种严重破坏社会主义秩序的犯罪分子和蜕化变质分子,还有贪污盗窃、投机倒把的新剥削分子。“四人帮”的某些残余,没有改造好的极少数地主富农分子和其他旧剥削阶级的某些残余,也还会继续坚持反动立场,进行反社会主义的政治和经济活动,并且国内阶级斗争又同国际阶级斗争密切地联系着,因此,我们还必须对他们实行无产阶级专政。我们应当采取的方针是:承认有阶级斗争,但今后再不需要也再不应该进行大规模的急风暴雨式的群众阶级斗争。我们的根本任务已经由解放生产力变为在新的生产关系下面保护和发展生产力。
translated_text: From July 18 to July 1, the second session of the Standing Committee of the Fifth National People's Congress was held in Beijing. Chairman Ye Jianying delivered the opening and closing speeches. The "Government Work Report" adopted at the meeting said: In our country (except Taiwan), the landlord class and the rich peasant class as classes have been eliminated. The capitalist class as a class no longer exists. After nearly 30 years of struggle and education, the vast majority of these people have been transformed into self-reliant laborers. Of course, our country still has counter-revolutionaries and enemy agents, as well as various criminals and degenerate elements who seriously undermine the socialist order, and new exploiters who embezzle, steal, and speculate. Some remnants of the "Gang of Four", a very small number of landlords and rich peasants who have not been transformed, and some remnants of other old exploiting classes will continue to adhere to reactionary positions and carry out anti-socialist political and economic activities. In addition, the domestic class struggle is closely linked to the international class struggle. Therefore, we must also implement the dictatorship of the proletariat over them. The policy we should adopt is: recognize that there is class struggle, but there is no need and should be no large-scale, stormy mass class struggle in the future. Our fundamental task has changed from liberating productivity to protecting and developing productivity under new production relations. translated_text: On the 29th, Deng Xiaoping, Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Committee and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, pointed out when meeting with all comrades of the enlarged meeting of the Standing Committee of the Navy Party Committee that, as far as the whole country is concerned, through the debate on practice as the only criterion for testing truth and the "two whatevers", our ideological line has been relatively clearly resolved, and the ideological line advocated by Comrade Mao Zedong of seeking truth from facts, integrating theory with practice, and starting from reality has been restored and developed. translated_text: On the 30th, Xinhua News Agency reported that the National Disciplinary Inspection Work Conference was recently held in Beijing. The conference studied several issues on further improving the Party's style, enforcing Party discipline, and strengthening Party building. Hu Yaobang, the third secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, delivered a speech entitled "Several Opinions on Improving the Party's Style and Enforcing Party Discipline". The speech put forward six requirements for improving the Party's style: (1) We must earnestly educate our Party members, especially Party cadres, to resolutely implement and safeguard the line, principles and a whole set of policies determined by the Party Central Committee in the new era to ensure the political and ideological unity of the whole Party. (2) We must earnestly and resolutely fight against factionalism, safeguard the unity of the whole Party on the basis of Marxist principles, and use the material unity of the organization to consolidate the political and ideological unity of the Party. (3) We must earnestly make the Party's organizational life more normal, and do everything in accordance with democratic centralism. We must not allow individuals to have the final say, and we must not allow extreme democratization and anarchism. (4) We must strive to overcome the bad style of some Party members, especially some leading cadres, who are seriously divorced from the masses and seriously corrode the body of the Party, and carry forward the fine style of our Party. (5) We must conscientiously restore the fine tradition of effective intra-party struggle, adhere to the principles of unity-criticism-unity and punishment for past mistakes, and cure the disease to save the patient. (6) We must reform the party's cadre system step by step, and implement the election, examination, assessment, supervision, reward and punishment, removal, rotation, retirement and other systems step by step. He also proposed that a series of party rules and regulations should be quickly formulated, such as the norms of political life within the party, the living standards of leading cadres, the specific provisions of conscientiously implementing democratic centralism, the rights and obligations of party members, etc., and implement them after approval by the Central Committee.

translated_text: On the 4th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued a "Request Report on the Handling of Some Cases before the Cultural Revolution" approved by the Central Committee. events:
5日——29日 中共中央组织部在北京召开全国组织工作座
谈会。会议内容是:围绕组织工作适应全党工作重点的转移和保
证四个现代化建设的需要,着重研究解决当前党的建设中几个重
要问题,如落实干部政策、调整领导班子、党员教育、干部培训
以及改革干部制度等,中共中央政治局委员、中共中央秘书长胡
耀邦在会上传达了中央有关党的组织工作的一些重要指示。他指
出,新时期党的组织路线,就是使党的组织工作,干部工作促进
和确保四个现代化的实现;组织工作的重点应该放到提高全党同
志实现四个现代化的坚定性、积极性和创造性上。中共中央组织
部部长宋任穷在会议结束时作了总结发言。
会议形成的几个主要文件,经中央领导同志审阅同意,于
1980年2月22日由中央组织部发出。文件有:《关于加强领导
班子建设的几点意见》、《关于善始善终地搞好落实干部政策工作
的意见》和《宋任穷同志在全国组织工作座谈会上的总结发
言》。经座谈会讨论修改的《关于实行干部考核制度的意见》,已
由中央组织部于1979年11月21日发出。
translated_text: From the 5th to the 29th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee held a national symposium on organizational work in Beijing. The content of the meeting was: focusing on the organizational work to adapt to the shift of the focus of the whole party's work and to ensure the needs of the four modernizations, focusing on studying and solving several important problems in the current party building, such as the implementation of cadre policies, adjustment of leadership teams, party member education, cadre training, and reform of the cadre system. Hu Yaobang, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary-General of the CPC Central Committee, conveyed some important instructions of the Central Committee on the party's organizational work at the meeting. He pointed out that the party's organizational line in the new era is to make the party's organizational work and cadre work promote and ensure the realization of the four modernizations; the focus of organizational work should be placed on improving the firmness, enthusiasm and creativity of all party comrades in realizing the four modernizations. Song Renqiong, Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, made a summary speech at the end of the meeting. Several major documents formed at the meeting were reviewed and approved by the central leaders and issued by the Central Organization Department on February 22, 1980. The documents include: "Several Opinions on Strengthening Leadership Team Building", "Opinions on Implementing Cadre Policies from Beginning to End" and "Comrade Song Renqiong's Summary Speech at the National Organization Work Symposium". The "Opinions on Implementing the Cadre Appraisal System", which was revised after discussion at the symposium, was issued by the Central Organization Department on November 21, 1979.

The plenary session added Wang Heshou, Liu Lanbo, Liu Lantao, An Ziwen, Li Chang, Yang Shangkun, Zhou Yang, Lu Dingyi, Hong Xuezhi, Peng Zhen, Jiang Nanxiang, and Bo Yibo as members of the Central Committee, and prepared to ratify them at the 12th National Congress of the Communist Party of China. events: 全会增补王鹤寿、刘澜波、刘澜涛、安子文、李昌、杨尚昆、周扬、陆定一,洪学智、彭真、蒋南翔、薄一波为中央委员,准备在中国共产党第十二次全国代表大会上予以追认。全会增选赵紫阳、彭真为中央政治局委员。

events:
29日 中共中央副主席、全国人大常委会委员长叶剑英在
庆祝建国30周年大会上发表重要讲话。《讲话》高度评价了毛泽
东、周恩来、朱德等老一辈无产阶级革命家的不朽功绩,全面回
顾了建国30年来的战斗历程,深刻批判了林彪、“四人帮”两个反
革命阴谋集团,充分肯定了建国30年以来党和人民取得的重大
成就,初步总结了建国30年来的经验教训,提出了今后的奋斗
目标。《讲话》指出,政治路线要以思想路线做基础,还要靠组
织路线来保证。现在各级领导班子的建设问题和干部制度的改革
问题,已经成为十分迫切的任务,提到我们的议事日程上来了。
《讲话》要求,在建设各级领导班子时,在强调革命化的同时,
要注意年轻化和专业化。
translated_text: On the 29th, Ye Jianying, Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Committee and Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, delivered an important speech at the celebration of the 30th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China. The speech highly praised the immortal achievements of Mao Zedong, Zhou Enlai, Zhu De and other older generation proletarian revolutionaries, comprehensively reviewed the battle process of the 30 years since the founding of the People's Republic of China, profoundly criticized the two counter-revolutionary conspiracy groups of Lin Biao and the "Gang of Four", fully affirmed the major achievements made by the Party and the people in the 30 years since the founding of the People's Republic of China, preliminarily summarized the experience and lessons of the 30 years since the founding of the People's Republic of China, and put forward the future struggle goals. The speech pointed out that the political line should be based on the ideological line and must be guaranteed by the organizational line. Now the construction of leadership teams at all levels and the reform of the cadre system have become very urgent tasks and have been put on our agenda. The speech requires that when building leadership teams at all levels, while emphasizing revolutionization, attention should be paid to youth and professionalism.

events: 1979年9月29日,叶剑英同志在庆祝中华人民共和国成立三十周年大会上的讲话中指出,目前我们的干部制度存在着严重的缺陷,不仅不利于人才的发现、选拔和培养,不利于干部队伍的逐步年轻化和专业化,而且往往造成许多人才的埋没和浪费。必须经过周密计划,采取坚决有力的措施,认真进行必要的改革。
translated_text: On September 29, 1979, Comrade Ye Jianying pointed out in his speech at the meeting celebrating the 30th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China that there are serious defects in our current cadre system, which is not only not conducive to the discovery, selection and training of talents, and not conducive to the gradual rejuvenation and professionalization of the cadre team, but also often causes many talents to be buried and wasted. We must make careful plans, take resolute and powerful measures, and earnestly carry out necessary reforms.

events:

名干部的任务,经有关省市委和中央、国家机关部委共同努力,
于7月上旬全部完成。报告还总结了这次调干中的成绩和问题,
提出了今后为西藏调干的方针。

Through the joint efforts of the relevant provincial and municipal party committees and the central and state organs and ministries, it was completed in early July. The report also summarized the achievements and problems in this transfer and put forward the policy for transferring cadres to Tibet in the future.

He pointed out that we should pay serious attention to cultivating and discovering talents and use them properly; we should change the phenomenon of seniority-based promotion; and we should quickly establish a degree system and technical titles.

events:
2日 中共中央召集中央党政军机关副部长以上干部报告
会。中共中央副主席邓小平在会上作了题为《高级干部要带头发
扬党的艰苦朴素、密切联系群众的优良传统》的报告。报告分三
个问题;(一)高级干部的生活待遇;(二)认真选拔接班人;
(三)切实关心群众生活。他在谈到认真选拔接班人问题时强调
指出,我们国家面临的一个严重问题,不是四个现代化的路线、
方针对不对,而是缺少一大批实现这个路线、方针的人才。现在
我们搞四个现代化,急需培养、选拔一大批合格的人才。这是一
个新课题,也是对老同志和高级干部提出的一个责任,就是要认
真选好接班人。他指出,老同志现在的责任很多,第一位的责任是
什么,就是认真选好接班人。中共中央、国务院同时下发了《关
于高级干部生活待遇的若干规定》和邓小平所作的《高级干部要
带头发扬党的艰苦朴素、密切联系群众的优良传统》的报告。
translated_text: On the 2nd, the CPC Central Committee convened a report meeting for cadres above the deputy minister level in the central party, government and military organs. Deng Xiaoping, vice chairman of the CPC Central Committee, delivered a report entitled "Senior cadres should take the lead in carrying forward the party's fine tradition of hard work, plain living and close ties with the masses". The report was divided into three issues: (1) the living conditions of senior cadres; (2) the careful selection of successors; and (3) the practical concern for the lives of the masses. When talking about the issue of careful selection of successors, he emphasized that a serious problem facing our country is not that the line and policy of the four modernizations are wrong, but that there is a lack of a large number of talents who can realize this line and policy. Now that we are carrying out the four modernizations, we urgently need to train and select a large number of qualified talents. This is a new topic and also a responsibility put forward to old comrades and senior cadres, that is, to carefully select successors. He pointed out that old comrades now have many responsibilities, and the first responsibility is to carefully select successors. The CPC Central Committee and the State Council simultaneously issued "Several Provisions on the Living Allowance of Senior Cadres" and Deng Xiaoping's report "Senior Cadres Should Take the Lead in Carrying Forward the Party's Fine Tradition of Hard Work, Plain Living and Close Ties with the Masses".

events: 1979年11月2日,邓小平同志在中央党政军机关副部长以上干部会上作了《高级干部要带头发扬党的优良传统》的报告。报告指出,现在庙很多,领导机关和军队指挥机关庞大、臃肿,官僚主义、官僚机构、官僚制度的害处极大。所以,我们要改革现行的干部工作制度,建立有利于提拔年轻干部的制度。他认为,不能只建立顾问制度,重要的是建立退休制度。
translated_text: On November 2, 1979, Comrade Deng Xiaoping delivered a report entitled "Senior Cadres Should Take the Lead in Carrying Forward the Party's Fine Traditions" at a meeting of cadres at or above the level of deputy ministers in the central party, government and military organs. The report pointed out that there are too many temples, and the leading organs and military command organs are huge and bloated. Bureaucracy, bureaucratic institutions and bureaucratic systems are extremely harmful. Therefore, we must reform the current cadre work system and establish a system that is conducive to the promotion of young cadres. He believes that it is not enough to just establish an advisory system, but it is important to establish a retirement system.

events: 3日 中共中央、国务院批转国家档案局关于处理“文化大革命”运动中形成的含有冤假错案内容的文书材料的意见,提出了立卷的范围,已立卷归档的文件有诬蔑不实之词的处理办法,并指出考察干部历史应以人事档案为准,不要以文书档案为依据。今后如有人利用私自保存的材料对他人进行诬陷和打击报复的,应按党纪国法处理。
translated_text: On the 3rd, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council approved the State Archives Administration's opinion on handling documents and materials containing false and wrongful convictions during the "Cultural Revolution" movement, proposed the scope of filing, and the handling method for documents that have been filed and have slanderous and untrue words, and pointed out that the investigation of cadre history should be based on personnel files, not on documents and files. In the future, if someone uses privately preserved materials to frame and retaliate against others, they should be dealt with according to party discipline and national laws. The CPC Central Committee and the Central Military Commission approved Wang Ping as the deputy secretary-general of the Central Military Commission. The CPC Central Committee approved Jiao Linyi as the secretary of the Hunan Provincial Party Committee.

events: 17日 中共中央批转中央统战部、中央组织部等五部门关于对原工商业者的若干具体政策的规定。规定的第二条提出:原工商业者的原来成份,仍然是资本家或资本家的代理人,他们过去档案材料上填写的成份,是历史记载,不再改动。从1979年7月起,他们填写现在的成份时,是干部就填“干部”,和工人一样参加生产劳动的就填“工人”。今后不要再叫他们“资本家”、“资产阶级工商业者”或“私方人员”等。
translated_text: On the 17th, the CPC Central Committee approved the provisions of the Central United Front Work Department, the Central Organization Department and other five departments on some specific policies for former industrialists and businessmen. The second article of the provisions stated that the original composition of former industrialists and businessmen is still capitalists or agents of capitalists. The composition they filled in on the archives in the past is a historical record and will not be changed. From July 1979, when they fill in their current composition, if they are cadres, they will fill in "cadres", and if they participate in production labor like workers, they will fill in "workers". In the future, they will no longer be called "capitalists", "bourgeois industrialists and businessmen" or "private personnel". The CPC Central Committee approved Liang Buting as the first secretary of the Qinghai Provincial Committee; and agreed that Zhang Qi would be the vice chairman of the All-China Federation of Trade Unions.

调,党的领导是四项基本原则中带根本性的一条。
《人民日报》发表题为《迎接大有作为的年代》的社论。社
论指出,实现四个现代化,这是我们今后相当长时期的中心工
作,其他工作都要为这个中心服务。为了把经济搞上去,我们要
继续坚定不移地贯彻“调整、改革、整顿、提高”的方针。
translated_text: On the 1st, Deng Xiaoping, Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Committee and Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, pointed out at the New Year's Tea Party held by the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference that the 1980s was an important era for realizing the "four modernizations". Our most fundamental task was to do our own things well, that is, to do four things well: first, we must adhere to the party's political line; second, we must have a stable and united political situation; third, we must have an entrepreneurial spirit of hard work; fourth, we must establish a cadre team with professional knowledge who adhere to the socialist path. He particularly emphasized that the leadership of the party is the most fundamental of the four basic principles. The People's Daily published an editorial entitled "Welcome to the Era of Great Achievements". The editorial pointed out that realizing the four modernizations is our central task for a considerable period of time in the future, and other work must serve this center. In order to develop the economy, we must continue to unswervingly implement the policy of "adjustment, reform, rectification, and improvement".

转发的这个报告指出,对所谓“彭德怀、高岗、习仲勋反党集团”
的提法,一概推倒;对其受到株连的干部和群众,尚未平反的要
很快平反。
translated_text: On the 5th, the United Front Work Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Supreme People's Court, the Ministry of Public Security, the Ministry of Civil Affairs, the General Political Department of the Military Commission and other units issued the "Explanation on Several Issues Regarding the Implementation of the Policy for the Former Kuomintang Uprising and Surrendering Personnel". The document discussed four issues: (i) the boundaries of the uprising and surrendering personnel; (ii) the review and approval work; (iii) the resettlement issue; and (iv) the issue of the implicated family members and children. The document emphasized that the employment, military service, education, admission to the party and the league, the granting of titles, professional titles, rewards and punishments of the family members and children of the uprising and surrendering personnel should be based on their own conditions and should not be discriminated against. The CPC Central Committee approved the "Request Report on the Thorough Rehabilitation of the So-called "Peng, Gao, and Xi Anti-Party Group" by the CPC Shaanxi Provincial Committee. The report forwarded by the Central Organization Department on January 11 pointed out that the so-called "Peng Dehuai, Gao Gang, and Xi Zhongxun Anti-Party Group" should be completely overturned; the cadres and masses who were implicated should be rehabilitated as soon as possible.

events:

北京举行。会议讨论通过《关于党内政治生活的若干准则》,《关
于刘少奇、瞿秋白的复查平反报告》、《关于康生、谢富治问题的
审查报告》,准备提交党的十一届五中全会审议。3月15日,中
共中央正式公布《关于党内政治生活的若干准则》。其中特别强
调指出,党的各级组织、各部门、每一个共产党员,都要自觉
地、坚定不移地执行党的政治路线和思想路线;要坚持集体领
导,反对个人专断;要维护党的集中统一,严格遵守党的纪律;
要接受党和群众的监督,不准搞特权。
translated_text: From March 7 to 25, the second plenary session of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China was held in Beijing. The meeting discussed and passed the "Several Regulations on Political Life within the Party", the "Reexamination and Rehabilitation Report on Liu Shaoqi and Qu Qiubai", and the "Review Report on the Issues of Kang Sheng and Xie Fuzhi", and prepared to submit them to the Fifth Plenary Session of the Eleventh Central Committee of the Party for deliberation. On March 15, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China officially announced the "Several Regulations on Political Life within the Party". It was particularly emphasized that all party organizations, departments, and every Communist Party member at all levels must consciously and unswervingly implement the party's political line and ideological line; adhere to collective leadership and oppose individual dictatorship; maintain the party's centralized unity and strictly abide by party discipline; accept supervision from the party and the masses and are not allowed to enjoy privileges.

events:

军队干部改办转业是必要的,但考虑到目前正进行国民经济调
整,经济上还有不少困难,改办转业问题要放到1980年或再长
一点时间来解决。5月10日,总政治部等七部门发出执行这一
文件若干具体问题的规定。

出,林彪、“四人帮”诬陷谭震林同志为叛徒等一切不实之词,应

translated_text: On the 10th, the CPC Central Committee, the State Council, and the Central Military Commission approved the "Request Report on the Re-employment of Demobilized Military Cadres from 1969 to 1975" by the General Political Department, the Ministry of Civil Affairs, and the General Bureau of Labor. The report pointed out that it was necessary to re-employ the 410,000 military cadres who were demobilized during this period, but considering that the national economy was currently undergoing adjustment and there were still many economic difficulties, the re-employment issue should be put off until 1980 or a little longer. On May 10, the General Political Department and other seven departments issued regulations on the implementation of several specific issues of this document. The CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on the Rehabilitation of Comrade Tan Zhenlin". The notice pointed out that all the false accusations made by Lin Biao and the "Gang of Four" against Comrade Tan Zhenlin as a traitor should be overturned and thoroughly rehabilitated.

events:
16日 中共中央召集干部报告会,中共中央副主席邓小平
作了《目前的形势和任务》的重要报告,提出八十年代要做的三
件大事:反对霸权主义,维护世界和平;台湾回归祖国,实现祖
国统一;加紧四个现代化建设。三件大事的核心是现代化建设。
他指出,实现四个现代化必须解决四个问题:(一)要有一条坚
定不移的,贯彻始终的政治路线;(二)要有一个安定团结的政
治局面;(三)要有一股艰苦奋斗的创业精神;(四)要有一支坚
持走社会主义道路的,具有专业知识和能力的干部队伍。报告还
强调了坚持和改善党的领导的重要性。1月28日,中共中央转
发了这个报告。
translated_text: On the 16th, the CPC Central Committee convened a cadre report meeting. Deng Xiaoping, Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Committee, made an important report entitled "The Current Situation and Tasks", proposing three major tasks to be done in the 1980s: oppose hegemonism and safeguard world peace; Taiwan's return to the motherland and achieve national reunification; and speed up the construction of the four modernizations. The core of the three major tasks is modernization. He pointed out that the realization of the four modernizations must solve four problems: (i) there must be an unswerving and consistent political line; (ii) there must be a stable and united political situation; (iii) there must be a spirit of hard work and entrepreneurship; (iv) there must be a cadre team with professional knowledge and ability who adhere to the socialist road. The report also emphasized the importance of upholding and improving the party's leadership. On January 28, the CPC Central Committee forwarded this report.

For married couples who are separated from each other, the problem should generally be solved through organizational transfers, based on the principle of large cities to small and medium-sized towns, inland areas to border areas, and first- and second-tier regions to third-tier regions.

events: 1980年1月21日,国务院批转1979年11月全国人事局长会议纪要,要求各地区各部门结合实际情况贯彻执行。会议学习了中央文件,本着实践是检验真理的唯一标准的原则,着重研究了人事工作如何适应全党全国工作着重点转移和国民经济调整的需要问题,确定新时期人事工作的根本任务就是改要贯彻执行党的组织路线,促进和确保党的政治路线的实现,紧紧围绕“四化”革建设这个中心,做好对干部的考核、调配、调整、录用、培训、奖惩和工资福利等30工作;协助党委组织部门做好干部制度､干部队伍结构的改革工作,发现、选拔各行各业的优秀人才,充实到岗位上来;提高干部的积极性和创造性,为“四化”建设作出贡献。
translated_text: On January 21, 1980, the State Council approved the minutes of the National Personnel Bureau Directors' Meeting in November 1979, requiring all regions and departments to implement it in light of their actual conditions. The meeting studied the central documents and, in line with the principle that practice is the only criterion for testing truth, focused on studying how personnel work can adapt to the needs of the shift in the focus of the whole party and the whole country's work and the adjustment of the national economy, and determined that the fundamental task of personnel work in the new era is to implement the party's organizational line, promote and ensure the realization of the party's political line, and closely focus on the "four modernizations" reform and construction as the center, and do a good job in the assessment, deployment, adjustment, recruitment, training, rewards and punishments, and wages and benefits of cadres; assist the party committee organization department in reforming the cadre system and cadre team structure, discover and select outstanding talents from all walks of life, and fill them in positions; improve the enthusiasm and creativity of cadres, and contribute to the "four modernizations".

events: 28日 中共中央组织部、国家科学技术委员会党组转发国务院科技干部局《关于对留苏回国学生反映问题的处理意见》。《意见》提出,对留苏回国的同志在政治上要充分信任,工作上要合理安排使用,要承认他们在国外获得的学术称号,在国内授予相应的技术职称,并解决工资遗留问题,关心他们的物质生活。29日 中共中央发出《关于成立中央党史委员会及其工作机构的通知》。中央党史委员会由华国锋、叶剑英、邓小平、李先念、陈云、聂荣臻、邓颖超、胡耀邦组成。在中央党史委员会领导下,成立党史编审委员会,编审委员会由胡耀邦、彭真、粟裕、胡乔木、陆定一、李维汉、程子华、杨尚昆、王鹤寿、安子文、姚依林,冯文彬组成。在党史编审委员会领导下,成立党史研究室,党史研究室的领导成员是:主任胡乔木,副主任胡绳、华楠、李新、廖盖隆。

translated_text: On the 5th, the CPC Central Committee approved the minutes of the National Party School Work Symposium. With the approval of the CPC Central Committee, the CPC Central Organization Department, the CPC Central Propaganda Department and the CPC Central Party School jointly held the National Party School Work Symposium in Beijing from December 25, 1979 to January 17, 1980. The meeting emphasized that it is the task of Party schools at all levels to re-arm cadres with the basic theories of Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought and various professional knowledge, to ensure the unity of the whole Party in the ideological and political lines, so as to strengthen and improve the Party's leadership. The State Council and the Central Military Commission approved the General Political Department's implementation of the supplementary provisions of the "Notice of the CPC Central Committee on the Rehabilitation and Correction of the Issues of Right-leaning Opportunists". On June 1, the Ministry of Civil Affairs, the State Administration of Labor and the General Political Department of the Military Commission responded to the specific issues in the implementation of this document. The CPC Central Organization Department issued the "Supplementary Notice on the Handling of Some Cases Before the Cultural Revolution". The review and correction of public servants who were wrongly dismissed before the Cultural Revolution and the handling of the remaining problems should focus on solving the problems politically. The handling of the re-arrangement of work and economic issues must be strictly controlled and resolutely handled in accordance with the relevant policies and regulations of the central government.

The "Decision" pointed out that the national customs system will be brought under the unified management of the central government, and the General Administration of Customs of the People's Republic of China will be established as an agency directly under the State Council to uniformly manage the national customs institutions, personnel establishment and operations; local customs will be supervised and guided by the people's governments of the provinces, cities and autonomous regions where they are located; and tariff revenue will be unified under the central government.

的领导关系,由受同级党委领导改为受同级党委和上级纪委双重

translated_text: On the 22nd, the CPC Central Committee approved the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection's request for instructions on changing the leadership relationship between the provincial, municipal, autonomous region and lower-level Party committees and discipline inspection committees. The Central Committee agreed to change the leadership relationship between the provincial, municipal, autonomous region and lower-level Party committees and discipline inspection committees from being led by the Party committees at the same level to being led by both the Party committees at the same level and the higher-level discipline inspection committees, with the Party committees at the same level being the main leadership. The leadership relationship between the discipline inspection groups or discipline inspection committees of the Party committees of the ministries, commissions and bureaus of the State Council also adopts the above-mentioned dual leadership principle.

events: 23日——29日 中国共产党第十一届五中全会在北京举行。中心议题是加强和改善党的领导。到会中央委员201人,候补中央委员118人。另有各地方各部门负责同志37人列席会议。中共中央主席华国锋,副主席叶剑英、邓小平、李先念、陈云出席会议,并作了重要讲话。
translated_text: From the 23rd to the 29th, the Fifth Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China was held in Beijing. The central topic was to strengthen and improve the party's leadership. 201 Central Committee members and 118 alternate Central Committee members attended the meeting. In addition, 37 responsible comrades from various local departments attended the meeting. Chairman Hua Guofeng of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, Vice Chairman Ye Jianying, Deng Xiaoping, Li Xiannian, and Chen Yun attended the meeting and delivered important speeches. The plenary session discussed the Constitution of the Communist Party of China (draft revision) and decided to print and distribute it to the whole party for discussion and revision; passed the "Several Principles on Political Life within the Party"; elected Hu Yaobang and Zhao Ziyang as members of the Political Bureau Standing Committee; decided to re-establish the Central Secretariat and elect Hu Yaobang as general secretary, Wan Li, Wang Renzhong, Fang Yi, Gu Mu, Song Renqiong, Yu Qiuli, Yang Dezhi, Hu Qiaomu, Hu Yaobang, Yao Yilin, and Peng Chong as secretaries; decided to approve the resignation requests of Wang Dongxing, Ji Dengkui, Wu De, and Chen Xilian, and to relieve or request their removal from the leadership positions they held in the party and the country; recommended that the National People's Congress amend Article 45 of the Constitution to cancel the provision that citizens "have the right to use big-character posters, big-character posters, big-character posters, and big-character posters"; and passed a resolution to rehabilitate Liu Shaoqi.

events: 全会讨论了《中国共产党章程》(修改草案),并决定印发全党讨论,提出修改意见;通过了《关于党内政治生活的若干准则》;增选胡耀邦、赵紫阳为政治局常委;决定重新设立中央书记处,选举胡耀邦为总书记,万里、王任重、方毅、谷牧、宋任穷、余秋里、杨得志,胡乔木、胡耀邦、姚依林、彭冲为书记;决定批准汪东兴、纪登奎、吴德、陈锡联的辞职请求,免除或提请免除他们所担负的党和国家的领导职务;建议全国人民代表大会修改宪法第四十五条,取消公民“有运用大鸣、大放、大辩论、大字报的权利”的规定;通过了为刘少奇平反昭雪的决议。
translated_text: From the 23rd to the 29th, the Fifth Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China was held in Beijing. The central topic was to strengthen and improve the party's leadership. 201 Central Committee members and 118 alternate Central Committee members attended the meeting. In addition, 37 responsible comrades from various local departments attended the meeting. Chairman Hua Guofeng of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, Vice Chairman Ye Jianying, Deng Xiaoping, Li Xiannian, and Chen Yun attended the meeting and delivered important speeches. The plenary session discussed the Constitution of the Communist Party of China (draft revision) and decided to print and distribute it to the whole party for discussion and revision; passed the "Several Principles on Political Life within the Party"; elected Hu Yaobang and Zhao Ziyang as members of the Political Bureau Standing Committee; decided to re-establish the Central Secretariat and elect Hu Yaobang as general secretary, Wan Li, Wang Renzhong, Fang Yi, Gu Mu, Song Renqiong, Yu Qiuli, Yang Dezhi, Hu Qiaomu, Hu Yaobang, Yao Yilin, and Peng Chong as secretaries; decided to approve the resignation requests of Wang Dongxing, Ji Dengkui, Wu De, and Chen Xilian, and to relieve or request their removal from the leadership positions they held in the party and the country; recommended that the National People's Congress amend Article 45 of the Constitution to cancel the provision that citizens "have the right to use big-character posters, big-character posters, big-character posters, and big-character posters"; and passed a resolution to rehabilitate Liu Shaoqi.

events:
25日 中共中央宣传部、中共中央组织部联合发出《关于
加强干部教育工作的意见》。《意见》要求各级党委和各条战线的
领导机关,必须把干部教育工作当作实现四个现代化的根本大
计,认真抓起来。新时期干部教育的方针是:以马列主义、毛泽
东思想为指导,以解决我国四化建设的问题为中心,学习有关的
理论和实践知识,培养一支懂得马克思主义基本知识和党在新时
期的路线、方针、政策,坚持社会主义道路,具有专业知识,富
于艰苦创业精神的干部队伍,并从中造就一大批专家。
中共中央宣传部、中共中央组织部联合发出《关于加强党员
教育健全党的组织生活的意见》。《意见》要求各级党组织加强对
党员的马列主义、毛泽东思想的教育,新时期形势任务与党的路
线、方针、政策的教育,社会主义民主与法制的教育,共产主义
伟大理想和党的优良传统的教育。继续搞好实践是检验真理唯一
标准的学习讨论。同时,要求把党的组织生活进一步健全起来。
中共中央组织部发出《关于做好西藏内调干部工作的通
知》。8月6日,中共中央、国务院批转西藏自治区党委和人民
政府《关于大批调出进藏干部、工人的请示报告》。中央组织部
在《通知》中指出,进藏的同志基本上完成了历史任务,除留一
部分领导骨干和技术骨干外,大部分同志将分期分批调回内地。
要求有关地区和部门的党组织,一定要高度重视,认真抓好这项
工作。
translated_text: On the 25th, the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee and the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee jointly issued the "Opinions on Strengthening Cadre Education". The "Opinions" require that party committees at all levels and leading organs of all fronts must take cadre education work as a fundamental plan for realizing the four modernizations and take it seriously. The policy of cadre education in the new era is: guided by Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought, centered on solving the problems of my country's four modernizations, learning relevant theoretical and practical knowledge, cultivating a cadre team that understands the basic knowledge of Marxism and the party's line, principles, and policies in the new era, adheres to the socialist road, has professional knowledge, and is full of hard work and entrepreneurship, and cultivates a large number of experts from them. The Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee and the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee jointly issued the "Opinions on Strengthening Party Member Education and Improving Party Organizational Life". The "Opinions" require party organizations at all levels to strengthen the education of party members on Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought, the education of the situation and tasks of the new era and the party's line, principles, and policies, the education of socialist democracy and the legal system, and the education of the great ideals of communism and the party's fine traditions. Continue to do a good job in learning and discussing that practice is the only criterion for testing truth. At the same time, it is required to further improve the party's organizational life. The Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued a "Notice on Doing a Good Job in the Work of Transferring Cadres to Tibet". On August 6, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council approved the "Request Report on the Transfer of a Large Number of Cadres and Workers to Tibet" by the Party Committee and the People's Government of the Tibet Autonomous Region. The Organization Department of the Central Committee pointed out in the "Notice" that the comrades who went to Tibet have basically completed their historical tasks. Except for some leading cadres and technical backbones, most of the comrades will be transferred back to the interior in stages and batches. It is required that the party organizations of relevant regions and departments must attach great importance to and earnestly do a good job in this work.

events:
26日——3月6日 中共中央组织部在北京召开全国干部档
案工作座谈会。4月16日,中央组织部印发这次会议讨论制定
的《关于加强干部档案工作的意见》和《干部档案工作条例》。
《意见》指出,干部档案工作是干部工作的一个组成部分。加强
干部档案工作,搞好干部档案建设,是做好干部工作的必要条
件。各级党委和主管部门,应予以关心和加强领导。
translated_text: From March 26 to March 6, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee held a national symposium on cadre archives in Beijing. On April 16, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued the "Opinions on Strengthening Cadre Archives Work" and "Cadre Archives Work Regulations" discussed and formulated at this meeting. The "Opinions" pointed out that cadre archives work is an integral part of cadre work. Strengthening cadre archives work and doing a good job in cadre archives construction are necessary conditions for doing a good job in cadre work. Party committees and competent departments at all levels should pay attention to and strengthen leadership.

events:
29日 中共中央副主席邓小平在党的十一届五中全会第三
次会议上作《坚持党的路线,改进工作方法》的重要讲话。他指
出,我们党在现阶段的政治路线,就是一心一意地搞四个现代
化。实事求是,一切从实际出发,理论联系实际,坚持实践是检
验真理的标准,这就是我们党的思想路线。他还指出,注意工作
方法,克服官僚主义,这也是摆在我们面前的一个迫切问题。
translated_text: On the 29th, Deng Xiaoping, Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Committee, delivered an important speech entitled "Adhere to the Party's Line and Improve Working Methods" at the third meeting of the Fifth Plenary Session of the 11th CPC Central Committee. He pointed out that the political line of our party at the current stage is to carry out the four modernizations wholeheartedly. Seeking truth from facts, proceeding from reality in everything, integrating theory with practice, and insisting that practice is the criterion for testing truth, this is the ideological line of our party. He also pointed out that paying attention to working methods and overcoming bureaucracy is also an urgent issue before us.

events:
2日 中共中央发出通知,邓小平免兼中国人民解放军总参
谋长、总参谋部党委第一书记;杨得志任总参谋长、总参谋部党
委第一书记、中央军委副秘书长、军委办公会议成员。
translated_text: On the 2nd, the CPC Central Committee issued a notice that Deng Xiaoping was relieved of his concurrent posts as Chief of the General Staff of the Chinese People's Liberation Army and First Secretary of the Party Committee of the General Staff; Yang Dezhi was appointed Chief of the General Staff, First Secretary of the Party Committee of the General Staff, Deputy Secretary-General of the Central Military Commission, and member of the Military Commission Office Meeting.

events:
3日 中共中央组织部印发部分省、市、自治区党委组织部
信访工作座谈会纪要和《各级党委组织部门处理来信来访工作暂
行条例》。《纪要》强调,加强领导,是做好信访工作的关键。当
前信访案件很多,首先应抓住那些急案,难案、大案,认真处
理。要采取各种方法对上访人员进行思想政治工作。
translated_text: On the 3rd, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued the minutes of the symposium on petition work held by the Organization Departments of the Party Committees of some provinces, cities and autonomous regions and the Provisional Regulations on the Handling of Petitions and Letters by the Organization Departments of Party Committees at All Levels. The minutes emphasized that strengthening leadership is the key to doing a good job in petition work. There are many petition cases at present, and we should first focus on those urgent, difficult and major cases and handle them seriously. We should adopt various methods to carry out ideological and political work on petitioners.

events: 17日 中共中央政治局常委决定,成立中央财政经济领导小组,赵紫阳任组长,成员有余秋里、方毅、万里、姚依林、谷牧;同意撤销原国务院财政经济委员会。
translated_text: On the 17th, the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee decided to establish a central financial and economic leading group, with Zhao Ziyang as the leader and Yu Qiuli, Fang Yi, Wan Li, Yao Yilin, and Gu Mu as members; and agreed to abolish the former State Council Financial and Economic Committee. At the same time, it was decided to establish the National Energy Committee, with Yu Qiuli as the director.

events: 同时,决定成立国家能源委员会,余秋里任主任。
translated_text: On the 17th, the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee decided to establish a central financial and economic leading group, with Zhao Ziyang as the leader and Yu Qiuli, Fang Yi, Wan Li, Yao Yilin, and Gu Mu as members; and agreed to abolish the former State Council Financial and Economic Committee. At the same time, it was decided to establish the National Energy Committee, with Yu Qiuli as the director.

events:
18日 中共中央组织部发出《1980年工作要点》,提出了要
做的几个方面的工作:(一)认真做好中央交办的有关召开党的
十二大的准备工作;(二)以选拔培养接班人为中心,继续加强
领导班子建设;(三)加强党的思想建设和组织建设,发挥党员
的先锋模范作用;(四)抓好干部培训工作;(五)调查和总结有
关干部制度改革的一些经验;(六)搞好顾问工作和干部离休、
退休工作;(七)善始善终地搞好落实干部政策的工作;(八)加
强部机关自身的建设。
translated_text: On the 18th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Main Points for Work in 1980", which proposed several aspects of work to be done: (1) to earnestly prepare for the convening of the 12th National Congress of the Party as assigned by the Central Committee; (2) to continue to strengthen the construction of the leadership team with the selection and training of successors as the center; (3) to strengthen the ideological and organizational construction of the Party and give full play to the vanguard and exemplary role of Party members; (4) to do a good job in cadre training; (5) to investigate and summarize some experiences related to the reform of the cadre system; (6) to do a good job in advisory work and cadre retirement and retirement work; (7) to implement cadre policies from beginning to end; (8) to strengthen the construction of the department itself.

events:
31日—5月12日 中共中央组织部分三批在北京召开选
拔优秀中青年干部和整顿问题比较多的地、县领导班子座谈会。
会上讨论并制订了《关于抓紧做好选拔优秀中青年干部工作的意
见》、《整顿问题比较多的地县领导班子座谈会纪要》。《意见》指
出,选拔中青年干部一定要把思想搞对头,树立适应“四化”需要
的新的用人观点,坚决破除论资排辈、唯成份论等老框框,克服
对知识分子的错误认识。
中央书记处6月23日会议讨论并通过了上述两个文件。中
央组织部于6月25日将两个文件发给各地各部门贯彻执行。
translated_text: From May 31 to May 12, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee held a symposium in Beijing for the selection of outstanding young and middle-aged cadres and the rectification of prefecture and county leadership teams with more problems. The "Opinions on Grasping the Work of Selecting Outstanding Young and Middle-aged Cadres" and "Minutes of the Symposium on Rectifying Prefectural and County Leadership Teams with More Problems" were discussed and formulated at the meeting. The "Opinions" pointed out that the selection of young and middle-aged cadres must be correct in thinking, establish a new view of employment that meets the needs of the "four modernizations", resolutely break the old framework of seniority and class status, and overcome the wrong understanding of intellectuals. The Central Secretariat discussed and passed the above two documents at a meeting on June 23. The Central Organization Department sent the two documents to all localities and departments for implementation on June 25.

events:
2日 中共中央组织部、中央统战部印发北京市委转发的
《关于科技骨干外流情况的报告》的通知。《通知》指出,知识分
子外流,如不采取有力措施制止,对我国实现四个现代化是十分
不利的。要求各地参照北京市的做法,认真贯彻党的知识分子政
策和侨务政策,切实解决他们工作、生活中的问题,把可能非正
常出国出境的科技骨干稳定下来。
translated_text: On the 2nd, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the United Front Work Department of the CPC Central Committee issued a notice on the "Report on the Outflow of Scientific and Technological Talents" forwarded by the Beijing Municipal Committee. The "Notice" pointed out that the outflow of intellectuals would be very detrimental to my country's realization of the Four Modernizations if effective measures were not taken to stop it. It was required that all localities refer to the practices of Beijing, conscientiously implement the Party's intellectual policy and overseas Chinese policy, effectively solve their problems in work and life, and stabilize the scientific and technological talents who may go abroad abnormally.

events:
4日 在吉林省召开的第五届人民代表大会第二次会议上,
选举又文为省五届人大常委会主任,决定于克为省长。
translated_text: On the 4th, at the second session of the Fifth People's Congress held in Jilin Province, Youwen was elected as the chairman of the Fifth Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee and Yu Ke was decided to be the governor.

events:
8日 中共中央决定成立对外宣传小组,成员由中央宣传部
等14个单位的负责同志参加。组长朱穆之,副组长张灿明、吴
学谦。
translated_text: On the 8th, the CPC Central Committee decided to set up an external propaganda group, whose members were responsible comrades from 14 units including the Central Propaganda Department. The group leader was Zhu Muzhi, and the deputy group leaders were Zhang Canming and Wu Xueqian.

events: 8日——16日 第五届全国人大常委会第十四次会议在北京举行。
translated_text: From the 8th to the 16th, the 14th meeting of the Fifth National People's Congress Standing Committee was held in Beijing. The meeting decided to appoint Zhao Ziyang and Wan Li as vice premiers of the State Council, dismiss Deng Kui and Chen Xilian from their posts as vice premiers of the State Council, and accept Wu De's resignation as vice chairman of the current NPC Standing Committee.

events: 会议决定任命赵紫阳、万里为国务院副总理,免去登奎、陈锡联的国务院副总理职务,接受吴德辞去本届人大常委会副委员长职务。
translated_text: From the 8th to the 16th, the 14th meeting of the Fifth National People's Congress Standing Committee was held in Beijing. The meeting decided to appoint Zhao Ziyang and Wan Li as vice premiers of the State Council, dismiss Deng Kui and Chen Xilian from their posts as vice premiers of the State Council, and accept Wu De's resignation as vice chairman of the current NPC Standing Committee.

events: 18日 中共中央书记处讨论通过《关于中央书记处研究室的工作任务、机构设置、干部等问题的请示报告》。
translated_text: On the 18th, the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee discussed and approved the "Request Report on the Work Tasks, Organizational Structure, and Cadres of the Research Office of the Central Secretariat". It was decided that Deng Liqun would be the director of the research office.

events: 决定由邓力群任研究室主任。
translated_text: On the 18th, the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee discussed and approved the "Request Report on the Work Tasks, Organizational Structure, and Cadres of the Research Office of the Central Secretariat". It was decided that Deng Liqun would be the director of the research office.

events:
21日 中共中央组织部印发《关于复查“61人案件”的补充
报告》。 早在1978年12月16日,中共中央就转发了中共中央组
织部《关于“61人案件”的调查报告》。调查报告认为,“文化大革
命”中提出的所谓薄一波等61人叛徒集团是不存在的,是一个大
错案,应当纠正。
translated_text: On the 21st, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued the "Supplementary Report on the Review of the "61 People Case". As early as December 16, 1978, the CPC Central Committee forwarded the "Investigation Report on the "61 People Case"" of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee. The investigation report believes that the so-called 61-member traitor group including Bo Yibo proposed during the "Cultural Revolution" does not exist, and it is a big miscarriage of justice that should be corrected.

events:
22日 中共中央组织部发出《关于把落实干部政策的工作
进行到底的几点意见》。《意见》要求,对于应结论尚未结论、应
复查尚未复查的案件,要抓紧复查,作出结论。对极少数至今还
在派性或者对落实干部政策抵触,顶着不办的,要采取必要的
组织措施。对已复查的案件,要认真做好检查验收工作。
translated_text: On the 22nd, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued "Several Opinions on Carrying out the Work of Implementing the Cadre Policy to the End". The "Opinions" require that cases that should have been concluded but have not been concluded, and cases that should have been reviewed but have not been reviewed, should be reviewed as soon as possible and conclusions should be drawn. For the very few who are still factional or resist the implementation of the cadre policy and refuse to deal with it, necessary organizational measures should be taken. For the cases that have been reviewed, the inspection and acceptance work should be done carefully.

events:
23日 中共中央印发经中央政治局会议讨论通过的《关于
十二大代表选举工作的几点意见》和《关于丧失工作能力的老同
志不当十二大代表和中央委员候选人的决定》两个文件。
translated_text: On the 23rd, the CPC Central Committee issued two documents, "Several Opinions on the Election of Delegates to the 12th National Congress" and "Decision on Old Comrades Who Have Lost Their Ability to Work Not Being Candidates for Delegates to the 12th National Congress and Members of the Central Committee", which were discussed and approved by the Central Political Bureau.

events: 1980年5月5日,民政部发布《干部调配工作暂行规定》。规定指出,干部调配应根据社会主义现代化建设和当前国民经济调整的需要,保证重点,充实基层,加强科研、生产第一线。干部调配工作要切实贯彻执行任人唯贤的干部路线,做到知人善任,用其所长,调配得当。《暂行规定》还对调配的方法､手续和纪律作出了规定。
translated_text: On May 5, 1980, the Ministry of Civil Affairs issued the "Interim Regulations on Cadre Allocation". The regulations pointed out that cadre allocation should be based on the needs of socialist modernization and the current adjustment of the national economy, ensuring key points, enriching the grassroots, and strengthening the front line of scientific research and production. The cadre allocation work should earnestly implement the cadre line of appointing people on the basis of merit, knowing people and assigning them to positions, using their strengths, and allocating them properly. The "Interim Regulations" also stipulates the methods, procedures and disciplines of allocation.

events:
13日 中共中央组织部、中共中央统战部发出《关于进一
步做好台湾省籍归侨知识分子工作,防止人才外流的意见》。其
中特别强调,对台籍归侨知识分子的工作安排,提职、晋级、入
党及其子女入团、入党、参军等均应一视同仁,不得歧视。
translated_text: On the 13th, the Organization Department and the United Front Work Department of the CPC Central Committee issued the "Opinions on Further Improving the Work of Returned Overseas Chinese Intellectuals from Taiwan Province and Preventing the Outflow of Talents". It particularly emphasized that the work arrangements, promotions, promotions, joining the party, and their children joining the league, joining the party, and joining the army should be treated equally and without discrimination.

events:
15日 中央书记处对在“三支两军”中犯错误干部的处理问
题作出重要指示。书记处认为,在“文化大革命”的历史条件下,
部队的一些人在“三支两军”中犯错误是难免的。对他们犯错误的
原因,要进行历史的分析,还要看本人对错误的认识和态度。对
待历史问题,只能按政策办,宜粗不宜细,宜宽不宜严。7月11
日,中纪委、总政治部、中组部联合发出关于认真贯彻中央书记
处重要指示的通知,要求各级党组织按照中央指示精神,对这些
人的未结束了案件抓紧研究,尽快结论处理。
translated_text: On the 15th, the Central Secretariat issued important instructions on the handling of cadres who made mistakes in the "three branches and two armies". The Secretariat believed that under the historical conditions of the "Cultural Revolution", it was inevitable that some people in the army made mistakes in the "three branches and two armies". The reasons for their mistakes should be analyzed historically, and their understanding and attitude towards the mistakes should also be considered. When dealing with historical issues, we can only follow policies, and it is better to be rough than to be detailed, and to be lenient than to be strict. On July 11, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, the General Political Department, and the Organization Department of the Central Committee jointly issued a notice on conscientiously implementing the important instructions of the Central Secretariat, requiring party organizations at all levels to study the unfinished cases of these people in accordance with the spirit of the Central Committee's instructions and reach conclusions and handle them as soon as possible.

events:
17日 伟大的马克思主义者、无产阶级革命家、久经考验
的卓越的党和国家领导人刘少奇追悼大会在北京隆重举行。党和
国家领导人以及首都各方面代表一万多人参加追悼大会。中共中
央副主席、国务院副总理邓小平致悼词。
translated_text: On the 17th, a memorial service for Liu Shaoqi, a great Marxist, proletarian revolutionary, and a time-tested and outstanding party and state leader, was held in Beijing. More than 10,000 party and state leaders and representatives from all walks of life in the capital attended the memorial service. Deng Xiaoping, Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, delivered a eulogy.

events:
18日 中共中央总书记胡耀邦在中央组织部召开的选拔优
秀中青年干部工作座谈会上作题为《今后两年组织工作的几件大
事》的讲话。他提出,今后两年主要抓好四件大事:(一)基本
上把中央、省(市、自治区)、地(市)、县(市)、公社各级和
各方面的领导班子调整好,以适应“四化”发展的迫切要求。
(二)切实把党风党纪搞好,使党的威信有一个大幅度的提高。
(三)努力改进各级领导班子的工作方法,促进广大干部在思想
上、政治上、业务能力上更快地成长起来。(四)认真做好召开
党代会的各项准备工作,力争把党的十二大和各级党代会开成建
国以来最好的大会之一。
translated_text: On the 18th, Hu Yaobang, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, delivered a speech entitled "Several Major Events in Organizational Work in the Next Two Years" at a symposium on the selection of outstanding young and middle-aged cadres held by the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee. He proposed that four major events should be focused on in the next two years: (1) Basically, the leadership teams at all levels and aspects of the central government, provinces (municipalities, autonomous regions), prefectures (municipalities), counties (municipalities), and communes should be adjusted to meet the urgent requirements of the "four modernizations" development. (2) The Party's style and discipline should be improved to greatly enhance the Party's prestige. (3) Efforts should be made to improve the working methods of the leadership teams at all levels to promote the faster growth of the majority of cadres in terms of ideology, politics, and professional ability. (4) Carefully prepare for the convening of the Party Congress and strive to make the 12th National Congress of the Party and the Party Congresses at all levels one of the best congresses since the founding of the People's Republic of China.

events:
20日 中共中央组织部发出《关于重新颁发“中共中央管理
的干部职务名称表”的通知》。《通知》指出,为了从组织上保证
新时期总任务的胜利完成,经中央批准,重新修订和颁发属中央
管理的干部职务名称表。《通知》重申,党管干部是我们党一贯
的传统,是党的干部管理制度的根本原则。一切党组织和每一个
党员、干部,都必须自觉地遵守和维护党管干部的原则,同违背
这个原则的宗派主义和分散主义等错误倾向作斗争。
中共中央发出《关于为罗瑞卿同志平反的通知》。中央决
定,有关对罗瑞卿同志诬蔑不实之词的材料,一律按规定处理;
受株连的同志,也应予以平反,恢复名誉。
translated_text: On the 20th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on Re-issuing the List of Cadre Titles Managed by the CPC Central Committee". The "Notice" pointed out that in order to ensure the successful completion of the general tasks in the new period from an organizational perspective, the list of cadre titles managed by the Central Committee was revised and issued with the approval of the Central Committee. The "Notice" reiterated that the party's management of cadres is our party's consistent tradition and the fundamental principle of the party's cadre management system. All party organizations and every party member and cadre must consciously abide by and uphold the principle of party management of cadres and fight against erroneous tendencies such as sectarianism and decentralization that violate this principle. The CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on Rehabilitating Comrade Luo Ruiqing". The Central Committee decided that all materials related to the slanderous and untrue words against Comrade Luo Ruiqing should be handled in accordance with regulations; comrades who were implicated should also be rehabilitated and their reputations restored.

events:
11日 中共中央批转中央统战部《关于爱国人士中的右派
复查问题的请示报告》。中央批语指出,粉碎“四人帮”后,中央
决定把错划的右派改正过来,是深得人心的,具有重大意义。
1957年确有极少数资产阶级右派分子向党和社会主义猖狂进
攻,对这种进攻进行反击是完全必要的,这是一个方面。但反右
派斗争确实扩大化了,这又是一个方面。中央认为,只看到一个
方面而否定另一个方面,是不符合实际的;一段时间以来,党内
外一些同志,对反右派斗争持全盘否定的态度,这是错误的。
translated_text: On the 11th, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China approved the "Report on the Review of Rightists Among Patriotic People" submitted by the Central United Front Work Department. The Central Committee's comments pointed out that after smashing the "Gang of Four", the Central Committee's decision to correct the wrongly classified rightists was popular and of great significance. In 1957, there were indeed a very small number of bourgeois rightists who launched a rampant attack on the Party and socialism. It was absolutely necessary to counterattack this attack. This is one aspect. But the anti-rightist struggle was indeed expanded. This is another aspect. The Central Committee believes that it is not in line with reality to only see one aspect and deny the other. For a period of time, some comrades inside and outside the Party have held a completely negative attitude towards the anti-rightist struggle, which is wrong.

events:
19日 中共中央发出《关于清理“文化大革命”中一些干部
在报刊和文电上被点名批判问题的通知》。《通知》指出:(一)
对“文化大革命”中在中央、地方以及军队报刊上被错误点名批判
的同志,宣布一律予以平反,强加给他们的诬蔑不实之词,统统
予以推倒。对这些同志历史功过是非的评价,均以中央或相应一
级党委最后作出的复查结论、平反决定为准。原则上不再在报刊
上或发中央文件一一宣布平反。(二)对“文化大革命”中在中央
和地方党组织或革委会发出的文电上,一些同志错被点名批判的
问题,按1979年8月17日《中共中央关于清理历史遗留问题中
涉及到有关中央文件的处理办法的通知》精神处理,不再由中央
发文件一一宣布撤销。
translated_text: On the 19th, the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on Clearing Up the Issues of Some Cadres Being Named and Criticized in Newspapers and Documents during the "Cultural Revolution"". The "Notice" pointed out: (i) All comrades who were wrongly named and criticized in central, local and military newspapers during the "Cultural Revolution" will be rehabilitated, and all the false accusations imposed on them will be overturned. The evaluation of the historical merits and demerits of these comrades will be based on the final review conclusion and rehabilitation decision made by the Central Committee or the corresponding first-level Party Committee. In principle, rehabilitation will no longer be announced one by one in newspapers or in central documents. (ii) The issue of some comrades who were wrongly named and criticized in documents issued by the central and local party organizations or revolutionary committees during the "Cultural Revolution" will be handled in accordance with the spirit of the "Notice of the CPC Central Committee on the Handling Methods of Relevant Central Documents in the Clearing Up of Historical Issues" on August 17, 1979, and will no longer be revoked one by one by the Central Committee issuing documents.

events:

民政部政府机关人事局和国务院军队转业干部安置工作小组办公
室合并成立国家人事局,负责综合管理政府系统的人事工作,由
焦善民任局长。
translated_text: On the 14th, the State Council issued the "Notice on the Establishment of the National Personnel Bureau", deciding to merge the Ministry of Civil Affairs' Government Personnel Bureau and the State Council's Military Retired Cadres Placement Working Group Office to form the National Personnel Bureau, which will be responsible for the comprehensive management of personnel work in the government system, with Jiao Shanmin as the director.

events: 1980年7月14日,国务院发出《关于成立国家人事局的通知》。通知说,为了进一步加强人事工作,使人事工作更好地为“四化”建设服务,国务院决定将民政部政府机关人事局和国务院军队转业干部安置工作小组办公室合并成立国家人事局。国家人事局的工作任务是:按照干部管理权限和范围,负责干部的管理、调配、调整、培训、考核和晋升工作;承办国务院依照法律规定任免干部的工作;吸收录用干部;负责军队转业干部安置工作;承办国家行政机关工作人员奖惩工作;国家机关、事业单位工作人员的工资福利工作;干部的退休退职工作;对各地区和国务院各部门的人事工作进行业务指导工作。1980年8月18日,邓小平同志在中央政治局扩大会议上发表《党和国家领导制度的改革》的讲话。讲话分析了党和国家领导制度、干部制度方面存在的主要弊端,即官僚主义､权力过分集中､家长制､干部领导职务终身制和形形色色的特权现象。讲话指出,如果不坚决改革现行制度中的弊端,过去出现过的一些问题今后就有可能重新出现。只有对这些弊端进行有计划有步骤而又坚决彻底的改革,人民才会信任我们的领导,才会信任党和社会主义,我们的事业才有无限的希望。要坚决解放思想,克服重重障碍,打破老框框,勇于改革不合时宜的组织制度、人事制度,大力培养发现和破格使用优秀人才,坚决同一切压制和摧残人才的现象作斗争。并指出,干部人事制度改革“关键是要健全干部的选举、招考、任免、考核、弹劾、轮换制度,对各级各类领导干部职务的任期以及离休退休,要按照不同情况,作出适当的明确的规定”。
translated_text: On July 14, 1980, the State Council issued the "Notice on the Establishment of the State Personnel Bureau". The notice said that in order to further strengthen personnel work and make personnel work better serve the "four modernizations" construction, the State Council decided to merge the Ministry of Civil Affairs' Government Personnel Bureau and the State Council's Military Retired Cadres Placement Working Group Office to form the State Personnel Bureau. The tasks of the State Personnel Bureau are: in accordance with the authority and scope of cadre management, responsible for the management, deployment, adjustment, training, assessment and promotion of cadres; undertake the work of the State Council's appointment and removal of cadres in accordance with the law; absorb and recruit cadres; be responsible for the placement of military retired cadres; undertake the reward and punishment of state administrative staff; salary and welfare work for state organs and public institutions staff; cadre retirement work; and provide professional guidance to personnel work in various regions and departments of the State Council. On August 18, 1980, Comrade Deng Xiaoping delivered a speech on "Reform of the Party and State Leadership System" at the enlarged meeting of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee. The speech analyzed the main drawbacks in the leadership system and cadre system of the Party and the state, namely, bureaucracy, excessive concentration of power, patriarchy, lifelong tenure of leading cadres and various forms of privilege. The speech pointed out that if the drawbacks in the current system are not resolutely reformed, some problems that have occurred in the past may reappear in the future. Only by carrying out planned, step-by-step, resolute and thorough reforms of these drawbacks can the people trust our leadership, the Party and socialism, and our cause will have unlimited hope. We must resolutely emancipate our minds, overcome numerous obstacles, break the old framework, and have the courage to reform outdated organizational and personnel systems, vigorously cultivate, discover and use outstanding talents in an exceptional manner, and resolutely fight against all phenomena that suppress and destroy talents. It also pointed out that the key to the reform of the cadre and personnel system is to improve the system of election, recruitment, appointment, removal, assessment, impeachment and rotation of cadres, and to make appropriate and clear provisions for the term of office and retirement of leading cadres at all levels and of all types according to different situations.

events:

中央组织部彻底平反恢复名誉的请示报告》。《请示报告》指出,
中央组织部是党中央在党的组织工作方面的一个重要办事机关,
是中央管理党的组织工作的一个主要部门,尽管在工作中发生过
这样那样的缺点和错误,但它始终是遵循毛泽东思想,在党中央
的领导下工作的。
translated_text: On the 15th, the CPC Central Committee approved the forwarding of the Central Organization Department's "Request Report on Complete Rehabilitation and Restoration of the Reputation of the Central Organization Department before 1966". The "Request Report" pointed out that the Central Organization Department is an important office of the Party Central Committee in the party's organizational work and a major department of the Central Committee in managing the party's organizational work. Although there have been various shortcomings and mistakes in its work, it has always followed Mao Zedong Thought and worked under the leadership of the Party Central Committee.

events:

统计工作是党的干部工作的一个组成部分,是进行调查研究、做

translated_text: From August 21 to 28, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the State Personnel Bureau jointly held a national meeting on party member statistics and cadre statistics. On August 28, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued a notice entitled "Several Opinions on Strengthening Cadre Statistics". It emphasized that cadre statistics is an integral part of the Party's cadre work and a necessary condition for conducting investigations and research and doing a good job in cadre work.

events:

团强加给肖华同志的罪名和诬蔑不实之词予以推倒,彻底平反,
恢复名誉;对受株连的干部、家属、子女也应做好善后工作,消
除影响。
translated_text: On the 24th, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued a notice to overturn the charges and false accusations imposed on Comrade Xiao Hua by the two counter-revolutionary groups of Lin Biao and the "Gang of Four", to completely redress his wrongdoing and restore his reputation; and to do a good job of post-processing for the cadres, family members, and children who were implicated to eliminate the impact.

events:
28日 中共中央同意总政治部《关于黄克诚同志的复查结
论》。撤销一九五九年庐山会议以来,历次对黄克诚同志的审查
报告;对其在文化大革命中所受打击迫害,予以彻底平反,恢复
名誉;对受株连的家属、子女和其他同志,均予以彻底平反,恢
复名誉,消除影响。

All previous review reports on Comrade Huang Kecheng since the 1959 Lushan Conference were revoked; the attacks and persecutions he suffered during the Cultural Revolution were completely rehabilitated and his reputation was restored; his family members, children and other comrades who were implicated were completely rehabilitated, their reputations restored, and the impact eliminated.

events:
30日 中共中央印发关于坚持“少宣传个人”的几个问题的
指示。8月12日,《人民日报》刊载中央的这个指示。10月20
日, 中央书记处会议决定,在今后二、三十年内,一律不挂现任
中央领导人的像,以利于肃清个人迷信。
translated_text: On the 30th, the CPC Central Committee issued a directive on several issues concerning "less publicity of individuals". On August 12, the People's Daily published this directive from the Central Committee. On October 20, the Central Secretariat decided that in the next two or three decades, no portraits of current central leaders would be hung in order to eliminate personal superstition.

events:
6日 中共中央、国务院发出通知,批转西藏自治区党委和
人民政府《关于大批调出进藏干部、工人的请示报告》。《通知》
指出,西藏解放以来,中央从内地先后派去大批干部、工人和文
教、卫生、科技人员,他们同西藏广大人民一道,艰苦奋斗,辛
勤工作,对发展西藏的政治、经济和文化,对建设边疆、维护民
族团结、捍卫祖国统一,培养当地民族干部,都作出了很大贡
献。现在,他们基本上完成了历史任务,除留一部分领导骨干和
技术骨干继续在藏工作外,大部分同志分期分批调回内地。
translated_text: On the 6th, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued a notice to approve the "Request Report on the Transfer of a Large Number of Cadres and Workers to Tibet" by the Party Committee and the People's Government of the Tibet Autonomous Region. The "Notice" pointed out that since the liberation of Tibet, the Central Government has successively sent a large number of cadres, workers, and cultural, educational, health, and scientific and technological personnel from the inland areas. Together with the vast majority of the Tibetan people, they have worked hard and made great contributions to the development of Tibet's politics, economy, and culture, to the construction of the border, to the maintenance of ethnic unity, to the defense of the unity of the motherland, and to the training of local ethnic cadres. Now, they have basically completed their historical tasks. Except for some leading cadres and technical backbones who continue to work in Tibet, most of the comrades will be transferred back to the inland areas in stages and batches.

events:
13日 中共中央、国务院作出《关于设置顾问的决定》。中
央决定,在县级以上单位设置顾问,并且作为一项制度,长期坚
持下去。各级党委要加强对顾问工作的领导。要认真地按照条件
选配,在政治上予以尊重,生活上予以照顾。研究重大问题时,
要主动地真心实意地听取他们的意见,重视他们的建议,切实发
挥他们的作用。
translated_text: On the 13th, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council made the "Decision on the Establishment of Advisors". The Central Committee decided to establish advisors in units above the county level and to maintain this system for a long time. Party committees at all levels should strengthen their leadership over the work of advisors. They should be carefully selected according to their conditions, respected politically and taken care of in life. When studying major issues, they should actively and sincerely listen to their opinions, attach importance to their suggestions, and effectively play their role.
