品和接受对方赠送的礼品。只有外事单位和外贸机构的工作人
员,可以按照工作需要,同对方互赠对等的礼品。取消过去零星
物品归个人,高级消费品按百分之几作价内部处理的规定。
translated_text: On the 16th, the CPC Central Committee issued the "Decision on Prohibiting the Giving and Receiving of Gifts in External Activities", which stipulated that in the future, except for the party and state leaders who gave gifts to each other on behalf of the party and the state in their interactions with foreign leaders, no other unit or individual may give gifts to foreigners, overseas Chinese or Hong Kong and Macao businessmen or accept gifts from the other party under any pretext in external activities. Only staff members of foreign affairs units and foreign trade institutions may give equal gifts to each other according to work needs. The previous regulations that sporadic items belonged to individuals and high-end consumer goods were internally handled at a certain percentage were abolished.

events:
18日——23日 中共中央在北京召开政治局扩大会议。中
共中央副主席邓小平发表了《党和国家领导制度的改革》的重要
讲话。这篇讲话提出了肃清封建主义和资产阶级思想影响的问
题,分析了党和国家领导制度、干部制度等方面存在的弊端,强
调要废除干部领导职务实际上存在的终身制,改变权力过分集中
的状况,逐步实现各级领导人员的革命化、年轻化、知识化、专
业化。8月31日,政治局讨论通过了这个讲话。9月11日,中
共中央发出关于印发这个讲话的通知。
translated_text: From August 18 to 23, the CPC Central Committee held an enlarged meeting of the Political Bureau in Beijing. Deng Xiaoping, Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Committee, delivered an important speech entitled "Reform of the Party and State Leadership System". This speech raised the issue of eliminating the influence of feudalism and bourgeois ideology, analyzed the shortcomings of the party and state leadership system and cadre system, and emphasized the need to abolish the de facto lifelong tenure of cadre leadership positions, change the situation of excessive concentration of power, and gradually realize the revolutionization, rejuvenation, knowledge and professionalization of leaders at all levels. On August 31, the Political Bureau discussed and passed this speech. On September 11, the CPC Central Committee issued a notice on the printing and distribution of this speech.

events:
21日 中共中央组织部发出《关于为受所谓全国第一张大
字报诬陷的同志平反的通知》。《通知》指出,“文化大革命”一开
始,林彪、江青、康生、陈伯达一伙,出于篡党夺权的需要,抛
出聂元梓等人的所谓“第一张大字报”,并组织人炮制《人民日
报》评论员文章,诬陷北京大学党委和北大党委书记陆平、北京
市委大学科学工作部副部长宋硕、北大党委副书记彭珮云。中共
北京市委 1979年2月和3月已为北京大学党委和陆平、宋硕、
彭珮云作出了彻底平反的决定。
translated_text: On the 21st, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued a "Notice on Rehabilitating Comrades Framed by the So-called First Big-Character Poster in the Country". The "Notice" pointed out that at the beginning of the "Cultural Revolution", Lin Biao, Jiang Qing, Kang Sheng, Chen Boda and their gang, out of the need to usurp the party and seize power, threw out the so-called "first big-character poster" by Nie Yuanzi and others, and organized people to fabricate a commentary article in the "People's Daily" to frame the Party Committee of Peking University and its Secretary Lu Ping, Deputy Director of the University Science Work Department of the Beijing Municipal Party Committee Song Shuo, and Deputy Secretary of the Peking University Party Committee Peng Peiyun. In February and March 1979, the Beijing Municipal Party Committee of the CPC made a decision to completely rehabilitate the Party Committee of Peking University and Lu Ping, Song Shuo, and Peng Peiyun.

events: 21日——26日 第五届全国人大常委会第十五次会议在北京举行。会议决定解除宋振明的石油部部长职务。
translated_text: From the 21st to the 26th, the 15th meeting of the Standing Committee of the Fifth National People's Congress was held in Beijing. The meeting decided to establish the National Energy Commission and appointed Vice Premier Yu Qiuli as the director of the National Energy Commission; appointed Vice Premier Yao Yilin as the director of the State Planning Commission and dismissed Yu Qiuli from the post of director of the State Planning Commission; appointed Vice Premier Wan Li as the director of the State Agricultural Commission and dismissed Wang Renzhong from the post of director of the State Agricultural Commission; appointed Wang Bingqian as the Minister of Finance and dismissed Wu Bo from the post of Minister of Finance. The meeting decided to remove Song Zhenming from the post of Minister of Petroleum.

events: 会议决定设立国家能源委员会,任命国务院副总理余秋里兼任国家能源委员会主任;任命姚依林副总理兼任国家计划委员会主任,免去余秋里的国家计划委员会主任职务;任命万里副总理兼任国家农业委员会主任,免去王任重的国家农业委员会主任职务;任命王丙乾为财政部部长,免去吴波的财政部部长职务。
translated_text: From the 21st to the 26th, the 15th meeting of the Standing Committee of the Fifth National People's Congress was held in Beijing. The meeting decided to establish the National Energy Commission and appointed Vice Premier Yu Qiuli as the director of the National Energy Commission; appointed Vice Premier Yao Yilin as the director of the State Planning Commission and dismissed Yu Qiuli from the post of director of the State Planning Commission; appointed Vice Premier Wan Li as the director of the State Agricultural Commission and dismissed Wang Renzhong from the post of director of the State Agricultural Commission; appointed Wang Bingqian as the Minister of Finance and dismissed Wu Bo from the post of Minister of Finance. The meeting decided to remove Song Zhenming from the post of Minister of Petroleum.

events:
25日 中共中央书记处、国务院举行联席会议,讨论处理
“渤海二号”钻井船翻沉事故。8月26日,《人民日报》刊载国务
院关于处理“渤海二号”事故的决定,建议全国人大常委会解除宋
振明石油部部长的职务。
中共中央组织部重新制定了《关于中国共产党党员和党组织
统计工作制度》。
中共中央组织部、中共中央宣传部联合发出《关于中央宣传
部分管干部的通知》。《通知》指出,中央书记处1980年6月5
日第二十六次会议确定,在中央统一领导下,中央宣传部分管党
中央、国务院和各省、市、自治区所属宣传文化系统中央管理的
干部和这方面的专家,并批准中央宣传部设立干部管理局。
translated_text: On the 25th, the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council held a joint meeting to discuss the handling of the "Bohai No. 2" drilling ship capsizing accident. On August 26, the People's Daily published the State Council's decision on handling the "Bohai No. 2" accident, suggesting that the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress remove Song Zhenming from his post as Minister of the Ministry of Petroleum. The Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee re-established the "Statistical Work System for Members of the Communist Party of China and Party Organizations". The Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the Propaganda Department of the CPC Central Committee jointly issued the "Notice on the Management of Cadres by the Central Propaganda Department". The "Notice" pointed out that the 26th meeting of the Central Secretariat on June 5, 1980 determined that under the unified leadership of the Central Committee, the Central Propaganda Department would manage the cadres and experts in the propaganda and cultural systems of the Central Committee, the State Council and the provinces, cities and autonomous regions, and approved the establishment of the Cadre Management Bureau of the Central Propaganda Department.

events: 28日——9月12日 第五届全国政协第三次会议在北京举行。会议增补何长工、萧克、程子华、杨秀峰、沙千里、包尔汉、周培源、钱昌照为第五届全国政协副主席。
translated_text: From September 28 to September 12, the third session of the Fifth National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference was held in Beijing. The meeting added He Changgong, Xiao Ke, Cheng Zihua, Yang Xiufeng, Sha Qianli, Bao Erhan, Zhou Peiyuan, and Qian Changzhao as vice chairmen of the Fifth National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference. The meeting decided that Guo Qing, Peng Chong, Zhao Ziyang, Song Renqiong, Yang Jingren, and Panchen Erdeni Chokyi Gyaltsen would no longer serve as vice chairmen of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

events: 会议决定国清,彭冲、赵紫阳、宋任穷、杨静仁、班禅额尔德尼·却吉坚赞不再兼任全国政协副主席。
translated_text: From September 28 to September 12, the third session of the Fifth National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference was held in Beijing. The meeting added He Changgong, Xiao Ke, Cheng Zihua, Yang Xiufeng, Sha Qianli, Bao Erhan, Zhou Peiyuan, and Qian Changzhao as vice chairmen of the Fifth National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference. The meeting decided that Guo Qing, Peng Chong, Zhao Ziyang, Song Renqiong, Yang Jingren, and Panchen Erdeni Chokyi Gyaltsen would no longer serve as vice chairmen of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

events: 30日—9月10日 第五届全国人大第三次会议在北京举行。会议讨论了制定发展国民经济长远规划和继续推进经济改革等问题。会议还接受陈永贵要求解除他的副总理职务的请求。
translated_text: From September 30 to September 10, the Third Session of the Fifth National People's Congress was held in Beijing. The meeting discussed the formulation of a long-term plan for the development of the national economy and the continued promotion of economic reforms. The meeting decided to accept Hua Guofeng's request to resign as Premier of the State Council; the meeting decided, based on the proposal of the CPC Central Committee, that Zhao Ziyang would be Premier of the State Council; it decided to accept the requests of Deng Xiaoping, Li Xiannian, Chen Yun, Xu Xiangqian, Wang Zhen, and Wang Renzhong to resign as Vice Premiers of the State Council and Nie Rongzhen, Liu Bocheng, Zhang Dingcheng, Cai Chang, and Zhou Jianren to resign as Vice Chairmen of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress; Peng Chong, Xi Zhongxun, Su Yu, Yang Shangkun, and Panchen Erdeni Choegyi Gyaltsen were elected as Vice Chairmen, and Yang Shangkun was also Secretary-General of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress. The meeting also accepted Chen Yonggui's request to remove him from his position as Vice Premier.

events: 会议决定接受华国锋辞去国务院总理的请求;会议根据中共中央的提议,决定赵紫阳为国务院总理;决定接受邓小平、李先念、陈云、徐向前、王震、王任重辞去国务院副总理职务和聂荣臻、刘伯承、张鼎丞、蔡畅、周建人辞去人大常委副委员长职务的请求;增选彭冲、习仲勋、粟裕、杨尚昆、班禅额尔德尼·却吉坚赞为副委员长,杨尚昆兼人大常委会秘书长。
translated_text: From September 30 to September 10, the Third Session of the Fifth National People's Congress was held in Beijing. The meeting discussed the formulation of a long-term plan for the development of the national economy and the continued promotion of economic reforms. The meeting decided to accept Hua Guofeng's request to resign as Premier of the State Council; the meeting decided, based on the proposal of the CPC Central Committee, that Zhao Ziyang would be Premier of the State Council; it decided to accept the requests of Deng Xiaoping, Li Xiannian, Chen Yun, Xu Xiangqian, Wang Zhen, and Wang Renzhong to resign as Vice Premiers of the State Council and Nie Rongzhen, Liu Bocheng, Zhang Dingcheng, Cai Chang, and Zhou Jianren to resign as Vice Chairmen of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress; Peng Chong, Xi Zhongxun, Su Yu, Yang Shangkun, and Panchen Erdeni Choegyi Gyaltsen were elected as Vice Chairmen, and Yang Shangkun was also Secretary-General of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress. The meeting also accepted Chen Yonggui's request to remove him from his position as Vice Premier.

events:
20日 中共中央组织部发出《关于专科学校党委书记、校
长改由省、市、自治区党委和中央有关部委党组管理的通知》。
translated_text: On the 20th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued a notice on the management of the party committee secretaries and presidents of vocational colleges by the provincial, municipal and autonomous regional party committees and the party groups of relevant central ministries and commissions.

events:
24日 中共中央发出《关于妥善安排军队退出现役干部的
通知》,指出妥善安排这些同志,对于促进安定团结、加强四化
建设有着重要意义。要求军队和地方各级党委一定要高度重视,
认真办好。
translated_text: On the 24th, the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on Proper Arrangement of Retired Military Cadres", pointing out that proper arrangement of these comrades is of great significance to promoting stability and unity and strengthening the construction of the Four Modernizations. It requires the military and local party committees at all levels to attach great importance to it and do it well.

events:
25日 中共中央组织部发出《关于严格执行转移党员组织
关系手续的意见》。其中指出,对那些没有正当理由,长期不转
移组织关系,不按指定单位去报到的党员,应给予严肃批评和教
育,限期报到。经教育不改的,要視其情况,严肃处理。
translated_text: On the 25th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Opinions on Strictly Implementing the Procedures for Transferring Party Members' Organizational Relationships". It pointed out that those party members who have no legitimate reasons, have not transferred their organizational relations for a long time, and have not reported to the designated units should be severely criticized and educated, and report within a time limit. Those who do not change after education should be dealt with seriously according to their circumstances.

events:
26日 中共中央印发《关于审判林彪、江青反革命集团案
的通知》。《通知》对审判工作作了部署;要求通过对林彪、江青
反革命集团案的审判,达到揭露敌人,打击敌人,教育人民,加
强社会主义法制,调动广大群众的积极性,促进安定团结和四化
建设的目的。11月20日,最高人民法院特别法庭对林彪、江青
两个反革命集团的十名主犯开始进行审判。1981年1月25日
作出判决。判处江青、张春桥死刑,缓期二年执行,剥夺政治权
利终身。对王洪文、姚文元、陈伯达、黄永胜、吴法宪、李作
鹏、邱会作、江腾蛟也分别判刑,给予法律制裁。
translated_text: On the 26th, the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on the Trial of the Lin Biao and Jiang Qing Counter-Revolutionary Groups". The "Notice" made arrangements for the trial work; it required that through the trial of the Lin Biao and Jiang Qing counter-revolutionary groups, the purpose of exposing the enemy, attacking the enemy, educating the people, strengthening the socialist legal system, mobilizing the enthusiasm of the masses, and promoting stability, unity and the construction of the Four Modernizations would be achieved. On November 20, the Special Court of the Supreme People's Court began to try the ten main criminals of the Lin Biao and Jiang Qing counter-revolutionary groups. The verdict was made on January 25, 1981. Jiang Qing and Zhang Chunqiao were sentenced to death with a two-year reprieve and deprived of political rights for life. Wang Hongwen, Yao Wenyuan, Chen Boda, Huang Yongsheng, Wu Faxian, Li Zuopeng, Qiu Huizuo, and Jiang Tengjiao were also sentenced and given legal sanctions.

events: 26日——29日 第五届全国人大常委会第十六次会议在北京举行。
translated_text: From the 26th to the 29th, the 16th meeting of the Fifth National People's Congress Standing Committee was held in Beijing. The meeting appointed Yong Wentao as Minister of Forestry and dismissed Luo Yuchuan from the post of Minister of Forestry.

events: 会议任命雍文涛为林业部部长,免去罗玉川的林业部部长职务。
translated_text: From the 26th to the 29th, the 16th meeting of the Fifth National People's Congress Standing Committee was held in Beijing. The meeting appointed Yong Wentao as Minister of Forestry and dismissed Luo Yuchuan from the post of Minister of Forestry.

events:
27日 中共中央、国务院、中央军委批转总政治部《关于
志愿军被俘归来人员问题的复查处理意见》。
translated_text: On the 27th, the CPC Central Committee, the State Council, and the Central Military Commission approved the General Political Department's "Opinions on the Review and Handling of Issues Regarding the Returning Captured Volunteer Army Personnel."

events:
29日 中共中央发出批转《公安部、最高人民检察院、最
高人民法院党组<关于‘胡风反革命集团’案件的复查报告>的通
知》。《通知》指出:中央决定,凡定为胡风反革命分子的,一律
改正,恢复名誉,从平反之日起恢复原工资待遇,本人历史上有
其它问题的,是什么问题就按什么问题作结论,并由原单位妥善
做好对他们的安置工作。
translated_text: On the 29th, the CPC Central Committee issued a notice approving the "Notice on the Review Report on the Case of the Hu Feng Counter-Revolutionary Group" by the Party Group of the Ministry of Public Security, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, and the Supreme People's Court". The notice pointed out: The Central Committee decided that all those who were identified as Hu Feng counter-revolutionaries should be corrected, their reputations restored, and their original wages and benefits restored from the date of rehabilitation. For those who have other problems in their history, the conclusion will be made based on the problems, and their original units should properly handle their resettlement work.

events: 1980年9月29日,第五届人大常委会第十六次会议通过了《国务院关于老干部离职休养的暂行规定》。国务院于10月7日公布。规定指出,根据党和国家关心、爱护老干部的传统,让年老体弱、不能坚持正常工作的老干部离职休养,在政治上予以尊重,在生活上予以照顾,这是改革和完善我国干部制度的一项重要举措,也是社会主义制度优越性的体现。这既有利于老干部的健康,也有利于年轻干部的成长。
translated_text: On September 29, 1980, the 16th meeting of the Standing Committee of the Fifth National People's Congress passed the "Interim Provisions of the State Council on the Retirement and Rest of Old Cadres". The State Council promulgated it on October 7. The provisions pointed out that according to the tradition of the Party and the State caring for and loving old cadres, old cadres who are old and weak and cannot continue to work normally should be allowed to retire and rest, respected politically and taken care of in life. This is an important measure to reform and improve my country's cadre system and a manifestation of the superiority of the socialist system. This is not only beneficial to the health of old cadres, but also to the growth of young cadres.

events:
7日 国务院发出《关于公布《国务院关于老干部离职休养
的暂行规定>的通知》。《暂行规定》经9月25日第五届全国人
民代表大会常务委员会第十六次会议通过,凡第一、二次国内革
命战争时期参加革命工作的干部、抗日战争时期参加革命工作的
副县长及相当职务或行政十八级以上的干部,建国以前参加革命
工作的行政公署副专员及相当职务或行政十四级以上的干部,年
老体弱,不能坚持正常工作的,应当离休。已经退休的干部,符
合上述规定的应当改为离休。
translated_text: On the 7th, the State Council issued the Notice on the Announcement of the State Council's Provisional Regulations on the Retirement and Rest of Old Cadres. The Provisional Regulations were adopted at the 16th meeting of the Standing Committee of the Fifth National People's Congress on September 25. All cadres who participated in the revolutionary work during the First and Second Civil Revolutionary Wars, deputy county heads and cadres of equivalent positions or administrative level 18 or above who participated in the revolutionary work during the Anti-Japanese War, and deputy commissioners of administrative offices and cadres of equivalent positions or administrative level 14 or above who participated in the revolutionary work before the founding of the People's Republic of China, who are old and weak and cannot continue to work normally, should retire. Retired cadres who meet the above requirements should change to retirement.

events:
9日 中共中央决定,调习仲勋、杨尚昆到中央工作,免去
他们在广东省的党内外职务;任命任仲夷为广东省委第一书记,
免去其辽宁省委第一书记职务;任命郭峰为辽宁省委第一书记。
translated_text: On the 9th, the CPC Central Committee decided to transfer Xi Zhongxun and Yang Shangkun to work in the central government and remove them from their posts in Guangdong Province; appointed Ren Zhongyi as the first secretary of the Guangdong Provincial Party Committee and removed him from his post as the first secretary of the Liaoning Provincial Party Committee; and appointed Guo Feng as the first secretary of the Liaoning Provincial Party Committee.

events:
10日——12月5日 中共中央政治局连续召开会议,主要
议题是中央政治局准备向十一届六中全会提出的人事更动方案。
12月5日,中央政治局会议一致通过《中央政治局会议通报》。
1981年1月9日,中共中央发布《关于扩大传达<中央政治局
会议通报>的通知》,决定把《通报》扩大传达到县级党员干
部。
同一期间,中共中央政治局扩大会议在北京举行。会议讨论
了华国锋在粉碎“四人帮”以来的主要错误。华国锋要求辞去所担
任的职务。会议经过充分讨论,一致决议:(一)向六中全会建
议,同意华国锋辞去中共中央主席、中共中央军委主席的职务;
(二)向六中全会建议,选举胡耀邦为中共中央主席、邓小平为
中共中央军委主席;(三)在六中全会前,暂由胡耀邦主持中央
政治局和中央常委的工作,由邓小平主持中央军委的工作。会议
决定对《关于建国以来党的若干历史问题的决议(讨论稿)》,参
照讨论中提出的意见进行改写。
translated_text: From December 10 to December 5, the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee held consecutive meetings, the main topic of which was the personnel change plan that the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee was preparing to propose to the Sixth Plenary Session of the Eleventh Central Committee. On December 5, the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee unanimously passed the "Notice of the Political Bureau Meeting of the CPC Central Committee". On January 9, 1981, the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on Expanding the Dissemination of the <Notice of the Political Bureau Meeting of the CPC Central Committee>", deciding to expand the dissemination of the "Notice" to county-level party members and cadres. During the same period, an enlarged meeting of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee was held in Beijing. The meeting discussed Hua Guofeng's main mistakes since the smashing of the "Gang of Four". Hua Guofeng asked to resign from his position. After full discussion, the meeting unanimously decided: (i) to propose to the Sixth Plenary Session that Hua Guofeng resign from the posts of Chairman of the CPC Central Committee and Chairman of the CPC Central Military Commission; (ii) to propose to the Sixth Plenary Session that Hu Yaobang be elected Chairman of the CPC Central Committee and Deng Xiaoping be elected Chairman of the CPC Central Military Commission; (iii) before the Sixth Plenary Session, Hu Yaobang will temporarily preside over the work of the Central Political Bureau and the Central Standing Committee, and Deng Xiaoping will preside over the work of the Central Military Commission. The meeting decided to rewrite the "Resolution on Certain Historical Issues of the Party Since the Founding of the People's Republic of China (Draft for Discussion)" in accordance with the opinions raised in the discussion.

events:
14日 中共中央组织部印发《关于解放前一些群众团体要
求定性问题的处理意见》的通知。这个意见已经中央书记处10
月6日会议讨论同意。
translated_text: On the 14th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued a notice on "Opinions on the handling of the issue of some mass organizations requesting a qualitative assessment before liberation". This opinion was discussed and agreed upon at the meeting of the Central Secretariat on October 6.

events:
14日——29日 中共中央纪律检查委员会召开第三次贯彻
《关于党内政治生活的若干准则》座谈会。中共中央总书记胡耀
邦作了《关于坚定不移地搞好党风》的讲话。《讲话》传达了中
共中央副主席陈云关于“执政党的党风问题是有关党的生死存亡
的问题,必须抓紧搞,永远搞”的重要意见。中共中央纪律检查
委员会常务书记黄克诚作了《关于党风问题和正确评价毛主席历
史功绩》的讲话。1981年1月8日,中共中央批转了这次会议
的《纪要》。
translated_text: From the 14th to the 29th, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China held the third symposium on the implementation of the "Several Principles on Political Life within the Party". Hu Yaobang, General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, delivered a speech on "Unswervingly Improving the Party's Conduct". The speech conveyed the important opinion of Chen Yun, Vice Chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, that "the Party's conduct in the ruling party is a matter of life and death for the party, and must be dealt with promptly and forever". Huang Kecheng, Executive Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China, delivered a speech on "Party Conduct and Correct Evaluation of Chairman Mao's Historical Contributions". On January 8, 1981, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China approved the "Minutes" of this meeting.

events:
15日 中共中央宣传部、统战部、组织部和国家科委联合
发出转发《国务院科技干部局、国家人事局关于解决专家兼职过
多问题的几点意见》的通知。《通知》指出,专家兼任一定的职
务,参加一些社会活动是必要的,但兼职过多,将严重影响他们
的专业工作、身体健康和对中青年专家的培养。要求各级党委和
有关部门采取切实可行的措施,逐步改变这种状况。
translated_text: On the 15th, the Publicity Department, United Front Work Department, Organization Department and State Science and Technology Commission of the CPC Central Committee jointly issued a notice forwarding the "Several Opinions of the State Council Science and Technology Cadre Bureau and the State Personnel Bureau on Solving the Problem of Too Many Experts Taking on Part-time Jobs". The "Notice" pointed out that it is necessary for experts to take on certain positions and participate in some social activities, but too many part-time jobs will seriously affect their professional work, physical health and the training of young and middle-aged experts. It requires party committees at all levels and relevant departments to take practical measures to gradually change this situation.

events:
16日 中共中央批转中央纪律检查委员会《关于康生、谢
富治的两个审查报告》。中央指出,党的十一届三中全会决定对
康生,谢富治进行审查,已查明康生、谢富治两人,政治品质表
现恶劣,在“文化大革命”期间,直接参与林彪、江青等人篡党夺
权的反革命阴谋活动,犯下严重罪行。中央决定把康生、谢富治
的反革命罪行向全党公布,撤销对两人的《悼词》,开除他们的
党籍。中央要求全党同志都应当从康生、谢富治的问题上吸取教
训,以康生、谢富治为戒,认真地执行《关于党内政治生活的若
干准则》,增强党性锻炼,注意品质修养,做真正合格的共产党
员,共同努力严肃党纪,搞好党风,把我们的党建设好。
translated_text: On the 16th, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China approved and forwarded the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection's "Two Review Reports on Kang Sheng and Xie Fuzhi". The Central Committee pointed out that the Third Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee of the Party decided to review Kang Sheng and Xie Fuzhi, and it has been found that Kang Sheng and Xie Fuzhi have bad political qualities. During the "Cultural Revolution", they directly participated in the counter-revolutionary conspiracy activities of Lin Biao, Jiang Qing and others to usurp the party and seize power, and committed serious crimes. The Central Committee decided to announce the counter-revolutionary crimes of Kang Sheng and Xie Fuzhi to the whole party, revoke the "Eulogy" for the two, and expel them from the party. The Central Committee requires all party comrades to learn lessons from the problems of Kang Sheng and Xie Fuzhi, take Kang Sheng and Xie Fuzhi as a warning, conscientiously implement the "Several Principles on Political Life within the Party", strengthen party spirit training, pay attention to quality cultivation, be truly qualified Communist Party members, and work together to strictly enforce party discipline, improve party style, and build our party well.

events:

检查委员会《关于瞿秋白同志被捕问题的复查报告》。《报告》指
出,瞿秋白被捕后,坚持了党的立场,保持了革命节操,显示了
视死如归、从容就义的英勇气概。“文化大革命”中,把瞿秋白定
为叛徒是完全错误的,应当彻底平反,恢复名誉。
translated_text: On the 19th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee forwarded the "Re-examination Report on the Arrest of Comrade Qu Qiubai" of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, which was approved by the Central Secretariat. The "Report" pointed out that after Qu Qiubai was arrested, he adhered to the party's position, maintained his revolutionary integrity, and showed the heroic spirit of facing death with equanimity and calmly accepting the martyrdom. It was completely wrong to define Qu Qiubai as a traitor during the "Cultural Revolution", and he should be thoroughly rehabilitated and his reputation restored.

events:

杨尚昆等同志平反问题的请示报告》。《请示报告》指出,林彪、
江青、康生一伙强加给杨尚昆同志的一切罪名,全属不实之词,

For those who have been implicated and have not yet been rehabilitated, please ask the relevant party committee to announce the rehabilitation and restore their reputation.

部职务名称表”中几个具体问题的通知》。
translated_text: On the 24th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued a "Notice on Several Specific Issues in the Implementation of the 'List of Positions of Officials Managed by the CPC Central Committee'".

events: 1980年10月28日,《人民日报》发表特约评论员文章《党和国家领导制度的一项重要改革》。文章说,党的十一届五中全会提出,要废止实际存在的干部领导职务终身制,这是对我们党和国家领导制度和干部制度所作的一项重要改革。文章指出,领导职务终身制的弊端越来越明显:一是出现了领导干部的老化,二是阻碍人才的培养和成长,三是不利于贯彻民主集中制。因此,废除领导职务终身制,对改善党和政府的领导,提高领导工作的效率和质量,克服官僚主义,具有迫切的现实意义,而且也是关系到完善国家基本政治制度的一个重要问题。
translated_text: On October 28, 1980, the People's Daily published a special commentator article entitled "An Important Reform of the Party and State Leadership System". The article said that the Fifth Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee of the Party proposed to abolish the actual lifelong tenure of leading cadres, which is an important reform of our party and state leadership system and cadre system. The article pointed out that the disadvantages of the lifelong tenure of leading positions are becoming more and more obvious: first, the aging of leading cadres has occurred, second, it hinders the training and growth of talents, and third, it is not conducive to the implementation of democratic centralism. Therefore, abolishing the lifelong tenure of leading positions has urgent practical significance for improving the leadership of the party and the government, improving the efficiency and quality of leadership work, and overcoming bureaucracy. It is also an important issue related to the improvement of the country's basic political system.

events:

无产阶级革命战士、彝族人民的好儿子张冲在北京逝世,终年

events:

On December 20, the two departments jointly issued the "Minutes of the Symposium on the Work of Propaganda and Cultural Cadres", clarifying the cadres in charge of the propaganda department of the party committee, several major tasks of the propaganda department cadres in the future, and the need to continue to eliminate the "leftist" poison in the cadre work.

events:

海、辽宁、山东、河南、湖南、四川、贵州、甘肃等10省市委
组织部关于选拔优秀中青年干部工作座谈会。19日,中央组织
部副部长陈野在会上讲话。

On the 19th, Chen Ye, Deputy Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, spoke at the meeting.

events:
10日 中共中央组织部发出通知,转发《中共河北省委组
织部关于共产党员不允许参加宗教活动的通知》。《通知》强调,
共产党人是无神论者,决不允许参加宗教活动。对参加宗教活动
的党员,要劝阻,要教育。如果经过教育仍坚持信仰宗教的,要

The "Notice" emphasized that Communists are atheists and are absolutely not allowed to participate in religious activities. Party members who participate in religious activities should be dissuaded and educated. If they still insist on believing in religion after education, they should be persuaded to quit the party.

events:
16日 中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅转发民航总局党委
《关于落实两航起义人员政策的请示报告》。两航起义是指1949
年11月9日,原中国、中央两家航空公司员工在香港宣布起
义,由中国航空公司总经理刘敬宜、中央航空公司总经理陈卓林
率领,毅然驾驶12架飞机,在没有地面导航和气象保障的困难
条件下,冒着可能遭遇敌人袭击的危险,胜利飞抵天津、北京。
中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅转发这个报告的批语中指出,
组织两航起义是我党在建国前后领导的一件很成功的工作,在国
内外影响很大。认真做好对这部分人的政策落实工作,直接关系
到四化建设和台湾归回祖国的统一大业。
translated_text: On the 16th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council forwarded the "Request Report on the Implementation of the Policy for the Two Airlines Uprising Personnel" by the Party Committee of the Civil Aviation Administration of China. The Two Airlines Uprising refers to the uprising announced by the employees of the former China Airlines and Central Airlines in Hong Kong on November 9, 1949. Led by Liu Jingyi, general manager of China Airlines, and Chen Zhuolin, general manager of Central Airlines, they resolutely drove 12 planes, under the difficult conditions of no ground navigation and meteorological support, and risked the risk of enemy attacks, and successfully flew to Tianjin and Beijing. The comments of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council forwarding this report pointed out that organizing the two airline uprisings was a very successful work led by our party before and after the founding of the People's Republic of China, and it had a great impact at home and abroad. Carefully implementing the policy for this group of people is directly related to the four modernizations and the great cause of Taiwan's return to the motherland.

events:
16日——25日 中共中央在北京召开工作会议。中共中央
政治局常委陈云、赵紫阳、李先念、邓小平先后在会上讲话。会
议充分肯定了建国31年来取得的巨大成绩,肯定党的十一届三
中全会以来的好形势;同时也指出和分析了建国以来特别是
1957年以来经济建设中“左”的错误是主体错误;提出了在经济
上进一步调整,政治上进一步安定的重要方针。1981年1月5
日,中共中央发出《关于印发中央四位常委在中央工作会议上的
重要讲话的指示》,强调各级党组织和全体党员都必须无条件地
同中央保持在政治上的一致,要求全党全军全国人民同心同德,
扎扎实实,完成这次会议提出的各项任务。
中共中央副主席陈云在讲话中说,实现四个现代化,必须靠
我们党的领导。有人说我们现在的干部大多是“万金油”,我看,
搞四化建设没有这些“万金油”干部是不行的。不要小看这些“万
金油”干部的作用。但是干部队伍的年轻化、知识化、专业化、
制度化,仍然是我们在干部政策上的大方针。我们老干部必须担
负起挑选这些德才兼备的青年干部的责任。陈云同志还指出,开
国以来经济建设方面的主要错误是“左”的错误。这是主体方面的
错误。
中共中央副主席邓小平讲话指出,经济调整是件大事;四项
原则必须坚持,核心是坚持党的领导;老干部要把选拔和培养中
青年干部,作为第一位,庄严的职责。别的工作做不好,固然
要作自我批评,这项工作做不好,就要犯历史性的大错误。要在
坚持社会主义道路的前提下,使我们的干部年轻化、知识化、专
业化,当然首先要革命化,并且要制定逐步完善的干部制度来加
以保证。
translated_text: From January 16 to 25, the CPC Central Committee held a working meeting in Beijing. Chen Yun, Zhao Ziyang, Li Xiannian and Deng Xiaoping, members of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, spoke at the meeting. The meeting fully affirmed the great achievements made in the 31 years since the founding of the People's Republic of China and the good situation since the Third Plenary Session of the 11th CPC Central Committee. At the same time, it also pointed out and analyzed that the "left" mistakes in economic construction since the founding of the People's Republic of China, especially since 1957, were the main mistakes. It put forward the important policy of further adjustment in the economy and further stability in politics. On January 5, 1981, the CPC Central Committee issued the "Instructions on Printing and Distributing the Important Speeches of the Four Standing Committee Members of the Central Committee at the Central Working Conference", emphasizing that party organizations at all levels and all party members must unconditionally maintain political unity with the Central Committee, and requiring the whole party, the whole army and the people of the whole country to be of one mind and one heart, and to complete the tasks proposed by this meeting in a down-to-earth manner. Chen Yun, Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Committee, said in his speech that the realization of the four modernizations must rely on the leadership of our party. Some people say that most of our current cadres are "jack of all trades". In my opinion, it is impossible to carry out the construction of the four modernizations without these "jack of all trades" cadres. Don't underestimate the role of these "jack of all trades" cadres. However, the rejuvenation, knowledge, specialization and institutionalization of the cadre team are still the major principles of our cadre policy. Our veteran cadres must take the responsibility of selecting these young cadres with both moral integrity and ability. Comrade Chen Yun also pointed out that the main mistakes in economic construction since the founding of the People's Republic of China were "leftist" mistakes. This is a mistake in the subject. Deng Xiaoping, Vice Chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, pointed out in his speech that economic adjustment is a major event; the four principles must be upheld, and the core is to uphold the leadership of the Party; veteran cadres must take the selection and training of young and middle-aged cadres as their first and solemn duty. If other work is not done well, of course, self-criticism must be made, but if this work is not done well, a historic mistake will be made. On the premise of adhering to the socialist path, we must make our cadres younger, more knowledgeable and more professional. Of course, they must first be revolutionary, and a gradually improved cadre system must be formulated to ensure this.

events: 23日 中共中央任命阴法唐为西藏自治区党委第一书记。

translated_text: On the 27th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the Party Group of the Ministry of Education issued the "Notice on the Management of Leading Cadres in Institutions of Higher Education" and the "Opinions on Strengthening the Construction of Leading Groups in Institutions of Higher Education". 机关安排党外人士担任领导职务的情况和今后意见的报告》。中

events:
8日 中共中央批转中央纪律检查委员会召开的第三次贯彻
《关于党内政治生活的若干准则》座谈会纪要。中央在批语中指
出:从领导做起,层层带头,一级抓一级,是贯彻执行《准
则》、纠正不正之风的关键。特别是中央一级党政机关和各省、
市、自治区以及部队军以上领导干部,更要言行一致,以身作
则,首先做出榜样。中央在批语中要求,中央纪委和各级纪委的
工作都要进一步加强。各级党委应当把纪律检查工作列入党委的
重要议事日程,加强对纪律检查工作的领导,建立健全纪检机
构,调整和充实纪检部门的领导骨干,支持纪检部门对不正之风
的斗争。为了便于开展工作,各级党委在通常情况下,要吸收纪
委主持日常工作的同志,列席同级党委的常委会议。
translated_text: On the 8th, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China approved the minutes of the third symposium on the implementation of the "Several Regulations on Political Life within the Party" held by the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection. In its comments, the Central Committee pointed out that starting from the leadership, taking the lead at all levels, and grasping each level is the key to implementing the "Regulations" and correcting unhealthy tendencies. In particular, leading cadres at the central level of party and government organs and provinces, cities, autonomous regions, and military forces above the army level must be consistent in their words and deeds, set an example, and be the first to set an example. In its comments, the Central Committee required that the work of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and discipline inspection committees at all levels should be further strengthened. Party committees at all levels should include discipline inspection work on the important agenda of the party committees, strengthen leadership over discipline inspection work, establish and improve discipline inspection institutions, adjust and enrich the leading cadres of discipline inspection departments, and support discipline inspection departments in their fight against unhealthy tendencies. 林彪、江青反革命集团案,是建国以来特别重大的反革命刑事案
件。这次审判工作,在中央领导下,是由人大常委会决定成立的

translated_text: On the 14th, the People's Daily reported that in 1980, more than 700 counties, cities, and states across the country held party congresses in accordance with the party constitution and the "Several Principles on Political Life within the Party" and elected county, city, and state party committees. (ii) The verdict on the 10 principal offenders of the Lin Biao and Jiang Qing counter-revolutionary group case was made by the Central Committee based on the process and results of the preliminary investigation, prosecution and trial, after repeated deliberation and extensive consultation, and after careful suggestions. The Central Committee believes that such a verdict is correct, can stand the test of history, and is in line with the long-term interests of the entire Party, the entire army and the people of all ethnic groups in the country. translated_text: On the 27th, Hu Yaobang, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, issued instructions on the issue of intellectuals: intellectuals, whether they are party members or non-party members, are cadres of the party and the state. According to the provisions that cadres should be managed in a unified manner, the work of intellectuals should of course be managed by the Central Organization Department, and other central departments also have an unshirkable responsibility. He also suggested setting up a liaison group, led by a deputy minister of the Central Organization Department, with people from relevant departments participating, to hold regular meetings to set topics, investigate situations, conduct inspections, and handle matters. On May 5, the first meeting of the liaison group for intellectuals was held, and Song Renqiong, Secretary of the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee and Minister of the Central Organization Department, spoke at the meeting. Shen Yanbing, a pioneer of my country's modern progressive culture, a great revolutionary writer and one of the earliest members of the Communist Party of China, Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, Honorary Chairman of the China Federation of Literary and Art Circles, and Chairman of the China Writers Association, died in Beijing at the age of 85. On the 31st, the CPC Central Committee decided to restore Shen Yanbing's party membership based on his request before his death and his performance throughout his life, and his party age would be counted from 1921. Before his death, Shen Yanbing left a will, which stated that his 250,000 yuan in royalties would be used as a fund to establish a literary prize for long novels.

translated_text: On the 8th, Chen Yun, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, wrote an article entitled "Promoting and Training Young and Middle-aged Cadres is an Urgent Task". The article pointed out that from now on, thousands of young and middle-aged cadres should be promoted and trained, and young and middle-aged cadres with both moral integrity and ability should be trained in work positions at all levels. Old cadres should guide them and help them, so that a large number of young and middle-aged cadres can become a powerful reserve force for our party and government work at all levels, and leading cadres can be selected from them at any time. This method is the most beneficial method for us and it is also the method we should strive to do. The article also suggested that the Central Organization Department should establish a Youth Cadre Bureau and a Technical Cadre Bureau. On June 8, Chen Yun, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, talked with the leading comrades of the Central Organization Department, once again emphasizing the importance of selecting outstanding young and middle-aged cadres, and proposed that the Central Organization Department should establish a Youth Cadre Bureau, and the provincial and prefectural committees should also establish corresponding institutions. On July 31, the Central Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on the Establishment of a Youth Cadre Management Agency".

translated_text: On the 26th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee held a telephone conference to greet the audience. The topic was to speed up the selection of outstanding young cadres. In his speech, Song Renqiong, Secretary of the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee and Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, conveyed the conversation between Deng Xiaoping, Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Committee, and the responsible comrades of the Liaoning Provincial Party Committee, emphasizing the need to speed up the selection of outstanding young cadres into the leadership team; affirmed the achievements of the previous two years, but overall, the pace was quite slow; and required veteran cadres to take the important responsibility of discovering, cultivating and selecting outstanding young cadres. It was pointed out that if this work was not done well, a historic mistake would be made. It was required that party committees at all levels really put this work on the important agenda. The Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the Party Group of the Ministry of Health jointly issued the "Notice on Strengthening and Improving the Management of the National Health Work Team". In response to the outstanding problems in the management of the health work team during the ten years of unrest, the "Notice" proposed that the leadership teams of health administrative departments and grassroots health units at all levels should be carefully equipped, and attention should be paid to selecting cadres who understand and are familiar with health business to serve in leadership positions. The Party organizations of health administrative departments at all levels should regard the management of cadres as an important task, actively assist the Party committees and governments in building a good health work system, and strive to do a good job in the training, assessment, deployment, and promotion of cadres. When appointing, removing, and transferring health administrative leaders at all levels, the Party committee organization departments should seek the opinions of the health administrative leadership departments in advance.

events: 1981年5月28日至6月8日,国家人事局召开全国人事局长会议。中央组织部部长宋任穷作了重要讲话,国务院副总理杨静仁出席会议。会议进-步明确了人事部门的职责范围,还就如何肃清“左”的错误思想影响,更好地落实党的知识分子政策,做好干部离休､退休、退职工作以及如何进一步搞好人事部门的自身建设等问题进行了深入讨论。
translated_text: From May 28 to June 8, 1981, the State Personnel Bureau held a national meeting of personnel bureau directors. Song Renqiong, head of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, delivered an important speech, and Yang Jingren, vice premier of the State Council, attended the meeting. The meeting further clarified the scope of responsibilities of personnel departments, and also conducted in-depth discussions on how to eliminate the influence of "leftist" erroneous ideas, better implement the party's intellectual policy, do a good job in the retirement, retirement and resignation of cadres, and how to further improve the self-construction of personnel departments.

events:
29日 中华人民共和国的缔造者之一,中华人民共和国名
誉主席,中国各族人民敬爱的领导人,举世闻名的爱国主义、民
主主义、国际主义、共产主义的伟大战士,保卫世界和平事业的
久经考验的前驱,中国共产党优秀党员宋庆龄在北京逝世,终年
90岁。6月3日,在人民大会堂举行隆重的追悼大会,中共中央
总书记胡耀邦主持大会,中共中央副主席邓小平致悼词。
translated_text: On the 29th, Song Qingling, one of the founders of the People's Republic of China, the honorary president of the People's Republic of China, the beloved leader of the Chinese people of all ethnic groups, the world-renowned great fighter for patriotism, democracy, internationalism, and communism, the time-tested pioneer in the cause of defending world peace, and an outstanding member of the Communist Party of China, died in Beijing at the age of 90. On June 3, a grand memorial meeting was held in the Great Hall of the People. Hu Yaobang, general secretary of the CPC Central Committee, presided over the meeting, and Deng Xiaoping, vice chairman of the CPC Central Committee, delivered a eulogy.

events:
29日——6月8日 中共中央组织部、国家经济委员会、全
国总工会联合在北京召开企业民主管理座谈会。会议总结交流了
企业民主管理的经验,分析研究存在的问题;提出进一步推广和
完善职工代表大会制度的意见;讨论修改职工代表大会试行守
则。国务院副总理万里和中共中央书记处书记、中央组织部部长
宋任穷到会作了讲话。
translated_text: From June 29 to June 8, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the State Economic Commission, and the All-China Federation of Trade Unions jointly held a symposium on enterprise democratic management in Beijing. The meeting summarized and exchanged experiences in enterprise democratic management, analyzed and studied existing problems; put forward opinions on further promoting and improving the system of workers' congresses; and discussed and revised the trial code of workers' congresses. Vice Premier Wan Li and Secretary of the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee and Minister of the Organization Department Song Renqiong attended the meeting and delivered speeches.

events:
8日 中共中央书记处书记、中央组织部部长宋任务在全国
人事局长会议上强调,在实行经济调整和政治安定的关键时期,
人事部门要在妥善地安排好老干部的同时,积极发现和推荐人
才,培养和选拔中青年干部到各级领导岗位上来。
translated_text: On the 8th, Song Renwu, Secretary of the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee and Minister of the Central Organization Department, stressed at the National Personnel Bureau Directors' Conference that during the critical period of economic adjustment and political stability, personnel departments should not only properly arrange for veteran cadres, but also actively discover and recommend talents, and train and select young and middle-aged cadres to leadership positions at all levels.

events:
9日 中共中央批准,叶剑英任全国人大常委会党组书记;
彭真、邓颖超(女)、韦国清、乌兰夫、彭冲任副书记;同意李
绪鄂、宋健任第七机械工业部副部长。
中共中央批准,朱良、李淑铮(女)任中共中央联
络部副部长;同意萧桐、王德瑛任国家建委副主任;罗东明、曹
文斌任商业部副部长。
第五届全国人大常委会第十九次会议决定,接受彭真副委员
长辞去兼任全国人民代表大会常务委员会法制委员会主任职务的
请求,任命习仲勋副委员长兼任全国人民代表大会常务委员会法
制委员会主任。同时,任命安志文为第六机械工业部部长。
translated_text: On the 9th, the CPC Central Committee approved Ye Jianying as the Secretary of the Party Group of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress; Peng Zhen, Deng Yingchao (female), Wei Guoqing, Ulanhu, and Peng Chong as Deputy Secretaries; Li Xu'e and Song Jian were approved as Deputy Ministers of the Seventh Ministry of Machinery Industry. The CPC Central Committee approved Zhu Liang and Li Shuzheng (female) as Deputy Ministers of the Liaison Department of the CPC Central Committee; Xiao Tong and Wang Deying were approved as Deputy Directors of the State Construction Commission; Luo Dongming and Cao Wenbin were approved as Deputy Ministers of the Ministry of Commerce. The 19th meeting of the Standing Committee of the Fifth National People's Congress decided to accept Vice Chairman Peng Zhen's request to resign from the post of Director of the Legal Affairs Committee of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, and appointed Vice Chairman Xi Zhongxun as Director of the Legal Affairs Committee of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress. At the same time, An Zhiwen was appointed as Minister of the Sixth Ministry of Machinery Industry.

events:
27日——29日 中共十一届六中全会在北京举行。出席会
议的中央委员195人,候补中央委员114人,列席53人。中央
政治局常委胡耀邦、叶剑英、邓小平、赵紫阳、李先念、陈云、
华国锋主持了会议。全会审议并一致通过《关于建国以来党的若
干历史问题的决议》,在党的指导思想上完成了拨乱反正的历史
任务。全会一致同意华国锋辞去中共中央主席和中共中央军事委
员会主席职务的请求,选举胡耀邦为中央委员会主席,增选赵紫
阳为副主席,改选华国锋为副主席;改选邓小平为中央军事委员
会主席;中央政治局常务委员会由中央委员会主席胡耀邦、副主
席叶剑英、邓小平,赵紫阳、李先念、陈云、华国锋组成。
translated_text: From the 27th to the 29th, the Sixth Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China was held in Beijing. 195 members of the Central Committee attended the meeting, 114 alternate members of the Central Committee, and 53 people attended the meeting. The meeting was chaired by the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee Hu Yaobang, Ye Jianying, Deng Xiaoping, Zhao Ziyang, Li Xiannian, Chen Yun, and Hua Guofeng. The plenary session reviewed and unanimously passed the "Resolution on Certain Historical Issues of the Party Since the Founding of the People's Republic of China", completing the historical task of correcting the wrongs in the guiding ideology of the party. The plenary session unanimously agreed to Hua Guofeng's request to resign from the positions of Chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and Chairman of the Central Military Commission of the Communist Party of China, elected Hu Yaobang as Chairman of the Central Committee, added Zhao Ziyang as Vice Chairman, and re-elected Hua Guofeng as Vice Chairman; re-elected Deng Xiaoping as Chairman of the Central Military Commission; the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee was composed of Chairman of the Central Committee Hu Yaobang, Vice Chairman Ye Jianying, Deng Xiaoping, Zhao Ziyang, Li Xiannian, Chen Yun, and Hua Guofeng.

events:
1日 首都一万多人隆重集会,热烈庆祝中国共产党成立六
十周年。中共中央主席胡耀邦在讲话中指出,中国共产党的六十
年,是为中国民族解放和人民幸福而前仆后继、英勇奋斗的六十
年,是马克思列宁主义普遍原理同中国革命具体实践愈益结合的
六十年,是党内正确纠正错误、光明面战胜阴暗面的六十年。六
十年来的历史经验,集中到一点,就是一定要有一条马克思主义
的革命路线,要有一个能够确立和坚持这条路线的无产阶级政
党。他还就如何把我们党建设成为团结和领导全国各族人民进行
社会主义现代化建设的坚强核心问题,向全党提出了六点要求。
translated_text: On the 1st, more than 10,000 people in the capital held a grand rally to celebrate the 60th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China. In his speech, Hu Yaobang, Chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, pointed out that the 60 years of the Communist Party of China are 60 years of successive and heroic struggles for the liberation of the Chinese nation and the happiness of the people, 60 years of the increasing integration of the universal principles of Marxism-Leninism with the concrete practice of the Chinese revolution, and 60 years of correct correction of mistakes within the party and victory of the bright side over the dark side. The historical experience of the past 60 years can be summarized in one point, that is, there must be a Marxist revolutionary line and a proletarian party that can establish and adhere to this line. He also put forward six requirements to the whole party on how to build our party into a strong core that unites and leads the people of all ethnic groups in the country to carry out socialist modernization.

events: 1981年7月1日,在庆祝中国共产党成立六十周年大会上,胡耀邦强调指出,要把更多德才兼备、年富力强的干部选拔到各级领导岗位上来,建设好一支革命化、年轻化、知识化、专业化的干部队伍,是摆在全党面前的一项紧迫的战略任务。
translated_text: On July 1, 1981, at the meeting celebrating the 60th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China, Hu Yaobang emphasized that it was an urgent strategic task for the entire Party to select more cadres with both moral integrity and ability, who are young and capable, to leadership positions at all levels and to build a revolutionary, young, knowledgeable and professional cadre team.

events:
2日——4日 中共中央召开省、市、自治区党委书记座谈
会。中共中央政治局常委陈云、邓小平、胡耀邦、赵紫阳先后讲
话。陈云在讲话中指出,必须成千上万地提拔中青年干部,闹派
性的骨干分子、打砸抢分子,一个也不能提到领导岗位上来;老
干部离休退休工作必须做好。邓小平在讲话中指出,国际合作领
域里面,我们应当量力而行,但是,凡是能够办到的,即使有少
量困难,我们能够克服的,就应该快上。我们的经济建设,经过
三年调整之后,要有一个4%左右的发展速度。
translated_text: From the 2nd to the 4th, the CPC Central Committee held a symposium for provincial, municipal and autonomous regional party committee secretaries. Chen Yun, Deng Xiaoping, Hu Yaobang and Zhao Ziyang, members of the Standing Committee of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau, gave speeches one after another. In his speech, Chen Yun pointed out that thousands of young and middle-aged cadres must be promoted, and no factional backbone elements or elements of looting and vandalism should be promoted to leadership positions; the retirement of old cadres must be done well. In his speech, Deng Xiaoping pointed out that in the field of international cooperation, we should do what we can, but we should do everything we can, even if there are a few difficulties, and we can overcome them quickly. After three years of adjustment, our economic construction should have a growth rate of about 4%.

events:
10日 中共中央发出通知,任命杨尚昆为中央军委常委、
中央军委秘书长;免去耿飚中央军委秘书长职务。
translated_text: On the 10th, the CPC Central Committee issued a notice appointing Yang Shangkun as a member of the Standing Committee of the Central Military Commission and Secretary-General of the Central Military Commission; Geng Biao was removed from his post as Secretary-General of the Central Military Commission.

events:
12日 中共中央发出通知,要求各级党组织结合六中全会
文件的学习向全体党员和县以上非党干部传达中共中央政治局常
委叶剑英、李先念、胡耀邦、陈云、邓小平在十一届六中全会上
的重要讲话。
translated_text: On the 12th, the CPC Central Committee issued a notice requiring party organizations at all levels to convey to all party members and non-party cadres at the county level and above the important speeches made by Ye Jianying, Li Xiannian, Hu Yaobang, Chen Yun, and Deng Xiaoping, members of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, at the Sixth Plenary Session of the 11th CPC Central Committee in conjunction with the study of the documents of the Sixth Plenary Session.

events: 中共中央统战部,中共中央组织部联合发出《关于原工商业者安排使用中几个问题的通知》。《通知》指出,"文革"中对原工商业者一律撤销其原任职务,并下放劳动,这是不对的。"文革"前安排为干部和担任领导职务的,应当承认其干部身份。对在职的原工商业者,不论"文革"以前是否担任领导职务,都应当根据中央已有文件的精神,合理安排使用。
translated_text: On the 14th, the CPC Central Committee agreed to appoint Feng Bingjun, Li Kefei, Han Liping and Liu Pingtian as vice ministers of the Ministry of Railways. The CPC Central Committee United Front Work Department and the CPC Central Committee Organization Department jointly issued the "Notice on Several Issues in the Arrangement and Employment of Former Industrialists and Businessmen". The "Notice" pointed out that during the "Cultural Revolution", all former industrialists and businessmen were dismissed from their original positions and sent to work in the countryside, which was wrong. Those who were arranged as cadres and held leadership positions before the "Cultural Revolution" should be recognized as cadres. Former industrialists and businessmen in office, regardless of whether they held leadership positions before the "Cultural Revolution", should be reasonably arranged and employed in accordance with the spirit of the existing documents of the Central Committee.

events: 14日 中共中央同意,酆炳军、李克非、韩力平、刘平田任铁道部副部长。
translated_text: On the 14th, the CPC Central Committee agreed to appoint Feng Bingjun, Li Kefei, Han Liping and Liu Pingtian as vice ministers of the Ministry of Railways. The CPC Central Committee United Front Work Department and the CPC Central Committee Organization Department jointly issued the "Notice on Several Issues in the Arrangement and Employment of Former Industrialists and Businessmen". The "Notice" pointed out that during the "Cultural Revolution", all former industrialists and businessmen were dismissed from their original positions and sent to work in the countryside, which was wrong. Those who were arranged as cadres and held leadership positions before the "Cultural Revolution" should be recognized as cadres. Former industrialists and businessmen in office, regardless of whether they held leadership positions before the "Cultural Revolution", should be reasonably arranged and employed in accordance with the spirit of the existing documents of the Central Committee.

events:
16日 中共中央书记处讨论内蒙古自治区工作问题。8月3
日,中共中央转发了《中央书记处讨论内蒙古自治区工作的纪
要》。《纪要》指出,要继续强调加强民族团结,既要照顾“主体”
民族蒙古族,又要照顾汉族和其他民族。在干部配备方面,自治
区一级的少数民族干部要有一定比例,在少数民族聚居区,以少
数民族干部为主;在汉族聚居区,以汉族干部为主。
translated_text: On the 16th, the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee discussed the work of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region. On August 3, the CPC Central Committee forwarded the Minutes of the Central Secretariat's Discussion on the Work of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region. The Minutes pointed out that we should continue to emphasize strengthening ethnic unity, taking care of both the "main" ethnic Mongolians and the Han and other ethnic groups. In terms of cadre deployment, there should be a certain proportion of ethnic minority cadres at the autonomous region level. In ethnic minority concentrated areas, ethnic minority cadres should be the main force; in Han concentrated areas, Han cadres should be the main force.

events:
17日 中共中央组织部副部长陈野在中央党校组织干部
训练班上就《关于当前组织工作的几个问题》作了讲话。讲话分
为五个方面:(一)全面加强领导班子建设,在坚持革命化的前
提下,逐步实现领导班子的年轻化、知识化和专业化。(二)正
确掌握干部标准,全面坚持党的干部政策。(三)加强党员教育
和干部教育,不断提高党员质量和干部水平。(四)坚持党的民
主集中制,健全党的生活,提高党组织的战斗力。(五)加强组
织部门的自身建设,把组织工作提高到一个新的水平。
translated_text: On the 17th, Chen Ye, Deputy Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, delivered a speech on "Several Issues Regarding Current Organizational Work" at the Central Party School Organization Cadre Training Class. The speech was divided into five aspects: (i) Comprehensively strengthen the construction of the leadership team, and gradually realize the rejuvenation, knowledge and professionalization of the leadership team under the premise of adhering to revolution. (ii) Correctly grasp the cadre standards and fully adhere to the party's cadre policy. (iii) Strengthen party member education and cadre education, and continuously improve the quality of party members and the level of cadres. (iv) Adhere to the party's democratic centralism, improve party life, and improve the combat effectiveness of party organizations. (v) Strengthen the self-construction of the organization department and raise the organizational work to a new level.

events:
18日 中共中央副主席邓小平在会见香港《明报》社长查
良镛时指出,四个坚持的核心是党的领导。为了保证四个现代化
建设,为了保持政策的连续性,我们的干部要在坚持社会主义道
路的前提下搞革命化、知识化、专业化和年轻化。这是陈云同志
提出来的。这是我们一直要坚持贯彻到底的方针。搞四个现代化
不年轻一点不行。
translated_text: On the 18th, Deng Xiaoping, Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Committee, pointed out during a meeting with Cha Liangyong, the editor-in-chief of Hong Kong Ming Pao that the core of the four principles is the leadership of the Party. In order to ensure the construction of the four modernizations and to maintain the continuity of policies, our cadres must be revolutionary, knowledgeable, professional and young while adhering to the socialist road. This was proposed by Comrade Chen Yun. This is the policy we must always adhere to and implement. To carry out the four modernizations, one must be young at least.

events:
29日 中共中央同意,解方、王辰生、王厚德任全国供销
合作总社副主任;庄炎林任国务院侨务办公室副主任;杨一木任
国家机械设备成套总局局长。
translated_text: On the 29th, the CPC Central Committee agreed to appoint Jie Fang, Wang Chensheng, and Wang Houde as deputy directors of the National Supply and Marketing Cooperatives; Zhuang Yanlin as deputy director of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council; and Yang Yimu as director of the State Machinery and Equipment Administration.

events: 30日 中共中央组织部发出《关于安排和组织好离休、退休、退职党员组织生活的通知》。《通知》要求,各级党委组织部门,不仅要关心离休、退休、退职的党员的身体和生活,而且要特别注意从政治上关心他们,组织他们过好党的组织生活。《通知》对做好这项工作提出了七条意见。
translated_text: On the 30th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on Arranging and Organizing the Organizational Life of Retired, Resigned, and Resigned Party Members". The "Notice" requires that the organization departments of the Party committees at all levels should not only care about the health and life of retired, retired, and resigned party members, but also pay special attention to caring about them politically and organizing them to live a good party organizational life. The "Notice" puts forward seven suggestions for doing this work well. The CPC Central Committee agreed that Zhou Renshan would serve as the deputy director of the Legal Affairs Committee of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

events: 中共中央同意,周仁山任全国人大常委会法制委员会副主任。
translated_text: On the 30th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on Arranging and Organizing the Organizational Life of Retired, Resigned, and Resigned Party Members". The CPC Central Committee agreed that Zhou Renshan would serve as the deputy director of the Legal Affairs Committee of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

events:

央书记处书记。
translated_text: On the 1st, the CPC Central Committee agreed that Wang Jiangong, Chen Haosu and He Guang would serve as secretaries of the Secretariat of the Communist Youth League Central Committee.

events:
3日——8日 中共中央宣传部在北京召开全国思想战线问
题座谈会。中共中央主席胡耀邦就如何加强党对思想战线的领
导,改变涣散软弱状态的问题作了讲话。会议讨论了中共中央副
主席邓小平7月17日同中央宣传部门有关负责同志的谈话。邓
小平指出,坚持四项基本原则,核心是坚持党的领导,而资产阶
级自由化的核心,就是反对党的领导。11日,中共中央印发
小平、胡耀邦关于思想战线问题的谈话和讲话的通知。《通知》
指出,当前思想战线的领导存在着的涣散软弱状态是相当普遍的
现象。凡是有这种现象的地方,党的领导者应该坚强起来和统一
起来,以利于及时地克服各种错误倾向,增强在坚持四项基本原
则的基础上的团结。特别是对于那种要脱离社会主义轨道、脱离
党的领导、搞资产阶级自由化的社会思潮,要进行严肃的正确的
批评和必要的恰当的斗争。
translated_text: From July 3 to 8, the Propaganda Department of the CPC Central Committee held a national symposium on ideological front issues in Beijing. Hu Yaobang, Chairman of the CPC Central Committee, made a speech on how to strengthen the party's leadership over the ideological front and change the lax and weak state. The meeting discussed the conversation between Deng Xiaoping, Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Committee, and relevant responsible comrades of the Central Propaganda Department on July 17. Deng Xiaoping pointed out that the core of adhering to the Four Cardinal Principles is to adhere to the leadership of the party, while the core of bourgeois liberalization is to oppose the leadership of the party. On the 11th, the CPC Central Committee issued a notice on the conversation and speech of Xiaoping and Hu Yaobang on the ideological front issues. The "Notice" pointed out that the current lax and weak state of leadership on the ideological front is a fairly common phenomenon. Wherever there is such a phenomenon, the party leaders should be strong and united, so as to help overcome various erroneous tendencies in a timely manner and strengthen unity on the basis of adhering to the Four Cardinal Principles. In particular, serious and correct criticism and necessary and appropriate struggle should be carried out against the social thoughts that want to deviate from the socialist track, deviate from the leadership of the party, and engage in bourgeois liberalization.
