events: 28日——12月14日 第五届全国政协委员会第四次会议在北京召开。
translated_text: From December 28 to December 14, the fourth meeting of the Fifth National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference was held in Beijing. The meeting elected Liu Fei and Dong Qiwu as vice chairmen of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference; and elected Ye Duyi, Feng Ding, Liu Mengchun, Li Jue, Yang Fangzhi, Yang Zhilin, Wu Gengmei, Song Shaozhi, Zhang Dazhi, Zhang Ruping, Zhang Jiabin, Zhang Jingli, Rong Gaotang, Zhao Zili, Hu Feng, Ling Qihan, Huang Zhengqing, Yu Ping, and Jiao Shizhai as standing committee members.

events: 会议增选刘斐、董其武为全国政协副主席;增选叶笃义、冯定、刘孟纯、李觉、杨放之、杨植霖、吴羹梅、宋劭之、张达志、张如屏、张家彬、张敬礼、荣高棠、赵子立、胡风、凌其翰、黄正清、喻屏、焦实斋为常务委员。
translated_text: From December 28 to December 14, the fourth meeting of the Fifth National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference was held in Beijing. The meeting elected Liu Fei and Dong Qiwu as vice chairmen of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference; and elected Ye Duyi, Feng Ding, Liu Mengchun, Li Jue, Yang Fangzhi, Yang Zhilin, Wu Gengmei, Song Shaozhi, Zhang Dazhi, Zhang Ruping, Zhang Jiabin, Zhang Jingli, Rong Gaotang, Zhao Zili, Hu Feng, Ling Qihan, Huang Zhengqing, Yu Ping, and Jiao Shizhai as standing committee members.

events: 30日——12月13日 第五届全国人大第四次会议在北京召开。
translated_text: From December 30 to December 13, the Fourth Session of the Fifth National People's Congress was held in Beijing. The meeting elected Zhu Xuefan as the Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Fifth National People's Congress.

events: 会议补选朱学范为第五届全国人大常委会副委员长。
translated_text: From December 30 to December 13, the Fourth Session of the Fifth National People's Congress was held in Beijing. The meeting elected Zhu Xuefan as the Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Fifth National People's Congress.

events: 1981年11月30日,在第五届全国人大四次会议上,国务院在政府工作报告中指出,最近,国务院根据中共中央的建议,对克服官僚主义的问题又进行了多次研究和讨论,决心采取果断措施,坚决改变部门林立、机构臃肿、层次繁多、互相扯皮、人浮于事、副职虚职过多、工作效率很低这类不能容忍的状况,以便有效地领导现代化建设工作。
translated_text: On November 30, 1981, at the Fourth Session of the Fifth National People's Congress, the State Council pointed out in its government work report that recently, based on the suggestions of the CPC Central Committee, the State Council has conducted many studies and discussions on the issue of overcoming bureaucracy, and is determined to take decisive measures to resolutely change the intolerable situation of numerous departments, bloated institutions, numerous levels, mutual wrangling, redundant staff, too many deputy positions and low work efficiency, so as to effectively lead the work of modernization.

events:
16日 中共第十一届中央委员会委员,共产主义战士,无
产阶级革命家,闽西革命根据地的主要创建者之一,原第五届全
国人大常委会副委员长张鼎丞在北京逝世,终年83岁。
translated_text: On the 16th, Zhang Dingcheng, a member of the 11th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, a communist fighter, a proletarian revolutionary, one of the main founders of the revolutionary base in western Fujian, and former vice chairman of the Standing Committee of the Fifth National People's Congress, died in Beijing at the age of 83.

events:
24日——31日 在河南省召开的第五届人民代表大会第四
次会议上,补选刘杰为省人大常委会主任,选举戴苏理为省长。
translated_text: From 24th to 31st, at the fourth session of the fifth People's Congress held in Henan Province, Liu Jie was elected as the chairman of the Standing Committee of the Provincial People's Congress, and Dai Suli was elected as the governor.

events:
2日 中共中央、国务院颁发《国营工厂厂长暂行条例》。
中共中央、国务院在批示中指出,这个暂行条例和已经颁发的
《国营工业企业职工代表大会暂行条例》以及即将颁发的《中国
共产党工业企业基层组织工作条例》,共同遵循的根本原则是党
委集体领导、职工民主管理、厂长行政指挥。这些原则,是根据
多年来的经验对我国工业企业内部的领导制度和管理制度所作出
的新概括。
中共中央、国务院作出《关于国营工业企业进行全面整顿的
决定》。中共中央、国务院决定,从1982年起,用两三年时间,
有计划有步骤地、点面结合地、分期分批地对所有国营工业企业
进行全面的整顿工作。
translated_text: On the 2nd, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued the "Interim Regulations on Directors of State-Owned Factories". In their instructions, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council pointed out that the fundamental principles followed by this interim regulation, the already issued "Interim Regulations on the Workers' Congress of State-Owned Industrial Enterprises" and the soon-to-be-issued "Regulations on the Work of Grassroots Organizations of the Communist Party of China in Industrial Enterprises" are collective leadership by the Party Committee, democratic management by workers, and administrative command by factory directors. These principles are new summaries of the leadership and management systems within my country's industrial enterprises based on years of experience. The CPC Central Committee and the State Council made the "Decision on Comprehensive Rectification of State-Owned Industrial Enterprises". The CPC Central Committee and the State Council decided that starting from 1982, they would use two to three years to carry out comprehensive rectification of all state-owned industrial enterprises in a planned and step-by-step manner, combining points and areas, and in phases and batches.

events: 5日 中共中央同意,张根生任吉林省省长。
translated_text: On the 5th, the CPC Central Committee agreed to appoint Zhang Gensheng as the governor of Jilin Province.

events:
5日——12日 全军政治工作会议在北京召开。中央军委主
席邓小平、中央军委副主席叶剑英先后作了重要讲话。
translated_text: From the 5th to the 12th, the Political Work Conference of the whole army was held in Beijing. Chairman of the Central Military Commission Deng Xiaoping and Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission Ye Jianying successively delivered important speeches.

events:
7日——12日 全国工交企业思想政治工作座谈会在天津召
开。中共中央组织部、中共中央宣传部、全国总工会、共青团中
央等九个部门,上海、北京、天津、辽宁等十个省、市的有关负
责同志和部分企业代表参加了会议。会议指出,要结合各项工作
和职工思想实际,进行形势、任务和党的方针政策的教育,要加
强工人阶级主人翁责任感的教育。会议还讨论和研究了建立、健
全党委领导下的厂长负责制和党委领导下的职工代表大会制等问
题。
translated_text: From the 7th to the 12th, the National Symposium on Ideological and Political Work in Industrial and Transportation Enterprises was held in Tianjin. Nine departments including the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Propaganda Department of the CPC Central Committee, the All-China Federation of Trade Unions, and the Central Committee of the Communist Youth League, as well as relevant responsible comrades from ten provinces and cities including Shanghai, Beijing, Tianjin, and Liaoning, and representatives of some enterprises attended the meeting. The meeting pointed out that it is necessary to combine various work and the actual thoughts of employees to carry out education on the situation, tasks, and the principles and policies of the Party, and to strengthen the education of the sense of responsibility of the working class as masters. The meeting also discussed and studied the establishment and improvement of the factory director responsibility system under the leadership of the Party Committee and the system of workers' representative congresses under the leadership of the Party Committee.

events:
11日 中共中央发出《紧急通知》指出,走私贩私,贪污
受贿,把大量国家财产窃为己有等,是严重违法犯罪行为。对于
这个严重毁坏党的威信,关系我党生死存亡的重大问题,全党一
定要抓住不放,雷厉风行地加以解决。对那些情节严重的犯罪干
部,首先是占据重要职位的犯罪干部,必须依法逮捕,加以最严
厉的法律制裁,有的特大案件的处理结果要登报。
translated_text: On the 11th, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued an "urgent notice" pointing out that smuggling, corruption, bribery, and stealing large amounts of state property for personal use are serious illegal and criminal acts. The whole party must seize this major issue that seriously undermines the party's prestige and concerns the survival of our party and resolve it with swift and resolute action. Those criminal cadres with serious circumstances, especially those who occupy important positions, must be arrested according to law and subject to the most severe legal sanctions. The results of handling some major cases must be published in newspapers.

events:
13日 中共中央政治局先后两次召开会议,讨论中央机构
精简问题。中共中央副主席邓小平在会上作了《精简机构是一场
革命》的重要讲话。他指出,精简是革命,选贤任能也是革命。
出要解决好,更重要的是解决进。1月19日,中央将邓小平的
重要讲话印发给中央各部委和国家机关各部委党组。6月28
日,中共中央发出《中央党政机关机构改革第一阶段总结和下一
阶段打算》的文件。
translated_text: On the 13th, the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee held two meetings to discuss the issue of streamlining the central institutions. Deng Xiaoping, Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Committee, delivered an important speech at the meeting entitled "Streamlining the Institutions is a Revolution". He pointed out that streamlining is a revolution, and selecting and appointing talented people is also a revolution. It is important to solve the problems of exit and the problems of entry. On January 19, the CPC Central Committee issued Deng Xiaoping's important speech to the Party committees of all central ministries and state agencies. On June 28, the CPC Central Committee issued a document entitled "Summary of the First Phase of the Central Party and Government Institutional Reform and Plans for the Next Phase".

events: 1982年1月13日,邓小平同志在中央政治局讨论机构精简问题会议上发表讲话《精简机构是一场革命》。指出:如果不搞这场革命,让党和国家的组织继续目前这样机构臃肿重叠、职责不清,许多人员不称职、不负责,工作缺乏精力､知识和效率的状况,这是不可能得到人民赞同的,必须下决心精简机构和人员。并指出,这一次革命,不但要注意“出”的问题,还特别要注意“进”的问题。进和出,进摆在第一位。选人要选好,要选贤任能。选贤就是德,任能无非是专业化、知识化,有实际经验,身体能顶得住。
translated_text: On January 13, 1982, Comrade Deng Xiaoping delivered a speech entitled "Streamlining the Organization is a Revolution" at the meeting of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee to discuss the issue of streamlining the organization. He pointed out that if this revolution is not carried out, and the party and state organizations continue to be in the current state of bloated and overlapping organizations, unclear responsibilities, many incompetent and irresponsible personnel, and lack of energy, knowledge and efficiency in work, it will be impossible to gain the approval of the people, and we must be determined to streamline the organization and personnel. He also pointed out that in this revolution, we must pay attention not only to the issue of "exit", but also to the issue of "entry". In and out, entry comes first. We must select people well, and we must select virtuous people and appoint capable people. Selecting virtuous people means virtue, and appointing capable people means specialization, knowledge, practical experience, and physical ability.

events:
15日 中共中央批准,杨汝岱任四川省委常务书记,杨析
综任四川省委委员、常委、副书记,聂荣贵任四川省委常委、副
书记。
translated_text: On the 15th, the CPC Central Committee approved Yang Rudai as the executive secretary of the Sichuan Provincial Committee, Yang Xizong as a member, standing member and deputy secretary of the Sichuan Provincial Committee, and Nie Ronggui as a standing member and deputy secretary of the Sichuan Provincial Committee.

events:
17日 中共中央组织部、中共国务院侨务办公室党组联合
发出《关于充分发挥归侨干部作用的意见》。《意见》指出,归
侨、侨眷干部是社会主义四化建设的重要力量之一。对他们在政
治上要一视同仁;工作上要人尽其才,合理安排,正确使用;生
活上要适当照顾;同时要抓好冤假错案的平反工作。
translated_text: On the 17th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the Party Leadership Group of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the CPC State Council jointly issued the "Opinions on Fully Utilizing the Role of Returned Overseas Chinese Cadres". The "Opinions" pointed out that returned overseas Chinese and their families are one of the important forces in the construction of the four modernizations of socialism. They should be treated equally in politics; they should be given full play to their talents, reasonably arranged, and used correctly in work; they should be properly cared for in life; and at the same time, the work of redressing unjust, false, and wrong cases should be done well.

events: 1982年1月17日,国家人事局发出《关于发布〈国家行政机关工作人员升级奖励试行办法〉的通知》。要求对于按照《国务院关于国家行政机关工作人员的奖惩暂行规定》应当给予升级奖励的工作人员,要给予升级奖励。升级奖励,是对国家行政机关有功人员的一种带有政治荣誉性的物质鼓励,不同于一般的提高工资级别。受升级奖励的人员,必须是坚决拥护和执行党的三中全会以来的路线方针政策,在工作中尽职尽责,有显著成绩的。给予升级奖励,一般是在原有级别基础上提升一级,对于有特殊贡献的人员,也可以提升两级。
translated_text: On January 17, 1982, the State Personnel Bureau issued the "Notice on the Release of the Trial Measures for Rewarding the Promotion of State Administrative Organs". It requires that the staff who should be given promotion rewards in accordance with the "Interim Regulations of the State Council on Rewards and Punishments for State Administrative Organs" should be given promotion rewards. Promotion rewards are a kind of material encouragement with political honor for meritorious personnel of state administrative organs, which is different from the general increase in salary levels. Personnel who receive promotion rewards must firmly support and implement the line, principles and policies of the Party since the Third Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee, perform their duties conscientiously in their work, and have significant achievements. Promotion rewards are generally given by raising the original level by one level, and for those who have made special contributions, they can also be promoted by two levels.

events: 1982年1月24日,李先念同志在中共中央、国务院举行的春节团拜会上致词,他说,1982年要抓好两件事,一是精简机构,克服官僚主义,提高工作效率;二是严肃处理经济领域的重大犯罪案件。
translated_text: On January 24, 1982, Comrade Li Xiannian delivered a speech at the Spring Festival party held by the CPC Central Committee and the State Council. He said that two things should be done well in 1982. One was to streamline institutions, overcome bureaucracy and improve work efficiency; the other was to seriously deal with major criminal cases in the economic field.

events:
30日 中共中央发出《关于检查一次知识分子工作的通
知》。《通知》要求各级党委要在今年上半年检查一次知识分子工
作,切实研究制定改进措施,力争在短期内做出成绩。4月3
日,中央办公厅转发了中央组织部《关于中央机关检查对高级知
识分子落实政策情况的报告》。
translated_text: On the 30th, the CPC Central Committee issued a "Notice on the Inspection of Intellectual Work". The "Notice" requires Party committees at all levels to inspect intellectual work once in the first half of this year, earnestly study and formulate improvement measures, and strive to achieve results in the short term. On April 3, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee forwarded the "Report on the Inspection of the Implementation of the Policy on Senior Intellectuals by Central Organs" by the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee.

events: 3日 中共中央批准,项南任福建省委第一书记。
translated_text: On the 3rd, the CPC Central Committee approved Xiang Nan as the first secretary of the Fujian Provincial Party Committee.

events: 6日 中共中央批准,郭洪超任甘肃省委副书记。
translated_text: On the 6th, the CPC Central Committee approved Guo Hongchao as the deputy secretary of the Gansu Provincial Party Committee.

events: 8日 中共中央同意,王宪、张百发任北京市副市长。
translated_text: On the 8th, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China agreed to appoint Wang Xian and Zhang Baifa as deputy mayors of Beijing.

events:
10日 中共中央组织部印发《发展党员工作座谈会纪要》。
在此之前,中央组织部于1981年12月和1982年1月分两批召
开了发展党员工作座谈会。座谈会认为,今后发展党员工作,要
从建设“两个文明”,坚持四项基本原则和培养共产主义事业接班
人这个战略任务来考虑,又要考虑到目前党风还没有根本好转,
还存在思想、组织、作风不纯的问题。就全国来说,既不能停止
发展,又绝不可以大发展。
中共中央组织部发出关于《农村实行生产责任制后加强党的
基层组织建设座谈会纪要》的通知。《纪要》就当前党的农村基
层组织的任务,充分发挥共产党员的模范带头作用,搞好基层领
导班子建设,改进领导方法和工作作风,以及加强对党的农村基
层组织建设的领导等五个方面提出了要求。
translated_text: On the 10th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Minutes of the Symposium on the Development of Party Members". Prior to this, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China held two symposiums on the development of party members in December 1981 and January 1982. The symposium believed that in the future, the development of party members should be considered from the strategic task of building "two civilizations", adhering to the four basic principles and cultivating successors to the cause of communism, and taking into account that the current party style has not fundamentally improved, and there are still problems of impure thoughts, organizations and work styles. For the whole country, we can neither stop development nor develop too much. The Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued a notice on the "Minutes of the Symposium on Strengthening the Construction of the Party's Grassroots Organizations after the Implementation of the Production Responsibility System in Rural Areas". The "Minutes" put forward requirements in five aspects: the current tasks of the party's grassroots organizations in rural areas, giving full play to the exemplary role of Communist Party members, building a good grassroots leadership team, improving leadership methods and work style, and strengthening the leadership of the construction of the party's grassroots organizations in rural areas.

events:
18日 中共中央组织部转发山西省纪律检查委员会、省委
组织部《关于干部任免、调动中几项纪律制度的通知》。在批语
中指出,为了严格党的组织纪律,保证干部调配工作的正常进
行,各级党委组织部都应当象山西省委组织部那样,切实克服涣
散软弱状态,认真解决部分干部不服从分配的无纪律现象,在干
部调配工作中,一定要坚持原则,不姑息迁就。对不服从分配的
干部,该批评的要批评,该处分的要给予必要的处分。
中共中央副主席邓小平会见诺罗敦·西哈努克亲王时说:现
在我们正在搞体制改革。官僚主义、机构臃肿、人浮于事的现象
必须消除。干部老化问题也到了非解决不可的时候了。我们下了
很大的决心,把它当作一次革命。当然,这是对体制的革命,而
不是对人民的革命。
translated_text: On the 18th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee forwarded the "Notice on Several Discipline Systems in the Appointment, Removal and Transfer of Cadres" issued by the Discipline Inspection Commission of Shanxi Province and the Organization Department of the Provincial Party Committee. In the comments, it was pointed out that in order to strictly enforce the party's organizational discipline and ensure the normal progress of cadre deployment, the organization departments of party committees at all levels should, like the Organization Department of the Shanxi Provincial Party Committee, effectively overcome the lax and weak state and seriously solve the undisciplined phenomenon of some cadres who do not obey the allocation. In the cadre deployment work, we must adhere to principles and not tolerate or condone. For cadres who do not obey the allocation, those who should be criticized should be criticized, and those who should be punished should be given necessary punishments. When meeting with Prince Norodom Sihanouk, Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Committee Deng Xiaoping said: We are now carrying out institutional reform. Bureaucracy, bloated institutions, and redundant personnel must be eliminated. The problem of aging cadres has also reached a time when it must be solved. We have made a great determination and regard it as a revolution. Of course, this is a revolution to the system, not a revolution to the people.

events: 1982年2月18日,邓小平同志在北京会见西哈努克亲王和夫人时说,现在我们正在搞体制改革。官僚主义、机构臃肿、人浮于事的现象必须消除。干部老化问题也到了非解决不可的时候了。我们下了很大的决心,把它当作一次革命。
translated_text: On February 18, 1982, Comrade Deng Xiaoping met with Prince Sihanouk and his wife in Beijing and said, "We are now carrying out institutional reform. Bureaucracy, bloated institutions, and redundant personnel must be eliminated. The problem of aging cadres has also reached a point where it must be solved. We have made a great determination and regard it as a revolution."

events:
20日 中共中央作出《关于建立老干部退休制度的决定》。
《决定》指出,担任中央、国家机关部长、副部长,省、市、自
治区党委第一书记、书记、省长、副省长的干部,正职一般不超
过65岁,副职一般不超过 60岁。担任司局长的干部,一般不超
过60岁。4月10日,国务院发布《关于老干部离职休养制度的
几项规定》。12月10日劳动人事部发出《贯彻国务院关于老干
部离职休养规定中具体问题的处理意见》。10月11日,中央办
公厅转发中央组织部《关于发挥中央、国家机关离休老干部的作
用的意见》。
translated_text: On the 20th, the CPC Central Committee made the "Decision on Establishing a Retirement System for Veteran Cadres". The "Decision" pointed out that the cadres who serve as ministers and vice ministers of the central and state organs, first secretaries, secretaries, governors and vice governors of provincial, municipal and autonomous region party committees are generally not over 65 years old, and vice-secretaries are generally not over 60 years old. The cadres who serve as directors of departments and bureaus are generally not over 60 years old. On April 10, the State Council issued the "Several Provisions on the Retirement System for Veteran Cadres". On December 10, the Ministry of Labor and Personnel issued the "Opinions on Implementing the State Council's Regulations on Retirement and Rest for Veteran Cadres". On October 11, the General Office of the Central Committee forwarded the "Opinions on Giving Play to the Role of Retired Veteran Cadres in Central and State Organs" of the Organization Department of the Central Committee.

events: 1982年2月20日,中共中央发布《关于建立老干部退休制度的决定》。决定指出,老干部离休退休和退居二线的制度,是保障党和国家政治生活正常进行和健康发展的一项极其重要的制度,必须立即着手有系统地建立和健全起来,使之经常化,并且严格地加以实行。担任司局长一级的干部,一般不超过60岁。当然,个别未到离休退休年龄,但因身体不好,难以坚持正常工作的,经过组织批准,可以提前离休退休。另一方面,个别虽已达到离休退休年龄,但因工作确实需要,身体又可坚持正常工作的,经过组织批准,也可以在一定时间内暂不离休退休,继续担任领导职务。老干部离休退休以后,一定要很好地安排照顾,基本政治待遇不变,生活待遇还要略为从优,并注意很好地发挥他们的作用。在老干部离休退休的同时,要大胆地提拔中青年干部到各级主要领导岗位上来。
translated_text: On February 20, 1982, the CPC Central Committee issued the "Decision on Establishing a Retirement System for Veteran Cadres". The decision pointed out that the retirement and resignation system for veteran cadres is an extremely important system to ensure the normal and healthy development of the political life of the Party and the country. It must be established and improved systematically immediately, made regular, and strictly implemented. Taking into account the actual situation and replacement conditions of the current cadres, the retirement age limit for veteran cadres is stipulated as follows: Ministers and deputy ministers of the central and state organs, first secretaries and secretaries of provincial, municipal and autonomous regional party committees, governors and deputy governors of provincial governments, and major responsible cadres of provincial, municipal and autonomous regional discipline inspection committees and courts and procuratorates, the age limit for the main position is generally not more than 65 years old, and the age limit for the deputy position is generally not more than 60 years old. The age limit for cadres at the level of director of a department or bureau is generally not more than 60 years old. Of course, some individuals who have not reached the retirement age but are unable to maintain normal work due to poor health can retire early with the approval of the organization. On the other hand, some individuals who have reached retirement age but whose work really requires them and whose health can continue to work normally can, with the approval of the organization, not retire for a certain period of time and continue to hold leadership positions. After retirement, veteran cadres must be well taken care of, with their basic political treatment unchanged and their living treatment slightly better, and they must be given full play. At the same time as veteran cadres retire, we must boldly promote young and middle-aged cadres to major leadership positions at all levels.

events: 1982年4月10日,国务院发出《关于老干部离职休养制度的几项规定〉的通知》。决定对建国前参加中国共产党所领导的革命战争、脱产享受供给制待遇的和从事地下革命工作的老干部,达到离职休养年龄的,实行离职休养的制度。已经退休的干部,符合离职规定的,应当改为离休。《规定》对老干部离休的年龄作了详细的规定,并指出,老干部离休后,基本政治待遇不变,生活待遇略为从优。
translated_text: On April 10, 1982, the State Council issued the "Notice on Several Provisions on the Retirement and Rest System for Old Cadres". It was decided to implement a retirement and rest system for old cadres who had participated in the revolutionary wars led by the Communist Party of China before the founding of the People's Republic of China, enjoyed full-time treatment and engaged in underground revolutionary work, and reached the retirement and rest age. Retired cadres who meet the retirement regulations should be changed to retirement. The "Regulations" made detailed provisions on the retirement age of old cadres, and pointed out that after retirement, the basic political treatment of old cadres will remain unchanged, and their living treatment will be slightly better.

events: 13日 中共中央、国务院发出《关于打击经济领域中严重犯罪活动的决定》。《决定》指出,要集中力量抓紧处理大案要案,并且着重整顿党的组织、干部作风和严密各项管理制度。对严重破坏经济的罪犯,不管是什么人,不管他属于哪个单位,不论他的职务高低,都要铁面无私,执法如山,决不允许有丝毫例外,更不允许任何人袒护、说情、包庇。如有违反,无论是谁,一律要追究责任。《决定》要求,在党的干部特别是中高级干部,以及他们的子女亲属中,加强共产主义思想教育,严肃地坚地保持我们党的工人阶级先锋队的性质,保持共产党员的共产主义纯洁性。中共中央组织部发出《关于中国人民大学哲学等专业招收部分在职干部的通知》。《通知》指出,根据中央关于实现干部队伍革命化、知识化、专业化、年轻化的精神,中国人民大学从1982 年起,在哲学、国际共产主义运动史、中共党史、法律和新闻专业,试行招收部分具有三年以上工龄的在职干部为本科生。招生办法是所在单位推荐,上级党委组织部门批准,参加全国统一报名、考试,适当降低录取分数,学校根据德、智、体全面考核的原则,单独择优录取。
translated_text: On the 13th, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued the "Decision on Striking Serious Criminal Activities in the Economic Field". The "Decision" pointed out that we must concentrate our efforts on handling major cases, and focus on rectifying the party's organization, the work style of cadres and strict management systems. Criminals who seriously damage the economy, no matter who they are, no matter which unit they belong to, no matter how high their positions are, must be enforced impartially and strictly, and no exceptions will be allowed, let alone anyone's protection, intercession, or shielding. If there is a violation, no matter who it is, they will be held accountable. The "Decision" requires that communist ideological education be strengthened among party cadres, especially middle and senior cadres, and their children and relatives, and that the nature of our party as the vanguard of the working class and the communist purity of Communist Party members be maintained seriously and firmly. The Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on the Recruitment of Some In-service Cadres in Philosophy and Other Majors at Renmin University of China". The Notice pointed out that in accordance with the spirit of the Central Committee on achieving the revolutionization, knowledge, specialization and rejuvenation of the cadre team, Renmin University of China has tried to recruit some in-service cadres with more than three years of service as undergraduates in philosophy, history of the international communist movement, history of the Communist Party of China, law and journalism since 1982. The enrollment method is to recommend the unit, approve the superior party committee organization department, participate in the national unified registration and examination, appropriately lower the admission score, and the school will select the best candidates based on the principle of comprehensive assessment of morality, intelligence and physical fitness. The Central Committee of the Communist Party of China agreed and approved that Huang Hua would concurrently serve as Minister of Foreign Affairs, Wu Xueqian would serve as Secretary of the Party Group and First Deputy Minister of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Gong Dafei, Zhang Wenjin, Han Xu, Qian Qichen and Wen Yezhan would serve as Deputy Ministers; Yang Bo would serve as Minister and Secretary of the Party Group of the Ministry of Light Industry, Ji Long would serve as Deputy Minister and Deputy Secretary of the Party Group, Wang Wenzhe and He Zhihua would serve as Deputy Ministers; Lin Hujia would serve as Minister and Secretary of the Party Group of the Ministry of Agriculture, Animal Husbandry and Fisheries, Zhu Rong would serve as Deputy Minister and Deputy Secretary of the Party Group, and He Kang and Xiao Peng would serve as Deputy Ministers.

translated_text: From May 22 to May 4, the 23rd meeting of the Standing Committee of the Fifth National People's Congress was held in Beijing. Premier Zhao Ziyang made an "Explanation on the Progress of the State Council's Institutional Reform and Three Proposals". He announced that the establishment of the ministries and commissions of the State Council has been completed. The State Council originally had 52 ministries and commissions, which has now been reduced to 41. According to statistics from 38 ministries and commissions, in addition to part-time ministers and directors, there are 167 ministers, deputy ministers, and directors and deputy directors, which is 67% less than the original 505; there were 720 departments and bureaus, which has now been reduced by 32%, and there were 2,450 directors and deputy directors, which has now been reduced by 43%. The meeting passed the appointment of vice premiers and state councilors of the State Council, as well as the resolution to remove Yu Qiuli, Geng Biao, Fang Yi, Gu Mu, Kang Shien, Chen Muhua, Bo Yibo, Ji Pengfei, Yang Jingren, Zhang Aiping, and Huang Hua from their positions as vice premiers of the State Council. events: 1982年5月4日,第五届人大常委会第二十三次会议通过《关于国务院部委机构改革实施方案的决议》,将原国家劳动总局、国家人事局、国务院科学技术干部局、国家机构编制委员会合并成立劳动人事部。5月6日,劳动人事部召开成立大会,万里副总理讲话指出,劳动人事部的任务是搞好三项改革,即人事制度改革、领导制度改革、工资制度改革,为两个文明建设即精神文明和物质文明建设服务,为实现“四化”服务。
translated_text: On May 4, 1982, the 23rd meeting of the Fifth National People's Congress Standing Committee passed the "Resolution on the Implementation Plan for the Reform of the State Council's Ministries and Commissions", merging the former State Bureau of Labor, the State Personnel Bureau, the State Council Science and Technology Cadre Bureau, and the State Organization and Establishment Committee to form the Ministry of Labor and Personnel. On May 6, the Ministry of Labor and Personnel held its inaugural meeting. Vice Premier Wan Li pointed out in his speech that the task of the Ministry of Labor and Personnel is to carry out three reforms, namely, personnel system reform, leadership system reform, and wage system reform, to serve the construction of two civilizations, namely spiritual civilization and material civilization, and to serve the realization of the "four modernizations".

大贡献。
translated_text: On the 3rd, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on Issuing Two Provisional Regulations on the Work of Grassroots Party Organizations in Industrial Enterprises and Financial and Trade Enterprises". The "Notice" pointed out that the key to running socialist enterprises well lies in strengthening and improving the party's leadership. The Central Committee hopes that through the implementation of these regulations, the leadership and management level of enterprises will be improved, the political quality and technical level of the majority of employees will be improved, and the economic benefits in various fields such as production, construction, and circulation will be improved, making greater contributions to the country's socialist modernization.

The work in this stage mainly has the following four experiences: (1) ideological mobilization is relatively deep, and leaders do the work personally; (2) the direction is clear and the steps are steady; (3) the implementation of the mass line is relatively good; (4) trust and rely on old comrades and give full play to their role.

events: 1982年6月28日,中共中央印发《中央党政机关机构改革第一阶段总结和下一阶段打算》发出通知,指出,中央认为,在新的形势下,必须着手进行党政机构和政治、经济体制的改革。改革的第一步就是精简机构,调整领导班子,紧缩编制,以克服官僚主义,提高工作效率。这是一场深刻的革命,是革体制和制度的命,革领导职务终身制的命,革官僚主义的命。
translated_text: On June 28, 1982, the CPC Central Committee issued a notice titled "Summary of the First Phase of the Central Party and Government Institutional Reform and Plans for the Next Phase", pointing out that the CPC Central Committee believed that under the new situation, it was necessary to start the reform of the party and government institutions and the political and economic systems. The first step of the reform was to streamline the institutions, adjust the leadership team, and tighten the establishment to overcome bureaucracy and improve work efficiency. This was a profound revolution, a revolution of the system and institutions, a revolution of the lifelong tenure of leadership positions, and a revolution of bureaucracy.

events:

题》中指出:体制改革的中心应当抓住两条:一条是建立起管理
体制、责任制,制定出规章制度,定额等等;第二条是解决好领
导班子,选出“明白人”组成领导班子。这一条可能比第一条更重

translated_text: On the 26th, Deng Xiaoping, Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Committee, pointed out in "On the Seventh Five-Year Plan and Long-term Planning" that the focus of institutional reform should be on two points: one is to establish a management system and responsibility system, formulate rules and regulations, quotas, etc.; the second is to solve the leadership team and select "clear-headed people" to form the leadership team. This point may be more important than the first one. Without "clear-headed people" in charge, a unit will not achieve any results. Now is the time to make this issue clearer.

events:

小平、陈云分别作了重要讲话。邓小平指出,鉴于我们党的状
况,我们干部老化,但老同志是骨干。我们需要有一个顾问委员
会来过渡。在这个过渡阶段,必须认真使干部队伍年轻化,为退
休制度的建立和领导职务终身制的废除创造条件。陈云指出,党
的干部交接班问题历来是党的一件大事,必须成千上万地提拔中
青年干部;在提拔中青年干部时,必须对“三种人”保持警惕,就
是说,决不能提拔造反起家的人,帮派思想严重的人、打砸抢分
子,对这些人一个也不能提拔,已经提拔的,必须坚决把他们撤
下来。
translated_text: On the 30th, the CPC Central Committee held an enlarged meeting of the Political Bureau, and Vice Chairmen Deng Xiaoping and Chen Yun of the CPC Central Committee delivered important speeches respectively. Deng Xiaoping pointed out that in view of the situation of our party, our cadres are aging, but the old comrades are the backbone. We need an advisory committee to make the transition. In this transitional period, we must earnestly make the cadre team younger and create conditions for the establishment of a retirement system and the abolition of the lifelong tenure of leadership positions. Chen Yun pointed out that the issue of the handover of party cadres has always been a major event for the party, and thousands of young and middle-aged cadres must be promoted; when promoting young and middle-aged cadres, we must be vigilant against the "three types of people", that is, we must never promote people who started out as rebels, people with serious gang mentality, and people who smash, loot and rob. None of these people can be promoted, and those who have been promoted must be resolutely removed.

translated_text: From the 1st to the 11th, the 12th National Congress of the Communist Party of China was held in Beijing. There were 1,600 formal delegates and 149 alternate delegates attending the congress, representing more than 39 million party members. Deng Xiaoping, executive chairman of the presidium of the congress and vice chairman of the CPC Central Committee, delivered an opening speech, pointing out that this congress would be the most important meeting since the Seventh National Congress of the Party; our modernization construction must proceed from China's reality, combine the universal truth of Marxism with the specific reality of our country, follow our own path, and build socialism with Chinese characteristics; speeding up socialist modernization construction, striving to achieve the reunification of the motherland including Taiwan, opposing hegemonism and safeguarding world peace are the three major tasks of our people in the 1980s. Hu Yaobang, chairman of the CPC Central Committee, delivered a report entitled "Comprehensively Create a New Situation in Socialist Modernization Construction". The report is divided into six parts: (i) Historic transformation and new great tasks; (ii) Promoting the overall development of the socialist economy; (iii) Striving to build a high level of socialist spiritual civilization; (iv) Striving to build a high level of socialist democracy; (v) Adhering to an independent foreign policy; (vi) Building the Party into a strong core to lead the cause of socialist modernization. Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Committee Ye Jianying and Chen Yun delivered important speeches at the conference, focusing on the handover of new and old cadres. Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Committee Li Xiannian delivered the closing speech. The conference reviewed and adopted the new Constitution of the Communist Party of China. 210 members of the Central Committee and 138 alternate members of the Central Committee were elected; 172 members of the Central Advisory Committee were elected; and 132 members of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection were elected.

events:
3日 中共中央、国务院作出《关于中央党政机关干部教育
工作的决定》。《决定》指出,干部教育工作的基本任务,是使全
体干部在马克思主义理论、专业知识、科学文化水平和领导管理
能力等方面都得到提高,成为坚持社会主义道路的,具有必备的
专业知识的党和国家的合格工作人员。《决定》要求,今后中央
党政机关的所有干部都要分期分批参加轮训,使干部教育工作经
常化、正规化、制度化,力争三、五年内使干部队伍的政治、业
务水平得到明显提高,以适应社会主义现代化建设的需要。
translated_text: On the 3rd, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued the "Decision on the Education of Cadres in Central Party and Government Organs". The "Decision" pointed out that the basic task of cadre education is to improve all cadres in terms of Marxist theory, professional knowledge, scientific and cultural level, leadership and management ability, and become qualified party and state staff who adhere to the socialist path and have the necessary professional knowledge. The "Decision" requires that in the future, all cadres of central party and government organs must participate in rotation training in stages and batches, so that cadre education work can be regularized, formalized and institutionalized, and strive to significantly improve the political and professional level of the cadre team within three to five years to meet the needs of socialist modernization.

events: 1982年10月3日,中共中央、国务院作出《关于中央党政机关干部教育工作的决定》,规定今后中央党政机关的所有干部都要分期分批地参加轮训。要不失时机地抓紧培训干部,把干部教育工作经常化、正规化、制度化。一、干部教育要纳入国民教育计划;二、中央党政机关的所有干部都要分批分期参加轮训,一般做到每三年离职学习半年,成为一种制度;三、把干部培训和任用结合起来;四、干部离职学习期间,工资福利和其他待遇不变;五、对具有大专以上程度,但缺乏基层工作经验的年轻干部,要有计划地安排他们到第一线去取得实际工作经验。
translated_text: On October 3, 1982, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued the "Decision on the Education of Cadres in Central Party and Government Organs", stipulating that all cadres in central party and government organs must participate in rotation training in batches in the future. We must seize the opportunity to train cadres and make cadre education work regular, formal and institutionalized. First, cadre education should be included in the national education plan; second, all cadres in central party and government organs must participate in rotation training in batches and phases, generally leaving their jobs for half a year every three years, and this should become a system; third, cadre training should be combined with appointment; fourth, during the period of leaving their jobs for study, the salary, benefits and other benefits of cadres will remain unchanged; fifth, for young cadres with college degree or above but lacking grassroots work experience, they should be arranged in a planned way to go to the front line to gain practical work experience.

events:
11日 中共中央办公厅转发中央组织部《关于发挥中央、
国家机关离休老干部的作用的意见》。在中央和中央国家机关的
机构改革中,有一大批老干部退出领导岗位,离职休养。《意
见》希望各部委采取多种方式,组织离休老干部继续发挥作用,
安排他们做些力所能及的工作。并要求各部委党组(党委)把这
项工作列入议事日程。
translated_text: On the 11th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee forwarded the "Opinions on Giving Play to the Role of Retired Cadres in Central and State Organs" issued by the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee. In the institutional reform of the central and state organs, a large number of veteran cadres have retired from leadership positions and retired for recuperation. The "Opinions" hopes that all ministries and commissions will adopt various methods to organize retired veteran cadres to continue to play a role and arrange for them to do some work within their capacity. It also requires the Party Groups (Party Committees) of all ministries and commissions to put this work on the agenda.

events:
12日 中共中央办公厅转发中央组织部《关于加强在中年
知识分子中发展党员工作的报告》。《报告》中强调,当前在知识
分子中发展党员的主要对象应是中年知识分子中的优秀分子。
translated_text: On the 12th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee forwarded the Central Organization Department's "Report on Strengthening the Work of Recruiting Party Members Among Middle-aged Intellectuals". The "Report" emphasized that the main targets for recruiting party members among intellectuals should be the outstanding members among middle-aged intellectuals.

events:
14日 中共中央办公厅转发中共北京市委《关于在党员中
开展反腐蚀教育的情况报告》。中央办公厅在批语中指出,中央
书记处认为:北京市委从1981年以来,连续抓了几次全市性的
教育活动,努力加强党的思想建设和组织建设,改变过去党不管
党的状况。最近又在党员中积极开展反腐蚀教育,这些都是很好
的,是十分必要的。各地区要参照北京市委的经验,结合学习贯
彻十二大文件,作出对党员进行教育的具体安排。
translated_text: On the 14th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee forwarded the Beijing Municipal Committee's "Report on the Anti-Corruption Education among Party Members". In its comments, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee pointed out that the Central Secretariat believed that the Beijing Municipal Committee had carried out several city-wide education activities since 1981, striving to strengthen the party's ideological and organizational construction and change the past situation where the party did not care about the party. Recently, it has actively carried out anti-corruption education among party members. These are all very good and necessary. All regions should refer to the experience of the Beijing Municipal Committee, combine the study and implementation of the 12th National Congress documents, and make specific arrangements for educating party members.

events:
16日 中共中央决定,杨德中任中共中央办公厅第一副主
任,主持办公厅的日常工作。
translated_text: On the 16th, the CPC Central Committee decided that Yang Dezhong would serve as the first deputy director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and be in charge of the daily work of the General Office.

events:
26日 中共中央发出《关于省级领导班子配备的几点原则
意见的通知》。《通知》规定:(一)人员配备要精干;(二)坚决
执行德才兼备的原则;(三)按照中央规定掌握好干部任职年
龄;(四)减少交叉兼职;(五)妥善安排年老体弱,不能坚持正
常工作的同志;(六)认真走好群众路线;(七)成立以来任务为
首的指导小组,协助各省、市、自治区进行机构改革工作。11
月13日,中央办公厅印发了宋任穷在省、市、自治区党委主要
负责同志电话会议上的讲话。
translated_text: On the 26th, the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on Several Principles and Opinions on the Staffing of Provincial Leadership Teams". The "Notice" stipulates: (i) Staffing should be lean and capable; (ii) The principle of both moral integrity and professional competence should be firmly implemented; (iii) The age limit for cadres to hold office should be properly controlled in accordance with the central regulations; (iv) Cross-employment should be reduced; (v) Proper arrangements should be made for comrades who are old and weak and cannot continue to work normally; (vi) The mass line should be followed conscientiously; (vii) Since its establishment, the task-oriented steering group has assisted provinces, cities and autonomous regions in carrying out institutional reforms. On November 13, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee issued Song Renqiong's speech at the telephone conference of the main responsible comrades of the provincial, municipal and autonomous regional party committees.

events:
28日 中共中央同意,张寿任国家计委副主任;批准李子
奇任甘肃省委委员、常委、副书记,并同意其任常务副省长。
translated_text: On the 28th, the CPC Central Committee agreed to appoint Zhang Shou as deputy director of the State Planning Commission; approved Li Ziqi as a member, standing member, and deputy secretary of the Gansu Provincial Party Committee, and agreed to appoint him as executive vice governor.

events:
29日 中共中央决定,王全国任湖北省委委员、常委、常
务书记。
translated_text: On the 29th, the CPC Central Committee decided that Wang Quanguo would serve as a member, standing committee member, and executive secretary of the Hubei Provincial Committee.

events:
30日 中共中央组织部发出《关于办理老干部离职休养手
续的通知》。《通知》指出,对应当离职休养的干部,各部门领导
要在做好思想工作的基础上,按照干部管理权限,向主管的党委
(党组)写出书面报告,说明理由,并填写《干部离休审批表》。
经批准后,即可通知干部离休,并授予老干部离休荣誉证。
translated_text: On the 30th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued a "Notice on the Procedures for Retiring Veteran Cadres". The "Notice" pointed out that for cadres who should retire and recuperate, leaders of various departments should, on the basis of doing a good job in ideological work, write a written report to the competent party committee (party group) in accordance with the authority of cadre management, explain the reasons, and fill out the "Cadre Retirement Approval Form". After approval, the cadre can be notified to retire and be awarded a retirement honor certificate.

events: 4日 中共中央发出《关于四川省领导班子调整的通知》。
translated_text: On the 4th, the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on the Adjustment of the Sichuan Provincial Leadership Team". Yang Rudai was appointed as the Secretary of the Provincial Party Committee, Yang Xizong was appointed as the Deputy Secretary of the Provincial Party Committee and Governor, Nie Ronggui and Feng Yuanwei were appointed as Deputy Secretaries of the Provincial Party Committee, He Haoju, Xu Chuan, Liu Chunfu, Gu Jinchi, Luo Tongda, and Kang Zhenhuang were appointed as Deputy Governors. Tan Qilong and Lu Dadong were appointed as the Director and Deputy Director of the Provincial Advisory Committee and Member of the Standing Committee of the Provincial Party Committee respectively.

events: 杨汝岱任省委书记,杨析综任省委副书记、省长,聂荣贵、冯元蔚任省委副书记,何郝炬、许川、刘纯夫、顾金池、罗通达、康振黄任副省长。谭启龙、鲁大东分别任省顾问委员会主任、副主任和省委常委。
translated_text: On the 4th, the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on the Adjustment of the Sichuan Provincial Leadership Team". Yang Rudai was appointed as the Secretary of the Provincial Party Committee, Yang Xizong was appointed as the Deputy Secretary of the Provincial Party Committee and Governor, Nie Ronggui and Feng Yuanwei were appointed as Deputy Secretaries of the Provincial Party Committee, He Haoju, Xu Chuan, Liu Chunfu, Gu Jinchi, Luo Tongda, and Kang Zhenhuang were appointed as Deputy Governors. Tan Qilong and Lu Dadong were appointed as the Director and Deputy Director of the Provincial Advisory Committee and Member of the Standing Committee of the Provincial Party Committee respectively.

events: 4日——8日 共青团第十届四中全会在北京召开。韩英因工作需要,由党中央行安排工作。
translated_text: From the 4th to the 8th, the 4th Plenary Session of the 10th Central Committee of the Communist Youth League was held in Beijing. The plenary session reviewed and approved in principle the Constitution of the Communist Youth League of China (Draft Amendment) and elected Wang Zhaoguo as the first secretary of the Secretariat of the Central Committee of the League. Han Ying was assigned work by the Central Committee of the Party due to work needs.

events: 全会审议并原则通过了《中国共产主义青年团章程(修改草案)》,选举王兆国为团中央书记处第一书记。
translated_text: From the 4th to the 8th, the 4th Plenary Session of the 10th Central Committee of the Communist Youth League was held in Beijing. The plenary session reviewed and approved in principle the Constitution of the Communist Youth League of China (Draft Amendment) and elected Wang Zhaoguo as the first secretary of the Secretariat of the Central Committee of the League. Han Ying was assigned work by the Central Committee of the Party due to work needs.

events:
8日 中共中央办公厅发出《关于成立机构改革指导小组的
通知》。《通知》指出,中央书记处决定,由中共中央政治局委
员、中央组织部部长宋任穷牵头,成立省、市、自治区机构改革
指导小组,在中央政治局和书记处领导下,负责指导各省、市、
自治区一级机构改革和领导班子配备工作。
translated_text: On the 8th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on the Establishment of an Institutional Reform Steering Group". The "Notice" pointed out that the Central Secretariat decided to establish a provincial, municipal and autonomous region institutional reform steering group led by Song Renqiong, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Minister of the Central Organization Department. Under the leadership of the Central Political Bureau and the Secretariat, it is responsible for guiding the institutional reform and leadership team deployment at the provincial, municipal and autonomous region level.

events:
11日 中共中央批准,蒋光化任中共中央对外联络部部
长;同意赵庆夫任水利电力部副部长。
translated_text: On the 11th, the CPC Central Committee approved Jiang Guanghua as the Minister of the CPC Central Committee's International Liaison Department and agreed to Zhao Qingfu as the Deputy Minister of the Ministry of Water Resources and Electric Power.

events:
12日 中共中央、国务院决定,赵守一任国务院军队转业
干部安置工作小组组长。
translated_text: On the 12th, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council decided that Zhao Shouyi would serve as the head of the State Council's military cadre placement work group.

events:
14日——15日 中共北京市委召开五届一次会议,选举段
君毅为市委第一书记,焦若愚、陈希同,赵鹏飞为副书记,通过
贾庭三为市顾问委员会主任。
translated_text: On the 14th and 15th, the Beijing Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China held the first meeting of the fifth session, elected Duan Junyi as the first secretary of the Municipal Committee, Jiao Ruoyu, Chen Xitong, and Zhao Pengfei as deputy secretaries, and approved Jia Tingsan as the director of the Municipal Advisory Committee.

events: 14日——24日 全国党员教育工作会议在山东省济南市召开。会议以党的十二大精神为指导,强调要在全党加强以新党章为主要内容的党员教育工作,要求全体党员认真学习,坚决执行新党章,努力做符合新党章要求的合格党员,在社会主义物质文明和精神文明建设中发挥先锋模范作用。
translated_text: From the 14th to the 24th, the National Party Member Education Work Conference was held in Jinan, Shandong Province. Guided by the spirit of the 12th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, the conference emphasized the need to strengthen party member education work with the new party constitution as the main content throughout the party, requiring all party members to study the new party constitution seriously, resolutely implement the new party constitution, strive to be qualified party members who meet the requirements of the new party constitution, and play a pioneering and exemplary role in the construction of socialist material and spiritual civilization. Song Renqiong, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Minister of the Central Organization Department, and Deng Liqun, Secretary of the Central Secretariat and Minister of the Central Propaganda Department, spoke at the meeting.

events: 中共中央政治局委员、中央组织部部长宋任穷和中央书记处书记、中央宣传部部长邓力群在会上讲话。
translated_text: From the 14th to the 24th, the National Party Member Education Work Conference was held in Jinan, Shandong Province. Guided by the spirit of the 12th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, the conference emphasized the need to strengthen party member education work with the new party constitution as the main content throughout the party, requiring all party members to study the new party constitution seriously, resolutely implement the new party constitution, strive to be qualified party members who meet the requirements of the new party constitution, and play a pioneering and exemplary role in the construction of socialist material and spiritual civilization. Song Renqiong, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Minister of the Central Organization Department, and Deng Liqun, Secretary of the Central Secretariat and Minister of the Central Propaganda Department, spoke at the meeting.

events: 15日 中共中央同意,王汉斌任全国人大常委会秘书长。
translated_text: On the 15th, the CPC Central Committee agreed to appoint Wang Hanbin as the Secretary-General of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

events:
19日 第五届全国人大常委会第二十五次会议决定,任命
吴学谦为外交部部长,免去黄华的外交部部长职务;任命张爱萍
为国务院国务委员兼任国防部部长,免去耿飙的国务院国务委员
兼国防部部长职务。
translated_text: On the 19th, the 25th meeting of the Standing Committee of the Fifth National People's Congress decided to appoint Wu Xueqian as Minister of Foreign Affairs and remove Huang Hua from the post of Minister of Foreign Affairs; to appoint Zhang Aiping as State Councilor and concurrently Minister of National Defense and remove Geng Biao from the post of State Councilor and concurrently Minister of National Defense.

events:
27日 中共中央组织部发出《关于行政十四级、十八级以
上干部离休后分别按司局级和处级待遇的通知》。《通知》指出,
建国前参加革命工作未担任司局(地)级职务的行政十四级以
上老干部离休后,一般可享受司局(地)级的政治待遇和生活
待遇;建国前参加革命工作未担任处(县)级职务的行政十八级
以上老干部离休后,一般可享受处(县)级的政治、生活待遇。
translated_text: On the 27th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on the Retirement of Administrative Level 14 and 18 Cadres at the Department and Bureau Level and Division Level Respectively". The "Notice" pointed out that administrative level 14 and above veteran cadres who participated in the revolutionary work before the founding of the People's Republic of China and did not hold a department or bureau (prefecture) level position can generally enjoy the political and living benefits of the department or bureau (prefecture) level after retirement; administrative level 18 and above veteran cadres who participated in the revolutionary work before the founding of the People's Republic of China and did not hold a division (county) level position can generally enjoy the political and living benefits of the division (county) level after retirement.

events:
1日《人民日报》报道,中共中央政治局常委邓小平最近
同国家计委负责人谈话时指出,要加强科技队伍的管理。科技人
员分布在国防、民用、各种科研单位和高等院校,要想管起来,
没有一个很强有力的权威机构,搞不动。这个机构既管民用部门
的,也能管军队的,过去聂总管过,那时管得好,人才可以按需
要调动、集中使用。所谓落实二十年的生产规划、落实知识分子
政策,第一位的就是落实科技队伍的管理使用问题。这个问题应
当抓紧解决。
translated_text: On the 1st, the People's Daily reported that Deng Xiaoping, a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, recently pointed out in a conversation with the head of the State Planning Commission that it is necessary to strengthen the management of the scientific and technological team. Scientific and technological personnel are distributed in national defense, civilian, various scientific research units and colleges and universities. If you want to manage them, there is no strong and authoritative organization. This organization can manage both civilian departments and the military. In the past, General Nie was in charge. At that time, he managed well and talents could be mobilized and used in a centralized manner according to needs. The so-called implementation of the 20-year production plan and the implementation of the intellectual policy, the first thing is to implement the management and use of the scientific and technological team. This problem should be solved as soon as possible.

events:
2日 国务院作出《关于调整国家机关、科学文教卫生等部
门部分工作人员工资的决定》。《决定》指出,从1982年10月1
日起,调整国家机关、科学文教卫生等部门部分工作人员的工
资。1983年和以后的两年,将陆续调整企业部分职工的工资,
并积极着手工资制度的改革。
translated_text: On the 2nd, the State Council made the "Decision on Adjusting the Wages of Some Staff Members of State Organs, Science, Culture, Education, Health and Other Departments". The "Decision" pointed out that starting from October 1, 1982, the wages of some staff members of state organs, science, culture, education, health and other departments will be adjusted. In 1983 and the following two years, the wages of some employees in enterprises will be adjusted successively, and the reform of the wage system will be actively carried out.

events:
3日 中共中央组织部发出《关于召开省、市、自治区党代
表大会有关几个具体问题的通知》。《通知》对省、市、自治区党
代表大会的代表名额,省、市、自治区党委委员、候补委员名
额,顾问委员会委员名额和纪律检查委员会委员名额以及省、
市、自治区顾问委员会、纪律检查委员会的名称等问题作了具体
的规定。
translated_text: On the 3rd, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on Several Specific Issues Concerning the Convening of Provincial, Municipal and Autonomous Regional Party Congresses". The "Notice" made specific provisions on the number of representatives to the provincial, municipal and autonomous regional party congresses, the number of members and alternate members of the provincial, municipal and autonomous regional party committees, the number of members of the advisory committees and the number of members of the disciplinary inspection committees, as well as the names of the provincial, municipal and autonomous regional advisory committees and disciplinary inspection committees.

events:
7日 中共中央、国务院发出《关于省、市、自治区党政机
关机构改革若干问题的通知》。通知对以下几个问题提出了原则
意见和建议:(一)配备好领导班子;(二)认真精简机构;
(三)改革地区体制;(四)紧缩编制;(五)妥善安排好老干
部;(六)轮训干部;(七)公安、检查、法院和司法行政系统的
编制单列管理;(八)以国务院业务部门为主与地方双重领导的
单位,它的体制变动、机构改革、人员编制紧缩等问题,由国务
院业务主管部门商同地方政府提出改革方案,报国务院批准等。
translated_text: On the 7th, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued the "Notice on Several Issues Concerning the Institutional Reform of Party and Government Organs in Provinces, Cities and Autonomous Regions". The notice put forward principle opinions and suggestions on the following issues: (i) equip the leadership team; (ii) seriously streamline the organization; (iii) reform the regional system; (iv) tighten the establishment; (v) properly arrange for veteran cadres; (vi) train cadres in rotation; (vii) manage the establishment of public security, inspection, courts and judicial administration systems separately; (viii) for units with dual leadership of the State Council business departments and local governments, their system changes, institutional reforms, staff establishment tightening and other issues shall be proposed by the State Council business departments in consultation with local governments and submitted to the State Council for approval.

events:
10日 第五届全国人大五次会议通过《中华人民共和国国
务院组织法》。同日,还通过了关于修改《中华人民共和国地方
各级人民代表大会和地方各级人民政府组织法》的若干规定的决
议。
translated_text: On the 10th, the Fifth Session of the Fifth National People's Congress passed the "Organic Law of the State Council of the People's Republic of China". On the same day, it also passed a resolution on amending certain provisions of the "Organic Law of Local People's Congresses and Local People's Governments at All Levels of the People's Republic of China".

events:
15日 中共中央组织部和公安部联合发出《关于中国人民
武装警察部队各级领导机关成立临时党委和干部配备的几个问题
的通知》。

events: 1982年12月20日,劳动人事部发出《关于建立国家行政机关工作人员岗位责任制的通知》。通知指出,实行岗位责任制,是克服官僚主义,改善机关领导,转变机关作风,提高工作效率的一项重要措施。要求各级国家行政机关,已经建立岗位责任制的单位,要总结经验,进一步巩固和完善;凡是未建立岗位责任制的单位都应在完成机构改革的同时,把机关工作人员的岗位责任制建立起来。制定岗位责任制,必须从实际出发,根据本部门或本单位的工作任务职责范围和权限,明确规定各级各类工作人员的具体工作任务,提出每个人正确履行的职责和行使的权力,有些工作还应规定质量、指标、时限等具体要求。实行岗位责任制要同考核制度、奖惩制度以及工资制度的改革紧密结合。机关实行岗位责任制和个人执行岗位责任制的好与不好,作为考核工作人员的依据,作为奖惩工作人员的基础,也将作为国家统一调整工资时的必要条件。
translated_text: On December 20, 1982, the Ministry of Labor and Personnel issued the "Notice on Establishing the Post Responsibility System for Staff of State Administrative Organs". The notice pointed out that the implementation of the post responsibility system is an important measure to overcome bureaucracy, improve the leadership of organs, change the work style of organs, and improve work efficiency. It requires that the state administrative organs at all levels, units that have established the post responsibility system, should summarize their experience, further consolidate and improve it; all units that have not established the post responsibility system should establish the post responsibility system for staff of organs while completing the institutional reform. In formulating the post responsibility system, it is necessary to proceed from reality, and according to the scope of work tasks, responsibilities and authority of the department or unit, clearly define the specific work tasks of staff at all levels and types, and put forward the duties and powers that each person should correctly perform. For some work, specific requirements such as quality, indicators, and time limits should also be stipulated. The implementation of the post responsibility system should be closely combined with the reform of the assessment system, reward and punishment system, and wage system. The implementation of the post responsibility system by organs and the performance of the post responsibility system by individuals will serve as the basis for assessing staff, as the basis for rewarding and punishing staff, and will also serve as a necessary condition for the state to uniformly adjust wages.

translated_text: On the 30th, the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on the Cleansing of the "Three Types of People" in the Leadership Team". The "Notice" emphasized that it is necessary to resolutely clean out the three types of people from the leadership team: those who started out as rebels, those with serious gang mentality, and those who smashed, looted, and robbed. (一)企业有权根据有利于加强经营管理,有利于提高劳动生产

translated_text:
On the 1st, the People's Daily published a New Year's Day editorial entitled "Adding New Glory to Our Great Cause". The editorial pointed out that in 1983, work on all fronts and in all regions must move forward, and in particular, significant achievements must be made on two issues: First, to complete the institutional reforms at the provincial, municipal, autonomous region and prefectural and municipal levels, and strive to further improve the party style, social atmosphere and public security; second, to strive to achieve a comprehensive development level of the national economy that is not lower than that of last year, and to make practical preparations for continued healthy development in 1984 and the following years. In short, it can be summed up in two sentences: reform must be resolute, and the economy must be grasped. The General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council jointly issued the "Notice on the Issues of Departments Not Interfering in the Organization and Staffing of Enterprises". The Notice stipulates:
(i) Enterprises have the right to determine their own organizational structure and staffing ratios based on the principle of strengthening business management, improving labor productivity, improving economic benefits, and striving for simplicity; (ii) Relevant departments shall not rigidly stipulate organizational structure and staffing ratios for enterprises; (iii) The organizational structure and staffing of enterprises shall be comprehensively managed by labor and personnel departments at all levels.

translated_text: On the 20th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee published Chen Yun's comments on regular cadre exchanges in its Organization Work Newsletter. events:
25日 中共中央办公厅转发公、检、法三党组《关于进一
步复查平反政法系统经手办理的冤、假、错案的意见的报告》。
转发批语指出,现在的问题,主要是在“文化大革命”当中和“文
化大革命”以前由政法系统经手办理的案件中,都还有一定数量
的冤、假、错案没有得到平反纠正。中央要求,各级党委和公、
检、法机关及有关部门,要抓紧工作,务必把一切尚未平反的
冤假错案坚决平反纠正过来。
中共中央办公厅发出《关于县(市)和市辖区设立政协问题
的通知》。《通知》规定,没有设立政协的县(市)和市辖区,统
战对象多的可以设立政协;统战对象很少的也可以不设,由各
省、市、自治区党委根据当地情况决定。《通知》要求,不要把
政协变成一个安排党内老干部的机构。
translated_text: On the 25th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee forwarded the "Report on Further Reviewing and Redressing Unjust, False, and Wrong Cases Handled by the Political and Legal System" by the Party Groups of the Public Security, Procuratorate, and Court. The forwarding comments pointed out that the current problem is that there are still a certain number of unjust, false, and wrong cases that have not been redressed and corrected in the cases handled by the political and legal system during and before the "Cultural Revolution". The Central Committee requires that party committees at all levels and public security, procuratorial, judicial organs and relevant departments should work hard to resolutely redress and correct all unjust, false, and wrong cases that have not yet been redressed. The General Office of the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on the Establishment of CPPCCs in Counties (Cities) and Municipal Districts". The "Notice" stipulates that counties (cities) and municipal districts that have not established CPPCCs can establish CPPCCs if there are many united front objects; if there are few united front objects, they can also not establish one, and the decision will be made by the provincial, municipal, and autonomous regional party committees based on local conditions. The "Notice" requires that the CPPCC should not be turned into an institution for arranging veteran cadres within the party.

From November 1 to 8, 1982, the Central Propaganda Department and the Central Organization Department jointly held a national propaganda, culture and education cadre management symposium in Beijing. The meeting focused on strengthening the cadre team building, exchanged information and experiences, and discussed and put forward opinions on strengthening the propaganda, culture and education cadre team building and improving the cadre management level in the new era.

组《关于派赴各省、市、自治区的工作组的几项任务》。任务共

translated_text: On the 4th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee forwarded the "Several Tasks of the Working Groups Dispatched to Provinces, Cities and Autonomous Regions" issued by the Provincial, Municipal and Autonomous Region Institutional Reform Guidance Group. There are eight tasks in total: (i) Under the leadership of the provincial, municipal and autonomous region party committees, help to adjust and deploy the leadership teams of the provincial departments, commissions, bureaus, and prefectures and cities; (ii) Continue to do a good job in the ideological work of retired comrades in the second and third lines, and do a good job in the transition and cooperation between the old and the new; (iii) Boldly adopt the democratic recommendation method to discover talents and enrich the list of reserve cadres at all levels; (iv) It is recommended to arrange for young old cadres to leave their jobs for two or three years to improve their cultural and scientific levels; (v) Help do a good job in the ideological work of retired old cadres; (vi) Help arrange for retired department and bureau-level cadres, and pay attention to continuing to play their role; (vii) It is recommended that each province select one hundred to several hundred outstanding college graduates to train at the grassroots level every year; (viii) Help strengthen the self-construction of organization and personnel departments.

The "Notice" said that after consultation with the Central Party School, a training course for organization and personnel work leading cadres will be held from March 15 to the end of July. The training targets are the directors and deputy directors of the cadre departments (bureaus) and personnel departments (bureaus) of the central and state organs, and a few young and outstanding directors and deputy directors. The learning content is philosophy, party building, and organization and personnel work.

translated_text: On the 11th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued five regulations that cadres at all levels must abide by during the institutional reform.

events:
12日中共中央组织部、劳动人事部联合发出《关于整顿
“以工代干”问题的通知》。《通知》规定了“以工代干”人员转为干
部的条件,并且重申,1979年12月全国人事局长会议明确提出
今后一律不再搞“以工代干”,这个原则必须坚持。
中共中央发出《关于印发中纪委第二次全体会议工作报告
<尽快实现党风的根本好转>的通知》。《通知》指出,力争尽快
实现党风根本好转是全党的一项重大任务。中央希望各级党委:
(一)在组织党员干部,特别是各级领导干部学习领会文件精神
的基础上,召开一次贯彻中纪委全会精神的专题会议。(二)组
织党的干部,特别是各级领导干部,联系实际,对照检查自己的
思想和工作,发扬成绩,克服缺点,纠正错误。
translated_text: On the 12th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the Ministry of Labor and Personnel jointly issued the "Notice on Rectifying the Problem of "Workers Substituting Cadres"". The "Notice" stipulates the conditions for "Workers Substituting Cadres" to be converted into cadres, and reiterates that the National Personnel Bureau Directors' Conference in December 1979 clearly proposed that "Workers Substituting Cadres" would no longer be carried out in the future, and this principle must be upheld. The CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on Printing and Distributing the Work Report of the Second Plenary Session of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection <Achieving a Fundamental Improvement in the Party's Style as Soon as Possible>". The "Notice" pointed out that striving to achieve a fundamental improvement in the party's style as soon as possible is a major task for the whole party. The Central Committee hopes that party committees at all levels: (a) On the basis of organizing party members and cadres, especially leading cadres at all levels to study and understand the spirit of the document, hold a special meeting to implement the spirit of the plenary session of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection. (b) Organize party cadres, especially leading cadres at all levels, to link with reality, check their own thoughts and work, carry forward their achievements, overcome shortcomings, and correct mistakes.

events:
14日 中共中央发出《关于加强党员教育工作的通知》。
《通知》规定,今后几年内要在全党加强以新党章为主要内容的
党员教育,并把它与其他重要文件的学习很好地结合起来。各地
开始整党前,要以这一教育作为全面整党的准备;整党开展以
后,要继续进行这一教育。通过教育使每个党员明确十个问题:
①党的性质、地位和作用;②党的指导思想;③党的最终目标和现
阶段的总任务;④社会主义社会的基本特征和它的优越性;⑤新时
期我国社会的主要矛盾;⑥全心全意为人民服务是党的宗旨;⑦党
的民主集中制是党的根本组织原则,党的纪律是执行路线的保
证;⑧党员的标准和党的干部的基本条件;⑨坚持和改善党的领
导;⑩ 党风问题是执政党的生死存亡的大问题。
translated_text: On the 14th, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on Strengthening Party Member Education". The "Notice" stipulates that in the next few years, the party should strengthen party member education with the new party constitution as the main content, and combine it well with the study of other important documents. Before the rectification of the party begins in various places, this education should be used as a preparation for the overall rectification of the party; after the rectification of the party begins, this education should continue. Through education, each party member will clarify ten issues: ① The nature, status and role of the party; ② The guiding ideology of the party; ③ The ultimate goal of the party and the general task of the current stage; ④ The basic characteristics of socialist society and its superiority; ⑤ The main contradictions of our country's society in the new period; ⑥ Serving the people wholeheartedly is the purpose of the party; ⑦ The party's democratic centralism is the fundamental organizational principle of the party, and the party's discipline is the guarantee for the implementation of the line; ⑧ The standards of party members and the basic conditions of party cadres; ⑨ Uphold and improve the party's leadership; ⑩ The party style issue is a major issue of life and death for the ruling party.

On the 15th, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued the "Notice on Several Issues Concerning the Institutional Reform of Party and Government Organs in Cities and Prefectures". The following opinions were put forward on specific issues in the institutional reform: (i) Actively try to merge cities and prefectures; (ii) Manage both cities and rural areas well; (iii) The retained regional party and government organs should become veritable dispatched agencies; (iv) Autonomous prefectures should also carry out institutional reform, and their institutional settings should not be too detailed; (v) Strengthen leadership to ensure the smooth progress of the reform.

events: 1983年2月15日,中共中央、国务院发布《关于地市州党政机关机构改革若干问题的通知》。在人事制度改革方面,通知要求在配备地市州的领导班子时,一定要坚持任人唯贤,坚持走群众路线。坚决大胆地选拔任用德才兼备、年富力强的中青年干部,注意选拔妇女干部和少数民族干部,在政府机关要适当地安排非党人士。地市州定编以后,多下来的人员,要根据不同情况,采取多种办法,妥善安置。可以分配一些干部到县､社、厂矿企业去工作;对文化科学水平低的干部,可以送往学校学习、培养;还可以采取留职停薪的办法,接受社会招聘,参加各种形式的承包责任制,使他们各得其所。
translated_text: On February 15, 1983, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued the "Notice on Several Issues Concerning the Reform of Party and Government Institutions in Cities and Prefectures". In terms of personnel system reform, the notice requires that when equipping the leadership teams of cities and prefectures, we must insist on appointing people on the basis of merit and adhere to the mass line. We must resolutely and boldly select and appoint young and middle-aged cadres who are both capable and virtuous, pay attention to selecting women cadres and ethnic minority cadres, and appropriately arrange non-party members in government agencies. After the establishment of the quotas of cities and prefectures, the surplus personnel should be properly placed in a variety of ways according to different situations. Some cadres can be assigned to work in counties, communes, factories and mines; cadres with low cultural and scientific levels can be sent to schools for study and training; they can also take the method of taking leave without pay, accepting social recruitment, and participating in various forms of contract responsibility system, so that they can all get what they deserve.

events:

委《关于成立中国石油化工总公司的报告》。中共中央和国务院
决定,中国石油化工总公司筹备小组由国务委员康世恩分管。

events:

善安排离休老干部的经验》,指出把老干部离休工作抓紧抓细,
既要切实做好服务工作,又要认真组织那些身体还好,能做一定
工作的同志继续发挥作用,让所有离休老干部都能各得其所。
translated_text: On the 21st, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China forwarded "The Experience of the Ministry of Machinery Industry in Properly Arranging Retired Veteran Cadres in Institutional Reform", pointing out that the work of retired veteran cadres should be handled promptly and carefully. It is necessary to do a good job in service and to seriously organize those comrades who are in good health and can do certain work to continue to play their roles, so that all retired veteran cadres can get what they deserve.

events:
22日——3月2日 第二次全国党校工作会议在京举行。会
议要求各级党校必须根据中央指示,尽快转向正规化培训干部
为主;确定了正规化培训干部的方针。5月3日,中共中央发出
《关于印发<中共中央关于实现党校教育正规化的决定〉和〈关
于第二次全国党校工作会议情况的报告>的通知》。《中共中央关
于实现党校教育正规化的决定》指出,党校教育的正规化,主要
指办学方式和课程设置的正规化。它对于实现干部队伍的革命
化、年轻化、知识化、专业化,对于把我们的党建设成为领导社
会主义现代化事业的坚强核心,对于继往开来、保证党的路线的
连续性,都有重大意义。
translated_text: From March 22 to March 2, the Second National Party School Work Conference was held in Beijing. The conference required party schools at all levels to shift to regular training of cadres as soon as possible according to the instructions of the Central Committee; it determined the policy of regular training of cadres. On May 3, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on Printing and Distributing the "Decision of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Realizing the Regularization of Party School Education" and the "Report on the Situation of the Second National Party School Work Conference". The "Decision of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Realizing the Regularization of Party School Education" pointed out that the regularization of party school education mainly refers to the regularization of school-running methods and curriculum settings. It is of great significance to realize the revolutionization, rejuvenation, knowledge and specialization of the cadre team, to build our party into a strong core to lead the cause of socialist modernization, and to carry forward the past and ensure the continuity of the party's line.

events: 28日——3月5日 第五届全国人大常委会第二十六次会议在北京举行。
translated_text: From March 28 to March 5, the 26th meeting of the Fifth National People's Congress Standing Committee was held in Beijing. At the meeting, Ye Jianying's letter to this meeting suggesting that he should no longer be elected as a representative of the Sixth National People's Congress and no longer be listed as a candidate for the chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress was read out. (2) We must oppose the erroneous tendency of separating and opposing intellectuals from the working class and regarding them as "alien forces", establish the correct concept that intellectuals are part of the working class, and strengthen the unity of workers, peasants and intellectuals a hundredfold. (3) We must oppose the erroneous tendency of separating and opposing the adherence to the leadership of the Party from the implementation of expert leadership, establish the correct concept that to lead, one must be an expert, and vigorously strengthen the knowledge and specialization of the cadre team under the premise of revolutionization.

events:
6日——20日 中共中央组织部在北京召开全国组织工作座
谈会。会议内容主要是贯彻干部“四化”方针、改革领导班子结
构、改革干部制度,提高干部队伍素质以及加强组织部门自身建
设等。参加座谈会的有各省、市、自治区党委组织部负责人、整
党试点负责人、干部制度改革搞得好的单位的党委负责人以及国
家机关各部委、国务院直属总局负责干部工作的同志等,共三百
二十余人。
中共中央组织部部长陈野作了题为《改革的精神加速领
导班子和干部队伍的“四化”建设》的报告。《报告》着重讲了组
织工作的重大转变,努力开创组织工作的新局面,组织部门要有
一个新气象等三个问题。同时,提出了四项重要任务:(一)继
续改革领导班子的结构,加快革命化、年轻化、知识化、专业化
的步伐;(二)大力提高干部队伍的政治和业务素质;(三)有领
导有计划地改革干部制度;(四)按照中央的部署认真搞好整
党。中共中央9月2日批转了这个《报告》。在转发通知中强
调,尽快实现干部队伍的革命化、年轻化、知识化和专业化,是
一项伟大的建设工程。按照干部“四化”的要求,搞好干部队伍、
特别是各级领导班子的建设,是新时期党的组织路线的核心,也
是组织战线当前和今后一个时期的首要任务。会议还讨论、修改
了《关于领导班子“四化”建设的八年规划》、《关于改革干部管理
体制若干问题的规定》、《全国干部培训规划要点》、《关于建立省
部级后备干部制度的意见》等四个文件。10月5日,中共中央
组织部正式印发了这四个文件的修订稿。
translated_text: From the 6th to the 20th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee held a national symposium on organizational work in Beijing. The content of the meeting was mainly to implement the "four modernizations" policy for cadres, reform the leadership team structure, reform the cadre system, improve the quality of the cadre team, and strengthen the self-construction of the organization department. Participants in the symposium included the heads of the organization departments of the provincial, municipal and autonomous regional party committees, the heads of the party rectification pilot projects, the heads of the party committees of units that have done well in the cadre system reform, and the comrades in charge of cadre work in various ministries and commissions of state organs and the general bureaus directly under the State Council, totaling more than 320 people. Chen Ye, Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, made a report entitled "The spirit of reform accelerates the "four modernizations" construction of the leadership team and the cadre team." The report focused on three issues: the major changes in organizational work, efforts to create a new situation in organizational work, and the need for the organization department to have a new atmosphere. At the same time, four important tasks were proposed: (i) continue to reform the structure of the leadership team and accelerate the pace of revolutionization, rejuvenation, knowledge and specialization; (ii) vigorously improve the political and professional quality of the cadre team; (iii) reform the cadre system in a planned manner under leadership; (iv) conscientiously carry out the rectification of the party in accordance with the deployment of the central government. The CPC Central Committee approved this "Report" on September 2. In the forwarding notice, it was emphasized that it is a great construction project to realize the revolutionization, rejuvenation, knowledge and specialization of the cadre team as soon as possible. In accordance with the requirements of the "four modernizations" of cadres, building a good cadre team, especially the leadership team at all levels, is the core of the party's organizational line in the new era and the primary task of the organizational front at present and in the future. The meeting also discussed and revised four documents, including "Eight-Year Plan for the Construction of the "Four Modernizations" of the Leadership Team", "Regulations on Several Issues Concerning the Reform of the Cadre Management System", "Key Points of the National Cadre Training Plan", and "Opinions on the Establishment of a Provincial and Ministerial Reserve Cadre System". On October 5, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee officially issued the revised drafts of these four documents.

《规定》指出,为了确保国家重点建设项目和重大科技攻关任务

中小城市;从内地到边远地区;从科技人员富余的部门和单位,

translated_text: On the 13th, the State Council issued the "Several Provisions on the Reasonable Flow of Scientific and Technological Personnel". The "Provisions" pointed out that in order to ensure the completion of national key construction projects and major scientific and technological tasks, revitalize the economy, and achieve the four modernizations, it is necessary to make appropriate adjustments to the existing scientific and technological personnel and improve the management and use of scientific and technological personnel. It is necessary to promote the flow of scientific and technological personnel in a planned and step-by-step manner in a reasonable direction, that is, from cities to rural areas; from large cities to small and medium-sized cities; from inland areas to remote areas; from departments and units with surplus scientific and technological personnel to departments and units with weak scientific and technological forces that are in urgent need of strengthening.

translated_text: On the 29th, the CPC Central Committee appointed Li Rui, Lü Feng, Wang Zhaohua, and Cao Zhi as deputy ministers of the CPC Central Organization Department, Bai Zhimin, Zheng Bo Ke, and Liu Huafeng as consultants of the CPC Central Organization Department, and removed Lin Tie, Liao Zhigao, Li Chuli, Shuai Mengqi, and Li Buxin from their positions as consultants of the CPC Central Organization Department, and removed Zeng Zhi, Yang Shijie, and Zhao Zhenqing from their positions as deputy ministers of the CPC Central Organization Department. The CPC Central Committee agreed to appoint Li Hao, Ai Zhisheng, Wu Qingtong, Chen Chu, and Gu Ming as deputy secretaries-general of the State Council.

events:
