选派专业技术干部的通知》。《通知》指出,为西藏选派一批专业
技术干部,是完全必要的。《通知》就以下问题作出规定: (一)
选派一批专业技术干部去西藏工作采取对口选派的办法; (二)
坚持少而精的原则;(三)在藏工作时间,一般为三年,粮、
户、、工资关系可以不转。
translated_text: On the 3rd, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the Ministry of Labor and Personnel jointly issued the "Notice on the Selection of Professional and Technical Cadres for Tibet". The "Notice" pointed out that it is absolutely necessary to select a group of professional and technical cadres for Tibet. The "Notice" stipulates the following issues: (a) The selection of a group of professional and technical cadres to work in Tibet shall adopt the method of counterpart selection; (b) Adhere to the principle of fewer but better; (c) The working time in Tibet is generally three years, and the grain, household, and salary relationship may not be transferred.

events:
8日 《人民日报》发表题为《新班子要有新作风》的社
论。社论指出,当前机构改革工作正在深入进行。许多地方和单
位的领导班子作了调整。新班子组建起来之后,理应十分注意自
身的思想建设和作风建设,提高政策思想水平,改进领导作风,
开创本地区、本单位的新局面。
translated_text: On the 8th, the People's Daily published an editorial entitled "New Leadership Teams Must Have New Work Styles". The editorial pointed out that the current institutional reform work is in-depth. The leadership teams of many places and units have been adjusted. After the new team is formed, it should pay great attention to its own ideological construction and work style construction, improve the level of policy and thought, improve the leadership style, and create a new situation in the region and unit.

events:
9日 《人民日报》报道,中央和国家机关机构改革工作小
组最近提出,当前要着重研究解决五个问题:(一)进一步明确
各部委的主要任务和职责; (二)适当地层层放权。(三)逐步建
立科学的领导体系。(四)机关服务工作企业化、社会化。 (五)
使干部结构更合理。
translated_text: On the 9th, the People's Daily reported that the central and state organs reform working group recently proposed that the current focus should be on studying and solving five issues: (a) further clarifying the main tasks and responsibilities of each ministry; (b) appropriately delegating power to each level; (c) gradually establishing a scientific leadership system; (d) making the service work of the organs more corporate and socialized; and (e) making the cadre structure more reasonable.

events: 1983年8月9日,《人民日报》发表评论员文章《把机构改革工作认真抓下去》,指出,当前要研究和解决五个主要问题:一是进一步明确各部委主要任务和职责;二是要适当地层层放权;三是逐步建立科学的领导体系;四是逐步实现机关服务工作企业化、社会化;五是使干部结构更合理。
translated_text: On August 9, 1983, the People's Daily published an editorial entitled "Take the Institutional Reform Work Seriously", pointing out that five major issues need to be studied and resolved at present: first, further clarify the main tasks and responsibilities of various ministries and commissions; second, appropriately delegate power to all levels; third, gradually establish a scientific leadership system; fourth, gradually realize the enterprise and socialization of government service work; and fifth, make the cadre structure more reasonable.

events: 10日 中共中央组织部发出经中央书记处批准的《关于加紧培养省级党委一把手接班人的报告》。《报告》就力争一两年内解决好省级党委一把手接班人问题,提出以下五项措施: (一)对现任党委常委和正副省长中的年轻干部,要大胆放手使用;(二)选拔一批年富力强的好角色到大城市、省直重要的综合部门,以及大型厂矿企业、重点高等院校担任党政一把手;(三)抓紧“第三梯队”的建设;(四)抓紧落实干部正规化培训;(五)教育新上来的干部严格要求自己。
translated_text: On the 10th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued a report approved by the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee on speeding up the training of successors to provincial party committee leaders. The report proposed the following five measures to strive to solve the problem of successors to provincial party committee leaders within one or two years: (i) Young cadres among the current party committee standing committee members and provincial governors and vice governors should be boldly used; (ii) A group of young and energetic people should be selected to serve as party and government leaders in large cities, important provincial comprehensive departments, large factories and mines, and key universities; (iii) The construction of the "third echelon" should be accelerated; (iv) Regular cadre training should be implemented; (v) New cadres should be educated to strictly demand themselves.

events:

生到基层培养锻炼的通知》。《通知》指出,从今年开始,各省、
市、自治区每年都要选调一批应届优秀大学生,到基层进行重点
培养锻炼,几年后,择优选拔到适当的领导岗位。这是实现领导班
子“四化”的重要措施,应作为培养干部的一项制度长期坚持下
去。
translated_text: On the 20th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on Selecting Outstanding University Graduates to Be Trained at the Grassroots Level". The "Notice" pointed out that starting from this year, each province, city, and autonomous region will select a group of outstanding university graduates every year to be trained at the grassroots level. After a few years, the best will be selected to appropriate leadership positions. This is an important measure to achieve the "four modernizations" of the leadership team, and it should be maintained as a system for training cadres for a long time.

events:

The Provincial Advisory Committee elected Xu Jiansheng as the director of the Provincial Advisory Committee.

events:
1日 中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅联合发出《关于整顿
职称评定工作的通知》。《通知》指出,为了克服目前评定职称工
作中出现的混乱现象,中央书记处,国务院决定:全国评定职称
工作暂停,进行一次认真的检查,总结和全面的整顿。中央书记
处、国务院决定成立中央职称评定工作领导小组,赵守一为组
长,郁文为副组长。
中共中央组织部发出《关于从中央、国家机关中选派部分年
轻干部到基层或地方锻炼的通知》。《通知》指出,近几年的实践
证明,从领导机关挑选一些文化程度较高的优秀年轻干部到基层
任职锻炼,是培养造就干部、提高机关干部素质的有效措施之
一。中央、国家机关各部门应当积极地,有计划地分期分批地进
行这项工作。
translated_text: On the 1st, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council jointly issued the "Notice on the Rectification of the Title Evaluation Work". The "Notice" pointed out that in order to overcome the current chaos in the title evaluation work, the Central Secretariat and the State Council decided to suspend the national title evaluation work and conduct a serious inspection, summary and comprehensive rectification. The Central Secretariat and the State Council decided to establish a central title evaluation work leading group, with Zhao Shouyi as the leader and Yu Wen as the deputy leader. The Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on Selecting Some Young Cadres from the Central and State Organs to Work at the Grassroots or Local Levels". The "Notice" pointed out that the practice in recent years has proved that selecting some outstanding young cadres with a high level of education from the leading organs to work at the grassroots level is one of the effective measures to cultivate cadres and improve the quality of cadres in the organs. All departments of the central and state organs should actively and systematically carry out this work in stages and batches.

events: 1983年9月1日,中央组织部发出《关于从中央、国家机关中选派部分年轻干部到基层或地方锻炼的通知》。指出,从领导机关挑选一批文化程度较高的优秀年轻干部到基层任职锻炼,是培养造就干部、改善机关干部素质的有效措施之一。中央国家机关各部门应当积极地、有计划地、分期分批地进行这项工作。选派对象主要是缺乏基层或地方领导工作经验的部和司局级后备干部,以及其他有培养前途的年轻干部。下派地点,要本着定向培养、专业对口的原则,合理地选择。
translated_text: On September 1, 1983, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the Notice on Selecting Some Young Cadres from the Central and State Organs to Work at the Grassroots or Local Levels. It pointed out that selecting a group of outstanding young cadres with high education from leading organs to work at the grassroots level is one of the effective measures to cultivate and train cadres and improve the quality of cadres in organs. All departments of the central state organs should actively, systematically, and in stages and batches carry out this work. The objects of selection are mainly reserve cadres at the ministry and bureau level who lack grassroots or local leadership work experience, as well as other young cadres with training prospects. The place of dispatch should be reasonably selected based on the principles of targeted training and professional matching.

委书记,姚广、钱其琛任副书记。

events:
3日 国务院发出《关于认真整顿招收退休、退职职工子女
工作的通知》。
translated_text: On the 3rd, the State Council issued the "Notice on Seriously Rectifying the Work of Recruiting Children of Retired and Resigned Employees".

events:
6日 中共中央组织部发出《关于妥善安排退到二、三线的
老干部几个问题的通知》。《通知》规定: (一)退到二、三线的
老干部的政治、生活待遇,要明确由哪个单位负责;(二)有两
个办公室的,逐步过渡到只在主要工作单位设办公室;(三)要
及时了解退到二、三线的老干部参加组织生活、阅读文件,用
车、医疗等情况,发现问题,抓紧解决。
translated_text: On the 6th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on Several Issues Concerning the Proper Arrangement of Veteran Cadres Retired to the Second and Third Fronts". The "Notice" stipulates: (1) The political and living treatment of veteran cadres who have retired to the second and third fronts must be clearly defined by which unit is responsible; (2) For those who have two offices, they should gradually transition to setting up an office only in the main work unit; (3) It is necessary to timely understand the veteran cadres who have retired to the second and third fronts' participation in organizational life, reading documents, using cars, medical treatment, etc., and solve problems as soon as possible when they are discovered.

events:
8日 中共中央组织部发出《关于任免国家机关和其他行政
领导职务必须按照法律程序和有关规定办理的通知》。《通知》指
出,我们党领导人民制定宪法和法律,更要领导人民贯彻执行好
宪法和法律。各级党委要认真学习和带头遵守宪法和有关法律的
规定,养成依法办事的习惯。对下级党委和组织、干部部门在任
免、调动干部工作中是否有违反宪法和法律的问题,要经常检查
监督,发现问题,及时纠正。《通知》指出了六个应注意的问
题。
translated_text: On the 8th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on the Appointment and Removal of State Organs and Other Administrative Leadership Positions Must Be Handled in Accordance with Legal Procedures and Relevant Regulations". The "Notice" pointed out that our party leads the people to formulate the Constitution and laws, and must lead the people to implement the Constitution and laws. Party committees at all levels must earnestly study and take the lead in abiding by the provisions of the Constitution and relevant laws, and develop the habit of doing things in accordance with the law. Regular inspections and supervision should be carried out to see if there are any violations of the Constitution and laws in the appointment, removal and transfer of cadres by lower-level party committees, organizations, and cadre departments, and problems should be found and corrected in a timely manner. The "Notice" pointed out six issues that should be paid attention to.

events: 1983年9月8日,中央组织部发出《关于任免国家机关和其他行政领导职务必须按照法律程序和有关规定办理的通知》。通知指出,凡依法应由各级人民代表大会选举产生或由人大常委会决定任命以及由国务院和地方各级人民政府任命的领导职务,必须遵照组织法的有关规定,严格按照程序办理。法律规定有任期的职务,在任期未满前,非有特殊情况,不要轻易调动;必须调整时,应按规定程序履行调动、任免手续。
translated_text: On September 8, 1983, the Central Organization Department issued the "Notice on the Appointment and Removal of State Organs and Other Administrative Leadership Positions Must Be Handled in Accordance with Legal Procedures and Relevant Regulations". The notice pointed out that all leadership positions that should be elected by the people's congresses at all levels or appointed by the Standing Committee of the People's Congress, as well as appointed by the State Council and local people's governments at all levels, must comply with the relevant provisions of the Organization Law and strictly follow the procedures. Positions with term limits stipulated by law should not be easily transferred before the term expires unless there are special circumstances; when adjustments are necessary, the transfer, appointment and removal procedures should be carried out in accordance with the prescribed procedures.

events:
12日 国务院发布《国务院关于高级专家离休退休若干问
题的暂行规定》的通知。《暂行规定》指出,副教授、副研究员
以及相当这一级职称的高级专家,经所在单位报请上一级主管机
关批准,可以适当延长离休退休年龄,但最长不超过65周岁;
教授、研究员以及相当这一级职称的高级专家,经所在单位报请
省、市、自治区人民政府或中央、国家机关的部委批准,可以延
长离休退休年龄,但最长不超过70周岁;学术造诣高深,在
国内外有重大影响的杰出高级专家,经国务院批准,可以暂缓离
休退休,继续从事研究或著述工作。
国务院发出《关于延长部分骨干教师、医生、科技人员退休
年龄的通知》。《通知》指出,讲师、主治医师、工程师、农艺
师、助理研究员以及具有高等院校、中等专业学校和高中毕业学
历或经严格考核取得同等学历的,教学经验丰富的中、小学教师
中,确因工作需要,身体能够坚持正常工作,有较强的业务能
力,本人又愿意继续工作的,经所在单位报请县一级以上主管机
关严格审查批准,可将他们的退休年龄延长一至五年,延长后的
退休年龄,女同志最长不得超过60周岁,男同志最长不得超过
65周岁。
translated_text: On the 12th, the State Council issued the "State Council's Interim Provisions on Several Issues Concerning the Retirement of Senior Experts". The "Interim Provisions" pointed out that associate professors, associate researchers and senior experts with equivalent titles can appropriately extend their retirement age after their units apply to the higher-level competent authorities for approval, but the maximum age shall not exceed 65 years old; professors, researchers and senior experts with equivalent titles can extend their retirement age after their units apply to the provincial, municipal, autonomous regional people's government or the ministries and commissions of the central and state organs for approval, but the maximum age shall not exceed 70 years old; outstanding senior experts with profound academic attainments and significant influence at home and abroad can postpone their retirement and continue to engage in research or writing work with the approval of the State Council. The State Council issued the "Notice on Extending the Retirement Age of Some Key Teachers, Doctors and Scientific and Technological Personnel". The Notice points out that lecturers, attending physicians, engineers, agronomists, assistant researchers, and middle and primary school teachers with college, secondary vocational school and high school graduation qualifications or equivalent qualifications obtained through strict assessment and rich teaching experience, who are physically able to continue working due to work needs, have strong professional capabilities, and are willing to continue working, can have their retirement age extended by one to five years after their units apply to the competent authorities at or above the county level for strict review and approval. After the extension, the retirement age for female comrades shall not exceed 60 years old, and the maximum age for male comrades shall not exceed 65 years old.

events: 1983年9月12日,国务院发布《关于高级专家离休、退休若干问题的暂行规定》。高级专家离休退休年龄,一般应按国家统一规定执行。对其中少数高级专家,确因工作需要,身体能够坚持正常工作,征得本人同意,经有关机关批准,其离休退休年龄可以适当延长副教授、副研究员以及相当这一级职称的高级专家,经批准,可以适当延长离退休年龄,但最长不超过65周岁;教授､研究员以及相当这一级职称的高级专家,经批准,可以延长离退休年龄,但最长不超过70岁。学术上造诣高深,在国内外有重大影响的杰出高级专家,经国务院批准,可以暂缓离休退休,继续从事研究或著述工作。高级专家离休退休的待遇,按国家统一规定办理。在有些情况下,退休费标准可以适当提高。
translated_text: On September 12, 1983, the State Council issued the "Interim Provisions on Several Issues Concerning the Retirement of Senior Experts". The retirement age of senior experts should generally be implemented in accordance with the unified national regulations. For a small number of senior experts, if their health is able to continue to work normally due to work needs, their retirement age can be appropriately extended with their consent and approval by relevant authorities. Associate professors, associate researchers and senior experts with equivalent titles can appropriately extend their retirement age with approval, but the maximum age shall not exceed 65 years old; professors, researchers and senior experts with equivalent titles can extend their retirement age with approval, but the maximum age shall not exceed 70 years old. Outstanding senior experts with profound academic attainments and major influence at home and abroad can postpone their retirement and continue to engage in research or writing work with the approval of the State Council. Among the senior experts whose retirement age is extended, those who hold administrative leadership or management positions should be relieved of their administrative leadership or management positions when they reach the retirement age stipulated by the state, so that they can concentrate on continuing to engage in science and technology or culture and art. The retirement benefits of senior experts shall be handled in accordance with the unified national regulations. In some cases, the retirement benefits can be appropriately increased.

events: 延长离休退休年龄的高级专家中,担任行政领导职务或管理职务的,在达到国家统一规定的离休退休年龄时,应当免去其行政领导职务或管理职务,使他们集中精力继续从事科学技术或文化艺术等工作。

For a small number of senior experts, if their health is able to continue to work normally due to work needs, their retirement age can be appropriately extended with their consent and approval by relevant authorities. The retirement benefits of senior experts shall be handled in accordance with the unified national regulations. In some cases, the retirement benefits can be appropriately increased.

events:
15日 中华人民共和国审计署在首都人民大会堂召开成立
大会。国务院副总理田纪云、国务委员王乾,财经界知名人士
和 23 个省、市、自治区审计局负责人出席了成立大会。田纪云
副总理在讲话中指出,成立审计署是为了实行审计监督,是搞活
经济、提高经济效益,维护财经纪律的需要。
translated_text: On the 15th, the National Audit Office of the People's Republic of China held its inaugural meeting in the Great Hall of the People in Beijing. Vice Premier Tian Jiyun, State Councilor Wang Qian, well-known figures in the financial and economic circles, and heads of audit bureaus of 23 provinces, cities, and autonomous regions attended the inaugural meeting. events: 1983年10月5日,中央组织部印发《关于领导班子“四化”建设的八年规划》《关于改革干部管理体制若干问题的规定》、《关于建立省部级后备干部制度的意见》等三个修订稿。关于领导班子“四化”建设,指导思想是,必须适应社会主义现代化建设的要求,切实搞好新老干部的合作与交替,选拔一大批确属德才兼备、文化程度较高、真正懂行、有闯劲,能开创新局面的优秀中青年干部担任领导工作,使领导班子形成梯形年龄结构和合理的知识结构､专业结构,真正成为领导社会主义现代化建设事业的坚强核心。关于干部管理体制的改革,要本着管少､管活､管好的精神,在党委统一领导下,实行组织部门的统一管理和分部分级管理相结合的原则。各级各部门要明确职责,减少层次,提高效率,管好领导班子,管好后备干部,搞好对干部的考察了解、培养教育和选拔使用,全面做好干部管理工作。关于后备干部制度的建立,要根据后备干部的条件,搞好后备干部的选定、培养、考核和管理,使新老干部的交替有雄厚的后备力量
translated_text: On October 5, 1983, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued three revised drafts, namely, "Eight-Year Plan for the Construction of the "Four Modernizations" of the Leading Group", "Regulations on Several Issues Concerning the Reform of the Cadre Management System", and "Opinions on the Establishment of a Provincial and Ministerial Reserve Cadre System". Regarding the construction of the "four modernizations" of the leading group, the guiding ideology is that it is necessary to adapt to the requirements of socialist modernization, effectively carry out the cooperation and alternation of new and old cadres, select a large number of outstanding young and middle-aged cadres who are truly both morally and professionally competent, have a high level of education, are truly knowledgeable, have the courage to take on new tasks, and can create new situations to serve as leaders, so that the leading group can form a ladder-shaped age structure and a reasonable knowledge structure and professional structure, and truly become a strong core to lead the cause of socialist modernization. Regarding the reform of the cadre management system, we must follow the spirit of managing fewer, managing more, and managing better, and under the unified leadership of the Party Committee, implement the principle of combining unified management of the organization department with management at different levels. All levels and departments must clarify their responsibilities, reduce levels, improve efficiency, manage the leading group well, manage reserve cadres well, do a good job in investigating, understanding, training, educating, selecting and using cadres, and do a good job in cadre management in an all-round way. Regarding the establishment of a reserve cadre system, we must select, train, assess and manage reserve cadres based on their conditions, so that there is a strong reserve force for the replacement of old and new cadres.

events: 11日——12日 中国共产党第十二届中央委员会第二次全体会议在北京举行。中共中央政治局常委胡耀邦、叶剑英、邓小平、赵紫阳、李先念、陈云出席并主持了会议。到会的中央委员201人,中央候补委员136人,中央顾问委员会委员150人,中央纪律检查委员会委员124人,中央机关和地方党委的负责同志11人列席了会议。全会一致通过《中共中央关于整党的决定》,号召全体党员认真学习整党文件,积极参加整党。全会选举产生中央整党工作指导委员会,主任胡耀邦,副主任万里、余秋里、薄一波(主持常务)、胡启立、王鹤寿。在这次会议上,邓小平、陈云就整党问题分别作了重要讲话。邓小平在强调整党不能走过场的同时,还提出思想战线不能搞精神污染,必须大力加强党对思想战线的领导。陈云在讲话中强调,这次整党必须把“三种人”清除出党;执政党的党风问题是有关党的生死存亡的问题;要充分注意对外开放中带来的消极影响。
translated_text: On the 11th and 12th, the Second Plenary Session of the 12th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China was held in Beijing. Standing Committee members of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee Hu Yaobang, Ye Jianying, Deng Xiaoping, Zhao Ziyang, Li Xiannian and Chen Yun attended and presided over the meeting. 201 members of the Central Committee, 136 alternate members of the Central Committee, 150 members of the Central Advisory Committee, 124 members of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, and 11 responsible comrades of central organs and local party committees attended the meeting. The plenary session unanimously adopted the "Decision of the CPC Central Committee on Party Rectification", calling on all party members to study the documents on party rectification seriously and actively participate in party rectification. The plenary session elected the Central Party Rectification Steering Committee, with Hu Yaobang as the director, Wan Li, Yu Qiuli, Bo Yibo (in charge of standing committee), Hu Qili and Wang Heshou as vice directors. At this meeting, Deng Xiaoping and Chen Yun made important speeches on the issue of party rectification. While Deng Xiaoping stressed that the party reform should not be a formality, he also proposed that the ideological front should not be spiritually polluted and that the party's leadership over the ideological front should be strengthened. In his speech, Chen Yun emphasized that the party rectification must eliminate the "three types of people" from the party; the party style of the ruling party is a matter of life and death for the party; full attention should be paid to the negative impact of opening up to the outside world. In accordance with the provisions of the Party Constitution, the plenary session decided to replace Yang Taifang and Lang Dazhong, alternate members of the Central Committee, as members of the Central Committee.

政府的通知》。《通知》指出,当前的首要任务是把政社分开,建
立乡政府乡的规模一般以原有公社的管辖范围为基础,编制不
得超过现有公社人员。乡政府建立后,要按照《中华人民共和国

translated_text: On the 12th, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued the "Notice on the Separation of Government and Commune and the Establishment of Township Governments". The "Notice" pointed out that the current priority is to separate government and commune and establish township governments. The size of townships is generally based on the jurisdiction of the original communes, and the establishment shall not exceed the existing commune personnel. After the township government is established, it shall exercise its powers in accordance with the provisions of the "Organic Law of Local People's Congresses and Local People's Governments at All Levels of the People's Republic of China".

events:

走群众路线的通知》。《通知》规定,凡进行机构改革、整顿领导
班子或日常提拔任命干部,一般要采取民主推荐、民意测验等形
式,充分走群众路线,并由组织部门进行全面考察,党委(党

translated_text: On the 3rd, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on Adhering to the Mass Line in Reporting to the Central Committee for Appointment of Cadres". The "Notice" stipulates that in all institutional reforms, rectification of leadership teams or daily promotion and appointment of cadres, democratic recommendations and public opinion polls should be adopted to fully follow the mass line, and the organization department should conduct a comprehensive investigation, and the party committee (party group) should make a collective discussion and decision. No individual has the right to decide on the appointment of cadres. In the future, all cadres who are reported to the Central Committee for appointment should also report on their adherence to the mass line.

The Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the Ministry of Labor and Personnel jointly issued the "Notice on Forwarding Gansu Province's Strict Prohibition of Unhealthy Trends in the Rectification of "Workers Substitute Cadres"". The "Notice" pointed out that a few units ignored the notices and regulations of the Organization Department of the Central Committee and the Ministry of Labor and Personnel in the rectification of "workers substitute cadres", arbitrarily expanded the scope of transfer, relaxed standards, took the opportunity to build relationships, use backdoors, and rush to transfer cadres. events: 1日 中共中央、国务院发出《关于县级党政机关机构改革若干问题的通知》。《通知》对县级领导班子的配备、机构设置、人员编制等问题,提出了六项要求:(一)县级党政领导班子,要坚决贯彻精干原则和干部“四化”方针;(二)县级工作部门的设置,要根据党政合理分工的精神和精简原则,大大简化和紧缩;(三)党群机关人员编制,可精简20%左右;(四)有计划地交流主要领导干部;(五)妥善安排离退休老干部,充分发挥他们的作用;(六)各机关各单位都必须遵守纪律。
translated_text: On the 1st, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued the "Notice on Several Issues Concerning the Institutional Reform of County-level Party and Government Organs". The "Notice" put forward six requirements on the deployment, organization and staffing of county-level leadership teams: (i) The county-level party and government leadership teams must resolutely implement the principle of leanness and the "four modernizations" policy for cadres; (ii) The establishment of county-level work departments must be greatly simplified and tightened in accordance with the spirit of reasonable division of labor between the party and the government and the principle of streamlining; (iii) The staffing of party and mass organizations can be streamlined by about 20%; (iv) There should be planned exchanges of major leading cadres; (v) Retired cadres should be properly arranged to give full play to their role; (vi) All organs and units must abide by discipline. The CPC Central Committee agreed that Zhu Tianshun would be the chairman of the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China; Chen Li would be the president, and approved him as the secretary of the party group.

events: 1983年12月1日,党中央、国务院发出《关于县级党政机构改革若干问题的通知》。在人事制度改革方面,要求在配备领导班子成员时,必须严格把好政治关､年龄关和文化关,选拔干部应坚持以革命化为前提。要结合机构改革,对县级主要领导干部有计划地进行交流。对于离休退休的老干部,要妥善安排,充分发挥他们的作用。对于精简下来的人员,要扎扎实实地做好思想工作,同时按照干部的不同情况,广开门路,分别安排适当工作。

For retired old cadres, proper arrangements should be made to give full play to their role. For the streamlined personnel, ideological work should be done in a down-to-earth manner, and at the same time, according to the different situations of the cadres, a wide range of channels should be opened up and appropriate work should be arranged for them.

作的中心任务之一,也是整党重要工作之一。当务之急要在前一
段工作的基础上,加快步伐,细心工作,保证在明年“七·一”以

translated_text: From the 15th to the 24th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the Propaganda Department of the CPC Central Committee held a national cadre training symposium in Beijing. The meeting exchanged experiences in cadre training and formulated a cadre training plan. On the 16th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee held a telephone conference on the construction of the provincial and ministerial "third echelon". The meeting proposed that the construction of the third echelon is one of the central tasks of the party's organizational work in 1984 and one of the important tasks of party rectification. The editorial pointed out that we should focus on economic construction and do a better job in other aspects of work and struggle. We should effectively strengthen the party's leadership on the ideological front, conscientiously and correctly eliminate spiritual pollution, and promote the construction of socialist spiritual civilization. We should continue to do a good job in institutional reform and economic system reform, and further realize the revolutionization, rejuvenation, knowledge and professionalization of the cadre team. events:

央组织部审批的通知》。《通知》根据中央书记处一九八三年十二
月一日会议决定,将原报中央审批的中央、国家机关司局长级干

干部和地市中层干部必须把好“三关”的通知》。强调指出,把好
政治关、年龄关、文化关,特别是把好政治关,是配备好省和地
市两级机构领导干部的关键,决不能让“三种人”和犯有严重错误

translated_text: On the 6th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on the Change of the Approval of the Appointment and Removal of Director-level Cadres to the Central Organization Department". events: 10日 中共中央组织部发出《关于中央、国家机关不属于中央管理的干部享受司局长级待遇的审批原则和办法的通知》。《通知》规定:经中央或国务院批准设立的相当于部、委司局级机构(不包括京外单位),担任这些机构中党、政正副职的干部,原则上可享受司局长级干部待遇。按处级干部配备的副职,不能提高其待遇。
translated_text: On the 10th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on the Approval Principles and Methods for the Central and State Organs Cadres Not Under the Central Management to Enjoy the Treatment of Directors and Bureau-level Cadres". The "Notice" stipulates that in principle, cadres who hold the positions of Party and government chief and deputy chief in agencies equivalent to ministries and commissions and approved by the Central Committee or the State Council (excluding units outside Beijing) can enjoy the treatment of directors and bureau-level cadres. Deputy positions assigned to division-level cadres cannot have their treatment increased. Cadres who have served as directors and bureau-level positions and were later transferred to lower positions due to work needs (excluding those who were demoted due to punishment) will not have their original treatment unchanged. Cadres who participated in revolutionary work before the founding of the People's Republic of China and are currently or have served as directors and bureau-level positions (excluding those who were demoted due to punishment) with a salary level of fourteen can enjoy the treatment of deputy directors and bureau-level cadres.

events: 曾经担任过司局长级职务,后因工作需要(不包括受处分降职使用的调任较低职务的干部,原待遇不变。建国前参加革命工作,现任或曾任正处长级职务(不包括受处分降职使用的),工资级别为十四级的干部,可享受副局长级待遇。
translated_text: On the 10th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on the Approval Principles and Methods for the Central and State Organs Cadres Not Under the Central Management to Enjoy the Treatment of Directors and Bureau-level Cadres". The "Notice" stipulates that in principle, cadres who hold the positions of Party and government chief and deputy chief in agencies equivalent to ministries and commissions and approved by the Central Committee or the State Council (excluding units outside Beijing) can enjoy the treatment of directors and bureau-level cadres. Deputy positions assigned to division-level cadres cannot have their treatment increased. events: 1984年1月10日至20日,中共中央组织部和劳动人事部举行全国党政机关实行岗位责任制座谈会。各省、自治区、直辖市组织部长、人事局长和中央国家机关各部委组织、干部部门的负责同志参加了会议。会议提出,党政机关､群众团体、事业单位要普遍建立岗位责任制。指出建立岗位责任制是深入进行机构改革必不可少的一个重要步骤。中共中央书记处书记宋任穷到会讲制了话,国务院副总理田纪云出席了会议。
translated_text: From January 10 to 20, 1984, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the Ministry of Labor and Personnel held a symposium on the implementation of the post responsibility system in the party and government organs across the country. The heads of the organization departments and personnel bureaus of provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the central government and the responsible comrades of the organization and cadre departments of the ministries and commissions of the central state organs attended the meeting. The meeting proposed that the party and government organs, mass organizations and public institutions should generally establish the post responsibility system. It was pointed out that the establishment of the post responsibility system is an important and indispensable step in deepening institutional reform. Song Renqiong, Secretary of the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee, spoke at the meeting, and Tian Jiyun, Vice Premier of the State Council, attended the meeting.

events:
25日 中共中央批准,胡开明任河北省顾问委员会副主
任,免去其安徽省顾问委员会副主任职务。
translated_text: On the 25th, the CPC Central Committee approved Hu Kaiming to serve as the deputy director of the Hebei Provincial Advisory Committee and to be relieved of his post as the deputy director of the Anhui Provincial Advisory Committee.

events:
27日 中共中央组织部、中共中央宣传部、劳动人事部、
财政部联合发出《优先提高有突出贡献的中青年科学、技术、管
理专家生活待遇的通知》。根据中央书记处的指示,《通知》“对那
些在国内外有名望的中青年科学家生活待遇方面的问题,如工资
问题、级别问题、住房问题,两地分居问题,医疗问题等”作了
具体规定。1984年国家为提高这部分同志的生活待遇拨专款30
万元。
translated_text: On the 27th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Propaganda Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Ministry of Labor and Personnel, and the Ministry of Finance jointly issued the "Notice on Prioritizing the Improvement of Living Benefits for Young and Middle-aged Scientific, Technical, and Management Experts with Outstanding Contributions". According to the instructions of the Central Secretariat, the "Notice" made specific provisions on "issues related to the living benefits of young and middle-aged scientists who are famous at home and abroad, such as salary issues, rank issues, housing issues, separation issues, medical issues, etc." In 1984, the state allocated a special fund of 300,000 yuan to improve the living benefits of these comrades.

events: 30日 中共中央同意,杨重扬任农牧渔业部副部长。
translated_text: On the 30th, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China agreed to appoint Yang Chongyang as Vice Minister of Agriculture, Animal Husbandry and Fisheries.

events:
5日 久经考验的共产主义战士、党和军队的优秀领导人、
无产阶级革命家、杰出的军事家、中央顾问委员会常务委员粟
裕,因病在北京逝世,终年76岁。
translated_text: On the 5th, Su Yu, a time-tested communist fighter, an outstanding leader of the Party and the army, a proletarian revolutionary, an outstanding military strategist, and a standing member of the Central Advisory Committee, died of illness in Beijing at the age of 76.

events:
11日 中共中央组织部转发共青团中央《关于协助党委建
立省级团委后备干部制度的意见》。要求各省、市、自治区党委
组织部帮助、指导团委选好后备干部名单。
translated_text: On the 11th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee forwarded the Communist Youth League Central Committee's "Opinions on Assisting Party Committees in Establishing a Provincial Youth League Committee Reserve Cadre System". It required the Organization Departments of the Party Committees of provinces, cities, and autonomous regions to help and guide the Youth League Committees in selecting a list of reserve cadres.

events: 14日 全国政协副主席周叔弢在天津逝世,终年93岁。
translated_text: On the 14th, Zhou Shutao, Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, passed away in Tianjin at the age of 93.

events:
15日 中共中央组织部发出《关于加强中外合资经营企业
党的工作的几点意见》。《意见》指出,上级主管部门要切实加强
对合营企业的指导、帮助和监督;派到企业的我方领导人要认真
贯彻党的方针、政策和国家的法律、法令,执行双方签订的合
同、章程,正确地行使职权;企业中的党组织要根据合营企业的
特点开展经常活动,加强思想政治工作,使党的路线、方针、政
策在合营企业中得到正确的贯彻执行。
中共中央组织部、中共中央政法委员会、劳动人事部、财政
部、司法部联合发出《关于迅速为劳改、劳教部门配备干部的通
知》。要求为劳改、劳教单位充实干部6万名。
translated_text: On the 15th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued "Several Opinions on Strengthening the Party's Work in Sino-foreign Joint Ventures". The "Opinions" pointed out that the superior competent departments should effectively strengthen the guidance, assistance and supervision of the joint ventures; the leaders sent to the enterprises should conscientiously implement the party's principles, policies and national laws and decrees, implement the contracts and charters signed by both parties, and correctly exercise their powers; the party organizations in the enterprises should carry out regular activities according to the characteristics of the joint ventures, strengthen ideological and political work, and ensure that the party's line, principles and policies are correctly implemented in the joint ventures. The Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Political and Legal Affairs Commission of the CPC Central Committee, the Ministry of Labor and Personnel, the Ministry of Finance, and the Ministry of Justice jointly issued the "Notice on Rapidly Allocating Cadres to Labor Reform and Reeducation-through-Labor Departments". It is required to supplement 60,000 cadres for labor reform and reeducation-through-labor units.

events:
23日在中共新疆维吾尔自治区第三届第一次会议上,选
举王恩茂为自治区党委第一书记,司马义·艾买提、铁木尔·达
瓦买提、祁果、李嘉玉、贾那布尔为书记。自治区顾问委员会全
体会议选举白成铭为自治区顾问委员会主任。
translated_text: On the 23rd, at the first meeting of the third Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region Communist Party, Wang Enmao was elected as the first secretary of the autonomous region party committee, and Simayi Aimaiti, Timur Dawamat, Qi Guo, Li Jiayu, and Janabul were elected as secretaries. The plenary meeting of the autonomous region advisory committee elected Bai Chengming as the director of the autonomous region advisory committee.

events:
29日 中共中央组织部、劳动人事部、国家科学技术委员
会、中国科学技术协会、中直机关党委、国家机关党委联合发出
《关于举办新技术革命知识讲座的通知》。其目的是为了提高广大
干部,特别是高、中级领导干部,对正在兴起的技术革命及其对
社会的影响有所认识,对当代新兴产业群的形成和发展有所了
解。讲座分两个阶段进行,每个阶段分十讲。
translated_text: On the 29th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Ministry of Labor and Personnel, the National Science and Technology Commission, the China Association for Science and Technology, the Party Committee of the Central Government Agencies, and the Party Committee of the State Agencies jointly issued the "Notice on Holding Lectures on New Technology Revolution Knowledge". The purpose is to improve the understanding of the cadres, especially the senior and middle-level leaders, on the emerging technology revolution and its impact on society, and to understand the formation and development of contemporary emerging industrial clusters. The lectures are divided into two stages, each with ten lectures.

events:
4日 中共中央整党工作指导委员会发出《关于对照检查阶
段必须注意的若干事项的通知》。《通知》指出,对照检查,是这
次整党的关键阶段;对照检查要自上而下地进行,领导班子必须
作出表率;要认真开展批评与自我批评;要防止走过场;要坚持
边整边的方针。
translated_text: On the 4th, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China's Party Consolidation Work Steering Committee issued a "Notice on Several Matters that Must Be Paid Attention to During the Comparison and Inspection Phase". The "Notice" pointed out that comparison and inspection is the key stage of this party rectification; comparison and inspection should be carried out from top to bottom, and the leadership team must set an example; criticism and self-criticism should be carried out seriously; formalities should be avoided; and the policy of rectification while doing so should be adhered to.

events:
14日 中共中央组织部发出《关于各级组织、干部部门要
切实抓好企业领导班子整顿和建设的通知》。《通知》指出,目
前,一些组织、干部部门还存在只重视党政干部,不重视经济、
技术干部的现象,对企业领导班子的调整工作不够关心;组织、
干部部门中,具有经济工作经验和专业技术知识的人还比较少。
这种状况很不适应四化建设新形势的需要。《通知》要求,今年
内做好三项主要工作:(一)抓好全国三千个大中型骨干企业领
导班子的思想、业务建设和进一步完善组织建设,厂长、党委书
记的配备,要实现高文化结构;(二)建立培养企业后备干部的
制度;(三)调整好中小型企业的领导班子。
translated_text: On the 14th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on Organizations and Cadres at All Levels to Effectively Grasp the Rectification and Construction of Enterprise Leadership Teams". The "Notice" pointed out that at present, some organizations and cadres departments still only pay attention to party and government cadres, but not to economic and technical cadres, and are not concerned enough about the adjustment of enterprise leadership teams; there are relatively few people with economic work experience and professional and technical knowledge in the organization and cadres departments. This situation is not in line with the needs of the new situation of the Four Modernizations. The "Notice" requires that three major tasks be completed this year: (1) Grasp the ideological and business construction of the leadership teams of 3,000 large and medium-sized backbone enterprises across the country and further improve the organizational construction, and the staffing of factory directors and party committee secretaries must achieve a high cultural structure; (2) Establish a system for cultivating enterprise reserve cadres; (3) Adjust the leadership teams of small and medium-sized enterprises.

events: 20日 中共中央书记处开会讨论中央组织部《关于国务院侨务办公室领导班子调整配备的请示报告》,要求中组部和侨办继续考虑,提拔年轻的同志担任侨办的书记和主任。今后在干部使用问题上,凡是已退下来的同志,除非特殊需要,一般都不再安排到第一线任职。
translated_text: On the 20th, the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee held a meeting to discuss the Central Organization Department's "Request Report on the Adjustment of the Leadership Team of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council", requiring the Central Organization Department and the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office to continue to consider promoting young comrades to serve as secretaries and directors of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office. In the future, when it comes to the use of cadres, all retired comrades will generally no longer be assigned to the front line unless there is a special need.

events: 21日 中共中央同意,金鑫任国家税务总局局长。
translated_text: On the 21st, the CPC Central Committee agreed to appoint Jin Xin as the Director of the State Administration of Taxation.

events:
22日 中共中央批准,严东生任中国科学院党组书记,并
同意其任副院长;同意卢嘉锡、周光召、孙鸿烈任副院长。
translated_text: On the 22nd, the CPC Central Committee approved Yan Dongsheng as the Party Secretary of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and approved him as Vice President; approved Lu Jiaxi, Zhou Guangzhao, and Sun Honglie as Vice Presidents.

events:
28日 中共中央同意,刘纪原任航天工业部副部长;批准
金冲及任中共中央文献研究室副主任。
translated_text: On the 28th, the CPC Central Committee agreed to appoint Liu Jiyuan as Vice Minister of the Ministry of Aerospace Industry and approved Jin Chongji as Deputy Director of the CPC Central Committee Literature Research Office.

events:
5日 中共中央书记处讨论并原则同意中央组织部关于中共
中央、国务院《关于改变中央和国家机关直接从应届大专毕业生
中吸收干部的办法的通知》的请示报告。会议决定,请中央组织
部尽快研究制定一套干部升迁、轮换、交流、奖惩的制度。30
日,中共中央、国务院发出《关于改变中央和国家机关直接从应
届大专毕业生中吸收干部的办法的通知》。中央决定,从1985年
开始,中央和国家机关原则上不再直接从应届大专院校毕业生中
吸收干部。所需干部,各部门可以根据自己的工作性质、任务和
干部“四化”的要求,在国家规定的编制数额内,按照有关部门批
准的补充干部的指标,从北京和京外择优挑选经过三年以上基层
工作锻炼,具有大专毕业文化程度的干部。有直属单位的,一般
应从所属基层单位选用;没有直属单位的,通过组织、人事部门
从本系统或其他基层单位选调。一般行政事务干部,应在北京就
地选调。4月30日,中共中央、国务院专门就这个问题发了通
知。
translated_text: On the 5th, the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee discussed and agreed in principle to the Central Organization Department's request report on the CPC Central Committee and the State Council's "Notice on Changing the Methods of Central and State Organs Directly Recruiting Cadres from Fresh College Graduates". The meeting decided to ask the Central Organization Department to study and formulate a set of systems for cadre promotion, rotation, exchange, rewards and punishments as soon as possible. On the 30th, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued the "Notice on Changing the Methods of Central and State Organs Directly Recruiting Cadres from Fresh College Graduates". The Central Committee decided that starting from 1985, the central and state organs would no longer directly recruit cadres from fresh college graduates in principle. For the required cadres, each department can select the cadres who have been trained in grassroots work for more than three years and have a college degree from Beijing and outside Beijing within the establishment quota stipulated by the state and in accordance with the indicators for supplementary cadres approved by the relevant departments. If there are directly affiliated units, they should generally be selected from the affiliated grassroots units; if there are no directly affiliated units, they should be selected from the system or other grassroots units through the organization and personnel departments. General administrative cadres should be selected and transferred locally in Beijing. On April 30, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued a special notice on this issue.

events:
10日 中共中央同意,叶飞、庄希泉任全国侨联第三届委
员会名誉主席,刘国基为主席,王汉杰、刘念智、庄世平、庄明
理、连贯、萧岗、吴恒兴、陈明、陈宗基、蚁美厚、洪丝丝、郭
棣活、郭瑞人、黄军军、黄登保、黄鼎臣、廖灿辉为副主席。
translated_text: On the 10th, the CPC Central Committee agreed that Ye Fei and Zhuang Xiquan would serve as honorary chairmen of the Third Committee of the All-China Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese, Liu Guoji would serve as chairman, and Wang Hanjie, Liu Nianzhi, Zhuang Shiping, Zhuang Mingli, Lian Guan, Xiao Gang, Wu Hengxing, Chen Ming, Chen Zongji, Yi Meihou, Hong Sisi, Guo Dihuo, Guo Ruiren, Huang Junjun, Huang Dengbao, Huang Dingchen, and Liao Canhui would serve as vice chairmen.

events:
12日 中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅发出《关于派遣留
学人员工作的几个问题的通知》。《通知》规定,(一)进一步明
确派遣留学人员工作的方针。(二)今后留学人员工作由中央引
进国外智力领导小组统一归口领导。(三)在今年下半年召开一
次全国留学人员工作会议,总结经验,统一思想,制订和完善各
项规章制度。
translated_text: On the 12th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council issued the "Notice on Several Issues Concerning the Work of Sending Overseas Students". The "Notice" stipulates that (a) the policy of sending overseas students will be further clarified. (b) In the future, the work of overseas students will be under the unified leadership of the Central Leading Group for Introducing Foreign Intelligence. (c) A national conference on overseas students will be held in the second half of this year to summarize experience, unify ideas, and formulate and improve various rules and regulations.

events:
14日 中共中央同意,廖晖任国务院侨务办公室主任,并
批准其为党组书记。
translated_text: On the 14th, the CPC Central Committee agreed to appoint Liao Hui as the director of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council and approved him as the secretary of the Party Group.

events: 16日 中共中央组织部发出《关于转发江苏省委组织部<关于“文化大革命”前冤假错案摸底排队和复查工作安排情况的报告>的通知》。《通知》指出,江苏的做法可供各地参考。各级党委组织部门应当在党委的统一领导下,协同有关部门抓紧抓好落实干部政策的工作,务必把一切尚未纠正的冤假错案坚决改正过来。
translated_text: On the 16th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued a "Notice on Forwarding the Report of the Organization Department of the Jiangsu Provincial Committee on the Arrangements for the Investigation, Queuing and Reexamination of Unjust, False and Wrong Cases before the Cultural Revolution". The "Notice" pointed out that Jiangsu's approach can be used as a reference for all localities. Party committee organization departments at all levels should, under the unified leadership of the party committee, coordinate with relevant departments to implement cadre policies and resolutely correct all unjust, false and wrong cases that have not yet been corrected. The CPC Central Committee agreed that Mo Yanzhong would be the deputy director of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council and approved him as the deputy secretary of the party group; and agreed that Zhuang Yanlin would be the deputy director.

events: 中共中央同意,莫燕忠任国务院侨务办公室副主任,并批准其为党组副书记;同意庄炎林任副主任。
translated_text: On the 16th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued a "Notice on Forwarding the Report of the Organization Department of the Jiangsu Provincial Committee on the Arrangements for the Investigation, Queuing and Reexamination of Unjust, False and Wrong Cases before the Cultural Revolution". The "Notice" pointed out that Jiangsu's approach can be used as a reference for all localities. Party committee organization departments at all levels should, under the unified leadership of the party committee, coordinate with relevant departments to implement cadre policies and resolutely correct all unjust, false and wrong cases that have not yet been corrected. The CPC Central Committee agreed that Mo Yanzhong would be the deputy director of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council and approved him as the deputy secretary of the party group; and agreed that Zhuang Yanlin would be the deputy director.

events:
20日 中共中央批准,免去周光春广西壮族自治区党委副
书记、顾问委员会主任职务;任命覃应机为广西壮族自治区顾问
委员会主任,同意免去其自治区政协主席职务;同意免去钟枫自
治区人大常委会副主任职务。
translated_text: On the 20th, the CPC Central Committee approved the removal of Zhou Guangchun from his post as deputy secretary of the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Party Committee and director of the Advisory Committee; appointed Tan Yingji as director of the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Advisory Committee and agreed to remove him from his post as chairman of the Autonomous Region CPPCC; and agreed to remove Zhong Feng from his post as deputy director of the Autonomous Region People's Congress Standing Committee.

events:
23日 中共中央书记处最近两次开会,讨论中央组织部的
《汇报提纲》和中央组织部报送的《中共中央关于建立县以上党
政机关领导干部交流制度的决定(代拟稿)》。会议指出,党的十
一届三中全会以来,我们党在干部工作上进行了一些革命性的变
革,主要是废除了领导干部职务终身制,提出了干部队伍要实现
“四化”,使全党组织工作的面貌为之一新。总的来讲,组织工作
(主要是干部工作)现在是建国以来最好的时期之一,也是拨乱
反正、开创党的工作新局面的重要组成部分。但是,目前就全国
组织部门的工作来讲,还不能适应新的历史时期的需要,特别是
在提拔有知识、有闯劲,年轻的干部问题上,阻力还相当大,各
级组织部门都应该在这方面起带头作用。会议要求组织部门:在
干部工作上,今后要继续贯彻执行中央的方针、政策,抓紧落实
知识分子政策。考虑到中央机关和省级机关正在进行整党,关于
建立干部交流制度的决定,暂缓下发。
translated_text: On the 23rd, the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee held two meetings recently to discuss the "Report Outline" of the Central Organization Department and the "Decision of the CPC Central Committee on Establishing a System for the Exchange of Leading Cadres in Party and Government Organs at or above the County Level (Draft)" submitted by the Central Organization Department. The meeting pointed out that since the Third Plenary Session of the 11th CPC Central Committee, our party has made some revolutionary changes in cadre work, mainly abolishing the lifetime tenure of leading cadres and proposing that the cadre team should achieve "four modernizations", which has brought a new look to the work of the entire party organization. Generally speaking, organizational work (mainly cadre work) is now one of the best periods since the founding of the People's Republic of China, and it is also an important part of correcting the wrongs and creating a new situation in the party's work. However, at present, the work of the national organization departments cannot meet the needs of the new historical period, especially in the issue of promoting knowledgeable, enterprising and young cadres. The resistance is still quite large, and the organization departments at all levels should take the lead in this regard. The meeting required the organization departments: In the future, in terms of cadre work, we must continue to implement the central government's principles and policies and speed up the implementation of the intellectual policy. Considering that the central and provincial organs are undergoing party rectification, the decision on establishing a cadre exchange system will be temporarily postponed.

events:
26日 中共中央发出《关于任免国家机关领导人员必须严
格依照法律程序办理的通知》。《通知》指出,各级国家机关的领
导人员由本级人民代表大会选举产生或由它的常务委员会决定任
免,是宪法和法律赋予它的职权。我们党领导人民制定了宪法和
法律,也要领导人民执行宪法和法律。党组织的一切活动都不能
违背宪法和法律的规定,这是党和国家政治生活中必须遵守的一
个基本原则,必须引起各级党委的高度重视。
中共中央书记处召开会议,讨论中央组织部《关于调整部分
省市自治区党政领导班子的初步设想》。会议指出,从党的十二
大以来,我们对调整省、部级领导班子等工作取得了很大的成
绩,开创了干部工作的新局面。但是,总的来看,这几年调整中
央和省一级领导班子的步子不是大了,而是小了点。因此,今明
两年要进一步解放思想,步子迈大一些,求得经过这一次的调
整,使中央和省一级领导班子能够稳定五至八年。从现在开始到
明年全国党代表会议,中央机关应进行一次较大的调整,上来一
批年轻同志,退出一批老同志。选拔年轻干部时,要注意选拔那
些经过基层锻炼、有实际工作经验、思想上能吃苦、好学上进的
优秀干部。退出第一线的老同志,不要再去干预现任领导班子的
工作。
translated_text: On the 26th, the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on the Appointment and Removal of State Organ Leaders Must Be Strictly Handled in Accordance with Legal Procedures". The "Notice" pointed out that the leaders of state organs at all levels are elected by the people's congresses at the same level or appointed and removed by their standing committees, which is the power granted to them by the Constitution and laws. Our party led the people to formulate the Constitution and laws, and must also lead the people to implement the Constitution and laws. All activities of the party organization must not violate the provisions of the Constitution and laws. This is a basic principle that must be observed in the political life of the party and the country, and must be highly valued by party committees at all levels. The Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee held a meeting to discuss the "Preliminary Idea on Adjusting the Party and Government Leadership Teams of Some Provinces, Cities and Autonomous Regions" of the Central Organization Department. The meeting pointed out that since the 12th CPC National Congress, we have made great achievements in adjusting the provincial and ministerial leadership teams and created a new situation in cadre work. However, generally speaking, the steps taken to adjust the central and provincial leadership teams in recent years have not been big, but a little small. Therefore, we should further emancipate our minds and take bigger steps in the next two years, so that the central and provincial leadership teams can be stable for five to eight years after this adjustment. From now until the National Party Congress next year, the central organs should make a major adjustment, with a group of young comrades coming up and a group of old comrades retiring. When selecting young cadres, we should pay attention to selecting outstanding cadres who have been trained at the grassroots level, have practical work experience, are able to endure hardships, and are eager to learn and make progress. Old comrades who have retired from the front line should not interfere with the work of the current leadership team.

events: 1984年4月26日,中共中央发出《关于任免国家机关领导人员必须严格革依照法律程序办理的通知》。通知重申:任免国家机关领导人员必须严格按照宪法和法律规定的程序办理,并下发了中央组织部于1983年9月8日制定的《关于任免国家机关和其他行政领导职务必须按照法律程序和有关规定办理的通知》,要求各地、各部门贯彻执行。
translated_text: On April 26, 1984, the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on the Appointment and Removal of State Organ Leaders Must Be Strictly Carried out in Accordance with Legal Procedures". The notice reiterated that the appointment and removal of state organ leaders must be strictly carried out in accordance with the procedures prescribed by the Constitution and laws, and issued the "Notice on the Appointment and Removal of State Organs and Other Administrative Leadership Posts Must Be Carried out in Accordance with Legal Procedures and Relevant Regulations" formulated by the Central Organization Department on September 8, 1983, requiring all localities and departments to implement it.

events: 30日 中共中央书记处召开会议,讨论中央组织部、劳动人事部党组就《关于实行机关工作岗位责任制的决定》和《关于人事制度若干问题的改革意见》两个文件的请示报告。会议指出,目前全国各级机关普遍实行岗位责任制的条件尚不具备,中央转发这个文件的时机还不成熟。各级党的组织部门、政府的人事部门,今后两、三年内,主要应抓好以下四件事情:1.要狠抓领导班子的调整工作,选拔优秀的年轻干部,安排好老干部。2.要扎扎实实地完成清理“三种人”的工作。3. 要狠抓干部政策的落实,特别是要落实好知识分子干部、归侨、起义人员的政策,不留尾巴。4.结合整党,克服以权谋私、官僚主义等歪风邪气;要注重调查研究,深入解决实际问题,不作表面文章。
translated_text: On the 30th, the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee held a meeting to discuss the request reports of the Party Groups of the Central Organization Department and the Ministry of Labor and Personnel on the two documents, "Decision on the Implementation of the Post Responsibility System for Work in Institutions" and "Opinions on the Reform of Certain Issues in the Personnel System". The meeting pointed out that the conditions for the universal implementation of the post responsibility system in institutions at all levels across the country are not yet in place, and the time is not yet ripe for the central government to forward this document. In the next two or three years, the party organization departments and government personnel departments at all levels should focus on the following four things: 1. Pay close attention to the adjustment of the leadership team, select outstanding young cadres, and arrange for old cadres. 2. Complete the work of cleaning up the "three types of people" in a down-to-earth manner. 3. Pay close attention to the implementation of cadre policies, especially the implementation of policies for intellectual cadres, returned overseas Chinese, and uprising personnel, and leave no tails. 4. Combine the rectification of the party and overcome the evil tendencies such as abuse of power for personal gain and bureaucracy; focus on investigation and research, and solve practical problems in depth, without superficial work. The CPC Central Committee appointed Qiao Shi as the Minister of the CPC Central Organization Department and removed him from his post as Director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee; appointed Wang Zhaoguo as Director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee, with Hu Jintao as the Standing Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Youth League; and removed Chen Ye from his post as Minister of the CPC Central Organization Department and appointed him as an advisor to the Central Organization Department.

events: 1984年4月30日,中共中央､国务院发出《关于改变中央和国家机关直接从应届大专毕业生中招收干部的办法的通知》。决定从1985年开始,中央和国家机关原则上不再直接从应届大专院校毕业生中吸收干部。所需干部,各部门可根据自己的工作性质、任务和干部“四化”的要求,在国家规定的编制数额内,按照有关部门批准的补充干部的标准,从北京或京外择优挑选经过三年以上基层工作锻炼、具有大专毕业文化程度的干部。有直属单位的,一般应从所属基层单位选调;没有直属单位的,通过组织人事部门从本系统或其他基层单位选调。一般行政事务干部,应在北京就地选调。有些专业性很强的工种,如确实需要直接从应届大专毕业生中挑选的,经批准可以在下达指标范围内选用。
translated_text: On April 30, 1984, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued the "Notice on Changing the Method of Directly Recruiting Cadres from Fresh College Graduates in Central and State Organs". It was decided that starting from 1985, the central and state organs would no longer directly recruit cadres from fresh college graduates in principle. For the cadres needed, each department can select the cadres who have been trained in grassroots work for more than three years and have a college degree from Beijing or outside Beijing according to the nature of their work, tasks and the requirements of the "four modernizations" of cadres, within the establishment quota stipulated by the state and in accordance with the standards for supplementary cadres approved by the relevant departments. If there are directly affiliated units, they should generally be selected from the affiliated grassroots units; if there are no directly affiliated units, they should be selected from the system or other grassroots units through the organization and personnel department. General administrative affairs cadres should be selected locally in Beijing. For some highly professional jobs, if they really need to be directly selected from fresh college graduates, they can be selected within the scope of the issued indicators with approval.

events:
18日 中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅发出《认真搞好国
营工业企业领导体制改革试点工作的通知》。中央书记处指出,
当前我国国营企业存在的一个突出的问题是无人负责,实际上是
无权负责,无法负责,无力负责。为了改变这种状况,必须积极
改革国营工业企业领导体制,在生产经营和行政管理工作方面实
行厂长(经理)负责制。为了制定好国营工业企业法,决定选择
一百多个工业企业和一两个中等城市进行改革工厂领导体制的试
点。确定辽宁省大连市和江苏省常州市的国营工业企业普遍进行
这项改革;同时在北京、天津、上海、沈阳等四城市选择一批企
业进行试点。其他省、自治区,有条件的也可以自选少数企业进
行试点。
translated_text: On the 18th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council issued the "Notice on Earnestly Carrying out Pilot Work on the Reform of the Leadership System of State-owned Industrial Enterprises". The Central Secretariat pointed out that a prominent problem in my country's state-owned enterprises at present is that no one is responsible, in fact, they have no right to be responsible, cannot be responsible, and are unable to be responsible. In order to change this situation, it is necessary to actively reform the leadership system of state-owned industrial enterprises and implement the factory director (manager) responsibility system in production, operation and administrative management. In order to formulate a good law on state-owned industrial enterprises, it was decided to select more than 100 industrial enterprises and one or two medium-sized cities to carry out pilot reforms of the factory leadership system. It was determined that state-owned industrial enterprises in Dalian, Liaoning Province and Changzhou, Jiangsu Province would generally carry out this reform; at the same time, a group of enterprises in Beijing, Tianjin, Shanghai, Shenyang and other four cities would be selected for pilot projects. Other provinces and autonomous regions, if conditions permit, can also select a small number of enterprises for pilot projects.

events:
21日 中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅发出《关于控制各
种纪念活动的通知》。《通知》指出,对党和国家历史上做出过重
大贡献的人物和值得纪念的事件,举办适当的纪念活动是必要
的,但这种活动越来越多,规模越来越大,既长形式主义,又
有损于党和国家的形象。《通知》规定,今后对历史人物的纪念
应控制在他们的诞辰或逝世逢十、逢百周年时进行,一般发表纪
念性文章即可;具有全国或国际意义的重大历史事件的纪念活
动,由中宣部或省一级党委提出方案,报党中央批准后执行;各
种纪念活动都要有助于推动生产和工作,力戒浮夸、铺张、形式
主义和表面文章。
translated_text: On the 21st, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council issued the "Notice on Controlling Various Commemorative Activities". The "Notice" pointed out that it is necessary to hold appropriate commemorative activities for people who have made great contributions to the history of the Party and the country and events worth remembering, but such activities are becoming more and more numerous and larger in scale, which is both formalistic and detrimental to the image of the Party and the country. The "Notice" stipulates that in the future, commemoration of historical figures should be controlled on the tenth or centenary of their birth or death, and generally commemorative articles can be published; commemorative activities for major historical events of national or international significance shall be proposed by the Central Propaganda Department or provincial party committees, and implemented after approval by the Party Central Committee; various commemorative activities shall help promote production and work, and strive to avoid exaggeration, extravagance, formalism and superficiality.

events:
24日 中共中央书记处召开会议,讨论并原则同意《中共
中央组织部对国家经委党组建议党中央成立经济工作机构的意
见》。会议认为,企业的思想政治工作确实需要加强,但是应该
依靠各省、自治区、直辖市党委特别是企业党组织来进行这项工
作,中央没有必要专门成立做思想政治工作的机构。目前中央、
国家机关机构仍然过多,还需要进行精简
translated_text: On the 24th, the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee held a meeting to discuss and agree in principle on the "Opinions of the CPC Central Organization Department on the State Economic Commission Party Group's Suggestion on the Party Central Committee to Establish an Economic Work Organization". The meeting believed that the ideological and political work of enterprises does need to be strengthened, but it should rely on the provincial, autonomous region, and municipal party committees, especially the enterprise party organizations, to carry out this work. The central government does not need to set up a special organization for ideological and political work. At present, there are still too many central and state organs and institutions, and they need to be streamlined.

events: 1984年6月30日,中共中央组织部、劳动人事部联合发出《关于逐步推行机关工作岗位责任制的通知》提出,推行岗位责任制,必须从实际出发,讲求实效。各级党政机关的情况不同,同一机关各部门的工作也有差异,应根据各自的特点和需要,选择最适合本单位情况的岗位责任制。如有的可采取职责任务考评责任制,有的可采用专业岗位责任制或技术承包责任制,有的可采用联系经济效益的岗位责任制等等。制定和实行岗位责任制,形式可以多种多样。不论采取何种形式,都必须有利于实现整党的目标和推进经济领域里的改革,有利于政企分工、党政分工,真正解决机关中职责不清、分工不明、推诿扯皮､干好干坏一个样等问题,绝不能搞形式主义。
translated_text: On June 30, 1984, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the Ministry of Labor and Personnel jointly issued the "Notice on the Gradual Implementation of the Job Responsibility System in Government Agencies", proposing that the implementation of the job responsibility system must proceed from reality and emphasize effectiveness. The situations of party and government agencies at all levels are different, and the work of various departments in the same agency is also different. According to their respective characteristics and needs, they should choose the job responsibility system that best suits the situation of their units. For example, some can adopt the responsibility system for job duties and responsibilities assessment, some can adopt the professional job responsibility system or the technical contracting responsibility system, and some can adopt the job responsibility system linked to economic benefits, etc. There are many forms for formulating and implementing the job responsibility system. No matter what form is adopted, it must be conducive to achieving the goal of party rectification and promoting reforms in the economic field, conducive to the division of labor between government and enterprises, and between the party and the government, and truly solve the problems of unclear responsibilities, unclear division of labor, buck-passing, and the same treatment for good and bad work in government agencies. Formalism must not be adopted.

translated_text: On July 14, 1984, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on Revision of the List of Titles of Cadres Managed by the CPC Central Committee", pointing out that the Central Secretariat decided to reform the cadre management system, appropriately delegate the authority of cadre management, adopt a hierarchical management and responsibility-based approach, and reduce the scope of cadres managed by the central government. In principle, the central government only manages the main leading cadres at the next level, so as to manage fewer, better and more active cadres. It requires the provincial, municipal and autonomous regional party committees and the central ministries and commissions to take specific measures to do a good job in cadre management. In the work, we must resolutely implement the policy of revolutionizing, rejuvenating, knowledgeable and professionalizing the cadre team, and conscientiously and responsibly do a good job in the appointment, removal, transfer, assessment, training, review, promotion, rewards and punishment of the cadres under our management. All localities and departments should clarify their respective responsibilities, reduce the approval levels, simplify procedures and improve work efficiency.

For those who have joined these organizations as formal members and have always persisted in revolutionary work, their time of participation in revolutionary work can be counted from the date of joining these organizations. translated_text: On the 12th, according to the opinions of the central leaders, Xinhua News Agency reported the collective self-examination of the leaders of the Central Organization Department in the rectification of the Party. The self-examination focused on five aspects: (i) the steps taken in implementing the "four modernizations" of the cadre team, especially the leadership team, were not big enough, and there was a lack of initiative and innovative spirit; (ii) there was a lack of due attention to the construction of the leadership team in the economic, scientific research, cultural and educational fronts; (iii) in the implementation of the intellectual policy, some effective measures and suggestions were not put forward in time for certain problems that should be solved; (iv) there was a lack of sharpness and tenacity in promoting the reform of the cadre system; (v) the internal construction of the organs was not tight enough, and some problems were not solved in time. The collective self-examination analyzed the reasons for the above problems. First, the party's organizational work must serve the general tasks and general goals determined by the 12th National Congress of the Party. It has not completely gotten rid of the residual influence of "leftist" thinking and the constraints of some old frameworks, which has hindered the broadening of horizons and strides forward. Second, the working methods are unscientific and the work style is not in-depth. Third, the learning of new knowledge is insufficient. In response to the above problems, the collective inspection proposed specific rectification measures. The CPC Central Committee approved the Central Organization Department's "Report on the Adjustment of County-level Leadership Teams in Provinces, Autonomous Regions, and Municipalities Directly under the Central Government". The CPC Central Committee agreed with the report of the Central Organization Department and pointed out that the adjustment of county-level leadership teams across the country has achieved significant results, but there are still a few county-level party and government leadership teams that are older and less educated, and the situation of professional mismatch is still relatively common. The central government requires all localities to conduct a focused review of the adjusted county-level leadership teams, and all those that do not meet the requirements must be resolved with determination and planning.

events: 1984年9月29日,《人民日报》刊登周恩来同志1963年5月29日在中共中央和国务院直属机关负责干部会议上的报告《反对官僚主义》,要求以这个讲话为指导,反对机关中存在的官僚主义,提高工作效率。周恩来的讲话分析了官僚主义的二十种表现及其危害,指出:“官僚主义在我们执政的党内,在我们的国家机关内,的确是十分有害、非常危险的……官僚主义的态度和作风已经给我们的工作造成许多损失,如果听其发展,不坚决加以克服,必将造成更大的危害。我们绝不能容许官僚主义再继续发展下去。”
translated_text: On September 29, 1984, the People's Daily published Comrade Zhou Enlai's report "Oppose Bureaucracy" at the meeting of responsible cadres of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council on May 29, 1963, calling for the use of this speech as a guide to oppose bureaucracy in the organs and improve work efficiency. Zhou Enlai's speech analyzed 20 manifestations of bureaucracy and its harm, pointing out: "Bureaucracy is indeed very harmful and dangerous in our ruling party and in our state organs... The bureaucratic attitude and style have caused a lot of losses to our work. If we allow it to develop and do not resolutely overcome it, it will inevitably cause greater harm. We must not allow bureaucracy to continue to develop."

events:

全面或部分实行了乡(镇)干部选聘合同制,已选聘干部6万余
名。实行选聘合同制,是用人单位根据工作需要和干部条件,经
过考核,确定选聘人员,并签定合同,明确选聘人员的责、权、
利和用人单位对选聘人员承担的义务。合同期满后,双方商定是
否续聘,不续聘的回原生产或工作岗位。各地选聘的主要是乡
(镇)党、政、群机关的一般工作人员,被选聘的大多是农村和
集镇中的高中毕业生和电大、夜大、函大的毕业生。
translated_text: On the 15th, the People's Daily reported that 25 provinces, municipalities and autonomous regions across the country have fully or partially implemented the contract system for the selection and appointment of township (town) cadres, and more than 60,000 cadres have been selected and appointed. The implementation of the contract system for the selection and appointment means that the employer determines the selected personnel based on work needs and cadre conditions, and signs a contract after assessment, clarifying the responsibilities, rights and interests of the selected personnel and the obligations of the employer to the selected personnel. After the expiration of the contract, the two parties agree on whether to renew the contract. If not, the selected personnel will return to their original production or work positions. The selected personnel in various places are mainly general staff members of township (town) party, government and mass organizations. Most of the selected personnel are high school graduates and graduates of TV universities, night universities and correspondence universities in rural areas and towns.

events:

《中共中央关于经济体制改革的决定》,并决定明年9月召开党的
全国代表会议。《决定》第九条是专门讲“起用一代新人,造就一
支社会主义经济管理干部的宏大队伍”的,指出当前的迫切任务
是,大胆起用,积极培养成千上万中青年经济管理干部。各级党
委一定要细心发现和考察他们,务必不要被过了时的老观念,老
框框所束缚,不要搞烦琐哲学、求全责备,务必不要受派性和各
种闲言碎语的干扰。中央要求,1985年底以前完成企业领导班
子特别是骨干企业领导班子的调整,在不太长的时间内,要形成
一支门类齐全的、成龙配套的社会主义经济管理干部和技术干部
的宏大队伍,进行社会主义建设必须尊重知识、尊重人才。
《人民日报》发表题为《建设好企业班子,促进经济改革》
的社论。社论指出,一个好的企业领导班子,应该是政治素质
好,党性强,有事业心,作风民主、正派、内部团结,能开展批
评与自我批评;懂得党的政策,并能结合企业的实际情况,在生
产、经营活动中创造性地贯彻执行,勇于改革,能开创企业新局
面;具有较高的文化程度,专业配套,有管理好现代化企业的知
识和本领;比较年轻,精干,能稳定较长的时间;善于结合经济
活动做好思想政治工作,推进两个文明的建设。
translated_text: On the 20th, the Third Plenary Session of the 12th CPC Central Committee was held in Beijing. The plenary session unanimously adopted the "Decision of the CPC Central Committee on Economic System Reform" and decided to convene the National Party Congress in September next year. Article 9 of the "Decision" specifically talks about "employing a new generation of people and creating a large team of socialist economic management cadres", pointing out that the current urgent task is to boldly employ and actively cultivate tens of thousands of young and middle-aged economic management cadres. Party committees at all levels must carefully discover and examine them, and must not be bound by outdated old concepts and old frameworks, and must not engage in tedious philosophy and seek perfection. They must not be disturbed by factionalism and various gossips. The Central Committee requires that the adjustment of enterprise leadership teams, especially backbone enterprise leadership teams, be completed before the end of 1985. In a relatively short period of time, a large team of socialist economic management cadres and technical cadres with a full range of categories and complete matching should be formed. Respect for knowledge and talents is necessary for socialist construction. The People's Daily published an editorial entitled "Building a Good Enterprise Team and Promoting Economic Reform". The editorial pointed out that a good enterprise leadership team should have good political qualities, strong party spirit, a sense of professionalism, a democratic and upright style, internal unity, and the ability to carry out criticism and self-criticism; understand the party's policies, and can creatively implement them in production and business activities in accordance with the actual situation of the enterprise, be brave in reform, and be able to create a new situation for the enterprise; have a high level of education, professional support, and the knowledge and ability to manage modern enterprises; be relatively young, capable, and able to maintain stability for a long time; be good at combining economic activities to do a good job in ideological and political work and promote the construction of two civilizations.

events: 1984年10月20日,中共第十二届三中全会在北京举行,全会一致通过了《中共中央关于经济体制改革的决定》。提出要按照精简、统一、效能的原则,改进机关作风,提高工作人员的素质。要改变那种长期形成的领导机关不是为基层和企业服务,而是让基层和企业围着领导机关转的局面,扫除机构重叠、人浮于事、职责不清、互相扯皮的官僚主义和弊,使各级领导机关把自己的全部工作切实转移到为发展生产服务、为基层和企业服务,为国家的繁荣强盛和人民的富裕幸福服务的轨道上来。
translated_text: On October 20, 1984, the Third Plenary Session of the 12th CPC Central Committee was held in Beijing, and the plenary session unanimously adopted the "Decision of the CPC Central Committee on Economic System Reform". It proposed to improve the work style of government agencies and improve the quality of staff in accordance with the principles of streamlining, unification and efficiency. It is necessary to change the long-standing situation in which the leading organs do not serve the grassroots and enterprises, but let the grassroots and enterprises revolve around the leading organs, and eliminate the bureaucracy and malpractices of overlapping institutions, redundant personnel, unclear responsibilities, and wrangling with each other, so that the leading organs at all levels can effectively shift all their work to the track of serving the development of production, serving the grassroots and enterprises, and serving the prosperity and strength of the country and the prosperity and happiness of the people.

events: 1日 中共中央书记处召开会议,讨论并原则同意《中央组织部、中央宣传部报送“全国干部培训工作座谈会纪要”和建议成立干部教育工作小组的请示》。讨论中提出,实现干部队伍“四化”,是社会主义现代化建设事业的重要组织保证,大规模地、正规化地培训在职干部,是实现干部队伍“四化”的根本途径;干部培训工作的根本目的,是培养和造就适应社会主义现代化建设需要的合格干部;在干部培训上,优先照顾老、少、边、山、穷地区,特别是老区;在做好干部培训工作的同时,一定要细心深入地去发现和考察干部,大胆起用一代新人。会议决定成立中央干部教育领导小组,由邓力群任组长,袁宝华、杜润生、王照华、曾德林任副组长。领导小组办公室设在中央组织部。各省、自治区、直辖市党委也应成立干部教育工作领导小组。这次会议还讨论并原则同意中央组织部《关于地方县级以上党委委员、候补委员和相当于县级以上党委、党组成员的党龄问题的通知》。会议决定,对于不满党章规定党龄的优秀中青年干部,确系工作需要,省、自治区、直辖市党委可以变通执行党章关于党龄问题的规定。
translated_text: On the 1st, the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee held a meeting to discuss and agree in principle to the "Minutes of the National Cadre Training Symposium" and the request for the establishment of a cadre education working group submitted by the Central Organization Department and the Central Propaganda Department. During the discussion, it was proposed that the realization of the "four modernizations" of the cadre team is an important organizational guarantee for the cause of socialist modernization, and large-scale and regular training of in-service cadres is the fundamental way to achieve the "four modernizations" of the cadre team; the fundamental purpose of cadre training is to cultivate and create qualified cadres who meet the needs of socialist modernization; in cadre training, priority should be given to old, young, border, mountainous, and poor areas, especially old revolutionary base areas; while doing a good job in cadre training, it is necessary to carefully and deeply discover and examine cadres and boldly use a new generation of people. The meeting decided to establish a central cadre education leading group, with Deng Liqun as the leader, and Yuan Baohua, Du Runsheng, Wang Zhaohua, and Zeng Delin as deputy leaders. The leading group office is located in the Central Organization Department. The provincial, autonomous region, and municipal party committees should also establish a cadre education leading group. The meeting also discussed and agreed in principle to the Central Organization Department's "Notice on the Party Age of Local Party Committee Members and Alternate Members at or Above the County Level and Members of Party Committees and Party Groups at or Above the County Level". The meeting decided that for outstanding young and middle-aged cadres whose party age is less than the party constitution's stipulation, if it is indeed necessary for work, the provincial, autonomous region, and municipal party committees can flexibly implement the party constitution's stipulations on party age.

translated_text: On the 3rd, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued the "Decision on Prohibiting Party and Government Organs and Party and Government Officials from Engaging in Business and Running Enterprises". The "Decision" pointed out that our party and government organs, as well as the officials serving in these organs, must conscientiously perform the duties entrusted by the party and the state in the economic system reform and accelerating economic construction. Adhere to the principle of separation of government and enterprise responsibilities, separation of officials and businessmen, and promote a clean, honest, fair and upright style. It is absolutely not allowed to use the power in hand to violate the provisions of the party and the state to engage in business, set up enterprises, seek personal gain, and compete with the people. Party and government leading organs and leading comrades at all levels must keep a clear mind and resolutely put an end to the phenomenon of party and government officials engaging in business and running enterprises. The Decision made specific provisions on five issues: (1) Public funds, loans and self-raised funds of cadres in office shall not be used to run enterprises, and their economic interests shall not be linked to those of enterprises run by the masses; (2) No one may engage in business or run enterprises in the form of sole proprietorship, joint venture, part-time work, or dividends, and it is not allowed to use power to seek profits for enterprises run by their family members, relatives and friends; (3) No unit or individual may raise the salary standards of cadres in party and government organs on their own, and it is wrong to carry out self-funded salary reform; (4) Retired cadres with certain expertise may engage in technical and knowledge consulting, lectures, medical treatment and other activities with the approval of relevant departments, and receive the labor remuneration they deserve in accordance with the contract. It is not allowed to use the relationship with old comrades and old subordinates to purchase or resell scarce materials in the country. Smuggling, tax evasion, short selling and profiteering are strictly prohibited; (5) Enterprises that have been established before the decision is issued should be properly handled in accordance with the above spirit.

events: 1984年12月3日,中共中央、国务院发布《关于严禁党政机关和党政干部经商办企业的决定》。要求各级党政领导机关特别是经济部门及其领导干部更要正确发挥领导和组织经济建设的职能,坚持政企职责分开、官商分离的原则,发扬清正廉明、公道正派的作风,切实做到一心一意为发展生产服务,为企业和基层服务。决不允许运用手中的权力,违反党和国家的规定去经营商业,兴办企业,谋取私利,与民争利党政机关不得使用公款、贷款以及在职干部自筹资金,自办企业或与群众合办企业,不得在经济利益上与群众兴办的企业挂在一起。党政机关在职干部,一律不得以独资或合股、兼职取酬、搭干股分红等方式经商、办企业;也不允许利用职权为其家属、亲友所办的企业谋取利益。
translated_text: On December 3, 1984, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued the "Decision on Strictly Prohibiting Party and Government Organs and Party and Government Cadres from Doing Business and Running Enterprises". It requires that Party and government leading organs at all levels, especially economic departments and their leading cadres, should correctly play the role of leading and organizing economic construction, adhere to the principle of separation of government and enterprise responsibilities and separation of officials and businessmen, carry forward the style of being honest, upright, fair and upright, and truly serve the development of production, enterprises and grassroots with one heart and one mind. It is absolutely not allowed to use the power in hand to violate the provisions of the Party and the State to run business, start enterprises, seek personal gain, and compete with the people for benefits. Party and government organs shall not use public funds, loans, and self-raised funds by in-service cadres to run enterprises on their own or jointly run enterprises with the masses, and shall not be linked to enterprises established by the masses in terms of economic interests. In-service cadres of party and government organs shall not engage in business or run enterprises in the form of sole proprietorship or joint stock, part-time remuneration, or dividends from joint stock; nor shall they use their power to seek benefits for enterprises run by their family members, relatives and friends.
