The plenary session of the Provincial Advisory Committee elected Liu Lin as the Director of the Provincial Advisory Committee. The People's Daily reported that the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee recently held a symposium in Guiyang on solving the problem of "difficulties in joining the Party" for outstanding intellectuals. The meeting was attended by the heads of the organization departments of the Party Committees of 14 provinces and autonomous regions in the southwest, northwest, and central and southern regions. The meeting summarized some experiences and practices in further developing Party members among intellectuals in the new era, mainly: (a) Continuously eliminate the influence of "leftism" and correct the guiding ideology of developing Party members. (b) Go deep into reality, investigate and study, find problems, and solve them. (c) The Party Committee attaches great importance to it, and the main responsible comrades personally take charge of it. (d) Starting from reality, take various measures to strengthen training and education work, and develop one by one when one matures.

events:
29日 中共中央发出《批转<关于加强干部培训工作的报
告〉的通知》。中央指出,大规模地,正规培训在职干部提
高干部队伍的政治、业务素质和经营管理水平,是实现干部队伍
“四化”的根本途径之一。要求各级党委一定要立足当前,放眼未
来,下大决心,抓好干部培训这件具有战略意义的大事。
translated_text: On the 29th, the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on Approving the Report on Strengthening Cadre Training". The CPC Central Committee pointed out that large-scale and formal training of in-service cadres to improve the political, professional and management level of the cadre team is one of the fundamental ways to achieve the "four modernizations" of the cadre team. It requires Party committees at all levels to focus on the present, look to the future, make great efforts, and do a good job in cadre training, which is a strategically important event.

events: 1984年12月29日,中共中央批转中央组织部、中央宣传部《关于加强干部培训工作的报告》。报告指出,大规模地,正规化地培训在职干部,提高干部队伍的政治、业务素质和经营管理水平,是实现干部队伍“四化”的根本途径之一。干部培训工作要坚持从实际出发,注意质量,避免单纯追求指标,追求学历。对于不同层次、不同类型、不同年龄、不同文化程度的干部,要针对各自的特点确定培训目标。对于经济体制改革和国民经济发展急需的经营管理､法律､财会等方面的人才,要优先培养。对于45岁以下,不到中专文化程度的干部,要采取有力措施,加快培训速度。
translated_text: On December 29, 1984, the CPC Central Committee approved and forwarded the "Report on Strengthening Cadre Training" by the Organization Department and the Propaganda Department of the CPC Central Committee. The report pointed out that large-scale and regular training of in-service cadres and improving the political, professional and management level of the cadre team is one of the fundamental ways to achieve the "four modernizations" of the cadre team. Cadre training should adhere to the actual situation, pay attention to quality, and avoid the pursuit of indicators and academic qualifications. For cadres of different levels, types, ages and educational levels, training goals should be determined according to their respective characteristics. Priority should be given to the training of talents in management, law, accounting and other fields that are urgently needed for economic system reform and national economic development. For cadres under the age of 45 with less than a secondary technical school education, effective measures should be taken to speed up the training.

The Notice pointed out that Party Member Education Publications have developed rapidly and have become a powerful tool for strengthening Party building. It requires the Propaganda Departments and Organization Departments of local Party Committees to help the editorial departments of Party Member Education Publications to conscientiously implement the spirit of the Minutes.

events:
7日 中共中央组织部、中共中央统战部联合发出《关于确
定建国前民主党派成员参加革命工作时间和享受离休待遇的有关
规定》。《规定》要点是:(一)符合中央组织部1982年11号文
件规定的,按11号文件办理;(二)在第一届全国政协会议召开
之前,加入各民主党派的成员,一直坚持革命工作,其参加革命
工作时间可从1949年9月21日算起,享受离休待遇;(三)虽
与共产党没有直接联系,但确为革命事业做出较大贡献的民主党
派成员,其参加革命工作的时间由中央统战部审定。11月6
日,中央组织部和中央统战部又发出贯彻上述规定的《若干问题
的说明》,进一步划清哪些可以享受离休待遇,哪些不能享受离
休待遇的界限。
translated_text: On the 7th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the United Front Work Department of the CPC Central Committee jointly issued the "Regulations on Determining the Time of Participation in Revolutionary Work and Retirement Benefits for Members of Democratic Parties before the Founding of the People's Republic of China". The key points of the "Regulations" are: (1) Those who meet the requirements of Document No. 11 of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee in 1982 shall be handled in accordance with Document No. 11; (2) Before the convening of the first National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, members who joined the democratic parties and persisted in revolutionary work can enjoy retirement benefits from September 21, 1949; (3) Although they have no direct connection with the Communist Party, members of democratic parties who have made great contributions to the revolutionary cause shall have their time of participation in revolutionary work determined by the United Front Work Department of the CPC Central Committee. On November 6, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the United Front Work Department of the CPC Central Committee issued the "Explanation of Certain Issues" to implement the above regulations, further clarifying the boundaries of who can enjoy retirement benefits and who cannot enjoy retirement benefits.

events:
11日中共中央组织部发出《关于个人不得私自索取证明
材料的通知》。《通知》规定: (一)要把有关禁止个人索取证明
材料的规定及其意义传达到基层;(二)为解决入党、团、参
军,参加革命工作时间等问题进行调查时,应由干部所在单位的
党组织或人事部门负责进行;(三)证明材料必须由所在单位按
规定转交被证明人的组织上处理;(四)证明材料,必须证明
人所在单位的党组织审查,加盖公章方能有效;(五)证明人不
得徇私情写与事实不符的证明,更不能作假证;(六)过去组织
上按个人索取的不符合事实的证明材料,作出的不正确结论,应
采取适当方式加以纠正。
translated_text: On the 11th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued a "Notice on Individuals Not Being Allowed to Privately Request Certification Materials". The "Notice" stipulates: (1) The regulations and their significance regarding prohibiting individuals from requesting certification materials must be communicated to the grassroots; (2) When investigating issues such as the time of joining the party, the league, joining the army, and participating in revolutionary work, the party organization or personnel department of the cadre's unit should be responsible for conducting the investigation; (3) The certification materials must be transferred to the organization of the person being certified by the unit in accordance with regulations for processing; (4) The certification materials must be reviewed by the party organization of the unit where the certifier is located and stamped with the official seal to be effective; (5) The certifier must not write a certificate that is inconsistent with the facts for personal reasons, let alone make false testimony; (6) In the past, the incorrect conclusions drawn by the organization based on the certification materials that were inconsistent with the facts requested by individuals should be corrected in an appropriate manner.

events:
24日 中共中央组织部发出《关于补充省部级第三梯队人
选的通知》。《通知》指出,省部级第三梯队已初具规模,但还不
能适应需要,人数也未达到规定的要求。《通知》规定各省、
区、市和各部委、各人民团体按原分配数补齐缺额,上报人数应
多于缺额的三分之一。已经达到分配数额的,可增报二至五名。
今后,省部级第三梯队人选因进领导班子或因调整而造成的缺
额,均于次年三月底前补报,以保证规定的第三梯队人数。
translated_text: On the 24th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued a "Notice on Supplementing the Third Echelon of Provincial and Ministerial Level Candidates". The "Notice" pointed out that the third echelon of provincial and ministerial level has taken shape, but it cannot meet the needs and the number of people has not reached the prescribed requirements. The "Notice" stipulates that all provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities, ministries and people's organizations should fill the vacancies according to the original allocation, and the number of people reported should be more than one-third of the vacancies. If the allocation has been reached, two to five more people can be reported. In the future, the vacancies of the third echelon of provincial and ministerial level candidates due to joining the leadership team or due to adjustments shall be reported before the end of March of the following year to ensure the prescribed number of third echelons.

events:

受各种公司、中心及任何经济实体聘任为名誉董事长、顾问等职
务的要求,已经承担的宣布无效。”
translated_text: On the 28th, the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee held a meeting and decided that the central leaders "will not accept requests from various companies, centers or any economic entities to be appointed as honorary chairman, consultant or other positions, and those that have already been appointed will be declared invalid."

events: 1日 中共中央组织部发出通知,转发《关于党的地方各级代表大会若干具体问题的暂行规定》。《通知》指出,地方党的各级委员会都要按照党章规定按期召开党代表大会,对那些不按期召开党代表大会的党组织,上级党委要切实加强监督检查。《暂行规定》就代表名额及比例,代表的产生,代表资格的审查、党的委员会的委员和候补委员名额、顾委委员和主任名额、纪委委员和书记名额等16个问题,作了具体规定。中共中央发出《关于增选十二届中央委员会成员的准备工作的通知》。根据十二届三中全会决定,今年9月召开党的全国代表会议,增选中央委员会成员。为了做好这项准备工作,《通知》就增选中央委员的名额,候选人的条件以及产生办法作出了规定。
translated_text: On the 1st, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued a notice forwarding the "Interim Provisions on Certain Specific Issues of Local Party Congresses at All Levels". The "Notice" pointed out that local party committees at all levels must hold party congresses on schedule in accordance with the provisions of the party constitution, and the higher-level party committees must effectively strengthen supervision and inspection of party organizations that fail to hold party congresses on schedule. The "Interim Provisions" made specific provisions on 16 issues, including the number and proportion of representatives, the selection of representatives, the review of representative qualifications, the number of members and alternate members of the party committee, the number of advisory committee members and directors, and the number of discipline inspection committee members and secretaries. The CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on the Preparation for the Election of Members of the 12th Central Committee". According to the decision of the Third Plenary Session of the 12th Central Committee, the National Party Congress will be held in September this year to elect members of the Central Committee. In order to do a good job in this preparation, the "Notice" made provisions on the number of additional members of the Central Committee, the conditions for candidates, and the method of selection.

events:
8日 中共中央纪律检查委员会召集中央机关、国家机关各
部委和人民团体党组领导成员及纪委、纪检组负责人会议,研究
如何纠正目前经济体制改革形势下出现的新的严重不正之风问
题。会议要求,全党要严格党的纪律,做到有令必行,有禁必
止。中央各机关、国务院各部委要在纠正新的不正之风方面作表
率。
translated_text: On the 8th, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China convened a meeting of the leading members of the party groups of the central organs, ministries and commissions of state organs and people's organizations, as well as the heads of the discipline inspection committees and discipline inspection groups to study how to correct the new serious unhealthy trends that have emerged under the current economic system reform situation. The meeting required that the whole party should strictly enforce party discipline and ensure that orders must be carried out and prohibitions must be stopped. Central organs and ministries and commissions of the State Council should set an example in correcting new unhealthy trends.

events: 中共中央组织部负责人就加快干部队伍“四化”步伐、大胆起用一代新人答新华社记者和人民日报记者问。主要内容是:1982年机构改革以来,自上而下地全面调整各级领导班子,已经取得了两个重要的突破:一个是约有90万名老同志带头以实际行动废除领导职务终身制,退到二、三线;另一个是有8万多名有知识,懂专业、德才兼备的中青年干部被选拔到县以上各级领导岗位,使各级领导班子的结构发生了变化,出现了新老干部之间合作与交替的局面。当前应着重注意的是,要大胆放手地选拔政治素质好,有真才实学,富有改革创新精神,能够开创新局面的中青年干部。要着重考察选拔对象的工作实践和他们的组织领导能力。离开对工作实践的考察和比较而凭印象来选人,就很难避免失误。要继续扩大“第三梯队”,把培养和使用衔接起来,把尊重知识、尊重人才当作是一项根本性国策。
translated_text: On the 9th, the CPC Central Committee approved Feng Ling'an to serve as a member, standing committee member and secretary of the CPC Central Committee's directly affiliated organs. The head of the CPC Central Organization Department answered questions from Xinhua News Agency and People's Daily reporters on accelerating the pace of the "four modernizations" of the cadre team and boldly employing a new generation of people. The main content is: Since the institutional reform in 1982, the overall adjustment of leadership teams at all levels from top to bottom has achieved two important breakthroughs: one is that about 900,000 old comrades have taken the lead in abolishing the lifelong system of leadership positions with practical actions and retreated to the second and third lines; the other is that more than 80,000 young and middle-aged cadres with knowledge, professional knowledge, and both moral integrity and ability have been selected to leadership positions at all levels above the county level, which has changed the structure of leadership teams at all levels and has led to cooperation and alternation between new and old cadres. At present, we should pay attention to boldly selecting young and middle-aged cadres with good political qualities, real talents and knowledge, and a spirit of reform and innovation, who can create new situations. We should focus on examining the work practice of the selected objects and their organizational leadership capabilities. It is difficult to avoid mistakes if we select people based on impressions without examining and comparing their work practices. We should continue to expand the "third echelon", link up training and use, and regard respecting knowledge and talents as a fundamental national policy.

events:
11日 中共中央组织部发出《关于抓紧调整好骨干企业领
导班子等有关问题的通知》。《通知》要求:(一)还没有调整的
骨干企业领导班子,务于今年6月底前调整好;(二)正在调整
和准备调整领导班子的骨干企业,要配齐总工程师、总经济师、

行任期制,各级组织、干部部门要会同有关部门对厂长任期作出
具体规定。
translated_text: On the 11th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on the Adjustment of the Leadership Team of Key Enterprises and Other Related Issues". The "Notice" requires: (i) The leadership team of key enterprises that have not yet been adjusted must be adjusted before the end of June this year; (ii) Key enterprises that are adjusting or preparing to adjust their leadership teams must be equipped with chief engineers, chief economists, and chief accountants; (iii) The State Council has decided that from this year onwards, factory directors (managers) will implement a term system, and organizations and cadre departments at all levels must work with relevant departments to make specific regulations on the term of office of factory directors.

events:
14日 中共中央组织部发出《关于改变“文化大革命”前干
部政治历史问题审查结论审批权限的通知》。根据中央下放干部
管理权限的精神,《通知》就原属中央管理的干部有关复查改正
后的结论审批和党员党籍、党龄问题的审批,除现仍属中央管的
干部以外,其他干部改由各省、自治区、直辖市党委和中央各部
委、国家机关各部委党组审批。
translated_text: On the 14th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on Changing the Authority for Approving the Conclusions of the Review of Political and Historical Issues of Cadres before the "Cultural Revolution"". In accordance with the spirit of the central government's decentralization of cadre management authority, the "Notice" changed the approval of the conclusions of the review and correction of cadres formerly under the central government's management and the approval of party membership and party age issues to the provincial, autonomous region, and municipal party committees and the central ministries and state organs. The approval of other cadres, except for the cadres who are still under the central government's management, will be changed to the approval of the provincial, autonomous region, and municipal party committees and the central ministries and state organs.

events:
2日——7日 全国科技工作会议在北京召开。各省、市、
自治区,国务院各部门和一些重点科研单位的有关负责同志、著
名科学家等共400多人出席了会议。胡耀邦、邓小平、赵紫阳、
彭真、邓颖超等党和国家领导人出席了7日的闭幕式,并讲了
话。
邓小平在讲话中着重指出,在建设有中国特色的社会主义
时,一定要坚持发展物质文明和精神文明,坚持五讲四美三热
爱,教育全国人民做到有理想、有道德、有文化、有纪律。他还
指出,改革经济体制,最重要的,我最关心的,是人才。改革科
技体制我最关心的,还是人才。人才问题,别的不说了,今天就
讲两点。第一,能不能每年给知识分子解决一点问题,要切切实
实解决,要真见效。第二,要创造一种环境,使拔尖人才能够脱
颖而出。改革就是要创造这种环境。人才是有的。不要因为他们
不是全才,不是党员,没有学历,没有资历,就把人家埋没了。
善于发现人才,团结人才,使用人才,是领导者成熟的主要标志
之一。
translated_text: From the 2nd to the 7th, the National Science and Technology Work Conference was held in Beijing. More than 400 people, including responsible comrades and famous scientists from various provinces, municipalities, autonomous regions, departments of the State Council and some key scientific research units, attended the conference. Party and state leaders such as Hu Yaobang, Deng Xiaoping, Zhao Ziyang, Peng Zhen, and Deng Yingchao attended the closing ceremony on the 7th and delivered speeches. In his speech, Deng Xiaoping emphasized that when building socialism with Chinese characteristics, we must persist in developing material and spiritual civilization, adhere to the five stresses, four beauties and three loves, and educate the people of the whole country to have ideals, morality, culture and discipline. He also pointed out that the most important thing in reforming the economic system, and what I care most about, is talent. What I care most about in reforming the science and technology system is still talent. I won't talk about other issues about talent. Today I will talk about two points. First, can we solve a problem for intellectuals every year? We must solve it in a practical way and it must be effective. Second, we must create an environment so that outstanding talents can stand out. Reform is to create such an environment. Talents do exist. Don't bury them just because they are not all-rounders, not party members, have no education, and no qualifications. Being good at discovering talents, uniting talents, and using talents is one of the main signs of a mature leader.

别、增加机构层次、扩大人员编制,不得超越规定任命副职,更

次认真的检查清理,凡不符合规定的,要坚决采取措施加以纠
正。各地要加强对机构、编制的统一管理。中央和国务院各主管
部门不要因强调业务对口而要求地方增设机构和扩大人员编制。
translated_text: On the 24th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council issued the "Notice on Preventing Party and Government Organs from Adding Institutions and Expanding Staffing without Authorization". The "Notice" stipulates that from now on, party and government organs and mass organizations at all levels shall not add institutions, increase institutional levels, increase institutional levels, and expand staffing at will, and shall not appoint deputy positions beyond the regulations, let alone add nominal positions. All regions and departments shall conduct a serious inspection and cleanup of the institutional setup, staffing, and cadre appointments in their regions and departments in accordance with the relevant regulations of the Party and the State. Any non-compliance shall be resolutely corrected by measures. All localities shall strengthen the unified management of institutions and staffing. The competent departments of the Central Committee and the State Council shall not require localities to add institutions and expand staffing because of the emphasis on business matching.

events: 1985年6月4日,中共中央、国务院发布《关于国家机关和事业单位工作人员工资制度改革问题的通知》。从1985年7月1日起,机关、事业单位实行以职务工资为主要内容的结构工资制。这次工资制度改革的原则,一是贯彻按劳分配原则,适当体现奖勤罚懒､奖优罚劣;体现多劳多得､少劳少得;体现脑力劳动和体力劳动、复杂劳动和简单劳动、熟练劳动和非熟练劳动､繁重劳动和非繁重劳动之间的差别。二是把工作人员的工资同本人的工作职务､责任和劳绩密切联系起来。三是使工作人员的工资普遍有所增加。四是建立起正常的晋级增资制度,随着国民经济的发展,逐步提高国家机关、事业单位工作人员的实际工资水平。结构工资的组成部分是基础工资､职务工资、工龄工资和奖励工资。
translated_text: On June 4, 1985, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued the Notice on the Reform of the Wage System for Staff of State Organs and Public Institutions. From July 1, 1985, government agencies and public institutions implemented a structural wage system with position wages as the main content. The principles of this wage system reform are: first, to implement the principle of distribution according to work, appropriately reflect the reward of diligence and punishment of laziness, reward of excellence and punishment of inferiority; reflect more work, more pay, less work, less pay; reflect the difference between mental and physical labor, complex and simple labor, skilled and unskilled labor, heavy and non-heavy labor. Second, closely link the wages of staff with their job positions, responsibilities and performance. Third, generally increase the wages of staff. Fourth, establish a normal promotion and salary increase system, and gradually improve the actual wage level of staff of state organs and public institutions with the development of the national economy. The components of structural wages are basic wages, position wages, seniority wages and bonus wages.

translated_text: On the 6th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued a "Notice on Two Typical Incidents of Violation of the Regulations on the Collection, Use and Management of Party Dues". The "Notice" pointed out that the former Party Committee and Organization Department of the Machinery Bureau of Taiyuan City, Shanxi Province, who embezzled party dues, and Liu Dengling, a party member and deputy district head of Xiaoyan District, Anhua County, Hunan Province, who used his power to embezzle party dues for business, were both bad behaviors that violated party rules and laws, and it was necessary to severely deal with them and related personnel. The "Notice" requires all localities and party committees and organization departments of all departments to conduct a serious inspection of the collection, use and management of party dues, find problems and deal with them in a timely manner. The Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued a "Notice on Holding a Professional Training Course for Organizational Work". The "Notice" stipulates that within two or three years, political and professional training will be conducted in batches for leading cadres of organizational work at all levels. This training should adopt the principle of "tiered management and tiered training". The Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee is responsible for training the heads and deputy heads of the Organization Departments of the provincial (district, city) Party Committees, the heads of the departments (bureaus) of the central and state organs, and the leading cadres of large enterprises under the central government, a total of 300 people; the training of other cadres is the responsibility of various regions and departments. Time arrangement: one month of political courses, two months of professional courses and special research, one month of modern knowledge lectures, and half a month of summary, a total of four and a half months. This class will be held for 4 to 5 consecutive sessions.

国政协副主席,全国人大常委会委员,中国民主同盟中央副主

translated_text: On the 12th, Hua Luogeng, an outstanding Chinese mathematician, famous educator and social activist, Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, member of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, Vice Chairman of the Central Committee of the China Democratic League, member of the Presidium and Academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, and Vice Chairman of the China Association for Science and Technology, died of a sudden heart attack in Tokyo, Japan. events: 18日 中共中央在中南海怀仁堂举行纪念会,纪念中国共产党早期的主要领导人之一、伟大的马克思主义者瞿秋白就义50周年。中央政治局委员杨尚昆代表中共中央在会上讲话,高度评价了瞿秋白为中国革命艰难创业,为共产主义理想奋斗牺牲的崇高的献身精神和巨大的革命功绩,扫除在他生前身后横加给他的一切诬陷的灰尘,恢复和发扬瞿秋白作为中国共产主义运动史上杰出的早期领导人的光辉。
translated_text: On the 18th, the CPC Central Committee held a memorial meeting in the Huairen Hall of Zhongnanhai to commemorate the 50th anniversary of the martyrdom of Qu Qiubai, one of the main leaders of the early Communist Party of China and a great Marxist. Yang Shangkun, a member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, spoke at the meeting on behalf of the CPC Central Committee, highly praising Qu Qiubai's lofty dedication and great revolutionary achievements in his hard work for the Chinese revolution and his struggle and sacrifice for the communist ideal, sweeping away all the false accusations against him during his lifetime and after his death, and restoring and carrying forward the glory of Qu Qiubai as an outstanding early leader in the history of the Chinese communist movement. The State Council appointed Chen Muhua as the chairman of the Board of Directors of the People's Bank of China; Ho Tung-chang, Yang Haibo, Zhu Kaixuan, Liu Bin, Peng Peiyun (female), Zou Shiyan, Wang Mingda, and Liu Zhongde as deputy directors of the State Education Commission; and removed Pei Jian from the position of chairman of the Board of Directors of the People's Bank of China.

events:
22日——29日 中共中央纪律检查委员会在北京召开全国
端正党风工作经验交流会。中共中央政治局常委、中共中央纪律
检查委员会第一书记陈云在会上发表了书面讲话。他说,要使全
党同志明白,我们干的是社会主义事业,最终目的是实现共产主
义,这一点,非常重要。在党中央领导下,我们国家现在进行的
经济建设,是社会主义的经济建设、经济体制改革也是社会主义
的经济体制改革。任何一个共产党员,每时每刻都必须牢记,我
们是搞社会主义的四个现代化,不是搞别的现代化,我们进行的
事业,是社会主义事业。要充分认识到,社会主义精神文明的建
设,关键是执政党要有好的党风;要提高共产党员的素质,要加
强共产党员的党性教育。
translated_text: From the 22nd to the 29th, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China held a national exchange meeting on the experience of rectifying the party style in Beijing. Chen Yun, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China and first secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China, delivered a written speech at the meeting. He said that it is very important to make all party comrades understand that what we are doing is the cause of socialism and the ultimate goal is to realize communism. Under the leadership of the Party Central Committee, the economic construction that our country is currently carrying out is socialist economic construction, and the economic system reform is also socialist economic system reform. Any Communist Party member must always remember that we are carrying out the four modernizations of socialism, not other modernizations, and the cause we are carrying out is the cause of socialism. We must fully realize that the key to the construction of socialist spiritual civilization is that the ruling party must have a good party style; to improve the quality of Communist Party members, we must strengthen the party spirit education of Communist Party members.

events:
23日 中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅发出通知,转发全
国妇联《关于在招生、招工、提干等方面存在的轻视妇女、歧视
妇女问题的报告》。《通知》指出,《报告》经中央书记处、国务
院同意,并要求各地区、各部门认真贯彻执行。
《报告》在列举了在招生、招工、提干等方面存在的种种轻
视、歧视妇女的现象后,提出如下建议:(一)在招工、招生、
招聘以及住房分配等方面要切实保障妇女的合法权益。凡适合女
同志学习的专业和从事的工种,都应保证妇女有相当的比例。在
提干方面男女应一视同仁。(二)对编余的女职工应妥善安排,
不得强行采取放长假等办法简单处理了事。(三)建议国务院有
关部门研究解决延长女科技人员、女教师、女干部的退休年龄问
题。(四)党委要加强对培养女干部工作的领导,组织部门应有
专人负责,有计划地培养、选拔女干部。(五)提高妇女素质,
开发妇女智力,必须从小学抓起。
translated_text: On the 23rd, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council issued a notice forwarding the All-China Women's Federation's "Report on the Problems of Disdain and Discrimination against Women in Enrollment, Recruitment, and Promotion of Officials". The "Notice" pointed out that the "Report" was approved by the Central Secretariat and the State Council, and required all regions and departments to implement it conscientiously. After listing the various phenomena of disdain and discrimination against women in enrollment, recruitment, and promotion of officials, the "Report" made the following suggestions: (i) Women's legitimate rights and interests must be effectively protected in recruitment, recruitment, and housing allocation. All majors suitable for female comrades to study and types of work should ensure that there is a considerable proportion of women. Men and women should be treated equally in terms of promotion of officials. (ii) Female employees who are left over should be properly arranged, and should not be simply dealt with by forcibly taking long vacations. (iii) It is recommended that relevant departments of the State Council study and solve the problem of extending the retirement age of female scientific and technological personnel, female teachers, and female cadres. (IV) The Party Committee should strengthen its leadership in the training of female cadres, and the Organization Department should have a dedicated person to plan and train and select female cadres. (V) Improving the quality of women and developing their intelligence must start from primary school.

events:

企业党组织座谈会。会议主题是交流实行厂长负责制后企业党委
如何工作的经验,研究新情况、新问题,积极推进经济体制改
革。中共中央组织部副部长曹志在会上就以下五个问题发表讲
话:(一)关于党对企业的领导问题;(二)关于企业党组织的地
位和作用问题;(三)关于党委发挥保证和监督作用问题;(四)
关于党委书记和厂长的关系问题;(五)关于加强企业思想政治
工作问题。
translated_text: From the 24th to the 29th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee held a symposium for party organizations of industrial enterprises in some provinces and cities in Beijing. The theme of the meeting was to exchange experiences on how the party committees of enterprises work after the implementation of the factory director responsibility system, study new situations and new problems, and actively promote economic system reform. Cao Zhi, deputy director of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, delivered a speech on the following five issues at the meeting: (i) on the party's leadership over enterprises; (ii) on the status and role of enterprise party organizations; (iii) on the role of the party committee in guaranteeing and supervising; (iv) on the relationship between the party committee secretary and the factory director; and (v) on strengthening the ideological and political work of enterprises.

events:

员会和中直机关党委、国家机关党委《关于挑选机关干部参加培
训中小学教师工作的请示》发出通知。《通知》指出,挑选机关
干部参加培训中小学教师的工作,是贯彻落实《中共中央关于教
育体制改革的决定》的实际步骤。《请示》中提出,动员、挑选
和组织党政机关干部帮助培训中小学教师的工作,是领导机关的
干部深入基层,了解教改,了解社会,密切干群关系的一条重要
途径,对培养和锻炼干部、考察干部也是一个好机会。要下决心
动员和挑选优秀干部,包括第三梯队的人选,参加这项工作。
translated_text: On the 26th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council forwarded the "Request for Instructions on Selecting Officials to Participate in the Training of Primary and Secondary School Teachers" issued by the State Education Commission, the Party Committee of the Central Government, and the Party Committee of the State Organs. The "Notice" pointed out that selecting official cadres to participate in the training of primary and secondary school teachers is a practical step to implement the "Decision of the CPC Central Committee on the Reform of the Education System". The "Request" proposed that mobilizing, selecting and organizing party and government officials to help train primary and secondary school teachers is an important way for leading officials to go deep into the grassroots, understand education reform, understand society, and strengthen the relationship between officials and the masses. It is also a good opportunity to train and exercise officials and examine officials. We must be determined to mobilize and select outstanding officials, including candidates from the third echelon, to participate in this work.

events:
27日 中共中央就批转中央组织部《关于省部级第三梯队
建设工作的报告》发出通知。《通知》指出,建设好第三梯队,
大胆起用和培养一代新人,是党和国家的一项极为重要的战略任
务。中央认为,在搞活经济、对外开放和推进改革的实践中,已
经和正在涌现出大批优秀人才。各级党委和组织部门,要进一步
开阔视野,深入基层,充分走群众路线,把各条战线上经过实践
考验,政治素质好,知识面广,勇于改革创新,能打开局面的优
秀人才,尽快选拔到各级领导岗位上来。在选拔第三梯队的工作
中,要严格把好政治关。凡是党性不强,伸手要官、热衷于搞不
正之风的人,都不能列入第三梯队。要注意防止派性残余的干
扰,选人不能有亲疏之分。
translated_text: On the 27th, the CPC Central Committee issued a notice on the approval of the Central Organization Department's "Report on the Construction of the Third Echelon at the Provincial and Ministerial Level". The "Notice" pointed out that building a good third echelon and boldly employing and training a new generation of people is an extremely important strategic task for the Party and the country. The Central Committee believes that in the practice of revitalizing the economy, opening up to the outside world and promoting reform, a large number of outstanding talents have emerged and are emerging. Party committees and organization departments at all levels should further broaden their horizons, go deep into the grassroots, fully follow the mass line, and select outstanding talents who have been tested by practice on all fronts, have good political qualities, broad knowledge, courage to reform and innovate, and can open up the situation to leadership positions at all levels as soon as possible. In the work of selecting the third echelon, we must strictly control the political gate. Anyone who is not strong in party spirit, asks for official positions, and is keen on engaging in unhealthy practices cannot be included in the third echelon. We must pay attention to preventing the interference of factional remnants, and there should be no distinction between relatives and strangers in selecting people.

events:

在中央党校发表题为《关于当前组织工作的几个问题》的讲话。
乔石同志说,干部“四化”是干部队伍建设的长远的战略方针。这
一方针的制定,还将为我们的子孙后代立下一个好的规矩,使我
国的干部队伍,永远沿着革命化、年轻化、知识化和专业化的方
向前进。调整配备领导班子,不仅要注意领导班子成员的个人素
质,选拔德才兼备的优秀人才,还要注意整个班子的群体素质,
合理地配备各类人才,组成合理的群体结构。不能只满足于选进
了多少年轻的干部,增加了多少具有大专文化程度的专业人才,
更重要的是要考虑整个班子是否符合干部“四化”的要求,年龄,
知识和专业结构是否合理,能不能开创新局面。这是一个新课
题,需要认真研究解决。
translated_text: On the 2nd, Qiao Shi, alternate secretary of the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee and head of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, delivered a speech entitled "On Several Issues in Current Organizational Work" at the Central Party School. Comrade Qiao Shi said that the "four modernizations" of cadres are the long-term strategic policy for the construction of the cadre team. The formulation of this policy will also set a good rule for our future generations, so that our cadre team will always move forward in the direction of revolutionization, rejuvenation, knowledge and specialization. When adjusting and deploying the leadership team, we should not only pay attention to the personal qualities of the members of the leadership team and select outstanding talents with both moral integrity and ability, but also pay attention to the group quality of the entire team, reasonably deploy various types of talents and form a reasonable group structure. We cannot be satisfied with how many young cadres have been selected and how many professional talents with college education have been added. What is more important is to consider whether the entire team meets the requirements of the "four modernizations" of cadres, whether the age, knowledge and professional structure are reasonable, and whether it can create a new situation. This is a new topic that needs to be studied and solved seriously.

干部不兼任经济实体职务的补充通知》。《通知》规定,所有在职
和退居二、三线的党政机关干部,一律不准兼任或受聘担任全
民、集体和个体所有制各类公司、企业等经济实体的职务。已经
担任的,应辞去兼任和担任的职务,或辞去党政机关的职务。以
上规定,同样适用于中外合资、合作企业。如有特殊情况需要党
政机关干部兼任各类公司、企业中职务的,必须经中共中央、国
务院批准。
translated_text: On the 9th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council issued the "Supplementary Notice on Party and Government Officials Not Holding Concurrent Positions in Economic Entities". The "Notice" stipulates that all party and government officials in office and those who have retired to the second or third line are not allowed to hold concurrent positions or be employed to hold positions in all kinds of companies, enterprises and other economic entities of the whole people, collectives and individuals. Those who have already held concurrent positions should resign from the concurrent positions or resign from the positions in party and government agencies. The above provisions also apply to Sino-foreign joint ventures and cooperative enterprises. If there are special circumstances that require party and government officials to hold concurrent positions in various companies and enterprises, they must be approved by the CPC Central Committee and the State Council.

events: 1985年7月9日,中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅发出《关于党政机关干部不兼任任何经济实体职务的补充通知》,规定,所有在职和退居二线的党政机关干部,一律不兼任全民所有制各类公司、企业等实体经济的职务。已经兼任的,应辞去兼任的职务,或辞去党政机关的职务。这个原则同样适用于中外合资、合作企业。
translated_text: On July 9, 1985, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council issued the "Supplementary Notice on Party and Government Officials Not Holding Any concurrent posts in economic entities", stipulating that all incumbent and retired party and government officials should not hold concurrent posts in all kinds of state-owned companies, enterprises and other real economic entities. Those who have already held concurrent posts should resign from the concurrent posts or resign from the party and government posts. This principle also applies to Sino-foreign joint ventures and cooperative enterprises.

translated_text: On the 19th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on Printing and Distributing Several Typical Materials on the Construction of Rural Party Grassroots Organizations". The "Notice" pointed out that the Cishan Second Street Party Branch in Wu'an County, Hebei Province led the masses to walk the road of common prosperity, the Chengguan Township Party Committee of Gai County, Liaoning Province fully played the vanguard and exemplary role of party members in the development of commodity production, the Xiayi County Party Committee of Henan Province adjusted the leadership team of the rural party branch to adapt to the needs of the new situation, the Gaocheng County Party Committee of Hebei Province improved the setting of rural party grassroots organizations, and how the Huai'an County Party Committee of Jiangsu Province strengthened the construction of rural grassroots party organizations. The five materials reflect from different aspects some of the current situations and practices of party organizations at all levels in strengthening rural party grassroots organizations under the new situation, which can be used for reference by various places. At the same time, it is emphasized that the current focus should be grasped, and the adjustment of grassroots leadership teams should be studied and resolved, and how to give full play to the role of grassroots organizations as a fighting fortress and the vanguard and exemplary role of party members should be studied. The setting of grassroots organizations should be improved according to the new situation and new tasks, and the education and management of party members should be strengthened, and the work of developing party members should be done well.

events: 1985年8月22日,国务院副总理田纪云在会见联合国文官制度改革研讨会各国代表时指出,随着我国经济体制改革的深入进行,我们越来越感到,行政管理,包括行政机构和人事管理等同经济基础很不适应。我国行政管理方面存在的问题主要是:一是机构多,而且重叠,特别是各种临时性机构太多;二是机构、部门职责不清,在工作中相互扯皮、相互推诿的现象严重;三是人浮于事,常常是一个职位的工作几个人干,搞“人海战术”;四是工作效率低;五是缺乏科学的、严格的干部聘任、考核、晋升、奖惩､离退休等制度。进行政府机构和人事制度改革势在必行。
translated_text: On August 22, 1985, when meeting with representatives of various countries at the United Nations Civil Service System Reform Seminar, Vice Premier Tian Jiyun pointed out that as my country's economic system reform deepens, we increasingly feel that administrative management, including administrative agencies and personnel management, is not adapted to the economic foundation. The main problems in my country's administrative management are: first, there are too many agencies and they overlap, especially too many temporary agencies; second, the responsibilities of agencies and departments are unclear, and there is a serious phenomenon of mutual wrangling and mutual shirking in work; third, there are too many people for the work, and often several people do the work of one position, using the "human sea tactics"; fourth, the work efficiency is low; fifth, there is a lack of scientific and strict systems for cadre appointment, assessment, promotion, rewards and punishments, and retirement. It is imperative to reform government agencies and personnel systems.

translated_text: From the 18th to the 23rd, the National Congress of the Communist Party of China was held in Beijing. The meeting was chaired by Hu Yaobang, Deng Xiaoping, Zhao Ziyang, Li Xiannian and Chen Yun, members of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee. Hu Yaobang, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, delivered an opening speech, and Zhao Ziyang, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, explained the proposal (draft) for the "Seventh Five-Year Plan". The meeting agreed to the request of 64 old comrades to no longer serve as members of the Central Committee or alternate members of the Central Committee, agreed to the request of 37 old comrades to no longer serve as members of the Central Advisory Commission, and agreed to the request of 30 old comrades to no longer serve as members of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection. translated_text: On the 4th, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued the "Regulations on Further Preventing Party and Government Organs and Party and Government Officials from Engaging in Business and Running Enterprises". The "Regulations" pointed out that after the "Decision on Strictly Prohibiting Party and Government Organs and Party and Government Officials from Engaging in Business and Running Enterprises" was issued by the CPC Central Committee and the State Council in December 1984, most of the enterprises run by party and government organs have been closed or decoupled from party and government organs; most of the party and government officials who participated in engaging in business and running enterprises have returned to work in government agencies or resigned from party and government positions. However, this unhealthy trend has not been completely stopped. To this end, further regulations were made on the following ten issues: (1) Party and government organs, including party committees at all levels and state power organs, administrative organs, judicial organs, procuratorial organs and institutions affiliated to these organs, are not allowed to engage in business and run enterprises. (2) All cadres and employees of the above-mentioned organs, including retired cadres, are not allowed to work in enterprises except with special approval; those who have already worked must resign immediately. (3) Retired cadres, except for those with special approval, are not allowed to work in state-owned enterprises. If they work in non-state-owned enterprises, they must retire two years later and are no longer entitled to retirement benefits. (4) Any cadres and employees who participate in illegal business activities or provide convenience for them shall be subject to party and government discipline, and leading cadres shall be dealt with strictly. (5) The children and spouses of leading cadres who work in party and government organs and affiliated institutions shall not engage in business or run enterprises. Those who work in other units are also not allowed to use the influence and relationships of leading cadres to engage in business and run enterprises for illegal profit. (6) After the enterprises run by party and government organs and affiliated institutions and their cadres are closed, the approved business departments shall be responsible for clearing up economic problems. (7) The industrial and commercial administrative authorities shall strictly review and approve the applications for the establishment of enterprises and handle them in accordance with the law. Those who fail to perform their duties shall be held accountable. (8) These regulations apply to mass organizations such as trade unions, the Communist Youth League, the Women's Federation, the Federation of Literary and Art Circles, the Science and Technology Association, and various associations and societies, as well as the cadres and employees of these organizations. If there are special circumstances and a non-commercial enterprise needs to be established, it must be reported to the State Council or the provincial (regional, municipal) government for approval. (IX) The establishment of labor service companies and enterprises run by townships and sub-districts for the purpose of arranging employment for young people shall be investigated and studied by the relevant departments and separately regulated. (X) The establishment of enterprises by military agencies and military cadres shall be handled in accordance with the relevant regulations of the State Council and the Central Military Commission.

translated_text: On the 22nd, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council forwarded the "Supplementary Opinions on Further Implementing the Minutes of the Enlarged Meeting of the Central Policy Implementation Group" by the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Ministry of Labor and Personnel, the United Front Work Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Ministry of Finance, and the Ministry of Urban and Rural Construction and Environmental Protection. The Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council pointed out that it is a major political task to basically complete the task of implementing the policy before the 13th CPC National Congress, and Party committees and governments at all levels must grasp it as soon as possible. The "Supplementary Opinions" require a clean-up of the work of redressing unjust, false and wrong cases, and properly resolve the remaining issues; clarify the responsibilities of clearing up the property confiscated, confiscated and occupied private housing during the "Cultural Revolution"; and correct the economic crimes and criminal crimes that have been handled wrongly since the Third Plenary Session of the 11th CPC Central Committee. On December 4, the above five ministries jointly issued supplementary regulations to this document, further clarifying the objects of appropriate care, approval procedures and funding sources for those whose salary levels are obviously low due to unjust, false and wrong cases. The Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued a notice forwarding the "Report on Doing a Good Job in Recommending Outstanding League Members as Party Development Targets" by the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee of the Communist Youth League. The "Notice" pointed out that the Communist Youth League is the assistant and reserve force of the Party. The League organizations assist the Party organizations in doing a good job in education and recommend outstanding League members as Party development targets. This traditional practice has been proven to be effective in practice. Under any circumstances, we must adhere to the standards of Party members and put ensuring the quality of new Party members first. The CPC Central Committee decided that Chen Junsheng would concurrently serve as the Secretary of the Party Committee of the Central State Organs; Song Yiping would be removed from his position as the Secretary of the Party Committee of the CPC Central State Organs; Zhang Jingyuan would serve as the Deputy Secretary of the Party Committee of the CPC Central State Organs and be removed from his position as the Deputy Secretary-General of the State Council. The CPC Central Committee agreed that He Jiesheng would serve as the Deputy Minister of the Ministry of Health, approved him as a member of the Party Group, and removed him from his position as the Standing Committee Member of the Hubei Provincial Party Committee.

events: 28日 中共中央组织部发出《关于调整和改进农村中党的基层组织设置的意见》。《意见》指出,原有农村基层党组织的设置,已不适应新形势和新任务的要求,要求各省、自治区、直辖市党委组织部针对农村乡镇企业、经济联合体、专业户大量涌现,农民党员外出务工、经商日益增多的新情况,按照党章的有关规定,逐步调整和改进农村中党的基层组织的设置,并加强管理。
translated_text: On the 28th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued the "Opinions on Adjusting and Improving the Setting of Grassroots Party Organizations in Rural Areas". The "Opinions" pointed out that the original setting of grassroots party organizations in rural areas is no longer suitable for the requirements of the new situation and new tasks. It requires the Organization Departments of the Party Committees of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government to gradually adjust and improve the setting of grassroots party organizations in rural areas and strengthen management in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Party Constitution in response to the emergence of a large number of rural township enterprises, economic associations, and professional households, and the increasing number of peasant party members working and doing business outside the home. translated_text: From April 7 to April 9, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Propaganda Department of the CPC Central Committee, and the Ministry of Radio, Film and Television jointly sent an investigation team to investigate the leadership of the Beijing Film Studio and put forward adjustment principles: the new team members should be young and energetic, have the courage to explore and innovate, boldly adhere to reform, and have a high sense of social responsibility; the leadership of the Party Committee should be strengthened; the new team members should be fair and upright, recruit people from all corners of the country, and appoint people based on their merits; the new team members should have the spirit of dedication, be willing to serve as a stepping stone for others, and work wholeheartedly for the revitalization of the film industry; the structure of the leadership team should conform to the characteristics of the Beijing Film Studio; cadres from various cultural units should communicate with each other.

translated_text: On the 8th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on the Timely Transfer of Party Member Organizational Relations after Party Members' Work Transfer". The "Notice" stipulates that after a party member's work transfer, his organizational relationship must be transferred in a timely manner. Without party membership, he cannot enjoy the right to vote, be elected and vote in the party; party members and cadres who hold multiple positions should place their party membership in the unit where they are mainly employed and participate in organizational activities; organization departments at all levels should strengthen supervision, inspection and criticism and education.

events:

会委员离休、退休应先辞去委员职务问题的通知》。《通知》规
定,省人大常委会委员如要求离休、退休,应先由本人辞去委员
职务,然后再办理离、退休手续。以上精神同样适用省、自治
区、直辖市顾委委员和政协委员。
中共中央办公厅发出《关于黑龙江省委仍不设立省委经济工
作部的复函》。3月10日,中央书记处会议讨论认为,黑龙江省
委还是不要成立经济工作部。《复函》指出,省委成立经济工作
机构,不仅在省委同政府厅局之间增加中间层次,不符合中央历
来关于精简机构、提高工作效率的精神,而且这个机构同经济管
理部门的职责、工作范围难以划清,在实际工作中会造成许多重
复和矛盾,甚至干扰经济工作的正常进行。已经建立经济工作部
门的10个省(区、市),中央希望他们在进一步总结经验的基础
上,研究妥善解决这个问题的办法。
translated_text:
On the 11th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on the Issue of Provincial (Regional and Municipal) People's Congress Standing Committee Members Resigning from Their Membership Before Retiring". The "Notice" stipulates that if a member of the Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee requests to retire, he or she should first resign from his or her membership and then go through the procedures for retirement. The above spirit also applies to members of the advisory committees and CPPCC members of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government.
The General Office of the CPC Central Committee issued the "Reply on the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee Still Not Establishing the Provincial Party Committee's Economic Work Department". On March 10, the Central Secretariat discussed and believed that the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee should not establish an economic work department. The "Reply" pointed out that the establishment of an economic work agency by the provincial party committee not only adds an intermediate level between the provincial party committee and government departments and bureaus, which is not in line with the central government's spirit of streamlining agencies and improving work efficiency, but also the responsibilities and work scope of this agency and the economic management department are difficult to distinguish, which will cause many duplications and contradictions in actual work and even interfere with the normal progress of economic work. The central government hopes that the 10 provinces (autonomous regions and municipalities) that have established economic work departments will study ways to properly solve this problem based on further summarizing their experience.

events:
25日 中共中央组织部发出《关于广东省海南区党委组织
部严重违反党费管理使用规定的通报》。《通报》指出,海南区党
委组织部将党费专项存款,另立户头,提取利息一万多元,作为
“福利补助”发给机关工作人员,这是无视党规党法,违反党费管
理、使用规定,为小团体谋私利的严重错误。《通报》转发他们
的检讨,要求各地区各部门对党费收缴管理情况进行一次认真检
查,对违反规定的应及时严肃处理。
translated_text: On the 25th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued a "Notice on the serious violation of party fee management and use regulations by the Organization Department of the Hainan District Party Committee of Guangdong Province". The "Notice" pointed out that the Hainan District Party Committee Organization Department set up a special account for party fee deposits and withdrew more than 10,000 yuan in interest as "welfare subsidies" to the staff of the agency. This is a serious mistake of ignoring party rules and laws, violating party fee management and use regulations, and seeking personal gain for a small group. The "Notice" forwarded their review and required all regions and departments to conduct a serious inspection of the collection and management of party fees, and to deal with violations of regulations in a timely and serious manner.

events:

间我国劳动、工资、人事制度改革的重点要放在企业的工资制度
改革、用工制度的改革和做好国家机构改革的有关工作上。人事

translated_text: On the 7th, the National Conference of Directors of Labor and Personnel Departments ended. The personnel system reform mainly reforms the cadre appointment system, gradually implements the cadre employment system, the appointment system, and the term system, implements cadre exchanges and reasonable mobility, and strengthens the macro-control of the cadre team.

translated_text: On the 22nd, the CPC Central Committee agreed that Pan Liansheng would be appointed as the Deputy Minister of the Ministry of Chemical Industry and approved him as a member of the Party Group. The Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee forwarded the Central Party School's "Suggestions on arranging work for the Central Party School's training class students as soon as possible after graduation". The Central Party School enrolled 293 students in the second training class in the fall of 1984 and 93 three-year students in the fall of 1983. After two or three years of study, they are about to graduate. The "Suggestions" of the Central Party School have been reviewed and agreed by the leading comrades of the Central Secretariat.

events:
4日 中共中央、国务院发出《关于改进和加强出国留学人
员工作若干问题的通知》。《通知》进一步明确了出国留学人员工
作的方针,要从我国四化建设的实际出发,密切结合生产建设、
科学研究和人才培养的需要,以解决科研、生产中的问题和增强

translated_text: On the 4th, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued the "Notice on Improving and Strengthening the Work of Overseas Students". The "Notice" further clarified the guidelines for the work of overseas students, which should be based on the actual situation of my country's four modernizations, closely combined with the needs of production construction, scientific research and talent training, to solve problems in scientific research and production and enhance the ability to train high-level talents. It requires dispatching on demand, ensuring quality, and consistency between learning and application; strengthening management education; and striving to create conditions so that overseas students can apply what they have learned after returning to China.

events: 1986年8月28日,经国务院批准,16个中等城市列为全国第一批机构改革试点城市。这16个城市是:江门、丹东、潍坊、苏州、无锡、常州、马鞍山、厦门、绍兴、安阳、洛阳、黄石、衡阳、自贡、宝鸡、天水。1986年9月13日,邓小平同志在听取中央财经领导小组汇报时指出,政治体制改革的目的是调动群众的积极性,提高效率,克服官僚主义。1986年11月9日,邓小平同志在《政治体制改革的一些设想》中提出:政治体制改革的三个目标是始终保持党政机关的活力;克服官僚主义,提高行政效率;调动基层和工人、农民、知识分子的积极性。1986年11月28日,中央办公厅转发中共中央组织部《关于领导班子年轻化几个问题的通知》。通知指出,领导班子年轻化应以革命化为前提,符合知识化、专业化的要求;领导班子年轻化建设,要在年龄结构上保持干部新老交替的正常格局。
translated_text: On August 28, 1986, with the approval of the State Council, 16 medium-sized cities were listed as the first batch of pilot cities for institutional reform in the country. These 16 cities are: Jiangmen, Dandong, Weifang, Suzhou, Wuxi, Changzhou, Ma'anshan, Xiamen, Shaoxing, Anyang, Luoyang, Huangshi, Hengyang, Zigong, Baoji, and Tianshui. On September 13, 1986, Comrade Deng Xiaoping pointed out when listening to the report of the Central Finance and Economics Leading Group that the purpose of political system reform is to mobilize the enthusiasm of the masses, improve efficiency, and overcome bureaucracy. On November 9, 1986, Comrade Deng Xiaoping proposed in "Some Ideas on Political System Reform": The three goals of political system reform are to always maintain the vitality of party and government organs; overcome bureaucracy and improve administrative efficiency; and mobilize the enthusiasm of grassroots and workers, farmers, and intellectuals. On November 28, 1986, the General Office of the Central Committee forwarded the "Notice on Several Issues Concerning the Rejuvenation of the Leading Group" of the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China. The notice pointed out that the rejuvenation of the leadership team should be based on revolutionization and meet the requirements of knowledge and specialization; the rejuvenation of the leadership team should maintain a normal pattern of alternation of old and new cadres in terms of age structure.

events:
4日 中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅作出《关于全国区、
乡、镇党政机关人员编制的有关规定》。区、乡、镇党政机关的
人员编制范围包括:党委副书记,正副区、乡、镇长以及有关
民政、财政、青年团、妇联等人员。不包括编制单列的公安、司
法人员和企事业单位的管理人员以及县以上各级机关派驻在区、
乡、镇的各种机构的人员。区、乡、镇的党、政领导干部一般不
要交叉兼职,其他人员分工不宜过细,不要求与上级部门对口,
可设些小组进行综合管理,不要一事设立一职。
translated_text: On the 4th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council issued the "Regulations on the Staffing of District, Township and Town Party and Government Organs Nationwide". The staffing scope of district, township and town party and government organs includes: deputy party committee secretaries, mayors and deputy mayors of districts, townships and towns, and personnel related to civil affairs, finance, youth leagues, women's federations, etc. It does not include public security and judicial personnel and management personnel of enterprises and institutions with separate staffing, as well as personnel of various institutions stationed in districts, townships and towns by county-level and above agencies. Party and government leaders in districts, townships and towns generally should not hold overlapping positions, and the division of labor of other personnel should not be too detailed, and they are not required to be in line with higher-level departments. Some groups can be set up for comprehensive management, and it is not necessary to set up one position for each matter.

events:
11日——17日 中共中央组织部、国家教育委员会党组、
国家科学技术委员会党组和国家科技领导小组办公室联合在北京
召开全国高等学校、科研院所领导班子建设工作座谈会。各省、
自治区、直辖市党委组织部、部分宣传部、科教部、科委、国务
院有关部门干部司(局)负责人和部分高等学校的主要领导干部
参加了会议,共200人。座谈会着重讨论解决配齐高等学校和科
研院所主要领导干部缺额和调整少数问题较多的领导班子的问
题。中共中央组织部部长健行、国家教委副主任杨海波和国家
科委、国务院科技领导小组办公室副主任郭树言在会上讲话。
9月22日,上述四个单位联合发出通知,印发了这次座谈会
《纪要》;同时,中共中央组织部印发了尉健行的讲话。
translated_text: From the 11th to the 17th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Party Group of the State Education Commission, the Party Group of the State Science and Technology Commission and the Office of the State Science and Technology Leading Group jointly held a national seminar on the construction of leadership teams in colleges and universities and research institutes in Beijing. The heads of the Organization Departments of the Party Committees of provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the Central Government, some propaganda departments, science and education ministries, science and technology commissions, and the cadres departments (bureaus) of relevant departments of the State Council and some major leading cadres of colleges and universities attended the meeting, a total of 200 people. The seminar focused on solving the problem of filling the vacancies of major leading cadres in colleges and universities and research institutes and adjusting the leadership teams with more problems. Jian Xing, Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, Yang Haibo, Deputy Director of the State Education Commission, and Guo Shuyan, Deputy Director of the State Science and Technology Commission and the Office of the State Council Science and Technology Leading Group, spoke at the meeting. On September 22, the above four units jointly issued a notice and issued the "Minutes" of this seminar; at the same time, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued Wei Jianxing's speech.

events:
15日 中共中央、国务院发出《关于颁发全民所有制工业
企业三个条例的通知》。《通知》指出,《全民所有制工业企业厂
长工作条例》、《中国共产党全民所有制工业企业基层组织工作条
例》和《全民所有制工业企业职工代表大会条例》的颁发,对克
服当前企业领导体制中某些不协调状况,理顺各方面关系,提高
管理水平,加快“四化”建设,具有十分重要的意义,要求各地各
部门认真贯彻实行。11月11日,中共中央、国务院发出贯彻执
行这三个条例的补充通知,明确指出,从党委领导下的厂长负责
制到厂长负责制的转变,是企业领导体制的重大改革。全民所有
制工业企业的厂长(经理)是一厂之长,是企业法人的代表,对
企业负有全面责任,处于中心地位,起中心作用。
中共中央组织部发出《关于检查落实知识分子政策工作的通
知》。《通知》指出,落实知识分子政策,解决历史遗留问题的任
务,有的地区和部门已基本完成,大部分地区和部门计划下半年
完成。为了确保工作质量,善始善终,要求对已基本完成任务的
单位进行一次认真检查,并对检查的范围和内容、组织领导与步
骤方法提出了具体要求。
translated_text: On the 15th, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued the "Notice on Issuing Three Regulations on State-Owned Industrial Enterprises". The "Notice" pointed out that the issuance of the "Regulations on the Work of Factory Directors of State-Owned Industrial Enterprises", the "Regulations on the Work of Grassroots Organizations of the Communist Party of China in State-Owned Industrial Enterprises" and the "Regulations on Workers' Congresses of State-Owned Industrial Enterprises" is of great significance to overcoming certain incoordination in the current enterprise leadership system, straightening out various relationships, improving management level, and accelerating the "four modernizations" construction, and requires all localities and departments to implement them conscientiously. On November 11, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued a supplementary notice on the implementation of these three regulations, clearly pointing out that the transition from the factory director responsibility system under the leadership of the Party Committee to the factory director responsibility system is a major reform of the enterprise leadership system. The factory director (manager) of a state-owned industrial enterprise is the head of a factory and the representative of the enterprise legal person. He has full responsibility for the enterprise, is in a central position, and plays a central role. The Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on Inspecting the Implementation of the Policy on Intellectuals". The Notice pointed out that the tasks of implementing the policy on intellectuals and solving historical problems have been basically completed in some regions and departments, and most regions and departments plan to complete them in the second half of the year. In order to ensure the quality of work and to ensure a good start and a good end, it is required to conduct a serious inspection of the units that have basically completed the tasks, and specific requirements are put forward for the scope and content of the inspection, the organization and leadership, and the steps and methods.

events:
16日——20日 中共中央组织部在北京召开选调生工作会
议。出席会议的有29个省、自治区、直辖市的党委组织部长
(副部长)和青干处长。会议学习了中央组织部给中央书记处
《关于贯彻中央对选调生工作指示精神的报告》,回顾了选调应届
优秀大学毕业生到基层培养锻炼的情况,肯定了知识分子走与群
众相结合的正确道路;同时指出这种预先公开确定人选的做法已
不适应变化了的情况,需要改变,以避免由此而带来的一些消极
影响和不利因素。10月18日中央组织部印发了这次会议的《纪
要》和尉健行在会上的讲话。
translated_text: From the 16th to the 20th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China held a work meeting on the selection of selected students in Beijing. Attending the meeting were the heads of the Organization Departments (deputy heads) and heads of the Youth Cadre Departments of the Party Committees of 29 provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the Central Government. The meeting studied the "Report on Implementing the Central Committee's Instructions on the Work of Selected Students" given by the Organization Department of the Central Committee to the Secretariat of the Central Committee, reviewed the situation of selecting outstanding university graduates to be trained at the grassroots level, and affirmed the correct path of intellectuals to combine with the masses; at the same time, it was pointed out that this practice of publicly determining candidates in advance is no longer suitable for the changing situation and needs to be changed to avoid some negative effects and unfavorable factors brought about by it. On October 18, the Organization Department of the Central Committee issued the "Minutes" of this meeting and Wei Jianxing's speech at the meeting.

events:
20日 中共中央决定,吴官正任江西省委委员、常委、副
书记。
translated_text: On the 20th, the CPC Central Committee decided that Wu Guanzheng would serve as a member, standing member, and deputy secretary of the Jiangxi Provincial Committee.

events:
26日 中共中央、国务院发出《关于加强农村基层政权建
设工作的通知》。其要点是:(一)明确党政分工,理顺党政关
系;(二)实行党政分开,促进农村经济进一步发展;(三)简政
放权,健全和完善乡政府的职能;(四)切实搞好乡政府的自身,
建设;(五)努力提高干部素质,认真改进工作作风;(六)搞好
村(居)民委员会的建设;(七)加强对农村基层政权建设的领
导。
translated_text: On the 26th, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued the "Notice on Strengthening the Construction of Rural Grassroots Political Power". The main points are: (1) clarify the division of labor between the Party and the government and rationalize the relationship between the Party and the government; (2) implement the separation of the Party and the government to promote the further development of the rural economy; (3) streamline administration and delegate power, and improve and perfect the functions of the township government; (4) effectively improve the self-construction of the township government; (5) strive to improve the quality of cadres and earnestly improve the work style; (6) improve the construction of village (neighborhood) committees; (7) strengthen the leadership of the construction of rural grassroots political power.

events:
28日 中国共产党第十二届中央委员会第六次全体会议在
北京举行。出席这次会议的有中央委员199人,候补中央委员
126人;列席会议的,有中顾委委员161人,中纪委委员122
人,有关负责同志25人。中共中央政治局常委胡耀邦、邓小
平、赵紫阳、李先念、陈云主持会议。全会通过了《中共中央关
于社会主义精神文明建设指导方针的决议》,决定1987年10月
召开党的第十三次全国代表大会。
translated_text: On the 28th, the Sixth Plenary Session of the 12th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China was held in Beijing. Attending the meeting were 199 members of the Central Committee and 126 alternate members of the Central Committee; attending the meeting were 161 members of the Central Advisory Commission, 122 members of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, and 25 relevant responsible comrades. The Standing Committee members of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee Hu Yaobang, Deng Xiaoping, Zhao Ziyang, Li Xiannian, and Chen Yun presided over the meeting. The plenary session passed the "Resolution of the CPC Central Committee on the Guiding Principles of Socialist Spiritual Civilization Construction" and decided to hold the 13th National Congress of the Party in October 1987.

events:
30日 中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅发出《关于批复西
藏自治区党政机关机构改革方案的通知》。《通知》指出,中央、
国务院原则同意西藏自治区党委、政府所报机构改革方案。《通
知》还指出:(一)机构改革的目的,是使上层建筑更好地为经
济基础服务,促进西藏生产力和商品经济的发展,使人民尽快富
裕,民族更加团结,加快西藏建设步伐。这是研究机构改革中各
种问题的出发点和归宿。(二)西藏的情况比较特殊,机构改革
必须从本地的实际出发。(三)对因机构改革变动工作的职工,
区党委和政府一定要负责到底。(四)中央、国务院各部门对西
藏的机构改革要大力支持,积极配合。
translated_text: On the 30th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council issued the "Notice on Approving the Reform Plan of the Party and Government Organs in the Tibet Autonomous Region". The "Notice" pointed out that the Central Committee and the State Council agreed in principle to the reform plan submitted by the Party Committee and the Government of the Tibet Autonomous Region. The "Notice" also pointed out: (a) The purpose of the reform is to make the superstructure better serve the economic base, promote the development of Tibet's productivity and commodity economy, make the people rich as soon as possible, make the ethnic groups more united, and accelerate the pace of construction in Tibet. This is the starting point and destination for studying various issues in the reform of institutions. (b) The situation in Tibet is relatively special, and the reform of institutions must start from the actual situation of the local area. (c) The Party Committee and the government of the region must be responsible to the end for the employees whose jobs are changed due to the reform of the institutions. (d) All departments of the Central Committee and the State Council should strongly support and actively cooperate with the reform of the institutions in Tibet.

events:
3日 久经考验的忠诚的共产主义战士,无产阶级军事家、
我军卓越的军事指挥员,全国人大常委会副委员长韩先楚在北京
逝世,终年74岁。
translated_text: On the 3rd, Han Xianchu, a long-tested and loyal communist fighter, proletarian military strategist, outstanding military commander of our army, and Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, passed away in Beijing at the age of 74.

events:
3日——7日 中央纪律检查委员会第八次全体会议在北京
举行。会议一致拥护党的十二届六中全会通过的决议。中共中央
政治局常委、中央纪律检查委员会第一书记陈云在讲话中强调指
出,社会主义精神文明建设,是有关整个社会主义建设成败的大
问题。全国党的纪检部门,要从纪检工作上保证,促进社会主义
经济体制、政治体制改革的健康发展。党的各级纪检工作部门不
仅要对妨碍、破坏改革的人和事坚决反对和纠正,而且要使纪检
工作成为促进改革的重要力量。纪律检查部门和全党各级党的组
织,必须重视执政党条件下党员的政治思想教育和党性教育。
translated_text: From the 3rd to the 7th, the 8th plenary session of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection was held in Beijing. The meeting unanimously supported the resolution adopted by the 6th Plenary Session of the 12th CPC Central Committee. Chen Yun, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and first secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, emphasized in his speech that the construction of socialist spiritual civilization is a major issue related to the success or failure of the entire socialist construction. The discipline inspection departments of the Party across the country must ensure and promote the healthy development of the reform of the socialist economic system and political system through discipline inspection work. The discipline inspection departments at all levels of the Party must not only resolutely oppose and correct those who hinder and undermine the reform, but also make the discipline inspection work an important force to promote the reform. The discipline inspection departments and the Party organizations at all levels of the Party must attach importance to the political and ideological education and party spirit education of the Party members under the conditions of the ruling party.

events:
4日 中共中央整党工作指导委员会办公室、中共中央组织
部联合发出《关于进一步做好整党党员登记工作的通知》。强
调要切实加强对基层整党中党员登记工作的领导;整党工作已基
本结束的单位,应抓紧做好由于各种原因暂未登记党员的工作;
要认真做好缓期登记党员的考察教育以及缓期登记期满后的审议
处理工作。
translated_text: On the 4th, the Office of the CPC Central Committee Steering Committee for Party Consolidation and the CPC Central Committee Organization Department jointly issued the "Notice on Further Improving the Registration of Party Members in the Party Consolidation". It emphasized that the leadership of the registration of party members in the grassroots party consolidation should be strengthened; units where the party consolidation work has basically been completed should speed up the work of party members who have not been registered for various reasons; and the inspection and education of party members who have deferred registration and the review and handling of the deferred registration after the expiration of the registration period should be done seriously.

events:
6日 中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅发出通知,转发中央
组织部、中央宣传部、中央统战部、国家科委、劳动人事部、中
国科协、解放军总政治部《关于发挥离退休专业技术人员作用的
暂行规定》。《通知》指出,离退休专业技术人员仍是我国一支重
要的专业技术力量。支持和帮助他们继续发挥作用,要从工作需
要和他们的实际出发,坚持自愿和量力而行的原则,形式可多种
多样。《暂行规定》就离退休专业技术人员继续从事专业技术活
动的报酬、差旅费、户籍、使用资料、设备等问题作了规定。
translated_text: On the 6th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council issued a notice forwarding the "Interim Provisions on the Role of Retired Professionals and Technical Personnel" issued by the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Propaganda Department of the CPC Central Committee, the United Front Work Department of the CPC Central Committee, the State Science and Technology Commission, the Ministry of Labor and Personnel, the China Association for Science and Technology, and the General Political Department of the People's Liberation Army. The "Notice" pointed out that retired professional and technical personnel are still an important professional and technical force in my country. Supporting and helping them to continue to play a role should be based on work needs and their actual situation, and adhere to the principles of voluntariness and ability, and the forms can be diverse. The "Interim Provisions" stipulates the remuneration, travel expenses, household registration, use of materials, equipment and other issues for retired professional and technical personnel to continue to engage in professional and technical activities.

events:
7日 中国人民解放军的缔造者之一,伟大的无产阶级革命
家、军事家、马克思主义军事理论家刘伯承在北京逝世,终年
94岁。
translated_text: On the 7th, Liu Bocheng, one of the founders of the Chinese People's Liberation Army, a great proletarian revolutionary, military strategist, and Marxist military theorist, died in Beijing at the age of 94.

events:
12日 中共中央同意,李岚清任对外经济贸易部副部长,
并批准其为党组副书记,不再担任天津市副市长职务;同意张皓
若任对外经济贸易部副部长,党组成员,不再担任中国石油化工
总公司副总经理、党组成员职务。
translated_text: On the 12th, the CPC Central Committee agreed that Li Lanqing would be appointed as the Deputy Minister of the Ministry of Foreign Economic Relations and Trade, and approved him as the Deputy Secretary of the Party Group, and he would no longer be the Deputy Mayor of Tianjin; it also agreed that Zhang Hao would be appointed as the Deputy Minister of the Ministry of Foreign Economic Relations and Trade and a member of the Party Group, and he would no longer be the Deputy General Manager and a member of the Party Group of China Petrochemical Corporation.

events:
17日 中共中央批准,曾庆红任上海市委副书记;朱宗葆
不再担任上海市委常委、委员和副市长职务。
translated_text: On the 17th, the CPC Central Committee approved Zeng Qinghong to serve as deputy secretary of the Shanghai Municipal Committee; Zhu Zongbao no longer served as a member of the Standing Committee, a member of the Shanghai Municipal Committee, or deputy mayor.

events: 《人民日报》报道,陕西省委查处组织人事违纪案,5名厅局级干部利用职权安排子女亲属受到追究。并发表题为《肃清政治生活中的封建遗毒》的评论员文章。
translated_text: On the 20th, the CPC Central Committee agreed that Zhou Zhengqing would be appointed as the vice president of the People's Bank of China and approved him as a member of the Party Group. The People's Daily reported that the Shaanxi Provincial Party Committee investigated and dealt with the case of organizational and personnel violations, and five bureau-level cadres who used their power to arrange for their children and relatives to be investigated. It also published a commentator article entitled "Eliminating the Feudal Relics in Political Life".

events: 20日 中共中央同意,周正庆任中国人民银行副行长,并批准其为党组成员。
translated_text: On the 20th, the CPC Central Committee agreed that Zhou Zhengqing would be appointed as the vice president of the People's Bank of China and approved him as a member of the Party Group. The People's Daily reported that the Shaanxi Provincial Party Committee investigated and dealt with the case of organizational and personnel violations, and five bureau-level cadres who used their power to arrange for their children and relatives to be investigated. translated_text: On the 18th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee forwarded the "Notice on Several Issues Concerning the Rejuvenation of the Leadership Team" and the "Notice on Several Issues Concerning the Adjustment of Incompetent Current Leading Cadres" issued by the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee. The "Notice" pointed out that the above two documents have been approved by the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee and forwarded to all regions and departments for implementation in light of the actual situation. The key points of the "Notice on Several Issues Concerning the Rejuvenation of the Leadership Team" are: (i) We must persist in the strategic reform of the rejuvenation of the leadership team; (ii) The rejuvenation of the leadership team is based on revolutionization and meets the requirements of knowledge and specialization; (iii) The rejuvenation of the leadership team must maintain a normal pattern of alternation between the old and the new in terms of age structure; (iv) The work of rejuvenation of the leadership team must organically combine the strategic needs of achieving the grand goals of the new era with the requirements of adapting to the current construction and reform. The main points of the "Notice on Several Issues Concerning the Adjustment of Incompetent Leading Cadres" are: (i) Incompetent leading cadres should be adjusted in a timely manner; (ii) Incompetent leading cadres should be adjusted in accordance with principles and treated differently; (iii) After cadres adjust their jobs, their salaries should be determined according to their new positions; (iv) Incompetent cadres should be adjusted in strict accordance with the management authority and approval procedures; (v) Strengthen leadership, make careful arrangements, and do a good job.

translated_text: From December 26 to December 2, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee held a national exchange meeting on the deeds and experiences of advanced party branches and outstanding party members in Beijing. The meeting was attended by 80 representatives of advanced party branches (general branches, party committees) and 167 outstanding Communist Party members, as well as leaders of the organization departments of the party committees of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the central government and relevant departments of the central and state organs. Wang Zhaoguo, secretary of the Central Secretariat, was entrusted by the CPC Central Committee to deliver a speech entitled "Improving Party Life and Enhancing the Vitality of Grassroots Party Organizations" at the closing meeting, proposing five measures to strengthen party building and improve grassroots party life: (1) Improve grassroots organizations and improve the content and methods of organizational life; (2) Improve and develop democracy within the party; (3) Adhere to the ideological, political and principled nature of party life; (4) Solve problems within the organization independently and responsibly; (5) Educate party members to make contributions and improve themselves in the construction of the two civilizations. On the same day, party and state leaders Hu Yaobang, Deng Xiaoping, Zhao Ziyang and others met with all the representatives attending the meeting. At the end of each year, a mass evaluation or public opinion poll should be conducted in conjunction with the work summary. This is an important measure to promote socialist democracy in cadre work, increase the voice of the masses, and allow the masses to participate in the selection and supervision of cadres. The content of the evaluation is mainly about morality, ability, diligence, and performance, with the focus on evaluating their work performance and ideological style. On the basis of mass evaluation and organizational assessment, a realistic evaluation should be made of each cadre.
