translated_text: On the 11th, Xinhua News Agency reported that the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued a supplementary notice on the implementation of the three regulations on state-owned industrial enterprises. The "Notice" pointed out that the factory director (manager) of a state-owned industrial enterprise is the head of a factory and the legal representative of the enterprise. He has overall responsibility for the enterprise, is in a central position, and plays a central role. The factory director (manager) and the party committee secretary must fulfill their duties conscientiously and responsibly in accordance with this new requirement and work together. The "Notice" requires that the party organizations in enterprises should wholeheartedly support the reform of the leadership system of the enterprise and actively support the factory director (manager) in exercising his powers. In accordance with the requirements of the "Regulations on the Work of Grassroots Organizations of State-Owned Industrial Enterprises of the Communist Party of China", we should conscientiously explore the working methods of the party organizations in enterprises in the new era and effectively play the guarantee and supervision role of the party organizations. For factory directors (managers) or party committee secretaries who do not meet the work requirements, the relevant competent departments should actively and carefully make organizational adjustments.

关和事业单位工作人员职务变动后确定职务工资问题的通知》。
《通知》规定:(一)因工作需要,由组织决定调动工作而变动职
务的工作人员,应按照其职务变动后新任职务的工资标准重新确

作而改任较低职务的工作人员,不能保留原职务工资额。(四)
工作人员晋升职务,不能超过所在单位经上级编制、人事部门核
定的人员结构比例和职数限额。(五)工作人员职务变动后,新
确定的职务工资,从任免机关批准新任职务的下月起执行。
translated_text: On the 12th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council issued the "Notice on the Determination of the Position Wages of Staff Members of State Organs and Institutions after the Position Change". The "Notice" stipulates: (a) Staff members who change their positions due to work needs and are decided by the organization to transfer their jobs should have their wages re-determined according to the wage standards of their new positions after the position change. (b) Staff members who are promoted to new positions shall be paid according to the position wage standards of their new positions after the promotion. (c) Staff members who are transferred to lower positions due to incompetence in their work during their tenure shall not retain their original position wages. (d) Staff members who are promoted to higher positions shall not exceed the personnel structure ratio and position limit approved by the superior organization and personnel department of the unit. (e) After the position change of staff members, the newly determined position wages shall be implemented from the next month after the appointment and removal authority approves the new position.

translated_text: On the 13th, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China issued a notice on "Communist Party members must strictly abide by the Party Constitution". The notice pointed out that no matter who they are, how high their status is, how great their reputation is, if they violate the party's political discipline, violate the four basic principles, and promote bourgeois liberalization, they will be subject to party discipline. For the very few people who ignore the repeated warnings of the party organization, act recklessly, and seriously endanger the party, they must be resolutely expelled from the party to maintain the purity of the party. The notice requires that party organizations at all levels and every party member must resolutely fight against all words and deeds that violate the party constitution. The Shanghai Municipal Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China made the "Decision on Expelling Wang Ruowang from the Party". The "Decision" pointed out that since 1979, especially in the past two years, Wang Ruowang has often used the opportunity of making reports and publishing articles to advocate bourgeois liberalization and oppose the four basic principles. He has not changed his ways despite repeated warnings, and has seriously violated the party constitution and the "Several Principles on Political Life within the Party". He has completely lost the conditions of a Communist Party member.

events: 16日 中共中央政治局举行扩大会议。会议对胡耀邦进行了严肃的同志式的批评,同时也如实地肯定了他工作中的成绩。参加这次中央政治局扩大会议的有:中央政治局委员 18人,中央政治局候补委员2人;中央书记处书记4人;中央顾问委员会负责人17人;中央纪律检查委员会负责人2人;以及其他有关同志。
translated_text: On the 16th, the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee held an enlarged meeting. At the meeting, Hu Yaobang reviewed his mistakes on major political principles during his tenure as General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, which violated the principle of collective leadership of the Party, and requested the Central Committee to approve his resignation from the post of General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee. The meeting made serious comradely criticisms of Hu Yaobang, and at the same time, it also truthfully affirmed his achievements in work. The enlarged meeting decided: (1) to unanimously agree to accept Hu Yaobang's request to resign from the post of General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee; (2) to unanimously elect Zhao Ziyang as Acting General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee; (3) to submit the above two decisions to the next plenary session of the CPC Central Committee for ratification; (4) to continue to retain Hu Yaobang's position as a member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee. Those who attended this enlarged meeting of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee included: 18 members of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, 2 alternate members of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee; 4 secretaries of the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee; 17 heads of the Central Advisory Committee; 2 heads of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection; and other relevant comrades.

25日 国家经济委员会、中共中央组织部发出关于印发
《“七五”期间全国大中型企业领导干部岗位职务培训规划要点》
的通知。《规划要点》指出,大中型企业领导干部培训要围绕经
济体制改革对企业提出的要求确定培训内容,以提高企业领导干
部的政治思想和业务素质为目标,着重进行马列主义基本理论、
现代化管理、领导科学、经济法规和涉外经济知识的教育。《规
划要点》提出,所有大中型企业的领导干部,在任职期间,都要
脱产参加为期四个半月的岗位职务培训,取得“岗位职务培训证
书”,并作为连任的必备条件之一。
translated_text: On the 25th, the State Economic Commission and the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued a notice on the issuance of the "Key Points of the National Training Plan for Leading Cadres of Large and Medium-sized Enterprises during the Seventh Five-Year Plan Period". The "Key Points of the Plan" pointed out that the training content of leading cadres of large and medium-sized enterprises should be determined around the requirements of the economic system reform for enterprises, with the goal of improving the political thinking and professional quality of enterprise leading cadres, focusing on the education of basic theories of Marxism-Leninism, modern management, leadership science, economic laws and regulations, and foreign-related economic knowledge. The "Key Points of the Plan" proposed that all leading cadres of large and medium-sized enterprises should participate in a four-and-a-half-month full-time job training during their tenure, and obtain a "Job Training Certificate", which is one of the necessary conditions for re-election.

events:
28日 中共中央发出《关于当前反对资产阶级自由化若干
问题的通知》。《通知》指出,这场斗争,从总体上说,是对广大
党员进行一次坚持四项基本原则,全面、正确理解和贯彻执行党
的十一届三中全会以来的路线、方针、政策的教育。这场斗争严
格限于党内,而且主要在政治思想领域内进行,着重解决根本政
治原则和政治方向问题,即主要是反对企图摆脱共产党的领导、
否定社会主义道路的错误思潮。要始终坚持正面教育为主,团结
绝大多数的方针。要采取和风细雨,心平气和,以理服人的方
法,坚决避免过去那种“以人划线,上挂下联,层层检查,人人
过关”,以及号召揭发检举等“左”的错误做法。
translated_text: On the 28th, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on Several Issues in the Current Fight against Bourgeois Liberalization". The "Notice" pointed out that this struggle, in general, is an education for the majority of party members to adhere to the Four Cardinal Principles and fully and correctly understand and implement the line, principles and policies of the party since the Third Plenary Session of the Eleventh Central Committee. This struggle is strictly limited to the party and is mainly carried out in the field of political thought, focusing on solving the fundamental political principles and political direction issues, that is, mainly opposing the erroneous thoughts that attempt to break away from the leadership of the Communist Party and deny the socialist path. We must always adhere to the principle of focusing on positive education and uniting the vast majority. We must adopt a gentle and calm approach to convince people with reason, and resolutely avoid the past "drawing lines based on people, hanging links from top to bottom, checking at all levels, and everyone passing the test", as well as calling for exposure and denunciation and other "leftist" erroneous practices.

events:
3日 《人民日报》报道,国务院颁布《关于进一步推进科
技体制改革的若干规定》。《规定》指出,今年要进一步放活科研
机构,促进多层次、多形式的科研生产联合,推动科技与经济的
紧密结合,进一步改革科技人员管理制度,放宽对科技人员
的政策,为充分发挥科技人员作用创造良好的社会环境。规定要
求,国务院各部门都要实行政研职责分开,简政放权,把科研机
构逐步放到企业、企业集团、行业和中心城市;科研机构要实行
精简缩编。在近几年内,一般不再新增机构、扩大编制,对现有
科技人员要进行调整,有进有出,新老交替,以形成一支精干的
科技队伍;全面实行所长负责制,科研机构的业务与行政管理工
作由所长全权负责。
translated_text: On the 3rd, the People's Daily reported that the State Council promulgated the "Several Regulations on Further Promoting the Reform of the Science and Technology System". The "Regulations" pointed out that this year, scientific research institutions should be further liberalized, multi-level and multi-form scientific research and production cooperation should be promoted, the close integration of science and technology and economy should be promoted, the management system of scientific and technological personnel should be further reformed, and the policies on scientific and technological personnel should be relaxed to create a good social environment for giving full play to the role of scientific and technological personnel. The regulations require that all departments of the State Council should implement the separation of administrative and research responsibilities, streamline administration and delegate power, and gradually transfer scientific research institutions to enterprises, enterprise groups, industries and central cities; scientific research institutions should be streamlined and reduced. In recent years, generally no new institutions will be added or the establishment will be expanded. Existing scientific and technological personnel should be adjusted, with both inflows and outflows, and the old and new will be replaced to form a lean scientific and technological team; the director responsibility system will be fully implemented, and the business and administrative management of scientific research institutions will be the sole responsibility of the director.

events:
6日 中共中央整党工作指导委员会发出通知,要求各地继
续按照中央整党工作指导委员会《关于农村整党工作部署的通
知》的要求和中共中央党工作指导委员会常务副主任薄一波
1986年12月29日《关于村级整党中如何正确认识和把握突出。
重点问题的谈话》精神,进一步加强领导,切实做好各项整党工
作,决不能稍有松懈。已基本结束村级整党工作的地方和单位,
要抓紧解决整党中的遗留问题,从思想上、作风上、纪律上、组
织上巩固发展整党成果。
translated_text: On the 6th, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China’s Party Rectification Work Steering Committee issued a notice requiring all localities to continue to follow the requirements of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China’s Party Rectification Work Steering Committee’s “Notice on the Arrangement of Rural Party Rectification Work” and the spirit of the “Talk on How to Correctly Understand and Grasp the Prominent Key Issues in Village-level Party Rectification” by Bo Yibo, Executive Deputy Director of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China’s Party Work Steering Committee on December 29, 1986, to further strengthen leadership and do a good job in various party rectification work, and never relax. Localities and units that have basically completed village-level party rectification work should speed up the resolution of remaining problems in the party rectification and consolidate and develop the results of the party rectification in terms of ideology, style, discipline, and organization.

events:
16日 中共中央书记处举行会议,讨论《中央组织部关于
中央管理干部审批程序问题的请示》。会议认为,改革中央管理
干部的审批程序,应当同政治体制改革,特别是干部制度改革相
结合。中央组织部要继续调查研究,提出干部制度改革方案,报
中央审批。
会议还讨论了《劳动人事部关于推迟女干部离休退休年龄问
题的调查报告》和《全国妇联关于延长女干部退休年龄问题的意
见》。会议认为,推迟女干部离休退休年龄问题,应从我国国情
出发,同就业政策、劳动力结构等方面结合起来考虑,慎重对
待。会议决定,请劳动人事部、中央组织部、全国妇联、全国人
大等部门,根据中央书记处讨论的精神,对是否推迟女干部离休
退休年龄问题深入调查研究,提出具体意见。
全国纪检工作会议在北京举行。会议强调,要严肃党的政治
纪律,反对资产阶级自由化,加强党内监督。会议要求,1987
主要抓好五项工作:维护党的政治纪律;纪检工作要成为促进
改革的重要力量;继续纠正不正之风;加强党性教育;发挥监督
作用。
translated_text: On the 16th, the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee held a meeting to discuss the "Request of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee on the Approval Procedures for Central Management Cadres". The meeting believed that the reform of the approval procedures for central management cadres should be combined with the reform of the political system, especially the reform of the cadre system. The Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee should continue to investigate and study, propose a reform plan for the cadre system, and submit it to the Central Committee for approval. The meeting also discussed the "Investigation Report of the Ministry of Labor and Personnel on Postponing the Retirement Age of Female Cadres" and the "Opinions of the All-China Women's Federation on Extending the Retirement Age of Female Cadres". The meeting believed that the issue of postponing the retirement age of female cadres should be considered in combination with employment policies, labor force structure and other aspects based on my country's national conditions and treated with caution. The meeting decided to ask the Ministry of Labor and Personnel, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the All-China Women's Federation, the National People's Congress and other departments to conduct in-depth investigations and studies on whether to postpone the retirement age of female cadres in accordance with the spirit of the discussion of the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee and put forward specific opinions. The National Disciplinary Inspection Work Conference was held in Beijing. The meeting emphasized the need to strictly enforce the party's political discipline, oppose bourgeois liberalization, and strengthen internal party supervision. The meeting required that 1987 should focus on five tasks: maintaining the party's political discipline; discipline inspection work should become an important force in promoting reform; continue to correct unhealthy tendencies; strengthen party spirit education; and play a supervisory role.

events:
18日 中共中央组织部发出《关于继续做好后备干部调整
补充工作的通知》。《通知》指出,省、地、县党政领导班子,中
央和国家机关部委直属局及其司局,省直厅局委办,要着重补充
一批比较成熟,近期可进领导班子的人选;选拔后备干部要改进
选拔考核方法,必须经过群众路线、组织部门考核、党委(党
组)集体讨论、上级组织部门审定的程序;要特别重视对后备干
部政治素质、理论水平、党性锻炼的考察,严格把好政治关;切
实执行后备干部能进能出的制度,经考核和实践检验确属相形见
编者,应进行调整。
translated_text: On the 18th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on Continuing to Do a Good Job in the Adjustment and Supplementation of Reserve Cadres". The "Notice" pointed out that the provincial, prefectural and county party and government leadership teams, the central and state organs and their departments and bureaus, and the provincial bureaus and offices should focus on supplementing a group of relatively mature candidates who can join the leadership team in the near future; the selection and assessment methods of reserve cadres should be improved, and they must go through the procedures of mass line, organization department assessment, party committee (party group) collective discussion, and approval by the superior organization department; special attention should be paid to the examination of the political quality, theoretical level, and party spirit training of reserve cadres, and strict political control should be exercised; the system of reserve cadres being able to enter and exit should be implemented effectively, and those who are found to be inferior to the editor after assessment and practical verification should be adjusted.

events:
2日 《人民日报》报道,我国已开始全面培训企业领导干
部。第一期全国大型企业厂长(经理)岗位职务培训班开学,
主要培训大中型企业的厂长(经理)、党委书记、总工程师、总
经济师和总会计师。为了保证培训质量,国家教委、中共中央组
织部和国家经委以及高等院校的部分专家、教授联合成立了大中
型企业领导干部培训教育指导委员会,负责教材的编写和教学工
作。对培训期满成绩合格者,指导委员会将发给证书。从1988
年开始,未经培训和没有取得培训证书者,一律不予任职。
translated_text: On the 2nd, the People's Daily reported that my country has begun comprehensive training for corporate leaders. The first national large-scale enterprise director (manager) job position training class started, mainly training large and medium-sized enterprise directors (managers), party committee secretaries, chief engineers, chief economists and chief accountants. In order to ensure the quality of training, the State Education Commission, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, the State Economic Commission and some experts and professors from colleges and universities jointly established the Large and Medium-sized Enterprise Leader Training Education Steering Committee, which is responsible for the compilation of teaching materials and teaching work. The Steering Committee will issue certificates to those who pass the training. Starting from 1988, those who have not received training and have not obtained training certificates will not be appointed.

events: 1987年3月12日,中央组织部和劳动人事部就《关于补充乡镇干部实行选任制和聘用制的暂行规定》发出通知,指出乡镇干部实行选任制和聘用制,是改革干部任用制度的一项内容,补充乡镇一般干部,在行政编制定员内,实行聘用制。受聘人员在聘用期间被选举担任乡镇领导职务的,随之改为选任。聘用乡镇干部,必须坚持“公开招考”,择优聘用的原则,被聘用后,用人单位与受聘人员签订合同或协议,明确规定双方的权利、义务、职责及聘用期限等事项。选任或聘用的人员,在任期和聘期内,享有国家工作人员应有的权利,履行所承担的义务,尽职尽责地搞好本职工作。按照干部管理权限,用人单位应根据工作岗位责任制的要求,对选任、聘用人员加强考核。选任人员在任期内,如因失职渎职或犯严重错误失去任职条件的,可依法免职。聘用人员不能履行合同或协议,可以解聘。选任或聘任人员在任期或聘期内,执行以职务工资为主的结构工资制。
translated_text: On March 12, 1987, the Central Organization Department and the Ministry of Labor and Personnel issued a notice on the "Interim Provisions on the Implementation of the Election and Employment System for Supplementing Township Cadres", pointing out that the implementation of the election and employment system for township cadres is a part of the reform of the cadre appointment system. The employment system is implemented within the administrative staffing system to supplement general township cadres. If the employed personnel are elected to serve as township leaders during the employment period, they will be changed to election. The employment of township cadres must adhere to the principle of "open recruitment" and the principle of selecting the best. After being hired, the employer and the employed personnel sign a contract or agreement to clearly stipulate the rights, obligations, responsibilities and employment period of both parties. During the term of office and the term of employment, the elected or employed personnel shall enjoy the rights that state employees should have, perform the obligations they undertake, and do their job well with due diligence. In accordance with the cadre management authority, the employing unit should strengthen the assessment of the elected and employed personnel according to the requirements of the job position responsibility system. If the elected personnel lose the qualifications for office due to dereliction of duty or serious mistakes during their term of office, they may be dismissed according to law. If the employed personnel cannot perform the contract or agreement, they can be dismissed. During the term of office or employment, the selected or employed personnel shall implement the structural wage system with position salary as the main component.

events:
14日 中共中央组织部和劳动人事部《关于补充乡镇干
部实行选任制和聘用制的暂行规定》发出通知。《通知》指出:
乡镇干部实行选任制和聘用制,是改革干部任用制度的一项内
容,对于促进乡镇干部队伍的革命化、年轻化、知识化、专业
化,逐步做到干部能进能出,能上能下,搞好基层政权和党的组
织建设,有着十分重要的意义。《通知》规定了六个方面的内
容:(一)乡镇党政机关及人民团体的领导人员,一律由选举产
生。(二)补充乡镇一般干部,实行聘任制。(三)选聘用人员
除政治条件合格外,年龄一般应在35岁以下,身体健康,具有
高中、中专以上文化程度。(四)聘用必须坚持“公开招考、择优
聘用”的原则。(五)选、聘用人员在任职期间享有国家工作人员
应有的权力,履行所承担的义务,执行以职务工资为主的结构工
资制。(六)全民所有制事业单位参照本规定办理。
translated_text: On the 14th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the Ministry of Labor and Personnel issued a notice on the "Interim Provisions on the Implementation of the Election and Employment System for Supplementing Township Cadres". The "Notice" pointed out that the implementation of the election and employment system for township cadres is a part of the reform of the cadre appointment system. It is of great significance to promote the revolutionization, rejuvenation, knowledge and professionalization of the township cadre team, gradually achieve the ability of cadres to enter and exit, to move up and down, and to improve the grassroots political power and party organization construction. The "Notice" stipulates six aspects: (1) The leaders of township party and government organs and people's organizations shall all be elected. (2) The appointment system shall be implemented for the supplement of general township cadres. (3) In addition to meeting the political requirements, the selected personnel shall generally be under 35 years old, in good health, and have a high school or technical secondary school education or above. (4) The employment must adhere to the principle of "open recruitment and selection of the best". (5) The selected and hired personnel shall enjoy the rights and responsibilities that state employees should have during their term of office, and shall implement a structural wage system based mainly on position wages. (6) Public institutions owned by the whole people shall follow these regulations.

events: 1987年3月26日,干部人事制度改革专题组提出,工作人员的概念过于宽泛,不能突出行使国家行政权力、执行国家公务人员的职业特点,建议将《国家行政机关工作人员条例》改为《国家公务员暂行条例》。1987年5月20日,中央政治体制改革研讨小组听取干部人事制度改革专题组汇报认为,在我国建立国家公务员制度的考虑基本可行;“国家公务员”这个概念比“干部”“工作人员”都要清楚,能较好地表达政府系统中依法行使国家行政权力、执行国家公务的人员特点。
translated_text: On March 26, 1987, the cadre and personnel system reform special group proposed that the concept of staff was too broad and could not highlight the professional characteristics of personnel who exercised state administrative power and performed state public affairs, and suggested that the "Regulations on Staff of State Administrative Organs" be changed to the "Interim Regulations on State Public Servants". On May 20, 1987, the Central Political System Reform Research Group listened to the report of the cadre and personnel system reform special group and believed that the consideration of establishing a state public service system in my country was basically feasible; the concept of "state public servant" was clearer than "cadres" and "staff members", and could better express the characteristics of personnel in the government system who exercised state administrative power and performed state public affairs in accordance with the law.

党的基本总结和进一步加强党的建设》的重要报告。
《报告》指出,这次整党的宝贵经验和深刻教训各有两条。
两条宝贵经验是,没有采取大轰大嘴,大搞“群众运动”的方式,

互相结合,互相促进。两条深刻教训是,不少部门和单位的领导
由于受到孤立强调“端正业务指导思想”的影响,放松以至严重
略了思想、作风、纪律和组织的整顿,以至在整党后期,出现了

打断,结果使资产阶级自由化的思潮的泛滥日趋严重,直至后来
酿成了少数学生闹事的“学潮”。

(一)坚持党要管党的原则,切实搞好党政分开;(二)加强党的
思想理论建设,努力提高党员的政治素质;(三)抓好党的作风
建设,密切党和群众的关系;(四)适应新形势的发展,不断加
强各级领导班子的建设;(五)健全党的组织建设和制度建设,
进一步提高党的战斗力。

On behalf of the CPC Central Committee and the CPC Central Committee, Bo Yibo made an important report on "Basic Summary of Party Rectification and Further Strengthening Party Building". The "Report" pointed out that there are two valuable experiences and profound lessons in this party rectification. The two valuable experiences are that we did not adopt the method of big talk and "mass movement", and successfully avoided the "left" erroneous practices that prevailed in the past political movements; we always paid attention to correctly handling the relationship between the party rectification work and reform and economic work, and basically achieved mutual combination and mutual promotion. Two profound lessons are that many leaders of departments and units, influenced by the isolated emphasis on "correcting the guiding ideology of business", relaxed or even seriously neglected the rectification of thoughts, work styles, discipline and organization, so that in the later period of the rectification, several new unhealthy tendencies emerged and spread rapidly; individual leading comrades did not implement the decisions of the Central Committee, resulting in the struggle against spiritual pollution being interrupted soon after the rectification began, and the flood of bourgeois liberalization became increasingly serious, until later it led to a "student movement" in which a few students made trouble. The "Report" put forward five suggestions for continuing to build the party after the rectification: (1) Adhere to the principle that the party should manage the party and do a good job in separating the party and the government; (2) Strengthen the party's ideological and theoretical construction and strive to improve the political quality of party members; (3) Do a good job in the party's work style construction and strengthen the relationship between the party and the masses; (4) Adapt to the development of the new situation and continuously strengthen the construction of leadership teams at all levels; (5) Improve the party's organizational construction and system construction and further improve the party's combat effectiveness.

events:

督;二要发扬党的民主传统,扩大党内民主,加强民主集中制;

活会,认真开展批评和自我批评;四要严明党的纪律,对违法乱
纪的党员要严肃处理;五要对党员进行马列主义、毛泽东思想的
教育,进行党的路线、方针、政策和优良传统的教育,提高全党
的理论水平和政治素质,真正达到工人阶级先进分子的标准。
translated_text: On the 27th, the Central Advisory Committee of the Communist Party of China and the Organization Department of the Communist Party of China held a symposium in Beijing to commemorate the "July 1st" and strengthen party building. Song Ping, Minister of the Organization Department of the Communist Party of China, presided over the symposium. Qiao Shi, member of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China and Secretary of the Central Secretariat, and more than 30 old comrades who participated in revolutionary work in the early days of the founding of the party, the Great Revolution, the Agrarian Revolution, and the Anti-Japanese War attended the symposium. The old comrades who spoke believed that an important issue in the future party building is that the party must manage itself. They proposed that in order to strengthen the party's construction, first, supervision should be strengthened. Party members and party cadres, as well as the Central Committee, should accept supervision; second, the party's democratic tradition should be carried forward, inner-party democracy should be expanded, and democratic centralism should be strengthened; third, the party's organizational life should be well done. Party members and cadres at all levels should participate in organizational life meetings and earnestly carry out criticism and self-criticism; fourth, the party's discipline should be strictly enforced, and party members who violate laws and disciplines should be severely dealt with; fifth, party members should be educated in Marxism-Leninism, Mao Zedong Thought, the party's line, principles, policies and fine traditions, so as to improve the theoretical level and political quality of the whole party and truly meet the standards of advanced elements of the working class.

索賄问题的决定》。《决定》要点是:(一)共产党员,特别是党
员领导干部,不管是谁,因受贿、索賄而触犯刑律的,一律开除
党籍;无论采用什么方式索賄的党员,都必须主动交待问题,否
则,一经查出,即予以党纪制裁;共产党员今后再有索贿行为,
不论情节轻重,一律清除出党。(二)对经济活动中正常的“回
扣”,任何人不得以任何理由和借口窃为己有,一律上缴国家或
集体,违者按党纪、法纪严格处理。(三)各级党组织包括纪律
检查机关,要切实加强对党员的教育、管理和监督,绝不允许拿
党的原则做交易。对那些有索贿、受贿问题的党员,必须坚决查
处,如果姑息迁就,不予处理,要追究其所在党组织的领导责
任。
translated_text: On the 30th, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection issued the "Decision on Resolutely Investigating and Handling the Problem of Communist Party Members Extorting Bribes". The main points of the "Decision" are: (1) Communist Party members, especially leading party members, who violate the criminal law by accepting bribes or extorting bribes, no matter who they are, must be expelled from the party; Party members who extort bribes in any way must take the initiative to confess the problem, otherwise, once discovered, they will be punished by party discipline; Communist Party members who extort bribes in the future, regardless of the severity of the circumstances, will be expelled from the party. (2) No one may take the normal "kickbacks" from economic activities for their own use for any reason or excuse, and they must be turned over to the state or the collective. Violators will be strictly dealt with in accordance with party discipline and laws. (3) Party organizations at all levels, including discipline inspection agencies, must effectively strengthen the education, management and supervision of party members, and never allow the party's principles to be traded. Party members who have problems with extortion and bribery must be resolutely investigated and dealt with. If they are condoned and not dealt with, the leadership of the party organization to which they belong will be held accountable.

translated_text: On the 6th, the People's Daily reported that my country will implement planned management of cadre growth in party and government organs and state-owned enterprises and institutions nationwide from this year, so as to gradually adjust the structure of the cadre team, effectively control the blind expansion of the cadre team, and make the cadre team grow reasonably. The main contents of implementing the planned management of cadre growth include: in the future, all departments and units accepting college and technical school graduates allocated by the state, military demobilized cadres, and cadres recruited or hired in small quantities from other aspects due to special needs must be included in the cadre growth plan, and the natural attrition and replenishment of cadres must also be managed by plan. In terms of planning arrangements, the needs of national key construction projects and newly built and expanded departments, the needs of remote mountainous areas and ethnic minority areas for cadres must be guaranteed, and the increase of cadres in party and government organs must be strictly controlled. The cadres needed by various departments and units should first be adjusted from the existing cadres within the establishment quota. If they cannot be solved, they should be supplemented by selecting the best from college and technical school graduates and military demobilized cadres allocated by the state within the cadre increase plan quota. In principle, they should not be recruited from the society. Some departments that need to be strengthened, if their grassroots units really need to recruit a small number of people from the society, should mainly recruit or employ the best graduates from correspondence universities, vocational universities, radio and television universities, night universities, self-funded day university graduates and vocational high school graduates. 问。这位负责人说,自1982年机构改革以来,干部工作也进行
了改革:(一)建立了老干部退休离休制度。到1986年底,全国
已有 137 万建国前参加革命工作的老干部离休。(二)大胆提拔

部管理权限。(四)结合各行各业的特点,进行多种形式选拔干
部的试验。

政企分开和管人管事既紧密结合又合理制约的原则,进一步抓
好干部的分类管理。(二)实行干部的分类管理,首先要从国家
行政机关入手,把现在干部队伍中行使国家权力、执行国家公务
的这一部分人员分离出来,建立相应的管理制度,依法进行科学

和检察机关等各类领导人员和工作人员的管理制度。(三)在干
部管理的改革中,要进一步废除干部领导职务终身制,完善选
举、委任、聘任制度,规定任期,促进人员的合理进退和交流。
translated_text: On the 10th, the head of the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China answered reporters' questions about the reform of the cadre system. The head said that since the institutional reform in 1982, the cadre work has also been reformed: (a) A retirement system for veteran cadres has been established. By the end of 1986, 1.37 million veteran cadres who participated in the revolutionary work before the founding of the People's Republic of China had retired. (b) Young and relatively young cadres were boldly promoted and appointed. The entire cadre team has made a big step forward in achieving revolutionization, rejuvenation, knowledge and specialization. (c) The authority to manage cadres has been decentralized. (d) In combination with the characteristics of various industries, various forms of cadre selection experiments have been carried out. In the future, the reform of the cadre system needs to focus on the following: (a) Further improve the classified management of cadres in accordance with the principles of separation of party and government, separation of government and enterprises, and close integration and reasonable constraints in the management of people and affairs. (ii) To implement the classified management of cadres, we must first start with the state administrative organs, separate the personnel who exercise state power and perform state duties from the current cadre team, establish a corresponding management system, and conduct scientific management in accordance with the law; then gradually study and establish a management system for various types of leaders and staff such as party committees, state power organs, judicial organs, and procuratorates. (iii) In the reform of cadre management, we must further abolish the lifelong tenure of cadre leadership positions, improve the election, appointment, and appointment system, stipulate terms of office, and promote the reasonable entry and exit and exchange of personnel.

translated_text: From November 25 to November 1, the 13th National Congress of the Communist Party of China was held in Beijing. Deng Xiaoping, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, presided over the opening ceremony of the congress. Zhao Ziyang, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, was entrusted by the 12th Central Committee to deliver a report to the congress entitled "Advancing along the road of socialism with Chinese characteristics". The report is divided into seven parts: (i) Historic achievements and the tasks of this congress; (ii) The primary stage of socialism and the basic line of the party; (iii) On the strategy of economic development; (iv) On economic system reform; (v) On political system reform; (vi) Strengthening party building in reform and opening up; (vii) Striving for new victories of Marxism in China. 1,936 delegates attended the congress, and 61 were specially invited. Some members of the 12th Central Committee, members of the Central Advisory Committee, members of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, some old comrades in the party, and other relevant responsible comrades in the party, a total of 317 people attended the congress. The conference used secret ballot to elect candidates for the Central Committee, members of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and alternate members of the Central Committee, and proposed candidates for members of the Central Advisory Committee. events: 1987年10月25日,中国共产党第十三次全国代表大会通过的政治报告指出,“进行干部人事制度的改革,就是要对‘国家干部进行合理分解,改变集中统一管理的现状,建立科学的分类管理体制;改变用党政干部的单一模式管理所有人员的现状,形成各具特色的人事管理制度;改变缺乏民主法制的现状,实现干部人事的依法管理和公开监督。”“当前干部人事制度改革的重点,是建立国家公务员制度,即制定法律和规章,对政府中行使国家权力、执行国家公务的人员,依法进行科学管理。”“凡进入公务员队伍,应当通过法定考试,公开竞争;他们的岗位职责有明确规范,对他们的考核按法定的标准和程序进行,他们的升降奖惩应以工作实绩为主要依据;他们的培训、工资、福利和退休的权利由法律保障。”“建立和完善这样一种制度,需要相当长的过程。当前要抓紧制定国家公务员条例及相应的配套措施,组建国家公务员管理机构,筹办国家行政学院。”
translated_text: On October 25, 1987, the political report adopted by the 13th National Congress of the Communist Party of China pointed out that "the reform of the cadre and personnel system is to rationally decompose the state cadres, change the current situation of centralized and unified management, and establish a scientific classification management system; change the current situation of managing all personnel with a single model of party and government cadres, and form a personnel management system with unique characteristics; change the current situation of lack of democracy and the rule of law, and realize the legal management and open supervision of cadres and personnel." "The current focus of the cadre and personnel system reform is to establish a national civil service system, that is, to formulate laws and regulations to scientifically manage the personnel who exercise state power and perform state duties in the government." "Anyone who enters the civil service team should pass the statutory examination and compete openly; their job responsibilities have clear regulations, and their assessment is carried out according to statutory standards and procedures. Their promotion, demotion, rewards and punishments should be based mainly on work performance; their training, wages, benefits and retirement rights are guaranteed by law." "It will take a long time to establish and improve such a system. At present, we must speed up the formulation of national civil service regulations and corresponding supporting measures, establish a national civil service management agency, and prepare for the establishment of the National School of Administration."

调剂解决。中央办公厅、国务院办公厅通知各地认真做好调整干
部结构工作。
中共中央组织部和劳动人事部在《关于调整干部结构的意
见》中指出,为了有利于调整干部结构,对自愿到政法、税务等.
需要加強的部门工作的所有在编干部,只要条件适合,流向合
理,都应支持和放行。要严格控制从社会上招收干部,对于某些
部门所属的县及县以下基层单位,从在职干部调整解决确有困
难的,可以从社会上少量招收,但必须按照先调整,后招收的原
则进行。上述增加干部的来源,从党政群机关及部分事业单位调
整的,不得少于增加干部总数的30%;从社会上招收的,不得
超过增加干部总数的20%。为控制党政机关人员的增长,对调
出干部的专业经济管理部门实行抽人减编,特别是职能正在转变
的部门,要适当多抽一些人员,多减一些编制,同时要相应核减
工资总额和行政经费。超编单位调出干部后,一律不予补充。
translated_text: On the 3rd, the Party Central Committee and the State Council decided to transfer more than 500,000 cadres to strengthen the political and legal comprehensive management and economic supervision departments in the next two years. These cadres will mainly be transferred from the existing cadres. The General Office of the Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council notified all localities to do a good job in adjusting the cadre structure. The Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the Ministry of Labor and Personnel pointed out in the "Opinions on Adjusting the Cadre Structure" that in order to facilitate the adjustment of the cadre structure, all the cadres on the payroll who voluntarily work in the political and legal, taxation and other departments that need to be strengthened should be supported and released as long as the conditions are suitable and the flow is reasonable. It is necessary to strictly control the recruitment of cadres from the society. For some departments, if there are difficulties in adjusting and solving the problems from the grassroots units at or below the county level, a small number of cadres can be recruited from the society, but it must be carried out in accordance with the principle of adjustment first and then recruitment. The sources of the above-mentioned increase in cadres, those adjusted from party, government, mass organizations and some public institutions, shall not be less than 30% of the total number of cadres increased; those recruited from the society shall not exceed 20% of the total number of cadres increased. In order to control the growth of personnel in party and government organs, the professional economic management departments that have transferred out cadres will implement the policy of reducing staff and reducing the establishment. In particular, departments whose functions are changing should appropriately transfer more personnel and reduce the establishment. At the same time, the total salary and administrative expenses should be reduced accordingly. After the overstaffed units transfer out cadres, they will not be replaced.

translated_text: On the 21st, the People's Daily reported that the Party committees, advisory committees, and discipline inspection committees of 14 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, and the People's Congresses, governments, and CPPCCs of 29 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government will hold elections this year. The Central Government requires that provincial elections must meet the needs of reform, and personnel arrangements should be conducive to the separation of the Party and the government. After the election, the provincial Party committees will no longer have full-time deputy secretaries or standing committee members who are not in government positions but in charge of government work, and the number of Party committee standing committee members should be appropriately reduced. In principle, the number of positions in the government leadership team will not increase, and no new government advisors will be arranged. Existing government advisors who are over 70 years old should retire. The number of positions in the leadership teams of the National People's Congress and the CPPCC should also be appropriately reduced. Provincial advisory committees with less than 10 members will be changed to advisory groups, and advisory groups may not be set up if the number is less than 3. The 24th meeting of the Standing Committee of the Sixth National People's Congress decided to appoint Peng Peiyun (female) as the director of the National Family Planning Commission; and to remove Wang Wei from the position of director of the National Family Planning Commission. The Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the Ministry of Labor and Personnel issued the "Notice on the Implementation of the Central Organization Department's Document No. 2 of 1987". The "Notice" pointed out that the departments that the Central Committee and the State Council have determined to be abolished or merged are not allowed to promote cadres; the newly established departments that have been approved can be equipped with cadres according to the number of posts stipulated by the Central Committee; all departments that have been determined to be retained, on the basis of implementing functional transformation, strictly equip cadres according to the number of posts stipulated by the Central Committee, and those who are promoted and used must be strictly controlled.

translated_text: From the 22nd to the 25th, the Central Organization Department held a symposium on the replacement of provincial leadership teams in nine provinces and cities, including Beijing, Shanxi, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Shandong, Henan, Hunan, Sichuan, and Gansu. Song Ping pointed out that it would be beneficial to conduct a good election to update the candidates within a certain range before the meeting and solicit opinions. This is the consistent practice of our party. Song Ping also said that in the differential election, there will always be people who lose. Comrades in office must withstand the test of losing. After a period of practice, everyone will gradually get used to the differential election. The Party Committee must dare to do work and take the initiative to do work.

The meeting reviewed and approved the work report made by General Secretary Zhao Ziyang on behalf of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee to the plenary session. The list of candidates for the leadership of state institutions proposed by the Political Bureau to be recommended to the Seventh National People's Congress and the list of candidates for the leadership of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference to be recommended to the Seventh National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference were reviewed and approved. There were 168 members of the Central Committee and 106 alternate members of the Central Committee attending the meeting. There were 183 members of the Central Advisory Commission, 68 members of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, and 36 relevant responsible comrades attending the meeting.

events:
16日 中央组织部发出通知,转发解放军总政治部《关于
建国前我军开办的学校及训练班学员入伍时间问题的通知》。《通
知》规定,原非我在职人员,建国前入我军开办的学校或训练班
学习,学习后即分配工作的,其入伍时间从入校之日算起。学校
随部队行动中招收的学员,从招收到部队之日算起。凡建国后入
校(或到部队)的学员,无论学校是否属于建国前开办,其入伍
时间不能从建国前算起。
translated_text: On the 16th, the Central Organization Department issued a notice forwarding the General Political Department of the People's Liberation Army's "Notice on the Enlistment Time of Students in Schools and Training Classes Established by Our Army before the Founding of the People's Republic of China". The "Notice" stipulates that for those who were not in our service before the founding of the People's Republic of China and entered schools or training classes established by our army to study before the founding of the People's Republic of China and were assigned to work after their studies, their enlistment time shall be counted from the date of admission to the school. For students enrolled by the school during the movement of the troops, the enlistment time shall be counted from the date of admission to the troops. For students who entered the school (or joined the troops) after the founding of the People's Republic of China, regardless of whether the school was established before the founding of the People's Republic of China, their enlistment time cannot be counted from before the founding of the People's Republic of China.

events:

意觉人任对外经济贸易部副部长;免去世镛《人民日报》社
副总编辑职务。

events:
18日 中共中央政治局常委、国务院代总理李鹏在中央国
家机关党的工作会议上发表重要讲话强调机关党的工作只能加
强,不能削弱;要求从事机关党务和政治工作的同志振奋精神,
认清责任,开拓进取,努力做好自己的工作。
translated_text: On the 18th, Li Peng, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Acting Premier of the State Council, delivered an important speech at the Party Work Conference of Central State Organs, emphasizing that the Party work of the organs can only be strengthened, not weakened; he required comrades engaged in the Party affairs and political work of the organs to cheer up, recognize their responsibilities, forge ahead, and work hard to do their jobs well.

events: 1988年3月23日,中央组织部､劳动人事部发出《关于政法､税务、工商行政部门和银行、保险系统招收干部实行统一考试的通知》。通知指出:在全国建立国家公务员制度之前,要在选拔干部方面尽量增加透明程度、开放程度和群众参与程度,对政法部门和综合、监督等部门招收干部的工作,可采取公开招考,择优录用或聘用的办法。根据这个精神,招收干部应坚持面向社会,公开报名,统一考试,德智体全面考核,择优录用或聘用的原则。
translated_text: On March 23, 1988, the Central Organization Department and the Ministry of Labor and Personnel issued the "Notice on the Implementation of Unified Examinations for the Recruitment of Cadres in the Political and Legal, Taxation, Industrial and Commercial Administration Departments, and Banks and Insurance Systems". The notice pointed out that before the establishment of the national civil service system in the country, the degree of transparency, openness and public participation in the selection of cadres should be increased as much as possible. The recruitment of cadres in the political and legal departments and comprehensive and supervisory departments can be carried out through open recruitment and selection or employment. According to this spirit, the recruitment of cadres should adhere to the principles of facing the society, open registration, unified examinations, comprehensive assessment of morality, intelligence and physical fitness, and selection or employment of the best.

events:

translated_text: From the 24th to the 28th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee held a symposium for the directors of the research offices of the Organization Departments of the Party Committees of provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the Central Government in Qingdao, Shandong Province. The main content of the meeting was to exchange experiences, coordinate research topics, implement the relevant tasks proposed in the 1988 work points of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, and discuss how to improve and strengthen the work of the research offices. Lv Feng, deputy director of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, attended the meeting and delivered an important speech, emphasizing the need to strengthen the investigation, research and publicity work of organizational work.

events: 25日——4月11日 第七届全国政协会议在北京举行。

events: 1988年3月25日,第七届全国人民代表大会第一次会议召开。国务院代总理李鹏作《政府工作报告》。报告提出:“要在改革政府机构的同时,抓紧建立和逐步实施国家公务员制度,尽快制定《国家公务员条例》,研究制定《国家公务员法》,开办行政学院,培养行政管理人员。今后各级政府录用公务员,要按《国家公务员条例》的规定,通过考试,择优选拔。”
translated_text: On March 25, 1988, the first session of the Seventh National People's Congress was held. Li Peng, Acting Premier of the State Council, delivered a "Government Work Report". The report proposed: "While reforming government institutions, we must speed up the establishment and gradual implementation of the national civil service system, formulate the "National Civil Service Regulations" as soon as possible, study and formulate the "National Civil Service Law", open administrative colleges, and train administrative personnel. In the future, governments at all levels must recruit civil servants in accordance with the provisions of the "National Civil Service Regulations", pass the examination, and select the best."

events:
26日 中共中央组织部印发《关于党的省、自治区、直辖
市代表大会实行差额选举的暂行办法》的通知。规定党的省、自
治区、直辖市代表大会的代表、委员会的委员、候补委员和常务
委员会委员,纪律检查委员会的委员、常务委员实行差额选举;
候选人得到的赞成票超过应到会选举人数的半数为当选。对差额
的比例、候选人产生的程序等,也作了相应的规定。
translated_text: On the 26th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued a notice on the "Interim Measures for the Implementation of Competitive Elections at the Party's Provincial, Autonomous Region, and Municipality Congresses". It stipulates that the representatives of the Party's provincial, autonomous region, and municipality congresses, members, alternate members, and standing committee members, and members and standing committee members of the Discipline Inspection Commission shall be elected by differential elections; candidates shall be elected if they receive more than half of the votes of the candidates who should be present at the election. Corresponding regulations have also been made on the proportion of differentials and the procedure for selecting candidates.

events: 1988年3月28日,国务委员宋平在第七届全国人大一次会议上对《国务院机构改革方案》作说明。为了适应党政职能分开后干部人事制度改革的要求,推行国家公务员制度,强化政府的人事管理职能,组建人事部。其主要职能是,建立和推行国家公务员制度,加强对国家人事行政和政府机构、编制的法制管理,综合协调各行业专业技术人员的分类管理,并承担有关国家机关工作人员的管理职能和原由国家科学技术委员会管理科技干部的职能。1988年3月30日,人事部筹备组决定,成立公务员制度工作小组,抓紧做好公务员制度实施的准备工作。
translated_text: On March 28, 1988, State Councilor Song Ping explained the "State Council Institutional Reform Plan" at the first session of the Seventh National People's Congress. In order to meet the requirements of the cadre personnel system reform after the separation of party and government functions, promote the national civil service system, strengthen the government's personnel management functions, and establish the Ministry of Personnel. Its main functions are to establish and promote the national civil service system, strengthen the legal management of national personnel administration and government agencies and establishment, comprehensively coordinate the classified management of professional and technical personnel in various industries, and assume the management functions of relevant state agency staff and the functions of the State Science and Technology Commission to manage scientific and technological cadres. On March 30, 1988, the preparatory group of the Ministry of Personnel decided to set up a civil service system working group to speed up preparations for the implementation of the civil service system.

events:

藤任国家教育委员会副主任,免去其中国科学院副院长职务;免
去杨海波国家教育委员会副主任、党组副书记职务。

光学、洛布桑国家民族事务委员会副主任职务;批准免去金宝生
广西壮族自治区党委副书记职务。
translated_text: On the 5th, the CPC Central Committee approved that Cao Zhi be appointed as the deputy secretary-general of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress; Teng Teng be appointed as the deputy director of the State Education Commission, and be relieved of his post as the vice president of the Chinese Academy of Sciences; Yang Haibo be relieved of his post as the deputy director and deputy secretary of the Party Group of the State Education Commission. The CPC Central Committee also approved that Su Xing be appointed as the vice president of the CPC Central Party School; approved the removal of Huang Guangxue and Lobusang from their posts as deputy directors of the State Ethnic Affairs Commission; and approved the removal of Jin Baosheng from his post as the deputy secretary of the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Party Committee.

events:
8日 中共中央组织部、全国妇联发出《在改革开放中加强
培养选拔女干部工作的意见》。《意见》指出,我国从业妇女总数
已达二亿二千多万,占从业人口总数的43.6%;女干部已有800
万,占干部总数的28.8%,而女干部在省、地、县领导班子中
只占5%左右,乡一级更低。《意见》强调,各级党委要切实重
视对妇女干部的培养和选拔工作,采取各种有力措施,为女干部
走上各级领导岗位创造良好的环境。要在三、五年内,使县、乡
两级女干部的比例有较大幅度的增长,基本做到县县有女领导干
部。
translated_text: On the 8th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the All-China Women's Federation issued the "Opinions on Strengthening the Training and Selection of Female Cadres in Reform and Opening Up". The "Opinions" pointed out that the total number of employed women in my country has reached more than 220 million, accounting for 43.6% of the total employed population; there are 8 million female cadres, accounting for 28.8% of the total number of cadres, while female cadres only account for about 5% of the provincial, prefectural and county leadership teams, and even lower at the township level. The "Opinions" emphasized that party committees at all levels must pay real attention to the training and selection of female cadres and take various effective measures to create a good environment for female cadres to take up leadership positions at all levels. Within three to five years, the proportion of female cadres at the county and township levels will increase significantly, and basically every county will have female leading cadres.

events: 1988年4月9日,第七届人大一次会议原则批准国务院机构改革方案,人事部正式成立。
translated_text: On April 9, 1988, the First Session of the Seventh National People's Congress approved in principle the State Council's institutional reform plan, and the Ministry of Personnel was formally established.

events:
10日 中共中央组织部发出《关于认真做好企事业单位党
组织实行属地领导试点工作的通知》。《通知》规定了试点工作的
指导思想,强调试点工作中应以党的十三大精神为指针,以党章
为依据,坚持积极稳妥的原则,从实际出发,大胆探索,不断总
结和积累经验,有领导、有步骤地进行,并要与其它各项改革配
套进行,与加强党的制度建设结合起来。
translated_text: On the 10th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on Earnestly Carrying out the Pilot Work of Implementing Local Leadership of Party Organizations in Enterprises and Institutions". The "Notice" stipulates the guiding ideology of the pilot work, emphasizing that the pilot work should be guided by the spirit of the 13th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, based on the Party Constitution, adhere to the principle of being proactive and prudent, proceed from reality, boldly explore, constantly summarize and accumulate experience, and be carried out in a planned and step-by-step manner. It should be carried out in conjunction with other reforms and combined with strengthening the party's system construction.

events: 15日 中共中央批准,成立中国共产党中国人民政治协商会议第七届全国委员会党组,同时撤销全国政协机关党组。政协七届全国委员会党组书记李先念;副书记王任重、阎明复;成员有方毅、谷牧、杨静仁、康克清、马文瑞、钱学森、胡绳、钱正英、司马义·艾买提、周绍静。中共中央批准,成立中国共产党第七届全国人民代表大会常务委员会党组,同时撤销全国人大常委会机关党组和全国人大常委会法制工作委员会党组。七届全国人大常委会党组由9人组成:书记万里;成员有习仲勋、彭冲、叶飞、廖汉生、倪志福、陈慕华、王汉斌、曹志。
translated_text: On the 15th, the CPC Central Committee approved the establishment of the Party Group of the Seventh National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference of the Communist Party of China, and at the same time abolished the Party Group of the National Committee of the CPPCC. The Party Group Secretary of the Seventh National Committee of the CPPCC was Li Xiannian; Vice Secretaries were Wang Renzhong and Yan Mingfu; members were Fang Yi, Gu Mu, Yang Jingren, Kang Keqing, Ma Wenrui, Qian Xuesen, Hu Sheng, Qian Zhengying, Simayi Aimaiti, and Zhou Shaojing. The CPC Central Committee approved the establishment of the Party Group of the Standing Committee of the Seventh National People's Congress of the Communist Party of China, and at the same time abolished the Party Group of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress and the Party Group of the Legal Affairs Committee of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress. The Party Group of the Seventh National People's Congress Standing Committee was composed of 9 people: Secretary Wan Li; members were Xi Zhongxun, Peng Chong, Ye Fei, Liao Hansheng, Ni Zhifu, Chen Muhua, Wang Hanbin, and Cao Zhi. events: 1988年6月1日,中共中央发出《关于党和国家机关必须保持廉洁的通知》,提出党和国家行政机关保持廉洁的基本要求是:党和国家机关工作人员要正确运用人民赋予的权力来为人民办事,切实做到:严守法纪,不贪赃枉法;制秉公尽职,不以权谋私;艰苦奋斗,不奢侈浪费。必须依法惩处索贿、受贿、贪污､弄权渎职､敲诈勒索等违法犯罪活动,必须坚决刹住受礼送礼、大吃大喝等不良风气,要把廉政建设同建立和健全各项制度结合起来,通过法律和制度来保证党和国家机关的廉洁。
translated_text: On June 1, 1988, the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on the Party and State Organs Must Maintain Integrity", which put forward the basic requirements for the Party and State administrative organs to maintain integrity: Party and state organ staff must correctly use the power granted by the people to serve the people, and truly do the following: strictly abide by laws and disciplines, not take bribes or pervert the law; be impartial and perform duties, not abuse power for personal gain; work hard, not be extravagant and wasteful. It is necessary to punish illegal and criminal activities such as soliciting bribes, accepting bribes, embezzlement, abuse of power, and extortion according to law, and resolutely stop the bad habits of accepting and giving gifts, eating and drinking lavishly, and combine the construction of clean government with the establishment and improvement of various systems, and ensure the integrity of the Party and state organs through laws and systems.

events:
6日 中共中央组织部副部长赵宗在接受记者采访时说,
自1982年机构改革以来,河北、山西、山东、陕西、四川、贵
州、北京等省、直辖市,以及广东、广西、江西、湖南、江苏、
河南、黑龙江等省、自治区的部分地区,结合调整领导班子和换
届选举,有计划、有步骤地对地、县两级领导干部实行了易地交
流。山东等省和一些县、市党政主要领导同志已基本交流了一
遍。
translated_text: On the 6th, Zhao Zong, deputy director of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, said in an interview with reporters that since the institutional reform in 1982, Hebei, Shanxi, Shandong, Shaanxi, Sichuan, Guizhou, Beijing and other provinces and municipalities, as well as parts of Guangdong, Guangxi, Jiangxi, Hunan, Jiangsu, Henan, Heilongjiang and other provinces and autonomous regions, have implemented the exchange of leading cadres at the prefecture and county levels in a planned and step-by-step manner in conjunction with the adjustment of leadership teams and elections. The main leading comrades of the party and government in Shandong and other provinces and some counties and cities have basically been exchanged.

events:
8日 中共中央同意,吴景春(女)任国家计划委员会副主
任;屠由瑞任铁道部副部长;刘积斌任财政部副部长,免去其国
家有资产管理局局长职务;批准葛洪升任浙江省委副书记。
translated_text: On the 8th, the CPC Central Committee agreed to appoint Wu Jingchun (female) as deputy director of the State Planning Commission; Tu Yourui as deputy minister of the Ministry of Railways; Liu Jibin as deputy minister of the Ministry of Finance, and was relieved of his post as director of the State-owned Assets Administration Bureau; and approved Ge Hong's promotion to deputy secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee.

events:
11日 中共中央决定,任建新任最高人民法院党组书记;
刘复之任最高人民检察院党组书记。
translated_text: On the 11th, the CPC Central Committee decided that Ren Jianxin would be appointed as the Party Secretary of the Supreme People's Court; Liu Fuzhi would be appointed as the Party Secretary of the Supreme People's Procuratorate.

events:
12日 《人民日报》报道,新的国家计委组建基本完成,
同已经撤销的原国家计委、经委相比,新计委司局级职能机构从
原两委66个减少到26个,减少60%,机关干部减少40%多。
translated_text: On the 12th, the People's Daily reported that the establishment of the new State Planning Commission was basically completed. Compared with the original State Planning Commission and the Economic Commission that had been abolished, the new State Planning Commission's department-level functional agencies were reduced from 66 to 26, a reduction of 60%, and the number of agency cadres was reduced by more than 40%.

events:
15日 《人民日报》报道,据中共中央组织部统计,1982
年到1987年,通过县以上党校、管理干部学院、干部学校培训
的各级各类干部达734万多人次,其中获得大专学历的干部有
115万多人,取得中专学历的有62万多人,取得高中学历的干
部有56万人。
translated_text: On the 15th, the People's Daily reported that according to statistics from the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, from 1982 to 1987, more than 7.34 million cadres of all levels and types were trained in party schools, management cadre colleges, and cadre schools at or above the county level, of which more than 1.15 million cadres obtained college degrees, more than 620,000 obtained secondary technical school degrees, and 560,000 obtained high school degrees.

events:
16日 中共中央组织部召开新闻发布会宣布:经中央批
准,从今年开始,在我国建立地方党政领导干部年度工作考核制
度。同时还指出,从 1983 年以来,各地和各部门采用德才测评
方法考察的干部有27万多人,其中地厅级干部3万多人。1986
年以来各地还普遍对各级领导班子进行了民主考评,被考评的领
导干部有18万多人。
translated_text: On the 16th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China held a press conference and announced that, with the approval of the Central Committee, an annual work assessment system for local party and government leading cadres will be established in my country starting this year. It also pointed out that since 1983, more than 270,000 cadres have been assessed by various regions and departments using the method of moral and talent assessment, including more than 30,000 prefecture-level and department-level cadres. Since 1986, various regions have also generally conducted democratic assessments on leadership teams at all levels, and more than 180,000 leading cadres have been assessed.

events:
18日 中共中央同意,谢高觉任邮电部副部长;方顺任
国家地震局局长,免去其地质矿产部副部长职务;连尹任民政部
副部长。
translated_text: On the 18th, the CPC Central Committee agreed to appoint Xie Gaojue as Vice Minister of Posts and Telecommunications; Fang Shun as Director of the State Seismological Bureau, dismissed from his post as Vice Minister of Geology and Mineral Resources; Lian Yin as Vice Minister of Civil Affairs.

events:
22日 新华社报道,党的十一届三中全会以来的9年中,
全国共发展新党员1285万多名。其中各类专业技术人员有 230
万。优秀知识分子“入党难”的问题已基本得到解决。
在每年发展的新党员中,35岁以下的和具有高中以上文化
程度的都分别占三分之二以上。到1987年底,在全国4700万党
员中,35岁以下的占27.3%,具有高中以上文化程度的由1978
年的12.8%上升到28.5%。
translated_text: On the 22nd, Xinhua News Agency reported that in the nine years since the Third Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee of the Party, more than 12.85 million new Party members have been recruited nationwide. Among them, there are 2.3 million professional and technical personnel of various types. The problem of "difficulty in joining the Party" for outstanding intellectuals has been basically solved. Among the new Party members recruited each year, those under 35 years old and those with a high school education or above account for more than two-thirds respectively. By the end of 1987, among the 47 million Party members nationwide, those under 35 years old accounted for 27.3%, and those with a high school education or above increased from 12.8% in 1978 to 28.5%.

events:
24日 《人民日报》报道,1987年国家实行干部计划管理
之后,干部增长速度由“六五”期间的增长6.98%,下降到年
增长5.11%,控制在国家下达指标之内,干部队伍结构的总体
分布也随之趋向合理化。
translated_text: On the 24th, the People's Daily reported that after the state implemented the planned management of cadres in 1987, the growth rate of cadres dropped from 6.98% during the "Sixth Five-Year Plan" period to 5.11% per year, which was within the state's target, and the overall distribution of the cadre team structure also tended to be rationalized.

events:
25日——7月1日经中共中央批准,中共中央组织部在北
京召开全国组织工作会议。出席会议的有各省、自治区、直辖市
党委主管组织工作的负责同志和组织部负责同志;中央、国家机
关各部委、各人民团体的干部司(局)长或组织部长;国务院部
分直属单位和军委总政治部的有关负责同志。
会上,中共中央政治局委员、中共中央组织部部长宋平作了
题为《深化改革,从严治党,从组织上保证党的基本路线的贯彻
执行》的报告。宋平的《报告》共分六部分:(一)关于党员队
伍的建设;(二)关于党组织的建设;(三)关于进一步贯彻干部
“四化”方针,加强领导班子建设;(四)关于实行干部分类管理
和加强宏观指导;(五)关于提高选拔干部工作的民主程度;
(六)关于干部交流。
《报告》指出,从严治党,就要严格党员标准,坚决清除党
内的腐败分子,妥善处置不合格的党员;要保证发展党员的质
量,重视吸收生产和工作第一线的优秀分子入党;从严治党,要
从党政机关做起,保持党政机关的廉洁。
《报告》强调,必须根据不同类型干部的特点,采取民主选
举、民主推荐、民主评议、民主考核、公开招聘、公开考试等不
同方式选用人才,努力提高干部选拔工作的民主程度。
translated_text: From July 25 to July 1, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee held a national organization work conference in Beijing with the approval of the CPC Central Committee. Attendees included the responsible comrades in charge of organization work and the responsible comrades of the Organization Department of the Party Committees of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the heads of the cadre departments (bureaus) or the heads of the Organization Departments of the ministries and commissions of the Central Government and the people's organizations; and the relevant responsible comrades of some directly affiliated units of the State Council and the General Political Department of the Military Commission. At the meeting, Song Ping, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, delivered a report entitled "Deepening Reform, Strictly Governing the Party, and Ensuring the Implementation of the Party's Basic Line from an Organizational Perspective". Song Ping's "Report" is divided into six parts: (i) on the construction of the party member team; (ii) on the construction of the party organization; (iii) on further implementing the "four modernizations" policy of cadres and strengthening the construction of the leadership team; (iv) on implementing classified management of cadres and strengthening macro-guidance; (v) on improving the degree of democracy in the selection of cadres; and (vi) on cadre exchanges. The report points out that strict party governance requires strict standards for party members, resolutely eliminating corrupt elements within the party, and properly handling unqualified party members; it is necessary to ensure the quality of party member recruitment and attach importance to recruiting outstanding members from the front line of production and work; strict party governance must start from party and government organs and maintain the integrity of party and government organs. The report emphasizes that it is necessary to adopt different methods such as democratic election, democratic recommendation, democratic evaluation, democratic assessment, open recruitment, and open examinations to select talents according to the characteristics of different types of cadres, and strive to improve the degree of democracy in cadre selection.

events:
27日——7月1日 中共中央组织部副部长率中国共产
党组织工作考察团访问民主德国。
translated_text: July 27 - July 1 The Deputy Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China led a Chinese Communist Party organization work inspection team to visit the German Democratic Republic.

events:
28日 《人民日报》报道,据统计,近几年国务院授予的
全国劳动模范称号的15名同志都是共产党员;全国总工会授予
的4304名“五一劳动奖章”获得者中,党员占97%;全国妇联等
单位表彰的50名女企业家,有48名是共产党员;国家科委评选
的1341名“有突出贡献的科技管理专家”中,党员占64%;国家
教委授予的1000名“人民教师奖章”获得者中,党员占80%;
1983年到1987年5年中,全军授予各种荣誉称号的255人中,
党员占93%,其中军委授予荣誉称号的23名全是党员。
translated_text: On the 28th, the People's Daily reported that according to statistics, in recent years, 15 comrades awarded the title of National Model Workers by the State Council are all members of the Communist Party; among the 4,304 recipients of the "May 1st Labor Medal" awarded by the All-China Federation of Trade Unions, 97% are members of the Communist Party; among the 50 female entrepreneurs commended by the All-China Women's Federation and other units, 48 are members of the Communist Party; among the 1,341 "outstanding scientific and technological management experts" selected by the State Science and Technology Commission, 64% are members of the Communist Party; among the 1,000 recipients of the "People's Teacher Medal" awarded by the State Education Commission, 80% are members of the Communist Party; from 1983 to 1987, among the 255 people awarded various honorary titles in the entire army, 93% were members of the Communist Party, and all 23 of them were awarded honorary titles by the Military Commission.

events: 30日 中共中央决定,李成仁任中共中央对外联络部副部长。
translated_text: On the 30th, the CPC Central Committee decided that Li Chengren would serve as Deputy Minister of the International Liaison Department of the CPC Central Committee.

events:
1日 《人民日报》发表社论,题为《共产党员要牢记自己
的使命》。社论指出,在整个改革开放的过程中,我们必须做到
两个坚定不移,即改革开放,繁荣经济,要坚定不移;保持廉
洁,防止腐败,也要坚定不移。作为一名共产党员,应当有明确
的党员意识,时刻记住自己是一个共产党员,要为共产主义事业
奋斗终生。由此出发,在改革、开放,实现现阶段我国各族人民
的共同理想,把我国建设成为富强、民主、文明的社会主义现代
化国家的伟大事业中,应当有更自觉的使命感,有更鲜明的开拓
精神和献身精神。
中共中央纪律检查委员会颁布《党员领导干部犯严重官僚主
义失职错误党纪处分的暂行规定》。
translated_text: On the 1st, the People's Daily published an editorial entitled "Communists should bear in mind their mission". The editorial pointed out that throughout the process of reform and opening up, we must be firm in two aspects: reform and opening up, economic prosperity, and integrity, and prevention of corruption. As a Communist Party member, you should have a clear sense of party membership, always remember that you are a Communist Party member, and fight for the cause of communism for your whole life. Starting from this, in the great cause of reform and opening up, realizing the common ideals of the people of all ethnic groups in our country at this stage, and building our country into a prosperous, democratic, and civilized socialist modern country, you should have a more conscious sense of mission, a more distinct pioneering spirit and dedication. The Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China promulgated the "Interim Provisions on Party Discipline Punishment for Party Members and Leading Cadres Committing Serious Bureaucratic Dereliction of Duty".

events:
2日 《人民日报》发表题为《把好党员队伍的“入口”关》
的评论员文章。文章强调,为了从严治党,保持党的先进性和纯
洁性,今后,必须一方面严肃而妥善地处置不合格党员;另一方
面,要在发展党员时把保证质量放在第一位,坚决纠正忽视质量
的倾向,把好党员队伍的“入口”关。
translated_text: On the 2nd, the People's Daily published a commentary article entitled "Keep a Good Entrance to the Party Member Team". The article emphasized that in order to strictly govern the party and maintain the party's advanced nature and purity, in the future, on the one hand, unqualified party members must be dealt with seriously and properly; on the other hand, quality assurance must be given priority when recruiting party members, and the tendency to ignore quality must be resolutely corrected to keep a good entrance to the party member team.

events: 3日 中共中央同意,王迺任国家外国专家局局长。
translated_text: On the 3rd, the CPC Central Committee agreed to appoint Wang Nai as the Director of the State Administration of Foreign Experts Affairs.

events:
5日 李鹏主持总理办公会议,研究筹建国家行政学院
题。会议认为,国家行政学院是适应政治体制改革和经济体制改
革的需要,为实施国家公务员制度而决定建立的。它的职责任务
主要是培养高、中级国家公务员。委托中国人民大学负责筹建工
作,由袁宝华任组长,建成后与人民大学脱钩,由国务院领导。
translated_text: On the 5th, Li Peng presided over the Prime Minister's Office Meeting to study the establishment of the National School of Administration. The meeting believed that the National School of Administration was established to meet the needs of political and economic system reforms and to implement the national civil service system. Its duties and responsibilities are mainly to train senior and middle-level national civil servants. Renmin University of China was entrusted with the preparatory work, with Yuan Baohua as the team leader. After completion, it will be decoupled from Renmin University and led by the State Council.

events: 1988年7月5日,李鹏总理主持总理办公会议,专题讨论筹建国家行政学院的问题,要求国家行政学院走新型的社会化的办学方式,主要培训高中级公务员。教育计划与国家公务员制度要紧密联系。公务员晋升、任职前要在行政学院取得晋升任职资格。
translated_text: On July 5, 1988, Premier Li Peng presided over the Premier's Office Meeting to discuss the establishment of the National School of Administration. He required the National School of Administration to adopt a new socialized way of running schools, mainly training high- and middle-level civil servants. The education plan should be closely linked to the national civil service system. Civil servants must obtain promotion qualifications at the School of Administration before they can be promoted or appointed.

events:
7日中共中央同意,任命穆青为新华通讯社社长,郭超
人、曾建徽、庞炳庵、丁翔起为副社长;胡传治为中国船舶工业
总公司总经理;陈锦华为中国石油化工总公司总经理;钟一鸣为
中国海洋石油总公司总经理;王芳为中国人民武装警察部队总部
第一政委、李连秀为司令、张秀夫为政委。
translated_text: On the 7th, the CPC Central Committee agreed to appoint Mu Qing as the president of Xinhua News Agency, Guo Chaoren, Zeng Jianhui, Pang Bing'an, and Ding Xiangqi as vice presidents; Hu Chuanzhi as the general manager of China State Shipbuilding Corporation; Chen Jinhua as the general manager of China Petrochemical Corporation; Zhong Yiming as the general manager of China National Offshore Oil Corporation; Wang Fang as the first political commissar of the headquarters of the Chinese People's Armed Police Force, Li Lianxiu as the commander, and Zhang Xiufu as the political commissar.

events:

去陈维仁、韩树英中共中央党校副校长职务。
translated_text: On the 12th, the CPC Central Committee approved Xing Si to be the vice president of the CPC Central Party School; Chen Weiren and Han Shuying were dismissed from their posts as vice presidents of the CPC Central Party School.

events:

偕家属到山东省烟台市休养。
translated_text: From 14th to 29th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China invited 31 outstanding experts from inside and outside the party to recuperate in Yantai City, Shandong Province with their families.

中国社会科学院副院长,免去其国务院国际问题研究中心副总干
事职务;免去邹恩同民政部副部长职务。

events:

班”开学典礼。参加培训的有各省、自治区、直辖市及计划单列
市的人事厅局长,国务院各部委、直属局的人事厅局长,共106
人。
translated_text: On the 19th, the Ministry of Personnel held the opening ceremony of the "National Civil Service System Training Course" at Renmin University of China. Participants in the training included directors of personnel departments of provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities directly under the Central Government and cities with independent planning status, and directors of personnel departments of ministries and commissions of the State Council and directly affiliated bureaus, a total of 106 people.

translated_text: On July 20, 1988, the State Council decided to set up a leading group for the establishment of the National School of Administration, with Comrade Yuan Baohua as the group leader and Comrade Cheng Lianchang and others as members of the leading group.

events:
21日 中共中央同意并转发中央组织部《关于逐步撤销国
务院各部门党组有关问题的意见》。中共中央在通知中指出,撤
销党组的工作,应结合机构改革,有组织、有步骤地进行。要注
意工作的相互衔接,要加强机关党委的工作。
中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅发出《关于解决公司政企不
分问题的通知》。《通知》规定,各级党政机关和群众团体,必须
严格执行中央有关严禁党政机关和党政干部经商办企业的规
定,政企不分的公司,必须将经营权与行政权严格分开,各级党
政机关和群众团体不准从公司抽取资金补充机关经费;从现在起
停止审批党政机关离退休干部和已到离退休年龄尚未办理手续的
干部担任公司职务,停止审批成立新的公司(涉外企业和私营企
业除外)。
translated_text: On the 21st, the CPC Central Committee agreed and forwarded the Central Organization Department's "Opinions on the Gradual Removal of Party Groups of Departments under the State Council". The CPC Central Committee pointed out in the notice that the work of removing party groups should be carried out in an organized and step-by-step manner in conjunction with institutional reform. Attention should be paid to the connection between work and the work of the party committees of organs. The General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council issued the "Notice on Solving the Problem of Indistinguishability between Government and Enterprise in Companies". The "Notice" stipulates that party and government organs and mass organizations at all levels must strictly implement the central government's regulations on strictly prohibiting party and government organs and party and government cadres from engaging in business and running enterprises. Companies that do not distinguish between government and enterprise must strictly separate management rights from administrative rights. Party and government organs and mass organizations at all levels are not allowed to withdraw funds from companies to supplement agency funds; from now on, the approval of retired cadres of party and government organs and cadres who have reached retirement age but have not yet completed the formalities for taking up positions in companies will be stopped, and the approval of the establishment of new companies (except for foreign-related enterprises and private enterprises) will be stopped.

translated_text: On August 24, 1988, the Party Group of the Ministry of Personnel of the Communist Party of China decided to establish the Ministry of Personnel Leading Group for the Implementation of the Civil Service System. Group leader: Cheng Lianchang; members: Liu Chengquan, Xu Songtao, Yang Peiqing (later succeeded by Niu Yuesheng), Dai Guangqian, Wang Leibao, Cheng Silin, Kang Yao, Cheng Yinsheng, Liu Jialin, Zhou Libo, Hu Wei (later succeeded by Zhang Zhihong). On August 25, 1988, the Organization Department and the Ministry of Personnel of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on the Conscientious Implementation of the Cadre Retirement System". It is required that cadres who have reached the prescribed retirement age should go through the retirement procedures in a timely manner without the need for them to apply in person. Organization and personnel departments at all levels should report to the appointment and removal authority for approval in advance according to the cadre management authority for cadres who have reached the retirement age in their units, notify them one month before they reach the retirement age, and complete the relevant procedures as required within one month after they reach the retirement age, and they will no longer be listed as regular staff. A small number of cadres who are in good health and have specialized skills, when they reach the prescribed retirement age, can be hired by the employing unit in accordance with policy regulations after completing the retirement procedures if they are truly required for work, but they will not be listed as regular staff.

translated_text: On the 25th, the Organization Department and the Personnel Department of the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on the Conscientious Implementation of the Cadre Retirement (Leaving) System". The "Notice" stipulates that cadres who have reached the prescribed retirement age (years) should go through the retirement procedures in a timely manner, and do not need to apply in person. For individual cadres at the prefecture, city (department, bureau) level and above who are temporarily retained due to work needs, or who need to be arranged to serve in the National People's Congress or the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, the unit where they are located should propose the reasons and time for retention or arrangement in advance, and report to the appointment and removal authority for approval according to the cadre management authority. The retirement age of female cadres shall be implemented in accordance with the provisions of the document No. 2 of the Organization Department of the Central Committee and the Ministry of Labor and Personnel (1987). The "Notice" points out that cadre retirement work is a regular work. Organizations, personnel departments and veteran cadre work departments at all levels should perform their duties, strictly implement relevant systems, do a good job in in-depth and meticulous ideological work and various management work, take good care of the lives of retired cadres, and pay attention to giving full play to their roles according to individual conditions.

events:
