出,在经济体制改革的关键时期,党的各级领导干部和全体共产
党员在深化改革的过程中,要坚决贯彻落实党中央和国务院已经
制定和即将制定的有关决定,真正做到令行禁止,统一行动,并
努力做好思想政治工作,使广大群众理解和支持改革,为改革创
造一个良好的社会环境。
translated_text: From the 25th to the 31st, Qiao Shi, a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, pointed out during his inspection in Shandong that in the critical period of economic system reform, the leading cadres at all levels of the Party and all Communist Party members should resolutely implement the relevant decisions that have been made and will be made by the Party Central Committee and the State Council in the process of deepening reform, truly implement orders and unify actions, and strive to do a good job in ideological and political work, so that the masses can understand and support the reform and create a good social environment for the reform.

events:
26日——9月29日 中共中央组织部副部长赵宗率企业
人事制度改革研究小组成员赴匈牙利、法国,就企业领导体制和
人事管理问题作专题考察。
27日 中共中央政治局委员、中共中央组织部部长宋平在
《关于坚决清除党内腐败分子,妥善处置不合格党员的思想反
映》的材料上批示:这项工作要认真研究、落实,不然定会走过
场,甚至过场也不走。还要总结好的经验,介绍成功的办法。是
否可以搞年终党员考评,如可以,现在就要着手准备工作。
translated_text: September 26th - September 29th Zhao Zong, Deputy Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, led members of the research team on enterprise personnel system reform to Hungary and France to conduct special inspections on enterprise leadership system and personnel management issues. September 27th Song Ping, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, wrote on the material "Thoughts on Resolutely Eliminating Corrupt Elements in the Party and Properly Dealing with Unqualified Party Members": This work must be studied and implemented seriously, otherwise it will be a formality, or even a formality. It is also necessary to summarize good experiences and introduce successful methods. Is it possible to conduct an annual party member assessment? If so, we must start preparations now.

events: 1日——6日 中国妇女第六次全国代表大会在北京召开。大会以社会主义初级阶段的理论和党的基本路线为指导,总结了改革十年来我国妇女运动的基本经验和存在的问题,确定了今后.妇女运动的任务,动员和组织妇女投身改革和建设的伟大实践,推进妇女解放事业的发展。
translated_text: From the 1st to the 6th, the Sixth National Congress of Chinese Women was held in Beijing. Guided by the theory of the primary stage of socialism and the basic line of the Party, the Congress summarized the basic experience and existing problems of the women's movement in my country in the past ten years of reform, determined the tasks of the women's movement in the future, mobilized and organized women to participate in the great practice of reform and construction, and promoted the development of women's liberation. The meeting elected Chen Muhua as the President of the All-China Women's Federation, Zhang Guoying, Huang Qiwei, Lin Liyun, Apei Caidan Zhuoga, Mai Nur Hasmu, Hao Zhichun, Zhang Suwo, Lu Leshan, Nie Li, and Wei Yu as Vice Presidents of the All-China Women's Federation, and Zhang Guoying as Secretary of the Secretariat of the Sixth All-China Women's Federation.

events: 会议选举陈慕华为全国妇联主席,张帼英、黄启璪、林丽韫,阿沛·才旦卓嘎、玛依努尔·哈斯木、郝治纯、张素我、卢乐山、聂力、韦钰为全国妇联副主席,张帼英为第六届全国妇联书记处书记。
translated_text: From the 1st to the 6th, the Sixth National Congress of Chinese Women was held in Beijing. Guided by the theory of the primary stage of socialism and the basic line of the Party, the Congress summarized the basic experience and existing problems of the women's movement in my country in the past ten years of reform, determined the tasks of the women's movement in the future, mobilized and organized women to participate in the great practice of reform and construction, and promoted the development of women's liberation. The meeting elected Chen Muhua as the President of the All-China Women's Federation, Zhang Guoying, Huang Qiwei, Lin Liyun, Apei Caidan Zhuoga, Mai Nur Hasmu, Hao Zhichun, Zhang Suwo, Lu Leshan, Nie Li, and Wei Yu as Vice Presidents of the All-China Women's Federation, and Zhang Guoying as Secretary of the Secretariat of the Sixth All-China Women's Federation.

events:

主席缪云台,因病在北京逝世,终年94岁。
translated_text: On the 3rd, Miao Yuntai, a famous patriotic democratic figure and political activist, and vice chairman of the 7th National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, died of illness in Beijing at the age of 94.

events:

副省长职务;周平任国家科学技术委员会副主任。
translated_text: On the 5th, the CPC Central Committee agreed that Cao Zeyi would be appointed as Vice Minister of Health; Wang Ruisong would be appointed as Vice President of the Chinese Academy of Sciences; Zhang Chunyuan would be appointed as Vice Minister of Water Resources and would no longer serve as Vice Chairman of the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Government; Cai Ninglin would be appointed as Vice Minister of Materials and would no longer serve as Vice Governor of Fujian Province; Zhou Ping would be appointed as Vice Director of the State Science and Technology Commission.

events: 新华社全文发布中央纪律检查委员会《关于处理、控告和申诉的若干规定》。《规定》的内容是:(一)受理检举、控告和申诉的范围;(二)处理检举、控告的程序;(三)处理党员申诉的程序;(四)对处理检举、控告和申诉的要求和办法;(五)要求报告处理结果的案件,必须送报的材料。
translated_text: On the 6th, Xinhua News Agency reported that the State Council had recently formed a new Environmental Protection Committee, with Song Jian, State Councilor and Director of the National Science and Technology Commission, as the Director of the Environmental Protection Committee. Xinhua News Agency published the full text of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection's "Several Provisions on Handling, Accusations and Appeals". The contents of the "Provisions" are: (a) the scope of accepting reports, accusations and appeals; (b) the procedures for handling reports and accusations; (c) the procedures for handling appeals by party members; (d) the requirements and methods for handling reports, accusations and appeals; (e) the materials that must be submitted for cases requiring reporting of handling results.

The CPC Central Committee approved that Wang Jiaxi (female) would be appointed as the deputy secretary of the Beijing Municipal Committee.

events: 1988年9月9日,国务院第二十一次常务会议审议通过《国家行政机关工作人员贪污贿赂行政处分暂行规定》,9月13日由总理发布施行。国家行政机关工作人员利用职务上的便利,贪污公共财物、挪用公款、收受贿赂以及行贿或者介绍贿赂的,分别给予警告、记过、记大过、降级、降职、撤职、开除留用察看、开除处分。
translated_text: On September 9, 1988, the 21st executive meeting of the State Council reviewed and approved the "Interim Provisions on Administrative Sanctions for Corruption and Bribery by State Administrative Organ Staff", which was promulgated and implemented by the Premier on September 13. State administrative organ staff who use their position to embezzle public property, misappropriate public funds, accept bribes, offer bribes or introduce bribes shall be given warnings, demerits, serious demerits, demotion, demotion, dismissal, dismissal with probation, or dismissal.

events:
12日 中共中央组织部发出《关于高级干部子女出国审批
工作的通知》。《通知》规定,今后高级干部子女出国,均按一般
出国人员的正常手续审批,在履行正常手续后,由审批单位在
15日内报送中央组织部或有关省、自治区、直辖市党委、总政
治部备案。高级干部和外事工作人员的子女公派或自费出国留
学,同一般留学人员一样,按国务院和国家教委有关出国留学的
规定办理。
translated_text: On the 12th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on the Approval of Children of Senior Cadres Going Abroad". The "Notice" stipulates that in the future, the children of senior cadres going abroad will be approved according to the normal procedures for general overseas personnel. After completing the normal procedures, the approval unit shall submit it to the Central Organization Department or the relevant provincial, autonomous region, municipal party committee, and general political department for filing within 15 days. The children of senior cadres and foreign affairs staff who go abroad to study at public or self-funded shall be handled in accordance with the relevant regulations of the State Council and the State Education Commission on studying abroad, just like general overseas students.

events:

定》经李鹏总理签署,发布施行。《规定》指出,制定这个规

The "Provisions" pointed out that the purpose of formulating this provision was to "enforce political discipline, supervise the integrity and diligence of state administrative organ staff, and ensure the smooth progress of socialist construction and reform and opening up."

events:
15日——21日 中共中央政治局在北京召开中央工作会
议。会议讨论了治理经济环境,整顿经济秩序,全面深化改革的
问题。中共中央总书记赵紫阳主持会议并作了讲话,中共中央政
治局常委、国务院副总理姚依林作了关于价格、工资改革初步方
案的说明。
translated_text: From the 15th to the 21st, the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee held a central work conference in Beijing. The conference discussed the issues of managing the economic environment, rectifying the economic order, and comprehensively deepening reform. Zhao Ziyang, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, presided over the meeting and delivered a speech. Yao Yilin, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, explained the preliminary plan for price and wage reform.

events:
24日 根据中共中央决定,中共中央组织部发出《关于变
动五十四个企事业单位领导干部职务管理权限的通知》。《通知》
规定,将第一汽车制造厂、北京大学、中国农业科学院等五十四
个企事业单位的行政领导干部职务,移交国务院管理,其具体管
理工作由国家人事部承办。
translated_text: On the 24th, according to the decision of the CPC Central Committee, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on Changing the Management Authority of Leading Cadres of 54 Enterprises and Institutions". The "Notice" stipulates that the administrative leading cadres of 54 enterprises and institutions, including the First Automobile Works, Peking University, and the Chinese Academy of Agricultural Sciences, will be transferred to the State Council for management, and their specific management work will be undertaken by the State Personnel Ministry.

events:
26日——30日 中共十三届三中全会在北京举行。全会听
取并审议通过了赵紫阳总书记代表中央政治局作的报告。全会还
听取了中共中央政治局常委姚依林就价格、工资改革初步方案所
作的说明。全会原则通过《关于价格、工资改革的初步方案》和
《中共中央关于加强和改进企业思想政治工作的通知》。
全会批准中央政治局提出的治理经济环境、整顿经济秩序、
全面深化改革的指导方针和政策、措施。全会确定,把明后两年
改革和建设的重点突出地放到治理经济环境和整顿经济秩序上
来。全会指出,为了保证治理经济环境、整顿经济秩序和深化改
革的顺利完成,必须加强党的领导,充分发挥我们的政治优势。
要特别强调党的领导核心作用和党的纪律,特别强调局部利益服
从全局利益。同时,通过治理环境、整顿秩序和深化改革的实践
来加强党的建设,提高党组织的战斗力,发挥党员的先锋模范作
用。
出席这次会议的,有中央委员165人,候补中央委员103
人;列席会议的,有中央顾问委员会委员184人,中央纪律检查
委员会委员67人,以及有关方面的主要负责同志63人。
translated_text:
From the 26th to the 30th, the Third Plenary Session of the 13th CPC Central Committee was held in Beijing. The plenary session listened to and reviewed and approved the report made by General Secretary Zhao Ziyang on behalf of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee. The plenary session also listened to the explanation made by Yao Yilin, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, on the preliminary plan for price and wage reform. The plenary session approved in principle the "Preliminary Plan for Price and Wage Reform" and the "Notice of the CPC Central Committee on Strengthening and Improving Ideological and Political Work in Enterprises". The plenary session approved the guiding principles, policies and measures proposed by the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee for governing the economic environment, rectifying the economic order and comprehensively deepening reform. The plenary session determined that the focus of reform and construction in the next two years should be placed on governing the economic environment and rectifying the economic order. The plenary session pointed out that in order to ensure the smooth completion of governing the economic environment, rectifying the economic order and deepening reform, it is necessary to strengthen the leadership of the Party and give full play to our political advantages. Special emphasis should be placed on the core leadership role of the Party and the Party's discipline, and on the subordination of local interests to the overall interests. At the same time, through the practice of governing the environment, rectifying the order and deepening the reform, we will strengthen the party building, improve the combat effectiveness of the party organization and give full play to the vanguard and exemplary role of party members. 
Attending the meeting were 165 members of the Central Committee and 103 alternate members of the Central Committee; attending the meeting were 184 members of the Central Advisory Committee, 67 members of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, and 63 main responsible comrades from relevant parties.

events:
28日 《人民日报》发表题为《发挥我们的政治优势》的
社论。社论指出,明后两年改革和建设的重点是治理经济环境、
整顿经济秩序。为此,要发挥我们的政治优势,加强党的领导,
严肃党纪、政纪、法纪,以保证改革在党的领导下克服困难顺利
推进。关键是要解决好局部和整体、小局和大局的关系问题,局
部要服从整体,小局要服从大局。
中共中央发出《关于加强和改进企业思想政治工作
的通知》。《通知》指出:(一)加强和改进企业思想政治工作是
现代化建设和改革开放顺利进行的重要保证,全党要高度重视思
想政治工作,同时必须改进思想政治工作;(二)建立在厂长
(经理)全面负责下的企业职工思想政治工作的新体制;(三)从
实际出发确定思想政治工作的任务和内容;(四)采取正确方针
和方法,注重思想政治工作的效果;(五)积极稳妥地向新体制
过渡,不断总结企业思想政治工作的新经验。
translated_text: On the 28th, the People's Daily published an editorial entitled "Exploiting Our Political Advantages". The editorial pointed out that the focus of reform and construction in the next two years is to manage the economic environment and rectify the economic order. To this end, we must exert our political advantages, strengthen the leadership of the Party, and strictly enforce Party discipline, political discipline, and legal discipline to ensure that reforms can overcome difficulties and proceed smoothly under the leadership of the Party. The key is to solve the relationship between the local and the overall, the small situation and the overall situation. The local situation should be subordinate to the overall situation, and the small situation should be subordinate to the overall situation. The Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on Strengthening and Improving the Ideological and Political Work of Enterprises". The Notice points out: (i) Strengthening and improving the ideological and political work of enterprises is an important guarantee for the smooth progress of modernization construction and reform and opening up. The whole party should attach great importance to ideological and political work and must improve ideological and political work; (ii) Establish a new system of ideological and political work for enterprise employees under the overall responsibility of the factory director (manager); (iii) Determine the tasks and content of ideological and political work based on actual conditions; (iv) Adopt correct policies and methods and pay attention to the effectiveness of ideological and political work; (v) Actively and steadily transition to the new system and constantly summarize new experiences in ideological and political work in enterprises.

events:
3日 中央办公厅、国务院办公厅作出《关于县以上党和国
家机关退(离)休干部经商办企业问题的若干规定》规定县以
上党和国家机关退(离)休干部,(一)不得兴办商业性企业,
不得到这类企业任职并从事经济活动。 (二)不得到全民所有制
企业和外商投资企业(公司)任领导职务(或名誉职务)、管理
职务。 (三)可以应聘到全民所有制的非商业性企业任职。但到
原所在机关主管行业任职,必须在退休满两年以后。其收入按有
关规定执行,否则取消退休待遇。(四)从事技术开发、服务经
营活动的,按中共中央1984年27号文件执行。军队机关退休干
部经商办企业问题,由中央军委参照本规定制定具体办法。
translated_text: On the 3rd, the General Office of the Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council issued the "Several Provisions on the Issue of Retired (Resigned) Cadres of Party and State Organs at or above the County Level Engaging in Business and Running Enterprises", which stipulates that retired (retired) cadres of Party and State organs at or above the county level (a) shall not establish commercial enterprises, shall not work in such enterprises and engage in economic activities. (b) shall not hold leadership positions (or honorary positions) or management positions in state-owned enterprises and foreign-invested enterprises (companies). (c) They may apply for positions in state-owned non-commercial enterprises. However, they must work in the industry under the jurisdiction of their original organs after two years of retirement. Their income shall be implemented in accordance with relevant regulations, otherwise their retirement benefits shall be cancelled. (d) Those engaged in technology development and service business activities shall be implemented in accordance with Document No. 27 of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China in 1984. The Central Military Commission shall formulate specific measures for retired cadres of military organs to engage in business and run enterprises in accordance with these regulations.

events:
5日 中央党的建设工作小组就1988年和1989年如何贯彻
十三大提出的在改革开放中加强党的建设、从严治党的方针,如
何落实中央有关加强党的建设的任务等问题,提出意见和建议:
(一)1988年第四季度,围绕十三届三中全会精神的贯彻,重点
抓一下党的纪律的整顿;(二)1988年第四季度开始至1989年
上半年,要结合治理环境、整顿秩序的任务对党员普遍进行一次
民主评议,对地(市)、县党政领导干部进行年度工作考核;
(三) 1989年上半年,重点抓基层党组织建设,特别是企业、乡
村、学校、机关的党支部建设;(四)1989年下半年,重点抓
省、地、县三级党员领导干部的培训;(五)加强制度建设,在
党的建设方面逐步形成若干个条例;(六)同党内的腐败行为作
斗争;(七)加强党建理论研究。
translated_text: On the 5th, the Central Party Building Working Group put forward opinions and suggestions on how to implement the policy of strengthening party building and strictly governing the party in reform and opening up put forward by the 13th National Congress in 1988 and 1989, and how to implement the central tasks of strengthening party building: (i) In the fourth quarter of 1988, around the implementation of the spirit of the Third Plenary Session of the 13th Central Committee, focus on the rectification of party discipline; (ii) From the fourth quarter of 1988 to the first half of 1989, in conjunction with the tasks of governing the environment and rectifying order, a democratic evaluation of party members should be conducted universally, and annual work assessments should be conducted for prefecture (city) and county party and government leading cadres; (iii) In the first half of 1989, focus on the construction of grassroots party organizations, especially the construction of party branches in enterprises, villages, schools, and government agencies; (iv) In the second half of 1989, focus on the training of party member leading cadres at the provincial, prefectural, and county levels; (v) Strengthen institutional construction and gradually form a number of regulations in party building; (vi) Fight against corruption within the party; (vii) Strengthen theoretical research on party building.

events:
10日 中共中央组织部副部长赵宗鼐主持部办公会议,讨
论创办《党建研究》杂志的有关事项。会议决定《党建研究》杂
志于1989年3月创刊。
translated_text: On the 10th, Zhao Zongnai, Deputy Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, presided over a meeting of the department to discuss the establishment of the magazine "Party Building Research". The meeting decided that the magazine "Party Building Research" would be launched in March 1989.

events:
17日 中共中央组织部发出《关于做好处置不合格党员工
作的通知》。《通知》指出,在处置不合格党员的工作中,要做细
致的思想工作和组织工作,搞好试点,搞好民主评议,严格履行
手续。对于那些大多数党员和非党群众认为不合格的党员,必须
提交支部大会讨论,讨论时,要认真听取本人的说明和申辩,按
照少数服从多数的原则进行表决,形成决议。党支部党员除
名、劝退或者提出限期改正,都应报上级党委审批。《通知》强
调,处置不合格党员,是一项细致的,政策性很强的工作,各级
党委和组织部门要注意反映情况,研究政策,总结经验。
translated_text: On the 17th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on Doing a Good Job in Dealing with Unqualified Party Members". The "Notice" pointed out that in dealing with unqualified party members, it is necessary to do meticulous ideological and organizational work, carry out pilot projects, carry out democratic evaluation, and strictly follow procedures. For those party members who are considered unqualified by the majority of party members and non-party members, they must be submitted to the branch meeting for discussion. During the discussion, the party member's explanation and defense must be listened to carefully, and the resolution must be formed by voting in accordance with the principle of minority obeying the majority. The removal, persuasion or deadline for rectification of party members in the party branch should be reported to the higher-level party committee for approval. The "Notice" emphasized that dealing with unqualified party members is a meticulous and highly policy-oriented work, and party committees and organization departments at all levels should pay attention to reflecting the situation, studying policies, and summarizing experiences.

translated_text: On the 26th, the International Seminar on China's Civil Service System and Human Resources Development, jointly organized by the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the Ministry of Personnel, opened in Beijing. Participants included more than 30 senior officials in charge of civil service management from countries and regions such as the United States, Canada, Federal Germany, France, Hungary, Japan, Singapore, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, and Hong Kong, senior experts in personnel management and personnel managers of large companies, senior officials from the United Nations Administrative Development Corporation, the International Labor Organization, the Economic Commission of the European Communities, and the International Public Service Association, as well as more than 80 Chinese entrepreneurs, experts in personnel management, and cadre management workers. Zhao Dongwan, Minister of the Ministry of Personnel, delivered an opening speech at the meeting, and Liu Zepeng, Deputy Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and Director of the China Senior Personnel Management Officials Training Center, delivered a congratulatory speech at the meeting.

events: 1988年10月26日,由中央组织部和人事部联合举办的中国公务员制度暨人力资源开发国际研讨会在北京开幕。参加会议的有加拿大、原联邦德国、法国、日本、新加坡、英国、美国等七个国家和香港地区的政府高级人事官员和著名学者,联合国行政发展司和开发计划署、国际劳工局、国际公职协会等国际组织的官员,国内部分学者和中央组织部、人事部有关司领导,共五十人。此外,部分省市和部委人事部门负责人二十余人列席了会议。会议由张志坚副部长主持,赵东宛部长致开幕词,中组部副部长刘泽彭,英国内阁办公室次官､人事管理局局长摩根和联合国开发计划署驻北京办事处代表莫里先生先后致词,程连昌副部长作主题发言。这次研讨会的目的,一是论证《国家公务员暂行条例》及其配套法规和推行公务员制度方案的科学性、可行性;二是研讨中国这样发展中的社会主义国家建立和推行公务员制度的若干重要问题。1988年10月28日,国务院总理李鹏在中南海紫光阁接见了参加中国公务员制度暨人力资源开发国际研讨会的外国高级人事官员、专家、学者,中组部和人事部的负责同志接见时在座。李鹏总理在接见时指出,机构精简和人员减少时,要注意把精干的人和领导保留下来,在这一基础上实行公务员制度,留下的人也要经过考核和培训。
translated_text: On October 26, 1988, the International Seminar on China's Civil Service System and Human Resources Development, jointly organized by the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the Ministry of Personnel, opened in Beijing. The participants included senior personnel officials and famous scholars from seven countries including Canada, the former Federal Republic of Germany, France, Japan, Singapore, the United Kingdom, the United States and Hong Kong, officials from international organizations such as the United Nations Administrative Development Division and the Development Program, the International Labor Office, and the International Public Service Association, some domestic scholars and leaders of relevant departments of the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the Ministry of Personnel, a total of 50 people. In addition, more than 20 heads of personnel departments of some provinces, cities and ministries attended the meeting. The meeting was chaired by Vice Minister Zhang Zhijian, Minister Zhao Dongwan delivered the opening speech, Vice Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China Liu Zepeng, Under-Secretary of the British Cabinet Office and Director of the Personnel Management Bureau Morgan and Mr. Morrie, Representative of the United Nations Development Program in Beijing, delivered speeches in succession, and Vice Minister Cheng Lianchang made a keynote speech. The purpose of this seminar was, firstly, to demonstrate the scientificity and feasibility of the "Interim Regulations on National Civil Servants" and its supporting laws and regulations and the plan for implementing the civil service system; secondly, to discuss several important issues in the establishment and implementation of the civil service system in a developing socialist country like China. On October 28, 1988, Premier Li Peng of the State Council met with foreign senior personnel officials, experts and scholars who attended the International Seminar on China's Civil Service System and Human Resources Development in Ziguang Pavilion, Zhongnanhai. Responsible comrades from the Organization Department and the Ministry of Personnel were present at the meeting. Premier Li Peng pointed out during the meeting that when streamlining institutions and reducing personnel, attention should be paid to retaining capable people and leaders, and on this basis, the civil service system should be implemented, and those who remain should also be assessed and trained.

events:

干部人事制度改革取得的进展主要是:废除了领导职务终身制,
确立和执行了干部革命化、年轻化、知识化、专业化方针,使干

部和群众的民主意识大大增强。
translated_text: On the 27th, Xinhua News Agency reported that according to the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, the progress made in the reform of the cadre personnel system in my country in recent years is mainly: abolishing the lifelong tenure of leadership positions, establishing and implementing the policy of revolutionary, young, knowledgeable and professional cadres, which has brought about great changes in the cadre team, especially the leadership teams at all levels; changing the situation of excessive concentration of cadre management authority and delegating cadre management authority; further improving the cadre election system; and improving the degree of publicity, openness and transparency of cadre appointment, removal and promotion. Some departments and units have implemented the principles of openness, equality, competition and merit, and implemented a system of selecting and employing people based on competition for positions and contributions for treatment; the democratic awareness of the majority of cadres and the masses has been greatly enhanced.

events:
29日 国务院总理李鹏在中南海会见参加中国公务员制度
暨人力资源开发国际研讨会的联合国和国际组织的官员以及十几
个国家的专家、学者。李鹏指出,中国先改革机构,后实行公务
员制度,实行公务员制度要先立法。要建立具有吸引力的公务员
工资制度,但这种制度要适合国情。要在公务员的报酬方面改变
目前政府机关工作人员收入低于企业同类人员水平的状况,同
时,还要提倡公务员的献身精神。
translated_text: On the 29th, Premier Li Peng of the State Council met with officials from the United Nations and international organizations, as well as experts and scholars from more than a dozen countries, who attended the International Seminar on China's Civil Service System and Human Resources Development in Zhongnanhai. Li Peng pointed out that China should reform its institutions first and then implement the civil service system. Legislation should be made before implementing the civil service system. An attractive civil service salary system should be established, but this system should be suitable for national conditions. The current situation in which the income of government employees is lower than that of similar employees in enterprises should be changed in terms of civil service remuneration. At the same time, the dedication of civil servants should be promoted.

events: 17日 《人民日报》报道,近期中共中央党校举办了为期两个月的中直机关党委书记研究班,研究加强和改善机关党的工作。参加研究班的有中直机关党委专职书记、副书记,共44人。中直工委常务副书记顾云飞参加了研究班。

events:
22日 国务院召开常务会议,讨论并原则通过了《禁止国
家行政机关及其工作人员在国内公务活动中赠送和接受礼品的规
定(草案)》。规定国家行政机关及其工作人员不得借鉴定会、评
比会、业务会、订货会、展销会、招待会、茶话会、新闻发布
会、座谈会、研讨会等形式赠送和接受礼品,也不许以祝贺节日
以及试用、借用、品尝、鉴定等名义赠送和接受礼品。对于违反
者,将根据情节轻重,除令其退赔外,分别给予警告,记过,记
大过,降级直至撤职处分。
translated_text: On the 22nd, the State Council held a standing meeting to discuss and approve in principle the "Prohibition of State Administrative Organs and Their Staff from Giving and Accepting Gifts in Domestic Official Activities (Draft)". It stipulates that state administrative organs and their staff are not allowed to give and accept gifts in the form of meetings, appraisal meetings, business meetings, ordering meetings, trade fairs, receptions, tea parties, press conferences, seminars, etc., nor are they allowed to give and accept gifts in the name of celebrating festivals, trial use, borrowing, tasting, and appraisal. For violators, in addition to being ordered to pay compensation, they will be given warnings, demerits, serious demerits, demotions, and even dismissal according to the severity of the circumstances.

events:
26日 《人民日报》报道,各级纪委5年内处理 360 万信
访案件,平均每天2000件左右。这些案件主要涉及党员干部以
权谋私、敲诈勒索、贪污盗窃、违反财经纪律、欺压群众、打击
报复等问题。据统计,在检举控告信件中,匿名信一般占30%
左右。这些匿名信反映的情况,经查属实和基本属实的所占比例
与署名信件大体相当,占70%以上。
translated_text: On the 26th, the People's Daily reported that the Commissions for Discipline Inspection at all levels handled 3.6 million petitions in five years, an average of about 2,000 cases per day. These cases mainly involved party members and cadres abusing their power for personal gain, extortion, embezzlement and theft, violating financial discipline, oppressing the masses, and retaliating. According to statistics, anonymous letters generally account for about 30% of the letters of denunciation and accusation. The proportion of the situations reflected in these anonymous letters that were found to be true and basically true after investigation was roughly the same as that of signed letters, accounting for more than 70%.

events:
29日 人事部部长赵东宛在全国人事厅局长会议上说,国
务院机构改革进展顺利,新组建的部委都已投入正常运行,保留
的部门职能、定机构、定编制的“三定”工作接近完成,一些部
门的深化改革正在进行。据统计,非常设机构从原来的75个减
少至44个,司局级机构减少了20%多,改革后的定编人员比改
前实有人数减少1万人。他还说,从1989年开始,地方的机
构改革将相继展开,大体用三四年的时间完成。1989年主要在
省一级进行,1990年至1991年在地、市、县展开,1991年以
后,再考虑乡镇一级的机构改革。
translated_text: On the 29th, Zhao Dongwan, Minister of Personnel, said at the National Personnel Department Directors' Meeting that the State Council's institutional reform was progressing smoothly, and the newly established ministries and commissions had all been put into normal operation. The "three determinations" of the functions, institutions and staffing of the retained departments were nearly completed, and the deepening reform of some departments was underway. According to statistics, the number of non-permanent institutions was reduced from 75 to 44, and the number of department-level institutions was reduced by more than 20%. The number of staff after the reform was 10,000 less than the actual number before the reform. He also said that starting from 1989, local institutional reforms would be launched one after another, and would be completed in about three to four years. In 1989, it was mainly carried out at the provincial level, and from 1990 to 1991, it was carried out at the prefecture, city and county levels. After 1991, the institutional reform at the township level would be considered.

events: 1988年11月29日,全国人事工作会议在北京远望楼宾馆开幕。赵东宛部长作了报告。提出,1989年将在国务院和省政府少数部门开始进行国家公务员制度试点工作。李鹏总理于12月1日在中南海接见全国人事厅局长会议部分代表。
translated_text: On November 29, 1988, the National Personnel Work Conference opened at Beijing Yuanwanglou Hotel. Minister Zhao Dongwan made a report. On December 1, Premier Li Peng met with some representatives of the National Personnel Department Directors Conference in Zhongnanhai.

events: 1988年12月1日,中共中央组织部、人事部发布《关于加强流动人员档案管理工作的通知》。指出,流动人员人事档案管理是人事管理工作的组成部分,应按人事管理权限,统一由党委组织部门、政府人事部门及所属的人才流动服务中心等机构负责。其他机构不得承担流动人员人事档案的管理工作;任何人不得私自保管他人或本人档案。流动人员人事档案管理,必须坚决执行国家的保密制度,遵循分级管理的原则。

The management of mobile personnel files must resolutely implement the national confidentiality system and follow the principle of hierarchical management.

events:
22日 《人民日报》发表题为《伟大的十年》的社论。社
论回顾了十年来我们党和国家所发生的巨大变化。同时总结了十
年中积累起来的五条最主要经验:(一)必须始终不渝地坚持实
事求是的思想路线;(二)必须以生产力为根本标准,以经济建
设为中心,大力发展社会主义商品经济;(三)必须坚持四项基
本原则和改革开放的总方针;(四)必须大力发展社会主义民
主、健全社会主义法制,加强社会主义精神文明建设,坚决维护
安定团结的政治局面;(五)必须从严治党、从严治政,大力加
强党的建设。
translated_text: On the 22nd, the People's Daily published an editorial entitled "The Great Decade". The editorial reviewed the tremendous changes that have taken place in our party and country over the past decade. At the same time, it summarized the five most important experiences accumulated over the past decade: (1) We must unswervingly adhere to the ideological line of seeking truth from facts; (2) We must take productivity as the fundamental standard, economic construction as the center, and vigorously develop the socialist commodity economy; (3) We must adhere to the four basic principles and the general policy of reform and opening up; (4) We must vigorously develop socialist democracy, improve the socialist legal system, strengthen the construction of socialist spiritual civilization, and resolutely maintain a stable and united political situation; (5) We must strictly govern the party and the government and vigorously strengthen party building.

translated_text: From the 27th to the 30th, the National Party Member Education Work Conference was held in Beijing. events: 1989年1月5日,中共中央组织部、人事部发出《关于国家行政机关补充工作人员实行考试办法的通知》强调,从1989年起,国家行政机关补充工作人员,要贯彻公开、平等、竞争的原则,通过考试、考核、择优录用,把好“进口”关,为今后全面推行公务员考试录用制度创造条件。要求各级组织人事部门加强对这项工作的组织领导,严防弄虚作假、徇私舞弊的现象发生。1989年2月25日,中组部、人事部联合发出《关于实行中央国家机关司处级领导干部年度工作考核制度的通知》。通知指出,建立年度考核工作制度,对于加强机关干部队伍的自身建设,反对官僚主义作风,清除腐败现象,提高行政效率,以及深化干部人事制度改革,有着十分重要的作用。同时,也为我国实行公务员制度创造条件。

At the same time, it also creates conditions for the implementation of the civil service system in my country.

员进一步提高马列主义理论水平。这是提高党政干部素质的一项

translated_text: On the 12th, Song Ping, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, delivered an important speech at a symposium for students of the 5th provincial and ministerial-level leading cadres’ reading class, which was about to end. He pointed out that a large proportion of the comrades who joined the party in the 1970s and 1980s are young and energetic, have a high level of science and culture, and are full of pioneering and innovative spirit. The shortcomings are that they lack basic theoretical knowledge of Marxism-Leninism and practical work training. This is a fundamental measure to improve the quality of party and government cadres. In the future, a system must be formed, and all comrades who enter the party and government leadership teams must go to the party school to study the basic theory of Marxism; those who have already entered the leadership team must also receive short-term training in stages and batches to make up for this lesson.

系党的基本路线来进行。
乔石说,把握好党的建设同基本路线的内在联系,需要注意三
点:(一)必须按基本路线的要求来建设党和从严治党。(二)必须联
系基本路线的贯彻执行进行党的建设。(三)必须用执行基本路线
的实效来检验党建工作的好坏。

步建设好各级领导班子,切实推进干部制度改革。根据干部队伍
“四化”方针,着重从优秀中青年知识分子中选拔干部,仍然是一项
战略任务。3月27日《人民日报》全文发表了这个讲话。
translated_text: On the 2nd, Qiao Shi, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and head of the Central Party Building Working Group, emphasized at the closing meeting of the Central Party Building Research Class that in the new era, party building should be closely centered around the theme of building the party into a strong core to lead the cause of socialist modernization and be closely linked to the party's basic line. Qiao Shi said that in order to grasp the inherent connection between party building and the basic line, we need to pay attention to three points: (1) We must build the party and govern the party strictly according to the requirements of the basic line. (2) We must link party building with the implementation of the basic line. (3) We must use the effectiveness of the implementation of the basic line to test the quality of party building work. Qiao Shi also pointed out that we must unswervingly implement the "four modernizations" policy for the cadre team, further build good leadership teams at all levels, and effectively promote cadre system reform. According to the "four modernizations" policy for the cadre team, it is still a strategic task to focus on selecting cadres from outstanding young and middle-aged intellectuals. On March 27, the People's Daily published the full text of this speech.

人士担任政府领导职务,是全党的一项重要任务。(二)根据需要和
可能,有计划有步骤地在国务院部委和直属机构中配备一些党外
干部担任部、局领导职务。先在教育、科技、文化、卫生、体育、农村、

的实际状况,对其在政府中任职的年龄要求,可适当放宽。(四)为
保证党与党外人士团结合作政策的连续性和稳定性,必须大力培
养和选拔党外新的代表人物。(五)党的各级组织要对党外领导干
部政治上信任,工作上支持,生活上关怀照顾。
translated_text: On the 4th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the United Front Work Department of the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on the Selection of Non-Party Persons to Serve as Government Leaders". The main points of the "Notice" are as follows: (1) The selection of non-party persons to serve as government leaders is an important task for the whole party. (2) According to needs and possibilities, some non-party cadres should be assigned to the leadership positions of departments and bureaus in the ministries and commissions of the State Council and its directly affiliated institutions in a planned and step-by-step manner. First, they should be assigned to the leadership teams of the departments of education, science and technology, culture, health, sports, rural areas, textiles, justice and other departments. events: 1989年3月20日,人事部向被确定为推行公务员制度试点单位的审计署､海关总署(含系统)、国家税务局、国家环保局、国家统计局、国家建材局发出《关于印发〈中央国家行政机关国家公务员制度试点总体方案>的通知》。1989年4月4日,第七届全国人大二次会议通过了《中华人民共和国行政诉讼法》,于1990年10月1日施行。根据这个法律,公民、法人或其他组织认为行政机关和行政机关工作人员的具体行政行为侵犯其合法权益,有权依照法律向人民法院提起诉讼。人民法院经过审理,确认具体行政行为主要证据不足的;适用法律、法规错误的;违反法定程序的;超越职权的;滥用职权的,可以判决重新作出具体行政行为。具体行政行为给公民、法人或其他组织的合法权益造成损害的,必须承担侵权赔偿责任。《行政诉讼法》的制定和施行,是我国社会主义法制建设的一件大事,也是我国社会主义民主政治建设的一个重要步骤。
translated_text: On March 20, 1989, the Ministry of Personnel issued a "Notice on Issuing the Overall Plan for the Pilot Program of the National Civil Service System in Central State Administrative Organs" to the National Audit Office, the General Administration of Customs (including its system), the State Administration of Taxation, the State Environmental Protection Administration, the State Bureau of Statistics, and the State Bureau of Building Materials, which were identified as pilot units for the implementation of the civil service system. On April 4, 1989, the Second Session of the Seventh National People's Congress passed the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, which came into effect on October 1, 1990. According to this law, citizens, legal persons or other organizations who believe that the specific administrative actions of administrative organs and their staff infringe upon their legitimate rights and interests have the right to file a lawsuit with the people's court in accordance with the law. After trial, if the people's court finds that the specific administrative action is insufficient in main evidence; the application of laws and regulations is wrong; the statutory procedures are violated; the authority is exceeded; and the authority is abused, it may order a new specific administrative action. If a specific administrative action causes damage to the legitimate rights and interests of citizens, legal persons or other organizations, the tort liability must be borne. The formulation and implementation of the Administrative Procedure Law is a major event in the construction of my country's socialist legal system and an important step in the construction of my country's socialist democratic politics.

17日 中共中央召开党外人士座谈会,邀请各民主党派中
央、全国工商联领导同志和无党派人士,讨论中央军委主席邓小平
在接见首都戒严部队军以上干部时的讲话和中共中央、国务院《告
全体共产党员和全国人民书》,同时,听取党外同志对当前工作的
意见和建议。中共中央政治局常委乔石主持座谈会,全国人大常委
会副委员长习仲勋、全国政协副主席王任重等出席了座谈会。
translated_text: On the 17th, the CPC Central Committee held a symposium for non-party members, inviting leaders of the central committees of various democratic parties, the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce, and non-party members to discuss the speech of Deng Xiaoping, Chairman of the Central Military Commission, when he met with military and above cadres of the capital's martial law troops and the "Letter to All Communist Party Members and the People of the Whole Country" by the CPC Central Committee and the State Council, and at the same time, to listen to the opinions and suggestions of non-party comrades on current work. Qiao Shi, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, presided over the symposium, and Xi Zhongxun, Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, and Wang Renzhong, Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, attended the symposium.

events:
18日 中共中央决定,高狄任《人民日报》社社长,不再担任
中共中央党校副校长职务;邵华泽任《人民日报》社总编辑;薛驹任
中共中央党校常务副校长,不再担任中共浙江省顾问委员会主任
职务;钱李仁不再担任《人民日报》社社长职务;谭文瑞不再担任

translated_text: On the 18th, the CPC Central Committee decided that Gao Di would serve as the president of the People's Daily and no longer serve as the vice president of the CPC Central Party School; Shao Huaze would serve as the editor-in-chief of the People's Daily; Xue Ju would serve as the executive vice president of the CPC Central Party School and no longer serve as the director of the CPC Zhejiang Provincial Advisory Committee; Qian Liren would no longer serve as the president of the People's Daily; and Tan Wenrui would no longer serve as the editor-in-chief of the People's Daily.

events: 23日——24日 中国共产党第十三届中央委员会第四次全体会议在北京召开。出席这次会议的中央委员170人,候补中央委员106人。列席会议的中央顾问委员会委员184人,中央纪律检查委员会委员68人,有关方面负责同志29人。全会审议并通过了李鹏代表中央政治局提出的《关于赵紫阳同志在反党反社会主义的动乱中所犯错误的报告》;对中央领导机构的部分成员进行了必要的调整。全会决定,撤销赵紫阳的中共中央委员会总书记、中央政治局常委、中央政治局委员、中央委员和中央军事委员会第一副主席的职务,对他的问题继续进行审查。在此之前,中共中央政治局于6月19日至21日举行了扩大会议,为四中全会的召开作了必要的准备。
translated_text: On the 23rd and 24th, the Fourth Plenary Session of the 13th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China was held in Beijing. 170 members of the Central Committee and 106 alternate members of the Central Committee attended the meeting. 184 members of the Central Advisory Committee, 68 members of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, and 29 responsible comrades from relevant departments attended the meeting. The plenary session reviewed and approved the "Report on Comrade Zhao Ziyang's Mistakes in the Anti-Party and Anti-Socialist Turmoil" proposed by Li Peng on behalf of the Central Political Bureau; and made necessary adjustments to some members of the central leadership. The meeting elected Jiang Zemin as General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China; Jiang Zemin, Song Ping, and Li Ruihuan were elected as members of the Standing Committee of the Central Political Bureau; and Li Ruihuan and Ding Guangen were elected as secretaries of the Central Secretariat. The plenary session decided to remove Zhao Ziyang from his positions as General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, member of the Standing Committee of the Central Political Bureau, member of the Central Political Bureau, member of the Central Committee, and first vice chairman of the Central Military Commission, and to continue to review his issues. Hu Qili was removed from his posts as member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, and secretary of the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee; Rui Xingwen and Yan Mingfu were removed from their posts as secretaries of the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee. Prior to this, the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee held an enlarged meeting from June 19 to 21 to make necessary preparations for the convening of the Fourth Plenary Session of the CPC Central Committee.

events:
25日 中国共产党中央顾问委员会和中国共产党中央纪律
检查委员会分别举行第四次全体会议,一致拥护党的十三届四中
全会通过的各项决定。
translated_text: On the 25th, the Central Advisory Committee of the Communist Party of China and the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China held their fourth plenary sessions respectively, unanimously supporting the decisions adopted by the Fourth Plenary Session of the 13th Central Committee of the Party.

events:
同日《人民日报》发表题为《坚持立国之本,走好强国之路》
的社论。社论指出,四项基本原则是立国之本,必须毫不动摇,始终
一贯地加以坚持;改革开放是强国之路,必须坚定不移,一如既往
地贯彻执行,绝不回到闭关锁国的老路上去。
translated_text: On the same day, the People's Daily published an editorial entitled "Adhere to the Foundation of the Country and Take the Road to a Strong Country". The editorial pointed out that the Four Cardinal Principles are the foundation of the country and must be adhered to unswervingly and consistently; reform and opening up are the road to a strong country and must be implemented unswervingly and consistently, and we must never return to the old path of closing the country to the outside world.

events:
29日 中共中央组织部、监察部制定出《关于加强工作联系
的意见》。其主要内容是:(一)监察部查处违法违纪案件涉及监察
对象中的中央管理干部的,必要时可将主要情况、重要事实通报给
中共中央组织部。(二)中共中央组织部通过来信来访和考察干部,
发现其中属于监察部管辖范围内的监察对象有严重违反政纪行为
的,必要时可将有关材料转送或摘要抄送监察部。(三)中共中央组
织部在提拔、任用、考察干部工作中,对有违反政纪行为正受调查
或群众反映但尚未调查的干部,属于监察部监察对象的,可向监察
部了解情况,听取意见。(四)中共中央组织部和监察部的领导同志
建立不定期的联系制度,就有关干部情况沟通信息,交换意见。
translated_text: On the 29th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the Supervision Department formulated the "Opinions on Strengthening Work Contact". Its main contents are: (a) When the Supervision Department investigates and handles illegal and disciplinary cases involving central management cadres among the supervision targets, it may report the main situation and important facts to the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee when necessary. (b) When the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee discovers through letters, visits and inspections of cadres that the supervision targets under the jurisdiction of the Supervision Department have serious violations of political discipline, it may transfer or copy the summary to the Supervision Department when necessary. (c) In the promotion, appointment and inspection of cadres, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee may inquire about the situation and listen to the opinions of the Supervision Department for cadres who are under investigation for violations of political discipline or have been reported by the masses but have not yet been investigated. (d) The leading comrades of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the Supervision Department shall establish an irregular contact system to communicate information and exchange opinions on the situation of relevant cadres.

events: 29日——7月6日 第七届全国人大常委会第八次会议在北京召开。
translated_text: July 29 - July 6 The 8th meeting of the 7th National People's Congress Standing Committee was held in Beijing. The meeting decided to remove Zhao Ziyang from his post as Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission. After voting, the meeting appointed Yang Bo as Vice Chairman of the Financial and Economic Committee of the National People's Congress; the meeting appointed Gu Xiulian as Minister of Chemical Industry and removed Qin Zhongda from his post as Minister of Chemical Industry based on the proposal of Premier Li Peng of the State Council; and appointed Ruan Chongwu as Minister of Labor.

events: 会议决定撤销赵紫阳的中央军委副主席职务。会议经过表决,任命杨波为全国人大财经委员会副主任委员;会议根据国务院总理李鹏的提请,任命顾秀莲为化工部部长,免去秦仲达的化工部部长职务;任命阮崇武为劳动部部长。
translated_text: July 29 - July 6 The 8th meeting of the 7th National People's Congress Standing Committee was held in Beijing. The meeting decided to remove Zhao Ziyang from his post as Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission. After voting, the meeting appointed Yang Bo as Vice Chairman of the Financial and Economic Committee of the National People's Congress; the meeting appointed Gu Xiulian as Minister of Chemical Industry and removed Qin Zhongda from his post as Minister of Chemical Industry based on the proposal of Premier Li Peng of the State Council; and appointed Ruan Chongwu as Minister of Labor.

events:
1日 中共中央组织部举行纪念“七一”大力加强党的建设座
谈会。中共中央政治局常委、中央组织部部长宋平主持会议并作了
讲话。中共中央顾问委员会副主任薄一波、宋任务和50多位抗日
战争前参加革命工作的老党员参加了座谈会。康世恩、王鹤寿、陈
丕显、伍修权、胡乔木、黄火青、陆定一、耿飚、王首道先后在会上发
言。中共中央总书记江泽民发表了重要讲话。他指出,这次制止动
乱和平息反革命暴乱的斗争再次证明,我们党是有力量的。要下决
心对各级党组织从思想上到组织上进行一次认真的整顿。要总结
这场斗争的经验教训,冷静地回顾和思考党的工作,加强党的建
设,加强思想政治工作。要坚持邓小平同志倡导的两手抓的方针,
坚持党要管党。省、地、县党委,直至工厂、农村、机关、学校、连队等
基层党组织,都要聚精会神地抓好党的建设。党内各级领导干部一
定要带头,切实办好几件党心民心为之振奋的事情。
translated_text: On the 1st, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee held a symposium to commemorate the "July 1st" and vigorously strengthen party building. Song Ping, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, presided over the meeting and delivered a speech. Bo Yibo, deputy director of the CPC Central Advisory Committee, Song Renwu and more than 50 veteran party members who participated in revolutionary work before the Anti-Japanese War attended the symposium. Kang Shien, Wang Heshou, Chen Pixian, Wu Xiuquan, Hu Qiaomu, Huang Huoqing, Lu Dingyi, Geng Biao, and Wang Shoudao spoke at the meeting. Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, delivered an important speech. He pointed out that this struggle to stop the unrest and quell the counter-revolutionary riots once again proved that our party is powerful. We must be determined to carry out a serious rectification of party organizations at all levels from the ideological to the organizational level. We must summarize the lessons learned from this struggle, calmly review and reflect on the party's work, strengthen party building, and strengthen ideological and political work. We must adhere to the policy of "grasping both ends" advocated by Comrade Deng Xiaoping and insist that the party must manage itself. The provincial, prefectural and county party committees, as well as the grassroots party organizations in factories, rural areas, government departments, schools and companies, must concentrate on building the party. Leading cadres at all levels within the party must take the lead and do a good job in doing a few things that will inspire the hearts of the party and the people.

events: 1989年7月4日,中华人民共和国人事部与联合国开发计划署在钓鱼台国宾馆举行《为推行公务员制度的改革,进行人事管理方面的培训》合作项目文件签字仪式。
translated_text: On July 4, 1989, the Ministry of Personnel of the People's Republic of China and the United Nations Development Program held a signing ceremony for the cooperation project document "Providing training in personnel management to promote the reform of the civil service system" at the Diaoyutai State Guesthouse.

events: 6日 中共中央同意,王守强任水利部副部长。
translated_text: On the 6th, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China agreed to appoint Wang Shouqiang as Vice Minister of Water Resources.

events:
12日 中共中央发出《关于当前提拔任用干部有关问题的通
知》。《通知》指出,在清查、清理工作期间,一般不宜提拔干部,急需
提拔的,必须做好考察工作。干部调动和干部交流应按照这一精神
办理。
translated_text: On the 12th, the CPC Central Committee issued a "Notice on Current Issues Concerning the Promotion and Appointment of Cadres". The "Notice" pointed out that during the period of investigation and cleanup, it is generally not appropriate to promote cadres. Those who are in urgent need of promotion must be investigated. The transfer and exchange of cadres should be handled in accordance with this spirit.

events:
14日 中共中央总书记江泽民、中共中央政治局常委李鹏、
李瑞环同参加全国高等学校工作会议的部分同志座谈。中央几位
领导同志在讲话中要求,高等学校的领导,今后要旗帜鲜明地反对
资产阶级自由化,理直气壮地坚持四项基本原则,加强对青年学生
的思想政治工作;要切实整顿好高校领导班子,建立一支精干的政
工队伍。
translated_text: On the 14th, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, Li Peng and Li Ruihuan, members of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, held a discussion with some comrades who attended the National Conference on Higher Education. In their speeches, several central leaders demanded that the leaders of higher education institutions should clearly oppose bourgeois liberalization, firmly uphold the four basic principles, strengthen ideological and political work for young students, and effectively rectify the leadership teams of higher education institutions and establish a capable political work team.

events: 1989年7月15日,公安部发布《关于公安机关辞退公安干警的规定》。指出,实行辞退制度是公安机关解除公安干警身份的行政措施,不具备惩戒性质,并对辞退的条件和程序及被辞退干警的待遇作了规定。这是我国国家行政机关中的第一个规定辞退的规章。
translated_text: On July 15, 1989, the Ministry of Public Security issued the "Regulations on the Dismissal of Police Officers by Public Security Organs". It pointed out that the implementation of the dismissal system is an administrative measure for public security organs to remove the status of public security officers, which is not a disciplinary measure, and stipulated the conditions and procedures for dismissal and the treatment of dismissed police officers. This is the first regulation in my country's national administrative organs to stipulate dismissal.

events:
16日 中共中央、国务院发出《关于省级以上党政机关不直
接从高等学校应届毕业生中吸收干部的通知》。《通知》规定:(一)
省级以上党政机关及所属从事社会科学研究的事业单位和具有政
府管理职能的公司,不直接从高等学校应届毕业生(含大学毕业直
接考入的研究生)中吸收干部。(二)省级以上党政机关从经过基层
工作锻炼的高校毕业生中挑选干部,必须具有较高的政治素质和
业务能力。(三)今后,高等学校应届毕业生应主要到基层工作,经
受全面锻炼,增长才干。(四)各级党委和政府要加强对这项工作的领导。
translated_text: On the 16th, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued the "Notice on Party and Government Organs at or above the Provincial Level Not Recruiting Cadres Directly from College Graduates". The "Notice" stipulates: (a) Party and government organs at or above the provincial level and their affiliated institutions engaged in social science research and companies with government management functions shall not directly recruit cadres from college graduates (including postgraduate students directly admitted after graduating from university). (b) Party and government organs at or above the provincial level select cadres from college graduates who have been trained in grassroots work, and they must have high political qualities and professional abilities. (c) In the future, college graduates should mainly work at the grassroots level, undergo comprehensive training, and increase their abilities. (d) Party committees and governments at all levels should strengthen their leadership over this work.

events: 1989年7月16日,中共中央､国务院发布《关于省级以上党政机关不直接从高等学校应届毕业生中吸收干部的通知》。要求省级以上党政机关及所属从事社会科学研究的事业单位和具有政府管理职能的公司,不直接从高等学校应届毕业生中吸收干部,所需人员,各部门根据自己的工作性质、任务和干部革命化、年轻化、知识化、专业化的要求,在国家规定的编制限额内,按照有关部门批准当年增加干部的指标,从基层经过实践锻炼、具有大专以上文化程度的干部中择优挑选。
translated_text: On July 16, 1989, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued the "Notice on Party and Government Organs at or above the Provincial Level Not Recruiting Cadres Directly from Fresh Graduates from Institutions of Higher Learning". It requires Party and Government Organs at or above the Provincial Level and their affiliated institutions engaged in social science research and companies with government management functions not to recruit cadres directly from fresh graduates from institutions of higher learning. The required personnel shall be selected by each department from cadres who have been trained in practice and have a college degree or above, within the establishment limit prescribed by the state and in accordance with the indicators for increasing cadres approved by the relevant departments for that year, based on their own work nature, tasks and requirements for revolutionary, young, knowledgeable and professional cadres.

events:
19日 中共中央批准,李贵鲜任中国人民银行党组书记;免
去刘鸿儒的中国人民银行党组副书记和中国人民银行副行长职
translated_text: On the 19th, the CPC Central Committee approved Li Guixian as the Party Secretary of the People's Bank of China; Liu Hongru was dismissed from his posts as Deputy Party Secretary of the People's Bank of China and Deputy Governor of the People's Bank of China.

events:
20日 中共中央总书记江泽民、中共中央政治局常委李鹏、
李瑞环在全国宣传部长会议上发表讲话。中央领导同志在讲话中
一致强调,各级党委都要加强思想政治工作。企业党委要把思想政
治工作的责任担当起来,要设立必要的职能机构,建立一支精干的
专职工队伍;要建立健全干部学习制度,规定学习时间,实行轮
训办法,使各级干部特别是中高级干部有机会系统地学习马列主
义、毛泽东思想;要把具有马克思主义理论素养作为干部革命化的
标志之一,作为选拔任用干部的考核标准。
translated_text: On the 20th, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, Li Peng, and Li Ruihuan, members of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, delivered speeches at the National Propaganda Ministers' Conference. In their speeches, the central leaders unanimously emphasized that party committees at all levels must strengthen ideological and political work. Enterprise party committees must take responsibility for ideological and political work, establish necessary functional agencies, and build a team of capable and professional staff; they must establish and improve the cadre learning system, stipulate learning time, and implement rotation training methods so that cadres at all levels, especially middle and senior cadres, have the opportunity to systematically learn Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought; they must regard the theoretical literacy of Marxism as one of the signs of the revolutionary nature of cadres and as the assessment standard for the selection and appointment of cadres.

events:
27日——28日 中共中央政治局在北京举行全体会议,讨论
并通过了《中共中央、国务院关于近期做几件群众关心的事的决
定》和《中共中央关于加强宣传、思想工作的通知》。
党中央和国务院决定近期要做的七件事是:(一)进一步清理
整顿公司;(二)坚决制止高干子女经商;(三)取消对领导同志少量
食品的“特供”;(四)严格按规定配车,严格禁止进口小轿车;(五)
严格禁止请客送礼;(六)严格控制领导干部出国;(七)严肃认真地
查处贪污、受贿、投机倒把等犯罪案件,特别要抓紧查处大案要案。
translated_text: On the 27th and 28th, the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee held a plenary meeting in Beijing to discuss and pass the "Decision of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council on Doing Several Things of Public Concern in the Near Future" and the "Notice of the CPC Central Committee on Strengthening Propaganda and Ideological Work". The Party Central Committee and the State Council decided to do seven things in the near future: (i) further clean up and rectify companies; (ii) resolutely stop the children of high-ranking officials from doing business; (iii) cancel the "special supply" of small amounts of food for leading comrades; (iv) strictly allocate cars according to regulations and strictly prohibit the import of small cars; (v) strictly prohibit entertaining and giving gifts; (vi) strictly control the overseas travel of leading cadres; (vii) seriously investigate and deal with crimes such as embezzlement, bribery, speculation and profiteering, especially major cases.

Jiang Zemin's speech emphasized: (i) In this political struggle, our party's ranks and organizations are generally good and have withstood the test. (ii) We must fight against corruption and corrupt elements and strengthen the connection between the party and the masses. For corruption that has become a trend, no matter how many people are involved, we must investigate it thoroughly. (iii) We must give full play to the political core role of party organizations at all levels. The party organizations in enterprises must play a political core role, which does not contradict the factory director responsibility system stipulated in the Enterprise Law. (iv) We must rely wholeheartedly on the working class. Our party is the vanguard of the working class, and those who have deprived others of their rights cannot join the party. (v) The method of examining cadres cannot be just to give scores, but to inherit the party's traditions, follow the mass line, and listen to feedback from all sides. (vi) Party committee leading cadres must study philosophy and political economics.

translated_text: On the 28th, the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee held a plenary meeting in Beijing to discuss several issues on strengthening the party's construction at present and passed the "Notice of the CPC Central Committee on Strengthening Party Construction". The "Notice" emphasized: (a) It is necessary to conduct an investigation and cleanup within the party, and re-register party members in some units. (b) Party committees at all levels must organize forces and conduct an in-depth investigation of leading cadres at or above the county (department) level according to the cadre management authority. According to the investigation results, necessary organizational adjustments should be made to the leadership team. The principle of both moral integrity and ability cannot be replaced by the "productivity standard" in the selection and appointment of cadres. (c) Leading cadres at all levels must firmly establish the idea of serving the people wholeheartedly, often go deep into reality, go deep into the grassroots, go deep into the masses, and strengthen the relationship between cadres and the masses. (d) Enterprises implement the factory director responsibility system, and the grassroots organizations of the party's enterprises are in the political core position. (e) Colleges and universities implement the principal responsibility system under the leadership of the party committee. The trial of the principal responsibility system will no longer be expanded. (6) Emphasis should be placed on training and recruiting outstanding members among workers, farmers and intellectuals on the front line of production into the Party, and in particular, efforts should be made to recruit Party members among industrial workers. In fact, there is an exploitative relationship between private business owners and workers, and they should not be recruited into the Party. (7) A Marxist Party-building team should be established to study new issues in Party-building and enrich and develop Marxist Party-building theory.

16日 《人民日报》报道,据中共中央组织部有关部门介绍,
与建国初期相比,我国干部队伍有三大变化,一个显著特点。
(一)干部队伍的规模由小至大。建国初期,干部队伍只有170
万人,其中40万人是从旧政权中接收留用的。现在已达3000万
人,比1954年的663万,增长了4倍多。整个干部队伍中95%以
上是建国以后参加工作的。
(二)干部队伍的专业门类少到全。1954年,专业技术干部
只有57万人,占干部队伍总数的8.6%。到1988年,各类专业技
术人员已达近2100万人,占干部队伍总数的67%。现在,21个大
的专业门类的各类专门人才,都有相当数量。
(三)干部队伍的文化专业素质由低到高。到1988年,高中、中
专以上文化程度的干部已达2304万人,占75%,其中大专以上文
化程度的干部861万人,占28%。
一个显著特点是,这支干部队伍是由几代革命者融为一体的
战斗队,她既有久经考验的老一代无产阶级革命家;又有已经成长
起来的、经验丰富而又年富力强的中年一代;还有一大批正在成长
着的年轻一代,他们是各条战线的生力军。
translated_text:
On the 16th, the People's Daily reported that according to the relevant departments of the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, compared with the early days of the founding of the People's Republic of China, my country's cadre team has undergone three major changes and one significant feature. (I) The size of the cadre team has grown from small to large. In the early days of the founding of the People's Republic of China, the cadre team had only 1.7 million people, of which 400,000 were retained from the old regime. Now it has reached 30 million people, more than four times the 6.63 million in 1954. More than 95% of the entire cadre team have joined the work after the founding of the People's Republic of China. (II) The professional categories of the cadre team have changed from few to full. In 1954, there were only 570,000 professional and technical cadres, accounting for 8.6% of the total number of cadres. By 1988, the number of professional and technical personnel of various types had reached nearly 21 million, accounting for 67% of the total number of cadres. Now, there are a considerable number of specialized talents of various types in 21 major professional categories. (III) The cultural and professional quality of the cadre team has changed from low to high. By 1988, the number of cadres with a high school or technical secondary school education or above had reached 23.04 million, accounting for 75%, of which 8.61 million cadres with a college education or above, accounting for 28%.
A notable feature is that this cadre team is a fighting team that is made up of several generations of revolutionaries. It includes both the old generation of proletarian revolutionaries who have been tested for a long time, the middle-aged generation who have grown up, are experienced and in their prime, and a large number of young people who are growing up, and they are the fresh forces on all fronts.

20日 《人民日报》报道,新中国成立40年来,全国共产党员
已由建国初的近450万人发展到今天的4800多万人,基层党组织
由建国初的约20万个发展到今天的近300万个。在党员队伍中工
人成份明显增加。到1988年底,工人党员已发展到797万人,相当
于1949年的71.2倍。工人党员在党员队伍中的比重由1949年的
2.5%增加到17%。党员队伍的文化科学知识水平也有很大提高。
据统计,1988年底全国党员中具有高中以上文化程度的有1480
多万人,占党员总数的30.4%,比1949年增长362倍。同时,各级
党组织对不合格党员进行了严肃处理。如,对“文革”中突击发展的
13万名不合格党员作了除处理;1983年开始的整党中,开除党
籍的有3万3千多人,不予登记的有9万余人;近两年,民主评议
党员中劝退和除出党的有6万多人。
translated_text: On the 20th, the People's Daily reported that in the 40 years since the founding of the People's Republic of China, the number of Communist Party members nationwide has grown from nearly 4.5 million at the beginning of the founding of the People's Republic of China to more than 48 million today, and the grassroots party organizations have grown from about 200,000 at the beginning of the founding of the People's Republic of China to nearly 3 million today. The worker component in the party ranks has increased significantly. By the end of 1988, the number of worker party members had grown to 7.97 million, equivalent to 71.2 times that of 1949. The proportion of worker party members in the party ranks increased from 2.5% in 1949 to 17%. The cultural and scientific knowledge level of the party members has also greatly improved. According to statistics, at the end of 1988, there were more than 14.8 million party members with a high school education or above, accounting for 30.4% of the total number of party members, an increase of 362 times compared with 1949. At the same time, party organizations at all levels have dealt seriously with unqualified party members. For example, 130,000 unqualified party members who were recruited during the Cultural Revolution were removed; during the party rectification that began in 1983, more than 33,000 people were expelled from the party and more than 90,000 people were not registered; in the past two years, more than 60,000 party members were persuaded to withdraw from the party or expelled from the party through democratic evaluation.

translated_text: On the 29th, more than 10,000 people gathered in the capital to celebrate the 40th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China. 的干部,是不可能担当起他所面临的各种艰苦、复杂的任务的。我
们必须努力培养和造就一大批青年马克思主义者。他们应该具有
较深厚的理论修养和较广阔的视野,密切联系群众,懂得中国国
情,自觉根据理论同实际相结合的原则,创造性地开展工作。如果
不提出并解决这个任务,我们的党就不可能有坚强的后备队,就不
可能胜利地走向未来。这是我们的社会主义事业能否长久地坚持
和发展下去的一个具有战略意义的大问题,必须引起全党同志的
高度重视。
translated_text: On the 28th, the CPC Central Committee held a grand meeting in Beijing to commemorate the 100th anniversary of the birth of Li Dazhao, a pioneer of the communist movement in my country, a great Marxist, an outstanding proletarian revolutionary, and one of the main founders of the Communist Party of China. Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, attended the meeting and delivered an important speech. Yang Shangkun, President of the State, Li Peng, Qiao Shi, Yao Yilin, Song Ping, and Li Ruihuan, members of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, attended the commemorative meeting. Peng Zhen presided over the meeting. In his speech, Jiang Zemin pointed out that our cadres, especially senior party cadres, must study the basic theories of Marxism seriously. A cadre who lacks Marxist theoretical cultivation is unlikely to take on the various difficult and complex tasks he faces. We must work hard to cultivate and train a large number of young Marxists. They should have a deeper theoretical cultivation and a broader vision, keep close contact with the masses, understand China's national conditions, and consciously carry out their work creatively based on the principle of combining theory with practice. If this task is not proposed and resolved, our party will not have a strong reserve team and will not be able to move towards the future victoriously. This is a major issue of strategic significance for whether our socialist cause can be maintained and developed for a long time, and it must be taken seriously by all party members.

events: 1989年11月4日,人事部发出《关于国家行政机关工作人员培训工作的通知》。提出,国家行政机关根据经济社会发展的需要,按照人事制度改革的要求,在党的路线方针政策的指导下,对工作人员有计划有目的地组织培训,是人事管理工作的重要组成部分。国家行政机关工作人员的培训要坚持“两手抓”,一手抓马列主义、毛泽东思想教育,一手抓业务培训。培训工作必须以马列主义毛泽东思想为指导,坚持理论联系实际,贯彻学用一致,按需施教,讲求实效的原则,体现培训和任用相结合的方针。通知还就岗位培训、入门培训､晋升资格培训和公务员制度的培训提出了具体的要求。
translated_text: On November 4, 1989, the Ministry of Personnel issued the "Notice on the Training of State Administrative Organs' Staff". It proposed that the state administrative organs should organize training for staff in a planned and targeted manner according to the needs of economic and social development, in accordance with the requirements of personnel system reform, and under the guidance of the party's line, principles and policies, which is an important part of personnel management. The training of state administrative organ staff should adhere to the "two-handed approach", one hand to Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought education, and the other hand to professional training. The training work must be guided by Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought, adhere to the principle of combining theory with practice, implement the principle of unity of learning and application, teaching according to needs, and emphasizing effectiveness, and reflect the principle of combining training and appointment. The notice also puts forward specific requirements for job training, entry training, promotion qualification training and training in the civil service system.

Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, delivered an important speech at the end of the plenary session.
