The key points are: (i) firmly establish the guiding ideology of sustained, stable and coordinated development of the national economy; (ii) adhere to the mass line and improve leadership style; (iii) strengthen democratic centralism and improve the party's combat effectiveness; (iv) strengthen theoretical study and improve the scientific nature of the party's work.

events:
8日 中共中央政治局常委、中央书记处书记李瑞环在同出
席京津沪企业思想政治工作研讨会的代表座谈时指出,思想政治
工作是党的“传家宝”,是我们的政治优势。这个政治优势是我们党
在长期革命和建设中,在马克思主义理论指导下,逐步形成的一套
区别于资本主义的基本经验和特征。开展思想政治工作,一是进行
马克思主义普遍教育;二是针对职工存在的现实问题,进行深入细
致的思想政治工作;三是经常不断地开展学先进、赶先进的群众性
自我教育;四是发挥党团员的模范带头作用;五是开展群众喜闻乐
见的活动,寓教于乐;六是把关心群众生活纳入到思想政治工作中
去。
translated_text: On the 8th, Li Ruihuan, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Central Secretariat, pointed out at a discussion with representatives attending the seminar on ideological and political work in enterprises in Beijing, Tianjin and Shanghai that ideological and political work is the party's "family heirloom" and our political advantage. This political advantage is a set of basic experiences and characteristics that our party has gradually formed in the long-term revolution and construction under the guidance of Marxist theory, which are different from capitalism. To carry out ideological and political work, first, carry out universal education in Marxism; second, carry out in-depth and meticulous ideological and political work in response to the practical problems of employees; third, carry out mass self-education of learning from and catching up with the advanced; fourth, give full play to the exemplary role of party members and league members; fifth, carry out activities that the masses like to hear and see, and combine education with entertainment; sixth, incorporate concern for the lives of the masses into ideological and political work.

events:
10日 中共中央组织部发出《关于当前提拔任用干部有关问
题的补充通知》。《通知》规定,在清查清理期间,各地区、各部门对
派驻香港人员的提拔任用,一律待清查清理工作结束后按有关规
定办理,人员轮换也按上述精神执行。
translated_text: On the 10th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued a "Supplementary Notice on Current Issues Concerning the Promotion and Appointment of Cadres". The "Notice" stipulates that during the period of investigation and cleanup, the promotion and appointment of personnel stationed in Hong Kong by all regions and departments shall be handled in accordance with relevant regulations after the investigation and cleanup work is completed, and personnel rotation shall also be implemented in accordance with the above spirit.

events:
同日 新华社报道,在“两院”《通告》和监察部《通告》的感召
和威慑下,到规定的期限10月31日止,全国检察机关投案自首
的3.6万多人,党员占9363人,县处级干部742人,厅局级干部
40人,副部级干部1人。
translated_text: On the same day, Xinhua News Agency reported that under the inspiration and deterrence of the "Notice" of the "Two Courts" and the "Notice" of the Ministry of Supervision, by the stipulated deadline of October 31, more than 36,000 people surrendered to the procuratorates across the country, including 9,363 party members, 742 county-level cadres, 40 bureau-level cadres, and 1 deputy ministerial-level cadre.

events:
11日 首都各界隆重集会,纪念伟大的革命人道主义者、国
际主义者、共产主义战士白求恩逝世50周年,诞辰100周年。中共
中央总书记、中共中央军委主席江泽民出席大会。中共中央政治局
常委李瑞环在讲话中指出,由于中国共产党的倡导和毛泽东同志
《纪念白求恩》这篇著名文章的影响;白求恩精神已在中国共产党
和中国人民中间形成为一种风范,一种楷模,一种准则,一种传统。
白求恩精神已经成为中华民族之魂的一个组成部分。
translated_text: On the 11th, people from all walks of life in the capital held a grand gathering to commemorate the 50th anniversary of the death and the 100th anniversary of the birth of the great revolutionary humanitarian, internationalist, and communist fighter Bethune. Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee and Chairman of the CPC Central Military Commission, attended the meeting. Li Ruihuan, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, pointed out in his speech that due to the advocacy of the CPC and the influence of Comrade Mao Zedong's famous article "In Memory of Bethune", the Bethune spirit has become a style, a model, a criterion, and a tradition among the CPC and the Chinese people. The Bethune spirit has become an integral part of the soul of the Chinese nation.

events:
12日 全国政协六届委员会副主席、“九三学社中央委员会
名誉主席、中国科学技术协会全国委员会名誉主席、中国共产党党
员、著名桥梁专家茅以升,因病在北京逝世,终年94年。
translated_text: On the 12th, Mao Yisheng, Vice Chairman of the Sixth National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, Honorary Chairman of the Central Committee of the Jiusan Society, Honorary Chairman of the National Committee of the China Association for Science and Technology, member of the Communist Party of China, and famous bridge expert, died of illness in Beijing at the age of 94.

On the 13th, the CPC Central Committee agreed that Zhang Youcai would be appointed as the Deputy Minister of Finance; Zhao Zong would concurrently serve as the Deputy Secretary of the Party Group of the Ministry of Personnel and the Deputy Minister of the Ministry of Personnel; Cheng Lianchang would be appointed as the Deputy Secretary of the Party Group of the Ministry of Personnel; Gao Wen would no longer serve as the Deputy Governor of Jilin Province.

events:
13日——29日 中共中央组织部在北京举办第一期组织部
长专题研究班,研究关于加强企业党的建设问题。参加研究班的有
9个省市组织部的负责同志,4个计划单列城市的市委领导,6个
大型骨干企业的党委领导成员,及中共中央组织部有关局、室的同
志,共22人。在研讨期间,中共中央政治局常委、中共中央组织部
部长宋平及副部长赵宗鼐、吕枫、孟连崑、刘泽等多次同学员们
一起座谈。研究班结束时,宋平作了重要讲话。最后,研究班提出
了《关于充分发挥企业党组织政治核心作用的若干建议》。
translated_text: From the 13th to the 29th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee held the first seminar for Organization Department Directors in Beijing to study the issue of strengthening the party building in enterprises. The seminar was attended by 9 provincial and municipal organization departments, 4 municipal party committee leaders of independently planned cities, 6 large backbone enterprise party committee leaders, and comrades from relevant bureaus and offices of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, a total of 22 people. During the seminar, Song Ping, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, and deputy ministers Zhao Zongnai, Lu Feng, Meng Liankun, Liu Ze and others held discussions with the participants many times. At the end of the seminar, Song Ping made an important speech. Finally, the seminar put forward "Several Suggestions on Giving Full Play to the Political Core Role of Enterprise Party Organizations".

events:
16日——22日 中共中央总书记、中央军委主席江泽民到云南
视察边疆民族地区。他在视察时强调指出,民族和睦、民族团结,发
展民族经济、教育、文化,改善群众生活,这是所有在民族地区工作
的干部必须高度重视的问题。他还指出,干部不下去,嘴上讲群众
路线,那是空的。从中央开始,省、地、县的干部都要深入到群众中
去调查研究,到基层抓各项工作的落实。
translated_text: From the 16th to the 22nd, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, visited Yunnan to inspect the ethnic minority areas in the border areas. During his inspection, he emphasized that ethnic harmony and unity, the development of ethnic economy, education, and culture, and the improvement of people's lives are issues that all cadres working in ethnic minority areas must attach great importance to. He also pointed out that if cadres do not go down to the grassroots, it is empty talk about the mass line. Starting from the central government, cadres at the provincial, prefectural, and county levels must go deep into the masses to conduct investigations and research, and go to the grassroots to implement various tasks.

events:
17日 《人民日报》报道,经全国清理整顿公司领导小组审查
批准,中央国家机关第一批撤销1018个公司。其中,有国务院50
个部门的982个公司,中直机关7个部门的36个公司。
translated_text: On the 17th, the People's Daily reported that after review and approval by the National Leading Group for Cleaning Up and Rectifying Companies, the central government agencies have cancelled the first batch of 1,018 companies. Among them, there are 982 companies from 50 departments of the State Council and 36 companies from 7 departments of the central government agencies.

events:
18日 在天津市第十一届人大三次会议上,聂壁初当选为天
津市市长。
translated_text: On the 18th, at the third session of the 11th Tianjin Municipal People's Congress, Nie Bichu was elected mayor of Tianjin.

events:
19日 中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅发出《关于进一步加
强信访工作的通知》。《通知》指出,各级党委和政府要重视信访工
作,切实加强对信访工作的领导,处理好群众的信访问题,加强信
访部门和信访队伍的建设。
translated_text: On the 19th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council issued the "Notice on Further Strengthening Petition Work". The "Notice" pointed out that party committees and governments at all levels should attach importance to petition work, effectively strengthen the leadership of petition work, handle petition issues of the masses, and strengthen the construction of petition departments and petition teams.

events:
20日 中共中央组织部就国务院各部门下属单位党的组织
设置问题发出通知。《通知》规定:国务院各部委、直属局、直属公司
党的关系在地方的下属单位,其党的组织设置,由所在地方党委决
定,有关部门党组(党委)可以同地方党委协商,但不得直接发文决
定这些单位党的组织设置。
translated_text: On the 20th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued a notice on the establishment of party organizations in subordinate units of various departments of the State Council. The "Notice" stipulates that the establishment of party organizations in subordinate units of various ministries, directly affiliated bureaus, and directly affiliated companies of the State Council with local party relations shall be decided by the local party committee. The party groups (party committees) of relevant departments may consult with local party committees, but they may not directly issue documents to decide on the establishment of party organizations in these units.

events:
21日 中共中央组织部发出《关于转发中共北京市委组织部
“关于党员重新登记工作的安排”的通知》。《通知》要求各省、部级
党委(党组)结合本地区本单位实际情况,对党员登记工作作出安
排和部署。北京市委组织部的《安排意见》对党员重新登记的目的
和指导思想、范围、准予登记和不予登记的界限、步骤和方法及组
织领导都作了明确规定。
translated_text: On the 21st, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued a "Notice on Forwarding the Arrangements for Party Member Re-registration Work of the Organization Department of the CPC Beijing Municipal Committee". The "Notice" requires all provincial and ministerial Party committees (Party groups) to make arrangements and deployments for party member registration work in light of the actual conditions of their respective regions and units. The "Arrangements Opinions" of the Organization Department of the Beijing Municipal Committee clearly stipulates the purpose and guiding ideology, scope, the boundaries of approval and non-registration, steps and methods, and organizational leadership of party member re-registration.

events:
22日中共中央政治局常委、中共中央组织部部长宋平同第
七期省部级领导干部读书班和第一期组织部长专题研究班的学员
举行座谈。宋平强调,各级干部都要挤时间学习马列主义理论,要
建立干部学习马列主义理论的制度。省部级干部在一届任期内,要
到中央党校学习一次。凡是准备进入省部级领导班子的干部,最好
先到中央党校理论班学习一年。同时,还要结合当前形势和任务,
由各部门举办短期培训班,一届任期内可办一、二期。平时,干部也
要自觉地学习,领导干部要带头。
translated_text: On the 22nd, Song Ping, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, held a discussion with the students of the seventh provincial and ministerial level leading cadres reading class and the first organization minister special research class. Song Ping emphasized that cadres at all levels must squeeze out time to study Marxist-Leninist theory and establish a system for cadres to study Marxist-Leninist theory. Provincial and ministerial level cadres must study at the Central Party School once during their term of office. All cadres who are preparing to join the provincial and ministerial level leadership team should first study in the Central Party School theory class for one year. At the same time, in combination with the current situation and tasks, short-term training courses should be held by various departments, and one or two sessions can be held during one term of office. In normal times, cadres should also study consciously, and leading cadres should take the lead.

events:
23日 中共中央组织部发出通知,转发河南省委组织部《关
于整顿农村软弱涣散党支部情况的报告》。《通知》要求各省、自治
区、直辖市党委组织部门,务必按照中共中央1989年9号文件精
神,迅速摸清情况,派出得力干部,在今冬明春认真负责地对农村
软弱涣散的党组织加以整顿,帮助提高。
translated_text: On the 23rd, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued a notice forwarding the "Report on the Rectification of Weak and Disorganized Party Branches in Rural Areas" by the Organization Department of the Henan Provincial Party Committee. The "Notice" requires the organization departments of the Party committees of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government to follow the spirit of Document No. 9 of the CPC Central Committee in 1989, quickly find out the situation, send capable cadres, and conscientiously and responsibly rectify and improve weak and disorganized party organizations in rural areas this winter and next spring.

events:
28日 中共中央组织部发出《关于向从事干部档案工作30
年的人员颁发“荣誉证书”具体办法的通知》。《通知》规定,对符合
条件的从事干部档案工作30年的工作人员,由各省、自治区、直辖
市党委组织部门批准授予《荣誉证书》。军队颁发办法由军委总政
治部制定。
translated_text: On the 28th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on the Specific Methods for Issuing "Honorary Certificates" to Personnel Who Have Been Engaged in Cadre Archives Work for 30 Years". The "Notice" stipulates that for qualified personnel who have been engaged in cadre archives work for 30 years, the "Honorary Certificate" shall be approved by the organization departments of the party committees of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the central government. The issuance method of the military is formulated by the General Political Department of the Military Commission.

events:
30日 中共中央同意,桂世庸任国家计划委员会副主任;石
希玉任铁道部副部长。
中共中央批准,滕文生、郑科扬、卫建林任中共中央政策研究
室副主任。
中共中央决定,沈达人到江苏省工作,不再担任宁夏自治区党
委书记、常委、委员职务。
translated_text: On the 30th, the CPC Central Committee agreed that Gui Shiyong would be appointed as deputy director of the State Planning Commission; Shi Xiyu would be appointed as deputy minister of the Ministry of Railways. The CPC Central Committee approved that Teng Wensheng, Zheng Keyang, and Wei Jianlin would be appointed as deputy directors of the CPC Central Policy Research Office. The CPC Central Committee decided that Shen Daren would work in Jiangsu Province and would no longer serve as secretary, standing committee member, or member of the Ningxia Autonomous Region Party Committee.

events: 1989年12月2日,张志坚副部长率中国人事代表团一行六人赴尼泊尔参加东部地区共同行政组织第十三次大会和该组织第三十六届执行理事会。这是我国政府恢复在东部地区共同行政组织席位后首次出席的会议。张志坚副部长当选为本届大会副主席和第三十六届执委会第一副主席。
translated_text: On December 2, 1989, Vice Minister Zhang Zhijian led a Chinese personnel delegation of six people to Nepal to attend the 13th General Assembly of the Eastern Regional Common Administrative Organization and the 36th Executive Council of the organization. This was the first meeting attended by the Chinese government after it resumed its seat in the Eastern Regional Common Administrative Organization. Vice Minister Zhang Zhijian was elected as the Vice Chairman of this General Assembly and the First Vice Chairman of the 36th Executive Committee.

events:
4日——20日 中共中央组织部在北京举办第二期组织部长
专题研究班,研究关于加强领导班子建设问题。参加研究班的有
11个省和6个地市的党委组织部负责同志及中央组织部有关局、
室的同志,共20人。研讨期间,中共中央政治局常委、中共中央组
织部部长宋平和中共中央组织部副部长赵宗鼐、吕枫、刘泽彭等同
学员进行了座谈。12月19日,宋平在研究班汇报会上发表了重要
讲话。他调强,坚持马克思主义,坚持社会主义方向,关键是要把我
们这个党建设好,把各级领导班子建设好,使领导权牢牢掌握在忠
于马克思主义的人手中。
translated_text: From the 4th to the 20th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee held the second special seminar for Organization Department Ministers in Beijing to study the issue of strengthening the leadership team building. The seminar was attended by 20 people, including responsible comrades from the Organization Departments of the Party Committees of 11 provinces and 6 prefecture-level cities and comrades from relevant bureaus and offices of the Central Organization Department. During the seminar, Song Ping, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, and Zhao Zongnai, Lv Feng, Liu Zepeng, and other deputy ministers of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, held discussions with the participants. On December 19, Song Ping delivered an important speech at the seminar report meeting. He stressed that the key to adhering to Marxism and the socialist direction is to build our party well, to build leadership teams at all levels well, and to ensure that the leadership is firmly in the hands of people who are loyal to Marxism.

events:
5日 陕西省第七届人大十次会议,决定任命郑斯林为陕西
省副省长。
translated_text: On the 5th, the 10th Session of the 7th Shaanxi Provincial People's Congress decided to appoint Zheng Silin as the Vice Governor of Shaanxi Province.

events:
7日 中共中央批准,袁启彤任福建省委副书记;同意郁文、
曲维镇、江流任中国社会科学院副院长;同意交通银行党组继续保
留,戴相龙任交通银行党组书记、总经理,免去李祥瑞交通银行党
组书记职务;马峰任中国作协党组书记,玛拉沁夫任中国作协党组
副书记;免去冯牧的中国作协党组副书记;林默涵任中国文联党组
书记,孟伟哉任中国文联党组副书记;免去吴祖强的中国文联党组
书记职务;于洪恩任全国总工会党组副书记;免去朱厚泽的全国总
工会党组副书记、全国总工会副主席、书记处第一书记职务;免去
李定的中共中央统战部副部长职务;免去刘正的湖南省委副书记、
常委职务。
translated_text: On the 7th, the CPC Central Committee approved Yuan Qitong as the deputy secretary of the Fujian Provincial Party Committee; approved Yu Wen, Qu Weizhen, and Jiang Liu as vice presidents of the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences; approved the Bank of Communications Party Committee to continue to retain Dai Xianglong as the Party Committee Secretary and General Manager of the Bank of Communications, and removed Li Xiangrui from the position of Party Committee Secretary of the Bank of Communications; Ma Feng as the Party Committee Secretary of the China Writers Association, and Ma Laqinfu as the Deputy Party Committee Secretary of the China Writers Association; removed Feng Mu from the position of Deputy Party Committee Secretary of the China Writers Association; Lin Mohan as the Party Committee Secretary of the China Federation of Literary and Art Circles, and Meng Weizai as the Deputy Party Committee Secretary of the China Federation of Literary and Art Circles; removed Wu Zuqiang from the position of Party Committee Secretary of the China Federation of Literary and Art Circles; Yu Hongen as the Deputy Party Committee Secretary of the All-China Federation of Trade Unions; removed Zhu Houze from the positions of Deputy Party Committee Secretary of the All-China Federation of Trade Unions, Vice Chairman of the All-China Federation of Trade Unions, and First Secretary of the Secretariat; removed Li Ding from the position of Deputy Minister of the United Front Work Department of the CPC Central Committee; and removed Liu Zheng from the position of Deputy Secretary and Standing Committee Member of the Hunan Provincial Party Committee.

events:
9日 新华社报道,全国县、乡换届选举工作在今冬明春将全
面展开。据测算,全国将有七亿多选民参加这次选举。
translated_text: On the 9th, Xinhua News Agency reported that the nationwide county and township elections will be fully launched this winter and next spring. According to estimates, more than 700 million voters will participate in this election.

events:
10日 中国共产党优秀党员,久经考验的忠诚的共产主义战
士,无产阶级革命家,杰出的外交家,我党我军优秀的政治工作者
和文化工作者,中共中央顾问委员会常委黄镇,因病在北京逝世,
终年 80岁。
translated_text: On the 10th, Huang Zhen, an outstanding member of the Communist Party of China, a long-tested and loyal communist fighter, a proletarian revolutionary, an outstanding diplomat, an outstanding political worker and cultural worker of our party and army, and a member of the Standing Committee of the Central Advisory Commission of the Communist Party of China, died of illness in Beijing at the age of 80.

events:
14日 中共中央批准,张帼英任广东省委副书记,免去其全
国妇联党组副书记、书记处第一书记职务;宋宝瑞任四川省委副书
记。同意地质矿产部党组继续保留,增补宋瑞祥任地质矿产部党组
副书记;财政部党组继续保留,增补刘仲黎任财政部党组副书记;
成立中国海洋石油总公司党组,钟一鸣任中国海洋石油总公司党

translated_text: On the 21st, the CPC Central Committee issued a notice on strengthening and improving the Party's leadership over the work of trade unions, the Communist Youth League, and the Women's Federation. The Notice proposes the following issues in strengthening and improving the Party's leadership over the work of trade unions, the Communist Youth League, and the Women's Federation, and giving full play to the role of these mass organizations: (i) Party committees at all levels must firmly establish the idea of wholeheartedly relying on the working class and the broad masses of the people, and attach great importance to the work of trade unions, the Communist Youth League, and the Women's Federation; (ii) Party organizations must exercise unified leadership over trade unions, the Communist Youth League, and the Women's Federation; (iii) support trade unions, the Communist Youth League, and the Women's Federation to carry out their work independently in accordance with the law and their respective charters; (iv) support trade unions, the Communist Youth League, and the Women's Federation to better safeguard the specific interests of the masses they represent while safeguarding the overall interests of the people of the country; (v) give full play to the role of trade unions, the Communist Youth League, and the Women's Federation in ideological and political education; (vi) give full play to the role of trade unions, the Communist Youth League, and the Women's Federation in democratic participation and democratic supervision in the management of state and social affairs; (vii) enhance the vitality of grassroots trade unions, the Communist Youth League, and the Women's Federation; (viii) strengthen the construction of the cadre team of trade unions, the Communist Youth League, and the Women's Federation. On the same day, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, Li Peng, Qiao Shi, Yao Yilin, Song Ping, Li Ruihuan, members of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, and Ding Guangen, alternate member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and secretary of the Secretariat, met with all the representatives attending the 11th Executive Committee of the All-China Federation of Trade Unions. In his speech, Jiang Zemin emphasized that the working class is the main force of socialist revolution and construction, and in the current governance, rectification and deepening of reform, we must also rely wholeheartedly on the working class. Overcome temporary difficulties, and dawn is ahead. In his speech, Song Ping pointed out that the Communist Party of China is the vanguard of the working class, and the fighting power of the Communist Party comes from the working class and the masses. The fate of the working class is linked to socialism and the Communist Party. If someone attempts to oppose socialism and attack the Communist Party of China, the working class must rise up and fight them resolutely.

events: 27日 中共中央发出《关于建立健全省部级领导干部学习制度的通知》。《通知》规定,省、自治区、直辖市党委、政府和中央、国家机关各部委的领导干部,每届任期内,须到中央党校进修一次。主要学习马克思主义基本理论、党的基本路线和党内政治生活的基本准则,运用马克思主义的世界观和方法论,联系实际,研究弄清一些重大问题,充实理论基础,提高理论水平。《通知》规定,省、自治区、直辖市党委、政府和中央、国家机关各部委的领导干部,每年至少拿出半个月时间,选读一些马克思主义理论著作和其它有关书籍,结合实际,集中精力思考一些问题,总结经验。《通知》规定,选拔进省、自治区、直辖市党委、政府和中央、国家机关各部委领导班子的干部,应考虑其马克思主义基础理论的水平。拟推荐的人选应先送中央党校进行为期一年的马克思主义基本理论和党内政治生活基本准则的培训。要注意选拔非党干部、妇女干部和少数民族干部参加培训。《通知》还规定了不担任领导职务的中央委员、候补中央委员,可根据他们的具体情况,分别采取上述办法,作出学习培训安排。
translated_text: On the 27th, the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on Establishing and Improving the Study System for Provincial and Ministerial Leading Cadres". The "Notice" stipulates that leading cadres of provincial, autonomous regional and municipal party committees, governments and central and state organs must go to the Central Party School for advanced studies once during each term of office. They mainly study the basic theories of Marxism, the basic line of the Party and the basic principles of political life within the Party, apply the Marxist world outlook and methodology, link with reality, study and clarify some major issues, enrich the theoretical foundation and improve the theoretical level. The "Notice" stipulates that leading cadres of provincial, autonomous regional and municipal party committees, governments and central and state organs should take at least half a month each year to select and read some Marxist theoretical works and other relevant books, combine with reality, concentrate on thinking about some problems, and summarize experience. The "Notice" stipulates that the selection of cadres into the leadership teams of provincial, autonomous regional and municipal party committees, governments and central and state organs should take into account their level of basic Marxist theory. The candidates to be recommended should first be sent to the Central Party School for a one-year training on the basic theories of Marxism and the basic norms of political life within the Party. Attention should be paid to selecting non-Party cadres, women cadres and ethnic minority cadres to participate in the training. The "Notice" also stipulates that the Central Committee members and alternate Central Committee members who do not hold leadership positions can adopt the above-mentioned methods and make study and training arrangements according to their specific circumstances.

events:

translated_text: On the 29th, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, Li Peng, Qiao Shi, Yao Yilin, Song Ping and Li Ruihuan, members of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, held a discussion with all members of the Party Building Theory Research Class. Song Ping presided over the discussion, and Jiang Zemin delivered an important speech on strengthening party building. Comrades Li Peng and Qiao Shi also spoke. At the same time, he emphasized that the leadership of the party and the state at all levels must be in the hands of people who are loyal to Marxism.

events:
30日 中共中央发出《关于坚持和完善中国共产党领导的多
党合作和政治协商制度的意见》。《意见》指出,中国共产党领导的
多党合作制,是马克思列宁主义同中国革命与建设相结合的一个
创造,是符合中国国情的社会主义政党制度。我国的多党合作必须
坚持中国共产党的领导,必须坚持四项基本原则,这是中国共产党
同各民主党派合作的政治基础。中国共产党对各民主党派的领导
是政治领导,即政治原则、政治方向和重大方针政策的领导。中国
共产党同各民主党派合作的基本方针是,“长期共存、互相监督、肝
胆相照、荣辱与共”。《意见》要求,加强中国共产党和各民主党派之
间的合作与协商,进一步发挥民主党派成员、无党派人士在人民代
表大会中的作用,举荐民主党派成员、无党派人士担任各级政府及
司法机关的领导职务,进一步发挥民主党派在人民政协中的作用,
支持各民主党派加强自身建设。
translated_text: On the 30th, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Opinions on Upholding and Improving the Multi-Party Cooperation and Political Consultation System under the Leadership of the Communist Party of China". The "Opinions" pointed out that the multi-party cooperation system led by the Communist Party of China is a creation that combines Marxism-Leninism with China's revolution and construction, and is a socialist party system that conforms to China's national conditions. my country's multi-party cooperation must uphold the leadership of the Communist Party of China and must uphold the four basic principles, which are the political basis for the cooperation between the Communist Party of China and the democratic parties. The leadership of the Communist Party of China over the democratic parties is political leadership, that is, leadership in political principles, political direction and major policies and guidelines. The basic principle of the cooperation between the Communist Party of China and the democratic parties is "long-term coexistence, mutual supervision, mutual trust, and sharing of honor and disgrace". The "Opinions" require strengthening cooperation and consultation between the Communist Party of China and the democratic parties, further giving play to the role of members of democratic parties and non-party personages in the National People's Congress, recommending members of democratic parties and non-party personages to serve as leaders of governments and judicial organs at all levels, further giving play to the role of democratic parties in the People's Political Consultative Conference, and supporting the democratic parties to strengthen their own construction.

events:
同日 中共中央总书记江泽民和中共中央政治局常委李鹏、
乔石、姚依林、宋平、李瑞环邀请各民主党派、全国工商联主要领导
人和无党派爱国人士,就当前国内国际形势和坚持与完善中国共
产党领导的多党合作和政治协商制度问题举行座谈会。江泽民在
座谈时指出,在坚持四项基本原则和改革开放的前提下,首先,全
国上下要齐心协力把经济搞上去,增强我们的国力,提高人民的生
活;其次,要采取有力措施,对国内外敌对势力的破坏活动进行坚
决斗争;另外,要通过党政部门、各民主党派及工、青、妇群众团体
等各种渠道,倾听和反映人民群众的呼声和意见,正确的意见要及
时加以解决,不正确或暂时办不到的意见要给以解释。
translated_text: On the same day, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, and Li Peng, Qiao Shi, Yao Yilin, Song Ping, and Li Ruihuan, members of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, invited the main leaders of the democratic parties, the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce, and non-partisan patriots to hold a symposium on the current domestic and international situation and the issue of upholding and improving the multi-party cooperation and political consultation system under the leadership of the Communist Party of China. During the symposium, Jiang Zemin pointed out that under the premise of adhering to the four basic principles and reform and opening up, first, the whole country should work together to develop the economy, enhance our national strength, and improve people's lives; second, we must take effective measures to resolutely fight against the sabotage activities of hostile forces at home and abroad; in addition, we must listen to and reflect the voices and opinions of the people through various channels such as party and government departments, democratic parties, and labor, youth, and women's mass organizations. Correct opinions should be promptly resolved, and incorrect or temporarily unfeasible opinions should be explained.

events:

指出,中国八十年代的三大任务取得很大成就,九十年代要继续建
设有中国特色的社会主义。为了实现九十年代的任务,必须首先加
强和改善党的领导。
translated_text: On the 31st, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, accepted an interview with reporters on the eve of the New Year and pointed out that China had made great achievements in the three major tasks in the 1980s, and would continue to build socialism with Chinese characteristics in the 1990s. In order to achieve the tasks in the 1990s, it was necessary to first strengthen and improve the leadership of the Party.

events:
3日 中共中央组织部就印发《中央组织部一九九○年工作
要点》发出通知。《要点》提出,一九九○年主要抓好下列几项工作:
(一)加强清理工作的指导,搞好干部考察和党员登记工作;(二)调
整、配备好省部级领导班子,指导搞好县市换届选举;(三)认真选
拔、培养后备干部,改变目前省部级主要负责干部接替人选不足的
被动局面;(四)加强党政领导干部群众的紧密联系,抓好领导班
子的思想作风建设;(五)大力加强党的基层组织建设,重点解决好
企业､高校､农村党组织建设中的紧迫问题;(六)加强干部工作的
宏观管理,克服干部管理中的混乱现象;(七)大力加强干部培训工
作;(八)积极推进组织制度和干部人事制度改革;(九)做好知识分
子工作;(十)进一步加强老干部工作;(十一)进一步推进党的建设
理论的学习和研究;(十二)提高组织部门干部队伍的素质。
translated_text:
On the 3rd, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued a notice on the issuance of the "Main Points of the Work of the Organization Department of the Central Committee in 1990". The "Key Points" proposed that the following tasks should be focused on in 1990:
(i) Strengthen the guidance of the clean-up work, do a good job in cadre inspection and party member registration; (ii) Adjust and equip the provincial and ministerial leadership teams, and guide the county and city elections; (iii) Carefully select and train reserve cadres to change the passive situation of insufficient candidates for successors of the provincial and ministerial cadres; (iv) Strengthen the close contact between party and government leading cadres and the masses, and do a good job in the ideological and work style construction of the leadership team; (v) Vigorously strengthen the construction of grassroots party organizations, and focus on solving urgent problems in the construction of party organizations in enterprises, universities, and rural areas; (vi) Strengthen the macro-management of cadre work and overcome the chaos in cadre management; (vii) Vigorously strengthen cadre training; (viii) Actively promote the reform of organizational system and cadre personnel system; (ix) Do a good job in intellectual work; (x) Further strengthen the work of veteran cadres; (xi) Further promote the study and research of party building theory; (xii) Improve the quality of the cadre team of the organization department.

events:

民团体接收应届大、中专以上毕业生计划的通知》。《通知》要求中
央直属机关各部委、各人民团体机关和所属在京事业、企业单位要
严格执行中发(1984)12号(即《中共中央、国务院关于改变中央和
国家机关直接从应届大专毕业生中吸收干部的办法的通知》)和中
发(1989)5号文件(即《中共中央、国务院关于省级以上党政机关
不直接从高等学校应届毕业生中吸收干部的通知》的规定,除个
别专业性很强的工作外,不得直接从应届毕业生中吸收干部。直接
吸收的,也要严格控制在核定的编制数之内,并尽量在北京生源中
挑选。
translated_text: On the 5th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on Submitting the Plan for Central Government Departments and People's Organizations to Recruit Fresh Graduates from Colleges and Technical Secondary Schools and Above". The "Notice" requires all ministries and commissions directly under the central government, all people's organizations and their affiliated institutions and enterprises in Beijing to strictly implement the provisions of Document No. 12 of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (1984) (i.e., "Notice of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council on Changing the Method of Central and State Organs Directly Recruiting Cadres from Fresh Graduates from Colleges and Technical Secondary Schools") and Document No. 5 of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (1989) (i.e., "Notice of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council on Party and Government Organs at or above the Provincial Level Not Directly Recruiting Cadres from Fresh Graduates from Colleges and Universities"). Except for some highly professional jobs, cadres shall not be directly recruited from fresh graduates. For direct recruitment, it shall also be strictly controlled within the approved establishment number and selected from Beijing students as much as possible.

events:
10日 中共中央总书记江泽民、中央政治局常委李鹏、乔石、
姚依林、李瑞环,中央政治局候补委员、书记处书记丁关根会见出
席全国省、区、市党委秘书长座谈会的同志。
江泽民指出,各级办公厅是各级党委的工作机构,处在承上启
下的重要地位,承担着为领导提供情况,贯彻实施,协调落实以及
处理日常事务的任务,是领导机关上情下达、下情上达的枢纽。这
就要求反映的情况一定要全面、准确、实事求是,既不能报喜不报
忧,也不能报忧不报喜,不能一叶障目,以偏概全。江泽民同志强
调,办公厅的工作人员,政治上要过得硬,要坚定地同党中央保持
一致,具有严明的组织纪律性;作风上要坚持实事求是和群众路
线;对自己要严格要求,保持廉洁,要不断提高自身的政策理论水
平和业务素质,提高办事效率。李鹏指出,办公厅是各级党政领导
联系群众的一条重要渠道,对领导决策的正确与否影响很大。因
此,办公厅一定要真实、准确、全面地反映情况,不断提高工作质
量,为各级领导创造一个好的工作条件。同时,还要带头加强廉政
建设,使各级党政领导机关与人民群众保持密切的联系。
translated_text: On the 10th, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, Li Peng, Qiao Shi, Yao Yilin, Li Ruihuan, members of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, and Ding Guangen, alternate member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and secretary of the Secretariat, met with comrades attending the symposium of secretaries-general of provincial, regional and municipal party committees across the country. Jiang Zemin pointed out that the general offices at all levels are the working bodies of the party committees at all levels, and they are in an important position of connecting the upper and lower levels. They are responsible for providing information to the leaders, implementing, coordinating and implementing, and handling daily affairs. They are the hubs for the leadership to communicate information from the upper level to the lower level and from the lower level to the upper level. This requires that the situation reflected must be comprehensive, accurate, and realistic. It is not allowed to report good news but not bad news, nor to report bad news but not good news, and it is not allowed to be blinded by one leaf and generalize from a single case. Comrade Jiang Zemin emphasized that the staff of the general office must be strong in politics, firmly maintain consistency with the Party Central Committee, and have strict organizational discipline; they must adhere to the principle of seeking truth from facts and the mass line in their work style; they must be strict with themselves, maintain integrity, and constantly improve their own policy theory level and professional quality to improve their work efficiency. Li Peng pointed out that the General Office is an important channel for party and government leaders at all levels to connect with the masses, and has a great impact on the correctness of leadership decisions. Therefore, the General Office must reflect the situation truthfully, accurately and comprehensively, continuously improve the quality of work, and create a good working condition for leaders at all levels. At the same time, it must take the lead in strengthening the construction of clean government, so that party and government leadership organs at all levels can maintain close contact with the people.

events:

导干部的若干规定》的通知。《通知》指出:地方党委在推荐领导干
部时,要重视人大代表和人大常委会组成人员的意见。人事安排方
案确定之后,人大常委会党组要按照党委的意见,开展工作,使党
委的意见得到贯彻落实。人民代表大会及其常委会,需要了解由它
选举或决定的干部的情况,可以要求负责推荐干部的党组织或提
名人介绍,也可以通过审议工作报告、视察工作,依法质询等方式
进行,但不要设立考察干部的专门机构,也不宜采取组织、人事部
门那种考察干部的方式去直接考察干部。为便于做好地方党委向

translated_text: On the 12th, the CPC Central Committee issued a notice on "Several Provisions on the Recommendation of Leading Cadres by Local Party Committees to Local State Organs". The notice pointed out that when recommending leading cadres, local party committees should attach importance to the opinions of deputies to the National People's Congress and members of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress. After the personnel arrangement plan is determined, the Party Group of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress should carry out work in accordance with the opinions of the Party Committee to ensure that the opinions of the Party Committee are implemented. The People's Congress and its Standing Committee need to understand the situation of the cadres elected or decided by it. They can ask the party organization or nominator responsible for recommending cadres for introduction, or conduct inquiries in accordance with the law, etc., but they should not set up a special agency for cadre inspection, nor should they adopt the cadre inspection method of the organization and personnel departments to directly inspect cadres. In order to facilitate the work of local party committees recommending leading cadres to local state organs and coordinate the relationship between state organs in personnel appointment and removal work, local party committees can recommend a responsible cadre of the party committee's organization department to concurrently serve as a leader of the government's personnel department. The "Several Provisions" stipulates eleven issues, including the scope of recommendation, the conditions that should be adhered to when recommending leading cadres, the procedures that should be followed in personnel arrangements, and the main tasks of temporary party organizations in elections.

translated_text: On the 14th, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued the "Notice on Organizing Party and Government Officials to Go to the Grassroots". translated_text: On the 1st, Qiao Shi, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the CPC Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, published an article in the second issue of the Party Building magazine in 1990, emphasizing the strengthening of the party's centralization and unity and the building of party style. The article pointed out that the Fifth Plenary Session of the 13th CPC Central Committee unified the thinking of the whole party on the main issues of governance, rectification and deepening reform, and in the future, it will be necessary to unify actions on this basis. Whatever the Party Central Committee and the State Council decide on must be done without compromise; it is never allowed to do "you have policies, I have countermeasures" again, and it is never allowed to happen again that "there are orders but no implementation, and there are prohibitions but no stopping". In this regard, discipline inspection committees at all levels should attach great importance to it, strengthen supervision and inspection of party organizations and party member leading cadres in implementing the central decisions, and adhere to and maintain the seriousness of party discipline. Whoever fails to implement or resists the decisions of the Party Central Committee in disguised form is destroying the party's centralization and unity and violating party discipline. This is absolutely not allowed. The article emphasizes that in order to do a good job in building party style, leading cadres and leading organs must set an example, and leading cadres and leading organs must take the lead in doing everything that is required to be done below. At the same time, every party member must strictly follow the requirements of the party constitution, starting from himself, and must not lower the requirements for himself under any excuse.

translated_text: On the 8th, Wei Jianxing, Minister of the Ministry of Supervision, reported to the National People's Congress representatives who were inspecting in Beijing on the promotion of administrative supervision and the resolute fight against corruption. He said that in recent years, the phenomenon of cadres violating laws and disciplines, mainly manifested in corruption and bribery, abuse of power for personal gain, bureaucratic style, extravagant eating and drinking, and waste, has constituted a serious social and political problem and has attracted the attention of the Party Central Committee and the State Council. Since the Ministry of Supervision resumed its preparation and work in 1987, it has now developed into a supervision system with more than 60,000 people. It has done a lot of work to implement the decisions of the Party Central Committee and the State Council to strengthen the construction of clean government and punish corruption: (1) By the end of 1989, the supervision system had received 216,178 reports, filed 57,941 cases for investigation and punishment, and 54,720 cases were closed; (2) The staff members who violated discipline were dealt with, including 39,591 1,000 people were given administrative sanctions, 4,799 people were transferred to judicial organs for handling, and the country recovered 590 million yuan in property losses; (3) A number of cases of illegal and disciplinary violations by leading cadres were solved. Last year, the supervisory organs received clues about problems of provincial and ministerial cadres involving 155 people, 52 of whom have been investigated and resolved. Among the 40 major cases investigated by the Ministry of Supervision, 22 cases were investigated, involving 13 provincial and ministerial cadres, and 4 have been investigated and dealt with; (4) In 1989, the national supervisory system had set up 1,800 reporting hotlines, and reporting and letter reporting became the main channels for supervisory organs to handle cases; (5) For issues that the masses have great opinions about, such as the prevalence of ordering meetings, the use of public funds for entertaining and giving gifts, and the monopoly of important agricultural production materials such as land, fertilizers, pesticides, and agricultural films, supervisory organs at all levels have conducted supervision and inspection.

The Chairman shall be appointed and removed from office by the State Council after approval by the Central Government. The Vice Chairman of the Executive Council of the China Disabled Persons' Federation and the head of the directly affiliated units that enjoy the treatment of a bureau-level institution shall be managed by the Ministry of Civil Affairs. The candidates for the Chairman and Vice Chairman of the Presidium shall be reported to the Central Organization Department for approval by the Ministry of Civil Affairs before the election; the candidates for the Director and Deputy Director of the Evaluation Council and the Chairman and Vice Chairman of the Presidium of the Special Associations shall be reported to the Party Group of the Ministry of Civil Affairs for approval before the election, and then elected according to the prescribed procedures.

events:
16日——19日 中共中央组织部在北京召开全国省､自治
区、直辖市党委组织部长会议。100%與中文
会议的中心议题是讨论,研究如何继续全面深入地搞好干部
考察工作,切实加强各级领导班子建设;确保党和国家的各级领导
权牢牢掌握在忠于马克思主义的人手里。会议期间,中共中央总书
记江泽民、中共中央政治局常委宋平同与会同志进行了座谈并发
表重要讲话。中共中央组织部部长吕枫作了题为《进一步搞好干部
考察工作,切实加强各级领导班子建设》的报告。中共中央组织部
副部长赵宗作了总结发言。
吕枫的报告的主要内容为:一、继续全面深入地搞好干部考察
工作;二、调整充实各级领导班子,确保各级领导权掌握在忠于马
克思主义的人手里;三、发扬党的优良传统,切实加强领导班子思
想作风建设。
吕枫在谈到干部考察工作时说,全国已抽调3万多名干部,对
近百万县处以上现职领导干部进行考察。经过几个月的努力,这项
工作已取得了明显成绩。中央国家机关已考察局处级干部3万8
千多人,30个省、区、市已考察厅处级干部37万余人。各级党委和
组织人事部门的同志要及时总结经验,继续加紧工作,不能松劲,
更不能走过场。
吕枫指出,维护和巩固党的领导地位,坚持社会主义制度,关
键是建设好各级领导班子。建设好领导班子,首先是选人问题。党
的十一届三中全会以后,我们党制定的干部队伍“四化”方针是正
确的,贯彻执行这一方针取得了很大成绩。在实际工作中也有一些
教训,主要是一度对革命化注意不够,理解不全面。今年,县乡一级
普遍换届选举,有12个省区党委要换届,其它省、区、市和中央、国
家机关各部门领导班子,也有调整的任务。我们在换届和调整领导
班子时,要继续贯彻执行干部队伍“四化”方针,要把革命化放在第
一位,按照德才兼备的标准选人、用人、育人。吕枫指出,当前,大多
数领导班子是好的,是执行党的基本路线的,是努力为人民服务
的。但也有些领导班子在思想作风上存在不少问题,当前需要着重
解决的有五个问题:第一,要努力解决领导干部马克思主义理论素
养不高的问题。第二,要继续解决领导干部中存在的以权谋私、为
政不廉的问题。第三,要认真解决领导干部脱离群众、脱离实际的
问题。第四,要切实解决民主集中制原则贯彻得不好的问题。第五,
要抓紧解决领导班子不团结不协调的问题。
会议期间,中共中央总书记江泽民、中共中央政治局常委宋平
同出席全国省、自治区、直辖市党委组织部长会议的同志举行座
谈。
江泽民在座谈时指出,我们从1989年春夏之交发生的动乱和
反革命暴乱中深刻认识到,一定要使党和国家的各级领导权牢牢
掌握在忠于马克思主义的人手里。政治路线确定以后,干部是一个
决定性的因素。中央提出考察干部,有着重大的意义。通过干部考
察,要加强各级领导班子建设。领导班子建设,不仅要着眼于当前,
还要着眼于21世纪。江泽民指出,这些年,我们按照革命化、年轻
化、知识化、专业化的方针,加强各级领导班子建设,做了大量工
作,需要总结经验。在干部“四化”方针中,革命化应放在首位,这方
面的工作今后要继续加强。我们的接班人必须是坚定地忠于马克
思主义的人。我们要抓紧工作,从保证党的马克思主义路线的连续
性和国家长治久安的高度,在组织上打好基础。江泽民说,各级干
部都要加强马列主义理论的学习,学习不能停留在一般的知识教
育上,要作为改造世界观的武器和实践的指南。要学会运用马列主
义的立场、观点、方法观察和处理问题。特别要学好历史唯物主义
和辩证唯物主义。江泽民指出,现在我们党执政党,各级政权机
构都掌握着一定的权力。我们一定要恢复和加强党与人民群众的
血肉联系。他说,解放初期,党中央、毛主席就提醒党的干部要警
惕,不要被资产阶级的糖衣炮弹所打中,不要脱离群众,现在看来,
这样的提醒仍有重要的现实意义。江泽民说,各级领导班子要加强
廉政建设,特别是各级领导干部要从自身做起。宋平在讲话中强
调,考察干部是为了加强各级领导班子建设。考察干部主要是看他
们是否坚持四项基本原则,坚持改革开放,反对资产阶级自由化;
是否廉洁奉公,是否联系群众,要下决心,下力气把这项工作做好。
宋平指出,干部下基层要带一个任务,就是要帮助搞好党的基层组
织建设和基层政权建设。
translated_text: From the 16th to the 19th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee held a national meeting of the Organization Department Ministers of the Party Committees of provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the Central Government in Beijing. 100% in Chinese. The central topic of the meeting was to discuss and study how to continue to do a good job in the comprehensive and in-depth inspection of cadres, effectively strengthen the construction of leadership teams at all levels, and ensure that the leadership of the Party and the country at all levels is firmly in the hands of people who are loyal to Marxism. During the meeting, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, and Song Ping, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, held a discussion with the comrades present and delivered important speeches. Lv Feng, Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, made a report entitled "Further Improve the Work of Cadre Inspection and Effectively Strengthen the Construction of Leadership Teams at All Levels". Zhao Zong, Deputy Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, made a summary speech. The main contents of Lv Feng's report are: 1. Continue to do a good job in the comprehensive and in-depth inspection of cadres; 2. Adjust and enrich the leadership teams at all levels to ensure that the leadership at all levels is in the hands of people who are loyal to Marxism; 3. Carry forward the fine traditions of the Party and effectively strengthen the ideological and style construction of the leadership team. When talking about the cadre inspection work, Lv Feng said that more than 30,000 cadres have been selected nationwide to inspect nearly one million incumbent leading cadres at the county and department level. After several months of hard work, this work has achieved significant results. The central state organs have inspected more than 38,000 bureau-level cadres, and 30 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities have inspected more than 370,000 department-level cadres. Comrades from party committees and organizational personnel departments at all levels should sum up experience in a timely manner, continue to work hard, and not relax, let alone go through the motions. Lv Feng pointed out that the key to maintaining and consolidating the party's leadership and upholding the socialist system is to build good leadership teams at all levels. To build a good leadership team, the first thing is to select people. After the Third Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee of the Party, our party formulated the "four modernizations" policy for the cadre team, which was correct, and great achievements have been made in implementing this policy. There are also some lessons in actual work, mainly because we once paid insufficient attention to revolutionization and did not fully understand it. This year, the county and township levels will hold general elections. 12 provincial and regional party committees will be replaced, and the leadership teams of other provinces, regions, cities, and central and state organs and departments will also be adjusted. When we replace and adjust the leadership team, we must continue to implement the "four modernizations" policy of the cadre team, put revolutionization first, and select, employ, and educate people according to the standards of both moral integrity and ability. Lu Feng pointed out that at present, most leadership teams are good, implement the party's basic line, and strive to serve the people. However, some leadership teams have many problems in their ideological style. There are five problems that need to be focused on at present: First, we must strive to solve the problem of low Marxist theoretical literacy among leading cadres. Second, we must continue to solve the problem of abuse of power for personal gain and corruption among leading cadres. Third, we must seriously solve the problem of leading cadres being out of touch with the masses and reality. Fourth, we must effectively solve the problem of poor implementation of the principle of democratic centralism. Fifth, we must promptly solve the problem of disunity and disharmony among the leadership team. During the meeting, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, and Song Ping, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, held a discussion with comrades attending the National Conference of Organization Ministers of Provincial, Autonomous Region and Municipal Party Committees. Jiang Zemin pointed out at the discussion that we have deeply realized from the turmoil and counter-revolutionary riots in the spring and summer of 1989 that we must firmly grasp the leadership of the Party and the country at all levels in the hands of people who are loyal to Marxism. After the political line is determined, cadres are a decisive factor. The central government’s proposal to examine cadres is of great significance. Through cadre examinations, we must strengthen the construction of leadership teams at all levels. The construction of leadership teams should not only focus on the present, but also on the 21st century. Jiang Zemin pointed out that in recent years, we have strengthened the construction of leadership teams at all levels in accordance with the principles of revolutionization, rejuvenation, knowledge and specialization, and have done a lot of work, and we need to summarize our experience. In the "four modernizations" policy of cadres, revolutionization should be placed first, and work in this regard should continue to be strengthened in the future. Our successors must be people who are firmly loyal to Marxism. We must work hard to lay a solid organizational foundation from the perspective of ensuring the continuity of the party's Marxist line and the long-term stability of the country. Jiang Zemin said that cadres at all levels must strengthen the study of Marxist-Leninist theory. Learning cannot stop at general knowledge education, but should be used as a weapon to transform the world outlook and a guide for practice. We must learn to use the Marxist-Leninist standpoint, viewpoint, and method to observe and deal with problems. In particular, we must learn historical materialism and dialectical materialism. Jiang Zemin pointed out that our party is now the ruling party, and political institutions at all levels have certain powers. We must restore and strengthen the flesh-and-blood ties between the party and the people. He said that in the early days of liberation, the Party Central Committee and Chairman Mao reminded party cadres to be vigilant and not to be hit by the sugar-coated bullets of the bourgeoisie and not to be separated from the masses. Now it seems that such a reminder still has important practical significance. Jiang Zemin said that leadership teams at all levels must strengthen the construction of clean government, especially leading cadres at all levels must start from themselves. In his speech, Song Ping emphasized that the inspection of cadres is to strengthen the construction of leadership teams at all levels. The main thing to examine cadres is whether they adhere to the Four Cardinal Principles, adhere to reform and opening up, and oppose bourgeois liberalization; whether they are honest and dedicated to their work, and whether they are connected with the masses. We must be determined and work hard to do this work well. Song Ping pointed out that cadres should have one task when they go to the grassroots, which is to help build the grassroots party organizations and grassroots political power.

translated_text: On the 20th, Song Ping, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, attended the "Deng Xiaoping on Party Building" study symposium hosted by the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee and the People's Publishing House and delivered a speech. Song Ping pointed out that Comrade Xiaoping also attached great importance to the connection between the party and the people. At present, our party and country are in a critical period. Whether we can maintain the flesh-and-blood connection between the party and the people, unite all the people to work together and overcome difficulties will directly affect the success or failure of our cause. If our party wants to gain the heartfelt support of the people, it must resolutely overcome corruption within the party and truly win the trust of the people. It is also necessary to establish and improve a strict and effective mass supervision system, combining ideological education with the constraints of systems and disciplines. Song Ping pointed out that Comrade Xiaoping attached great importance to the construction of the cadre team and the leadership team, emphasizing that the leadership of the party and the country at all levels must be in the hands of cadres who are loyal to Marxism and have both moral integrity and ability. 会主义制度就能巩固和发展。要坚持马列主义、毛泽东思想,坚持

权真正掌握在忠于马克思主义、全心全意为人民服务、密切联系群
众的人手中。要抓好基层党组织的建设,使基层党组织和每个党员
发挥先锋队的作用。
translated_text: From the 24th to the 28th, Song Ping, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, inspected work in Sichuan. During the inspection, Song Ping emphasized that stability is the top priority at present. To maintain political, economic and social stability, the key is to build our party well. As long as the party is well built, the socialist system can be consolidated and developed. We must adhere to Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought and adhere to the nature of the vanguard of the working class. The core is to do a good job in the construction of leadership teams at all levels so that the leadership is truly in the hands of those who are loyal to Marxism, serve the people wholeheartedly and keep close contact with the masses. We must do a good job in the construction of grassroots party organizations so that grassroots party organizations and every party member can play the role of vanguards.

events:
25日——28日 中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理姚依林
在陕西进行调查研究。姚依林在调查研究期间指出,10年来,我们
对党的建设,抓得比较少,党的思想建设、组织建设和制度建设等
方面都有所削弱。中央已经开了多次会研究这个问题,我觉得党的
建设非得由党委统一来抓不可,不能把党的建设变成某一个部门
的事。我看只是一两个部门是抓不起来的。这是我们目前一项非
常艰巨的工作。
translated_text: From the 25th to the 28th, Yao Yilin, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, conducted an investigation and research in Shaanxi. During the investigation and research, Yao Yilin pointed out that in the past 10 years, we have paid less attention to party building, and the party's ideological construction, organizational construction and institutional construction have all been weakened. The Central Committee has held many meetings to study this issue. I think party building must be unified by the party committee and cannot be turned into the business of a certain department. I think it cannot be done by just one or two departments. This is a very arduous task for us at present.

events:

李瑞环在山东考察工作。李瑞环在考察期间指出,各级党政干部下
基层,是密切联系群众的重要形式,一定要把这件事真正办好办

translated_text: From March 26 to March 1, Li Ruihuan, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Central Secretariat, inspected work in Shandong. translated_text: On February 26, 1990, the Ministry of Personnel issued the "Interim Provisions on the Establishment of Integrity in Personnel Departments", which put forward specific anti-corruption behavioral norms for the examination and recruitment, assessment, appointment of cadres, salary promotion, determination of organizational establishment and indicators for increasing staff and salaries, cadre deployment, evaluation and appointment of professional and technical positions, and the placement of military officers after retirement.

委、中央党校校长乔石在开学典礼上强调,提高各级党的领导干部

translated_text: On the 1st, the Central Party School of the Communist Party of China held a spring opening ceremony. Qiao Shi, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China and president of the Central Party School, emphasized at the opening ceremony that improving the Marxist theoretical level of party leaders at all levels and their ability to use Marxism to analyze and solve practical problems is necessary for building socialism with Chinese characteristics and for our party's cause to be inherited from generation to generation and continuously move forward. events:
7日 中共中央纪委发出通报,给予安全部副部长孙文芳以
党内严重警告处分。《通报》指出,孙文芳收受李田民的钱物,其

translated_text: On the 7th, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China issued a notice, giving Sun Wenfang, deputy minister of the Ministry of Security, a serious warning within the party. events:
同日 中共中央总书记江泽民在“三八”国际劳动妇女节80
周年纪念大会上发表《全党全社会都要树立马克思主义妇女观》的
讲话。江泽民指出,马克思主义的妇女观,是马克思主义理论体系
的组成部分。它的主要内容有:第一,妇女被压迫是人类历史发展
一定阶段上的社会现象。第二,妇女解放的程度是衡量普遍解放的
天然尺度。第三,参加社会劳动是妇女解放的一个重要先决条件。
第四,妇女解放是一个长期的历史过程。第五,妇女在创造人类文
明、推动社会发展中具有伟大的作用。
translated_text: On the same day, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, delivered a speech entitled "The whole party and society should establish a Marxist view of women" at the 80th anniversary of the International Women's Day on March 8. Jiang Zemin pointed out that the Marxist view of women is an integral part of the Marxist theoretical system. Its main contents are: First, women's oppression is a social phenomenon at a certain stage of human historical development. Second, the degree of women's liberation is a natural measure of universal liberation. Third, participation in social labor is an important prerequisite for women's liberation. Fourth, women's liberation is a long historical process. Fifth, women play a great role in creating human civilization and promoting social development.

events:
9日 《人民日报》报道,党的十一届三中全会以来,全国一大
批优秀妇女干部在改革开放和现代化建设中脱颖而出,走上各级
领导岗位。据统计,1988年底,我国30个省区市的地厅级党政领
导班子中女干部达到1023人,占领导班子成员总数的6.2%。中
国妇女干部管理学院自1979年以来,共培训妇女干部1万余人
次。北京等 27个省区市妇女干校规模不断扩大,现已可同时容纳
4000名学员学习,成为培训女干部的重要基地。
translated_text: On the 9th, the People's Daily reported that since the Third Plenary Session of the 11th CPC Central Committee, a large number of outstanding women cadres have stood out in the reform and opening up and modernization construction and have taken up leadership positions at all levels. According to statistics, at the end of 1988, there were 1,023 female cadres in the party and government leadership teams at the prefecture and department level in 30 provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities in my country, accounting for 6.2% of the total number of leadership team members. Since 1979, the China Women Cadre Management College has trained more than 10,000 women cadres. The scale of women's cadre schools in 27 provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities, including Beijing, has continued to expand and can now accommodate 4,000 students at the same time, becoming an important base for training female cadres.

events:
9日——12日 中国共产党第十三届中央委员会第六次全体
会议在北京召开。全会审议通过了《中共中央关于加强党同人民群
众联系的决定》。出席会议的中央委员166人,中央候补委员 103
人。中央顾问委员会委员、中央纪律检查委员会委员、有关方面负
责同志列席了全会。江泽民、李鹏在全会上作了重要讲话。
《决定》共分九个部分:(一)人民群众是我们党的力量源泉和
胜利之本。能否始终保持和发展同人民群众的血肉联系,直接关系
到党和国家的盛衰兴亡。(二)我们党要密切同人民群众的联系,领
导人民群众胜利前进,首要的问题是必须保证决策和决策的执行
符合人民的利益。(三)各级领导干部必须经常深入基层,深入群
众,扎扎实实工作,把党的路线、方针、政策落到实处。(四)从中央
到地方,各级党委要在深化政治体制改革中,推进社会主义民主
和法制建设,积极疏通和拓宽党同人民群众联系的渠道。(五)坚定
不移地加强廉政建设,继续发扬艰苦奋斗精神,克服党内存在的消
极腐败现象。这是改善党群关系,保证我们事业立于不败之地的战
略措施。(六)对各级领导机关和领导干部必须加强监督。要建立
和完善党内监督与党外监督,自上而下的监督与自下而上的监督
的制度。(七)党的基层组织和广大党员,都要联系群众,宣传群众,
组织群众,充分发挥战斗保垒作用和先锋模范作用。(八)在党内普
遍深入地进行马克思主义群众观点和党的群众路线的再教育。
(九)各级党委要组织广大党员用整风精神学习和贯彻执行这个决
定。
translated_text: From the 9th to the 12th, the Sixth Plenary Session of the 13th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China was held in Beijing. The plenary session reviewed and passed the "Decision of the CPC Central Committee on Strengthening the Party's Ties with the Masses". 166 members of the Central Committee and 103 alternate members of the Central Committee attended the meeting. Members of the Central Advisory Committee, members of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, and responsible comrades from relevant departments attended the plenary session. Jiang Zemin and Li Peng delivered important speeches at the plenary session. The "Decision" is divided into nine parts: (i) The masses are the source of our party's strength and the basis of its victory. Whether we can always maintain and develop the flesh-and-blood ties with the masses is directly related to the rise and fall of the party and the country. (ii) Our party must maintain close ties with the masses and lead the masses to advance victoriously. The first issue is to ensure that decisions and the implementation of decisions are in line with the interests of the people. (iii) Leading cadres at all levels must often go deep into the grassroots and the masses, work down-to-earth, and implement the party's line, principles, and policies. (4) From the central to the local level, Party committees at all levels should promote socialist democracy and legal system construction in deepening political system reform, and actively clear and broaden the channels for the Party to connect with the masses. (5) We must unswervingly strengthen the construction of clean government, continue to carry forward the spirit of hard work, and overcome the negative and corrupt phenomena existing in the Party. This is a strategic measure to improve the relationship between the Party and the masses and ensure that our cause is invincible. (6) Supervision must be strengthened over leading organs and leading cadres at all levels. We must establish and improve the system of internal and external supervision, and supervision from top to bottom and supervision from bottom to top. (7) The grassroots organizations of the Party and the majority of Party members must connect with the masses, publicize the masses, organize the masses, and give full play to their role as a fighting bastion and a vanguard and model. (8) Carry out universal and in-depth re-education on the Marxist mass viewpoint and the Party’s mass line within the Party. (9) Party committees at all levels should organize the majority of Party members to study and implement this decision in the spirit of rectification.

events:
15日 《人民日报》报道,据最高人民检察院负责人介绍,
1989年全国检察机关共受理贪污、贿赂案件1.16763件,已立案侦
查58926件,已决定逮捕贪污、贿赂人犯20794名,向人民法院提
起公诉 19406名。在立案侦查的案件中,有万元以上的贪污、贿赂
大案 13057件;有县处级以上干部875人,内有司局级以上干部
72名。到1989年底,已收到人民法院对9078名人犯了有罪判
决,其中判处死刑的31名。1989年全国检察机关共追缴贪污、贿
赂赃款赃物合4.8286亿元人民币。
translated_text: On the 15th, the People's Daily reported that according to the head of the Supreme People's Procuratorate, in 1989, the procuratorates across the country accepted 116,763 cases of corruption and bribery, 58,926 cases were filed for investigation, 20,794 corruption and bribery offenders were arrested, and 19,406 people were prosecuted in the people's courts. Among the cases filed for investigation, there were 13,057 major corruption and bribery cases with a total value of more than 10,000 yuan; 875 cadres at or above the county and department level, including 72 cadres at or above the department and bureau level. By the end of 1989, the people's courts had received guilty verdicts against 9,078 people, including 31 sentenced to death. In 1989, the procuratorates across the country recovered a total of 482.86 million yuan in corruption and bribery.

员)、曾建徽(中央宣传部副部长)负责。

Among them, 36,699 cases were given or recommended for political disciplinary sanctions, and 40,507 people were given administrative sanctions, including 1,675 county-level and above cadres. More than 5,000 people were transferred to judicial organs, and economic losses of 640 million yuan were recovered. In 1989, the Ministry of Supervision received 205 reports of disciplinary violations by provincial and ministerial-level cadres, involving 155 people, including 35 provincial and ministerial-level officials and 120 deputy provincial and ministerial-level officials. 28 people have been investigated and dealt with. By the deadline of October 31, 1989, the supervisory organs at all levels had received more than 17,600 people who surrendered and confessed their crimes, including more than 2,100 people from central state organs and more than 15,000 people from local organs at all levels. Last year, the national supervisory system had established more than 1,800 reporting agencies and reporting telephones. According to incomplete statistics, from January to December 1989, nearly 842,000 reports were received from the people in letters, visits, and telephone calls, of which 694,000 were within the scope of supervision business.

translated_text: From the 12th to the 16th, the first party building work conference for colleges and universities since the founding of the People's Republic of China was held in Beijing. Li Tieying, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, State Councilor, and Director of the State Education Commission, delivered an important speech. Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, and Li Peng and Song Ping, members of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, held a discussion with some representatives attending the meeting. During the discussion, Jiang Zemin emphasized that party committees at all levels should put school work on the agenda and mobilize the whole party and society to care about school work. Li Peng said that the work of colleges and universities should put the issue of what kind of people to cultivate first. During the discussion, Song Ping pointed out that the party committees of colleges and universities should recognize their important responsibilities and ensure that colleges and universities are always under the leadership of the party and take on the task of cultivating socialist successors. To strengthen the construction of party organizations in colleges and universities, it is necessary to do a good job in the construction of party committees. Leaders in charge of colleges and universities in provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the central government, party committee secretaries of some colleges and universities, leaders of relevant ministries and commissions of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, and comrades in charge of education attended the symposium. Lv Feng, Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, spoke at the closing meeting. In his speech, Lv Feng pointed out that the construction of party branches in colleges and universities is a weak link. To strengthen the construction of branches and improve the combat effectiveness of branches, it is very important to select those outstanding party members as branch secretaries. The branch should strengthen the education, management and supervision of party members, assign tasks to party members to do mass work, and establish a responsibility system. Lv Feng said that under the premise of adhering to the collective leadership of the party committee, the important role of the principal should be fully played, and the enthusiasm of organizations at all levels and all aspects of the school should be fully utilized. Lv Feng required that the college work committee, the party committee organization department, the propaganda department and the education department should clarify their responsibilities, appropriately divide the work, and work closely together under the unified leadership of the provincial, district and municipal party committees to jointly do a good job in the party construction work in colleges and universities.

events: 1990年4月16日,全国人事厅局长会在北京友谊宾馆开幕。赵东宛部长作了《搞好人事工作治理整顿,深化干部人事制度改革》的报告。指出,建立和推行公务员制度的工作要上新的台阶。1990年要努力完成条例的修改和有关单项法规的拟定工作;进一步搞好公务员制度的综合试点,探索实施的经验;围绕廉政建设,在面上试行一些现实急需､条件成熟的单项法规;继续做好培训工作。
translated_text: On April 16, 1990, the National Personnel Department Directors' Meeting opened at the Beijing Friendship Hotel. Minister Zhao Dongwan delivered a report entitled "Do a good job in the governance and rectification of personnel work and deepen the reform of the cadre and personnel system." He pointed out that the work of establishing and promoting the civil service system should be taken to a new level. In 1990, efforts should be made to complete the revision of the regulations and the drafting of relevant individual regulations; further improve the comprehensive pilot of the civil service system and explore the experience of implementation; focus on the construction of clean government, and try out some individual regulations that are urgently needed and mature in reality; and continue to do a good job in training.

events: 1990年4月16日,《求是》杂志刊出赵东宛部长重要文章《建立有中国特色社会主义的国家公务员制度》。文章对于我国公务员制度的形成和发展、公务员制度的指导思想和特点、建立和推行公务员制度的意义及总体思路等重要问题进行了论述。指出,我国的公务员制度,是在邓小平同志关于改革干部人事制度的思想指导下制定的,它继承和发扬了党和国家干部人事工作的优良传统,总结吸收了干部人事制度改革的经验,借鉴了外国一些科学合理的做法,是一套比较科学的政府机关人事管理制度。建立和推行公务员制度,对于加强廉政建设,对于提高政府工作人员素质和政府机关工作效率,对于维护和发展社会安定团结､巩固人民民主专政,都有着积极的､现实的意义。
translated_text: On April 16, 1990, the magazine Qiushi published an important article by Minister Zhao Dongwan entitled "Establishing a Socialist National Civil Service System with Chinese Characteristics". The article discussed important issues such as the formation and development of my country's civil service system, the guiding ideology and characteristics of the civil service system, the significance of establishing and promoting the civil service system, and the overall thinking. It pointed out that my country's civil service system was formulated under the guidance of Comrade Deng Xiaoping's thoughts on reforming the cadre and personnel system. It inherited and carried forward the fine traditions of the party and state cadre and personnel work, summarized and absorbed the experience of cadre and personnel system reform, and drew on some scientific and reasonable practices of foreign countries. It is a relatively scientific personnel management system for government agencies. The establishment and implementation of the civil service system has positive and practical significance for strengthening the construction of clean government, improving the quality of government workers and the work efficiency of government agencies, maintaining and developing social stability and unity, and consolidating the people's democratic dictatorship.

events:
26日 新华社报道,据中共中央组织部统计:1989年全国共
发展党员113.5万名,另有951.9万名积极分子向党组织提出入
党申请,并以实际行动争取入党。在去年发展的新党员中,各条战
线的先进模范人物占37.6%;生产、科研、教学、服务等一线的优
秀工人、农牧渔民、知识分子占54%。这些新党员中,年龄在35岁
以下的占 2/3。据统计,截止1989年底,全国有951.9万人向党组
织提出了入党申请,与1989年6月底的统计数字相比,增加232
万人。申请入党的人员中,25岁以下的青年有279万人;在各个行
业第一线的有533万人。
translated_text: On the 26th, Xinhua News Agency reported that according to statistics from the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China: In 1989, a total of 1.135 million party members were recruited nationwide, and another 9.519 million activists applied to the party organization to join the party and took practical actions to strive to join the party. Among the new party members recruited last year, advanced model figures in various fronts accounted for 37.6%; outstanding workers, farmers, herdsmen, fishermen, and intellectuals in production, scientific research, teaching, and service accounted for 54%. Among these new party members, those under the age of 35 accounted for 2/3. According to statistics, by the end of 1989, 9.519 million people nationwide had applied to the party organization to join the party, an increase of 2.32 million compared with the statistics at the end of June 1989. Among those who applied to join the party, there were 2.79 million young people under the age of 25; and 5.33 million were in the front line of various industries.

events:
9日 中共中央纪律检查委员会印发《中共中央纪委贯彻<中
共中央关于加强党同人民群众联系的决定>的实施意见》。《实施意
见》提出要从六个方面落实加强党同人民群众的联系:(一)用整风
精神深入学习和贯彻执行《决定》。(二)按照《决定》的要求,集中力
量继续查处一批大案要案。(三)以《决定》为武器,大力加强党风建
设和廉政建设。(四)发挥纪检机关的职能作用,加强对党的路线、
方针、政策和决议贯彻执行情况的监督检查。(五)抓紧制定《中国
共产党党内监督条例》,加强纪检工作的制度建设。(六)进一步改
进工作作风和工作方法,提高工作水平。
translated_text: On the 9th, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China issued the "Implementation Opinions of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China on Implementing the Decision of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Strengthening the Ties between the Party and the People". The "Implementation Opinions" proposed to implement the strengthening of the ties between the Party and the people from six aspects: (1) Deeply study and implement the "Decision" in the spirit of rectification. (2) In accordance with the requirements of the "Decision", concentrate on continuing to investigate and deal with a number of major cases. (3) Use the "Decision" as a weapon to vigorously strengthen the construction of party style and clean government. (4) Give full play to the functions of the discipline inspection organs and strengthen the supervision and inspection of the implementation of the party's line, principles, policies and resolutions. (5) Speed up the formulation of the "Regulations on Intra-Party Supervision of the Communist Party of China" and strengthen the institutional construction of discipline inspection work. (6) Further improve the work style and methods and improve the level of work.

events:
10日 中共中央组织部下发《关于修订<中共中央管理的干
部职务名称表>的通知》。《通知》对中央管理干部的范围和任免报
批程序,作了调整和规定。《通知》要求各级党委组织部门,要在党
委领导下,承担起对干部人事工作宏观管理的任务,履行指导、检
查、综合、协调的职责。要严格对干部职级待遇和领导干部职数的
管理,任何地区和部门,都不得突破现有规定,自行提高干部的职
级和待遇,不得擅自增加领导干部职数,也不得随意自设新名称的
领导职务。
translated_text: On the 10th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on the Revision of the List of Titles of Cadres Managed by the CPC Central Committee". The "Notice" adjusted and stipulated the scope of cadres managed by the Central Committee and the procedures for the approval of appointments and removals. The "Notice" requires the organization departments of the Party committees at all levels to assume the task of macro-management of cadre personnel work under the leadership of the Party committees, and perform the duties of guidance, inspection, integration and coordination. The management of cadre ranks and treatment and the number of leading cadres must be strictly enforced. No region or department may break through the existing regulations, increase the ranks and treatment of cadres on their own, increase the number of leading cadres without authorization, or arbitrarily set up new leadership positions.

events:
14日 中共中央组织部副部长刘泽彭就贯彻江泽民总书记
在“五四”报告会上的讲话答记者问。刘泽彭指出,党的十一届三中
全会以来,我国知识分子工作进入了一个新的时期。经过全党的艰
苦努力,知识分子工作取得了显著成绩。首先,我们本着实事求
是的精神,坚决纠正了知识分子工作中的“左”的错误,对历史上造
成的知识分子的冤假错案,进行了彻底平反,恢复名誉,安排了适
当的工作。其次,我们党提出了“尊重知识、尊重人才”的正确方针,
重申了知识分子是工人阶级一部分的科学论断,强调知识分子同
工人、农民一样,是社会主义事业的依靠力量,并载入我国宪法。第
三,积极发展优秀知识分子入党。据统计,1979年至1989年全国
有275万优秀知识分子加入中国共产党。在各类专业技术人员中,
党员人数已近三分之一。第四,各级党委和政府按照干部“四化”方
针和德才兼备的原则,培养和选拔了一大批优秀知识分子进入各
级领导岗位。到目前,全国已有100多万专业技术干部担任各级党
政领导职务。第五,党和政府用极大的努力改善知识分子的工作条
件和提高他们的生活待遇。刘泽彭指出,知识分子工作虽然取得很
大成绩,但也存在一些亟待解决的问题。当前,应抓好以下几项工
作:一、各级党组织要增强做好知识分子工作的责任感和紧迫感,
把它作为一项重要任务来抓。二、要采取有力措施加强知识分子的
思想政治工作。三、党委组织部门要直接管理、掌握一批优秀专家、
拔尖人才。四、各级党组织要为知识分子同社会实践相结合,同工
农相结合创造条件,提供方便。五、继续为知识分子创造良好的工
作和生活条件。
translated_text: On the 14th, Liu Zepeng, Deputy Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, answered questions from reporters on the implementation of General Secretary Jiang Zemin’s speech at the May 4th Report Conference. Liu Zepeng pointed out that since the Third Plenary Session of the 11th CPC Central Committee, the work of intellectuals in my country has entered a new period. After the hard work of the whole party, the work of intellectuals has achieved remarkable results. First, in the spirit of seeking truth from facts, we resolutely corrected the "left" mistakes in the work of intellectuals, thoroughly vindicated the unjust, false and wrong cases of intellectuals in history, restored their reputations and arranged appropriate work. Secondly, our party put forward the correct policy of "respecting knowledge and talents", reaffirmed the scientific conclusion that intellectuals are part of the working class, emphasized that intellectuals, like workers and peasants, are the relying force of the socialist cause, and included it in the Constitution of my country. Third, actively develop outstanding intellectuals to join the party. According to statistics, from 1979 to 1989, 2.75 million outstanding intellectuals joined the Communist Party of China. Among all kinds of professional and technical personnel, the number of party members has reached nearly one-third. Fourth, the Party committees and governments at all levels have trained and selected a large number of outstanding intellectuals to enter leadership positions at all levels in accordance with the "four modernizations" policy for cadres and the principle of both moral integrity and ability. So far, more than 1 million professional and technical cadres have served as party and government leaders at all levels across the country. Fifth, the Party and the government have made great efforts to improve the working conditions of intellectuals and improve their living conditions. Liu Zepeng pointed out that although great achievements have been made in the work of intellectuals, there are also some problems that need to be solved urgently. At present, the following tasks should be done well: First, Party organizations at all levels should strengthen the sense of responsibility and urgency in doing a good job in the work of intellectuals and take it as an important task. Second, effective measures should be taken to strengthen the ideological and political work of intellectuals. Third, the organization departments of the Party committees should directly manage and master a group of outstanding experts and top talents. Fourth, Party organizations at all levels should create conditions and provide convenience for intellectuals to combine with social practice and with workers and farmers. Fifth, continue to create good working and living conditions for intellectuals.
