events: 1990年5月22日至26日,人事部在哈尔滨召开修改《国家公务员暂行条例》讨论会。全国人大常委会法工委、内务司法委员会,最高人民检察院,国务院法制局,14个省市区人事厅局,国务院10个部委局,中央组织部和人事部的实际工作者及专家学者参加了会议。讨论会一致认为条例第16稿的內容和结构已基本成熟。
translated_text: From May 22 to 26, 1990, the Ministry of Personnel held a discussion meeting in Harbin to revise the Interim Regulations on National Civil Servants. Practical workers and experts and scholars from the Legislative Affairs Commission and the Internal and Judicial Committee of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Legislative Affairs Bureau of the State Council, 14 provincial, municipal and district personnel departments, 10 ministries and commissions of the State Council, and the Central Organization Department and the Ministry of Personnel attended the meeting. The discussion meeting unanimously agreed that the content and structure of the 16th draft of the regulations were basically mature.

translated_text: On the 24th, the CPC Central Committee agreed to appoint Yang Zhe as deputy director of the State Council Research Office; Zhang Wenyue as deputy minister of the Ministry of Geology and Mineral Resources, and Xia Guozhi was dismissed from the post of deputy minister of the Ministry of Geology and Mineral Resources; Sun Qi concurrently served as secretary of the Liaoning Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection, and Gao Zi was dismissed from the post of secretary of the Liaoning Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection. events:
25日 中共中央发出通知,印发《关于县以上党和国家机关
党员领导干部民主生活会的若干规定》。《规定》指出:健全和坚持
党员领导干部民主生活会制度,对于实现党的正确领导,保证党的
路线、方针、政策和决议的正确贯彻执行,具有重要作用。要通过党
员领导干部民主生活会,加强党内监督和领导班子的思想、作风
建设,提高依靠自身力量解决问题和矛盾的能力。《规定》对民主生
活会的基本内容,召开时间、方式等有关问题作了具体规定。
translated_text: On the 25th, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued a notice and issued the "Several Regulations on Democratic Life Meetings of Party Members and Leading Cadres in Party and State Organs at or above the County Level". The "Regulations" pointed out that improving and adhering to the system of democratic life meetings for party members and leading cadres plays an important role in realizing the correct leadership of the party and ensuring the correct implementation of the party's line, principles, policies and resolutions. Through democratic life meetings of party members and leading cadres, we must strengthen internal party supervision and the ideological and style construction of the leadership team, and improve the ability to rely on their own strength to solve problems and contradictions. The "Regulations" made specific provisions on the basic content of democratic life meetings, the time and method of convening, and other related issues.

events:
同日 中共中央政治局常委宋平在中央党校第八期省部级
干部读书班学员进行座谈时指出,党要搞好自身建设,首先要配备
好党的各级领导干部,使领导权牢牢掌握在忠于马克思主义的人
手里。要重视干部的培训,除了抓好高中级干部的培训外,还要抓
好县级干部的培训,使他们从年轻的时候就接受系统的马克思主
义教育,树立正确的世界观、人生观。这对干部的成长和今后的工
作大有好处。宋平说,把党建设好,要注意建立健全规章制度,把党
员特别是党的领导干部置于组织和群众的监督之下。要坚持民主
集中制原则,认真开展批评与自我批评。只要上下共同努力,党的
优良传统就一定能恢复和发扬,社会主义事业就一定能兴旺发达。
参加这一期省部级干部读书班的共41人,来自25个省、区、市以
及部队和中央国家机关。
translated_text: On the same day, Song Ping, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, pointed out in a discussion with the students of the 8th Provincial and Ministerial Cadre Reading Class of the Central Party School that if the Party wants to do a good job in its own construction, it must first equip the Party's leading cadres at all levels so that the leadership is firmly in the hands of those who are loyal to Marxism. It is necessary to attach importance to the training of cadres. In addition to the training of high- and middle-level cadres, it is also necessary to do a good job in the training of county-level cadres so that they can receive systematic Marxist education from a young age and establish a correct world outlook and outlook on life. This is of great benefit to the growth of cadres and their future work. Song Ping said that to build the Party well, it is necessary to pay attention to the establishment and improvement of rules and regulations, and to place Party members, especially Party leading cadres, under the supervision of the organization and the masses. It is necessary to adhere to the principle of democratic centralism and earnestly carry out criticism and self-criticism. As long as the top and the bottom work together, the Party's fine traditions will surely be restored and carried forward, and the socialist cause will surely prosper. A total of 41 people from 25 provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities, as well as the military and central state organs participated in this provincial and ministerial cadre reading class.

events:

translated_text: On the 30th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the Party Committee of the Ministry of Public Security jointly issued the "Notice on Strengthening the Management of Public Security Organs' Leading Cadres". The "Notice" stipulates and explains the training and selection, management system, and inspection and appointment procedures of public security organ leading cadres.

events: 7日 经中共中央批准,中央纪律检查委员会发出《关于铁道部原副部长罗云光等党员领导干部贪污受贿被开除党籍的通报》。《通报》要求全党吸取教训,按照党的十三届六中全会要求,坚持不懈地搞好党风建设和廉政建设,密切党群关系,把反腐败斗争进行到底,保证治理整顿和深化改革的顺利进行。
translated_text: On the 7th, with the approval of the CPC Central Committee, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection issued a "Notice on the Expulsion of Party Members and Leading Cadres, including Luo Yunguang, Former Deputy Minister of the Ministry of Railways, from the Party for Corruption and Bribery". The "Notice" requires the whole party to learn lessons, follow the requirements of the Sixth Plenary Session of the 13th CPC Central Committee, unremittingly improve the Party's work style and clean government, strengthen the relationship between the Party and the masses, carry out the anti-corruption struggle to the end, and ensure the smooth progress of governance, rectification and deepening reform.

translated_text: On the same day, the CPC Central Committee approved the transfer of Wen Jing to the position of deputy director of the State Ethnic Affairs Commission, dismissing him from his positions as member of the Standing Committee and member of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Party Committee and vice chairman of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region People's Government, and dismissing Bao Yushan and Zhang Zhu from their positions as deputy directors of the State Ethnic Affairs Commission; Wu Jichuan was transferred to the position of member, standing committee member and deputy secretary of the Henan Provincial Party Committee, and dismissed from his position as deputy minister of the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications; Yao Minxue was dismissed from his positions as deputy secretary, standing committee member and member of the Henan Provincial Party Committee.

events:
9日 新华社报道,中共中央党校重视少数民族干部的培训,
自1977年以来,先后有2200多名来自全国各少数民族的高中级
领导干部在中央党校学习马列主义基本理论、中共党史和党的建
设的基本理论,以及党政领导干部必备的业务知识等课程,大大提
高了政治思想水平和领导水平,在各自的工作岗位上,为维护党的
领导,坚持社会主义道路,维护多民族的社会主义祖国的安定团
结,发挥了重要作用。
translated_text: On the 9th, Xinhua News Agency reported that the Central Party School of the Communist Party of China attaches great importance to the training of ethnic minority cadres. Since 1977, more than 2,200 high- and middle-level leading cadres from ethnic minorities across the country have studied the basic theories of Marxism-Leninism, the history of the Communist Party of China and the basic theories of party building, as well as the necessary professional knowledge for party and government leading cadres at the Central Party School, which greatly improved their political and ideological levels and leadership levels. In their respective jobs, they have played an important role in maintaining the leadership of the party, adhering to the socialist path, and maintaining the stability and unity of the multi-ethnic socialist motherland.

events:

的通知》。《通知》要求参考《干部考察工作总结提纲》,认真总结近
年来在领导班子建设和选拔、培养干部工作方面的经验教训,并
提出加强和改进的建议与打算。
translated_text: On the 10th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued a "Notice on Summarizing the Cadre Inspection Work". The "Notice" requires reference to the "Cadre Inspection Work Summary Outline", conscientiously summarizing the experience and lessons learned in recent years in the construction of leadership teams and the selection and training of cadres, and proposing suggestions and plans for strengthening and improving.

events:
13日 中共中央总书记江泽民同出席全国省、自治区、直辖
市党校校长会议的同志座谈。
江泽民指出,党校特别是中央和各省、区、市党校要通过培训,
引导和帮助干部从以下五个方面努力提高自己的素质:第一,具有
履行职责所需要的马克思主义理论功底,懂得中国国情,注意理论
联系实际,努力坚持马列主义、毛泽东思想;第二,坚定地站稳无产
阶级立场,正确贯彻执行党的基本路线,自觉坚持四项基本原则和
改革开放,反对资产阶级自由化,经得起执政、改革开放以及反“和
平演变”的考验,在错综复杂的国际国内形势下不迷失方向;第三,
坚定不移地沿着建设有中国特色的社会主义道路前进,有开创新
局面的信心和决心,有为实现党中央提出的战略目标而百折不挠
地奋斗的勇气和能力;第四,全心全意为人民服务,密切联系群众,
走群众路线,发扬党的艰苦奋斗的优良传统;第五,贯彻民主集中
制原则,胸襟开阔,有全局观念,善于团结同志,特别是能够团结有
不同意见的同志一道工作,有领导和组织才能。
江泽民在座谈中还指出,必须面向现代化,面向世界,面向未
来,从党和国家的命运,从和平演变与反和平演变的战略高度,充
分认识干部的理论学习和理论武装的重要,充分认识坚持和发展
马克思主义的重要,进一步发挥党校作为培训党的领导干部,组织
和培养马克思主义理论队伍,学习、研究、坚持和发展马列主义、毛
泽东思想的重要阵地的作用,努力把各级党校办成对干部进行党
性锻炼的熔炉。
translated_text: On the 13th, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, held a discussion with comrades attending the National Conference of Party School Principals of Provinces, Autonomous Regions and Municipalities. Jiang Zemin pointed out that Party schools, especially those of the Central Committee and the provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities, should guide and help cadres to improve their quality through training in the following five aspects: first, they should have the theoretical knowledge of Marxism required to perform their duties, understand China's national conditions, pay attention to the connection between theory and practice, and strive to adhere to Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought; second, they should firmly stand firm on the proletarian standpoint, correctly implement the Party's basic line, consciously adhere to the Four Cardinal Principles and reform and opening up, oppose bourgeois liberalization, withstand the test of governing, reform and opening up, and opposing "peaceful evolution", and be able to stand firm in the wrong Do not lose your way in the complex international and domestic situation; third, unswervingly advance along the road of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, have the confidence and determination to create a new situation, and have the courage and ability to persevere in striving to achieve the strategic goals set by the Party Central Committee; fourth, serve the people wholeheartedly, keep close contact with the masses, follow the mass line, and carry forward the party's fine tradition of arduous struggle; fifth, implement the principle of democratic centralism, be open-minded, have a holistic concept, be good at uniting comrades, especially comrades with different opinions, and have leadership and organizational skills. Jiang Zemin also pointed out in the symposium that we must face modernization, the world, and the future, and fully recognize the importance of theoretical learning and theoretical arming of cadres from the strategic height of the destiny of the party and the country and peaceful evolution and anti-peaceful evolution, fully recognize the importance of upholding and developing Marxism, and further play the role of party schools as an important position for training party leaders, organizing and cultivating Marxist theoretical teams, and studying, studying, upholding and developing Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought, and strive to make party schools at all levels a melting pot for party spirit training for cadres.

会常务委员会委员、第七届全国人民代表大会外事委员会委员的职务。

On June 28, the Standing Committee of the Seventh National People's Congress issued a notice to remove Zhao Fusan from his posts as a member of the Standing Committee of the Seventh National People's Congress and a member of the Foreign Affairs Committee of the Seventh National People's Congress.

events:
19日——27日 中共中央总书记江泽民在广东考察工作。江
泽民在考察时指出:我们要在保持政治和社会稳定的同时,集中精
力把经济搞上去,关键的问题在于必须把我们的党建设好。在沿海
开放地区和经济特区,切实抓好党的建设和思想政治工作,加强社
会主义精神文明建设,具有特别重要的意义。他指出,在对外开放
的形势下,我们一方面要引进、吸收国外先进的科学技术、管理经
验和优秀文化;另一方面,要坚持社会主义方向,抵制资本主义腐
朽思想的侵蚀。因此,开放地区和特区的党组织,一定要认真抓好
自身建设,特别要把党的基层组织建设好,把领导班子建设好。各
级党组织要结合实际,有针对性地认真做好广大党员、干部和群众
的思想政治工作,使共产党员和广大干部充分发挥建设社会主义
的积极性,抵制资产阶级腐朽思想的侵蚀,经得起执政和改革开放
的考验。
translated_text: From the 19th to the 27th, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, inspected work in Guangdong. During the inspection, Jiang Zemin pointed out that we must concentrate on developing the economy while maintaining political and social stability. The key issue is that we must build our party well. In the coastal open areas and special economic zones, it is of special significance to do a good job in party building and ideological and political work and strengthen the construction of socialist spiritual civilization. He pointed out that under the situation of opening up to the outside world, on the one hand, we must introduce and absorb foreign advanced science and technology, management experience and excellent culture; on the other hand, we must adhere to the socialist direction and resist the erosion of capitalist decadent ideas. Therefore, the party organizations in open areas and special zones must earnestly do a good job in their own construction, especially the construction of the party's grassroots organizations and the construction of the leadership team. Party organizations at all levels should combine reality and do a good job in ideological and political work for the majority of party members, cadres and the masses in a targeted manner, so that the Communist Party members and the majority of cadres can give full play to their enthusiasm for building socialism, resist the erosion of bourgeois decadent ideas, and withstand the test of governing and reform and opening up.

events:
22日——27日 中共中央政治局常委乔石在贵州考察工作。
乔石在考察时强调,中央作出加强党同人民群众联系的决定后,各
地干部下基层的情况是好的,群众反映也是好的。各级党委要关心
下去的干部。干部下基层,不要造声势、搞形式,一阵风,要踏踏实
实地为群众办实事,帮助基层解决实际问题,并长期坚持下去。
乔石在谈到党的建设和廉政建设问题时强调,要坚持常抓不
懈。这也是关系到稳定的一个重要问题。他说,既要认真查处严重
违法乱纪的,也要肯定好的,宣传好的。廉政建设要注意抓典型,正
面的､反面的都要抓,但要注意实事求是。
translated_text:
From the 22nd to the 27th, Qiao Shi, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, inspected work in Guizhou.
During the inspection, Qiao Shi emphasized that after the Central Committee made the decision to strengthen the connection between the Party and the people, the situation of cadres going to the grassroots in various places was good, and the people's response was also good. Party committees at all levels should care about the cadres who go down to the grassroots. When cadres go to the grassroots, they should not make a fuss, engage in formalities, or just go for a while. They should do practical things for the masses, help the grassroots solve practical problems, and persist in doing so for a long time.
When talking about the issues of party building and clean government construction, Qiao Shi emphasized that we must persist in doing so. This is also an important issue related to stability. He said that we must seriously investigate and punish those who seriously violate laws and disciplines, and we must also affirm and publicize the good. In the construction of clean government, we must pay attention to typical cases, both positive and negative, but we must pay attention to seeking truth from facts.

On the 25th, the 7th issue of Party Building magazine published an article by the head of the Organization Department of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee on the status of the party members in my country. Our party currently has 49 million members. Generally speaking, this team is good. Communist Party members constitute the main body of the heroes and models on all fronts: On the eve of the 40th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China, among the 2,790 people awarded the title of National Model Workers and Advanced Workers by the State Council, 90.6% were party members; among the 5,365 "May 1st" Labor Medal winners awarded by the All-China Federation of Trade Unions, 80.5% were party members; among the 2,219 young and middle-aged experts with outstanding contributions awarded by the State Science and Technology Commission, 63.4% were party members; and among the 19,769 outstanding teachers (teaching Among the 511 national agricultural model workers in 1990, 83.2% were Party members; among the 100 outstanding farmer entrepreneurs in the country, 87% were Party members, and the 10 best farmer entrepreneurs were all Communist Party members; since 1979, among the soldiers awarded honorary titles by the Central Military Commission and various headquarters, various military services, and major military regions, 92.7% were Party members, and all those awarded honorary titles by the Central Military Commission were Party members.

工作暂行条例》。《暂行条例》规定,党员人数在五百名以上或所辖

translated_text: On the 27th, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued a notice to print and distribute the "Interim Regulations on the Election of the Grassroots Organizations of the Communist Party of China". When an election is held, if the number of people with voting rights present exceeds four-fifths of the number of people who should be present, the meeting is valid.

events:

和中央国家机关优秀共产党员、优秀党务工作者和先进基层党组

今不过七十几年的历史,中间出现一些曲折是不奇怪的,也是符合

translated_text: On the 30th, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, met with representatives attending the commendation conference for outstanding Communist Party members, outstanding party workers and advanced grassroots party organizations in the CPC Central Committee and central state organs and delivered a speech. From the long river of historical development, the emergence of socialist countries has only been a history of more than 70 years. Socialist China will always stand tall among the nations of the world. events:

会,座谈如何进一步加强党的建设,纪念建党69周年。中共中央政
治局常委宋平主持座谈会。
宋平在座谈会上说,我们的党,是有4900多万党员的大党,我
们党的建设搞得好不好,直接关系着国家的兴衰,社会主义建设事
业的成败。现在全党抓党建的大气候已初步形成,并取得了成效。
宋平希望大家为进一步搞好党的建设献计献策,把我们党建设得
更加坚强,更有战斗力,以更加优异的成绩迎接明年建党70周年。
中共中央组织部部长吕枫在座谈会上说,近一年来,加强党的
建设,主要抓了五件事:一是以马克思主义基本理论为指导,大力
澄清在党的思想理论建设上资产阶级自由化搞乱了的理论是
非,纠正了那些削弱、淡化党的领导的错误主张和做法。二是对近
百万县(处)以上干部进行了全面考察。三是按照从严治党的方针,
进行了民主评议党员的工作。四是惩治腐败,加强廉政建设,密切
党和人民群众的联系。五是总结前几年组织制度、干部制度改革的

理。在谈到怎样进一步加强党的建设时,吕枫指出,首先是领导权
问题,使领导权真正掌握在忠于马克思主义的人手中。第二是党员
队伍建设问题。第三是加强基层党组织的建设。
translated_text: On the same day, some old comrades and some outstanding party workers held a symposium in Beijing to discuss how to further strengthen party building and commemorate the 69th anniversary of the founding of the party. Song Ping, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, presided over the symposium. Song Ping said at the symposium that our party is a large party with more than 49 million members. Whether our party building is well done is directly related to the rise and fall of the country and the success or failure of the socialist construction cause. Now the general climate of party building has been initially formed and has achieved results. Song Ping hopes that everyone will contribute ideas and suggestions to further improve party building, build our party stronger and more combative, and welcome the 70th anniversary of the founding of the party next year with more outstanding achievements. Lv Feng, Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, said at the symposium that in the past year, five things have been focused on strengthening party building: First, guided by the basic theory of Marxism, vigorously clarify the theoretical right and wrong of the party's ideological and theoretical construction that has been messed up by bourgeois liberalization, and correct those wrong propositions and practices that weaken and dilute the party's leadership. Second, a comprehensive inspection was conducted on nearly one million county (department) and above cadres. Third, in accordance with the principle of strict party governance, democratic appraisal of party members was carried out. Fourth, corruption was punished, clean governance was strengthened, and the ties between the party and the people were strengthened. Fifth, the experience of the reform of the organizational system and cadre system in the past few years was summarized, and the "four modernizations" policy of the cadre team was implemented more comprehensively and correctly, the system of local party committees recommending cadres to state organs was improved, the differential election was improved, the leadership system of enterprises and universities was further clarified, cadre exchanges were carried out, and macro-management of cadre work was strengthened. When talking about how to further strengthen party building, Lu Feng pointed out that the first issue is the issue of leadership, so that leadership is truly in the hands of people who are loyal to Marxism. The second is the issue of party member team building. The third is to strengthen the construction of grassroots party organizations.

events:

29日在党建理论研究班上的讲话,题目是《为把党建设成更加坚
强的工人阶级先锋队而斗争》。讲话分八个部分:第一,充分认识搞

队性质;第三,坚持和加强党的执政地位和领导作用;第四,切实把
思想建设放在党的建设的首位;第五,健全民主集中制,增强党的
团结和统一;第六,始终保持党同人民群众的血肉联系;第七,确保

translated_text: On the 1st, the People's Daily published a speech by Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, at a party building theory study class on December 29, 1989, entitled "Struggle to Build the Party into a Stronger Vanguard of the Working Class". The speech is divided into eight parts: First, fully understand the importance and urgency of building the party well; second, we must uphold the party's nature as the vanguard of the working class; third, uphold and strengthen the party's ruling status and leadership role; fourth, truly put ideological construction at the top of party building; fifth, improve democratic centralism and enhance the party's unity and solidarity; sixth, always maintain the flesh-and-blood ties between the party and the people; seventh, ensure that the leadership cores at all levels are composed of people loyal to Marxism; eighth, attach great importance to the study, research and dissemination of Marxist party building theory.

events:

题目是《牢记党的根本宗旨》。社论指出:共产党除了工人阶级和人
民群众的利益,没有自己特殊的利益。密切党与人民群众的血肉联
系,全心全意地为人民服务,是我们党一切活动的根本目的,是党
永远立于不败之地的可靠保证。所谓党性,最根本的就是为人民服
务的自觉性。共产党员要增强自己的党性,就要提高全心全意为人
民服务的自觉性。社论说,每一个共产党员,都应该用自己的行动
实践党的全心全意为人民服务的宗旨,给人们做出榜样。只要广大
共产党员、尤其是各级干部率先垂范,同人民群众紧紧地联系在一
起,任何困难和压力也压不倒我们,而只能被我们压倒。
translated_text: On the same day, the People's Daily published an editorial to commemorate the 69th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China, entitled "Bear in mind the fundamental purpose of the Party". The editorial pointed out: The Communist Party has no special interests other than the interests of the working class and the people. To strengthen the flesh-and-blood ties between the Party and the masses and to serve the people wholeheartedly is the fundamental purpose of all our Party's activities and a reliable guarantee for the Party's eternal invincibility. The so-called Party spirit is the most fundamental consciousness of serving the people. To enhance their Party spirit, Communist Party members must improve their consciousness of serving the people wholeheartedly. The editorial said that every Communist Party member should practice the Party's purpose of serving the people wholeheartedly with his or her own actions and set an example for people. As long as the majority of Communist Party members, especially cadres at all levels, take the lead and closely connect with the masses, no difficulties or pressures can overwhelm us, but can only be overwhelmed by us.

translated_text: On the 7th, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China made the "Decision on Implementing the Exchange System for Leading Cadres of Party and State Organs". The "Decision" pointed out that the planned exchange of leading cadres is a fine tradition of our party and an important measure to train and improve cadres' quality. Years of practice have proved that the implementation of this system is conducive to leading cadres to undergo training in a broader scope, broaden their horizons, enrich their experience, increase their talents, and improve their leadership level; it is conducive to leading cadres to work boldly in a new environment, cheer up, change their style, conduct in-depth investigations and research, and maintain close contact with the masses. At the same time, it is also convenient to make reasonable adjustments to the structure of the leadership team and enhance the overall function of the leadership team. In order to institutionalize and regularize the exchange of leading cadres, the Central Committee decided to implement the exchange system for leading cadres of party and state organs at all levels, starting from the ministries and commissions of the central party and state organs, provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the central government.

events:

查处的党组织和党员党纪处分的规定(试行)》的通知。为严肃党的

节轻重和造成的后果,给予必要的党纪处分。《规定》分8章23条。
translated_text: On the 11th, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China issued a notice on the "Regulations on Party Discipline Punishment for Party Organizations and Party Members Who Hinder the Investigation and Handling of Disciplinary Violations (Trial Implementation)". In order to enforce party discipline, ensure that party organizations at all levels promptly and accurately investigate and handle disciplinary violations within the party, and eliminate interference and resistance in the investigation and handling of cases, the "Regulations" stipulate corresponding penalties for the persons under investigation, persons who know about the case, party organizations and party member leading cadres of the units where the case occurred, informants, case handlers and other personnel who violate the Party Constitution, the "Code" and national laws and regulations during the investigation, evidence collection, approval and trial of the case. Those who resist, obstruct, interfere with, and sabotage the investigation and handling of disciplinary violations, and prevent the investigation and handling of cases from proceeding smoothly, shall be given necessary party discipline sanctions according to the severity of the circumstances and the consequences. 作能否获得全胜的关键。
translated_text: On the 12th, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China issued a notice and issued a report on cleaning up the illegal construction of private houses by party and government cadres and the use of public funds to renovate houses beyond the standard. The report listed the main manifestations of illegal and disciplinary problems in party and government cadres using their power to build private houses and using public funds to renovate houses beyond the standard: first, the phenomenon of excessive land occupation is very serious; second, there are a large number of problems of using power to encroach on state, collective and mass assets; third, some party and government cadres embezzle, accept bribes, speculate and profiteer in order to build private houses, and even commit serious crimes; fourth, a considerable number of party and government cadres build houses not for their own use, but for renting and selling for profit; fifth, some cadres use public funds to renovate houses beyond the standard, and even embezzle the country's foreign exchange to buy high-end luxury commercial houses for individuals. The report also puts forward suggestions for cleaning up the illegal construction of private houses and the use of public funds to renovate houses beyond the standard. (1) Guided by the spirit of the Sixth Plenary Session of the Central Committee, we will unify deployment, centralize leadership, concentrate time and strength, and earnestly carry out the work of cleaning up the party and government cadres who violated discipline and law to build private houses and use public funds to renovate houses beyond the standard, and carry it through to the end. (2) Clarify policies, strictly control, and resolutely curb the unhealthy trend of party and government cadres who violated discipline and law to build private houses and use public funds to renovate houses beyond the standard. (3) Strengthening leadership is the key to whether the work of cleaning up the party and government cadres who violated discipline and law to build private houses and use public funds to renovate houses beyond the standard can achieve complete success.

events:
12日——15日 中共中央组织部召开党员重新登记工作座
谈会。参加会议的有北京、上海、江苏、辽宁、山西、四川、湖南、陕西
等八个省市委组织部和中直、中央国家机关工委组织部的负责同
志。会议交流了前一阶段党员重新登记工作的情况,介绍了经验,
对党员重新登记工作中有关组织处理、政策界限等问题进行了讨
·论,统一了认识。中央组织部部长吕枫、副部长赵宗到会讲话。吕
枫在讲话中强调指出,对党员重新登记工作,我们要进一步提高认
识,统一思想,再接再厉,善始善终地认真抓好。党员重新登记,要
立足于对党员进行教育,宣传党员标准,使党员成为合格党员。组
织处理要严肃认真地进行,注意掌握政策。党员素质的提高,是一
项长期的任务。但是,要通过党员重新登记,使党员的思想觉悟、精
神面貌有一个明显的变化。
translated_text: From the 12th to the 15th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China held a symposium on the re-registration of party members. The meeting was attended by responsible comrades from the Organization Departments of the Party Committees of eight provinces and cities, including Beijing, Shanghai, Jiangsu, Liaoning, Shanxi, Sichuan, Hunan, and Shaanxi, as well as the Organization Departments of the Central Committee and the Central State Organs Working Committee. The meeting exchanged the situation of the re-registration of party members in the previous stage, introduced the experience, discussed the issues of organizational treatment and policy boundaries in the re-registration of party members, and unified the understanding. Lv Feng, Minister of the Central Organization Department, and Zhao Zong, Deputy Minister, spoke at the meeting. In his speech, Lv Feng emphasized that we must further improve our understanding of the re-registration of party members, unify our thinking, make persistent efforts, and do a good job from beginning to end. The re-registration of party members should be based on educating party members, publicizing party member standards, and making party members qualified party members. Organizational treatment should be carried out seriously and conscientiously, and attention should be paid to mastering policies. Improving the quality of party members is a long-term task. However, through the re-registration of party members, there should be a significant change in the ideological awareness and spiritual outlook of party members.

events:
14日 中共中央发出《关于加强统一战线工作的通知》。《通
知》的主要内容:(一)坚持和发展统一战线是党的一项坚定不移的
战略方针。(二)高举爱国主义、社会主义旗帜,巩固和发展最广泛
的爱国统一战线。(三)坚持党对统一战线的领导权。(四)坚决维
护国家的稳定。(五)充分发扬社会主义民主,密切联系党外人士。
(六)努力为四化建设、改革开放服务。(七)认真贯彻落实党的统一
战线的各项政策。(八)积极培养和选拔党外干部。(九)全党重视
做统一战线工作。
translated_text: On the 14th, the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on Strengthening the Work of the United Front". The main contents of the "Notice": (1) Upholding and developing the united front is an unswerving strategic policy of the Party. (2) Hold high the banner of patriotism and socialism, consolidate and develop the broadest patriotic united front. (3) Uphold the Party's leadership over the united front. (4) Resolutely safeguard national stability. (5) Fully develop socialist democracy and maintain close ties with non-Party members. (6) Strive to serve the Four Modernizations, Reform and Opening Up. (7) Conscientiously implement the Party's policies on the united front. (8) Actively cultivate and select non-Party cadres. (9) The whole Party attaches importance to the work of the united front.

events:
16日 《人民日报》转载中共中央政治局常委宋平刊登在《求
是》杂志1990年第14期上的文章《共产党员的历史使命》。文章指
出,当代中国共产党人的历史使命,就是发挥工人阶级先锋战士的
作用,进一步振奋革命精神,全身心地投入建设和改革事业,为把
我国建设成为社会主义现代化国家,奋发努力,建功立业。文章还
提出,当前要突出强调从以下几个方面认真加强党性修养:富有理
想,坚定信念;联系群众,克己奉公;坚持原则,敢于斗争;勤奋学
习,勇于创造;严守纪律,维护团结。核心是解决立场和世界观问
题。只有经常自觉地进行党性修养和思想改造,才能经受住执政和
改革开放的考验,经受住发展社会主义商品经济的考验,经受住和
平演变与反和平演变斗争的考验,成为名副其实的共产党员。
translated_text: On the 16th, the People's Daily reprinted the article "The Historical Mission of Communist Party Members" by Song Ping, a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, which was published in the 14th issue of the magazine "Seeking Truth" in 1990. The article pointed out that the historical mission of contemporary Chinese Communists is to play the role of vanguard fighters of the working class, further inspire the revolutionary spirit, devote themselves to the cause of construction and reform, and work hard to build our country into a socialist modern country. The article also proposed that at present, we should emphasize the following aspects of conscientiously strengthening party spirit cultivation: be full of ideals and firm beliefs; connect with the masses, be selfless and dedicated to the public; adhere to principles and dare to fight; study diligently and be creative; strictly observe discipline and maintain unity. The core is to solve the problem of standpoint and world outlook. Only by constantly and consciously cultivating party spirit and remoulding thoughts can we withstand the test of governing and reform and opening up, the test of developing a socialist commodity economy, and the test of peaceful evolution and the struggle against peaceful evolution, and become true Communists.

events:
17日 新华社报道,中共中央政治局常委宋平,7月中旬在河
北省省直机关和地市领导干部会议上讲话中说,我们党历来是重
视干部交流的。实行干部交流,有利于干部在更广阔的范围里经受
锻炼,开阔眼界,增长才干,积累经验,是使干部更快地成长的一种
有效办法。宋平强调指出,有计划地对领导干部进行交流,是培养
锻炼干部,提高干部素质的一项重要措施,也是广泛发现人才的一
条有效途径。干部经过几个不同岗位的锻炼,工作都搞得好,就说
明这个干部确实比较优秀,任用他担负更大的责任,就比较有把握
能够胜任。
translated_text: On the 17th, Xinhua News Agency reported that Song Ping, a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, said in a speech at a meeting of leading cadres of the provincial government and prefecture-level cities in Hebei Province in mid-July that our party has always attached great importance to the exchange of cadres. The implementation of cadre exchange is conducive to the cadres to be trained in a wider range, broaden their horizons, increase their talents, and accumulate experience. It is an effective way to make cadres grow faster. Song Ping emphasized that the planned exchange of leading cadres is an important measure to train and improve the quality of cadres, and it is also an effective way to discover talents widely. After training in several different positions, the cadres have done a good job, which means that this cadre is indeed quite good, and it is more certain that he can be competent if he is appointed to take on greater responsibilities.

events:
18日 中共中央纪律检查委员会发出通知,印发《中共中央
纪律检查委员会关于叛逃,出走的共产党员党籍、党纪处理的暂行
规定》。《暂行规定》指出,本规定所称的“叛逃”,是指逃往国外、境
外不归或滯留国外,境外不归,并有反对党和社会主义祖国的言行
或申请政治避难的行为。因触犯我国刑律,为逃避制裁,逃往国外、
境外的,视为叛逃。本规定所称的“出走”,是指前往国外,境外不归
或滞留国外、境外不归,但没有反对党和社会主义祖国的言行的行
为。《暂行规定》还对哪些人应给予开除党籍、党内除名、留党察看
等处分作了明确规定。
translated_text: On the 18th, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China issued a notice and issued the "Interim Provisions of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China on the Handling of Party Membership and Party Discipline of Communist Party Members Who Defect or Run Away". The "Interim Provisions" pointed out that the "defection" referred to in these provisions refers to fleeing abroad, not returning abroad, or staying abroad, not returning abroad, and having words and deeds against the party and the socialist motherland, or applying for political asylum. Those who violate our country's criminal law and flee abroad to evade sanctions are considered defectors. The "runaway" referred to in these provisions refers to going abroad, not returning abroad, or staying abroad, not returning abroad, but not having words and deeds against the party and the socialist motherland. The "Interim Provisions" also clearly stipulates who should be expelled from the party, expelled from the party, and placed on probation within the party.

events:

胡锦涛当选为自治区党委书记。
translated_text: On the same day, at the first plenary session of the Fourth Committee of the Communist Party of China in the Tibet Autonomous Region, Hu Jintao was elected as the Secretary of the Party Committee of the Autonomous Region.

events:

当选为省委书记,程维高、吕传赞、李炳良当选为省委副书记。

events:
25日——27日 中共中央组织部、全国妇联在长春联合召开
培养选拔女干部工作座谈会。中共中央政治局常委宋平给会议写
了信,作了重要指示。全国人大常委会副委员长、全国妇联主席陈
慕华参加了会议,并作了重要讲话。中央组织部副部长赵宗同志
作了总结讲话。
宋平在写给会议的信中指出:培养选拔妇女干部,是一项很重
要的工作。各级党委、政府都应把它列入议事日程,切实抓起来。宣
传舆论部门、教育部门、组织人事部门以及妇联、工会、共青团、科
协等群众团体和各民主党派,也要积极配合,采取有效措施,创造
条件,帮助女干部更好地锻炼成长,使更多的妇女人才脱颖而出,
造就一支密切联系妇女群众、忠诚于社会主义事业,德才兼备的女
干部队伍。
translated_text: From the 25th to the 27th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the All-China Women's Federation jointly held a symposium on the training and selection of female cadres in Changchun. Song Ping, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, wrote a letter to the meeting and gave important instructions. Chen Muhua, Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress and President of the All-China Women's Federation, attended the meeting and delivered an important speech. Comrade Zhao Zong, Deputy Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, delivered a summary speech. In his letter to the meeting, Song Ping pointed out that training and selecting women cadres is a very important task. Party committees and governments at all levels should put it on the agenda and take it seriously. Propaganda and public opinion departments, education departments, organization and personnel departments, as well as mass organizations such as the Women's Federation, trade unions, the Communist Youth League, and the Science and Technology Association, and various democratic parties should also actively cooperate, take effective measures, create conditions, help female cadres to better train and grow, enable more female talents to stand out, and create a team of female cadres who are closely connected with the women masses, loyal to the socialist cause, and have both ability and integrity.

events:
28日 中共中央组织部转发江苏省委组织部《关于善始善终
搞好干部考察工作的通知》。《通知》要求各地结合本地区、本部门
的实际情况,对如何善始善终地搞好干部考察工作,作出妥善安
排,圆满完成干部考察任务,并运用好干部考察成果。
translated_text: On the 28th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee forwarded the "Notice on How to Conduct Cadre Inspections from Beginning to End Well" issued by the Organization Department of the Jiangsu Provincial Committee. The "Notice" requires all localities to make proper arrangements on how to conduct cadre inspections from beginning to end well in light of the actual conditions of their regions and departments, to complete cadre inspection tasks satisfactorily, and to make good use of the results of cadre inspections.

events:
31日 中共中央发出通知,印发《中国共产党党内法规制定
程序暂行条例》。《条例》规定,党内法规的名称为党章、准则、条例、
规则、规定、办法、细则。中央纪律检查委员会、中央各部门制定并
发布的党内法规,称规定、办法、细则。《条例》对党内法规的规划、
起草、审定、发布作了明确规定。
translated_text: On the 31st, the CPC Central Committee issued a notice to issue the "Provisional Regulations on the Procedures for Formulating Intra-Party Regulations of the Communist Party of China". The "Regulations" stipulate that the names of intra-party regulations are party constitutions, guidelines, regulations, rules, regulations, methods, and detailed rules. The intra-party regulations formulated and issued by the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and various central departments are called regulations, methods, and detailed rules. The "Regulations" clearly stipulate the planning, drafting, approval, and issuance of intra-party regulations.

events:
同日 中共中央组织部召开全国部分省区市选拔、管理优秀
专家和拔尖人才工作经验交流会。中央组织部副部长赵宗在会
上讲话。他就党委组织部门如何做好知识分子工作讲了三点意见:
一、加强领导是做好知识分子工作的关键,要增强做好这项工作的
责任感和紧迫感。二、认真贯彻落实江泽民同志“五四”讲话精神,
进一步加强和改进知识分子工作。三、切实抓好管理和掌握优秀专
家、拔尖人才的工作。
translated_text: On the same day, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee held a national experience exchange meeting on the selection and management of outstanding experts and top talents in some provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities. Zhao Zong, deputy director of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, spoke at the meeting. He made three suggestions on how the Party Committee Organization Department can do a good job in intellectual work: 1. Strengthening leadership is the key to doing a good job in intellectual work, and we must enhance the sense of responsibility and urgency to do this work well. 2. Seriously implement the spirit of Comrade Jiang Zemin’s "May 4th" speech and further strengthen and improve intellectual work. 3. Effectively manage and master the work of outstanding experts and top talents.

events:
1日 中共中央组织部依据《中国共产党章程》的规定,制订
了《中国共产党发展党员工作细则(试行)》,下发全党。
《细则》分6章33条,对发展党员工作的全过程作了明确具体
的规定。《细则》要求党的基层组织加强对入党积极分子的培养、教
育和考察;严格按照程序接收预备党员,把住“入口关”;做好对预
备党员的教育、考察和转正工作。《细则》强调各级党委必须把发展
党员工作列入重要议事日程,切实加强领导。对发展党员工作中出
现的违纪问题,一定要严肃查处。违反党章规定而被吸收入党的,
不予承认,并对有关责任者批评教育以至给予必要的纪律处分。
translated_text: On the 1st, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China formulated the "Detailed Rules for the Development of Party Members of the Communist Party of China (Trial)" in accordance with the provisions of the "Constitution of the Communist Party of China" and issued it to the whole party. The "Detailed Rules" are divided into 6 chapters and 33 articles, which clearly and specifically stipulate the whole process of developing party members. The "Detailed Rules" require the grassroots party organizations to strengthen the training, education and inspection of active members to join the party; strictly accept probationary members in accordance with the procedures and keep the "entrance gate"; do a good job in the education, inspection and formalization of probationary members. The "Detailed Rules" emphasize that party committees at all levels must include the development of party members on the important agenda and effectively strengthen leadership. Any violations of discipline in the development of party members must be seriously investigated and dealt with. Those who are admitted into the party in violation of the provisions of the party constitution will not be recognized, and the relevant responsible persons will be criticized and educated and given necessary disciplinary sanctions.

events: 會中共中央决定,增补邓力群为中央党史领导小组副组长。增补后,中央党史领导小组组长为杨尚昆,副组长为胡乔木、薄一波、邓力群。

events:
4日 中共中央纪律检查委员会、中共中央组织部、监察部、
人事部联合发出《关于加强工作联系的通知》。《通知》就执行党纪、

检、监察机关与组织、人事部门之间的联系与配合,及时通报情况,
共同做好工作等有关事项,作了重申和补充。
translated_text: On the 4th, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China, the Organization Department of the Communist Party of China, the Supervision Department, and the Ministry of Personnel jointly issued the "Notice on Strengthening Work Contact". The "Notice" reiterated and supplemented the implementation of party discipline and political discipline, and further strengthened the contact and cooperation between discipline inspection and supervision agencies at all levels and organization and personnel departments in the investigation and understanding of cadre selection and appointment work, timely reporting of situations, and joint work.

events:
5日——10日 中共中央组织部、中央政策研究室、民政部、
共青团中央、全国妇联联合召开全国村级组织建设工作座谈会。会
议围绕在新形势下按照党的基本路线的要求,进一步加强党支
部为核心的村级组织建设,密切党和政府同农民群众的血肉联系,
团结和带领广大农民发展经济,走共同富裕的社会主义道路这一
主题,分析了全国村级组织建设工作的现状,交流了经验,并对今
后进一步加强村级组织建设提出十项建议和意见:
一、加强村级组织建设是当前农村工作的一项重要而紧迫的
任务;二、加强村级组织建设的指导思想和工作目标;三、村级组织

translated_text: From the 5th to the 10th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Central Policy Research Office, the Ministry of Civil Affairs, the Central Committee of the Communist Youth League, and the All-China Women's Federation jointly held a national symposium on village-level organization construction. The meeting focused on the theme of further strengthening the construction of village-level organizations with party branches as the core in accordance with the requirements of the party's basic line under the new situation, strengthening the flesh-and-blood ties between the party and the government and the peasant masses, uniting and leading the broad masses of farmers to develop the economy and take the socialist road of common prosperity. It analyzed the current situation of village-level organization construction work across the country, exchanged experiences, and put forward ten suggestions and opinions on further strengthening village-level organization construction in the future: 1. Strengthening village-level organization construction is an important and urgent task in current rural work; 2. Strengthening the guiding ideology and work goals of village-level organization construction; 3. Village-level organizations should take leading the masses to deepen rural reforms, develop the economy, and take the road of common prosperity as their priority. Central tasks; Fourth, further build the village party branch into a strong and dynamic leadership core; Fifth, conscientiously implement the "Organization Law of Village Committees (Trial)" and strengthen grassroots democratic politics; Sixth, strengthen the construction of village league branches and women's congresses, and give full play to their role in the construction of rural civilizations; Seventh, care for village cadres, improve their quality, stabilize the team, and strengthen the relationship between cadres and the masses; Eighth, persist in educating farmers on socialism, patriotism, and collectivism, and strengthen spiritual civilization construction; Ninth, continue to resolutely and conscientiously rectify weak and scattered village organizations; Tenth, leaders at all levels should face the grassroots, serve the grassroots, and effectively strengthen the leadership of village organization construction. Song Ping, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, delivered a speech entitled "Strive to Enhance the Cohesion and Combat Power of Village Organizations with Party Branches as the Core" at the National Symposium on Village Organization Construction. The main contents are: First, we must attach great importance to and effectively strengthen the construction of village organizations. The issue of farmers has always been the fundamental issue of China's revolution and construction. At this stage, the peasants' problems and rural work problems, in the final analysis, are that the Party must educate, guide, unite and organize peasants in accordance with the requirements of the basic line of the new period, continuously improve agricultural productivity, develop the rural economy, unswervingly follow the socialist road, and promote the overall progress of rural society. Second, conscientiously strengthen the construction of village-level organizations with the Party branch as the core. Building a good Party branch is a need for building a new socialist countryside and an urgent requirement of the vast number of farmers. The Party branch should strengthen the education and management of Party members so that Party members can play a pioneering and exemplary role in the construction of the two civilizations. The Party branch should take mobilizing and organizing the masses to deepen rural reforms, develop commodity production, strengthen the rural economy, and take the road of common prosperity as the central task. According to the requirements of the "Organization Law of Village Committees (Trial)", under the leadership of the Party organization, we should gradually establish and improve the Village Committee and promote the construction of grassroots democratic politics in rural areas. Strengthening the socialist ideological education of farmers and doing a good job in the construction of socialist spiritual civilization are important tasks of rural grassroots organizations. Third, under the leadership of the Party Committee, all parties should work together to build a new socialist countryside. We must strive to establish a new rural work pattern that adapts to the needs of the new situation. At the grassroots level, we must take the party organization as the core, the village committee and village cooperative economic organization as the support, the Communist Youth League as the assistant, and pay attention to the role of mass organizations such as the Women's Congress, work closely together, form a joint force, and build a new socialist countryside around the center of educating, guiding, uniting, and organizing farmers to develop the economy and take the road of common prosperity. Minister of Civil Affairs Cui Naifu, Deputy Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee Zhao Zongnai, First Secretary of the Communist Youth League Central Committee Song Defu, Vice Chairman of the All-China Women's Federation and First Secretary of the Secretariat Huang Qi successively spoke at the symposium. On December 13, the CPC Central Committee agreed and approved the "Minutes of the National Symposium on Village Organization Construction".

events:
17日 中共中央政治局常委宋平,在国防大学研究系发表讲
话,主要内容是:
第一,为什么当前要强调党的建设。从我们党的历史和国际共
产主义运动的历史来看,无论是在革命战争时期,还是社会主义建
设时期,党的建设都是决定党的事业成败的根本问题。领导社会主
义现代化建设这样艰巨复杂的事业需要坚强的党,防止和挫败和
平演变同样需要坚强的党。
第二,坚持和发展马克思主义建党原则,把我们党建设得更
好。当前特别需要在以下几个重大问题上,进一步提高认识,统一
思想:(1)必须坚持党的工人阶级先锋队性质。(2)必须坚持马克思
列宁主义、毛泽东思想的指导地位。(3)必须坚持民主集中制。
(4)必须坚持以经济建设为中心,集中全力把经济搞上去。(5)必须
密切党同人民群众的联系。(6)必须把党的基层组织建设好。
第三,坚持社会主义道路问题。社会主义制度,是同几千年来
的私有制度根本对立的全新制度,是人们认识和把握了社会发展
的客观规律,自觉地建立起来的制度。在坚持社会主义道路这个根
本问题上,中国的历史和现实已经作出了明确的回答,每个共产党
员都必须有清醒的认识,决不能有丝毫含糊和动摇。在东欧的演变
中,流行着“民主社会主义”的主张,提出以多党制、议会制、三权分
立等取代无产阶级专政的政治制度,以私有化和完全的市场经济
否定社会主义经济制度,以思想多元化否定马克思主义的指导地
位。我们国家不能走西方的资本主义道路,也不能搞东欧的“民主
社会主义”,这点必须十分明确。
translated_text:
On the 17th, Song Ping, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, delivered a speech at the Research Department of the National Defense University. The main content was:
First, why should we emphasize party building at present? From the history of our party and the history of the international communist movement, whether in the revolutionary war period or the socialist construction period, party building is the fundamental issue that determines the success or failure of the party's cause. Leading such a difficult and complex cause as socialist modernization construction requires a strong party, and preventing and thwarting peaceful evolution also requires a strong party.
Second, adhere to and develop the Marxist principles of party building and build our party better. At present, it is particularly necessary to further improve understanding and unify thinking on the following major issues: (1) We must adhere to the party's nature as the vanguard of the working class. (2) We must adhere to the guiding role of Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought. (3) We must adhere to democratic centralism.
(4) We must adhere to economic construction as the center and concentrate all our efforts on developing the economy. (5) We must strengthen the party's ties with the people. (6) We must build the party's grassroots organizations well.
Third, adhere to the issue of the socialist path. The socialist system is a completely new system that is fundamentally opposed to the private ownership system that has existed for thousands of years. It is a system that people have consciously established by recognizing and grasping the objective laws of social development. On the fundamental issue of adhering to the socialist path, China's history and reality have given a clear answer. Every Communist Party member must have a clear understanding and must not be vague or wavering. In the evolution of Eastern Europe, the proposition of "democratic socialism" is popular, proposing to replace the political system of the dictatorship of the proletariat with a multi-party system, a parliamentary system, and a separation of powers, negating the socialist economic system with privatization and a complete market economy, and negating the guiding role of Marxism with ideological pluralism. Our country cannot follow the Western capitalist path, nor can it engage in Eastern European "democratic socialism". This must be made very clear.

events:
4日 中共中央发出关于批转中央纪律检查委员会《关于加
强党风廉政建设的意见》的通知。《通知》指出,我们党是久经考
验的伟大的党,党的基本状况是好的,得到了人民群众的信赖和拥
护。但是,应该清醒地看到,党内确实存在着不正之风和消极腐败
现象,它严重地侵蚀党的肌体,败坏党的声誉,影响党同人民群众
的关系。在执政和改革开放条件下加强党风廉政建设,是一项长
期而艰巨的任务,对于进一步发挥党在社会主义现代化建设中的
领导核心作用,保证国家政治、经济和社会的稳定发展,都具有十
分重要的意义。各级党委和政府,一定要从党和国家的生死存亡、
改革开放的兴衰成败的高度,充分认识党风廉政建设的重要性
和紧迫性,切实加强领导,采取有力措施,把这项工作持之以恒地
抓下去。要继续坚决落实中央已经作出的加强党风廉政建设的
各项决定和提出的各项措施,扎扎实实、脚踏实地地办好群众关心
的事。要说到做到,说一件办一件,务求落实,务求见效,以取信于
民。要努力克服形式主义,防止一阵风。要不断健全监督机制,进
行综合治理,正确掌握政策,把党风廉政建设卓有成效地进行下
去。
translated_text: On the 4th, the CPC Central Committee issued a notice on approving the "Opinions on Strengthening the Construction of Party Conduct and Clean Government" of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection. The "Notice" pointed out that our party is a great party that has been tested for a long time. The basic situation of the party is good and it has won the trust and support of the people. However, we should be soberly aware that there are indeed unhealthy tendencies and negative corruption phenomena in the party, which seriously erode the party's body, damage the party's reputation, and affect the relationship between the party and the people. Strengthening the construction of party conduct and clean government under the conditions of ruling and reform and opening up is a long-term and arduous task. It is of great significance to further play the leading role of the party in socialist modernization and ensure the stable development of the country's politics, economy and society. Party committees and governments at all levels must fully recognize the importance and urgency of the construction of party conduct and clean government from the perspective of the survival of the party and the country and the rise and fall of reform and opening up, and effectively strengthen leadership and take effective measures to carry out this work persistently. We must continue to resolutely implement the various decisions and measures that the Central Committee has made to strengthen the Party's work style and clean government, and do things that the masses care about in a down-to-earth manner. We must do what we say, do what we say, and strive to implement and achieve results to win the trust of the people. We must strive to overcome formalism and prevent a one-off trend. We must continuously improve the supervision mechanism, carry out comprehensive governance, correctly grasp policies, and carry out the Party's work style and clean government construction effectively.

各级领导干部要以身作则,率先垂范,做出榜样。纪检机关要主动
发挥作用,与有关部门密切配合,形成一股力量,充分发挥检查监
督的整体效能。乔石强调,我们党的一切工作包括党风党纪工作都
必须紧密围绕党的基本路线去进行,并要求纪检干部在以身作则、

translated_text: From December 30 to December 2, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China held a national commendation meeting for advanced discipline inspection organizations and outstanding discipline inspection cadres in Beijing. The meeting commended 55 advanced discipline inspection organizations and 296 outstanding discipline inspection cadres. Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the Communist Party of China, Qiao Shi, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China and Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, and Chen Zuolin, Deputy Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, attended the meeting and delivered speeches. Jiang Zemin asked party organizations at all levels to truly place party style, party discipline and clean government construction in an important position, strengthen leadership over discipline inspection work, support discipline inspection agencies in improving organizational construction and team building, and help them solve difficulties and problems in their work. Party leaders at all levels should set an example, take the lead and set an example. Discipline inspection agencies should take the initiative to play their role, work closely with relevant departments, form a force, and give full play to the overall effectiveness of inspection and supervision. Qiao Shi emphasized that all the work of our party, including the work on party style and discipline, must be carried out closely around the party's basic line, and required the discipline inspection cadres to set a good example in five aspects: leading by example, being honest and dedicated, seeking truth from facts, self-criticism and connecting with the masses.

events:
4日——8日中共中央组织部在北京召开第三次全国干部
档案工作会议。会议确定,今后干部档案工作的重点,将转到抓好
收集干部档案材料,充实干部档案内容上来。中央组织部部长吕
枫、副部长孟连崑到会讲话。吕枫说,干部档案工作是党和国家干
部工作不可缺少的一个重要组成部分,是为贯彻党的干部路线、方
针和政策服务的,是做好干部工作的基本条件之一。他说,干部档
案管理是门科学,管理工作要科学化。要进一步完善各项制度,切
实做好收集反映干部德、能、勤、绩的材料,充实档案内容的工作。
吕枫要求各地区、各部门,借这次会议的东风,对本地区本部门的
干部档案工作进行一次检查,通过检查,巩固成绩,发扬优点,找出
差距,提出改进的措施,努力把干部档案工作向前推进一步。
translated_text: From the 4th to the 8th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China held the third national cadre archives work conference in Beijing. The conference determined that the focus of cadre archives work in the future will shift to collecting cadre archives materials and enriching the content of cadre archives. Lv Feng, Minister of the Central Organization Department, and Meng Liankun, Deputy Minister, spoke at the meeting. Lv Feng said that cadre archives work is an indispensable and important part of the party and state cadre work, serves to implement the party's cadre line, principles and policies, and is one of the basic conditions for doing a good job in cadre work. He said that cadre archives management is a science, and management work must be scientific. We must further improve various systems, do a good job in collecting materials reflecting the morality, ability, diligence and performance of cadres, and enrich the content of archives. Lv Feng asked all regions and departments to take advantage of this conference to conduct an inspection of the cadre archives work in their regions and departments, consolidate achievements, carry forward advantages, find gaps, propose improvement measures, and strive to push cadre archives work forward.

events:
25日——30日 中国共产党第十三届中央委员会第七次全
体会议在北京举行。
会议审议并通过《中共中央关于制定国民经济和社会发展十
年规划和“八五”计划的建议》。《建议》分七方面内容:一、主要奋斗
目标和基本指导方针;二、经济发展的产业重点和地区布局;三、发
展科技教育文化事业的任务和政策;四、改善人民生活和健全社会
保障;五、深化经济体制改革的方向、任务和措施;六、进一步扩大
对外开放;七、全党全国人民团结起来,为实现十年规划和“八
五”计划而奋斗。中共中央总书记江泽民作重要讲话,中共中央政
治局常委、国务院总理李鹏就《建议》草案作了说明。
全会高度评价十一届三中全会以来我国改革开放和社会主义
现代化建设所取得的巨大成就,充分肯定十三届四中全会以来各
项工作所取得的显著成绩。全会指出,从1991年到2000年,在我
国社会主义现代化建设的历史进程中,是非常关键的时期,制定与
实施十年规划和“八五”计划,必须坚定不移地走建设有中国特色
的社会主义道路,坚定不移地推进改革开放,坚定不移地贯彻执行
国民经济持续、稳定、协调发展的方针,坚定不移地执行自力更生、
艰苦奋斗、勤俭建国的方针,坚定不移地贯彻执行物质文明建设和
精神文明建设一起抓的方针。
出席会议的有中央委员171人,候补中央委员107人。列席会
议的有中央顾问委员会委员161人,中央纪律检查委员会委员67
人,有关方面负责同志78人。
translated_text:
From the 25th to the 30th, the Seventh Plenary Session of the 13th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China was held in Beijing. The meeting reviewed and passed the "Proposal of the CPC Central Committee on Formulating the Ten-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development and the Eighth Five-Year Plan". The "Proposal" is divided into seven aspects: 1. Main goals and basic guidelines; 2. Industrial priorities and regional layout of economic development; 3. Tasks and policies for developing science, technology, education and culture; 4. Improving people's lives and improving social security; 5. Direction, tasks and measures for deepening economic system reform; 6. Further expanding opening up to the outside world; 7. The whole party and the people of the country unite to strive for the realization of the Ten-Year Plan and the Eighth Five-Year Plan. Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, delivered an important speech, and Li Peng, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Premier of the State Council, explained the draft of the "Proposal". The plenary session highly praised the great achievements made in my country's reform and opening up and socialist modernization since the Third Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee, and fully affirmed the remarkable achievements made in various tasks since the Fourth Plenary Session of the 13th Central Committee. translated_text: From the 7th to the 11th, the National Conference of Organization Ministers of Party Committees of Provinces, Autonomous Regions and Municipalities Directly under the Central Government was held in Beijing. During the meeting, Song Ping, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, held a discussion with some comrades attending the meeting. Song Ping pointed out in the discussion that it is necessary to vigorously strengthen the party's own construction and comprehensively improve the party's combat effectiveness. He said that the party's organizational work serves the political line. After the political tasks are proposed, the task of the organization department is to organize implementation and make every effort to implement them. The Seventh Plenary Session of the Party Central Committee proposed the guidelines and tasks of the "Eighth Five-Year Plan" and the Ten-Year Plan. The next ten years will be a crucial decade for my country's socialist construction. We must further strengthen the party's own construction, pay close attention to the implementation of various tasks, improve the party's combat effectiveness, inspire the spirit of all party comrades, unite the people of all ethnic groups in the country, strive to promote economic construction, fight corruption and prevent degeneration, and build socialism with Chinese characteristics. He said that the party's combat effectiveness is hidden in the vast number of party members and the masses. As long as we are good at guiding, we can give full play to it and complete various undertakings. Song Ping said that the core of strengthening the construction of the leadership team is to make the leadership of the party and the country in the hands of people who are loyal to Marxism. We must select and appoint cadres with both moral integrity and ability. Morality, first of all, is a firm political stance, a firm belief in Marxism, adherence to and maintenance of the party's leadership, adherence to socialism, and serving the people wholeheartedly. Song Ping said that the grassroots organizations of the party should be good at mobilizing the enthusiasm of the masses. Enterprise leaders should rely wholeheartedly on the working class, inspire the sense of responsibility of the broad masses of workers and staff, unite as one, and promote the construction of the two civilizations of the enterprise. At the opening of the meeting, Lv Feng, Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, delivered a report entitled "On the Main Tasks of Organizational Work in 1991". The report briefly reviewed the achievements of the organizational front in 1990, summarized the new situation facing the current organizational front, and put forward the work tasks for 1991. Lv Feng said that the main tasks for 1991 are: (i) to make good organizational adjustments to the leadership team and focus on ideological and work style construction. translated_text: On the 11th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the National Audit Office jointly issued the "Notice on Strengthening the Management of Leading Cadres of Local Audit Institutions at All Levels". The "Notice" stipulates that the management of leading cadres of local audit institutions at all levels shall implement a dual leadership system with the local party committee as the main body. When appointing, removing, transferring, rewarding or punishing leading cadres of audit institutions, local party committees shall seek the opinions of the higher-level audit institutions in advance. The National Audit Office and local audit institutions at all levels shall assist local party committees in strengthening the inspection and understanding of the leadership teams of audit institutions, frequently reflect the situation, and take the initiative to propose suggestions for appointment, removal, transfer, reward or punishment. The National Audit Office assists local party committees in managing the directors and deputy directors of provincial (district, city) audit bureaus, and shall strengthen the inspection and understanding of the main leading cadres of the audit bureaus of cities with independent planning status, promptly report the situation to the municipal party committee, and propose suggestions for adjustments and staffing of the audit bureau leadership teams. After the appointment and removal of the directors and deputy directors of the provincial (district, city) audit bureaus and the audit bureaus of cities with independent planning status, the provincial audit bureaus shall report to the National Audit Office for record. After the reserve cadres of the provincial (district, city) audit bureau leadership team are determined, the audit bureau should, in accordance with the relevant regulations of the Central Organization Department, submit the "Reserve Cadre Registration Form" to the provincial (district, city) party committee and send it to the National Audit Office at the same time. Any changes in the reserve cadre candidates should also be reported in a timely manner.

章,介绍了陈云同志1990年1月24日同浙江省党政军领导同志

比较､反复”的条幅,并对这15个字作了详细解释。陈云同志说:这

题处于萌芽状态时,就能够及时发现。所谓广,就是全国各省市各
行各业,都有许多高中级干部(包括离退休的)。在某种意义上讲,

有必要,缺一不可。
translated_text: On the 18th, the People's Daily reported that Li Zemin, secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China, wrote an article introducing the spirit of the conversation between Comrade Chen Yun and the leading comrades of the party, government and military of Zhejiang Province on January 24, 1990. Comrade Chen Yun wrote a banner at that time that read "Not only following the superiors, not only following the books, but only following the facts, exchanging, comparing, and repeating", and explained these 15 words in detail. Comrade Chen Yun said: Of these 15 words, the first 9 words are materialism, and the last 6 words are dialectics, which together are materialistic dialectics. When talking about the methods of investigation and research, Chen Yun said that one is to personally lead a working group or send a working group to the countryside and factories, which is of course necessary; the other is that every high- and middle-level cadre has close friends and staff around him who dare to speak the truth, through whom he can often hear the voices of grassroots cadres and the masses. The latter type of investigation and research has the characteristics of "truth, speed, and breadth". The so-called truth means that they dare to reflect the real situation and speak their minds. The so-called fast means that when the problem is in its infancy, it can be discovered in time. The so-called wide means that there are many high- and middle-level cadres (including retired ones) in all walks of life in all provinces and cities across the country. In a sense, the latter kind of investigation and research is more important than the former. Both kinds of investigation and research are necessary and indispensable.

一个省、一个自治区,关键是省、自治区的核心领导,首先是省委、

作,特别是改革开放以来小平同志的著作,学习好。

Cadres at all levels, especially leading cadres, must strive to learn the basic theories of Marxism, learn the party's line and policies, serve the people wholeheartedly, and keep close contact with the masses. If our cadres are always true Marxists, our country will not change color, we can maintain close contact with the masses, and we can ensure that we truly achieve clean government. It should be said that overall, our party is still a great party. But we must not underestimate the harm caused by corruption. Since we moved to the city, we have become the ruling party. The members of the ruling party, especially the leading cadres of the ruling party, have power in their hands and can better serve the people, but this power is also prone to problems. Therefore, we must have a clear understanding. The key lies in the party's cadre team. The key to a province or an autonomous region is the core leadership of the province or autonomous region, first of all, the provincial party committee and the autonomous region party committee. Therefore, only by building a good cadre team can we form a strong backbone force to unite and lead the masses and do a good job in all aspects. Second, strengthen the construction of the party's grassroots organizations. Only when the party's grassroots organizations are well built can our cause be consolidated and developed. The central government is about to issue a notice on agricultural and rural work in 1991, which also specifically talks about the construction of rural grassroots organizations. The "Enterprise Law" was passed by the National People's Congress, and we must conscientiously implement this law. The factory director responsibility system has not changed. However, the party organization must strengthen its political core role, participate in the decision-making of major issues in the enterprise, and lead ideological and political work and spiritual civilization construction. In addition, it is best for the appointment and removal of cadres to go through the party committee, for example, the party committee secretary and the factory director will deliberate, and then the party committee will conduct a collective study, and finally the factory director will appoint. There are leadership skills and political level issues here. The factory director plays a central role in the production command, business management, and technology development of the enterprise, and this point must never be shaken. Now some people are arguing about whether the "center" or the "core" is bigger. This argument should stop. I say that the "two hearts" should become one heart. We should work together to really improve our economy and production. While strengthening the construction of grassroots organizations, we should also strengthen the work of leading organs. Finally, while focusing on the construction of material civilization, party committees at all levels must also seriously focus on the construction of socialist spiritual civilization. We must carry out in-depth socialist ideological education in factories and rural areas. For most cadres, they must also study Chairman Mao's relevant works, especially Comrade Xiaoping's works since the reform and opening up, in light of China's reality.

events:
同日 《人民日报》刊载中央组织部部长吕枫的文章《大力推
进干部交流工作》。文章指出,进行干部交流的根本目的,是培养锻
炼干部,开阔眼界,增长才干。具体说来,干部交流,一是干部自身
成长的需要。通过不同地区、不同部门、不同层次、不同岗位的锻
炼,才能见多识广,学到更多的本领,获得更丰富的经验。我们常讲
干部要“四化”,知识面要一点,如果只懂那么一点,面很窄,负责
全面领导工作就困难。前不久中央领导同志讲过,今后各部部长、
省长首先应该是政治家,要做到这一点,应该站得更高,看得更远。
所以,干部交流应该是全面锻炼干部的好办法,是干部自身成长的
需要。二是工作的需要。如某县缺一个局长,县与县之间交流一下,
问题就可以解决。某一个班子的年龄结构不理想,某一个班子缺少
分管或擅长某一方面工作的干部。互相交流一下,也可以解决。三
是群众的需要。群众也很希望干部交流,这有利于打破“关系网”,
树立好的风气。目前我们还没有全面实行干部回避制度,即本地人
不在本地担任主要领导职务,有的省搞了,群众很拥护。这种办法
对干部本人也有好处。如果在本地工作,亲戚朋友都来找,想摆脱
也摆脱不了。事实证明,干部交流有利于打破“关系网”。近几年经
过努力,我们交流了一大批干部,其中包括省部级干部上百人,地
县一级就更多了,有的省县级干部交流了百分之八十以上,从多数
反映来看是好的。
吕枫在文章中强调:实行干部交流,要改变一种观念。现在一
搞干部交流,有人就认为是干部犯错误了,这种交流等于犯错误的
观念,一定要改。干部交流今后要形成制度,甚至还可以规定年限,
在这个地区干多少年以后,就要调往另一个地区。
translated_text: On the same day, the People's Daily published an article by Lv Feng, Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, entitled "Vigorously Promote the Exchange of Cadres". The article pointed out that the fundamental purpose of cadre exchange is to train and exercise cadres, broaden their horizons and increase their abilities. Specifically, cadre exchange is, first, a need for the growth of cadres themselves. Only through training in different regions, departments, levels and positions can one become more knowledgeable, learn more skills and gain more experience. We often say that cadres should be "four-oriented" and have a broad knowledge base. If they only know a little bit, it will be very narrow and it will be difficult to be responsible for overall leadership. Not long ago, a leading comrade of the Central Committee said that in the future, ministers and governors should first be politicians. To achieve this, they should stand higher and see further. Therefore, cadre exchange should be a good way to train cadres in an all-round way and a need for the growth of cadres themselves. Second, it is a need for work. For example, if a county lacks a director, the problem can be solved by exchanging between counties. The age structure of a certain team is not ideal, and a certain team lacks cadres who are in charge of or good at a certain aspect of work. Exchanges can also solve the problem. The third is the needs of the masses. The masses also hope that cadres can exchange, which is conducive to breaking the "relationship network" and establishing a good atmosphere. At present, we have not fully implemented the cadre avoidance system, that is, local people do not hold major leadership positions in the local area. Some provinces have done so, and the masses are very supportive. This method is also good for the cadres themselves. If you work in the local area, relatives and friends will come to you, and you can't get rid of them even if you want to. Facts have proved that cadre exchanges are conducive to breaking the "relationship network". In recent years, after efforts, we have exchanged a large number of cadres, including hundreds of provincial and ministerial cadres, and even more at the county level. In some provinces, county-level cadres have exchanged more than 80%, which is good from the majority of feedback. Lu Feng emphasized in the article: To implement cadre exchanges, we must change a concept. Now, when cadres are exchanged, some people think that the cadres have made mistakes, and this concept of exchange equals making mistakes must be changed. In the future, cadre exchanges must be institutionalized, and even a time limit can be stipulated. After working in this area for a certain number of years, they will be transferred to another area.

translated_text: On the 22nd, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the United Front Work Department of the CPC Central Committee jointly issued the "Notice on the Recommendation of Members of Democratic Parties and Non-Party Persons to Lead Judicial and Procuratorial Organs". The "Notice" stipulates that the recommendation of members of democratic parties and non-party persons to lead judicial and procuratorial organs must adhere to the "four modernizations" policy and the cadre standards of both moral integrity and ability. The qualifications for appointment are: (1) support the basic line of the Communist Party of China, adhere to the four basic principles, adhere to reform and opening up, and have a high level of policy; (2) have a strong sense of professionalism, certain organizational and leadership capabilities, take the overall situation into consideration, maintain unity, be fair and upright, have a democratic style, and be diligent and honest; (3) have certain legal expertise, judicial expertise or rich experience in judicial and procuratorial work, and have a certain social reputation; (4) be in good health and able to work normally. The Notice stipulates the steps and procedures for the nomination work: The work of nominating members of democratic parties and non-party members to serve as leaders of the trial and procuratorial organs should be carried out in an active, steady, planned and step-by-step manner based on the actual situation, and one person should be selected as soon as he or she is mature. It is possible to first nominate qualified members of democratic parties and non-party members to serve as leaders of the people's courts and people's procuratorates in provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities directly under the central government, and cities with independent planning status and provincial cities with conditions. In order to meet the needs of opening up to the outside world and united front work, priority should be given to nominating qualified members of democratic parties and non-party members to serve in the people's courts and people's procuratorates in special economic zones and coastal open cities. The Organization Department of the Party Committee should carefully investigate the recommended candidates, and after soliciting the opinions of the Party Group of the People's Court and the People's Procuratorate at the next higher level, report to the Party Committee for approval according to the cadre management authority, and handle the appointment procedures in accordance with legal procedures. The Notice also stipulates that a group of qualified members of democratic parties and non-party members should be hired in a planned manner to serve as people's jurors of people's courts at or above the provincial level and special prosecutors of people's procuratorates to participate in the research and consultation on important laws and policies, and to participate in the trial, investigation, review and trial of some major and difficult cases.

教问题的通知》。《通知》指出,共产党员是工人阶级的有共产主义
觉悟的先锋战士,是无神论者,只能信仰马列主义、毛泽东思想,不
得信仰宗教,不得参加宗教活动。共产党员信仰宗教,参加宗教活
动,违背党的性质,削弱党组织的战斗力,降低在群众中的威信,

惯,参加一些传统的婚丧仪式和群众性节日活动,不应视为信仰宗
教或参加宗教活动。对信教党员的处理,要区别不同情况,慎重对
待,妥善处理。(1)对于极少数参与煽动宗教狂热,利用宗教反对四
项基本原则,反对党的路线、方针、政策,破坏国家统一和民族团结
