导他们认真学习马克思主义,多参加一些社会实践,接触实际,了
解国情,努力提高自己的政治素质和业务水平。目前高校学生党
员人数普遍偏少,不利于发挥党组织的作用,要把学生中符合党员
条件的优秀分子吸收到党的队伍中来。
translated_text: On the 26th, the Central Organization Department, the Central Propaganda Department, the State Education Commission, the Central Committee of the Communist Youth League, and the All-China Federation of Education Workers held a joint commendation meeting in Beijing to commend 210 outstanding ideological and political workers in colleges and universities who have made outstanding achievements in recent years. Song Ping, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, Li Tieying, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, and Lv Feng, Minister of the Central Organization Department, and Wang Renzhi, Minister of the Central Propaganda Department, attended the commendation meeting and issued certificates of honor to the commended persons. After the meeting, Song Ping and Li Tieying held a discussion with some of the commended persons and some representatives attending the party building work conference of colleges and universities. After fully affirming the achievements and experience of ideological and political work in colleges and universities, Song Ping pointed out that school moral education is first to cultivate students to have a firm and correct political direction and adhere to the socialist path. Whether we can pass on the banner of socialism from generation to generation in China depends to a large extent on the success or failure of our youth education. Party organizations in colleges and universities must recognize their important responsibilities. We should carry out in-depth education on modern and contemporary history and national conditions for young students, create conditions for them to participate in social practice appropriately and contact the masses of workers and peasants, which will be of great benefit to helping them establish a correct world and life outlook in their youth. Song Ping pointed out that it is necessary to ensure that the leadership of colleges and universities is truly in the hands of people who are loyal to Marxism, and we must be determined to select outstanding cadres to enrich the leadership team of colleges and universities. Our teaching team is generally good, and the proportion of young and middle-aged teachers in colleges and universities is increasing. We should guide them to study Marxism seriously, participate in more social practice, contact reality, understand national conditions, and strive to improve their political quality and professional level. At present, the number of party members among college students is generally small, which is not conducive to the role of party organizations. We must absorb outstanding students who meet the conditions of party members into the party team.

events:
同日 中共中央发出《中共中央关于党和国家高级干部逝世
后丧事改革的通知》。《通知》规定: (一)党和国家高级干部逝世后,
丧事应本着从简的原则,由组织办理,家属、亲友要积极配合。对逝
世者生前关于丧事简办的愿望,组织和家属、亲友应予以充分尊重
和支持。(二)党和国家高级干部逝世后,不举行遗体告别仪式,不
开追悼会。(三)逝世者的生平由组织负责撰写。家属、亲友可以向
组织提供有关情况,但不应干预。(四)党和国家高级干部逝世后,
除个别经中央批准按有关民族、宗教礼仪办理丧事外,均实行火
葬,骨灰安放在当地公墓,不另建骨灰存放点,不修墓建碑。对提出
不保留骨灰的,提倡骨灰就地就近处理,不组织到外地撒散。(五)
党和国家高级干部逝世后,只公布逝世者的简要生平。要特殊报道
的,须经中央批准,并着重报道对逝者生前业绩、品德的缅怀。
translated_text: On the same day, the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice of the CPC Central Committee on the Reform of Funerals for Senior Party and State Cadres". The "Notice" stipulates: (1) After the death of senior party and state cadres, the funeral should be handled by the organization in accordance with the principle of simplicity, and the family members, relatives and friends should actively cooperate. The organization, family members, relatives and friends should fully respect and support the wishes of the deceased for a simple funeral. (2) After the death of senior party and state cadres, no farewell ceremony for the body and no memorial service will be held. (3) The organization is responsible for writing the life of the deceased. Family members, relatives and friends can provide relevant information to the organization, but should not interfere. (4) After the death of senior party and state cadres, except for a few who are approved by the Central Committee to handle funerals according to relevant ethnic and religious rituals, cremation is implemented, and the ashes are placed in local cemeteries. No additional ashes storage sites will be built, and no tombs or monuments will be built. For those who propose not to retain the ashes, it is recommended that the ashes be handled locally and nearby, and not organized to be scattered in other places. (V) After the death of a senior Party or State official, only a brief biography of the deceased will be published. Special reports must be approved by the Central Committee and should focus on commemorating the deceased's achievements and moral character.

translated_text: On the same day, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee forwarded the "Report on Several Issues That Need to be Solved to Further Give Play to the Role of the Working Class as the Main Force" by the Party Group of the All-China Federation of Trade Unions. The "Report" pointed out that it is necessary to attach importance to developing party members and selecting cadres from outstanding workers. At present, the number of party members among industrial workers is relatively small. It is recommended to further strengthen the party's work among the workers, especially among industrial workers, actively recruit outstanding workers who meet the conditions of party members to join the party, enrich the strength of party organizations on the front line of production, and gradually change the situation of lack of party members in teams. It is recommended to select and employ cadres from outstanding workers in accordance with the principle of both moral integrity and ability. The production, operation, technical and other management personnel and political workers of enterprises can be selected from outstanding workers by enterprises according to their needs and in accordance with relevant national policies and regulations through the employment system and other methods. Excellent workers with training prospects should be selected and sent to colleges and universities for further study in a planned and step-by-step manner, and they can be recommended to take up corresponding leadership positions in enterprises or selected to work in party and government agencies according to needs.

events:
27日——28日 由中央组织部召开的全国老干部先进个人、
先进集体表彰会在北京开幕。各省、自治区、直辖市,中央国家机关
各部委,中国人民解放军和新疆生产建设兵团的226名先进个人
和先进集体代表出席了会议。中央组织部部长吕枫、副部长孟连崑
在开幕式上讲话。
会议期间,中共中央政治局常委宋平到会作了重要讲话。他指
出:在座的老同志,都有几十年的革命经历,都曾在各自的岗位上
为党和人民作出了贡献。
宋平说,经济建设是全党工作的中心。今后十年,我们能不能
把国民经济搞上去,实现第二步战略目标,不仅关系到国家和民族
的振兴,而且关系到我国社会主义事业的前途和命运。只要我们走
好了这一步,就可以为21世纪的更大发展奠定坚实的基础,我们
的社会主义制度就可以进一步巩固。资产阶级政治家所鼓吹的共
产主义“大失败”就会彻底破产,社会主义的红旗就会继续高高飘
扬。所以我们一定要增强紧迫感和责任感。
宋平说,当前,西方敌对势力正加紧推行其和平演变战略。他
们的目的是要摧毁社会主义制度。对此,全党同志必须保持清醒头
脑,做好各项工作,坚持开展反腐败斗争,筑起反和平演变的钢铁
长城。
宋平强调指出,要搞好经济建设,反对和平演变,最关键的是
从政治上、思想上、组织、作风上进一步把我们党建设好,保持党
同人民群众的血肉联系。党的建设的一个核心问题是要解决好领
导权问题。我们要在以江泽民同志为核心的党中央领导下,把各级
领导班子建设成为忠诚于马克思主义的坚强的战斗集体。由于自
然规律的作用,老同志或迟或早都要退下来,这就有一个急需培养
造就革命事业接班人,正确解决新老干部的合作与交替的问题。这
是全党的责任,也是老同志的责任。我们不仅要考虑未来5年,10
年,而且要面对21世纪,培养造就一大批社会主义事业接班人。
会议期间,薄一波到会发表重要讲话。他指出,老干部、老同志
虽然年事高了,离开了第一线,但还是有自己的历史使命和历史作
用的。大家建立的功业在,大家长期奋斗在人民群众中留下的历史
影响在,大家参与创造和发展党的优良传统在,大家坚定的革命信
念和丰富的政治经验还在,这些东西在平时特别是在关键时刻,都
会起作用的,是国家和社会稳定的重要因素。
他说,对于一个老干部、老党员来说,一息尚存,革命精神就不
能衰退。按照唯物辩证法的观点,一切事物都是可变的,但对于一
个共产党员来说,共产主义的信念是永远不能改变的。离休、退休,
退居二、三线,不是革命到了头,应该继续从事一些自己力所能及
的工作,春蚕到死丝方尽。老同志要好好保持晚节,始终不忘记入
党时宣誓为共产主义事业奋斗终生的初衷。一辈子做对人民有益
的事,这是人生最大的幸福。薄一波在讲话中,针对当前国际国内
形势,对老干部、老同志提出了几点希望。一是要关心国家大事。二
是要加强学习。活到老学到老、改造到老。三是要牢记党的宗旨。
共产党人要志在事业上,功在群众中,成为群众的核心,群众的模
范。要永远和群众同呼吸共命运,与群众同甘共苦,与群众同心同
德,共济时艰,不断夺取新的胜利。四是要保持廉洁作风。
translated_text: On the 27th and 28th, the National Commendation Meeting for Advanced Individuals and Advanced Collectives of Veteran Cadres, held by the Organization Department of the Central Committee, opened in Beijing. 226 representatives of advanced individuals and advanced collectives from provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities directly under the Central Government, central government agencies, the Chinese People's Liberation Army and the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps attended the meeting. Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee Lv Feng and Deputy Minister Meng Liankun spoke at the opening ceremony. During the meeting, Song Ping, a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, delivered an important speech. He pointed out that the old comrades present had decades of revolutionary experience and had made contributions to the Party and the people in their respective positions. Song Ping said that economic construction is the center of the work of the whole Party. In the next ten years, whether we can develop the national economy and achieve the second strategic goal is not only related to the revitalization of the country and the nation, but also to the future and destiny of our country's socialist cause. As long as we take this step well, we can lay a solid foundation for greater development in the 21st century, and our socialist system can be further consolidated. The "great failure" of communism advocated by bourgeois politicians will be completely bankrupt, and the red flag of socialism will continue to fly high. Therefore, we must strengthen our sense of urgency and responsibility. Song Ping said that at present, Western hostile forces are stepping up their peaceful evolution strategy. Their goal is to destroy the socialist system. In this regard, all comrades in the party must keep a clear mind, do a good job in all aspects, persist in carrying out the fight against corruption, and build a steel Great Wall against peaceful evolution. Song Ping emphasized that in order to do a good job in economic construction and oppose peaceful evolution, the most important thing is to further build our party politically, ideologically, organizationally, and in style, and maintain the flesh-and-blood ties between the party and the people. A core issue of party building is to solve the problem of leadership. Under the leadership of the Party Central Committee with Comrade Jiang Zemin as the core, we must build the leadership teams at all levels into a strong fighting collective loyal to Marxism. Due to the role of natural laws, old comrades will retire sooner or later, which urgently needs to cultivate successors to the revolutionary cause and correctly solve the problem of cooperation and alternation between new and old cadres. This is the responsibility of the whole party and the old comrades. We should not only consider the next five or ten years, but also face the 21st century and cultivate a large number of successors to the socialist cause. During the meeting, Bo Yibo delivered an important speech. He pointed out that although the old cadres and comrades are old and have left the front line, they still have their own historical mission and historical role. The achievements you have established are there, the historical influence left by your long-term struggle among the people is there, the fine traditions of your participation in creating and developing the party are there, and your firm revolutionary beliefs and rich political experience are still there. These things will play a role in peacetime, especially at critical moments, and are important factors in the stability of the country and society. He said that for an old cadre and an old party member, the revolutionary spirit cannot decline as long as he is still alive. According to the viewpoint of materialist dialectics, everything is changeable, but for a Communist Party member, the belief in communism can never change. Retirement, retirement, retreat to the second or third line, does not mean that the revolution has come to an end. You should continue to do some work within your ability. The silkworm will not stop spinning until it dies. Old comrades should maintain their integrity and never forget the original intention of swearing to fight for the cause of communism for their whole lives when they joined the party. Doing things that are beneficial to the people for a lifetime is the greatest happiness in life. In his speech, Bo Yibo put forward several hopes for old cadres and old comrades in view of the current international and domestic situation. First, they should care about national affairs. Second, they should strengthen their studies. They should learn and reform until they are old. Third, they should remember the purpose of the party. Communists should be determined to work hard, make contributions to the masses, become the core of the masses, and be the model of the masses. They should always share the same fate with the masses, share weal and woe with the masses, be of one mind with the masses, help the masses in times of difficulty, and constantly win new victories. Fourth, they should maintain an honest style.

《毛泽东选集》第一至四卷第二版,由人民出版社出版,自7月1日

translated_text: On the 28th, Qiao Shi, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, gave a party class to the central departments and bureau-level cadres. The topic was: Strengthening the party spirit training of Communist Party members. He focused on three issues: the extreme importance of strengthening party spirit training in the new historical period; the basic requirements for strengthening party spirit training; leading cadres should take the lead in strengthening party spirit training and self-cultivation. When talking about the basic requirements for strengthening party spirit training, Qiao Shi emphasized four aspects: First, firm communist ideals and beliefs, and unswervingly adhere to the leadership of the party; Second, consciously study and master the basic theories of Marxism and Mao Zedong Thought, adhere to seeking truth from facts, integrating theory with practice, and proceeding from reality in everything; Third, firmly establish the world outlook of serving the people wholeheartedly and keep close contact with the masses; Fourth, adhere to the party's democratic centralism, strengthen organizational discipline, and carry out serious criticism and self-criticism. Qiao Shi hopes that the leading cadres and all party members of the central government agencies will set an example of diligent study, linking theory with practice, and seeking truth from facts; set an example of clean government, diligence, and close contact with the masses; set an example of not advocating empty talk and doing more practical things; set an example of persisting in reform and daring to explore; set an example of abiding by laws and regulations and resolutely fighting against unhealthy tendencies and corruption. Qiao Shi said that the central government agencies are the working institutions of the Party Central Committee and should set an example of strengthening party spirit under the direct leadership of the Party Central Committee. Every party member of the central government agencies should adhere to the principles of the Party, especially the leading cadres, who should set an example of party spirit cultivation, so as to influence and drive all party members to strengthen their party spirit and effectively strengthen party building. Weight On the 30th, according to the decision of the CPC Central Committee, the second edition of the first to fourth volumes of the Selected Works of Mao Zedong, revised by the CPC Central Committee Document Editing Committee, was published by the People's Publishing House and will be distributed in Xinhua Bookstores across the country from July 1. The second edition of Volumes 1 to 4 of Selected Works of Mao Zedong retains the original articles of the first edition, with only one article, "Oppose Book Worship", added. This revision includes the main text, explanations and notes. Volumes 1 to 4 of Selected Works of Mao Zedong include Mao Zedong's major works during the New Democratic Revolution. These works embody the scientific results of combining the basic principles of Marxism-Leninism with the practice of the Chinese revolution and are a concentrated summary of Mao Zedong Thought. Deng Xiaoping wrote the title for the second edition of Volumes 1 to 4 of Selected Works of Mao Zedong.

events:
1日 中共中央在首都人民大会堂举行万人大会,隆重庆祝
中国共产党建党70周年。党和国家领导人江泽民、杨尚昆、李鹏、
万里、李先念、乔石、宋平、李瑞环、王震等出席了大会,江泽民作长
篇重要讲话。
江泽民的讲话共三部分:一、中国共产党70年的奋斗历程;
二、当代中国共产党人的庄严使命;三、进一步加强中国共产党的
建设。
江泽民在回顾了我们党70年的奋斗历程后,把党领导各族人
民为中国社会的进步所做的许多事情,归纳为三件大事:第一,完
成反帝反封建的新民主主义革命任务,结束了中国半殖民地半封
建的历史;第二,消灭剥削制度和剥削阶级,确立了社会主义制度;
第三,开创建设有中国特色社会主义的道路,逐步实现社会主义现
代化,这件事情还正在做。这三件大事,使中国发生了翻天覆地的
变化。
江泽民指出,在70年的斗争中,我们党积累了极其丰富的经
验,归结到一点,就是把马克思主义的基本原理同中国革命和建设
的具体实践相结合,走自己的道路。
江泽民说,毛泽东同志是中国共产党和中国各族人民的伟大
领袖,是伟大的马克思主义者,是伟大的无产阶级革命家、战略家
和理论家。邓小平同志是捍卫、坚持和发展马列主义、毛泽东思想
的杰出代表,他提出的关于建设有中国特色社会主义的理论、路
线、方针和原则,是集中全党智慧和经验的创造,是在新的历史条
件下对马列主义、毛泽东思想的一个最重大的贡献。
江泽民在讲话中指出:当代中国共产党人的庄严使命是:坚持
党的基本路线,团结和带领全国各族人民,沿着建设有中国特色的
社会主义道路,自力更生、艰苦创业,把我国建设成为富强、民主、
文明的社会主义现代化国家。
江泽民全面阐述了建设有中国特色的社会主义的经济、政治、
文化后指出:加强这三方面的建设,根本的目的是为了充分调动广
大人民群众的积极性,推动社会生产力的发展和社会的全面进步。
建设有中国特色社会主义的经济、政治和文化,必须在坚持四项基
本原则的前提下,坚持改革开放的总方针。
江泽民在论述加强党的建设问题时,提出了四个方面的内容:
第一,必须努力提高全党的马克思主义水平;第二,必须努力提高
全党同志为人民服务的自觉性;第三,必须努力提高党的各级组织
的战斗力;第四,必须努力培养和造就千百万社会主义事业的接班
人。
江泽民号召,全党同志要发扬我们一贯倡导的革命精神,大
公无私和先人后己精神,严守纪律和自我牺牲精神,坚持革命乐观
主义,排除万难去争取胜利的精神,坚定不移地朝着我们的奋斗目
标迈进。
translated_text: On the 1st, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China held a 10,000-person meeting in the Great Hall of the People in Beijing to solemnly celebrate the 70th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China. Party and state leaders Jiang Zemin, Yang Shangkun, Li Peng, Wan Li, Li Xiannian, Qiao Shi, Song Ping, Li Ruihuan, Wang Zhen and others attended the meeting, and Jiang Zemin delivered a long and important speech. Jiang Zemin's speech consists of three parts: First, the 70-year struggle of the Communist Party of China; Second, the solemn mission of contemporary Chinese Communists; Third, further strengthening the construction of the Communist Party of China. After reviewing the 70-year struggle of our party, Jiang Zemin summarized the many things that the party has led the people of all ethnic groups to do for the progress of Chinese society into three major events: First, completing the task of the new democratic revolution against imperialism and feudalism, ending China's semi-colonial and semi-feudal history; second, eliminating the exploitation system and the exploiting class, and establishing the socialist system; third, opening up the road to building socialism with Chinese characteristics and gradually realizing socialist modernization, which is still being done. These three major events have brought about earth-shaking changes in China. Jiang Zemin pointed out that in the 70 years of struggle, our party has accumulated extremely rich experience, which boils down to one point, that is, combining the basic principles of Marxism with the concrete practice of China's revolution and construction, and taking its own path. Jiang Zemin said that Comrade Mao Zedong was a great leader of the Communist Party of China and the Chinese people of all ethnic groups, a great Marxist, a great proletarian revolutionary, strategist and theorist. Comrade Deng Xiaoping was an outstanding representative of defending, upholding and developing Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought. The theory, line, policy and principles he put forward on building socialism with Chinese characteristics are the creation of the wisdom and experience of the whole party, and are the most important contribution to Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought under the new historical conditions. In his speech, Jiang Zemin pointed out that the solemn mission of contemporary Chinese Communists is to adhere to the basic line of the party, unite and lead the people of all ethnic groups in the country, follow the road of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, rely on self-reliance and hard work, and build our country into a prosperous, democratic and civilized socialist modern country. Jiang Zemin comprehensively expounded on the construction of the economy, politics, and culture of socialism with Chinese characteristics, and pointed out that the fundamental purpose of strengthening the construction of these three aspects is to fully mobilize the enthusiasm of the broad masses of the people, promote the development of social productivity and the overall progress of society. To build the economy, politics and culture of socialism with Chinese characteristics, it is necessary to adhere to the general policy of reform and opening up on the premise of adhering to the four basic principles. When discussing the issue of strengthening party building, Jiang Zemin put forward four aspects: First, we must strive to improve the Marxist level of the whole party; second, we must strive to improve the consciousness of all party comrades in serving the people; third, we must strive to improve the combat effectiveness of party organizations at all levels; fourth, we must strive to cultivate and train millions of successors to the cause of socialism. Jiang Zemin called on all comrades in the party to carry forward the revolutionary spirit we have always advocated, the spirit of selflessness and putting others before oneself, the spirit of strict discipline and self-sacrifice, adhere to revolutionary optimism, and the spirit of overcoming all difficulties to win victory, and move forward unswervingly towards our goal.

events:
同日《人民日报》为庆祝中国共产党成立70周年发表社论,
题目是《坚定地走自己的路》。
社论指出,党在70年的奋斗历史中,积极累了极为丰富的经
验,千条万条,归结到一条,就是把马克思主义的普遍真理同中国
革命和建设的具体实际结合起来,走自己的路。
社论指出,走自己的路,丝毫不能脱离马克思主义,丝毫不能
脱离中国国情;如果脱离了,就必然使革命和建设遭挫折、走弯路。
只有把二者紧密地结合起来,才能前进,才能胜利。走自己的路,就
必须密切联系群众,紧紧地同人民群众站在一起,人民群众是我们
党的力量的源泉和胜利的根本。理论联系实际的过程,也就是党联
系群众的过程。我们要万分珍惜并不断加强同人民群众的血肉联
系,这是使我们的事业无往而不胜的基本保证。走自己的路,没有
现成的经验可循,只能在实践中探索前进。我们党在历史上虽然发
生过失误,遭受过挫折,但总是认真吸取教训,纠正失误,朝着既定
的目标奋进,显示了对马克思主义的坚定信仰和对人民利益的无
限忠诚,显示了用马克思主义武装起来的无产阶级政党的巨大力
社论强调指出,我们要以马克思主义的建党学说为指导,加强
党的自身建设。在新的历史时期,能不能在执政条件下继续坚持全
心全意为人民服务的宗旨,能不能在改革开放和发展商品经济的
环境中继续保持共产党人的共产主义的纯洁性,能不能筑起抵御
国内外敌对势力“和平演变”的钢铁长城,这是我们党面临的严重
考验,也是党的建设必须着重解决的重大课题。
translated_text: On the same day, the People's Daily published an editorial to celebrate the 70th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China. The title was "Resolutely Walking Our Own Road". The editorial pointed out that the Party has actively accumulated extremely rich experience in its 70-year history of struggle. All these experiences can be summed up in one sentence, which is to combine the universal truth of Marxism with the concrete reality of China's revolution and construction and walk our own road. The editorial pointed out that walking our own road cannot be separated from Marxism or China's national conditions; if we do, the revolution and construction will inevitably suffer setbacks and take detours. Only by closely combining the two can we move forward and win. To walk our own road, we must closely connect with the masses and stand firmly with the people. The people are the source of our party's strength and the root of its victory. The process of connecting theory with practice is also the process of the party connecting with the masses. We must cherish and constantly strengthen our flesh-and-blood ties with the people, which is the basic guarantee for our cause to be invincible. To walk our own road, there is no ready-made experience to follow, and we can only explore and advance in practice. Although our party has made mistakes and suffered setbacks in history, it has always carefully learned lessons, corrected mistakes, and strived towards the established goals, showing its firm belief in Marxism and its infinite loyalty to the interests of the people, and the great power of the proletarian party armed with Marxism. The editorial emphasized that we must take the Marxist theory of party building as a guide to strengthen the party's own construction. In the new historical period, whether we can continue to adhere to the purpose of serving the people wholeheartedly under the conditions of being in power, whether we can continue to maintain the communist purity of the Communists in the environment of reform and opening up and developing the commodity economy, and whether we can build a steel Great Wall to resist the "peaceful evolution" of hostile forces at home and abroad, this is a serious test facing our party and a major issue that must be focused on in party building.

events:
4日 中共中央发出关于学习《毛泽东选集》一至四卷第二版
的通知。
《通知》指出,中共中央决定,《毛泽东选集》第一至四卷第二版
在建党70周年之际出版,是一件具有重大政治意义的事情。中央
认为,《毛选》一至四卷应是今后长时期内对干部群众包括青年学
生进行思想理论教育的基本教材,是深入开展马克思列宁主义、毛
泽东思想教育的重要内容。各级干部特别是县以上领导干部应当
把《毛选》作为常备必读的政治课本,经常地坚持不懈地进行学习。
为了更好地开展《毛选》一至四卷的学习,中央强调:一、充分认识
新时期学习《毛选》一至四卷的重要意义。二、重掌握理论联系实
际的学习方法。三、把学习《毛选》一至四卷同学习十一届三中全会
以来的路线、方针、政策结合起来,同学习邓小平等同志的著作结
合起来。四、把学习《毛选》一至四卷同学习中共党史和党的建设理
论结合起来。五、把学习《毛选》一至四卷同学习马克思列宁主义基
本理论结合起来。
translated_text: On the 4th, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued a notice on studying the second edition of Volumes 1 to 4 of Selected Works of Mao Zedong. The notice pointed out that the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China decided that the second edition of Volumes 1 to 4 of Selected Works of Mao Zedong would be published on the occasion of the 70th anniversary of the founding of the Party, which is a matter of great political significance. The Central Committee believes that Volumes 1 to 4 of Selected Works of Mao Zedong should be the basic textbooks for ideological and theoretical education for cadres and the masses, including young students, for a long period of time in the future, and are an important content for in-depth education in Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought. Cadres at all levels, especially leading cadres at the county level and above, should regard Selected Works of Mao Zedong as a political textbook that must be read regularly and unremittingly. In order to better carry out the study of Volumes 1 to 4 of Selected Works of Mao Zedong, the Central Committee emphasized: 1. Fully understand the importance of studying Volumes 1 to 4 of Selected Works of Mao Zedong in the new era. 2. Focus on mastering the learning method of combining theory with practice. 3. Combine the study of Volumes 1 to 4 of Selected Works of Mao Zedong with the study of the line, principles, and policies since the Third Plenary Session of the Eleventh Central Committee, and with the study of the works of Comrade Deng Xiaoping and others. 4. Combine the study of Volumes 1 to 4 of Selected Works of Mao Zedong with the study of the history of the Communist Party of China and the theory of party building. 5. Combine the study of Volumes 1 to 4 of Selected Works of Mao Zedong with the study of the basic theories of Marxism-Leninism.

events: 6日 中共中央、国务院发出《关于成立中央机构编制委员会的通知》。《通知》指出:为了加强中央对全国机构编制工作的领导,理顺各方面的关系,加强集中统一管理,严格控制机构编制膨胀,推进机构改革和行政管理体制改革,中共中央、国务院决定成立中央机构编制委员会。《通知》规定中央机构编制委员会负责全国机构改革和机构编制管理工作。其主要职责是:(一)根据党中央、国务院关于经济体制改革和政治体制改革的要求,研究拟订机构改革和行政管理体制改革的总体方案,经党中央、国务院批准后组织实施。审核党中央各部门、国务院各部门和省级机构改革方案,按程序报党中央、国务院批准。指导地方各级机构改革和行政管理体制改革工作。(二)拟订机构编制管理的政策和法规。统一管理全国党政机关,人大、政协、法院、检察院机关,各民主党派、人民团体机关及事业单位的机构编制工作。(三)管理党中央各部门、国务院各部门的职能配置及调整工作,协调各部门之间,各部门与地方之间的职责分工。(四)审核党中央、国务院机关的机构设置方案并按程序报批。审批党中央各部门、国务院各部门的人员编制、厅局级机构的设置及领导职数,党中央各部门、国务院各部门垂直领导和双重领导以中央部门领导为主单位的机构设置和人员编制,我国驻外机构的人员编制和领导职数。(五)审核省、自治区、直辖市党委和人民政府厅局级机构的设置和人员编制,省以下地方各级党政机关的人员编制总额,报党中央、国务院批准。(六)审批全国人大、全国政协、最高人民法院、最高人民检察院和各民主党派、人民团体机关的机构设置、人员编制和司局级以上领导职数总额,必要时报党中央、国务院批准。(七)审批地方各级人大、政协、法院、检察院和各民主党派、人民团体机关的人员编制总额及分配方案。(八)审批党中央、国务院直属事业单位的机构编制及机构编制管理方面的其他重要事项,指导协调地方事业单位机构编制管理工作。(九)监督检查各级机关机构编制的执行情况。(十)完成党中央、国务院交办的与机构编制有关的其他工作任务。中央机构编制委员会下设办公室,由赵东宛兼主任,曾庆红、张志坚兼副主任。
translated_text:
On the 6th, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued the "Notice on the Establishment of the Central Organization and Establishment Committee". The "Notice" pointed out: In order to strengthen the central leadership over the national organization and establishment work, straighten out the relationship between various aspects, strengthen centralized and unified management, strictly control the expansion of organization and establishment, and promote institutional reform and administrative system reform, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council decided to establish the Central Organization and Establishment Committee. The "Notice" stipulates that the Central Organization and Establishment Committee is responsible for the national institutional reform and institutional establishment management work. Its main responsibilities are: (a) According to the requirements of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council on economic system reform and political system reform, study and formulate the overall plan for institutional reform and administrative system reform, and organize its implementation after approval by the CPC Central Committee and the State Council. Review the institutional reform plans of various departments of the CPC Central Committee, various departments of the State Council and provincial-level institutions, and submit them to the CPC Central Committee and the State Council for approval in accordance with procedures. Guide the institutional reform and administrative system reform work at all levels of local governments. (b) Formulate policies and regulations for institutional establishment management. Unified management of the institutional establishment work of the national party and government organs, the National People's Congress, the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, the courts, the procuratorates, the democratic parties, the people's organizations and public institutions. (iii) Manage the functional configuration and adjustment of the various departments of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council, coordinate the division of responsibilities between departments and between departments and localities. (iv) Review the organizational structure plans of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council and submit them for approval according to procedures. Review the staffing of the various departments of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council, the establishment of bureau-level institutions and the number of leadership positions, the organizational structure and staffing of the vertical and dual leadership units of the various departments of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council with the central department as the main leader, and the staffing and leadership positions of our country’s overseas institutions. (v) Review the establishment and staffing of bureau-level institutions of the provincial, autonomous region and municipal party committees and people’s governments, and the total number of staffing of local party and government organs at all levels below the provincial level, and submit them to the CPC Central Committee and the State Council for approval. (vi) Review the organizational structure, staffing and the total number of leadership positions above the bureau-level of the National People’s Congress, the National Committee of the Chinese People’s Political Consultative Conference, the Supreme People’s Court, the Supreme People’s Procuratorate and the organs of the democratic parties and people’s organizations, and submit them to the CPC Central Committee and the State Council for approval when necessary. (VII) Review and approve the total number of personnel and allocation plans of local people's congresses, CPPCCs, courts, procuratorates, democratic parties and people's organizations at all levels.
(VIII) Review and approve the organization establishment and other important matters of organization establishment management of institutions directly under the CPC Central Committee and the State Council, and guide and coordinate the organization establishment management of local institutions. (IX) Supervise and inspect the implementation of the organization establishment of organs at all levels. (X) Complete other work tasks related to organization establishment assigned by the CPC Central Committee and the State Council. The Central Organization Establishment Committee is headed by Li Peng and deputy director by Song Ping. The Central Organization Establishment Committee has an office, with Zhao Dongwan serving as director and Zeng Qinghong and Zhang Zhijian serving as deputy directors.

11日 新华社报道,中共中央纪律检查委员会就宁夏回族自
治区烟草专卖局局长杨杰严重违法乱纪的问题发出通报。
《通报》说,宁夏烟草专卖局党组书记、局长、烟草公司经理杨
杰利用职务之便,大量收受,索要贿赂;积名优卷烟,倒卖牟利;
向下属公司索要“业务费”、“招待费”,从中贪污;以“样品烟”拉关
系,走后门,肆意进行经济犯罪活动。杨杰贪污受贿9.2万余元,同
案犯、销售处处长王艳菊贪污受贿13.1万元,此案涉及人员之多,
犯罪金额之大,为建国以来烟草行业所罕见。杨杰已被开除党籍、
开除公职,于1990年9月被依法逮捕。
《通报》强调,纠正行业不正之风,抓领导、领导抓是关键。各级
党委和组织人事部门要在纠正行业不正之风的工作中考察和识别.
干部,在改革和发展商品经济的新形势下,要特别重视那些管钱管
物的单位和部门的领导干部的配备,坚持任人唯贤的干部路线,一
定要把德才兼备、廉洁奉公的干部选拔配备到各行业的领导岗位
上去。党的各级组织、尤其是各部门的党组织和监督检查机关都要
不断完善行业内部、外部的监督机制,发挥监督机制的效能,使党
的各级干部严格置于人民群众的监督之下。
translated_text: On the 11th, Xinhua News Agency reported that the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China issued a notice on the serious violations of law and discipline by Yang Jie, director of the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region Tobacco Monopoly Bureau. The "Notice" said that Yang Jie, secretary of the Party Committee, director, and manager of the tobacco company of the Ningxia Tobacco Monopoly Bureau, took advantage of his position to accept and demand bribes in large quantities; he accumulated high-quality cigarettes and resold them for profit; he demanded "business fees" and "entertainment fees" from subordinate companies and embezzled them; he used "sample cigarettes" to build relationships and use backdoors to engage in economic crimes at will. Yang Jie embezzled and accepted bribes of more than 92,000 yuan, and his accomplice, Wang Yanju, director of the sales department, embezzled and accepted bribes of 131,000 yuan. The number of people involved in this case and the amount of crime involved are rare in the tobacco industry since the founding of the People's Republic of China. Yang Jie has been expelled from the Party and dismissed from public office, and was arrested according to law in September 1990. The "Notice" emphasized that the key to correcting unhealthy trends in the industry is to grasp the leadership and the leadership grasps. Party committees and personnel departments at all levels should examine and identify cadres in the process of correcting unhealthy practices in the industry. Under the new situation of reform and development of commodity economy, special attention should be paid to the appointment of leading cadres in units and departments that manage money and property, and the cadre line of appointing people on the basis of merit should be adhered to. Cadres with both ability and integrity and honesty should be selected and assigned to leadership positions in various industries. Party organizations at all levels, especially party organizations and supervisory inspection agencies in various departments, should constantly improve the internal and external supervision mechanisms of the industry, give full play to the effectiveness of the supervision mechanisms, and ensure that party cadres at all levels are strictly under the supervision of the people.

思想作风建设,效果较好,值得借鉴。当前,抓领导班子思想作风建

translated_text: On the same day, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee forwarded the notice "Investigation on the CPC Huaihua Prefectural Committee's Use of the Rectification Spirit to Grasp the Ideological and Work Style Construction of County-level Leading Groups". The "Notice" pointed out that strengthening the ideological and work style construction of the leadership team is an important task proposed by the National Organization Ministers' Conference last year and this year. Over the past year, various regions and departments have done a lot of work in this regard and achieved certain results, but the development is uneven. The main problem is that there are many general calls, but not enough effective measures. The Huaihua Prefectural Committee used the spirit of rectification to grasp the ideological and work style construction of the county-level leadership team, and the effect is good, which is worth learning from. At present, the key to grasping the ideological and work style construction of the leadership team is that party organizations at all levels must raise awareness, enhance the sense of urgency, make great determination, take effective measures, strengthen specific guidance, and earnestly implement it. Organization departments at all levels should actively assist the party committee in doing a good job, conduct in-depth research on existing problems, promote good experiences and practices, and achieve results in a down-to-earth manner.

events:
15日 中共中央纪律检查委员会发出《关于严明纪律,确保
抗洪救灾斗争胜利的通知》。
中纪委在《通知》中对各级党组织和全体共产党员提出要求:
1.要在党中央、国务院的统一号令和统一指挥下,进一步增强
组织纪律性,牢固树立全局观念,一切以国家和人民的利益为重,
做到局部利益无条件地服从全局利益。 
2. 要继续发扬社会主义大协作的精神,全力以赴支持抗洪救
灾。未遭受洪涝灾害的地区和其他战线的党员干部要坚守岗位,努
力生产和工作,以实际行动支援抗洪救灾。
3.要充分发挥党组织的战斗堡垒作用和党员的先锋模范作用。
4.要严格遵守党的纪律和国家的法律法令。各级纪检机关要
严格执行党的纪律,对于只顾局部利益、个人利益,不执行党中央、
国务院号令,造成严重后果的;对于玩忽职守,失职渎职,拖拉推
诿,贻误救灾时机的;对于在抗洪救灾中经不住考验,见危不救,以
致贪生怕死,临阵脱逃的,要坚决查处。各项抗洪救灾的钱物要严
加保管,切实做到专款专物专用,对那些挪用、贪污、盗窃救灾款物
的违纪违法行为,一经发现,必须严惩不贷。
translated_text: On the 15th, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on Strict Discipline to Ensure Victory in the Fight against Floods and Disaster Relief". In the "Notice", the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection put forward requirements for party organizations at all levels and all Communist Party members: 1. Under the unified command and unified command of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, further strengthen organizational discipline, firmly establish the overall concept, put the interests of the country and the people first, and make local interests unconditionally subordinate to the overall interests. 2. Continue to carry forward the spirit of socialist cooperation and go all out to support flood control and disaster relief. Party members and cadres in areas that have not suffered from floods and other fronts should stick to their posts, work hard to produce and work, and support flood control and disaster relief with practical actions. 3. Give full play to the role of the party organization as a fighting fortress and the vanguard and exemplary role of party members. 4. Strictly abide by the party's discipline and the laws and regulations of the country. Disciplinary inspection agencies at all levels must strictly enforce party discipline and resolutely investigate and punish those who only care about local interests and personal interests, fail to implement the orders of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, and cause serious consequences; those who neglect their duties, fail to perform their duties, procrastinate and shirk their responsibilities, and miss the opportunity to provide disaster relief; those who cannot withstand the test in flood relief, fail to provide relief when in danger, and even escape from the battlefield out of fear of death. All money and materials for flood relief must be strictly kept, and special funds and materials must be used for special purposes. Once discovered, those who violate discipline and law by misappropriating, embezzling, and stealing disaster relief funds and materials must be severely punished.

events:

分发挥基层党组织和党员的作用。
《通知》要求广大基层党组织和共产党员从思想上、组织上、物
质上做好准备,严阵以待,再接再厉,发扬连续作战的精神,战胜可
能出现的更大自然灾害。0年出
《通知》希望灾区的广大基层党组织在抗洪抢险斗争中,团结
带领群众战胜困难,更好地发挥党的政治优势,深入细致地做好思
想政治工作,稳定群众情绪,增强群众信心,安排好群众生活,组织
好生产自救,把损失降到最低限度。要及时宣传抗洪救灾中党员和
群众的先进事迹,弘扬革命英雄主义精神。党委组织部门要在这场
斗争中注意做好党员、干部的考察工作。
《通知》要求灾区所有的共产党员,牢记党的全心全意为人民
服务的宗旨,把全局的利益放在第一位,把人民的利益放在第一
位,在抗洪救灾第一线继续经受生与死、公与私的考验,冲锋在前,
退却在后,不怕牺牲,克服困难,尽最大努力保护人民群众的利益。
要求各级党组织认真做好救援灾区的工作,没有受灾地区的党组
织要动员和组织党员群众艰苦奋斗,努力工作,增加生产,厉行节
约,以实际行动支援灾区人民。
translated_text: On the same day, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued a notice requiring all localities to give full play to the role of grassroots party organizations and party members in flood control and disaster relief. The "Notice" requires the grassroots party organizations and Communist Party members to be prepared ideologically, organizationally, and materially, to be ready, to make persistent efforts, to carry forward the spirit of continuous combat, and to overcome possible greater natural disasters. The "Notice" issued in 2000 hopes that the grassroots party organizations in the disaster-stricken areas will unite and lead the masses to overcome difficulties in the fight against floods and rescue, better play the party's political advantages, do a good job in ideological and political work in depth and detail, stabilize the mood of the masses, enhance the confidence of the masses, arrange the lives of the masses, organize production and self-help, and minimize the losses. It is necessary to timely publicize the advanced deeds of party members and the masses in flood control and disaster relief, and promote the spirit of revolutionary heroism. The organization department of the party committee should pay attention to the inspection of party members and cadres in this struggle. The Notice requires all Communist Party members in the disaster-stricken areas to bear in mind the Party's purpose of serving the people wholeheartedly, put the interests of the overall situation and the people first, continue to withstand the test of life and death, public and private interests on the front line of flood control and disaster relief, charge ahead, retreat behind, not be afraid of sacrifice, overcome difficulties, and do their utmost to protect the interests of the people. Party organizations at all levels are required to do a good job in rescuing the disaster-stricken areas. Party organizations in areas not affected by the disaster should mobilize and organize party members and the masses to work hard, work hard, increase production, practice strict economy, and support the people in the disaster-stricken areas with practical actions.

events:
23日 中共中央组织部、人事部联合发出《关于坚持乡镇干
部选聘制和择优录用部分优秀乡镇选聘制干部的通知》。《通知》规
定:实行乡镇干部选聘制是从优秀农民中选拔干部的主要途径,各
地区要继续坚持乡镇干部选聘制,巩固和发展改革成果。各地区可
根据国家有关政策精神逐步解决当前选聘制干部在培养使用、管
理以及生活等方面存在的实际问题,使这一制度不断完善。各地可
在坚持乡镇干部选聘制的前提下,择优录用部分选聘制干部。这项
工作要加强宏观控制,从严控制数量,严格把好质量关,有计划、有
步骤地进行。每年录用的数量由各省(自治区、直辖市)组织人事部
门根据实际需要和可能作出计划,向中央组织部、人事部写出专题
报告,经综合平衡后批准执行,各地不得突破批准和录用数额。录
用所需“农转非”指标,由地方政府主管部门统筹解决,地方组织人
事部门负责分配使用。《通知》还对录用的资格条件,录用的具体办
法和程序作了规定。
translated_text: On the 23rd, the Organization Department and the Ministry of Personnel of the CPC Central Committee jointly issued the "Notice on Adhering to the Selection and Appointment System for Township Cadres and Selectively Recruiting Some Outstanding Township Cadres under the Selection and Appointment System". The "Notice" stipulates that the implementation of the township cadre selection and appointment system is the main way to select cadres from outstanding farmers. All regions should continue to adhere to the township cadre selection and appointment system to consolidate and develop the reform achievements. All regions can gradually solve the current practical problems of the selection and appointment system cadres in terms of training, use, management and life in accordance with the spirit of relevant national policies, so as to continuously improve this system. All regions can select and recruit some selected and appointed cadres on the premise of adhering to the township cadre selection and appointment system. This work should strengthen macro-control, strictly control the quantity, strictly control the quality, and be carried out in a planned and step-by-step manner. The number of recruitments each year shall be planned by the organization and personnel departments of each province (autonomous region, municipality directly under the central government) according to actual needs and possibilities, and write a special report to the Organization Department and the Ministry of Personnel of the CPC Central Committee. After comprehensive balancing, it shall be approved for implementation. All regions shall not exceed the approved and recruited amount. The "agricultural to non-agricultural" indicators required for recruitment will be coordinated and solved by the competent departments of local governments, and the local organization and personnel departments will be responsible for allocation and use. The "Notice" also stipulates the qualifications, specific methods and procedures for recruitment.

events:
同日 中共中央党史工作领导小组组长杨尚昆主持召开中共
中央党史工作领导小组会议,审议并批准中共中央党史研究室所
著《中国共产党的七十年》一书的出版。该书是中共中央党史研究
室根据中共中央党史工作领导小组的决定,为纪念中国共产党成
立70年而撰写的。全书简明而又完整地叙述了党的历史道路和基
本经验,是一部具有相当高水平的党史著作,是干部、党员学习党
史的比较好的教材。邓小平题写了书名。
translated_text: On the same day, Yang Shangkun, head of the CPC Central Committee Party History Work Leading Group, chaired a meeting of the CPC Central Committee Party History Work Leading Group to review and approve the publication of the book "Seventy Years of the Communist Party of China" written by the CPC Central Committee Party History Research Office. The book was written by the CPC Central Committee Party History Research Office in accordance with the decision of the CPC Central Committee Party History Work Leading Group to commemorate the 70th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China. The book succinctly and completely describes the party's historical path and basic experience. It is a party history work of a fairly high level and a relatively good textbook for cadres and party members to learn party history. Deng Xiaoping wrote the title of the book.

events:
13日 中共中央政治局常委、中央党校校长乔石在全国党校
校长座谈会上发表讲话。乔石在讲话中指出,各级党校在当前新的
形势下,要把四个方面的工作抓紧抓好。第一,党校要在对干部进
行马克思主义、列宁主义、毛泽东思想教育中,更好地贯彻理论联
系实际的方针,联系国际国内形势,联系工作实际和干部思想实
际,努力提高教学质量,使干部通过党校的轮训和培训,提高思想
政治素质,增强经受各种考验的自觉性。第二,党校要着力培养
青年干部,造就忠诚于马克思主义的社会主义事业接班人上取得
经验。第三,党校要进一步加强对社会主义现代化建设中出现的一

translated_text: On the 13th, Qiao Shi, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and president of the Central Party School, delivered a speech at the National Party School Presidents Symposium. In his speech, Qiao Shi pointed out that under the current new situation, party schools at all levels must pay close attention to four aspects of work. First, party schools should better implement the principle of linking theory with practice in educating cadres on Marxism, Leninism, and Mao Zedong Thought, link the international and domestic situation, link the actual work and the actual thinking of cadres, and strive to improve the quality of teaching, so that cadres can improve their ideological and political qualities and enhance their consciousness of withstanding various tests through rotation and training in party schools. Second, party schools should focus on cultivating young cadres and gain experience in cultivating successors to the socialist cause who are loyal to Marxism. Third, party schools should further strengthen theoretical research on some major issues that have emerged in socialist modernization construction, and explore ideas and countermeasures to solve these problems. Fourth, party schools should earnestly strengthen the construction of teachers and cadres and establish necessary systems.

events: 22日 中共中央组织部、中共公安部委员会联合发出《关于试行<公安机关领导干部任职条件>的通知》。《通知》指出,公安机关是人民民主专政的重要工具之一,担负着保卫国家安全和维护社会治安的重任。因此,在选拔各级公安机关领导干部时,一定要把政治条件放在首位。同时,要充分考虑公安机关的业务特点,选配熟悉公安业务的干部。凡从非公安系统选拔和调配的,要按照“先培训,后上岗”的原则,经相应的公安院校培训后再予任命。个别确因工作急需不能培训的,应同上一级公安机关协商后先办理任命手续,并在任职后一年内安排培训。
translated_text: On the 22nd, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the CPC Public Security Committee jointly issued the "Notice on the Trial Implementation of the "Establishment Conditions for Public Security Organ Leading Cadres". The "Notice" pointed out that the public security organs are one of the important tools of the people's democratic dictatorship and are responsible for safeguarding national security and maintaining social order. Therefore, when selecting leading cadres of public security organs at all levels, political conditions must be placed first. At the same time, the business characteristics of public security organs should be fully considered and cadres familiar with public security business should be selected. Those who are selected and deployed from non-public security systems should be appointed after training in the corresponding public security academies in accordance with the principle of "training first, then taking up the post". Individuals who cannot be trained due to urgent work needs should consult with the public security organs at the next higher level to go through the appointment procedures first, and arrange training within one year after taking office. The "Establishment Conditions for Public Security Organ Leading Cadres" specifically stipulates the appointment conditions for directors and deputy directors of departments, directors and deputy directors, and directors and deputy political commissars of public security organs.

权始终掌握在真正忠于马克思主义的人手里。(二)加强思想理论
教育,努力提高青年干部的政治素质。针对目前青年干部普遍缺少

干部,应根据他们的具体情况,在今后五年内补上基层锻炼这一

这项具有战略意义的工作做好。
translated_text: On the 6th, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China made the "Decision on Grasping the Training and Education of Young Cadres". The main contents of the "Decision": (i) Training and educating young cadres is a very important and urgent task. Party organizations at all levels must be far-sighted, strengthen their sense of responsibility, improve their consciousness, and earnestly grasp the work of training and educating young cadres to ensure that the leadership of the party and the country is always in the hands of those who are truly loyal to Marxism. (ii) Strengthen ideological and theoretical education and strive to improve the political quality of young cadres. In view of the current actual situation that young cadres generally lack basic theoretical training in Marxism, theoretical training will be carried out for various types of young cadres in stages, batches, and levels in the next five years. In the training, it is necessary to establish a strict system, pay attention to the connection between theory and practice, and strengthen party spirit training. (iii) Organize young cadres to undergo training in practice. For young cadres with training prospects, especially young cadres around 40 years old, they should be selected and sent to the grassroots to serve and train purposefully. For young cadres who graduate from colleges and universities and are directly assigned to work in party and state organs at or above the prefecture (city) level, they should be given a lesson on grassroots training in the next five years according to their specific circumstances. In the future, those who are promoted to leading cadres at or above the department level in party and state organs at or above the prefecture (city) level must have more than three years of grassroots work experience. (IV) Exchange or rotate young leading cadres in a planned manner. Through several years of efforts, the following should be gradually achieved in party and state organs at all levels: All young cadres who are to be promoted to leadership positions at the next level should generally have experience in more than two jobs at the next level; under the same conditions, those who have performed well in exchanges or rotations between multiple departments and multiple jobs should be promoted and used first. (V) We should be both enthusiastic and caring for young cadres and strict with them. Party committees at all levels and their organization departments should know people and assign them to positions, directly grasp a group of outstanding young cadres at different levels, list them as reserve candidates for leadership teams at all levels and types, and formulate practical training plans and implement them conscientiously. (VI) The whole party should take action, strengthen leadership, and do a good job in training and educating young cadres. Each level should be responsible for its own work and strengthen supervision and inspection. Party committees and government personnel departments at all levels should formulate training and education plans, propose specific plans, and make specific arrangements based on the situation of young cadres in their regions and departments, and assist party committees and governments at the same level in doing a good job in this strategically significant work.

translated_text: On the 24th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued a "Notice on Serious Disciplinary Violations in the Election of the 3rd Session of the 9th People's Congress of Luoyang City, Henan Province". The "Notice" pointed out that the failure of the Luoyang Municipal People's Congress to elect a mayor in March this year was mainly caused by the former mayor, Comrade Han Xiying, who made mistakes and was demoted, and engaged in a large number of unorganized activities in order to compete for the mayor. translated_text: On the 28th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee, the General Office of the State Council, and the General Office of the Central Military Commission forwarded a notice on "Request for Instructions on Solving the Treatment Issues of Retired Cadres Transferred from the Military to the Government for Resettlement before 1981". The Organization Department, the Ministry of Civil Affairs, the Ministry of Personnel, the Ministry of Finance, and the General Political Department of the CPC Central Committee jointly requested the CPC Central Committee, the State Council, and the Central Military Commission, saying that retired cadres transferred from the military to the government for resettlement and management should not have too large a difference in treatment, regardless of when they were transferred. In particular, many retired cadres transferred before 1981 joined the army during the Agrarian Revolution and the Anti-Japanese War and made positive contributions to the founding of New China. Their current treatment is too different from that of other retired military cadres, which is indeed unreasonable and should be properly resolved. Considering that solving all the problems of these retired cadres will cost a lot of money (about 300 million yuan) and the national finance will have difficulty in bearing the burden, it is recommended to mainly solve the political and living treatment issues that need to be solved for retired cadres, and other issues should remain as they are. The specific solutions are as follows: (i) Considering that these retired cadres were directly approved for retirement by the military and were retired in 1982 according to the regulations of the State Council and the Central Military Commission, they are in the same situation as other cadres who were approved for retirement by the military and were awarded the Medal of Merit and Honor. It is recommended that the Central Military Commission award them the Medal of Merit and Honor of the Chinese People's Liberation Army. The specific implementation measures shall be formulated by the relevant departments of the General Political Department. (ii) The living benefits of retired cadres shall, in principle, follow the standards for retired military cadres from the month the document is issued. Their wages, the retirement allowance increased by the adjustment of the military salary structure in 1988, the military service salary (salary) increased in 1989, and transportation expenses, public expenses, clothing expenses, nursing expenses, laundry expenses, book and newspaper expenses, non-staple food price subsidies, funeral expenses, pensions, living allowances for survivors, and new living benefits items added in the future shall be implemented in accordance with the standards for retired military cadres transferred to local areas after 1984. Other management expenses, medical expenses, etc., shall still follow the relevant regulations for retired cadres in the resettlement area. (III) The housing needs of retired cadres who do not have houses or have housing difficulties shall be solved by the local people's government through adjustment of public housing, or included in the urban residential housing construction plan for unified arrangement and gradually solved.

translated_text:
From July 7 to 10, the Central Organization Department held a national cadre training work conference in Beijing. The main task of this conference is to conscientiously implement the spirit of Comrade Jiang Zemin’s "July 1" speech on strengthening Marxist theoretical education, improving the quality of the cadre team, and cultivating successors to the socialist cause, discuss and deploy the cadre training plan for the next five years, comprehensively improve the political theory and professional quality of cadres, and build a strong and powerful cadre team that adapts to the needs of the new situation and new tasks. Song Ping, a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, delivered an important speech entitled "Studying Marxist Theory and Strengthening Party Spirit Training" during a discussion with the conference representatives. The speech consists of three parts: 1. Cadres, especially high- and middle-level cadres, must study Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought conscientiously. Learning Marxist theory is not only about understanding book knowledge, but more importantly, learning to apply it. The training and education of cadres includes two aspects, one is theoretical education, and the other is practical training. Neither of these two aspects can be neglected. Leading cadres should be good at thinking and working independently on the premise of adhering to the correct direction, and should not wait for superiors to issue documents or for central leaders to speak for everything. Mastering the theoretical weapons of Marxism-Leninism can improve the ability to judge right from wrong and work independently. Otherwise, when encountering sudden events, one will not be able to see the essence of the matter, come up with no solution, and fail to form a force, causing losses to the party's cause. It is very dangerous for leading cadres to be not good at independent thinking and working independently and completely rely on the superiors and others. 
Second, we must pay close attention to the education of young cadres. The Central Committee has made the "Decision on Paying Close Attention to the Training and Education of Young Cadres", which is very important. The revolutionary cause must be passed down from generation to generation, and old comrades will gradually retire, and young cadres will always take over. 
At present, young cadres account for a large proportion of our country's cadre team. They grew up under the socialist system and are generally a force that can be relied on. However, we must also see that young cadres generally have little experience, lack of experience, and a shallow foundation in Marxist theory. They have not experienced the old society and have no personal experience of class exploitation and national oppression. This requires strengthening their education on China's modern and contemporary history, basic national conditions and basic Marxist theories, allowing them to participate in social practice, go to the countryside and factories to be tempered, learn the ideological qualities of the working people, and make them more determined to love our party, our country, and socialism. Strict requirements should be put forward for young cadres who have already taken up leadership positions. If the education of young cadres is done well, the hostile forces' peaceful evolution plot will fail. To educate young cadres, old comrades should do more work, make friends and talk with young people, not only to teach by words, but also to teach by example, and bring out good ideas and good work styles. There are many outstanding talents among the young people. Organization departments at all levels should pay attention to selecting outstanding cadres from them for key training and put them in important positions and difficult environments to train and improve. Attention should be paid to doing a good job in ideological and political work for college students and middle school students, and doing a good job in the work of young teachers. Now, "Mao Zedong fever" has begun to appear among young people. We must take advantage of the situation and strengthen their education on Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought. 3. We should pay attention to strengthening the party spirit. Comrades who do party work, especially those who do party organization work, should be determined to become professional revolutionaries, fight for the cause of communism all their lives, serve the people wholeheartedly, work for the party wholeheartedly, have a spirit of self-sacrifice, actively contribute, not be afraid of hardship, not be afraid of loss, resist corruption, and never get involved. When learning theory, we must combine it with reality, touch on ideas, and emphasize practical results. We must take up the weapons of criticism and self-criticism to form a political atmosphere in the party that emphasizes party spirit and principles. Comrade Zhou Enlai said that we should learn until we are old and reform until we are old. We must constantly transform our subjective world by studying Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought. In his speech at the opening ceremony, Lv Feng, Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, reviewed the remarkable achievements made in cadre training since the Third Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee of the Party under the correct leadership of the Party Central Committee and with the joint efforts of party committees, governments at all levels and the vast number of cadres. At the same time, he pointed out that cadre training is far from meeting the needs of the new situation and new tasks. The theoretical level of the whole party, especially the party's middle and high-level cadres, is still far from the ruling status of our party and the historical responsibility it shoulders. He hopes that party committees and governments at all levels will face up to the existing problems and continue to push cadre training to a new stage of development. Lu Feng pointed out that we must be good at observing and handling problems from a political perspective, always firmly believe in Marxism; have firm socialist beliefs, and persevere in building socialism with Chinese characteristics for life; have strong party spirit and principles, and dare to fight against all wrong ideas and anti-Marxist trends; have strong organizational leadership, management and professional skills, and be good at handling complex contradictions and controlling the overall situation. Lu Feng especially emphasized that the training and education of young cadres must be put on the important agenda. This major event related to the rise and fall of the party and the country must not be taken lightly or carelessly. The meeting ended on October 10. Zhao Zong, deputy director of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, made a summary speech.

translated_text:
On the 11th, the People's Daily reported that my country's government institutional reform and personnel system reform have achieved initial success. Over the past decade of reform and opening up, my country has carried out two institutional reforms from the central government to local governments. The most recent State Council institutional reform was carried out from 1988 to 1990. The number of units under the State Council has been reduced from 72 to 68, and the number of State Council staff has been reduced by nearly 8,000 compared with before the reform, a decrease of about 15%. At the same time, pilot work on local government institutional reform has also been carried out in four provinces (autonomous regions), four cities and nine counties. The achievements of my country's personnel system reform are mainly reflected in six aspects: (i) In accordance with the "four modernizations" policy for cadres, a cadre team that initially meets the needs of socialist modernization has been established. By the end of 1990, the total number of cadres in my country had reached more than 33 million, of which more than 24 million were professional and technical personnel, accounting for 2.5% of the total number of cadres. (ii) The de facto lifelong tenure of leadership positions has been abolished, and the normal alternation of new and old cadres has been basically achieved through the establishment of a normal retirement system. In recent years, an average of nearly one million cadres have retired in my country every year, and the number of retired cadres has now reached more than 8 million.
(III) In terms of cadre appointment methods, the single appointment system has been broken, and various appointment forms such as appointment, employment, and election have been adopted according to the different situations of institutions, institutions, and enterprises.
(IV) The principle of open competition is adopted, and the staff of government agencies are recruited through examinations and assessments. At present, the vast majority of provinces (autonomous regions, municipalities directly under the central government) and more than 40 departments of the State Council have implemented the examination recruitment system, and more than 30,000 government agency staff have been recruited in the past two years.
(V) The leadership and leadership exchange system has been implemented in an organized manner. It has trained and cultivated cadres and promoted the construction of clean government. Ximeiqi
(VI) Cadre training has gradually become regularized and institutionalized. According to statistics, from 1979 to 1990, about 16 million cadres of all levels and types entered cadre schools, colleges, and secondary vocational schools for full-time study.

translated_text: On October 11, 1991, at a press conference held by the Ministry of Personnel for the 14th Conference of the Eastern Region Public Administration Organization, Zhang Zhijian, Vice Minister of the Ministry of Personnel, said that the national civil service system regulations are being drafted as soon as possible, and the pilot work of the national civil service system is being carried out smoothly in six departments of the central government, namely the National Audit Office, the General Administration of Customs, the National Bureau of Statistics, the National Building Materials Bureau, the National Environmental Protection Bureau, and the State Administration of Taxation. Li Peng pointed out that the next step of administrative reform in my country will also gradually improve the civil service system. At present, we are conducting a pilot project for this work. Our civil servants must not only have the spirit of serving the people, but also be familiar with the business and have certain practical work experience. Therefore, our civil servants are mainly selected from outstanding talents in factories, rural areas and practical work departments. Civil servants selected from school graduates must also first be trained and tested in practice. Under the conditions of reform and opening up, we must pay great attention to strengthening the management of public officials, giving full play to the role of supervisory agencies, and strengthening the construction of clean and diligent government. Li Peng said that after streamlining the organization, we will gradually establish and improve the retirement system for the placement of redundant personnel, and on the other hand, arrange some people in enterprises, institutions and the tertiary industry. Li Peng said that China's current administrative institutions are divided into five levels: central, provincial, prefectural (municipal), county, and township. China has a large population, uneven population distribution in various regions, and uneven economic development. The establishment of administrative institutions will be set up in accordance with the principle of adapting measures to local conditions, and reform will be a long-term task.

The reform of administrative agencies at all levels in my country is an important part of political system reform. Therefore, our civil servants are mainly selected from outstanding talents in factories, rural areas and practical work departments. Civil servants selected from school graduates must also first be trained and tested in practice. translated_text: From the 25th to the 27th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China held a national symposium on democratic appraisal of party members in Beijing to summarize and exchange the situation and experience of implementing the "Opinions on Establishing a Democratic Appraisal System for Party Members" approved by the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China in the past few years, and to discuss in depth how to make the democratic appraisal of party members regular and institutionalized in accordance with the principle of strict party governance. Zhao Zong, deputy director of the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, spoke at the meeting. The main content of the speech: (I) The situation and basic experience of the national democratic appraisal of party members. In 1989, 40.76 million party members participated in the democratic appraisal nationwide, accounting for 82.3% of the total number of party members. In 1990, the number was 47.02 million, of which 3.72 million re-registered as party members, and the number of party members participating in the appraisal accounted for 93.4% of the total number of party members. In the past three years, party organizations in various places have actively explored and done a lot of work in carrying out this work and accumulated experience. In summary, there are mainly the following four points: (1) Integrate the education, management and supervision of party members and focus on improving the political quality of party members. (2) Correctly use the weapons of criticism and self-criticism, and rely on one's own strength to solve the problems existing in the ranks of party members. (3) Combine commending advanced people and promoting positive factors within the party with dealing with unqualified party members and overcoming negative factors to keep the party organization alive and vibrant. (4) Combine democratic evaluation of party members with democratic evaluation of branches to comprehensively strengthen the construction of the party's grassroots organizations. (II) In accordance with the principle of strict party governance, further improve the work of democratic evaluation of party members. After the democratic evaluation of party members is regularized and institutionalized, special emphasis should be placed on effectiveness, quality assurance, and attention should be paid to three links to prevent it from becoming a formality. These three links are: ideological education should be the central link; criticism and self-criticism should be advocated in a serious and earnest manner; and organizational handling should be done seriously. Democratic evaluation of party members should highlight the evaluation focus and solve the problems existing in party organizations and members in a targeted manner.

translated_text: From the 25th to the 29th, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China held a national meeting of secretaries-general of provincial, regional and municipal discipline inspection committees in Beijing. The meeting focused on how to further improve the work of discipline inspection organs under the new situation, improve the quality and efficiency of work, serve as a good adviser and assistant to the party committee, and raise the work of discipline inspection to a new level. The meeting of the Ministry of Workers proposed that under the new situation, the important tasks facing the discipline inspection organs are to closely focus on the party's basic line, strengthen the party's style, discipline and clean government, seriously investigate and deal with violations of discipline within the party, promote the healthy development of economic construction with strict discipline, and ensure that reform and opening up proceed smoothly in the direction of socialism; through unremitting anti-corruption struggle, maintain the purity of the party, and further strengthen the flesh-and-blood ties between the party and the people. The meeting proposed that "first, we must be resolute, and second, we must be persistent" in carrying out the anti-corruption struggle, which is an important measure to strengthen party building and oppose peaceful evolution. According to statistics, from 1982 to the first half of 1991, discipline inspection organs at all levels investigated and dealt with 1.78 million cases of party members violating discipline, and punished more than 1.26 million party members, including more than 270,000 expelled from the party and more than 80,000 punished by criminal law. In 1989 and 1990 alone, more than 390,000 cases of party violations were investigated and dealt with, and more than 320,000 party members were punished, including more than 70,000 expelled from the party, accounting for about 1/4 of the total number of party violations investigated and dealt with and party members punished in the past 10 years. The discussion meeting emphasized that the Secretary-General should take the construction of discipline inspection organs as a regular task and take effective measures to effectively strengthen the ideological construction, organizational construction, style construction and system construction of the organs, so that the discipline inspection organs and the majority of discipline inspection cadres can adapt to the needs of the situation and tasks and strive to do a better job.

translated_text: On the 9th and 10th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the All-China Women's Federation held a symposium in Beijing on the training and selection of female cadres in some provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities. The meeting summarized the situation of the training and selection of female cadres in the country in recent years, especially since the Changchun Conference, exchanged experiences, and put forward opinions and requirements for further improving this work. Chen Muhua, Vice Chairman of the National People's Congress and President of the All-China Women's Federation, delivered a report entitled "Improve awareness, keep working hard, and further improve the training and selection of cadres." The main contents of the "Report": Period (I) The basic situation of the current training and selection of female cadres. In the past two years, party committees at all levels have included the training and selection of female cadres on the agenda. According to incomplete statistics, in recent years, women's federations at all levels have recommended tens of thousands of outstanding female talents to party committees at the same level, among which a considerable number of female cadres have been promoted and appointed. Strengthened the training of female cadres. In view of the growth patterns and characteristics of female cadres, local organization departments and women's federations have organized special training courses for female cadres, focusing on improving their Marxist-Leninist theoretical level, psychological quality, political participation awareness and scientific management ability; many provincial, prefectural and county party committee organization departments have planned to exchange and train female cadres, so that some female cadres have improved their decision-making ability and practical work ability. The team of female cadres continues to develop. According to statistics, the number of female cadres in my country has reached 10.04 million, accounting for 30.26% of the total number of cadres. In addition, the downward trend of the proportion of women in the county and township party and government leadership teams has been basically controlled. However, the current development of work in various places is not balanced enough, and there is a serious shortage of reserve candidates for female leading cadres at all levels, which should arouse our attention. (II) The key to doing a good job in female cadre work is to continue to raise awareness. Doing a good job in training and selecting female cadres is an urgent need to promote national economic and social development; it is a manifestation of the superiority of the socialist system and an important part of the strategic task of training and cultivating millions of successors to the socialist cause. (III) Some suggestions for future work. First, continue to do a good job in basic work; second, the training of female cadres should be more targeted; third, we should broaden our horizons and seize opportunities in the selection of female cadres; fourth, the Women's Federation should find its position and angle in the training and selection of female cadres; fifth, the majority of female cadres should work hard, improve their quality, and be enterprising. Meng Liankun, deputy director of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, also delivered a speech at the meeting. The main content was: (a) further improve awareness and enhance the consciousness of doing a good job in training and selecting female cadres; (b) take effective measures to strengthen the leadership of the training and selection of female cadres; (c) strengthen training and further improve the overall quality of female cadres; (d) boldly select and use female cadres on the premise of adhering to standards.
