translated_text: On the 15th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on Several Issues Concerning Dual Management of Cadres". The "Notice" stipulates the responsibilities and powers of both the supervisors and assistants in the dual management of cadres and the appointment and removal procedures. The responsibilities of the party groups (party committees) of the relevant departments of the Central Committee are: (1) the deployment and adjustment of the party and government leadership teams, and the approval of the candidates for the party committees and the election results of the party committees of units whose party relations are not local or cross-provincial when the party committees are replaced; (2) the ideological and work style construction of the leadership team; (3) cadre inspection, assessment, appointment and removal, transfer, exchange, approval for going abroad, salary and benefits, administrative rewards and punishments, and cadre file management; (4) political review; (5) cadre political theory learning and training, cadre job position training and various business training; (6) retirement work and management of veteran cadres; (7) selection and training of reserve cadres; (8) management of the cadre team. The responsibilities of the local party committees in assisting the relevant central ministries and commissions in managing cadres are: (1) to make suggestions on the deployment and adjustment of the party and government leadership teams, and to approve the results of the party’s relations with the local party committees; (2) to assist in the ideological and work style construction of the party and government leadership teams; (3) to assist in the inspection, assessment and political review of cadres; (4) to assist in the political theory study, training and professional training of cadres; (3) to recommend outstanding cadres and assist in the exchange of cadres; (6) to assist in the management of veteran cadres; (7) to assist in the selection and training of reserve cadres. The responsibilities of the local party committee are: (1) the deployment and adjustment of the party and government leadership team, and the approval of the candidates for the party committee meeting and the election results when the party committee changes its term; (2) the ideological and work style construction of the leadership team; (3) the inspection, assessment, appointment, removal, transfer, exchange, approval of going abroad, salary, rewards and punishments, and management of cadre files; (4) the study and training of cadre political theory; (5) political review; (6) retirement work and management of veteran cadres; (7) the selection and training of reserve cadres; and (8) the management of the cadre team. The responsibilities of the Party committees (Party committees) of the relevant central departments in assisting the local Party committees in managing cadres are: (1) to propose suggestions for the deployment and adjustment of the Party and government leadership teams; (2) to assist in the ideological and work style construction of the Party and government leadership teams; (3) to assist in the inspection, assessment and political review of cadres; (4) to guide and plan the post training and various business training of cadres in the system, and arrange and implement them together with the local Party committees; (5) to recommend outstanding cadres and assist in the exchange of cadres; (6) to assist in the selection and training of reserve cadres.

events: 25日 中共中央组织部、国务院生产办公室联合发出《关于印发〈1991-1995年全国企业干部培训规划要点>的通知》。《规划要点》分六个部分:(一)指导思想和原则。企业干部培训工作必须以马列主义、毛泽东思想为指导,全面贯彻党的基本路线,为实现国民经济和社会发展十年规划和“八五”计划服务,为企业的改革发展和两个文明建设服务。企业干部培训必须坚持理论与实际相结合的原则。必须坚持改革与发展的方向。(二)目标和要求。总目标是:以岗位培训为重点,以企业领导干部及其后备人员为主要对象,对企业各级各类干部进行整体、配套培训,使干部的政治业务素质和管理能力有一个明显的提高,努力造就一支能经得起执政、改革开放和发展商品经济、反对和平演变考验的宏大的企业于部队伍,有效地为深化企业改革,强化企业管理,提高经济效益服务。培训的基本要求是:把提高企业干部的政治素质放在首位;努力提高企业干部的业务素质;继续改善企业干部队伍的文化结构。(三)主要任务。重点抓好国营大中型企业领导干部及其后备人员的岗位任职资格培训和国家考试。从1992年开始,对全国预算内企业领导干部分期分批开展岗位任职资格培训和国家考试。“八五”期间,全国预算内大中型企业厂长(经理)、党委书记、工会主席及总工程师、总经济师、总会计师,除参加过岗位职务培训的以外,都要按规定参加一次岗位任职资格培训和国家考试。对后备人员培训的内容和要求参照现职企业领导干部的办法,采取全脱产培训形式进行,逐步做到先培训后上岗。要抓紧关键性岗位的干部培训,对现任车间主任和工段长,要在“八五”期间培训一遍。要根据企业实际需要开展学历教育。企业领导干部和大中型企业的其他干部,在规划期内都要达到岗位规范所要求的文化水平。要继续开展对外合作培训,提高和扩大引进效益。要认真抓好企业技术干部的继续教育。重视和加强对企业青年干部的培养。(四)培训基地、教师队伍及教材建设。(五)政策和措施。“八五”期间,大中型工交企业新任厂级领导干部必须做到持有证书,方能任职或承包企业。经选举产生的党委书记、工会主席,未取得培训证书的应在选举、任命后二年内取得培训证书。要建立培训工作目标责任制、干部学习登记制、干部培训质量检查评估制等。还要加强企业干部教育管理队伍的自身建设,努力建设一支政治素质优良,熟悉业务工作,热爱干部培训事业,密切联系企业,勇于开拓前进的企业干部教育管理队伍。此外,还要保证必要的培训经费。(六)管理和分工。企业领导干部培训工作,由全国企业管理干部培训工作领导小组统一领导。国务院生产办公室承担领导小组办公室日常工作,负责企业干部培训工作的规划协调、组织指导和督促检查,重点抓好预算内企业领导干部培训工作,指导经济管理干部学院和企业管理培训中心的有关业务建设。
translated_text:
On the 25th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council Production Office jointly issued the "Notice on Issuing the 1991-1995 National Enterprise Cadre Training Plan Outline". The "Plan Outline" is divided into six parts: (I) Guiding ideology and principles. Enterprise cadre training must be guided by Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought, fully implement the Party's basic line, serve the realization of the Ten-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development and the "Eighth Five-Year Plan", and serve the reform and development of enterprises and the construction of two civilizations. Enterprise cadre training must adhere to the principle of combining theory with practice. It must adhere to the direction of reform and development. (II) Goals and requirements. The overall goal is: focus on job training, take enterprise leaders and their reserve personnel as the main objects, conduct overall and supporting training for all types of cadres at all levels of enterprises, so that the political and professional quality and management ability of cadres will be significantly improved, and strive to create a large enterprise cadre team that can withstand the test of governing, reform and opening up, developing commodity economy, and opposing peaceful evolution, and effectively serve to deepen enterprise reform, strengthen enterprise management, and improve economic efficiency. The basic requirements for training are: to put the improvement of the political quality of enterprise cadres first; to strive to improve the professional quality of enterprise cadres; and to continue to improve the cultural structure of the enterprise cadre team.
(III) Main tasks. Focus on the post qualification training and national examinations for leading cadres and reserve personnel of state-owned large and medium-sized enterprises. Since 1992, post qualification training and national examinations have been carried out in stages and batches for leading cadres of enterprises within the national budget. During the "Eighth Five-Year Plan" period, the factory directors (managers), party committee secretaries, union chairmen, chief engineers, chief economists, and chief accountants of large and medium-sized enterprises within the national budget, except those who have participated in post job training, must participate in post qualification training and national examinations once according to regulations. The content and requirements of the training of reserve personnel refer to the methods of current enterprise leaders, and adopt the form of full-time training, and gradually achieve training before taking up the post. We must speed up the training of cadres in key positions, and train the current workshop directors and section chiefs during the "Eighth Five-Year Plan" period. We must carry out academic education according to the actual needs of enterprises. Leading cadres of enterprises and other cadres of large and medium-sized enterprises shall reach the cultural level required by the job specifications within the planning period. We shall continue to carry out foreign cooperation training to improve and expand the benefits of introduction. We shall earnestly grasp the continuing education of technical cadres of enterprises. We shall attach importance to and strengthen the training of young cadres of enterprises. (IV) Construction of training bases, teaching staff and teaching materials. (V) Policies and measures. During the "Eighth Five-Year Plan" period, new factory-level leading cadres of large and medium-sized industrial and transportation enterprises must hold certificates before they can take up their posts or contract enterprises. Party secretaries and labor union chairmen elected by elections who have not obtained training certificates shall obtain training certificates within two years after election and appointment. We shall establish a training work target responsibility system, a cadre learning registration system, and a cadre training quality inspection and evaluation system. We shall also strengthen the self-construction of the enterprise cadre education and management team, and strive to build a team of enterprise cadre education and management with excellent political qualities, familiarity with business work, love for cadre training, close contact with enterprises, and courage to forge ahead. In addition, necessary training funds shall be guaranteed. (VI) Management and division of labor. The training of enterprise leaders is under the unified leadership of the National Leading Group for Enterprise Management Leaders Training. The State Council Production Office is responsible for the daily work of the Leading Group Office, and is responsible for the planning, coordination, organization, guidance, supervision and inspection of enterprise leader training, focusing on the training of enterprise leaders within the budget, and guiding the relevant business construction of the Economic Management Cadre College and the Enterprise Management Training Center.

translated_text:
From the 25th to the 29th, the 8th Plenary Session of the 13th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China was held in Beijing. 
171 members of the Central Committee and 105 alternate members of the Central Committee attended the meeting. Members of the Central Advisory Committee, members of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and relevant leaders attended the meeting. The plenary session was chaired by the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, and Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, delivered an important speech. 
The plenary session reviewed and passed the "Decision of the CPC Central Committee on Further Strengthening Agricultural and Rural Work". The Decision consists of ten parts: 1. Achievements in agriculture and rural work in the 1980s and the main tasks in the 1990s; 2. Stabilize and improve the Party's basic policies in rural areas and continue to deepen rural reform; 3. Continue to adjust the rural industrial structure and promote the comprehensive development of the rural economy; 4. Implement the development strategy of revitalizing agriculture through science and technology and education; 5. Accelerate the comprehensive management of major rivers, lakes and lakes and carry out extensive basic construction of farmland water conservancy; 6. Increase agricultural investment to a considerable extent and accelerate the development of agricultural industry; 7. Do a good job in poverty alleviation and coordinated development among regions to promote common prosperity; 8. Effectively strengthen the construction of rural grassroots organizations; 9. Continue to carry out in-depth socialist ideological education and strengthen the construction of rural spiritual civilization and democratic legal system; 10. Further strengthen the Party's leadership over rural work. The Plenary Session fully affirmed the Party's basic policies in rural areas since the Third Plenary Session of the Eleventh Central Committee and highly praised the great achievements made in my country's rural reform and construction in the 1980s. The great transformation of China's rural areas is a great creation of the Chinese Communists represented by Comrade Deng Xiaoping, who combined the basic principles of Marxism with China's specific reality, and has greatly enriched the theory and practice of our party's construction of socialism with Chinese characteristics. The meeting stressed that we must unswervingly deepen rural reform and promote the comprehensive development of the rural economy. We must continue to stabilize the responsibility system based on household contract responsibility system, constantly improve the two-tier management system combining centralization and decentralization, actively develop the agricultural social service system, gradually strengthen the strength of the collective economy, and guide farmers to the path of common prosperity. The plenary session reviewed and passed the "Resolution on Convening the 14th National Congress of the Communist Party of China" and determined that the 14th National Congress of the Party will be held in Beijing in the fourth quarter of next year. The plenary session believes that the 14th National Congress of the Party will be a meeting of great significance in the process of my country's socialist modernization, and will have a huge and far-reaching impact on the great cause of inheriting the past and advancing the construction of socialism with Chinese characteristics. To welcome the convening of the 14th National Congress, the most important thing is to fully implement the Party's focus on economic construction, adhere to the four basic principles, adhere to the basic line of reform and opening up, strive to consolidate and develop a stable and united political situation, continue to deepen reform and expand opening up, and concentrate on doing a better job in economic work and other work. We must adhere to strict party governance, earnestly improve the party's ideology, organization and style of work, strive to improve the theoretical level of Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought and the political quality of the majority of party members and cadres, especially leading cadres, and enhance the party's cohesion and combat effectiveness. The plenary session called on all levels of party organizations and all Communist Party members to closely unite around the Party Central Committee with Comrade Jiang Zemin as the core, lead the people of all ethnic groups in the country, work hard and strive hard, and welcome the convening of the 14th National Congress of the Party with outstanding achievements in reform and construction.

events:
9日 中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅联合发出《关于认真检
查对严禁用公款吃喝送礼等有关规定执行情况的通知》。
《通知》指出:近几年,党中央、国务院对制止用公款请客送礼、
滥发钱物和公费旅游等不正之风,多次发布文件,作出了明确规
定,各地区、各部门也制定了相应制度和措施,取得了一定成效。但
也有相当一些地区和部门没有认真执行。当前用公款吃喝送礼、挥
霍浪费之风又重新抬头,广大群众对此反映强烈,如任其蔓延,党
和政府就会严重脱离群众失信于民。因此,今后在惩治腐败,加强
党风廉政建设的工作中,要认真检查有关规定的执行情况,采取
切实措施把这几股歪风坚决刹住。为此,党中央、国务院重申:1、各
级党和国家机关及其工作人员(包括离休、退休人员,下同)在国内
进行各种公务活动(外事活动除外),严禁用公款搞任何形式的宴
请。上级到下级单位(包括到企业、事业单位)、同级之间、地区之间
进行公务活动,需在住所或到单位就餐时,一律吃工作餐,坚决取
消每到一地要请吃一顿的做法。2、党和国家机关及其工作人员在
国内公务活动中,不得以任何名义赠送和接受礼物,下级单位不得
给上级单位或上级领导送礼,各省、自治区、直辖市一律不准给中
央领导同志、中央和国家机关送礼。3、各地区、各部门、各单位不得
以任何借口,任何形式滥发奖金、补贴、津贴、购物券和实物,不准
借召开各种会议及纪念、庆祝等活动的名义发纪念品或礼物。4、不
准借出差、开会、参观、学习、培训和考察等名义用公款旅游。
《通知》还要求从领导机关和领导干部抓起,特别是中央和国
家机关各部门要带好头。今后各地区、各部门都要把执行党中央、
国务院关于严禁用公款吃喝送礼等有关规定的情况,作为领导干
部民主生活会的重要内容,并将检查情况及时报告中央。
translated_text: On the 9th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council jointly issued the "Notice on Carefully Checking the Implementation of Relevant Provisions on Strictly Prohibiting the Use of Public Funds for Eating, Drinking and Giving Gifts". The "Notice" pointed out: In recent years, the Party Central Committee and the State Council have issued documents and made clear regulations on stopping the unhealthy practices of using public funds for entertaining and giving gifts, indiscriminate distribution of money and materials, and public-funded travel. Various regions and departments have also formulated corresponding systems and measures, and have achieved certain results. However, there are also quite a few regions and departments that have not implemented them seriously. At present, the trend of using public funds for eating, drinking, giving gifts, and squandering has re-emerged, and the masses have strong reactions to this. If it is allowed to spread, the party and the government will seriously lose touch with the masses and lose the trust of the people. Therefore, in the future, in the work of punishing corruption and strengthening the construction of party style and clean government, we must carefully check the implementation of relevant regulations and take practical measures to resolutely stop these unhealthy practices. To this end, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council reiterate: 1. Party and state organs at all levels and their staff (including retired personnel, the same below) are strictly prohibited from using public funds to hold any form of banquets when conducting various official activities in China (except for foreign affairs activities). When superiors visit subordinate units (including enterprises and institutions), between the same level, and between regions for official activities, they must eat working meals at their residences or units, and resolutely abolish the practice of treating each place to a meal. 2. Party and state organs and their staff are not allowed to give or accept gifts in any name during domestic official activities. Subordinate units are not allowed to give gifts to superior units or superior leaders. All provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities are not allowed to give gifts to central leaders, central and state organs. 3. All regions, departments, and units are not allowed to abuse bonuses, subsidies, allowances, shopping coupons, and physical objects under any pretext or in any form, and are not allowed to give souvenirs or gifts in the name of holding various meetings and commemorative and celebratory activities. 4. It is not allowed to use public funds for travel in the name of business trips, meetings, visits, studies, training and inspections. The "Notice" also requires that the leading organs and leading cadres should take the lead, especially the central and state organs and departments. In the future, all regions and departments should make the implementation of the relevant regulations of the Party Central Committee and the State Council on strictly prohibiting the use of public funds for eating, drinking and giving gifts as an important part of the democratic life meeting of leading cadres, and report the inspection results to the central government in a timely manner.

9日——13日 全国省、自治区、直辖市党委组织部长会议在
北京召开。参加会议的主要有各省区市党委组织部长、计划单列市
党委组织部长、中央和国家机关各部委组织人事部门的负责人等,
共253人。开幕式上,中央组织部部长吕枫作了题为《紧紧围绕迎
接党的十四大,扎扎实实做好一九九二年的组织工作》的报告。 会
议期间,代表们认真讨论了1992年的组织工作,7位同志介绍了
工作经验。会议研究部署了十四大代表选举的具体事项。中央组
织部副部长孟连崑作了《以高度负责的精神做好十四大代表的选
举工作》的讲话。中央书记处书记、中央统战部部长丁关根就统战
工作和对非党干部的实职安排等问题作了讲话。会议闭幕前,中央
政治局常委宋平与部分会议代表进行座谈并作了重要讲话。闭幕
式上,吕枫作了总结讲话。
吕枫在工作报告中回顾了1991年的组织工作后说,1992年
组织工作总的要求是,认真贯彻十三届八中全会和中央工作会议
精神,以做好十四大组织准备工作为重点,紧紧围绕经济建设这个
中心,从严治党,大力加强各级领导班子建设,基层党组织建设和
党员、干部队伍建设,为继续贯彻执行党的基本路线,顺利实现第
二步战略目标,挫败西方敌对势力的和平演变图谋,维护国家的长
治久安,提供更坚强的组织保证。
吕枫在报告中部署了1992年的主要工作任务:一、切实做好
十四大代表的选举和干部考察、领导班子调整工作;二、突出重点,
继续抓好领导班子的思想作风建设;三、把培养和造就社会主义事
接班人的工作向前推进一步;四、加强对党员和干部的教育,坚
定信念,增强党性;五、分类指导,狠抓薄弱环节,全面加强基层党
组织建设。
吕枫说,1992年的组织工作中,有大量的人事准备工作要做。
在工作中,一定要坚持德才兼备的原则,把德放在第一位;一定要
重视干部的实践锻炼和在关键时刻的表现;一定要注意领导班子
结构的合理搭配;一定要进一步拓宽视野,广泛发现优秀人才;一
定要把领导班子成员的增补、调整与干部交流、岗位轮换结合起来
进行,一定要选配好领导班子的主要负责人。
吕枫说,1992年要突出重点,继续抓好领导班子的思想作风
建设。这个问题要同干部考察和班子调整结合起来,同整顿领导机
关作风结合起来,同抓下级的思想作风结合起来。画海长发麻
吕枫强调指出,各级组织、干部部门一定要加强自身建设,牢
固树立“服从服务于经济建设这个中心”的思想,加强督促检查和
具体指导,用优异的工作成绩,迎接党的十四次全国代表大会的胜
利召开。
丁关根在讲话中回顾了毛泽东、邓小平和江泽民同志关于统
一战线工作的一系列重要论述后指出,在九十年代,在建设有中国
特色的社会主义、实现第二步战略目标中,爱国统一战线负有重
任,工作大有可为。要坚持和完善中国共产党领导的多党合作和政
治协商制度;要完成各民主党派、无党派人士、少数民族、宗教等各
界党外代表人物由老一代向新一代的逐步过渡;要加强党外知识
分子工作,充分调动他们的积极性;要认真贯彻民族区域自治法,
深入细致地做好民族工作;要更加自觉地加强宗教工作,要进一步
做好对台工作;要做好非公有制经济代表人物的工作;要加强统一
战线中的思想教育工作。
丁关根阐述了在九十年代统战工作中,搞好非党干部实职安
排的重要政治意义,希望通过统一战线理论政策的宣传教育,提高
全党对党外人士实职安排工作的认识,切实做好这项工作。他说,
在新的历史时期,随着国内阶级状况和统一战线内部关系的根本
变化,党同党外人士合作共事已建立在共同的政治基础上,是一种
崭新的社会主义同志关系,要进一步加强和改善党同党外人士的
合作共事关系。党对党外人士,要坚持一放手、二帮助的原则,在政
治上信任,放手发挥他们的作用,帮助他们做出成绩;要切实保证
党外干部有职有权有责;要坚持党外干部商量办事;要和党外干
部交朋友;要给予党外干部学习提高的机会;要妥善安排党外干部
的生活。
孟连崑的讲话主要内容有:一、充分认识做好十四大代表选举
工作的重要意义。二、按照中央通知的要求,确保代表的政治素质
和代表构成的广泛性。把握代表的政治素质,特别要注意以下两
点:一是政治立场和政治倾向。他们必须具有坚定的共产主义信:
念,经得起执政;改革开放和反“和平演变”的考验;能自觉、全面地
坚持和执行党的以经济建设为中心,坚持四项基本原则,坚持改革
开放的基本路线。二是道德品质和思想作风。他们必须能自觉坚
持党的全心全意为人民服务的宗旨;能正确处理局部利益与全局
利益,眼前利益与长远利益,以及国家、集体、个人三者利益的关
系;公道正派,勇于同不良倾向和错误思想行为作斗争;清正廉洁,
密切联系群众,受到群众的拥护。三、一定要认真做好代表候选人

按规定的程序办事。五、加强对代表选举工作的领导。

主要内容:(一)认真做好党的十四大有关组织方面的准备工作。
(二)继续抓好党的建设,提高党的战斗力。
宋平说,开好十四大,对于动员全党全国各族人民完成十年
规划和“八五”计划,实现第二步战略目标,增强我们的综合国力,

立场的人,政治上的投机分子进入领导班子。考察和任用干部还应
注意干部的思想品德和工作才干。特别是各级领导骨干,要有坚强
的党性,有改革开放的意识,公道正派,能够团结各方面同志一道
工作,廉洁奉公,真正全心全意为人民服务。组织部门要严格把好
这个关,否则就没有尽到自己的责任。宋平说,在考察工作中,我们

translated_text:
From the 9th to the 13th, the National Conference of Organization Ministers of Provincial, Autonomous Region and Municipal Party Committees was held in Beijing. The main participants of the conference included the Organization Ministers of Provincial, Autonomous Region and Municipal Party Committees, the Organization Ministers of Municipal Party Committees with Independent Planning, and the heads of the Organization and Personnel Departments of various ministries and commissions of the Central Government and the State Organs, totaling 253 people. At the opening ceremony, Lv Feng, Minister of the Central Organization Department, delivered a report entitled "Focusing on Welcoming the 14th National Congress of the Party and Doing a Solid Job in the Organization Work in 1992". During the meeting, the delegates seriously discussed the organizational work in 1992, and 7 comrades introduced their work experience. The meeting studied and arranged the specific matters of the election of delegates to the 14th National Congress. Meng Liankun, Deputy Minister of the Central Organization Department, delivered a speech entitled "Doing a Good Job in the Election of Delegates to the 14th National Congress with a Highly Responsible Spirit". Ding Guangen, Secretary of the Central Secretariat and Minister of the Central United Front Work Department, delivered a speech on issues such as the united front work and the actual job arrangements for non-party cadres. Before the closing of the meeting, Song Ping, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee, held a discussion with some delegates to the meeting and delivered an important speech. At the closing ceremony, Lv Feng made a summary speech. In his work report, Lv Feng reviewed the organizational work in 1991 and said that the general requirements for organizational work in 1992 are to conscientiously implement the spirit of the Eighth Plenary Session of the 13th Central Committee and the Central Working Conference, focus on the organizational preparations for the 14th National Congress, closely focus on economic construction, strictly govern the party, vigorously strengthen the construction of leadership teams at all levels, grassroots party organizations and party members and cadres, and provide a stronger organizational guarantee for continuing to implement the party's basic line, smoothly achieving the second step of the strategic goal, thwarting the peaceful evolution plot of Western hostile forces, and maintaining the country's long-term stability. In his report, Lv Feng arranged the main tasks for 1992: 1. To do a good job in the election of representatives to the 14th National Congress, cadre inspection and leadership team adjustment; 2. To highlight key points and continue to do a good job in the ideological and work style construction of the leadership team; 3. To push forward the work of training and cultivating socialist successors; 4. To strengthen the education of party members and cadres, strengthen their beliefs and enhance their party spirit; 5. To provide classified guidance, focus on weak links and comprehensively strengthen the construction of grassroots party organizations. Lv Feng said that there is a lot of personnel preparation work to be done in the organizational work in 1992. In the work, we must adhere to the principle of both moral integrity and ability, and put morality first; we must attach importance to the practical training of cadres and their performance at critical moments; we must pay attention to the reasonable matching of the leadership team structure; we must further broaden our horizons and widely discover outstanding talents; we must combine the addition and adjustment of leadership team members with cadre exchanges and job rotations, and we must select the main leaders of the leadership team. Lv Feng said that in 1992, we must highlight key points and continue to do a good job in the ideological and work style construction of the leadership team. This issue should be combined with cadre inspection and team adjustment, with the rectification of leadership style, and with the ideological style of subordinates. Huahai Changfa Ma
Lv Feng emphasized that organizations and cadre departments at all levels must strengthen their own construction, firmly establish the idea of "obeying and serving the center of economic construction", strengthen supervision and inspection and specific guidance, and use excellent work achievements to welcome the successful convening of the 14th National Congress of the Party.
In his speech, Ding Guangen reviewed a series of important statements by Mao Zedong, Deng Xiaoping and Jiang Zemin on the work of the united front and pointed out that in the 1990s, in building socialism with Chinese characteristics and achieving the second strategic goal, the patriotic united front has a heavy responsibility and great work to do. We must uphold and improve the multi-party cooperation and political consultation system under the leadership of the Communist Party of China; we must complete the gradual transition of non-party representatives from the old generation to the new generation, including democratic parties, non-party personages, ethnic minorities, religions, etc.; we must strengthen the work of non-party intellectuals and fully mobilize their enthusiasm; we must conscientiously implement the Law on Regional Ethnic Autonomy and do a good job in ethnic work in depth and detail; we must more consciously strengthen religious work, further do a good job in Taiwan work; we must do a good job in the work of representatives of the non-public economy; we must strengthen ideological education work in the united front. Ding Guangen elaborated on the important political significance of doing a good job in the actual job arrangement of non-party cadres in the united front work in the 1990s, hoping that through the propaganda and education of the united front theory and policy, the whole party will improve its understanding of the actual job arrangement of non-party personages and do a good job in this work. He said that in the new historical period, with the fundamental changes in the domestic class situation and the internal relations of the united front, the cooperation and work between the party and non-party personages has been established on a common political basis, which is a brand-new socialist comradeship. We must further strengthen and improve the cooperation and work relationship between the party and non-party personages. The Party should adhere to the principle of "let go" and "help" for non-Party members, trust them politically, let them play their roles, and help them achieve results; ensure that non-Party cadres have positions, rights and responsibilities; insist on discussing matters with non-Party cadres; make friends with non-Party cadres; give non-Party cadres opportunities to learn and improve; and properly arrange the lives of non-Party cadres.
The main contents of Meng Liankun's speech are: 1. Fully understand the importance of doing a good job in the election of representatives to the 14th National Congress. 2. Ensure the political quality of representatives and the breadth of the composition of representatives in accordance with the requirements of the Central Committee's notice. To grasp the political quality of representatives, special attention should be paid to the following two points: 1. Political stance and political inclination. They must have firm communist beliefs, be able to withstand the test of governing, reform and opening up, and fighting "peaceful evolution"; and be able to consciously and comprehensively adhere to and implement the Party's basic line of focusing on economic construction, adhering to the four basic principles, and adhering to reform and opening up. 2. Moral quality and ideological style. They must consciously uphold the Party's purpose of serving the people wholeheartedly; correctly handle the relationship between local interests and overall interests, immediate interests and long-term interests, and the interests of the state, the collective, and the individual; be fair and upright, and have the courage to fight against bad tendencies and wrong thoughts and behaviors; be honest and upright, keep close contact with the masses, and be supported by the masses. 3. We must do a good job in the preliminary investigation of candidate representatives. 4. The election of representatives must fully promote democracy and strictly follow the prescribed procedures. 5. Strengthen the leadership of the election of representatives. During the meeting, Song Ping, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, held a discussion with some comrades attending the National Conference of Organization Ministers of Provincial, Autonomous Region, and Municipal Party Committees and delivered an important speech. The main content of the speech: (a) Do a good job in the preparation of the organization of the 14th National Congress of the Party. (b) Continue to do a good job in party building and improve the party's combat effectiveness. Song Ping said that holding the 14th National Congress well is of great significance for mobilizing the whole party and people of all ethnic groups in the country to complete the Ten-Year Plan and the Eighth Five-Year Plan, achieve the second strategic goal, and enhance our comprehensive national strength; it is also of great significance for further strengthening party building, enabling our party to withstand the three major tests, and consolidate and develop the socialist cause. When talking about the election of representatives to the 14th National Congress, the National People's Congress, the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, the government and local party committees, Song Ping asked the organization department to do the relevant organizational preparation work in a very serious and earnest spirit and a high sense of political responsibility under the leadership of the party committee in accordance with the requirements of the central government. Special attention should be paid to three links: First, do a good job in cadre inspection. It is necessary to pay attention to the political stance and performance of cadres at critical moments to prevent oversight in the appointment of personnel, so as to prevent people who doubt or even deny Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought, people who adhere to the bourgeois liberal stance, and political speculators from entering the leadership team. When inspecting and appointing cadres, attention should also be paid to the ideological and moral qualities and work abilities of cadres. In particular, the leading cadres at all levels should have strong party spirit, awareness of reform and opening up, be fair and upright, be able to unite comrades from all walks of life to work together, be honest and dedicated, and truly serve the people wholeheartedly. The organization department must strictly control this, otherwise it will not fulfill its responsibilities. Song Ping said that in the investigation work, we must also pay attention to expanding our horizons and discovering a group of young or relatively young outstanding cadres. We must pay attention to selecting cadres from those with practical experience. If we have identified them, we must boldly select them and give them heavy responsibilities. For those cadres who are really not suitable for their current positions, we must also be determined to adjust them to jobs that are suitable for their moral and professional conditions. The selection of cadres must be carried out strictly in accordance with procedures and must be carried out from all corners of the country. We must prevent unhealthy trends in the use of personnel, and those who ask for official positions cannot be given official positions. Second, we must fully promote democracy and follow the mass line. Third, we must consider the overall situation. Whether it is the election of representatives to the 14th National Congress or the change of terms of the National People's Congress, the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, the government, and the Party Committee, there is a problem of overall consideration. In conjunction with the change of leadership, there is also the issue of cadre exchange, which also needs to be considered comprehensively.
When talking about strengthening party building, Song Ping said that our party building has always been closely linked with the party's political line. We must educate the majority of party members and cadres to deeply understand and correctly implement the party's basic line. Not only comrades doing economic work should always keep in mind that economic construction is the center, but comrades doing organizational work and other work should also always keep in mind that economic construction is the center, consciously focus on this center, and do their work well. Adhering to the four basic principles and adhering to reform and opening up are ultimately for the purpose of making our economic construction better. 
Song Ping pointed out that in terms of organizational construction, we must make the party organization and party members play a role through our work. We must carry out socialist ideological education and effectively build grassroots organizations.
Song Ping said that by strengthening ideological construction and organizational construction and enhancing the party's combat effectiveness, comrades in the organization department shoulder important responsibilities and have a broad space to display their talents. I hope that comrades will work hard and make new achievements in this regard.

On the 29th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on Printing and Distributing the 1991-1995 National Cadre Training Plan". Third, the requirements for various types of cadre training, including learning time, content, methods, etc., are clearly stipulated. Fourth, measures to be taken to improve cadre training. These include: giving full play to the role of training bases such as party schools and cadre schools; strengthening teaching materials; strengthening the leadership team and teaching staff of party schools and cadre schools; effectively guaranteeing cadre training funds; further establishing and improving cadre training systems, etc.

We must further strengthen the party's ideological construction, organizational construction, and style construction, strive to improve the theoretical level of Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought and the political quality of the majority of party members and cadres, especially leading cadres, strengthen the party's ties with the people, resolutely correct unhealthy tendencies, and continuously improve the party's combat effectiveness and cohesion. translated_text:

When talking about strengthening the cadre team building in ethnic minority areas, Jiang Zemin said that over the past 40 years, tens of thousands of Han cadres, workers, intellectuals, and PLA officers and soldiers have responded to the party's call to work and live in ethnic minority areas, and have made great contributions to the development of fraternal ethnic groups and the prosperity and progress of ethnic minority areas. The people of all ethnic groups will never forget them. In the future, Han comrades and ethnic minority comrades should continue to carry forward the fine tradition of mutual respect and mutual learning, work together, work hard, and make greater contributions to the prosperity and development of ethnic minorities and ethnic minority areas. Minority cadres have extensive and close ties with members of their own ethnic groups and are the backbone of our party's work in ethnic affairs. In order to meet the needs of socialist modernization and reform and opening up, Party committees at all levels should make greater efforts to further strengthen the training of ethnic minority cadres, especially middle and senior cadres and various scientific and management talents. We should not only expand the number of cadres in a planned way, but also work hard to improve their quality and structure; we should not only pay attention to selecting a group of cadres from ethnic minorities who can play a backbone role in the 1990s, but also pay attention to selecting a group of outstanding young and middle-aged cadres across the century. When talking about further strengthening the Party's leadership over ethnic work, Jiang Zemin emphasized that the Communist Party of China is the core force leading my country's socialist cause and the core force for the unity of the Chinese nation. To strengthen the Party's leadership over ethnic work, we must first unswervingly implement the Party's basic line, adhere to seeking truth from facts, proceed from reality in everything, solve my country's ethnic issues, and vigorously strengthen the education of Marxist ethnic views and the Party's ethnic policies among cadres and masses of all ethnic groups. Communist Party members, especially Party cadres, regardless of their nationality, must firmly establish the Marxist world outlook, and through their exemplary role, influence and lead the masses of their own nationality and other nationalities to bravely advance along the road of socialism with Chinese characteristics.
Premier Li Peng of the State Council also delivered a speech at the end of the conference. In his speech, he pointed out that in order to adapt to the needs of the reform and opening-up situation, the vast number of cadres in ethnic minority areas and ethnic minority areas must further emancipate their minds and actively explore. In the future, we must continue to pay attention to expanding the number of ethnic minority cadres, but also pay attention to improving the structure and improving their quality. We must proceed from the actual conditions of various regions, departments and ethnic groups and pay attention to cultivating more economic, scientific and technological, and management talents of ethnic minorities. All departments, systems and industries should actively adopt various methods and forms to help ethnic minority areas cultivate various professional talents. We must educate cadres and Communist Party members of all ethnic groups, regardless of their nationality, to firmly establish the Marxist world outlook, to understand and solve problems based on the common interests of all ethnic groups, and to strive to overcome and eliminate various ideas and concepts that are not conducive to the cause of national unity and progress.

translated_text: From the 13th to the 19th, the first council of the National Party Building Research Association and the theoretical seminar on strengthening party spirit training in the three major tests were held in Beijing. The meeting discussed the relationship between party spirit and class nature, people's nature, and nationality; the connotation of the three major tests and the requirements for party spirit cultivation; the relationship between the commodity economy principle and the party spirit principle. The comrades attending the meeting believed that the core issue of strengthening party spirit training for Communist Party members is to solve the problem of stance and world outlook. The party spirit cultivation and training of party members cannot be separated from the great practice of building socialism with Chinese characteristics by hundreds of millions of people. Adhering to the focus on economic construction and striving to promote economic construction is a requirement of party spirit; adhering to the four basic principles and adhering to the socialist direction is a requirement of party spirit; adhering to reform and opening up and always standing in the forefront of reform and opening up is also a requirement of party spirit. Whether we can resolutely, comprehensively and correctly implement the party's basic line and resolutely overcome various thoughts and tendencies that deviate from the party's correct line is a fundamental sign of testing the party spirit of Communist Party members at this stage. Comrades attending the meeting pointed out that our party is shouldering the historical responsibility of leading the people of the whole country to build socialism with Chinese characteristics. Only by strengthening the party spirit can our party and members withstand the three major tests and better shoulder the new historical mission. The Council passed the Constitution and leadership of the National Party Building Research Association and determined the theoretical research topics of the research association this year and next year.

translated_text: On the 15th, the Central State Organs Working Committee held the Fourth Party Discipline Inspection Work Conference. events: 16日 中共中央印发关于调整省级人大、政协副职和常委任年龄界限的通知。《通知》规定:(一)在省级人大、政协中担任主任、主席职务的党员干部,其任职年龄界限仍为70岁,其中担任民主党派、工商联的中央和省级负责人以及在国内外有较大影响,工作需要的,可不受任职年龄界限的限制。省级人大、政协常委任职年龄界限,由各省、自治区、直辖市党委根据本地实际情况自行掌握,但党员常委最高年龄界限不超过65岁。(二)为了适时补充新的人选,避免换届时调整面过大,以利省级人大、政协领导班子的建设,在保证多数领导成员能任满一届的情况下,任届中期可对任年龄到限或丧失工作能力以及其他原因需作变动的进行一次调整。(三)新的任职年龄界限的规定,从1993年省级人大、政协换届时实行。为保持人大、政协工作的连续性,各地可从实际出发,在1993年各省、自治区、直辖市人代会、政协全体会议时,对省级人大、政协领导班子进行个别增补。在增补时,要着重从工作需要出发,把那些政治上坚定,德才兼备,比较年轻,适合做人大、政协工作的同志,提名为候选人。
translated_text: On the 16th, the CPC Central Committee issued a notice on adjusting the age limits for deputy posts and standing committee members of provincial-level people's congresses and CPPCCs. The notice stipulates: (i) The age limit for party members and cadres who serve as directors and chairpersons of provincial-level people's congresses and CPPCCs is still 70 years old. Among them, those who serve as central and provincial leaders of democratic parties and the Federation of Industry and Commerce and have a great influence at home and abroad and are required by work are not subject to the age limit. The age limit for provincial-level people's congresses and CPPCC standing committee members shall be determined by the party committees of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the central government according to local actual conditions, but the maximum age limit for party members standing committee members shall not exceed 65 years old. (ii) In order to supplement new candidates in a timely manner and avoid too large adjustments during the term change, so as to facilitate the construction of the provincial-level people's congress and CPPCC leadership team, while ensuring that most leadership members can serve a full term, adjustments can be made in the middle of the term for those who reach the age limit or lose their ability to work or other reasons that require changes. (iii) The new age limit provisions will be implemented from the time of the provincial-level people's congress and CPPCC term change in 1993. In order to maintain the continuity of the work of the National People's Congress and the CPPCC, local governments can make individual additions to the provincial-level National People's Congress and CPPCC leadership teams based on actual conditions during the People's Congresses and CPPCC plenary sessions of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government in 1993. When making additions, emphasis should be placed on work needs, and those comrades who are politically firm, have both moral integrity and ability, are relatively young, and are suitable for work in the National People's Congress and the CPPCC should be nominated as candidates.

translated_text: On the 28th, the Central Advisory Committee of the Communist Party of China, the Organization Department of the Communist Party of China, the General Political Department of the People's Liberation Army, and the Beijing Municipal Committee jointly held a Spring Festival tea party for veteran comrades in Beijing on behalf of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China. Song Ping, a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China, expressed his condolences to veteran comrades across the country on behalf of the Party Central Committee at the meeting. Comrade Song Ping said in his speech that the Party Central Committee sincerely hopes that the majority of veteran comrades can play a greater role in the new year. There are now more than 6 million retired cadres across the country, which is a great force. At present, our party is facing many new situations and new problems, and it is urgent to use Marxism as a guide, conduct in-depth discussions from the combination of theory and practice, and make scientific answers. This is an important task for the whole party and an incumbent and glorious task for veteran comrades. Veteran comrades have a high sense of revolutionary mission and responsibility, rich work experience, and many comrades have a deep foundation in Marxist theory. Everyone has retired from the front line and has more ample time. Through appropriate forms, we organize old comrades to systematically study Marxism-Leninism, Mao Zedong Thought and Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory on building socialism with Chinese characteristics, learn current political affairs, learn the party's policies and guidelines, and discuss some issues while learning, and make suggestions for the party's cause. This is of great benefit to giving full play to the political and ideological advantages of old cadres and promoting my country's socialist modernization and reform and opening up. We hope that all old comrades will strive to do what Comrade Zhou Enlai said, learn until old age, reform until old age, and play their roles better. Song Ping said that at present, our cadre team is in the process of replacement of the old and the new, and it is very important and urgent to strengthen the training and education of young cadres. Old comrades should do a good job of caring for and cultivating the younger generation with a high sense of responsibility for the party's cause and the future of the country. Old comrades understand the national conditions, the history of China's revolutionary struggle, and have firm beliefs in socialism and communism and rich experience. It is hoped that old comrades will give full play to their advantages and make more and greater contributions to cultivating successors to the socialist cause under the leadership of party committees at all levels. Party committees and governments at all levels and relevant departments should cherish the role of old comrades, care about their lives, and actively create conditions to give full play to the advantages of old comrades. The tea party was hosted by Bo Yibo, deputy director of the Advisory Committee. More than 2,000 people attended the tea party, including members of the Central Advisory Committee in Beijing, old comrades who have withdrawn from the Central Advisory Committee, retired deputy ministers, veteran cadres above the rank of deputy corps, relatives of deceased veteran comrades, responsible comrades of various departments of the central party, government and military and Beijing, leaders of various democratic parties and non-party personages, old workers, old farmers, and old intellectuals.

的规定》的通知。规定如下:
一、党员交纳党费的数额
1. 凡有工资收入的党员,每月按照工资收入的一定比例交纳
每每月工资收入在100元(含100元)以下者,交纳月工资收入
的0.5%;
商品每月工资收入在100元以上至200元(含200元)者,交纳月
工资收入的1%;
每月工资收入在 200元以上至300元(含300元)者,交纳月
工资收入的1.5%;
每月工资收入在300元以上至500元(含500元者,交纳月
工资收入的2%;
每月工资收入在500元以上者,交纳月工资收入的3%。
工资基数如下办法计算:国家机关、事业单位包括基础工
资、职务(岗位工资、年功性津贴(工龄、教龄、护龄津贴等);企业
包括计时工资或计件工资、年功性津贴、浮动工资效益工资。精子
没有固定职业从事临时工、协议工的党员,在有工资收入期
间,参照上述计算办法按比例交纳党费。 
2. 在乡镇企业工作的农民党员,按其月工资收入参照第一条
第一款规定的比例交纳党费。其他农民党员每月交纳党费1角。
3. 学生党员(包括没有工资收入的研究生党员),没有经济收
入或依靠抚恤、救济为生的党员,每月交纳党费1角。
4. 城市和农村中从事个体工商经营的党员,每月按上季度
纳所得税后月平均收入,参照第一条第一款规定的比例交纳党费。
5. 军队中的党员交纳党费的标准,由军委总政治部规定。
二、生活确有困难的党员,由本人提出申请,经党支部委员会
批准,可以少交或免交党费。

一次交纳党费1000元以上的,应全部上交中央。由所在党组织汇
交中央组织部(附该党员的简要情况),中央组织部给本人出具收
四、党员应自觉地向所在党组织交纳党费。如有特殊情况不能
亲自交纳或不能按月交纳时,经党支部委员会同意,可以委托其他
党员代为交纳或预交、补交,预交,补交的时间一般不得超过6个月。
五、对不按规定交纳党费的党员,党组织应及时对其进行批
评、教育。无正当理由连续6个月不交纳党费的,按自行脱党处理。
translated_text:
On the 24th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued a notice on the "Regulations on the Methods for Communist Party Members to Pay Party Dues". The regulations are as follows: 
1. The amount of party dues paid by party members
1. All party members with wage income shall pay a certain proportion of their wage income every month
For those with monthly wage income below 100 yuan (including 100 yuan), pay 0.5% of their monthly wage income;
For those with monthly wage income between 100 yuan and 200 yuan (including 200 yuan), pay 1% of their monthly wage income;
For those with monthly wage income between 100 yuan and 200 yuan (including 200 yuan), pay 1% of their monthly wage income;
For those with monthly wage income between 100 yuan and 200 yuan (including 200 yuan), pay 1% of their monthly wage income; For those with monthly wages of more than 200 yuan to 300 yuan (including 300 yuan), pay 1.5% of the monthly wage income; for those with monthly wages of more than 300 yuan to 500 yuan (including 500 yuan), pay 2% of the monthly wage income; for those with monthly wages of more than 500 yuan, pay 3% of the monthly wage income. The wage base is calculated as follows: State organs and institutions include basic wages, job (post wages, seniority allowances (length of service, teaching years, nursing years allowances, etc.); enterprises include time wages or piece wages, seniority allowances, floating wages and efficiency wages. Sperm Party members who do not have a fixed job and are engaged in temporary or contractual work shall pay party dues in proportion to the above calculation method during the period of wage income. 2. Farmer party members working in township enterprises shall pay party dues according to their monthly wage income in accordance with the proportion stipulated in the first paragraph of Article 1. Other farmer party members pay 10 cents per month in party dues. 3. Student Party members (including postgraduate Party members without salary income), Party members without economic income or relying on pensions and relief for living, shall pay a monthly Party dues of 10 cents.
4. Party members engaged in individual business in urban and rural areas shall pay Party dues based on their average monthly income after paying income tax in the previous quarter, in accordance with the proportion stipulated in the first paragraph of Article 1.
5. The standards for party members in the military to pay party dues are set by the General Political Department of the Military Commission.
2. Party members who are truly in financial difficulty may apply for less or no party dues upon approval by the party branch committee.
3. In addition to paying party dues as required, party members may voluntarily pay more without limit. Party members who voluntarily pay party dues of more than 1,000 yuan at a time shall submit all of them to the Central Committee. The party organization to which they belong shall submit the party dues to the Central Organization Department (with a brief profile of the party member attached), and the Central Organization Department shall issue a receipt to the party member.
4. Party members shall consciously pay party dues to their party organizations. If there are special circumstances that prevent them from paying in person or paying monthly, they may entrust other party members to pay on their behalf or make advance or make up the payment with the consent of the party branch committee. The time for advance and make-up payment shall generally not exceed 6 months.
5. Party organizations shall promptly criticize and educate party members who fail to pay party dues as required. Those who fail to pay party dues for 6 consecutive months without justifiable reasons shall be treated as voluntarily leaving the party.

28日 中共中央发出关于传达学习邓小平同志重要谈话的
通知。《通知》指出,1月18日至2月21日邓小平同志先后到武
昌、深圳、珠海和上海等地视察并发表了重要谈话。邓小平同志的
重要谈话,不仅对当前的改革和建设,对开好党的十四大,具有十
分重要的指导作用,而且对整个社会主义建设事业,具有重大而深
远的意义。《通知》要求全党同志尤其是各级领导干部,要认真学
习,全面深刻地领会谈话的精神实质,紧密结合实际,认真贯彻落
实。《通知》还全文转载了邓小平同志谈话内容。 
邓小平说,革命是解放生产力,改革也是解放生产力。过去,只
讲在社会主义条件下发展生产力,没有讲还要通过改革解放生产
力,不完全。应该把解放生产力和发展生产力两个讲全了。
要坚持党的十一届三中全会以来的路线方针政策,关键是坚
持“一个中心,两个基本点”。不坚持社会主义,不改革开放,不发展
经济,不改善人民生活,只能是死路一条。基本路线要管一百年,动
摇不得。只有坚持这条路线,人民才会相信你,拥护你。谁要改变
三中全会以来的路线方针政策,老百姓不答应,谁就会被打倒。
在这短短的十几年内,我们国家发展得这么快,使人民高兴,
世界瞩目,这就足以证明三中全会以来路线方针政策的正确性,谁
想变也变不了。
邓小平指出,改革开放胆子要大一些,敢于试验,不能像小脚
女人一样。看准了的,就大胆地试,大胆地闯。深圳的重要经验就
是敢闯。没有一点的精神,没有一点“冒”的精神,没有一股气呀,
劲呀,就走不出一条好路,走不出一条好路,走不出一条新路,就干
不出新的事业。
改革开放迈不开步子,不敢闯,说来说去就是怕资本主义的东
西多了,走了资本主义道路。要害是姓“资”还是姓“社”的问题。判
断的标准,应该主要看是否有利于发展社会主义社会的生产力,是
否有利于增强社会主义国家的综合国力,是否有利于提高人民的
生活水平。
邓小平指出,计划多一点还是市场多一点,不是社会主义与资
本主义的本质区别。计划经济不等于社会主义,资本主义也有计
划;市场经济不等于资本主义,社会主义也有市场。计划和市场都
是经济手段。社会主义的本质,是解放生产力,发展生产力,消灭剥
削,消除两极分化,最终达到共同富裕。就是要对大家讲这个道理。
证券、股市,这些东西究竟好不好,有没有危险,是不是资本主义独
有的东西,社会主义能不能用?允许看,但要坚决地试。看对了,搞
一两年对了,放开;错了,纠正,关了就是了。关,也可以快关,也可
以慢关,也可以留一点尾巴。怕什么,坚持这种态度就不要紧,就不
会犯大错误。总之,社会主义要赢得与资本主义相比较的优势,就
必须大胆吸收和借鉴人类社会创造的一切文明成果,吸收和借鉴
当今世界各国包括资本主义发达国家的一切反映现代社会化生产
规律的先进经营方式,管理方法。
邓小平指出,现在,有右的东西影响我们,也有“左”的东西影
响我们,但根深蒂固的还是“左”的东西。有些理论家,政治家,拿大
帽子吓唬人的,不是右,而是“左”。“左”带有革命的色彩,好象越
“左”越革命。“左”的东西在我们党的历史上可怕呀!一个好好的
东西,一下子被他搞掉了。右可以送社会主义,“左”也可以送
社会主义。中国要警惕右,但主要是防止“左”。右的东西有,动乱
就是右的!“左”的东西也有。把改革开放成是引进和发展资本
主义,认为和平演变的主要危险来自经济领域,这些就是“左”。我
们必须保持清醒的头脑,这样就不会犯大错误,出现问题也容易纠
正和改正。
邓小平在谈到抓住时机,发展经济时说,能发展就不要阻挡,
有条件的地方要尽可能搞快点,只要是讲效益,讲质量搞外向型经
济,就没有什么可以担心的。低速度就等于停步,甚至等于后退。要

励不切实际的高速度,还是要扎扎实实,讲求效益,稳步协调地发
展。对于我们这样发展中的大国来说,经济要发展得快一点,不可
能总是那么平平静静、稳稳当当。要注意经济稳定、协调地发展,但
稳定和协调也是相对的,不是绝对的。发展才是硬道理。这个问题
要搞清楚。如果分析不当,造成误解,就会变得谨小慎微,不敢解放
思想,不敢放开手脚,结果是丧失时机,犹如逆水行舟,不进则退。

术是第一生产力。要提倡科学,靠科学才有希望。
邓小平说,知识分子是工人阶级的一部分。老科学家、中年科
学家很重要,青年科学家也很重要。希望所有出国学习的人回来,
不管他们过去的政治态度怎么样,都可以回来,回来后妥善安排。
这个政策不能变。希望大家通力合作,为加快发展我国科技和教育
事业多做实事。搞科技,越高越好,越新越好。对我们的国家要爱,

On the 28th, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued a notice on conveying and studying Comrade Deng Xiaoping’s important speech. The "Notice" pointed out that from January 18 to February 21, Comrade Deng Xiaoping visited Wuhan, Shenzhen, Zhuhai and Shanghai and delivered important speeches. Comrade Deng Xiaoping’s important speech not only has a very important guiding role in the current reform and construction and the successful convening of the 14th National Congress of the Party, but also has a great and far-reaching significance for the entire socialist construction cause. The "Notice" requires all party comrades, especially leading cadres at all levels, to study carefully, fully and deeply understand the spirit of the speech, closely combine it with reality, and conscientiously implement it. The "Notice" also reprinted the full text of Comrade Deng Xiaoping’s speech. 
Deng Xiaoping said that revolution is to liberate productivity, and reform is also to liberate productivity. In the past, we only talked about developing productivity under socialist conditions, but did not talk about liberating productivity through reform, which was incomplete. We should talk about both liberating productivity and developing productivity. 
To adhere to the line, principles and policies of the Party since the Third Plenary Session of the Eleventh Central Committee, the key is to adhere to "one center and two basic points." If we do not adhere to socialism, reform and opening up, develop the economy, and improve people's lives, we will end up in a dead end. The basic line must be maintained for a hundred years and cannot be shaken. Only by adhering to this line will the people believe in you and support you. Whoever wants to change the line, principles, and policies since the Third Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee will be defeated if the people do not agree. In just over a decade, our country has developed so fast, making the people happy and attracting the world's attention. This is enough to prove the correctness of the line, principles, and policies since the Third Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee. No one can change them even if they want to. Deng Xiaoping pointed out that reform and opening up should be bolder and dare to experiment, and not be like women with bound feet. If you see the right thing, try it boldly and boldly. The important experience of Shenzhen is to dare to take risks. Without a little spirit, without a little "adventurous" spirit, without a breath of energy, you can't find a good way, a good way, a new way, and you can't do a new cause. Reform and opening up cannot take a step forward, and people dare not make new breakthroughs. In the final analysis, it is because they are afraid that there will be too many capitalist things and they will take the capitalist road. The key question is whether it is "capitalist" or "socialist". The criterion for judgment should be whether it is conducive to the development of the productive forces of socialist society, whether it is conducive to strengthening the comprehensive national strength of the socialist country, and whether it is conducive to improving the people's living standards. Deng Xiaoping pointed out that whether there is more planning or more market is not the essential difference between socialism and capitalism. A planned economy is not equal to socialism, and capitalism also has plans; a market economy is not equal to capitalism, and socialism also has markets. Both planning and markets are economic means. The essence of socialism is to liberate productivity, develop productivity, eliminate exploitation, eliminate polarization, and ultimately achieve common prosperity. This is what we need to tell everyone. Securities and stock markets, are these things good or not? Are they dangerous? Are they unique to capitalism? Can socialism use them? It is allowed to be seen, but it must be tried resolutely. If it is right, do it for one or two years. If it is right, open it; if it is wrong, correct it and close it. It can be closed quickly or slowly, or it can leave a little tail. What are you afraid of? It doesn't matter if you stick to this attitude, and you won't make big mistakes. In short, if socialism wants to gain an advantage over capitalism, it must boldly absorb and learn from all the civilized achievements created by human society, and absorb and learn from all the advanced business methods and management methods that reflect the laws of modern socialized production in all countries in the world today, including developed capitalist countries. Deng Xiaoping pointed out that now, there are right things that influence us, and there are "left" things that influence us, but the deep-rooted ones are still "left" things. Some theorists and politicians use big hats to scare people, not right, but "left". "Left" has a revolutionary color, as if the more "left", the more revolutionary. "Left" things are terrible in the history of our party! A good thing was destroyed by it in an instant. The right can give socialism, and the "left" can also give socialism. China must be vigilant against the right, but mainly prevent "left". There are right things, and unrest is right! There are "left" things too. To regard reform and opening up as the introduction and development of capitalism, and to believe that the main danger of peaceful evolution comes from the economic field, is "leftist". We must keep a clear mind, so that we will not make big mistakes, and problems can be easily corrected and rectified. When talking about seizing opportunities and developing the economy, Deng Xiaoping said that if development is possible, it should not be blocked, and where conditions permit, it should be done as quickly as possible. As long as it is efficient, quality-oriented and export-oriented, there is nothing to worry about. Low speed means stagnation, or even retreat. We must seize opportunities, and now is a good opportunity. my country's economic development should always strive to reach a higher level every few years. Of course, it does not encourage unrealistic high speeds, but still needs to be down-to-earth, efficient, steady and coordinated. For a large developing country like us, the economy needs to develop faster, and it is impossible to always be so calm and steady. We should pay attention to stable and coordinated economic development, but stability and coordination are also relative, not absolute. Development is the hard truth. This issue must be clarified. If the analysis is not done properly and misunderstandings are caused, people will become cautious and afraid to liberate their minds and let go of their hands and feet. As a result, they will lose opportunities, just like sailing against the current. If they do not advance, they will retreat. Deng Xiaoping said that if the economy is to develop faster, it must rely on science and education. Science and technology are the primary productive forces. We must promote science and rely on science to have hope. Deng Xiaoping said that intellectuals are part of the working class. Old scientists, middle-aged scientists, and young scientists are also important. I hope that all those who have studied abroad will come back, regardless of their past political attitudes, and they can come back and be properly arranged after they come back. This policy cannot be changed. I hope everyone will work together to do more practical things to accelerate the development of science and technology and education in our country. When it comes to science and technology, the higher the better, the newer the better. We must love our country and make our country developed. Deng Xiaoping pointed out that we must persist in doing both things, one hand is reform and opening up, and the other hand is cracking down on all kinds of criminal activities. Both hands must be strong. Facts have proved that the Communist Party can eliminate ugly things. We must oppose corruption throughout the process of reform and opening up. For cadres and Communist Party members, the construction of clean government should be taken as a major task. We still have to rely on the legal system, which is more reliable. In short, as long as our productivity develops, maintains a certain economic growth rate, and insists on doing both, the construction of socialist spiritual civilization can be carried out. In the entire process of reform and opening up, we must always pay attention to upholding the four basic principles. At the Sixth Plenary Session of the 12th Central Committee, I proposed that it would take 20 years to oppose bourgeois liberalization. Now it seems that it will take more than 20 years. The rampant bourgeois liberalization has extremely serious consequences. It took more than ten years to build the special zone, but it collapsed overnight. It is easy to collapse, but it is difficult to build. If you don't pay attention when the signs appear, something will go wrong. Relying on the dictatorship of the proletariat to defend the socialist system is a basic view of Marxism. Marx said that the theory of class struggle was not his invention, and the real invention was the theory of the dictatorship of the proletariat. Historical experience has proved that the newly emerging class that has just seized power is generally weaker than the power of the hostile class, so it must use dictatorship to consolidate its power. Democracy is practiced on the people, and dictatorship is practiced on the enemy. This is the people's democratic dictatorship. Using the power of the people's democratic dictatorship to consolidate the people's power is a just thing, and there is no reason to lose. We have only been practicing socialism for a few decades and are still in the primary stage. Consolidating and developing the socialist system will require a very long historical period, and it will require several generations, dozens of generations, or even dozens of generations of unremitting efforts. We must never take it lightly. Deng Xiaoping pointed out that the correct political line must be guaranteed by the correct organizational line. Whether China's affairs can be done well, whether socialism and reform and opening up can be maintained, whether the economy can develop faster, and whether the country can be long-term and stable, in a certain sense, the key lies in people. Imperialism is engaged in peaceful evolution and pins its hopes on the generations after us. We must educate our army, our dictatorship institutions, the Communist Party members, the people and the youth. If there is a problem in China, it will still be within the Communist Party. We must be clear-headed about this issue, pay attention to training people, and select people with both moral integrity and ability to join the team according to the standards of "revolutionary, young, knowledgeable, and professional". We say that the basic line of the party must be maintained for a hundred years, and long-term stability depends on this. What really concerns the overall situation is this matter. This is an issue at hand, and it has not been successfully resolved. I hope it will be resolved well. Now we must select people who are recognized by the people as adhering to the reform and opening-up line and have political achievements, and boldly put them into the new leadership body, so that the people feel that we are sincere in reform and opening up. The people look at practice. When the people see that socialism is better or reform and opening up is better, our cause will be everlasting! We must further recruit young people to join the team. We must pay attention to the training of the next generation of successors. Let more young people grow up. When they grow up, we will feel relieved. I am still not at ease! In the final analysis, the key is to do a good job within the Communist Party. Whether the development path of China established by the Third Plenary Session of the Eleventh Central Committee can be upheld depends on everyone's efforts, especially on educating the next generation. Deng Xiaoping pointed out that there is a problem now, that is, there is too much formalism. Formalism is also bureaucracy. We should spare time to do more practical things, do more and talk less. I suggest that we focus on this problem. We should study Marxism-Leninism in a refined way and make it useful. Long articles are read by a few professionals. How can the masses read them? It is formalistic to require everyone to read big books, which is impossible. Seeking truth from facts is the essence of Marxism. We should promote this, not books. The success of our reform and opening up is not based on books, but on practice and seeking truth from facts. Practice is the only criterion for testing truth. I have not read many books, but I believe in Chairman Mao's "seeking truth from facts". In the past, we relied on this to fight wars, and now we rely on this to carry out construction and reform. We have been talking about Marxism all our lives, but in fact, Marxism is not mysterious. Marxism is a very simple thing, a very simple truth. Deng Xiaoping pointed out, I firmly believe that there will be more people in the world who support Marxism, because Marxism is science. It uses historical materialism to reveal the laws of human social development. Feudal society replaced slave society, capitalism replaced feudalism, and socialism will inevitably replace capitalism after a long process of development. This is the irreversible general trend of social and historical development, but the road is tortuous. How many times has the dynasty been restored in the hundreds of years since capitalism replaced feudalism? Therefore, in a certain sense, a certain temporary restoration is also a regular phenomenon that is difficult to completely avoid. Some countries have experienced serious twists and turns, and socialism seems to have been weakened, but the people have been tempered and learned lessons from it, which will promote socialism to develop in a healthier direction. Therefore, don't panic, don't think that Marxism has disappeared, is useless, and has failed. How can this be! The two major issues of world peace and development have not been resolved so far. Socialism
China should use practice to show the world that China opposes hegemony and power politics and will never seek hegemony. China is a firm force in maintaining world peace.
We must continue to move forward on the road of building socialism with Chinese characteristics. Capitalism has been developing for hundreds of years, and how long have we been developing socialism! What's more, we have delayed it for 20 years. If we can build our country into a medium-level developed country in 100 years since the founding of the People's Republic of China, it will be amazing! From now until the middle of the next century, it will be a very important period, and we must work hard. The burden on our shoulders is heavy and the responsibility is great!

translated_text:
On the 29th, the Organization Department and the Personnel Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China jointly issued the "Notice on Implementing Several Issues in the Document No. 27 of the Organization Communication [1991]". The "Notice" requires: 
1. The recruitment of some outstanding township selected cadres must be carried out step by step within the approved recruitment plan under the premise of adhering to the township cadre selection system. 
2. The recruitment targets are those who have served as the secretary and deputy secretary of the township party committee and the mayor and deputy township mayor for more than 3 years among the selected cadres approved by the organization and personnel departments at or above the county level within the staffing and cadre increase plan of the township organs. The scope of recruitment targets shall not be expanded on their own. 
3. In accordance with the requirements of the "Notice", the recruitment of township selected cadres must adhere to the combination of examination and assessment, with assessment as the main method. The examination content is mainly based on the party's rural work policies and basic knowledge of rural work. The focus of the assessment is the political attitude, ideological quality, work style, work ability and work performance of the personnel to be recruited. In the assessment, attention should be paid to listening to the opinions of the masses. 
4. Regarding the requirement in the Notice that "those who have been commended at the provincial or ministerial level or above can be given priority for recruitment under the same conditions", local governments can make specific regulations based on actual conditions.
5. The Notice requires that the annual recruitment plan made by local governments should be reported to the Central Organization Department and the Ministry of Personnel in the name of the provincial organization and personnel departments before the end of November of the previous year (it can be sent to the Cadre Allocation Bureau of the Central Organization Department and the Examination and Recruitment Department of the Ministry of Personnel). After comprehensive balancing, the Central Organization Department and the Ministry of Personnel will jointly approve and issue it before the end of January of the same year.
6. The recruitment of township selected cadres should unify policies and enforce strict discipline. Regions that have already carried out recruitment should conscientiously clean up in accordance with the requirements of the Notice, and all regulations that are inconsistent with the spirit of the Notice will be stopped.

translated_text: On the same day, Zhao Dongwan, Minister of the Ministry of Personnel, pointed out at the National Personnel Department Directors' Meeting that the conditions for implementing the civil service system in my country are basically mature. translated_text: On the 9th and 10th, the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee held a plenary meeting in Beijing to seriously discuss several major issues of my country's reform and development. The meeting was chaired by Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee. The meeting emphasized that we must unswervingly implement the party's basic line of "one center and two basic points", seize the current favorable opportunity, accelerate the pace of reform and opening up, concentrate on economic construction, and continue to move forward along the road of socialism with Chinese characteristics. The meeting believed that liberating and developing productivity is the fundamental task of our party to lead the people in building socialism. To this end, we must unswervingly adhere to the focus on economic construction, adhere to the four basic principles, and adhere to reform and opening up. If we firmly grasp the party's basic line for a hundred years without wavering, the country will be able to maintain long-term stability and China will have great hope. The telephone conference emphasized that reform and opening up should be bolder, and we should be brave in innovation and dare to experiment. We must further emancipate our minds and adhere to seeking truth from facts. If we have identified the right thing, we should boldly try and boldly break through. We should accelerate the development of the socialist commodity economy, boldly absorb and learn from all the civilized achievements created by human society, and absorb and learn from the advanced business and management methods of all countries in the world today, including Western developed countries. The meeting pointed out that from now until the end of this century is a critical period. We must recognize the situation, seize opportunities, work hard, pay attention to efficiency, accelerate the pace of economic development, and strive to reach a higher level in a few years. Science and technology are the primary productive forces, and accelerating economic development must rely on science and technology and education. The meeting pointed out that at present, we must pay special attention to grasping the major issues that affect the overall situation in reform and construction, conduct in-depth investigations and studies, determine the strategic thinking and policy propositions for the next period, and conscientiously organize and implement them. Leaders at all levels must avoid formalism and bureaucracy, and free up their main energy to do more practical things. The meeting required that all party comrades, especially leading cadres at all levels, should conscientiously study Comrade Deng Xiaoping’s series of important expositions on building socialism with Chinese characteristics, and further enhance the consciousness of fully implementing the party’s basic line. We must be vigilant against the right, but mainly prevent "left". We should adhere to the two-pronged approach, strengthen the construction of socialist spiritual civilization and democratic legal system, and consolidate and develop a stable and united political situation. All Party members should closely unite around the Party Central Committee with Comrade Jiang Zemin as the core, unite and lead the people of all ethnic groups, and welcome the successful convening of the 14th National Congress of the Party with outstanding achievements in reform and construction.

两县领导干部重大受贿案的通报》。清流、尤溪两批案件共涉及
298人,其中党员173人,科局级干部66人,县处级干部25人。经
查处,已追究法律、纪律责任的156人,其中党员101人,科局级干
部44人,县处级干部14人。清流县委书记余有炜受贿5754元,被

方面的,全党同志,特别是各级领导干部必须认真汲取,以增强反
腐败的自觉性和免疫力。各级党委要以清流、尤溪两县为借鉴,采

translated_text: On the 1st, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China issued a "Notice on Major Bribery Cases of Leading Cadres in Qingliu and Youxi Counties in Fujian Province". The two batches of cases in Qingliu and Youxi involved a total of 298 people, including 173 party members, 66 department-level cadres, and 25 county-level cadres. After investigation, 156 people have been held accountable for legal and disciplinary responsibilities, including 101 party members, 44 department-level cadres, and 14 county-level cadres. Yu Youwei, secretary of the Qingliu County Party Committee, accepted bribes of 5,754 yuan, was expelled from the party, and sentenced to 2 years in prison according to law; Jiang Yunfu, secretary of the Youxi County Party Committee, accepted bribes of 14,760 yuan, was expelled from the party, and sentenced to 5 years in prison according to law. The economic cases in Qingliu and Youxi counties in 2004 reflect the seriousness of corruption and the urgency of the fight against corruption. The case involves a wide range of areas, involves many county-level leading cadres, and involves a large amount of illegal and disciplinary violations characterized by power-for-money transactions, which is shocking. The Bulletin pointed out that the lessons learned from the major economic cases in Qingliu and Youxi counties are multifaceted, and all party members, especially leading cadres at all levels, must learn from them to enhance their awareness and immunity against corruption. Party committees at all levels should learn from Qingliu and Youxi counties, take effective measures, and effectively strengthen the party style and clean government construction of the leadership team itself to ensure the smooth progress of economic construction and reform and opening up.
