抓紧培养教育青年干部的决定>的实施意见》的通知。《实施意见》
的主要内容:
一、有计划地对青年干部进行思想理论教育,努力提高青年干
部的政治业务素质。根据青年干部的状况,要对他们进行马克思主
义基本理论的教育,进行邓小平同志关于建设有中国特色社会主
义理论的教育。在教育培训中,要根据不同对象、不同层次以及培
训时间的长短,合理安排学习内容,做到少而精,讲实效。
从1992年起,用5年左右的时间,分期分批将各级各类青年
干部普遍轮训一次。
中央党政机关中年轻的正副司(局)级和正副处级干部(年龄
一般可掌握在45岁以下),分别送中央党校、中央党校中直机关分
校和国家机关分校进行培训。中央党校本部的培训班,每期为一
年,中央党校分校的培训班,每期为5个月左右。中央党校轮训不
过来的,可由本系统的干部院校,或由本部门开办青年干部理论培
训班,按照中央党校的培训内容和时间要求进行培训。各部门年轻
的科级以下干部(年龄一般可掌握在40岁以下),由本部门的党校
或干部院校负责培训,或由本部门开办青年干部理论培训班进行
培训,培训时间不少于3个月。
省、自治区、直辖市党政机关中年轻的正副厅(局)级和正副处
级干部(年龄一般可掌握在45岁以下),除属中央党校的培训对象
外,应分别送省(区、市)委党校、省(区、市)直机关党校进行培训,
也可送本系统的干部院校进行培训,培训时间不少于3个月。各部
门年轻的科级以下干部(年龄一般可掌握在40岁以下),可由省
(区、市)直机关工委(党委)组织培训,或由各部门的培训机构负责
培训,或由各部门开办青年干部理论培训班进行培训。无论采取何
种形式,培训时间不少于3个月。
土地(市､州、盟)党政机关中年轻的正副处级干部和县(市、区、
旗)党政机关中年轻的正副科级干部(年龄一般可掌握在35岁以
下),除属上级党校的培训对象外,分别送地、县级党校进行培训,
或采取其它形式进行培训,培训时间不少于3个月。地,县级党政
机关中的其他青年干部,由地、县委组织培训,每人离岗培训的时
间不少于2个月。
参加培训的青年干部年龄的具体掌握,各地、各部门可根据本
单位青年干部的实际状况,作出相应规定。
二、分期分批安排青年干部到社会实践中去经受锻炼,努力提
高青年干部建设社会主义现代化的本领。省级以上党政机关及所
属从事社会科学研究的事业单位和具有政府管理职能的公司,以
及工会、共青团、妇联机关中的青年干部,凡未在农村,或企业单
位,或地、市以下(含地、市)党政机关和事业单位,或部队师级以下
(含师级)单位工作满3年的,从1992年起,应根据干部的不同情
况,开辟多种渠道,分期分批地安排他们去基层锻炼。今后,因特殊
需要直接分配进入省级以上党政机关及所属从事社会科学研究的
事业单位和具有政府管理职能的公司,以及工会、共青团、妇联机
关的大中专学校毕业生(含大学毕业生直接考入的研究生),须先
放到基层工作1至3年后再回机关工作;对不适合上述单位工
作的,应另行安排。要有计划地安排青年领导干部到基层锻炼。青
年领导干部锻炼的去向、形式和时间,由各地、各部门根据自己的
实际情况作出安排,组织实施。根据干部本人的情况和工作需要,
可以平职安排,也可以低职安排。
从1992年起,地(市、州、盟)以上党政机关及所属从事社会科
学研究的事业单位和具有政府管理职能的公司,以及工会、共青
团、妇联机关,提拔处级以上(含副处)青年领导干部,一般须具有
3年以上的基层工作经历。
三、认真做好选调生的选拔培养工作。从1992年起,中央和省
(区、市)两级组织人事部门,可会同有关方面,每年从高等学校应
届毕业生中挑选一批品学兼优的毕业生,视实际情况,分配到县
(市、区、旗)或农村乡镇或企业工作,经过2年以上的基层锻炼,按
照增员指标,经过考试考核,分别补充到地级以上党政机关干部队
伍中来。
选调生名单由中央和省(区、市)两级组织人事部门内部掌握,
选调生的录用工作,由人事部门负责。
选调生在基层工作期间,当地组织人事部门(以人事部门为
主),应通过适当方式对其进行考察了解,对其中表现优秀的,上级
组织人事部门要把情况掌握起来。在工作方法上,要注意不能造成
选调生的特殊感和优越感,不要许愿,教育他们树立扎根基层的思
想,与干部群众打成一片。

translated_text:
On the 11th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued the Notice on Implementing the Decision of the CPC Central Committee on Speeding up the Training and Education of Young Cadres. The main contents of the Implementation Opinions are as follows: 1. Carry out ideological and theoretical education for young cadres in a planned manner and strive to improve the political and professional quality of young cadres. According to the situation of young cadres, they should be educated in the basic theories of Marxism and Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory on building socialism with Chinese characteristics. In education and training, the learning content should be reasonably arranged according to different objects, different levels and the length of training time, so as to be concise and effective. Since 1992, it has taken about 5 years to train young cadres of all levels and types in phases and batches. Young cadres at the department (bureau) level and deputy department level (age can generally be controlled under 45 years old) in the central party and government organs are sent to the Central Party School, the Central Party School Central Direct Organs Branch and the State Organs Branch for training. The training courses of the Central Party School headquarters are one year each, and the training courses of the Central Party School branches are about five months each. Those who cannot be trained at the Central Party School can be trained by the cadre schools of the same system or by the theoretical training courses for young cadres held by the department, in accordance with the training content and time requirements of the Central Party School. The young cadres below the section level in each department (generally under 40 years old) shall be trained by the party school or cadre school of the department, or by the theoretical training courses for young cadres held by the department, and the training time shall not be less than 3 months. The young cadres at the level of director (bureau) and deputy director (department) and the level of director and deputy director (division) in the party and government organs of provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the Central Government (generally under 45 years old), except for those who are trained by the Central Party School, shall be sent to the party schools of provincial (district, municipal) committees and the party schools of provincial (district, municipal) direct organs for training, or sent to the cadre schools of the same system for training, and the training time shall not be less than 3 months. Young cadres below the section level in various departments (age can generally be kept under 40 years old) can be trained by the provincial (district, city) direct agency working committee (party committee), or by the training institutions of various departments, or by theoretical training courses for young cadres held by various departments. Regardless of the form adopted, the training time shall not be less than 3 months. Young cadres at the division level and deputy division level in the party and government organs of the land (city, prefecture, league) and young cadres at the section level and deputy section level in the party and government organs of the county (city, district, banner) (age can generally be kept under 35 years old), except for those who are the training targets of the higher-level party school, shall be sent to the district and county party schools for training, or other forms of training shall be adopted, and the training time shall not be less than 3 months. Other young cadres in the party and government organs of the district and county shall be trained by the district and county party committees, and each person shall be off-duty for training for not less than 2 months. The specific grasp of the age of young cadres participating in the training can be made by various localities and departments according to the actual situation of young cadres in their units. 2. Arrange young cadres to undergo training in social practice in stages and batches, and strive to improve their ability to build socialist modernization. Young cadres in provincial-level and above party and government organs, their affiliated institutions engaged in social science research, and companies with government management functions, as well as trade unions, the Communist Youth League, and the Women's Federation, who have not worked in rural areas, enterprises, or party and government organs and institutions below the prefecture and city level (including prefecture and city level), or military units below the division level (including division level) for three years, should be arranged to go to the grassroots level for training in stages and batches according to the different situations of the cadres from 1992 onwards through various channels. In the future, college and technical school graduates (including graduate students directly admitted by university graduates) who are directly assigned to provincial-level and above party and government organs, their affiliated institutions engaged in social science research, and companies with government management functions, as well as trade unions, the Communist Youth League, and the Women's Federation due to special needs, must first be placed at the grassroots level for 1 to 3 years before returning to work in the organs; those who are not suitable for work in the above-mentioned units should be arranged separately. Young leading cadres should be arranged to train at the grassroots level in a planned manner. The destination, form and time of training for young leading cadres shall be arranged and implemented by all localities and departments according to their actual conditions. According to the cadres' own situation and work needs, they can be arranged at the same level or at a lower level. Since 1992, party and government organs at or above the prefecture (city, state, league) level and their affiliated institutions engaged in social science research and companies with government management functions, as well as trade unions, the Communist Youth League, and the Women's Federation, have promoted young leading cadres at or above the department level (including deputy department level), and generally they must have more than 3 years of grassroots work experience. 3. Do a good job in the selection and training of selected students. Since 1992, the organization and personnel departments at the central and provincial (district, city) levels can, together with relevant parties, select a group of outstanding graduates from colleges and universities every year, and assign them to work in counties (cities, districts, banners) or rural towns or enterprises according to actual conditions. After more than two years of grassroots training, they will be added to the cadre teams of party and government organs at or above the prefectural level according to the recruitment indicators and after examinations and assessments. The list of selected students is controlled by the organization and personnel departments at the central and provincial (district, city) levels, and the recruitment of selected students is the responsibility of the personnel departments. During the period of selected students working at the grassroots level, the local organization and personnel departments (mainly the personnel departments) should investigate and understand them through appropriate means. For those who perform well, the superior organization and personnel departments should keep track of the situation. In terms of working methods, we should pay attention to not giving selected students a sense of specialness and superiority, and not make wishes. We should educate them to establish the idea of taking root in the grassroots and integrate with the cadres and the masses. Fourth, implement exchanges or job rotation for young leading cadres in party and government organs. Those young leading cadres who have worked in leading organs for a long time should be purposefully transferred to prefecture-level and county-level party and government organs or grassroots organizations for 1 to 2 years to increase their grassroots work and practical work experience; those young leading cadres who have worked at the grassroots level for a long time should be systematically transferred to higher-level leading organs and comprehensive departments for 1 to 2 years to increase their work experience in leading organs. For young cadres, they can be consciously arranged to rotate in different positions in their departments and units. For those who are to be promoted to the next level of leadership, they should gradually rotate in two or more positions at the next level. Fifth, strict requirements should be imposed on young cadres, education should be strengthened, and strict management should be implemented. Party organizations and administrative leaders of various departments and units should pay attention to giving young cadres burdens and arrange them to work in places or positions with relatively difficult conditions and greater work difficulties so that they can be tempered. At the same time, we should strengthen the specific guidance of young cadres, regularly understand and check the thoughts, learning and work of young cadres, and effectively help them strengthen their party spirit, overcome shortcomings, carry forward their achievements and improve their quality. For the problems of young cadres, those who should be criticized should be severely criticized, and those who should be dealt with should be dealt with seriously. We must never condone or let them go.
6. Give full play to the role of middle-aged and elderly cadres in mentoring and helping young cadres. We should pay attention to the role of middle-aged and elderly cadres in mentoring and helping young cadres. The specific forms and methods shall be determined by each department and unit according to their own situation. We should educate young cadres to fully respect middle-aged and elderly comrades, learn from them with an open mind, and inherit and carry forward the fine traditions and style of the Party.
7. Effectively strengthen the leadership of the training and education of young cadres. The Party committees of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government and the Party groups (Party committees) of ministries and commissions of the central state organs should formulate training plans, propose plans, make specific arrangements, and instruct the relevant departments to organize and implement them according to the situation of young cadres in their regions and departments. In the future, we should combine the annual work summary with a comprehensive inspection of the training and education of young cadres, summarize and promote good experience, study and solve problems that arise in the work, and explore new methods for training and educating young cadres.

translated_text: On the 17th, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China and the Organization Department of the Communist Party of China jointly issued the "Notice on the Approval Procedures for the Appointment and Removal of Leading Cadres of Provincial, Autonomous Region, and Municipal Commissions of Discipline Inspection and Discipline Inspection Groups (Discipline Committees) of Central and State Organs". The "Notice" pointed out: In order to strengthen the management of leading cadres of provincial, autonomous region, and municipal commissions of discipline inspection and discipline inspection groups (discipline committees) of central and state organs, and institutionalize and standardize the approval work of cadre appointment and removal, in accordance with the spirit of the Party Constitution and relevant regulations, combined with the actual situation of the discipline inspection system, specific provisions are made on the approval procedures for the appointment and removal of leading cadres of provincial, autonomous region, and municipal commissions of discipline inspection and discipline inspection groups (discipline committees) of central and state organs, and the method of submitting materials. The "Notice" stipulates that when the provincial, autonomous region, and municipal commissions of discipline inspection change their terms, the candidates for the secretary, deputy secretary, and standing committee of the commissions of discipline inspection shall be proposed by the provincial, autonomous region, and municipal party committee, and after obtaining the consent of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, they shall be submitted to the Central Committee for approval. During the recess of the Party Congress, the adjustment of the secretaries and deputy secretaries of the provincial, autonomous region and municipal discipline inspection committees shall be proposed by the party committees at the same level, and after obtaining the consent of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, the candidates shall be reported to the Central Committee for approval. The "Notice" also stipulates that the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection shall consult with the party group (party committee) of the department where the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection dispatches the group leader, deputy group leader, bureau-level inspector and deputy bureau-level director of the office. After the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection investigates, the group leader shall be appointed and removed by the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection; the deputy group leader shall be appointed and removed by the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection after filing with the Central Organization Department; the bureau-level inspector and deputy bureau-level director of the office shall be appointed and removed by the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection. The secretaries and deputy secretaries of the Central directly affiliated organs and central state organs shall be proposed by the Central directly affiliated organs and central state organs working committees in consultation with the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection. After the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection investigates and agrees, the secretary shall be appointed and removed by the working committee reported to the Central Committee; the deputy secretary shall be appointed and removed after filing with the Central Organization Department, and the appointment and removal notice shall be copied to the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection. The leaders (secretaries) and deputy leaders (deputy secretaries) of the discipline inspection groups (discipline committees) of the party groups (party committees) of the departments of the central and state organs shall be nominated by the party groups (party committees) of the departments or the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection in consultation with the party groups (party committees) of the departments. After investigation and approval by the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, the leaders (secretaries) shall be reported to the Central Committee for appointment and removal by the party groups (party committees) of the departments; the deputy leaders (deputy secretaries) shall be appointed and removed after being reported to the Central Organization Department for record by the party groups (party committees) of the departments, and the appointment and removal notice shall be copied to the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection.

20日 中共中央总书记江泽民与首都应届高校毕业生座谈
并发表重要讲话。江泽民指出,尊重知识、尊重人才,努力为各种人
才的脱颖而出和正确使用创造良好的条件,最大限度地发挥知识
分子的创造才能,应当始终成为我们党和政府坚定不移的方针,并
且要一年比一年做得好。离开教育和科技的发展,离开人才的培
养,离开知识分子对知识的掌握,运用和传播作用,要把我们的经
济转到依靠科技进步和提高劳动者素质的轨道上来,是不可能的。
江泽民指出,要加快经济的发展,就必须实行改革开放,而实行改
革开放的一个重要目的和内容,就是要把国外包括资本主义国家
的一切好的先进的东西学过来,为我所用。
江泽民指出,社会主义作为一种崭新的社会制度,只有在继承
和利用资本主义社会已经创造出来的全部社会生产力和全部优秀
文化成果的基础上,并结合新的实际进行新的创造,才能顺利地建
立起来,并最终建设成功。但是,在过去的长时间内,我们在对待资
本主义的问题上,往往只看到或更多看到的是社会主义同它对立
的一面,而很少看到社会主义同它还有学习、借鉴,合作和利用的
一面,这是认识上的一种片面性,是不符合社会历史发展的辩证法
的。这种认识上的片面性,不利于社会主义经济文化的发展和进
步。
江泽民说,小平同志提出必须坚持改革开放,坚持解放思想,
坚持实事求是,一个很重要的方面,就是要求我们摆脱过去的一些
片面认识,大胆利用国外包括西方国家的资金和先进技术,大胆吸
收和借鉴世界各国包括资本主义发达国家的一切反映现代化社会
化生产规律的先进的经营方式和管理方法。立足我们的实际,把国
外的这些有用的好的东西认真学过来,用来改进,提高和发扬中国
的东西,创造有中国特色的新东西,这样我们进行社会主义建设和
社会主义改革的本事就会大起来,就可以加快我们经济和社会的
发展。所以,我们在学习和利用西方国家的一切有用的东西时,思
想要更解放一些,胆子要更大一些,步子要更快一些,不要被“姓社
还是姓资”问题的抽象争论所束缚而迈不开步子。因为学习和利用
这些有用的东西,不存在“姓社姓资”的问题,它们是人类的共同文
明成果;资本主义可以用,社会主义也可以用。
江泽民说,当然,我们在学习和借鉴资本主义国家一切好的东
西的时候,不能妄自菲薄,不能对社会主义事业没有信心。我们并
不是一切都落后。至于极少数人,其中也包括极少数知识分子在
内,认为中国应该实行“全盘西化”,对于这种错误倾向,我们任何

translated_text: On the 20th, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, held a discussion with the recent college graduates in the capital and delivered an important speech. Jiang Zemin pointed out that respecting knowledge and talents, striving to create good conditions for all kinds of talents to stand out and be used correctly, and giving full play to the creative talents of intellectuals should always be the unswerving policy of our party and government, and it should be done better year by year. Without the development of education and science and technology, without the cultivation of talents, without the mastery, application and dissemination of knowledge by intellectuals, it is impossible to turn our economy to the track of relying on scientific and technological progress and improving the quality of workers. Jiang Zemin pointed out that in order to accelerate economic development, it is necessary to implement reform and opening up, and an important purpose and content of implementing reform and opening up is to learn all the good and advanced things from foreign countries, including capitalist countries, and use them for our own benefit. Jiang Zemin pointed out that socialism, as a brand-new social system, can only be successfully established and finally built on the basis of inheriting and utilizing all the social productivity and all the excellent cultural achievements created by capitalist society, and combining new creations with new realities. However, for a long time in the past, when dealing with the issue of capitalism, we often only saw or more saw the side of socialism that was in opposition to it, and rarely saw the side of socialism that could learn from, draw on, cooperate with and utilize it. This is a one-sided understanding and is not in line with the dialectics of social and historical development. This one-sided understanding is not conducive to the development and progress of socialist economy and culture. Jiang Zemin said that Comrade Xiaoping proposed that we must adhere to reform and opening up, emancipate our minds, and seek truth from facts. One very important aspect is that it requires us to get rid of some of the one-sided understandings of the past, boldly utilize foreign funds and advanced technology including those of Western countries, and boldly absorb and learn from all advanced business methods and management methods that reflect the laws of modern socialized production in various countries in the world including developed capitalist countries. Based on our reality, we should seriously learn these useful and good things from abroad, use them to improve, enhance and carry forward Chinese things, and create new things with Chinese characteristics. In this way, our ability to carry out socialist construction and socialist reform will be enhanced, and we can accelerate the development of our economy and society. Therefore, when we learn and use all the useful things from Western countries, we should be more open-minded, bolder, and faster in our steps. We should not be constrained by the abstract debate on "socialism or capitalism". Because when learning and using these useful things, there is no question of "socialism or capitalism". They are the common civilizational achievements of mankind. Capitalism can use them, and socialism can also use them. Jiang Zemin said that of course, when we learn and draw on all the good things from capitalist countries, we should not be self-deprecating and lose confidence in the socialist cause. We are not backward in everything. As for the very few people, including a very few intellectuals, who believe that China should implement "total Westernization", we should always pay attention to prevent this wrong tendency and not let it interfere with our reform and opening up. 1. Reform in the South Jiang Zemin emphasized that on the one hand, we should boldly learn and draw on all the good things from foreign countries, and on the other hand, we should resolutely resist decadent things. The two complement each other and are indispensable. Jiang Zemin put forward three requirements to college students. First, we must go deep into reality and the masses, adhere to the combination of theory and practice, adhere to the combination of workers and peasants, and closely link the future of individuals with the future and destiny of the motherland. Second, we must work hard and strive for self-improvement. Third, we must strengthen learning in work, consciously overcome shortcomings and faults, and make ourselves mature and improve faster. Jiang Zemin emphasized that the majority of young intellectuals should attach great importance to and study Comrade Xiaoping’s theory on building socialism with Chinese characteristics. This theory is an important contribution to Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought, a new and major development of scientific socialism, and can also be said to be unique in the treasure house of Marxism. Students and the majority of young people must learn Comrade Xiaoping’s theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics well and thoroughly, use it to arm their own minds, boldly explore, be brave to innovate, give full play to their talents, and make more contributions to building socialism with Chinese characteristics.

作研究会负责人谈话。
李瑞环在谈话中指出,邓小平同志倡导的建设有中国特色的
社会主义的理论和路线,是国际共产主义运动的正确总结,是马列
主义、毛泽东思想在新的历史条件下的运用和发展,是中国人民创
造历史的伟大成果,是中国共产党人特别是邓小平同志等老一辈
无产阶级革命家集体智慧的结晶。实践证明,在当今中国只有这套
理论和路线,才能顶住风浪,巩固政权,发展自己。因此,对这套理
论和路线,我们必须百倍地珍惜,扭住不放地坚持。邓小平同志年
初的重要谈话,坚持、丰富和发展了这套理论和路线,回答了当前
国际、国内许多重大的根本的问题,既有深刻重大的理论意义,又
有鲜明的现实针对性,在国内外产生了强烈的反响。我们要认真刻
苦地学习,全面准确地领会,真心实意地贯彻。对这篇谈话,任何三
心二意或含含糊糊,动摇或背离,都会给我们的事业带来灾难性的
后果。当前,学习好、宣传好、贯彻好这个谈话,是全党的大事,也是
宣传战线的大事,理所当然也是企业思想政治工作的大事。
李瑞环指出,思想政治工作只能落实到经济上,业务上。要坚
持以经济建设为中心,紧密结合经济工作一道去做,不能搞空头政
治和“两张皮”。坚持党的基本路线要一百年不变,也就是说经济建
设的中心地位一百年不变。因此,思想政治工作不能游离于经济建
设这个中心之外,更不能搞“自我中心”两个中心或多中心,妨碍
和干扰经济建设的发展。思想政治工作者必须提高执行党的基本
路线的自觉性,强化为经济建设服务的意识,自觉地服从和服务于
经济建设。思想政治工作只有在经济建设和改革开放的长过程中,
找到自己合适的位置,才能发挥自己特有的作用,体现自身存在的
价值。这样,思想政治工作就一定能大有作为,就始终是“春天”。
李瑞环强调指出,从一定意义上说,领导者的责任就在于把群
众的积极性充分地调动起来,并合理地发挥出去。我们事业的兴衰
成败,归根到底取决于人民群众,“取决于群众的自觉与自动”。思
想政治工作就是要通过各种方式、方法和途径,使群众了解自己的
利益与责任,自觉地为自己的利益而奋斗,也就是要启发群众的自
觉性,调动群众的积极性,把国家的各项建设事业搞好。改革的目
的是什么?就是为了充分调动人的积极性,尽快发展社会生产力。
所有的领导者,不但要做到自己工作积极,更重要的是要通过自己
的积极使他人,多数人都积极。
李瑞环最后说,坚持四项基本原则包含着加强思想政治工作
的内容。加强思想政治工作是建设有中国特色的社会主义的客观
必然。思想政治工作是坚持唯物史观的应有之义,是实现远大理想
的必需条件,是贯彻基本路线的可靠保证,是协调人际关系的基本
方法,是凝聚全民族力量的重要途径,是办好社会主义企业的内在
要求。加强思想政治工作是当前形势的迫切要求。现在改革正在
深化,许多新情况、新问题、新矛盾需要研究解决。思想政治工作在
化解矛盾、协调关系,理顺情绪等方面要做的事会越来越多,可以
说大有用武之地,思想政治工作者肩上的担子不是轻了而是更重
了。当然,思想政治工作也确有一个不断适应新形势的问题。但这
不是个要不要的问题,而是个如何改进,改善的问题。为了从组织
上切实加强对企业思想政治工作的领导,各级党委和企业党组织
要继续按照中央已有的规定,保持必要的政工机构和精干的专职
政工人员。企业在改革中涉及政工机构和人员变动时,既要符合精
简、精干的原则,又要保证工作的正常运转。历史经验证明,思想政
治工作必须全党动手,依靠大家,我希望各级领导和各个方面都来
重视这项工作。
translated_text: On the 21st, Li Ruihuan, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, talked with the head of the Chinese Workers' Ideological and Political Work Research Association. In the conversation, Li Ruihuan pointed out that the theory and line of building socialism with Chinese characteristics advocated by Comrade Deng Xiaoping is a correct summary of the international communist movement, the application and development of Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought under new historical conditions, the great achievement of the Chinese people in creating history, and the crystallization of the collective wisdom of the Chinese Communists, especially Comrade Deng Xiaoping and other older generation proletarian revolutionaries. Practice has proved that in today's China, only this set of theories and lines can withstand the wind and waves, consolidate the regime, and develop itself. Therefore, we must cherish this set of theories and lines a hundred times and stick to it. Comrade Deng Xiaoping's important talk at the beginning of the year upheld, enriched and developed this set of theories and lines, answered many major and fundamental issues at home and abroad, and had both profound and important theoretical significance and clear practical relevance, which had a strong response at home and abroad. We must study it seriously and hard, understand it comprehensively and accurately, and implement it sincerely. Any hesitation or ambiguity, wavering or deviation from this conversation will bring disastrous consequences to our cause. At present, studying, publicizing and implementing this conversation well is a major event for the whole party, a major event for the propaganda front, and of course a major event for the ideological and political work of enterprises. Li Ruihuan pointed out that ideological and political work can only be implemented in the economy and business. We must adhere to the focus on economic construction and closely combine it with economic work. We must not engage in empty politics and "two skins". Adhering to the party's basic line must remain unchanged for a hundred years, that is, the central position of economic construction must remain unchanged for a hundred years. Therefore, ideological and political work cannot be separated from the center of economic construction, and it must not be "self-centered" with two or more centers to hinder and interfere with the development of economic construction. Ideological and political workers must improve their consciousness of implementing the party's basic line, strengthen their awareness of serving economic construction, and consciously obey and serve economic construction. Only when ideological and political work finds its own appropriate position in the long process of economic construction and reform and opening up can it play its unique role and reflect the value of its own existence. In this way, ideological and political work will surely achieve great results and will always be "spring". Li Ruihuan emphasized that, in a certain sense, the responsibility of leaders is to fully mobilize the enthusiasm of the masses and give full play to it. The rise and fall of our cause ultimately depends on the masses, "depending on the consciousness and initiative of the masses". Ideological and political work is to use various ways, methods and channels to make the masses understand their own interests and responsibilities, and consciously fight for their own interests, that is, to inspire the consciousness of the masses, mobilize the enthusiasm of the masses, and do a good job in the country's various construction undertakings. What is the purpose of reform? It is to fully mobilize people's enthusiasm and develop social productivity as soon as possible. All leaders should not only be active in their own work, but more importantly, make others, most of them, active through their own enthusiasm. Li Ruihuan finally said that adhering to the four basic principles includes the content of strengthening ideological and political work. Strengthening ideological and political work is an objective necessity for building socialism with Chinese characteristics. Ideological and political work is the inherent meaning of adhering to the materialist conception of history, a necessary condition for realizing lofty ideals, a reliable guarantee for implementing the basic line, a basic method for coordinating interpersonal relationships, an important way to gather the strength of the whole nation, and an inherent requirement for running socialist enterprises well. Strengthening ideological and political work is an urgent requirement of the current situation. Now that reform is deepening, many new situations, new problems, and new contradictions need to be studied and resolved. There will be more and more things to do in ideological and political work in resolving contradictions, coordinating relationships, and sorting out emotions. It can be said that there is a lot of room for ideological and political work. The burden on the shoulders of ideological and political workers is not lighter but heavier. Of course, ideological and political work does have a problem of constantly adapting to new situations. But this is not a question of whether or not to do it, but a question of how to improve and improve it. In order to effectively strengthen the leadership of ideological and political work in enterprises from an organizational perspective, party committees at all levels and enterprise party organizations should continue to maintain necessary political work institutions and capable full-time political workers in accordance with the existing regulations of the Central Committee. When enterprises change political work institutions and personnel during reform, they must comply with the principles of streamlining and efficiency, and ensure the normal operation of work. Historical experience has proven that ideological and political work must be carried out by the whole party and rely on everyone. I hope that leaders at all levels and all aspects will attach importance to this work.

李鹏指出,在我国经济、政治和社会发展中具有重要的地
位。县级建制是国家管理体制中直接面对广大农村、功能比较完备
的一级政权组织,在行政管理层次中处于基础地位。十多年来,我
国农村面貌发生了举世瞩目的变化,特别是乡镇企业的崛起和商
品经济的发展,使农村经济发生了历史性的进步。但是,作为城乡
结合部的县,不少方面还不能适应经济改革的进展和发展社会主
义商品经济的需要,加快县级综合改革势在必行。
李鹏说,当前全国正在积极贯彻邓小平同志重要讲话精神,是
进一步深化改革和扩大开放的好时期。他要求,各级党政部门,从
本地的实际情况出发,进一步推动县级综合改革的进程。他指出,
随着生产力的发展,县级综合改革的开展,必然要求县级机构进行
相应的改革。
李鹏提出,县级机构改革首先要明确指导思想。县的工作重点
在农村,首先要抓好农业,同时要抓好乡镇企业和第三产业,促进
农村经济和社会的全面发展。县级机构改革总的方向是走“小机
构、大服务”的路子,减少行政干预,进一步发展服务体系。县级机
构主要任务是贯彻执行党的基本路线,重点抓好规划、监督、服务、
信息。
李鹏说,从一些试点县的经验看,县级机构要将部分经济管理
部门改为经济实体和服务机构。由单纯的行政管理职能更多地转
为服务职能。这些经济和服务实体应逐步与行政财政脱钩,不赋予
行政管理职能,也不能成为政府办的为机关谋福利的公司,而应成
为自收自支或企业化管理的实体。
李鹏指出,县级机构在转变职能中要理顺县与乡镇的关系,政
府与企业的关系。属于乡镇的职权要下放给乡镇,属于企业的权要
下放给企业。
李鹏说,县级机构改革要大力精简机构和人员编制。要根据经
济发展水平、人口,面积等多种因素,对全国的县进行合理分类,制
订各种类别的县级机构的设置与人员编制。除中央规定必设的机
构外,其余机构可以根据各地的具体情况,因地制宜设置。上级政
府部门要支持县级机构改革,不要所有部门都要求上下对口。
谈到县级事业单位的改革时,李鹏说,要区别不同情况,采取
不同办法。从发展看,要逐步减少全额拨款和定额补贴的事业单
位。要把竞争机制、风险机制、激励机制引入事业单位,使各类事业
单位更好地为社会和经济发展服务。
李鹏强调,在精简机构中,要十分重视合理使用人才,实行人
员分流。要充分发挥离开机关人员的聪明才智和技术专长,使之成
为经济实体和服务组织的骨干力量,实现人力资源的合理配置。
会议提出,要进一步解放思想,大胆探索,加快县级综合改革
的步伐,在有条件的县率先建立社会主义商品经济的新体制和计
划与市场相结合的经济运行机制。
县级综合改革是80年代初开始的。目前,全国已有23个省、
自治区、直辖市确定了290个县(市)开展综合改革的试点。
实践表明,县级综合改革的基本经验是:打破城乡界限和部门
分割,实行农工商一体化,探索城乡经济协调发展的新途径;扩大
县级经济管理自主权,赋予县统筹经济发展的权力和调节手段;改
县级工业管理体制,转换企业经营机制,焕发各类所有制企业的
活力;培育市场,搞活流通,探索计划与市场结合的实现形式;转换
政府职能,精简机构,探索县级机构改革的新路子;向乡镇放权,理
顺县乡关系。
十多年来,县级综合改革使城乡经济格局发生了深刻变化,城
乡分割的局面开始打破,小城镇的建设明显加快,乡镇企业蓬勃发
展,县级自我发展能力增强。财政收入亿元县已达114个,国民生
产总值超亿元的乡镇已有2093个。
translated_text: On the 23rd and 24th, the State Commission for Restructuring the Economic System held a national county-level comprehensive reform experience exchange meeting. Li Peng, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Premier of the State Council, held a discussion with the participating representatives and delivered an important speech. Li Peng pointed out that the county-level system plays an important role in my country's economic, political and social development. The county-level system is a first-level political organization in the national management system that directly faces the vast rural areas and has relatively complete functions. It occupies a basic position in the administrative management level. Over the past decade, China's rural landscape has undergone remarkable changes, especially the rise of township enterprises and the development of the commodity economy, which have brought historic progress to the rural economy. However, as a county at the junction of urban and rural areas, many aspects cannot adapt to the progress of economic reform and the need to develop a socialist commodity economy. It is imperative to accelerate the comprehensive reform at the county level. Li Peng said that the country is currently actively implementing the spirit of Comrade Deng Xiaoping's important speech, and it is a good time to further deepen reform and expand opening up. He asked the party and government departments at all levels to proceed from the actual local conditions and further promote the process of comprehensive reform at the county level. He pointed out that, with the development of productivity, the implementation of comprehensive reform at the county level will inevitably require corresponding reforms in county-level institutions. Li Peng proposed that the reform of county-level institutions must first clarify the guiding ideology. The focus of the county's work in rural areas is to focus on agriculture first, and at the same time, to focus on township enterprises and the tertiary industry to promote the comprehensive development of rural economy and society. The general direction of county-level institutional reform is to take the path of "small institutions, big services", reduce administrative intervention, and further develop the service system. The main task of county-level institutions is to implement the party's basic line, focusing on planning, supervision, services, and information. Li Peng said that based on the experience of some pilot counties, county-level institutions should change some economic management departments into economic entities and service institutions. From pure administrative management functions to more service functions. These economic and service entities should gradually be decoupled from administrative finance, not given administrative management functions, and cannot become government-run companies that seek benefits for government agencies, but should become self-supporting or enterprise-managed entities. Li Peng pointed out that county-level institutions should straighten out the relationship between counties and townships, and the relationship between the government and enterprises in the transformation of their functions. The powers that belong to townships should be delegated to townships, and the powers that belong to enterprises should be delegated to enterprises. Li Peng said that the reform of county-level institutions should vigorously streamline institutions and staffing. According to various factors such as economic development level, population, and area, the counties across the country should be reasonably classified, and the establishment and staffing of various types of county-level institutions should be formulated. In addition to the institutions that must be set up by the central government, the remaining institutions can be set up according to the specific conditions of each place. The higher-level government departments should support the reform of county-level institutions, and not all departments should require upper and lower counterparts. When talking about the reform of county-level public institutions, Li Peng said that different situations should be distinguished and different methods should be adopted. From the perspective of development, the number of public institutions with full funding and fixed subsidies should be gradually reduced. Competition mechanisms, risk mechanisms, and incentive mechanisms should be introduced into public institutions so that various public institutions can better serve social and economic development. Li Peng emphasized that in streamlining institutions, great attention should be paid to the rational use of talents and the diversion of personnel. We should give full play to the wisdom and technical expertise of the personnel who have left the government, so that they can become the backbone of economic entities and service organizations, and realize the rational allocation of human resources. The meeting proposed that we should further emancipate our minds, boldly explore, accelerate the pace of comprehensive reform at the county level, and take the lead in establishing a new system of socialist commodity economy and an economic operation mechanism combining planning with the market in counties with conditions. Comprehensive reform at the county level began in the early 1980s. At present, 23 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities have identified 290 counties (cities) to carry out pilot comprehensive reforms. Practice has shown that the basic experience of comprehensive reform at the county level is: breaking the urban-rural boundaries and departmental divisions, implementing agricultural and industrial integration, and exploring new ways to coordinate the development of urban and rural economies; expanding the autonomy of county-level economic management, giving counties the power and means of regulation to coordinate economic development; reforming the county-level industrial management system, transforming the enterprise operation mechanism, and revitalizing enterprises of all types of ownership; cultivating the market, revitalizing circulation, and exploring the implementation form of combining planning with the market; transforming government functions, streamlining institutions, and exploring new ways to reform county-level institutions; delegating power to townships and straightening out county-town relations. Over the past decade, comprehensive reforms at the county level have brought about profound changes in the urban-rural economic structure. The urban-rural divide has begun to break down, the construction of small towns has accelerated significantly, township enterprises have flourished, and the county's self-development capabilities have been enhanced. There are now 114 counties with fiscal revenues of 100 million yuan, and 2,093 townships with a gross national product of over 100 million yuan.

党和国家干部制度改革的重要组成部分。做好干部退休工作,妥善
安置好退休干部,对于保证干部队伍新老交替的顺利进行,使各级

translated_text: On the same day, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the Ministry of Personnel of the State jointly issued a notice on "Opinions on Strengthening Cadre Retirement Work". The "Notice" pointed out that the implementation of the cadre retirement system is an important part of the reform of the cadre system of our party and the state. Doing a good job in cadre retirement and properly placing retired cadres is of great significance to ensuring the smooth transition of the old and new cadres, making organizations at all levels full of vitality and vigor, and promoting the development of reform and opening up and economic construction. All regions and departments must conscientiously implement the principles and policies of the party and the state on cadre retirement work, effectively strengthen leadership, put cadre retirement work on the agenda, and promptly study and solve relevant major issues. The cadre retirement work department must conscientiously perform its duties, conduct in-depth investigations and studies, put forward suggestions and solutions to problems, serve as a good adviser to the party committee and the government, and actively consult with relevant departments to strive for support from all aspects of society and jointly do a good job in cadre retirement. The Notice requires that organizations and personnel departments at all levels should strictly implement the cadre retirement system, conscientiously implement the spirit of the "Decision of the CPC Central Committee on Establishing a Retirement System for Old Cadres" (Zhongfa [1982] No. 13) and the "Notice on Conscientiously Implementing the Cadre Retirement (Leaving) System" (Zhongzufa [1988] No. 9) and other relevant regulations of the Central Organization Department and the State Personnel Department. All cadres who have reached retirement age, except those whose retirement age is extended or who remain in office in accordance with national regulations, should go through retirement procedures on time. Conscientiously implement the political and living benefits of retired cadres. After the cadres retire, the relevant units should organize retired cadres to study documents, listen to reports, participate in party organizational life, participate in relevant activities, and report relevant situations in accordance with the policies and regulations of the Party and the State, so that they can keep abreast of the Party's line, principles, policies and major domestic and international events. It is necessary to listen to and understand the opinions and requirements of retired cadres, do a good job in meticulous ideological work, and encourage them to continue to carry forward the glorious tradition and maintain revolutionary youth under the new situation of reform and opening up. The Notice requires that all regions and departments should actively support retired cadres to make further contributions to socialist modernization construction according to their professional expertise, interests, physical conditions, etc. They should focus on economic construction and play the role of retired cadres in an organized and led manner. Retired cadres who play their roles and make outstanding achievements should be commended and rewarded. Retired cadres should strictly implement the policies and relevant laws of the Party and the State, adhere to the principles of voluntariness and doing what they can, do more social work to make up for deficiencies, advocate the spirit of dedication without regard to remuneration, and allow reasonable remuneration within the scope of policy regulations. The Notice also requires that all regions and departments can refer to the spirit of "special funds for the management and activities of retired personnel, which should be listed separately in the administrative budget of the agency" in the document No. 32 of the State Machinery Bureau [1988], and make appropriate arrangements for the funds for the management and activities of retired cadres in light of the actual situation, and provide certain financial support. Localities and units with conditions can also solve the problem of insufficient funds for retired cadres' activities and management by organizing retired cadres to play a role in generating income, so as to support and ensure the development of retired cadres' management work.

translated_text: From the 28th to the 31st, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the State Council Leading Group for Economic Development in Poverty-stricken Areas and the China Foundation for Poverty Alleviation jointly held a symposium on the exchange of cadres between economically developed and impoverished areas in Beijing. The meeting summarized the situation of cadre exchanges between economically developed and impoverished areas to promote economic development. The meeting believed that the exchange of cadres between economically developed and impoverished areas is a better new form of gradually moving towards common prosperity under the current conditions in my country, where the rich first lead the poor, and this kind of exchange promotes economic cooperation and cooperation between the two sides on the basis of mutual benefit and complementary advantages, and becomes an important measure to promote common economic development; it is an effective way to train and exercise cadres. The meeting suggested that cooperation and exchanges between economically developed and impoverished areas must be based on complementary advantages and mutual benefit. The goals and responsibilities of the cadres in the counterpart exchanges should be very clear, and they should mainly focus on assisting in economic construction. The cadre exchange work should adhere to the principle of seeking truth from facts, and prevent a rush or forced conduct due to lack of conditions. The exchange of cadres should be flexible and diverse, focus on effectiveness, avoid formalism, and effectively strengthen leadership and organizational management. Lv Feng, Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, spoke at the meeting. He made six comments on how organizational work can serve economic construction. First, we must further firmly establish the guiding ideology of obeying and serving the center of economic construction, closely combine organizational work with the practice of economic construction and reform and opening up, and test organizational work by the results achieved in serving economic construction. Second, we must focus on the implementation of the party's basic line and the needs of economic development, and do a good job in the construction of leadership teams at all levels. Third, boldly select outstanding young cadres to join the team, and continue to do a good job in the training and education of young cadres. Fourth, we must firmly establish the concept of "science and technology is the first productive force", respect knowledge and talents, further do a good job in intellectual work, and mobilize the enthusiasm of intellectuals. Fifth, we must adapt to the requirements of deepening reform of the economic system, combine institutional reform and enterprise transformation of operating mechanisms, and accelerate the pace of reform of the cadre and personnel system. Sixth, we must further strengthen the construction of grassroots party organizations and give full play to the vanguard and exemplary role of the majority of Communist Party members in construction and reform. Representatives from Jiangsu, Shaanxi, Tianjin, Gansu, Shandong and Sichuan introduced their practices and experiences in cadre exchanges at the meeting. Chen Pixian, Chen Ye and other veteran comrades, heads of the Organization Departments of the Party Committees of 27 provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the Central Government, the Leading Groups for Poverty Alleviation and relevant departments of the Central State Organs attended the symposium. Li Xiannian, Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference and Honorary President of the China Foundation for Poverty Alleviation, sent a congratulatory letter to the symposium.

9日 中共中央总书记江泽民在中央党校省部级干部进修班
上发表题为《深刻领会和全面落实邓小平同志的重要谈话精神,把
经济建设和改革开放搞得更快更好》的重要讲话。
江泽民在讲话中共阐述了九个方面的问题:(1)关于抓住当前
有利时机,加快改革开放和经济建设的发展;(2)关于改革也是革
命也是解放生产力;(3)善于积极向资本主义国家学习和借鉴有用
的东西;(4)关于加快经济体制改革;(5)关于推进政治体制改革;
(6)关于坚持“两手抓”的方针;(7)关于解放思想、实事求是和要警
惕右但主要是防止“左”;(8)关于加强党的建设和提高党的领导水
平;(9)关于贯彻落实小平同志重要谈话精神的要求。
江泽民在概括了邓小平同志在十一届三中全会以后提出的建
设有中国特色社会主义理论的要点之后说,十多年来小平同志所
提出的各种重要的理论观点和实际决策,都体现了马克思主义的
基本原理同中国现代化建设具体实际的结合和统一,因而经得起
社会实践的检验和历史风波的考验,因而,具有稳定性和连续性,
因而能随着实践的前进而不断得到丰富和发展。小平同志的重要
思想是一以贯之的,他最近的谈话,也是他十多年来关于建设有中
国特色社会主义的一贯思想的高度体现和新的发展。
江泽民要求党的各级领导干部首先是高级干部,不仅要努力
学习和掌握十一届三中全会以来小平同志的一系列战略思想、理
论观点和决策原则,而且要努力学习他在研究新情况解决新问题
中实事求是精神和马克思主义的立场、观点、方法,以便改进领导
工作,提高领导水平和领导艺术。
江泽民说,综观当前的国际国内形势,对我们加快改革开放的
步伐,加快经济发展来说,有利不少。只要我们紧紧抓住和充分利
用这些有利条件或良好机遇,完全可以把经济建设和改革开放搞
得更快更好,如果我们放过了这种有利时机,没有新的发展和新的
作为,那就会犯历史性的错误。
在谈到关于改革也是革命也是解放生产力时,江泽民说,小平
同志要求我们把改革提到革命,提到解放生产力这样应有的高度
上来认识和把握,这就把改革的性质、目的、意义,讲得更完全更透
彻了。
改革的一个核心问题,就是要从根本上改变束缚生产力发展
的原有经济体制,建立充满生机与活力的新经济体制。清除不利于
生产力发展的障碍,使生产力进一步得到解放,从这个意义上说改
革也是一次革命,改革也是解放生产力。
在谈到关于大胆向资本主义国家学习和借鉴有用的东西时,
江泽民指出,社会主义作为一种崭新的社会制度,只有在继承和利
用资本主义社会已经创造出来的全部社会生产力和全部优秀文化
成果的基础上,并结合新的实际进行新的创造,才能顺利建设成
功。但是,在过去长时期内,我们在对待资本主义问题上,往往只看
到或更多看到的是社会主义词它对立和斗争的一面,而很少看到
社会主义同它还有学习、借鉴、合作和利用的一面。这种认识上的
片面性,不符合社会历史发展的辩证法,不利于社会主义经济文化
的进步。
小平同志提出必须坚持改革开放,坚持解放思想和实事求是,
一个很重要的方面,就是要求我们摆脱过去的一些片面认识大胆
利用国外主要是资本主义国家的资金、人才和先进技术,大胆吸收
和借鉴世界各国包括资本主义发达国家的一切现代化社会生产规
律的先进的经营方式和管理方法。立足我国实际,把国外的这些有
用的东西认真学过来,在社会主义基础上加以运用、改进、提高,以
创造和发展中国特色的新东西,这样我们进行社会主义现代化
建设和改革开放的本事就会增大起来,就可以加快我国经济和社
会的发展,赢得与资本主义相比较的优势。所以我们在学习和利用
资本主义国家的一切有用东西时,思想要更解放一些,胆子要更大
一些,步子要更快一些,办法要更多一些,而不要被“姓社还是姓
资”问题的抽象争论束缚自己的思想和手脚,迈不开前进的步子。
因为学习和利用这些有用的东西,不存在“姓社姓资”问题,它们是
人类社会共同创造的文明成果,资本主义社会可以用,社会主义社
会也可以用。
我们在学习和借鉴资本主义国家一切好的东西时,当然不能
妄自菲薄,不能对社会主义事业缺乏信心。我们并不是一切都落
后,如果因为要向外国学习,就以为自己什么也不行了,变成盲目
崇外,那同样是一种片面性。
至于极少数人,认为中国对西方国家的政治制度、经济制度,
如议会制、多党制,私有制等,也应照搬过来,对于这种错误倾向,
我们任何时候都要警惕和防止,不能让它们干扰我们的改革开放
还有一种观点,认为随着现代科学技术的发展和资本主义社
会出现的新变化,社会主义与资本主义两种制度会越来越溶合在
一起,这种抹去两种制度区别的所谓“趋同论”,我认为也是站不住
脚的。社会主义同资本主义在基本政治制度、经济制度上是有着本
质区别的,这种本来就存在的根本界限,无疑是应该划清的,而不
可以含糊。
关于加快经济体制改革,江泽民说,加快经济体制改革的根本
任务,就是要尽快建立社会主义的新经济体制。而建立新经济体制
的一个关键问题,是要正确认识计划与市场问题及其相互关系,就
是要在国家宏观调控下,更加重视和发挥市场在资源配置上的作
用合适
江泽民说,我国社会主义的新经济体制的主要特征:一是在所
有制结构上,坚持以公有制经济为主体,个体经济、私营经济和其
他经济成分为补充,多种成分共同发展;二是在分配制度上,坚持
以按劳分配为主体,其他分配方式为补充,允许和鼓励一部分地
区、一部分人先富起来,逐步实现共同富裕,防止两极分化;三是在
经济运行机制上,把市场经济和计划经济的长处有机结合起来,充
分发挥各自的优势作用,促进资源的优化配置,合理调节社会分
配。
江泽民强调说,要加快新经济体制的建立,当前必须抓紧解决
好几个关键性的问题。
一是转变政府职能,切实实行政企职责分开。政府对社会经济
活动的管理职能,主要是统筹规划、掌握政策、组织协调、提供服务
和检查监督,运用经济手段、法律手段和必要的行政手段,保证经
济总量平衡和重大经济结构与布局的协调。入小弟干至
二是抓紧企业特别是国有大中型企业的经营机制的转换,真
正推动企业走上市场,使它们成为市场竞争的主体,成为真正的法
人实体,真正实现自主经营、自负盈亏、自我发展、自我约束和自担
风险,达到责全利相统一。
三是要适应商品经济和价值规律的要求,切实更新计划观念,
转变计划管理职能和方式,使计划能够真正反映市场的供求变化。
同时,要更多地运用经济政策和经济杠杆引导和调控市场健康发
展。
四是大力培育和发展市场,建立统一的完备的社会主义市场。
五是要加强经济法规和经济运行所必需的其他基础设施建
设。在谈到政治体制改革的目标时,江泽民说,政治体制改革的目
标是,建设有中国特色的社会主义民主政治,健全社会主义法制,
切实保障人民群众当家作主的权利。我们将继续完善人民代表大
会制度,继续完善中国共产党领导的多党合作和政治协商制度。同
时,我们将通过实现干部队伍“四化”等措施,增强党政机关和领导
班子的活力;通过机构改革和克服官僚主义、形式主义,提高决策
效率和办事效率;通过实行政企职责分开、权力下放等措施,充分
调动各行各业和基层群众的积极性。我们进行政治体制改革的总
的目的,就是有利于巩固社会主义制度,有利于巩固党的领导,有
利于在党的领导下和社会主义制度下发展社会生产力,有利于贯
彻十一届三中全会以来制定的路线方针政策,有利于取得和保持
一个经济发展所必需的稳定的社会政治环境。
江泽民强调指出,当前,需要迅速提上日程并抓紧解决的一项
重要政治体制改革任务,就是进一步进行机构改革,实行精兵简
政。改革的指导思想是:按照政企职责分开和精简、统一、效能的原
则,转变职能,理顺关系,精兵简政,提高效率。总的方向是搞“小机
关,大服务”。为了保证机构改革的顺利进行,要大力加强思想政治
工作,充分考虑各方面的承受能力,有领导有秩序地分步实施。
江泽民在谈到要坚持“两手抓”的方针时说,既要把经济建设、
物质文明搞上去,又要把社会主义精神文明搞上去,做到两个文明
同时并茂。在精神文明建设中,要注意坚持把对人民的爱国主义、
集体主义、社会主义教育同进行中华民族优秀的思想文化传统、优
良的社会公德教育,有机地结合和统一起来。
实行“两手抓”,应该成为我们领导现代化建设和改革开放事
业的一个重要指导思想和领导方法、领导艺术。这样就可以使我们
的政策更加鲜明,使我们在工作中防止顾此失彼。
在谈到解放思想、实事求是时,江泽民说,解放思想,是党的十
一届三中全会以来的一个非常重要的原则精神。所谓解放思想,就
是要勇于冲破落后的传统观念的束缚,善于从实际出发,努力去开
拓进取。
在防止和反对错误倾向的问题上,要警惕右,但主要是防止
“左”。现实生活表明,“左”的表现主要是停留在过去对马克思主义
的某些原则、某些本本的教条式理解上,或者停留在过去对社会主
义的一些不科学的甚至完全扭曲了的认识上,或者停留在改革开
放前那些超越社会主义初级阶段的不正确的思想和政策上,而不
是用马克思主义的立场、观点、方法分析变化了的客观实际,因此
不容易接受改革开放的正确政策,甚至怀疑和否定改革开放,认为
搞改革开放就会走向资本主义道路,仍用过去那种“阶级斗争为
纲”的思想来影响以至冲击经济建设为中心。右的表现主要是怀疑
和否定四项基本原则,搞资产阶级自由化,甚至制造政治动乱,企
图改变我们的社会主义制度和改革开放的正确方向。无论是“左”
还是右,都会给党造成巨大危害,都可以送社会主义。
江泽民说,为什么小平同志在讲到警惕右时,特别指出主要是
防止“左”呢?这一点很重要,我们一定要深刻领会。这是因为在党
的历史上,“左”的错误泛滥的时间很长,影响很深,在改革开放中
要开辟新的道路,要改变妨碍生产力发展的原有模式和做法时,阻
力常常主要是来自“左”的方面。由于“左”的东西往往带着一些革
命色彩,容易给人们以迷惑作用,这就更需要提醒我们的领导干部
要特别注意防止“左”的干扰。
江泽民就加强党的建设和领导,谈了四个问题:一是关于新时
期衡量党员先锋模范作用的标准问题。二是关于党的领导干部要
以身作则问题。三是关于加强学习问题。四是大力加强党的基层
组织建设问题。
江泽民最后指出,现在各级党委的一个重要任务,就是要深刻
领会和全面落实小平同志的重要谈话精神,进一步发挥广大干部
和群众的积极性、主动性和创造性,使其成为加快改革开放和经济
发展的强大动力。
translated_text: On the 9th, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, delivered an important speech entitled "Deeply understand and fully implement the spirit of Comrade Deng Xiaoping's important talk, and make economic construction and reform and opening up faster and better" at the Central Party School's provincial and ministerial cadres training class. In his speech, Jiang Zemin elaborated on nine aspects: (1) on seizing the current favorable opportunity to accelerate the development of reform and opening up and economic construction; (2) on reform is also a revolution and the liberation of productivity; (3) on being good at actively learning and drawing on useful things from capitalist countries; (4) on accelerating economic system reform; (5) on promoting political system reform; (6) on adhering to the principle of "grasping both ends"; (7) on emancipating the mind, seeking truth from facts and being vigilant to the right but mainly to prevent "left"; (8) on strengthening party building and improving the party's leadership level; (9) on implementing the requirements of Comrade Xiaoping's important talk. Jiang Zemin summarized the key points of the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics put forward by Comrade Deng Xiaoping after the Third Plenary Session of the Eleventh Central Committee and said that the various important theoretical viewpoints and practical decisions put forward by Comrade Xiaoping over the past decade have embodied the combination and unity of the basic principles of Marxism with the concrete reality of China's modernization construction, and therefore can withstand the test of social practice and the test of historical turmoil, and therefore have stability and continuity, and can be continuously enriched and developed with the progress of practice. Comrade Xiaoping's important thoughts are consistent, and his recent talks are also a high degree of embodiment and new development of his consistent thoughts on building socialism with Chinese characteristics over the past decade. Jiang Zemin requires that leading cadres at all levels of the Party, especially senior cadres, should not only strive to learn and master Comrade Xiaoping's series of strategic thoughts, theoretical viewpoints and decision-making principles since the Third Plenary Session of the Eleventh Central Committee, but also strive to learn his spirit of seeking truth from facts and Marxist positions, viewpoints and methods in studying new situations and solving new problems, so as to improve leadership work and improve leadership level and leadership art. Jiang Zemin said that the current international and domestic situation is beneficial to us in accelerating the pace of reform and opening up and accelerating economic development. As long as we firmly grasp and make full use of these favorable conditions or good opportunities, we can make economic construction and reform and opening up faster and better. If we miss this favorable opportunity and have no new development and new actions, we will make a historical mistake. When talking about the fact that reform is also a revolution and the liberation of productivity, Jiang Zemin said that Comrade Xiaoping asked us to understand and grasp reform at the level of revolution and the liberation of productivity, which explains the nature, purpose and significance of reform more completely and thoroughly. A core issue of reform is to fundamentally change the original economic system that restricts the development of productivity and establish a new economic system full of vitality and vigor. Remove obstacles that are not conducive to the development of productivity and further liberate productivity. In this sense, reform is also a revolution and reform is also the liberation of productivity. When talking about boldly learning and drawing on useful things from capitalist countries, Jiang Zemin pointed out that socialism, as a brand-new social system, can only be successfully built on the basis of inheriting and utilizing all the social productive forces and all the excellent cultural achievements that have been created by capitalist society, and combining new creations with new realities. However, in the past, when dealing with the issue of capitalism, we often only saw or more saw the side of socialism that was in opposition and struggle with it, and rarely saw the side of socialism that was learning, drawing on, cooperating and utilizing it. This one-sided understanding is not in line with the dialectics of social and historical development and is not conducive to the progress of socialist economy and culture. Comrade Xiaoping proposed that we must adhere to reform and opening up, adhere to emancipating the mind and seeking truth from facts. A very important aspect is that we must get rid of some of the one-sided understandings of the past, boldly utilize the funds, talents and advanced technologies of foreign countries, mainly capitalist countries, and boldly absorb and draw on the advanced business methods and management methods of all modern social production laws in countries around the world, including developed capitalist countries. Based on our country's reality, we should learn these useful things from foreign countries seriously, apply, improve and enhance them on the basis of socialism, so as to create and develop new things with Chinese characteristics. In this way, our ability to carry out socialist modernization and reform and opening up will be enhanced, and we can accelerate the development of our country's economy and society and gain advantages compared with capitalism. Therefore, when we learn and use all the useful things from capitalist countries, we should be more open-minded, bolder, faster and more resourceful, and not be bound by the abstract debate on "socialism or capitalism" and unable to move forward. Because when learning and using these useful things, there is no "socialism or capitalism" problem. They are the civilized achievements created by human society. They can be used by capitalist society and socialist society. When we learn and draw lessons from all the good things from capitalist countries, we must not be self-deprecating and lack confidence in the cause of socialism. We are not backward in everything. If we think we can do nothing because we want to learn from foreign countries and become blindly worshipping foreign countries, it is also a one-sidedness. As for the very few people who think that China should copy the political and economic systems of Western countries, such as parliamentary system, multi-party system, private ownership, etc., we must always be vigilant and prevent such erroneous tendencies and not let them interfere with our reform and opening up. There is also a view that with the development of modern science and technology and the new changes in capitalist society, the two systems of socialism and capitalism will increasingly merge together. I think this so-called "convergence theory" that erases the difference between the two systems is also untenable. Socialism and capitalism are essentially different in basic political and economic systems. This fundamental boundary that already exists should undoubtedly be drawn and cannot be ambiguous. Regarding accelerating economic system reform, Jiang Zemin said that the fundamental task of accelerating economic system reform is to establish a new socialist economic system as soon as possible. A key issue in establishing a new economic system is to correctly understand the issues of planning and market and their relationship, that is, to attach more importance to and give full play to the role of the market in resource allocation under the macro-control of the state. Jiang Zemin said that the main features of my country's new socialist economic system are: first, in terms of ownership structure, adhere to the public ownership economy as the main body, individual economy, private economy and other economic elements as supplements, and multiple elements develop together; second, in terms of distribution system, adhere to distribution according to work as the main body, other distribution methods as supplements, allow and encourage some regions and some people to get rich first, gradually achieve common prosperity, and prevent polarization; third, in terms of economic operation mechanism, organically combine the strengths of market economy and planned economy, give full play to their respective advantages, promote the optimal allocation of resources, and reasonably adjust social distribution. Jiang Zemin emphasized that in order to accelerate the establishment of a new economic system, several key issues must be addressed at present. First, transform government functions and effectively implement the separation of government and enterprise responsibilities. The government's management functions for social and economic activities are mainly to coordinate planning, grasp policies, organize and coordinate, provide services and inspect and supervise, and use economic means, legal means and necessary administrative means to ensure the balance of economic aggregate and the coordination of major economic structures and layouts. Second, we should speed up the transformation of the operating mechanism of enterprises, especially large and medium-sized state-owned enterprises, and truly promote enterprises to enter the market, so that they can become the main body of market competition and become real legal entities, truly realize independent operation, self-financing, self-development, self-discipline and self-risk, and achieve the unity of responsibility, fullness and benefit. Third, we should adapt to the requirements of commodity economy and value law, effectively update the planning concept, transform the planning management functions and methods, so that the plan can truly reflect the changes in market supply and demand. At the same time, we should make more use of economic policies and economic levers to guide and regulate the healthy development of the market. Fourth, we should vigorously cultivate and develop the market and establish a unified and complete socialist market. Fifth, we should strengthen the construction of economic laws and other infrastructure necessary for economic operation. When talking about the goal of political system reform, Jiang Zemin said that the goal of political system reform is to build socialist democracy with Chinese characteristics, improve the socialist legal system, and effectively protect the people's right to be masters of their own country. We will continue to improve the people's congress system and the multi-party cooperation and political consultation system under the leadership of the Communist Party of China. At the same time, we will enhance the vitality of party and government organs and leadership teams through measures such as realizing the "four modernizations" of the cadre team; improve decision-making efficiency and work efficiency through institutional reform and overcoming bureaucracy and formalism; and fully mobilize the enthusiasm of all walks of life and grassroots people through measures such as separation of government and enterprise responsibilities and decentralization of power. The overall purpose of our political system reform is to help consolidate the socialist system, consolidate the party's leadership, develop social productivity under the party's leadership and the socialist system, implement the line, principles and policies formulated since the Third Plenary Session of the Eleventh Central Committee, and obtain and maintain a stable social and political environment necessary for economic development. Jiang Zemin emphasized that at present, an important task of political system reform that needs to be put on the agenda quickly and solved urgently is to further carry out institutional reform and implement a streamlined administration. The guiding ideology of the reform is: in accordance with the principles of separation of government and enterprise responsibilities and streamlining, unification and efficiency, transform functions, straighten out relations, streamline administration and improve efficiency. The general direction is to create "small institutions, big services". In order to ensure the smooth progress of institutional reform, it is necessary to vigorously strengthen ideological and political work, fully consider the bearing capacity of all parties, and implement it step by step under leadership and order. When talking about adhering to the principle of "grasping both ends", Jiang Zemin said that it is necessary to promote economic construction and material civilization, and to promote socialist spiritual civilization, so that both civilizations flourish at the same time. In the construction of spiritual civilization, attention should be paid to the organic combination and unification of the people's patriotism, collectivism, and socialist education with the excellent ideological and cultural traditions of the Chinese nation and excellent social morality education. Implementing "grasping both ends" should become an important guiding ideology, leadership method and leadership art for our leadership of modernization construction and reform and opening up. This will make our policies more distinct and prevent us from neglecting one thing while focusing on another in our work. When talking about emancipating the mind and seeking truth from facts, Jiang Zemin said that emancipating the mind is a very important principle and spirit since the Third Plenary Session of the Eleventh Central Committee of the Party. The so-called emancipation of the mind means having the courage to break through the shackles of backward traditional concepts, being good at starting from reality and striving to forge ahead. In preventing and opposing wrong tendencies, we must be vigilant against the right, but mainly prevent the "left". Real life shows that the manifestation of "leftism" is mainly to stay in the past dogmatic understanding of certain principles and books of Marxism, or to stay in the past unscientific or even completely distorted understanding of socialism, or to stay in the incorrect ideas and policies that surpassed the primary stage of socialism before reform and opening up, instead of using the Marxist standpoint, viewpoint and method to analyze the changed objective reality. Therefore, it is not easy to accept the correct policy of reform and opening up, and even doubt and deny reform and opening up, thinking that reform and opening up will lead to the capitalist road, and still use the past "class struggle as the key link" to influence and even impact economic construction. The manifestation of rightism is mainly to doubt and deny the four basic principles, engage in bourgeois liberalization, and even create political turmoil, attempting to change our socialist system and the correct direction of reform and opening up. Whether it is "left" or right, it will cause great harm to the party and can give up socialism. Jiang Zemin said, why did Comrade Xiaoping especially point out that it is mainly to prevent "leftism" when talking about being vigilant against rightism? This is very important and we must deeply understand it. This is because in the history of the Party, the "left" mistakes have been rampant for a long time and have had a profound impact. In the reform and opening up, when opening up new roads and changing the original models and practices that hinder the development of productivity, the resistance often comes mainly from the "left". Since "left" things often have some revolutionary colors and are easy to confuse people, it is even more necessary to remind our leading cadres to pay special attention to preventing "left" interference. Jiang Zemin talked about four issues on strengthening party building and leadership: First, the standard for measuring the vanguard and exemplary role of party members in the new period. Second, the issue of leading cadres of the Party setting an example. Third, the issue of strengthening learning. Fourth, the issue of vigorously strengthening the construction of grassroots party organizations. Jiang Zemin finally pointed out that an important task of party committees at all levels now is to deeply understand and fully implement the spirit of Comrade Xiaoping's important talks, and further give play to the enthusiasm, initiative and creativity of the broad masses of cadres and the masses, so that they can become a powerful driving force for accelerating reform and opening up and economic development.

26日 中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅联合下发关于党政机
关兴办经济实体和党政机关干部从事经营活动问题的通知。《通
知》指出,最近一个时期,一些地区陆续作出规定,鼓励党政机关兴
办各类经济实体,提倡和支持党政机关干部从事各种经营活动。这
是一个政策性强而且比较复杂的问题,必须坚持政企分开的原则。
为了防止出现政企不分、官商不分及以权谋私等问题,通知规定:
一、县及县以上党政机关(包括党委机关、国家权力机关、行政
机关、审判机关、检察机关),要坚决执行中共中央、国务院历来的
规定,不准经商办企业。所兴办的各类经济实体,必须与党政机关
在财务、名称、人事等方面彻底脱钩。严格划清党政机关管理职权
与经济实体经营权的界限,凡是经济实体,必须根据国家法律和政
策的规定,自主经营,自负盈亏。严禁用经济实体经营所得增加机
关干部的工资、奖金、补贴等收入或用作其他福利开支。严禁党政
机关利用自己掌握的权力为经济实体谋取非法利益。
在当前机构改革试点和下一步机构改革中,由政府经济管理
部门成建制转为经济实体的,要严格实行政企职责分开,不能“一
个机构、两块牌子”,不能再行使政府部门的行政管理职能。翅
二、县及县以上党政机关在职干部一律不得经商办企业,不
得兼有党政机关干部和企业职工双重身份。在机构改革试点中,应
支持和鼓励一部分干部从党政机关分离出来,从事包括第三产业
在内的各种经济活动,尤其应提倡其中的专业技术人员领办、承
包､租赁亏损､微利企业,创办开发性、服务性的经济实体。但这些
人员不能保留原在党政机关担任的职务,不能再以党政机关的名
义或以党政机关干部的身份从事经营活动,要与党政机关脱钩。
三、各级党委、政府要遵照党中央、国务院的要求,抓紧当前有
利时机,进一步解放思想,加快改革开放和经济发展步伐,力争使
经济更好更快地上一个新台阶;同时要继续抓好廉政建设、纠正部
门和行业不正之风等工作,注意掌握好党政机关兴办经济实体和
党政机关干部从事经营活动中的政策界限。要认真研究新情况,及
时解决新问题,使本地区、本部门的改革开放和经济建设工作更健
康地向前发展。
translated_text:
On the 26th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council jointly issued a notice on the establishment of economic entities by party and government agencies and the engagement of party and government agency cadres in business activities. The "Notice" pointed out that in recent times, some regions have successively made regulations to encourage party and government agencies to establish various economic entities and advocate and support party and government agency cadres to engage in various business activities. This is a highly policy-oriented and relatively complex issue, and the principle of separation of government and enterprises must be upheld. In order to prevent the emergence of problems such as the fusion of government and enterprises, the fusion of officials and businessmen, and the abuse of power for personal gain, the notice stipulates: 1. Party and government agencies at or above the county level (including party committees, state power organs, administrative organs, judicial organs, and procuratorates) must resolutely implement the regulations of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council and are not allowed to engage in business and run enterprises. All types of economic entities established must be completely decoupled from party and government agencies in terms of finance, name, personnel, etc. Strictly draw a clear line between the management authority of party and government agencies and the operating rights of economic entities. All economic entities must operate independently and bear their own profits and losses in accordance with the provisions of national laws and policies. It is strictly forbidden to use the income from the operation of economic entities to increase the salary, bonus, subsidy and other income of government officials or to use it for other welfare expenses. It is strictly forbidden for party and government organs to use their own power to seek illegal benefits for economic entities. In the current institutional reform pilot and the next institutional reform, the government economic management departments that are transformed into economic entities must strictly implement the separation of government and enterprise responsibilities. They cannot be "one institution with two brands" and can no longer exercise the administrative management functions of government departments. Wing 2. Incumbent cadres of county-level and above party and government organs are not allowed to engage in business and run enterprises, and cannot have the dual identities of party and government cadres and enterprise employees. In the institutional reform pilot, some cadres should be supported and encouraged to separate from party and government organs and engage in various economic activities including the tertiary industry. In particular, professional and technical personnel should be encouraged to lead, contract, lease loss-making and low-profit enterprises, and establish development and service economic entities. However, these personnel cannot retain their original positions in party and government organs, and cannot engage in business activities in the name of party and government organs or as party and government organ cadres. They must be separated from party and government organs.
3. Party committees and governments at all levels should follow the requirements of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, seize the current favorable opportunity, further emancipate their minds, accelerate the pace of reform and opening up and economic development, and strive to take the economy to a new level better and faster; at the same time, they should continue to do a good job in building a clean government, correcting unhealthy trends in departments and industries, and pay attention to the policy boundaries between party and government organs in establishing economic entities and party and government organ cadres in engaging in business activities. We must carefully study new situations and solve new problems in a timely manner to enable the reform and opening up and economic construction work in this region and department to move forward more healthily.

30日 中共中央组织部、国家人事部、财政部、民政部联合发
出《关于妥善解决离任村干部生活困难问题的通知》。
《通知》指出:目前,农村中,特别是老、少、边穷地区,有一部
分离任村干部,由于种种原因,生活比较困难。应该看到,离任村干
部中的绝大多数人,长期辛勤操劳在农村工作的最基层,为我国农
村的发展和繁荣做出了积极贡献。在他们离任后,继续给予必要照
顾,妥善解决其生活困难问题,对于充分体现党和政府对广大农村
基层干部的关怀爱护,进一步密切党群关系,提高党在群众中的威
信;对于调动在职村干部的积极性,加强以党支部为核心的村级组
织建设,推动农村改革和农村经济的发展,具有十分重要的意义。
解决离任村干部生活困难问题,应本着“积极稳妥、因地制宜、
统筹兼顾,区别对待”的原则,采取发放生活困难补贴等方式予以
解决。补贴的对象和范围,补贴标准和任职多长时间给予补贴等,
由各省、区、市根据本地实际情况,自行确定。其补贴资金的筹集,
可采取乡镇企业补一点、村级集体经济出一点、地方财政拨一点的
办法解决,或由各地根据本地的实际情况采取其它办法解决。在筹
集补贴资金时,要严格按国务院颁发的《农民承担费用和劳务管理
条例》(1991年12月7日国务院令第92号)的有关规定执行。
对那些身体尚好,有一定劳动能力的离任村干部,可照顾他们
在村里做些力所能及的工作,或者帮助他们发展家庭副业,鼓励他
们通过自身努力增加经济收入,克服生活困难;对那些完全丧失生
活能力的,应给予特殊照顾。
在妥善解决离任村干部生活困难的同时,要注意从政治上关
心他们。对在职时有突出贡献的离任村干部,可授予荣誉称号,颁
发荣誉证书,增强他们的荣誉感。在一些重大节日,乡镇党委和政
府要组织慰问离任村干部,认真听取他们的意见,帮助他们排忧解
难,形成一种尊重和关心离任村干部的良好风尚。
translated_text: On the 30th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, the Ministry of Personnel, the Ministry of Finance, and the Ministry of Civil Affairs jointly issued the "Notice on Properly Solving the Difficulties of the Life of Outgoing Village Cadres". The "Notice" pointed out: At present, in rural areas, especially in old, young, border and poor areas, some outgoing village cadres have a difficult life due to various reasons. It should be noted that the vast majority of outgoing village cadres have worked hard at the grassroots level in rural areas for a long time and have made positive contributions to the development and prosperity of rural areas in my country. After they leave office, continuing to provide necessary care and properly solving their living difficulties is of great significance to fully reflect the care and love of the Party and the government for the vast number of grassroots rural cadres, further strengthen the relationship between the Party and the masses, and enhance the prestige of the Party among the masses; to mobilize the enthusiasm of incumbent village cadres, strengthen the construction of village-level organizations with the Party branch as the core, and promote rural reform and rural economic development. To solve the problem of living difficulties of outgoing village cadres, we should follow the principle of "active and prudent, adapting to local conditions, taking into account all factors and treating them differently" and adopt the method of issuing living difficulties subsidies. The recipients and scope of subsidies, subsidy standards and the length of time for subsidies shall be determined by each province, autonomous region and municipality according to local actual conditions. The fundraising of subsidy funds can be solved by the method of township enterprises subsidizing a little, village collective economy contributing a little, local finance allocating a little, or by other methods adopted by various places according to local actual conditions. When raising subsidy funds, we must strictly follow the relevant provisions of the "Regulations on the Management of Farmers' Expenses and Labor Services" issued by the State Council (State Council Order No. 92 of December 7, 1991). For those outgoing village cadres who are still in good health and have a certain working ability, we can take care of them and do some work in the village within their capacity, or help them develop family sideline businesses, encourage them to increase their economic income through their own efforts and overcome living difficulties; those who have completely lost their ability to live should be given special care. While properly solving the living difficulties of outgoing village cadres, we should pay attention to caring for them politically. Outgoing village cadres who have made outstanding contributions while in office can be awarded honorary titles and issued honorary certificates to enhance their sense of honor. On some major festivals, township party committees and governments should organize condolences to outgoing village cadres, listen carefully to their opinions, help them solve their problems, and form a good trend of respecting and caring for outgoing village cadres.
