万名。截止1991 年底,全国申请入党的人数共有1241万名,比上
年同期增加300余万名。
translated_text: According to statistics from the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, 1.636 million new members were admitted nationwide last year. By the end of 1991, the number of people who applied to join the party nationwide was 12.41 million, an increase of more than 3 million over the same period last year.

events: 1日——4日 中央组织部、中央宣传部和国家教育委员会党组在北京联合召开全国高等学校党的建设工作会议。会议的主要任务是,学习、贯彻邓小平同志视察南方重要谈话精神和中央政治局全体会议精神,总结交流近几年来的工作经验,明确在新形势下加强和改进高校党的建设和思想政治工作任务,研究深化高教改革的指导思想和基本方针,促进高教事业更好地为社会主义现代化服务。中央组织部部长吕枫、中央宣传部部长王忍等有关部门的领导同志出席了会议。中共中央政治局委员、国务委员兼国家教育委员会主任、党组书记李铁映作了题为《加强党的建设,深化高校改革,为经济建设服务》的报告。中共中央政治局常委宋平同会议部分代表进行了座谈。宋平在座谈时说,近几年来,各级党委和高校党组织按照小平同志关于要聚精会神抓党的建设的意见和中央的部署,认真贯彻执行党的基本路线,加强高校党的建设和思想政治工作,取得了很大成绩。他强调,小平同志视察南方的重要谈话,对加强高校党的建设和思想政治工作具有重要指导意义。当前,加快改革开放和经济发展步伐,急需大批优秀人才,在这方面,高等学校担负着光荣的责任,一定要认真学习贯彻小平同志重要谈话精神,把高校党建工作搞得更好。宋平指出,高校党委要贯彻好党的基本路线和党的教育方针,掌握好办学方向,积极领导高校的改革,使高校工作跟上时代前进的步伐,适应经济建设和改革开放的要求。要发挥我们党的优势,抓好领导班子和干部队伍建设,稳定和提高高校党务工作和思想政治工作队伍。下功夫把党支部建设好,把党支部建设的成效作为检验党建工作的重要标准。要在保证质量的前提下,加强培养,及时把符合条件的优秀分子吸收到党的队伍中来。宋平指出,高校的思想政治工作必须紧密结合时代的特点和学校的实际,掌握师生的思想脉搏,有的放矢,这样才能解决问题,收到实效。党委要重视教师的工作,从各方面关心他们。
translated_text: From the 1st to the 4th, the Central Organization Department, the Central Propaganda Department and the Party Group of the State Education Commission jointly held a national conference on party building in colleges and universities in Beijing. The main tasks of the conference were to study and implement the spirit of Comrade Deng Xiaoping's important speech during his inspection in the south and the spirit of the plenary meeting of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee, summarize and exchange work experience in recent years, clarify the tasks of strengthening and improving party building and ideological and political work in colleges and universities under the new situation, study the guiding ideology and basic principles of deepening higher education reform, and promote higher education to better serve socialist modernization. Lv Feng, Minister of the Central Organization Department, Wang Ren, Minister of the Central Propaganda Department and other leaders of relevant departments attended the meeting. Li Tieying, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, State Councilor and Director of the State Education Commission and Secretary of the Party Group, delivered a report entitled "Strengthening Party Building, Deepening College Reform, and Serving Economic Construction". Song Ping, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, held a discussion with some representatives of the conference. Song Ping said at the forum that in recent years, Party committees at all levels and party organizations in colleges and universities have conscientiously implemented the Party's basic line and strengthened party building and ideological and political work in colleges and universities in accordance with Comrade Xiaoping's opinions on concentrating on party building and the deployment of the Central Committee, and have achieved great results. He emphasized that Comrade Xiaoping's important speech during his inspection in the south has important guiding significance for strengthening party building and ideological and political work in colleges and universities. At present, accelerating the pace of reform and opening up and economic development urgently requires a large number of outstanding talents. In this regard, colleges and universities have a glorious responsibility and must conscientiously study and implement the spirit of Comrade Xiaoping's important speech to do a better job in party building in colleges and universities. Song Ping pointed out that the party committees of colleges and universities should implement the party's basic line and the party's education policy, master the direction of running schools, actively lead the reform of colleges and universities, make college work keep pace with the times, and adapt to the requirements of economic construction and reform and opening up. We must give full play to the advantages of our party, do a good job in the construction of leadership teams and cadres, and stabilize and improve the party work and ideological and political work teams in colleges and universities. We should work hard to build party branches well and take the effectiveness of party branch construction as an important criterion for testing party building work. Under the premise of ensuring quality, we should strengthen training and timely absorb qualified outstanding members into the party ranks. Song Ping pointed out that the ideological and political work of colleges and universities must be closely combined with the characteristics of the times and the actual situation of the school, grasp the ideological pulse of teachers and students, and be targeted, so as to solve problems and achieve practical results. The party committee should attach importance to the work of teachers and care about them in all aspects.

events:
7日 中共中央组织部、国家人事部联合发出《关于加强国家
行政机关工作人员晋升行政职务管理工作的通知》。《通知》规定:
一、晋升工作人员行政职务,必须全面贯彻执行干部队伍革命
化、年轻化、知识化、专业化的方针,坚持党的德才兼备的原则。
晋升行政职务的工作人员,必须能坚定地贯彻执行党的以经
济建设为中心,坚持四项基本原则,坚持改革开放的基本路线和各
项方针政策,有较强的事业心和责任感,做出工作实绩,廉洁奉公,
遵纪守法,作风正派,全心全意为人民服务,具有所任职务需要的
文化专业知识水平和工作能力。晋升行政领导职务的,还必须具有
胜任领导工作的理论政策水平和组织领导能力及良好的工作作
风,并符合领导集体在年龄结构等方面的要求。
二、晋升工作人员行政职务,要实行任职资格审查制度。列为
晋升初选对象的,除符合第一条规定的标准外,还应符合下列资格
条件:
(一)近两年年度考核连续为优秀或近3年连续为称职以上。
对尚未进行年度考核的,可根据预选对象近二、三年的德才表现和
工作实绩,确认是否符合本项资格条件的原则要求。
(二)晋升科员和正副科级职务,应具有高中、中专以上文化程
度;晋升正副处、司(厅)级职务,应具有大专以上文化程度。
(三)晋升正科、正处级职务,需分别任副科、副处级职务2年
以上;晋升科员、副科、副处、副司(厅)、正司(厅)级职务,需分别任
办事员、科员、正科、正处、副司(厅)级职务3年以上;晋升地(市)
以上机关处级以上领导职务必须具有3年以上的基层工作经历;
逐步做到晋升上一级领导职务,应具有下一级两个以上工作岗位
的经历。
(四)符合任职亲属回避规定。
(五)身体健康,能坚持正常工作。
(六)任免机关根据具体职位需要规定的其他条件。
对确有与拟任职务相适应的政治思想水平和工作能力,且成
绩特别突出,可适当放宽(二)、(三)两项所规定的资格条件。
三、晋升工作人员行政职务,必须在国家规定的职务设置范围
和职数限额内进行。
四、工作人员的行政职务,要逐级晋升。个别确因工作需要,德
才条件和工作实绩又特别突出者可越级晋升,但只能越一级晋升。
五、晋升工作人员行政职务,要严格按照下列规定程序办理:
(一)采取领导和群众相结合的办法推荐预选对象。
(二)对预选对象进行资格审查,提出初选对象。
(三)对初选对象进行全面考核,广泛听取群众意见,择优提出
拟晋升人选。
(四)在对拟晋升人选进一步审核的基础上,经任免机关领导
集体研究决定后任命公布。其中,晋升司(厅)级职务的,遇有放宽
资格条件和中组发〔1990〕2号文件第三条所列情况的,要按2号
文件规定办理;晋升处级以下职务的,任命前应参照2号文件精
神,征求主管部门的意见。
六、晋升行政领导职务的,要先经培训再到职工作。目前培训
条件不具备或因特殊情况不能先培训的,经任免机关批准,可以先
到职后培训,但须在任职后1年内进行。
translated_text:
On the 7th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the Ministry of Personnel of the State jointly issued the "Notice on Strengthening the Management of the Promotion of Administrative Positions of Staff in State Administrative Organs". The "Notice" stipulates: 1. When promoting staff to administrative positions, it is necessary to fully implement the policy of revolutionizing, rejuvenating, knowledge-based and professionalizing the cadre team, and adhere to the party's principle of both moral integrity and ability. Staff members who are promoted to administrative positions must be able to firmly implement the party's focus on economic construction, adhere to the four basic principles, adhere to the basic line of reform and opening up and various policies and policies, have a strong sense of professionalism and responsibility, make work achievements, be honest and dedicated, abide by laws and regulations, have a decent style, serve the people wholeheartedly, and have the cultural and professional knowledge level and work ability required for the position. Those who are promoted to administrative leadership positions must also have the theoretical policy level and organizational leadership ability and good work style that are competent for leadership work, and meet the requirements of the leadership group in terms of age structure and other aspects. 2. When promoting staff to administrative positions, a qualification review system must be implemented. Those who are listed as preliminary candidates for promotion, in addition to meeting the standards stipulated in Article 1, shall also meet the following qualifications: (i) The annual assessments for the past two years have been excellent or the annual assessments for the past three years have been competent or above. For those who have not yet undergone annual assessments, the preliminary candidates’ performance in moral integrity and ability and their work performance in the past two or three years can be used to determine whether they meet the principle requirements of this qualification. (ii) For promotion to section members and section-level positions, candidates should have a high school or technical secondary school education or above; for promotion to section-level positions, candidates should have a college education or above. (III) To be promoted to the position of section chief or division chief, one must have served as deputy section chief or deputy division chief for more than 2 years; to be promoted to the position of section member, deputy section chief, deputy division chief, deputy department (bureau), or department (bureau), one must have served as clerk, section member, section chief, division chief, or deputy department (bureau) for more than 3 years; to be promoted to the position of department chief or above in prefecture (city) level or above, one must have more than 3 years of grassroots work experience; to be promoted to the next level of leadership, one must have experience in more than two positions at the next level.
(IV) To meet the provisions on avoidance of relatives in office.
(V) To be in good health and able to work normally.
(VI) Other conditions stipulated by the appointment and removal authority according to the needs of the specific position.
For those who have the political and ideological level and work ability that are suitable for the proposed position and have outstanding performance, the qualification conditions stipulated in items (II) and (III) may be appropriately relaxed.
III. The promotion of staff to administrative positions must be carried out within the scope of position setting and the number of positions stipulated by the state.
IV. The administrative positions of staff must be promoted step by step. Individuals who are truly required by the work and whose moral, professional and work performance are particularly outstanding may be promoted by skipping levels, but they can only be promoted by one level.
5. The promotion of staff to administrative positions must be handled strictly in accordance with the following procedures:
(i) The pre-selected candidates are recommended by combining the leadership and the masses.
(ii) The pre-selected candidates are examined for qualifications and the preliminary candidates are proposed.
(iii) The preliminary candidates are comprehensively assessed, the opinions of the masses are widely listened to, and the candidates for promotion are proposed based on merit.
(iv) On the basis of further review of the candidates for promotion, the appointment and announcement are made after the collective study and decision of the leaders of the appointment and removal agency. Among them, those who are promoted to department (bureau) level positions shall be handled in accordance with the provisions of Document No. 2 if there are relaxations in the qualification conditions and the circumstances listed in Article 3 of Document No. 2 of the Central Organization Department (1990); those who are promoted to positions below the division level shall refer to the spirit of Document No. 2 before appointment and seek the opinions of the competent department.
6. Those who are promoted to administrative leadership positions must first undergo training and then take up their posts. If the conditions for training are not met at present or training cannot be conducted first due to special circumstances, training can be conducted after taking office with the approval of the appointment and removal authority, but it must be conducted within 1 year after taking office.

events:

告:伟大的无产阶级革命家、政治家、著名社会活动家,坚定的马克
思主义者,党和国家的卓越领导人,中国妇女运动的先驱,原中共

translated_text: On the 11th, the CPC Central Committee, the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, the State Council, and the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference solemnly announced that Deng Yingchao, a great proletarian revolutionary, politician, famous social activist, staunch Marxist, outstanding leader of the Party and the country, pioneer of the Chinese women's movement, former member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, Vice Chairman of the National People's Congress, and Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, died of illness at 6:55 on July 11, 1992 in Beijing at the age of 88.

events:
同日 中共中央组织部转发中国科协《关于对农村基层干部
和党员进行实用技术培训的意见》的通知。
《意见》指出,对农村党员和基层干部进行科技文化知识教育
和发展商品经济的教育,是农村党员教育、基层干部培训的一项重
要内容。实施这个《意见》,对于提高农村基层干部和党员的科技文
化素质,充分发挥他们在科技兴农和带领群众发展农村经济、实现
共同富裕中的模范带头作用,具有重要意义。
《意见》还就培训工作的指导思想､目标及内容提出了具体要
求,力争用3至5年时间,把农村中的村干部和党员普遍培训一
遍。通过培训,使他们掌握一至两项适用于本地的先进生产技术和
经营管理技术,并使其中一批人达到相当于农民技术员或农民技
师的水平,逐步形成一支认真执行党在农村的各项方针政策,懂技
术、会管理、善经营,能带领群众发展商品经济、实现共同富裕的基
层干部队伍和党员队伍。
translated_text: On the same day, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee forwarded the notice of the China Association for Science and Technology on "Opinions on Practical Technology Training for Grassroots Cadres and Party Members in Rural Areas". The "Opinions" pointed out that educating rural party members and grassroots cadres on scientific and cultural knowledge and developing commodity economy is an important content of rural party member education and grassroots cadre training. The implementation of this "Opinion" is of great significance for improving the scientific and cultural quality of grassroots cadres and party members in rural areas and giving full play to their exemplary leading role in promoting agriculture with science and technology and leading the masses to develop rural economy and achieve common prosperity. The "Opinions" also put forward specific requirements for the guiding ideology, goals and content of the training work, and strive to use 3 to 5 years to train all village cadres and party members in rural areas. Through training, they will master one or two advanced production technologies and business management technologies applicable to the local area, and enable a group of them to reach the level of farmer technicians or farmer technicians, and gradually form a team of grassroots cadres and party members who conscientiously implement the party's various policies and guidelines in rural areas, understand technology, manage, and operate well, and can lead the masses to develop commodity economy and achieve common prosperity.

events:
12日 《人民日报》刊登邓颖超同志生前写给中共中央的信。
全文如下:
中共中央:
我是1924年在天津成立共青团的第一批团员。1925年3月
天津市党委决定我转党,成为中共正式党员。
人总是要死的。对于我死后的处理,恳切要求党中央批准我以
下的要求:
1.遗体解剖后火化。
2. 骨灰不保留,撒掉,这是在1956年决定实行火葬后,我和周
恩来同志约定的。
3.不搞遗体告别。
4.不开追悼会。
5. 公布我的这些要求,作为我已逝世的消息。因为我认为共产
党员为人民服务是无限的,所作的工作和职务也都是党和人民决
定的。
以上是1978年7月1日写的,此次重抄再增加以下两点:
1. 我所住的房舍,原同周恩来共住的,是全民所有,应交公使
用,万勿搞什么故居和纪念等,这是我和周恩来同志生前就反对的。
2.对周恩来同志的亲属,侄儿女辈,要求党组织和有关单位的
领导和同志们,勿以因周恩来同志的关系,或以对周恩来同志的感
情出发,而不依据组织原则和组织纪律给予照顾安排。这是周恩来
同志生前一贯执行的。我也坚决支持的。此点对端正党风是非常
必要的。我无任何亲戚,唯一的一个远房侄子,他很本分,从未以我
的关系提任何要求和照顾。以上两点,请一并予以公布。
邓颖超  1982年6月17日重写
translated_text:
On the 12th, the People's Daily published a letter written by Comrade Deng Yingchao to the CPC Central Committee before her death.
The full text is as follows:
Central Committee of the Communist Party of China:
I was one of the first members of the Communist Youth League founded in Tianjin in 1924. In March 1925, the Tianjin Municipal Party Committee decided that I would transfer to the party and become a formal member of the CPC.
People will die. Regarding the treatment of my death, I earnestly request the Party Central Committee to approve my following requests:
1. The body will be cremated after dissection.
2. The ashes will not be kept but scattered. This was agreed upon by Comrade Zhou Enlai and me after the decision to implement cremation in 1956.
3. No farewell ceremony for the body.
4. No memorial service.
5. Publish these requests of mine as the news of my death. Because I believe that the service of Communist Party members to the people is unlimited, and the work and duties they do are also determined by the Party and the people.
The above was written on July 1, 1978. The following two points are added in this reprint:
1. The house I live in was originally shared with Zhou Enlai. It is owned by the whole people and should be handed over to the public for use. Do not build any former residence or memorial, etc. This is what Comrade Zhou Enlai and I opposed during our lifetime.
2. For Comrade Zhou Enlai's relatives, nephews and nieces, we ask the leaders and comrades of the party organization and relevant units not to give care and arrangements based on the relationship with Comrade Zhou Enlai or their feelings for Comrade Zhou Enlai, instead of following the organizational principles and organizational discipline. This is what Comrade Zhou Enlai always did during his lifetime. I also firmly support it. This point is very necessary for correcting the party style. I have no relatives, only a distant nephew, who is very honest and has never made any requests or care based on my relationship. Please make the above two points public.
Deng Yingchao rewrote on June 17, 1982

translated_text: From the 17th to the 31st, the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee and the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee jointly held a national seminar on party member education and management in Yantai, Shandong. Liu Zhongde, deputy director of the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee, and Zhao Zong, deputy director of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, spoke at the seminar. The seminar also invited leaders of relevant central departments and some experts and scholars to give special reports. The seminar carefully studied the important speech of Comrade Deng Xiaoping during his inspection in the south and the spirit of the plenary meeting of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, and studied and discussed how to strengthen and improve party member education and management work under the conditions of accelerating reform and opening up and economic development from the combination of theory and practice, and put forward opinions. 1. translated_text:
On the 22nd, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued a notice on "Opinions on Further Improving the Work of Recommending Outstanding League Members as Party Development Targets". The main contents of the "Opinions": 1. Raise awareness and give full play to the role of "recommending outstanding members" in the construction of the party member team and the Communist Youth League. Recommending outstanding league members as party development targets is necessary to cultivate successors to the socialist cause, strengthen the construction of the party member team, and enrich the new forces of the party; it is also necessary to stimulate the political enthusiasm of the majority of young league members and enhance the attractiveness and cohesion of the Communist Youth League organization. Deepening the "recommending outstanding members" work and strengthening the ideological education of the majority of young league members can further encourage them to make contributions to reform and opening up and economic construction. Developing outstanding league members to join the party and gradually increasing the proportion of young party members in the party will help build a party team full of vitality and vigor. Party and league organizations at all levels should further improve their understanding of the importance of doing a good job in "recommending outstanding members", enhance their political sense of responsibility and consciousness, and take effective measures to strive to implement this work at the grassroots level. In the future, young people under the age of 28 who join the Party should generally be recruited from League members; recruiting League members to join the Party should generally be recommended by the League organization.
Make the "recommendation" work gradually become the main channel for the Party organization to recruit young Party members, and make the Communist Youth League members the main source of the Party organization to recruit young Party members.
2. Put the foothold of the "recommendation" work on the training and education of League members. Strengthening the training and education of League members and improving the ideological and political quality of League members are the premise and foundation of the "recommendation" work, and are also the main purpose of the "recommendation". Party and League organizations at all levels should educate League members on patriotism, collectivism, and socialism. League members should be organized to seriously study Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory on building socialism with Chinese characteristics, the Party's basic line and various policies and policies, and educate and guide the majority of League members to actively participate in reform and opening up and economic construction. Through ideological education and social practice, they can firmly establish the correct political direction and establish a scientific world outlook and outlook on life. The basic meaning can be shown in
For League members who want to join the Party, the Party and League organizations should train and educate them according to the standards of Party members. They should be organized to study the basic theories of Marxism and the basic knowledge of the Party, guide them to consciously implement the Party's basic line and various policies and guidelines, and play an exemplary role in socialist modernization. They should also be educated on the history and glorious traditions of the Party, help them strengthen the Party's concept, and correct their motivation for joining the Party.
3. The "recommendation" work should adhere to standards and ensure quality. The League organization should adhere to the basic conditions for Party members stipulated in the Party Constitution when recommending development targets, and conduct inspections on League members who apply to join the Party. The League organization should promptly recommend to the Party organization those outstanding League members who support the Party's program, actively implement the Party's basic line, make achievements in reform and opening up, economic construction, and socialist spiritual civilization construction, and basically meet the conditions for Party membership; those whose conditions are not yet mature should continue to be cultivated to prevent the one-sided pursuit of the number of recommendations and the reduction of standards.
4. The "recommendation" work should be closely combined with the focus of the work of developing Party members. In the coming period, we must strengthen the work of developing Party members in enterprises, rural production lines, and among young people. In accordance with this requirement, the League organizations should make the training and recommendation of outstanding League members in the production line and key positions the focus of the "recommendation" work.

Enterprise League organizations should focus on training and recommending outstanding League members who have emerged in the work of deepening enterprise reform, promoting technological progress, and improving economic benefits, especially the production and technical backbones and team leaders. Rural League organizations should focus on training and recommending village cadres, science and technology demonstration leaders, and outstanding League members who have made achievements in deepening rural reform, developing rural economy, and leading the masses to achieve common prosperity. 
It is necessary to attach importance to training and recommending outstanding League members among college students. The League organizations of higher education institutions should do a good job in "recommendation" from the beginning of freshmen's enrollment, educate early, select seedlings early, and train early.
After the active members of the Party among middle school students are admitted to higher education institutions, the middle school party organization should promptly transfer the relevant materials of training and education to the party organization of the higher education institution, and the training and education time can be calculated continuously. For those who meet the conditions for party membership, the party organizations of colleges and universities can recruit them into the party when they are in the lower grades of college. Through the "recommendation" activities, we should promote the work of developing party members among college students and gradually increase the proportion of party members among college students. 
5. Party organizations at all levels should further strengthen the leadership of the "recommendation" work. The "recommendation" work should be carried out under the unified leadership of party organizations at all levels. Party organizations at all levels should support and help the Communist Youth League organizations to carry out the "recommendation" work. We should guide the league organizations to strengthen their own construction, focus on selecting outstanding young party members to serve as league cadres, and continuously improve the political quality of grassroots league cadres. When deploying the work of developing party members, we should put forward requirements for the league organizations to carry out the "recommendation" work, and when formulating the annual work plan for developing party members, we should consult the league organizations.

务。
乔石指出,党校在把学习马克思主义放在首位的同时,还应注

设的重要力量。他希望各级党委要领导和关心党校的改革,帮助党

translated_text:
From July 23 to 28, a national symposium for party school principals was held in Beijing. The main topic of the meeting was to summarize experiences, find gaps, further emancipate the mind, explore ideas and methods for deepening the reform of party school work, and push forward the work and construction of party schools in a down-to-earth manner under the new situation, based on the important speech of Comrade Deng Xiaoping during his inspection in the south, the plenary session of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee, and the important speech of Comrade Jiang Zemin at the Central Party School.

Qiao Shi, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and president of the Central Party School, emphasized in his speech at the symposium on July 25 that the way out for party schools lies in reform, and the development of party schools depends on reform. The work of party schools should also be strengthened through reform.

He said that the focus of the reform of party schools is teaching reform. Teaching reform is to adhere to the combination of theory and practice, closely combine the international situation and the reality of contemporary socialist development, focus on the basic line of the party, and serve the construction of socialism with Chinese characteristics.

Qiao Shi said that the important thing in the Party School teaching reform is to conscientiously implement Comrade Deng Xiaoping's instruction that "learning Marxism-Leninism should be refined and effective", so as to apply what you have learned and make it effective. Through learning, you can grasp the spiritual essence of Marxism and learn to use the Marxist standpoint, viewpoint and method to solve the practical problems of China's socialist modernization construction. Qiao Shi said that it is necessary to carefully select and read some original works of Marxism-Leninism that best reflect the basic principles of Marxism, including the works of Mao Zedong and Deng Xiaoping, as the key content of Party School learning. The Party School should cultivate batches of leading cadres and theoretical backbones who can unswervingly implement the Party's basic line. This is the fundamental and long-term task of the Party School. Qiao Shi pointed out that while putting the study of Marxism first, the Party School should also pay attention to the study of economic knowledge and modern scientific knowledge, appropriately increase the weight of this aspect, and expand the knowledge. When talking about the issue of invigorating the academic atmosphere of the Party School, Qiao Shi said that the Party School's theoretical research and theoretical propaganda should follow the spirit of Comrade Deng Xiaoping's talk, liberate the mind, update the concept, and break through the shackles of those outdated old concepts. He also emphasized that to liberate the mind, it is necessary to implement the "Double Hundred" policy, encourage teaching and scientific research personnel to study new situations, explore new problems, and encourage academic debates. He said that we emphasize the connection between theory and practice, and sometimes it is inevitable to make some mistakes in connection with practice. If you make a mistake, you should pay attention to correcting it in practice. Don't punish people, don't arbitrarily make political claims, and don't arbitrarily make big accusations. Of course, teachers should also have more contact with reality and consciously enhance their ability to identify and resist mistakes. Qiao Shi finally said that party school education serves the party's central task and basic line. In the current new situation of accelerating reform and opening up and seizing the opportunity to carry out socialist modernization, party committees at all levels should make use of the party school as a position and make good use of this team to give full play to the role of party schools in training cadres, comprehensively implementing the party's basic line, and using Marxism to explore and study major issues, so that party schools can become an important force in promoting reform and opening up and promoting economic construction. He hopes that party committees at all levels will lead and care about the reform of party schools, help party schools come up with ideas, solve practical problems, and create the necessary conditions for running party schools well.

想。第四,树立干部工作的民主和开放思想。

设提出了新的要求。我们一定要联系实际,解放思想,实事求是,把

放,越要加强党的领导,搞好党的建设。我们有一个好的党,有用马
列主义、毛泽东思想武装起来的党的坚强领导,这是我们能够大胆

武装全党,提高执行党的基本路线的自觉性和坚定性,使各级党组
织和广大共产党员始终站在经济建设和改革开放的前列,更好地

制,加强对青年干部的教育,切实做好培养选拔接班人的工作;切

绩、群众公认的干部选拔上来。要注意挑选一批德才兼备的优秀年

想,更新观念。不能论资排辈,就照顾,也不能求全责备。要放开
视野,拓宽渠道,走群众路线,深入到建设和改革第一线去,到群众

革开放的要求。干部人事制度改革,要统盘规划,分步实施,逐步配

宋平强调指出,组织部门的同志,要进一步解放思想,更新观
念,坚持实事求是,不断改进工作。要学习经济,熟悉经济,了解经

From the 4th to the 8th, the National Conference of Organization Ministers of Party Committees of Provinces, Autonomous Regions and Municipalities was held in Beijing. Lv Feng, Minister of the Central Organization Department, delivered a speech entitled "Seriously Implementing the Spirit of Comrade Deng Xiaoping's Important Talks and Promoting Organizational Work to Better Serve Economic Construction". Xie Chang Lv Feng's speech consisted of five parts: First, build the leadership team into a strong leadership collective that fully implements the party's basic line; second, actively and boldly select young cadres and cultivate qualified successors; third, accelerate the pace of reform of the cadre and personnel system; fourth, give full play to the important role of scientific and technological personnel in the cause of modernization construction; fifth, enterprise party organizations and Communist Party members should stand at the forefront of enterprise reform. Lv Feng pointed out in his speech that at present, my country's economic construction and reform and opening up have entered a new stage of development. The whole party and the people of the country are concentrating on accelerating the pace of reform and opening up and pushing economic construction to a new level. Under this situation, the vast majority of comrades on the organizational front must unswervingly and comprehensively implement the principle of focusing on economic construction, adhering to the four basic principles, adhering to the basic line of reform and opening up, firmly establish the guiding ideology of serving the economic construction as the center, and provide a solid organizational guarantee for economic construction and reform and opening up through fruitful work.
Lu Feng said that in order to further create a new situation in organizational work and make our work more closely serve economic construction, we must fully implement Comrade Deng Xiaoping’s important talk and the spirit of the plenary meeting of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee in practical work, and use them to unify our thoughts and actions. This is the most important ideological basis for us to do a good job in organizational work.
Lu Feng said that we must further emancipate our minds, update our concepts, and forge ahead. Organizational work must obey and serve the center of economic construction, and cannot deviate from this center;
In equipping the leadership team, we must start from whether we can promote economic construction and reform and opening up and play a core role, select people according to the situation, and be able to go up and down, rather than simply starting from arrangements or care; in selecting cadres, we must dare to use those who are bold in reform, brave in pioneering, and have outstanding performance, rather than being demanding or ranking by seniority; in the issue of knowing people, we must open up our horizons and broaden channels, rather than being limited to a small circle and looking at people with old eyes; in promoting the reform of the cadre and personnel system, we must dare to take risks, dare to try, and be brave to innovate. We must boldly absorb and learn from the useful methods and methods of foreign personnel management, and we must not be afraid of this or that and dare not break through. In work, we must be vigilant against the right, but mainly prevent "left", get rid of the shackles of old ideas, and strive to explore new ways to do a good job in organizational work and promote economic development. When talking about the leadership team building, Lv Feng emphasized that we should use the important speech spirit of Comrade Deng Xiaoping to unify the thoughts and actions of leading cadres at all levels, and strive to improve the consciousness and firmness of implementing the party's basic line. We should seize the favorable opportunity of the change of leadership in the next two years to adjust and equip the leadership teams at all levels into a leadership collective that adheres to the party's basic line. We should boldly select a group of people who are loyal to Marxism, adhere to the party's basic line, and are recognized by the people as people who adhere to reform and opening up and have political achievements, and put them in leadership teams and important positions at all levels. We must resolutely adjust cadres who are not enterprising, do nothing, and are not competent for their current positions. According to regulations, those who have reached the age limit for office should retire from their current positions, except for a few who are approved by the organization to stay in office due to work needs. We should pay attention to enhancing the leadership team's ability to lead economic work. We should attach great importance to building a good enterprise leadership team and strive to create a team of entrepreneurs. We should seriously solve the problem of team unity and internal friction. We must strictly adhere to the principle of democratic centralism. When talking about the selection of young cadres, Lv Feng pointed out that we should take advantage of the opportunity of the change of leadership in the next two years to select a group of outstanding young cadres to join the leadership teams at all levels, so that the age of the leadership team members will form a ladder structure. The age composition of the party and government leadership teams at the prefecture and county levels should be younger. In terms of the reform of the cadre personnel system, Lv Feng proposed that we should take the implementation of the national civil service system as an opportunity to implement the classification management of cadres in a planned manner; firmly adhere to the reform of cadres being able to move up and down; continue to improve the cadre selection and appointment system; gradually implement and improve the democratic evaluation system of leading cadres; gradually implement the probation period system among the appointed leading cadres at the bureau, department and section levels of party and government organs; further promote the cadre exchange and cadre avoidance system; establish a flexible and diverse enterprise personnel system that meets the requirements of enterprise reform and development; and combine the institutional reform of party and government organs to closely combine the streamlining of personnel with the promotion of the rational allocation of talents. Lu Ji also pointed out that in the cause of modernization construction, we must give full play to the important role of scientific and technological personnel, actively support and guide scientific and technological personnel to participate in the main battlefield of economic construction, and accelerate the transformation of scientific and technological achievements into real productivity; we must effectively master and manage the local first-class scientific and technological talents to provide talent guarantee for economic construction; we must further promote the work of selecting deputy county (city) heads and deputy township (town) heads for science and technology; we must strive to create conditions, fully tap the potential of existing scientific and technological personnel, and effectively overcome the phenomenon of wasting talents.
Lu Feng pointed out that the party organizations and the majority of Communist Party members in enterprises should stand at the forefront of reform, actively participate in and promote reform, and ensure the smooth progress of reform. The political core role of the party organization in enterprises should be reflected in promoting enterprise reform, promoting enterprise development, improving economic efficiency, and doing a good job in the construction of two civilizations.
Lu Feng called on the majority of comrades on the organizational front to take the spirit of Comrade Deng Xiaoping’s important speech during his inspection in the south as a guide, creatively do a good job in various tasks, and welcome the successful convening of the 14th National Congress of the Party with outstanding achievements. On the 6th, Zhang Quanjing, deputy director of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, delivered a speech entitled "Seriously implement the spirit of the Central Document No. 6 and do a good job in the replacement of local leadership teams next year". The main contents are: 1. Fully understand the new situation facing the replacement of local leadership teams next year; 2. According to the requirements of the party's basic line, equip local leadership teams; 3. Emancipate the mind, update concepts, correctly identify and select cadres; 4. Implement the various regulations and measures of the central government with the spirit of reform; 5. Strengthen and improve the party's leadership in the replacement. When talking about continuing to adhere to the "four modernizations" policy of cadres and the principle of both moral integrity and ability, and strengthening the construction of leadership teams, Zhang Quanjing emphasized that we must focus on solving several problems in conjunction with the replacement of leadership: First, boldly select cadres who are brave in reform, familiar with the economy, and have outstanding political achievements to join the team. It is required that leaders at all levels not only have good political qualities, but also have a pioneering and enterprising spirit, can correctly implement the reform and opening-up policy, understand macroeconomics and modern management, and have the ability to make decisions on major economic construction and social issues. Second, there should be new breakthroughs in promoting the rejuvenation of the leadership team. Third, further improve the overall structure of the leadership team. As the leading core of various local undertakings, the local party committee should have cadres who are competent in charge of the economy, party and mass organizations, ideology, etc.; the local government is the local administrative organ, and the team should have members who are familiar with the leadership and management work in industry, agriculture, finance and trade, science and technology, culture and education, politics and law, etc. At the same time, attention should be paid to selecting qualified female cadres, non-party cadres, and minority cadres to join the team. It should proceed from reality, adhere to standards, and not be too demanding. Fourth, to equip a united and coordinated leadership team, it is necessary to pay good attention to the ideological cultivation and personality characteristics of cadres, pay attention to whether the cadres have strong party spirit, take the overall situation into consideration, can tolerate others, are good at cooperation and work, and adhere to the principle of democratic centralism. At the same time, for teams that have been disunited for a long time and seriously affect their work, we must make up our minds to adjust. Fifth, we must effectively strengthen and equip the "top leaders" of the party and government. In addition to being politically strong, familiar with the economy, courageous in pioneering, and able to manage the overall work, the candidate for the "top leader" should also pay special attention to democratic style, broad-minded, good at uniting comrades, giving full play to everyone's role, and working together to do a good job; Sixth, doing a good job in this change of term is also an opportunity to strengthen the ideological and style construction of the leadership team. In his speech, Zhang Quanjing emphasized that in the selection of cadres, we must further establish the following ideas: First, establish the idea of selecting talents in an unconventional way. Second, establish the idea of looking at the mainstream, the essence, and the development of employment. Third, establish the idea of respecting and cherishing talents. Fourth, establish a democratic and open idea in cadre work. Zhang Quanjing emphasized that it is necessary to implement the various regulations and measures proposed in the Central Document No. 6 on the change of term in the spirit of reform. First, we must insist that cadres can be promoted or demoted. Second, promote cadre exchanges in conjunction with the change of term. Third, carry out the promotion of democracy throughout the entire process of the change of term. Fourth, conscientiously act in accordance with the central government's requirements on the age of office. Fifth, strictly implement the provisions of the Central Document No. 6 on the number of positions in the team. Sixth, we should pay real attention to retired comrades and continue to play their roles. Zhang Quanjing also put forward several opinions on strengthening and improving the party's leadership in the election work: First, we should adhere to the law and conscientiously implement the relevant policies and guidelines of the Central Committee. We should unify the implementation of national laws and regulations with the party's policies and guidelines. Second, we should do a good job in selecting and recommending candidates. Third, we should do a good job in ideological and political work in depth and detail. Fourth, we should strengthen the leadership of the election work. During the meeting, Song Ping, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, held a discussion with comrades attending the National Conference of Organization Ministers of Provincial, Autonomous Region and Municipal Party Committees. In his speech, Song Ping pointed out that Comrade Deng Xiaoping's important talk not only has important guiding significance for my country's economic construction and reform and opening up, but also has important guiding significance for comprehensively strengthening party building, including ideological, political, organizational and style building. Comrade Deng Xiaoping's talk put forward new requirements for strengthening party building under the new situation. We must link reality, emancipate our minds, seek truth from facts, and learn and implement the spirit of Comrade Xiaoping's talk well. Song Ping pointed out that historical experience has proved that the victory of the Chinese revolution depends on the correct leadership of our party; similarly, building socialism with Chinese characteristics also depends on the more mature and more effective leadership of our party under new historical conditions. The more reform and opening up, the more we must strengthen the party's leadership and do a good job in party building. We have a good party, with a strong leadership of the party armed with Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought, which is the most powerful guarantee for us to boldly implement reform and opening up. If we build the party well and the party is strong and powerful, our cause will be invincible. Song Ping emphasized that we must arm the whole party with Comrade Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, improve the consciousness and firmness of implementing the party's basic line, so that party organizations at all levels and the majority of Communist Party members always stand at the forefront of economic construction and reform and opening up, and better play the role of fighting fortress and vanguard model; the organizational line must obey the political line and ensure the realization of the political line. Organizational work must provide a strong organizational guarantee for the comprehensive implementation of the Party's basic line, consciously obey and serve the center of economic construction, adhere to the four basic principles, and adhere to reform and opening up; Party and government leadership teams at all levels must be built into politically firm, courageous in reform, united and coordinated, connected with the masses, honest and pragmatic leadership groups, and better play a leading role in socialist modernization; we must adhere to and improve democratic centralism, strengthen the education of young cadres, and do a good job in training and selecting successors; we must effectively strengthen the construction of grassroots organizations and improve combat effectiveness. Song Ping pointed out that we must earnestly do a good job in the replacement of local leadership teams in the next two years, adhere to the "four modernizations" policy of the cadre team and the principle of both moral integrity and ability, and truly select cadres who have been tempered and tested in practice, have made outstanding achievements in implementing the Party's basic line, especially in reform and opening up, and are recognized by the masses. We must pay attention to selecting a group of outstanding young cadres with both moral integrity and ability to join the team. Talents are there, the problem is that we discover them. First of all, we must liberate our minds and update our concepts. We cannot give care to people based on seniority, nor can we be too demanding. We should open our horizons, broaden our channels, follow the mass line, go deep into the front line of construction and reform, go among the masses, discover talents widely, and select talents well. Song Ping said that we should actively promote the reform of the cadre and personnel system to adapt to the requirements of economic construction and reform and opening up. The reform of the cadre and personnel system should be planned comprehensively, implemented in steps, and gradually matched. In the reform, we should adhere to the principle of the party managing cadres, gradually establish and improve a scientific classification management system and competition and incentive mechanisms, mobilize the enthusiasm of cadres, and provide institutional guarantees for outstanding talents to stand out and give full play to their talents. Through the reform of the cadre and personnel system, we should effectively solve the problem of whether cadres can be promoted or demoted. The exchange of cadres should be taken as an important task. Now, institutional reform is imperative. We should combine the streamlining of personnel with the improvement of the cadre team structure and the promotion of productivity development. Song Ping emphasized that comrades in the organization department should further emancipate their minds, update their concepts, adhere to seeking truth from facts, and constantly improve their work. We must study economics, be familiar with economics, understand the overall situation of economic work, and better serve economic construction.

translated_text: From the 26th to the 29th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Policy Research Office of the CPC Central Committee, the Ministry of Justice, and the Ministry of Civil Affairs jointly held a national exchange meeting on the experience of governing villages according to law and democratic management in Zhangqiu County to learn from Comrade Deng Xiaoping’s important speech during his inspection in the south at the beginning of the year and promote the experience of Zhangqiu and other places. Since 1988, Zhangqiu County has gradually incorporated village-level work with production and operation, social order and organizational construction as the main content into the legal track and implemented standardized management on the basis of strengthening the supporting construction of village-level organizations with party branches as the core, creating an experience of establishing systems according to law, governing villages according to systems, and democratic management under the leadership of party branches. During the meeting, the representatives discussed the experience of Zhangqiu and conducted field visits and inspections. Representatives from the Suihua Prefectural Committee of Heilongjiang Province, Xianghe County of Hebei Province, Ninghua County of Fujian Province, Changping County of Beijing, Baiyang Village of Baoshan District of Shanghai, and Jiubao District of Anshan City of Liaoning Province spoke at the meeting. Minister of Justice Cai Cheng spoke at the meeting. He pointed out that Zhangqiu and other places have implemented rule of law in villages and democratic management, which has played an important role in rural grassroots work. First, it has strengthened the construction of village-level organizations with party branches as the core, improved the leadership methods of party branches, and better played the core leadership role of village party branches and the role of other village-level organizations; second, it has promoted the reform of the rural economic system and the development of the rural economy; third, it has effectively strengthened the construction of socialist democracy and legal system at the grassroots level in rural areas; fourth, it has implemented the "Organization Law of Village Committees (Trial)" and promoted the development of villagers' autonomy; fifth, it has promoted the comprehensive management of social security, maintained rural social stability, and promoted the construction of spiritual civilization. At the meeting, Zheng Keyang, deputy director of the Central Policy Research Office, and Duoji Cairang, deputy minister of the Ministry of Civil Affairs, also spoke, and Wu Lianyuan, deputy minister of the Central Organization Department, summarized the meeting.

events:
28日——30日 中共中央组织部、国家人事部召开全国乡镇
干部聘用制工作座谈会。中央组织部副部长孟连崑、人事部副部长
程连昌在座谈会上讲话。 台南味季同平小歌下单,
孟连崑同志说,我们这次会议的主要议题是,深入学习贯彻
邓小平同志视察南方重要谈话和政治局全体会议精神,紧密围绕
经济建设这个中心,总结交流近些年来实行乡镇干部聘用制的经
验,研究在推进干部人事制度改革中,如何坚持和完善乡镇干部聘
用制,以促进乡镇干部队伍建设,保证农村经济加快发展,迈上一
个新台阶。
现在,我国农村有5.5万个乡镇,其党政机关干部有128万
人,这是党的干部队伍的重要组成部分。他们担负着贯彻落实党在
农村的各项方针政策,具体组织领导农村各项工作的重任,是直接
带领广大农民群众发展农村经济,维护农村社会治安和政治稳定,
实现建设社会主义新农村宏伟目标的骨干力量。
为进一步做好乡镇干部聘用制工作,连同志就以下几个
问题提出了意见:
第一,深化乡镇干部人事制度的改革,要以党的基本路线为指
针,牢固树立为农村改革和经济建设服务的思想,增强改革意识,
加大改革力度,抓住难点,结合实际,积极试验,建立健全制度。实
践已经证明,坚持实行乡镇干部聘用制,完全符合干部人事制度改
革的方向,效果也是好的。各地组织人事部门都要在总结经验的基
础上,进一步认识实行乡镇干部聘用制的必要性和重要性,采取切
实措施,坚定不移地坚持和推进这一制度,逐步使这一制度成为乡
镇补充干部的主要制度。既然是一项重要改革,就难免遇到困难。
对于出现的新情况、新问题,既不能回避,更不能走回头路,要用改
革的观念,看待改革中遇到的矛盾,采取有利于推进这项改革的办
法,努力解决工作中的实际问题。
第二,解放思想,大胆培养、选聘适应改革和建设需要的优秀
人才。农村新经济体制的建立和发展,需要大量优秀人才。必须进
一步完善选聘制度,坚持公开、竞争、择优的原则,把那些德才兼
备,适应农村经济建设需要的各类人才有计划地聘用到乡镇干部
队伍中来,对政绩突出,适合担任乡镇领导职务的优秀人才,要不
拘一格,大胆启用,充分发挥他们的聪明才智。同时要加强对他们
的培养教育,这方面的工作,过去比较薄弱,目前乡镇干部队伍的
素质,还不能完全适应发展商品经济的需要,必须下大力加强培
养,尽快提高。要注意从农村村组干部队伍抓起,有计划、有目的地
选拔一批年纪轻、文化高、能力强、表现好的优秀农民、回乡知青、
退伍军人充实村组干部队伍,保持村组干部有较好的素质,为乡镇
聘用制干部队伍提供人才资源。
第三,健全制度,强化竞争、激励、解聘机制,使聘用制干部队
伍建设进入良性循环轨道。聘用制的活力就在于能干能民,能进能
出、能上能下,优胜劣汰。目前,保持这项制度活力的关键,是強化
竞争、激励、解聘机制,要建立健全聘用制干部的年度考核,聘期考
核制度,把考核结果作为受聘干部升降、奖惩、续聘、解聘的依据。
通过考核,把那些德才素质好,政绩突出的,及时提拔到乡镇领导
岗位上来,对于工作表现较差,不能履行合同规定义务,群众意见
很大的,要及时予以解聘,对政绩平平者,合同期满,不再续聘。不
能降低标准,搞照顾性续聘。要采取切实措施,用制度作保障,解决
“出口”不畅问题。
坚持有计划、有步骤地从选聘制乡镇领导干部中少量择优录
用为国家固定干部。并加强宏观管理,从严控制数量,严格把好质
量关。
要逐步建立聘用制干部交流制度。
第四,加强宏观调控、计划管理。下一步,随着机构改革的深入
开展,县以上领导机关将会有一定数量的干部充实到农村基层,为
此,要处理好补充聘用制干部与机关人员精简的关系,使干部聘用
工作适应这一改革的形势。一方面,从现在起,要加强聘用干部的
宏观调控、计划管理,控制招聘规模。另一方面,从长期坚持干部聘
用制出发,仍要继续做好干部聘用工作。但要在增干指标和编制定
员内,根据工作需要补充聘用干部。缺额多的乡镇,可作出计划,逐
步聘用补充;编制已满员的,可以出一聘一;超编的,一律不许聘用
干部。
第五,因地制宜,妥善解决好聘用制干部的待遇和养老保险问
题。聘用制干部的政治、生活待遇(包括看文件,听报告、职务晋升、
工资奖金、补贴、医疗等方面),要同乡镇同级固定干部一视同仁,
在什么岗位享受什么待遇。粮油供应要根据本地实际,尽量给予方
便。聘用制干部在聘期间,原承担的农村义务工及其他负担,要本
着有利于他们集中精力开展工作,给予适当照顾的精神,予以减免。
要逐步建立聘用制干部社会养老保险制度。
第六,切实加强对乡镇干部聘用工作的领导。各地党委和政
府,要把坚持和完善乡镇干部聘用制当作干部人事制度改革的一
件大事,列入议事日程,定期研究,针对干部聘用工作中出现的新
情况、新问题,及时提出解决办法和完善制度的意见。
translated_text:
From the 28th to the 30th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the Ministry of Personnel of the State held a national symposium on the employment system of township cadres. Meng Liankun, deputy director of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, and Cheng Lianchang, deputy director of the Ministry of Personnel, spoke at the symposium. Comrade Meng Liankun said that the main topic of our meeting is to thoroughly study and implement the important speeches of Comrade Deng Xiaoping during his inspection of the south and the spirit of the plenary meeting of the Political Bureau, closely focus on the center of economic construction, summarize and exchange the experience of implementing the employment system of township cadres in recent years, and study how to adhere to and improve the employment system of township cadres in the process of promoting the reform of the cadre and personnel system, so as to promote the construction of the township cadre team, ensure the accelerated development of the rural economy, and take it to a new level. At present, there are 55,000 townships in rural areas of my country, with 1.28 million cadres in party and government organs, which is an important part of the party's cadre team. They are responsible for implementing the Party's various policies and guidelines in rural areas, organizing and leading various rural work, and are the backbone of directly leading the broad masses of farmers to develop the rural economy, maintain rural social security and political stability, and achieve the grand goal of building a new socialist countryside. In order to further improve the employment system of township cadres, Comrade Lian put forward opinions on the following issues: First, to deepen the reform of the township cadre personnel system, we must take the Party's basic line as a guide, firmly establish the idea of serving rural reform and economic construction, enhance the awareness of reform, increase the intensity of reform, grasp the difficulties, combine with reality, actively experiment, and establish a sound system. Practice has proved that insisting on the implementation of the township cadre employment system is fully in line with the direction of cadre personnel system reform, and the effect is also good. Organization and personnel departments in all localities must further recognize the necessity and importance of implementing the township cadre employment system on the basis of summarizing experience, take practical measures, unswervingly adhere to and promote this system, and gradually make this system the main system for supplementing township cadres. Since it is an important reform, it is inevitable to encounter difficulties. We should neither avoid nor go back to the old ways when new situations and new problems emerge. We should view the contradictions encountered in the reform with the concept of reform, adopt measures that are conducive to promoting this reform, and strive to solve practical problems in our work.
Second, we should emancipate our minds and boldly cultivate and recruit outstanding talents who are adapted to the needs of reform and construction. The establishment and development of the new rural economic system requires a large number of outstanding talents. We must further improve the selection and recruitment system, adhere to the principles of openness, competition, and selection, and systematically recruit talents of all kinds who are both morally and professionally qualified and adapted to the needs of rural economic construction into the ranks of township cadres. We should not stick to one pattern and boldly employ outstanding talents who have outstanding political achievements and are suitable for township leadership positions, so as to give full play to their wisdom and talents. At the same time, we should strengthen their training and education. In the past, this aspect of work was relatively weak. At present, the quality of the township cadre team cannot fully meet the needs of developing a commodity economy. We must make great efforts to strengthen training and improve it as soon as possible. We should pay attention to starting from the rural village cadre team, and select a group of young, highly educated, capable and well-performing outstanding farmers, returned educated youth and veterans in a planned and purposeful manner to enrich the village cadre team, maintain the quality of village cadres, and provide talent resources for the township contract cadre team. Third, improve the system, strengthen the competition, incentive and dismissal mechanism, and put the contract cadre team construction into a virtuous cycle track. The vitality of the contract system lies in the ability to work, to enter and exit, to move up and down, and the survival of the fittest. At present, the key to maintaining the vitality of this system is to strengthen the competition, incentive and dismissal mechanism. It is necessary to establish and improve the annual assessment and contract period assessment system for contract cadres, and use the assessment results as the basis for promotion, demotion, reward and punishment, renewal and dismissal of contract cadres. Through assessment, those with good moral character and outstanding political achievements should be promoted to township leadership positions in a timely manner. Those with poor work performance, failure to fulfill contractual obligations, and great public dissatisfaction should be dismissed in a timely manner. Those with mediocre political achievements will not be re-hired upon expiration of the contract. The standards cannot be lowered and the re-hiring should be done out of consideration. Practical measures should be taken to solve the problem of unsmooth "export" with institutional guarantees. Adhere to the planned and step-by-step selection of a small number of township leaders from the selected and appointed system as fixed state cadres. And strengthen macro-management, strictly control the number, and strictly control the quality. A system for the exchange of hired cadres should be gradually established. Fourth, strengthen macro-control and planning management. In the next step, with the deepening of institutional reform, a certain number of cadres from county-level and above leading organs will be added to the rural grassroots. To this end, it is necessary to handle the relationship between the supplementary hired cadres and the streamlining of the staff of the organs, so that the cadre recruitment work can adapt to the situation of this reform. On the one hand, from now on, we must strengthen the macro-control and planning management of hired cadres and control the scale of recruitment. On the other hand, starting from the long-term adherence to the cadre employment system, we must continue to do a good job in cadre employment. However, we must recruit additional cadres according to work needs within the cadre increase indicators and staffing quotas. Townships with many vacancies can make plans and gradually recruit additional cadres; those with full staffing can recruit one for one; those with overstaffing are not allowed to recruit cadres. Fifth, we should take local conditions into consideration and properly solve the treatment and pension insurance issues of hired cadres. The political and living treatment of hired cadres (including reading documents, listening to reports, job promotion, salary bonuses, subsidies, medical care, etc.) should be treated equally with fixed cadres at the same level in townships, and they should enjoy the same treatment as their posts. Grain and oil supply should be based on local conditions and should be as convenient as possible. During the period of employment, the rural compulsory labor and other burdens originally undertaken by hired cadres should be reduced or exempted in the spirit of helping them concentrate on their work and giving them appropriate care. We should gradually establish a social pension insurance system for employed cadres.
Sixth, we should strengthen the leadership of township cadre employment. Party committees and governments at all levels should regard the adherence to and improvement of the township cadre employment system as a major event in the reform of the cadre personnel system, put it on the agenda, conduct regular research, and promptly propose solutions and suggestions for improving the system in response to new situations and new problems in cadre employment.

The majority of party members, especially leading party members, should learn profound lessons from Chen Yongfang's degeneration, earnestly strengthen the transformation of their world outlook, consciously accept the supervision of the party organization and the people, constantly enhance their party spirit and sense of discipline, and resist the erosion of decadent bourgeois ideas at any time and under any circumstances, so as to become qualified Communist Party members who can withstand the test of governing, reform and opening up, and developing commodity economy.

translated_text: From the 8th to the 10th, the Central and State Organs Veteran Work Experience Exchange Meeting was held in Beijing. Lv Feng, Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, spoke at the meeting. He said that veteran cadres are the precious wealth of the Party and the country, and veteran cadre work is an important part of cadre work. This year marks the 10th anniversary of the promulgation of the "Decision of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Establishing a Retirement System for Veteran Cadres". Over the past 10 years, with the attention and care of party committees and governments at all levels and party and government leaders of various departments of the central and state organs, and with the efforts of veteran cadre departments, veteran cadre work has achieved great results. Lv Feng believes that the current new situation of reform has created conditions for veteran cadre work and also put forward higher requirements. He said that among the 6.56 million retired cadres, nearly half of them retired from enterprises, which is an important force for doing a good job in enterprise reform. We should pay attention to giving full play to their technical expertise and organize them to contribute to the development of production within their capacity. Lv Feng said that veteran comrades have a special role in cultivating successors. They understand history, understand national conditions, have a high level of Marxism and rich practical experience, and their words and deeds have strong persuasiveness, appeal and appeal. He hopes that the old cadres department will actively create conditions to support retired comrades in training and educating the next generation. Lu Feng asked the old cadres department to further enhance their sense of responsibility and consciousness to take the old cadres work to a new level. Meng Liankun, deputy director of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, made six points at the meeting on the issue of striving to create a new situation in the work of old cadres: First, we must further strengthen the leadership of the work of old cadres. Second, we must organize and lead the role of old cadres. Third, we must care for and love old comrades politically. Fourth, we must work hard to solve the difficulties and ensure the implementation of the living benefits of old cadres. Fifth, we must use existing facilities to do a good job in service. Sixth, we must work hard to improve the self-construction of the old cadres work team.

视察南方的重要谈话,对推进我国的改革开放和现代化建设,具有
重大而深远的指导意义,对在新的历史条件下从政治上、思想上、..
组织上、作风上全面加强党的建设,同样具有重大而深远的指导意
义,极大地鼓舞了全党加快改革和建设步伐,进一步做好党建工作
的积极性。《意见》指出,党建工作要认真贯彻邓小平同志重要谈话
和中央政治局全体会议精神,毫不动摇地坚持党的基本路线,牢固
树立以经济建设为中心的思想,从严治党,搞好党的自身建设,密
切党同人民群众的联系,使党的各级组织和广大共产党员始终站
在改革和建设的前列,充分发挥党在建设有中国特色社会主义伟
大事业中的领导核心作用。《意见》的主要内容:
(一)用建设有中国特色社会主义的理论武装全党,提高执行
党的基本路线的自觉性和坚定性人海 )
学习和掌握建设有中国特色社会主义的理论,是党的思想建
设的根本任务。要教育党员、干部认清形势,振奋精神,树立更好更
快地发展经济的雄心壮志。要教育党员、干部解放思想,增强改革
开放意识,坚持实事求是。在把握“一个中心、两个基本点”问题上,
要警惕右,但主要是防止“左”。不要被姓“资”姓“社”的抽象争论束
缚自己的手脚。要认清社会主义的本质是解放生产力,发展生产
力,消灭剥削,消除两极分化,最终达到共同富裕。对有利于发展社
会主义社会的生产力,有利于增强社会主义国家的综合国力,有利
于提高人民生活水平的事情,就大胆去干。要尊重实践,尊重群众
的创造。不能固守那些过去起过作用,现在已经不适用的东西,不
能搞“本本主义”。不能把本来属于社会主义的东西,误认为是资本
主义的。不能把人类社会共同创造的文明成果和反映现代社会化
生产规律的先进经营方式和管理方法,看成是资本主义独有的。即
使是资本主义的东西,也要加以区别。在我国政治经济条件制约
下,只要是有利于社会主义经济发展的,就要敢于利用;一时把握
不准的,要允许看,允许试验。对确属资本主义腐朽的东西,要坚决
抵制和摒弃。要教育党员、干部始终坚持四项基本原则,为经济建
设和改革开放提供政治保证。
(二)加强领导班子建设,大胆选拔优秀年轻干部
我重要进一步把各级领导班子建设成为政治坚定、勇于改革、团结
协调,联系群众、廉洁务实、精干高效,能够更好地贯彻执行党的基
本路线的领导集体。各级领导班子都要切实加强思想作风建设,坚
持原则,增强团结,提高解决自身问题的能力。
选拔干部配备领导班子,要全面执行干部队伍“四化”方针和
