On the 16th, the CPC Central Committee issued the "Opinions of the CPC Central Committee on Strengthening Party Building and Improving the Party's Combat Effectiveness in Reform and Construction". The "Opinions" pointed out that Comrade Deng Xiaoping's important speech during his inspection tour in the south at the beginning of this year has a significant and far-reaching guiding significance for promoting my country's reform, opening up and modernization. It also has a significant and far-reaching guiding significance for comprehensively strengthening party building in terms of politics, ideology, organization and style under new historical conditions. It has greatly encouraged the enthusiasm of the whole party to accelerate the pace of reform and construction and further improve party building work. The "Opinions" pointed out that party building work should conscientiously implement the spirit of Comrade Deng Xiaoping's important speech and the plenary meeting of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee, unswervingly adhere to the party's basic line, firmly establish the idea of focusing on economic construction, strictly govern the party, do a good job in the party's own construction, and strengthen the party's ties with the people, so that party organizations at all levels and the majority of Communist Party members always stand in the forefront of reform and construction, and give full play to the party's leading core role in the great cause of building socialism with Chinese characteristics. The main contents of the "Opinion": 
(I) Arm the whole party with the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and improve the consciousness and firmness of implementing the party's basic line 
Learning and mastering the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics is the fundamental task of the party's ideological construction. Party members and cadres should be educated to recognize the situation, cheer up, and establish the ambition to develop the economy better and faster. Party members and cadres should be educated to emancipate their minds, enhance the awareness of reform and opening up, and adhere to seeking truth from facts. In grasping the "one center and two basic points", we should be vigilant against the right, but mainly prevent "left". Don't be bound by abstract arguments about "capitalism" and "socialism". We should recognize that the essence of socialism is to liberate productivity, develop productivity, eliminate exploitation, eliminate polarization, and ultimately achieve common prosperity. We should boldly do things that are conducive to the development of productivity in socialist society, to strengthening the comprehensive national strength of the socialist country, and to improving people's living standards. We must respect practice and respect the creativity of the masses. We cannot stick to things that worked in the past but are no longer applicable, and we cannot engage in "book worship". We must not mistake things that originally belong to socialism for capitalism. We must not regard the civilization achievements created by human society and the advanced business methods and management methods that reflect the laws of modern socialized production as unique to capitalism. Even if they are capitalist things, we must distinguish them. Under the constraints of my country's political and economic conditions, as long as they are conducive to the development of the socialist economy, we must dare to use them; if we are not sure about them at the moment, we must allow them to be seen and tested. We must resolutely resist and abandon things that are indeed decadent capitalism. We must educate party members and cadres to always adhere to the four basic principles and provide political guarantees for economic construction and reform and opening up. (II) Strengthen the construction of leadership teams and boldly select outstanding young cadres. It is important to further build leadership teams at all levels into leadership collectives that are politically firm, courageous in reform, united and coordinated, connected with the masses, honest and pragmatic, efficient and efficient, and able to better implement the party's basic line. Leadership teams at all levels must earnestly strengthen ideological and work style construction, adhere to principles, strengthen unity, and improve their ability to solve their own problems. In selecting cadres and equipping the leadership team, we must fully implement the "four modernizations" policy of the cadre team and the principle of both moral integrity and ability. In the new era, the moral integrity and ability of cadres are mainly measured by their performance in implementing the party's basic line. Leading cadres must have a theoretical level of Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought that is commensurate with the performance of their duties, be able to fully implement the party's basic line, and firmly follow the socialist road with Chinese characteristics; have a high degree of revolutionary dedication and leadership ability competent for their work; have a strong sense of reform and opening up and a pioneering and innovative spirit; be honest in politics, keep close contact with the masses, have a democratic style, and work solidly. For cadres who have outstanding political achievements in reform and construction and are recognized by the masses, we must boldly select and reuse them. For cadres who do nothing and are not competent for their current positions, we must decisively adjust them down. We must speed up the discovery and selection of outstanding young cadres to join the leadership team. We must attach importance to the training and selection of women cadres, ethnic minority cadres, and non-party cadres. We must resolutely break through the shackles of concepts such as seniority, accommodation and care, and perfectionism, liberate our minds, broaden channels, and select talents in an unconventional way. In selecting cadres, we must fully promote democracy and follow the mass line. In appointing cadres, we must be fair and upright, strictly follow the prescribed procedures, and prevent and correct unhealthy practices in employing people.
(III) Adapt to the requirements of economic construction and reform and opening up, and further improve the construction of local party committees at all levels. Local party committees at all levels must put the leadership of economic construction at the center of their work.
We must constantly improve the level of leadership in economic work. We must adhere to the principle of "grasping both ends" and make sure that "both hands must be strong."
(IV) Promote democracy within the party, adhere to and improve democratic centralism. Democratic centralism is a fundamental system of our party. Only by adhering to the combination of centralization on the basis of democracy and democracy under centralized guidance can we give full play to the enthusiasm, initiative and creativity of party organizations at all levels and the vast majority of party members and cadres, ensure the correctness of the party's decisions and the unity of action, strengthen the party's unity, and improve the party's combat effectiveness. Party organizations at all levels and party member leading cadres must strictly abide by the relevant provisions of the Party Constitution and the norms of political life within the party, and senior party cadres must set an example. The central and provincial (ministerial) Party committees (Party groups) should play an exemplary role in implementing democratic centralism. Any violation of democratic centralism should be corrected in a timely manner. Further promote intra-Party democracy and enliven Party life. Every Party organization and Party member must consciously safeguard the Party's centralized unity, and ensure that individuals obey the organization, the minority obeys the majority, the lower level obeys the higher level, and the whole Party obeys the Party's National Congress and the Central Committee. Resolutely oppose any behavior that undermines the Party's unity. Party committees at all levels should improve the Party committee system, adhere to collective leadership, give full play to the role of the plenary committee, and improve the scientific nature of decision-making and the effectiveness of decision-making. Strengthen intra-Party supervision and improve the supervision system of leading cadres from bottom to top, from top to bottom, and within the Party committee. (V) Strengthen cadre training and comprehensively improve the quality of cadres Party schools, management cadre schools, training centers, etc. at all levels and departments are important positions for carrying out cadre education. Party and government leaders should pay attention to the construction of these institutions, guide them to reform teaching content, improve teaching methods, improve the level of teachers, and give full play to their role. In the teaching of the basic theories of Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought, we must closely link them with the reality of construction and reform, implement the principle of being concise and concise, help cadres strengthen their party spirit, and improve their ability to use Marxism to study new situations, summarize experiences, and solve new problems. At the same time, we must combine the work needs of various types of cadres, increase the content of policies and regulations related to economic development and reform and opening up, and strengthen the training of modern scientific and cultural knowledge and commodity, market, and management knowledge. We must vigorously do a good job in training and educating young cadres and create millions of reliable successors to the socialist cause. We must train and educate young cadres with a high sense of historical responsibility and urgency, and help them focus on solving three problems: first, firmly follow the socialist road with Chinese characteristics; second, make the party's basic line take root in their minds; third, adhere to the purpose of serving the people wholeheartedly and establish a Marxist world outlook. Organize young cadres to go to the front line of construction and reform to undergo training and increase their talents. (VI) Combine economic and political system reforms to accelerate the pace of cadre and personnel system reform

The cadre and personnel system reform should be comprehensively planned, implemented in steps, and gradually matched with the reform

The basic goal of the reform is to adhere to the principle of the Party managing cadres, gradually establish and improve a scientific classification management system and competition and incentive mechanisms, mobilize the enthusiasm of various types of cadres, and provide institutional guarantees for outstanding talents to stand out and display their talents. We must improve the methods of cadre management, so that the management of people and the management of affairs are closely combined and reasonably restricted.

Combined with the institutional reform of party and government organs, the civil service system should be gradually implemented in state administrative organs. We should speed up the formulation of detailed rules for the implementation of the regulations for the staff of the Communist Party of China organs, and implement them in conjunction with the expansion of the pilot of the civil service system. Other state organs and mass organizations should also form their own distinctive cadre and personnel management systems.

Seize the current favorable opportunity for enterprises to transform their operating mechanisms and reform their personnel systems.

(VII) Strengthen the construction of grassroots party organizations and give full play to the role of party organizations as a fighting fortress and the vanguard and exemplary role of Communist Party members

At present, there are too few party members on the front line of production. We must earnestly cultivate activists and, under the premise of adhering to standards and ensuring quality, absorb qualified comrades into the party ranks. We must pay special attention to cultivating and absorbing outstanding young workers, farmers and intellectuals into the party.
The party organizations of state-owned enterprises should focus on production and operation and give full play to their political core role.
Rural grassroots party organizations should conscientiously implement the decisions of the Eighth Plenary Session of the 13th CPC Central Committee, actively lead the broad masses of farmers to deepen rural reforms, develop rural economy and gradually achieve the goal of building a moderately prosperous society, and implement the party's basic line at the grassroots level. We should further improve the supporting construction of village-level organizations with party branches as the core.
(VIII) Seriously carry forward the fine traditions of the party and effectively improve the leadership style
Leading organs at all levels should take the lead in carrying forward the fine traditions and style of linking theory with practice, maintaining close ties with the masses, and criticizing and self-criticizing, vigorously advocate a pragmatic spirit, work hard, talk less and do more, and overcome bureaucracy and formalism. We should streamline meetings, compress documents, reduce the activities of welcoming and seeing off leading cadres, and make time to go deep into the grassroots, the masses, and conduct investigations and research.
We must tell the truth, reflect the situation truthfully, report good news when there is good news, report bad news when there is bad news, and oppose telling lies.
Leading organs and leading cadres at all levels must take the lead in strengthening the party's work style and building a clean government, and resolutely and persistently fight against corruption.

translated_text: From the 21st to the 24th, the Central Organization and Establishment Committee held a national symposium on the pilot reform of county-level institutions in Beijing. The important topics of the meeting were to check and understand the implementation of Premier Li Peng's speech on "Actively Promoting County-level Institutional Reform" in various places, summarize and exchange the experience of the pilot reform of county-level institutions, and study the problems encountered in the pilot process and solutions. Zhao Dongwan, Minister of Personnel, member of the Central Organization and Establishment Committee and Director of the Office, delivered a speech at the meeting entitled "Seriously Summarize Experience and Further Promote the Pilot Reform of County-level Institutions". He said that my country's institutional setup and administrative management system have not yet completely gotten rid of the highly centralized planned economic system, and in many aspects cannot meet the needs of economic development. There is too much direct government management, weak macro-control, and the responsibilities of government and enterprises have not been completely separated. The service function is relatively weak. The relationship between superior and subordinate agencies, government departments, and party and government departments has not been completely straightened out. The organization is huge, the staff is too many, the functions are overlapping, and there is a lot of wrangling, and the efficiency is low. If this situation is not changed as soon as possible, it will seriously restrict economic development and the deepening of economic system reform. Zhao Dongwan emphasized that administrative system and institutional reform is not only an urgent task of political system reform, but also a necessary condition for deepening economic system reform. The purpose is to closely focus on economic construction, reform the administrative system and institutional settings that are not adapted to economic development, streamline the institutions that should be streamlined, and strengthen the functions that should be strengthened, so as to create conditions for the liberation and development of productivity. During the meeting, Premier Li Peng of the State Council held a discussion with comrades at the National Symposium on the Pilot Work of County-level Institutional Reform. Li Peng said that the time for comprehensive institutional reform is gradually ripe. Now the pilot work of county-level institutional reform has started well and the situation is very good. The number of pilot counties nationwide has reached more than 350, and a lot of good experience has been gained. On this basis, we must strengthen leadership, expand the pilot, carry out supporting work, and comprehensively promote the development of institutional reforms at all levels to serve economic construction and the development of productivity. Li Peng said that the superior business departments should delegate power, support the reforms below, and not interfere. Institutional reform must adhere to the principle of separation of government and enterprises, and government departments will no longer directly manage enterprises. To this end, we must strengthen macro-management, transform functions, streamline institutions, implement "small institutions, big services", and improve work efficiency. State organs will gradually implement the civil service system. Li Peng pointed out that institutional reform is a major event, and party committees and governments at all levels should put this work on the important agenda. We must strengthen leadership to ensure the smooth progress of institutional reform.

23日 中共中央组织部、中共中央统战部发出《关于加强和
改善各级人民政府及司法机关中党同党外人士合作共事的意见》
的通知。《通知》指出,在各级人民政府和司法机关中坚持党同党外
人士合作共事,是我党一项长期的重要的政策,是坚持和完善中国
共产党领导的多党合作和政治协调制度、建设社会主义民主政治
的一项重要内容。党的十一届三中全会以来,党同党外人士的合作
共事关系,总的情况是好的。目前已有近6000名党外干部在县以
上政府领导班子中任职;多数地方和部门的党组织重视发挥党外
干部的作用,支持他们的工作;党外同志也尽职尽责,努力做好工
作。随着党领导的多党合作和政治协商制度的不断完善,今后还会
有更多的党外干部担任各级人民政府和司法机关领导职务。为了
更好地贯彻党的基本路线,全面落实党的统一战线方针政策,进一
步加强和改善各级人民政府和司法机关中党同党外人士的合作共
事,并逐步规范化、制度化,现提出如下意见:
·一,充分发挥党外干部的作用。在各级人民政府和司法机关担
任领导职务的党外干部,一般都具有良好的政治和业务素质,在工
作中对他们应当充分信任,放手使用,热情支持。在研究工作分工
时,要注意党外干部的专长和实际水平,并认真听取他们的意见,
要扬长避短,发挥优势,力求做到人尽其才,才尽其用,充分调动他
们的积极性、创造性。
二、保证党外干部有职有权。党外干部担任领导职务,就要有
职,有权、有责。一方面要保证他们依法行使职权,另一方面要帮助
他们守职尽责。党外干部应按工作分工,参加行政领导,参与有关
方针政策的研究,参与本地区或本部门全局性重大问题的讨论与
决策。他们阅读文件,除纯属党务和某些有特殊规定的外,应象同
级党员干部一样对待。其分管业务范围内的干部任免、调动,要听
取并尊重他们的意见。
三、坚持同党外干部商量办事。在同党外干部的合作中,加强
同他们的协商,认真倾听他们的意见和建议,合理的应积极采纳,
不妥当的要耐心、细致地加以说明。要定期向党外干部通报情况,
和他们共同总结工作,交流经验,研究问题。做到以诚相待,团结共
事。
四、正确看待党外干部。搞好合作共事,关键是对党外干部要
有正确的认识。党的组织和党员领导干部要坚持从实际出发,客
观、全面地评价党外干部。要把握干部的本质和主流,主要看他们
贯彻党的基本路线的政治态度和工作实绩。对党外干部要坚持条
件,防止降格以求,也不要求全责备。对党外干部在工作中取得的
成绩要充分肯定并予以鼓励;对他们因经验不足或其他原因造成
的差错,要客观分析,主动为他们承担一些责任,引导他们总结经
验教训,改进工作。
五、和党外干部交朋友。党员领导干部要同党外干部多接触,
多交往,通过个别谈心、小型座谈,登门拜访等多种形式,沟通感
情,交流思想,增进相互了解和信任。在同党外干部交往中,要平等
相待,坦诚相见。
六、给予学习提高的机会。要有计划有步骤地安排党外干部进
党校或社会主义学院参加短期培训。
七、关心党外干部的生活。这是党的干部政策的一项重要内
容,也是切实搞好合作共事的一个不可缺少的方面。要努力为党外
干部排忧解难,多做实事。改善党外干部的工作条件和生活条件,
对其提级、调资、医疗、住房等问题,应同党员干部一视同仁。对他
们生活上确有困难的,应尽可能帮助解决。
八、加强党委对合作共事工作的领导。在同党外人士合作共事
中,党的组织和党员领导干部处于主导方面。各级党组织和党员领
导干部要认真学习《中共中央关于坚持和完善中国共产党领导的
多党合作和政治协商制度的意见》(中发〔1989〕14号)和《中共中
央关于加强统一战线工作的通知》(中发〔1990〕10号),搞好同党
外人士合作共事。党委组织部在考察领导班子时,也要考察班子内
的党外干部,同时要把党员干部同党外干部合作共事的情况作为
一项考核内容。党委统战部要了解合作共事的情况,总结经验,提
出建议;发现问题,应商请有关方面或请示党委,妥善解决。
translated_text:
On the 23rd, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the United Front Work Department of the CPC Central Committee issued a notice on "Opinions on Strengthening and Improving the Cooperation and Collaboration between the Party and Non-Party Personages in People's Governments and Judicial Organs at All Levels". The "Notice" pointed out that insisting on the cooperation and collaboration between the Party and non-Party personages in people's governments and judicial organs at all levels is an important long-term policy of our Party and an important part of upholding and improving the multi-party cooperation and political coordination system led by the Communist Party of China and building socialist democratic politics. Since the Third Plenary Session of the 11th CPC Central Committee, the overall situation of the cooperation and collaboration between the Party and non-Party personages has been good. At present, nearly 6,000 non-Party cadres have served in the leadership teams of governments at or above the county level; most local and departmental Party organizations attach importance to the role of non-Party cadres and support their work; non-Party comrades also fulfill their duties and work hard. With the continuous improvement of the multi-party cooperation and political consultation system led by the Party, more non-Party cadres will serve in leadership positions in people's governments and judicial organs at all levels in the future. In order to better implement the Party's basic line, fully implement the Party's united front policies, further strengthen and improve the cooperation and collaboration between the Party and non-Party members in people's governments and judicial organs at all levels, and gradually standardize and institutionalize it, the following opinions are put forward: 1. Give full play to the role of non-Party cadres. Non-Party cadres who hold leadership positions in people's governments and judicial organs at all levels generally have good political and professional qualities. They should be fully trusted, used freely, and supported enthusiastically in their work. When studying the division of work, we should pay attention to the expertise and actual level of non-Party cadres, and listen to their opinions carefully. We should make the best use of their strengths and avoid their weaknesses, give full play to their advantages, strive to make the best use of talents, and fully mobilize their enthusiasm and creativity. 2. Ensure that non-Party cadres have positions and powers. Non-Party cadres who hold leadership positions must have positions, powers, and responsibilities. On the one hand, we must ensure that they exercise their powers in accordance with the law, and on the other hand, we must help them fulfill their duties. Non-Party cadres should participate in administrative leadership, research on relevant policies and guidelines, and discussion and decision-making on major issues of the region or department according to their work division. When reading documents, they should be treated the same as Party cadres at the same level, except for those that are purely Party affairs and certain special provisions. The appointment, removal and transfer of cadres within their respective business scope should be listened to and respected.
3. Insist on consulting with non-Party cadres. In cooperation with non-Party cadres, strengthen consultation with them, listen carefully to their opinions and suggestions, actively adopt reasonable ones, and patiently and carefully explain inappropriate ones. Regularly inform non-Party cadres of the situation, summarize work with them, exchange experiences, and study problems. Be sincere and work together.
4. Correctly view non-Party cadres. The key to good cooperation and work is to have a correct understanding of non-Party cadres. Party organizations and Party member leading cadres should adhere to starting from reality and objectively and comprehensively evaluate non-Party cadres. To grasp the essence and mainstream of cadres, we should mainly look at their political attitude and work performance in implementing the Party's basic line. We should insist on conditions for non-Party cadres, avoid lowering our standards, and not demand perfection. We should fully affirm and encourage the achievements made by non-Party cadres in their work; we should objectively analyze their mistakes due to lack of experience or other reasons, take some responsibility for them, and guide them to sum up their experience and lessons and improve their work.
5. Make friends with non-Party cadres. Party member leading cadres should have more contact and communication with non-Party cadres, and communicate feelings, exchange ideas, and enhance mutual understanding and trust through various forms such as individual talks, small-scale discussions, and door-to-door visits. In communicating with non-Party cadres, we should treat them equally and be frank with them.
6. Give them opportunities to learn and improve. We should arrange non-Party cadres to attend short-term training in Party schools or socialist colleges in a planned and step-by-step manner.
7. Care about the lives of non-Party cadres. This is an important part of the Party’s cadre policy and an indispensable aspect of effectively cooperating and working together. We should work hard to solve problems for non-Party cadres and do more practical things. Improve the working and living conditions of non-Party cadres, and treat them equally with Party cadres in terms of promotion, salary adjustment, medical care, housing, etc. If they have real difficulties in life, we should help them solve them as much as possible.
8. Strengthen the leadership of the Party Committee over cooperation and collaboration. In cooperation and collaboration with non-Party people, Party organizations and Party member leading cadres are in the leading position. Party organizations and Party member leading cadres at all levels should earnestly study the "Opinions of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Upholding and Improving the Multi-Party Cooperation and Political Consultation System under the Leadership of the Communist Party of China" (Zhongfa [1989] No. 14) and the "Notice of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Strengthening the Work of the United Front" (Zhongfa [1990] No. 10), and do a good job in cooperation and collaboration with non-Party people. When inspecting the leadership team, the Organization Department of the Party Committee should also inspect the non-Party cadres in the team, and at the same time, the cooperation and collaboration between Party members and cadres and non-Party cadres should be included in the assessment content. The United Front Work Department of the Party Committee should understand the situation of cooperation and collaboration, summarize experience, and put forward suggestions; if problems are found, they should consult with relevant parties or ask the Party Committee for instructions to properly resolve them.

translated_text: On the 24th, the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on Doing a Good Job in the Reelection of Local People's Congresses at All Levels". The reelection work should be guided by the important speech of Comrade Deng Xiaoping during his inspection in the south and the spirit of the plenary meeting of the Central Political Bureau, fully promote democracy, strictly abide by the law, and select citizens who modelly abide by the Constitution and laws, strive to serve the people, maintain close ties with the masses, can represent the interests and will of the people, and have a certain ability to participate in politics and affairs as local people's congress representatives; according to the principles of revolutionization, rejuvenation, knowledge, and specialization and the principle of both moral integrity and ability, select outstanding talents recognized by the masses who have outstanding political achievements in implementing the party's basic line, are brave in reform, and are pioneering and enterprising into the leadership of local state organs at all levels. The "Notice" emphasizes the following issues that need attention: (1) Carefully prepare for the reelection. (2) Adhere to the provisions of differential elections and 10 people jointly nominating candidates. (3) Attention should be paid to the breadth and representativeness of representatives. (4) The Standing Committees of the People's Congresses at all levels should be well built. (5) The work of township people's congresses should be strengthened. The "Notice" emphasizes that party committees at all levels should effectively strengthen the leadership of the term change work, pay attention to studying new situations and solving new problems. It is necessary to support the local people's congresses at all levels and their standing committees to play their roles in accordance with the law. The party committees of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the central government should make specific deployments and arrangements for the term change work in light of the actual conditions of their regions.

translated_text: On the 25th, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China issued a "Notice on the Corruption of Some Party and Government Officials in Fuping County, Hebei Province". The "Notice" pointed out that this was a typical case of corruption among major county-level leading cadres. The two county party secretaries Wang Zhenrong and Song Xijiu, the county magistrate Yang Facheng and other leading cadres abused their power, accepted bribes, became corrupt and degenerate, and became the "protective umbrella" of some corrupt elements. Due to their influence, some party members and cadres followed suit, abused their power for personal gain, embezzled bribes, bent the law for personal gain, oppressed the masses, carried out illegal activities by any means, and unscrupulously embezzled state and collective funds, making an old revolutionary base area a mess, and the people complained. The problems in Fuping County show that in some places, top-down supervision has not been organically combined with bottom-up supervision, and an effective supervision mechanism has not been formed. At the same time, the main reason is that the county party committee has serious deviations in its guiding ideology, has not implemented the policy of "grasping both ends", and has neglected and relaxed the fight against corruption. As a result, economic work was not carried out, corruption spread and aroused the dissatisfaction of the people. The "Notice" requires that party organizations at all levels should learn profound lessons from the problems in Fuping County, always adhere to the principle of "grasping both ends", closely focus on economic construction, strengthen party building, improve party conduct and clean government, and incorporate anti-corruption into the entire process of reform and opening up and economic construction. The focus of anti-corruption is leading organs and leading cadres. It is necessary to effectively strengthen supervision of leading groups at all levels, and regularize and institutionalize the inspection of team members. When problems are found, they should be dealt with in a timely manner, those who should be criticized and educated should be criticized and educated, those who should be adjusted should be adjusted in a timely manner, and those who should be investigated and dealt with must be investigated and dealt with seriously, and problems should not be solved after they pile up, so as to ensure the integrity of leading groups at all levels and make them truly a strong core for building socialism with Chinese characteristics.

导。
translated_text: From the 26th to the 28th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China held a symposium on the work of party building in the organs in Beijing. The main topic of the meeting was to closely focus on the implementation of the important speech of Comrade Deng Xiaoping during his inspection of the south and the spirit of the plenary meeting of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee, summarize and exchange the experience of party building in the organs, and study and solve the main problems that need to be solved urgently in the work. Zhao Zong, deputy director of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, made an important speech at the meeting. He said that with the deepening of economic and political system reforms, the party and state organs themselves are also facing the arduous task of institutional reform. Under this situation, strengthening the party building of the organs is of special importance. He pointed out that from the current status of the party building work of the organs, the party building of the organs has been strengthened, which has ensured the completion of various tasks of the organs. But overall, the party building work of the organs is still relatively weak. The outstanding problems are that the problems of impure thoughts and styles of some party members and cadres are relatively prominent; the problem of ineffective supervision of party members and cadres, especially party leading cadres, is common; quite a few grassroots branches lack vitality, and there are no effective measures for the education and management of party members. translated_text:
On the 28th, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council issued a notice on conscientiously implementing the "Regulations on the Transformation of the Operation Mechanism of State-Owned Industrial Enterprises". The main contents of the "Notice": 1. The central link of economic system reform is enterprise reform, and the key to enterprise reform is to transform the enterprise operation mechanism. At present and in the future, the main responsible comrades of the party and government at all levels should focus on transforming the enterprise operation mechanism and take the implementation of the "Regulations" as the central task. Through learning and publicity, party and government cadres at all levels, enterprise employees and personnel from all walks of life will understand and master the relevant provisions of the "Regulations" and correctly implement the "Regulations". 2. To transform the enterprise operation mechanism, it is necessary to transform government functions. Party and government departments at all levels should follow the relevant provisions of the "Regulations", focus on the entry of enterprises into the market, and follow the principle of separation of government and enterprise responsibilities, "macro management and micro liberalization", change their work style, improve work efficiency, and do a good job in service. Party and government departments at all levels shall not require enterprises to set up counterpart institutions and increase staff establishment. We must stop all acts of levying on enterprises, reduce their burdens, support them in reforming, and create favorable external conditions for them to enter the market.
3. The focus of transforming the business mechanism of enterprises is to implement the autonomy of business operations of enterprises. Governments at all levels must unswervingly delegate the autonomy of business operations to enterprises. The relevant departments and personnel must be held accountable for any acts that infringe on the autonomy of business operations of enterprises.
4. Enterprises must make full use of the autonomy of business operations granted by the Regulations and actively enter the domestic and international markets to compete. We must consciously accept the supervision of relevant government departments and society, strengthen internal supporting reforms, improve business management methods, and comprehensively improve the quality of enterprises.
5. Enterprise party organizations, trade unions, the Communist Youth League and other organizations must carry out work around the transformation of enterprise business mechanisms, do a good job in ideological and political work, support the work of factory directors, and ensure the smooth progress of the transformation of enterprise business mechanisms.
6. We must speed up the formulation of implementation measures for the Regulations.
7. All local party and government departments should do a good job in cleaning up the current laws, regulations and policy documents. The "Notice" requires party and government leaders at all levels to strengthen leadership and personally grasp the study, publicity and implementation of the "Regulations". In accordance with the provisions of the "Regulations", the departments and offices responsible for organizing and implementing the regulations should be clearly defined, and classified guidance and step-by-step progress should be adhered to. Relevant problems in implementing the "Regulations" should be discovered and resolved in a timely manner, and good experiences and practices should be summarized and promoted, and typical cases should be used to promote overall work.

为了发展壮大党的力量,各地党组织按照“坚持标准,保证质

展的 751. 2 万名新党员中,有工人117.4万名,占23.6%;农牧渔

现有党员队伍中,高中以上文化程度的比例,已由1978年底的
12.8%,提高到34.9%。
按照从严治党的要求,各地加强对党员的教育、管理和监督。

加强。到1991年底,全国共建立党的基层组织324万个,遍布全国
城乡各个行业。
农村实行联产承包责任制后,各地按照“有利于农村经济体制
改革,有利于加强党同农民群众的关系,有利于加强对党员的教育
管理”的原则,调整和改进农村党的基层组织设置,改变了一些地
方一度存在的“有党组织无党员、有党员无党组织”的状况。各地在
加强以党支部为核心的村级组织配套建设、增强村级组织整体功
能的同时,重点对软弱涣散的农村党支部分期分批地进行了整顿,
收到较好效果。
企业党组织围绕生产经营和深化改革开展工作,政治核心地
位和作用逐步加强。多数企业党委负起了领导思想政治工作的责
任。许多党委在参与重大问题的决策、支持厂长依法行使职权、全

中制的基本原则、党内生活的基本要求,作了明确的规定。党的

设的新路子,特别是以江泽民同志为核心的党中央十分重视党的

市党委制定的有关党的组织制度方面的规章制度达200多件。这

translated_text: On the same day, Xinhua News Agency reported that since the Third Plenary Session of the 11th CPC Central Committee, the organization of the Communist Party of China has been continuously strengthened, further promoting reform and opening up and socialist modernization. According to the Central Organization Department, there are currently more than 51 million members of the Communist Party of China in the country, playing an important role on all fronts. In recent years, among the advanced workers and heroes and model figures selected by various regions and departments, Communist Party members account for more than 70%. In order to develop and strengthen the party's strength, local party organizations have actively cultivated and absorbed advanced elements among workers, farmers and intellectuals on the front line of production into the party in accordance with the principle of "adhering to standards, ensuring quality, improving structure, and cautious development". Since the 13th CPC National Congress, among the 7.512 million new party members developed nationwide, there are 1.174 million workers, accounting for 23.6%; and 1.174 million farmers, herders and fishermen, accounting for 15.6%. Among the 24 million professional and technical personnel of various types in the country, party members account for 1/3. The number of female party members and ethnic minority party members has also increased significantly. Among the new party members developed in recent years, those with a high school education or above and those under 35 years old account for more than 2/3. Among the existing party members, the proportion of those with a high school education or above has increased from 12.8% at the end of 1978 to 34.9%. In accordance with the requirements of strict party governance, various places have strengthened the education, management and supervision of party members. In 1988, based on the experience of various places, the Central Committee decided to establish a democratic evaluation system for party members. In 1991, 48.03 million party members participated in the democratic evaluation activities, 3.528 million party members were commended by the party organization, of which 1.323 million party members were awarded the title of outstanding Communist Party members by the higher-level party committees, and 154,000 unqualified party members were dealt with by the organization. While strengthening the construction of the party member team, the construction of the party's grassroots organizations has also been significantly strengthened. By the end of 1991, a total of 3.24 million grassroots party organizations had been established across the country, covering all industries in urban and rural areas. After the implementation of the contract responsibility system for linking output to remuneration in rural areas, various places adjusted and improved the grassroots party organization settings in rural areas in accordance with the principle of "benefiting the reform of the rural economic system, strengthening the relationship between the party and the peasant masses, and strengthening the education and management of party members", changing the situation of "party organizations without party members, and party members without party organizations" that once existed in some places. While strengthening the supporting construction of village-level organizations with party branches as the core and enhancing the overall functions of village-level organizations, various places focused on rectifying weak and scattered rural party branches in stages and batches, and achieved good results. The party organizations of enterprises carry out work around production and operation and deepening reforms, and their political core status and role are gradually strengthened. Most enterprise party committees have assumed the responsibility of leading ideological and political work. Many party committees have done a lot of work and accumulated valuable experience in participating in the decision-making of major issues, supporting factory directors to exercise their powers according to law, and relying wholeheartedly on the working class to run enterprises well. In recent years, various places have conscientiously implemented the spirit of the Central Committee's "Notice on Strengthening Party Building in Colleges and Universities", and party building and ideological and political work in colleges and universities have achieved remarkable results. Party organizations at all levels have actively explored new ways and methods to strengthen and improve the party building work in the organs, and the work has made new progress. The construction of party organizations in scientific research, culture, and urban streets has also been strengthened to varying degrees. The "Several Regulations on Political Life within the Party" adopted by the Fifth Plenary Session of the Eleventh Central Committee of the Party clearly stipulates the basic principles of democratic centralism and the basic requirements of party life. The Thirteenth National Congress of the Party proposed to take a new path to strengthen party building by institutional construction without political movements. In particular, the Party Central Committee with Comrade Jiang Zemin as the core attaches great importance to party building, and a new situation has emerged in the construction of party regulations and organizational systems. Since the Third Plenary Session of the Eleventh Central Committee of the Party, the Party Central Committee, relevant central departments, and provincial, autonomous region, and municipal party committees have formulated more than 200 rules and regulations on the party's organizational system. These rules and regulations involve the organizational work of the entire party, cadre deployment, cadre exchange and avoidance, leadership team democratic life meetings, party members' behavioral norms, party elections, party supervision and party organizational life, etc., ensuring and promoting the development of the party's organizational construction in the direction of standardization and institutionalization.

The "Notice" requires that retired and retired personnel will generally no longer be sent abroad to perform official duties. events: 同日 中国共产党第十四次全国代表大会主席团举行第一次会议。江泽民同志在会议结束时讲了话。会议由大会秘书长乔石主持。会议听取了中国共产党第十四次全国代表大会代表资格审查委员会关于代表资格审查的报告。报告说,十三届八中全会确定党的十四大代表名额为2000名,中央分配到各选举单位的名额共1992名。代表选出后逝世1名(李先念),中央批复代表 1991名后又逝世2名(胡乔木、王密妮),实有代表1989名。报告说,党的十四大代表的选举工作,认真贯彻执行了民主集中制原则。党的十四大代表具有广泛的代表性。建党初期和北伐战争时期,土地革命战争时期,抗日战争时期,解放战争时期以及建国以后各个时期入党的党员都有适当数量的代表。报告说,代表资格审查委员会认为,全国34个选举单位选出的1989名代表,符合党章和中央关于选举党的十四大代表通知的规定,代表资格有效。周会报告说,这次大会参照十三大的做法,中央确定了46 1927年以前入党,并在党内担任过重要领导职务,德高望重的老党员为特邀代表。他们具有与正式代表同样的权利。会议还通过了大会列席和来宾的事项。中央决定,邀请党内有关负责同志和部分党外人士列席这次大会。列席这次大会的有:不是十四大代表的十三届中央委员会及中央顾问委员会、中央纪律检查委员会的成员,不是十四大代表或特邀代表的党内部分老同志,以及其他有关负责同志,共307人。还邀请了全国人大常委会党外副委员长,全国政协副主席,各民主党派、全国工商联负责人和无党派人士,以及全国人大、全国政协常委中在京党外人士和部分少数民族、宗教界人士等,共139位,作为来宾列席大会开幕式和闭幕式。主席团会议还通过了十四大会议日程。根据日程,十四大将于10月12日上午在北京开幕,10月18日下午闭幕。
translated_text: On the same day, the Presidium of the 14th National Congress of the Communist Party of China held its first meeting. Comrade Jiang Zemin spoke at the end of the meeting. The meeting was chaired by Qiao Shi, the Secretary-General of the Congress. The Presidium meeting approved the list of the 31-member Standing Committee of the Presidium by a show of hands, and approved Hu Jintao, Ding Guangen and Wen Jiabao as Deputy Secretaries-General of the Congress. The meeting listened to the report of the Qualification Review Committee of the 14th National Congress of the Communist Party of China on the qualification review of delegates. The report said that the 8th Plenary Session of the 13th Central Committee determined that the number of delegates to the 14th National Congress of the Party was 2,000, and the Central Committee allocated a total of 1,992 delegates to each electoral unit. One delegate died after being elected (Li Xiannian), and two more died after the Central Committee approved 1,991 delegates (Hu Qiaomu and Wang Minni), leaving a total of 1,989 delegates. The report said that the election of delegates to the 14th National Congress of the Party conscientiously implemented the principle of democratic centralism. The delegates to the 14th National Congress of the Party are widely representative. There are appropriate numbers of representatives from the party members who joined the party in the early days of the founding of the party and during the Northern Expedition, the Agrarian Revolutionary War, the Anti-Japanese War, the Liberation War, and various periods after the founding of the People's Republic of China. The report said that the Delegate Qualification Review Committee believed that the 1,989 representatives elected by 34 electoral units across the country met the provisions of the Party Constitution and the Central Committee's notice on the election of representatives to the 14th National Congress of the Party, and their representative qualifications were valid. The Zhou Hui report said that this congress referred to the practice of the 13th National Congress, and the Central Committee determined that 46 old party members who joined the party before 1927 and held important leadership positions in the party and were highly respected as special invited representatives. They have the same rights as formal representatives. The meeting also passed matters regarding the attendance and guests of the congress. The Central Committee decided to invite relevant responsible comrades in the party and some non-party people to attend this congress. Those attending this congress included: members of the 13th Central Committee, the Central Advisory Committee, and the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection who were not representatives of the 14th National Congress, some old comrades in the party who were not representatives of the 14th National Congress or special invited representatives, and other relevant responsible comrades, a total of 307 people. A total of 139 people were invited to attend the opening and closing ceremonies of the conference, including vice chairpersons of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, vice chairpersons of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, leaders of various democratic parties, the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce, and non-party members, as well as non-party members of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress and the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference in Beijing, and some ethnic minorities and religious figures. The presidium meeting also approved the agenda of the 14th National Congress. According to the schedule, the 14th National Congress will open in Beijing on the morning of October 12 and close on the afternoon of October 18.

translated_text: On the 12th, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, delivered a report entitled "Accelerating the pace of reform, opening up and modernization, and winning greater victories in the cause of socialism with Chinese characteristics" on behalf of the 13th Central Committee at the 14th National Congress of the CPC. The report is divided into four parts: 1. Basic summary of the great practice of 14 years; 2. Main tasks of reform and construction in the 1990s; 3. International situation and our foreign policy; 4. Strengthening party building and improving party leadership. In his report, Jiang Zemin pointed out that the cause we have been engaged in for 14 years is to adhere to the party's basic line, liberate and develop productivity through reform and opening up, and build socialism with Chinese characteristics. In terms of the breadth and depth of social changes it has caused, it has started a new revolution. These 14 years are the 14 years in which we have truly concentrated our efforts on socialist modernization, the 14 years in which the people's living standards have improved the fastest, a new situation in history has been created, remarkable achievements have been made, and the party has won the support of the broad masses of the people. In his report, he comprehensively expounded the main contents of the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, and highly praised Comrade Deng Xiaoping, the chief architect of my country's socialist reform and opening up and modernization, for his historic and significant contribution to the creation of the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics. Jiang Zemin emphasized that the experience of 14 years of great practice can be summarized as follows: we must unswervingly adhere to the basic line of the Party guided by the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics. This is the most reliable guarantee for our cause to withstand the test of risks and successfully reach the goal. In his report, Jiang Zemin said that in order to push forward the great cause of socialism with Chinese characteristics in the 1990s, the most fundamental thing is to adhere to the basic line of the Party, accelerate reform and opening up, and concentrate on economic construction. Judging from the development of the domestic and international situation, the speed of my country's economic development in the 1990s can be faster. According to preliminary estimates, an increase of 8 to 9 percent is possible, and we should move towards this goal. When talking about what kind of target model should be determined for my country's economic system reform, Jiang Zemin said that this is a major issue related to the overall situation of the entire socialist modernization construction. The core of this issue is to correctly understand and handle the relationship between planning and the market. He pointed out that the development of practice and the deepening of understanding require us to clearly state that the goal of my country's economic system reform is to establish a socialist market economic system in order to further liberate and develop productive forces. When talking about the main tasks of reform and construction in the 1990s, Jiang Zemin emphasized that in order to accelerate reform and opening up and promote economic development and social progress, we must strive to achieve ten major tasks related to the overall situation: we must focus on the establishment of a socialist market economic system and accelerate the pace of economic reform; further expand opening up to the outside world and make better use of foreign capital, resources, technology and management experience; adjust and optimize the industrial structure, attach great importance to agriculture, and accelerate the development of basic industries, basic infrastructure and the tertiary industry; accelerate scientific and technological progress, vigorously develop education, and give full play to the role of intellectuals; give full play to the advantages of various regions, accelerate regional economic development, and promote the rationalization of the national economic layout; actively promote political system reform, so that socialist democracy and legal system construction have a greater development; make up your mind to carry out administrative management system and institutional reform, and effectively transform functions, rationalize relations, streamline the military and government, and improve efficiency; adhere to the two-pronged approach, and raise the construction of socialist spiritual civilization to a new level; continuously improve people's lives, strictly control population growth, and strengthen environmental protection; strengthen military construction, enhance national defense strength, and ensure the smooth progress of reform and opening up and economic construction. Jiang Zemin pointed out in his report that the world today is in a historical period of great changes. The bipolar pattern has ended, various forces have re-differentiated and regrouped, and the world is moving towards a multipolar direction. Peace and development are still the two major themes of the world today. China has always adhered to an independent and peaceful foreign policy. Maintaining our country's independence and sovereignty and promoting world peace and development are the basic goals of China's foreign policy. On issues involving national interests and state sovereignty, we will never succumb to any external pressure. China will never seek hegemony or expansion, and will oppose any form of hegemonism, power politics, and aggressive expansion. China is willing to develop friendly and cooperative relations with all countries on the basis of the Five Principles of Peaceful Coexistence. In international exchanges, we will never impose our social system and ideology on others, and similarly, we will never allow other countries to impose their social system and ideology on China. Our principled position will never change. When talking about strengthening party building and improving party leadership, Jiang Zemin stressed that the party's basic line must be adhered to unswervingly for a long time, socialist reform and opening up and modernization construction must be carried out better and faster, and the key to the country's long-term stability and prosperity lies in our party and in persisting in arming the whole party with Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics. In the new historical period, we must combine the new reality and follow the party's basic line; insist on the party's self-management and strict governance, strengthen and improve party building, strive to improve the party's governance and leadership level, and better play the leading role in the great cause of building socialism. Jiang Zemin emphasized that to strengthen and improve the party's leadership, we must do a good job in the following aspects: First, earnestly study the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and enhance the consciousness and firmness of implementing the party's basic line. Second, strengthen the construction of the leadership team and cultivate successors to the socialist cause. Third, close the connection between the party and the masses and resolutely overcome negative corruption. Fourth, strengthen the construction of grassroots party organizations and give full play to the vanguard and exemplary role of party members. Fifth, adhere to and improve democratic centralism and safeguard the unity and solidarity of the Party. In his report, Jiang Zemin highly praised the work of the Central Advisory Committee. He said that in the 10 years since its establishment, the Central Advisory Committee has assisted the Party Central Committee in maintaining the unity of the Party and social stability, promoting reform and opening up and modernization, and has done a lot of fruitful work, and has established new historical achievements for the Party, the country and the people. (Dinner) Jiang Zemin finally said that from now until the middle of the next century, it is a very important and precious period for the prosperity of the motherland and the prosperity of the socialist cause. He called on all comrades of the Party and people of all ethnic groups across the country to unite more closely under the leadership of the Party Central Committee, breathe together, share destiny, and be connected in heart, hold high the great banner of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, and forge ahead towards the grand goal!

events: 1992年10月12日,中国共产党第十四次全国代表大会在北京开幕。江泽民同志在政治报告中指出:要下决心进行行政管理体制改革和机构改革,切实做到转变职能、理顺关系、精兵简政、提高效率。他说,机构改革,精兵简政,是政治体制改革的紧迫任务,也是深化经济改革、建立市场经济体制和加快现代化建设的重要条件。各级党委和政府必须统一认识,按照政企分开和精简、统一､效能的原则,下决心对现行行政管理体制和党政机构进行改革。综合经济管理部门的工作重点要转到加强宏观调控上来。撤并某些专业经济管理部门和职能交叉重复或业务相近的机构,大幅度裁减非常设机构。精简机关人员,严格定编定员。机构改革、精兵简政是一项艰巨任务,必须统筹规划,精心组织,上下结合,分步实施,三年内基本完成。要把人员精简同提高工作效率和发展社会生产力结合起来,既改善机关人员结构,提高人员素质,又使大批人才转移到第三产业和其他需加强的工作岗位上去,成为现代化建设的生力军。江泽民强调要加快人事劳动制度改革,逐步建立健全符合机关、事业、企业不同特点的科学的分类管理体制和有效的激励机制。这方面的改革要同机构改革、工资制度改革相结合。尽快推行国家公务员制度。
translated_text: On October 12, 1992, the 14th National Congress of the Communist Party of China opened in Beijing. In his political report, Comrade Jiang Zemin pointed out that we must be determined to carry out administrative system reform and institutional reform, and truly transform functions, straighten out relations, streamline administration, and improve efficiency. He said that institutional reform and streamlining administration are urgent tasks for political system reform, and are also important conditions for deepening economic reform, establishing a market economy system, and accelerating modernization. Party committees and governments at all levels must have a unified understanding and make up their minds to reform the current administrative system and party and government institutions in accordance with the principles of separation of government and enterprises, streamlining, unification, and efficiency. The focus of the work of comprehensive economic management departments should be shifted to strengthening macroeconomic regulation. Some professional economic management departments and institutions with overlapping functions or similar businesses should be withdrawn and merged, and non-permanent institutions should be significantly reduced. Streamline the staff of government agencies and strictly set quotas. Institutional reform and streamlining administration are arduous tasks that must be planned in an overall manner, carefully organized, combined with top-down and bottom-up, and implemented in steps, and basically completed within three years. We should combine staff reduction with improving work efficiency and developing social productivity, improve the staff structure and quality of the staff, and transfer a large number of talents to the tertiary industry and other jobs that need to be strengthened, so as to become the main force of modernization. Jiang Zemin stressed the need to accelerate the reform of the personnel and labor system, and gradually establish and improve a scientific classification management system and effective incentive mechanism that conforms to the different characteristics of government agencies, institutions and enterprises. This reform should be combined with institutional reform and wage system reform. The national civil service system should be implemented as soon as possible.

14日 中共中央组织部、国家人事部、劳动部、财政部联合发
出《关于增加部分老红军、老干部生活困难补助费的通知》。《通
知》指出,1979年4月17日,民政部、国家劳动总局、财政部《关
于解决部分老红军、老干部工资过低和生活困难补助问题的通知》
(民发〔1979〕23号、1979〕劳总薪字第24号、1979]财事字第85
号)中规定,为了从优解决第一、二次国内革命战争时期的老红军、
老干部的生活困难,由国家财政按每人每年30元拨一笔专款。根
据这部分老红军、老干部的实际情况,经研究决定,从1992年度
起,对他们的生活困难补助增加到每人每年100 元。所需经费,分
别由中央和地方财政负担。
这项经费的管理和使用仍按原规定执行,即:“中央级各部门
掌握使用,地方由各省、市、自治区负责管理老红军、老干部的主管
单位统一掌握使用,列‘职工福利费”目,主要用于解决所在单位福
利费解决不了的老红军、老干部及其遗属(直系亲属)的困难补
助。”
translated_text: On the 14th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, the Ministry of Personnel, the Ministry of Labor, and the Ministry of Finance jointly issued the "Notice on Increasing the Living Difficulty Subsidy for Some Old Red Army and Old Cadres". The "Notice" pointed out that on April 17, 1979, the Ministry of Civil Affairs, the State General Bureau of Labor, and the Ministry of Finance issued the "Notice on Solving the Problems of Low Wages and Living Difficulty Subsidy for Some Old Red Army and Old Cadres" (Minfa [1979] No. 23, 1979] Lao Zongxin No. 24, 1979] Caishi No. 85), which stipulated that in order to solve the living difficulties of the old Red Army and old cadres during the first and second domestic revolutionary wars, the state finances will allocate a special fund of 30 yuan per person per year. According to the actual situation of these old Red Army and old cadres, it was decided after research that starting from 1992, their living difficulties subsidy will be increased to 100 yuan per person per year. The required funds will be borne by the central and local finances respectively. The management and use of this fund is still implemented according to the original regulations, namely: "The central departments shall control and use it, and the local departments in charge of the old Red Army and old cadres in the provinces, cities and autonomous regions shall control and use it in a unified manner, and list it as "employee welfare funds", mainly used to solve the difficulties of the old Red Army, old cadres and their dependents (immediate relatives) who cannot be solved by the welfare funds of their units."

translated_text: On the 15th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council issued the Notice on Adjusting the Approval Authority for Sending Temporary Personnel Abroad and Inviting Foreigners to China. The Notice requires that after the approval authority is adjusted, the leading Party and government organs at all levels must conscientiously implement the relevant regulations of the Central Committee, strengthen macroeconomic regulation, strictly control and strictly manage in the approval work. Going abroad on official business must have a clear official purpose and substantive content, pay attention to effectiveness, eliminate general inspections, and strictly prohibit unhealthy practices such as public-funded overseas travel. Leading Party and government cadres at all levels must set an example and set an example. The Notice emphasizes that without the approval of the State Council or the Central Foreign Affairs Leading Group, all regions and departments shall not delegate or delegate in disguise the approval authority for sending people abroad and inviting them to China. Approval departments that violate regulations, engage in fraud, and abuse approval authority shall be severely dealt with. In serious cases, their approval authority shall be suspended or withdrawn.

events: 1992年10月15日,在中外记者招待会上,人事部部长赵东宛在回答记者关于人事制度改革的提问时指出,经过几年的准备工作,我们的公务员制度已经有了基础,取得了以下进展:一是我们已经有了一个适合中国国情的公务员条例,目前正按法律程序进行审批;二是为取得推行公务员制度的经验,已经进行了将近四年的试点工作,并取得了预期的效果,今年以来,全国已有二十度几个省、自治区、直辖市进行试点;三是公务员条例中的某些单项制度,如考试录用制度､亲属回避制度等,已在全国范围内试行;四是为全面推行公务员制度培训了一批骨干力量,国家行政学院的筹建工作进展顺利。因此,今后我们将根据十四大精神加快推行公务员制度。全面推行公务员制度必须在机构改革的基础上进行,首先从中央和省两级政府开始,然后在省以下机关推行,大体用三年或更长一点时间,在全国范围内基本建立起公务员制度,并逐步加以完善。
translated_text: On October 15, 1992, at a press conference for Chinese and foreign journalists, Zhao Dongwan, Minister of the Ministry of Personnel, pointed out in response to reporters' questions about the reform of the personnel system that after several years of preparatory work, our civil service system has already laid a foundation and has made the following progress: First, we already have a civil service regulation that suits China's national conditions, which is currently being approved in accordance with legal procedures; second, in order to gain experience in promoting the civil service system, we have carried out pilot work for nearly four years and achieved the expected results. Since this year, more than 20 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities have carried out pilot work; third, some individual systems in the civil service regulations, such as the examination recruitment system and the relative avoidance system, have been tried out nationwide; fourth, a group of backbone forces have been trained for the comprehensive implementation of the civil service system, and the preparation work for the National School of Administration is progressing smoothly. Therefore, in the future, we will accelerate the implementation of the civil service system in accordance with the spirit of the 14th National Congress. The comprehensive implementation of the civil service system must be carried out on the basis of institutional reform, starting with the central and provincial governments, and then implemented in agencies below the provincial level. It will take about three years or more to basically establish a civil service system nationwide and gradually improve it.

translated_text: On the 27th, the CPC Central Committee held a symposium for leaders of democratic parties, the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce, and non-party leaders. Li Peng, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Premier of the State Council, presided over the meeting. General Secretary Jiang Zemin introduced the situation of the 14th National Congress of the CPC. Also attending the meeting were members of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee Qiao Shi, Li Ruihuan, Zhu Rongji, Liu Huaqing, and Hu Jintao. In his speech, Jiang Zemin said that the 14th National Congress of the CPC was very well held, and the major policies, goals and tasks were clearly defined. The key is to work hard and implement them. The first task at present is to lead and do a good job in the study, publicity and implementation of the spirit of the 14th National Congress, so that it can truly become the conscious and practical actions of the broad masses of cadres and the people, and become a powerful driving force for comprehensively promoting the construction of socialism with Chinese characteristics. In his speech, Jiang Zemin said that the major achievements and main features of the 14th National Congress of the Communist Party of China were to fully affirm the great achievements made in the reform and opening up and modernization construction in the 14 years since the Third Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee, to make a solemn conclusion on a series of major decisions and important achievements of the Party in the past 14 years, to systematically expound Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, to make arrangements for the main tasks of the 1990s, and to clearly determine to adhere to the Party's basic line for a hundred years, to clearly determine to establish China's socialist market economic system, and to clearly determine to arm the whole Party with Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics. He said that the 14th National Congress was a congress of unity, a congress of victory, and a congress to comprehensively promote reform and opening up and socialist modernization. Jiang Zemin said that studying, publicizing and implementing the spirit of the 14th National Congress was a major event in the political life of the people of all ethnic groups in the country, and Communist Party members should take the lead. He pointed out that studying the documents of the 14th National Congress should be combined with studying Comrade Deng Xiaoping's works and important talks during his inspection tour in the south. He asked leading cadres at all levels to strive to learn from Comrade Deng Xiaoping, master dialectical materialism, unify emancipating the mind and seeking truth from facts, combine the local and departmental realities, carry out work creatively, and implement the spirit of the 14th National Congress. Jiang Zemin emphasized that there is a lot of work to be done to adhere to Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and the basic line of our party. As for domestic work, there are two main points: First, we must always adhere to economic construction as the center, and no matter what storms we encounter, we must concentrate our efforts to unswervingly promote economic construction. Second, around the center of economic construction, we must continue to handle the relationship between adhering to the four basic principles and adhering to reform and opening up, and handle the relationship between socialist material civilization construction and spiritual civilization construction, and truly do both hands and make both hands strong. He made a request to all the friends present, to the democratic parties, the Federation of Industry and Commerce and the representatives of non-party personages: "Sincerely hope to get your cooperation, help and supervision." In his speech, Jiang Zemin hoped that the democratic parties, the Federation of Industry and Commerce and the representatives of non-party personages would continue to make important contributions to my country's socialist modernization. He said that the democratic parties are an important force in my country's socialist modernization. Whether it is reform and opening up, economic development and social progress, or promoting the completion of the great cause of peaceful reunification of the motherland in accordance with the principle of "one country, two systems", the democratic parties, the Federation of Industry and Commerce and the representatives of non-party personages have glorious responsibilities. He said that in the process of implementing the spirit of the 14th National Congress, our party and relevant state departments will further listen to the opinions and suggestions of the democratic parties, the Federation of Industry and Commerce and the representatives of non-party personages, improve the relevant systems and regulations, and do a better job in implementation. Jiang Zemin said that the deep friendship and the good relationship of mutual trust and mutual support established between the Communist Party of China and the democratic parties, the Federation of Industry and Commerce and the representatives of non-party personages in decades of revolution and construction have also opened a new chapter in the advancement of our common cause. The common goal of the motherland's prosperity and the Chinese nation's entry into the ranks of the world's advanced nations requires us to breathe together, share the same fate, and unite more closely. In the process of implementing the spirit of the 14th National Congress, I believe that the democratic parties, the Federation of Industry and Commerce, and non-party representatives will definitely play their positive role better and make new and important contributions to accelerating the pace of reform and opening up and socialist modernization and winning greater victories in the cause of socialism with Chinese characteristics. After General Secretary Jiang Zemin's speech, the leaders of the democratic parties, the Federation of Industry and Commerce, and non-party representatives spoke warmly and congratulated the successful convening of the 14th National Congress of the Communist Party of China. In their speeches, they also put forward many good suggestions and opinions on implementing the spirit of the 14th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and accelerating the pace of reform and opening up and economic construction.

translated_text: On the 30th, the People's Daily reported that the grassroots party organizations in rural areas across the country have conscientiously implemented the party's basic line and the party's policies and guidelines in rural areas, closely centered on the development of rural economy and the gradual realization of common prosperity, and continuously strengthened their own construction, so that the core leadership role of the party organizations has been fully exerted. According to statistics from relevant departments, the total industrial and agricultural output value of 2,643 towns and villages in the country has exceeded the 100 million yuan mark, and the industrial and agricultural output value of more than 400 villages has exceeded 50 million yuan. Following the advanced party organizations such as Doudian in Beijing, Liuzhuang in Henan, Huaxi in Jiangsu, Xincheli and Bashan in Shandong, Hongzui in Jilin, Honglin in Hubei, and Nanling in Guangdong, a large number of advanced models leading the masses to pursue a well-off society and build a new socialist countryside have emerged across the country, forming a gratifying situation in which "hundreds of red flags" guide hundreds of thousands of party branches to stride forward. According to the needs of the new situation and new tasks, various places have adhered to the principle of "four modernizations" of the cadre team and the principle of both ability and political integrity, and insisted on selecting outstanding party members who are willing and able to lead the masses to overcome poverty and become rich into the grassroots leadership team, which has enhanced the vitality of the township party committee and village party branch leadership team. By the end of 1991, there were 187,000 village party branch secretaries under the age of 35, accounting for 26.4% of the total number of branch secretaries; 92,000 with a high school education or above, accounting for 19% of the total number of branch secretaries. In order to give full play to the vanguard and exemplary role of rural party members, various places started from carrying out party members' contact with farmers, and gradually developed to "party member responsibility areas", "party-mass joint enrichment groups" and "one team (party member service team) five groups (joint enrichment group, old party member advisory group, financial audit group, joint spiritual civilization group, civil mediation group)" and other forms of activities, so that the role of the vast majority of rural party members, including "non-employed party members", has also been better played. According to a recent survey of 7,746 party members in 270 villages in 15 towns and five counties in Jilin, Hubei and Shaanxi provinces, 1,263 were rated as outstanding party members, accounting for 16% of the total number of party members; 5,769 were rated as qualified party members, accounting for 73% of the total number of party members. The above two items together account for 89% of the total number of party members.
