events:
3日 中共中央政法委员会、中共中央组织部、中央编委办公
室、人事部、财政部联合印发《关于给政法部门增加编制的通知》。
《通知》指出,根据中央政治局全体会议决定,在“八五”期间给
政法部门增加编制20万人。《通知》规定,增编20万人于1993年
至1995年分3年实施完成,每年各增编1/3。增编重点是充实政
法各部门基层单位和个别薄弱环节,不包括中央一级政法各部门,
省、自治区、直辖市一级政法各部门的领导机关原则上不增加编
制。要清理临时人员,逐步冲销超编人员。
《通知》说,这次增编主要从政法专业学校和大专院校毕业生
及部队转业军官中择优录用,也可以从党政机关及事业单位选调
适合从事政法工作的人员。从部队转业军官中吸收做政法工作的
人员,一律经过政法专业培训考察合格后方可调入上岗。除边远地
区及条件艰苦的劳改劳教单位外,不从社会上直接招收工作人员。
translated_text: On the 3rd, the Political and Legal Affairs Commission of the CPC Central Committee, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Office of the Central Editorial Committee, the Ministry of Personnel, and the Ministry of Finance jointly issued the "Notice on Increasing the Staffing of Political and Legal Departments". The "Notice" pointed out that according to the decision of the plenary meeting of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, the staffing of political and legal departments will be increased by 200,000 people during the "Eighth Five-Year Plan". The "Notice" stipulates that the increase of 200,000 people will be completed in three years from 1993 to 1995, with an increase of 1/3 each year. The focus of the increase is to strengthen the grassroots units and individual weak links of various political and legal departments, excluding the political and legal departments at the central level. In principle, the leading organs of the political and legal departments at the provincial, autonomous region, and municipality level will not increase the staffing. Temporary personnel should be cleared and the overstaffing should be gradually offset. The "Notice" said that this increase will mainly be recruited from graduates of political and legal professional schools and colleges and retired officers of the army, and personnel suitable for political and legal work can also be selected from party and government agencies and public institutions. Personnel recruited from retired military officers to work in the political and legal fields must undergo professional political and legal training and be qualified before they can be transferred to the posts. Except for remote areas and labor reform and reeducation-through-labor units with difficult conditions, staff members will not be directly recruited from the society.

events:
7日 10日 中共中央组织部在四川省乐山市召开全国
省、区、市党委组织部研究室主任会议。中央组织部副部长李铁林
在会上讲了话讲话为: (一)大力加强调查研究是新形势发展的迫
切需要。(二)进一步明确新形势下组织部门调查研究的指导思想
和工作思路,(三)悉心研究当前组织工作亟待解决的新问题。
(四)切实加强组织部门调研队伍的建设。
李铁林说,部里提出要大兴调查研究之风,把1993年变为组
织战线的调查研究年,加大调查的力度和分量。在调查研究的指导
思想和工作思路上,必须注意和把握以下几点:第一,进一步解放
思想,实事求是。研究问题要大胆地想,工作要大胆地搞,大胆地
试,不要等.不要怕风险。在调查研究中,不带框框,不存偏见,不搞
先入为主,要坚持实事求是。第二,紧密围绕组织工作为经济建设
服务开展调研。第三,既要重视掌握情况,总结经验的跟踪性调研,
又要重视预测趋势,探路开道的超前性调研。第四,注重调研成果
的综合利用。
李铁林要求大家要悉心研究当前组织工作亟待解决的新问
题,如关于建立社会主义市场经济体制与党的组织关系的问题;关
于地方党政领导班子如何提高领导经济工作能力的问题;关于深
化干部人事制度改革的问题;关于坚持和完善民主集中制的问题;
关于青年干部成长规律的问题;关于新形势下国有企业和其他各
种经济组织中党的工作问题;关于党员教育管理的问题。
4月30日,中共中央组织部印发了《李铁林同志在全国省区
市党委组织部研究室主任会议上的讲话》。
translated_text: On the 7th and 10th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China held a national meeting of directors of research offices of the Organization Departments of provincial, regional and municipal party committees in Leshan City, Sichuan Province. Li Tielin, deputy director of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, spoke at the meeting. His speech was: (i) Vigorously strengthening investigation and research is an urgent need for the development of the new situation. (ii) Further clarify the guiding ideology and working ideas of the investigation and research of the organization department under the new situation. (iii) Carefully study the new problems that need to be solved in the current organizational work. (iv) Effectively strengthen the construction of the research team of the organization department. Li Tielin said that the department proposed to vigorously promote the investigation and research, turn 1993 into the investigation and research year of the organizational front, and increase the intensity and weight of the investigation. In the guiding ideology and working ideas of investigation and research, we must pay attention to and grasp the following points: First, further emancipate the mind and seek truth from facts. We must think boldly when studying problems, work boldly, and try boldly. Don't wait. Don't be afraid of risks. In investigation and research, we should not have frameworks, prejudices, or preconceived ideas, and we must insist on seeking truth from facts. Second, conduct research closely around organizational work to serve economic construction. Third, we should attach importance to follow-up research to grasp the situation and summarize experience, and also attach importance to advanced research to predict trends and explore new paths. Fourth, pay attention to the comprehensive use of research results. Li Tielin asked everyone to carefully study the new problems that need to be solved in the current organizational work, such as the relationship between the establishment of a socialist market economic system and the party organization; how local party and government leadership teams can improve their ability to lead economic work; deepening the reform of the cadre personnel system; adhering to and improving democratic centralism; the growth law of young cadres; the party work in state-owned enterprises and other economic organizations under the new situation; and the education and management of party members. On April 30, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued "Comrade Li Tielin's Speech at the National Conference of Directors of Research Offices of Provincial, Regional and Municipal Party Committees Organization Departments".

23日——26日 中共中央组织部在广东省珠海市召开全国
外商投资企业党的工作座谈会。会议主要议题是,交流外商投资企
业党的工作经验,研讨外商投资企业中党的工作中亟待解决的问
题,并在珠海市进行了实地考察。会上,中央组织部副部长赵宗
作了讲话。
赵宗鼐在讲话中对党的十一届三中全会以来外商投资企业中
党的工作情况进行了回顾,充分肯定了几年来外商投资企业党的
工作所取得的成绩。同时也指出了当前存在的不容忽视的问题。他
强调,要进一步提高对做好外商投资企业党的工作重要性的认识,
进一步明确外商投资企业党组织工作的指导思想和职责任务,从
实际出发,创造性地开展工作。从大的方面看,党组织的工作主要
是两个方面:一是要认真做好中方人员的工作,二是要处理好同外
方的关系。开展工作,必须根据外商投资企业的特点,讲究方式方
法,不能简单地套用国有企业的做法。要根据不同类型企业的具体
情况,在实践中继续探索和总结,不断加以丰富和完善。
赵宗强调,要努力搞好外商投资企业党组织的自身建设。他
说,加强党组织的自身建设,是履行党组织的职责,发挥党组织在
中方员工中的政治核心作用的基础。要迅速改变外商投资企业中
党的工作长期无人过问,没人去抓的状况。在没有条件建立党组织
的企业,要先把工会、共青团组织建立起来。已建立党组织的,要切
实加强思想、组织和作风建设,加强对党员的教育和管理,努力提
高党组织的战斗力,外商投资企业中的党员领导干部要把自己置
于党组织的监督之下,企业里的物质文明建设和精神文明建设,业
务工作和思想政治工作,要两个任务一起下,两付担子一起挑,两
项成果一起要。赵宗还强调,要切实加强对外商投资企业党的工
作的领导,并根据当前存在问题和会上讨论意见,提出了具体要
求。
8月27日,中共中央组织部印发了赵宗鼐的讲话。
translated_text: From the 23rd to the 26th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China held a national symposium on the Party work of foreign-invested enterprises in Zhuhai City, Guangdong Province. The main topic of the meeting was to exchange experiences in the Party work of foreign-invested enterprises and discuss the urgent problems to be solved in the Party work of foreign-invested enterprises, and a field investigation was conducted in Zhuhai City. At the meeting, Zhao Zong, deputy director of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, made a speech. In his speech, Zhao Zongnai reviewed the Party work in foreign-invested enterprises since the Third Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee of the Party, and fully affirmed the achievements made in the Party work of foreign-invested enterprises in the past few years. At the same time, he also pointed out the current problems that cannot be ignored. He emphasized that we must further enhance our understanding of the importance of doing a good job in the Party work of foreign-invested enterprises, further clarify the guiding ideology and duties and responsibilities of the Party organizations of foreign-invested enterprises, and carry out work creatively based on reality. From a broad perspective, the work of the Party organization mainly has two aspects: one is to do a good job in the work of Chinese personnel, and the other is to handle the relationship with the foreign party well. In carrying out work, we must pay attention to methods and methods based on the characteristics of foreign-invested enterprises, and we cannot simply apply the practices of state-owned enterprises. According to the specific conditions of different types of enterprises, we should continue to explore and summarize in practice, and constantly enrich and improve them. Zhao Zong stressed that efforts should be made to improve the self-construction of the party organizations in foreign-invested enterprises. He said that strengthening the self-construction of the party organizations is the basis for fulfilling the responsibilities of the party organizations and giving full play to the political core role of the party organizations among Chinese employees. It is necessary to quickly change the situation that the party work in foreign-invested enterprises has been neglected and no one has taken charge of it for a long time. In enterprises where there are no conditions to establish party organizations, trade unions and Communist Youth League organizations should be established first. For those who have established party organizations, they should effectively strengthen ideological, organizational and style construction, strengthen the education and management of party members, and strive to improve the combat effectiveness of party organizations. Party member leaders in foreign-invested enterprises should put themselves under the supervision of party organizations. The material and spiritual civilization construction, business work and ideological and political work in enterprises should be carried out together, and two tasks should be carried together, and two results should be achieved together. Zhao Zong also stressed that it is necessary to effectively strengthen the leadership of the party work in foreign-invested enterprises, and put forward specific requirements based on the current problems and the opinions discussed at the meeting. On August 27, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China printed and distributed Zhao Zongnai's speech.

translated_text: On the same day, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council issued the "Notice on Strictly Prohibiting Party and Government Organs and Their Staff from Accepting and Giving Gifts and Securities in Official Activities". The "Notice" stipulates: (a) Party and government organs at all levels and their staff (including retired cadres and personnel entrusted and employed by party and government organs to perform public duties), especially leading organs and leading cadres, shall not accept gifts and securities in any name or disguised form during official activities including ceremonial celebrations, press conferences and economic activities. Anyone who violates the regulations and accepts gifts and securities shall be resolutely investigated and given party and government discipline sanctions according to the amount and severity of the circumstances. Those who ask for or hint at the other party to give gifts and securities shall be severely punished. Those who violate the criminal law shall be punished according to law. (ii) All regions, departments, units (including enterprises and institutions) shall not give gifts and securities to party and government organs and their staff in the form or name of business meetings, receptions, order exhibitions, press conferences and other meetings and various activities such as ceremonies, celebrations, commemorations, business, etc. Any violation of the regulations shall be investigated for the responsibility of the relevant leaders. (iii) Party and government organs at all levels and their staff must hand over all gifts and securities accepted in foreign-related activities (including exchanges with overseas Chinese and compatriots from Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan) within one month and turn them over to the state treasury. Those who fail to hand them over on time will be treated as embezzlement. The "Notice" also puts forward requirements for financial departments, auditing agencies, party discipline inspection agencies and administrative supervision agencies at all levels to implement the spirit of the above regulations.

Leading cadres at all levels must always adhere to the principle of "grasping both ends". Not only should material civilization construction reach a new level, but spiritual civilization construction should also reach a new level. They complement each other and cannot be separated from each other. Only when both civilizations are successfully built can socialism with Chinese characteristics be considered successfully built. If people's thoughts slip and the social atmosphere is not good, it will be difficult to develop the economy, and even if it does, it will not be consolidated. Everyone must understand this dialectical relationship. events:
9日 《人民日报》报道,党的十一届三中全会以来,在党中央
的重视和各级党组织的努力下,一大批德才兼备的优秀年轻干部
在改革和建设的实践中成长起来。全国已有26万多名中青年干部
走上了县以上领导岗位,45岁以下的干部占干部队伍总数的70%
以上,成为干部的主体。1991年底具有大专以上文化程度的已占
干部队伍总数的71%。
最近一期《党建》杂志发表的署名文章《新老交替十四年
党的十一届三中全会以来培养选拔年轻干部工作回顾》,系统地阐
述了改革开放以来年轻干部成长的情况。
文章说,1981年党的十一届六中全会通过决议,决定废除干
部领导职务终身制,在革命化的前提下逐步实现各级领导人员的
年轻化、知识化和专业化。1982年党中央作出了建立老干部退休
制度的决定,提出必须选拔和培养成千上万的德才兼备、年富力强
的中青年干部,逐步从老干部手里接班。到1983年7月,全国有
23.8万名老干部离职休养,使我们在打破干部职务终身制,实现
新老干部的合作与交替方面迈出了关键一步。到1991年底,全国
离休干部已达656万多人。
我们党从1981年底开始了改善领导班子结构的工作。不仅缩
减了中央一级的党政机构和编制,而且使部、局两级领导班子的平
均年龄普遍下降了4至6岁。到1983年,经过调整,地方省、地两
级领导班子的平均年龄分别下降了7至8岁。中央组织部在总结
经验的基础上,于1983年10月制定了关于领导班子“四化”建设
的八年规划。各地各部门有计划有步骤地大力培养选拔年轻干部,
使领导班子结构不断改善。据1993年换届已结束的20个省、自治
区和直辖市的统计,省级政府班子成员50岁以下的已占34.7%,
大专以上文化程度的比例已提高到92.7%。
translated_text: On the 9th, the People's Daily reported that since the Third Plenary Session of the 11th CPC Central Committee, with the attention of the CPC Central Committee and the efforts of party organizations at all levels, a large number of outstanding young cadres with both ability and political integrity have grown up in the practice of reform and construction. More than 260,000 young and middle-aged cadres have taken up leadership positions at the county level and above, and cadres under the age of 45 account for more than 70% of the total number of cadres, becoming the main body of cadres. At the end of 1991, those with a college degree or above accounted for 71% of the total number of cadres. The signed article "A Review of the Work of Cultivating and Selecting Young Cadres Since the Third Plenary Session of the 11th CPC Central Committee in the Fourteen Years of New and Old Transition" published in the latest issue of the Party Building magazine systematically expounded the growth of young cadres since the reform and opening up. The article said that the Sixth Plenary Session of the 11th CPC Central Committee in 1981 passed a resolution to abolish the lifelong tenure of leading cadres and gradually realize the rejuvenation, knowledge and professionalization of leaders at all levels under the premise of revolutionization. In 1982, the Party Central Committee made a decision to establish a retirement system for veteran cadres, proposing that tens of thousands of young and middle-aged cadres with both ability and integrity, in their prime, must be selected and trained to gradually take over from veteran cadres. By July 1983, 238,000 veteran cadres had retired to rest, which was a key step in breaking the lifelong tenure system for cadres and achieving cooperation and alternation between old and new cadres. By the end of 1991, the number of retired cadres nationwide had reached more than 6.56 million. Our Party began to improve the structure of the leadership team at the end of 1981. Not only did it reduce the number of Party and government institutions and establishments at the central level, but it also reduced the average age of the leadership teams at the department and bureau levels by 4 to 6 years. By 1983, after adjustments, the average age of the leadership teams at the provincial and prefectural levels had dropped by 7 to 8 years, respectively. Based on the summary of experience, the Organization Department of the Central Committee formulated an eight-year plan for the "four modernizations" of the leadership team in October 1983. All localities and departments have vigorously cultivated and selected young cadres in a planned and step-by-step manner, and the leadership team structure has been continuously improved. According to statistics from 20 provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities that have completed the change of leadership in 1993, 34.7% of provincial government team members are under 50 years old, and the proportion of those with a college degree or above has increased to 92.7%.

translated_text: On the 18th, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China issued the "Opinions on the Establishment of Discipline Inspection and Supervision Institutions in Central Directly Affiliated Organs and Central State Organs" by the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and the Ministry of Supervision. Regarding the establishment of positions and cadre management in the discipline inspection and supervision institutions of central directly affiliated organs and central state organs, the "Opinions" stipulates: The dispatched discipline inspection group and the party group discipline inspection group (discipline inspection committee) shall have one group leader (secretary) and one to two deputy group leaders (deputy secretaries). The dispatched and internally established supervision bureau (office of the supervisory commissioner) shall have one director (commissioner) and one to two deputy directors (deputy commissioners). For the supervision bureau (office of the supervisory commissioner) that implements the joint office of discipline inspection and supervision, the director (commissioner) shall be the deputy group leader (deputy secretary) of the discipline inspection group (discipline inspection committee). The internal office of the dispatched and internally established discipline inspection and supervision institutions is collectively referred to as the office. The office shall have one director and one to two deputy directors. The deployment, appointment, removal and management of the above-mentioned cadres shall be implemented in accordance with the relevant documents of the General Office of the Central Committee and the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and the relevant provisions of the "Administrative Supervision Regulations of the People's Republic of China". The Opinion also stipulates the principles, forms, leadership system, working relationships and staffing of the discipline inspection and supervision agencies of the central government agencies and central state agencies.

济条件下,对党组织和党员的要求不是降低了,而是更高了。首先,
要在党员中继续深入进行理想、纪律的教育。共产党员要带头发展
社会主义市场经济,但不能利用职权损公肥私,搞权钱交易;共产党
员要学会市场经济,懂经营,善管理,带领群众共同致富,而不能只
顾个人发财。乔石指出,如果从上到下,层层都能先订几条自我约
法,发挥先锋模范作用,加上强化监督机制,那么全党的自我约束机
制就可能形成,全党、全国通行的纪律法规也比较容易出台了。总
之,纪律必须加强,那种认为“经济要上、纪检要让”的看法是非常错
误的。
translated_text: On the 22nd, Qiao Shi, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and president of the Central Party School, spoke at the 14th graduation ceremony of the Central Party School's provincial and ministerial cadres training class. Qiao Shi emphasized that under the market economy, the requirements for party organizations and party members have not been lowered, but have been higher. First, we must continue to carry out in-depth education on ideals and discipline among party members. Communist Party members should take the lead in developing the socialist market economy, but they should not use their power to harm the public and enrich themselves, or engage in power-for-money transactions; Communist Party members should learn market economy, understand business, be good at management, and lead the masses to get rich together, rather than just focusing on personal wealth. Qiao Shi pointed out that if all levels from top to bottom can first set a few self-discipline rules, play a pioneering and exemplary role, and strengthen the supervision mechanism, then the self-restraint mechanism of the whole party may be formed, and the discipline and laws and regulations that are accepted by the whole party and the whole country will be easier to introduce. In short, discipline must be strengthened, and the view that "the economy should be improved and the discipline inspection should be compromised" is very wrong.

想,增强改革意识,把干审工作做深做细。在新的历史条件下,要做

极性。各级领导,尤其是组织部的领导,对这项工作要进行具体的

导的指导帮助下,充分发挥自身的积极性、主动性和创造性。克服

作。有些问题处理不好,就会引起新矛盾,出现新的攀比。因此,我

translated_text: From the 26th to the 29th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China held a national provincial and regional party committee organization department cadre review work experience exchange meeting in Luoyang, Henan. Zhang Quanjing, deputy director of the Central Organization Department, said in his speech at the meeting that under the new historical conditions, cadre review work is still indispensable in strengthening the cadre team, the ideological and work style construction of the leadership team, and in the fight against corruption. The functions of supervision, protection, review, and management can be played through investigation and identification, information integration, macro research, education and improvement. Zhang Quanjing said that based on some good practices and experiences of cadre review work in various places, there are mainly the following points: (a) Start with establishing a contact system and introduce social supervision mechanisms into cadre management. (b) Actively participate in the investigation and understanding of a few leadership teams and leading cadres with strong reactions and greater controversy, and play the role of cadre review departments in reviewing and identifying problems. (c) Through investigation and research, timely grasp various tendencies and incipient problems, and make suggestions for strengthening the construction of the cadre team and establishing a sound supervision and restriction mechanism. (IV) In the education and management of cadres who have made serious mistakes, we should pay attention to finding out the bottom line, grasp the trend, and seriously study new situations and new problems. Zhang Quanjing emphasized that in order to thoroughly implement the spirit of the 1992 cadre review work symposium and do a good job in cadre review work in the new era, all localities should do a good job in the following aspects: (I) Actively practice and unremittingly implement the tasks of cadre review work under the new situation. (II) Emancipate the mind, enhance the reform consciousness, and do a deep and detailed job in cadre review. Under the new historical conditions, to do a good job in the supervision and review of cadres, we must not only inherit and carry forward some basic practices and experiences accumulated in the past years of work practice, but also emancipate the mind, establish a reform consciousness, and when encountering problems, we should not shrink back, nor stick to past practices. We should strive to resolve contradictions through practice and dare to innovate. (III) Strengthen leadership, combine the top and the bottom, and give full play to the two positive aspects. Leaders at all levels, especially the leaders of the Organization Department, should make specific plans, organization and arrangements for this work. When encountering problems, we should help solve them. The cadre review department must also give full play to its enthusiasm, initiative and creativity under the guidance and help of the leadership. Overcome the mentality of "waiting, relying, asking and watching". (IV) Complete the remaining tasks of the original cadre review work from beginning to end. In some provinces and cities, there are still individual hot issues that require further detailed work. If some problems are not handled well, new contradictions will arise and new comparisons will appear. Therefore, we must carry forward the previous serious, responsible, rigorous and meticulous work style and must not be lax or careless. (一)培养选拔少数民族干部是一件关系全局,具有战略意义
的大事。由于党中央的重视和全党上下长期的共同努力,少数民族
干部队伍作为党和国家整个干部队伍的重要组成部分,在改革和
建设的实践中进一步发展壮大,成为党和人民依赖的骨干力量。也
正是因为有了这样一支力量,才为加强民族团结,维护祖国统一,加
快民族地区经济和各项事业的发展,促进各民族的共同繁荣,提供
了强有力的组织保证。联系历史和现实,我们至少可以从中得到如
下启示:第一,正确解决民族问题,既要有正确的指导思想和政策,
又要有一支能够贯彻执行这些指导思想和政策的少数民族干部队
伍。第二建设有中国特色的社会主义,必须继续努力造就一支能更
好地团结带领民族地区各族人民共同奋斗的少数民族干部队伍。第
三,社会主义现代化建设,需要一个有利于我国对外开放的国际环
境,更需要有一个各民族团结和睦、社会政治稳定的内部环境,这也
要求我们必须进一步做好培养选拔少数民族干部的工作。
(C)在培养选拔少数民族干部工作中要注意解决好几个问
题。(1)继续壮大少数民族干部队伍,重在提高少数民族干部素质。

强少数民族中高级干部的培养选拔工作,对拟在近期担任中高级
领导职务的,要及早放到下一级重要岗位上锻炼。对比较成熟的后
备人选,要大胆提拔到较高层次的领导岗位上来。要加强对少数民

干部和汉族干部的团结合作。

translated_text:
From the 5th to the 19th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the United Front Work Department of the CPC Central Committee and the State Ethnic Affairs Commission jointly held a national symposium on the training and selection of ethnic minority cadres in Beijing. On the 8th, Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, delivered a speech with representatives attending the symposium. The main contents are as follows: (i) The training and selection of ethnic minority cadres is a major event of strategic significance that concerns the overall situation. Due to the attention of the Party Central Committee and the long-term joint efforts of the whole party, the team of ethnic minority cadres, as an important part of the entire cadre team of the Party and the country, has further developed and grown in the practice of reform and construction, becoming a backbone force that the Party and the people rely on. It is precisely because of such a force that a strong organizational guarantee has been provided for strengthening national unity, safeguarding the unity of the motherland, accelerating the development of the economy and various undertakings in ethnic areas, and promoting the common prosperity of all ethnic groups. In connection with history and reality, we can at least get the following inspirations from it: First, to correctly solve ethnic issues, we must have both correct guiding ideas and policies and a team of ethnic minority cadres who can implement these guiding ideas and policies. Second, in order to build socialism with Chinese characteristics, we must continue to work hard to create a team of minority cadres who can better unite and lead the people of all ethnic groups in ethnic areas to work together. Third, socialist modernization requires an international environment that is conducive to my country's opening up to the outside world, and even more so an internal environment of unity and harmony among all ethnic groups and social and political stability. This also requires us to do a good job in training and selecting minority cadres. (C) In the work of training and selecting minority cadres, we must pay attention to solving several problems. (1) Continue to expand the team of minority cadres, focusing on improving the quality of minority cadres. In training and selecting minority cadres, we must pay attention to both "quantity" and "quality". (2) Strengthen the training and selection of middle and senior minority cadres. For those who are going to hold middle and senior leadership positions in the near future, they should be placed in important positions at the next level as soon as possible for training. For relatively mature reserve candidates, we should boldly promote them to higher-level leadership positions. We should strengthen the search and training of non-party representatives among ethnic minorities. (3) Strengthen the construction of grassroots cadres in townships and towns in ethnic minority areas. (4) Firmly establish the idea of "two inseparables" and strengthen the unity and cooperation between ethnic minority cadres and Han cadres.
(III) Strengthen leadership, cooperate with all parties, and implement it strictly. Party committees at all levels should put the training and selection of ethnic minority cadres on the agenda and study them regularly. Party committees should divide the work and assign specific people to be responsible. Organization, United Front, Ethnic Affairs Commission, personnel, education, finance and other departments at all levels should actively assume their respective responsibilities, divide the work, strengthen contact, closely cooperate, work together, and serve as good advisers and assistants to the party committees and governments. The organization departments of party committees at all levels should take the lead in the training and selection of ethnic minority cadres and do a good job in comprehensive and coordinated work.
Li Tielin, deputy director of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, spoke at the opening of the meeting, Li Dezhu, deputy director of the United Front Department of the Central Committee, spoke at the end of the meeting, and Zhao Yannian, deputy director of the State Ethnic Affairs Commission, made a speech.
On July 13, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued the "Speech and Remarks by Comrade Hu Jintao, Comrade Li Tielin, Li Dezhu, and Comrade Zhao Yannian at the National Symposium on the Training and Selection of Minority Cadres".

translated_text: On the same day, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Propaganda Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Central Committee of the CPC Central Committee Working Committee, the State Organs Working Committee and the Beijing Municipal Committee of the CPC jointly held a symposium to commemorate the 72nd anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China. The symposium was chaired by Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat. Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, attended the symposium and delivered an important speech. In his speech, Jiang Zemin mainly talked about three issues: (1) In order to liberate and develop productivity in China and realize socialist modernization, it is necessary to strengthen the leadership of the Communist Party. (2) Further build the party in accordance with the requirements of the 14th National Congress. (3) Communist Party members, especially leading cadres, must strengthen their party spirit. In his speech, Jiang Zemin emphasized that the leadership of the party and party building are the fundamental guarantee for the success of economic construction and reform and opening up. The more reform and opening up, the more we develop the economy, the more we must strengthen the leadership of the party and do a good job in party building. This point must never be ignored or relaxed at any time. In the critical period of my country's reform and opening up and modernization, we must further strengthen the leadership of the party and do a good job in party building. Jiang Zemin emphasized that it is necessary to continue to fully implement the various tasks of strengthening and improving party building in accordance with the spirit of the 14th National Congress of the Communist Party of China. The general goal and requirement of party building work is to firmly grasp the theme and build the party into a stronger leadership core to lead socialist modernization; strive to improve the party's governance and leadership level; further enhance the cohesion of the party organization itself, its attraction to the masses, and its combat effectiveness in reform and construction. At present, we should focus on doing a good job in three aspects: First, we should maintain a high degree of ideological and political unity of the whole party. The most fundamental thing is to unremittingly arm the whole party, especially the leading cadres at the county level and above, with the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics. Second, we should consolidate the party's high degree of unity in organization and action, and the most important thing is to strictly implement democratic centralism. Party organizations at all levels must safeguard the overall interests of the party and the country, safeguard the unity and unity of the party, safeguard the authority of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, and ensure the smooth implementation of government orders. Third, we must always maintain close ties between the Party and the people, regard the fight against corruption as a major event in Party building and political power building, achieve results, win the trust of the people, and vigorously advocate and promote the spirit of hard work among all Party members, and resolutely oppose materialism, hedonism and extreme individualism. Jiang Zemin said that under the new historical conditions, Communist Party members should strengthen their Party spirit, emphasize consciously and diligently studying the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, unswervingly implement the Party's basic line and various principles and policies, and be models of emancipating the mind and seeking truth from facts, hard work, selfless dedication, and serving the people wholeheartedly, down-to-earth, hard work, and loyalty to duty, and oppose all kinds of negative corruption and promote new socialist trends. Leading cadres at all levels should do better than ordinary Party members and have stricter requirements.

26日 中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅印发《关于机构改革
人员分流中几个问题的通知》。《通知》主要内容是:(一)要正确认
识人员分流在机构改革中的重要作用,妥善安置好富余人员。
(二)机关分流出去的人员不得搞停薪留职、留薪留职。这些人员
不再保留原机关干部身份,不再列入机关编制,也不得列为编外人
员,不得以原机关名义或原机关干部身份从事经济活动(三)对
于由机关分流人员组成,兴办初期确有困难的经济实体,可在开办
资金､场地,贷款和稅收等方面予以适当扶持;对于从机关分流出
去后收入低于原单位的人员,可采取一定的过渡办法,但为时不得
超过两年。具体扶持措施和过渡办法由各地区、各部门根据实际情
况确定。(四)为分流机关人员而兴办的经济实体,必须坚持政企
分开的原则,自主经营,独立核算,自负盈亏,在职能、人员、财务等
方面与原机关彻底脱钩,由原机关负责管理或由行业主管部门归
口管理。原机关一律不得从这些经济实体获取利润,也不得以任何
借口收取管理费和获取其他好处。(五)由原政府经济管理机构转
成的经济实体,不得再兼有政府行政管理职能,不准搞成“翻牌公
司”或一个机构、两块牌子;其人员也不再具有原机关干部身份。任
何经济实体不得利用职权搞垄断性经营。(六)各级党政机关不得
以改革为名,将职责范围内的行政管理工作改为有偿服务。党政机
关干部不得在各类经济实体中兼职,个别确因情况特殊需要兼职
的,须按干部管理权限报批,但兼职不得兼薪。党政机关干部不得
从事第二职业和各种直接或间接的经济活动。
translated_text: On the 26th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council issued the "Notice on Several Issues in the Personnel Diversion in Institutional Reform". The main contents of the "Notice" are: (a) We must correctly recognize the important role of personnel diversion in institutional reform and properly place surplus personnel. (b) Personnel diverted from the agency shall not be suspended from work or retained. These personnel will no longer retain their original agency cadre status, will no longer be included in the agency establishment, and will not be listed as non-staff personnel, and will not engage in economic activities in the name of the original agency or in the identity of the original agency cadre. (c) For economic entities composed of personnel diverted from agencies and that have difficulties in the initial stage of establishment, appropriate support can be given in terms of start-up funds, sites, loans and taxes; for personnel diverted from agencies whose income is lower than that of their original units, certain transition measures can be adopted, but the duration shall not exceed two years. Specific support measures and transition measures shall be determined by each region and department based on actual conditions. (iv) Economic entities established to divert government personnel must adhere to the principle of separation of government and enterprise, operate independently, calculate independently, bear their own profits and losses, and be completely separated from the original government in terms of functions, personnel, finance, etc., and be managed by the original government or by the competent industry department. The original government shall not make profits from these economic entities, nor shall it charge management fees or obtain other benefits under any pretext. (v) Economic entities converted from the original government economic management agencies shall no longer have government administrative management functions, and shall not be turned into "flip companies" or one agency with two brands; their personnel shall no longer have the status of cadres of the original agency. No economic entity shall use its power to engage in monopolistic operations. (vi) Party and government agencies at all levels shall not, in the name of reform, change administrative management work within their scope of responsibility into paid services. Party and government agency cadres shall not take up part-time jobs in various economic entities. Individuals who really need to take up part-time jobs due to special circumstances must apply for approval according to the cadre management authority, but part-time jobs shall not be paid. Party and government agency cadres shall not engage in second jobs or various direct or indirect economic activities.

translated_text: On the same day, the People's Daily reported that it had learned from the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee that the leadership change of the people's congresses, governments and CPPCCs in 30 provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the central government had been successfully completed recently. The Party committees of all provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities adhered to the principle of "four modernizations" of the cadre team and the principle of both moral integrity and ability, fully followed the mass line, repeatedly deliberated, widely consulted, and solemnly and responsibly recommended relevant candidates to state organs and CPPCC organizations. The election results show that the candidates recommended by the Party committees and the wishes of the deputies to the National People's Congress and CPPCC members have achieved a good unity. 99% of the elected members of the provincial-level National People's Congress and CPPCC leadership teams, as well as the chief procurators of the procuratorate and the presidents of the courts were recommended by the Party committees. The age structure is basically reasonable. The youngest provincial governor is 48 years old, and the vice governor is 37 years old. The age structure of the leading bodies of the National People's Congress and the CPPCC has also improved significantly. Those under 60 years old account for 56% and 36% respectively. More than 400 old comrades have retired from provincial leadership positions with the interests of the country and the people as the priority. The overall quality of the new team has been improved. Most of the new government team members have served as the main leaders of prefectures, cities, bureaus and departments, have comprehensive leadership experience, are familiar with economic work, and have obvious achievements in implementing the party's basic line. Through the change of term, the government's ability to lead economic construction and other work has been further enhanced. The National People's Congress team has added many cadres who understand legislative work, and the CPPCC has added some new representatives, which is conducive to better play its functional role.

精减22%左右;全国乡级机关的编制总数精减42%左右。《方案》
还明确了事业单位改革的原则和方向,并按事业单位经费的不同
来源作了分类。《方案》指出,各级机构的改革在3年内基本完成,
地方机构改革开始实施和完成的时间可有所不同,不搞一刀切。
《实施意见》就如何贯彻落实《方案》问题,对中央直属机构、国
务院机构、地方党政机构以及全国人大、政协、法院、检察院系统的
机构改革提出具体意见。
translated_text: On the same day, the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on the Plan for the Reform of Party and Government Institutions" and the "Notice on the Implementation Opinions on the Plan for the Reform of Party and Government Institutions". The "Plan" pointed out that the guiding ideology of the reform of party and government institutions is to adapt to the requirements of the socialist market economy, and in accordance with the principles of separation of government and enterprise responsibilities and streamlining, unification and efficiency, transform functions, streamline relations, streamline administration and improve efficiency. The focus is on transforming government functions. The "Plan" stipulates that the adjusted central directly affiliated institutions are: the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and the State Supervision Department will work together, with two names for one institution; 9 working departments and service agencies; 2 dispatched agencies; 12 central deliberative committees or leading groups. The staff of the central directly affiliated institutions will be reduced by 15% of the existing establishment. There are 41 constituent departments of the State Council, about 18 directly affiliated agencies and service agencies, a total of about 59, which is about 27 fewer than the existing institutions. The staff of various departments of the State Council will be reduced by about 20%. The number of non-permanent institutions of the State Council will be reduced from 85 to 26. The average number of provincial and autonomous regional party and government agencies is controlled at around 55, with a 20% reduction in staff. The limit of party and government agencies in municipalities is controlled at around 75, with a 15% reduction in staff. The number of party and government agencies in regions across the country is controlled at around 30, with a 30% reduction in staff; the limits on the establishment of state institutions and staffing are more relaxed than those in regions; the establishment of party and government agencies in cities across the country is determined according to the classification of cities, and the total number of staff is reduced by 20%. The establishment of county and township party and government agencies across the country is determined according to the classification of counties and townships, and the total number of county-level agencies across the country is reduced by about 22%; the total number of township-level agencies across the country is reduced by about 42%. The "Plan" also clarifies the principles and direction of the reform of public institutions, and classifies them according to different sources of funds for public institutions. The "Plan" points out that the reform of institutions at all levels will be basically completed within 3 years, and the time for the implementation and completion of local institutional reforms may vary, and there will be no one-size-fits-all approach. The Implementation Opinions put forward specific opinions on how to implement the Plan and on the institutional reforms of central agencies, State Council agencies, local party and government agencies, and the National People's Congress, the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, the courts, and the procuratorates.

translated_text: From the 2nd to the 7th, the Central Policy Research Office held a meeting of directors of policy research offices of provincial, regional and municipal party committees across the country in Beijing. During the meeting, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, Ding Guangen and Wei Jianxing, members of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretaries of the Secretariat, held discussions with all the representatives attending the meeting. During the discussion, Jiang Zemin pointed out that Comrade Mao Zedong made great contributions to the formation and development of the fine tradition of investigation and research of our party. Comrade Deng Xiaoping also always attached importance to investigation and research and made great contributions to the formation and development of this fine tradition of the party. Whether in the theoretical aspect or in the practical aspect of investigation and research, Comrade Mao Zedong and Comrade Deng Xiaoping are our role models. Adhering to investigation and research is a basic requirement of dialectical materialism, an important channel for the Party to maintain close contact with the masses, and a basic working method and leadership system of our Party. In the new era, although the objects, contents, means and conditions of our investigation and research have undergone new changes, the status and role of investigation and research in the Party's decision-making and overall leadership work have not changed at all, but have become more important. They can only be strengthened in an all-round way and must not be weakened in any way. Jiang Zemin emphasized that historical experience shows that the solution to various problems depends on correct decisions, and correct decisions come from careful investigation and research of objective reality. The higher the leadership position, the more efforts the comrades must make to investigate and research major issues personally, which cannot be replaced by others. Without investigation, there is no right to speak, and without investigation, there is no right to make decisions. He required leaders at all levels above the county level, especially the top leaders, to take the lead in promoting investigation and research, and to take at least one or two months every year to go deep into the grassroots, go to villages and households in rural areas, and go to workshops and work groups in factories to listen to the voices of the masses in person, and understand what the masses are thinking, hoping for, welcoming, and opposing. Only in this way can we truly be anxious about the masses, think about what the masses think, and be truly practical in our work guidance. We should conduct systematic investigation and research on important issues that urgently need to be solved in our region and department, and propose solutions. He believed that all party comrades, especially leading cadres at all levels, would benefit a lot if they really do a deep and thorough investigation and research, the most basic work. It is up to people to plan and it is up to people to achieve success. It can be said that insisting on doing a good job in investigation and research is the basis for our planning and the way to achieve success. Jiang Zemin also required all party comrades, especially leading cadres at all levels, to strengthen their learning, and they must have a sense of urgency and enhance their consciousness. He said that the world is changing very fast. New science, new technology and new knowledge are constantly emerging. Our leading cadres need to learn or relearn a lot to improve their governance and leadership. Our slogan should always be to learn, learn and learn again. Jiang Zemin pointed out that leading cadres should focus on learning Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought, especially to study and master Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics; study and master the basic knowledge of developing a socialist market economy; study and master the basic knowledge of modern science and technology; study Chinese history, especially modern and contemporary Chinese history and the history of the Party, and through this study, strive to carry forward the fine traditions of the Chinese nation and the Party. He stressed that studying and mastering Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and insisting on using this theory to guide our thinking and work must run through the entire process of socialist modernization. This is a major event related to the future and destiny of our Party and the prosperity, strength and long-term stability of our country. If a party, a country, a nation, especially a large party, a large country and a large nation like ours, does not have the correct theory as a guide and the strong spiritual pillar based on the correct theory, then our party, country and nation will be unimaginable, and will become a mess. There will be no cohesion, fighting power and creativity, and there will be no bright future. All comrades in the party should understand the fundamental significance of persisting in learning and applying Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought, especially persisting in learning and applying the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics from such a historical height. Jiang Zemin said that leading cadres at all levels, especially senior cadres at the provincial and ministerial levels and above, must set an example and take the lead in establishing a new style of earnestly studying theory and correctly applying theory among all comrades and cadres in the party. It is hoped that leading cadres and comrades in the political research offices at all levels will learn the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics more deeply and systematically, understand it more accurately and comprehensively, and use it to guide their actions more consciously.

events: 1993年7月2日,中共中央发出7号文件,印发《关于党政机构改革的方案》和《关于党政机构改革方案的实施意见》。党的十四届二中全会通过的《关于党政机构改革的方案》指出,要把机构改革与干部人事制度和工资制度改革结合起来,配套进行。在各级政府定职能、定机构定编制之后,随即推行公务员制度,并进行工资制度改革。中央机构编制委员会提出的《关于党政机构改革方案的实施意见》指出,国务院各部门在“三定”方案批准后,即与推行公务员制度相衔接。大体步骤是:第一,进行职位分类,明确各职位的职责任务和任职资格条件;第二,按照职位的任职要求,选配人员,确定公务员级别;第三,实施职级工资制度。具体实施按统一部署进行。
translated_text: On July 2, 1993, the CPC Central Committee issued Document No. 7, printing and distributing the "Plan for the Reform of Party and Government Institutions" and the "Opinions on the Implementation of the Plan for the Reform of Party and Government Institutions". The "Plan for the Reform of Party and Government Institutions" adopted by the Second Plenary Session of the 14th CPC Central Committee pointed out that institutional reform should be combined with the reform of the cadre personnel system and the wage system, and carried out in a coordinated manner. After the functions, institutions and establishments of governments at all levels are determined, the civil service system will be implemented and the wage system will be reformed. The "Opinions on the Implementation of the Plan for the Reform of Party and Government Institutions" proposed by the Central Organization and Establishment Committee pointed out that after the approval of the "Three Determinations" plan, the various departments of the State Council will be connected with the implementation of the civil service system. The general steps are: first, classify positions and clarify the duties and responsibilities of each position and the qualifications for the position; second, select personnel and determine the civil service level according to the requirements of the position; third, implement the rank-based wage system. The specific implementation is carried out according to unified deployment.

组织任期的意见》。《意见》规定: (一)大中型企业、大专院校、规模

选举。因特殊情况需提前或延期进行换届选举的,应报上级党组织

translated_text: On the 6th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee forwarded the "Opinions of the CPC Central Committee Organization Department on the Term of Office of the Party's Grassroots Organizations". The "Opinions" stipulate: (a) The Party committees of large and medium-sized enterprises, colleges and universities, and large-scale scientific research institutes, and the Party committees of prefecture (city, state, league) and prefecture (city, state, league) level and above shall have a 4-year term, other grassroots Party committees shall have a 3-year term, the Party general branch committee and village Party branch committee shall have a 3-year term, and other Party branch committees shall have a 2-year term. (b) If more specific provisions are required or the provisions of Article 1 need to be flexibly implemented, they shall be determined by the Party committees of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, the Central Government Directly Affiliated Organs Working Committee, and the Central State Organs Working Committee according to actual conditions. For the railway and civil aviation systems, the Party Group of the Ministry of Railways and the Party Committee of the Civil Aviation Administration shall put forward opinions and report them to the Central Organization Department for approval. (c) After the term of office of the grassroots Party organization is determined, it shall not be changed at will in principle. If it is necessary to adjust, it must be reported to the Party organization that approved the term of office for approval. (d) The grassroots Party organization must hold elections for new terms on schedule. If the election needs to be advanced or postponed due to special circumstances, it should be reported to the higher-level party organization for approval. (5) The term of office of the grassroots organizations of the Chinese People's Liberation Army shall be proposed by the General Political Department and reported to the Central Military Commission for approval.

translated_text: On the 13th, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China and the Ministry of Supervision held a symposium on the discipline inspection and supervision work of the central state organs in Beijing. The meeting believed that at present, the situation of lax discipline, non-compliance with orders and non-stop prohibitions is quite serious. Strengthening supervision and inspection is of great practical significance to maintaining the authority of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, ensuring the smooth implementation of national government orders, and promoting the steady and healthy development of reform and opening up and economic construction. The meeting pointed out that investigating and handling cases of violations of laws and disciplines is an important measure to strictly govern the party and government and punish corruption, and is the central link of strict discipline enforcement. The discipline inspection and supervision organs of various central departments should continue to take the investigation and handling of cases of violations of laws and disciplines as a regular work of punishing corruption and do it well. First of all, we should pay attention to the cases that occurred in the ministries and commissions, and at the same time pay attention to the typical cases with influence in the system, strengthen the work of letters and visits and reporting, continuously expand the clues of cases, establish and improve the responsibility system for handling cases, strive to improve the level of case handling, and promptly correct the unhealthy trends in departments and industries, and further improve the party style and clean government construction. On the basis of investigation and research, we should identify the main problems existing in our department and system, carry out targeted special governance and achieve results.

translated_text: On the 14th, Qiao Shi, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and president of the Central Party School, attended the graduation ceremony of the Central Party School's 1993 summer students and delivered a speech. In his speech, Qiao Shi pointed out that as a member of the ruling party, every comrade should realize the urgency and importance of strengthening party spirit and party style construction under the socialist market economy. We must start with ourselves, endure hardships first and enjoy later, work hard, be honest and dedicated, and resolutely fight against negative corruption. Qiao Shi said that the more the market economy develops and the more reform and opening up develop, the higher the requirements for party members and cadres to exercise their party spirit. The development of the market economy has had many impacts on people's thoughts and values: on the one hand, the concept of competition, efficiency, time, and distribution according to work have been strengthened, which can mobilize people's enthusiasm, promote economic development, enhance national strength and improve people's lives, and the prestige of the party will also be improved; on the other hand, it also brings some negative factors such as egoism and materialism, which have impacted the ideals and beliefs of Communist Party members. Some comrades cannot correctly handle the relationship between local interests and overall interests, personal interests and collective interests. Some cadres use their power to seek special interests, leading to the growth of corruption within the party. Most people are now aware of the seriousness of this problem, but the problem lies in whether every leading cadre and every Communist Party member can set an example, be strict with themselves, and more consciously strengthen the party spirit, use party spirit to guarantee and promote the healthy development of the socialist market economy, and use party spirit to resist the negative effects that market economic activities may bring. Qiao Shi said that our party members and cadres must learn to lead and control the market economy, lead the people to develop production and get rich together, and must maintain the true nature of the Communists, always adhere to the purpose of serving the people wholeheartedly, correctly use the power granted by the people, and resolutely oppose the abuse of power for personal gain and power-for-money transactions; we must establish a holistic concept, overcome parochialism, and resolutely oppose actions that only care about immediate and local interests and damage the overall and long-term interests of the country. Qiao Shi emphasized that in the process of establishing a socialist market economy, every leading cadre of the Party and every level of the Party leadership must establish a clear and firm concept: whatever is required of the subordinates, they must do it first, otherwise they will not meet the minimum requirements for being a leader and a Party member. As a Party member, especially a leading Party cadre, you must not shout about resisting corruption, being honest and upright, and working diligently for the people, but do something else in actual action. This is the key to building a good Party style. The graduation ceremony was hosted by Xue Ju, Executive Vice President of the Central Party School. More than 900 graduates of the Central Party School in the summer of 1993 attended the graduation ceremony.

translated_text: On the 15th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee issued the Notice of the Central Editorial Committee Office on the Implementation Opinions on the Reform of Central Directly Affiliated Institutions. The Opinions proposed that the main tasks of the reform of central directly affiliated institutions are to straighten out relations, adjust structures, streamline internal institutions and personnel, further improve the cadre structure and improve cadre quality, and improve work efficiency. The Opinions stipulate that according to the plan determined by the Second Plenary Session of the 14th CPC Central Committee, there will be 12 offices of central directly affiliated ministries and commissions after the adjustment. The existing 12 deliberative committees or leading groups of the Party Central Committee will be retained. The reform of the institutions affiliated to the ministries and commissions will be implemented on a self-financing basis, fully funded, or gradually transitioned to self-financing, depending on the specific circumstances. The specific plan for the reform of the logistics service institutions of the organs will be determined by the Central Directly Affiliated Institutions Administration Bureau in accordance with the reform measures of the logistics institutions of the State Council organs. The Opinion stipulates that the proportion of administrative staff reduction in central agencies should, in principle, be no less than 15% of the proportion stipulated in the reform plan for party and government agencies; the proportion of staff reduction in public institutions enjoying national financial subsidies should, in principle, be no less than 10%. The Opinion also puts forward opinions and specific requirements on the implementation steps and related issues of the reform of central agencies.

events: 21日——23日 全国机构改革工作会议在北京召开。会议的主要议题是贯彻落实中央《关于党政机构改革的方案》和《关于党政机构改革方案的实施意见》;具体布置各级机构改革的步骤和要求;研究机构改革中的一些政策性问题中共中央政治局常委、书记处书记、中央机构编制委员会副主任胡锦涛主持会议并宣读了国务院总理李鹏为会议写的信。李鹏在信中说,搞好行政管理体制和机构改革,是党的十四大提出的90年代改革和建设的主要任务之一。我们要以邓小平同志建设有中国特色社会主义理论为指导,围绕建立社会主义市场经济体制的目标,按照政企职责分开和精简统一效能的原则,切实做到转变职能,理顺关系,精兵简政,提高效率,逐步建立功能齐全、结构合理、运转协调、灵活高效的行政管理体制。李鹏说,各级党委、政府要进一步提高认识,加强领导,统筹规划,精心组织,按照中央的部署,有秩序地推进改革。首先要抓紧研究制定本地机构改革的总体规划和具体方案,积极做好“定职能、定机构、定编制”的工作。23日 中共中央总书记、国家主席江泽民在与出席全国机构改革工作会议的部分代表进行座谈时发表重要讲话。他指出,机构改革是一项事关社会主义现代化全局的战略举措,必须把全党特别是各级领导干部对机构改革重要性的认识,统一到中央的精神上来。江泽民指出,机构改革是深化经济改革,建立社会主义市场经济体制和加快现代化建设的重要条件,是我国政治体制改革,加强社会主义民主与法制建设的紧迫任务,也是全面贯彻党的基本路线、巩固党的执政地位和社会主义政权的客观需要。党中央、国务院是把机构改革作为一项战略措施来部署的。全党同志特别是各级党政领导干部同样应该从战略的高度认识和组织实施这次改革,增强责任感和紧迫感。江泽民指出,政府的职能配置和机构设置,如何与社会主义现代化建设和建立社会主义市场经济体制的要求相适应,是这次机构改革要解决的首要问题。转变职能,理顺关系,精兵简政、提高效率是这次机构改革的目标。它们是紧密相联的整体,其中转变职能是第一位的,是机构改革工作中的关键。他说,当前行政管理体制和机构改革,要在两个方面有所突破。一方面,要按照政企分开的原则,把属于企业的自主权切实下放给企业,使企业真正成为自主经营、自负盈亏、自我发展、自我约束的法人实体和市场竞争主体;把属于市场调节的职能切实转移给市场,使市场在资源配置中更好地发挥基础性作用。另一方面,要建立健全宏观调控体系,合理划分中央与地方的职责权限,把当前利益与长远利益、局部利益与整体利益很好地结合起来,搞好总量平衡和综合协调,集中必要的财力物力进行重点建设,综合运用经济、法律和必要的行政手段,促进经济和社会更快更好地发展。江泽民指出,在机构改革中坚持解放思想、实事求是,就是要按照建设有中国特色社会主义的要求,按照建立社会主义市场经济体制的要求,考虑职能和机构的调整,对于应该改革而现在就可以改革的部分,坚决进行改革。同时要注意把改革的原则和本地实际结合起来,妥善地处理各自面临的问题。江泽民指出,这次机构改革是全方位的,是一项复杂而艰巨的系统工程。中央要求各级党政领导对机构改革的复杂性和艰巨性要有充分认识,做到统筹规划、精心组织、上下结合、分步实施。他指出,首先要切实加强对改革的领导,其次要注意掌握政策,第三要严明改革的纪律。各级领导干部要以对党和人民事业负责的精神,兢兢业业地投入机构改革工作,真正把改革方案落到实处。江泽民最后说,有全党认识的统一,有各级党委、政府的周密准备和精心组织,有广泛试点的基础,有广大机关干部的积极参与,机构改革一定能取得预期的成果。中央机构编制委员会委员兼办公室主任宋德福,以及各省、自治区、直辖市、计划单列市编委会的负责人和中央各部委的负责同志出席了会议。
translated_text: From the 21st to the 23rd, the National Institutional Reform Work Conference was held in Beijing. The main topics of the meeting were to implement the Central Committee's "Plan for the Reform of Party and Government Institutions" and "Opinions on the Implementation of the Plan for the Reform of Party and Government Institutions"; to specifically arrange the steps and requirements for institutional reforms at all levels; and to study some policy issues in institutional reform. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, Secretary of the Secretariat, and Deputy Director of the Central Institutional Organization Committee, presided over the meeting and read out the letter written by Premier Li Peng for the meeting. Li Peng said in the letter that improving the administrative management system and institutional reform is one of the main tasks of reform and construction in the 1990s proposed by the 14th National Congress of the Communist Party of China. We must take Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics as our guide, focus on the goal of establishing a socialist market economic system, follow the principles of separation of government and enterprise responsibilities and streamlining and unifying efficiency, and effectively transform functions, straighten out relationships, streamline administration, improve efficiency, and gradually establish an administrative management system with complete functions, reasonable structure, coordinated operation, flexibility and efficiency. Li Peng said that the Party committees and governments at all levels should further improve their understanding, strengthen leadership, make overall plans, and carefully organize to promote reform in an orderly manner in accordance with the central government's deployment. First of all, we must speed up the research and formulation of the overall plan and specific programs for local institutional reform, and actively do a good job in "determining functions, institutions, and staffing." On the 23rd, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee and President of the State, delivered an important speech at a symposium with some representatives attending the National Institutional Reform Work Conference. He pointed out that institutional reform is a strategic measure related to the overall situation of socialist modernization, and it is necessary to unify the understanding of the importance of institutional reform by the whole party, especially the leading cadres at all levels, with the spirit of the central government. Jiang Zemin pointed out that institutional reform is an important condition for deepening economic reform, establishing a socialist market economic system and accelerating modernization. It is an urgent task for my country's political system reform and strengthening socialist democracy and legal system construction. It is also an objective need to fully implement the party's basic line and consolidate the party's ruling position and socialist regime. The Party Central Committee and the State Council have deployed institutional reform as a strategic measure. All comrades of the Party, especially leading cadres of the Party and government at all levels, should also understand and organize the implementation of this reform from a strategic perspective, and enhance their sense of responsibility and urgency. Jiang Zemin pointed out that how the government's functional configuration and institutional setup can adapt to the requirements of socialist modernization and the establishment of a socialist market economic system is the primary issue to be resolved in this institutional reform. Transforming functions, streamlining relations, streamlining administration and improving efficiency are the goals of this institutional reform. They are closely linked as a whole, among which the transformation of functions is the first and the key to institutional reform. He said that the current administrative system and institutional reform must make breakthroughs in two aspects. On the one hand, in accordance with the principle of separation of government and enterprise, the autonomy of enterprises should be effectively delegated to enterprises, so that enterprises can truly become legal entities and market competition entities that are self-operated, self-financing, self-developed and self-disciplined; the functions of market regulation should be effectively transferred to the market, so that the market can play a better fundamental role in resource allocation. On the other hand, we should establish and improve the macro-control system, reasonably divide the responsibilities and powers of the central and local governments, combine the current interests with the long-term interests, the local interests with the overall interests, achieve a good balance of total volume and comprehensive coordination, concentrate the necessary financial and material resources for key construction, and comprehensively use economic, legal and necessary administrative means to promote faster and better economic and social development. Jiang Zemin pointed out that in the institutional reform, we should adhere to the principle of emancipating the mind and seeking truth from facts, that is, we should consider the adjustment of functions and institutions in accordance with the requirements of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and the requirements of establishing a socialist market economic system, and resolutely reform the parts that should be reformed and can be reformed now. At the same time, we should pay attention to combining the principles of reform with local realities and properly handle the problems faced by each party. Jiang Zemin pointed out that this institutional reform is all-round and a complex and arduous systematic project. The central government requires party and government leaders at all levels to have a full understanding of the complexity and arduousness of institutional reform, and to make overall planning, careful organization, top-down integration, and step-by-step implementation. He pointed out that we should first strengthen the leadership of reform, secondly, pay attention to mastering policies, and thirdly, enforce strict discipline in reform. Leading cadres at all levels should be responsible for the cause of the Party and the people, and conscientiously devote themselves to the work of institutional reform, and truly implement the reform plan. Jiang Zemin finally said that with the unity of the whole party's understanding, the careful preparation and meticulous organization of party committees and governments at all levels, the foundation of extensive pilot projects, and the active participation of the majority of cadres in government agencies, institutional reform will surely achieve the expected results. Song Defu, member of the Central Organization and Establishment Commission and director of the office, as well as the heads of the editorial committees of provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities directly under the central government, and cities with independent planning status, and responsible comrades from various central ministries and commissions attended the meeting.

translated_text: From the 26th to the 30th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee, and the State Education Commission jointly held a national conference on party building in colleges and universities in Beijing. During the conference, the experience of party building in colleges and universities in recent years was summarized and exchanged, a group of colleges and universities that have made remarkable achievements in party building, ideological and political work, and other work were commended, the new situation and existing problems faced by party building in colleges and universities under the conditions of developing a socialist market economy were analyzed, and opinions on further strengthening and improving party building and ideological and political work in colleges and universities were studied and put forward. During the meeting, Li Lanqing, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, held a discussion with some conference representatives and delivered an important speech. Lv Feng, Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, delivered a speech at the end of the meeting. Zhu Kaixuan, Secretary of the Party Group and Director of the State Education Commission, delivered a work report to the meeting on behalf of the two departments and one commission. Li Lanqing pointed out in a discussion with some conference representatives that the key to further reform and development of higher education is to strengthen the party's leadership over colleges and universities and strengthen party building and ideological and political work in colleges and universities. The Party building and ideological and political work in colleges and universities covers a wide range of content. One of the important tasks is to educate young students well, so that they can become builders and successors of the socialist cause with ideals, morality, culture and discipline. translated_text: From the 9th to the 12th, the National Organization Work Symposium was held in Beijing. Deputy secretaries and heads of organization in charge of the Party Committees of provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities, the Central Working Committee, and the Central State Organs Working Committee, the heads of the departments (bureaus) of the central and state organs, the heads of the departments (bureaus) of the cadres of the Central Military Commission and the Political Department of the Armed Police Force attended the meeting. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, spoke at the symposium. In his speech, Hu Jintao emphasized that learning and mastering the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics is of fundamental significance to the socialist modernization led by our party. In a certain sense, the level of theory determines the level of leadership. Only by learning the theory of socialism with Chinese characteristics well can we lead the practice of socialism with Chinese characteristics well. He asked the leadership teams at all levels to adhere to an effective learning system and grasp theoretical learning. The leadership teams at all levels above the county level should combine the summary work with the major theoretical and practical issues of reform and construction at regular intervals, make theoretical summaries of the actual situation and practical experience, and constantly gain regular knowledge. He pointed out that in the current implementation of the party's democratic centralism, two issues should be addressed: first, the leadership team should adhere to and improve the specific systems of democratic centralism; second, the whole party should obey the central government and ensure the implementation of the central government's decisions. The leadership teams and leading cadres at all levels should constantly enhance the overall concept, consciously safeguard the overall interests of the party and the country, safeguard the authority of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, and resolutely overcome the tendency of local protectionism, parochialism, and decentralism, ensure that orders are carried out, and ensure that the party and the country's orders are smooth. In response to the current spread and development of negative corruption, Hu Jintao said that the corruption problem has reached a time when it must be resolved with great determination. The whole party must unify its thinking and reach a consensus. It must not lose confidence, let alone take it lightly. It must see the long-term nature of the struggle and have a realistic sense of urgency. He required leading cadres at all levels to be honest and self-disciplined, set an example, and be a good example in rectifying the party style, especially the construction of clean government. They must dare to grasp and manage, and implement the policy of grasping both ends. The top leaders must personally grasp it, rely closely on the masses, start with the problems that the masses reflect most strongly, focus on solving a number of prominent problems, and resolutely correct the tendency of ineffective investigation and handling, laxity, and softness, win the trust of the people with practical actions, and shock the hearts of the party and the people. Hu Jintao hopes that the leading groups at all levels will truly change their work style, work hard to implement it, take the lead in promoting the style of investigation and research, and do the work step by step. The style of speaking the truth, doing honest things, and being honest people should be promoted throughout the party. Honest people should not suffer losses, nor should those who engage in fraud and formalism take advantage. Hu Jintao finally said that the central government’s attitude is firm in grasping the ideological and work style construction of the leading group, and the guiding ideology is clear, and the majority of party members, cadres, and the masses support it. Party committees at all levels must attach great importance to it and put it on the important agenda. They cannot stop and start, nor can they just deploy without checking. All localities and departments should determine the focus based on the actual situation, and stick to any outstanding problems and follow through to the end. They should combine the concentrated solution of outstanding problems with regular work, and gradually find a new way to strengthen the ideological and work style of the leadership team under the new situation by relying on education and the legal system.
