translated_text: On the 12th, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, held a discussion with all the representatives attending the meeting. He stressed that to strengthen the party building, we must first build the leadership teams at all levels. The leadership team building and organizational construction are the foundation, and the ideological and work style construction is the fundamental. In the current and future period, we must focus on solving three problems in the ideological and work style construction of the leadership team: First, we must earnestly study and master Comrade Deng Xiaoping’s theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, and strive to achieve the unity of emancipating the mind and seeking truth from facts, the unity of the subjective and the objective, and the unity of revolutionary enthusiasm and the spirit of seeking truth and scientific attitude. The leadership team and leading cadres, no matter how busy they are at work, must squeeze out the necessary time to study the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, and they should learn more deeply and systematically, understand more accurately and comprehensively, use it to guide their actions more consciously, and use this theory to study new situations and solve new problems at a higher level. This is a necessary condition for a strong leadership collective and a qualified and effective leading cadre. Second, we must strictly implement democratic centralism, strengthen the overall concept, enforce strict discipline, maintain a high degree of unity in the organization and action of the whole party, and ensure the smooth implementation of the party and state orders. We must always pay attention to giving full play to the initiative of both the central and local governments. If the overall interests are damaged, then the local interests cannot be protected. All regions and departments have the responsibility to safeguard and obey the overall interests of the country. In the current process of strengthening the macro-control of the national economy, we must pay special attention to this. Third, we must strengthen the construction of clean government, consciously resist and oppose negative corruption, and set an example for party members and cadres. In recent years, we have taken many measures and done a lot of work in strengthening the party style and clean government and carrying out the fight against corruption, which has been effective. However, the seriousness and harmfulness of the existing problems must not be underestimated, and we must not take it lightly. According to the experience of various places, we must do a good job in correcting unhealthy practices and fighting corruption. First, we must unify our thoughts and understanding, and be consistent from top to bottom, and work together to fight corruption; second, we must really work hard, and must not stop at general calls, but have specific arrangements and implement them vigorously; third, we must start from the things that the masses are most dissatisfied with, and firmly grasp the most prominent problems in our region, department, and unit, and solve them in a practical way; fourth, we must fully realize the arduousness and long-term nature of this struggle, and always work hard to win. In his speech, Jiang Zemin asked the leading organs at or above the county level to attach great importance to and do a solid job in the construction of the party's grassroots organizations. He said that the party's grassroots organizations are the foundation of the party's entire combat effectiveness and the foundation of our party's governance. Only when the foundation is solid and reliable can the party as a whole have strong combat effectiveness, the party's ruling position will be as solid as a rock, and we can withstand the test of any storms and continuously advance the cause of socialism with Chinese characteristics. Establishing party organizations at the grassroots level and striving to build grassroots party organizations into battle fortresses that unite and lead the masses to implement the party's political line, complete the party's central tasks, and realize the party's goals is an important historical experience and unique political advantage of our party, which must be upheld at all times. Jiang Zemin hopes that comrades in the organization department will earnestly study Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and improve their ability to do a good job in organization work in the new era; inherit and carry forward the party's fine traditions, adhere to the party's principles, adhere to the standards for employment and cadre policies, be fair and upright, and resolutely resist and correct unhealthy tendencies in cadre personnel work; carry out in-depth investigations and research, timely understand new situations in organization construction, study new problems, summarize new experiences, and raise work to a new level, and strive to build the organization department into a department with the strongest party spirit, the most correct style, and outstanding work, and serve as a good adviser and assistant to the party committee in party construction, especially organization construction.

On the 18th, the CPC Central Committee held a briefing for non-party members to inform the leaders of the democratic parties, the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce and non-party members of the CPC Central Committee's deployment and opinions on launching the anti-corruption struggle. The symposium was chaired by Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee. Jiang Zemin pointed out that strengthening the construction of clean government and fighting against various corruption phenomena to ensure the smooth progress of reform and opening up and economic construction is the consistent thought of Comrade Xiaoping and our party, and it is also an important issue to strengthen the connection between the party and the people. He hopes that non-party members will carry forward the fine tradition of mutual trust and sharing honor and disgrace, actively offer suggestions, discuss the major plan of anti-corruption and promote integrity, and work together with our party to resolutely and effectively carry out the anti-corruption struggle and create a good social environment for deepening reform and accelerating development. Jiang Zemin pointed out that our party has always attached great importance to the anti-corruption issue. It is our important policy to grasp reform and opening up on the one hand and the anti-corruption struggle on the other. Since the reform and opening up, our party has always emphasized that rectifying the party style and strengthening the construction of clean government is a major event, and is determined to achieve results and win the trust of the people. It emphasizes that party member leading cadres, especially senior cadres, must be strict with themselves, set an example, and take the lead in fighting corruption. Generally speaking, the situation of our leadership teams at all levels is good, and the situation of the party members is good. However, there are indeed serious problems among a few leading cadres and party members, which has caused the negative corruption phenomenon to change its form and spread in some aspects, which is very destructive and corrosive. At present, money worship, hedonism, and extreme individualism have grown among some party members and cadres. Some people even use their power for personal gain by any means, and even embezzle, accept bribes, and extort money. The masses have strong reactions to this and hate it. The growth and spread of negative corruption will not only directly affect the smooth progress of reform and opening up and modernization, but also seriously damage the image and prestige of the party. Recently, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China has made serious research on deepening the fight against corruption and is ready to take more resolute measures and make new arrangements. Jiang Zemin pointed out that it is an important guarantee to carry out the fight against corruption to strengthen the supervision of party members and cadres by party organizations and discipline inspection organs at all levels, strengthen the supervision of our party by the people, democratic parties and non-party personages, and establish and improve a supervision system that combines internal and external parties, top-down and bottom-up supervision.
Wei Jianxing, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, Secretary of the Secretariat, and Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, reported at the meeting the deployment and opinions of the CPC Central Committee on the recent nationwide anti-corruption struggle. He introduced the current situation of the anti-corruption struggle, emphasized the importance of the anti-corruption struggle, and put forward the ideas and countermeasures for the anti-corruption struggle under the new situation of developing a socialist market economy.
Wei Jianxing proposed that the anti-corruption struggle should focus on three aspects in the near future: leading cadres of party and government organs at all levels should take the lead in being honest and self-disciplined; concentrate on investigating and handling a number of major cases; and severely curb several unhealthy tendencies that the masses strongly reflect. He said that all relevant departments should cooperate closely, concentrate on investigating and handling a number of major cases in the near future, strictly enforce the law, and strengthen the crackdown.
Li Ruihuan, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, Hu Jintao, Ding Guangen and Wei Jianxing, members of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, Ren Jianxin, Secretary of the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, and Wang Zhaoguo, Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference and Minister of the Central United Front Work Department, attended the symposium.

translated_text: On the 20th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued a notice on the "1992 National Party Member Development Work Situation". In 1992, a total of 1.762 million party members were developed nationwide, 126,000 more than the previous year, and continued to show a steady growth trend. The main practices and characteristics of party member development work in various places are: (i) Party organizations at all levels firmly established the guiding ideology of doing a good job in party member work around the center of economic construction. (ii) Emphasis was placed on the key points of party member development work, and attention was paid to weak links. The problem of few party members in the front line of production in enterprises and rural areas was alleviated to a certain extent. In 1991, 1.126 million of the newly developed party members nationwide worked in the front line of production, accounting for 63.9% of the total number of developed party members, including 808,000 workers, farmers, herdsmen and fishermen, accounting for 45.8%. There were 290,000 professional and technical personnel of various types, accounting for 16.5%. In industrial, construction and transportation enterprises nationwide, the number of production teams without party members decreased from 37.2% in the previous year to 34.5%, and the number of administrative villages without party members decreased by 53% compared with the previous year. (III) “Recommendation” has promoted the work of developing party members among young people. Paying attention to discovering and cultivating outstanding Communist Youth League members to join the party has become an important part of the work of developing party members for party organizations at all levels. By the end of 1992, the number of applicants for party membership nationwide reached more than 12.851 million, an increase of nearly 2.2 million over the same period last year. In 1992, the number of young party members under the age of 25 increased by 37,000 over the previous year, and young people under the age of 35 continued to account for more than 2/3 of the new party members. (IV) Strengthen institutionalization and standardization, and establish a quality assurance system for developing party members that adapts to the new situation and task requirements. (V) Strengthen guidance on the work of developing party members. There are more than 50,000 full-time and part-time organizers nationwide, including more than 25,000 full-time organizers. There are also some urgent issues to be studied and resolved in the work of developing party members in 1992. First, how to correctly understand the standards for developing party members in the new era, and there is still a lack of consensus on understanding. Second, the progress of developing party members in the production line and among young people, the measures and extent to solve the weak links, are still far from the needs of party member team building and economic construction. Third, there are still some problems in implementing the provisions of the Party Constitution and the detailed rules for developing party members. Fourth, the construction of the team of active party members faces some new problems. Fifth, there are signs of instability in the team of organizers. Several tasks should be focused on in the future: First, continue to strengthen the work of developing party members in enterprises, rural production lines and young people, and provide classified guidance and typical guidance for different situations and problems. Second, pay attention to studying how to adhere to the standards for developing party members under the conditions of a socialist market economy. Third, guide all localities to strengthen the construction of the team of active party members under the new situation. Fourth, strengthen the study of new situations and new problems faced by the work of developing party members under the new situation.

The second plenary session of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China was held in Beijing from the 20th to the 25th. 106 members of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection attended the meeting, and the heads of the discipline inspection and supervision organs of provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities, central and state organs, the People's Liberation Army, and the Armed Police Force attended the meeting. Wei Jianxing, member of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China, Secretary of the Secretariat, and Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, presided over the meeting. The plenary session reviewed and approved the report "Adapting to the New Situation, Deepening the Fight against Corruption, and Serving the Comprehensive Implementation of the Party's Basic Line" made by Wei Jianxing on behalf of the Standing Committee of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection. Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the Communist Party of China, delivered an important speech at the plenary session. Members of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China, members and alternate members of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China, secretaries of the Secretariat, and leaders of relevant parties in Beijing attended the meeting. The plenary session carefully studied and discussed Jiang Zemin's important speech, and unanimously agreed that Jiang Zemin's speech profoundly expounded Deng Xiaoping's series of important ideas on rectifying the party style, strengthening the construction of clean government, and opposing corruption, and clarified the importance and urgency of the current anti-corruption struggle, the guiding ideology of the anti-corruption struggle and the principles that should be followed. It has very important guiding significance for promoting the anti-corruption struggle under the new situation, strengthening party building and political power building, and ensuring the smooth progress of reform and opening up and economic construction.
The plenary session put forward the ideas and countermeasures for the current anti-corruption struggle in accordance with the requirements of the new situation. Anti-corruption should be carried out in close combination with major reform measures and the implementation of administrative and economic decisions; anti-corruption should focus on two tasks: first, resolutely punish corrupt elements, and second, resolutely overcome various negative corruption phenomena, including correcting unhealthy tendencies; anti-corruption should strengthen the study of laws and policies, timely standardize behavior, and put the punishment of corruption on the track of the legal system; anti-corruption should strengthen comprehensive governance, both to treat the symptoms and the root causes; in the anti-corruption struggle, the main thing is to strengthen ideological and political education for the majority of party members. The plenary session pointed out that the fight against corruption is long-term, arduous and urgent. We must resolutely and persistently carry out the struggle and continuously achieve phased results. According to the deployment and requirements of the Party Central Committee, the whole Party must focus on three tasks at present and must achieve phased results in the near future. First, leading cadres of party and government organs must take the lead in being honest and self-disciplined. We must consciously implement the various regulations that the Central Committee has made in strengthening the party's work style and clean government construction and set a good example. In view of the current situation, the following requirements are reiterated and put forward to leading cadres at the county (department) level and above of party and government organs: (a) It is not allowed to engage in business or run enterprises; it is not allowed to engage in paid intermediary activities, and it is not allowed to use power to provide any preferential conditions for spouses, children and relatives and friends to engage in business or run enterprises. (b) It is not allowed to work part-time (including honorary positions) in various economic entities. Individuals who are approved to work part-time shall not receive any remuneration; it is not allowed to reimburse various expenses that should be paid by individuals from subordinate units and other enterprises and institutions. (c) It is not allowed to buy and sell stocks. (IV) It is forbidden to accept gifts and various securities during official activities; it is forbidden to accept credit cards given by subordinate units and other enterprises and institutions, and it is forbidden to use credit cards obtained by the unit with public funds for personal use. (V) It is forbidden to use public funds to obtain various forms of club memberships, and it is forbidden to use public funds to participate in high-consumption entertainment activities.
Second, investigate and deal with a number of major cases. Focus on investigating and dealing with illegal and disciplinary cases of party and government leading organs, leading cadres, judicial departments, administrative law enforcement departments, economic management departments and their staff. Those who seriously interfere with and hinder the investigation and handling of cases must be dealt with resolutely.
Third, severely curb several unhealthy trends that the masses strongly reflect. We must focus on curbing the unhealthy trend of arbitrary charges across the country, focusing on curbing the abuse of power by state organs and their subordinate departments. We must also curb the unhealthy trend of using public funds for overseas travel. All regions, departments, and industries must proceed from reality and solve several key problems through special rectification in the near future. It must be reiterated that all Party and government organs at all levels are not allowed to engage in business, and those that have already engaged in business must completely separate from their original units in accordance with regulations. Implement the "two-line system of revenue and expenditure", and all fines and confiscations of law enforcement departments must be turned in in accordance with regulations, and the required funds will be allocated by fiscal funds at all levels. The plenary session requires that we continue to strengthen supervision and inspection of the implementation of the Party Central Committee and the State Council's measures to strengthen and improve macroeconomic regulation. We must resolutely investigate and punish unorganized and undisciplined behaviors that seriously violate the principle of democratic centralism and do not obey orders or prohibitions, ensure the smooth implementation of government orders, and maintain the authority of the Party Central Committee and the State Council. The plenary session emphasized that the fight against corruption must adhere to the following principles: adhere to the basic line of the Party, focus on economic construction, and serve the promotion of reform, construction and development; the current focus of anti-corruption is on the leading organs of the Party and government, judicial departments, administrative law enforcement departments, and economic management departments; start with leading cadres, first of all, senior cadres, including staff around leading cadres; strictly handle cases in accordance with the law, investigate cases of violations of laws and disciplines to the end, adhere to facts as the basis, laws and disciplines as the criterion, and deal with them seriously; rely closely on the people to carry out the fight against corruption, and do not engage in mass movements; combine punishing corruption with supporting integrity, vigorously publicize and commend advanced models who are honest and dedicated to the public and have the courage to fight against corruption, and promote the good style of hard work, love for the people, hard work, and willingness to contribute. The plenary session pointed out that the fight against corruption must be taken as a major political task and done well. It must be carried out under the leadership of party committees at all levels, with the whole party taking action and the party and government working together, and the main leaders of the party and government must take full responsibility. Party committees and governments at all levels must always adhere to the strategic policy of "grasping both sides and making both sides strong", firmly grasp the center of economic construction, earnestly do a good job in anti-corruption and party style and clean government construction, and be unwavering in reform and opening up, economic development, and unwavering in opposing corruption, rectifying party style, and strengthening clean government construction. Discipline inspection and supervision agencies shoulder important responsibilities in rectifying party style, strengthening clean government construction and fighting corruption. Party committees and governments at all levels should strengthen their leadership over discipline inspection and supervision work, support discipline inspection and supervision agencies in performing their duties, and discipline inspection and supervision agencies should adapt to the new situation, emancipate their minds, seek truth from facts, strengthen their own construction with the spirit of reform, better play the two functions of discipline inspection and supervision, and raise their work to a new level. On September 15, the People's Daily published the full text of Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, at the second plenary meeting of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection on the 21st. The speech is divided into nine aspects. (i) Consolidate and develop the current good situation; (ii) Make a realistic assessment of the current situation of the fight against corruption; (iii) Fighting corruption is an inevitable requirement for implementing the Party's basic line and an important guarantee for concentrating efforts on economic development; (iv) The whole Party must re-learn Comrade Deng Xiaoping's expositions on rectifying the Party's style, strengthening the construction of clean government, and combating corruption; (v) Correctly understand the social and historical causes of corruption; (vi) Focus on the work of combating corruption in the near future; (vii) The fight against corruption must grasp the following principles: (viii) The fight against corruption must be persisted in for a long time; (ix) Party committees at all levels must strengthen leadership. Jiang Zemin pointed out that the fight against corruption is an important task for the whole Party. The Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and the discipline inspection and supervision organs at all levels must earnestly assume their responsibilities, including certain coordination responsibilities, and do a good job. Our discipline inspection and supervision team is a good team. In rectifying the Party's style, strengthening the construction of clean government, and combating corruption, the discipline inspection and supervision organs, as the main functional agencies, have done a lot of work in the past, and they will shoulder great responsibilities now and in the future. The second plenary session of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection clearly put forward the task of strengthening the self-construction of the discipline inspection and supervision organs with the spirit of reform, which is very good and necessary. Only by doing so can the discipline inspection and supervision organs truly improve their quality and combat effectiveness and better play their role.

events: 1993年8月20日,人事部部长宋德福在《人民日报》发表文章《勇于改革不合时宜的人事制度》,就《国家公务员暂行条例》的背景和过程、建立国家公务员制度的目的、国家公务员制度的指导原则、国家公务员制度具有的特点、国家公务员制度的主要内容、国家公务员制度的实施等重要问题作了论述和说明。指出,公务员制度的建立,标志着具有中国特色的国家行政机关新的人事管理制度的初步确立。要求各地各部门统筹规划,协调安排,有领导、有组织､有计划地分步骤进行。大体用三年时间,在全国建立起新的人事管理机制,然后再逐步完善。
translated_text: On August 20, 1993, Song Defu, Minister of Personnel, published an article in the People's Daily entitled "Be Brave to Reform the Outdated Personnel System", in which he discussed and explained important issues such as the background and process of the "Interim Regulations on National Civil Servants", the purpose of establishing the national civil service system, the guiding principles of the national civil service system, the characteristics of the national civil service system, the main contents of the national civil service system, and the implementation of the national civil service system. He pointed out that the establishment of the civil service system marked the initial establishment of a new personnel management system for national administrative organs with Chinese characteristics. It is required that all localities and departments make overall plans, coordinate arrangements, and proceed in a planned, organized, and step-by-step manner. It will take about three years to establish a new personnel management mechanism throughout the country, and then gradually improve it.

translated_text: On the 21st, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee issued a notice on the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection's "Request for Instructions on the Implementation of the Central Committee's Recent Anti-Corruption Work Arrangement". translated_text: From the 22nd to the 28th, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee and President of the State, inspected work in Dalian and held a symposium on some large and medium-sized enterprises in North China and Northeast China during this period. Jiang Zemin pointed out at the symposium that large and medium-sized state-owned enterprises are the pillars of the national economy, the backbone of socialist modernization, the main source of national fiscal revenue, and occupy an important position in economic and socialist development. Doing a good job in large and medium-sized state-owned enterprises is of great significance to strengthening the country's economic strength, improving people's living standards, and giving full play to the superiority of socialism. Recently, the central government has adopted a series of policy measures to strengthen macroeconomic regulation, with the aim of deepening reform, transforming mechanisms, optimizing structures, and improving efficiency. To achieve this goal, it depends to a large extent on the reform and development of large and medium-sized state-owned enterprises. Therefore, in the process of deepening reform and strengthening macroeconomic regulation, it is necessary to place the development of large and medium-sized state-owned enterprises in an important position, and to transform the operating mechanism of large and medium-sized state-owned enterprises, optimize the organizational structure and product structure of enterprises through deepening internal reforms of enterprises, and truly turn the development of large and medium-sized state-owned enterprises to a track centered on improving economic efficiency. Jiang Zemin pointed out that the fundamental way out for the development of large and medium-sized state-owned enterprises lies in deepening reform, and the focus should be on the following aspects: First, unswervingly implement the "Regulations" and transform the enterprise operation mechanism. We must continue to transform government functions, implement the separation of government and enterprises, implement the powers granted to enterprises by the "Regulations" without compromise, ensure the legal status of enterprises and the right to make independent decisions in business activities, and make enterprises truly become legal entities and market competition subjects that operate independently, bear their own profits and losses, develop themselves, and restrain themselves. Enterprises should make full use of the environment and conditions created by the "Regulations", look inward, and work hard on their internal strength. They should improve the internal operation and management of enterprises, promote technological progress, improve product quality and economic benefits, enhance market competitiveness, and take the path of expanding production with connotation. We must strengthen ideological and political work, carry out professional ethics education, enhance the sense of responsibility of employees, and build a strong team of employees. Second, accelerate supporting reforms to create a good external environment for enterprises. We should speed up the reform of the financial system, investment system, and fiscal and taxation system, and establish a perfect macro-control system that is compatible with the socialist market economy system; we should vigorously develop the commodity market and the production factor market in accordance with the requirements of unity, openness, competition, orderliness, and controllability, actively cultivate and regulate the financial market, develop technology, information, labor and other markets, and form a sound, multi-level market system as soon as possible; we should develop social insurance, establish and improve the social security system, reduce the burden of large and medium-sized state-owned enterprises, and enhance the self-development ability of enterprises. Third, strengthen the management of state-owned assets and gradually establish a modern enterprise system. We should speed up the reform of the state-owned asset property rights management system and the legislation of state-owned assets, straighten out the property rights relationship and the relationship between the state and enterprises, prevent the loss of state-owned assets, and maintain and increase the value of state-owned assets. The modern enterprise system is the result of the development of large-scale socialized production and commodity economy, and is the inherent requirement of the development of productivity. Establishing a modern enterprise system that is adapted to the requirements of the development of the socialist market economy with clear property rights and a clear responsibility system is the key to running large and medium-sized state-owned enterprises well. Jiang Zemin stressed that in order to deepen reform and improve the state-owned large and medium-sized enterprises, we must adhere to the guidance of Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and the spirit of the 14th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, adhere to the party's basic line of "one center, two basic points", emancipate the mind, and seek truth from facts. Leaders of all regions and departments should put the improvement of state-owned large and medium-sized enterprises on the important agenda, especially focusing on improving the labor productivity and economic benefits of enterprises. He said that state-owned large and medium-sized enterprises have a strong, reliable and well-trained workforce, a strong material and technical foundation accumulated over many years, and successful experience in operation and management. As long as the enthusiasm of enterprises and the enthusiasm of the majority of employees is fully mobilized, they will definitely be able to improve. The Party and the government have high hopes for state-owned large and medium-sized enterprises. State-owned large and medium-sized enterprises should fully recognize their own advantages, boldly explore, and have the courage to practice, and take a development path with Chinese characteristics, and make new contributions to reform and opening up and socialist modernization.

27日 中共中央组织部印发《关于进一步加强外商投资企业
党的工作的意见》。《意见》主要内容是:(一)充分认识做好外商投
资企业党的工作的重要性。(二)抓紧在外商投资企业中建立健全
党的组织。(三)进一步明确外商投资企业党组织开展工作的指导
思想和职责任务。(四)积极探索、创造适合外商投资企业特点的工
作方法和活动方式。(五)加强和改进对外商投资企业中党的工作
的领导。
《意见》指出,在我国境内兴办的外商投资企业中,按照《中国
共产党章程》建立党组织,开展党的活动,是合乎我国有关法律规
定的。许多单位的经验证明,只要我们做好工作,外商是会理解的,
关键在于我们自己要有明确的认识。《意见》强调,凡有正式党员3
人以上的企业,都应按照党章规定抓紧建立党的组织。党员不足3
人的,可按地区或行业成立联合党支部,隶属于有关部门或当地党
组织。党组织负责人一般由中方党员主要行政领导人担任。当前
首先要把那些规模较大、职工人数较多的企业的党组织建立起来。
《意见》指出,外商投资企业党组织开展工作的指导思想是,从
企业的实际出发,认真贯彻执行党的基本路线和对外开放的方针
政策,紧紧围绕生产经营开展党的工作,促进企业的发展。外商投
资企业中的党组织应在中方员工中发挥政治核心作用,其主要职
责是:保证监督国家法律、法规的贯彻执行,维护中外双方的合法
权益;做好中方员工的思想政治工作,坚持不懈地对员工进行建设
有中国特色社会主义理论的教育,党的基本路线教育、爱国主义和
集体主义教育,提高贯彻执行党的基本路线的自觉性和坚定性,抵
御各种腐朽思想的侵蚀;教育中方员工努力学习国外(境外)先进
科学技术和管理经验,培养造就技术和管理人才;搞好党组织的自
身建设,加强对党员特别是中方领导人员的教育和监督,充分发挥
党员的先锋模范作用;领导工会、共青团等群众组织,支持他们按
照各自的章程独立自主地开展工作;做好统战工作。
translated_text: On the 27th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Opinions on Further Strengthening Party Work in Foreign-Invested Enterprises". The main contents of the "Opinions" are: (1) Fully understand the importance of doing a good job in the party work of foreign-invested enterprises. (2) Establish and improve party organizations in foreign-invested enterprises as soon as possible. (3) Further clarify the guiding ideology and duties of the party organizations in foreign-invested enterprises. (4) Actively explore and create working methods and activities suitable for the characteristics of foreign-invested enterprises. (5) Strengthen and improve the leadership of party work in foreign-invested enterprises. The "Opinions" pointed out that in foreign-invested enterprises established in my country, it is in accordance with the relevant laws and regulations of my country to establish party organizations and carry out party activities in accordance with the "Constitution of the Communist Party of China". The experience of many units has proved that as long as we do a good job, foreign investors will understand. The key is that we ourselves must have a clear understanding. The "Opinions" emphasizes that all enterprises with more than 3 formal party members should establish party organizations in accordance with the provisions of the party constitution. If there are less than 3 party members, joint party branches can be established according to regions or industries, and they will be affiliated with relevant departments or local party organizations. The head of the party organization is generally the main administrative leader of the Chinese party members. At present, the party organizations of those enterprises with larger scale and more employees should be established first. The "Opinion" points out that the guiding ideology of the party organizations of foreign-invested enterprises is to proceed from the actual situation of the enterprise, conscientiously implement the party's basic line and the principles and policies of opening up to the outside world, carry out the party's work closely around production and operation, and promote the development of the enterprise. The Party organizations in foreign-invested enterprises should play a political core role among Chinese employees. Their main responsibilities are: to ensure and supervise the implementation of national laws and regulations, and safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of both Chinese and foreign parties; to do a good job in the ideological and political work of Chinese employees, and unremittingly educate them on the theory of socialism with Chinese characteristics, the Party's basic line, patriotism and collectivism, to improve the consciousness and firmness of implementing the Party's basic line, and to resist the erosion of various decadent ideas; to educate Chinese employees to study foreign (overseas) advanced science and technology and management experience, and cultivate technical and management talents; to do a good job in the self-construction of the Party organization, strengthen the education and supervision of Party members, especially Chinese leaders, and give full play to the vanguard and exemplary role of Party members; to lead mass organizations such as trade unions and the Communist Youth League, and support them to carry out their work independently in accordance with their respective charters; and to do a good job in united front work.

省级换届工作情况和进一步加强地方领导班子建设几点意见的报
告》。
《报告》指出,1993年省级人大、政府、政协领导班子换届工作
取得了比较明显的成效,主要体现在:(一)党委向国家机关推荐干

政府正副职226名、政协正副主席342名、法检“两长”60名。当选
的人大、政府领导班子成员和法检“两长”中,党委推荐的占
98.6%,当选的政协领导班子成员都是党委推荐的。(二)充实了一
批优秀的年轻干部,新班子在年轻化方面有较大的进展。这次省级
换届共提拔干部332名,其中政府90名。省级政府新班子成员中,
50岁以下的81名,比换届前增加53名,由13.1%提高到
35.8%;平均年龄为52岁,比换届前下降4岁,新班子年龄结构基
本合理。人大、政协班子成员平均年龄比换届前分别下降7岁和5
岁。60岁以下的人大正副主任148名,比换届前增加112名,由占

厅局的主要领导职务。大专以上文化程度的,由换届前的79.3%

部队伍建设,特别是抓好党政一把手后备人选的选拔和培养。
(三)要下大决心推进干部交流(四)加强和改进干部考察工作,严
格把好用人关(五)继续做好领导班子的个别调整、完善工作。
translated_text:
On the 31st, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee forwarded the CPC Central Committee Organization Department's "Report on the 1993 Provincial Leadership Change and Several Opinions on Further Strengthening the Construction of Local Leadership Teams". The "Report" pointed out that the leadership change of provincial people's congresses, governments, and CPPCCs in 1993 achieved relatively obvious results, mainly reflected in: (i) The Party Committee performed its duties of recommending cadres to state organs relatively well, and the personnel arrangement plans proposed were well implemented. 30 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities elected a total of 900 provincial cadres, including 272 people's congress directors and vice-chairmen, 226 government directors and vice-chairmen, 342 CPPCC directors and vice-chairmen, and 60 judicial and prosecutorial heads. Among the elected members of the NPC, government leadership team, and judicial and prosecutorial heads, 98.6% were recommended by the Party Committee, and all the elected members of the CPPCC leadership team were recommended by the Party Committee. (ii) A group of outstanding young cadres were added, and the new team has made great progress in rejuvenation. A total of 332 cadres were promoted in this provincial leadership change, including 90 government officials. Among the new members of the provincial government, 81 are under 50 years old, an increase of 53 from before the change of term, from 13.1% to 35.8%; the average age is 52 years old, 4 years lower than before the change of term, and the age structure of the new team is basically reasonable. The average age of the members of the National People's Congress and the CPPCC team has dropped by 7 and 5 years respectively compared with before the change of term. There are 148 directors and vice-directors of the National People's Congress under the age of 60, an increase of 112 from before the change of term, from 11.6% to 54.4%; there are 120 directors and vice-directors of the CPPCC under the age of 60, an increase of 75 from before the change of term, from 11.3% to 35.1%. (III) The overall quality of the new team has improved, and the government's ability to lead economic work has been further enhanced. Most of them have served as the main leaders of prefectures, cities, bureaus and departments. The proportion of those with college education or above has increased from 79.3% before the change of term to 92.9%. The number of female cadres and non-party cadres has increased. Many comrades are familiar with economic work. (IV) Promoted the reform of the cadre system and the improvement of the election methods of local state organs.
82 cadres were exchanged. 405 veteran comrades retired from provincial leadership positions.
The report emphasizes that after the change of leadership, the following tasks should be done well: (I) Focus on the ideological and work style construction of the leadership team. (II) Further strengthen the construction of the reserve cadre team of the leadership team, especially the selection and training of reserve candidates for the top leaders of the party and government.
(III) Make great efforts to promote cadre exchanges (IV) Strengthen and improve cadre inspection work and strictly control the use of personnel (V) Continue to do a good job in individual adjustment and improvement of the leadership team.

translated_text: On the 1st, leading comrades of the Party and the State, including Jiang Zemin, Li Peng, Qiao Shi, Li Ruihuan, Zhu Rongji, Liu Huaqing and Hu Jintao, attended the Seventh National Congress of Chinese Women. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, delivered a congratulatory speech to the Congress on behalf of the CPC Central Committee. In his congratulatory speech, Hu Jintao pointed out that the All-my country Women's Federation is a social mass organization of women of all ethnic groups and all walks of life in China who have united under the leadership of the Communist Party of China to strive for further liberation. It shoulders the important responsibility of uniting and educating the broad masses of women and striving hard for the construction of a prosperous, democratic and civilized socialist country. Since the Third Plenary Session of the 11th CPC Central Committee, women's federations at all levels have played an important role in reform, opening up and modernization. The majority of women's federation cadres have worked diligently and conscientiously and have made great achievements. Under the new situation, the tasks facing the women's federation are more arduous, and the status and role of the women's federation organization are more important. Women's Federations at all levels should be guided by the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, adhere to the implementation of the Party's basic line, carry out work closely around the center of economic construction, fully perform various functions, give play to their own advantages, and unite women of all ethnic groups and all walks of life more closely through distinctive activities such as "double learning and double comparison" and "women's contribution", so as to make new achievements and make new contributions to promoting my country's reform, opening up and modernization. We must strengthen and improve ideological and political education, give full play to the role of democratic participation and democratic supervision, and better represent and safeguard women's rights and interests. We must actively promote the reform and construction of the Women's Federation itself, focus on the grassroots, maintain close contact with women, frequently study new situations and new problems, summarize new experiences, and strive to make the work of the Women's Federation popular and socialized. Hu Jintao pointed out that the leading cadres of the Party must become advocates and practitioners of the Marxist view of women. Party committees and governments at all levels must take practical measures to further give play to the superiority of the socialist system in protecting women's legitimate rights and interests and improving women's status. We must incorporate the development of women and children's affairs into the social development plan and do our best to do practical and good things for women and children. Party committees at all levels should expand their horizons, broaden channels, implement measures, and boldly select outstanding women cadres with both moral integrity and ability to join the leadership teams at all levels. They should strengthen and improve the leadership of the Party committees over the work of the Women's Federation, support the Women's Federation to independently and creatively carry out its work in accordance with the law and its own charter, and give full play to the role of the Women's Federation as a bridge and link between the Party committees and the women's masses and the role of the social pillar of the people's political power. The whole society should care about women's cause, promote women's progress, and promote the continued healthy development of the women's movement.

义发展史上的一个新的历史时期。经过14年多的奋斗、探索和发
展之后,真正走出了一条有中国特色的道路,并且终于确立了有步
骤地建立社会主义市场经济体制。目前全党范围内已越来越明确

路发生摇摆。乔石强调,真正走好有中国特色社会主义道路,是我
们中国共产党人的历史责任。对于理论学习的重要性,我们就是要

translated_text: On the 4th, Qiao Shi, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and president of the Central Party School, Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and secretary of the Secretariat, Wei Jianxing, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, and others attended the autumn opening ceremony of the Central Party School. Qiao Shi spoke at the opening ceremony, and he focused on strengthening theoretical learning. He said that our generation is in a new historical period in the history of socialist development. After more than 14 years of struggle, exploration and development, we have truly embarked on a path with Chinese characteristics, and finally established a socialist market economic system in a step-by-step manner. At present, the whole party has increasingly clearly recognized that the socialist path with Chinese characteristics is the only correct choice. This path is not ready-made, but requires us to rely on the basic principles of Marxism, closely combine with China's reality, and constantly explore and advance in practice. Qiao Shi pointed out that we have formulated the theory of the path of socialism with Chinese characteristics. To turn this theory into reality and into the great practice of 1.1 billion people, we need to constantly experiment and explore in practical work, persist in what we do right, correct what we do wrong, and summarize experience. To achieve this, we must be armed with the basic principles of Marxism and guided by the theory of socialism with Chinese characteristics. Otherwise, we may lose our way, make mistakes and not know how to correct them, or even waver in our decision to follow this path. Qiao Shi emphasized that it is the historical responsibility of the Chinese Communists to truly follow the path of socialism with Chinese characteristics. We must place the importance of theoretical study on such a high level and link it with the future of the country, the party, and socialism. We must not relax theoretical study just because the situation is developing rapidly, the daily work is busy and intense, and the task of deepening reform is arduous and heavy. Theoretical study helps us to recognize the situation, analyze problems, and guide practice, and it is to solve the problem of direction and route. Qiao Shi said that at present, we have encountered many problems in the practice of economic construction and reform and opening up. In our study, we can discuss some major ideological and theoretical issues and practical problems in real life in a targeted manner. This does not mean that we should find specific answers and solutions through study, but that we can have a clearer understanding of some major issues that are related to the overall situation through study and research, and we can achieve a relatively consistent ideology based on the theory of socialism with Chinese characteristics. 机关设置领导职务序列和非领导职务序列,党的机关工作者和级
别划分,参照《国家公务员暂行条例》执行,划分为15级,职务与级

可给以行政处分;对党的机关非党员的违纪行为的惩处,参照《国
家公务员暂行条例》有关规定执行。党的机关工作者的义务与权
力、职位分类、考核、奖励、纪律、职务升降、职务任免、培训、交流、

部,分别负责全国党的机关和本地区党的机关参照执行《国家公务
员暂行条例》工作的综合指导、监督和管理。
translated_text: On the 13th, the CPC Central Committee issued a notice forwarding the "Implementation Opinions of the CPC Central Committee Organization Department on the Trial Implementation of the Provisional Regulations on National Civil Servants by the Communist Party of China". The notice said that the central government decided that while the state administrative organs were promoting the national civil service system in a planned and step-by-step manner, the party organs would refer to the trial implementation of the "Provisional Regulations on National Civil Servants". The Central Organization Department is responsible for studying and formulating the implementation plan for the party organs to refer to the trial implementation of the "Provisional Regulations on National Civil Servants". Party organs at all levels should formulate specific plans and organize their implementation in accordance with the implementation opinions and implementation plans proposed by the Central Organization Department, combined with actual conditions. The "Implementation Opinions" are divided into five parts: (a) Trial scope. (b) Job grade setting and personnel classification. (c) Recruitment and selection. (d) Disciplinary sanctions. (e) Management and supervision. The "Implementation Opinions" stipulate that the staff members other than the workers and staff members in the working departments, service agencies and dispatched agencies of the Party committees at all levels of the central and local governments, as well as the street, township and town Party committees (referred to as "Party organ workers"), shall refer to the trial implementation. The Interim Regulations on National Civil Servants shall be implemented. The leadership and non-leadership positions of the Party organs shall be set up, and the division of Party organ workers and grades shall be implemented in accordance with the Interim Regulations on National Civil Servants, which are divided into 15 grades, with corresponding positions and grades. The Party organs shall recruit staff through recruitment and selection. The punishment of Party members who violate the discipline of the Party workers shall be implemented in accordance with the provisions of the Party Constitution, and administrative sanctions may be imposed when necessary; the punishment of non-Party members of the Party organs who violate the discipline shall be implemented in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Interim Regulations on National Civil Servants. The obligations and powers of Party organ workers, job classification, assessment, rewards, discipline, job promotion and demotion, job appointment and removal, training, exchange, avoidance, salary, insurance and welfare, resignation, retirement and appeal and accusation shall be implemented in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Interim Regulations on National Civil Servants. The Organization Department of the Central Committee and the Organization Departments of local Party committees at or above the county level shall be responsible for the comprehensive guidance, supervision and management of the implementation of the Interim Regulations on National Civil Servants by the Party organs nationwide and the Party organs in their respective regions.

型企业的经营机制,增强活力,提高素质,是建立社会主义市场经
济体制的中心环节。我们要建立的社会主义市场经济体制,其本质
特征就在于把反映现代社会化生产规律的市场机制同社会主义公
有制结合在一起,把市场在资源合理配置上的长处同社会主义制
度的优越性结合在一起,形成一种比资本主义条件下的市场经济
体制运行得更好更有效的崭新的经济体制。这就必须通过改革探
索建立现代企业制度,使企业真正成为法人实体和市场主体,以巨
大的实力、旺盛的活力进入市场,发挥主导作用。这需要有一个过
程,要付出艰苦的努力,但是我们必须解决好。
胡锦涛指出,搞好国有大中型企业要从两个方面努力。一方
面,必须加快政府职能转变,实行政企分开,把应该下放给企业的
权力坚决放给企业,同时搞好配套改革,抓紧建立健全有效的宏观
调控体系,强化政府服务职能,把该管理的事管住管好,为企业创
造良好的外部环境。另一方面,必须加快企业内部改革,解决好企
业本身的活力问题,胡锦涛希望企业党政工团尤其是党组织和行
政负责同志,增强责任感和使命感,充分认识各方面改革向深层次
推进的大趋势,主动抓住由此带来的有利时机,进一步解放思想,
更新观念,苦练内功,自立自强,同心同德,共同奋斗,用新思路、新
办法解决企业改革和发展面临的新问题,克服前进道路上的困难,
不断提高企业的整体素质。
在谈到要建立有中国特色的现代企业领导体制的问题时,胡
锦涛说,党的十四大重申了国有企业要充分发挥党组织的政治核
心作用,坚持和完善厂长负责制,全心全意依靠工人阶级。这三句
话互为依存,不可分割,都是社会主义市场经济条件下搞好国有大
中型企业所必需的。“三句话”的方针,是对多年来探索建立有中国
特色国有企业内部领导体制实践经验的科学总结。各级党政领导
和各类国有企业,要继续积极探索,总结和推广好的经验,更加自
觉地全面落实“三句话”。他强调,在企业转换经营机制,走向市场
的过程中,更要重视加强和改进企业党的建设,增强党组织的凝聚
力､吸引力和战斗力,充分发挥政治核心作用。
胡锦涛在讲话中还阐述了企业党建工作的指导思想以及加强
和改进企业党的建设的关系。他指出,企业党组织要紧密结合企业
改革和生产经营开展工作,为企业改革和发展服务,在这个过程中
体现政治核心作用。这是新形势下改进和加强企业党建工作的…
个突出要求,必须坚定不移。企业党组织要积极主动地参与企业改
革和发展中重大问题的决策,探索新的工作方式,真正把党的活动
渗透到企业改革和生产经营的各个环节中去。
胡锦涛说,建设有中国特色的社会主义,从一定意义上说关键
在人;搞好有中国特色的国有大中型企业,从一定意义上说,关键
也在人。他要求各级党政领导同志高度重视企业人才队伍的开发
和建设,尤其要抓住企业转换经营机制的有利时机,把企业领导班
子建设提高到一个新的水平。
中央组织部副部长赵宗鼐、中央政策研究室副主任郑科扬分
别在会议开始和结束时讲话。会议认为当前国有企业党建工作中
亟待明确的几个问题和主要意见是:(一)必须坚持企业党组织的
政治核心地位,更好地发挥政治核心作用。(二)进一步理顺企业党
政关系,积极探索保证党组织发挥政治核心作用的组织形式。
(三)企业党组织要紧紧围绕改革和生产经营开展工作,切实改进
工作方法和活动方式。(四)逐步建立切实可行的制度,保证企业党
组织参与重大问题的决策。(五)调整和改进企业党组织工作机构
的设置,加强党务工作队伍建设。(六)上级党委要切实加强和改进
对企业党建工作的领导。
10月25日,中央组织部、中央政策研究室印发了《关于胡锦涛
同志同全国国有企业党建工作座谈会代表座谈时的讲话的通知》。

On the 21st and 23rd, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the Central Policy Research Office jointly held a national symposium on the Party building of state-owned enterprises in Beijing. The main topic of the meeting was how to adapt to the requirements of implementing the Regulations on the Transformation of the Operating Mechanism of State-owned Industrial Enterprises, deepening internal reforms of enterprises, and further improving the work of large and medium-sized state-owned enterprises under the new situation of accelerating the establishment of a socialist market economic system, and effectively strengthen and improve the Party work of enterprises. Nearly 100 people, including the heads of the Organization Departments of the Party Committees of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, the heads of the Enterprise Working Committees of some provincial and municipal Party Committees, the Party Committee Secretaries and Directors (Managers) of some large and medium-sized state-owned enterprises, and the heads of relevant departments of the central state organs, attended the meeting. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, attended the meeting and held a discussion with the representatives attending the meeting. During the discussion, Hu Jintao pointed out that transforming the operating mechanism of state-owned enterprises, especially large and medium-sized enterprises, enhancing vitality, and improving quality are the central links in establishing a socialist market economic system. The essential characteristics of the socialist market economic system we want to establish are to combine the market mechanism that reflects the laws of modern socialized production with socialist public ownership, to combine the advantages of the market in the rational allocation of resources with the superiority of the socialist system, and to form a brand-new economic system that operates better and more effectively than the market economic system under capitalism. This requires the exploration of the establishment of a modern enterprise system through reform, so that enterprises can truly become legal entities and market entities, enter the market with great strength and vigor, and play a leading role. This requires a process and hard work, but we must solve it well. Hu Jintao pointed out that efforts should be made in two aspects to improve state-owned large and medium-sized enterprises. On the one hand, it is necessary to accelerate the transformation of government functions, implement the separation of government and enterprises, and resolutely delegate the power that should be delegated to enterprises to enterprises. At the same time, we must do a good job in supporting reforms, speed up the establishment and improvement of an effective macro-control system, strengthen the government's service functions, manage the things that should be managed, and create a good external environment for enterprises. On the other hand, it is necessary to speed up the internal reform of enterprises and solve the vitality problem of enterprises themselves. Hu Jintao hopes that the party, government, trade union and especially the party organization and administrative responsible comrades of enterprises will strengthen their sense of responsibility and mission, fully realize the general trend of deepening reform in all aspects, take the initiative to seize the favorable opportunities brought by this, further emancipate their minds, update their concepts, practice internal skills, be self-reliant, work together, and use new ideas and methods to solve new problems faced by enterprise reform and development, overcome difficulties on the road ahead, and continuously improve the overall quality of enterprises. When talking about the issue of establishing a modern enterprise leadership system with Chinese characteristics, Hu Jintao said that the 14th National Congress of the Communist Party of China reiterated that state-owned enterprises should give full play to the political core role of party organizations, adhere to and improve the factory director responsibility system, and rely wholeheartedly on the working class. These three sentences are interdependent and inseparable, and are all necessary for running large and medium-sized state-owned enterprises well under the conditions of a socialist market economy. The policy of the "three sentences" is a scientific summary of the practical experience of exploring and establishing an internal leadership system of state-owned enterprises with Chinese characteristics over the years. Party and government leaders at all levels and all types of state-owned enterprises should continue to actively explore, summarize and promote good experiences, and more consciously implement the "three sentences". He stressed that in the process of enterprises transforming their operating mechanisms and moving towards the market, more attention should be paid to strengthening and improving the party building of enterprises, enhancing the cohesion, attraction and combat effectiveness of party organizations, and giving full play to the role of political core. In his speech, Hu Jintao also elaborated on the guiding ideology of enterprise party building work and the relationship between strengthening and improving enterprise party building. He pointed out that enterprise party organizations should closely combine enterprise reform and production and operation to carry out work, serve enterprise reform and development, and reflect the role of political core in this process. This is a prominent requirement for improving and strengthening enterprise party building work under the new situation, and it must be unswerving. Enterprise party organizations should actively participate in the decision-making of major issues in enterprise reform and development, explore new working methods, and truly infiltrate party activities into all aspects of enterprise reform and production and operation. Hu Jintao said that in a certain sense, the key to building socialism with Chinese characteristics lies in people; in a certain sense, the key to running large and medium-sized state-owned enterprises with Chinese characteristics lies in people. He asked the leading comrades of the Party and government at all levels to attach great importance to the development and construction of the enterprise talent team, especially to seize the favorable opportunity of the enterprise's transformation of the operating mechanism and raise the construction of the enterprise leadership team to a new level.
Zhao Zongnai, Deputy Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, and Zheng Keyang, Deputy Director of the Central Policy Research Office, spoke at the beginning and end of the meeting respectively. The meeting believed that several issues and main opinions that need to be clarified in the current party building work of state-owned enterprises are: (1) It is necessary to uphold the political core position of the party organization of the enterprise and better play the role of the political core. (2) Further straighten out the party-government relationship in the enterprise and actively explore the organizational form that ensures that the party organization plays the role of the political core.
(3) The party organization of the enterprise should focus on reform and production and operation, and effectively improve the working methods and activities. (4) Gradually establish a practical system to ensure that the party organization of the enterprise participates in the decision-making of major issues. (5) Adjust and improve the setting of the working institutions of the party organization of the enterprise and strengthen the construction of the party work team. (6) The superior party committee should effectively strengthen and improve the leadership of the party building work of the enterprise. On October 25, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the Policy Research Office of the CPC Central Committee issued a notice on Comrade Hu Jintao’s speech at the symposium with representatives of the National State-owned Enterprise Party Building Symposium.

events:
2日 中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅发出《关于严禁用公费
变相出国(境)旅游的通知》《通知》规定:
(--)严格控制用公费出国(境)活动,凡属一般性考察、学习
和没有明确公务目的及实质内容的出国(境)活动,要坚决停下来;
出访团组必须严格执行有关规定,不得以任何理由绕道旅行或
自延长在境外停留的时间。要坚决贯彻执行《国务院办公厅关于派
遣团组和人员赴国(境)外培训的规定》,严格控制党政机关出国
(境)培训的团组和人员。这项工作统一由国家外国专家局归口管
理,从严掌握,并尽快制定管理办法。
(二)审批公务出国(境)经费要严格把关。上报出国(境)报告
时要说明经费来源和用汇数额。凡用汇未列入预算或超预算的团
组和人员,不得批准。违者要追究组团单位和审批机关领导的责
任。
(三)严禁党政机关干部索要,挤占企业事业单位的名额搭车
出国(境);因引进技术、设备等项目确需随企业团组出国(境)的,
要严格审核并由所在机关开支出国经费。
(四)中央和国家机关部委、直属机构中享有派遣临时出国
批权的单位,可以直接向党中央、国务院行文的公司和团体,可按
照规定的程序组织少量跨地区、跨部门出国(境)的团组,其他任何
单位包括各类学会、协会、基金会、中心、公司、院校、办事处等,均
不得组织跨地区、跨部门的团组和人员出国(境)进行考察、培训、
研讨、交流等活动,有特殊需要的须报省级以上主管部门批准。违
反的要追缴组团所得收入,并追究单位领导的责任。
(五)凡因公出国(境),必须严格按照规定的渠道和程序报
批,不准弄虚作假,不准异地办理护照,不准假借自费名义,改变身
份,不准通过旅行社渠道出国(境),各旅游部门不得办理公费出国
(境)的有关事宜
(六)公务组团出访,组团单位不准超过国家规定的标准收
费,不准从中牟利,也不准采取赠送“免费出国名额”,发给奖金或
回扣等办法招揽参团人员。
(七)各地区、各部门、各单位要对1992年7月1日以来公费
出国(境)情况进行一次清理,对检查发现的问题认真作出处理。凡
属用公费变相出国(境)旅游的,以本通知发布的时间为界,在这以
前的,可以适当从宽处理,但要把已由单位支付的制装费、伙食费
和零用钱,改由个人自理。在这以后的,要从严处理,所有出国
(境)旅游费用要全部自理,并视情节轻重给予适当的纪律处分;组
团单位的违纪收入要全部没收,上缴国库;对违反规定滥用审批权
和颁发护照权的单位,除追究当事人和主管领导的责任外,还要根
据情节轻重暂停直至取消该单位的审批权和颁发护照权。各地区、
各部门清理整顿的情况于1993年底以前报中纪委、监察部、外交
部、国务院外事办公室。
(八)纠正用公费出国(境)旅游的不正之风,由各级党委、政
府统一领导,各部门、各单位负责进行清理整顿。首先从领导机关
和领导干部抓起,中央国家机关要带头清理和制止。各地区外事办
和各部门主管外事工作的司(局)要加强对出国(境)工作的监督和
管理。财政部门和审计机关要加强财务管理和审计,严格执行财经
纪律。各级纪检、监察机关要加强监督检查,严肃查处用公费出国
(境)旅游的案件,特别是发生在各级领导干部中的案件;对继续弄
虚作假、顶风违纪的,要从严惩处,并有选择地予以公开处理。

On the 2nd, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council issued the "Notice on Strictly Prohibiting Disguised Overseas Travel at Public Expense". The "Notice" stipulates: (--) Strictly control overseas travel at public expense. All general inspections, studies, and overseas travel without clear official purposes and substantive content must be resolutely stopped; visiting groups must strictly implement relevant regulations and may not travel by detour or extend their stay abroad for any reason. We must resolutely implement the "Regulations of the General Office of the State Council on Sending Groups and Personnel to Overseas for Training" and strictly control the groups and personnel of party and government agencies going abroad for training. This work will be uniformly managed by the State Administration of Foreign Experts, strictly controlled, and management measures will be formulated as soon as possible. (II) Strict control must be exercised in the approval of official overseas travel expenses. When submitting overseas travel reports, the source of funds and the amount of foreign exchange used must be stated. Groups and personnel whose foreign exchange use is not included in the budget or exceeds the budget shall not be approved. Violators shall be held accountable by the leaders of the organizing unit and the approval authority.
(III) It is strictly forbidden for cadres of party and government organs to ask for or occupy the quota of enterprises and institutions to travel abroad; if they really need to travel abroad with enterprise groups due to the introduction of technology, equipment and other projects, they must be strictly reviewed and the funds for going abroad shall be paid by the relevant organs.
(IV) Units in the ministries and commissions of the central and state organs and directly affiliated institutions that have the right to approve temporary overseas trips can directly write to the Party Central Committee and the State Council for companies and groups to organize a small number of cross-regional and cross-departmental groups to go abroad in accordance with the prescribed procedures. Any other units, including various societies, associations, foundations, centers, companies, colleges, offices, etc., shall not organize cross-regional and cross-departmental groups and personnel to go abroad for inspections, training, seminars, exchanges and other activities. Special needs must be reported to the competent departments at or above the provincial level for approval. Violators shall recover the income from the group and hold the leaders of the units accountable.
(V) All official trips abroad must be approved in strict accordance with the prescribed channels and procedures. No fraud, passport application in a different place, change of identity under the pretext of self-funded, or trips abroad through travel agencies are allowed. All tourism departments are not allowed to handle matters related to official trips abroad.
(VI) Official delegations are not allowed to charge fees exceeding the national standard, make profits, or recruit participants by giving away "free overseas places", bonuses or kickbacks.
(VII) All regions, departments, and units should conduct a cleanup of official overseas trips since July 1, 1992, and deal seriously with the problems found in the inspection. All those who travel abroad in disguise at public expense can be treated leniently before the time of this notice, but the clothing, food, and pocket money paid by the unit must be paid by the individual. After this, they will be dealt with strictly. All expenses for traveling abroad will be borne by themselves, and appropriate disciplinary sanctions will be imposed depending on the severity of the case. All illegal income of the organizing unit will be confiscated and turned over to the state treasury. For units that violate regulations and abuse the approval power and passport issuance power, in addition to investigating the responsibilities of the parties and the leaders in charge, the approval power and passport issuance power of the unit will be suspended or even cancelled according to the severity of the case. The rectification situation of various regions and departments shall be reported to the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, the Ministry of Supervision, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and the State Council Foreign Affairs Office before the end of 1993. (VIII) Correcting the unhealthy trend of traveling abroad at public expense will be unified under the leadership of party committees and governments at all levels, and various departments and units will be responsible for rectification. First of all, it will start with leading organs and leading cadres, and the central state organs will take the lead in rectification and prevention. The foreign affairs offices of various regions and the departments (bureaus) in charge of foreign affairs of various departments should strengthen the supervision and management of overseas work. Financial departments and auditing agencies should strengthen financial management and auditing and strictly enforce financial discipline. Discipline inspection and supervision agencies at all levels should strengthen supervision and inspection, and severely investigate and deal with cases of using public funds to travel abroad, especially those occurring among leading cadres at all levels; those who continue to falsify information and violate discipline in defiance of the law should be severely punished and selectively dealt with publicly.

常委、书记处书记胡锦涛出席了开幕式,中共中央组织部副部长、
人事部部長朱德福在开幕式上致词。宋德福在讲话中指出,人才市
场是社会主义市场体系的组成部分。通过建立和完善人才市场机
制,形成适应社会主义市场经济要求的人才资源配置方式,让人才
走向市场,在市场中竞争,做到人尽其才,才尽其用,充分调动各类
人才建设社会主义的积极性,是人事制度改革的方向。他说,举办
这次交流大会,旨在促进全国人才市场的发展,使人事工作面向社
会,为经济建设服务,为人才服务,为用人单位服务。他希望各界关
心､重视人才市场,共同促进全国人才市场的蓬勃发展。

列市 635 个,国务院部委、局307个,据初步统计,国务院部委、

translated_text: On the same day, the National Talent and Technology Exchange Conference opened in Beijing. Zhu Defu, Deputy Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and Minister of the Ministry of Personnel, delivered a speech at the opening ceremony. In his speech, Song Defu pointed out that the talent market is an integral part of the socialist market system. By establishing and improving the talent market mechanism, forming a talent resource allocation method that adapts to the requirements of the socialist market economy, allowing talents to go to the market and compete in the market, making the best use of talents, and fully mobilizing the enthusiasm of all kinds of talents to build socialism, this is the direction of personnel system reform. He said that the purpose of holding this exchange conference is to promote the development of the national talent market, make personnel work face the society, serve economic construction, serve talents, and serve employers. He hopes that all sectors of society will pay attention to and attach importance to the talent market and jointly promote the vigorous development of the national talent market. There are 942 booths in this conference, including 635 from provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities directly under the Central Government and cities with independent planning status, and 307 from ministries and commissions of the State Council. According to preliminary statistics, the 68 delegations organized by the ministries and commissions of the State Council will recruit nearly 20,000 talents of various types. The talents to be recruited by the provincial and municipal delegations include both senior talents and junior talents and some university graduates.

translated_text: On the 4th, Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, Secretary of the Secretariat, and President of the Central Party School, delivered a speech at the seminar for provincial and ministerial-level leading cadres to study Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics. Hu Jintao pointed out that the 15 years since the Third Plenary Session of the 11th CPC Central Committee have been a period in which our party has combined the basic principles of Marxism with the reality of contemporary China and the characteristics of the times under new historical conditions, opened up a road to building socialism with Chinese characteristics, and firmly marched forward along this road. It is also a period in which Deng Xiaoping adhered to and developed Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought, and continuously enriched, improved, and developed the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics in the great practice of reform and opening up. In the past 15 years, my country's reform and opening up has gone through a magnificent historical process from rural reform to urban reform, from economic system reform to reform of all aspects of the system, from coastal opening to all-round opening up. The cause of building socialism with Chinese characteristics has withstood severe tests under the ever-changing world situation and has achieved great achievements that have attracted worldwide attention. The Chinese people's rich and vivid great practice is carried out under the guidance of the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, and at the same time provides an inexhaustible source for the continuous development of this theory. Deng Xiaoping respected the practice and initiative of the masses and always paid attention to the interests and wishes of the vast majority of the people. With his extraordinary Marxist pragmatic attitude, courage to explore, innovative spirit and revolutionary courage, he keenly grasped the pulse and opportunities of the development of the times, grasped the new things that represent the direction of the development of productive forces, and timely summarized the experience and creation of the masses, and sublimated it to the height of theory, so that the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics has been continuously enriched, improved and developed, showing great vitality. Hu Jintao said that to arm the whole party with the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, it is first necessary to arm the leading cadres at all levels of the party, especially the senior cadres. Our senior cadres take the lead in studying and applying this theory seriously, which can not only greatly improve their leadership level, strengthen the principle, system, foresight and creativity in their work, avoid or reduce major mistakes, but also drive the leading cadres and party members at all levels to study the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, promote the continuous improvement of the Marxist theoretical level of the whole party, and turn the great spiritual power into a huge material force to unite and rally the whole party and the people of the country to promote reform, opening up and modernization. The central government held a theoretical seminar for provincial and ministerial leading cadres to create a condition for everyone to concentrate on in-depth study of theory and research and think about problems, and at the same time further arouse the high attention of party organizations and leading cadres at all levels to study theory, form a strong atmosphere of serious study and research of theory in the whole party, and further implement the arming of the whole party with the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics. Hu Jintao hopes that the comrades in the seminar will seriously study and master the basic viewpoints and spiritual essence of the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, and summarize the experience of reform, opening up and modernization in the past 15 years in combination with the actual situation of their regions, departments and individuals. Strive to achieve greater results. He said that over the past 15 years, our Party has led the people of all ethnic groups in the country to start a new great revolution and opened a new chapter in Chinese history. The cause of all localities and departments has made great progress, and rich new experience has been created and accumulated in practice. This is a very valuable asset. Guided by the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, we should use theoretical thinking to seriously summarize, generalize and refine, and further deepen our understanding and understanding of scientific theories. This will be of great benefit to our correct decision-making, improvement of work, improvement of policies, and faster and better progress of our cause in the future. Hu Jintao pointed out in his speech that fundamentally changing the original economic system that restricts the development of my country's productive forces through reform and establishing a socialist market economic system full of vitality and vigor is an important part of Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics. The practice of 15 years has fully proved that we are on the right path and must continue to follow it unswervingly. The overall situation in the country is good. At the same time, some prominent contradictions and problems have also emerged in economic development. To solve these contradictions and problems, we cannot continue to use the old ideas and methods formed under the planned economic system in the past and are no longer applicable. Instead, we must use new ideas and new methods to solve them by deepening reform and accelerating the establishment of a socialist market economic system. Ding Guangen, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, presided over the meeting. Wei Jianxing, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, and other responsible comrades from relevant central departments attended the meeting. A total of 45 participants participated in this theoretical seminar for major provincial and ministerial leaders. Most of them are major responsible comrades from provincial, autonomous region, and municipal party committees and governments, central ministries and commissions, major PLA units, and armed police headquarters, as well as leading cadres and party theoretical workers on the propaganda and theoretical front.
