translated_text:
On the 5th, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued the "Decision on Several Tasks to be Done in the Near Future in the Fight against Corruption". The "Decision" pointed out that in view of the current situation, it was decided to focus on three tasks in the near future and achieve significant results.
(I) Leading cadres of party and government organs should take the lead in being honest and self-disciplined. Leading cadres at the county (department) level and above are not allowed to engage in the following activities: (1) They are not allowed to engage in business or run enterprises; they are not allowed to engage in paid intermediary activities; they are not allowed to use their power to provide any preferential conditions for their spouses, children and other relatives and friends to engage in business or run enterprises. (2) They are not allowed to work part-time (including honorary positions) in various economic entities; individuals who are approved to work part-time are not allowed to receive any remuneration; they are not allowed to reimburse various expenses that should be paid by individuals from subordinate units and other enterprises and institutions. (3) They are not allowed to buy and sell stocks. (4) They are not allowed to accept gifts and various securities during official activities; they are not allowed to accept credit cards given by subordinate units and other enterprises and institutions, and they are not allowed to use credit cards issued by the unit with public funds for personal use. (5) It is not allowed to use public funds to obtain club memberships of various forms, nor is it allowed to use public funds to participate in high-consumption entertainment activities.
( ) Investigate and handle a number of major cases. Focus on investigating and handling illegal and disciplinary cases by leading cadres of party and government leading organs and judicial departments, administrative law enforcement departments, economic management departments and their staff. Concentrate efforts to investigate and handle a number of major cases in the near future.
( ) Severely curb the unhealthy trends that the masses strongly complain about. We must concentrate our efforts nationwide to basically curb the unhealthy trend of charging fees indiscriminately, focusing on curbing the unhealthy trends of state organs and their subordinate departments arbitrarily turning the business within their responsibilities into charging items; arbitrarily establishing projects and expanding the scope of charging fees, raising charging standards; transferring part of their functions to subordinate economic entities to engage in paid services; using power and industry monopoly to force "services" and charging high fees; only charging fees without providing services, blatantly extorting, and other unhealthy trends of using power to make up excuses and charge fees indiscriminately. At the same time, we must curb the unhealthy trend of using public funds to travel abroad in disguise. All localities, departments and industries should proceed from reality and solve several key issues that the masses have strongly reflected through special governance in the near future. It must be reiterated that: (1) Party and government organs at all levels are not allowed to engage in business and run enterprises. Economic entities that have been established must be completely separated from the original organs in accordance with regulations. (2) Implement the "two-line system of revenue and expenditure". No locality or department is allowed to arbitrarily issue fees and fines, and is not allowed to link the statutory fees and fines that should be paid with the allocation of funds in the region or department, or the bonuses and benefits of employees. It is strictly prohibited to pay commissions. The "Decision" emphasizes that party committees and governments at all levels must effectively strengthen their leadership over several anti-corruption efforts in the near future and conscientiously grasp the principles of the anti-corruption struggle. Party committees and governments at or above the county level must immediately formulate plans in accordance with the requirements of the decision, combine the actual conditions of their regions and departments, carefully organize, and implement them vigorously. They must achieve significant results in the near future to inspire and boost the confidence and fighting spirit of party members, cadres and the masses.

translated_text:
On the 8th, with the approval of the Central Committee, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, and the Ministry of Supervision jointly formulated the "Implementation Opinions on the 'Five Provisions' on the Integrity and Self-discipline of Leading Cadres at or Above the County (Department) Level in Party and Government Organs". The "Opinions" stipulate: (i) The "Five Provisions" apply to leading cadres at or above the county (department) level in party and government organs, namely, leading cadres at or above the deputy county (department) level (including deputy county and department level) in party organs, people's congress organs, administrative organs, CPPCC organs, judicial organs, and supervisory organs, including those who have reached retirement age and have not yet completed retirement procedures. The "Five Provisions" also apply to leading cadres at or above the deputy county (department) level (including deputy county and department level) in mass organizations such as trade unions, Communist Youth League, Women's Federation, Federation of Literary and Art Circles, and Association for Science and Technology who hold non-leadership positions in the above-mentioned organs. (II) For violations of the "Five Provisions", all those that have been stipulated by the Party and the State shall be handled in accordance with the relevant provisions. For those that have not been stipulated in the past, they shall be handled in accordance with this "Implementation Opinion". For those who engage in business and run enterprises, use their power to provide preferential conditions for their spouses, children and relatives to engage in business and run enterprises, take part-time jobs (including honorary positions) in various economic entities and receive remuneration, reimburse various expenses that should be paid by individuals at subordinate units and other enterprises and institutions, and accept gifts and various securities during official activities, they shall be handled in accordance with the relevant regulations issued by the Party Central Committee, the State Council and the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection. If the person conducts self-examination and self-correction, he may be given a lighter punishment. For those that have not been stipulated in the past, they shall be handled in accordance with the following provisions: (1) Those who engaged in paid intermediary activities before the promulgation and implementation of the "Decision" shall be handled as engaging in business and running enterprises. After the promulgation and implementation of the "Decision", those who continue to engage in paid intermediary activities shall be ordered to stop the activities, their business income shall be confiscated, and they shall be given party and government discipline sanctions depending on the severity of the circumstances. (2) Shares legally held before the promulgation and implementation of the Decision must be registered with the unit where they are employed and sold in accordance with the stock trading rules. Employee shares already held must be immediately returned to the enterprise at the price at the time of issuance; after the issuance of the "Emergency Notice of the General Office of the State Council on Forwarding the Opinions of the State Commission for Restructuring the Economic System and Other Departments on Immediately Stopping the Irregular Practice of Issuing Employee Shares", those who purchased or obtained employee shares for free must immediately return them to the enterprise and be subject to party and government discipline sanctions depending on the severity of the circumstances. 
Those who buy and sell shares after the promulgation and implementation of the Decision shall be subject to party and government discipline sanctions depending on the severity of the circumstances and shall be dealt with in accordance with the provisions of the "Interim Regulations on the Administration of Stock Issuance and Trading". 
Shares obtained for free or illegally and their illegal gains shall be confiscated and party and government discipline sanctions shall be imposed. 
(3) Credit cards received from subordinate units or other enterprises and institutions under various names before the promulgation and implementation of the Decision, and credit cards of the unit used by individuals, shall be immediately revoked. The money spent on the above-mentioned credit cards for personal use shall be refunded in full, and the case shall be dealt with according to the severity of the case. Those who refuse to hand over the credit card and refuse to refund the money spent on personal use shall be dealt with more severely. After the promulgation and implementation of the "Decision", those who accept credit cards given by subordinate units or other enterprises and institutions in various names, or use the credit cards obtained by the unit with public funds for personal use, must immediately hand over the credit cards they hold, refund the money spent on personal use, and be subject to party and government discipline sanctions according to the severity of the case. (4) Those who used public funds to obtain membership of various clubs before the promulgation and implementation of the "Decision" must withdraw immediately. If they do not withdraw, they shall pay all the expenses. After the promulgation and implementation of the "Decision", those who still use public funds to obtain membership of various clubs must return the public funds and be subject to party and government discipline sanctions. (5) After the "Decision" is promulgated and implemented, if public funds are used to participate in high-consumption entertainment activities, the individual shall bear the expenses and be subject to party and government discipline sanctions depending on the circumstances. 
Those who violate the "Five Provisions" and violate the criminal law shall be dealt with by the judicial organs in accordance with the law. 
(III) This "Implementation Opinion" shall be organized and implemented by the Party Committees and governments at all levels, and the discipline inspection and supervision organs and organization departments at the same level shall be responsible for supervision and inspection.

《规定》内容主要有:(一)县及县以上各级党政机关要坚决贯
彻执行中央、国务院有关规定精神,不准经商办企业。(二)县及县

型的经济实体;(2)以部门名义向经济实体投资、入股:(3)接受各
类经济实体的挂靠。对现隶属于上述单位的经济实体,一律限期在
1994 年6 月底前转出。个别因特殊需要保留的,须报国务院或省
级人民政府批准。(三)上述部门外的国家机关为适应机构改革、转
变职能和分流人员等需要而组建的经济实体,必须与机关彻底脱
钩。(1)各类经济实体不得兼有行政管理和行业管理职能;(2)各类
经济实体在财务上与机关脱钩,并按国家规定缴纳税费;(3)党政
机关在职干部一律不得兼有机关干部和企业职工双重身份,不得

称。(四)组建企业集团必须坚持企业自愿和政策引导相结合的原
则,认真征求企业和各方面意见。(五)国家对各类经济实体不干预
其经营管理活动。(六)除法律法规另有规定外,各级党政机关均不
得利用职权,指定任何经济实体垄断经营业务,也不得限制,排斥

translated_text: On the 9th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council forwarded the State Economic and Trade Commission's "Regulations on the Disconnection of Party and Government Organs from the Economic Entities They Manage". The main contents of the "Regulations" are: (i) Party and government organs at the county level and above must resolutely implement the relevant regulations of the Central Committee and the State Council and are not allowed to engage in business and run enterprises. (ii) Party organs, people's congress organs, judicial organs, procuratorates and government organs at the county level and above, including public security, security, supervision, justice, auditing, taxation, industrial and commercial administration, land management, customs, technical supervision, commodity inspection and other departments and service agencies, are not allowed to: (1) establish any type of economic entity; (2) invest in or acquire shares in economic entities in the name of departments; (3) accept the affiliation of various types of economic entities. All economic entities currently affiliated with the above-mentioned units must be transferred out before the end of June 1994. Individuals that need to be retained due to special needs must be reported to the State Council or provincial people's governments for approval. (III) Economic entities established by state organs outside the above-mentioned departments to meet the needs of institutional reform, functional transformation and personnel diversion must be completely separated from the organs. (1) All types of economic entities shall not have administrative management and industry management functions; (2) All types of economic entities shall be financially separated from the organs and pay taxes and fees in accordance with national regulations; (3) Incumbent cadres of party and government organs shall not have the dual identities of cadres of the organs and employees of enterprises, and shall not work part-time in economic entities; (4) All types of economic entities shall not be named as party and government organs. (IV) The establishment of enterprise groups must adhere to the principle of combining voluntary participation of enterprises with policy guidance, and seriously solicit opinions from enterprises and all parties. (V) The state shall not interfere with the business management activities of various economic entities. (VI) Unless otherwise provided by laws and regulations, party and government organs at all levels shall not use their authority to designate any economic entity to monopolize business operations, nor shall they restrict or exclude economic entities outside their departments from engaging in business operations related to the functions of their departments. (VII) When establishing new economic entities during institutional reform, government departments shall not interfere with the normal production and operation activities of other enterprises, forcibly transfer personnel, funds, and materials to other enterprises, levy reserve funds, or grant special operating methods to newly established economic entities.

translated_text: On the 24th, party and state leaders Jiang Zemin, Li Peng, Qiao Shi, Li Ruihuan, Liu Huaqing, Hu Jintao and others attended the 12th National Congress of the All-China Federation of Trade Unions. The system of workers' congresses should be further improved and perfected. Major issues of enterprises should be discussed at workers' congresses or workers' conferences, and democratic participation and democratic supervision of workers should be strengthened. All powers of workers' democratic management should be fully implemented. Workers should consciously abide by labor discipline and safeguard the authority of administrative management. In non-publicly owned enterprises, workers are also the masters of the country, and the legitimate rights and interests of workers should be protected from infringement in accordance with the law. Hu Jintao pointed out that the All-China Federation of Trade Unions is a mass organization of the working class led by the party, a bridge and link between the party and the workers, and an important social pillar of the state power. Hu Jintao said that trade unions at all levels should consciously accept the leadership of the Party and maintain a high degree of unity with the Party Central Committee in politics, ideology and action. They should be guided by Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and the Party's basic line, focus on economic construction, give full play to their own characteristics and advantages, and fully perform various social functions. While safeguarding the overall interests of the people of the whole country, they should better express and safeguard the specific interests of the workers and the masses; mobilize and organize the workers and the masses to strive to complete the tasks of economic and social development; give full play to the role of democratic participation and democratic supervision in the management of state and social affairs; strengthen ideological and political education, and build a team of workers with ideals, morality, culture and discipline. They should strive to improve the level of self-construction and continuously enhance vitality and attractiveness. Hu Jintao stressed that party committees at all levels should further strengthen and improve the leadership of trade union work, regularly discuss important issues in trade union work, and support trade unions to carry out their work independently and creatively in accordance with the law and their own constitutions. We should guide and help trade unions to strengthen the construction of their cadre teams, especially attach importance to and strengthen the construction of the leadership teams of trade unions at all levels, and select and assign the leaders of trade unions at all levels in accordance with the principle of "four modernizations" of the cadre team and the principle of both moral integrity and ability.

告会。中共中央总书记江泽民、中共中央政治局常委李鹏、乔石、李
瑞环、朱镕基、刘华清、胡锦涛,国家副主席荣毅仁等中央领导同志
以及首都党政军各部门和各省、自治区、直辖市的负责同志出席了
报告会。李鹏主持会议。胡锦涛宣读了《中共中央关于学习(邓小
平文选〉第三卷的决定》。《决定》指出,《邓小平文选》第三卷已经出
版发行。这是党和国家政治生活中的一件大事。全党同志都要高
度重视,认真学习《决定》号召全党全军全国各族人民要在以江泽
民为核心的党中央领导下,坚持以建设有中国特色社会主义理论
为根本指针,坚持党的基本路线一百年不动摇,团结一心,扎实工

明的社会主义现代化国家而奋斗。江泽民在会上发表了重要讲话。
江泽民指出,邓小平的文选,前些年已经出版两卷,现在出版
的第三卷,是1982-1992年邓小平的主要著作。新一卷《邓小平文
选》,就是这10年邓小平领导我们推进改革开放和社会主义现代
化建设丰富经验的理论总结,也是引导我们继续胜利前进的科学
指南。三卷《邓小平文选》是一个整体。这次出版的第三卷同10年
前出版的第二卷,汇集了邓小平在形成和发展建设有中国特色社
会主义理论过程中的最重要最富有独创性的著作。它内容丰富,博
大精深,洋溢着鲜明的时代精神与民族精神,闪耀着马克思主义真
理的灿烂光辉。要认真学习,大力发扬这样的革命风格,使我们党
永远保持旺盛的战斗力和创造力。
江泽民指出,学习《邓小平文选》第三卷,深刻理解和把握以邓
小平同志为核心的第二代中央领导集体在开创全新事业中积累的
基本经验、创造的基本理论、形成的基本路线,一定会使我们全党
同志更加充满信心,更好地完成90年代的任务,胜利地迈向21世
纪。我们要通过学习,进一步统一思想,大大增强坚持党的基本理
论和基本路线的自觉性,坚定性和创造性。
江泽民强调,全党一定要认真学好《邓小平文选》第三卷,用党
的基本理论和基本路线统揽全局,更好地处理党的具体政策,具体
工作与党的总路线,总政策之间的关系。在我们的思想和工作中,
必须牢牢记住党的基本路线。
4日,《人民日报》全文发表了《中共中央关于学习(邓小平文
选>第三卷的决定》和江泽民在学习《邓小平文选》第三卷报告会上
的讲话。
translated_text: On the 2nd, the CPC Central Committee held a grand report meeting in Beijing to study the third volume of Selected Works of Deng Xiaoping. Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, Li Peng, Qiao Shi, Li Ruihuan, Zhu Rongji, Liu Huaqing, Hu Jintao, Vice President Rong Yiren and other central leaders, as well as responsible comrades from various departments of the party, government and military in the capital and various provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities attended the report meeting. Li Peng presided over the meeting. Hu Jintao read out the "Decision of the CPC Central Committee on Studying the Third Volume of Selected Works of Deng Xiaoping". The "Decision" pointed out that the third volume of Selected Works of Deng Xiaoping has been published and distributed. This is a major event in the political life of the party and the country. All comrades in the party should attach great importance to it and study it seriously. The "Decision" calls on the whole party, the whole army and people of all ethnic groups in the country to adhere to the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics as the fundamental guideline and the party's basic line for a hundred years under the leadership of the CPC Central Committee with Jiang Zemin as the core, unite as one, work hard, and build our country into a prosperous, democratic, civilized socialist modern country. Struggle. Jiang Zemin delivered an important speech at the meeting. Jiang Zemin pointed out that two volumes of Deng Xiaoping's Selected Works had been published in previous years, and the third volume now being published is Deng Xiaoping's main works from 1982 to 1992. The new volume of "Selected Works of Deng Xiaoping" is a theoretical summary of Deng Xiaoping's rich experience in leading us to promote reform and opening up and socialist modernization in the past 10 years, and it is also a scientific guide to lead us to continue to move forward victoriously. The three volumes of "Selected Works of Deng Xiaoping" are a whole. The third volume published this time, together with the second volume published 10 years ago, brings together the most important and richest works of Deng Xiaoping in the process of forming and developing the theory of socialism with Chinese characteristics. It is an original work. It is rich in content, profound, full of the distinct spirit of the times and the national spirit, and shining with the brilliant brilliance of Marxist truth. We must study it seriously and vigorously carry forward this revolutionary style so that our party will always maintain strong combat effectiveness and creativity. Jiang Zemin pointed out that studying the third volume of "Selected Works of Deng Xiaoping" and deeply understanding and grasping the basic experience accumulated, the basic theory created, and the basic line formed by the second generation of central leadership with Comrade Deng Xiaoping as the core in creating a new cause will surely make all our party comrades more confident, better complete the tasks of the 1990s, and march towards the 21st century victoriously. I We should further unify our thoughts through study, and greatly enhance the consciousness, firmness and creativity of adhering to the party's basic theory and basic line. Jiang Zemin emphasized that the whole party must seriously study the third volume of "Selected Works of Deng Xiaoping", use the party's basic theory and basic line to take charge of the overall situation, and better handle the relationship between the party's specific policies and specific work and the party's general line and general policy. In our thoughts and work, we must firmly remember the party's basic line. On the 4th, the People's Daily published the full text of "The Decision of the CPC Central Committee on Studying the Third Volume of "Selected Works of Deng Xiaoping" and Jiang Zemin's speech at the report meeting on studying the third volume of "Selected Works of Deng Xiaoping".

events: 1993年11月2日,《邓小平文选》第三卷出版发行。江泽民在学习《邓小平文选》第三卷报告会上强调,邓小平同志建设有中国特色社会主义理论,第一次比较系统地初步回答了中国这样的经济文化比较落后的国家如何建设社会主义,如何巩固和发展社会主义的一系列基本问题,用新的思想、观点,继承、丰富和发展了毛泽东思想,是马克思主义同中国实际相结合的最新成果,是当代中国的马克思主义。
translated_text: On November 2, 1993, the third volume of Selected Works of Deng Xiaoping was published. At the meeting to study the third volume of Selected Works of Deng Xiaoping, Jiang Zemin emphasized that Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics was the first to systematically answer a series of basic questions about how to build socialism and consolidate and develop socialism in a country like China, which is economically and culturally backward. It inherited, enriched and developed Mao Zedong Thought with new ideas and viewpoints. It is the latest achievement of combining Marxism with China's reality and is Marxism in contemporary China.

选》第三卷理论研讨班第二期学员举行全体会议。中共中央政治局
常委、书记处书记、中央党校校长胡锦涛到会讲话。他强调指出,各
级党组织要认真落实中央关于学习《邓小平文选》第三卷的决定和
江泽民同志在报告会上的重要讲话精神,把组织党员、干部特别是
领导干部学习新一卷《邓小平文选》这件大事认真抓好,取得实效。
胡锦涛指出,《邓小平文选》第三卷在建设有中国特色社会主
义理论的形成和发展中,在科学社会主义理论和马克思主义发展
史上,都具有重要的历史地位。这部著作同10年前出版的《邓小平
文选》第二卷相衔接、相统一,凝结了邓小平同志领导我们推进改

常强的针对性和现实指导意义。小平同志这部著作中谈到的事情,
是我们前些年做过的,也是我们当前和今后要继续做的。认真学习

translated_text: On the 3rd, the second session of the theoretical seminar for provincial and ministerial leaders to study the third volume of Selected Works of Deng Xiaoping held by the CPC Central Committee held a plenary meeting. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, Secretary of the Secretariat, and President of the Central Party School, spoke at the meeting. He emphasized that party organizations at all levels should conscientiously implement the Central Committee’s decision on studying the third volume of Selected Works of Deng Xiaoping and the spirit of Comrade Jiang Zemin’s important speech at the report meeting, and organize party members, cadres, especially leading cadres to study the new volume of Selected Works of Deng Xiaoping. This important event is done well and effective. Hu Jintao pointed out that the third volume of Selected Works of Deng Xiaoping has an important historical position in the formation and development of the theory of socialism with Chinese characteristics, and in the history of the development of scientific socialist theory and Marxism. This work is connected and unified with the second volume of Selected Works of Deng Xiaoping published 10 years ago. It condenses the rich experience and political wisdom of Comrade Deng Xiaoping in leading us to promote reform, opening up and modernization, and concentrates on his historic and great contribution to the creation of the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics as the core of the second generation of the central leadership. The works collected in the new volume of Selected Works of Deng Xiaoping span a period of 10 years, but when we read them today, we can see that they are very close to reality and have very strong pertinence and practical guiding significance. What Comrade Xiaoping talked about in this work is what we did in previous years and what we will continue to do now and in the future. Carefully studying this work is of great significance for us to further understand the situation, grasp the overall situation, unify our thoughts, enhance our consciousness and firmness in implementing the party's basic theory and basic line, and further do a good job in all aspects of work. Hu Jintao emphasized that to learn the third volume of Selected Works of Deng Xiaoping well, we must first follow the requirements of the central decision and work hard on studying the original works carefully. This anthology, like Comrade Xiaoping's other works, uses plain language, is concise and clear, but is rich in content, profound, with clear views, easy-to-understand, rigorous logic, and powerful arguments. It is permeated with the world outlook and methodology of thorough dialectical materialism and historical materialism, and shines with the brilliant glory of Marxist truth. This requires us to study with a strict scientific attitude, carefully read the original works article by article, correctly grasp the ideological connotation, and closely connect with the reality of reform and construction in the past 15 years, the reality of our region, department, and unit, and our own work and ideological reality. We should think while reading, summarize the experience and lessons in practice, and analyze the actual situation. Through learning, we can not only systematically understand Comrade Xiaoping’s strategic thinking and theoretical viewpoints, but also deeply understand the spiritual essence of them; we can not only carefully master Comrade Xiaoping’s theoretical principles, but also carefully learn his pragmatic attitude, courage to explore, innovative spirit and revolutionary style in using Marxist standpoints, viewpoints and methods to study new situations and solve new problems, strive to integrate the original works, consciously guide current work, seize opportunities, deepen reforms, accelerate the pace of establishing a socialist market economic system, and promote the continuous development of socialist modernization. A total of 45 students participated in the second theoretical seminar for major provincial and ministerial leaders. Most of them are the main responsible comrades of provincial, autonomous region and municipal party committees and governments, central ministries and commissions, major units of the People’s Liberation Army and the Central Committee of the Communist Youth League, as well as leading cadres and party theoretical workers on the propaganda theory front.

近中共中央组织了包括民主党派负责人参加的10个调查组,分赴
20个中央国家机关,对中央近期反腐败斗争工作部署的贯彻落实
情况进行了督促检查和调查研究。日前,各调查组对中央国家机关
一些部门的检查情况作了汇报。近日内,中央又另组织10个调查
组分赴河北、山西、辽宁、吉林、黑龙江、安徽、福建、江西、山东、海
南等20个省进行督促检查和调查研究。调查组下去前,中共中央
政治局委员、书记处书记、中纪委书记尉健行就调查的任务,要求
和注意事项等讲了话。
尉健行指出,江泽民在中央纪委二次全会上的重要讲话和中
央纪委二次全会以后,各省区市和中央国家机关都进行了认真的
传达学习和贯彻,现在已转入抓落实阶段。总的看,势头是好的,
抓得好的地区和部门已初见成效。但是,要在近期内取得明显的阶
段性成果,还需下很大的功夫。
尉健行要求各调查组以《邓小平文选》第三卷和江泽民讲话精
神为指导,把检查工作做好。要把监督检查的重点放在反腐败斗争
的实效上。主要目的在于发现和指出存在的问题,督促及时处理,
促进反腐败斗争深入发展并取得更大的实效。既要检查了解这次
反腐败斗争的传达、动员、学习、部署的情况,更要检查了解中央所
提出的三项任务的具体贯彻落实情况,从检查实效着眼了解工作
进展的情况和存在的问题。了解揭露出来的问题是否及时纠正解
决。

斗争的传达部署,更要狠抓落实;领导干部要自觉进行自查自纠,
廉洁自律,同时要加强组织监督,把自律和组织监督结合起来,统
一起来;领导机关既要抓本机关的廉政建设,又要组织力量对本系
统、本地区的纠风进行督促检查;既要抓治标,又要研究深层次的
问题,在治本上下功夫,做到标本兼治;要注意发现这次反腐败斗
争中的好的做法和经验,并予以推荐,也要注意发现并推荐廉洁奉
公,勇于同各种腐败现象作斗争的先进典型。
translated_text: On the 8th, the People's Daily reported that in order to promote the in-depth development of the anti-corruption struggle, the CPC Central Committee recently organized 10 investigation teams, including leaders of democratic parties, to go to 20 central state organs to supervise and inspect the implementation of the central government's recent anti-corruption work arrangements and conduct investigations and studies. Recently, each investigation team reported on the inspection of some departments of the central state organs. Recently, the central government organized another 10 investigation teams to go to 20 provinces including Hebei, Shanxi, Liaoning, Jilin, Heilongjiang, Anhui, Fujian, Jiangxi, Shandong, and Hainan to supervise and inspect and conduct investigations and studies. Before the investigation team went down, Wei Jianxing, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, Secretary of the Secretariat, and Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, spoke about the tasks, requirements, and precautions of the investigation. Wei Jianxing pointed out that after Jiang Zemin's important speech at the Second Plenary Session of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and the Second Plenary Session of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, all provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities, and central state organs have carefully conveyed, studied, and implemented it, and now it has entered the stage of implementation. Overall, the momentum is good, and the regions and departments that have done a good job have achieved initial results. However, it will take a lot of effort to achieve significant interim results in the near future. Wei Jianxing asked all investigation teams to take the third volume of "Selected Works of Deng Xiaoping" and the spirit of Jiang Zemin's speech as guidance to do a good job in inspection. The focus of supervision and inspection should be placed on the effectiveness of the anti-corruption struggle. The main purpose is to discover and point out existing problems, urge timely handling, promote the in-depth development of the anti-corruption struggle and achieve greater effectiveness. It is necessary to check and understand the communication, mobilization, study, and deployment of this anti-corruption struggle, and more importantly, to check and understand the specific implementation of the three tasks proposed by the central government, and understand the progress of the work and the existing problems from the perspective of inspection effectiveness. Understand whether the problems revealed are corrected and resolved in a timely manner. Wei Jianxing stressed that the main leading comrades of the Party and government at all levels should not only take charge of the communication and deployment of the anti-corruption struggle, but also pay close attention to its implementation; leading cadres should consciously conduct self-examination and self-correction, be honest and self-disciplined, and at the same time strengthen organizational supervision, combine self-discipline and organizational supervision, and unify them; leading organs should not only focus on the construction of clean government in their own organs, but also organize forces to supervise and inspect the rectification of work styles in their systems and regions; they should not only focus on treating the symptoms, but also study the deep-seated problems, work hard on treating the root causes, and achieve both symptomatic and root causes; they should pay attention to discovering good practices and experiences in this anti-corruption struggle and recommend them, and also pay attention to discovering and recommending advanced models who are honest and dedicated to the public and have the courage to fight against various corruption phenomena.

体会议在北京举行。
出席这次会议的中央委员182人,候补中央委员128人。有关
负责同志54人列席了会议。全会由中央政治局主持,中共中央总
书记江泽民在会上就当前形势、贯彻执行全会《决定》以及加强党
的建设和党的领导问题作了重要讲话。江泽民在讲话中强调,一是
必须坚决执行党的民主集中制原则。只有坚持民主集中制原则,才
能统一认识,统一步调。各级党组织要自觉把党和国家的利益摆在
第一位,做到局部利益服从整体利益,眼前利益服从长远利益,顾
全大局,保证中央各项方针政策的贯彻实施,保持全党在政治上、
组织上和行动上的高度统一。那种有令不行、有禁不止的行为,对
于我们的事业极为不利,是党的纪律所不允许的。二是加强党的基
层组织建设。党的基层组织是党的基础,基础稳固才能保证党的整
体有强大的战斗力,才能经得起任何风浪的考验。贯彻落实《决
定》需要各级党的组织共同努力,基层党组织也要做艰苦细致的工
作,把党的决定化为广大群众的行动。要下大决心把党的基层组织
建设成为团结带领群众实现党的奋斗目标的战斗堡垒。三是加强
各级领导班子建设。关键是按照干部队伍革命化、年轻化、知识化、
专业化的方针和德才兼备的要求,选好人用好人。要把那些忠于党
的事业,积极推进改革开放和现代化建设的干部特别是中青年干
部,选拔到各级领导岗位,使我们党的组织保持生机和活力。
全会审议通过了《中共中央关于建立社会主义市场经济体
制若干问题的决定》。《决定》共五十条,分十个部分:(一)我国经济

立现代企业制度;(三)培育和发展市场体系;(四)转变政府职能,
建立健全宏观经济调控体系;(五)建立合理的个人收入分配和社
会保障制度;(六)深化农村经济体制改革;(七)深化对外经济体制
改革,进一步扩大对外开放;(八)进一步改革科技体制和教育体
制;(九)加强法律制度建设;(十)加强和改善党的领导,为本世纪
末初步建立社会主义市场经济体制而奋斗。全会认为,《决定》把党

义现代化建设产生重大而深远的影响。全会强调,各级党委和政府

translated_text: From the 11th to the 14th, the Third Plenary Session of the 14th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China was held in Beijing. 182 members of the Central Committee and 128 alternate members of the Central Committee attended the meeting. 54 responsible comrades attended the meeting. The plenary session was presided over by the Political Bureau of the Central Committee. Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, made an important speech at the meeting on the current situation, the implementation of the "Decision" of the plenary session, and the strengthening of party building and party leadership. In his speech, Jiang Zemin emphasized that, first, the principle of democratic centralism of the party must be resolutely implemented. Only by adhering to the principle of democratic centralism can we unify our understanding and steps. Party organizations at all levels must consciously put the interests of the party and the country first, make local interests subordinate to overall interests, immediate interests subordinate to long-term interests, take the overall situation into consideration, ensure the implementation of various central policies and guidelines, and maintain a high degree of unity in the whole party in politics, organization and action. The behavior of not following orders and not stopping prohibitions is extremely detrimental to our cause and is not allowed by the party's discipline. Second, strengthen the construction of grassroots party organizations. The grassroots organizations of the Party are the foundation of the Party. Only a solid foundation can ensure that the Party as a whole has a strong fighting capacity and can withstand the test of any storm. The implementation of the "Decision" requires the joint efforts of Party organizations at all levels, and grassroots Party organizations must also do hard and meticulous work to turn the Party's decisions into the actions of the masses. We must make great efforts to build the grassroots organizations of the Party into a fighting fortress that unites and leads the masses to achieve the Party's goals. The third is to strengthen the construction of leadership teams at all levels. The key is to select and use good people in accordance with the principle of revolutionizing, rejuvenating, knowledgeable, and professionalizing the cadre team and the requirements of both moral integrity and ability. We must select those cadres who are loyal to the Party's cause and actively promote reform, opening up and modernization, especially young and middle-aged cadres, to leadership positions at all levels to keep our Party organizations alive and vibrant. The plenary session reviewed and adopted the "Decision of the CPC Central Committee on Several Issues Concerning the Establishment of a Socialist Market Economic System". The Decision consists of 50 articles and 10 parts: (1) New situation and new tasks facing my country's economic system reform; (2) Transforming the operating mechanism of state-owned enterprises and establishing a modern enterprise system; (3) Cultivating and developing the market system; (4) Transforming government functions and establishing a sound macroeconomic regulation system; (5) Establishing a reasonable personal income distribution and social security system; (6) Deepening rural economic system reform; (7) Deepening foreign economic system reform and further expanding opening up; (8) Further reforming the science and technology system and education system; (9) Strengthening the construction of the legal system; (10) Strengthening and improving the Party's leadership and striving to initially establish a socialist market economic system by the end of this century. The Plenary Session believes that the Decision systematizes and concretizes the goals and basic principles of economic system reform determined at the 14th National Congress of the Party. It is the overall plan for my country to establish a socialist market economic system and the action program for economic system reform in the 1990s. It will have a significant and far-reaching impact on my country's reform and opening up and socialist modernization. The plenary session stressed that Party committees and governments at all levels should use the Party's basic theory and basic line to take charge of the overall situation and focus more on accelerating reform. At present, we must firmly grasp the establishment of a modern enterprise system, market system and reforms in key areas such as finance, taxation, planning, investment, and foreign trade, formulate specific plans, take practical steps, and achieve new breakthroughs. The plenary session pointed out that in order to establish a socialist market economy and accelerate the pace of modernization, it is necessary to uphold and improve the Party's leadership and strengthen the Party's own construction. The whole Party should be armed with Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, and the firmness and consciousness of implementing the Party's basic line and the policies and guidelines for developing a socialist market economy should be enhanced. In order to meet the requirements of establishing a socialist market economic system and economic development, we should actively promote political system reform and strengthen socialist democratic politics and legal system construction. We should adhere to the principle of "grasping both hands and making both hands strong" and strengthen the construction of socialist spiritual civilization. We should carry out the anti-corruption struggle in depth and do a good job in building a clean government. We should strengthen the comprehensive management of public security. We should consolidate and develop a stable and united political situation.

translated_text: On the 14th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council forwarded the "Supplementary Regulations of the CPC Central Committee Organization Department and the Ministry of Personnel on the Review of Personnel Going Abroad on Official Business". The main contents of the "Regulations" are: (a) cadres at or above the county (department) level in ministries and commissions of the central and state organs and provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the central government, as well as cadres equivalent to or above the county (department) level, who go abroad temporarily on official business, can generally be approved together with the overseas mission, and no separate review procedures for personnel going abroad on official business will be required, except for those who have committed relatively serious mistakes and still need to go through the review procedures according to the cadre management authority. (II) The following units shall be added as approval units for personnel temporarily traveling abroad on official business: working departments of provincial, autonomous region and municipal party committees and party groups (party committees) of people's government departments (bureaus), organization departments and personnel bureaus of prefectural (municipal) party committees, county (municipal) party committees: separately planned cities, special economic zones, prefecture-level provincial cities in coastal open areas and prefecture-level provincial cities along borders and rivers, in addition to party committee organization departments and government personnel bureaus, foreign affairs and foreign trade and economic cooperation departments may be added as approval units as appropriate, party committees of public institutions with more foreign exchanges directly managed by central and state organs and ministries and provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities, large state-owned enterprises, medium-sized enterprises with more foreign exchanges, and party committees of state-owned enterprises with import and export rights approved by the State Economic and Trade Commission and the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation. (III) For cadres at or above the vice-provincial (ministerial) level who are stationed abroad, the provincial, autonomous region, and municipal party committees, the party groups (party committees) of the central ministries and state organs, and the party groups of people's organizations shall submit their opinions and then report to the central government for approval; for cadres at the division level and deputy division level, the departments authorized by the provincial, autonomous region, and municipal party committees and the party groups (party committees) of the central ministries and state organs, and the party groups of people's organizations shall be approved; for other personnel, the relevant departments of the provincial, autonomous region, and municipal party committees and the party groups (party committees) of the relevant departments (bureaus) of the people's governments, the prefectural (municipal) party committees, the organization and personnel departments of the central and state organs, and people's organizations shall be approved. The permanent personnel stationed in embassies and consulates abroad, in UN agencies, and in the Hong Kong and Macau branches of Xinhua News Agency shall still be handled in accordance with the original regulations. The "Notice" points out that after adjusting the approval authority for personnel traveling abroad on official business and simplifying the approval procedures, the leading organs of the Party and government at all levels should effectively strengthen macro-management. If the approval authority is delegated without authorization in violation of the central regulations, or if the responsibilities are not fulfilled conscientiously, or if fraud or abuse of approval authority causes serious consequences, the higher-level leading organs shall investigate the responsibilities of the relevant units and personnel, and even take back the approval authority for personnel going abroad.

15日 国务院印发《关于国家公务员制度实施方案的通知》。
《通知》指出,国家公务员制度的实施,要结合机构改革有计划、有
步骤地进行。在推行国家公务员制度过程中,严禁扩大实施范围,
滥设职位,突击提职,转干;违反规定的,要及时,坚决地纠正并追
究有关领导人员的责任;要注意研究新情况,解决新问题,切实加
强和改进思想政治工作,保证实施工作的顺利进行。
《国家公务员制度实施方案》共分四部分:(一)实施范围。
(二)实施步骤。(三)实施办法。(四)组织领导。另外,对国务院所
属部门、单位实施国家公务员制度的范围和国家公务员非领导职
务的设置原则、设置规格、任职条件,比例限额及实施步骤和要求
等都作了具体规定。
translated_text: On the 15th, the State Council issued the "Notice on the Implementation Plan of the National Civil Service System". The "Notice" pointed out that the implementation of the national civil service system should be carried out in a planned and step-by-step manner in conjunction with institutional reform. In the process of promoting the national civil service system, it is strictly forbidden to expand the scope of implementation, set up positions indiscriminately, promote positions suddenly, and transfer personnel; those who violate the regulations must be promptly and resolutely corrected and the responsibilities of the relevant leaders must be investigated; attention must be paid to studying new situations and solving new problems, and ideological and political work must be effectively strengthened and improved to ensure the smooth implementation of the work. The "Implementation Plan of the National Civil Service System" is divided into four parts: (a) Scope of implementation. (b) Implementation steps. (c) Implementation methods. (d) Organization and leadership. In addition, specific provisions are made on the scope of implementation of the national civil service system by departments and units under the State Council and the principles, specifications, conditions for appointment, proportion limits, implementation steps and requirements for non-leadership positions of national civil servants.

锦涛出席第二期省部级主要领导干部理论研讨班结业会议,并作
了重要讲话。胡锦涛在讲话中指出,领导干部学好《邓小平文选》第
三卷,要在四个方面作出努力。
第一,提高掌握建设有中国特色社会主义理论重要性和紧迫
性的认识,增强学习的自觉性。15年来,这一理论经受了我国改革
开放和现代化建设实践的检验,经受了国内政治风波和国际风云
变幻的严峻考验,证明它是颠扑不破的真理,是指导我们事业蓬勃
发展的最有力的武器。充分认识这一理论的政治意义和理论意义、
现实意义和长远意义,增强历史使命感和工作责任心,才能进一步
提高学习的自觉性,学习自觉性越高,学习效果就会越好。
第二,认真研读原著,在系统学习中把握精神实质。这部著作
里讲到的事,都是全党全国各族人民一直在做的事,同改革开放
和现代化建设的实践紧密联系,与我们国家、民族以至个人的命运
休戚相关,因此这部书感到分外亲切。书中的文章要言不烦,用
语简练,朴实通俗,却蕴含着丰富的内容和精深的思想,因此必须
对原著逐篇逐段刻苦研读。《邓小平文选》第三卷中的新思想、新观
点、新概括,是小平同志运用辩证唯物主义和历史唯物主义的世界
观、方法论,解决当代中国实际问题的创造性成果。要真正理解这
些成果,就必须以小平同志为榜样,尊重唯物论和辩证法,用小平
同志著作中体现的世界观和方法论去学习小平同志的科学结论。
第三,在认真阅读和领会原著的基础上,围绕一些重大问题组

学习才能深入。研讨中要贯彻解放思想、实事求是的思想路线,提

济体制的基本框架,表明我们党对建立新经济体制在理论上有了

胡锦涛最后希望全体学员把参加这次研讨班的学习作为新起

translated_text:
On the 30th, Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, Secretary of the Secretariat, and President of the Central Party School, attended the closing ceremony of the second theoretical seminar for provincial and ministerial leading cadres and delivered an important speech. In his speech, Hu Jintao pointed out that leading cadres should make efforts in four aspects to learn the third volume of Selected Works of Deng Xiaoping. First, improve the awareness of the importance and urgency of mastering the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and enhance the consciousness of learning. Over the past 15 years, this theory has withstood the test of my country's reform and opening up and modernization construction, and has withstood the severe test of domestic political turmoil and international changes, proving that it is an irrefutable truth and the most powerful weapon to guide the vigorous development of our cause. Only by fully understanding the political and theoretical significance, practical significance and long-term significance of this theory, and enhancing the sense of historical mission and work responsibility, can we further improve the consciousness of learning. The higher the consciousness of learning, the better the learning effect will be. Second, carefully study the original works and grasp the spiritual essence in systematic learning. The things mentioned in this book are what the whole party and people of all ethnic groups in the country have been doing. They are closely related to the practice of reform and opening up and modernization construction, and are closely related to the fate of our country, nation and even individuals. Therefore, this book feels particularly close. The articles in the book are concise, simple and popular, but they contain rich content and profound thoughts. Therefore, it is necessary to study the original works diligently. The new ideas, new viewpoints and new summaries in the third volume of "Selected Works of Deng Xiaoping" are the creative results of Comrade Xiaoping's use of the world outlook and methodology of dialectical materialism and historical materialism to solve the practical problems of contemporary China. To truly understand these results, we must take Comrade Xiaoping as an example, respect materialism and dialectics, and use the world outlook and methodology reflected in Comrade Xiaoping's works to learn Comrade Xiaoping's scientific conclusions. Third, on the basis of carefully reading and understanding the original works, organize discussions around some major issues. Learning must be independent thinking, and it also requires brainstorming. Only by combining the two can learning be in-depth. In the discussion, we should implement the ideological line of emancipating the mind and seeking truth from facts, advocate in-depth thinking, bold exploration, open-mindedness, expressing opinions, and learning from each other's strengths and weaknesses.
Fourth, carry forward the style of study that combines theory with practice, and pay attention to summing up experience and lessons. In combination with learning, seriously reflect on the practice of implementing the party's basic line, think about which of your own understandings and practices are correct and should be adhered to, and whether there are any vague understandings that need to be clarified. What experience and lessons should be learned in work, and are there any problems and areas for improvement that need to be vigilant in the process of moving forward. Doing a good job in combining theory with practice will greatly help improve your own ideological level and leadership level.
Hu Jintao emphasized that the "Decision of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Several Issues Concerning the Establishment of a Socialist Market Economic System" adopted by the Third Plenary Session of the 14th Central Committee has built the basic framework of the socialist market economic system, indicating that after our party has made a major breakthrough in the theory of establishing a new economic system, it has begun a great leap forward in practice. He said that in the reform and opening up of socialist China, a new situation will emerge, with the implementation of the "Decision" as the main content, the initial establishment of a socialist market economic system and the realization of a well-off life for the people by the end of this century as the basic goal, the comprehensive deepening of reform, further expansion of opening up, and better and faster promotion of economic development and social progress. This is a new situation that connects the past and the future and faces the 21st century. It is a new situation that plays a key role in achieving the third step of the strategic goal. All our work must adapt to and promote the development of this new situation. Hu Jintao finally hoped that all the participants would take the study of this seminar as a new starting point, unremittingly study Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, and use this theory as a guide to continuously create a new situation in their respective work. The second theoretical seminar for major provincial and ministerial leaders will start on November 2.

translated_text: On the 8th, the People's Daily reported that the Organization Department and the Ministry of Personnel of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China recently jointly issued the "Notice on Not Charging Fees in the Approval Procedures for Official Travel Abroad". The "Notice" pointed out that according to reports, some organizations, personnel departments and approval units for official travel abroad have set their own regulations and charged varying amounts of fees in the approval procedures for official travel abroad. This practice has increased the burden on grassroots units, is not conducive to the ideological and work style construction of organizations and personnel departments, and has damaged the image of party and government agencies. The "Notice" emphasized that handling the review and approval procedures for official travel abroad is a task within the scope of the responsibilities of organizations and personnel departments at all levels, and should be done conscientiously and responsibly in strict accordance with the spirit of relevant central documents to serve reform, opening up and economic construction. Organizations, personnel departments and approval departments for official travel abroad at all levels shall not arbitrarily set fees for any reason in the review and approval procedures for official travel abroad. The talent mobility agencies under the personnel departments of governments at all levels shall charge fees for the review procedures for the mobile personnel under their management to go abroad in accordance with the relevant regulations of the Ministry of Personnel, the Ministry of Finance and the National Price Bureau, and shall not expand the scope of fees or increase the fee standards without authorization. The "Notice" requires that all regions and departments should conduct a serious inspection and clean up whether there are any fees charged in the approval procedures for personnel going abroad on official business in their regions and departments, and immediately abolish the fee regulations made by themselves; the fees that have been collected should be handled according to different situations.

For example, reform will undoubtedly promote the improvement of people's lives in general, but not everyone's life will improve accordingly; many people have opinions on the various unhealthy trends in the party and society and the problems in social security, and some cadres have insufficient understanding of the significance of social stability, etc. Our cadres, especially leading cadres at all levels, must have a clear understanding of this. He stressed that in dealing with the relationship between reform, development and stability, we must adhere to seeking truth from facts and proceed from reality when determining reform and development measures; we must adhere to contact with the masses, listen to their voices at all times and in all places, respect their initiative and safeguard their interests; we must adhere to respecting practice, test existing experience with practice, and explore new experience in practice; we must work hard and drive the improvement of social atmosphere with the integrity and self-discipline of the cadre team. He said that as long as we always keep a clear mind in the process of building a socialist market economic system, pay attention to accumulating information at any time, conscientiously sum up experience, and correct mistakes in a timely manner, we will be able to avoid major setbacks and lead the people to complete this great task of creating history.

translated_text:
On the 11th, the People's Daily reported that the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council recently issued the "Notice on Strictly Prohibiting Extravagance and Waste in Eating, Drinking and Giving Gifts with Public Funds during the New Year's Day and Spring Festival in 1994". The "Notice" pointed out that the new year is coming. In order to have a festive, joyful, clean and honest New Year's Day and Spring Festival, and to promote the in-depth development of the anti-corruption struggle with practical actions, with the approval of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, the following requirements are now reiterated: 
We must streamline meetings and various celebrations and commendation activities, and resolutely not hold meetings that can be avoided. If it is really necessary to hold a meeting, we must also pay attention to frugality. 
We must vigorously advocate a civilized and frugal style, strictly prohibit the use of public funds for extravagant eating and drinking, and resolutely oppose unhealthy practices such as extravagance and waste. 
--It is not allowed to use public funds to give gifts and various securities, nor is it allowed to accept such gifts and securities. 
It is not allowed for subordinate units to give local specialties and other gifts to superior units or superior leaders, and for local governments to give gifts to central and state agencies. Leading agencies and leading cadres should take the lead in observing discipline and being honest and self-disciplined. No unit or individual is allowed to use public funds to organize or participate in high-consumption entertainment activities. The "Notice" emphasizes that the Party Central Committee, the State Council and the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection have made clear requirements to stop the use of public funds for eating, drinking, giving gifts, squandering and other unhealthy practices, and all regions, departments and units must resolutely implement them.

translated_text: From the 16th to the 24th, Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, inspected work in Yunnan Province. 成果,各级党政领导班子和纪检监察机关要对前一段反腐败斗争
工作情况进行一次回顾和检查,看看工作中还存在哪些问题和薄
弱环节,已取得的成果与中央和群众的要求还有哪些差距,在此基

translated_text: On the same day, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and the Ministry of Supervision jointly issued the "Notice on Unremittingly Grasping the Three Tasks of the Central Anti-Corruption Struggle in the Near Future". The "Notice" pointed out that in order to further grasp the three tasks of the central anti-corruption struggle in the near future and achieve significant phased results, the party and government leadership teams at all levels and the discipline inspection and supervision agencies should review and examine the previous anti-corruption work to see what problems and weak links still exist in the work, and what gaps there are between the results achieved and the requirements of the central government and the masses. On this basis, clarify responsibilities, take measures, and implement the three tasks one by one in a targeted manner. From now until the Spring Festival of 1994 is a critical period for achieving significant phased results in the anti-corruption struggle. All regions and departments must grasp the work. Before the Spring Festival, we must further consolidate and expand the achievements of the integrity and self-discipline of leading cadres. The situation of the democratic life meetings of the leading groups at or above the county level should be reported within an appropriate scope and subject to the comments and supervision of the masses; the problems found in self-examination should be handled in accordance with relevant regulations; departments and units that are ineffective in self-examination and self-correction and the masses are dissatisfied with the results of self-examination and self-correction should be seriously remedial; the very few cadres who have great public complaints and do not self-examination and self-correction should be checked and dealt with strictly after verification. We must increase the efforts to investigate and handle major cases. For cases with clear facts and conclusive evidence, especially those involving leading cadres, we must speed up the closure of the cases and selectively announce a number of cases with major impacts to the public; people or things that interfere with the investigation and handling of cases should be decisively dealt with. We must severely curb unhealthy tendencies, continue to thoroughly clean up the problems of arbitrary charges and the use of public funds for overseas travel, and promptly announce the cancellation of projects with arbitrary charges. For the projects that have been announced to be cancelled, we must organize forces to supervise and inspect and ensure that they are implemented. The leading organs with industry management responsibilities should continue to do a good job in rectifying the unhealthy tendencies in their industries. During this period, the New Year's Day and the Spring Festival coincided. The General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council issued the "Notice on Strictly Prohibiting the Extravagance of Using Public Funds for Eating, Drinking and Giving Gifts during the New Year's Day and the Spring Festival in 1994", reiterating the five provisions, which is a powerful promotion for the implementation of the three recent anti-corruption tasks of the central government. Party committees, governments and discipline inspection and supervision agencies at all levels should implement them conscientiously in light of the actual conditions of their regions and departments. Whether or not we can have a clean, honest, festive and joyful New Year's Day and Spring Festival should be used as a practical test of the results of the party's style and clean government construction and the anti-corruption struggle during this period. The discipline inspection and supervision agencies should do a good job in the publicity of the "Notice" and strengthen supervision and inspection of the implementation. Those who violate the rules in defiance of the rules should be strictly enforced and severely punished, and no tolerance should be shown. Those with serious circumstances and bad influence should be reported publicly. The implementation of the five provisions of the "Notice" should be closely combined with the implementation of the three recent anti-corruption tasks of the central government, so as to ensure that the anti-corruption struggle in this stage will achieve obvious results.

26日 中共中央、全国人大常委会、国务院、中央军委在首都
隆重举行大会,纪念中国共产党、中国人民解放军、中华人民共和
国的主要缔造者,中国各族人民的伟大领袖毛泽东同志诞辰 100
周年。党和国家领导人江泽民、李鹏、乔石、李瑞环、朱镕基、刘华
清、胡锦涛、荣毅仁等和首都各界1万多人出席了大会。中共中央
政治局常委、国务院总理李鹏主持大会。中共中央总书记江泽民在
会上发表长篇重要讲话。江泽民在讲话中高度评价了毛泽东同志
的丰功伟绩。江泽民指出,以毛泽东同志为主要代表的中国共产党
人,根据马克思列宁主义的基本原理,对中国长期革命和实践中的
一系列经验进行理论概括,形成了适合中国情况的科学指导思想,
这就是毛泽东思想。
江泽民说,1978年12月,我们党胜利召开十一届三中全会,
实现在党的历史上具有深远意义的伟大转折。邓小平同志在领导
我们党和国家摆脱“文化大革命”造成的深重灾难,进行指导思想
上的拨乱反正中,用极大的精力来解决正确评价毛泽东同志和毛
泽东思想的问题。邓小平指出,没有毛主席,至少我们中国人民还
要在黑暗中探索更长的时间。毛泽东同志的功绩是第一位的,他晚
年的错误是第二位的,他的错误是由于违反了他自己正确的东西,
他的错误是一个伟大的革命家,一个伟大的马克思主义者所犯的
错误。不仅今天,而且今后,我们都要高举毛泽东思想的旗帜。
江泽民说,在中国历史发展的这个重要阶段,邓小平把马克思
主义基本原理同中国实际和时代特征结合起来,继承和发展毛泽
东思想,以开辟社会主义建设新道路的巨大政治勇气和开拓马克
思主义新境界的巨大理论勇气,集中全党全国人民的智慧,创造
性地提出了建设有中国特色社会主义的理论。他说,我们党在70
多年的奋斗历程中,在自己的旗帜上写着马克思主义,写着马克思
列宁主义与中国革命的实践之统一的思想——邓小平建设有中国
特色社会主义的理论。
江泽民说,邓小平是我国社会主义改革开放和现代化建设的
总设计师。改革开放,是他创造性地发展毛泽东思想,发展马克思
列宁主义关于建设社会主义理论的最突出贡献。邓小平建设有中
国特色社会主义理论的形成,表明我们党对中国社会主义建设客
观规律的认识达到一个新的境界,也表明我们党领导的建设富强、
民主、文明的社会主义现代化国家的实践进入一个新的历史阶段。
江泽民说,今后无论发生什么情况,我们都要坚定不移地贯彻
执行党的基本路线,一百年不动摇。他说,我们必须坚定不移地发
展社会主义市场经济,推动我国社会生产力的迅速发展;必须坚持
发展社会主义民主,努力建设和完善有中国特色的民主政治,必须
大力加强社会主义精神文明建设,促进全体人民的思想道德和科
学文化素质的不断提高。要全面实现社会主义现代化建设的宏伟
任务,关键是用邓小平建设有中国特色社会主义理论武装全党,把
我们党建设好。他要求中国共产党党员要牢牢记住,我们应该而且
必须永远成为中国各族人民利益的忠诚的代表和维护者。
translated_text: On the 26th, the CPC Central Committee, the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, the State Council, and the Central Military Commission held a grand meeting in the capital to commemorate the 100th anniversary of the birth of Comrade Mao Zedong, the main founder of the Communist Party of China, the Chinese People's Liberation Army, and the People's Republic of China, and the great leader of the Chinese people of all ethnic groups. Party and state leaders Jiang Zemin, Li Peng, Qiao Shi, Li Ruihuan, Zhu Rongji, Liu Huaqing, Hu Jintao, Rong Yiren, and more than 10,000 people from all walks of life in the capital attended the meeting. Li Peng, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Premier of the State Council, presided over the meeting. Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, delivered a long and important speech at the meeting. In his speech, Jiang Zemin highly praised the great achievements of Comrade Mao Zedong. Jiang Zemin pointed out that the Chinese Communists, with Comrade Mao Zedong as the main representative, based on the basic principles of Marxism-Leninism, theoretically summarized a series of experiences in China's long-term revolution and practice, and formed a scientific guiding ideology suitable for China's situation, which is Mao Zedong Thought. Jiang Zemin said that in December 1978, our party successfully held the Third Plenary Session of the Eleventh Central Committee, achieving a great turning point with far-reaching significance in the history of the party. Comrade Deng Xiaoping used great energy to solve the problem of correctly evaluating Comrade Mao Zedong and Mao Zedong Thought in leading our party and country to get rid of the profound disaster caused by the "Cultural Revolution" and rectifying the chaos in guiding ideology. Deng Xiaoping pointed out that without Chairman Mao, at least we Chinese people would have to explore in the darkness for a longer time. Comrade Mao Zedong's achievements are the first, and his mistakes in his later years are the second. His mistakes were due to violating his own correct things. His mistakes were made by a great revolutionary and a great Marxist. Not only today, but also in the future, we must hold high the banner of Mao Zedong Thought. Jiang Zemin said that at this important stage in China's historical development, Deng Xiaoping combined the basic principles of Marxism with China's reality and the characteristics of the times, inherited and developed Mao Zedong Thought, and with great political courage to open up a new path for socialist construction and great theoretical courage to open up new horizons for Marxism, he concentrated the wisdom of the whole party and the people of the whole country and creatively put forward the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics. He said that in the course of our party's struggle for more than 70 years, it has written Marxism on its banner, and the thought of the unity of Marxism-Leninism and the practice of the Chinese revolution - Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics. Jiang Zemin said that Deng Xiaoping is the chief architect of my country's socialist reform and opening up and modernization. Reform and opening up is his most outstanding contribution to the creative development of Mao Zedong Thought and the development of Marxism-Leninism on the theory of building socialism. The formation of Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics shows that our party's understanding of the objective laws of China's socialist construction has reached a new level, and it also shows that the practice of building a prosperous, democratic and civilized socialist modern country under the leadership of our party has entered a new historical stage. Jiang Zemin said that no matter what happens in the future, we must unswervingly implement the party's basic line and never waver for a hundred years. He said that we must unswervingly develop the socialist market economy and promote the rapid development of our country's social productivity; we must persist in developing socialist democracy, strive to build and improve democratic politics with Chinese characteristics, and we must vigorously strengthen the construction of socialist spiritual civilization and promote the continuous improvement of the ideological and moral and scientific and cultural qualities of all the people. To fully realize the grand task of socialist modernization, the key is to arm the whole party with Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and build our party well. He asked the members of the Communist Party of China to remember that we should and must always be loyal representatives and defenders of the interests of the Chinese people of all ethnic groups.

30日 中共中央组织部、中共中央统战部、国家民族事务委
员会印发《关于进一步做好培养选拔少数民族干部工作的意见》。
其主要内容是:(一)进一步提高认识,明确做好培养选拔少数民族
干部工作的指导思想和主要任务。(二)加强培养教育,全面提高少
数民族干部队伍的素质。当前,要贯彻好中央关于学习《邓小平文
选》第三卷的决定,组织好广大少数民族干部,尤其是中、高级干部
的学习,增强贯彻执行党的基本路线的自觉性,坚定性和创造性。
大力开展文化､业务培训。加强实践培养锻炼。各级党校要切实承
担起培训少数民族干部的任务。(三)加强民族地区基层干部队伍
建设和少数民族专业技术干部队伍建设。可建立民族干部学校。有
计划地挑选一批有能力,适合于从事经济工作的少数民族干部,经
必要培训后输送到经济部门或企业工作。各普通高等院校和中等
专业技术学校,要有计划地增加少数民族学生名额。(四)做好少数
民族领导干部的选配工作。大胆地把那些在改革开放和经济建设
中政绩突出,群众拥护的优秀少数民族干部选拔到各级领导岗位,
尤其要注意挑选政治素质好、熟悉经济工作、勇于开拓的少数民族
干部进党政领导班子;特别优秀的可破格提拔。要重视培养选拔少
数民族中、高级干部,要切实加强和改进培养选拔少数民族后备干
部工作。
据中共中央组织部统计,截至1993年底,全国各级党
政群机关干部和企事业单位、中小学校的管理人员、专业技术人员
共有3699万多人(其中聘用人员508万多人)。各类机构人员均比
上一年有不同程度的增长。
据统计,各级党政群机关干部666万多人,比上一年增加了4
万多人,增长幅度仅为0.68%,是近10年来增加数量和增长幅度
最小的一年。1992 年一年中,有20余万名优秀中青年干部被选拔
到各级领导岗位,其中担任省(部)级职务的239人,地(厅)级职务
的 3105人,县(处)级职务的3万多人,乡(科)级职务的17万人,
担任乡(科)级职务的比上一年增加了1万多人。从各类机构人员
的变化情况看,各级组织、人事部门加强了对党政群机关干部的宏
观调控,近几年机关干部一直较大幅度增长的势头已得到有效的
抑制。但是,从各类人员增长总量看,仍不容乐观。
translated_text: On the 30th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the United Front Work Department of the CPC Central Committee, and the State Ethnic Affairs Commission issued the "Opinions on Further Improving the Work of Training and Selecting Minority Cadres". Its main contents are: (i) Further improve awareness and clarify the guiding ideology and main tasks of training and selecting minority cadres. (ii) Strengthen training and education to comprehensively improve the quality of minority cadres. At present, we must implement the Central Committee's decision on studying the third volume of "Selected Works of Deng Xiaoping", organize the study of the majority of minority cadres, especially middle and senior cadres, and enhance the consciousness, firmness and creativity of implementing the party's basic line. Vigorously carry out cultural and professional training. Strengthen practical training and exercise. Party schools at all levels must earnestly undertake the task of training minority cadres. (iii) Strengthen the construction of grassroots cadres in ethnic areas and the construction of minority professional and technical cadres. Ethnic cadre schools can be established. Plan to select a group of capable and suitable minority cadres for economic work and send them to work in economic departments or enterprises after necessary training. All ordinary colleges and universities and secondary professional and technical schools should plan to increase the number of minority students. (IV) Do a good job in selecting and assigning leading cadres of ethnic minorities. Boldly select outstanding ethnic minority cadres who have made outstanding achievements in reform and opening up and economic construction and are supported by the masses to leadership positions at all levels. In particular, pay attention to selecting ethnic minority cadres with good political qualities, familiarity with economic work, and courage to explore to join the party and government leadership team; particularly outstanding ones can be promoted by exception. We must attach importance to the training and selection of middle- and senior cadres of ethnic minorities, and we must effectively strengthen and improve the training and selection of reserve cadres of ethnic minorities. According to statistics from the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, as of the end of 1993, there were more than 36.99 million cadres of party, government and mass organizations at all levels and management personnel and professional and technical personnel of enterprises, institutions, primary and secondary schools (including more than 5.08 million hired personnel). The number of personnel in various institutions has increased to varying degrees compared with the previous year. According to statistics, there are more than 6.66 million cadres in party, government and mass organizations at all levels, an increase of more than 40,000 over the previous year, with an increase of only 0.68%, which is the smallest increase in number and growth rate in the past 10 years. In 1992, more than 200,000 outstanding young and middle-aged cadres were selected to leadership positions at all levels, including 239 provincial (ministerial) level positions, 3,105 prefectural (bureau) level positions, more than 30,000 county (division) level positions, and 170,000 township (section) level positions. The number of township (section) level positions increased by more than 10,000 over the previous year. Judging from the changes in personnel in various institutions, organizations and personnel departments at all levels have strengthened macro-control of cadres in party, government and mass organizations, and the momentum of a significant increase in cadres in recent years has been effectively curbed. However, judging from the total growth of various types of personnel, it is still not optimistic.

events:
19日 中共中央宣传部、中共中央组织部、中共中央政策研
究室印发《关于农村社会主义思想教育工作的总结报告》。《报告》
的主要内容是:
(一)两年多来工作发展的基本情况。
(二)主要成效和基本经验。主要有六个方面:(1)用邓小平同
志建设有中国特色社会主义理论和党的基本路线武装广大农村干
部和群众,为加快奔小康步伐打好思想基础。(2)紧紧扭住经济建
设这个中心不放,努力促进农村改革的深化和经济的发展。(3)加
强以党支部为核心的基层组织建设,为加快农村经济发展和社会
进步提供组织保证。各地按照中央的部署,都把加强以党支部为核
心的基层组织建设作为重点来抓,努力在农村基层建设一支“不走
的工作队”。在教育活动中,全国农村共整顿后进党支部66150个,
有变化的52432个,转化率一般为70%以上。(4)在解决实际问题
的过程中抓好思想教育,做到虚实结合。(5)严格执行政策,做到既
解决问题,又不伤害干部群众。(6)党委统一领导,各方面通力协
作,形成加强农村基层工作的合力。
(三)对今后工作的几点意见。(1)地,县委要切实把工作重心
和主要精力放在农村工作上。做出规划,用三、五年时间把农村基
层组织切实建设好。(2)各地各部门要经常保持一批机关干部驻乡
驻村工作。(3)县以上各有关部门都要在党委和政府的领导下,坚
持面向农村,服务农业,密切配合,协同行动,争取实现农业的新突
破,为农村改革和发展做出积极贡献。(4)在农村基层建设中,要始
终抓住以党支部为核心的村级组织配套建设,有计划地选拔、培养
党支部书记和村委会主任,大力搞好村级组织各项工作的制度建
设,进一步做好在优秀青年农民中发展党员的工作。对经济发展长
期缓慢和社会矛盾突出的乡村.要及时选派强有力的干部下去,帮
助解决问题,化解矛盾,进行必要的整顿。
translated_text:
On the 19th, the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, and the Policy Research Office of the CPC Central Committee issued the "Summary Report on Rural Socialist Ideological Education Work". The main contents of the "Report" are: (I) The basic situation of the development of work over the past two years. (II) The main achievements and basic experiences. There are six main aspects: (1) Arming the broad masses of rural cadres and the masses with Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and the party's basic line, and laying a good ideological foundation for accelerating the pace of building a moderately prosperous society. (2) Tightly grasping the center of economic construction, and strive to promote the deepening of rural reform and economic development. (3) Strengthening the construction of grassroots organizations with party branches as the core, and providing organizational guarantees for accelerating rural economic development and social progress. In accordance with the deployment of the central government, all localities have focused on strengthening the construction of grassroots organizations with party branches as the core, and strived to build a "non-moving work team" at the grassroots level in rural areas.
