translated_text: From the 21st to the 24th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee held a national party member education work conference in Beijing. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Central Secretariat, Wei Jianxing, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, Secretary of the Secretariat and Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, Lv Feng, Minister of the Central Organization Department, Deputy Ministers Song Defu, Zhao Zongnai and Zhang Quanjing, Xu Weicheng, Deputy Minister of the Central Propaganda Department, heads of relevant central departments, and heads of the Organization Departments, Propaganda Departments and Discipline Inspection Commissions of the Party Committees of provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities directly under the Central Government and some cities attended the meeting. The meeting proposed that the general requirements for party member education work are to adhere to the guidance of Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and the basic line of the Party, closely focus on economic construction, comprehensively improve the quality of the party members, enhance the combat effectiveness of the party organization, and mobilize the whole party to unite and strive for the establishment of a socialist market economic system and the realization of the second step strategic goal, and to fully implement the various strategic tasks proposed by the 14th National Congress of the Party. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Central Secretariat, delivered an important speech at the meeting. Hu Jintao pointed out that the new situation and new tasks require further strengthening and improving the education of party members and comprehensively improving the quality of the party members. Arming the broad masses of party members with the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics is the most important improvement in the education of party members in the new era; doing this work well is the most effective strengthening of the education of party members; if this work is done well, the ideological construction of the party and the entire party construction will have new progress, and the success of the socialist modernization construction will be more guaranteed. Hu Jintao said that Comrade Deng Xiaoping repeatedly emphasized the need to build our party well in the process of leading us to open up the road of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and to carry out new entrepreneurship, especially at important junctures. Comrade Deng Xiaoping's thoughts on the construction of the ruling party in the new era have greatly enriched and developed the party-building theories of Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought, and have a series of new viewpoints, new propositions, and new creations. We must study and master them well to guide the construction of the party. After listing some of Comrade Deng Xiaoping's statements on strengthening the party's ideological construction, doing a good job in party member education, and improving the quality of party members in the new era, Hu Jintao said that he hoped that comrades engaged in party construction and party member education would systematically study and research the relevant ideas in Comrade Xiaoping's works, deeply understand the essence of the spirit, link the practice of party member education in recent years, seriously summarize the experience and lessons, further improve the level of work, and do better in the future. Hu Jintao emphasized that the party member education work should take the use of Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics as the fundamental task to arm the whole party, thereby driving the completion of other education tasks. He pointed out that arming the whole party with the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics is a fundamental measure to strengthen and improve party construction and comprehensively improve the quality of party members, which is related to the future and destiny of our party, country and nation. Party organizations at all levels must work hard to do a good job in this ideological construction project that concerns fundamental matters. At present, we should organize party members and cadres to study the third volume of Selected Works of Deng Xiaoping and combine it with studying and implementing the decisions of the Third Plenary Session of the 14th Central Committee, guide everyone to use the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics to guide the reform practice of accelerating the establishment of a socialist market economic system, and strive to achieve practical results on three issues: (a) Strengthen the firmness and consciousness of establishing a socialist market economic system and developing a socialist market economy, further unify thoughts with the spirit of the 14th National Congress and the Third Plenary Session of the 14th Central Committee, and firmly implement the various decisions made by the Central Committee to promote reform. (b) Strive to master the knowledge of developing a socialist market economy, continuously improve the ability to control the socialist market economy, use new concepts that meet the requirements of establishing a new economic system to understand and deal with problems, and quickly connect their working methods with the process and measures of deepening reform. (III) Consciously strengthen the Party spirit in the development of the socialist market economy, study hard and work actively to establish a new economic system, correctly view certain interest adjustments that must be made in deepening reform, correctly handle the relationship between the whole and the part, the collective and the individual, adhere to the Party's ideals and beliefs, adhere to correct values, adhere to integrity and self-discipline, and withstand the new tests faced in the new era. Hu Jintao said that in the past few years, our Party has accumulated rich experience in educating Party members and formed many good forms and methods, which should undoubtedly be adhered to. At the same time, it must be seen that with the deepening of reform and opening up, the environment and conditions in which Party members live have changed greatly compared with the past. In this case, it is not enough to rely on the previous methods to do a good job in Party member education. It must be strengthened in the process of improvement and more efforts must be made to achieve practical results. First, we must closely link the practice of implementing the party's basic line and persist in serving reform, development and stability; second, we must make good use of theoretical weapons, be targeted, and strengthen the pertinence, persuasiveness and attractiveness of education; third, we must combine strengthening education and solving ideological problems with caring for party members and solving practical problems; fourth, we must combine strengthening party member education with improving management and enforcing party discipline; fifth, we must combine strengthening party member education management with strengthening grassroots party organization construction. Hu Jintao requires party committees at all levels to take the lead in implementing the principle of "the party must manage the party" and strengthen and improve the leadership of party member education. We must improve leadership methods, change work style, strengthen macro-guidance and specific supervision and inspection, strengthen investigation and research, and seriously analyze the new changes brought about by the great change of establishing a socialist market economic system to party members' values, thoughts, emotions and mental states. We must regularly summarize and promote the successful practices of strengthening party member education created by the grassroots, constantly accumulate experience in practice, gradually master the laws of party member education work under the new situation, and do a good job in party member education. On February 19, the Organization Department and the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee issued "Speech by Comrade Hu Jintao, Comrade Zhao Zong, and Comrade Liu Yunshan at the National Party Member Education Work Conference".

translated_text:
On the 25th and 26th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China held a national symposium for organization ministers in Beijing. The heads of the organization departments of the provincial, regional and municipal party committees attended the symposium. At the meeting, Zhang Quanjing, executive vice minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, delivered a speech entitled "Fully completing the tasks of organizational work in 1994". In his speech at the end of the national symposium for organization ministers, Lv Feng, Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, pointed out that now we are facing a new, more extensive and more profound change, that is, the transition from the long-term planned economic system to the establishment of a socialist market economic system. This great transformation has put forward new and higher requirements for the party's organizational work. In the process of establishing a socialist market economic system, the construction of grassroots party organizations and the work of cadres have encountered a large number of unprecedented new situations and new problems. For example, under the planned economic system, social members are relatively stable. In a unit or a certain area, many people do not move for decades. In the process of establishing a socialist market economic system, with the flow of labor, the mobility of party members is also increasing. How to strengthen the education and management of mobile party members has become a new topic in organizational work. Now there are some methods in various places, but we need to further explore and improve them, and create new methods and new ways. For example, under the planned economic system, the grassroots organizations of the Party were basically set up and managed according to administrative divisions, and the Party organizations in various social organizations were basically managed in the same way. However, under the conditions of the continuous development of the socialist market economy and the gradual formation of a new economic system, various new economic organizations have emerged one after another. How to set up the Party organizations and how to keep up with the Party work also needs to be actively explored. When studying and solving new problems, some good practices in the past that have been proven to be effective today should continue to be adhered to; those that are basically applicable but not perfect should be improved; those that are no longer applicable should be boldly explored and replaced with new methods. Lu Feng emphasized that in the situation of the transition from the old to the new system, comrades in the organization department should further emancipate their minds and update their concepts. Now, new problems and new contradictions continue to emerge, and it is becoming more and more important to strengthen the investigation and research and macro-guidance of organizational work. We must not only do a good job in daily specific work, but also strengthen the investigation and research of macro-guidance, provide guidance from the perspectives of ideological theory, policy regulations, and system construction, and take the initiative in work. This is a fundamental measure for us to improve our methods, change our work style, and improve our work level.
Lv Feng pointed out that the organization departments at all levels should further strengthen their own construction, arm themselves with the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, strive to improve their ideological and work levels, and take effective measures to stabilize the ranks of organization cadres.
On February 16, the Central Organization Department issued the "1994 Organization Work Points" and "Comrade Lv Feng and Comrade Zhang Quanjing's Speech at the Symposium of Organization Ministers of Provincial, Autonomous Region and Municipal Party Committees across the Country".

根本保证。我们要以邓小平同志建设有中国特色社会主义理论和

增强各级党组织在改革、发展和稳定中的凝聚力、吸引力、战斗力,
更好地发挥党的核心领导作用。邓小平同志建设有中国特色社会
主义的理论是我们进行改革开放和社会主义现代化建设丰富经验

全国离退休老干部已达700多万人。各级党委和政府要进一步提

部工作面临的新情况和新问题,总结新的经验。对老干部政治上要

善社会保障制度,及时研究､妥善解决老干部生活中出现的实际困
难,为他们老有所养、老有所为,老有所学、老有所乐,努力办实事、
办好事
translated_text: On the 1st, Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Central Secretariat, attended the Spring Festival Tea Party for Old Comrades held by the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and other departments and delivered a speech. In his speech, Hu Jintao pointed out that the Communist Party of China is the leading core of my country's socialist modernization. Further building our party well is the fundamental guarantee for winning the cause of building socialism with Chinese characteristics. We must take Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and the basic line of the Party as our guide, closely focus on economic construction, strive to adapt to the new situation of establishing a socialist market economic system, consciously adhere to the Party's nature as the vanguard of the working class and the purpose of serving the people wholeheartedly, further strengthen and improve Party building, enhance the cohesion, attraction and combat effectiveness of Party organizations at all levels in reform, development and stability, and better play the core leadership role of the Party. Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics is a theoretical summary of our rich experience in reform and opening up and socialist modernization, and is a spiritual pillar and scientific guide to guide us to continue to advance victoriously. In the new year, we will continue to organize the majority of cadres and party members to thoroughly study the third volume of Selected Works of Deng Xiaoping, and further implement the task of arming the whole party with the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics proposed by the 14th National Congress. We will earnestly strengthen the ideological and work style of the leadership team, adhere to and improve democratic centralism, and maintain a high degree of political, ideological and action unity of the whole party. In accordance with the "four modernizations" policy of the cadre team and the principle of both moral integrity and ability, we will vigorously cultivate and select outstanding young cadres. Hu Jintao pointed out that the work of veteran cadres is an important task of the Party and the government. At present, there are more than 7 million retired veteran cadres nationwide. Party committees and governments at all levels should further enhance their understanding of the work of veteran cadres, strengthen their leadership over the work of veteran cadres, earnestly study the new situations and new problems faced by the work of the veteran cadres, and summarize new experiences. We should care about veteran cadres politically and take care of them in their lives. We should closely combine the introduction of reform measures, gradually establish and improve the social security system, timely study and properly solve the practical difficulties in the lives of veteran cadres, and provide them with a place to live, something to do, something to learn, and something to enjoy, and strive to do practical and good things.

events: 1994年2月8日,劳动部、人事部颁发《《国务院关于职工工作时间的规定>的实施办法》。规定中华人民共和国境内的国家机关、社会团体、企业事业单位以及其他组织的职工从1994年3月1日起,实行每日8小时、平均每周工作44小时的工时制度。
translated_text: On February 8, 1994, the Ministry of Labor and the Ministry of Personnel issued the "Implementation Measures for the State Council's Provisions on Work Hours for Employees". It stipulates that from March 1, 1994, employees of state organs, social groups, enterprises, institutions and other organizations within the territory of the People's Republic of China shall implement a working hour system of 8 hours a day and an average of 44 hours a week.

们组织工作调查研究和宏观指导的主题。

务,就是从组织上保证社会主义市场经济体制的建立。以邓小平同
志 1992 年初发表重要谈话和党的十四大为标志,我国改革开放和

最近指出:“建立社会主义市场经济体制,加快现代化建设步伐,是

国人民要在稳定的政治局面下,实现两大奋斗目标。一个是发展的
目标,就是达到小康水平,实现社会主义现代化建设的第二步战略
目标:一个是改革的目标,就是初步建立社会主义市场经济体制。
改革和发展,紧密相关,相互促进。建立社会主义市场经济体制,不

革和发展这两大目标在稳定的环境里胜利实现,党的组织工作所

3月14日,中央组织部印发了《吕枫、赵宗同志在全国省、
区、市党委组织部调研工作会议上的讲话》。
translated_text:
From the 22nd to the 25th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China held a national research work meeting of the Organization Departments of the Provincial, Regional and Municipal Party Committees in Wuxi City, Jiangsu Province. The theme of the meeting was: Under the conditions of establishing a socialist market economic system, how to strengthen and improve organizational work and strengthen the macro-guidance of organizational work, research and deployment of research work; coordinate the research topics of organizational work in 1994; select and award outstanding research results of organizational work in 1993. Minister of the Central Organization Department Lv Feng and Deputy Minister Zhao Zong attended the meeting and delivered speeches at the meeting. The meeting pointed out that adhering to investigation and research is the basis for our planning and the way to achieve success. The fundamental purpose of strengthening the investigation and research of organizational work and macro-guidance is to propose methods and measures to improve work through investigation and research of new situations and new problems in organizational work, reform those organizational systems and cadre systems that are not in line with the requirements of the development of the situation, resolve the contradictions and problems that have emerged, further strengthen and improve party building, strengthen and improve party leadership, and make the party a strong core in leading the construction of socialism with Chinese characteristics. This is the theme of our investigation and research and macro-guidance of organizational work. The meeting stressed that at present and in the future, a major historical task of organizational work is to ensure the establishment of a socialist market economic system from an organizational perspective. With Comrade Deng Xiaoping’s important speech in early 1992 and the 14th National Congress of the Communist Party of China as the symbol, my country’s reform and opening up and modernization construction have entered a new historical development period. Comrade Jiang Zemin recently pointed out: "Establishing a socialist market economic system and accelerating the pace of modernization construction are the great historical tasks of the new period." Generally speaking, from now until the end of this century, the whole party and the people of the whole country must achieve two major goals under a stable political situation. One is the goal of development, which is to achieve a well-off level and realize the second strategic goal of socialist modernization construction; the other is the goal of reform, which is to initially establish a socialist market economic system. Reform and development are closely related and promote each other. The establishment of a socialist market economic system can not only provide a strong impetus for the realization of the second strategic goal of my country's modernization construction, but also create an important premise for the realization of the third strategic goal. To ensure the successful realization of the two major goals of reform and development in a stable environment from an organizational perspective, the tasks facing the party's organizational work are indeed arduous and heavy. On March 14, the Central Organization Department issued "Speech by Comrades Lü Feng and Zhao Zong at the National Provincial,
District, and Municipal Party Committee Organization Department Research Work Conference".

events:
4日——7日 全国党校工作会议在北京举行。中共中央总书
记江泽民出席会议并发表讲话。江泽民指出,我们党历来重视学
习的。每当革命和建设发展到一个重大转折时期,全党面临新的形
势和任务的时候,更是特别强调加强学习。过去几十年来,我们党
的事业取得的每一个发展和每一个胜利,都是同全党同志的学习
进步密不可分的。延安时期,全国解放前夕,我们在全党开展的大
学习活动,成效尤为明显。十一届三中全会以后,我国社会主义事
业进入了新的发展时期,在邓小平同志倡导下,全党又开始了一次
重新学习。十几年来我国改革发展取得的伟大成就,在很大程度上
也是得益于学习。回顾历史,在我们党几十年积累的丰富经验中,
最重要的一条,就是坚持马克思主义基本原理同中国具体实际相
结合,坚定不移地走自己的路,根据各个时期党所面临的形势和任
务的需要,刻苦学习,不断地进行新的创业。正因为我们党有坚持
学习的优良传统,善于根据形势和任务的变化,不断推进和深化马
克思主义理论同中国具体实际相结合,我们党才能战胜艰难险阻,
由小到大,由弱到强,团结带领广大人民群众,在不同的历史时期
走出符合中国实际的革命和建设道路,开创新的局面,从胜利走向
新的胜利,
江泽民要求各级党委从社会主义现代化事业的战略全局,
从党和国家长治久安的高度来看待干部教育工作,看待党校的
重要地位和作用。坚决防止和克服只抓用人,不抓育人,重视使
用,轻视培养的短期行为,注意把干部的选拔,使用同培养、教育
结合起来。这些年各级党校的工作成绩很大,为党培养了许多领
导干部和理论人才。现在的问题是,党校要适应新的形势,提高
办学质量。各级党委务必要加强领导,指导党校围绕全党工作的
大局,把握正确的办学方向,努力深化改革。按照干部管理权限,
逐级负责,落实干部轮训培训任务。及时研究解决党校工作中的
重大问题。注意充实和加强党校领导班子和教师队伍,逐步改善
党校的办学条件。
中共中央政治局常委、书记处书记、中央党校校长胡锦涛在会
上作了重要讲话。胡锦涛讲了五个问题:(一)进一步明确党校工作
面临的新形势和新任务;(二)坚持用建设有中国特色社会主义理
论指导党校工作;(三)深化党校改革,全面提高党校工作水平;
(四)办好党校的关键在于建设一支素质优良的教师队伍;(五)切
实加强党委对党校工作的领导。
胡锦涛指出,在历史发展的关键时期,在新的形势和任务
前,我们必须比以往任何时候都更加重视党的思想理论建设,更加
重视用马列主义、毛泽东思想,特别是邓小平同志建设有中国特色
社会主义理论武装全党,更加重视培养和提高广大干部,造就时代
所需要的合格人才。他说,培养干部需要全党从多方面努力,各级
党校担负着特殊重要的责任。紧密结合改革开放和社会主义现代
化建设的实践,用邓小平同志建设有中国特色社会主义理论武装
领导干部,培养理论骨干,开展理论研究和宣传,是新形势下党校
的根本任务,也是党中央对党校工作的基本要求。要抓好现职领导
干部的培训轮训,努力提高他们探索解决新时期政治经济社会文
化基本问题的本领,提高总揽全局的能力、驾驭社会主义市场经济
的能力、“两手抓”的能力和处理复杂矛盾的能力。要切实抓好青年
干部的培训,加强对理论骨干的培养,做好理论研究和理论宣传工
作。
胡锦涛指出,要切实加强党委对党校工作的领导,主要抓好三
条:一是领导班子建设。要挑选一批有较高马克思主义理论水平、
较多实际工作经验而又热心党校教育事业的同志,充实党校领导
班子,并加强党校领导班子的思想作风建设。二是管好办学方向。
三是帮助解决党校工作的重大问题。胡锦涛充分肯定了党校教育
战线的同志付出的艰辛劳动、做出的重要成绩,希望从事党校工作
的同志进一步振奋精神,开拓进取,努力探索有中国特色的党校教
育新路子,使党校在建设有中国特色社会主义事业中发挥更大的
作用。
translated_text: From the 4th to the 7th, the National Party School Work Conference was held in Beijing. Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, attended the meeting and delivered a speech. Jiang Zemin pointed out that our party has always attached great importance to learning. Whenever the revolution and construction develop to a major turning point and the whole party faces new situations and tasks, it is particularly emphasized to strengthen learning. In the past few decades, every development and every victory of our party's cause is inseparable from the learning and progress of all party comrades. During the Yan'an period, on the eve of the national liberation, the large-scale learning activities we carried out throughout the party were particularly effective. After the Third Plenary Session of the Eleventh Central Committee, my country's socialist cause entered a new period of development. Under the advocacy of Comrade Deng Xiaoping, the whole party began to learn again. The great achievements made in my country's reform and development over the past decade have also benefited from learning to a large extent. Looking back on history, among the rich experience accumulated by our party over the past few decades, the most important one is to adhere to the combination of the basic principles of Marxism with China's specific reality, unswervingly follow its own path, and study hard and constantly carry out new entrepreneurship according to the needs of the situation and tasks faced by the party in each period. It is precisely because our Party has a fine tradition of persisting in learning and is good at continuously advancing and deepening the integration of Marxist theory with China's specific reality according to changes in the situation and tasks that our Party can overcome difficulties and obstacles, grow from small to large, from weak to strong, unite and lead the broad masses of the people, and in different historical periods, embark on a revolutionary and construction path that conforms to China's reality, create a new situation, and move from victory to new victory. Jiang Zemin requires Party committees at all levels to view cadre education work and the important position and role of Party schools from the strategic overall situation of the socialist modernization cause and from the perspective of the long-term stability of the Party and the country. Resolutely prevent and overcome the short-term behavior of only focusing on employing people, not cultivating people, attaching importance to use, and despising training, and pay attention to combining the selection and use of cadres with training and education. In recent years, the work of Party schools at all levels has made great achievements and cultivated many leading cadres and theoretical talents for the Party. The current problem is that Party schools must adapt to the new situation and improve the quality of education. Party committees at all levels must strengthen leadership, guide Party schools to focus on the overall situation of the work of the whole Party, grasp the correct direction of education, and strive to deepen reform. According to the authority of cadre management, each level shall be responsible for implementing the training tasks of cadre rotation. Major problems in the work of the Party School shall be studied and solved in a timely manner. Attention shall be paid to enriching and strengthening the leadership team and teaching staff of the Party School, and gradually improving the conditions for running the Party School. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, Secretary of the Secretariat, and President of the Central Party School, delivered an important speech at the meeting. Hu Jintao talked about five issues: (i) further clarify the new situation and new tasks facing the work of the Party School; (ii) adhere to the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics to guide the work of the Party School; (iii) deepen the reform of the Party School and comprehensively improve the level of the work of the Party School; (iv) the key to running a good Party School lies in building a team of high-quality teachers; (v) effectively strengthen the leadership of the Party Committee over the work of the Party School. Hu Jintao pointed out that in the critical period of historical development, in the face of new situations and tasks, we must attach more importance to the ideological and theoretical construction of the Party than ever before, attach more importance to arming the whole Party with Marxism-Leninism, Mao Zedong Thought, and especially Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, and attach more importance to cultivating and improving the vast number of cadres and creating qualified talents needed by the times. He said that training cadres requires the efforts of the whole party from many aspects, and party schools at all levels bear a special and important responsibility. Closely combining the practice of reform and opening up and socialist modernization, arming leading cadres with Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, training theoretical backbones, and carrying out theoretical research and propaganda are the fundamental tasks of party schools under the new situation and the basic requirements of the Party Central Committee for party school work. We must do a good job in the training and rotation of current leading cadres, strive to improve their ability to explore and solve basic political, economic, social and cultural problems in the new era, improve their ability to take charge of the overall situation, control the socialist market economy, "grasp both ends" and handle complex contradictions. We must do a good job in the training of young cadres, strengthen the training of theoretical backbones, and do a good job in theoretical research and theoretical propaganda. Hu Jintao pointed out that we must effectively strengthen the leadership of the Party Committee over the work of party schools, mainly focusing on three aspects: First, the construction of the leadership team. We must select a group of comrades with a high level of Marxist theory, more practical work experience and enthusiastic about the party school education cause, enrich the party school leadership team, and strengthen the ideological and style construction of the party school leadership team. Second, manage the direction of running schools well. The third is to help solve major problems in the work of the Party School. Hu Jintao fully affirmed the hard work and important achievements of the comrades in the Party School education front, and hoped that the comrades engaged in the work of the Party School would further boost their spirits, forge ahead, and strive to explore new ways of Party School education with Chinese characteristics, so that the Party School can play a greater role in building socialism with Chinese characteristics.

8日 中共中央党校第三期省部级主要领导干部学习《邓小
平文选》第三卷理论研讨班开学典礼。中共中央政治局委员、书记
处书记丁根主持会议。中共中央政治局常委、书记处书记胡锦涛
出席会议并发表了讲话。出席会议的有中共中央政治局候补委员、
书记处书记温家宝,书记处书记任建新,还有中共中央有关部门负
责同志曾庆红、吕枫、郑必坚、赵宗鼐、汪家锡、逄先知、苏星、龚育
之,郑科扬、陈福今等。中央党校举办的这期省部级主要领导干部
理论研讨班,共有学员44人。大多数是省、自治区、直辖市、中央和
国家机关部委、军队各大单位的一些主要负责同志,还有宣传理论
战线副部级以上领导干部和党的理论工作者。中共中央政治局常
委、书记处书记、中央党校校长胡锦涛在讲话中指出,坚持党的基
本路线不动摇的自觉性和坚定性,首先来自掌握邓小平同志建设
有中国特色社会主义理论的系统性和完整性。只有真正掌握这一
科学理论体系,才能更好地把握和坚持党的基本路线,做到在任何
情况下都不动摇。
胡锦涛指出,邓小平同志建设有中国特色社会主义理论是一
个完整的科学理论体系,是马克思主义在当代中国进入新境界､达
到新高度的集中体现。要真正掌握这个理论体系,做到融会贯通,
并不是一件容易的事情,必须结合实际,经常地学,反复地学,注意
从总体上,相互联系上全面地、正确地理解和掌握科学的理论体
系,尤其注意在以下三个方面下功夫。一是紧紧围绕“什么是社会
主义、怎样建设和发展社会主义”这个首要的基本的理论问题,力
求全面系统地把握这一理论中的基本观点,特别是其中的新思想、
新观点、新论断,把十四大报告概括的九个基本问题真正学懂弄
通。二是正确理解小平同志著作中一系列基本观点之间的内在联
系,完整､准确的把握“一个中心､两个基本点”的基本路线的理论
依据。三是抓住解放思想,实事求是这个精髓,理解和掌握贯穿在
小平同志著作中的辩证唯物主义、历史唯物主义的世界观和方法
论,避免和减少唯心论和形而上学。
胡锦涛指出,抓住机遇、深化改革、扩大开放,促进发展,保持
稳定,是中央确定的工作大局。辩证地理解和把握改革、发展、稳定
的关系,在实际工作中把三者有机地结合起来,是十多年来建设有
中国特色社会主义经验的总结,是全面贯彻党的基本路线在认识
和实践上的一个新的进步。
胡锦涛指出,对这个问题有了共识以后,关键就是要研究在我
们的领导工作中,应当从总体上抓住哪些重要环节做好工作,当前
应当着力解决哪些突出问题,才能维护大局,加快经济体制改革,
通过深化改革促进国民经济持续、快速、健康发展,在改革和发展
中保持社会稳定。胡锦涛指出,在《邓小平文选》第三卷中,反复强
调的一个重要思想,就是要坚持“两手抓”和“两手都要硬”。现在大
家越来越认识到,经济建设越发展,改革任务越重,情况越复杂,矛
盾越多,越要重视精神文明建设,越要注意用科学的理论武装人,
用正确的舆论引导人,用高尚的精神塑造人,用优秀的作品鼓舞
人。大家也都赞成坚持“两手抓,两手都要硬”的方针。怎样按照小
平同志的要求,在抓好物质文明建设的同时,使精神文明建设这一
手真正硬起来,收到实效;如何在改革开放的全过程中,深入、持
久,卓有成效地开展反腐败斗争,打击各种犯罪活动,加强廉政建
设;在建立社会主义市场经济体制的新形势下,如何加强和改善党
的领导,加强和改进党的自身建设,更好地在改革和现代化建设中
发挥领导核心作用。所有这些问题都需要我们进行深入的研究。
translated_text: On the 8th, the opening ceremony of the third theoretical seminar for provincial and ministerial level leading cadres to study the third volume of Selected Works of Deng Xiaoping was held at the Party School of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China. Ding Gen, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, presided over the meeting. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, attended the meeting and delivered a speech. Attending the meeting were Wen Jiabao, alternate member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, Ren Jianxin, Secretary of the Secretariat, and responsible comrades from relevant departments of the CPC Central Committee, including Zeng Qinghong, Lv Feng, Zheng Bijian, Zhao Zongnai, Wang Jiaxi, Pang Xianzhi, Su Xing, Gong Yuzhi, Zheng Keyang, Chen Fujin, etc. There were 44 students in this theoretical seminar for provincial and ministerial level leading cadres held by the Central Party School. Most of them were some major responsible comrades in provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities directly under the Central Government, central and state organs, and major military units, as well as deputy ministerial-level leading cadres and party theoretical workers on the propaganda theory front. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, Secretary of the Secretariat, and President of the Central Party School, pointed out in his speech that the consciousness and firmness of adhering to the Party's basic line unswervingly comes first from mastering the systematicness and integrity of Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics. Only by truly mastering this scientific theoretical system can we better grasp and adhere to the Party's basic line and remain unshakable under any circumstances. Hu Jintao pointed out that Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics is a complete scientific theoretical system, which is a concentrated embodiment of Marxism entering a new realm and reaching a new height in contemporary China. It is not an easy task to truly master this theoretical system and to master it thoroughly. It must be combined with reality, studied frequently, and repeatedly, and attention must be paid to comprehensively and correctly understanding and mastering the scientific theoretical system in general and in relation to each other, and especially to the following three aspects. First, we should closely focus on the primary and basic theoretical question of "what is socialism and how to build and develop socialism", strive to comprehensively and systematically grasp the basic viewpoints in this theory, especially the new ideas, new viewpoints and new conclusions, and truly learn and understand the nine basic issues summarized in the report of the 14th National Congress. Second, we should correctly understand the internal connection between a series of basic viewpoints in Comrade Xiaoping's works, and fully and accurately grasp the theoretical basis of the basic line of "one center and two basic points". Third, we should grasp the essence of emancipating the mind and seeking truth from facts, understand and master the world outlook and methodology of dialectical materialism and historical materialism that runs through Comrade Xiaoping's works, and avoid and reduce idealism and metaphysics. Hu Jintao pointed out that seizing opportunities, deepening reforms, expanding opening up, promoting development, and maintaining stability are the overall work determined by the Central Committee. Dialectically understanding and grasping the relationship between reform, development and stability, and organically combining the three in practical work is a summary of the experience of building socialism with Chinese characteristics over the past decade, and a new progress in the understanding and practice of fully implementing the Party's basic line. Hu Jintao pointed out that after reaching a consensus on this issue, the key is to study which important links should be grasped in our leadership work and which prominent issues should be focused on in order to maintain the overall situation, accelerate economic system reform, promote sustained, rapid and healthy development of the national economy through deepening reform, and maintain social stability in reform and development. Hu Jintao pointed out that an important idea repeatedly emphasized in the third volume of "Selected Works of Deng Xiaoping" is to adhere to "grasping both sides" and "both hands must be strong". Now everyone is increasingly aware that the more economic construction develops, the heavier the reform tasks, the more complicated the situation, and the more contradictions there are, the more attention should be paid to the construction of spiritual civilization, and the more attention should be paid to arming people with scientific theories, guiding people with correct public opinion, shaping people with noble spirits, and inspiring people with excellent works. Everyone also agrees to adhere to the policy of "grasping both sides and both hands must be strong". How to follow Comrade Xiaoping's requirements and make the spiritual civilization construction really hard and effective while doing a good job in the material civilization construction; how to carry out the anti-corruption struggle in-depth, long-term and effectively in the whole process of reform and opening up, crack down on various criminal activities and strengthen the construction of clean government; how to strengthen and improve the party's leadership and the party's own construction in the new situation of establishing a socialist market economic system, and better play the leading role in reform and modernization. All these issues require our in-depth research.

events: 18日 中共中央办公厅转发《中央组织部、中央宣传部关于加强和改进党员教育工作的若干意见》。《意见》的主要内容是:(--)做好党员教育工作是实现党在新时期历史任务的重要保证。(二)当前和今后一个时期党员教育工作的指导思想。(三)党员教育工作的根本任务。(四)坚持党员教育的基本原则,改进党员教育的方式方法。(五)加强对党员教育工作的领导和组织。23日 中共中央组织部印发《关于加强股份制企业中党的工作的几点意见》。《意见》强调,搞好股份制试点工作,必须坚持党的基本路线,按照党中央、国务院的有关规定和要求进行,既要大胆借鉴世界各国反映现代社会化生产规律的先进经验,又要继承和发扬我们自己的优势,加强党对股份制企业的领导,加强股份制企业中党的工作,充分发挥党组织的战斗堡垒作用和共产党员的先锋模范作用,以增强企业活力,促进社会主义市场经济的发展。《意见》指出,股份制企业中党的基层组织,处于政治核心地位,发挥政治核心作用,围绕生产经营开展工作。其主要任务是:(一)贯彻执行党的基本路线,保证监督党和国家的方针政策的贯彻执行:(二)对企业生产经营、技术开发、行政管理、人事管理等方面的重大问题提出意见和建议,参与企业重大问题的决策;(三)加强党组织的思想、组织、作风建设,在企业的改革和发展中充分发挥基层党组织的战斗堡垒作用和共产党员的先锋模范作用;(四)领导企业思想政治工作和精神文明建设,培育适应现代企业制度和企业发展要求的有理想、有道德、有文化、有纪律的职工队伍;(五)支持股东会(股东大会、董事会、监事会和经理(总经理)依法行使职权,领导职工代表大会和工会、共青团等群众组织,协调企业内部各方面的关系,引导、保护和发挥各方面的积极性,同心同德办好企业。《意见》指出,股份制企业党组织领导班子的配备,必须坚持干部队伍“四化”方针和德才兼备的原则。主要成员一般应具备做好党务工作与经济工作的双重素质。党组织负责人可与董事会、监事会负责人或经理、副经理适当交叉任职。条件具备的,党委书记和董事长,或者党委书记和总经理可由一人担任。规模较大、职工和党员人数较多的企业,应设专职党委副书记。党委成员进入董事会、监事会,董事、监事、经理、副经理进入党委班子要严格按照党章、公司法和其他有关规定办理。《意见》要求,在组建股份制企业时,党组织的设置与调整工作应同步考虑和安排。凡具备条件的,应及时建立党的基层委员会、总支部委员会和支部委员会。股份制企业中的股东会、董事会、监事会与党委会、职工代表大会、工会等组织,不能互相代替,但有关负责人员可以适当相互兼职。党组织要积极支持其他组织按照各自的章程和有关规定开展活动,主动协调好企业内部各方面的关系,通过强有力的思想政治工作和深入细致的群众工作,凝聚各方的力量,使之紧密配合,互相补充,共同推动企业的改革与发展。《意见》强调,股份制企业党组织要从企业资产结构、领导体制、经营机制、用工与分配制度等方面的特点出发,认真改进工作方法和活动方式。对企业生产经营方面的重大问题,党组织要认真讨论研究,向董事会、经理提出意见和建议,而不应直接决策和指挥。要把加强党的思想政治工作与培育企业精神,建设企业文化、解决职工实际问题结合起来。要在国家有关股份制企业的法律、法规的范围内,紧紧抓住生产经营这个中心,围绕企业的改革和发展,积极主动地开展党的活动。
translated_text:
On the 18th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee forwarded the "Several Opinions of the Organization Department and the Propaganda Department of the CPC Central Committee on Strengthening and Improving Party Member Education". The main contents of the "Opinions" are:
(--) Doing a good job in party member education is an important guarantee for achieving the party's historical tasks in the new era.
(II) The guiding ideology of party member education work at present and in the future. (III) The fundamental tasks of party member education work. (IV) Adhere to the basic principles of party member education and improve the methods and means of party member education. (V) Strengthen the leadership and organization of party member education work.
On the 23rd, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued "Several Opinions on Strengthening Party Work in Joint-Stock Enterprises". The "Opinions" emphasized that in order to do a good job in the joint-stock pilot work, we must adhere to the party's basic line and carry out it in accordance with the relevant regulations and requirements of the Party Central Committee and the State Council. We must boldly learn from the advanced experience of countries around the world that reflects the laws of modern socialized production, and inherit and carry forward our own advantages, strengthen the party's leadership over joint-stock enterprises, strengthen the party's work in joint-stock enterprises, and give full play to the role of party organizations as a fighting fortress and the vanguard and exemplary role of Communist Party members, so as to enhance the vitality of enterprises and promote the development of the socialist market economy.
The Opinion points out that the grassroots party organizations in joint-stock enterprises are in a political core position, play a political core role, and carry out work around production and operation. Its main tasks are:
(i) Implement the party's basic line and ensure the supervision of the implementation of the party and state policies and guidelines; (ii) Put forward opinions and suggestions on major issues in the production and operation, technological development, administrative management, personnel management and other aspects of the enterprise, and participate in the decision-making of major issues of the enterprise; (iii) Strengthen the ideological, organizational and style construction of the party organization, and give full play to the role of the grassroots party organization as a fighting fortress and the vanguard and exemplary role of the Communist Party members in the reform and development of the enterprise; (iv) Lead the ideological and political work and spiritual civilization construction of the enterprise, and cultivate an ideal, moral, cultural and disciplined workforce that adapts to the modern enterprise system and the requirements of enterprise development; (v) Support the shareholders' meeting (shareholders' meeting, board of directors, board of supervisors and manager (general manager) to exercise their powers in accordance with the law, and lead the party members to ... The workers' congress and mass organizations such as the trade union and the Communist Youth League coordinate the relationships within the enterprise, guide, protect and give full play to the enthusiasm of all parties, and work together to run the enterprise well. The "Opinion" points out that the leadership team of the party organization of a joint-stock enterprise must adhere to the "four modernizations" policy of the cadre team and the principle of both ability and political integrity. The main members should generally have the dual qualities of doing a good job in party affairs and economic work. The person in charge of the party organization can appropriately cross-appoint with the person in charge of the board of directors, the board of supervisors, or the manager and deputy manager. If conditions are met, the party secretary and chairman, or the party secretary and general manager can be held by one person. Enterprises with larger scale and a large number of employees and party members should have a full-time deputy secretary of the party committee. If the party secretary is separated from the chairman and general manager, the chairman or general manager can serve concurrently if he meets the conditions. Deputy Secretary of the Party Committee.
Members of the Party Committee shall enter the board of directors and the board of supervisors, and directors, supervisors, managers and deputy managers shall enter the Party Committee in strict accordance with the Party Constitution, the Company Law and other relevant regulations.
The "Opinion" requires that when establishing a joint-stock enterprise, the establishment and adjustment of the Party organization should be considered and arranged simultaneously. Where conditions are met, the grassroots Party committees, general branch committees and branch committees should be established in a timely manner. The shareholders' meeting, board of directors, board of supervisors, party committees, workers' congresses, trade unions and other organizations in joint-stock enterprises cannot replace each other, but the relevant responsible persons can hold part-time positions in each other appropriately. The Party organization should actively support other organizations to carry out activities in accordance with their respective charters and relevant regulations, take the initiative to coordinate the relationships between various aspects within the enterprise, and through strong ideological and political work and in-depth and meticulous Mass work, gather the strength of all parties, make them work closely together, complement each other, and jointly promote the reform and development of enterprises. The "Opinion" emphasizes that the party organizations of joint-stock enterprises should start from the characteristics of the enterprise's asset structure, leadership system, operating mechanism, employment and distribution system, and conscientiously improve their working methods and activities. For major issues in the production and operation of enterprises, the party organizations should seriously discuss and study, and put forward opinions and suggestions to the board of directors and managers, but should not make decisions and direct directly. It is necessary to combine strengthening the party's ideological and political work with cultivating the enterprise spirit, building corporate culture, and solving the practical problems of employees. Within the scope of the state's laws and regulations on joint-stock enterprises, we must firmly grasp the center of production and operation, and actively carry out party activities around the reform and development of enterprises.

平文选》第三卷理论研讨班开学典礼。中共中央政治局委员、书记
处书记丁关根主持会议。中共中央政治局常委、书记处书记胡锦涛
出席会议并发表讲话。胡锦涛在讲话中指出,学习邓小平建设有中
国特色社会主义理论,要贯彻理论联系实际原则,在努力掌握理论
体系和研究解决当前的重大问题两方面多下功夫。只有掌握了科
学的世界观和方法论,才能正确判断形势,统一思想,把握大局,抓
住主要矛盾,增强工作中的预见性和科学性,克服一切困难,把改
革开放和社会主义现代化建设事业不断推向前进。出席会议的还
有中共中央书记处书记任建新,中央有关部门的负责同志曾庆红、
郑必坚、赵宗鼐、汪家缪、郑科扬、陈福今、周子玉。
translated_text: On the 10th, the opening ceremony of the fourth session of the theoretical seminar for provincial and ministerial level leading cadres studying the third volume of Selected Works of Deng Xiaoping was held at the Party School of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China. Ding Guangen, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, presided over the meeting. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, attended the meeting and delivered a speech. In his speech, Hu Jintao pointed out that in studying Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, we must implement the principle of integrating theory with practice and work hard on mastering the theoretical system and studying and solving current major problems. Only by mastering the scientific world outlook and methodology can we correctly judge the situation, unify our thoughts, grasp the overall situation, grasp the main contradictions, enhance the foresight and scientific nature of our work, overcome all difficulties, and continuously push forward the cause of reform and opening up and socialist modernization. Also attending the meeting were Ren Jianxin, Secretary of the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee, and responsible comrades from relevant central departments, Zeng Qinghong, Zheng Bijian, Zhao Zongnai, Wang Jiamiao, Zheng Keyang, Chen Fujin, and Zhou Ziyu.

events: 1994年6月16日,《国家公务员录用暂行规定》颁布实施,标志着公务员录用步入规范化、制度化轨道。此前,全国已有29个省市区和国务院63个部门,试行考试择优录用。从47万余名报考者中择优录用37.1万余人。
translated_text: On June 16, 1994, the "Interim Provisions on the Recruitment of National Civil Servants" was promulgated and implemented, marking the entry of civil servant recruitment into a standardized and institutionalized track. events:
21日 中共中央组织部转发中央国家机关工委《关于中央国
家机关各部门党组指导机关党委工作的意见》。《意见》就党组指导
机关党委工作的主要任务,主要做法以及机关党委要在党组的指
导下做好工作和中央国家机关工委要与各部门党组加强联系和协
调,共同做好机关党的工作方面提出了要求。党组指导机关党委工
作的主要任务是:(一)指导机关党委根据新时期党的建设的指导
思想及工委的工作部署,结合本部门实际,加强和改进党的思想、
组织和作风建设,全面履行机关党委的职责,提高机关党组织的凝
聚力,吸引力和战斗力。(二)指导机关党委搞好党员、干部的理论
学习,教育和引导他们用马列主义、毛泽东思想,特别是用邓小平
同志建设有中国特色社会主义的理论武装头脑,指导工作。(三)指
导机关党委在本部门实现党的路线、方针、政策的过程中,组织党
员、干部积极投身改革,协助行政领导完成各项任务,确保政令畅
通,做贯彻执行党和国家各项方针政策的模范。(四)指导机关党委
建立健全党内监督制度,加强对包括本部门行政负责人在内的党
员的监督,协助行政领导搞好勤政廉政,加强各级领导班子的思想
作风建设,提高工作效率,克服官僚主义。(五)指导机关党委配合
行政领导做好职工的思想政治工作和统战工作,加强对机关工、
青、妇等群众组织的领导,调动一切积极因素,促进本部门机关的
两个文明建设。
《意见》要求,机关党委要紧紧围绕党组的中心任务和重要部
署,安排好机关党的工作,积极主动地完成党组交办的任务;深入
调查研究,认真听取党员、干部的意见和建议,为党组和行政领导
正确决策、改进工作、任用干部当好参谋,提供服务;认真做好干部
职工的思想政治工作,领导群众组织积极开展社会主义精神文明
建设活动;协助党组开好民主生活会,组织好领导干部中心组的学
习,促进各级领导班子搞好思想作风建设;积极探索新形势下开展
党的工作的新方法、新途径,健全和活跃党内生活,切实加强和改
进机关党的自身建设;在召开重要会议,部署重要工作和组织重大
活动之前,及时向党组请示报告,取得党组的具体指导和支持。
《意见》规定,中央国家机关工委的主要职责是:规划中央国家
机关党的建设,分类指导各部门机关、企业、事业单位党的建设工
作;指导各级党组织抓好党的思想、组织、作风建设和党员教育管
理以及处以上干部的理论培训;指导各级党组织实施对党员特别
是党员领导干部的监督,定期了解各部门党员和群众对部门领导
干部的意见,及时向党中央反映各部门领导班子和领导干部的情
况和问题;指导各级党组织配合行政领导做好思想政治工作和统
战工作;负责各部门机关党委和纪委书记、副书记的审批、考核及
培训;领导中央国家机关党的纪律检查工作和工、青、如等群众组
织的工作;完成党中央交办的其他任务。
translated_text: On the 21st, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee forwarded the "Opinions on the Party Groups of the Departments of the Central State Organs Guiding the Work of the Party Committees of the Organs" issued by the Central State Organs Working Committee. The "Opinions" put forward requirements on the main tasks and main practices of the Party Group in guiding the work of the Party Committees of the Organs, as well as the requirements that the Party Committees of the Organs should do a good job under the guidance of the Party Groups and that the Central State Organs Working Committee should strengthen contact and coordination with the Party Groups of the departments to jointly do a good job in the Party work of the organs. The main tasks of the Party Group in guiding the work of the Party Committees of the Organs are: (i) guiding the Party Committees of the Organs to strengthen and improve the Party's ideology, organization and style construction in accordance with the guiding ideology of Party building in the new era and the work arrangements of the Working Committee, combined with the actual situation of the department, fully perform the duties of the Party Committees of the Organs, and improve the cohesion, attraction and combat effectiveness of the Party organizations of the Organs. (ii) guiding the Party Committees of the Organs to do a good job in the theoretical study of Party members and cadres, educate and guide them to arm their minds with Marxism-Leninism, Mao Zedong Thought, and especially Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, and guide their work. (III) Guide the Party Committee of the organ to organize Party members and cadres to actively participate in the reform and assist the administrative leaders in completing various tasks, ensure the smooth implementation of government orders, and set an example in implementing the various policies and guidelines of the Party and the state in the process of implementing the Party's line, principles and policies in the department. (IV) Guide the Party Committee of the organ to establish and improve the internal supervision system of the Party, strengthen the supervision of Party members including the administrative leaders of the department, assist the administrative leaders in doing a good job in diligence and integrity, strengthen the ideological and work style construction of the leadership teams at all levels, improve work efficiency, and overcome bureaucracy. (V) Guide the Party Committee of the organ to cooperate with the administrative leaders to do a good job in the ideological and political work and united front work of the employees, strengthen the leadership of the mass organizations such as the labor, youth and women's organizations of the organ, mobilize all positive factors, and promote the construction of the two civilizations in the organs of the department. The Opinion requires that the Party Committee of the organs should closely focus on the central tasks and important deployments of the Party Group, arrange the Party work of the organs, and actively and proactively complete the tasks assigned by the Party Group; conduct in-depth investigations and research, listen carefully to the opinions and suggestions of Party members and cadres, and provide services for the Party Group and administrative leaders to make correct decisions, improve work, and appoint cadres; conscientiously do a good job in the ideological and political work of cadres and workers, and lead mass organizations to actively carry out socialist spiritual civilization construction activities; assist the Party Group in holding democratic life meetings, organize the study of the central group of leading cadres, and promote the ideological and style construction of leadership teams at all levels; actively explore new methods and new ways to carry out the Party's work under the new situation, improve and activate the life within the Party, and effectively strengthen and improve the self-construction of the Party in the organs; before holding important meetings, deploying important work, and organizing major activities, promptly report to the Party Group and obtain specific guidance and support from the Party Group. The Opinion stipulates that the main responsibilities of the Central State Organs Working Committee are: planning the party building of the central state organs, and guiding the party building work of various departments, enterprises, and institutions in a classified manner; guiding party organizations at all levels to do a good job in the party's ideology, organization, and style construction and party member education and management, as well as theoretical training for cadres above the department level; guiding party organizations at all levels to implement supervision over party members, especially party member leading cadres, regularly understand the opinions of party members and the masses of various departments on departmental leading cadres, and promptly report the situation and problems of the leading groups and leading cadres of various departments to the Party Central Committee; guiding party organizations at all levels to cooperate with administrative leaders to do a good job in ideological and political work and united front work; responsible for the approval, assessment and training of secretaries and deputy secretaries of the party committees and discipline inspection committees of various departments; leading the party discipline inspection work of the central state organs and the work of mass organizations such as the labor, youth, and etc.; and completing other tasks assigned by the Party Central Committee.

特色社会主义理论和党的基本路线为指导,密切联系建立社会主
义市场经济体制的改革实践,围绕正确把握全党全国工作的大局,

水平,贯彻民主集中制､增强团结,全心全意为人民服务,加强廉政
勤政建设,深入实际、大兴调查研究等方面,取得新的明显的进步。
胡锦涛指出,新时期加强领导班子思想作风建设,要把深入学
习掌握邓小平同志建设有中国特色社会主义理论摆在首位,领导

色社会主义理论,多在掌握这个理论的科学体系上下功夫,在运用

的新思想、新观点、新论断的科学世界观和方法论。
胡锦涛强调,新的形势和任务要求我们进一步贯彻执行好党
的民主集中制,充分调动全党的积极性,依靠全党的聪明才智,保
持全党思想上政治上的高度一致和组织上行动上的高度统一,决
不能把民主集中制同过去高度集中的计划经济体制等同起来,也
不能把民主集中制同社会主义市场经济体制对立起来。他说,加強
民主集中制必须高度重视制度建设。要坚决改变有章不依,有规不
循的情况。中央,国家机关部委领导班子要带头增強在党的正确路
线基础上的团结,坚持民主集中制的决策原则,提高决策水平;健

督机制,提高对滥用职权现象的防范能力;时刻注意从全局出发看
待和处理好部门与部门之间的关系,维护中央的权威。总之要共同
努力,造成“又有集中又有民主,又有纪律又有自由,又有统一意
志,又有个人心情舒畅、生动活泼,那样一种政治局面”。
translated_text: On the 29th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee held an experience exchange meeting on the ideological and work style construction of the leadership teams of the central and state organs in Beijing. Responsible comrades from the ministries and commissions of the central and state organs attended the meeting. The meeting was chaired by Lv Feng, Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, and Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, delivered an important speech at the meeting. In his speech, Hu Jintao pointed out that to strengthen the ideological and work style construction of the leadership team, we must adhere to the guidance of Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and the basic line of the Party, closely link with the reform practice of establishing a socialist market economic system, focus on correctly grasping the overall situation of the work of the whole party and the whole country, and proceed from the actual ideological and work style of the leadership team, and strive to make new and significant progress in in-depth study of theory, improving ideological level, implementing democratic centralism, strengthening unity, serving the people wholeheartedly, strengthening the construction of clean and diligent governance, and going deep into reality and vigorously conducting investigations and research. Hu Jintao pointed out that in order to strengthen the ideological and work style construction of the leadership team in the new period, we must put in-depth study and mastery of Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics in the first place. In order to make new and significant progress in the ideological and work style construction of the leadership team, we must first make new and significant progress in this regard. He asked leading cadres to deeply study Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, work hard to master the scientific system of this theory, and work hard to apply the theory to study and solve practical problems. In particular, we must master Comrade Deng Xiaoping's scientific world outlook and methodology for forming his new ideas, new viewpoints, and new conclusions. Hu Jintao emphasized that the new situation and tasks require us to further implement the party's democratic centralism, fully mobilize the enthusiasm of the whole party, rely on the wisdom of the whole party, maintain the high degree of ideological and political unity of the whole party and the high degree of unity in organization and action. We must never equate democratic centralism with the highly centralized planned economic system of the past, nor can we oppose democratic centralism to the socialist market economic system. He said that strengthening democratic centralism must attach great importance to institutional construction. We must resolutely change the situation of not abiding by rules and regulations. The leadership of the central government and the ministries and commissions of the state organs should take the lead in strengthening unity based on the correct line of the Party, adhere to the decision-making principle of democratic centralism, and improve the level of decision-making; improve the political life of the leadership team and improve the ability to solve their own problems; improve the effective supervision mechanism and improve the ability to prevent the abuse of power; always pay attention to the overall situation and handle the relationship between departments, and maintain the authority of the central government. In short, we must work together to create "a political situation with both centralization and democracy, both discipline and freedom, both unified will, and personal comfort and liveliness."

events: 25日——28日 中国共产党第十四届中央委员会第四次全体会议在北京举行。出席这次会议的中央委员182人,候补中央委员122 人。中央纪律检查委员会委员、有关负责同志列席了会议。全会由中央政治局主持,中央委员会总书记江泽民作了重要讲话。全会集中讨论了党的建设问题,并作出了《中共中央关于加强党的建设几个重大问题的决定》。《决定》共分四个部分 20条。(一)党的建设面临的形势和任务。(二)坚持和健全民主集中制。(三)加强和改进党的基层组织建设。(四)培养和选拔德才兼备的领导干部。《决定》指出,党必须善于在改革开放的新形势下认识自己,加强自己,提高自己,认真研究和解决在自身建设中出现的新矛盾新问题。改革开放给党的建设注入了新的活力,同时党的建设也遇到了许多复杂情况。我们党已有5400多万党员,教育和管理的任务比过去任何时候都更加繁重。面对新情况,我们的工作还不适应。一些地方和单位党不管党治党不严,纪律松弛、组织涣散,思想上、组织上、作风上存在着种种不容忽视的问题。特别是某些消极因素和腐败现象在党内滋长蔓延,严重侵蚀着党员和干部队伍。对此,全党必须引起高度警觉和重视,严肃认真、扎扎实实地加以解决。要继续把党的思想建设放在首要地位,推动全党对建设有中国特色社会主义理论的学习不断向广度和深度发展。要围绕什么是社会主义、怎样建设社会主义这个基本问题,联系实际,把握理论的科学体系,统一全党思想,坚持党的基本路线一百年不动摇。要继续抓好党的作风建设,把反腐败斗争深入持久地进行下去。要深刻认识执政党的党风是关系党的生死存亡的问题。要在党员领导干部廉洁自律,查处违法违纪案件、纠正不正之风等方面不断取得新的进展,逐步建立健全有效的监督约束机制,进一步发扬艰苦奋斗的优良传统,密切党同人民群众的联系。《决定》指出,发展党内民主,充分发挥全党的积极性。发展党内民主是多层次､多方面､多途径的。党内民主要以实现党的纲领为目的,以引导,保护、发挥积极性为出发点,紧密结合党组织的职能和党员的权利、义务而展开,要鼓励党员解放思想,实事求是,勇于探索,敢讲真话。从党的中央委员会到每一个支部,从领导机关的决策到在党的会议和党的报刊上参加政策问题的讨论,从党内选举到对领导干部进行评议、监督,都要充分发扬民主。发展党内民主必须切实保障各级党组织和党员的民主权利。要疏通和拓宽党内民主渠道,使党员对党内事务有更多的了解和参与。要把党的方针政策、指示决议,及时传达给下级党组织和党员。有些重要事情应该在党内先讨论,让党员早知道。党章规定的党员的各项权利,任何组织和个人都不得侵犯。要制定党员权利保障条例。明确党员正确行使权利的原则和保障党员行使权利的措施。《决定》要求,坚持和完善集体领导和个人分工负责相结合的制度。凡属方针政策性的大事,凡属全局性的问题,凡属重要干部的推荐、任免和奖惩,都要由中央或地方党委集体决定。重大问题的决定,要充分酝酿、协商和讨论,并按照少数服从多数的原则表决。对集体的决定,任何个人无权改变,个人或少数人有不同意见允许保留,但必须无条件服从,并在行动上积极执行。集体领导和个人分工负责,二者不可偏废。要提倡领导干部敢于负责的精神,反对遇事推诿,互相扯皮和无人负责。党的委员会成员既要根据集体的决定和分工,切实履行自己的职责,又要关心全局工作,积极参与集体领导。在党的委员会内部,书记和委员是平等的。书记在集体领导负有主要责任,应当成为执行民主集中制的表率。党委成员要互相信任,互相支持,互相谅解,互相补充,包括互相帮助克服缺点和错误,不断增强领导班子的团结。《决定》指出,加强和健全党内监督,严肃党的纪律。党内监督的实质是党从人民利益出发,按照从严治党的要求进行自我约束和自我完善。主要是监督党的组织和党员是否正确地贯彻执行党的路线方针政策,是否正确地运用人民赋予的权力,是否严格地遵守民主集中制的各项制度。党内监督的重点是党的各级领导机关和领导干部。在发展社会主义市场经济的条件下,要特别注意防范在党员干部中发生违法违纪行为,党员无论从事何种职业,担负何种领导职务,都要严格遵守党的纪律,自觉接受党组织和群众的监督。坚持在纪律面前人人平等,对违纪党员要严肃查处。《决定》指出,党的基层组织建设的指导方针是:第一,必须紧紧围绕党的基本路线,为党的中心任务服务,用完成本单位任务的实际效果来检验基层党组织的工作。第二,必须用改革的精神研究新情况,解决新问题,运用已有的成功经验并进行革新和创造,改进基层党组织的活动内容和工作方式。第三,必须严格党内生活,严肃党的纪律,弘扬正气,反对歪风,保持党员队伍的先进性和纯洁性,增强基层党组织解决自身矛盾的能力。第四,必须立足于经常性工作,常抓不懈,既要制定切实可行的长期规划,又要抓紧解决当前的突出问题。《决定》指出,高级干部特别是省部以上党政主要领导干部的领导水平,尤其是政治水平如何,关系到党和国家的前途命运。这些干部不仅要努力成为有知识,懂业务,胜任本职工作的内行,而且首先要努力成为忠诚于马克思主义、坚持走有中国特色社会主义道路,会治党治国的政治家。他们应该具有坚定的政治信念,始终保持清醒的头脑,自觉坚持党的基本理论和基本路线,经得起各种风浪的考验;他们应该具有开阔的眼界,熟悉国情,了解世界,解放思想,实事求是,务实创新,开拓前进;他们应该具有宽阔的胸襟,讲党性,顾大局,模范执行民主集中制,公道正派,任人唯贤,善于团结同志一道工作;他们应该具有较强的领导能力,讲究领导艺术,审时度势,驾驭全局,善于协调各方面的力量;他们应该具有优良的作风,廉洁勤政,艰苦奋斗,深入实际,调查研究,谦虚谨慎,联系群众,真心诚意为人民谋利益。我们不仅要按照这样的要求提高现有高级干部的水平,而且要按照这样的要求培养和选拔接班人。《决定》指出,切实加强对县以上党政领导干部特别是年轻干部的培养教育。有人是用人的基础,只着眼于用人,忽视育人,是短视的。务必把培养教育干部作为一项事关全局的基础性工作坚持不懈地抓下去。要组织县以上党政领导干部认真学习马克思列宁主义、毛泽东思想,中心内容是学习和掌握邓小平同志建设有中国特色社会主义理论。同时,努力学习社会主义市场经济理论和基本知识,现代科学技术知识和法律知识,世界历史、中国历史特别是近现代史和中共党史。通过学习和实践,树立正确的世界观、人生观,更加自觉地坚持党的基本路线,增强工作中的原则性、系统性、预见性和创造性。坚决克服忙于事务和应酬,忽视和放松学习的倾向。要根据不同领导职务的不同要求,制定切实可行的教育和培训规划,分期分批对县以上党政领导干部进行培训,并对学习情况认真考核,把考核结果作为使用领导干部的重要依据之一。积极推进党校和各类干部学校的教育改革,更好地为培养德才兼备的领导干部服务。要根据党政领导干部的成长规律,采取多种形式,放手让他们在实践中锻炼。对有发展潜力的年轻干部,要加紧培养。对缺乏全面领导工作经验的,要及早放到一定层次的关键领导岗位压担子;对缺乏基层工作经验的,要放下去任职锻炼。要鼓励、引导和安排年轻干部到基层去,到群众中去,到改革和建设的第一线去,特别是到条件艰苦或情况复杂的环境中去,经受考验。《决定》要求,高度重视人才的发现和使用。抓紧选拔大批优秀年轻干部。要结合新的历史条件,全面正确地贯彻干部队伍“四化”方针和德才兼备原则,衡量干部的德和才,应该主要看贯彻执行党的基本路线的实绩,选人用人要注意社会公论。要破除论资排辈､求全责备,迁就照顾等陈旧观念,不拘一格选拔人才。要广开进贤之路,搞五湖四海,避免只在党政机关或周围熟悉的少数人中选干部,反对任人唯亲。对那些在改革开放和现代化建设中政绩突出、群众信任的优秀干部特别是年轻干部,要大胆提拔,委以重任。对那些思想品质不好、弄虚作假,伸手要官的人决不能提拔。要重视各级党政领导班子主要负责人的选拔培养,加强女干部、少数民族干部和非党干部的选拔培养工作。严格执行干部离退休制度,认真做好离退休干部工作。《决定》指出,加快党政领导干部选拔任用等重要制度的改革。要坚持党管干部的原则,改进党管干部的方法,继续扩大民主、完善考核、推进交流,加强监督,逐步形成优秀人才能够脱颖而出、富有生机与活力的用人机制。扩大选拔任用领导干部工作中的民主。无论选任还是委任,聘任领导干部,都要走群众路线,通过民主推荐、民意测验或民主评议,让群众更多地参与。同时,认真进行组织考察,由党委集体讨论决定。多数群众不拥护的,不应提拔。完善领导干部考核制度,并与升降、奖惩制度相衔接。要全面考核干部的德、能、勤、绩,注重考核工作实绩,坚持领导与群众相结合的考核方法。有关部门要根据不同领导职务的不同特点,制定科学的考核体系和标准,对工作实绩进行全面考核和准确评价。根据考核结果实施升降奖惩,对不胜任现职的要果断调整。要使干部能上能下形成制度。认真推行领导干部交流制度,并同回避制度和各级领导班子的任期制度结合起来。要有计划、有步骤地在上下级机关之间、地区之间,地区与部门之间、党政之间以及经济比较发达与相对落后地区之间进行干部交流,使他们在多种环境和岗位经受锻炼,增长才干。要加大省部级干部交流力度,继续推进地市县级干部交流,同时注意领导班子相对稳定。各级党委对领导干部的交流要统筹规划,周密安排,认真做好思想政治工作,严格执行党的纪律,坚决克服干部调不出,派不进的不良倾向,切实加强对选拔任用领导干部工作的监督检查,坚决防止和纠正用人上的不正之风。要制定和实行党政领导干部选拔任用工作条例,使选拔任用干部的工作规范化、制度化。对那些不遵守党的原则,违反组织人事纪律,在用人问题上搞不正之风的,要严肃处理。要认真推行国家公务员制度。对近年来一些地方在一定范围试行委任干部任期制、聘任制、试用制以及公开推荐与考试考核相结合选拔领导干部等,要认真研究和总结,使其不断完善。

From the 25th to the 28th, the Fourth Plenary Session of the 14th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China was held in Beijing. 182 members of the Central Committee and 122 alternate members of the Central Committee attended the meeting. Members of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and relevant responsible comrades attended the meeting. The plenary session was chaired by the Political Bureau of the Central Committee, and Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the Central Committee, delivered an important speech. The plenary session focused on the issue of party building and made the "Decision of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Several Major Issues Concerning Strengthening Party Building". The "Decision" is divided into four parts and 20 articles. (I) The situation and tasks facing party building. (II) Adhere to and improve democratic centralism. (III) Strengthen and improve the construction of grassroots party organizations. (IV) Cultivate and select leading cadres with both moral integrity and ability. The "Decision" points out that the party must be good at understanding itself, strengthening itself, and improving itself under the new situation of reform and opening up, and seriously study and solve new contradictions and new problems that arise in its own construction. Reform and opening up have injected new vitality into party building, but at the same time, party building has also encountered many complex situations. Our party has more than 54 million members, and the task of education and management is heavier than ever before. Faced with the new situation, our work is not yet adapted. Some local and unit party organizations do not manage the party strictly, discipline is lax, and organization is lax. There are various problems in ideology, organization, and work style that cannot be ignored. In particular, certain negative factors and corruption phenomena are growing and spreading within the party, seriously eroding the ranks of party members and cadres. In this regard, the whole party must be highly vigilant and pay attention, and seriously and down-to-earth to solve them. We must continue to put the party's ideological construction in the first place and promote the whole party's study of the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics to develop in breadth and depth. We must focus on the basic question of what socialism is and how to build socialism, link it with reality, grasp the scientific system of theory, unify the thinking of the whole party, and adhere to the party's basic line for a hundred years without wavering. We must continue to do a good job in the party's work style construction and carry out the anti-corruption struggle in depth and for a long time. We must deeply understand that the party style of the ruling party is a matter of life and death for the party. We must continue to make new progress in the self-discipline of party members and leading cadres, investigate and deal with cases of violations of laws and disciplines, and correct unhealthy practices, gradually establish and improve effective supervision and restraint mechanisms, further carry forward the fine tradition of hard work, and strengthen the party's ties with the people. The "Decision" points out that we should develop inner-party democracy and give full play to the initiative of the whole party. The development of inner-party democracy is multi-level, multi-faceted, and multi-channel. Inner-party democracy should be carried out with the purpose of realizing the party's program, with guidance, protection, and enthusiasm as the starting point, and closely combined with the functions of the party organization and the rights and obligations of party members. We should encourage party members to emancipate their minds, seek truth from facts, have the courage to explore, and dare to tell the truth. From the Central Committee of the Party to every branch, from the decision-making of the leading organs to participating in the discussion of policy issues at party meetings and party newspapers, from the election of the party to the evaluation and supervision of leading cadres, we must fully promote democracy. The development of inner-party democracy must effectively guarantee the democratic rights of party organizations and party members at all levels. We should clear and broaden the channels for democracy within the Party so that Party members can have a better understanding of and participate in Party affairs. We should promptly convey the Party's policies, instructions and resolutions to lower-level Party organizations and Party members. Some important matters should be discussed within the Party first so that Party members can know them in advance. No organization or individual may infringe upon the rights of Party members as stipulated in the Party Constitution. We should formulate regulations to protect the rights of Party members. We should clarify the principles for Party members to exercise their rights correctly and the measures to protect their exercise of rights. The "Decision" requires that we adhere to and improve the system of combining collective leadership with individual division of labor and responsibility. All major matters of policy, all overall issues, and all recommendations, appointments, removals, rewards and punishments of important cadres should be collectively decided by the Central or local Party committees. Decisions on major issues should be fully deliberated, negotiated and discussed, and voted on in accordance with the principle of minority obeying the majority. No individual has the right to change the collective decision. Individuals or a few people may have different opinions, but they must obey unconditionally and actively implement them in action. Collective leadership and individual division of labor and responsibility should not be neglected. We should promote the spirit of leading cadres to dare to take responsibility, oppose shirking responsibility, bickering and no one being responsible. Party committee members should not only fulfill their duties according to the collective decision and division of labor, but also care about the overall work and actively participate in collective leadership. Within the party committee, the secretary and the members are equal. The secretary bears the main responsibility for collective leadership and should be a model for implementing democratic centralism. Party committee members should trust each other, support each other, understand each other, and complement each other, including helping each other to overcome shortcomings and mistakes, and constantly enhance the unity of the leadership team. The "Decision" points out that we should strengthen and improve internal party supervision and enforce party discipline. The essence of internal party supervision is that the party proceeds from the interests of the people and exercises self-discipline and self-improvement in accordance with the requirements of strict party governance. It is mainly to supervise whether the party organizations and members correctly implement the party's line, principles and policies, whether they correctly use the power granted by the people, and whether they strictly abide by the various systems of democratic centralism. The focus of internal party supervision is the leading organs and leading cadres at all levels of the party. Under the conditions of developing a socialist market economy, special attention should be paid to preventing illegal and disciplinary violations among party members and cadres. Regardless of their occupations or leadership positions, party members must strictly abide by party discipline and consciously accept supervision from party organizations and the masses. We must insist that everyone is equal before discipline and severely investigate and punish party members who violate discipline. The "Decision" points out that the guiding principles for the construction of grassroots party organizations are: First, we must closely focus on the party's basic line, serve the party's central tasks, and use the actual results of completing the tasks of our units to test the work of grassroots party organizations. Second, we must study new situations and solve new problems with the spirit of reform, use existing successful experiences and carry out innovation and creation, and improve the activities and working methods of grassroots party organizations. Third, we must strictly enforce party life, strictly enforce party discipline, promote positive energy, oppose unhealthy trends, maintain the advanced nature and purity of the party member team, and enhance the ability of grassroots party organizations to resolve their own contradictions. Fourth, we must base ourselves on regular work and work tirelessly. We must not only formulate practical long-term plans, but also promptly resolve current outstanding problems. The Decision points out that the leadership level, especially the political level, of senior cadres, especially the leading cadres of the Party and government at the provincial and ministerial levels and above, is related to the future and destiny of the Party and the country. These cadres should not only strive to become experts who are knowledgeable, professional, and competent in their own work, but also first of all strive to become politicians who are loyal to Marxism, adhere to the path of socialism with Chinese characteristics, and are able to govern the Party and the country. They should have firm political convictions, always keep a clear mind, consciously adhere to the party's basic theory and basic line, and withstand the test of all kinds of storms; they should have broad horizons, be familiar with national conditions, understand the world, emancipate their minds, seek truth from facts, be pragmatic and innovative, and forge ahead; they should have broad minds, emphasize party spirit, take the overall situation into consideration, model the implementation of democratic centralism, be fair and upright, appoint people on the basis of merit, and be good at uniting comrades to work together; they should have strong leadership ability, pay attention to leadership art, judge the situation, control the overall situation, and be good at coordinating forces from all sides; they should have good work style, be honest and diligent, work hard, go deep into reality, investigate and study, be modest and prudent, connect with the masses, and sincerely seek benefits for the people. We should not only improve the level of existing senior cadres in accordance with such requirements, but also train and select successors in accordance with such requirements. The "Decision" points out that we should effectively strengthen the training and education of party and government leading cadres at or above the county level, especially young cadres. Having people is the basis for employing people. It is short-sighted to only focus on employing people and neglect cultivating people. We must persist in cultivating and educating cadres as a basic work that concerns the overall situation. We must organize party and government leaders at or above the county level to study Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought seriously, with the core content being to study and master Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics. At the same time, we must strive to learn the theory and basic knowledge of the socialist market economy, modern scientific and technological knowledge and legal knowledge, world history, Chinese history, especially modern and contemporary history, and the history of the Communist Party of China. Through learning and practice, we must establish a correct world outlook and outlook on life, more consciously adhere to the party's basic line, and enhance the principle, systematicness, foresight and creativity in our work. We must resolutely overcome the tendency to neglect and relax learning due to being busy with affairs and socializing. We must formulate practical education and training plans based on the different requirements of different leadership positions, train party and government leaders at or above the county level in stages and batches, and seriously assess their learning situation, and use the assessment results as one of the important bases for employing leading cadres. We must actively promote the education reform of party schools and various cadre schools to better serve the training of leading cadres with both moral integrity and ability.
According to the growth law of party and government leading cadres, various forms should be adopted to let them exercise in practice. Young cadres with development potential should be trained in a timely manner. Those who lack comprehensive leadership work experience should be placed in key leadership positions at a certain level as soon as possible; those who lack grassroots work experience should be placed in positions for training. events: 1994年9月25日至28日,党的十四届四中全会在北京举行。会议审议通过了《中共中央关于加强党的建设几个重大问题的决定》。决定根据党的建设面临的形势和任务,着重提出了坚持和健全民主集中制,加强和改进党的基层组织建设和培养选拔德才兼备的领导干部等重大问题。提出把加强党的建设作为新的伟大的工程。
translated_text: From September 25 to 28, 1994, the Fourth Plenary Session of the 14th CPC Central Committee was held in Beijing. The meeting reviewed and adopted the "Decision of the CPC Central Committee on Several Major Issues Concerning Strengthening Party Building". The decision, based on the situation and tasks facing party building, focused on major issues such as upholding and improving democratic centralism, strengthening and improving the construction of grassroots party organizations, and cultivating and selecting leading cadres with both moral integrity and ability. events:
14日 中共中央政治局常委、书记处书记、中央党校校长胡
锦涛在省部级干部党建问题专题研究班结业时,发表了重要讲话。
胡锦涛指出,学习贯彻党的十四届四中全会《决定》,必须按照中央
关于加强党的建设的整体部署,在继续认真抓好党的思想建设、作
风建设的同时,大力加强党的组织建设,并把三者有机地结合起
来,全面推进这一新的伟大工程。
胡锦涛指出,十四届四中全会是在我国改革开放和现代化建
设的关键时期召开的一次具有全局意义和长远意义的重要会议。
全会作出的《中共中央关于加强党的建设几个重大问题的决定》,
以邓小平同志建设有中国特色社会主义理论和十四大精神为指
导,明确提出了党的建设特别是组织建设的主要任务,指导思想、
工作方针和重大措施,形成了新形势下加强党的建设的整体部署,
是加强和改进新时期党的建设的纲领性文件。要深入学习全会文
件,领会精神实质,把全党思想统一到《决定》的基本精神上来。同
时,各级党委要精心组织,抓好《决定》的贯彻落实。
胡锦涛指出,在旧中国半殖民地半封建社会这种特殊的历史
条件下,以毛泽东同志为核心的第一代中央领导集体,把马克思主
义基本原理同中国革命实际相结合,制定了正确的政治路线,创造
性地解决了党的建设的一系列问题,建立起一支团结统一、纪律严
明、英勇善战的工人阶级先锋队。这的确是世界政治史上的罕见状:
举,是一个“伟大的工程”。正是因为有这样一个党,才领导人民完
成了新民主主义革命,确立了社会主义基本制度,并取得了社会主
义建设的巨大成就。胡锦涛说,以邓小平同志为核心的第二代中央
领导集体,把马克思主义基本原理同当代中国实际和时代特征相
结合,在确立和执行正确的政治路线的同时,围绕党的基本路线加
强党的建设,取得了巨大成绩,推动了全党在思想、理论、政治､组
织和作风建设上的重大进步,开创了新的伟大工程的光辉历程。改
革开放以来我国在各方面取得的举世瞩目的伟大成就,都是同党
的建设的成绩分不开的。邓小平同志继承、丰富和发展了毛泽东同
关于党的建设的理论,全面系统地提出了新时期党的建设理论,
为加强党的建设指明了方向。当前,在以江泽民同志为核心的党中
央的领导下,全党正在继往开来,大力推进新的伟大工程。
胡锦涛指出,党的思想建设、组织建设、作风建设是相互联系、
相互渗透、相辅相成的,构成了新的伟大工程的基本内容。无论抓
哪方面的建设,都有赖于也必然涉及其他方面的建设。因此,党的
建设必须作为系统工程全面来抓,才能真正抓好。十四大以来,在
以江泽民同志为核心的党中央领导下,我们党在坚持全面贯彻执
行基本路线的过程中,为推动思想、组织、作风建设作了大量工作,
取得了积极成果,在思想建设和作风建设方面都提出了明确要求,
作出了具体部署。从党组织的现实状况来看,从形势和任务发展的
需要来看,从全面加强党的建设的要求来看,当前加强党的组织建
设已经成为突出的环节。四中全会着重在加强组织建设方面特别
是就民主集中制,党的基层组织建设和干部培养选拔这三个问题,
集中进行研究,作出了工作部署,这是完全必要的,也是很及时的。
这样就形成了新形势下党的思想建设、组织建设、作风建设部署相
互配套、相互促进的全面加强党的建设的整体部署。在贯彻四中全
会《决定》,抓好组织建设这个突出环节的时候,不能忽视或放松了
思想建设、作风建设。
胡锦涛强调,切实抓好四中全会《决定》的学习和贯彻落实,是
关系全局的根本大事。对此,胡锦涛提出了五条意见:
(一)要组织各级领导干部和全体党员认真学习全会《决定》,
并且同学习邓小平同志关于党的建设的理论结合起来,联系十儿
