On the 14th, Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, Secretary of the Secretariat, and President of the Central Party School, delivered an important speech at the closing ceremony of the special study class on party building issues for provincial and ministerial cadres. Hu Jintao pointed out that in studying and implementing the "Decision" of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 14th CPC Central Committee, it is necessary to follow the overall deployment of the Central Committee on strengthening party building, and while continuing to earnestly grasp the party's ideological construction and style construction, vigorously strengthen the party's organizational construction, and organically combine the three to comprehensively promote this new great project. Hu Jintao pointed out that the Fourth Plenary Session of the 14th CPC Central Committee was an important meeting of overall and long-term significance held at a critical period of my country's reform and opening up and modernization construction. The "Decision of the CPC Central Committee on Several Major Issues Concerning Strengthening Party Building" made by the plenary session, guided by Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and the spirit of the 14th CPC National Congress, clearly put forward the main tasks of party building, especially organizational construction, guiding ideology, work principles and major measures, and formed an overall deployment for strengthening party building under the new situation. It is a programmatic document for strengthening and improving party building in the new era. We must thoroughly study the plenary session documents, understand the essence of the spirit, and unify the thinking of the whole party with the basic spirit of the "Decision". At the same time, party committees at all levels must carefully organize and implement the "Decision". Hu Jintao pointed out that under the special historical conditions of the semi-colonial and semi-feudal society of old China, the first generation of the central leadership collective with Comrade Mao Zedong as the core combined the basic principles of Marxism with the reality of the Chinese revolution, formulated a correct political line, creatively solved a series of problems in party building, and established a united, disciplined, brave and combative vanguard of the working class. This is indeed a rare case in the history of world politics and a "great project". It is precisely because of such a party that the people were led to complete the new democratic revolution, establish the basic socialist system, and achieve great achievements in socialist construction. Hu Jintao said that the second generation of the central leadership group with Comrade Deng Xiaoping as the core combined the basic principles of Marxism with the reality of contemporary China and the characteristics of the times. While establishing and implementing the correct political line, it strengthened the party's construction around the party's basic line and achieved great results, promoted the party's major progress in ideology, theory, politics, organization and style construction, and opened up a glorious course of the new great project. The great achievements made by my country in all aspects since the reform and opening up are inseparable from the achievements of party construction. Comrade Deng Xiaoping inherited, enriched and developed Comrade Mao Zedong's theory on party construction, comprehensively and systematically put forward the theory of party construction in the new era, and pointed out the direction for strengthening party construction. At present, under the leadership of the Party Central Committee with Comrade Jiang Zemin as the core, the whole party is carrying forward the past and vigorously promoting the new great project. Hu Jintao pointed out that the party's ideological construction, organizational construction and style construction are interconnected, mutually penetrating and complementary, and constitute the basic content of the new great project. No matter which aspect of construction is taken, it depends on and will inevitably involve other aspects of construction. Therefore, party construction must be taken as a systematic project in an all-round way to be truly effective. Since the 14th National Congress, under the leadership of the Party Central Committee with Comrade Jiang Zemin as the core, our party has done a lot of work to promote ideological, organizational and work style construction in the process of adhering to the comprehensive implementation of the basic line, and has achieved positive results. It has put forward clear requirements and made specific arrangements in terms of ideological construction and work style construction. From the current situation of the party organization, from the needs of the development of the situation and tasks, and from the requirements of comprehensively strengthening party construction, strengthening the party's organizational construction has become a prominent link. The Fourth Plenary Session of the 18th Central Committee focused on strengthening organizational construction, especially on the three issues of democratic centralism, the construction of the party's grassroots organizations and the training and selection of cadres, and concentrated on research and made work arrangements. This is completely necessary and timely. In this way, the overall deployment of comprehensively strengthening party construction has been formed in which the deployment of the party's ideological construction, organizational construction and work style construction under the new situation is mutually complementary and mutually reinforcing. When implementing the Decision of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee and grasping the prominent link of organizational construction, we must not ignore or relax ideological construction and style construction. Hu Jintao emphasized that earnestly grasping the study and implementation of the Decision of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee is a fundamental matter related to the overall situation. In this regard, Hu Jintao put forward five opinions: (I) We must organize leading cadres at all levels and all party members to study the Decision of the Plenary Session seriously, and combine it with the study of Comrade Deng Xiaoping’s theory on party building, link it with ten years of practical experience, study it seriously, deeply understand the spirit of the document, and improve ideological understanding. We must do a good job in promoting the Decision, guide and promote continuous deepening of learning. (II) All localities and departments must follow the requirements of the Decision, proceed from their own reality, formulate specific work goals and measures, and concretize the tasks proposed in the Decision. We must conduct in-depth investigations and studies, grasp the gaps and problems in party building, especially organizational construction, in our regions and departments, grasp the key points, and make the measures formulated, the systems established, and the methods proposed feasible. (III) We must work hard and regard the process of implementing the Decision as a process of effectively solving the main problems in the Party building of the local department. We must dare to touch upon contradictions, take effective measures to solve the existing problems one by one.
(IV) Party committees at all levels must strengthen leadership, truly recognize that the study and implementation of the Decision is related to the overall situation, insist on the Party's self-management and strict governance, and especially the main leading comrades of the Party committees must be in place. The superior Party committees must strengthen supervision and inspection of the lower-level Party committees, go deep into reality and the grassroots, promptly understand and solve the problems existing in the implementation, gain experience, guide the overall work, and achieve one level grasping one level, one level leading one level, and one level promoting one level.
(V) We must closely combine the implementation of the Decision with the current work of deepening reform, expanding opening up, promoting development, and maintaining stability, strengthen and improve Party building in practice, exercise and improve the ideological work level and leadership ability of leading cadres at all levels, give full play to the role of grassroots Party organizations and the majority of Party members in reform and construction, and make the study and implementation of the spirit of the plenary session and the current work combined and mutually promoted.

26日——29日 中共中央召开全国农村基层组织建设工作
会议,会议由中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理朱镕基主持。中
共中央政治局委员吴邦国、姜春云、尉健行,中共中央政治局候补
委员温家宝,中央书记处书记任建新,国务委员宋健、李贵鲜、陈俊
生以及各省、自治区、直辖市党委书记或省长,主管这项工作的副
书记或副省长,组织部、民政厅、农村工作部门负责人,部分团省
委、省妇联负责人,部分地,县委和基层党组织负责人,中央、国家
机关有关部门负责同志参加了会议。
这次会议主要是学习贯彻党的十四届四中全会的决定,交流
农村基层组织建设的经验,对新形势下加强农村基层组织建设工
作做出具体部署。
中共中央总书记、国家主席江泽民在会上发表了重要讲话,他
指出,农业、农村和农民问题,关系着改革开放和社会主义现代化
事业的大局,关系着党的执政地位的巩固,关系着国家长治久安。
这不但是个重大的经济问题,同时是个重大的政治问题。他要求从
中央到地方各级党委和政府务必要把农业和农村工作摆在经济工
作的首位,务必使农村经济发展和社会全面进步再上一个新台阶。
江泽民在讲话中说,为了完成新时期党在农村的历史任务,
定要把全国80多万个农村基层组织分期分批地建设好。关键是把
农村基层党组织建设好,充分发挥它的核心领导作用。
中共中央政治局常委、书记处书记胡锦涛发表重要讲话。胡锦
涛指出,到本世纪末我国要初步建立起社会主义市场经济体制,农
业生产要登上新台阶,农村改革要有新进展,农村社会面貌要有新
变化,全国多数农村要达到小康标准。适应新的形势和任务,农村
基层组织建设必须明确前进目标,这就是:要建设一个团结、坚强、
群众拥护的好领导班子,尤其要有一个好书记;培养锻炼一支富有
战斗力的好队伍;选准一条适合当地加快经济发展的好路子;完善
一个好经营体制;健全一套体现民主管理,保证工作有效运转的好
管理制度。
胡锦涛在报告中讲了五个问题:(一)从战略和全局的高度,充
分认识加强农村党组织为核心的基层组织建设的重要性、紧迫
性;(二)进一步明确加强农村基层组织建设的目标,重点和工作指
导思想;(三)切实加强农村基层党组织建设,更好地发挥党支部领
导核心作用和战斗堡垒作用:(四)通过加强培训和在实践中锻炼
提高,努力造就一支适应新形势要求,能够团结带领农民奔小康的
基层干部队伍;(五)各级党委首先是省、地、县委,要切实负起对农
村基层组织建设的领导责任。
胡锦涛指出,加强农村基层组织建设,要统筹安排,突出重点。
要力争用3年时间,有领导,有计划地首先把软弱涣散和处于瘫痪
状态的基层组织整顿好、建设好,切实解决当地群众普遍关心,影
响改革、发展、稳定的主要问题,特别是要建设好党支部领导班子。
对党支部战斗力较强,贯彻党的路线方针政策得力、经济发展快、
社会风气好的先进村,要提出新的发展目标,使各方面工作更上一
层楼,充分发挥它们在当地的示范、辐射、帮带作用。对中间状态的
村,有什么问题解决什么问题,什么突出就先解决什么问题。通过
坚持不懈的努力,使所有农村基层组织在现有基础上都有较大的
提高。在整个工作过程中,必须把保证党的基本路线的贯彻执行,
作为加强基层组织建设的根本着眼点和落脚点;必须紧紧抓住党
组织建设这个关键,同时抓好村民自治组织、集体经济组织和共青
团、妇联、民兵等各种组织的配套建设;必须认真研究新情况,解决
新问题,脚踏实地地开展工作。
胡锦涛强调指出,加强农村基层组织建设,关键是建设好基层
党组织。首先,要以全面提高领导素质和领导能力为重点,建设好
党支部领导班子,尤其要选好支部书记,使党组织认真贯彻执行党
的农村政策,在深化农村改革,全面发展农村经济,建设精神文明,
带领农民群众奔小康、实现共同富裕和共同进步中,充分发挥核心
领导作用和战斗堡垒作用。第二,要以有利于发展生产力,有利于
加强党的工作为原则,合理调整基层党组织设置,改进活动内容和
工作方式。第三,要以提高素质、增强党性为目标,大力加强对农村
党员的教育和管理,有计划有步骤地组织全体党员开展学习建设
有中国特色社会主义理论和党章的活动。第四,要以增强党组织的
活力为要求,认真做好在优秀青年农民中发展党员的工作。与此同
时,认真抓好其他村级组织的配套建设,使它们围绕党在农村的基
本任务,根据各自的章程和特点,积极主动地开展工作,充分发挥
应有的作用。
中央政治局候补委员、书记处书记温家宝作了会议总结。
translated_text: From the 26th to the 29th, the CPC Central Committee held a national rural grassroots organization construction work conference, which was chaired by Zhu Rongji, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council. Wu Bangguo, Jiang Chunyun, Wei Jianxing, members of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, Wen Jiabao, alternate member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, Ren Jianxin, secretary of the Central Secretariat, State Councilors Song Jian, Li Guixian, Chen Junsheng, as well as the party secretaries or governors of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the central government, the deputy secretaries or deputy governors in charge of this work, the heads of the Organization Department, the Civil Affairs Department, and the rural work departments, some provincial youth league committees, provincial women's federations, some prefectures, county committees and grassroots party organizations, and responsible comrades from relevant departments of the central and state organs attended the meeting. The main purpose of this meeting was to study and implement the decisions of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 14th CPC Central Committee, exchange experiences in the construction of rural grassroots organizations, and make specific arrangements for strengthening the construction of rural grassroots organizations under the new situation. Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee and President of the State, delivered an important speech at the meeting. He pointed out that the issues of agriculture, rural areas and farmers are related to the overall situation of reform and opening up and socialist modernization, the consolidation of the Party's ruling position and the long-term stability of the country. This is not only a major economic issue, but also a major political issue. He demanded that Party committees and governments at all levels from the central to the local level must put agriculture and rural work at the top of economic work and must take rural economic development and social progress to a new level. In his speech, Jiang Zemin said that in order to complete the Party's historical mission in rural areas in the new era, more than 800,000 rural grassroots organizations across the country must be built in phases and batches. The key is to build rural grassroots party organizations well and give full play to their core leadership role. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, delivered an important speech. Hu Jintao pointed out that by the end of this century, my country must initially establish a socialist market economic system, agricultural production must reach a new level, rural reform must have new progress, rural social outlook must have new changes, and most rural areas across the country must reach a well-off standard. To adapt to the new situation and tasks, the construction of rural grassroots organizations must have clear goals, which are: to build a united, strong, and well-supported leadership team, especially a good secretary; to train and cultivate a good team with strong fighting capacity; to choose a good way to accelerate economic development in the local area; to improve a good management system; to improve a good management system that reflects democratic management and ensures the effective operation of work. Hu Jintao talked about five issues in his report: (i) From a strategic and overall perspective, fully understand the importance and urgency of strengthening the construction of grassroots organizations with rural party organizations as the core; (ii) further clarify the goals, key points and work guiding ideas for strengthening the construction of rural grassroots organizations; (iii) effectively strengthen the construction of rural grassroots party organizations and better play the leading role of party branches and the role of fighting fortresses; (iv) through strengthening training and improving in practice, strive to create a grassroots cadre team that can adapt to the requirements of the new situation and unite and lead farmers to a well-off society; (v) Party committees at all levels, first of all provincial, prefectural and county party committees, must effectively assume the leadership responsibility for the construction of rural grassroots organizations. Hu Jintao pointed out that strengthening the construction of rural grassroots organizations requires overall planning and highlighting key points. We should strive to use three years to organize and build weak, lax and paralyzed grassroots organizations in a planned manner, and effectively solve the main problems that are of concern to the local people and affect reform, development and stability, especially to build a good leadership team of the party branch. For advanced villages with strong party branch combat effectiveness, effective implementation of the party's line, principles and policies, rapid economic development and good social atmosphere, new development goals should be proposed to take all aspects of work to a higher level and give full play to their demonstration, radiation and assistance in the local area. For villages in the middle state, we should solve whatever problems we have and solve the most prominent problems first. Through unremitting efforts, all rural grassroots organizations will be greatly improved on the existing basis. Throughout the entire work process, we must ensure the implementation of the party's basic line as the fundamental focus and foothold for strengthening the construction of grassroots organizations; we must firmly grasp the key of party organization construction, and at the same time do a good job in the supporting construction of village self-government organizations, collective economic organizations, and various organizations such as the Communist Youth League, Women's Federation, and militia; we must seriously study new situations, solve new problems, and carry out work down-to-earth. Hu Jintao emphasized that the key to strengthening the construction of rural grassroots organizations is to build a good grassroots party organization. First, we must focus on comprehensively improving leadership quality and leadership ability, build a good party branch leadership team, and especially select a good branch secretary so that the party organization can conscientiously implement the party's rural policies and give full play to the core leadership role and fighting fortress role in deepening rural reforms, comprehensively developing the rural economy, building spiritual civilization, and leading the farmers to a well-off society, achieving common prosperity and common progress. Second, we must reasonably adjust the grassroots party organization settings and improve the content of activities and working methods based on the principle of being conducive to the development of productivity and strengthening the party's work. Third, we should take improving the quality and strengthening the party spirit as the goal, vigorously strengthen the education and management of rural party members, and organize all party members to carry out activities of learning and building the theory of socialism with Chinese characteristics and the party constitution in a planned and step-by-step manner. Fourth, we should take strengthening the vitality of the party organization as the requirement and do a good job in developing party members among outstanding young farmers. At the same time, we should earnestly grasp the supporting construction of other village-level organizations so that they can actively carry out their work around the party's basic tasks in rural areas and according to their respective charters and characteristics, and give full play to their due role. Wen Jiabao, alternate member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee and secretary of the Secretariat, gave a summary of the meeting.

干部工作中不正之风的通知》。《通知》的主要内容是:
(一)坚持任人唯贤,反对任人唯亲。选拔任用干部必须坚持
干部队伍“四化”方针和德才兼备的原则,注重社会公论,注重实
绩。各级领导干部要出以公心,以对党和人民的事业高度负责的精
神,严格按照组织程序选贤任能。
(二)坚持干部职务安排由组织决定的原则,刹住拉关系,走
后门,伸手要官的恶劣风气。对跑官要官者,不仅坚决不给,而且要
严肃批评教育;教育不改的,应向本人所在单位通报情况。对经过
查实确属跑官要官而得到提拔任职的,要坚决予以撤销;对放弃原
则,给跑官要官者办理提职的单位直接负责人,要给予批评以至必
要的惩处。对搞个人封官许愿的,一经查出,也要严肃处理。
(三)选拔任用干部必须充分发扬民主,走群众路线,不准个
人或少数人说了算。无论选任还是委任,聘任领导干部,都要走群

On the 29th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on Resolutely Preventing and Correcting Unhealthy Trends in the Selection and Appointment of Cadres". The main contents of the "Notice" are:
(I) Adhere to the principle of appointing people on the basis of merit and oppose nepotism. The selection and appointment of cadres must adhere to the "four modernizations" policy of the cadre team and the principle of both moral integrity and ability, pay attention to social public opinion and pay attention to performance. Leading cadres at all levels must be impartial and highly responsible for the cause of the Party and the people, and strictly follow organizational procedures to select and appoint people of talent.
(II) Adhere to the principle that the arrangement of cadre positions is determined by the organization, and stop the bad trend of pulling relationships, using back doors, and asking for positions. For those who run for office, not only will they be resolutely not given, but they will also be severely criticized and educated; if they do not change after education, the situation should be reported to their units. Those who have been promoted and appointed after being verified to have run for office must be resolutely revoked; the direct person in charge of the unit who abandons the principle and handles the promotion of those who run for office should be criticized and even punished as necessary. Those who make promises for personal promotions must be dealt with seriously once they are found out.
(III) In selecting and appointing cadres, democracy must be fully promoted and the mass line must be followed. No individual or a few people are allowed to have the final say. Whether selecting or appointing, or hiring leading cadres, the mass line must be followed, democracy must be fully promoted, democratic recommendations, public opinion polls or democratic evaluations must be implemented, and those who are "recognized by the people to adhere to the reform and opening-up line and have political achievements" must be selected.
(IV) Strengthen the concept of confidentiality and strictly keep personnel secrets. When the Party Committee (Party Group) and the Organization and Personnel Department discuss personnel appointments and removals, no individual may disclose them without authorization, let alone disclose them to the parties concerned. Before the decision on the appointment, removal or transfer of cadres is officially notified, no one may spread it privately. No matter who leaks the personnel secrets of cadres, they must be carefully investigated and dealt with seriously.
(V) Strengthen the work style construction of the organization and personnel departments, and resolutely prevent and resist violations of the organization and personnel discipline. The organization and personnel departments have important responsibilities in the selection and appointment of cadres and should do their work diligently and conscientiously. Organization and personnel departments at all levels should strengthen their own ideological and work style construction, strictly enforce work discipline, take the lead in upholding the party's principles, and abide by the organization and personnel discipline and work system. The cadres of the organization and personnel departments should be loyal and honest, fair and upright, adhere to principles, and handle affairs impartially. They should dare to truthfully reflect the situation and dare to resist all violations of the party's principles and regulations and violations of the organization and personnel work discipline. Those who abandon principles and use their work to seek personal gain should be given disciplinary sanctions; those who are not suitable for working in the organization and personnel departments should be resolutely transferred.
(VI) Deepen the reform of the cadre and personnel system and strengthen system construction. To prevent and correct unhealthy trends in the selection and appointment of cadres, it is necessary to establish a new employment mechanism and supervision mechanism to adapt to the needs of the new situation and tasks. We should combine the establishment of a socialist market economy system, earnestly summarize the successful experience of cadre and personnel management, continue to boldly carry out new explorations, and continuously deepen the reform of the cadre and personnel system. All systems that have been clearly stipulated and proven to be good in practice must continue to be resolutely implemented; systems that really need to be improved must be improved as soon as possible according to new circumstances. Through reform, we will improve the party's management of cadres, continue to expand democracy, improve assessments, promote exchanges, strengthen supervision and inspection, and gradually form a personnel mechanism that allows outstanding talents to stand out and is full of vitality and vigor, providing institutional guarantees for preventing and correcting unhealthy trends in the selection and appointment of cadres.

translated_text: On the 2nd, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee forwarded the "Notice of the CPC Central Committee Propaganda Department and the CPC Central Committee Organization Department on Studying Volumes 1 and 2 of Selected Works of Deng Xiaoping". The "Notice" requires Party committees at all levels to effectively strengthen leadership over learning, combine it with reality, and implement it well. The "Notice" said that the 14th National Congress of the Communist Party of China proposed to arm the whole party with the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics. The Fourth Plenary Session of the 14th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China emphasized that the ideological construction of the Party should continue to be put in the first place, and promote the whole party's study of the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics to develop in breadth and depth. It has also provided us with another important textbook for further deepening the study of the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics. The Notice emphasizes that Party committees at all levels should continue to implement the "Decision of the CPC Central Committee on Studying Volume 3 of Selected Works of Deng Xiaoping" and make specific arrangements for the study of Volumes 1 and 2. Volumes 1, 2 and 3 should be studied as a whole. The revised and supplemented Volumes 1 and 2 of Selected Works of Deng Xiaoping, together with Volume 3 published in 1993, concentrate the main works of Comrade Deng Xiaoping. These works reflect the basic theoretical viewpoints and policy and strategic ideas formed by Comrade Deng Xiaoping from the late 1930s to the early 1990s, which combined the basic principles of Marxism-Leninism with the concrete practice of China's revolution and construction, and the characteristics of the times. They are the inheritance and development of Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought. Volumes 2 and 3 of Selected Works of Deng Xiaoping are connected and interconnected in content, forming a scientific system. These two volumes They are the foundational works of contemporary Chinese Marxism, the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics. In the study, we should focus on the basic question of what socialism is and how to build socialism, and deeply understand the origin, formation and development of Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics. We should carefully study the original works, grasp the spiritual essence, grasp the scientific system of the theory, integrate theory with practice, unify the thinking of the whole party, and adhere to the party's basic line for a hundred years. The "Notice" requires that party committees at all levels should effectively strengthen the leadership of learning and take the lead in doing a good job in the study of the party committee central group. events: 5日 中共中央发出《关于加强农村基层组织建设的通知》。《通知》的主要内容是:(一)实现新时期党在农村的历史任务,必须大力加强农村基层组织建设。(二)加强农村基层组织建设的主要目标和指导思想。《通知》指出农村基层组织建设,包括乡(镇)、村两级,重点是村。今后几年,要努力实现五项目标:一是建设一个好领导班子,尤其要有一个好书记,能够团结带领群众坚决贯彻执行党的路线方针政策。二是培养锻炼一支好队伍,共产党员能够发挥先锋模范作用,干部能够发挥示范带头作用,共青团员能够发挥助手和后备军作用。三是选准一条发展经济的好路子,充分发挥当地优势,加快农民脱贫致富奔小康的步伐。四是完善一个好经营体制,把集体统一经营的优越性和农户承包经营的积极性结合起来,增强经济发展的活力,引导和帮助农民走共同富裕的道路。五是健全一套好的管理制度,体现民主管理原则,保证工作有效运转,使村级各项工作逐步走上怎制度化、规范化的轨道。(三)村党支部和其他组织都要把贯彻执行党的基本路线、团结带领农民群众奔小康作为根本任务。《通知》指出,农村基层党组织必须认真贯彻“两手抓,两手都要硬”的方针,紧紧抓住发展农村生产力这个中心,同时加强社会主义精神文明建设,提高广大农民的思想道德水平和科学文化水平。深入开展创建文明村镇、文明农户活动。要丰富农村文化生活,推动移风易俗,同时加强对农村文化市场的管理和监督,坚定不移地利用健康、文明、进步的思想和风尚占领农村阵地。(四)加强农村基层党组织的建设,增强凝聚力和战斗力。《通知》要求,党支部建设要重点抓好领导班子建设,选好支部书记,形成能带领农民群众奔小康的坚强集体。尤其要注意选用那些尊重知识和人才、善于聚才用才的人。确实难以胜任的,要及时调整。《通知》要求,根据新的情况合理调整基层党组织设置,改进领导方式和工作方法。适应农村产业结构、劳动力就业结构以及党员分布情况的变化,党组织要及时调整设置形式。党支部、村委会、集体经济组织主要领导成员可以适当交叉兼职,保持精干,注重工作效率。所有基层党组织都要严格执行民主集中制,建立健全工作制度,积极主动地开展活动,加强党内监督。《通知》指出,加强和改进对农村党员的教育和管理,帮助党员全面提高素质、增强党性。从现在起,用3年左右时间,有计划有步骤地组织全体农村党员开展学习建设有中国特色的社会主义理论和学习党章的活动。学习要联系实际,开展批评与自我批评,促进农村基层组织的“五个好”建设,推动后进乡村的转化。(五)健全村民自治组织、集体经济组织和群团组织,促进村级各项工作的制度化、规范化。《通知》要求,当前应着重抓好:1. 村民选举制度。2.村民议事制度。3.村务公开制度。4.村规民约制度。(六)抓好农村基层干部队伍建设,全面提高基层干部素质。《通知》要求,对村级主要干部分期分批地进行培训。每年至少培训10天,每次解决几个最急需解决的问题。可以组织村干部轮流到县、乡党校学习,也可以组织到奔小康示范村实地考察,交流经验,互帮互助。《通知》要求:1.政治上关心爱护。对那些公正清廉,奋力工作,为农村发展和进步做出了突出贡献的优秀村干部,要充分肯定成绩,宣传他们的精神风貌,在社会上形成尊重基层干部的风气。2.建立适合农村基层特点的激励机制,使村干部干有所为,退有所安,老有所养。提倡干部报酬同工作实绩挂钩,并保证兑现。对群众公认有突出贡献的干部要给以奖励。积极创造条件,建立村干部养老保险制度,或者对离任村干部根据任职时间和贡献给以适当补贴。对一些贫困村中本来很低的干部报酬补贴尚不能兑现的问题,所在县、乡要积极设法解决。特别困难的地方,上级组织应给予必要的帮助。3.支持村干部依法行使职权,大胆进行工作。4.要把从优秀村干部中招聘录用乡镇干部作为一项重要制度长期坚持下去,并在实践中加以完善。《通知》指出,抓好农村基层干部的思想作风建设。着重教育他们坚持解放思想、实事求是的思想路线,牢记全心全意为人民服务的宗旨,努力学会在工作中走群众路线,发扬艰苦奋斗、任劳任怨的精神,自觉抵制拜金主义、个人主义和腐朽生活方式的侵蚀,克服简单粗暴的工作作风,反对弄虚作假。对思想作风有问题的干部,要及时批评教育。对违纪犯法的,要及时查处。(七)加强乡镇党委和乡镇政权建设,使其切实担负起加强村级组织建设的责任。《通知》要求,县级领导班子成员要注重从优秀的乡镇领导干部中选拔。《通知》指出,要抓好县(市)直各部门特别是执法部门乡镇单位党的建设,帮助他们认真执行“两公开一监督”制度,加强党风廉政建设,坚决纠正行业不正之风。县(市)有关部门设在乡镇的机构,要区别不同情况,有的放到乡镇管理,有的由乡镇和县直主管部门双重领导。实行双重领导的机构,干部的调动、任免、奖惩必须征得乡镇党委的同意。(八)各级党委要切实加强和改进对农村基层组织建设的领导。《通知》要求,省(自治区、直辖市)､地(市)县(市)委要把农村基层组织建设工作列入重要日程常抓不懈。党委领导同志要直接联系不同类型的村,经常深入到群众中去,发现和解决问题。在党委领导下,各有关职能部门要分工负责,密切配合,齐抓共管。由党委组织部门或农村工作部门牵头,及时沟通情况,协调工作。《通知》指出,加强农村基层组织建设,县(市)委是关键。县(市)委要切实履行以下职责:制定加强全县(市)农村基层组织建设的工作规则,确定每年组织实施的目标和措施;掌握农村基层组织的情况,抓住重点,实行分类指导;督促乡镇党委抓好村级组织建设;搞好村主要干部的培训:研究建立和实施有关乡村干部的激励机制。上级党委应按照这些职责来考核县(市)委抓农村基层组织建设工作的政绩。

(II) The main goals and guiding ideology of strengthening the construction of rural grassroots organizations. The "Notice" points out that the construction of rural grassroots organizations includes township (town) and village levels, with the focus on villages. In the next few years, we must strive to achieve five goals: First, build a good leadership team, especially a good secretary, who can unite and lead the masses to resolutely implement the party's line, principles and policies. Second, cultivate and train a good team, so that Communist Party members can play a pioneering and exemplary role, cadres can play a leading role in demonstration, and Communist Youth League members can play the role of assistants and reserve forces. Third, choose a good way to develop the economy, give full play to local advantages, and accelerate the pace of farmers' poverty alleviation and prosperity. Fourth, improve a good management system, combine the superiority of collective unified management with the enthusiasm of farmers' contract management, enhance the vitality of economic development, and guide and help farmers to take the road of common prosperity. Fifth, establish a good management system, reflect the principle of democratic management, ensure the effective operation of work, and gradually put all village-level work on the track of institutionalization and standardization.
(III) The village party branch and other organizations must take the implementation of the party's basic line and unite and lead the peasants to achieve a well-off society as their fundamental task. The "Notice" points out that the grassroots party organizations in rural areas must conscientiously implement the principle of "grasping both hands and making both hands strong", firmly grasp the center of developing rural productivity, and at the same time strengthen the construction of socialist spiritual civilization and improve the ideological and moral level and scientific and cultural level of the vast number of farmers. Carry out in-depth activities to create civilized villages and towns and civilized farmers. It is necessary to enrich rural cultural life, promote the transformation of customs, and at the same time strengthen the management and supervision of the rural cultural market, and unswervingly use healthy, civilized and progressive ideas and customs to occupy the rural position.
(IV) Strengthen the construction of grassroots party organizations in rural areas and enhance cohesion and combat effectiveness. The "Notice" requires that the construction of party branches should focus on the construction of leadership teams, select good branch secretaries, and form a strong collective that can lead the peasants to achieve a well-off society. We should emancipate our minds and select those who conscientiously implement the Party's line, principles and policies, are fair and honest, are young and capable, and can lead the masses to prosperity as branch secretaries in accordance with the principle of both moral integrity and ability. We should pay special attention to selecting those who respect knowledge and talents and are good at gathering and using talents. We should support the current branch secretaries who have been tested by practice, are competent for the work, and are supported by the masses. Those who are really incompetent should be adjusted in time. The "Notice" requires that the grassroots party organization settings be reasonably adjusted according to the new situation, and the leadership style and working methods should be improved. In order to adapt to the changes in the rural industrial structure, labor employment structure and the distribution of party members, the party organization should adjust the setting form in time. The main leading members of the party branch, village committee and collective economic organization can appropriately cross-job part-time, keep efficient and focus on work efficiency. All grassroots party organizations must strictly implement democratic centralism, establish and improve work systems, actively carry out activities, and strengthen internal party supervision. The "Notice" points out that the education and management of rural party members should be strengthened and improved to help party members improve their quality and enhance their party spirit in an all-round way. From now on, in about three years, we will organize all rural party members to carry out activities to study the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and study the party constitution in a planned and step-by-step manner. Learning should be linked to reality, and criticism and self-criticism should be carried out to promote the "five good" construction of rural grassroots organizations and promote the transformation of backward villages. (V) Improve the villagers' self-government organizations, collective economic organizations and mass organizations, and promote the institutionalization and standardization of various village-level work. The "Notice" requires that the current focus should be on: 1. Village election system. 2. Village discussion system. 3. Village affairs disclosure system. 4. Village rules and regulations system. (VI) Strengthen the construction of rural grassroots cadres and comprehensively improve the quality of grassroots cadres. The "Notice" requires that the main cadres at the village level be trained in stages and batches. The training should be at least 10 days a year, and several of the most urgent problems should be solved each time. Village cadres can be organized to take turns to study at county and township party schools, or they can be organized to visit demonstration villages for well-off villages to exchange experiences and help each other. The "Notice" requires: 1. Political care and love. 1. For those outstanding village cadres who are fair and honest, work hard, and have made outstanding contributions to rural development and progress, their achievements should be fully recognized, their spirit should be publicized, and a culture of respect for grassroots cadres should be formed in society. 2. Establish an incentive mechanism suitable for the characteristics of rural grassroots, so that village cadres can do what they do, retire and have a pension. Promote the link between cadre remuneration and work performance, and ensure that it is fulfilled. Reward cadres who are recognized by the masses for their outstanding contributions. Actively create conditions to establish a pension insurance system for village cadres, or give appropriate subsidies to outgoing village cadres based on their tenure and contributions. The counties and townships where the cadres' remuneration subsidies in some poor villages, which are already very low, cannot be fulfilled, should actively try to solve the problem. In particularly difficult places, the higher-level organizations should provide necessary assistance. 3. Support village cadres to exercise their powers according to law and work boldly. 4. It is necessary to adhere to the long-term recruitment of township cadres from outstanding village cadres as an important system and improve it in practice. The "Notice" points out that it is necessary to do a good job in the ideological and work style construction of grassroots cadres in rural areas. Emphasis should be placed on educating them to adhere to the ideological line of emancipating the mind and seeking truth from facts, bearing in mind the purpose of serving the people wholeheartedly, striving to learn to follow the mass line in work, carrying forward the spirit of hard work and hard work, consciously resisting the erosion of materialism, individualism and decadent lifestyles, overcoming simple and crude work styles, and opposing fraud. Cadres with problems in ideology and work style should be criticized and educated in a timely manner. Those who violate discipline and law should be investigated and dealt with in a timely manner. (VII) Strengthen the construction of township party committees and township political power, so that they can truly shoulder the responsibility of strengthening village-level organization construction. The "Notice" requires that members of the county-level leadership team should focus on selecting from outstanding township leaders. The "Notice" points out that it is necessary to strengthen the party building of all departments directly under the county (city), especially the law enforcement departments and township units, to help them conscientiously implement the "two disclosures and one supervision" system, strengthen the party style and clean government construction, and resolutely correct the unhealthy trends in the industry. The institutions of the relevant departments of the county (city) located in townships should be distinguished according to different situations. Some are placed in the management of townships, and some are under the dual leadership of townships and county-level departments. In institutions that implement dual leadership, the transfer, appointment, removal, reward and punishment of cadres must obtain the consent of the township party committee.
(VIII) Party committees at all levels must effectively strengthen and improve their leadership over the construction of rural grassroots organizations. The "Notice" requires that provincial (autonomous region, municipality), prefecture (city) and county (city) committees should put the construction of rural grassroots organizations on the important agenda and work tirelessly. Party committee leaders should directly contact different types of villages, often go deep into the masses, discover and solve problems. Under the leadership of the party committee, all relevant functional departments should divide responsibilities, work closely together, and work together. The party committee's organization department or rural work department will take the lead in timely communication and coordination of work.
The "Notice" points out that the county (city) committee is the key to strengthening the construction of rural grassroots organizations. The county (city) committee should earnestly perform the following duties: formulate work rules to strengthen the construction of rural grassroots organizations in the whole county (city), determine the goals and measures for organization and implementation every year; grasp the situation of rural grassroots organizations, grasp the key points, and implement classified guidance; urge the township party committee to do a good job in village-level organization construction; do a good job in training the main cadres of the village; study and establish and implement the incentive mechanism for relevant rural cadres. The superior party committee should evaluate the performance of the county (city) committee in the construction of rural grassroots organizations in accordance with these duties.

谈话。这位负责人指出,我们党历来主张用人要公道正派。几年来,
党中央和中央领导同志对用人上存在的不正之风,曾多次提出严

门特别是各级领导部门坚决执行《通知》提出的各项要求,就能够

的不正之风。
translated_text: On the 11th, the head of the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China made a speech on the "Notice on Resolutely Preventing and Correcting Unhealthy Trends in the Selection and Appointment of Cadres" recently issued by the Organization Department of the Central Committee. The head pointed out that our party has always advocated fair and upright employment. In the past few years, the Party Central Committee and the central leaders have repeatedly made severe criticisms of the unhealthy trends in the selection and appointment of cadres and demanded that they be effectively corrected. The "Decision" of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 14th Central Committee of the Party has made clear requirements for solving this problem. The Organization Department of the Central Committee has also done a lot of work to solve this problem. However, this problem still exists in some places, departments and units to varying degrees, and some are still very serious. We believe that as long as the party committees and organization and personnel departments at all levels, especially the leading departments at all levels, resolutely implement the requirements put forward in the "Notice", they will be able to effectively solve the problems in the selection and appointment of cadres and resolutely stop the unhealthy trends in the selection and appointment of cadres.

期,干部队伍建设必须着重完成两项战略任务:一是全面提高现
有领导干部的素质,把县以上各级领导班子建设好;二是抓紧培
养选拔任用年轻干部,努力造就大批能够跨世纪担当重任的领
导人才,这是当务之重,当务之急,是全面推进党的建设这个新
的伟大工程的关键性工程。各地各部门要按照十四届四中全会
《决定》的要求加紧工作,力争在三五年內使选拔优秀年轻干部
有新的突破,培养教育干部工作有新的加强,深化干部制度改革
有新的进展。
江泽民强调,确立了正确的政治路线以后,建设一支坚决而有
效地执行党的路线的干部队伍,是事业顺利发展的决定性因素。贯
彻干部“四化”方针,做好领导干部的培养、选拔和领导班子的建设
工作,更是总揽党的建设全局的一项重要工作。他在对邓小平同志
新时期关于干部队伍建设的精辟论述作出概括的阐述以后指出,
在新的历史时期,邓小平同志以无产阶级革命家的战略眼光和博
大胸怀,从有中国特色社会主义建设事业兴旺发达,党和国家长治

化建设新局面的过程中,始终注意推进各级领导班子和干部队伍
建设,尤其关注着年轻干部的成长。邓小平同志不仅大力倡导,身

点丰富和发展了我们党关于干部队伍建设的理论,把新时期干部

工作,把培养选拔德才兼备的领导干部,加强领导班子建设这件大
事进一步做好。

需要有点硬性要求。各地各部门要按照中央的有关要求,从自己
的实际情况出发,制定工作规划,明确工作目标,扎扎实实去做。
工作中必须进一步解放思想,在克服用人上的陈腐落后观念方
面取得新突破,带动选拔优秀年轻干部的实践取得新突破。尤其

任用、教育、监督这几个环节都管起来,真正管好。要克服重选拔、
轻培养,重使用,轻教育的现象。培养党政领导干部的根本着眼点
和着力点,在于保证党的基本路线全面正确地贯彻执行。随着我国
社会主义现代化事业的迅速发展和改革的不断深化,对外开放的

的要求越来越高。各级各部门必须按照中央已经作出的安排,抓

有三条:一是持久地、刻苦地、理论联系实际学习马克思主义;二
是自觉地、严格地按照党章规定参加党内生活;三是在改革开放和
现代化建设的实践中加强锻炼。这三条要密切结合,并更多地注重
实践锻炼。

事:(一)明确目标要求,突出工作重点,抓紧培养选拔优秀年轻干
部;(二)以教育培训、实践锻炼,加强管理为主要措施,全面提高现

设;(五)适应新形势、新任务的要求,加强组织部门的自身建设。

备的原则,把革命化放在第一位,全面了解干部贯彻执行党的基

translated_text: From December 30 to December 3, the CPC Central Committee held a national organizational work conference. The meeting was chaired by Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat. Ding Guangen, Wu Bangguo, Jiang Chunyun and responsible comrades of relevant central departments, secretaries of provincial, autonomous region and municipal party committees, and responsible comrades of central and state organs attended the meeting. The main task of this meeting is to study and implement the decision of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 14th CPC Central Committee, and to study and deploy the training and selection of leading cadres with both moral integrity and ability, and strengthen the construction of leadership teams at all levels under the guidance of Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and the basic line of the party. Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, and Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, respectively delivered important speeches at the meeting. Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, made a brief report on the organizational work in 1995 at the meeting. Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, pointed out in his speech that at present and in the future, the construction of the cadre team must focus on completing two strategic tasks: one is to comprehensively improve the quality of existing leading cadres and build a good leadership team at all levels above the county level; the second is to speed up the training, selection and appointment of young cadres and strive to cultivate a large number of leading talents who can shoulder important responsibilities across the century. This is the top priority and the most urgent task, and it is a key project for comprehensively promoting the new great project of party building. All localities and departments should step up their work in accordance with the requirements of the "Decision" of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 14th Central Committee, and strive to make new breakthroughs in the selection of outstanding young cadres, strengthen the work of training and educating cadres, and make new progress in deepening the reform of the cadre system within three to five years. Jiang Zemin emphasized that after establishing the correct political line, building a cadre team that resolutely and effectively implements the party's line is a decisive factor for the smooth development of the cause. Implementing the "four modernizations" policy for cadres and doing a good job in the training, selection and construction of leading cadres is an important task that takes charge of the overall party building. After summarizing Comrade Deng Xiaoping's insightful exposition on the construction of the cadre team in the new era, he pointed out that in the new historical period, Comrade Deng Xiaoping, with the strategic vision and broad mind of a proletarian revolutionary, started from the strategic height of the prosperity of the cause of socialist construction with Chinese characteristics and the long-term stability of the party and the country. In the process of leading the whole party and the people of the whole country to create a new situation in socialist modernization, he always paid attention to promoting the construction of leadership teams and cadre teams at all levels, especially paying attention to the growth of young cadres. Comrade Deng Xiaoping not only advocated vigorously and practiced it himself, but also put forward a scientific exposition on the construction of the cadre team and the leadership team in a comprehensive and systematic manner on the basis of studying new situations and summarizing new experiences. He enriched and developed our party's theory on the construction of the cadre team with a series of new ideas and new viewpoints, and made the guiding ideology, goal requirements, basic principles, working methods, system construction and wrong tendencies to be prevented and overcome in the new era of cadre team and leadership team construction very clear and thorough. Party committees at all levels, especially the main leading comrades and the leading comrades of the organization and personnel departments, must earnestly study and deeply understand Comrade Xiaoping's exposition, and insist on using it to guide their work, and do a better job in the major task of cultivating and selecting leading cadres with both moral integrity and ability and strengthening the construction of the leadership team. Jiang Zemin said that the task of selecting outstanding young cadres must be implemented, and some rigid requirements are needed within a certain period of time. All localities and departments should formulate work plans, clarify work goals, and do it in a down-to-earth manner in accordance with the relevant requirements of the Central Committee and based on their actual conditions. We must further emancipate our minds in our work, make new breakthroughs in overcoming outdated and backward concepts in employing people, and drive new breakthroughs in the practice of selecting outstanding young cadres. In particular, we must learn from the vision and courage of the older generation of revolutionaries in knowing people and appointing them to positions, consider issues from the strategic perspective of the long-term construction of the leadership team and the long-term stability of the country, and constantly expand our horizons in identifying people, broaden the channels for selecting people, improve the methods for selecting cadres, fully follow the mass line, and open up the road to talent. Jiang Zemin pointed out that educating people is the basic work for the development of talent resources and the prerequisite for creating and selecting high-quality talents. The Party Committee manages cadres. It must be fully responsible and manage all the links of discovery, training, selection, appointment, education, and supervision, and truly manage them well. We must overcome the phenomenon of emphasizing selection and neglecting training, emphasizing use and neglecting education. The fundamental focus and focus of cultivating party and government leading cadres is to ensure that the Party’s basic line is fully and correctly implemented. With the rapid development of my country's socialist modernization and the continuous deepening of reform, the further expansion of opening up to the outside world, and the changes in the world's economic and political landscape, the requirements for the ideological and theoretical literacy, economic management and scientific and technological knowledge, and especially the ability to govern the party and the country of our party and government leaders at all levels are getting higher and higher. All levels and departments must work hard in accordance with the arrangements made by the central government to comprehensively cultivate and improve the quality of leading cadres. There are three basic ways for cadres to train and grow: first, to study Marxism persistently, diligently, and in conjunction with theory and practice; second, to consciously and strictly participate in party life in accordance with the provisions of the party constitution; and third, to strengthen training in the practice of reform, opening up and modernization. These three points should be closely combined, and more emphasis should be placed on practical training. In his speech, Zhang Quanjing pointed out that the organizational work in 1995 should focus on five things: (i) clarify the goal requirements, highlight the work priorities, and speed up the training and selection of outstanding young cadres; (ii) take education and training, practical training, and strengthen management as the main measures to comprehensively improve the quality of existing leading cadres; (iii) improve the ideological style, improve the leadership team structure, and strengthen the construction of leadership teams at all levels; (iv) provide classified guidance, strengthen and improve the construction of grassroots party organizations; (v) adapt to the requirements of the new situation and new tasks, and strengthen the self-construction of the organization department. Zhang Quanjing pointed out that the starting point for training and selecting outstanding young cadres should be higher, the vision should be longer-term, and the courage should be greater. We must adhere to the "four modernizations" policy of the cadre team and the principle of both moral integrity and ability, put revolutionization first, fully understand the attitude and performance of cadres in implementing the party's basic line, understand the cadres' basic political stance, political inclination and ideological style, and also understand the cadres' professional level and organizational leadership ability, so that the cadres selected and trained can not only meet the requirements of the cross-century leadership in terms of age, but also meet the needs of the cross-century development of the party's cause in terms of moral integrity and ability, and ensure that the cause of socialism with Chinese characteristics is passed down from generation to generation. He pointed out that it is necessary to open up multiple channels to enable leading cadres to enrich their experience and increase their abilities in practical training. It is necessary to increase the intensity of cadre exchanges, expand the scope of exchanges, and cultivate cadres and discover talents in exchanges. Zhang Quanjing required that party organizations and leading cadres at all levels should attach importance to strengthening the construction of the party's grassroots organizations; earnestly carry out learning activities among party members on the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and the party constitution; concentrate on rectifying and building rural party branches that are weak, scattered and paralyzed; in the process of establishing a modern enterprise system, strengthen and improve the party building of state-owned enterprises; strengthen the work of developing party members among young people and women; improve and strengthen the management of mobile party members. On the 2nd, the General Office of the Central Committee issued "Comrade Jiang Zemin's Speech at the National Organization Work Conference".

30日 中共中央组织部印发《关于进一步整顿软弱涣散和擁
痪状态党支部的意见》。《意见》指出,近几年来,各地按照中央的部
署,结合本地实际,集中力量整顿农村软弱涣散和瘫痪状态党支
部,做了大量工作,取得明显成效。同时,必须看到,还有一些处于
软弱涣散和瘫痪状态的党支部,没有整顿或没有整顿好。这类党支
部的主要问题是:有的领导班子形不成核心,甚至处于瘫痪状态;
有的经济发展缓慢,群众生活没有明显改善;有的干部作风不好,
干群关系紧张,村风民风不正,社会治安混乱;还有极少数村党支
部被宗族势力或其他恶势力所把持。上述情况如不尽快改变,不仅
会严重削弱党对农村工作的领导,影响农村经济的发展,而且会危
及农村社会的稳定,动摇党在农村的工作基础。对此,各级党委一
定要有清醒的认识。
《意见》提出整顿工作的指导思想是:以邓小平同志建设有中
国特色社会主义理论和党的基本路线为指导,以整顿支部领导班
子,解决突出问题为重点,坚持思想整顿与必要的组织调整相结
合,上级党组织帮助整顿与提高党支部解决自身问题的能力相结
合,重点整顿党支部与整顿其他村级组织相结合。整顿工作的目
标,一是建设一个好领导班子,尤其是要有一个好书记,能够团结
带领群众坚决贯彻执行党的路线方针政策。二是培养锻炼一支好
队伍,共产党员能够发挥先锋模范作用,干部能够发挥示范带头作
用,共青团员能够发挥助手和后备军作用。三是选准一条发展经济
的好路子,充分发挥当地优势,加快农民脱贫致富奔小康的步伐。
四是完善一个好经营体制,把集体统一经营的优越性和农户承包
经营的积极性结合起来,增强经济发展的活力,引导和帮助农民走
共同富裕的道路。五是健全一套好的管理制度,体现民主管理原
则,保证工作有效运转,使村级各项工作逐步走上制度化、规范化
的轨道。
《意见》提出了整顿工作的基本做法:(一)摸清情况,制订整顿
规划和实施方案;(二)针对不同情况,采取不同方法,讲究整顿实
效;(三)重点整顿好党支部领导班子,选配好党支部书记;(四)认
真解决存在的突出问题,改变村里的落后状况;(五)帮助村党支部
找准发展经济的路子,尽快改变贫困落后面貌:(六)加强对党员的
教育管理,全面提高党员素质。
《意见》要求各级党委要把整顿工作列入重要的议事日程,加
强领导,切实抓紧抓好。县乡党委都要建立责任制,党委书记是第
一负责人。县委书记要亲自抓,县委常委要直接抓几个村党支部的
整顿工作。要针对这些村党支部存在的主要问题和不同原因进行
整顿,防止形式主义,注重实际效果。各省、自治区、直辖市党委要
按整顿工作的目的和要求,制订验收标准。组织、宣传、纪检、民政、
农业、群团等各有关方面,要在党委的统一领导下,充分发挥各自
的作用,并搞好团结协作,形成齐抓共管的合力。
translated_text: On the 30th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Opinions on Further Rectifying Weak, Fragile and Paralyzed Party Branches". The "Opinions" pointed out that in recent years, all localities have concentrated their efforts on rectifying weak, fragmented and paralyzed rural party branches in accordance with the deployment of the central government and combined with local realities, and have done a lot of work and achieved obvious results. At the same time, it must be noted that there are still some party branches that are in a weak, fragmented and paralyzed state, which have not been rectified or have not been rectified well. The main problems of this type of party branch are: some leadership teams cannot form a core, or are even in a paralyzed state; some have slow economic development and the lives of the masses have not improved significantly; some cadres have bad work styles, tense relations between cadres and the masses, unhealthy village customs and social order; and a very small number of village party branches are controlled by clan forces or other evil forces. If the above situation is not changed as soon as possible, it will not only seriously weaken the party's leadership over rural work and affect the development of the rural economy, but also endanger the stability of rural society and shake the foundation of the party's work in rural areas. Party committees at all levels must have a clear understanding of this. The guiding ideology of the rectification work proposed in the Opinion is: guided by Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and the basic line of the Party, focusing on rectifying the leadership team of the branch and solving outstanding problems, insisting on combining ideological rectification with necessary organizational adjustments, combining the superior party organization's help in rectification with improving the ability of the party branch to solve its own problems, and focusing on rectifying the party branch with rectifying other village-level organizations. The goals of the rectification work are, first, to build a good leadership team, especially a good secretary who can unite and lead the masses to resolutely implement the party's line, principles and policies. Second, to cultivate and train a good team, so that Communist Party members can play a vanguard and exemplary role, cadres can play a leading role in demonstration, and Communist Youth League members can play a role as assistants and reserve forces. Third, to choose a good way to develop the economy, give full play to local advantages, and accelerate the pace of farmers' poverty alleviation and prosperity. Fourth, to improve a good management system, combine the superiority of collective unified management with the enthusiasm of farmers' contract management, enhance the vitality of economic development, and guide and help farmers to take the road of common prosperity. Fifth, establish a good management system, embody the principle of democratic management, ensure the effective operation of the work, and gradually put all village-level work on the track of institutionalization and standardization. The "Opinions" put forward the basic approach to the rectification work: (a) find out the situation, formulate a rectification plan and implementation plan; (b) take different methods according to different situations, and pay attention to the effectiveness of rectification; (c) focus on rectifying the leadership team of the party branch and selecting the party branch secretary; (d) earnestly solve the outstanding problems and change the backward situation in the village; (e) help the village party branch find the right way to develop the economy and change the poverty and backwardness as soon as possible; (six) strengthen the education and management of party members and comprehensively improve the quality of party members. The "Opinions" require party committees at all levels to put the rectification work on the important agenda, strengthen leadership, and earnestly grasp it. County and township party committees must establish a responsibility system, and the party committee secretary is the first person in charge. The county party secretary must personally take charge, and the county party committee standing committee must directly take charge of the rectification work of several village party branches. We should rectify the main problems and different causes of these village party branches, prevent formalism, and focus on actual results. The provincial, autonomous region, and municipal party committees should formulate acceptance standards according to the purpose and requirements of the rectification work. Organization, propaganda, discipline inspection, civil affairs, agriculture, mass organizations and other relevant departments should give full play to their respective roles under the unified leadership of the party committee, and work together to form a joint force for joint management.

events:
8日 中共中央政治局常委、书记处书记胡锦涛在第五期党
员专家理论研究班上发表讲话。胡锦涛在讲话中指出,广大知识分
子特别是党员专家,要联系思想和科技工作实际,认真学习邓小平
同志建设有中国特色的社会主义理论,进一步认清自己肩负的历
史使命和重大责任,坚定社会主义信念,树立正确的人生观和价值
观,发扬拼搏精神,勇攀科技高峰,为改革开放和现代化建设做出
更大的贡献。胡锦涛指出,举办党员专家短期理论研究班,是提高
党员专家思想理论水平的一种好形式。要认真总结经验,使这种研
究班办得更好。
胡锦涛指出,当今世界以经济和科技为基础的综合国力较量
日趋激烈。我国的改革和建设任务也十分繁重艰巨。要促进我国
的经济又快又好地发展,推动社会全面进步,在国际上取得更加主
动的地位,都要求我们更加重视科技发展和知识分子作用的充分
发挥。
胡锦涛强调,“尊重知识、尊重人才”是邓小平同志的一贯思
想。关于“科学技术是第一生产力”,关于知识和知识分子的重要论
述,是建设有中国特色社会主义理论的重要组成部分。他说,改革
开放以来,邓小平同志一直十分关注着科学技术事业的发展和知
识分子队伍的建设,他从解放和发展生产力的高度,多次强调向科
学技术现代化进军,强调要造就一支浩浩荡荡的工人阶级的又红
又专的科学技术大军,培养一大批世界第一流的科学家、工程技术
专家,强调中国必须在世界高科技领域占有一席之地,并且把善于
发现人才、团结人才,使用人才,作为衡量领导者是否成熟的主要
标志之一。邓小平同志这方面的论述,是我们做好知识分子工作的
重要指针。各级党委、政府要认真学习、深刻领会,进一步提高认
识,统一思想,并在实际工作中全面贯彻落实。要把知识分子工作
摆上重要日程,切实加强领导。要认真总结经验,采取有效措施,及
时研究解决知识分子工作中出现的新情况新问题。要经常深入科
研､教学工作第一线,同知识分子交朋友,悉心听取他们的意见和
建议,满腔热情地帮助他们解决实际困难,为广大知识分子充分发
挥作用,为优秀人才脱颖而出创造良好的环境。
translated_text: On the 8th, Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, delivered a speech at the fifth Party Member Expert Theory Study Class. In his speech, Hu Jintao pointed out that the majority of intellectuals, especially Party members and experts, should connect their thoughts with the actual scientific and technological work, earnestly study Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, further recognize the historical mission and major responsibilities they shoulder, strengthen their socialist beliefs, establish a correct outlook on life and values, carry forward the spirit of hard work, bravely climb the peak of science and technology, and make greater contributions to reform, opening up and modernization. Hu Jintao pointed out that holding a short-term theoretical study class for Party members and experts is a good form to improve the ideological and theoretical level of Party members and experts. We must seriously sum up experience and make this kind of study class better. Hu Jintao pointed out that the competition of comprehensive national strength based on economy and science and technology in the world today is becoming increasingly fierce. my country's reform and construction tasks are also very heavy and arduous. To promote the rapid and sound development of my country's economy, promote the overall progress of society, and gain a more active position in the international arena, we must pay more attention to the development of science and technology and the full play of the role of intellectuals. Hu Jintao stressed that "respecting knowledge and talents" is the consistent thought of Comrade Deng Xiaoping. The important discussion on "science and technology is the primary productive force" and on knowledge and intellectuals is an important part of the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics. He said that since the reform and opening up, Comrade Deng Xiaoping has always paid great attention to the development of science and technology and the construction of the intellectual team. From the perspective of liberating and developing productive forces, he repeatedly emphasized the need to march towards the modernization of science and technology, to create a mighty army of red and professional scientists and engineers of the working class, to train a large number of world-class scientists and engineering experts, and to emphasize that China must occupy a place in the world's high-tech field. He also regarded being good at discovering, uniting and using talents as one of the main signs of measuring whether a leader is mature. Comrade Deng Xiaoping's discussion in this regard is an important guideline for us to do a good job in intellectual work. Party committees and governments at all levels should study and understand it carefully, further improve their understanding, unify their thinking, and fully implement it in practical work. We must put intellectual work on the important agenda and strengthen leadership. We should carefully summarize our experience, take effective measures, and promptly study and solve new situations and problems that arise in the work of intellectuals. We should often go to the front lines of scientific research and teaching, make friends with intellectuals, listen carefully to their opinions and suggestions, and enthusiastically help them solve practical difficulties, so as to create a good environment for the broad masses of intellectuals to fully play their roles and for outstanding talents to stand out.

国经济工作的卓越领导人,原中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理

中共中央组织部发出《关于试行<流动党员活动证>制
度的通知》。为了进一步改进和加强流动党员管理,根据党的十四
届四中全会决定精神,本着有利于党员合理流动,有利于党组织管
理,有利于党员发挥作用的原则,《通知》就《流动党员活动证》的适
用范围、《流动党员活动证》的制发以及《流动党员活动证》的使用

的领导,县(市)委要认真抓好落实。党委组织部门要严格执行有关
规定,加强具体指导。在试行过程中,各地要及时研究解决流动党

translated_text: On the 11th, Comrade Yao Yilin, an outstanding leader of the Party and the country, an outstanding proletarian revolutionary, an outstanding leader of China's economic work, and a former member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, died in Beijing due to ineffective treatment of illness at the age of 77. The Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on the Trial Implementation of the <Mobile Party Member Activity Permit> System". In order to further improve and strengthen the management of mobile party members, in accordance with the spirit of the decision of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 14th CPC Central Committee, in line with the principle of facilitating the reasonable flow of party members, facilitating the management of party organizations, and facilitating the role of party members, the "Notice" stipulates the scope of application of the "Mobile Party Member Activity Permit", the issuance of the "Mobile Party Member Activity Permit" and the use of the "Mobile Party Member Activity Permit". The "Notice" requires that party committees at all levels should strengthen their leadership in the trial implementation of the "Mobile Party Member Activity Permit", and county (city) committees should earnestly implement it. Party committee organization departments should strictly implement relevant regulations and strengthen specific guidance. During the trial process, all localities should promptly study and solve the problems existing in the management of mobile party members and establish a normal order for the management of mobile party members as soon as possible.

events:
30日 中共中央组织部、中共中央宣传部印发《关于在党员
中开展建设有中国特色社会主义理论和党章学习活动的意见》的
通知。《意见》的主要内容是:(一)充分认识开展学习活动的重要意
义。(二)学习的主要内容和要求。这次学习的主要内容是:邓小平
同志关于建设有中国特色社会主义理论的著作和《中国共产党章
程》。整个学习活动要坚持高标准严要求,不搞形式主义,不能走过
场,要扎实深入细致,切实解决基层组织和党员中存在的突出问
题。着重解决好三个问题:第一,树立共产主义理想,坚定走有中国
特色社会主义道路的信念,提高坚持党的基本理论和基本路线的
自觉性,模范执行党的各项政策。第,坚持全心全意为人民服务
的宗旨,密切联系群众,廉洁奉公,遵纪守法,自觉抵制拜金主义、
个人主义和腐朽生活方式的侵蚀。第三,按照党章规定认真履行义
务,正确行使权利,在改革和建设中建功立业。各级党组织对从事
不同职业的党员,要提出不同的学习重点和要求。(三)学习活动的
步骤方法,学习活动的形式和方法,要因地制宜。可充分利用各类
基层党校,分期分批地对党员进行短期轮训,也可采用冬训或办学
习班的形式对党员进行集中培训。对有一定文化程度的党员,可组
织他们重点选学有关文献;对没有阅读能力的党员,要组织力量对
他们进行宣讲和辅导,把自学同宣讲、适当集中轮训结合起来。对
外出流动党员,党组织要区别不同情况,采取有效措施,使他们都
能参加学习活动。短期外出(6个月以内)的党员,由原所在党组织
妥善安排他们的学习;长期外出的党员,由外出所在地党组织负责
安排他们参加学习活动。(四)学习活动的组织领导。各级党委要
把这项工作列入重要议事日程,建立责任制,切实抓紧抓好。在党
委的统一领导下,组织、宣传部门和纪检机关、党校密切配合,通力
合作,共同做好工作。县以上党委根据需要,可成立精干的工作班
子,负责抓好这项工作。对于处于软弱涣散和瘫痪状态的基层党组
织,上级党组织要派得力干部帮助整顿,把整顿工作同学习活动结
合起来。
translated_text: On the 30th, the Organization Department and the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee issued a notice on "Opinions on Carrying out Learning Activities on the Theory of Building Socialism with Chinese Characteristics and the Party Constitution among Party Members". The main contents of the "Opinions" are: (a) Fully understand the importance of carrying out learning activities. (b) The main contents and requirements of learning. The main contents of this study are: Comrade Deng Xiaoping's works on the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and the "Constitution of the Communist Party of China". The entire learning activity must adhere to high standards and strict requirements, not engage in formalism, and cannot be perfunctory. It must be solid, in-depth and meticulous, and effectively solve the outstanding problems existing in grassroots organizations and party members. Focus on solving three problems: First, establish the communist ideal, firmly believe in the road of socialism with Chinese characteristics, improve the consciousness of adhering to the party's basic theory and basic line, and implement the party's policies in an exemplary manner. Second, adhere to the purpose of serving the people wholeheartedly, keep close contact with the masses, be honest and dedicated, abide by discipline and laws, and consciously resist the erosion of materialism, individualism and decadent lifestyles. Third, conscientiously perform obligations and correctly exercise rights in accordance with the provisions of the Party Constitution, and make contributions in reform and construction. Party organizations at all levels should put forward different learning priorities and requirements for party members engaged in different professions. (III) The steps and methods of learning activities, the forms and methods of learning activities should be adapted to local conditions. We can make full use of various grassroots party schools to conduct short-term training for party members in stages and batches, or we can adopt winter training or school classes to conduct centralized training for party members. For party members with a certain level of education, we can organize them to focus on studying relevant literature; for party members who have no reading ability, we should organize forces to give them lectures and guidance, and combine self-study with lectures and appropriate centralized training. For mobile party members, party organizations should distinguish different situations and take effective measures to enable them to participate in learning activities. For party members who are away for a short period of time (within 6 months), their original party organizations shall properly arrange their studies; for party members who are away for a long time, the party organizations in the places where they are away shall be responsible for arranging their participation in learning activities. (IV) The organization and leadership of learning activities. Party committees at all levels should put this work on the important agenda, establish a responsibility system, and earnestly grasp it. Under the unified leadership of the Party Committee, the organization, propaganda departments, discipline inspection agencies, and party schools should work closely together and make concerted efforts to do a good job. Party committees at or above the county level can set up a capable working group to take charge of this work as needed. For grassroots party organizations that are weak, lax, and paralyzed, higher-level party organizations should send capable cadres to help rectify them and combine rectification work with learning activities.

translated_text: According to statistics from the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, by the end of December 1994, the number of cadres at all levels of party, government and mass organizations, management and professional and technical personnel of enterprises and institutions, and primary and secondary school teachers had reached 37.962 million (5.33 million employed personnel). Among them: 6.782 million cadres at all levels of party, government and mass organizations, 8.272 million management and professional and technical personnel of scientific research, education, health and other institutions, 15.401 million management and professional and technical personnel of state-owned enterprises such as factories, mines and companies, and 7.508 million primary and secondary school teachers led by education administrative departments. In the past year, 2.2 million new cadres have joined the cadre team, and more than 1.2 million have left the cadre team. The increase is 2.7%, which is 0.4 percentage points lower than the previous year. In the party, government and mass organizations at all levels, 146,000 outstanding cadres have been promoted to leadership positions at all levels. Among them: 66 people hold provincial (ministerial) level positions, 2,936 people hold prefectural (bureau) level positions, 28,000 people hold county (division) level positions, and 115,000 people hold township (section) level positions. Due to factors such as institutional reform, the number of leadership positions promoted throughout the year has decreased compared with the previous year. Among them, there are 6,300 fewer county (division) level positions and 55,000 fewer township (section) level positions.

events:
1日 《人民日报》发表了“总揽全局乘势前进”的元旦献辞。
《社论》指出,刚刚过去的一年,在我国改革开放和社会主义现
代化建设的发展史上,值得大书一笔。在这一年,全国上下一心打
了一场相当漂亮的改革攻坚战,在财税、金融、外汇、外贸、投资、价
格等方面进行了重大改革,取得了突破性进展,加强和改善了国家
宏观调控,为建立社会主义市场经济体制迈出了坚实的关键的一
步。对外开放进一步扩大,全年进出口总额首次突破2000亿美元,
国家外汇储备大幅度增加。国际上有影响的大财团、大企业来华投
资明显增多。在这一年,国内生产总值比上年增长了11.8%。国民
经济保持了持续、快速、健康发展的势头。农业尽管遭受严重自然
灾害,仍然取得较好收成。国家的交通、能源等重点建设项目进展
态势良好,尤其是当今世界最大的水利枢纽工程长江三峡工程正
式开工,世界为之瞩目,全国人民为之鼓舞。
《社论》指出,1994年的奋斗历程告诉我们,党中央在年初确
定的全党和全国工作的大局:“抓住机遇,深化改革,扩大开放,促
进发展,保持稳定”,是多么及时,多么正确!这一重大指导方针,充
分体现了党的“一个中心,两个基本点”基本路线的要求,高度概括
了今后一个时期党的工作的基本内容,完全符合1992年邓小平同
志重要谈话和党的十四大精神。实践证明,以二十字方针总揽全
局,不仅是1994年,而且是新的一年乃至以后一个长时期都要坚
定不移地遵循的总方针。
《社论》指出,1995年是实行国民经济和社会发展“八五”计划
的最后一年,也是为进入“九五”计划作好必要准备的一年,是承前
启后的一年。统一思想、总揽全局,加强协调、扎实工作,是我们在
新的一年里应当贯彻的指导思想。
translated_text: On the 1st, the People's Daily published a New Year's Day message of "taking a comprehensive view of the overall situation and moving forward with momentum". In this year, the whole country worked together to fight a very beautiful reform battle, carried out major reforms in finance, taxation, finance, foreign exchange, foreign trade, investment, prices, etc., achieved breakthrough progress, strengthened and improved national macroeconomic regulation, and took a solid and key step towards establishing a socialist market economic system. In this year, the gross domestic product increased by 11.8% over the previous year. The national economy maintained a momentum of sustained, rapid and healthy development. Despite severe natural disasters, agriculture still achieved a good harvest. The progress of key construction projects in the country, such as transportation and energy, is good, especially the official start of the Yangtze River Three Gorges Project, the world's largest water conservancy hub, which has attracted the attention of the world and inspired the people of the country. The editorial pointed out that the struggle in 1994 told us how timely and correct the overall situation of the Party Central Committee's work for the whole party and the whole country determined at the beginning of the year: "Seize opportunities, deepen reforms, expand opening up, promote development, and maintain stability" is! Practice has proved that the twenty-character policy is the general policy that must be followed unswervingly not only in 1994, but also in the new year and even for a long period of time thereafter. The editorial pointed out that 1995 is the last year of the implementation of the Eighth Five-Year Plan for national economic and social development, and is also the year to make necessary preparations for the Ninth Five-Year Plan. It is a year that connects the past and the future. Unifying thoughts, taking a comprehensive view of the overall situation, strengthening coordination, and working hard are the guiding principles we should implement in the new year.

国家机关各部委干部人事司(局)正副局长的轮训,由中央组织
部培训中心承担。对一部分比较年轻的省区市党委组织部副部长,
还可选送到中央党校进行政治理论和组织工作业务的系统学习。
各省、自治区、直辖市党委组织部,中央、国家机关各部委干部人事
司(局)要按照干部管理权限,组织好本部门和下一级组织、干部部
门负责人的培训。
translated_text:
On the 13th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on the Rotational Training of Organization Department Cadres at All Levels". The "Notice" pointed out that starting from 1995, it would take two years to carry out a planned and step-by-step rotation training for cadres at all levels of organization departments. Through rotation training, the political and professional quality and work level of organizational cadres will be further improved, and efforts will be made to cultivate a team of organizational work cadres with strong party spirit, good work style, fairness and integrity, integrity, reform and innovation, and proficiency in business. The "Notice" pointed out that in the rotation training, corresponding shifts should be set up according to the different requirements of cadres at different levels, different learning contents should be determined, and different learning methods should be adopted. The heads and deputy heads of the Organization Departments of the Provincial, Regional and Municipal Party Committees and the directors of the Cadre and Personnel Departments of the Central State Organs and Ministries should, on the basis of comprehensively and systematically studying the theory of the construction of the ruling party in the new era and mastering the overall goals and requirements of strengthening and improving party building under the conditions of reform and opening up, conduct in-depth discussions on the new situations and new problems currently faced, summarize fresh experiences, and study new countermeasures. At the same time, they should also learn some modern management knowledge, leadership science and working methods.
Cadres who have been engaged in organizational work for a short time should learn and master the business, work procedures and methods of organizational work, improve their professional quality as soon as possible and adapt to the needs of work. This rotation training of organizational cadres, each person's full-time study time is generally about one month.
The "Notice" stipulates that rotation training should be carried out in accordance with the principle of hierarchical responsibility. In addition to participating in the Central Party School's provincial and ministerial cadres training class as originally planned, the Central Organization Department will hold a special research class on organizational work according to the situation and needs. The rotation training of the deputy ministers of the organization departments of the party committees of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the central government, as well as the ministers of the organization departments of the party committees of 16 sub-provincial cities such as Guangzhou under the central government, and the directors and deputy directors of the cadre personnel departments (bureaus) of various ministries and commissions of the central and state organs will be undertaken by the Central Organization Department Training Center. For some relatively young deputy ministers of the organization departments of the provincial, autonomous region and municipal party committees,
they can also be selected to be sent to the Central Party School for systematic study of political theory and organizational work.
The Organization Departments of the Party Committees of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, and the Cadre and Personnel Departments (bureaus) of the ministries and commissions of the Central Government and the State Organs shall organize the training of the heads of their own departments and the next-level organizations and cadre departments in accordance with the authority of cadre management.

治局常委、书记处书记、中央党校校长胡锦涛出席,并向学员颁发

信息专业研讨班等班次的学员。中直机关、中央国家机关分校、部
队分部也有1760名学员同期毕业。毕业学员在校期间,以学习建
设有中国特色社会主义理论为中心内容,认真研读《邓小平文选》
第三卷,选读了一些马列主义、毛泽东思想的基本理论著作,学习

识,对当前改革和发展中的一些重大理论和现实问题进行了研讨。
