translated_text:
On the same day, the Central Party School of the Communist Party of China held its 1994 winter graduation ceremony. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China, Secretary of the Secretariat, and President of the Central Party School, attended the ceremony and issued graduation certificates to the students.
In the winter of 1995, a total of 410 students graduated from the Central Party School, including students from the training class for prefectural and municipal cadres of the training department, the training class for ethnic minority cadres in Xinjiang, Tibet, and Yunnan of the training department, and the library and information professional seminar. During their stay at the school, the graduates focused on learning the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, carefully studied the third volume of "Selected Works of Deng Xiaoping", selected some basic theoretical works of Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought, learned the basic theories of the socialist market economy and some basic knowledge required for modernization, and discussed some major theoretical and practical issues in the current reform and development.
The graduation ceremony was hosted by Su Xing, Vice President of the Central Party School, and attended by Zhang Quanjing, Liu Yunshan, Chen Fujin and other leaders of relevant central departments.

translated_text: From the 14th to the 16th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China held a symposium on cadre review work of some provincial and municipal party committees in Taiyuan. events:
20日 江泽民、李鹏、刘华清等中央领导同志出席中共中央
举办的社会主义法制建设讲座。讲座结束时,江泽民作了重要讲
话。
江泽民指出,我们党的领导主要是政治、思想、组织领导。而政
治领导的主要方式就是:使党的主张经过法定程序变成国家意志,
通过党组织的活动和党员的模范作用带动广大人民群众,实现党
的路线、方针、政策。党领导人民制定的宪法和法律是人民意志的
体现,是党的主张的体现。执行宪法和法律,是对人民意志的尊重,
是贯彻党的路线、方针、政策的重要保障。既要领导宪法和法律
的制定,又要自觉地在宪法和法律的范围内活动,严格依法办事,
依法管理国家。这对实现全党和人民意志的统一,对维护法律的尊
严和中央的权威关系十分重大。这就要求我们党和国家的各级领
导干部,必须不断地学习和掌握法律知识,具备较高的依法管理经
济、管理社会的能力。
江泽民说,为了适应社会主义市场经济发展和社会全面进步
的要求,我国法制建设的进程正在不断加快,提高领导干部的法律
素质已成为一项紧迫要求。各级领导干部一定要增强学习法律知
识的自觉性,并且要形成制度,除了每年集中听一两次法制课外,
还要充分发挥各级党校、干校在传授法律知识中的作用。邓小平同
志关于加强社会主义民主与法制建设的思想以及法律的基本知
识,应该成为党校、干校的必设课程。通过多种途径的学习和实践,
务必使各级领导干部的法律知识和依法管理经济社会事务的水
平,尽快地有一个较大的提高。
translated_text: On the 20th, Jiang Zemin, Li Peng, Liu Huaqing and other central leaders attended the lecture on socialist legal system construction held by the CPC Central Committee. At the end of the lecture, Jiang Zemin made an important speech. Jiang Zemin pointed out that the leadership of our party is mainly political, ideological and organizational leadership. The main way of political leadership is to make the party's propositions become the will of the state through legal procedures, and to drive the broad masses of people through the activities of the party organization and the exemplary role of party members to realize the party's line, principles and policies. The constitution and laws formulated by the party leading the people are the embodiment of the people's will and the embodiment of the party's propositions. The implementation of the constitution and laws is a respect for the people's will and an important guarantee for the implementation of the party's line, principles and policies. It is necessary to lead the formulation of the constitution and laws, and to consciously act within the scope of the constitution and laws, strictly act in accordance with the law, and manage the country in accordance with the law. This is of great importance to achieving the unity of the will of the whole party and the people, and to maintaining the dignity of the law and the authority of the central government. This requires that the leading cadres at all levels of our party and country must constantly learn and master legal knowledge and have a high ability to manage the economy and society in accordance with the law. Jiang Zemin said that in order to adapt to the requirements of the development of the socialist market economy and the overall progress of society, the process of legal system construction in my country is accelerating, and improving the legal quality of leading cadres has become an urgent requirement. Leading cadres at all levels must strengthen their awareness of learning legal knowledge and form a system. In addition to attending one or two legal courses every year, they must also give full play to the role of party schools and cadre schools at all levels in imparting legal knowledge. Comrade Deng Xiaoping's thoughts on strengthening socialist democracy and legal system construction and basic legal knowledge should become compulsory courses in party schools and cadre schools. Through learning and practice in various ways, it is imperative to make the legal knowledge of leading cadres at all levels and the level of managing economic and social affairs in accordance with the law improve as soon as possible.

events:
23日 中共中央总书记江泽民出席中纪委第五次全会并发
表重要讲话。
江泽民指出,在改革开放的条件下反对腐败,必须把集中惩处
和打击违法犯罪,加强法制建设,加强思想政治建设都努力做好,
使三个方面的工作有机地结合起来,相互促进,以利于把这场斗争
不断引向深入,保证改革开放和现代化建设的顺利进行。
江泽民强调,思想政治建设是我们党提高自身凝聚力、战斗力
的一条十分重要的经验,也是我们党始终保持工人阶级先锋队性
质,坚持拒腐防变的一项根本性措施。加强思想政治建设,提高干
部和党员队伍的思想政治素质,最根本的是要解决好世界观、人生
观问题。无论过去、现在和将来,这对每个干部和党员来说,都是首
要的问题。
江泽民指出,为当代建设有中国特色的社会主义而奋斗,为最
终实现共产主义而奋斗,这是我们最崇高的人生追求。当前,要帮
干部和党员认识和处理好三个关系:一是改革创新与继承优良
传统的关系,是对外开放中吸收和抵制的关系,三是先富与共同
富裕的关系。
江泽民说,立党为公,清正廉洁,是我们党受到人民群众拥护、
领导人民夺取革命和建设事业胜利的奥秘所在。在执政条件下,共
产党员坚持全心全意为人民服务的宗旨,坚持廉洁奉公,最重要的
是必须正确认识和对待手中的权力。
江泽民指出,我们党是靠艰苦奋斗不断发展壮大起来的。过去
干革命需要艰苦奋斗,今天搞社会主义现代化建设同样要靠艰苦
奋斗。古往今来,一个国家,一个民族,如果不提倡艰苦奋斗、勤俭

乐,不图进取,那么,这样的国家,这样的民族,是没有不走向衰落
的。
江泽民强调,各级领导干部能否以身作则,对加强党风建设和
廉政建设,推动反腐败斗争的深入发展至关重要。县(处)级以上领
导干部要严格执行中央提出的廉洁自律的规定,按照规定对照检
查自己。对违反规定拒不纠正的,对顶风违纪的,要严肃处理。对
国有企业和事业单位的领导干部,中纪委这次全会也提出了廉洁
自律的规定,要认真贯彻执行。各级领导干部不仅要对本地区、本
部门、本单位的各项工作全面负责,也要对反腐败和廉政建设全面
负责,自觉解决好这方面存在的问题。
会议由中共中央政治局委员、书记处书记、中央纪委书记健
行主持,李鹏、李瑞环、刘华清、胡锦涛等中央领导同志出席了会议。
translated_text: On the 23rd, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, attended the Fifth Plenary Session of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and delivered an important speech. Jiang Zemin pointed out that in order to fight corruption under the conditions of reform and opening up, we must do our best to concentrate on punishing and cracking down on illegal crimes, strengthen the construction of the legal system, and strengthen ideological and political construction, so that the three aspects of work can be organically combined and mutually promoted, so as to continuously deepen this struggle and ensure the smooth progress of reform and opening up and modernization. Jiang Zemin emphasized that ideological and political construction is a very important experience for our party to improve its cohesion and combat effectiveness, and it is also a fundamental measure for our party to always maintain the nature of the vanguard of the working class and persist in resisting corruption and preventing degeneration. To strengthen ideological and political construction and improve the ideological and political quality of cadres and party members, the most fundamental thing is to solve the problem of world outlook and outlook on life. Whether in the past, present or future, this is the primary issue for every cadre and party member. Jiang Zemin pointed out that striving for the contemporary construction of socialism with Chinese characteristics and striving for the ultimate realization of communism is our most noble pursuit in life. At present, we need to help cadres and party members understand and handle three relationships: the first is the relationship between reform and innovation and inheriting fine traditions, the second is the relationship between absorbing and resisting in opening up to the outside world, and the third is the relationship between getting rich first and common prosperity. Jiang Zemin said that building the party for the public and being honest and upright are the secrets of our party being supported by the people and leading the people to win the victory of revolution and construction. Under the conditions of being in power, Communist Party members must adhere to the purpose of serving the people wholeheartedly and be honest and upright. The most important thing is to correctly understand and treat the power in their hands. Jiang Zemin pointed out that our party has been continuously developed and strengthened by hard work. In the past, hard work was needed to carry out revolution, and today, hard work is also needed to carry out socialist modernization. Throughout the ages, if a country or a nation does not advocate hard work and thrift to build a country, people only want to sit back and enjoy the material civilization achievements created by their predecessors, covet pleasure, and do not seek progress, then such a country or such a nation will inevitably decline. Jiang Zemin stressed that whether leading cadres at all levels can set an example is crucial to strengthening the party's style of work and the construction of clean government and promoting the in-depth development of the fight against corruption. Leading cadres at the county (department) level and above must strictly implement the regulations on integrity and self-discipline put forward by the central government and examine themselves in accordance with the regulations. Those who refuse to correct violations of regulations and those who violate discipline in defiance of the law must be severely punished. For leading cadres of state-owned enterprises and institutions, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection also put forward regulations on integrity and self-discipline at this plenary session, which must be implemented conscientiously. Leading cadres at all levels must not only be fully responsible for all work in their regions, departments, and units, but also be fully responsible for anti-corruption and clean government construction, and consciously solve problems in this regard. events:

胡锦涛等出席。中共中央领导同志同各民主党派中央、全国工商联
负责人和无党派人士欢聚一堂,辞旧迎新,共商国事。中共中央政
治局常委、全国政协主席李瑞环主持座谈会。
江泽民在座谈会讲话中指出,1995年工作的指导思想和方针
是:坚持邓小平同志建设有中国特色社会主义理论和党的基本路
线,全面贯彻党的十四大和十四届三中、四中全会精神,进一步处
理好改革、发展、稳定的关系,加快建设社会主义市场经济体制,实

设和民主法制建设,促进社会全面进步。
李瑞环在讲话中指出,中国共产党领导的多党合作和政治协
商制度,是具有中国特色的社会主义民主政治制度。实践证明,这
个制度适合中国的国情,有其显著特点与优点。在过去相当长的时
间里,这个制度对我国的政治、经济和社会发展产生了深刻的影
响。今后在建立社会主义市场经济的过程中,这个制度必将发挥更

translated_text: On the 28th, the CPC Central Committee held a Spring Festival symposium for non-party members. Jiang Zemin, Li Ruihuan, Hu Jintao and others attended. The leaders of the CPC Central Committee, leaders of the central committees of democratic parties, the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce and non-party members gathered together to bid farewell to the old and usher in the new, and discuss state affairs. Li Ruihuan, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, presided over the symposium. In his speech at the symposium, Jiang Zemin pointed out that the guiding ideology and policy for work in 1995 are: adhere to Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and the basic line of the Party, fully implement the spirit of the 14th National Congress of the Party and the Third and Fourth Plenary Sessions of the 14th Central Committee, further handle the relationship between reform, development and stability, accelerate the construction of a socialist market economic system, realize the sustained, rapid and healthy development of the national economy, earnestly grasp the construction of the Party, the construction of spiritual civilization and the construction of democracy and the legal system, and promote the overall progress of society. In his speech, Li Ruihuan pointed out that the multi-party cooperation and political consultation system led by the Communist Party of China is a socialist democratic political system with Chinese characteristics. Practice has proved that this system is suitable for China's national conditions and has its own significant characteristics and advantages. In the past, this system has had a profound impact on my country's political, economic and social development for a long time. In the future, in the process of building a socialist market economy, this system will play a greater role.

目标,总要求和整体部署,认真抓好组织建设这个突出环节,坚持

translated_text: On the same day, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee issued the "1995 Work Points of the CPC Central Committee Leading Group for Party Building". The "Points" pointed out that in 1995, the Party building work should continue to adhere to the guidance of Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and the Party's basic line, closely focus on economic construction, firmly grasp and serve the overall situation of "seizing opportunities, deepening reforms, expanding opening up, promoting development, and maintaining stability", and concentrate on implementing the "Decision" of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 14th CPC Central Committee. In the work, we must correctly understand and implement the general goals, general requirements and overall deployment of Party building, earnestly grasp the prominent link of organizational construction, insist on organically combining ideological construction, organizational construction, and style construction, and strengthen the institutional construction with democratic centralism as the focus throughout all aspects of strengthening Party building, comprehensively promote the new great project, enhance the cohesion and combat effectiveness of Party organizations at all levels, improve the Party's leadership and governance level, and provide a stronger guarantee for reform, opening up and modernization. The main points of party building work in 1995 are: (i) Adhere to the priority of ideological construction and continue to promote the study of Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics to develop in breadth and depth. (ii) Increase the efforts to train and select leading cadres with both moral integrity and ability, and comprehensively strengthen the construction of leadership teams at all levels. (iii) Solidly strengthen and improve the construction of grassroots party organizations and improve the cohesion and combat effectiveness of party organizations. (iv) In accordance with the deployment of the Central Committee, unremittingly grasp the party style and clean government construction, and promote the continuous deepening of the anti-corruption struggle. (v) Strengthen and improve the leadership of the party committee over party building work, and strive to improve the level of party building work.

events:

国党建研究会联合召开县(市)委领导经济建设经验交流会。会议

胡锦涛在讲话中对领导班子的思想作风和精神状态提出了三
点要求:一是要坚持解放思想,实事求是,一切从实际出发的思想
路线。要实劲,讲实话,办实事,求实效。坚决防止和克服官僚主
义,形式主义以及虚报浮夸,华而不实等不良习气。二是要坚持全
心全意为人民服务的宗旨,发扬密切联系群众的优良传统。要经常
深入到群众中去,了解群众的情绪,倾听群众的呼声,关心群众的

俭节约的精神。各级领导干部要带头艰苦奋斗、廉洁奉公,坚持勤
俭办一切事业,努力做到先天下之忧而忧,后天下之乐而乐,用自
己的实际行动带出好的党风、好的民风。
translated_text: From the 8th to the 10th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Policy Research Office of the CPC Central Committee and the National Party Building Research Association jointly held an experience exchange meeting on the leadership of county (city) committees in economic construction. The theme of the meeting was to implement the spirit of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 14th CPC Central Committee and to focus on studying and exchanging ideas on how county (city) committees can strengthen and improve their leadership over economic work. Attending the meeting were 48 county (city) committee secretaries from all over the country and responsible comrades from some provincial party committee organization departments and research offices. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, visited some county (city) committee secretaries who participated in the experience exchange meeting and spoke after the discussion. Hu Jintao pointed out that the county (city) committee of our party is in a leading position among various organizations in the county (city), and is a very important organization at the first level that embodies and guarantees the leadership of the party, playing an important role in connecting the upper and lower levels. Carefully studying, summarizing and promoting the leadership experience accumulated by the Party committees at this level in the new entrepreneurial practice will play an important role in further improving the work level of local Party committees and leading cadres, better leading the reform and construction of the region, further building our Party, and ensuring the rapid and sound development of my country's socialist modernization. In his speech, Hu Jintao put forward three requirements for the ideological style and mental state of the leadership team: First, we must adhere to the ideological line of emancipating the mind, seeking truth from facts, and proceeding from reality. We must be practical, speak the truth, do practical things, and seek practical results. We must resolutely prevent and overcome bad habits such as bureaucracy, formalism, false reporting, exaggeration, and flashy. Second, we must adhere to the purpose of serving the people wholeheartedly and carry forward the fine tradition of close contact with the masses. We must often go deep into the masses, understand the emotions of the masses, listen to the voices of the masses, care about the sufferings of the masses, and strive to help the masses solve practical problems. Third, we must vigorously promote the spirit of hard work and thrift. Leading cadres at all levels should take the lead in hard work, honesty and dedication, adhere to diligence and thrift in all undertakings, strive to worry about the world before worrying about themselves, and enjoy the world after they enjoy themselves, and use their actual actions to bring out good party style and good people's style.

events:
9日 中共中央印发《党政领导干部选拔任用工作暂行条
例》。
《条例》指出,为认真贯彻执行党的干部路线、方针、政策,建立
科学规范的党政领导干部选拔任用制度,形成富有生机与活力的
用人机制,推进干部队伍的革命化、年轻化、知识化、专业化,保证
党的基本路线的全面贯彻执行和建设有中国特色社会主义事业的
顺利发展,根据《中国共产党章程》和国家有关法律、法规,制定《党
政领导干部选拔任用工作暂行条例》。
《条例》规定,选拔任用党政领导干部,必须坚持以下原则:
(--)党管干部的原则;(二)德才兼备、任人唯贤的原则;(三)群众公
认、注重实绩的原则;(四)公开、平等、竞争、择优的原则;(五)民主
集中制的原则;(六)依法办事的原则。
《条例》强调选拔任用党政领导干部,必须符合把领导班子建
设成为坚决贯彻党的基本路线、全心全意为人民服务,具有领导现
代化建设能力的坚强领导集体的要求。
条例适用于选拔任用中共中央、全国人大常委会、国务院、全
国政协、中央纪律检查委员会、最高人民法院、最高人民检察院的

上列工作部门的内设机构、县级以上党委、政府的直属事业单
位和工会、共青团、妇联等人民团体的领导干部的选拔任用,参照
本条例的有关规定执行。
《条例》分总则、选拔任用条件、民主推荐、考察、酝酿、讨论决
定,依法推荐、提名与民主协商、交流回避、辞职降职、纪律与监督
等十一章共五十四条。
translated_text: On the 9th, the CPC Central Committee issued the "Interim Regulations on the Selection and Appointment of Party and Government Leading Cadres". The "Regulations" pointed out that in order to conscientiously implement the party's cadre line, principles and policies, establish a scientific and standardized system for the selection and appointment of party and government leading cadres, form a vibrant and dynamic employment mechanism, promote the revolutionization, rejuvenation, knowledge and specialization of the cadre team, and ensure the comprehensive implementation of the party's basic line and the smooth development of the cause of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, the "Interim Regulations on the Selection and Appointment of Party and Government Leading Cadres" are formulated in accordance with the "Constitution of the Communist Party of China" and relevant national laws and regulations. The "Regulations" stipulate that the selection and appointment of party and government leading cadres must adhere to the following principles: (1) The principle of party management of cadres; (2) The principle of both moral integrity and ability, and the principle of meritocracy; (3) The principle of public recognition and emphasis on performance; (4) The principle of openness, equality, competition and selection of the best; (5) The principle of democratic centralism; (6) The principle of doing things according to law. The Regulations emphasize that the selection and appointment of leading party and government cadres must meet the requirements of building a strong leadership team that resolutely implements the party's basic line, serves the people wholeheartedly, and has the ability to lead modernization. The Regulations apply to the selection and appointment of leading members of the working departments of the CPC Central Committee, the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, the State Council, the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, the Supreme People's Court, and the Supreme People's Procuratorate, and the leading members of the local party committees, standing committees of the people's congresses, governments, political consultative conferences, discipline inspection committees, courts, procuratorates and their working departments at or above the county level (including the county level). The selection and appointment of leading cadres of the internal institutions of the above-mentioned working departments, directly affiliated institutions of the party committees and governments at or above the county level, and people's organizations such as trade unions, the Communist Youth League, and the Women's Federation shall be implemented in accordance with the relevant provisions of these Regulations. The Regulations are divided into 11 chapters and 54 articles, including general provisions, selection and appointment conditions, democratic recommendation, investigation, deliberation, discussion and decision, recommendation in accordance with the law, nomination and democratic consultation, exchange avoidance, resignation and demotion, discipline and supervision.

translated_text: On the 9th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the Ministry of Personnel of the State jointly issued the "Notice on Expediting the Processing of Retirement Procedures for Cadres". Among them, cadres who have served as provincial (ministerial) or deputy provincial (ministerial) level positions should be submitted by all localities and departments as soon as possible according to the above principles. Report to the central government for approval. The "Notice" stipulates that when current cadres reach the retirement age, they should submit their retirement procedures at the same time as they submit their application for removal from office. If they really need to continue to stay in office or make other arrangements due to work needs and do not handle the retirement procedures for the time being, they should state the reasons and the length of their stay in office, and report to the appointment and removal authority for approval. The Notice stipulates that in the future, when cadres reach retirement age, they will no longer need to apply for or obtain their consent to go through retirement procedures, but their units should notify the cadres themselves before going through the approval procedures, and relevant leaders should talk to them in advance to do a good job. After cadres who have reached retirement age leave their leadership positions, if they are hired to do consulting or advisory work, or hold honorary positions or positions in civil society groups, they should also go through retirement procedures and will no longer be included in the establishment of in-service personnel.

translated_text: On the 17th and 18th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee held a symposium on the election of party committees in some provinces and autonomous regions. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, attended the meeting and delivered an important speech. Hu Jintao pointed out that there are only more than two years from now to the convening of the 15th National Congress of the Party. The 15th National Congress of the Party will be an extremely important historical meeting facing the 21st century. Doing a good job in the construction of provincial party and government leadership teams, especially in equipping the main leaders of the party and government, and discovering and selecting a group of outstanding cadres, is actually making some necessary organizational preparations for the 15th National Congress. Therefore, holding these provincial and autonomous region party congresses well and selecting the leadership teams well is related to the overall situation and is an important political task that must be highly valued and effectively implemented. In his speech, Hu Jintao put forward four requirements for making good personnel arrangements for the change of leadership: First, we must put the overall improvement of the moral and professional qualities of existing leading cadres, improve the structure of the leadership team, and strengthen the overall function of the leadership team at the top of the personnel arrangements for the change of leadership. We must make great efforts to earnestly grasp the new party committee team after the change of leadership. Not only must the individual qualities be excellent, able to independently handle complex problems, and competent for the work they are in charge of, but also the leadership team must be reasonably matched in terms of knowledge, expertise, age, and temperament, so as to achieve complementary advantages, a combination of rigidity and flexibility, and form a joint force. At present, we must pay special attention to selecting major leading cadres who are strong in politics, good at unity and coordination, and have the ability to control the overall situation of local party and government work. Second, we must strive to achieve new breakthroughs in selecting outstanding young cadres. The general requirements of the work are to conscientiously implement the provisions of the relevant documents of the Central Committee, comprehensively implement the "four modernizations" policy of the cadre team and the principle of both moral integrity and ability, and select talents in accordance with the conditions of politicians' qualities, and never lower the standards. Third, we must be determined to deepen the reform of the cadre system and ensure the smooth progress of personnel arrangements for the change of leadership. Practices over the years have shown that the imperfect and ineffective implementation of the cadre selection and appointment system is a fundamental reason why it is difficult for outstanding talents to stand out, incompetent cadres to be adjusted, and personnel malpractices to be effectively stopped. Fourth, seize the favorable opportunity of the change of leadership and increase the intensity of cadre exchanges. Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, also spoke at the end of the meeting. He talked about four issues: (a) further improve the structure of the leadership team and improve the overall function of the team; (b) promote the improvement of the political and ideological quality of the leadership team; (c) further increase the intensity of cadre exchanges; (d) earnestly carry out cadre inspection and understanding work. On April 7, the Organization Department of the Central Committee issued "Speech by Comrade Hu Jintao and Comrade Zhang Quanjing at the Symposium on the Change of Leadership of Party Committees in Some Provinces and Autonomous Regions".

translated_text: From the 19th to the 28th, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, President of the State, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, inspected work in Jiangxi and Hunan. These issues are: on the potential and development prospects of agriculture; on the long-term stability of the household contract responsibility system and the development of moderate-scale operations in places with conditions; on the development of agriculture through science and technology and rural vocational and technical education; on the protection of cultivated land and the comprehensive development of agriculture; on the fundamental way out for surplus rural labor; on rural social atmosphere, social security and strengthening of spiritual civilization; on the relationship between strengthening the construction of rural grassroots party organizations and enhancing collective economic strength; on adapting to the requirements of the socialist market economy and striving to strengthen learning and change concepts, etc. Jiang Zemin stressed that in the process of reform and construction, we should attach great importance to the education of farmers. At present, we should focus on the ideological and political education of farmers in the following aspects: First, strengthen patriotism education; second, strengthen collectivism education; third, strengthen the basic knowledge education of building socialism with Chinese characteristics; fourth, strengthen the propaganda of materialism, basic common sense of atheism and other scientific common sense, and oppose feudal superstition and feudal clan activities; fifth, strengthen the education of not forgetting the country when getting rich, adhering to thrift and hard work. The education method should be correct, easy to understand, lively and practical. Jiang Zemin pointed out that the purpose of our socialist market economy is to improve the country's economic strength, make the country rich and strong, and enable all people to achieve common prosperity. Any place, department or individual must follow the principle that personal interests are subordinate to national interests, local interests are subordinate to overall interests, and immediate interests are subordinate to long-term interests. If you think that you can pursue your own interests at will and ignore the long-term interests of the collective, national, and ethnic groups in the socialist market economy, you are wrong. Jiang Zemin said that the correct handling of the interest relationship between individuals, collectives, and the country, between the local and the overall, and between the immediate and the long-term is a basic principle that must be followed not only in the planned economy, but also in the socialist market economy. Of course, the specific forms, means and methods of handling these interest relationships are different under these two economic systems.

translated_text: On the 20th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the State Economic and Trade Commission, the State Education Commission, the Ministry of Finance, and the Ministry of Personnel jointly issued the "Notice on Several Provisions on Strengthening the Management of Cadre Training". The "Notice" made specific provisions on the problems that have emerged in the current cadre education work, such as the low quality of classes, the use of classes to engage in unhealthy practices; some unreasonable fees; individual profit-making purposes; and some issuing academic qualifications or qualification certificates without the approval of any department. The regulations are divided into three parts and 19 articles. The regulations require that the separation of politics and administration should be adhered to. Party committees and government agencies generally do not directly organize training classes. The cadre training department is mainly responsible for formulating plans and proposing training tasks, and inspecting, supervising and guiding the implementation of training plans and training tasks. The specific teaching organization work of the class should generally be undertaken by the approved training institutions. It is necessary to establish a reporting and approval system for the holding of cadre training classes. All cadre training classes should be reported to the cadre training department in accordance with the cadre management authority, and can only be held after being approved and included in the plan. The approval content includes the training objects, teaching plans, class locations, funding sources, and fee amounts. The relevant regulations of the State Education Commission must be strictly implemented when holding academic courses mainly for cadres. The charging standards must be made public, and the income from fees must be used and managed in accordance with the regulations of the local financial department; the charging units must consciously accept the supervision and review of the financial, price and audit departments, and those who violate the regulations will be strictly investigated and punished. In serious cases, the leaders of the leading departments and the school-running units will be held accountable. The regulations also require strict re-examination and inspection of the issuance of academic certificates and qualification certificates by cadre schools and training institutions, and that academic certificates and qualification certificates shall not be issued without authorization, or that certificates with the same effect shall be issued as stated in the enrollment brochure.

translated_text: On the 21st, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued the "Opinions on Further Strengthening the Work of Developing Party Members among Young People". The "Opinions" put forward five requirements: (1) fully understand the importance and urgency of strengthening the work of developing party members among young people; (2) the guiding ideology and basic requirements for the work of developing party members among young people in the current and future period; (3) grasp the key links and take effective measures; (4) adhere to the standards of party members and ensure the quality of new party members; (5) effectively strengthen the leadership and specific guidance of the work of developing party members. The "Opinions" pointed out that there are still some urgent problems in the work of developing party members among young people. The main reasons are: some local and unit party organizations do not fully understand the importance of developing young party members and have not taken effective measures, especially some rural grassroots party organizations have not developed party members for a long time; some grassroots party organizations neglect the training and education of young people, and do not care enough for and help young people who apply to join the party, which dampens their political enthusiasm; some grassroots party organization leaders have ideas such as seniority and jealousy, which hinder the work of developing party members among young people; with the reform and opening up and the development of the socialist market economy, a large number of rural youth go out to work and do business, which increases the difficulty of training and educating young people and developing young party members. Due to the existence of these problems, the number of young party members in many places has decreased year by year. If effective measures are not taken to change this situation, it will inevitably affect the vitality of the party organization. The "Opinion" proposes that we must adhere to standards, ensure quality, improve structure, develop cautiously, and strengthen the work of developing party members among young people in a planned manner. We must focus on developing party members at the forefront of production and work, and strive to solve the problem of the decline in the number of young party members in rural areas and at the production front of enterprises. The work of developing young party members in rural areas should be carried out around deepening rural reform, comprehensively developing the rural economy, building spiritual civilization, and achieving the goal of building a moderately prosperous society and common prosperity and progress. The work of developing young party members in enterprises, especially state-owned enterprises, should be carried out around doing a good job in enterprise reform, transforming the operating mechanism, improving economic efficiency, and cultivating and building a team of "four-have" employees. We should attach importance to cultivating and recruiting outstanding young intellectuals from science and technology, education, culture, health and other units to join the party. We should strengthen the education of basic party knowledge among technical secondary and high school students, and those who are both good in character and academic performance and meet the conditions for party membership can be recruited into the party. We should attach importance to recruiting party members among young women and young people from ethnic minorities.

translated_text: On the 27th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on Submitting the List of Recommended Provincial and Ministerial Reserve Cadres". The "Notice" pointed out that in order to implement the instructions of the CPC Central Committee on speeding up the training and selection of outstanding young cadres, the Central Organization Department has been conducting a comprehensive inspection of provincial and ministerial reserve cadres since 1995 while conducting mid-term inspections of provincial and ministerial leadership teams. Therefore, each province, autonomous region, and municipality is required to submit 20-25 candidates, and each central and state agency ministry and people's organization is required to submit 5-10 candidates, of which 1/3 must be candidates who can join the team in the near future. In addition, each province, autonomous region, and municipality should recommend and submit a list of 3-5 outstanding county (city) party committee secretaries and county (city) governors around 35 years old. The "Notice" requires the selection of recommended candidates for reserve cadres. We must adhere to the policy of revolutionization, rejuvenation, knowledge, and specialization and the principle of both ability and political integrity, and select those cadres with good political and ideological qualities, outstanding work performance, development potential, relatively young and with certain prestige among the masses. The provincial and ministerial reserve cadre team must form a reasonable structure, with no less than 2/3 of them under the age of 50, of which a certain number should be under the age of 45; attention should be paid to selecting talents familiar with macroeconomic management and work in ideology, party affairs, politics and law, science and technology, finance, foreign economics and foreign trade. The ministries and commissions of the central and state organs and people's organizations should pay attention to selecting reserve candidates from the principal positions of the provincial, autonomous region, and municipal party committees and relevant government functional departments. There should also be a certain number of female cadres, ethnic minority cadres and non-party cadres. The "Notice" also requires that the reserve cadre candidates should be recommended in conjunction with the recommendation of new team candidates for the change of term or other methods of recommending outstanding young and middle-aged cadres, and reported after investigation by the organization and personnel department and discussion by the party committee (party group). When selecting candidates for non-Party reserve cadres, we must listen carefully to the opinions of the Party Committee's United Front Work Department. We must resolutely prevent the practice of selecting candidates by a small circle of people without democratic recommendations from the bottom up and without serious investigation and understanding.

translated_text: On the 4th, the People's Daily reported that since last winter and this spring, party committees at all levels have vigorously strengthened the construction of rural grassroots organizations with party organizations as the core. More than 450,000 cadres from government agencies across the country have been sent to rural villages to focus on helping to rectify weak and paralyzed party branches and earnestly solve outstanding problems that affect rural reform, development, and stability; at the same time, they have vigorously carried out the training of grassroots cadres, which has been welcomed by farmers. The rural grassroots organization construction work carried out this time is an important action to implement the "Decision" of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 14th CPC Central Committee and the spirit of the National Rural Grassroots Organization Construction Work Conference. Its main features are: deploying and guiding work in accordance with the "five good" goals put forward by the central government and striving to complete the rectification tasks in stages and batches within three years; focusing on rectifying and building weak and paralyzed party branches, comprehensively promoting the construction of rural grassroots organizations, and striving to improve the overall level; local party committees emphasize that they must follow the mass line, earnestly solve the outstanding problems that affect local reform, development and stability, and not engage in formalism or go through the motions; vigorously grasp the training of grassroots cadres and Communist Party members as an important task; attach great importance to the ideological education of farmers. Selecting cadres from government agencies to go to the countryside to help with work in villages and implementing the village responsibility system of government departments has been implemented as a measure in most parts of the country.

章。文章指出,前些时候,有些地方党委调整领导班子,实行所谓
“书记组阁”,即由党委书记个人挑选本级党委领导班子组成人员,
有的地方连同人大常委会、政府、政协以及群团组织的领导班子主

党的民主集中制原则和干部选拔任用工作的有关规定,与宪法、党
章相抵触,必须坚决予以纠正。
translated_text: On the same day, the People's Daily published a commentary article entitled "We must not have a 'cabinet formed by the secretary'". The article pointed out that some time ago, some local party committees adjusted their leadership teams and implemented the so-called 'cabinet formed by the secretary of the party committee, that is, the party committee secretary personally selected the members of the leadership team of the party committee at this level. In some places, the candidates for the main leaders of the leadership teams of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, the government, the CPPCC and mass organizations were also proposed by the party committee secretary personally. This practice seriously violated the party's democratic centralism principle and the relevant provisions on the selection and appointment of cadres, and was in conflict with the Constitution and the Party Constitution, and must be resolutely corrected.

translated_text: From the 5th to the 7th, the National Conference on the Placement of Retired Military Cadres was held in Beijing. Doing a good job in the placement of retired military cadres is necessary to deepen reform, promote development and maintain stability, to promote the new great project of party building, to strengthen the construction of leadership teams at all levels and the entire cadre team, to strengthen the construction of the army, to take the road of elite troops with Chinese characteristics, to maintain and improve the combat effectiveness of the army, and is also an important content and concrete manifestation of our local comrades' love for the people's army, care for and support for the construction of the army. events: 8日 中共中央组织部、中共中央宣传部、中央直属机关工委、中央国家机关工委、中共北京市委共同举行孔繁森事迹报告会。报告会由中央组织部部长张全景主持,来自中央直属机关､中央国家机关、北京市直属机关,以及解放军、武警部队的6000余名同志听取了领导干部的楷模孔繁森同志的事迹报告。在报告会上,报告团成员从不同侧面向人们介绍了孔繁森同志生前那一幕幕可歌可泣的事迹。报告结束后,中央组织部部长张全景、中央宣传部副部长刘云山在会上讲了话。张全景指出:孔繁森同志是90年代领导干部的优秀代表,也是在藏工作干部的优秀代表,他的事迹和精神催人泪下,催人奋进,我们为有这样的好党员,好干部感到光荣和骄傲。他的模范事迹具有鲜明的时代特点,集中体现了在新的历史条件下党的领导干部为党和人民的事业生命不息、奋斗不止的理想追求和精神风貌,体现了一个共产党员的坚强党性和崇高品德,为广大党员和干部树立了一个学习的好榜样。学习孔繁森同志的先进思想和模范事迹,对于深入贯彻落实党的十四届四中全会《决定》,加强领导班子思想作风建设,贯彻执行党的基本路线,促进我国的改革开放和社会主义现代化建设事业,有着重要的现实意义。在邓小平同志建设有中国特色社会主义理论哺育下,在以江泽民同志为核心的党中央领导下,一定会涌现出成千上万个孔繁森。刘云山说,孔繁森的事迹集中体现了当代共产党人和领导干部的精神风貌,他不愧为领导干部的楷模,90年代的焦裕禄。我们学习孔繁森同志,要紧紧抓住理想和信念这个世界观、人生观的重要问题。牢固树立为人民服务的价值观念,努力实践党的根本宗旨,在改革开放和社会主义现代化建设这场社会大变革中,经受住严峻的考验,做出应有的贡献。
translated_text: On the 8th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Central Committee of the CPC Directly Affiliated Organs Working Committee, the Central State Organs Working Committee, and the CPC Beijing Municipal Committee jointly held a report meeting on Kong Fansen's deeds. The report meeting was hosted by Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee. More than 6,000 comrades from the Central Committee of the CPC Directly Affiliated Organs, the Central State Organs, the Beijing Municipal Committee of the CPC, and the People's Liberation Army and the Armed Police Force listened to the report on the deeds of Comrade Kong Fansen, a role model for leading cadres. The members of the report group were: Tsering Zhuoga, Vice Chairman of the Tibet Autonomous Region, who had worked with Kong Fansen, Yang Gangling, Deputy Secretary-General of the Liaocheng District Administrative Office of Shandong Province, who was from Kong Fansen's hometown, Zhuoma, a reporter from Tibet TV who had accompanied Kong Fansen on interviews many times, An Qiyi, Director of the Office of the China Tibetology Research Center and former Secretary-General of the Ali Prefectural Committee, and Ming Jiu, Deputy Secretary of the Ali Prefectural Committee's Discipline Inspection Commission. At the report meeting, the members of the report group introduced to people the epic deeds of Comrade Kong Fansen during his lifetime from different perspectives. After the report, Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, and Liu Yunshan, Deputy Minister of the Propaganda Department of the CPC Central Committee, spoke at the meeting. Zhang Quanjing pointed out: Comrade Kong Fansen is an outstanding representative of leading cadres in the 1990s and an outstanding representative of cadres working in Tibet. His deeds and spirit are tear-jerking and inspiring. We feel honored and proud to have such a good party member and cadre. His exemplary deeds have distinct characteristics of the times, and they embody the ideal pursuit and spirit of the party's leading cadres who never stop fighting for the cause of the party and the people under the new historical conditions. They embody the strong party spirit and noble character of a Communist Party member, and set a good example for the majority of party members and cadres to learn from. Learning from Comrade Kong Fansen's advanced thoughts and exemplary deeds has important practical significance for thoroughly implementing the "Decision" of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 14th Central Committee of the Party, strengthening the ideological and work style construction of the leadership team, implementing the party's basic line, and promoting my country's reform and opening up and socialist modernization construction. Under the nourishment of Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and under the leadership of the Party Central Committee with Comrade Jiang Zemin as the core, thousands of Kong Fansen will surely emerge. Liu Yunshan said that Kong Fansen's deeds embody the spirit of contemporary Communists and leading cadres. He is worthy of being a model for leading cadres, the Jiao Yulu of the 1990s. We should learn from Comrade Kong Fansen and firmly grasp the important issues of ideals and beliefs, the world view and life view. We should firmly establish the value concept of serving the people, strive to practice the fundamental purpose of the Party, and withstand the severe test and make due contributions in the great social changes of reform and opening up and socialist modernization.

events:
9日——16日 中共中央政治局常委、书记处书记胡锦涛在
地处河北、山西、河南三省交界的5个县考察农村基层组织建设工
作。
胡锦涛在考察时指出:干关键,万关键,有一个好的领导班子
最关键;千重要,万重要,把经济搞上去最重要;千困难,万困难,凝
聚人心、群策群力做工作就不怕困难。
在深入农村基层考察的基础上,胡锦涛在林州市召开了有关
省市以及这次所到5县(市)的党委负责同志参加的座谈会,并在
座谈结束时发表了重要讲话。他强调,中央提出的加强农村基层组
织建设的指导思想和“五个好”的要求,已经十分明确,一定要全面
正确地加以贯彻。在工作中:第一,要坚持以经济建设为中心,围绕
团结带领农民群众奔小康,努力把党的基本路线和农村方针、政策
落实到基层。第二,要突出工作重点,解决好建设领导班子和拓开
发展路子问题。在一个村,解决了有人办事和有钱办事的问题,其
他的事情就好办了。第三,坚持分类指导,实事求是地解决存在的
突出问题,特别是影响当地改革、发展、稳定的热点和难点问题。第
四,要自始至终把组织整顿与思想教育结合起来,以普遍提高党员
的政治素质。
在谈到整顿后进村的工作时,胡锦涛指出,这是当前农村基层
组织建设的难点,也是必须认真抓好的一个重点,一定要确保工作
质量,讲求实际效果。做到整顿一个,改变一个,整顿一批,巩固一
批,绝不能搞形式,走过场。
translated_text: From the 9th to the 16th, Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, inspected the construction of rural grassroots organizations in five counties located at the junction of Hebei, Shanxi and Henan provinces. During the inspection, Hu Jintao pointed out: The key is to have a good leadership team; the most important thing is to develop the economy; no matter how difficult it is, we will not be afraid of difficulties if we unite the people and work together. On the basis of in-depth inspections at the grassroots level in rural areas, Hu Jintao held a symposium in Linzhou City attended by responsible comrades of the party committees of relevant provinces, cities and the five counties (cities) he visited, and delivered an important speech at the end of the symposium. He emphasized that the guiding ideology and the "five good" requirements for strengthening the construction of rural grassroots organizations proposed by the Central Committee have been very clear and must be fully and correctly implemented. In work: First, we must adhere to economic construction as the center, focus on uniting and leading the peasant masses to a well-off society, and strive to implement the party's basic line and rural principles and policies at the grassroots level. Second, we must highlight the work priorities and solve the problems of building a leadership team and opening up development paths. In a village, if the problems of having people to do things and having money to do things are solved, other things will be easy to do. Third, we must adhere to classified guidance and solve the existing prominent problems in a pragmatic way, especially the hot and difficult problems that affect local reform, development, and stability. Fourth, we must combine organizational rectification with ideological education from beginning to end to generally improve the political quality of party members. When talking about the work of rectifying backward villages, Hu Jintao pointed out that this is the difficulty of the current construction of rural grassroots organizations and a key point that must be seriously grasped. We must ensure the quality of work and pay attention to practical results. We must rectify one, change one, rectify a group, and consolidate a group. We must never engage in formalities or go through the motions.

events:
10日——16日 中共中央政治局常委、全国政协主席李瑞环
在辽宁考察国有大中型企业。
李瑞环在考察时指出,当前部分企业遇到的困难,如产业结构
不够合理、债务负担较重、生产设备老化、富余人员过多等,是在较
长的历史发展过程中沉积下来的,也是在经济体制转换中不可避
免会发生的。因此,解决这些问题,需要有一个过程,需要采取综合
配套措施。我们既要看到国有大中型企业目前的困难,也要看到它
们的固有优势和巨大潜力,要把中央的一般性原则同各地各行业
的具体实际结合起来,使优势和潜力得到发挥,使包袱变成财富,
这样,国有大中型企业一定能够闯过难关,焕发新的活力。李瑞环
说,在克服困难的整个过程中,需要宏观和微观两个方面的努力,
国家要尽可能充分利用国有大中型企业现有存量资产和资源优
势,把它们列入经济总体布局的重点。通过对现有企业注入资金、
更新改造,既可较快形成新的生产能力,节省大量配套资金,又可
帮助企业较快克服当前困难。企业自身要主动更新观念,转换机
制,不能停留在一切依赖国家的老框框内不动,更不能一遇困难就
希望国家再改回去。要把克服当前困难当成一种机遇,尽快适应新
的经济体制,形成与国内国际市场相衔接的现代企业制度。
translated_text: From the 10th to the 16th, Li Ruihuan, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, inspected large and medium-sized state-owned enterprises in Liaoning. During the inspection, Li Ruihuan pointed out that the difficulties currently encountered by some enterprises, such as unreasonable industrial structure, heavy debt burden, aging production equipment, and too many redundant personnel, are accumulated in the long historical development process and are inevitable in the transformation of the economic system. Therefore, solving these problems requires a process and comprehensive supporting measures. We must not only see the current difficulties of large and medium-sized state-owned enterprises, but also see their inherent advantages and huge potential. We must combine the general principles of the central government with the specific realities of various regions and industries, so that advantages and potential can be brought into play and burdens can be turned into wealth. In this way, large and medium-sized state-owned enterprises will surely be able to overcome difficulties and rejuvenate. Li Ruihuan said that in the entire process of overcoming difficulties, efforts are needed from both macro and micro aspects. The country should make full use of the existing stock assets and resource advantages of large and medium-sized state-owned enterprises as much as possible and include them in the focus of the overall economic layout. By injecting funds into existing enterprises and renovating and reforming them, new production capacity can be formed more quickly, saving a lot of supporting funds, and helping enterprises to overcome current difficulties more quickly. Enterprises themselves should take the initiative to update their concepts and transform their mechanisms. They cannot stay in the old framework of relying on the state for everything, and they cannot expect the state to change back when they encounter difficulties. They should regard overcoming current difficulties as an opportunity, adapt to the new economic system as soon as possible, and form a modern enterprise system that connects with the domestic and international markets.

events:

的社论。
社论指出,加强农村党组织为核心的基层组织建设,要围绕
党在农村的中心任务,努力达到中央提出的“五个好”的目标。即:
建设一个团结、坚强、群众拥护的好领导班子,尤其要有一个好书
记;培养锻炼一支富有战斗力的好的党员、干部队伍;选准一条适

体现民主管理,保证工作有效运转的好制度。重点是坚持抓好党
支部为核心的村级组织配套建设,以增强服务功能为重点的经营
体制建设,以民主管理为主要内容的工作制度建设,尤其要下力量
抓好软弱涣散和瘫痪状态党支部的整顿。
社论提出,当前,切实加强对基层组织建设的领导,应着重做
好以下工作: (一)省(自治区、直辖市)、地(市)、县(市)各级党委和
中央有关部门,都要把农村基层组织建设和在党员中开展学习活
动工作列入重要日程,做出规划,提出措施,真抓实干,常抓不
懈,逐级检查,督促落实。(二)加强农村基层组织建设,县委是
关键,负有直接的领导责任。县委书记是抓党建工作的第一责任
人。(三)省､地、县三级党政机关领导同志要直接联系不同类型的
村,特别是后进村,经常深入到群众中去,发现问题,解决问题,加
强调查研究,掌握第一手材料,总结典型经验,指导面上工作。
(四)在党委领导下,由组织部门或农村工作部门牵头,各有关职能
部门分工负责,及时沟通情况,协调工作,密切配合,齐抓共管。
translated_text: On the same day, the People's Daily published an editorial entitled "Strengthen Leadership over Grassroots Party Organization Construction". The editorial pointed out that strengthening grassroots organization construction with rural party organizations as the core should focus on the central tasks of the party in rural areas and strive to achieve the "five good" goals put forward by the central government. That is: building a united, strong and well-supported leadership team, especially a good secretary; training and training a good team of party members and cadres with strong fighting power; choosing a good way to accelerate local economic development; improving a good management system; and establishing a good system that reflects democratic management and ensures the effective operation of work. The focus is to adhere to the construction of village-level organizations with party branches as the core, the construction of management systems with the focus on enhancing service functions, and the construction of work systems with democratic management as the main content. In particular, efforts should be made to rectify weak, lax and paralyzed party branches. The editorial proposed that, at present, to effectively strengthen the leadership of grassroots organization building, the following work should be focused on: (i) Party committees at all levels of provinces (autonomous regions, municipalities directly under the central government), prefectures (cities), and counties (cities) and relevant central departments should put the construction of rural grassroots organizations and the development of learning activities among party members on the important agenda, make plans, propose measures, work hard, always pay attention, check step by step, and supervise implementation. (ii) The county party committee is the key to strengthening the construction of rural grassroots organizations and bears direct leadership responsibility. The county party committee secretary is the first person responsible for party building work. (iii) Leading comrades of party and government organs at the provincial, prefectural, and county levels should directly contact different types of villages, especially backward villages, often go deep into the masses, discover problems, solve problems, strengthen investigation and research, master first-hand materials, summarize typical experiences, and guide overall work. (iv) Under the leadership of the party committee, the organization department or rural work department will take the lead, and the relevant functional departments will be responsible for their respective tasks, communicate information in a timely manner, coordinate work, cooperate closely, and work together.

translated_text:
From the 20th to the 23rd, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee held a national exchange meeting on the experience of training and selecting young cadres in Beijing. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, attended the meeting and delivered a speech. In his speech, Hu Jintao fully affirmed the progress made in the training and selection of outstanding young cadres in the past few years, especially since the Fourth Plenary Session of the 14th CPC Central Committee. He pointed out that in the next three to five years, the goal requirements set by the Central Committee must be achieved and the age structure of the members of the leadership teams at all levels must be equipped in a tiered manner. The task is heavy and urgent, and work must be done early and well. Hu Jintao said that educating people is the basis for employing people, and employing people is the purpose of educating people. A high-level leadership team is composed of high-quality leadership talents, and high-quality leadership talents are the result of high-quality training and education work. It is necessary to organically combine training and education with selection and use so that the two aspects of work can promote each other. Summarizing the experience of many years, strengthening and improving the work of training and educating young cadres, we must grasp and do well the three basic links of doing a good job in theoretical study, focusing on practical training, and strict education management, and solve the fundamental problem of world outlook and outlook on life throughout these three basic links. In the work, we must implement batch training and practical training at the same time, with practical training as the focus; professional training and theoretical training at the same time, with theoretical training as the focus; off-the-job training and daily education management at the same time, with daily education management as the focus. Hu Jintao emphasized that we must fully and correctly implement the "four modernizations" policy of the cadre team and the principle of both moral integrity and ability, with "adhering to the reform and opening-up line", "having political achievements" and "people's recognition" as the main basis. These three points are essentially the organic combination and scientific application of the party's political line, ideological line and work line in cadre work, and are the accurate and dialectical embodiment of the party's principle of both moral integrity and ability under the new situation. It is a profound summary and high-level summary of the experience of cadre selection work over the past decade. Accurately grasping the scientific connotation and dialectical relationship of these three points and conscientiously implementing them in practice will greatly improve our work level of knowing people and assigning them to the right positions. Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, also spoke at the meeting. He pointed out that in cultivating young cadres, we must strengthen theoretical training, focus on practical training, strengthen education and management, so that they can grow up healthily under strict requirements and strict management. In the training and education, special attention should be paid to helping young cadres strengthen their party spirit and firmly establish the communist world outlook and outlook on life. Under the new situation of reform and opening up and the development of the socialist market economy, every subordinate, especially leading cadres, must withstand the test and pass the "five gates", namely the gate of positions, the gate of power, the gate of money, the gate of pornography, and the gate of human relations. Zhang Quanjing emphasized that the major policies, objectives and main measures of the Party Central Committee on the training and selection of young cadres have been clarified, and the key now is to implement them in a down-to-earth manner. We must truly implement the spirit of the decision of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 14th CPC Central Committee, the spirit of the National Organization Work Conference, and the spirit of this conference into actual work, strive to realize the deployment and requirements of the Central Committee, make breakthrough progress in promoting the rejuvenation of the leadership team, and ensure that the leadership team always maintains a reasonable hierarchical structure.
Wei Jianxing, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, and responsible comrades of relevant central departments, Zeng Qinghong, Chen Zuolin, Wang Jiaqiao, Xu Weicheng, Zheng Keyang, Song Defu, Wu Lianyuan, and Yu Yunyao, attended the meeting. Organization ministers and cadres directors of the Party Committees of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, deputy secretaries or organization ministers in charge of organization work of the Party Committees of 16 sub-provincial cities, heads of the cadres and personnel departments (bureaus) of various ministries and commissions of the central state organs and relevant directly affiliated units of the State Council, and leaders of some prefecture-level, municipal, and county Party Committees attended the meeting. Shandong, Shanghai and other provinces and cities introduced their experience in training and selecting young cadres at the meeting.
On May 10, the Central Organization Department issued "Speech by Comrade Hu Jintao and Comrade Zhang Quanjing at the National Experience Exchange Meeting on Training and Selecting Young Cadres".

党外干部工作座谈会上的讲话》。
translated_text: From the 25th to the 27th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the United Front Work Department of the CPC Central Committee jointly held a national symposium on the training and selection of non-party cadres in Beijing. Wang Zhaoguo, Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference and Minister of the Central United Front Work Department, and Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Central Organization Department, attended the meeting and delivered speeches respectively. A total of 200 people attended the meeting, including responsible comrades from the Organization Departments and United Front Work Departments of the Party Committees of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, heads of the cadre and personnel departments of the central state organs, and leading comrades from some prefecture-level cities. According to statistics, by the end of 1994, there were 1,512 democratic party members and non-party members in the leadership teams of the provincial, prefectural, and county governments, including 18 deputy provincial (municipal) governors and deputy chairmen of autonomous regions, 157 deputy commissioners, deputy mayors, and deputy governors, 364 deputy district heads of municipal districts, and 973 deputy county (city) heads. Compared with 1990, the number of non-Party cadres in the leadership teams of provincial, prefectural and county governments increased by 59.2% in 1994; the proportion of government leadership teams at all levels equipped with non-Party cadres showed an upward trend, among which the number of provincial governments equipped with non-Party cadres increased from 26.7% to 60%. · A number of non-Party people were hired by judicial organs and government departments as special supervisors, prosecutors, jurors, auditors and inspectors, and a certain number of non-Party people served as principals in local governments at all levels. Wang Zhaoguo fully affirmed the achievements made in his speech and said that the current situation is still far from the requirements of the central government. The key is that the understanding of this work by the leaders of some localities and units needs to be further improved. He pointed out that the training and selection of non-Party cadres is a concrete manifestation of the socialist party system with Chinese characteristics, an important measure to give full play to the role of democratic parties and non-Party people in participating in the discussion and administration of state affairs and democratic supervision, an inherent requirement of the people's democratic regime led by the Communist Party, and a necessary part of the construction of socialist democratic politics. It is necessary to make it clear that the work of training and selecting non-party cadres is by no means a stopgap measure, but a policy that must be adhered to for a long time; it is not something that can be done or not, but an important work related to the overall situation of the party and the country, and we must work hard to do it well. He required that the United Front Department and the Organization Department should work closely and cooperate with each other under the unified leadership of the Party Committee to jointly do a good job in training and selecting non-party cadres. Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, said in his speech that after research by the Organization Department of the Central Committee and the United Front Department of the Central Committee, the guiding ideology of the work of training and selecting non-party cadres at present and in the future is to take Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and the basic line of the party as the guidance, resolutely implement the spirit of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 14th Central Committee of the Party, adhere to the "four modernizations" policy of the cadre team and the principle of both moral integrity and ability, emancipate the mind, seek truth from facts, attach importance to training, lay the foundation, promote selection, and actively train and select non-party leaders at all levels who can take on important tasks across the century to serve reform, opening up and modernization. On April 25, the Central Organization Department issued "Comrade Zhang Quanjing's speech at the national symposium on the training and selection of non-party cadres."

Jiang Zemin said that the Central Organization Department and the Central Propaganda Department have issued the "Notice on Carrying out Activities to Learn from Comrade Kong Fansen". All party members, especially leading cadres at all levels, should use Kong Fansen's deeds and spirit as a mirror and a ruler in their thoughts and work, and often look at and measure themselves, make up for their shortcomings, and make continuous progress, so that they can truly withstand various severe tests and truly live up to our times, the party and the people. 《规定》要求,党和国家机关工作人员在国内交往中,不得收受

受后应登记,上交的礼品在规定期限内不登记或不如实登记、不上

《规定》中还明确本规定由各级党组织和行政部门负责执行,
各级纪检机关负责监督检查。
translated_text: On the 30th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council issued the "Regulations on the Implementation of a Registration System for Party and State Organ Staff to Receive Gifts in Domestic Interactions". The "Regulations" require that party and state organ staff shall not accept gifts that may affect the impartial performance of official duties in domestic interactions. Gifts that cannot be refused for various reasons must be registered and handed in. Other gifts received by party and state organ staff in domestic interactions (excluding interactions between relatives and friends) must be registered, except for those of small value. For gifts that should be registered and handed in after receiving them, if they are not registered or not registered truthfully or not handed in within the prescribed period, the party organization, administrative department or discipline inspection and supervision agency shall order them to register and hand them in, and give them criticism and education or party discipline and political discipline sanctions. The "Regulations" also clearly state that the party organizations and administrative departments at all levels are responsible for the implementation of these regulations, and the discipline inspection agencies at all levels are responsible for supervision and inspection.

From the 4th to the 31st, the first training class for leading cadres of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee was concluded. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee, held a discussion with the trainees and put forward the requirements of "strong party spirit, correct work style, practical work and refined business" on how to further strengthen the self-construction of the organization department and do a good job in the party organization work in the new era. Strong party spirit means having a high level of theoretical literacy, firm political beliefs, a sense of the overall situation, adhering to the purpose of serving the people wholeheartedly, and daring to carry out criticism and self-criticism. Correct work style means being fair and upright, and being able to seek truth from facts in work, especially in the evaluation, use and treatment of people, no matter what occasion or situation, and strictly follow the principles and policies of the party. Practical work means persisting in emancipating the mind, seeking truth from facts, seeking truth and being pragmatic, and doing practical work, starting from reality, creatively carrying out work, timely proposing new work ideas, constantly creating new experiences, and making new breakthroughs in various work. To be good at business means to be familiar with the various policies, principles and procedures of Marxist party-building theory and organizational work, understand the situation above, be familiar with the situation below, and be familiar with people, and become a "business expert" and "living dictionary" of organizational and cadre work. He also emphasized that party committees at all levels should effectively strengthen the leadership of organizational work, trust, rely on, support and care about organizational departments, and give full play to the functional role of organizational departments. At present, there are 100,000 organizational cadres in the country. In order to comprehensively improve the quality of this team and further improve the organizational work in the new era, the Central Organization Department decided to use two years from 1995 to train the cadres of the organizational department in a planned and step-by-step manner, with hierarchical responsibilities. During the training, Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, Song Defu, Deputy Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and Minister of Personnel, Zeng Peiyan, Deputy Director of the State Planning Commission, Gong Yuzhi, Vice President of the Central Party School, Sun Zhenyu, Deputy Minister of the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation, Wu Lianyuan, Li Tielin, Wang Xudong, Yu Yunyao, Deputy Ministers of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, Liu Junlin, Yang Jiansheng and other comrades gave guidance speeches.
91 leading cadres from the Organization Departments of the CPC Party Committees of provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities directly under the Central Government and some cities, the Personnel Departments (bureaus) of the central government and state organs, and the Party Committees of some large enterprises participated in the training.
On May 28, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued "Comrade Hu Jintao's Speech at the First Training Course for Leading Cadres of Organization Departments".

视、电化教育等手段,充分发挥党员电化教育的作用。有条件的地
方可建立科普培训示范基地。
translated_text: On the 15th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the China Association for Science and Technology issued the "Notice on the Key Points of the Practical Technology and Market Economy Knowledge Training Plan for Rural Party Members and Grassroots Cadres from 1995 to 2000". The "Notice" pointed out that in order to further improve the scientific and cultural quality of rural party members and grassroots cadres, enhance their ability to lead the masses to get rich together under the new situation of developing a socialist market economy, and give full play to their pioneering and exemplary role and demonstration and leading role, from now until 2000, party members and cadres of administrative villages and township enterprises across the country, especially young party members and cadres, will be trained in practical technology and market economy knowledge, with a focus on training the main leading cadres of 2 million administrative villages and township enterprises. Through training, they will master at least 12 advanced production technologies and business management knowledge applicable to the local area, and a group of them will reach the level of farmer technicians and farmer technicians. Gradually build a team of rural party members and grassroots cadres who can adapt to the requirements of market economic development and rely on science and technology to lead the masses on the road to common prosperity. The Notice also pointed out that the training should be mainly carried out in county and township party schools, agricultural correspondence universities and their branches and guidance stations, agricultural practical technology schools, and various professional and technical associations (research institutes), with various scientific research units, colleges and universities, and various societies as support, and attention should be paid to the role of agricultural broadcasting schools and amateur technical schools. We should make full use of various existing training facilities in counties, townships (towns), and villages, and gradually improve training conditions. At the same time, we should make full use of radio, film, television, and audio-visual education to give full play to the role of audio-visual education for party members. Where conditions permit, science popularization training demonstration bases can be established.

县以上政府职能部门也要注意配备党外干部担任领导职务。到

translated_text: On the 1st, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the United Front Work Department of the CPC Central Committee issued the "Opinions on Further Improving the Work of Cultivating and Selecting Non-Party Cadres to Serve as Leaders of Government and Judicial Organs". The "Opinions" pointed out that cultivating and selecting non-party cadres is an important part of the party's cadre work and is the basic work for consolidating and developing the patriotic united front. Further improving the work of cultivating and selecting non-party cadres to serve as leaders of government and judicial organs will help mobilize all positive factors to serve the cause of reform and opening up and socialist modernization; it will help uphold and improve the multi-party cooperation and political consultation system under the leadership of the Communist Party and promote the construction of socialist democratic politics; it will help promote the construction of people's democratic regimes and consolidate the socialist system; it will help promote the realization of the great cause of peaceful reunification of the motherland in accordance with the "one country, two systems" policy. The Opinion points out that the training and selection of non-Party cadres for leading positions in government and judicial organs must be guided by Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and the Party's basic line, and the spirit of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 14th CPC Central Committee must be firmly implemented. The "four modernizations" policy for the cadre team and the principle of both ability and political integrity must be adhered to. The Party leaders at all levels who can shoulder important tasks across the century must be actively trained and selected. All positive factors must be fully mobilized to promote the construction of socialist democratic politics and serve the cause of reform and opening up and socialist modernization. The Opinion proposes that the overall work goal of training and selecting non-Party cadres is that the leading bodies of provincial (autonomous region, municipality), prefectural (municipal, state, league), and county (city) governments must be equipped with non-Party cadres, and government functional departments above the county level must also pay attention to the deployment of non-Party cadres for leading positions. By the time the government leadership team is replaced in 1998, the leadership teams of the people's governments of 30 provinces (autonomous regions and municipalities), 16 sub-provincial cities and other provincial capital cities should be basically staffed with non-Party cadres; the leadership teams of other municipal (prefectural and league) people's governments and regional administrative offices should be staffed with non-Party cadres as much as possible; the central government ministries and commissions, directly affiliated bureaus, the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate should be staffed with non-Party cadres in a planned and step-by-step manner.
