events:
5日 《人民日报》全文发表中共中央总书记江泽民5月26
日在全国科学技术大会上的讲话。
江泽民讲话的主要内容是:(一)全面落实科技是第一生产力
的思想。(二)加速科技进步需要把握的几个重要问题。(三)培养
和造就大批德才兼备的科技人才。(四)加强党对科技工作的领导。
江泽民指出,科学技术人员是新的生产力的重要开拓者和科
技知识的重要传播者,是社会主义现代化建设的骨干力量。实施科
教兴国的战略,关键是人才。大大提高我国劳动者中科技人才的比
例,提高劳动者队伍的整体素质,对于我国社会主义现代化建设事
业具有重大意义。要积极创造条件,热忱欢迎留居海外的科技人员
回国工作,或以各种形式为祖国的现代化建设服务。我们不但要大
力培养各类科学技术人才,还要注重培养善于进行现代经营管理
的各类专家。要十分重视从工人、农民和其他劳动者中选拔培养科
技人才及各类专业技术能手。通过社会各界的努力,形成中华民族
的浩浩荡荡的科技队伍,向新科技革命进军,向社会主义现代化进
军!
江泽民要求,各级领导干部要认真学习马列主义、毛泽东思想
和邓小平同志建设有中国特色社会主义理论。同时,还要学习现代
科技知识,学习社会主义市场经济知识,学习法律知识。不仅从书
本上学习,更要注重在实践中学习。
translated_text: On the 5th, the People's Daily published the full text of Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee,'s speech at the National Science and Technology Conference on May 26. The main contents of Jiang Zemin's speech were: (i) Fully implement the idea that science and technology are the primary productive forces. (ii) Several important issues that need to be grasped to accelerate scientific and technological progress. (iii) Cultivate and train a large number of scientific and technological talents with both moral integrity and ability. (iv) Strengthen the Party's leadership over scientific and technological work. Jiang Zemin pointed out that scientific and technological personnel are important pioneers of new productive forces and important disseminators of scientific and technological knowledge, and are the backbone of socialist modernization. The key to implementing the strategy of rejuvenating the country through science and education is talent. Greatly increasing the proportion of scientific and technological talents among my country's workers and improving the overall quality of the workforce are of great significance to my country's socialist modernization. We must actively create conditions and warmly welcome scientific and technological personnel living abroad to return to work in China or serve the modernization of the motherland in various forms. We must not only vigorously cultivate various types of scientific and technological talents, but also focus on cultivating various types of experts who are good at modern business management. We must attach great importance to selecting and training scientific and technical talents and various professional and technical experts from workers, farmers and other laborers. Through the efforts of all sectors of society, we will form a mighty scientific and technological team of the Chinese nation to march towards the new scientific and technological revolution and socialist modernization! Jiang Zemin requires that leading cadres at all levels should earnestly study Marxism-Leninism, Mao Zedong Thought and Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics. At the same time, they should also learn modern scientific and technological knowledge, socialist market economy knowledge, and legal knowledge. Not only learn from books, but also pay attention to learning in practice.

events:
同日 中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理朱镕基给中央直
属机关和中央国家机关部级领导干部上党课。朱镕基强调,党的建
设必须紧密联系党的基本路线,围绕经济建设这个中心进行。联系
党的基本路线建设党,首先就要围绕经济建设这个中心开展党建
工作,通过加强党的自身建设促进经济建设。16年来,我们是努力
这样做的,也有不少经验值得总结。一是要全面正确贯彻“发展是
硬道理”的精神,经济的发展既要有较快的速度,又要保持持续、健
康的发展。十几年来,我们一直都在探索这个平衡点。二是在经济
建设中,农业是基础,科学教育是关键。农业这个基础一定要搞好,
否则国民经济不可能搞上去。第一是吃饭,第二才是建设。三是国
有企业是国民经济的支柱,必须坚定地深化改革,转换机制,使国
有企业增強活力,提高效益。
朱镕基说,发展经济,建立社会主义市场经济体制,要求加强
党的领导,也需要改善党的领导。这就必须尊重客观规律,主要用
经济的手段来抓经济。不能以党代企,以政代企、政企不分。党委、
政府抓经济工作,主要的是出主意,用干部,尤其要为企业配备一
个好的领导班子,保证党的路线方针和决策的贯彻执行。同时,要
两手抓、抓两手,两手都要硬。
这次党课是中组部、中直机关工委、中央国家机关工委联合组
织并报请中央同意举办的。国务委员、国务院秘书长、中央国家机
关工委书记罗干主持了这次党课。
参加党课的有中央直属机关、中央国家机关副部级以上的党
员领导干部、解放军三总部、武警总部和北京市的有关领导干部共
1100人。
translated_text: On the same day, Zhu Rongji, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, gave a party class to the ministerial-level leading cadres of the central government agencies and central state agencies. Zhu Rongji emphasized that party building must be closely linked to the party's basic line and carried out around the center of economic construction. To build the party in line with the party's basic line, we must first carry out party building work around the center of economic construction and promote economic construction by strengthening the party's own construction. Over the past 16 years, we have been working hard to do so, and there are many experiences worth summarizing. First, we must fully and correctly implement the spirit of "development is the hard truth". Economic development must have a faster speed and maintain sustained and healthy development. For more than a decade, we have been exploring this balance point. Second, in economic construction, agriculture is the foundation and scientific education is the key. The foundation of agriculture must be well developed, otherwise the national economy cannot be developed. The first is to eat, and the second is construction. Third, state-owned enterprises are the pillars of the national economy. We must firmly deepen reforms and transform mechanisms to make state-owned enterprises more dynamic and improve efficiency. Zhu Rongji said that developing the economy and establishing a socialist market economic system require strengthening and improving the leadership of the Party. This requires respecting objective laws and mainly using economic means to grasp the economy. The Party cannot replace enterprises, the government cannot replace enterprises, and the government and enterprises cannot be separated. The Party committee and the government should focus on economic work, mainly to give advice and use cadres, especially to equip enterprises with a good leadership team to ensure the implementation of the Party's line, principles and decisions. At the same time, we must grasp both hands and both hands must be strong. This party class was jointly organized by the Organization Department of the Central Committee, the Central Committee of the Central Government, and the Central State Organs Working Committee and reported to the Central Committee for approval. Luo Gan, State Councilor, Secretary-General of the State Council, and Secretary of the Central State Organs Working Committee, presided over the party class. 1,100 people attended the party class, including party member leading cadres at or above the vice-ministerial level of the Central Government, the three headquarters of the People's Liberation Army, the headquarters of the armed police, and relevant leading cadres in Beijing.

各级党委和政府要牢牢把握经济建设这个中心,进一步解放思想,

发挥其主导作用。要充分发挥当地的优势,增强信心和紧迫感,确

胡锦涛强调指出,在加强思想建设和作风建设的同时,要继续

translated_text: From the 15th to the 24th, Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, inspected work in Inner Mongolia and Ningxia. During the inspection, Hu Jintao emphasized that adhering to the leadership of the Party and strengthening Party building are the fundamental political and organizational guarantees for deepening reform, promoting development, maintaining stability, and achieving the grand goal of socialist modernization. After listening to the work reports of the Party Committees of Inner Mongolia and Ningxia Autonomous Regions, Hu Jintao pointed out that Party committees and governments at all levels must firmly grasp the center of economic construction, further emancipate their minds, establish new concepts that are compatible with the socialist market economic system, and unswervingly deepen reform. First of all, we must deepen the reform of state-owned enterprises, revitalize the state-owned economy, and better play its leading role. We must give full play to local advantages, enhance confidence and sense of urgency, and ensure sustained, rapid and healthy economic development. Hu Jintao emphasized that while strengthening ideological and work style construction, we must continue to strengthen organizational construction, especially the construction of the leadership team. We must fully adhere to the "four modernizations" policy of the cadre team and the principle of both moral integrity and ability, and truly select those outstanding young cadres who have strong party spirit, resolutely implement the party's line, principles, and policies, have outstanding work performance, and are supported by the masses to the leadership teams at all levels in a timely manner. The cadres we select are not only young and have professional knowledge, but also have good work style. Young cadres must devote themselves to the party's cause and proceed from the interests of the people. They must not be greedy for enjoyment or pursue fame and fortune. Those who are superficial in their work, do superficial work, engage in fraud, and seek fame and reputation must not be promoted or reused, and must be severely criticized and educated.

translated_text: From the 19th to the 26th, the senior training course on the implementation of the civil service system jointly organized by the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, the Ministry of Personnel and the National School of Administration was completed. In his speech at the training course, Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, pointed out that comprehensively improving the quality of cadres is a need of the situation and tasks, a need to strengthen the construction of the leadership team, a need to cultivate and select outstanding young cadres, and a need to fight corruption and promote integrity and maintain close contact with the masses. To improve the quality of cadres, we must take the requirements of the Party Constitution and the Fourth Plenary Session of the 14th Central Committee of the Party as our goal. At present, the most important thing is to do a good job in the education of world outlook and outlook on life, so that the majority of cadres can strengthen their communist ideals and socialist beliefs. To withstand the test of the market economy and reform and opening up, cadres must pass the "irrelevant" test, that is, the test of fame, power, money, sex and human relations. We must truly change our work style, maintain close contact with the masses, oppose inconsistency between words and deeds, and advocate consistency between words and deeds. This training course lasted for 8 days, and governors and deputy governors (municipal governors) in charge of personnel work from various provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the central government participated in the study. During the training, State Councilor Li Guixian held a discussion with the trainees. Relevant officials from the Organization Department and the Ministry of Personnel gave special reports on issues related to the civil service system. The trainees also discussed some key and difficult issues in the implementation of the civil service system from a theoretical and practical perspective.

events: 1995年6月19日,中共中央政治局常委、国务院总理李鹏在接见推行公务员制度高级研修班全体学员时强调,推行公务员制度是我国政治体制改革的一项重要内容,其目的是为了适王社会主义市场经济的需要,把各级政府建设成以为人民服务为宗旨的高效率有活力的政府,要建立有中国特色的国家公务员制度,做到依法行政,勤政廉政。
translated_text: On June 19, 1995, Li Peng, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Premier of the State Council, met with all the students of the advanced training course on the implementation of the civil service system and emphasized that the implementation of the civil service system is an important part of my country's political system reform. Its purpose is to meet the needs of the socialist market economy and build governments at all levels into efficient and dynamic governments with the purpose of serving the people. It is necessary to establish a national civil service system with Chinese characteristics and implement administration according to law, diligence and honesty.

events: 1995年6月19日,中组部、人事部、国家行政学院在京举行推行公务员制度高级研修班,国务院总理李鹏接见全体学员并作重要讲话。国务委员李贵鲜在开学典礼上强调,今年是推行公务员制度的关键一年。国务院各部门要先行一步,全面展开,并取得初步成效。地方国家公务员制度的实施要结合机构改革逐步全面展开。

translated_text: On the 28th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China made a decision to posthumously award Comrade Kong Fansen the title of "Model Communist Party Member and Outstanding Leading Cadre". During his time in the army, he took Comrade Lei Feng as an example, worked hard to study Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought, consciously transformed his world outlook, performed outstandingly, and was commended and rewarded many times. After joining the party, he strictly required himself with the standards of a Communist Party member and firmly upheld his communist ideals and beliefs. Since he took on leadership work, he has conscientiously practiced the fundamental purpose of Communists to serve the people wholeheartedly. After the Third Plenary Session of the Eleventh Central Committee of the Party, he worked hard to study Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, adhered to the Party's basic line, actively responded to the Party's call, and went to Tibet twice for work for ten years. He worked hard, selflessly, and struggled hard for the economic development of Tibet, the improvement of national unity and people's lives, and achieved outstanding political achievements. He is deeply supported and loved by the people of all ethnic groups. All Party members, especially leading cadres at all levels, should actively respond to the call issued by Comrade Jiang Zemin to "learn from Comrade Kong Fansen", learn from his noble qualities of loving the people and selfless dedication, establish a correct world and life outlook, be honest and self-disciplined, serve the people wholeheartedly, and be qualified Communist Party members and good public servants of the people.

translated_text: On the 30th, the People's Daily reported that the Communist Party of China has been growing stronger in reform and construction. At present, the total number of party members in the country has reached 55 million, and there are 3.4 million grassroots party organizations. Party organizations at all levels have fully implemented the party's basic line and the spirit of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 14th CPC Central Committee, focusing on developing new party members in production, work, youth and women. In the past year, a total of 1.87 million advanced elements from all fronts have joined the party organization. Among them, there are 854,000 workers in enterprises and rural production lines, farmers, herdsmen and fishermen, accounting for 45.7% of the total number of party members developed; there are 328,000 professional and technical personnel of various types, accounting for 17.6% of the total number of party members developed. Party organizations at all levels attach importance to cultivating and recruiting young people to join the party, and support and help the Communist Youth League organizations to earnestly carry out the work of recommending outstanding league members as party development targets. Among the newly recruited party members in 1994, there were 1.294 million young people under the age of 35, accounting for 69.2% of the total number of party members developed. Among them, new party members developed through the "recommendation" of the Communist Youth League accounted for 27.7% of the total number of party members developed; among the new party members, there were 360,000 women party members, accounting for 19.2% of the total number of party members developed; there were 1.324 million party members with a high school education or above, accounting for 70.8%. The party organization has added a large number of fresh blood, which has promoted the improvement of the distribution and composition of the party members. By the end of 1994, the number of administrative villages without Party members in rural areas had decreased by 32% compared with the previous year, and the number of production teams without Party members in industrial, construction and transportation enterprises had decreased by nearly 30,000 compared with the previous year. Among the 55 million Party members in the country, 22.085 million had a high school education or above, accounting for 39.9% of the total number of Party members. Compared with 1978, the absolute number increased by 17.358 million, and the proportion increased by 27.1 percentage points; there were 1.164 million young people under the age of 35, accounting for 21.1% of the total number of Party members; there were 8.492 million women Party members, accounting for 15.3% of the total number of Party members; there were 3.214 million ethnic minority Party members, accounting for 5.8% of the total number of Party members. In order to adapt to the needs of the new situation and tasks, all localities, in accordance with the deployment of the Central Committee, earnestly rectified the weak and paralyzed Party branches in rural areas, carried out learning activities on the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and the Party Constitution among all Party members, and further promoted the construction of the Party's grassroots organizations and the education and management of Party members. The quality of party members has been improved, and the combat effectiveness, attraction and cohesion of the party organization have been further enhanced. Among the national model workers and advanced workers commended by the State Council on May 1, 1995, 88.9% were members of the Communist Party of China. In times of loss of life and property of the country and the people or various critical moments, the majority of those who rushed to the front were Communist Party members. They stood up, endured hardships, were not afraid of violence, and were willing to shed blood and sacrifice for the benefit of the people. Now there are 12.97 million people applying to join the party organization nationwide, of which 55.7% are young people under the age of 35.

织部希望,获得优秀县(市)委书记称号的同志,更加严格要求自

模范;乐于奉献的模范;廉洁奉公的模范;保持党同人民群众的血肉

translated_text: On the same day, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China made a decision to commend outstanding county (city) party secretaries across the country. The "Decision" pointed out that in order to implement the spirit of the decision of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 14th Central Committee of the Party, establish advanced models, promote positive energy, and encourage leading cadres to comprehensively improve their own quality, the Central Organization Department decided to award the title of outstanding county (city) party secretaries to Wang Yaoping and 100 other comrades who have achieved outstanding results in the positions of county (city) party secretaries across the country and commend them. The "Decision" emphasizes that the county (city) party committee has the important responsibility of fully implementing the party's line, principles, and policies to the grassroots and the masses in the region, and is a very important organization at the first level that embodies and guarantees the party's leadership. Commending a group of outstanding county (city) party secretaries is of great significance to promoting the construction of leadership teams, guiding comrades in leadership positions to be motivated and enterprising, strive to improve their work level, and promote socialist modernization. The Central Organization Department hopes that comrades who have won the title of Outstanding County (City) Party Committee Secretary will be more strict with themselves, take Comrade Kong Fansen as an example, and be models of loyalty to the cause of the Party and the people and selfless work; models of willingness to make contributions; models of integrity and dedication; models of maintaining the flesh-and-blood ties between the Party and the people; models of seeking truth and being pragmatic; and models of withstanding various tests in the great cause of socialist modernization and making new contributions to the people.

表彰会。中共中央总书记江泽民在会议上发表重要讲话,中共中央

须在新形势下不断加强自身建设,努力提高执政水平和领导水平。
县以上各级领导同志要按照四中全会的要求锻炼和提高自己,努
力成为新时期合格的领导干部。尤其要在坚持正确的政治方向,增

会议结束时,与会同志向全国县(市)委书记发出了倡议书。
translated_text: From July 30 to July 2, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee held a commendation meeting for outstanding county (city) party secretaries. Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, delivered an important speech at the meeting. Li Peng, Zhu Rongji, Liu Huaqing and Hu Jintao, members of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, attended the meeting. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, presided over the meeting. In his speech, Jiang Zemin emphasized that in order to better play the core leadership role of the Party, the Party must continuously strengthen its own construction under the new situation and strive to improve its governance and leadership level. Leading comrades at all levels above the county level should exercise and improve themselves in accordance with the requirements of the Fourth Plenary Session of the Central Committee, and strive to become qualified leading cadres in the new era. In particular, there should be a great progress in adhering to the correct political direction, strengthening the overall concept, strengthening theoretical learning, and serving the people wholeheartedly. In his speech, Jiang Zemin reviewed the extraordinary struggle and great achievements of the Communist Party of China. He called on the whole party to unite as one, work hard, work hard, and strive for the second and third strategic goals of China's modernization under the leadership of the Party Central Committee and under the guidance of Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and the basic line of the Party, and strive to achieve the second and third strategic goals of my country's modernization! Hu Jintao said when presiding over the meeting that the purpose of the Central Organization Department commending 100 outstanding county (city) secretaries is to encourage and spur the majority of party members, especially leading cadres at all levels, to be guided by Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and the basic line of the Party, to work down-to-earth and actively, strive to create achievements, and continuously push forward my country's socialist modernization cause. Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Central Organization Department, read out the "Decision of the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Commending Outstanding County (City) Party Secretaries" at the meeting. Central leaders issued honorary certificates to the outstanding county (city) party secretaries who were commended. During the meeting, the delegates carefully studied the important speech of Comrade Jiang Zemin and exchanged their experiences on how to be a good county (city) party committee secretary under the new situation. At the end of the meeting, the comrades present issued a proposal to the county (city) party committee secretaries across the country.

events:

门遵照中央指示,对原中共北京市委常委、北京市副市长王宝森的

translated_text: On the 4th, the People's Daily reported that the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China and relevant departments, in accordance with the instructions of the Central Committee, conducted an in-depth investigation into the economic crimes of Wang Baosen, former member of the Standing Committee of the Beijing Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China and deputy mayor of Beijing. It has been found that Wang Baosen abused his power, embezzled, squandered, misappropriated public funds, and was corrupt during his tenure. events:

部轮训班。这期轮训班,采取辅导讲授、自学和集体座谈相结合的
方式,对学员进行系统培训。轮训班结业前.中共中央政治局常委、

胡锦涛指出,组织部门主要是做人的工作,做人的工作的干
部,首先应该正正派派地做人;组织部门是做党的建设工作的,从
事这项工作的干部,首先应该是一个真正的共产党员。组织部门的
干部特别是领导干部,要按照党的十四届四中全会提出的要求,不

translated_text: From the 5th to the 29th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee held the second training class for leading cadres of the organization department. This training class adopts a combination of tutoring, self-study and group discussion to provide systematic training for trainees. Before the training class ended, Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Central Secretariat, visited the trainees and gave a speech. Hu Jintao pointed out that the organization department is mainly engaged in human work, and cadres who do human work should first be upright people; the organization department is engaged in party building work, and cadres engaged in this work should first be a true Communist Party member. The cadres of the organization department, especially the leading cadres, should constantly temper themselves, improve themselves and perfect themselves in accordance with the requirements put forward by the Fourth Plenary Session of the 14th CPC Central Committee. During the training, the heads of some ministries and commissions of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council gave systematic lectures on learning Comrade Deng Xiaoping’s theory of building the ruling party, as well as my country’s economic situation, foreign trade, diplomatic work and other issues. Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, and Song Defu, Minister of the Personnel Department, respectively held discussions and provided guidance to the students on the business and self-development of the organization and personnel departments. The 100 students who participated in the study were mainly the heads of the organization departments of the provincial, regional and municipal party committees and the personnel departments of the central and state organs, as well as the party committee secretaries of some large enterprise groups.

events:
10日——13日 中共中央组织部、中共中央宣传部、国家教
委党组联合召开第五次全国高等学校党的建设工作会议。中共中
央政治局常委、国务院总理李鹏会见出席会议的代表,并作了重要
讲话。中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理李岚清出席会议并讲了
话。出席会议的有各省、自治区、直辖市党委及组织部、宣传部、教
育部门的负责同志和全国108所高等学校的负责同志。
李岚清在讲话中强调,今后5年是高校领导班子新老交替的
特殊时期,培养和选拔一批德才兼备的优秀年轻干部,实现新老班
子平稳过渡,是关系到高等教育改革、发展和稳定的关键。高等学
校党的组织建设要把力度放在这方面,采取切实措施,培养一大批
能够跨世纪担当重任的领导人才。他说,现在全国高校有党员近
30万人,党务政工干部3万多人,这是做好高校党建工作的一个
很好的基础。要充分依靠这支队伍,调动他们的积极性。各级党委
和高校要进一步重视政工队伍建设,切实解决他们的工资待遇及
在工作和生活中存在的实际问题。凡符合条件,可以走“双肩挑”的
同志都纳入教师或研究人员职务序列解决,研究职务序列中应包
括教育管理研究。凡专职从事党政管理工作的干部可以列入“教育
职员”序列,要使他们的待遇与同期毕业的教师平均水平大体相
当。李岚清最后强调,要把党建工作作为评价高校办学质量和水平
的重要指标。
国家教委主任朱开轩在会议报告中指出,今后5年,约占
60%的现职领导干部将陆续退出领导岗位,需要完成大跨度的领
导班子新老交接。因此,全面建设好高校领导班子已成为当务之
急。
中央组织部部长张全景作了会议总结讲话。他强调,加强高校
党的建设,主要责任在地方党委,中央、国家机关有关部委党组(党
委)对所属高校党的建设工作也负有重要的指导责任。各高校在加
强领导班子建设的同时,还要切实加强党总支、党支部的建设,門
格党的组织生活,加强对党员的教育管理。要做好在青年教师和大
学生中发展党员的工作,这是具有战略意义的大事。要重视在教师
中培养科技、学术带头人,重视在跨世纪的科技、学术带头人中培
养和发展新党员。

《李鹏、李岚清等领导同志在第五次全国高校党的建设工作会议上
的讲话》。
translated_text: From the 10th to the 13th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee, and the Party Group of the State Education Commission jointly held the Fifth National Conference on Party Building in Colleges and Universities. Li Peng, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Premier of the State Council, met with the representatives attending the conference and delivered an important speech. Li Lanqing, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, attended the conference and delivered a speech. The meeting was attended by responsible comrades from the Party Committees and Organization Departments, Propaganda Departments, Education Departments of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, as well as responsible comrades from 108 colleges and universities across the country. In his speech, Li Lanqing emphasized that the next five years will be a special period for the replacement of old and new leadership teams in colleges and universities. Cultivating and selecting a group of outstanding young cadres with both moral integrity and ability and achieving a smooth transition between the old and new teams are the key to the reform, development and stability of higher education. The construction of party organizations in colleges and universities should focus on this aspect and take practical measures to cultivate a large number of leadership talents who can shoulder important responsibilities across the century. He said that there are now nearly 300,000 party members and more than 30,000 party and political cadres in colleges and universities across the country, which is a good foundation for doing a good job in party building in colleges and universities. We must fully rely on this team and mobilize their enthusiasm. Party committees at all levels and colleges and universities should further attach importance to the construction of the political team and effectively solve their salary and benefits and practical problems in work and life. All comrades who meet the conditions and can "shoulder both shoulders" will be included in the teacher or researcher job sequence, and the research job sequence should include education management research. All cadres who are engaged in party and government management work full-time can be included in the "education staff" sequence, and their treatment should be roughly equivalent to the average level of teachers who graduated in the same period. Li Lanqing finally emphasized that party building work should be used as an important indicator for evaluating the quality and level of college education. Zhu Kaixuan, director of the State Education Commission, pointed out in the meeting report that in the next five years, about 60% of the current leading cadres will gradually withdraw from leadership positions, and a large-scale handover of new and old leadership teams will need to be completed. Therefore, it has become a top priority to comprehensively build a good college leadership team. Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, delivered a concluding speech at the meeting. He stressed that the main responsibility for strengthening the party building in colleges and universities lies with the local party committees, and the party groups (party committees) of the relevant ministries and commissions of the central and state organs also bear important guiding responsibilities for the party building work in their affiliated colleges and universities. While strengthening the construction of the leadership team, all colleges and universities should also effectively strengthen the construction of the general party branch and party branch, strictly regulate the party's organizational life, and strengthen the education and management of party members. It is a strategically significant matter to do a good job in developing party members among young teachers and college students. It is important to pay attention to cultivating scientific and academic leaders among teachers, and to cultivate and develop new party members among cross-century scientific and academic leaders. On July 25, the Organization Department of the Central Committee, the Propaganda Department of the Central Committee, and the State Education Commission jointly issued the "Speech of Li Peng, Li Lanqing and other leading comrades at the Fifth National Conference on Party Building in Colleges and Universities".

translated_text: On the 18th, Jiang Zemin, Li Peng, Qiao Shi, Li Ruihuan, Liu Huaqing, Hu Jintao, Rong Yiren and other party and state leaders attended the opening ceremony of the first meeting of the 8th Committee of the All-China Youth Federation and the 22nd Congress of the All-China Students Federation. translated_text: On the 15th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the State Economic and Trade Commission and other departments jointly issued the "Opinions on Strengthening the Construction of the Leadership Team of State-owned Enterprises", requiring local party committees, governments and relevant departments to take practical measures to strengthen the construction of the leadership team of state-owned enterprises, especially large and medium-sized state-owned enterprises, to provide guarantees for the smooth progress of state-owned enterprise reform and the healthy development of production. The "Opinions" pointed out that in strengthening the construction of the leadership team of state-owned enterprises, it is necessary to highlight key points and provide classified guidance, with the focus on large and medium-sized state-owned enterprises. In order to meet the needs of establishing a modern enterprise system, the first thing to do now is to do a good job in the construction of the leadership team of the 100 modern enterprise system pilot enterprises determined by the State Council, and adjust and enrich the leadership teams of these enterprises according to the management authority. This work will strive to be completed before the end of 1995 to ensure the smooth progress of the pilot work. For enterprises with serious losses, the reasons for the losses must be deeply analyzed. Any enterprise that suffers losses due to ineffective leadership teams must be adjusted and enriched in a timely manner. Arrangements should also be made for the leadership teams of other enterprises that need to be adjusted and enriched. The "Opinions" require that the inspection of the leadership teams of enterprises be done carefully. The objects of investigation include the leading members of the administrative and party organizations, with the focus on the main leaders of the party and government. A written investigation report should be written for the objects of investigation, and opinions and suggestions for adjustment and enrichment should be put forward. Those with outstanding performance should be praised and rewarded; those with average work should be required to improve; those with poor quality, incompetent for the current position, causing the decline or loss of enterprise benefits, and those with big problems and many contradictions should be resolutely adjusted, and vacancies should be filled in time; those who abuse power for personal gain, embezzle and corrupt, and cause major losses to the country and enterprises should be held accountable according to law. The Policy Research Office of the CPC Central Committee and the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee held a symposium on studying Xiaoping's theory of building the ruling party in the new era. Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, presided over the meeting. In his speech, he said that Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory on the construction of the ruling party in the new era is a complete, scientific and systematic theoretical system with rich content. It is extremely important for strengthening party building in the new era. It has made profound and insightful discussions on a series of major issues such as the party's ideological construction, organizational construction, style construction, institutional construction, and strengthening party leadership from a strategic perspective. The study of this theory should be closely combined with the implementation of the decision of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 18th CPC Central Committee, and the relationship between economic construction and party construction should be properly handled. Party construction should be strengthened around economic construction, and strengthening party construction should promote economic construction. We should vigorously strengthen the construction of grassroots party organizations in rural areas, enterprise party organizations and party organizations in government agencies. Chen Zuolin, deputy secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, made a written speech entitled "Do a good job in the integrity and self-discipline of leading cadres and correct the party's style." He pointed out that the integrity and self-discipline of leading cadres is an important measure to correct the party's style and oppose corruption. To do a good job in integrity and self-discipline, we must start with strengthening ideological and political construction, strengthen supervision and the construction of laws and regulations, and pay attention to consolidating the achievements that have been made. Liu Yunshan, deputy director of the Central Propaganda Department, said in his speech that in the new era, the construction of the ruling party should still put ideological construction first. This is a fine tradition of our party and an important part of Deng Xiaoping's theory of building the ruling party in the new era. Zheng Ke, deputy director of the Central Policy Research Office, emphasized in his speech that Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of party building is also a system. To master this system, we must start from clarifying what kind of party we want to build and strengthening party building from the perspective of the line. To study Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of party building, we must grasp the essence and learn the materialist dialectics that runs through it. Other speakers at the symposium included Yang Chaoshi, member of the Standing Committee of the Beijing Municipal Party Committee and Minister of Organization, Leng Rong, member of the Central Document Research Office and deputy editor, Fan Ping, professor of the Beijing Municipal Party School, and Shao Wen, professor of the Central Party School. Invited to attend the symposium were leaders and some experts, professors and theoretical workers from the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, the Central Propaganda Department, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, the State Organs Working Committee, the Central Party School, the National School of Administration, the All-China Federation of Trade Unions, the Central Committee of the Communist Youth League, the Central Literature Research Office, the Ministry of Railways, the People's Daily, the Qiushi Journal, the Press and Publication Administration, the General Political Department, the Political Department of the Armed Police, the Organization Department of the Beijing Municipal Committee, the Beijing Municipal Committee Party School, the Beijing Academy of Social Sciences and other departments.

Hu Jintao said that the vast number of veteran cadres, veteran party members, and veteran comrades who participated in the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression are witnesses of history, heroes of the country and the nation, and predecessors who educate and enlighten future generations. Party organizations at all levels should support and organize them to carry out patriotism, collectivism and socialist education for the majority of party members, cadres and the masses, especially young people, more effectively, so that the descendants of the Chinese nation will always remember the historical enlightenment of the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War, love the motherland and peace, and take the iron will and the heroic spirit of struggle and sacrifice shown by the revolutionary martyrs and predecessors in the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression as an example, bravely face the test of various difficulties and risks, and devote themselves wholeheartedly to the great cause of building the "four modernizations" and revitalizing China, to create the glory of our Chinese nation again. translated_text:
On the same day, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee held a symposium for old party members in rural areas to commemorate the 50th anniversary of the victory of the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression. 70 old party members from rural areas across the country who participated in the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression attended the symposium. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, attended the symposium and delivered a speech.
At present, there are 230,000 old party members who joined the party before the victory of the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression living in rural areas. These old rural party members, together with the people of all ethnic groups in the country, shared the same hatred of the enemy and went to the national crisis together during the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression, and made great contributions to the victory of the war. The 70 elderly people who came to Beijing at the invitation of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee to participate in the activities to commemorate the 50th anniversary of the victory of the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression are outstanding representatives of the 230,000 old party members in rural areas across the country. Among them are old soldiers of the Eighth Route Army, the New Fourth Army, the Northeast Anti-Japanese Allied Forces, the Dongjiang Column, and the Qiongya Column, guerrillas, militia and models of support who persisted in the war behind enemy lines, and widows of heroes and models of the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression.
On behalf of the Party Central Committee, Hu Jintao extended a warm welcome to these old heroes, old models and old party members, and fully affirmed the outstanding role played by these old comrades during the war years and the period of socialist construction. Hu Jintao asked the Party committees at all levels, especially the organization departments, to take extra care of the 230,000 rural old party members who participated in the War of Resistance Against Japan. They should help them solve practical difficulties, truly care about them politically and take care of them in life, and attach importance to giving full play to the role of these old party members, support them in educating young people on patriotism and revolutionary traditions, pass on good ideas and good work styles from generation to generation, and make greater contributions to cultivating builders and successors of the socialist cause.
Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, spoke at the symposium and highly praised the outstanding contributions of rural old party members in the War of Resistance Against Japan. He said that the reason for inviting everyone to Beijing this time was, on the one hand, to participate in the activities commemorating the 50th anniversary of the victory of the War of Resistance Against Japan, and on the other hand, he also wanted to invite everyone to contribute ideas and suggestions on developing the rural economy and strengthening the construction of rural grassroots party organizations. Relevant leaders from the PLA General Political Department, Personnel Department, Ministry of Agriculture, Ministry of Civil Affairs, All-China Women's Federation and other departments attended the symposium.

events: 23日 中共中央组织部就王志平,王辉理、李加思等3人因犯严重错误受到党纪政纪处分的问题,在全党进行了通报。《通报》说,中共中央纪委、天津市委查处了原天津市委委员、市委组织部副部长､市人事局局长、党组书记王志平在为其母亲办丧事期间,收受礼金,借机敛财,以权谋私,用公款吃喝玩乐,挥霍浪费等问题。贵州省委查处了原贵州省委组织部副部长兼秘书长王辉理,在修建全省党员电教中心工程中,擅自改变用途,突破基建规模,违法占地,并向企业拉赞助和挪用党费等问题。广东省委、阳江市委查处了原阳江市委常委、组织部长李思长期嫖娼,包娼,用公款送礼等问题。《通报》说,王志平等人身为党的组织部门领导干部,本应严于律己,率先垂范,勤政为民,模范遵守党纪国法,而他们却置党的纪律于不顾,滥用职权,贪图享乐,追求资产阶级腐朽糜烂的生活方式,在社会上造成很坏的影响,严重地损害了党的组织部门的形象。有关部门对他们作出严肃处理是完全必要的。《通报》说,事实再一次说明,在新的形势下,资产阶级腐朽思想无孔不入,也会向组织部门干部队伍渗透,侵害干部的思想。王志平等人所犯的错误,向我们敲了警钟。对此,组织战线的广大干部特别是领导干部,必须有清醒的认识,从中吸取深刻的教训。
translated_text: On the 23rd, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued a notice to the whole party regarding the issue that Wang Zhiping, Wang Huili, Li Jiasi and other three people were punished for violating party and government discipline for serious mistakes. The "Notice" said that the CPC Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and the Tianjin Municipal Committee investigated and dealt with Wang Zhiping, the former member of the Tianjin Municipal Committee, deputy director of the Municipal Committee Organization Department, director of the Municipal Personnel Bureau, and party group secretary, for accepting gifts, taking advantage of the opportunity to make money, abusing power for personal gain, using public funds for eating, drinking and having fun, and squandering during the funeral of his mother. The Tianjin Municipal Committee decided, and after review by the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and approval by the Party Central Committee, to revoke Wang Zhiping's position as member of the Tianjin Municipal Committee, deputy director of the Municipal Committee Organization Department, and party group secretary of the Municipal Personnel Bureau. The Standing Committee of the Municipal People's Congress decided to revoke Wang Zhiping's position as director of the Municipal Personnel Bureau. The Guizhou Provincial Committee investigated and dealt with Wang Huili, the former deputy director and secretary-general of the Organization Department of the Guizhou Provincial Party Committee, for arbitrarily changing the purpose of the construction of the provincial party member audio-visual education center, exceeding the scale of infrastructure, illegally occupying land, soliciting sponsorship from enterprises, and misappropriating party fees. The Guizhou Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection decided and reported to the Provincial Party Committee for approval to remove Wang Huili from his position as deputy director and secretary general of the Provincial Party Committee Organization Department. The Guangdong Provincial Party Committee and Yangjiang Municipal Party Committee investigated and dealt with the problems of Li Si, former member of the Standing Committee of the Yangjiang Municipal Party Committee and head of the Organization Department, who had been soliciting prostitution for a long time, keeping prostitutes, and using public funds for gifts. The Yangjiang Municipal Party Committee decided and reported to the Guangdong Provincial Party Committee for approval to expel Li Jiasi from the Party (his positions as member of the Yangjiang Municipal Party Committee, member of the Standing Committee of the Municipal Party Committee, and head of the Municipal Party Committee Organization Department were naturally revoked); the Yangjiang Municipal People's Congress removed Li Si's qualification as a municipal people's congress representative; the public security organs implemented a six-month custody and education for Li Jiasi. The "Notice" said that Wang Zhiping and others, as leading cadres of the party's organization department, should have been strict with themselves, set an example, worked diligently for the people, and modelly abided by the party's discipline and national laws, but they ignored the party's discipline, abused their power, coveted pleasure, and pursued a decadent and corrupt bourgeois lifestyle, which had a very bad impact on society and seriously damaged the image of the party's organization department. It is absolutely necessary for the relevant departments to deal with them seriously. The "Notice" said that the facts once again show that under the new situation, the decadent bourgeois ideology is pervasive and will also penetrate into the cadre team of the organization department and harm the cadres' thoughts. The mistakes made by Wang Zhiping and others have sounded a wake-up call for us. In this regard, the majority of cadres on the organizational front, especially leading cadres, must have a clear understanding and draw profound lessons from it.

events: 25日——28日 中国共产党第十四届中央委员会第五次全体会议在北京召开。出席这次会议的中央委员176人,候补中央委员125人。中央纪律检查委员会常务委员会委员和有关方面的负责同志列席会议。全会由中央政治局主持。江泽民同志作了重要讲话。全会审议并通过了《中共中央关于制定国民经济和社会发展“九五”计划和2010年远景目标的建议》,全文共分六个部分:(一)我国国民经济和社会发展的重要时期;(二)主要奋斗目标和指导方针;(三)经济建设的主要任务和战略布局;(四)改革开放的主要任务和部署;(五)社会发展的主要任务和基本政策;(六)全党全国各族人民团结起来,为实现“九五”计划和2010年远景目标而奋斗。李鹏同志就《建议》草案作了说明。全会审议并通过了中央纪律检查委员会《关于陈希同同志问题的审查报告》。鉴于他在经济等方面的问题有些还没有完全查清,决定对他的问题继续进行审查。全会号召,全党同志和全国各族人民,在以江泽民同志为核心的党中央领导下,更加紧密地团结起来,高举建设有中国特色的社会主义的伟大旗帜,为实现国民经济和社会发展“九五”计划和2010年远景目标,为把我国建设成富强、民主、文明的社会主义现代化国家而奋斗!
translated_text: From the 25th to the 28th, the Fifth Plenary Session of the 14th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China was held in Beijing. 176 members of the Central Committee and 125 alternate members attended the meeting. Members of the Standing Committee of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and responsible comrades from relevant departments attended the meeting. The plenary session was chaired by the Political Bureau of the Central Committee. Comrade Jiang Zemin delivered an important speech. The plenary session reviewed and adopted the "Proposal of the CPC Central Committee on Formulating the Ninth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development and the Long-Term Goals for 2010". The full text is divided into six parts: (i) Important periods of national economic and social development in my country; (ii) Main goals and guiding principles; (iii) Main tasks and strategic layout of economic construction; (iv) Main tasks and deployment of reform and opening up; (v) Main tasks and basic policies of social development; (vi) The whole party and people of all ethnic groups in the country unite to strive for the realization of the Ninth Five-Year Plan and the long-term goals for 2010. Comrade Li Peng explained the draft of the "Proposal". In accordance with the provisions of the Party Constitution, the Plenary Session decided to add Comrades Quan Li and Ma Qizhi, alternate members of the Central Committee, as members of the Central Committee. The Plenary Session decided to add Comrades Zhang Wannian and Chi Haotian as Vice Chairmen of the Central Military Commission, and Comrades Wang Ke and Wang Ruilin as members of the Central Military Commission. The Plenary Session reviewed and approved the "Report on the Review of Comrade Chen Xitong" by the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection. The Plenary Session decided to revoke his posts as a member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee and a member of the Central Committee, and recommended that he be removed from his post as a deputy to the National People's Congress in accordance with legal procedures. In view of the fact that some of his problems in the economy and other aspects have not been fully investigated, it was decided to continue the review of his problems. The Plenary Session called on all comrades of the Party and people of all ethnic groups in the country to unite more closely under the leadership of the Party Central Committee with Comrade Jiang Zemin as the core, hold high the great banner of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, and strive to achieve the "Ninth Five-Year Plan" for national economic and social development and the long-term goals for 2010, and to build our country into a prosperous, democratic, and civilized socialist modern country!

events: 5日——8日 中共中央组织部在北京召开全国农村基层组织建设经验交流会。会议主要议题是学习贯彻落实五中全会精神,全面分析农村基层组织建设的形势,总结交流经验,找出差距和不足,研究部署今冬明春的工作,进一步推动农村基层组织建设持续深入地开展,以取得新的更大的成绩。全国基层组织建设联系会议的领导成员,各省、自治区、直辖市党委组织部长和基层组织联系会议或领导小组办公室负责人,以及各省、自治区、直辖市有关部门负责人和部分地(市)、州、县委书记等共150多人出席了会议。中纪委、民政部、农业部、团中央、全国妇联的负责同志在会上发了言。中共中央政治局常委、书记处书记胡锦涛在会上做了题为《着眼大局,扎实工作,把农村基层组织建设得更好》的重要讲话。他强调指出,各级党政领导干部要很好领会、认真贯彻十四届五中全会精神,从全国改革、发展、稳定的大局出发,站在确保实现“九五”和2010年经济和社会发展目标的战略高度,坚决按照中央的部署和要求,进一步加强对农村基层组织建设的领导,坚持不懈地把这项工作做好。胡锦涛强调,中央提出的加强农村基层组织建设“五个好”的目标要求,彼此联系,相辅相成,不可分割。今后仍然要坚决按照“五个好”的目标要求做工作,坚持全面推进和重点突破相结合。对不同发展水平和工作基础的村,具体要求可以有所不同,但“五个好”的目标要求一个也不能少,都应当贯彻落实。在工作中应注意突出重点,继续着力抓好领导班子建设、选配好支部书记;找好加快发展经济的路子,同时壮大集体经济实力。胡锦涛最后说,加强农村基层组织建设,现在的关键在于逐级负责,加强领导,狠抓落实。首先要落实建立和实行党委抓党建,书记带头抓党建的责任制,真正做到思想到位,措施到位,工作到位。县(市)委对抓好农村基层组织建设负有直接的领导责任,应按照中央的有关规定把责任制切实建立和实行起来,着眼和着力于解决存在的问题,检验履行责任制如何,最终要以是否实实在在地解决问题为主要依据。中央组织部部长张全景在会上作了工作报告。张全景在讲话中回顾了一年来各地在加强农村基层组织建设工作方面所取得的成就。在充分肯定成绩和经验的同时,张全景说,农村基层组织存在的问题和薄弱环节还不少,工作发展不平衡,有些地方工作力度不够,措施也不得力。农村基层组织的现状与党中央的要求和农民群众的期望还有很大差距,与新形势新任务的需要还很不适应,整顿建设好农村基层组织工作的难度不能低估,任务相当艰巨,还需继续努力。他指出,今冬明春的工作重点就是要严格按照“五个好”的目标要求,在全面推进农村基层组织建设的同时,继续抓紧时间,集中力量,把软弱涣散和瘫痪状态的村党支部整顿好。“五个好”是一个完整的目标体系,互相联系,相辅相成。好班子是关键,好队伍是基础,好路子是中心,好机制是动力,好制度是保证。张全景强调,要充分发挥县、乡党委在加强农村基层组织建设中的作用,党委书记要真正尽到第一责任人的职责,要亲自抓部署、检查、落实,坚持做到常抓不懈。要继续下派得力干部驻村帮助工作,坚持和完善各级领导责任制和部门包村制度,并把这一制度长期坚持下去,对已经整顿的村,要认真检查验收,要做到整顿一个,合格一个,整顿一批,巩固一批。出席会议的有中央有关部委负责同志吕枫、侯宗宾、陈作霖、徐惟诚、陈福今,周子玉、郑科扬,中组部负责同志以及全国基层组织建设联系会议成员单位的负责同志.10 月 25 日,中央组织部印发了《胡锦涛同志和张全景同志在全国农村基层组织建设经验交流会上的讲话》。
translated_text: From the 5th to the 8th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee held a national rural grassroots organization construction experience exchange meeting in Beijing. The main topic of the meeting was to study and implement the spirit of the Fifth Plenary Session of the CPC Central Committee, comprehensively analyze the situation of rural grassroots organization construction, summarize and exchange experiences, find out the gaps and shortcomings, study and deploy the work this winter and next spring, and further promote the continuous and in-depth development of rural grassroots organization construction to achieve new and greater achievements. The leading members of the National Grassroots Organization Construction Liaison Meeting, the heads of the Organization Departments of the Party Committees of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government and the heads of the grassroots organization liaison meeting or leading group offices, as well as the heads of relevant departments of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government and some prefectures (cities), prefectures, and county party committees, a total of more than 150 people attended the meeting. Responsible comrades from the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, the Ministry of Civil Affairs, the Ministry of Agriculture, the Central Committee of the Communist Youth League, and the All-China Women's Federation spoke at the meeting. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, delivered an important speech entitled "Focusing on the overall situation, working hard, and building rural grassroots organizations better" at the meeting. He stressed that leading cadres of the Party and government at all levels should understand and implement the spirit of the Fifth Plenary Session of the 14th CPC Central Committee, proceed from the overall situation of national reform, development and stability, stand at the strategic height of ensuring the realization of the economic and social development goals of the "Ninth Five-Year Plan" and 2010, resolutely follow the deployment and requirements of the Central Committee, further strengthen the leadership of the construction of rural grassroots organizations, and unremittingly do a good job in this work. Hu Jintao emphasized that the "five good" goals and requirements put forward by the Central Committee to strengthen the construction of rural grassroots organizations are interconnected, complementary and inseparable. In the future, we must still resolutely work in accordance with the "five good" goals and requirements, and adhere to the combination of comprehensive promotion and key breakthroughs. For villages with different development levels and work bases, the specific requirements may be different, but none of the "five good" goals and requirements can be missed, and they should all be implemented. In the work, we should pay attention to highlighting the key points, continue to focus on the construction of the leadership team, select good branch secretaries; find a way to accelerate economic development, and at the same time strengthen the collective economic strength. Hu Jintao finally said that the key to strengthening the construction of rural grassroots organizations now lies in taking responsibility at each level, strengthening leadership, and strictly implementing it. First of all, we must implement the establishment and implementation of the responsibility system in which the Party committee takes charge of party building and the secretary takes the lead in party building, and truly ensure that the thoughts, measures, and work are in place. The county (city) committee has a direct leadership responsibility for the construction of rural grassroots organizations. It should establish and implement the responsibility system in accordance with the relevant regulations of the Central Committee, focus on and focus on solving existing problems, and test how the responsibility system is implemented. Ultimately, it should be based on whether the problems are actually solved. Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, delivered a work report at the meeting. In his speech, Zhang Quanjing reviewed the achievements made by various places in strengthening the construction of rural grassroots organizations over the past year. He pointed out that after a year of efforts, nearly 60,000 rural party branches have been rectified across the country, and a total of 450,000 cadres from various places have been sent to backward villages to help with work. A large number of relatively young party members with higher education, stronger working ability, and prestige among the masses have been newly selected as village branch secretaries. While fully affirming the achievements and experience, Zhang Quanjing said that there are still many problems and weak links in rural grassroots organizations, the work development is unbalanced, and the work efforts in some places are not strong enough and the measures are not effective. The current situation of rural grassroots organizations is still far from the requirements of the Party Central Committee and the expectations of the farmers, and it is still not adapted to the needs of the new situation and new tasks. The Notice pointed out that since February 1995, the Hunan Provincial Committee has organized forces to conduct a serious and in-depth investigation and research on the party building of 100 large and medium-sized state-owned enterprises in the province, and on this basis, put forward opinions on further strengthening and improving the party work in state-owned enterprises. This document is generally in line with the spirit of the Central Committee, and the measures are feasible. The Notice pointed out that state-owned enterprises are the pillars of the national economy. The modern enterprise system with public ownership as the main body is the foundation of the socialist market economic system. Establishing a modern enterprise system is the direction of the reform of large and medium-sized state-owned enterprises. Enhancing the vitality of state-owned enterprises, especially large and medium-sized state-owned enterprises, and giving play to the leading role of the state-owned economy are related to the success or failure of economic reform, the superiority of the socialist system, and the realization of the strategic goals of economic and social development. In order to carry out the reform of state-owned enterprises and establish a modern enterprise system, it is necessary to strengthen the party building of state-owned enterprises and give full play to the political core role of enterprise party organizations. The effective play of the political core role of enterprise party organizations depends to a large extent on their own work. The party organizations of enterprises must actively carry out their work in accordance with the duties stipulated in the party constitution, ensure and supervise the implementation of the principles and policies of the party and the state in enterprises; clarify the guiding ideology of the party work of enterprises, take ensuring the success of enterprise reform, transformation of operating mechanisms, and improvement of economic benefits as the starting point and end point of work, focus on party building around economic construction, and promote economic construction by strengthening party building; actively participate in the decision-making of major issues of enterprises, support factory directors (managers) to exercise their powers according to law, and gradually improve the leadership system of enterprises; rely wholeheartedly on the working class, support the participation of workers and staff in enterprise reform and management, and do a good job in ideological and political work; strengthen self-construction, continuously improve the quality of party cadres, emancipate the mind, cheer up the spirit, overcome the idea of doing nothing and difficulty in doing anything, and strive to explore the role of party branches as a fighting fortress and the role of party members as pioneers and models, and do a good job in ideological and political work in the new era.

27日 中共中央组织部部长张全景在全国易地安置离休干
部工作座谈会上讲话。
张全景指出,党中央、国务院对老党员、老干部非常重视,制定
了一系列关于老干部的政策和规定。从总体上说,党中央、国务院
的政策规定对做好老干部工作起了很重要的作用,绝大多数单位
贯彻执行也是很认真的。但是也应该看到,当前老干部工作中的问
题,主要是政策不落实。我们在强调落实政策当中,最重要的是强
调政治待遇不变、生活待遇略为从优,这是一项基本政策。对于中
央的政策、规定,我们要坚决贯彻落实。
中央组织部副部长李铁林在会上也作了发言。他说,离休干部
易地安置工作总的情况是比较好的。但是,我们也应当清醒地看
到,尽管当前全国易地安置的离休干部人数不多,却还有不少同志
的生活待遇没有得到很好落实,离休费、医药费被拖欠,生活很困
难,有的甚至连基本生活都得不到保障。出现这些问题的原因比较
多,情况也比较复杂。但其中的一个主要原因是少数离休干部的原
地区,原单位的党政领导对离休干部易地安置工作重视不够,对这
项工作采取了不负责任的态度。个别领导干部在离休干部安置出
去后,就一推了之,撒手不管,不闻不问,对接受安置单位的来函、
来人置之不理或避而不见,态度十分消极。这虽是极少数,却是绝
对不允许的。它违反了党中央、国务院有关老干部工作的政策规
定,伤害了易地安置离休干部的感情。李铁林说,老干部工作关键
在领导,领导在认识,认识在感情。可以说领导干部对待老同志的
态度,从一定程度上反映了这些领导干部对待党的历史,对待人民
群众的态度。接受安置的地区和单位要继续做好易地安置离休干
部的各项工作,在落实政治待遇上,要突出一个“同”字,做到与当
地离休干部一视同仁;在解决生活实际困难上,要突出一个“情”
字,做到千方百计,尽心尽力;在进行服务管理工作中,要突出一个
“诚”字,做到全心全意,一丝不苟。
12月26日,中央组织部印发了《张全景、李铁林同志在全国
易地安置离休干部工作座谈会上的讲话》。
translated_text: On the 27th, Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, spoke at the National Symposium on the Resettlement of Retired Cadres. Zhang Quanjing pointed out that the CPC Central Committee and the State Council attach great importance to veteran party members and cadres and have formulated a series of policies and regulations on veteran cadres. Generally speaking, the policies and regulations of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council have played a very important role in doing a good job in veteran cadres work, and the vast majority of units have also implemented them very seriously. However, it should also be noted that the current problems in veteran cadres work are mainly due to the lack of policy implementation. When we emphasize the implementation of policies, the most important thing is to emphasize that political treatment remains unchanged and living treatment is slightly better. This is a basic policy. We must resolutely implement the policies and regulations of the central government. Li Tielin, Deputy Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, also made a speech at the meeting. He said that the overall situation of the relocation of retired cadres is relatively good. However, we should also be soberly aware that although the number of retired cadres relocated nationwide is not large, there are still many comrades whose living treatment has not been well implemented, and their retirement benefits and medical expenses are in arrears. They live in difficulty, and some even cannot guarantee their basic living. There are many reasons for these problems, and the situation is quite complicated. But one of the main reasons is that the party and government leaders of the original regions and units of a few retired cadres did not pay enough attention to the relocation of retired cadres and took an irresponsible attitude towards this work. After the retired cadres were resettled, some leading cadres just pushed it aside, left it alone, and ignored or avoided the letters and visitors from the receiving units, with a very negative attitude. Although this is a very small number, it is absolutely not allowed. It violates the policies and regulations of the Party Central Committee and the State Council on the work of veteran cadres and hurts the feelings of the retired cadres who are resettled. Li Tielin said that the key to the work of veteran cadres lies in leadership, leadership lies in understanding, and understanding lies in feelings. It can be said that the attitude of leading cadres towards veteran comrades reflects, to a certain extent, the attitude of these leading cadres towards the history of the Party and the people. The regions and units that accept the resettlement should continue to do a good job in all aspects of the resettlement of retired cadres. In implementing political treatment, they should emphasize the word "same" and treat retired cadres in the same way as local cadres; in solving practical difficulties in life, they should emphasize the word "affection" and do everything possible and do their best; in providing services and management, they should emphasize the word "sincerity" and do it wholeheartedly and meticulously. On December 26, the Organization Department of the Central Committee issued "Speech by Comrades Zhang Quanjing and Li Tielin at the National Symposium on the Resettlement of Retired Cadres".

translated_text: On the 1st, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the Propaganda Department of the CPC Central Committee jointly issued the "Notice on the Concentrated Training of Rural Grassroots Cadres". The "Notice" pointed out that with the development of the socialist market economy, there are still some problems among rural grassroots cadres that are not adapted to the new situation, new tasks and new requirements. Therefore, it is necessary to conduct a centralized training for rural grassroots cadres. Through this centralized training, the majority of rural grassroots cadres will further grasp the basic viewpoints of Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, strengthen the communist ideal and the belief in taking the road of socialism with Chinese characteristics, and enhance the consciousness of implementing the party's basic line and the party's various policies and guidelines in rural areas; further master the basic knowledge of the party, conscientiously perform the obligations of party members in accordance with the provisions of the party constitution, correctly exercise the rights of party members, adhere to the purpose of serving the people wholeheartedly, effectively change the style of work, keep close contact with the masses, and play a leading and vanguard role in the construction of two civilizations in rural areas; further master the basic knowledge of the socialist market economy, and improve the ability to organize and lead the peasant masses to develop the economy and become rich and well-off. The "Notice" pointed out that this training will be carried out in a way that the three-level party schools of prefectures (cities), counties (cities), and townships (towns) will be responsible for each other and connected with each other, and training will be carried out step by step. All localities should seize the favorable opportunity of this winter and next spring to make arrangements and organize implementation. Where conditions permit, we should strive to train rural party members and cadres this winter and next spring; if conditions are not met for the time being, we can use two years to complete the training. The "Notice" emphasized that this training work will be carried out under the unified leadership of party committees at all levels, and the organization, propaganda departments and party schools should each assume their responsibilities, closely cooperate, work together, and do a good job together.

translated_text: From the 6th to the 8th, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, President of the State, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, inspected work in Beijing. The Central Committee clearly pointed out that we must not ignore Beijing's work achievements and the contributions made by the vast number of cadres in Beijing to reform and construction because of this problem. We must distinguish Chen Xitong and Wang Baosen from the vast number of cadres in Beijing, and distinguish their problems from the mainstream work and work achievements of the Beijing Municipal Party Committee and Municipal Government. Jiang Zemin warned comrades in Beijing to seriously learn lessons from the Chen Xitong problem and the Wang Baosen case, take them as a warning, and turn bad things into good things. events: 1995年11月7日,中央机构编制委员会和人事部联合召开全国事业单位机构和人事制度改革工作会议。国务委员、中央编委副主任李贵鲜在会上强调,要根据事业单位的性质、功能和特点,逐步建立既不同于机关,又有别于企业,符合事业单位自身特点和发展规律的,充满生机和活力的管理体制、运行机制和自我约束机制。确立科学的总体布局,坚持社会化的方向,推行多样的管理,实行制度化的总量控制。
translated_text: On November 7, 1995, the Central Organization and Establishment Commission and the Ministry of Personnel jointly held a national conference on the reform of the institutions and personnel systems of public institutions. Li Guixian, State Councilor and Deputy Director of the Central Organization and Establishment Commission, stressed at the conference that it is necessary to gradually establish a management system, operation mechanism and self-discipline mechanism that is different from both government agencies and enterprises, in line with the characteristics and development laws of public institutions, and full of vitality and vigor, based on the nature, functions and characteristics of public institutions. Song Defu, Director of the Central Organization and Establishment Commission and Minister of the Ministry of Personnel, pointed out at the conference that in promoting the reform of the institutions and personnel systems of public institutions, we must follow the principles of the Party managing cadres and separating politics from administration, the principles of classified management and supporting reforms, the principles of openness, equality, competition and selection, and the principles of decoupling, classification, decentralization and revitalization. We must establish a scientific overall layout, adhere to the direction of socialization, promote diversified management, and implement institutionalized total control.

events: 1995年11月14日,全国人事系统留学人员工作会议在北京召开。国务委员李贵鲜在会上强调,留学人员工作是改革开放事业的重要组成部分,要充分开发利用留学人才资源,进一步推动留学人员工作更好地为科技进步与经济发展服务,从留学回国人员中培养造就一批跨世纪学术和技术带头人。1995年12月18日,全国人事厅局长会议在北京召开。国务委员李贵鲜在会上要求,加快推行公务员制度步伐,争取1996年底完成国务院提出的用三年左右时间在全国基本建立起国家公务员制度的任务。人事部部长宋德福在报告中强调,要加快实现人事工作的“两个调整”,建设好“三支队伍”,即把适应计划经济的人事管理体制调整到与市场经济相配套的人事管理体制上,把传统的人事管理转变到整体性人才资源开发上来,建设好公务员队伍、专业技术人员队伍和管理人员队伍。
translated_text: On November 14, 1995, the National Personnel System Overseas Students Work Conference was held in Beijing. State Councilor Li Guixian stressed at the conference that overseas students work is an important part of the reform and opening-up cause. We must fully develop and utilize overseas students, further promote overseas students work to better serve scientific and technological progress and economic development, and cultivate a group of cross-century academic and technical leaders from overseas students. On December 18, 1995, the National Personnel Department Directors' Conference was held in Beijing. State Councilor Li Guixian demanded at the conference that the pace of promoting the civil service system be accelerated, and that the task proposed by the State Council to basically establish a national civil service system in about three years be completed by the end of 1996. translated_text: On the 18th, the People's Daily published a commentary article titled "Ask Comrade Li Runwu about Learning". The article pointed out that Comrade Li Runwu, the deputy mayor of Beijing, who was in his prime, suddenly died at his post. He left without leaving any last words, and left the world with countless work and a sincere heart for the people. Even in the last moments of his life, he still took on important responsibilities for the society and the people, and gave his light and heat. His character was as important as the mountains and rivers, and as brilliant as the sun and the moon.

events:

治局常委、国务院总理李鹏日前就这次会议作了重要指示。中共中
央政治局常委、书记处书记胡锦涛在中南海会见了会议的全体代

松,把学习贯彻五中全会精神和继续贯彻四中全会《决定》结合起

职能,在推进改革开放和现代化建设中处于十分重要的地位。中央
国家机关要更好地担负起时代赋予的光荣使命,保证完成好各项
任务,必须继续推进党的建设这一新的伟大工程。
translated_text: On the 20th, the 10th Party Work Conference of the Central State Organs was held. Li Peng, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Premier of the State Council, recently gave important instructions on this conference. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, met with all the representatives of the conference in Zhongnanhai and delivered an important speech. Li Peng pointed out that the party organizations and leading cadres at all levels must first unify their thinking, take the lead in changing their concepts, and unify their thinking with the spirit of the Fifth Plenary Session of the Central Committee. We must enhance our awareness of serving economic construction and carry out the party's work closely around the business of the departments. We must fully mobilize the enthusiasm and creativity of the majority of party members and cadres, and make more contributions to the formulation of the "Ninth Five-Year Plan" and the long-term planning for 2010 and the completion of the tasks for 1996. He also emphasized that party member leaders and cadres must be politically conscious, strengthen party spirit training, adhere to the policy of grasping both hands and making both hands strong, and care about and support the party work of the organs. The majority of party members and cadres must go deep into reality, go deep into the grassroots, conduct serious investigations and research, and truly change the work style of the organs and improve work efficiency. Reduce meetings, unnecessary evaluations, selections and other formalistic activities, and reduce the burden on the grassroots. We must continue to deepen the fight against corruption, further strengthen the building of a clean government, and earnestly correct the unhealthy trends in the industry. Many departments of the State Council are in charge of money, property and projects, and they must strictly demand themselves and set an example in building a diligent and clean government. In his speech, Hu Jintao demanded that the party organizations of various departments of the central state organs should firmly grasp the center of economic construction and not waver, firmly grasp the key of party building and not relax, combine the study and implementation of the spirit of the Fifth Plenary Session of the Central Committee with the continued implementation of the "Decision" of the Fourth Plenary Session of the Central Committee, and work hard to implement it. He emphasized that the central state organs are the advisers and assistants of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, and bear the macro-guidance and management functions from the economy to all fields of society, and they are in a very important position in promoting reform, opening up and modernization. The central state organs must better shoulder the glorious mission given by the times and ensure the completion of various tasks. They must continue to promote the new great project of party building.

events: 23日 中共中央组织部、人民日报联合举办纪念孔繁森同志逝世一周年座谈会。一年来,孔繁森同志的模范事迹在中华大地广为传颂,向孔繁森同志学习的热潮在全国各地掀起。他们在发言中指出,孔繁森是在党的长期培养教育下,深深扎根于人民群众的沃土之中成长起来的新时期党的干部的楷模。在孔繁森身上表现出来的当代共产党人顾全大局、无私奉献的坚强党性,热爱人民,服务人民的公仆情怀,清正廉洁、克己奉公的高尚品德,艰苦奋斗,知难而进的拼搏精神,开拓进取,求真务实的优良作风,已经成为全党和全社会共同的精神财富。与会同志表示,一定要深入持久地开展向孔繁森同志学习的活动,大力弘扬孔繁森精神。
translated_text: On the 23rd, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the People's Daily jointly held a symposium to commemorate the first anniversary of the death of Comrade Kong Fansen. Over the past year, Comrade Kong Fansen's exemplary deeds have been widely praised in China, and a wave of learning from Comrade Kong Fansen has swept across the country. People's Daily President Shao Huaze, Deputy Minister of the Organization Department Wu Lianyuan, Executive Deputy Director of the State Ethnic Affairs Commission Chen Hong, Director of the Intellectual Engineering Committee of the China Medical Foundation Qian Xinzhong, Deputy Minister of the Ministry of Civil Affairs Yang Yin, Secretary General of the Central Propaganda Department Dai Zhou, Secretary of the Secretariat of the Central Committee of the Communist Youth League Jiang Daming and others spoke at the symposium. In their speeches, they pointed out that Kong Fansen was a model of party cadres in the new era who grew up under the party's long-term training and education and was deeply rooted in the fertile soil of the people. The strong party spirit of contemporary Communists who take the overall situation into consideration and make selfless contributions, the feelings of public servants who love the people and serve the people, the noble character of being honest and upright, self-sacrificing and serving the public, the spirit of hard work and forging ahead despite difficulties, the fine style of pioneering and enterprising, seeking truth and being pragmatic, which are shown in Kong Fansen, have become the common spiritual wealth of the whole party and the whole society. The comrades attending the meeting expressed that they must carry out the activities of learning from Comrade Kong Fansen in depth and for a long time, and vigorously promote the spirit of Kong Fansen.
