events:
同日 中共中央政治局常委、书记处书记胡锦涛到中央组织
部培训中心,看望第六期党员专家理论研究班学员并讲话。
由中组部举办的这期党员专家研究班是11月14日开始的。
在为期两周的时间里,研究班采取辅导讲授、自学讨论及参观考察
相结合的方式,重点学习了邓小平同志建设有中国特色社会主义
理论、党的十四届五中全会及全国科技大会文件。有关部门领导和
专家学者先后就建设有中国特色社会主义理论、新时期党的建设、
我国的经济、科技体制改革和外交工作进行了辅导讲授。中组部部
长张全景、副部长王旭东分别出席开学典礼和学员讨论会,并讲了
话。学员们在北京、天津两地参观考察了国有大中型企业及科研院
所,还听取了天津市领导同志介绍天津的经济发展和改革开放情
况。研究班取得较好效果。
参加学习的29位学员来自中央、国家机关的11个部委和9
个省市,其中6位是中国科学院和中国工程院院士,大都是“中国
青年科技奖”获得者,有突出贡献的中青年专家、省、自治区、直辖
市优秀专家。他们平均年龄 44岁,最小的32岁。
translated_text: On the same day, Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, visited the training center of the Central Organization Department to visit the students of the sixth Party Expert Theory Research Class and delivered a speech. The Party Expert Research Class organized by the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee began on November 14. During the two-week period, the class adopted a combination of tutoring, self-study and discussion, and visits and inspections, focusing on studying Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, the Fifth Plenary Session of the 14th CPC Central Committee and the documents of the National Science and Technology Conference. Leaders of relevant departments and experts and scholars successively gave tutoring lectures on the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, party building in the new era, my country's economic and technological system reform and diplomatic work. Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, and Wang Xudong, Vice Minister, attended the opening ceremony and the student discussion meeting respectively and delivered speeches. The students visited large and medium-sized state-owned enterprises and scientific research institutes in Beijing and Tianjin, and listened to the introduction of Tianjin's economic development and reform and opening up by Tianjin leaders. The research class achieved good results. The 29 participants came from 11 ministries and commissions of the central and state organs and 9 provinces and cities. Among them, 6 were academicians of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and the Chinese Academy of Engineering. Most of them were winners of the "China Youth Science and Technology Award", young and middle-aged experts with outstanding contributions, and outstanding experts from provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities. Their average age was 44 years old, and the youngest was 32 years old.

events:
28日 中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席江泽民在
同国防大学学员座谈时发表讲话。
江泽民指出,本世纪的最后几年,是我国经济和社会发展、我
军现代化建设的关键时期。形势的发展,要求我们不断提高干部队
伍的素质,首要的是要加强学习。人们在改造客观世界的同时改造
主观世界,但这种改造是通过主观努力、刻苦学习完成的。只有不
断学习,才能使人知识不断更新,永葆革命青春。
江泽民强调,讲政治,是党的十四届五中全会的一个重要精
神。这是我们党的优良传统,任何时候都要讲政治。对军队而言,
讲政治是最重要的一条,过去一直是做得好的。政治工作是我军的
一大优势。军队要永远听党的话,保证党对军队的绝对领导,保证
枪杆子永远掌握在忠于党的人的手里。
translated_text: On the 28th, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, President of the State, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, delivered a speech at a discussion with students of the National Defense University. Jiang Zemin pointed out that the last few years of this century are a critical period for my country's economic and social development and the modernization of our army. The development of the situation requires us to continuously improve the quality of our cadres and the first thing is to strengthen learning. People transform the subjective world while transforming the objective world, but this transformation is achieved through subjective efforts and hard study. Only by continuous learning can people keep their knowledge updated and maintain revolutionary youth. Jiang Zemin emphasized that talking about politics is an important spirit of the Fifth Plenary Session of the 14th CPC Central Committee. This is a fine tradition of our party, and we must talk about politics at all times. For the army, talking about politics is the most important one, and it has always been done well in the past. Political work is a major advantage of our army. The army must always listen to the party, ensure the party's absolute leadership over the army, and ensure that the gun is always in the hands of people loyal to the party.

translated_text: From the 28th to the 29th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China held a national cadre personnel archives work experience exchange meeting. The meeting proposed that at present and in the future, the cadre personnel archives work should adhere to the "four modernizations" policy of the cadre team and the principle of both moral integrity and ability, based on collection and collation, focus on basic construction, improve management level, ensure the provision and utilization, and better serve the cadre personnel work and personnel decision-making work. Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Central Organization Department, and others attended the meeting, and Li Tielin, Deputy Minister of the Central Organization Department, spoke at the meeting. At the meeting, the "Decision on Commending Advanced Collectives and Advanced Workers in the National Cadre Personnel Archives Work" of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, the Ministry of Personnel, and the State Archives Administration was announced, and 161 advanced collectives and 187 advanced workers across the country were commended.

会的工作总体部署。在推进改革开放和现代化建设中解决好党的
建设的突出问题,继续推进党的建设这一新的伟大工程,为社会主
义现代化建设顺利进行提供坚强的保证。他说,中央关于加强党的
建设的总目标、总要求和总体部署都已明确。经过十四届四中全会
以来一年多的努力,党的建设有了新的进步,学习贯彻五中全会精
神又为党建工作提供了良好机遇,现在最重要的是继续扎实工作,

任制,在新形势下把党建工作提高到一个新水平。

论,特别是邓小平同志建设有中国特色社会主义理论,学习了党的

侯宗宾、中组部部长张全景等有关方面负责人出席。胡锦涛为学员
颁发了毕业证书。
translated_text: On the 30th, Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, Secretary of the Secretariat, and President of the Central Party School, attended the closing ceremony of the 19th Provincial and Ministerial Cadre Training Class of the Central Party School and delivered a speech. Hu Jintao pointed out that the key to achieving the "Ninth Five-Year Plan" and the 2010 long-term goals lies in the Party, in strengthening the Party's leadership, and in further improving Party building. Party committees at all levels should closely combine the continued implementation of the "Decision" of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 14th Central Committee with the implementation of the spirit of the Fifth Plenary Session of the Central Committee in terms of ideology and practical work. translated_text: From the 11th to the 13th, the National Organization Work Symposium was held in Beijing. This meeting was held with the approval of the CPC Central Committee. Its main task was to study and implement the spirit of the 14th Fifth Plenary Session of the Party and the important speeches of Comrade Jiang Zemin at the Fifth Plenary Session and the Central Economic Work Conference, and to study and deploy the organizational work in 1996. The symposium proposed that the organizational work in 1996 should focus on strengthening the ideological and political construction of the leading groups above the county level, comprehensively improve the quality of leading cadres, speed up the training and selection of young cadres, vigorously strengthen the construction of the grassroots organizations of the Party, especially the Party work in rural areas, enterprises and government agencies, and continue to promote the new great project of Party building, so as to provide a strong organizational guarantee for the realization of the "Ninth Five-Year Plan" and the 2010 vision goals. In his speech, Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, pointed out that in 1996, efforts should be made to do a good job in the following tasks: (i) Focus on strengthening the ideological and political construction of the leadership team and comprehensively improve the quality of leading cadres at all levels; (ii) Continue to speed up the training and selection of young cadres and timely select truly outstanding talents into the leadership teams at all levels; (iii) Take practical measures to strictly require, manage and supervise leading cadres; (iv) Conscientiously implement democratic centralism and continuously enhance the cohesion and combat effectiveness of the leadership team; (v) Deepen the reform of the cadre system and strengthen the macro-management of cadres; (vi) Strengthen and improve the construction of grassroots party organizations, focusing on the party work in rural areas and state-owned enterprises; (vii) Conduct in-depth learning activities on the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and the Party Constitution among party members. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, delivered an important speech at the symposium. He stressed that in the face of new situations and tasks, Party committees at all levels should always recognize the issues of Party building and leadership team building from the strategic and overall perspective of socialist modernization, firmly establish the idea that "the key to doing China's affairs lies in the Party" and "the key lies in people", seize the favorable opportunity to implement the spirit of the Fourth and Fifth Plenary Sessions of the 14th Central Committee, and do a good job in Party building, especially in leadership team building, solve the outstanding problems, further play the leading role of the Party in reform, development and stability, and ensure a good start in the first year of the "Ninth Five-Year Plan". Hu Jintao stressed that in strengthening the construction of the leadership team, the focus should be on ideological and political construction. The general requirement is to help leading cadres at all levels always firmly believe in the ideals and beliefs of socialism and communism, bear in mind the nature of the party and the purpose of serving the people wholeheartedly, resolutely implement the party's line, principles, and policies, keep in mind the overall situation of the work of the whole party and the whole country, be good at judging the situation, recognizing problems, and making decisions from a political perspective, and always maintain political clarity and firmness on issues related to the overall situation and fundamental principles. In the final analysis, it is necessary to firmly establish the Marxist world outlook and outlook on life and constantly enhance party spirit. At present, we must focus on solving four problems: First, we must unswervingly implement the party's basic theory, basic line, and basic policy, and always adhere to the correct political direction; second, we must strengthen the overall concept, resolutely safeguard the authority of the central government, and be consistent with the central government in politics, ideology, and actions; third, we must firmly establish the mass viewpoint, adhere to the mass line, serve the people wholeheartedly, and close the flesh-and-blood ties with the people; fourth, we must adhere to and carry forward the ideological style of seeking truth from facts, be pragmatic and seek truth, and really work hard. When talking about how to do a good job in training and selecting outstanding young cadres, Hu Jintao pointed out that this work has made obvious progress, but we must not be satisfied with the status quo. He asked the Party committees at all levels, especially the secretaries, to strengthen their sense of responsibility and urgency, and to grasp this major event related to the future and destiny of the Party and the country with due foresight and courage. He hoped that everyone would increase their efforts in four aspects, further emancipate their minds, and eliminate various ideological obstacles; expand their horizons in knowing people, broaden and clear the channels for selecting people; accelerate the reform of the cadre system, and provide institutional guarantees for selecting and using talents well; combine the selection and use of people with the training of people, and do a good job in the training and education of young cadres. At the same time, we should pay attention to the role of cadres of other age levels. Hu Jintao pointed out that we not only need a large number of party and government leading cadres who can adhere to the Party's basic line and have both moral integrity and ability, but also a large number of various types of talents with excellent quality. In order to adapt to the requirements of realizing a fundamental transformation of the economic system and economic growth mode, we must especially strive to cultivate and create a team of high-quality socialist enterprise managers and a team of high-quality scientific and technological talents. Party committees at all levels should face the world, modernization, and the future, focus on the healthy growth of a generation, adhere to the construction of the "three teams" together, and continuously create a large number of high-quality talents to achieve the cross-century goal. Hu Jintao required that party committees at all levels should further implement the responsibility system of party committees taking the lead in party building and secretaries taking the lead in party building. Under the new situation, party committees at all levels should further improve their work level and follow the two requirements repeatedly emphasized by Comrade Jiang Zemin: one is "learn, learn, and learn again", and the other is "implement, implement, and implement again."

照中央的政策规定办理,严格把关,保证了因公出国人员的质量。
但也有个别地区和部门在下放因公出国人员审批权限以后,指导
和监督不力,管理上出现失控。在对出国人员条件的掌握上,出现
了只重业务能力,不过问思想政治表现的倾向。通报要求各级党委
和组织、人事部门认真总结近几年因公出国人员审查工作,要加强
管理,严格把关;严格执行有关规定;防止此类问题的发生。
translated_text: On the 19th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued a notice on the investigation and handling of a case of fraud in the review procedures for personnel going abroad on official business by the Organization Department of the Huzhou Municipal Party Committee of Zhejiang Province. The "Notice" pointed out that recently, the Organization Department of the Huzhou Municipal Party Committee of Zhejiang Province discovered and handled serious fraud in the review procedures for Zhao Xinrong, deputy general manager of Huzhou Ruishi Chain Transmission Group Co., Ltd. in the approval work of personnel going abroad. Zhao Xinrong filled out the "Review Form for Personnel Going Abroad on Official Business" on his own in order to accompany the "China Light Cavalry Technical Delegation" to Japan for inspection. When filling it out, he concealed important circumstances such as being expelled from the party and sentenced to three years in prison, and fabricated his personal experience and political performance. The main person in charge of the Morong Township Party Committee of Nanxun District, Huzhou City, not only did not stop Zhao Xinrong's wrong practices, but signed and stamped his seal to agree to Zhao Xinrong's going abroad, knowing that Zhao Xinrong had been subject to party discipline and criminal sanctions. After discovering these problems during the review, the Organization Department of Huzhou Municipal Party Committee immediately took measures to stop Zhao Xinrong from going abroad with the delegation and dealt with the relevant responsible persons. The "Notice" pointed out that the review of personnel going abroad on official business is a serious political work. In order to do this work well, the central government has successively issued several documents, which clearly stipulate the approval conditions, approval authority and approval procedures for personnel going abroad on official business, as well as how to fill in the "Review Form for Personnel Going Abroad on Official Business". In the past few years, the vast majority of organizations and personnel departments have been able to conscientiously handle in accordance with the central government's policies and regulations, strictly control, and ensure the quality of personnel going abroad on official business. However, there are also some regions and departments that have not provided effective guidance and supervision after delegating the approval authority for personnel going abroad on official business, and management has been out of control. In the grasp of the conditions for personnel going abroad, there has been a tendency to only focus on business capabilities and not ask about ideological and political performance. The notice requires party committees at all levels and organization and personnel departments to seriously summarize the review of personnel going abroad on official business in recent years, strengthen management, strictly control; strictly implement relevant regulations; and prevent the occurrence of such problems.

events:
20日 中共中央总书记、国家主席江泽民,国务院总理李鹏
出席全国政法工作会议,并同部分代表进行座谈。
江泽民在座谈会上指出,纵观世纪之交的国际国内形势,我们
确有不可多得的历史机遇,同时也面临诸多挑战,中央最近强调高
级干部一定要讲政治,其中提出要有政治辨别力、政治敏锐性。党
的所有高级干部,包括省委书记、省长、各部部长,都应该在政治上
过得硬。越是深化改革、扩大开放,越要注意政治。我们强调讲政
治,是希望大家对国际国内敌对势力的活动,对维护安定团结政治
局面的极端重要性保持清醒的认识,不要埋头日常具体事务而在
日益复杂的斗争中迷失方向,归根到底,都是为了坚持经济建设这
个中心,为集中力量把经济搞上去提供强有力的政治保证,创造良
好的政治环境,如果政治上出了问题,社会不稳定,经济建设就会
受到严重干扰。所以,我们一定要坚持用辩证唯物主义的观点看问
题,正确处理改革、发展、稳定的关系,正确处理经济和政治的关
系。
translated_text: On the 20th, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee and President of the People's Republic of China, and Li Peng, Premier of the State Council, attended the National Political and Legal Work Conference and held a discussion with some representatives. Jiang Zemin pointed out at the symposium that, looking at the international and domestic situation at the turn of the century, we do have rare historical opportunities, but we also face many challenges. The Central Committee recently emphasized that senior cadres must be politically conscious, and proposed that they must have political discernment and political acumen. All senior cadres of the Party, including provincial party secretaries, governors, and ministers of various departments, should be strong in politics. The more we deepen reform and expand opening up, the more we should pay attention to politics. We emphasize politics because we hope that everyone will maintain a clear understanding of the activities of international and domestic hostile forces and the extreme importance of maintaining a stable and united political situation, and not bury their heads in daily specific affairs and lose their way in the increasingly complex struggle. In the final analysis, it is all for the purpose of adhering to the center of economic construction, providing strong political guarantees for concentrating efforts to develop the economy, and creating a good political environment. If there are problems in politics and social instability, economic construction will be seriously disturbed. Therefore, we must persist in looking at problems from the perspective of dialectical materialism, correctly handle the relationship between reform, development and stability, and correctly handle the relationship between economy and politics.

收入党。这样做,我们党才能不断增加新鲜力量,增强活力,才能更
好地带领人民群众进行改革开放和现代化建设。
translated_text: From the 2nd to the 9th, Qiao Shi, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, inspected work in Shanghai and Jiangsu. During the inspection, Qiao Shi pointed out that efforts should be made to build grassroots party organizations. One of the most important points is to cultivate outstanding young people who are active in the front lines of production, operation, scientific research and other work, and actively recruit those who meet the conditions into the party. In this way, our party can continuously increase fresh forces, enhance vitality, and better lead the people in reform, opening up and modernization.

events:
3日 中共中央组织部印发《中国共产党党内统计工作规
定》。
《规定》指出,为系统了解和及时掌握全国的党内基本状况、党
员队伍和党组织增减变化情况,以及党内组织生活和执行党内法
规等情况,为研究制定有关党的建设的方针政策和做好组织工作
提供数字依据。
《规定》要求,各级党委组织部门必须保证党内统计报表上报
时间的统一性和统计数据的真实性、完整性。党内统计报表的填报
原则和统计口径等,以中央组织部编制的《中国共产党党内统计年
报表统计指标编制说明》为准。各级填报单位在汇总上报前,必须
对统计数据进行认真、细致、全面的技术审核和逻辑审核,防止和
减少差错。
translated_text: On the 3rd, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Regulations on Internal Statistics of the Communist Party of China". The "Regulations" pointed out that in order to systematically understand and timely grasp the basic situation of the party, the increase and decrease of party members and party organizations, as well as the party's organizational life and the implementation of party regulations, it provides a digital basis for the research and formulation of policies and guidelines on party building and the organization of work. The "Regulations" require that the organization departments of party committees at all levels must ensure the uniformity of the reporting time of internal statistical reports and the authenticity and integrity of statistical data. The reporting principles and statistical caliber of internal statistical reports shall be based on the "Explanation on the Compilation of Statistical Indicators of the Annual Report of the Communist Party of China" compiled by the Central Organization Department. Before summarizing and reporting, reporting units at all levels must conduct a serious, detailed and comprehensive technical and logical review of statistical data to prevent and reduce errors.

events:
同日 中共中央组织部、人事部联合印发《关于贯彻落实<中
共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅关于千方百计解决部分群众生活困
难问题的通知》的意见》。
《意见》指出,关心群众生活,体察群众疾苦,解决群众困难,是
我们党的优良传统,是全心全意为人民服务宗旨的具体体现,是各
级党委和政府义不容辞的责任。对当前部分群众的生活困难问题,
各级组织人事部门一定要高度重视,从维护党的威信,密切党和政
府与人民群众的关系、增强党的凝聚力、调动广大群众的积极性、
维护社会稳定的高度,充分认识解决部分群众生活困难问题的重
要性。要以高度的政治责任感和满腔热情,认真解决和安排好困难
群众的生活问题。
《意见》要求各级党政主要负责同志要亲自过问这件事。组织
人事部门,老干部部门要发挥好职能作用,一级抓一级、层层负责,
建立责任制,落实到人。要做好督促检查工作。要千方百计筹措资
金,保证经费落实。
translated_text: On the same day, the Organization Department and the Personnel Department of the CPC Central Committee jointly issued the "Opinions on Implementing the Notice of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council on Doing Everything Possible to Solve the Difficulties in the Life of Some People". The "Opinions" pointed out that caring about the lives of the masses, understanding their sufferings, and solving their difficulties are the fine traditions of our party, the concrete embodiment of the purpose of serving the people wholeheartedly, and the unshirkable responsibility of party committees and governments at all levels. Regarding the current difficulties in the lives of some people, the organization and personnel departments at all levels must attach great importance to them, and fully recognize the importance of solving the difficulties in the lives of some people from the perspective of maintaining the prestige of the party, strengthening the relationship between the party and the government and the people, enhancing the cohesion of the party, mobilizing the enthusiasm of the masses, and maintaining social stability. With a high sense of political responsibility and full of enthusiasm, we must earnestly solve and arrange the living problems of the people in difficulty. The "Opinions" require the main responsible comrades of the party and government at all levels to personally inquire about this matter. The organization and personnel departments and the old cadres departments should play their functional roles, grasp the level at the level, be responsible at all levels, establish a responsibility system, and implement it to the people. Supervision and inspection work should be done well. We must do everything possible to raise funds and ensure that the funds are implemented.

events:

刘云山主持。
中共中央政治局委员、书记处书记、中共中央宣传部部长丁关

events:

结合选拔领导干部的暂行办法的通知》。
《通知》指出,采取公开推荐与考试考核相结合的办法选拔党
政领导干部,是一项重要改革,是坚持党管干部原则,改进党管干
部方法的有益探索。
《通知》要求,各省区市党委和中央、国家机关各部委党组(党
委),要进一步加强对公开选拔领导干部工作的领导,搞好宏观管
理和具体指导。近几年已进行这项改革的地方和部门,要认真总结
经验,使其不断完善,逐步实现科学化和制度化;尚未进行这项改
革的地方和部门,应在借鉴已有经验的基础上积极组织试行。
translated_text: On the 10th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China forwarded the "Notice on the Interim Measures for the Selection of Leading Cadres in Jilin Province by Combining Public Recommendation with Examination and Assessment". The "Notice" pointed out that the selection of party and government leading cadres by combining public recommendation with examination and assessment is an important reform and a useful exploration of adhering to the principle of party management of cadres and improving the methods of party management of cadres. The "Notice" requires that the party committees of all provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities and the party groups (party committees) of all ministries and commissions of the central and state organs should further strengthen the leadership of the open selection of leading cadres and do a good job in macro-management and specific guidance. Localities and departments that have carried out this reform in recent years should seriously summarize their experience, continuously improve it, and gradually realize scientific and institutionalized; localities and departments that have not yet carried out this reform should actively organize trials based on the experience they have learned.

events:

长、副理事长,党组书记、副书记、成员,由中央管理;中国残联执行

的。
translated_text: On the 15th, the People's Daily reported that Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee and President of the State, pointed out in relation to the development of metallurgical work in the country that in the new era of reform and development, wholehearted reliance on the working class is a basic political principle that cannot be shaken at any time. Without the master role, enthusiasm and creativity of the working class, enterprises and modern industries cannot be run well.

events:

于督查落实党的十四届四中全会精神情况的报告》。
《报告》指出,党的十四届四中全会以来党的建设和党建工作
取得了新成绩,呈现出进一步发展的好势头。
《报告》总结了新形势下加强党的建设的主要经验。

小平建设有中国特色社会主义理论武装全党的工作,为今后15年
的发展打下牢固的思想基础;二是把领导班子建设作为党的建设
的重点,在提高领导干部素质上下功夫;三是着眼大局,扎实工作,
把党的基层组织建设得更好;四是深入持久地开展反腐败斗争,密

translated_text: On the 16th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee forwarded the "Report of the Central Party Building Leading Group on the Supervision and Implementation of the Spirit of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 14th CPC Central Committee". The report pointed out that since the Fourth Plenary Session of the 14th CPC Central Committee, new achievements have been made in party building and party building work, showing a good momentum of further development. The report summarized the main experience of strengthening party building under the new situation. The report put forward opinions on strengthening party building work in the future: First, continue to do a good job in arming the whole party with Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, and lay a solid ideological foundation for the development in the next 15 years; second, take the construction of the leadership team as the focus of party building, and work hard to improve the quality of leading cadres; third, focus on the overall situation, work hard, and build the grassroots party organizations better; fourth, carry out in-depth and long-term anti-corruption struggles, and strengthen the flesh-and-blood ties between the party and the people; fifth, adhere to and improve democratic centralism, strictly enforce the party's organizational principles and political discipline, and maintain and strengthen the unity of the party.

events:
17日 《人民日报》以《领导干部一定要讲政治》为题,发表中
共中央总书记、国家主席江泽民1995年9月27日在十四届五中
全会召集人会议上讲话的部分内容。
江泽民在讲话中指出,各级领导干部尤其是高级干部务必带
头加强党性锻炼,在改造客观世界的同时,努力改造主观世界,严
以律己,防微杜渐。党员领导干部不论职务高低、党龄长短,如果放
弃世界观的改造,背离为人民服务的宗旨,把党和人民赋予的权力
作为谋取私利的手段,就会身败名裂。因此,一定要解决好世界观、
人生观问题。我们的党员领导干部首先是高级干部,应该思想境界
更高一些,坚持党的事业第一,坚持人民的利益第一,为国家、为民
族奋不顾身地工作。有了这样的精神支柱,站得就高了,眼界就
了,心胸就开阔了,对个人的名利待遇等等,就能够正确处理。只有
这样,人生才有意义,生活才充实,领导干部首先要堂堂正正做人,
做什么人,建议大家重读毛泽东同志的《纪念白求恩》。毛主席要求
共产党员学习白求恩同志毫无自私自利之心的精神,做一个高尚
的人,一个纯粹的人,一个有道德的人,一个脱离了低级趣味的人,
一个有益于人民的人。
江泽民强调,我们的高级干部,首先是省委书记、省长和部长,
中央委员和中央政治局委员,一定要讲政治。我这里所说的政治,
包括政治方向、政治立场、政治观点、政治纪律、政治鉴别力、政治
敏锐性。
translated_text: On the 17th, the People's Daily published part of the speech by Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee and President of the State, at the meeting of the conveners of the 14th Fifth Plenary Session of the CPC Central Committee on September 27, 1995, under the title "Leaders must be politically conscious". In his speech, Jiang Zemin pointed out that leaders at all levels, especially senior cadres, must take the lead in strengthening party spirit training, strive to transform the subjective world while transforming the objective world, and strictly discipline themselves to prevent and prevent problems from happening. Regardless of the position or length of party membership, if party member leaders abandon the transformation of their world outlook, deviate from the purpose of serving the people, and use the power granted by the party and the people as a means to seek personal gain, they will be ruined. Therefore, the problem of world outlook and outlook on life must be solved. Our party member leaders are first of all senior cadres, and their ideological realm should be higher, they should put the party's cause first, the people's interests first, and work for the country and the nation without hesitation. With such a spiritual pillar, they will stand higher, have a broader vision, and be more open-minded, and they will be able to correctly deal with personal fame, wealth, treatment, etc. Only in this way can life be meaningful and fulfilling. Leading cadres must first be upright and upright. What kind of person should they be? I suggest that everyone reread Comrade Mao Zedong's "In Memory of Bethune". Chairman Mao asked Communist Party members to learn from Comrade Bethune's spirit of selflessness and be a noble person, a pure person, a moral person, a person who is free from vulgar tastes, and a person who is beneficial to the people. Jiang Zemin emphasized that our senior cadres, first of all, provincial party secretaries, governors and ministers, members of the Central Committee and members of the Central Political Bureau, must be political. The politics I am talking about here include political direction, political stance, political views, political discipline, political discernment, and political acumen.

events:
同日 《人民日报》发表题为《群众观点、群众路线万万不能
丢》的评论员文章。
文章指出,毛泽东同志为我们党制定了“从群众中来,到群众
中去”的群众路线,以及一系列体现群众路线的领导方法和工作方
法,要求党的各级干部对于广大群众的切身利益问题,群众的生活
问题,一点也不能疏忽,一点也不能看轻。
文章指出,邓小平同志反复告诫全党要加强同人民群众的联
系,越是困难的时候越要关心群众,越是改革开放越要尊重群众的
首创精神和调动广大群众的积极性,并强调把“人民拥护不拥护”、
“人民赞成不赞成”、“人民高兴不高兴”、“人民答应不答应”作为全
党想事情,做工作,想得对不对,做得好不好的一个根本衡量尺度。
文章还指出,江泽民同志多次强调,领导干部首先是高级干部
必须讲政治。讲政治从根本上说,主要是对人民群众的态度问题,
同人民群众的关系问题。真正掌握和实践了群众观点、群众路线,
也就能真正掌握和实践党的实事求是的思想路线和彻底的历史唯
物论,也就从根本上懂得了政治。
translated_text: On the same day, the People's Daily published a commentator's article entitled "The Mass Viewpoint and the Mass Line Must Not Be Lost". The article pointed out that Comrade Mao Zedong formulated the mass line of "coming from the masses and going to the masses" for our party, as well as a series of leadership methods and working methods that embody the mass line, requiring party cadres at all levels to not neglect or underestimate the vital interests of the masses and the lives of the masses. The article pointed out that Comrade Deng Xiaoping repeatedly warned the whole party to strengthen its ties with the masses, to care more about the masses in difficult times, and to respect the initiative of the masses and mobilize the enthusiasm of the masses in reform and opening up. He also emphasized that "whether the people support it", "whether the people agree to it", "whether the people are happy", and "whether the people agree to it" should be the fundamental measure of whether the whole party thinks about things and does work, whether it is right or not, and whether it is done well. The article also pointed out that Comrade Jiang Zemin repeatedly emphasized that leading cadres, especially senior cadres, must be political. Fundamentally speaking, being political is mainly a question of attitude towards the masses and the relationship with the masses. If we truly grasp and practice the mass viewpoint and mass line, we will be able to truly grasp and practice the party's ideological line of seeking truth from facts and thorough historical materialism, and we will fundamentally understand politics.

events:
26日 中共中央总书记、国家主席江泽民在中央纪律检查委
员会第六次全体会议上发表重要讲话。江泽民指出,实现我国的
“九五”计划和跨世纪的宏伟目标,关键在于我们党在新的历史条
件下,在新的国内外环境中,努力保持党的工人阶级先锋队性质,
不断增强党的凝聚力和战斗力,切实提高党的执政水平和领导水
平,这是决定社会主义在中国巩固和发展的根本问题。各级党委
必从战略和全局的高度认识抓好党的建设的极端重要性,紧紧围
绕经济建设这个中心任务,继续全面加强党的建设,并按照中央部
署,加大工作力度,坚定不移地把反腐败斗争引向深入,务必使领
导干部廉洁自律,查处违法违纪案件、纠正部门和行业不正之风,
都取得更大更明显的实效。
江泽民强调,以身作则,廉洁自律,是各级领导干部必须具备
的品格,也是党和人民对他们的起码要求。我们的领导干部特别是
高级干部,无论在工作中还是日常生活中,都要严格要求自己,时
刻注意检点自己的言行,以高尚的道德情操,为广大党员和干部树
立好的榜样,中央关于领导干部廉洁自律的各项规定,所有领导干
部都必须不折不扣地做到。主要领导成员不仅要管好自己,而且要
带好领导班子,并对本地区、本单位的党风廉政建设工作全面负
责。要进一步加大工作力度,继续认真查处大案要案,震慑违法犯
罪分子,教育广大干部、党员,鼓舞人民群众的信心。发现严重违法
违纪的,不管涉及到谁,都要一查到底。
会议由中共中央政治局委员、书记处书记、中央纪律检查委员
会书记尉健行主持,中共中央政治局常委李鹏、乔石、李瑞环、刘华
清、胡锦涛出席会议。
translated_text: On the 26th, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee and President of the State, delivered an important speech at the Sixth Plenary Session of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection. Jiang Zemin pointed out that the key to achieving my country's "Ninth Five-Year Plan" and the grand goals across the century lies in our party's efforts to maintain the party's nature as the vanguard of the working class under the new historical conditions and in the new domestic and international environment, constantly enhance the party's cohesion and combat effectiveness, and effectively improve the party's governance and leadership level. This is the fundamental issue that determines the consolidation and development of socialism in China. Party committees at all levels must recognize the extreme importance of party building from a strategic and overall perspective, closely focus on the central task of economic construction, continue to strengthen party building in an all-round way, and in accordance with the central deployment, increase work efforts, unswervingly lead the anti-corruption struggle to a deeper level, and ensure that leading cadres are honest and self-disciplined, investigate and deal with illegal and disciplinary cases, and correct unhealthy trends in departments and industries, and achieve greater and more obvious results. Jiang Zemin emphasized that leading cadres at all levels must set an example and be honest and self-disciplined, which is the character that they must possess, and it is also the minimum requirement of the party and the people for them. Our leading cadres, especially senior cadres, must strictly demand themselves, always pay attention to their words and deeds, set a good example for the majority of party members and cadres with noble moral sentiments, and all leading cadres must strictly implement the various regulations of the Central Committee on the integrity and self-discipline of leading cadres. The main leading members must not only manage themselves well, but also lead the leadership team well, and be fully responsible for the work of building the party style and clean government in their regions and units. We must further increase our efforts, continue to seriously investigate and deal with major cases, deter lawbreakers and criminals, educate the majority of cadres and party members, and inspire the confidence of the people. If serious violations of laws and disciplines are found, no matter who is involved, they must be investigated to the end. The meeting was chaired by Wei Jianxing, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, Secretary of the Secretariat, and Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, and attended by Li Peng, Qiao Shi, Li Ruihuan, Liu Huaqing, and Hu Jintao, members of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee.

events:
1日 《人民日报》发表中共中央组织部部长张全景的署名文
章《要保持政治上的清醒和坚定》。文章从坚持坚定正确的政治方
向,牢记党的全心全意为人民服务的宗旨,严守党的政治纪律,坚
持党的干部路线和新时期的用人标准,坚持“两手抓,两手都要硬”
的方针等五个方面进行了论述。
文章指出,必须坚持干部队伍“四化”方针和德才兼备的原则,
全面考察了解干部,正确识别和选拔任用干部,有的领导干部往往
以个人的好恶,亲疏取人,甚至搞小圈子,培植个人势力;也有的把
德和才割裂开来,对立起来,忽视干部的政治素质。应该看到,用人
问题是一个重大的政治问题,用什么人,不用什么人,对整个干部
队伍具有重要的导向作用,关系到党的事业的成败。因此,选人用
人必须正确执行党的干部政策。既要积极推进干部制度改革,努力
造成优秀人才脱颖而出的机制,又要坚持党的选贤任能的原则和
标准,严格按规定的程序办事,坚决反对用人上的不正之风。凡是
思想政治素质不好的,不得提拔重用。对于那些不择手段跑官要官
或在用人上搞不正之风的,要严厉批评,情节严重的,要给予纪律
处分。
translated_text: On the 1st, the People's Daily published a signed article by Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, entitled "We Must Maintain Political Sobriety and Firmness". The article discussed five aspects, including adhering to a firm and correct political direction, bearing in mind the Party's purpose of serving the people wholeheartedly, strictly observing the Party's political discipline, adhering to the Party's cadre line and the employment standards in the new era, and adhering to the policy of "grasping both sides and making both hands strong". The article pointed out that it is necessary to adhere to the "four modernizations" policy of the cadre team and the principle of both moral integrity and ability, comprehensively investigate and understand cadres, and correctly identify and select and appoint cadres. Some leading cadres often select people based on their personal likes and dislikes, relatives and strangers, and even form small circles to cultivate personal power; some also separate morality and ability, set them against each other, and ignore the political quality of cadres. It should be noted that the issue of employment is a major political issue. Who to use and who not to use has an important guiding role in the entire cadre team and is related to the success or failure of the Party's cause. Therefore, the Party's cadre policy must be correctly implemented in the selection and employment of people. We must actively promote the reform of the cadre system and strive to create a mechanism for outstanding talents to stand out. We must also adhere to the party's principles and standards for selecting and appointing talented people, strictly follow the prescribed procedures, and resolutely oppose unhealthy practices in employing people. Those with poor ideological and political qualities shall not be promoted or reused. Those who use any means to seek official positions or engage in unhealthy practices in employing people shall be severely criticized, and those with serious circumstances shall be given disciplinary sanctions.

events:
7日 国务院召开第四次反腐败工作会议。国务院总理李鹏
作重要讲话。李鹏指出,反腐败斗争是国家政权建设的一项基本任
务,要巩固成果,突出重点,把反腐败斗争落到实处。并强调,领导
干部特别是高级干部要以身作则,廉洁自律。要集中力量查处大案
要案,进一步加大办案力度,这是反腐败斗争深入发展的客观要
求,也是反腐败斗争取得成效的重要标志之一。1995年案件查处
工作取得了比较明显的成效,公布了一批大案要案,对腐败分子起
到了一定的震慑作用。值得注意的是,查处的案件中,相当一部分
是近一两年的案,边查边犯、性质严重。因此,必须进一步加大办
案力度,继续突破一批有影响的大案要案。对那些以权谋私、贪赃
枉法、行贿受贿以及严重失职渎职的腐败分子,不论职位高低,都
要绳之以法,决不姑息养奸。
会议由国务委员李贵鲜主持,邹家华、钱其琛、李岚清、吴邦
国,姜春云,尉健行、迟浩田,宋健、陈俊生,彭珮云、罗干等出席。
translated_text: On the 7th, the State Council held the fourth anti-corruption work conference. Premier Li Peng of the State Council delivered an important speech. Li Peng pointed out that the fight against corruption is a basic task of state power construction. We must consolidate the achievements, highlight the key points, and put the fight against corruption into practice. He also emphasized that leading cadres, especially senior cadres, must set an example and be honest and self-disciplined. We must concentrate our efforts on investigating and handling major cases and further increase the intensity of case handling. This is an objective requirement for the in-depth development of the anti-corruption struggle and one of the important signs of the effectiveness of the anti-corruption struggle. In 1995, the investigation and handling of cases achieved relatively obvious results. A number of major cases were announced, which had a certain deterrent effect on corrupt elements. It is worth noting that a considerable number of the cases investigated and handled were cases in the past one or two years, and they were committed while being investigated and were of serious nature. Therefore, it is necessary to further increase the intensity of case handling and continue to break through a number of influential major cases. Corrupt elements who abuse their power for personal gain, embezzle and pervert the law, offer and accept bribes, and seriously neglect their duties must be brought to justice regardless of their position, and will never tolerate evil. The meeting was chaired by State Councilor Li Guixian, and attended by Zou Jiahua, Qian Qichen, Li Lanqing, Wu Bangguo, Jiang Chunyun, Wei Jianxing, Chi Haotian, Song Jian, Chen Junsheng, Peng Peiyun, Luo Gan and others.

events:

工作时强调,各级领导干部一定要牢固树立群众观点,坚持群众路
线,想问题、办事情都要做到一切为了群众,时刻关心群众,坚定相
信群众,处处依靠群众,扎扎实实为群众解决实际问题,把全心全
意为人民服务,诚心诚意为人民谋利益作为全部工作的出发点和
落脚点。他指出,各级党组织要结合实际,狠抓贯彻落实。尤其要
以加强思想政治建设为重点抓好领导班子建设,全面提高领导素
质。把中央关于领导干部一定要讲政治的要求,落实到贯彻执行党
的路线方针政策和工作部署上,落实到正确判断形势,提高辨別重
大原则是非的能力上,落实到加强党性锻炼和改进思想作风上要
进一步抓好优秀年轻干部的培养选拔工作,加大党政领导干部选
拔任用等重要制度的改革力度,为优秀人才脱颖而出创造良好的

translated_text: On the 8th, Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, emphasized during his inspection in Guangxi that leading cadres at all levels must firmly establish the viewpoint of the masses, adhere to the mass line, think about problems and do things for the masses, always care about the masses, firmly believe in the masses, rely on the masses everywhere, and solve practical problems for the masses in a down-to-earth manner, and take serving the people wholeheartedly and seeking benefits for the people sincerely as the starting point and foothold of all work. 核心。完成1996年改革和建设的任务,关键在于加强和改善党的
领导,进一步搞好党的建设。我们一定要按照中央的要求,密切结
合深化改革,扩大开放,促进发展,保持稳定的各项工作,从思想
上、政治上、组织上,作风上全面推进党的建设这个新的伟大工程。

结统一。
茶话会由中央组织部部长张全景主持。
translated_text: On the 12th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the General Political Department of the PLA, and the Beijing Municipal Committee of the CPC jointly held a Spring Tea Party for Old Comrades in the Great Hall of the People. On behalf of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council, Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, extended festive greetings and high respect to the old comrades attending the Spring Tea Party, retired veteran cadres across the country, and old comrades from all fronts. Hu Jintao said that the Communist Party of China is the leading core of building socialism with Chinese characteristics. The key to completing the tasks of reform and construction in 1996 lies in strengthening and improving the party's leadership and further improving party building. We must follow the requirements of the Central Committee, closely combine the work of deepening reform, expanding opening up, promoting development, and maintaining stability, and comprehensively promote the new great project of party building in terms of ideology, politics, organization, and style. We must continue to do a good job in arming the whole party with Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, and promote the development of Marxist theory learning in breadth and depth. We must focus on ideological and political construction, comprehensively improve the quality of leading cadres, and further enhance the overall function of the leadership team. We should focus on rural and state-owned enterprise party organizations, strengthen and improve grassroots organization building, and give full play to the role of grassroots party organizations as a fighting fortress. We should continue to follow the requirements of the Central Committee, increase our efforts, deepen the fight against corruption, and solidly promote the building of party style and clean government. We should do a good job in ideological education, system construction and supervision and inspection to uphold and improve democratic centralism, strictly enforce the party's organizational principles and political discipline, and maintain and strengthen the unity of the party. The tea party was hosted by Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee.

translated_text: On the 16th, the CPC Central Committee held a symposium for non-party members in Zhongnanhai to welcome the Spring Festival. Jiang Zemin, Li Ruihuan, Hu Jintao and other party and state leaders gathered with the central leaders of the democratic parties, the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce and non-party members to discuss state affairs and welcome the New Year. Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee and President of the State, emphasized that eight aspects of work should be done well in 1996: First, actively promote the transformation of the economic system and economic growth mode, and maintain the sustained, rapid and healthy development of the national economy. Second, vigorously promote the construction of socialist spiritual civilization and do a good job in propaganda. Third, strengthen the construction of socialist democracy and legal system and resolutely maintain social stability. We must continue to improve the people's congress system, accelerate the pace of legal construction required by the development of the socialist market economy; and effectively strengthen the comprehensive management of social security. Fourth, consolidate and develop the broadest patriotic united front and actively promote the reunification of the motherland. Fifth, strive to expand foreign relations and further create a new situation in diplomatic work. Sixth, strengthen party building and close the relationship between the party and the masses. We must earnestly strengthen ideological and political construction; implement the various tasks of organizational construction; strengthen the party's work style and clean government construction, carry out the anti-corruption struggle in depth and for a long time; vigorously carry forward the party's fine traditions and style. Seventh, further strengthen the revolutionary, modernized and regularized construction of the army and improve the level of national defense modernization. Eighth, further use Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics to arm the whole party and educate the people. The whole party must further improve the consciousness of learning and continuously deepen the study, research and publicity of this theory.

translated_text: On the same day, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee held a national telephone conference on the construction of rural grassroots organizations in Beijing. events:
5日——17日 第八届全国人民代表大会第四次会议在北京
开幕。党和国家领导人江泽民、李瑞环、朱镕基、刘华清、胡锦涛、荣
毅仁等出席会议,乔石委员长主持会议,李鹏总理代表国务院做题
为《关于国民经济和社会发展“九五”计划和2010年远景目标纲
要》的报告。
李鹏的报告共分九个部分:(一)“八五”时期国民经济和社会
发展的回顾;(二)今后15年的奋斗目标和指导方针;(三)促进国
民经济的持续、快速、健康发展;(四)以企业改革为中心积极推进
经济体制改革;(五)实施科教兴国战略和可持续发展战略;(六)加
强精神文明和民主法制建设;(七)积极促进祖国和平统一大业;
(八)关于国际形势和外交工作;(九)努力做好1996年的工作,为
“九五”创造一个良好开端。
3月6日,中共中央政治局常委、书记处书记胡锦涛在参加出
席第八届全国人民代表大会第四次会议的西藏代表团会议时说:
坚持党的基本理论、基本路线不动摇,是实现宏伟目标最重要的政
治保证。
3月7日,中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席江泽民
在参加第八届全国人民代表大会第四次会议的海南、江苏代表团
会议时强调.建设有中国特色社会主义,根本目的是全心全意为人
民谋利益。我们要始终贯彻一个重要原则,就是经济利益分配的着
力点必须首先保证广大工人、农民和知识分子得到实际利益,保证
他们的生活水平不断提高,保证他们充分享受改革开放和现代化
建设的成果,
3月8日,中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席江泽民
出席第八届全国人民代表大会第四次会议的上海代表团会议。江
泽民在谈话中指出,要从政治高度认识搞好国有企业的重要性。江
泽民指出,国有企业是我国国民经济的支柱,是社会主义市场经济
的主导力量。在企业改革中,要正确处理物的因素与人的因素,客
观条件与主观条件的关系。实践证明,一支素质好的职工队伍,一
个强有力的企业领导班子,往往是决定企业盛衰的最重要因素。在
企业改革中,首先要抓班子建设,抓队伍建设,这是搞好企业改革、

在参加出席第八届全国人民代表大会第四次会议的解放军代表团

3月17日,会议通过《关于国民经济和社会发展“九五”计划

国各族人民在邓小平建设有中国特色社会主义理论和党的基本路
线指引下,紧密团结在以江泽民同志为核心的党中央周围,万众一
心,励精图治,艰苦创业,开拓进取,为全面完成《纲要》确定的宏伟
任务而努力奋斗。
translated_text: From the 5th to the 17th, the 4th session of the 8th National People's Congress opened in Beijing. Party and state leaders Jiang Zemin, Li Ruihuan, Zhu Rongji, Liu Huaqing, Hu Jintao, Rong Yiren and others attended the meeting. Chairman Qiao Shi presided over the meeting. Premier Li Peng delivered a report on behalf of the State Council entitled "On the Ninth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development and the Outline of the Long-Term Objectives for 2010". Li Peng's report is divided into nine parts: (i) Review of the national economy and social development during the "Eighth Five-Year Plan" period; (ii) Goals and guidelines for the next 15 years; (iii) Promoting the sustained, rapid and healthy development of the national economy; (iv) Actively promoting economic system reform with enterprise reform as the center; (v) Implementing the strategy of rejuvenating the country through science and education and the strategy of sustainable development; (vi) Strengthening the construction of spiritual civilization and democracy and the legal system; (vii) Actively promoting the great cause of peaceful reunification of the motherland; (viii) On the international situation and diplomatic work; (ix) Striving to do a good job in 1996 and create a good start for the "Ninth Five-Year Plan". On March 6, Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, said at the meeting of the Tibet delegation attending the Fourth Session of the Eighth National People's Congress: Adhering to the Party's basic theory and basic line is the most important political guarantee for achieving the grand goal. On March 7, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, President of the State, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, emphasized at the meeting of the Hainan and Jiangsu delegations at the Fourth Session of the Eighth National People's Congress that the fundamental purpose of building socialism with Chinese characteristics is to seek benefits for the people wholeheartedly. We must always implement an important principle, that is, the focus of economic benefit distribution must first ensure that the broad masses of workers, farmers and intellectuals obtain actual benefits, ensure that their living standards continue to improve, and ensure that they fully enjoy the fruits of reform and opening up and modernization. On March 8, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, President of the State, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, attended the Shanghai delegation meeting of the Fourth Session of the Eighth National People's Congress. In his conversation, Jiang Zemin pointed out that we must recognize the importance of running state-owned enterprises from a political perspective. Jiang Zemin pointed out that state-owned enterprises are the pillars of my country's national economy and the leading force of the socialist market economy. In enterprise reform, we must correctly handle the relationship between material factors and human factors, and between objective conditions and subjective conditions. Practice has proved that a team of well-qualified employees and a strong enterprise leadership team are often the most important factors in determining the rise and fall of an enterprise. In enterprise reform, we must first focus on team building and team building, which is the premise and foundation for carrying out enterprise reform, reorganization, transformation and strengthening management. On March 11, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, President of the State and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, pointed out at the meeting of the PLA delegation attending the Fourth Session of the Eighth National People's Congress that the requirement of speaking politics should be implemented in the self-construction of leading cadres. First, we must persist in studying Marxism-Leninism, Mao Zedong Thought, and especially Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics. Second, we must persist in the absolute leadership of the Party over the army. At any time and under any circumstances, we must remain consistent with the Party Central Committee. Third, in the face of the erosion of decadent ideology and culture, we must always maintain the political character and integrity of the Communists, adhere to integrity and self-discipline, and establish a good image among the masses. On March 13, Qiao Shi, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, attended the Sichuan delegation meeting at the Fourth Session of the Eighth National People's Congress. During the discussion, Qiao Shi emphasized that efforts should be made to build a socialist legal state. Qiao Shi said that my country's constitution and laws are the implementation of the party's basic line and a series of policies and guidelines, and are formulated by the party leading the people through legal procedures. Our party organizations at all levels and the majority of party members, especially leading cadres, must consciously abide by the constitution and laws, act within the scope of the constitution and laws, and set an example for the whole society. On March 17, the meeting passed the "Resolution on the Outline of the Ninth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development and the Long-Term Objectives for 2010 and the Report on the Outline". The meeting called on the people of all ethnic groups in the country to unite closely around the Party Central Committee with Comrade Jiang Zemin as the core under the guidance of Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and the party's basic line, work together as one, work hard, work hard, forge ahead, and strive to fully complete the grand tasks set out in the Outline.

translated_text: From the 18th to the 20th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China held a national meeting of directors of research offices of the Organization Departments of provincial, regional and municipal party committees in Wuhan, Hubei Province. 轮训班围绕十四届四､五中全会精神,围绕八届人大四次会议通过
的《纲要》和江泽民同志关于“领导干部一定要讲政治”的一系列重
要讲话精神,联系组织工作实际,采取辅导讲授、自学和座谈的形
式进行深入地讨论和研究。
中共中央政治局常委、书记处书记胡锦涛来到学习班听取学
员们汇报学习心得并做了重要讲话。
胡锦涛讲了四个问题。一是实现“九五”计划和跨世纪的宏伟
目标,组织部门要担负起重要的历史责任。二是深入学习和坚决贯
彻江泽民同志关于讲政治的重要讲话,把思想统一到中央的精神
上来。三是按照讲政治的要求,进一步做好新形势下的组织工作,
为实现跨世纪宏伟目标提供坚强的组织保证。四是从基础工作抓
起,进一步提高组织部门干部的思想政治素质。
胡锦涛指出,全国从事组织工作的同志有10万多人。总的看,
这是一支政治坚定、作风正派、工作勤奋、清正廉洁的好队伍。这些
年来为加强党的建设做了大量工作,在广大干部群众中有较好的
形象。同时也要看到,我们的队伍中也确有一些干部的素质特别是
思想政治素质,还不适应新的形势任务的要求。有的政治敏感性不
够,政治鉴别力不强,在错误观点和思潮面前,有时分不清是非。有
的不善于用改革的精神解决工作中遇到的新问题,尤其是在遇到
困难和干扰时,执行党的方针政策就不那么坚定。还有极少数人以
权谋私,甚至买官卖官,或者经不起金钱、权力和美色的考验,成为
资产阶级思想和生活方式的俘虏。组织部门出现这些问题,固然有
多方面的原因,但是说到底,根本原因在于忽视政治,放松了思想
政治建设。我们不能因为存在这些问题,就否定组织部门干部的主
流和成绩;也不能因为主流是好的,就看不到存在的问题,更不能
掩盖问题。正确的态度应该是把贯彻党的组织路线同贯彻中央关
于讲政治的要求紧密结合起来,把加强思想政治建设摆在突出位
置,从领导干部抓起,花大气力提高组织部门干部的思想政治素
质。
胡锦涛还指出,一个人,有什么样的世界观,就有什么样的人
生观;有什么样的世界观、人生观,就有什么样的政治观。我们共产
党人应当树立的只能是马克思主义的世界观和人生观,这样才能
真正懂得并自觉实践党的政治主张,坚持党的奋斗纲领、根本宗
旨,政治路线、组织纪律;才能一身正气,克己奉公,表里如一,言行
一致;才能真正脚踏实地,埋头苦干地工作。这样做得越好,证明党
性越强。江泽民同志在强调讲政治的时候,提出领导干部要做到自
重、自省、自警、自励。组织部门干部也应该这样去做。组织部门虽
然只是党委的一个职能部门,但在人们的心目中位置重要,权力不
小。在组织部门工作的同志,一定要增强政治责任感,正确看待权
力、使用权力,把党和人民赋予的权力用来为人民服务,决不能用
来谋取半点私利;要经常反省自己的行为,检点自己的作风,坚持

座谈会由中组部部长张全景主持。
translated_text: From April 22 to April 14, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee held the fourth training class for leading cadres in the organization department. A total of 99 trainees participated in the training class, mainly responsible comrades from the organization departments of the provincial, autonomous region and municipal party committees and the personnel departments of the central and state organs. The training class focused on the spirit of the Fourth and Fifth Plenary Sessions of the 14th CPC Central Committee, the Outline adopted at the Fourth Session of the Eighth National People's Congress, and a series of important speeches by Comrade Jiang Zemin on "leading cadres must be politically conscious", and linked to the actual organizational work. In-depth discussions and research were conducted in the form of tutoring, self-study and seminars. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, came to the class to listen to the students' reports on their learning experience and made an important speech. Hu Jintao talked about four issues. First, to achieve the grand goals of the "Ninth Five-Year Plan" and the cross-century, the organization department must shoulder important historical responsibilities. Second, to thoroughly study and resolutely implement Comrade Jiang Zemin's important speech on being politically conscious, and unify thoughts with the spirit of the Central Committee. Third, in accordance with the requirements of political awareness, we should further improve the organizational work under the new situation and provide a strong organizational guarantee for achieving the grand goal of the new century. Fourth, we should start from the basic work and further improve the ideological and political quality of the cadres in the organization department. Hu Jintao pointed out that there are more than 100,000 comrades engaged in organizational work across the country. In general, this is a good team with firm political beliefs, upright style, hard work, and integrity. In recent years, a lot of work has been done to strengthen party building, and it has a good image among the broad masses of cadres and the people. At the same time, we should also see that there are indeed some cadres in our team whose qualities, especially their ideological and political qualities, are not yet adapted to the requirements of the new situation and tasks. Some are not politically sensitive enough, their political discrimination is not strong, and they sometimes cannot distinguish right from wrong in the face of wrong views and trends of thought. Some are not good at solving new problems encountered in their work with the spirit of reform, especially when they encounter difficulties and interference, they are not so firm in implementing the party's principles and policies. There are also a very small number of people who use their power for personal gain, even buy and sell official positions, or cannot withstand the test of money, power and beauty, and become captives of bourgeois ideas and lifestyles. There are many reasons for these problems in the organization department, but in the final analysis, the fundamental reason lies in neglecting politics and relaxing ideological and political construction. We cannot deny the mainstream and achievements of the cadres in the organization department because of these problems; nor can we ignore the existing problems because the mainstream is good, let alone cover up the problems. The correct attitude should be to closely combine the implementation of the party's organizational line with the implementation of the central government's requirements on talking about politics, put the strengthening of ideological and political construction in a prominent position, start with leading cadres, and make great efforts to improve the ideological and political quality of the cadres in the organization department. Hu Jintao also pointed out that a person's world view determines his outlook on life; his world view and outlook on life determine his political outlook. We Communists should only establish a Marxist world view and outlook on life, so that we can truly understand and consciously practice the party's political propositions, adhere to the party's struggle program, fundamental purpose, political line, and organizational discipline; only in this way can we be upright, self-denial and dedicated to the public, consistent in appearance and reality, and consistent in words and deeds; only in this way can we truly work down-to-earth and work hard. The better we do this, the stronger our party spirit is. When emphasizing politics, Comrade Jiang Zemin proposed that leading cadres should respect themselves, reflect on themselves, warn themselves, and encourage themselves. Organization department cadres should also do so. Although the organization department is only a functional department of the Party Committee, it has an important position in people's minds and has considerable power. Comrades working in the organization department must strengthen their sense of political responsibility, correctly view and use power, use the power granted by the Party and the people to serve the people, and never use it to seek the slightest personal gain; they must often reflect on their own behavior, examine their own style, adhere to the truth, correct their mistakes, and make their actions conform to the requirements of the Party and the expectations of the people; they must build a line of defense against corruption and maintain a clean mind, warn themselves from those illegal and criminal, corrupt and degenerate examples, learn lessons, and enhance their immunity to the erosion of decadent ideas and lifestyles; they must take Kong Fansen and other outstanding cadres as examples, bear in mind the trust of the Party and the people, promote the noble spirit of the Communists, and always maintain the true qualities of the people's servants. The symposium was hosted by Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee.

events:
26日 中共中央组织部印发《关于解决建国前入党的农村老
党员生活困难的几点意见》。
《意见》要求,各级党委,特别是县乡党委,要充分认识做好解
决建国前入党的农村老党员生活困难工作的重要性,切实加强领
导,采取多种方式帮助和扶持农村老党员发展经济,从根本上解决
他们的困难;适当提高农村老党员的生活困难补贴标准;有条件的
地方,提倡以县为单位建立“党员互助基金”。基金主要用于老党员
发展生产,建立致富项目等,也可用于对特困老党员的生活救济;
在政治上关心、爱护老党员。
translated_text: On the 26th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued "Several Opinions on Solving the Difficulties of Rural Old Party Members Who Joined the Party Before the Founding of the People's Republic of China". The "Opinions" require that party committees at all levels, especially county and township party committees, should fully recognize the importance of solving the difficulties of rural old party members who joined the party before the founding of the People's Republic of China, effectively strengthen leadership, and adopt various methods to help and support rural old party members to develop the economy and fundamentally solve their difficulties; appropriately increase the living subsidy standard for rural old party members; in places with conditions, advocate the establishment of a "Party Member Mutual Aid Fund" on a county basis. The fund is mainly used for old party members to develop production, establish wealth-making projects, etc., and can also be used for life relief for extremely poor old party members; politically care for and love old party members.

events:

繁森汇报会”总结回顾一年来宣传学习孔繁森活动的成效和经
验,以进一步深入持久地开展这项宣传学习活动。中组部部长张全
景、中宣部副部长徐光春分别在会上讲话。
张全景在总结概括了宣传学习孔繁森活动的四个特点后,进
一步提出,要把学习孔繁森活动作为加强各级领导班子思想政治
建设,提高领导干部思想政治素质的重要内容,抓实抓好;进一步
坚定信念,把学习孔繁森活动作为促进广大党员、干部牢固树立正
确的世界观、人生观和价值观的有效途径;进一步见诸行动,把学

translated_text: On the same day, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee held a "Learning Kong Fansen Report Meeting" in Beijing to summarize and review the results and experience of the publicity and learning activities of Kong Fansen over the past year, so as to further carry out this publicity and learning activity in a deep and lasting manner. Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, and Xu Guangchun, Deputy Minister of the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee, spoke at the meeting respectively. After summarizing the four characteristics of the publicity and learning activities of Kong Fansen, Zhang Quanjing further proposed that the learning activities of Kong Fansen should be taken as an important content to strengthen the ideological and political construction of leadership teams at all levels and improve the ideological and political quality of leading cadres, and should be carried out in a down-to-earth manner; further strengthen the belief and take the learning activities of Kong Fansen as an effective way to promote the broad masses of party members and cadres to firmly establish a correct world outlook, outlook on life and values; further put it into action, combine the learning activities of Kong Fansen with adhering to the basic line of the party and doing a good job in various tasks; further strengthen leadership, carefully organize, and carry out the learning activities of Kong Fansen in a deep and lasting manner.

events:
27日——5月4日 中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主
席江泽民在上海就国有企业的改革和发展问题再次进行考察。期
间,他还主持召开了有四川、河北、辽宁、山东、上海的8家企业负
责人参加的座谈会,听取了上海、江苏、浙江、山东4省市领导同志
关于搞好国有企业工作的情况汇报,并发表了重要讲话。
江泽民指出,国有企业的改革和发展,是关系到整个国民经济
发展的重大经济问题,也是关系到社会主义制度命运的重大政治
问题。国有企业的改革当前正处在一个非常关键的时刻,各级党委
和政府必须进一步坚定信心,加强领导,狠抓落实,加快国有企业
的改革和发展步伐。江泽民强调,在改革开放和发展社会主义市场
经济的新形势下,必须加强党的建设和思想政治工作,全心全意依
靠工人阶级,充分发挥我们党的优良传统和政治优势。
translated_text: From May 27 to May 4, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, President of the State, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, conducted another inspection in Shanghai on the reform and development of state-owned enterprises. During the inspection, he also presided over a symposium attended by the heads of eight enterprises in Sichuan, Hebei, Liaoning, Shandong, and Shanghai, listened to the reports of the leaders of Shanghai, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, and Shandong on the work of state-owned enterprises, and delivered an important speech. Jiang Zemin pointed out that the reform and development of state-owned enterprises is a major economic issue related to the development of the entire national economy, and also a major political issue related to the fate of the socialist system. The reform of state-owned enterprises is currently at a very critical moment. Party committees and governments at all levels must further strengthen their confidence, strengthen leadership, and implement them vigorously to accelerate the pace of reform and development of state-owned enterprises. Jiang Zemin emphasized that under the new situation of reform and opening up and the development of the socialist market economy, it is necessary to strengthen party building and ideological and political work, rely wholeheartedly on the working class, and give full play to the fine traditions and political advantages of our party.

events:
2日 中共中央组织部印发《关于胡锦涛同志和张全景、刘云
山,傅杰同志在全国党员学理论学党章座谈会上的讲话的通知》。
中共中央政治局常委、书记处书记胡锦涛了关于《提高党员
思想政治素质,进一步增强党的凝聚力和战斗力的重要讲话。讲
话共分三个方面:(一)必须从党的事业全局的高度充分认识提高
党员思想政治素质的重要性和紧迫性;(二)继续广泛深入地开展
“双学”活动,把提高党员思想政治素质的工作落到实处;(三)各级
党组织要加强对“双学”活动的领导,切实负起对党员教育和管理
的责任。
中央组织部部长张全景作了关于《提高素质,增强党性,深入
开展党员学理论学党章活动》的报告。报告共分五个方面:(一)
年来全国开展党员学理论、学党章活动的基本情况;(二)进一步提
高思想认识,不断增强抓好党员“双学”活动的责任感和紧迫感;
(三)贯彻理论联系实际的原则,切实解决党员队伍中存在的突出
问题;(四)采取得力措施,把党员“双学”活动引向深入;(五)加强
领导,狠抓落实。
张全景在讲话中指出,各级领导干部,特别是高级领导干部,
只有坚持不懈地学习邓小平建设有中国特色社会主义理论和党
章,学会运用马克思主义的立场、观点、方法观察事物、判断形势,
分析问题,才能进一步树立全局观念,自觉地在思想上、政治上､行
动上同党中央保持高度一致;才能牢牢把握社会主义发展的基本
规律,坚定共产主义理想和社会主义信念;不能自觉贯彻执行党的
基本路线,在错综复杂的矛盾与各种干扰面前,保持清醒的头脑,
坚定正确的政治方向。当前,特别需要指出的是,党员领导干部包
括企业的党员厂长､经理,都要增强党员意识。不论从事何种职业,
担任什么职务,都要首先想到自己是共产党员,自己的岗位是党组
织安排的。要按照党员标准和党的干部的基本要求严格要求自己,
做到清正廉洁、艰苦朴素、发扬民主、顾全大局,自觉接受党组织和
群众的批评监督。
张全景指出,讲政治,首先要讲学习。对于党员领导干部来说,
如果不努力学习,就很难提高自己的思想理论水平,也就很难坚定
正确的政治方向和政治立场,很难提高自己辨别政治是非的能力。
领导机关、领导干部学习得好不好,将直接影响着一个地方,一个
部门的学习风气和各项工作。因此,在这次“双学”活动中,一定要
把县以上领导机关、领导干部作为重点来抓,要学得更好些,提高
更大些。不能只要求下边学习,自己不学习。
张全景还指出,党员领导干部要提高学习的自觉性,要有一股
“钻”劲和“挤”劲。做到不进酒楼舞厅,减少不必要的应酬和事务,
努力看书学习,坚持数年,必有好处。江泽民同志一再强调,干部要
学习、学习、再学习。能否善于学习,肯于学习,这对领导干部来说,
既是一种精神境界高低的体现,也是一种党性修养强弱的表现。那
种把学习看作是额外负担、“软任务”的思想,是错误的;那种不读
书,不看报,不学无术,把大量时间浪费在不必要的应酬上的做法,
更是错误的,必须坚决反对。对于领导干部来说,坚持学习,是自己
毕生的任务。只有坚持学习,刻苦读书,丰富多种知识,扩大知识
面,才能不断提高理论思维能力,不断提高领导水平和科学决策能
力,适应不断变化的新形势对领导干部的要求,做新时期合格的共
产党员和领导干部。
中央宣传部副部长刘云山作了关于《提高认识,加大力度,把
党员学习活动引向深入》的总结讲话。
translated_text: On the 2nd, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on the Speech by Comrade Hu Jintao and Comrades Zhang Quanjing, Liu Yunshan, and Fu Jie at the National Symposium on Party Members' Study of Theory and Party Constitution". Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, delivered an important speech on "Improving the Ideological and Political Quality of Party Members and Further Enhancing the Cohesion and Combat Effectiveness of the Party". The speech was divided into three aspects: (i) We must fully understand the importance and urgency of improving the ideological and political quality of party members from the perspective of the overall situation of the party's cause; (ii) Continue to carry out the "double learning" activities extensively and deeply, and implement the work of improving the ideological and political quality of party members; (iii) Party organizations at all levels must strengthen the leadership of the "double learning" activities and earnestly assume the responsibility for the education and management of party members. Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, delivered a report on "Improving Quality, Strengthening Party Spirit, and Deepening the Activities of Party Members' Study of Theory and Party Constitution". The report is divided into five aspects: (1) The basic situation of the activities of learning theory and party constitution for party members across the country in recent years; (2) Further improve ideological awareness and continuously enhance the sense of responsibility and urgency of party members' "double learning" activities; (3) Implement the principle of integrating theory with practice and effectively solve the outstanding problems existing in the party members' team; (4) Take effective measures to deepen the "double learning" activities of party members; (5) Strengthen leadership and implement them. Zhang Quanjing pointed out in his speech that leading cadres at all levels, especially senior leading cadres, can only further establish the overall concept and consciously maintain a high degree of consistency with the Party Central Committee in ideology, politics and actions by unremittingly studying Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and the party constitution, and learning to use the Marxist standpoint, viewpoint and method to observe things, judge the situation and analyze problems; only then can they firmly grasp the basic laws of socialist development and strengthen the communist ideal and socialist faith; only then can they consciously implement the party's basic line, keep a clear mind in the face of complex contradictions and various interferences, and firmly adhere to the correct political direction. At present, it is particularly important to point out that party member leading cadres, including party member factory directors and managers of enterprises, must strengthen their awareness of being party members. No matter what profession they are engaged in or what position they hold, they must first think of themselves as Communist Party members and that their positions are arranged by the party organization. They must strictly demand themselves in accordance with the standards of party members and the basic requirements of party cadres, be honest and upright, live a simple and frugal life, promote democracy, take the overall situation into consideration, and consciously accept criticism and supervision from party organizations and the masses. Zhang Quanjing pointed out that when it comes to politics, we must first talk about learning. For party member leading cadres, if they do not study hard, it will be difficult to improve their ideological and theoretical level, and it will be difficult to firmly establish the correct political direction and political stance, and it will be difficult to improve their ability to distinguish political right from wrong. Whether the leading organs and leading cadres study well will directly affect the learning atmosphere and various work of a place or a department. Therefore, in this "double learning" activity, we must focus on leading organs and leading cadres above the county level, and learn better and improve more. We cannot only ask the lower levels to study without studying ourselves. Zhang Quanjing also pointed out that party member leading cadres should improve their self-consciousness in learning and have a strong desire to "drill" and "squeeze". They should avoid going to restaurants and dance halls, reduce unnecessary social activities and affairs, and study hard. If they persist for several years, they will definitely benefit. Comrade Jiang Zemin has repeatedly emphasized that cadres should study, study, and study again. Whether they are good at learning and willing to learn is not only a reflection of the level of their spiritual realm, but also a manifestation of the strength of their party spirit. The idea of regarding learning as an extra burden and a "soft task" is wrong; the practice of not reading books, not reading newspapers, being unlearned, and wasting a lot of time on unnecessary social activities is even more wrong and must be resolutely opposed. For leading cadres, persisting in learning is their lifelong task. Only by persisting in learning, studying hard, enriching a variety of knowledge, and expanding their knowledge can we continuously improve our theoretical thinking ability, leadership level and scientific decision-making ability, adapt to the requirements of the ever-changing new situation for leading cadres, and become qualified Communist Party members and leading cadres in the new era. Liu Yunshan, deputy director of the Central Propaganda Department, delivered a summary speech on "raising awareness, increasing efforts, and deepening party members' learning activities."

events:

科技专家国情考察团成员座谈。他强调,青年知识分子要认清自己
的历史责任,积极投身改革开放和现代化建设的伟大事业,坚持同
工农相结合、同实践相结合的方向,为实现跨世纪宏伟目标贡献自
己的聪明才智。

情考察团赴安徽、江苏参观考察。参加这次活动的24位专家,是由
中国科学院、国家教委、卫生部、农业部等9个部委推荐的,大部分
是留学回国人员,平均年龄38岁。他们都是在各自的研究领域内

座谈会由中央组织部部长张全景主持。中组部、国家教委、共

translated_text: On the 4th, Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, held a discussion with members of the National Conditions Investigation Team of Young Science and Technology Experts in Beijing. He stressed that young intellectuals should recognize their historical responsibilities, actively participate in the great cause of reform and opening up and modernization, adhere to the direction of combining with workers and peasants and combining with practice, and contribute their wisdom and talents to achieve the grand goals across the century. From April 22 to May 2, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee organized a National Conditions Investigation Team of Young Science and Technology Experts to visit Anhui and Jiangsu. The 24 experts who participated in this event were recommended by 9 ministries and commissions including the Chinese Academy of Sciences, the State Education Commission, the Ministry of Health, and the Ministry of Agriculture. Most of them were returned overseas students with an average age of 38. They are all young scientific and technological backbones who have worked hard, fought tenaciously, and achieved excellent results in their respective research fields. The symposium was hosted by Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee. Relevant leaders of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the State Education Commission, the Central Committee of the Communist Youth League, and the National Science and Technology Association attended the symposium.

规划的通知》。
《规划》共分为指导思想和基本原则、任务和要求,主要措施、
建立有中国特色的干部教育体系四个部分。
《通知》要求,各级党委、政府要从社会主义现代化事业的战略
全局,从党和国家长治久安的高度,充分认识干部教育培训工作的

中事关方向、政策等重大问题和教育培训机构领导班子建设问题。

实。
translated_text: On the 7th, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on the National Cadre Education and Training Plan from 1996 to 2000". The "Plan" is divided into four parts: guiding ideology and basic principles, tasks and requirements, main measures, and establishing a cadre education system with Chinese characteristics. The "Notice" requires that party committees and governments at all levels should fully recognize the important position and role of cadre education and training from the strategic overall situation of socialist modernization and the long-term stability of the party and the country. We must effectively strengthen leadership, especially manage major issues such as direction and policy in cadre education and training, and the construction of leadership teams in education and training institutions. In accordance with the principle of hierarchical responsibility and division of labor, we must regularly check and summarize the implementation of training plans, programs and various training policies to ensure the implementation of cadre training plans.
