的同志们并同大家合影。中央组织部部长张全景出席开班仪式并
作了“领导干部一定要把讲政治落到实处”的重要讲话。
张全景在讲话中指出,领导干部怎样做到讲政治,领导干部只
有掌握正确的理论,才能有正确的思想和行动,才能真正做到讲政
治。他讲了六个方面:(一)坚持用邓小平建设有中国特色社会主义
理论武装头脑,切实提高领导干部的思想理论水平。(二)牢固树立
群众观点,坚持群众路线,密切同人民群众的血肉联系。(三)坚持
实事求是的思想路线,大力提倡求真务实的工作作风。(四)树立正
确的世界观和人生观,不断提高拒腐防变的能力。(五)坚持民主集
中制,严格党的政治纪律。(六)坚持“两手抓、两手都要硬”的方针,
促进社会主义物质文明建设和精神文明建设的协调发展。
张全景在讲话中指出,现在的高级干部,大部分是建国以后成
长起来的,是在新时期走上领导岗位的。他们是我们干部队伍中最
优秀的部分,绝大多数是好的。但是,这一批人与老一辈革命家、政
治家相比,无论是斗争经历和从政的经验都显得不足,仍然有一个
成长和提高的问题。各级党组织要经过理论培训、实践锻炼、严格
管理等途径,努力提高现有领导干部的思想政治素质。领导干部自
己也要认清肩负的重大政治责任,努力学习,努力工作,努力锻炼,
自觉按照政治家的素质要求去做,成为新一代的政治家,用自己的
实际行动为广大干部作出表率。同时,要大力培养选拔年轻干部。
使我们的事业后继有人。没有大批年轻干部的成长,就会贻误我们
的事业。
张全景说,选拔干部必须全面贯彻党的干部队伍“四化”方针,
坚持以革命化为前提。邓小平同志曾反复强调,选拔干部不只是看
年龄这一条,还得德才兼备;不只是有了业务知识就能解决问题,
还要有好的作风。要把政治表现放在首位。从这些年的情况看,有
些干部选上来后犯错误,主要是在德的方面出了问题。因此,在选
拔任用干部时,要认真了解其政治素质,当然也不能忽视领导能
力,真正是德才兼备,坚持正确的用人导向。
张全景指出,考察干部的思想政治素质可以从四个方面来把
握:一是从贯彻执行党的基本路线的表现来考察干部的政治素质。
一个领导干部是否牢牢把握经济建设这个中心不动摇,既坚持改
革开放,又坚持四项基本原则,在领导工作中必然会反映出来。要
把贯彻执行党的基本路线的工作实绩,作为判断干部是否优秀、政
治上是否合格的重要依据。二是从关键时刻处理关键问题的表现
来考察干部的政治素质。同时要看干部的一贯表现,看其全部历史
和全部工作。三是通过日常的政治表现来考察干部的政治素质。作
为一个领导者,对国内外、省内外,部内外发生的一些重大事件,总
会有自己的看法,自己的判断。特别是对自己管辖范围内的事情,
总要表明自己的态度,要采取相应的措施去解决。一项改革措施出
台,是不是符合实际,是不是符合改革的方向,是能够从一个侧面
反映出干部的政治水平的。四是从如何对待个人得失来考察干部
的政治素质。把个人摆在一个什么位置上,很容易反映一个人的政
治品格。把个人凌驾于组织之上,只要组织照顾,不要组织纪律。
事当前,先替自己打算,追名逐利,见困难就躲,见荣誉就争,于已
有利的事就干,于己没利的事就推,对这种干部的政治素质就要打
个问号。还有那些迷恋于酒楼歌厅,沉醉于吃喝玩乐的干部,也不
可能是政治上好的干部。
translated_text: From June 9 to June 2, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China held the fifth training class for leading cadres of the organization department. The training class focused on the spirit of the Fourth and Fifth Plenary Sessions of the 14th CPC Central Committee, the Outline adopted at the Fourth Session of the Eighth National People's Congress, and a series of important speeches by Comrade Jiang Zemin on "leading cadres must be politically conscious", closely linked to the current actual organizational work, especially the current party building work, cadre work, and some hot and difficult issues in organizational work. There were 93 trainees in this class, mainly responsible comrades of the Organization Departments of the Party Committees of provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities directly under the Central Government and some sub-provincial cities, responsible comrades of the Personnel Departments of various ministries and commissions of the central state organs, and responsible comrades of the Party Committees of some large state-owned enterprise groups. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, visited the comrades who participated in the training and took photos with them. Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, attended the opening ceremony and delivered an important speech on "leading cadres must put politics into practice". In his speech, Zhang Quanjing pointed out that how leading cadres can be politically conscious is that only by mastering the correct theory can leading cadres have correct thoughts and actions and truly be politically conscious. He talked about six aspects: (1) Adhere to the use of Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics to arm their minds and effectively improve the ideological and theoretical level of leading cadres. (2) Firmly establish the mass viewpoint, adhere to the mass line, and maintain close flesh-and-blood ties with the people. (3) Adhere to the ideological line of seeking truth from facts and vigorously advocate a pragmatic work style. (4) Establish a correct world outlook and outlook on life and constantly improve the ability to resist corruption and prevent degeneration. (5) Adhere to democratic centralism and strictly enforce the party's political discipline. (6) Adhere to the principle of "grasping both hands and making both hands strong" to promote the coordinated development of socialist material and spiritual civilization construction. In his speech, Zhang Quanjing pointed out that most of the current senior cadres grew up after the founding of the People's Republic of China and took up leadership positions in the new era. They are the best part of our cadre team, and the vast majority are good. However, compared with the older generation of revolutionaries and politicians, this group of people is insufficient in both struggle experience and political experience, and there is still a problem of growth and improvement. Party organizations at all levels should strive to improve the ideological and political quality of existing leading cadres through theoretical training, practical training, strict management and other means. Leading cadres themselves should also recognize the important political responsibilities they shoulder, study hard, work hard, and exercise hard, consciously follow the quality requirements of politicians, become a new generation of politicians, and use their actual actions to set an example for the majority of cadres. At the same time, we must vigorously cultivate and select young cadres. So that our cause will have successors. Without the growth of a large number of young cadres, our cause will be delayed. Zhang Quanjing said that the selection of cadres must fully implement the party's "four modernizations" policy for the cadre team and insist on revolutionization as a prerequisite. Comrade Deng Xiaoping has repeatedly emphasized that the selection of cadres is not only based on age, but also on both moral integrity and ability; not only can problems be solved with professional knowledge, but also with good work style. Political performance should be put first. Judging from the situation in recent years, some cadres made mistakes after being elected, mainly because of their moral problems. Therefore, when selecting and appointing cadres, we must carefully understand their political qualities, and of course we must not ignore their leadership abilities. We must truly have both moral integrity and ability, and adhere to the correct orientation of personnel selection. Zhang Quanjing pointed out that the ideological and political qualities of cadres can be examined from four aspects: First, examine the political qualities of cadres from the performance of implementing the party's basic line. Whether a leading cadre firmly grasps the center of economic construction and adheres to reform and opening up, and adheres to the four basic principles, it will inevitably be reflected in the leadership work. The actual performance of implementing the party's basic line should be used as an important basis for judging whether the cadres are excellent and politically qualified. Second, examine the political qualities of cadres from their performance in handling key issues at critical moments. At the same time, we must look at the cadres' consistent performance, their entire history and all their work. Third, examine the political qualities of cadres through their daily political performance. As a leader, you will always have your own views and judgments on some major events that occur at home and abroad, within and outside the province, and within and outside the ministry. Especially for matters within their jurisdiction, they must always express their attitude and take corresponding measures to solve them. Whether a reform measure is in line with reality and the direction of reform can reflect the political level of cadres from one aspect. Fourth, examine the political quality of cadres from how they deal with personal gains and losses. The position in which a person is placed can easily reflect a person's political character. Putting individuals above the organization, only wanting the organization to take care of them, not the organization's discipline. When things are going on, they first plan for themselves, pursue fame and fortune, hide when they see difficulties, fight when they see honors, do things that are beneficial to themselves, and push things that are not beneficial to themselves. The political quality of such cadres should be questioned. There are also cadres who are obsessed with restaurants and karaoke bars and indulge in eating, drinking and having fun. They cannot be good cadres politically.

events: 10日——18日 中共中央政治局常委、书记处书记胡锦涛在贵州考察工作。他强调指出,今后5年和15年,是推进我国经济建设和社会发展的大好时机,各级党委和政府要动员和组织广大干部群众,振奋精神,增强信心,迎难而上,勇于开拓,为实现跨世纪宏伟目标努力奋斗。胡锦涛还就加强党的建设,为实现跨世纪宏伟目标提供坚强有力的组织保证谈了意见。中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理朱镕基到中央党校,为省部级干部国有企业党建工作研究班作了当前经济形势、国有企业改革和党建工作的报告。从5月6日开始,为期一个月的省部级干部国有企业党建工作研究班是由中共中央组织部、中共中央政策研究室、中共中央党校和国家经贸委联合举办的。参加研究班的有部分省、自治区、直辖市的有关负责同志,中央、国家机关有关部门的负责同志,以及一些大型国有企业党委书记、董事长和经理。研究班着重研究在深化改革、转换经营机制,建立现代企业制度中,如何充分发挥企业党组织政治核心作用等问题,以增强党组织的战斗力和凝聚力,进一步推动国有企业的改革和发展。
translated_text: From the 10th to the 18th, Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, inspected work in Guizhou. He stressed that the next five and fifteen years will be a great opportunity to promote my country's economic construction and social development. Party committees and governments at all levels should mobilize and organize the broad masses of cadres and the masses to cheer up, strengthen confidence, face difficulties, and be brave to explore and strive to achieve the grand goals across the century. Hu Jintao also talked about strengthening party building and providing a strong organizational guarantee for achieving the grand goals across the century. Zhu Rongji, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, went to the Central Party School and made a report on the current economic situation, state-owned enterprise reform and party building work for the provincial and ministerial cadres' state-owned enterprise party building work study class. Starting from May 6, the one-month provincial and ministerial cadres state-owned enterprise party building work study class was jointly organized by the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Policy Research Office of the CPC Central Committee, the CPC Central Party School and the State Economic and Trade Commission. Participants in the seminar included relevant responsible comrades from some provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, responsible comrades from relevant departments of the Central Government and state organs, as well as secretaries, chairmen, and managers of some large state-owned enterprises. The seminar focused on studying how to give full play to the political core role of the enterprise party organization in deepening reform, transforming the operating mechanism, and establishing a modern enterprise system, so as to enhance the combat effectiveness and cohesion of the party organization and further promote the reform and development of state-owned enterprises. The report meeting was hosted by Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, and attended by Wang Weicheng, Director of the Central Policy Research Office, Wang Jiaxi, Executive Vice President of the Central Party School, and Wang Zhongyu, Director of the State Economic and Trade Commission.

通知》。
《通知》指出:几年来,各级组织人事部门和广大干部人事档案
工作人员,认真落实1990年第三次全国干部档案工作会议提出的
各项任务,努力做好干部人事档案工作,为干部人事工作服务,取
得了显著成绩。但也有些地方的干部人事档案工作存在着管理不
严密、执行制度不严格的问题。为了进一步加强干部人事档案管理
工作,《通知》要求:上级拟提拔干部的材料,要认真按照《党政领导
干部选拔任用工作暂行条例》的规定,将干部人事档案连同其他有
关材料一并上报;在干部交流、引进人才等工作中,有关部门要认
真查阅干部人事档案;对收集的档案材料,要按照《干部人事档案
材料收集归档规定》的要求,认真鉴别,严格审查,防止不符合归档
要求的材料进入档案;转递干部人事档案,要通过机要交通和派专
人送取,严禁个人携带;要进一步加强干部人事档案工作制度建
设。
translated_text: On the 20th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on Strict Management of Cadre Personnel Files". The "Notice" pointed out that in the past few years, the organization and personnel departments at all levels and the majority of cadre personnel file staff have conscientiously implemented the various tasks proposed by the Third National Cadre File Work Conference in 1990, worked hard to do a good job in cadre personnel file work, served cadre personnel work, and achieved remarkable results. However, there are also problems in the management of cadre personnel file work in some places, such as lax implementation of the system. In order to further strengthen the management of cadres' personnel files, the "Notice" requires: the superiors' materials for the promotion of cadres must be carefully reported in accordance with the provisions of the "Interim Regulations on the Selection and Appointment of Party and Government Leading Cadres", and the cadres' personnel files together with other relevant materials; in the work of cadre exchange and introduction of talents, the relevant departments must carefully review the cadres' personnel files; the collected archival materials must be carefully identified and strictly examined in accordance with the requirements of the "Regulations on the Collection and Archiving of Cadres' Personnel Files" to prevent materials that do not meet the archiving requirements from entering the archives; the transfer of cadres' personnel files must be carried out through confidential transportation and by special personnel, and personal carrying is strictly prohibited; the construction of the cadre personnel file work system must be further strengthened.

干部人事部门负责人会议上的讲话》。
中央组织部副部长李铁林在讲话中主要讲了三个问题:近几
年开展干部交流工作的情况;1996年干部交流工作的意见;关于
中央、国家机关开展干部交流工作的几个具体问题。他指出,本年
度内,中组部计划组织约400至500名比较优秀的司局(厅)级
干部和县处级干部,在全国范围内进行交流。从交流范围看,既有
中央、国家机关与地方之间的上下交流,又有省、自治区、直辖市之
间的横向交流;从交流形式看,既有调动形式,又有挂职形式;从交
流效果的预测看,既可在一定程度上加快优秀年轻干部的培养,促
进领导班子的思想政治建设,为各级领导班子的必要调整作准备,
又可重点加强东部地区与中西部地区、少数民族地区、贫困地区的
干部交流。具体安排意见:一是把干部交流与领导班子的充实调整
结合起来,在1996、1997两年将一批优秀年轻干部选拔到省部级
领导岗位。二是从中央、国家机关和地方抽调部分干部上下交流。
三是从省、自治区、直辖市之间,抽调部分干部横向交流。四是结合
培养少数民族干部,选派170名左右少数民族干部到中央、国家机
关和经济相对发达地区挂职锻炼。李铁林还就中央、国家机关干部
交流的基本条件和人选产生的办法、交流去向和形式,时间要求和

translated_text: On the 28th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued "Comrade Li Tielin's Speech at the Meeting of Personnel Department Heads of Central and State Organs". In his speech, Li Tielin, Deputy Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, mainly talked about three issues: the situation of cadre exchange work in recent years; opinions on cadre exchange work in 1996; and several specific issues on the cadre exchange work of central and state organs. He pointed out that this year, the Organization Department of the Central Committee plans to organize about 400 to 500 relatively outstanding department-level (bureau)-level cadres and county-level cadres to exchange across the country. From the perspective of the scope of exchange, there are both vertical exchanges between central and state organs and local governments, and horizontal exchanges between provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; from the perspective of exchange forms, there are both transfer forms and temporary positions; from the perspective of the prediction of exchange effects, it can not only accelerate the training of outstanding young cadres to a certain extent, promote the ideological and political construction of leadership teams, and prepare for the necessary adjustments of leadership teams at all levels, but also focus on strengthening cadre exchanges between the eastern region and the central and western regions, ethnic minority areas, and poverty-stricken areas. Specific arrangements: First, combine the exchange of cadres with the enrichment and adjustment of the leadership team, and select a group of outstanding young cadres to provincial and ministerial leadership positions in 1996 and 1997. Second, select some cadres from the central and state organs and localities for upward and downward exchanges. Third, select some cadres from provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities for horizontal exchanges. Fourth, combine the training of ethnic minority cadres and select about 170 ethnic minority cadres to work in the central and state organs and relatively economically developed regions. Li Tielin also put forward specific requirements on the basic conditions for the exchange of cadres in the central and state organs, the method of selecting candidates, the destination and form of exchange, the time requirements, and the steps of exchange.

路,坚决贯彻执行党的基本理论、基本路线和各项方针政策;第二,
努力实践党的全心全意为人民服务的宗旨,密切联系群众,特别是
工农群众,坚决维护人民群众的利益;第三,解放思想,实事求是,
一切从实际出发,善于开拓前进,具有唯物辩证的思想方法和工作
方法;第四,模范遵纪守法,保持清正廉洁,发扬艰苦奋斗精神,自
拒腐防变,坚决反对消极腐败现象;第五,刻苦学习,勤奋敬业,
不断加强知识积累和经验积累,具备做好本职工作的专业知识和
能力。江泽民强调指出,要保证我国改革和建设事业顺利发展,保
证跨世纪宏伟目标的顺利实现,保证党和国家长治久安,大力加强
干部队伍建设,提高广大干部特别是领导干部的素质,已经成为摆
在全党面前的一项刻不容缓的重大任务。
座谈会由中共中央政治局常委、书记处书记胡锦涛主持。来自
全国各地的优秀领导干部和优秀共产党员代表,中央党校中青年
干部培训部学员,以及各有关部门的负责同志也出席了会议。
translated_text: On the 21st, the CPC Central Committee held a symposium in the Great Hall of the People to solemnly commemorate the 75th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China. Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, together with other leading comrades of the CPC Central Committee, carefully listened to the speeches of outstanding representatives of Communist Party members and young and middle-aged cadres, and delivered an important speech entitled "Strive to Build a High-Quality Cadre Team". Jiang Zemin proposed that the basic requirements for building a high-quality cadre team are, first, to have lofty communist ideals, adhere to the correct political direction, firmly follow the road of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, and resolutely implement the party's basic theory, basic line and various principles and policies; second, to strive to practice the party's purpose of serving the people wholeheartedly, to maintain close ties with the masses, especially the workers and peasants, and to resolutely safeguard the interests of the people; third, to emancipate the mind, seek truth from facts, proceed from reality in everything, be good at pioneering and advancing, and have dialectical materialist thinking methods and working methods; fourth, to modelly abide by laws and regulations, maintain integrity, carry forward the spirit of hard work, resist corruption and prevent degeneration, and resolutely oppose negative corruption phenomena; fifth, to study hard, be diligent and dedicated, constantly strengthen knowledge accumulation and experience accumulation, and have the professional knowledge and ability to do their job well. Jiang Zemin stressed that it is an urgent and important task for the whole party to ensure the smooth development of my country's reform and construction, the smooth realization of the grand cross-century goals, and the long-term stability of the party and the country, and to vigorously strengthen the construction of the cadre team and improve the quality of the majority of cadres, especially leading cadres. The symposium was chaired by Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat. Outstanding leading cadres and outstanding Communist Party members from all over the country, students of the Central Party School's Young and Middle-aged Cadre Training Department, and responsible comrades from relevant departments also attended the meeting.

events:

吉林考察工作。胡锦涛在考察时强调,江泽民同志关于建设高素质
干部队伍的讲话,对于在新形势下进一步推进党的建设这一新的
伟大工程,搞好当前和今后一个时期的领导班子和干部队伍建设,
具有十分重要的指导意义。各级党委要认真学习,结合实际,抓好
贯彻落实。要以加强领导班子思想政治建设为重点,全面提高领导
干部素质。最根本的是要努力学习马列主义、毛泽东思想,特别是
邓小平同志建设有中国特色社会主义理论。要坚持理论联系实际,
指导改造客观世界和主观世界。要认真贯彻党的干部路线和方针、
政策,讲政治、讲正气,严格按照党的干部标准和规定的工作程序
选拔任用干部,始终坚持育人、选人、用人、管人的正确导向,坚决
防止和克服用人上的不正之风。
translated_text: From the 21st to the 26th, Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, inspected work in Jilin. During the inspection, Hu Jintao emphasized that Comrade Jiang Zemin's speech on building a high-quality cadre team has very important guiding significance for further promoting the new great project of party building under the new situation and doing a good job in the construction of the leadership team and cadre team in the current and future period. Party committees at all levels should study it seriously, combine it with reality, and implement it well. We must focus on strengthening the ideological and political construction of the leadership team and comprehensively improve the quality of leading cadres. The most fundamental thing is to study Marxism-Leninism, Mao Zedong Thought, and especially Comrade Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics. We must adhere to the connection between theory and practice and guide the transformation of the objective world and the subjective world. We must conscientiously implement the party's cadre line, principles, and policies, be politically conscious and upright, strictly select and appoint cadres in accordance with the party's cadre standards and prescribed work procedures, always adhere to the correct orientation of educating, selecting, employing, and managing people, and resolutely prevent and overcome unhealthy tendencies in employing people.

translated_text: On the 22nd, the Organization Department of the Central Committee and the Party School of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China held a symposium for young and middle-aged cadres in Beijing to study and understand the important speech of Comrade Jiang Zemin at the symposium commemorating the 75th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China. Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, emphasized at the meeting that we must further increase the efforts in the construction of the cadre team, strengthen the training and education of cadres in accordance with the "Ninth Five-Year Plan" for national cadre education and training, grasp the fundamentals, and continue to earnestly implement the task of arming the whole party with Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics. At the same time, we must organize cadres to earnestly study socialist market economy knowledge, modern science and technology knowledge, and historical knowledge; we must actively organize and guide cadres to exercise in practice, encourage them to go to the front line of production, to the grassroots, to hard and difficult places, to the places where the party and the masses need them most, and be exercised in practice to increase their talents.

translated_text: On the 23rd, in order to cooperate with the proposal of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 14th CPC Central Committee to carry out a planned and step-by-step study activity of the theory and party constitution of building socialism with Chinese characteristics among all party members within three years, better implement the spirit of the Fourth and Fifth Plenary Sessions, and further promote the continuous and in-depth development of the study of theory and party constitution, on the occasion of the 75th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China, the Organization Department of the Central Organization Department, the Organization Department of the Party Committees of relevant provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, and the Organization Department of the General Political Department of the People's Liberation Army jointly produced and completed a 6-episode TV political documentary "Worthy of the Glorious Title". The Central Organization Department recently issued a notice requiring all grassroots party organizations to use this series of films as an image teaching material for further carrying out the "double learning" activities, and conscientiously organize party members, cadres, and the masses to watch and study.

events:
25日 据中共中央组织部统计,中国共产党成立75年来,党
的队伍不断发展壮大。1995年,全国共发展新党员219万多名。目
前,党的基层组织增至345万多个,党员总数已达5700多万名。
近年来,各级党委及其组织部门认真贯彻落实党的十四届四
中全会精神,适应改革开放和现代化建设的需要,注重在优秀的工
人､农民,知识分子和其他劳动者中培养和发展党员。在1995年新
发展的党员中,工作在企业、农村生产第一线的工人、农民等有
107万多名,占总发展人数的近一半;35岁以下的青年156万多
名,具有高中以上文化程度的155万多名,均占总发展数的70%
以上。在新党员中,妇女和少数民族人数也都高于往年,分别为45
万多名和16万多名。党员队伍的年龄、知识、性别、民族、职业等构
成情况进一步得到改善。
translated_text: According to statistics from the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on the 25th, the party's ranks have continued to grow and develop over the past 75 years since the founding of the Communist Party of China. In 1995, more than 2.19 million new party members were recruited nationwide. At present, the number of grassroots party organizations has increased to more than 3.45 million, and the total number of party members has reached more than 57 million. In recent years, party committees at all levels and their organization departments have conscientiously implemented the spirit of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 14th CPC Central Committee, adapted to the needs of reform and opening up and modernization, and focused on cultivating and developing party members among outstanding workers, farmers, intellectuals and other laborers. Among the newly recruited party members in 1995, more than 1.07 million were workers and farmers working on the front lines of production in enterprises and rural areas, accounting for nearly half of the total number of recruits; more than 1.56 million were young people under the age of 35, and more than 1.55 million had a high school education or above, both accounting for more than 70% of the total number of recruits. Among the new party members, the number of women and ethnic minorities was also higher than in previous years, at more than 450,000 and more than 160,000 respectively. The composition of the party members in terms of age, knowledge, gender, ethnicity, and occupation has been further improved.

events:

周年期间开展走访慰问红军老战士及有关活动的通知》。
《通知》要求各地、各单位要逐级负责,对第一、二次国内革命

上有困难的要千方百计帮助解决。
translated_text: On the 27th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on Visiting and Consoling Old Red Army Soldiers and Related Activities During the 60th Anniversary of the Victory of the Red Army's Long March". The "Notice" requires all localities and units to be responsible at each level, to visit and condole old comrades who participated in the revolution during the First and Second Civil Revolutionary Wars, as well as the families of old comrades, to check the implementation of living and political treatment, and to do everything possible to help those who have difficulties in life.

events:
28日 中共中央组织部在京召开全国先进基层党组织和优
秀党务工作者表彰大会。大会表彰了来自全国各地的500个先进
基层党组织,500名优秀党务工作者和12名优秀共产党员。中共
中央政治局常委、书记处书记胡锦涛在大会上发表讲话时强调,为
了建设一支高素质的干部队伍,以保证我们党领导全国人民把社
会主义现代化事业不断推向前进,必须在广大干部特别是领导干
部中切实加强思想政治教育,大力倡导坚持和发扬理论联系实际、
密切联系群众、批评与自我批评三大作风。
胡锦涛还强调,党的三大作风,是我们党在长期斗争中形成和
发展起来的好传统,是我们党区别于其他政党的显著标志和政治
优势,是我们党领导革命和建设事业从胜利走向胜利的一个根本
原因。在建设有中国特色社会主义的历史新时期,党的三大作风不
仅没有过时,而且必须发扬光大。
会上,中央组织部部长张全景作了关于《切实把党的基层组织
建设好》的讲话,讲话分六个方面。(一)充分认识抓好党的基层组
织建设的重要性和紧迫性;(二)下大力气抓好基层党组织领导班
子建设;(三)必须把思想建设摆在基层党组织建设的首位;(四)进
一步做好发展党员的工作;(五)以改革的精神研究新情况解决新
问题;(六)必须造就一支高素质的党务干部队伍。
大会由中央组织部部长张全景主持。出席会议的有关负责同
志还有吕枫、侯宗宾、陈作霖、王维澄、汪家、陈福今、郑科扬等。
8月2日,中央组织部印发了胡锦涛和张全景同志在全国先
进基层党组织和优秀党务工作者表彰会上的讲话。
translated_text: On the 28th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee held a national commendation conference for advanced grassroots party organizations and outstanding party workers in Beijing. The conference commended 500 advanced grassroots party organizations, 500 outstanding party workers and 12 outstanding Communist Party members from all over the country. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, stressed in his speech at the conference that in order to build a high-quality cadre team to ensure that our party leads the people of the whole country to continuously advance the cause of socialist modernization, it is necessary to strengthen ideological and political education among the broad masses of cadres, especially leading cadres, and vigorously advocate and carry forward the three styles of linking theory with practice, maintaining close ties with the masses, and criticizing and self-criticizing. Hu Jintao also emphasized that the three styles of the party are good traditions formed and developed by our party in the long struggle, and are the significant signs and political advantages that distinguish our party from other political parties. It is a fundamental reason why our party has led the revolution and construction cause from victory to victory. In the new historical period of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, the three styles of the party are not only not outdated, but must be carried forward. At the meeting, Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, delivered a speech on "Building the Party's Grassroots Organizations Well", which was divided into six aspects. (1) Fully understand the importance and urgency of building the Party's grassroots organizations; (2) Make great efforts to build the leadership team of the grassroots party organizations; (3) It is necessary to put ideological construction at the top of the grassroots party organization construction; (4) Further improve the work of developing party members; (5) Study new situations and solve new problems with the spirit of reform; (6) It is necessary to create a team of high-quality party cadres. The meeting was chaired by Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee. Other responsible comrades attending the meeting included Lv Feng, Hou Zongbin, Chen Zuolin, Wang Weicheng, Wang Jia, Chen Fujin, Zheng Keyang, etc. On August 2, the Organization Department of the Central Committee issued the speeches of Hu Jintao and Zhang Quanjing at the National Advanced Grassroots Party Organizations and Outstanding Party Workers Commendation Meeting.

events:
同日 中共中央政治局常委、国务院总理李鹏和国务院副总
理姜春云在黑龙江省重要煤炭基地双鸭山与黑龙江省各地、各条
战线的党员代表进行座谈,共庆“七一”。李鹏在座谈会上指出,在
我们党的历史上,也曾出现过错误,遭受到暂时的挫折和失败,但
我们没有被这些困难所吓倒。经过不断总结经验,吸取教训,战胜
了困难,重新站了起来。今天,在我们改革开放和实现现代化的过
程中,也难免会出现一些问题,遇到一些困难。我们的党有决心、有
信心、有能力解决问题、战胜困难,领导全国人民不断继续前进。
李鹏接着说:“中国共产党领导一切事业的核心力量。我们
广大的基层党组织在各方面都发挥着战斗堡垒作用,我们的党员
绝大多数是好的,在本职岗位上起着模范带头作用。这就是我们的

translated_text: On the same day, Li Peng, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Premier of the State Council, and Jiang Chunyun, Vice Premier of the State Council, held a discussion with representatives of party members from all parts and fronts of Heilongjiang Province in Shuangyashan, an important coal base in Heilongjiang Province, to celebrate the "July 1st". Li Peng pointed out at the symposium that in the history of our party, there have been mistakes, temporary setbacks and failures, but we have not been intimidated by these difficulties. After constantly summing up experience and learning lessons, we have overcome difficulties and stood up again. Today, in the process of our reform and opening up and modernization, it is inevitable that some problems will arise and some difficulties will be encountered. Our party has the determination, confidence and ability to solve problems, overcome difficulties, and lead the people of the whole country to continue to move forward. Li Peng went on to say: "The Chinese Communist Party is the core force in leading all undertakings. Our broad grassroots party organizations play the role of a fighting fortress in all aspects, and the vast majority of our party members are good and play an exemplary role in their posts. This is an important factor in our cause being able to make great strides forward."

events:

谈会上发表的《努力建设高素质的干部队伍》的讲话,向各级党委

正确导向,克服选人用人上的不正之风。
中央组织部部长张全景作了关于《认真学习贯彻江泽民同志
重要讲话,为建设高素质的干部队伍而努力工作》的讲话。讲话共

实施全国干部教育培养“九五”规划;(三)严格按照党的政策选拔

工作目标的实现;(六)讲学习、讲政治、讲正气,把组织部门的自身
建设提高到一个新水平。
全国 30 个省、自治区、直辖市和16 个副省级城市的党委组织
部长,中央、国家机关组织、干部部门的有关负责同志出席了会议。
7月23日,中央组织部印发了胡锦涛、张全景等在全国省区
市党委组织部长会议上的讲话。
translated_text: The National Organization Ministers' Conference was held in Beijing from the 9th to the 12th. The conference mainly studied the important speech "Strive to Build a High-Quality Cadre Team" made by Comrade Jiang Zemin at the symposium commemorating the 75th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China, linked it with the actual organizational work, and studied and deployed specific measures for implementation. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, attended the meeting and held discussions with some representatives. Hu Jintao put forward requirements to party committees and organization departments at all levels in response to Comrade Jiang Zemin's speech "Strive to Build a High-Quality Cadre Team" at the symposium commemorating the 75th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China. (I) Party and government leaders at all levels must take the lead in studying Comrade Jiang Zemin's important speech, further improve their understanding, unify their thinking, grasp the key points and work hard; (II) To build a high-quality cadre team, we must focus on improving the ideological and political quality of the majority of cadres, especially the leading cadres; (III) Cultivating and selecting outstanding young cadres is an urgent and major task that must be grasped and done well at present; (IV) Adhere to the correct orientation of the party's cadre work and overcome the unhealthy trends in selecting and employing people. Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, delivered a speech on "Studying and implementing Comrade Jiang Zemin's important speech earnestly and working hard to build a high-quality cadre team". The speech is divided into six aspects: (i) Deeply understand the great significance of Comrade Jiang Zemin's speech and enhance the sense of responsibility and mission of building a high-quality cadre team; (ii) Focus on theoretical study and comprehensively implement the "Ninth Five-Year Plan" for national cadre education and training; (iii) Strictly select and appoint cadres in accordance with the party's policies and resolutely fight against unhealthy practices and corruption in personnel selection; (iv) Adhere to strict party governance and strictly require, manage and supervise the leadership team and leading cadres; (v) Emancipate the mind, adhere to standards, and ensure the realization of the work goals of training and selecting outstanding young cadres proposed by the central government; (vi) Emphasize learning, politics, and integrity, and raise the self-construction of the organization department to a new level. The heads of the organization departments of the party committees of 30 provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities directly under the central government and 16 sub-provincial cities across the country, and relevant responsible comrades of the organization and cadre departments of the central and state organs attended the meeting. On July 23, the Central Organization Department issued the speeches of Hu Jintao, Zhang Quanjing and others at the National Conference of Organization Department Directors of Provincial, Regional and Municipal Party Committees.

translated_text: On the 27th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council issued the "Notice on Holding Birthday Commemoration Activities for Deceased Party and State Leaders". 民群众的拥护和赞扬,树立了新时期人民法官的高大形象;他入党
的时间虽然不长,但牢记入党的誓言,坚持人民利益高于一切,克
己奉公,任劳任怨,生命不息,奋斗不止,表现出坚强的党性,不愧
是一名真正的共产党员;他以自己的言行正确地回答了当代青年
应当如何珍惜自己的青春年华,应当怎样对待事业、工作和生活,
应当树立起什么样的世界观、人生观、价值观,为青年一代树立了

translated_text: On the 29th, a report meeting on Tan Yan's deeds was held in the Great Hall of the People jointly organized by the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Central Directly Affiliated Organs Working Committee, the Central State Organs Working Committee, the Supreme People's Court, the Beijing Municipal Committee, and the Liaoning Provincial Committee. Xu Guangchun, Deputy Minister of the Central Propaganda Department, presided over the meeting, and Wu Lianyuan, Deputy Minister of the Organization Department, made specific arrangements for further extensive study and publicity of Tan Yan's advanced deeds. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, attended the meeting and held discussions with members of the report group. Hu Jintao pointed out that Comrade Tan Yan was an ordinary young judge. Despite being seriously ill, he worked diligently, enforced the law impartially, created first-class work performance, was supported and praised by the people, and established a lofty image of people's judges in the new era. Although he had not been a member of the Party for a long time, he remembered his oath to join the Party, insisted that the interests of the people were above all else, was selfless and dedicated to the public, worked hard and never complained, and never stopped fighting until his life was over. He showed strong Party spirit and was worthy of being a true Communist Party member. With his words and deeds, he correctly answered how contemporary youth should cherish their youth, how they should treat their careers, work and life, and what kind of world outlook, outlook on life and values they should establish, setting an example for the younger generation to learn from.

translated_text:
On the 8th, the Interim Measures for the Rotation of National Civil Servants' Positions (Rotation) were promulgated.
The Interim Measures stipulate that the subjects of rotation are the directors and deputy directors of the ministries and commissions of the State Council and the directly affiliated institutions, the directors and deputy directors of the departments (bureaus) of the provincial government, the directors and deputy directors of the departments (bureaus) of the prefecture and municipal governments, and the directors and deputy directors of the bureaus of the prefecture and municipal governments, etc., who hold leadership positions.
The subjects of rotation also include non-leadership civil servants who work in special positions of work nature and directly involve the interests of specific management objects, such as management of personnel, finance, materials, project approval, certificate issuance and law enforcement supervision.
The Interim Measures stipulate that civil servants holding leadership positions who have served in the same position for more than 5 years should, in principle, be rotated, and the rotation period can be appropriately extended or shortened according to actual needs.

translated_text: On the same day, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued the "1996-2000 National Poverty Area Cadre Training Plan". The "Plan" explains the guiding ideology, training tasks and goals, training content and methods, main measures, organizational leadership and division of labor. The "Plan" points out that the tasks and goals of cadre training in poverty-stricken areas in the next five years are: to effectively carry out the training of cadres at all levels in counties, townships and villages in poverty-stricken areas across the country, and the first is to complete a new round of training for county-level leading cadres in 592 state-designated poverty-stricken counties. At the same time, county-level cadres in provincial poverty-stricken counties should be trained; rotation training should be organized for leading cadres in poverty-stricken townships and party branch secretaries and village cadres in poverty-stricken villages; the training and education of young and middle-aged cadres in poverty-stricken areas should be carried out; and training for factory directors and managers of county and township enterprises in poverty-stricken areas should be organized. The "Plan" also points out that the leading cadres of 592 state-designated poverty-stricken counties across the country should be trained in rotation. In each impoverished county, three county-level leading cadres (county party secretary, county magistrate, and deputy county magistrate in charge of poverty alleviation) and two directors of the Poverty Alleviation Office will be trained, plus one to two directors of the Poverty Alleviation Office at the provincial level in each province. A total of 3,000 people will be trained nationwide, and the goal is to be completed within three years.

提高人民群众的生活水平,巩固和完善社会主义制度,实现国家富

translated_text: On the 2nd, Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, Secretary of the Secretariat, and President of the Central Party School, delivered a speech at the opening ceremony of the autumn semester of the Central Party School. He stressed that we must unswervingly adhere to the party's basic theory, basic line, and basic policy, and we must firmly grasp the strategic task of building a high-quality cadre team. Hu Jintao pointed out that practice has eloquently proved that in order to enhance our country's comprehensive national strength, improve the people's living standards, consolidate and improve the socialist system, and achieve national prosperity and national rejuvenation, we must adhere to economic construction as the center, take the inevitable path of reform and opening up, vigorously liberate and develop social productivity, and concentrate on economic construction. Practice has also eloquently proved that in order to develop the economy well and quickly, and to ensure that reform, opening up, and modernization construction proceed smoothly in the right direction, there must be strong political guarantees. In order to provide political guarantees for socialist modernization, we must first unswervingly implement the party's basic theory and basic line; second, we must always maintain a stable and united political situation and a stable and orderly social environment; third, we must strive to provide strong spiritual motivation and intellectual support for reform, opening up, and economic development; fourth, we must strive to build a high-quality cadre team. Hu Jintao pointed out that adhering to the party's basic theory and basic line unswervingly requires first of all that leading cadres at all levels stand on the position of party spirit, fully and correctly understand and actively and resolutely practice the basic theory and basic line. The better this is done, the stronger the guiding role of scientific theory and correct line in work and the cohesion of cadres and the masses will be. Even if some difficulties and interference are encountered, they can be overcome and eliminated in time to continuously push forward the work. To be a politically strong leading cadre, one must consciously study Marxism-Leninism, Mao Zedong Thought, and especially Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, and use them to guide the transformation of the objective world and the subjective world, strengthen the firmness and consciousness of fully implementing and actively safeguarding the party's basic line and major policies, and avoid and reduce the one-sidedness and absolutism of work. The more such leading cadres there are, the stronger and more effective our party will be in leading the socialist modernization drive from victory to victory. translated_text: On the same day, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council forwarded the "Notice of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the State Education Commission, and the Ministry of Personnel on the Request for the Selection of Personnel from Party and Government Agencies and Institutions to Support Grassroots Education". translated_text: On the 5th, the CPC Central Committee agreed that Liu Zhizhong would no longer serve as the mayor of Chongqing, Sichuan Province; Wang Yunlong was removed from his positions as deputy secretary, standing committee member, and member of the Shanxi Provincial Party Committee and transferred to work in Chongqing, Sichuan Province. The CPC Central Committee approved that An Jinglin would serve as the director of China National Radio (at the vice-ministerial level); Tong Xiangrong would no longer concurrently serve as the director of China National Radio; Zhang Zhenhua would serve as the director of China Radio International (at the vice-ministerial level); Liu Jiayi would serve as the Auditor General of the National Audit Office; Zheng Li (female) was removed from her position as the Auditor General of the National Audit Office; Deng Guozheng would serve as the deputy secretary of the Hubei Provincial Party Committee. On the 11th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Ministry of Construction and the China Association for Science and Technology jointly issued the "Notice on the National Mayor Training Plan (1996-2000)". The "Plan" pointed out that according to the needs of the new situation and tasks, a national mayor training class will be held during the "Ninth Five-Year Plan" period, with two sessions held each year, a study period of about two months, 70 people in each session, and a plan to train 700 people in five years. The training targets are mayors of cities (excluding municipalities) in the country who have not yet participated in the national mayor training class, deputy mayors in charge of urban construction, and district heads and deputy district heads in charge of urban construction in municipalities. New mayors should be given priority. The "Plan" requires that the plan for the national mayor training class should be included in the cadre training plan of each province, autonomous region and municipality. The organization departments of the provincial, autonomous region and municipal party committees should formulate a personnel plan for participating in the national mayor training class in stages within five years. The training of trainees is the responsibility of the organization departments of the provincial, autonomous region and municipal party committees.

臣”身份,大包大揽,指手画脚,代替当地干部决策。在扶贫开发工
作中,尤其要注意真正用好扶贫资金。
国务委员陈俊生在会上也讲了话,他强调加强党的基层组
织建设,加快扶贫开发,是我们党在新的历史时期面临的两项重
要课题,也是我们党领导全国各族人民建设有中国特色社会主
义伟大事业中必须完成的两项历史任务。把扶贫开发和党的基
层组织建设结合起来,是尽快解决群众温饱,实现扶贫攻坚战略
目标的关键措施和组织保障;把党的基层组织建设和扶贫开发
结合起来,是巩固贫困地区党的基层组织,密切党群关系,提高

translated_text: On the 23rd, the Central Poverty Alleviation and Development Work Conference was held in Beijing. The conference emphasized the need to unify the whole party's understanding, mobilize the whole society, and increase the efforts of poverty alleviation and development. Jiang Zemin and Li Peng delivered important speeches, Zhu Rongji presided over the meeting, and Hu Jintao attended. Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee and President of the State, pointed out that only when the grassroots party organizations are strong and powerful can the masses be fully mobilized and organized, and great power can be radiated to effectively change the face of poverty. All localities should closely combine poverty alleviation and party building work, and in accordance with the deployment and requirements of the Central Committee on strengthening the construction of rural grassroots organizations, work hard to build grassroots organizations in poor villages, build a good team, choose a good path, and establish a good mechanism. The key to the construction of village-level organizations is to do two things well, one is to build a good branch, and the other is to develop the collective economy, so as to truly achieve "someone is in charge" and "money is available to do things". Zhu Rongji, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, spoke at the end of the meeting. He pointed out that the key to poverty alleviation is to select and equip the leadership team of poor counties, especially the county party secretary and county magistrate. The task of the working groups sent by the central and local party and government organs to poor counties and townships is to conduct in-depth investigations and help solve practical problems. They must not act as "imperial envoys" and take on too much responsibility, make decisions on behalf of local cadres. In the work of poverty alleviation and development, special attention should be paid to making good use of poverty alleviation funds. State Councilor Chen Junsheng also spoke at the meeting. He emphasized that strengthening the construction of grassroots party organizations and accelerating poverty alleviation and development are two important issues facing our party in the new historical period, and are also two historical tasks that must be completed in our party's leadership of the people of all ethnic groups in the country in building socialism with Chinese characteristics. Combining poverty alleviation and development with the construction of grassroots party organizations is a key measure and organizational guarantee to solve the problem of food and clothing for the masses as soon as possible and achieve the strategic goal of poverty alleviation; combining the construction of grassroots party organizations with poverty alleviation and development is an important way and necessary guarantee to consolidate the grassroots party organizations in poor areas, strengthen the relationship between the party and the masses, and improve the party's combat effectiveness, appeal, and cohesion. Simply grasping one task often results in half the effort with twice the result. Combining and twisting the two tasks together can achieve twice the result with half the effort.

translated_text: On the same day, the Sixth Plenary Session of the 14th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China was held in Beijing. The plenary session was presided over by the Political Bureau of the Central Committee, and Jiang Zemin delivered an important speech. The plenary session reviewed and adopted the "Resolution of the CPC Central Committee on Several Issues Concerning Strengthening the Construction of Socialist Spiritual Civilization" and the "Resolution on Convening the 15th National Congress of the Party", and determined that the 15th National Congress of the Party would be held in Beijing in the second half of 1997. The plenary session clearly pointed out that the guiding ideology of the construction of socialist spiritual civilization is: to be guided by Marxism-Leninism, Mao Zedong Thought and Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, adhere to the party's basic line and basic policies, strengthen ideological and moral construction, develop education, science and culture, arm people with scientific theories, guide people with correct public opinion, shape people with noble spirits, inspire people with excellent works, cultivate socialist citizens with ideals, morality, culture and discipline, improve the ideological and moral quality and scientific and cultural quality of the whole nation, and unite and mobilize people of all ethnic groups to build our country into a prosperous, democratic and civilized socialist modern country. The plenary session emphasized that the key to building material civilization lies in the party, and the key to building spiritual civilization also lies in the party. Party committees at all levels should correctly understand and handle the relationship between material and spiritual civilizations, always adhere to the principle of grasping both with both hands and making both hands strong, take the two civilizations as a unified goal, deploy, implement and inspect them together. At no time should the temporary economic development be exchanged at the cost of sacrificing spiritual civilization. The plenary session decided that the Central Committee would establish a steering committee for the construction of spiritual civilization. Each province, autonomous region and municipality directly under the Central Government may establish a corresponding institution. The plenary session called on all comrades of the Party and people of all ethnic groups in the country to closely unite around the Party Central Committee with Comrade Jiang Zemin as the core, hold high the great banner of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, unite as one, forge ahead, work hard, and welcome the convening of the 15th National Congress of the Party with outstanding achievements in the construction of the two civilizations.

重要问题的决议》。

国建设成为富强、民主、文明的社会主义现代化国家。今后15年,
我国社会主义精神文明建设的主要目标是:在全民族牢固树立建
设有中国特色社会主义的共同理想,牢固树立坚持党的基本路线
不动摇的坚定信念;实现以思想道德修养、科学教育水平、民主法

高;在全国范围形成物质文明建设和精神文明建设协调发展的良
好局面。
《决议》要求,加强和改善党对精神文明建设的领导。特别指
出,考核、评价党政领导班子和主要领导干部,不仅要看物质文明
建设的实绩和本领,而且要看领导精神文明建设的实绩和本领,并
将此作为使用和奖惩干部的基本依据;加强精神文明建设首先要
从严治党,搞好党风。
《决议》共分七部分三十条。
translated_text: On the same day, the CPC Central Committee issued the "Resolution on Several Important Issues Concerning Strengthening the Construction of Socialist Spiritual Civilization". The "Resolution" pointed out that strengthening the construction of socialist spiritual civilization is a major strategic task. The "Resolution" puts forward the guiding ideology and goal of the construction of socialist spiritual civilization. The general guiding ideology is: guided by Marxism-Leninism, Mao Zedong Thought and Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, adhering to the party's basic line and basic theory, strengthening ideological and moral construction, developing education, science and culture, arming people with scientific theories, guiding people with correct public opinion, shaping people with noble spirits, inspiring people with excellent works, cultivating socialist citizens with ideals, morality, culture and discipline, improving the ideological and moral quality and scientific and cultural quality of the whole nation, and uniting and mobilizing people of all ethnic groups to build our country into a prosperous, democratic and civilized socialist modern country. In the next 15 years, the main goals of my country's socialist spiritual civilization construction are: to firmly establish the common ideal of building socialism with Chinese characteristics in the whole nation, to firmly establish the unshakable belief in adhering to the party's basic line; to achieve a significant improvement in the quality of citizens with ideological and moral cultivation, scientific education level, and democratic legal concepts as the main content; to achieve a significant improvement in the quality of cultural life with active, healthy, rich and colorful, and serving the people as the main requirements; to achieve a significant improvement in the level of urban and rural civilization with social atmosphere, public order, and living environment as the main signs; to form a good situation of coordinated development of material and spiritual civilization construction across the country. The "Resolution" requires strengthening and improving the party's leadership over the construction of spiritual civilization. In particular, it points out that the assessment and evaluation of party and government leadership teams and major leading cadres should not only look at the actual performance and ability of material civilization construction, but also look at the actual performance and ability of leading spiritual civilization construction, and use this as the basic basis for the use and reward and punishment of cadres; to strengthen the construction of spiritual civilization, we must first strictly govern the party and improve the party style. The "Resolution" is divided into seven parts and 30 articles.

顿和建设。首先要在解决“有人办事,有钱办事”的问题上取得实
效,进而带动其他问题的解决。在重点整顿后进村的同时,要加强

基层组织建设统筹安排,同步进行。在着重抓好村级组织的同时,
还要认真抓好乡镇党组织的建设和整顿。每个县都要从实际出发,
确定具体的年度工作规划和方案,务求每年都有新的进展。
胡锦涛指出,农村基层组织建设工作,必须坚持党的基本路
线,紧紧围绕党在农村的中心工作,把加强基层组织建设同促进经

促进农村改革的深化,促进农业和农村经济的繁荣,保证粮食生产
稳定增长,保证我国农业综合生产能力、农村经济发展和农民收入
都能达到新水平,迈上新台阶。现在扶贫工作已经进入攻坚阶段。

这块硬骨头。要把扶贫开发工作同整顿和建设农村基层组织结合
起来安排,统一部署,同步工作。下派干部要一身二任,两项工作一
起抓。要坚持用邓小平建设有中国特色社会主义理论武装党员、群

主义思想去牢固占领农村思想文化阵地,旗帜鲜明地弘扬正气,反
对歪风邪气。积极开展创建文明村镇活动。

要把领导班子和干部队伍建设作为基层组织建设的治本之道、长

治强､思想好、清正廉洁、公道能干,同群众保持密切联系,能带领

力。要经常研究新情况,解决新问题,总结新经验,不断提高领导水
平。

加强农村基层组织建设,既是事关全局的长期的战略性任务,又是

迫任务;要突出重点,善始善终,全面完成3年整顿任务;要大力加

translated_text:
On the 25th, the National Rural Grassroots Organization Construction Work Symposium opened in Zhongnanhai. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, attended the opening ceremony and delivered an important speech. Hu Jintao emphasized that the construction of rural grassroots organizations must fully implement the "five good" tasks, enrich the content of the "five good" and improve the level of the "five good" according to the needs of the new situation and new tasks. The current focus of work is still to concentrate on the rectification and construction of backward villages. First of all, we must achieve practical results in solving the problem of "someone to do things, money to do things", and then drive the solution of other problems. While focusing on the rectification of backward villages, we must strengthen the specific guidance of the work on the surface, adhere to the coordinated arrangement of promoting rural reform, development, and stability with strengthening grassroots organization construction, and carry out them simultaneously. While focusing on village-level organizations, we must also earnestly grasp the construction and rectification of township party organizations. Each county must proceed from reality and determine specific annual work plans and programs to ensure new progress every year. Hu Jintao pointed out that the construction of rural grassroots organizations must adhere to the party's basic line, closely focus on the party's central work in rural areas, and combine the strengthening of grassroots organization construction with the promotion of economic development, poverty alleviation, and the strengthening of spiritual civilization. All work on the construction of rural grassroots organizations must obey and serve the overall situation of the party's work in rural areas, promote the deepening of rural reforms, promote the prosperity of agriculture and rural economy, ensure the stable growth of grain production, and ensure that my country's comprehensive agricultural production capacity, rural economic development and farmers' income can reach a new level and step onto a new stage. Now the poverty alleviation work has entered the critical stage. No matter how arduous the task is and how urgent the time is, we must win this battle and bite off this hard bone. We must combine poverty alleviation and development work with the rectification and construction of rural grassroots organizations, unify the deployment, and work simultaneously. The cadres sent down must have two responsibilities and do both tasks at the same time. We must persist in arming party members and the masses with Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and guide farmers to persist in taking the path of common prosperity. We should firmly occupy the ideological and cultural positions in rural areas with patriotism, collectivism and socialism, and clearly promote positive energy and oppose unhealthy tendencies. Actively carry out activities to create civilized villages and towns.
When talking about building a high-quality grassroots cadre team in rural areas, Hu Jintao required that the construction of the leadership team and cadre team must be regarded as the fundamental solution and long-term plan for grassroots organization construction, and great efforts and real efforts must be made to do a good job, and gradually create a cadre team at the village and township levels that is politically strong, ideologically good, honest and upright, fair and capable, maintains close contact with the masses, and can lead the peasant masses to build a socialist new countryside. At the same time, we must continue to do a good job in the training and selection of outstanding young rural cadres and the development of outstanding young farmers to join the party.
Regarding strengthening the leadership of the construction of grassroots organizations in rural areas, Hu Jintao emphasized that we must continue to adhere to and improve the responsibility system of the party committee managing party building and the secretary taking the lead in party building. Party committees at all levels, especially county (city) committees, must have a full understanding, work well, and fulfill their duties. We should continue to organize all forces to form an overall force to build rural grassroots organizations. We should frequently study new situations, solve new problems, summarize new experiences, and continuously improve leadership. Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, made a summary speech on "Increase efforts, implement vigorously, and unremittingly push forward the construction of rural grassroots organizations." Zhang Quanjing pointed out that strengthening the construction of rural grassroots organizations is not only a long-term strategic task that concerns the overall situation, but also an urgent task that cannot be delayed in deepening rural reforms and promoting the comprehensive development of various rural undertakings; we must highlight key points, start well and end well, and fully complete the three-year rectification task; we must vigorously strengthen the construction of township party committees and give full play to the positive role of township party committees; we must further strengthen leadership, increase work efforts, and implement the tasks of rectifying and building rural grassroots organizations. The opening ceremony was hosted by Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee. Responsible comrades of relevant central departments, including Wang Weicheng, Chen Fujin, Zhou Ziyu, Zheng Keyang, Liu Yunshan, and leaders of member units of the National Grassroots Organization Construction Liaison Conference attended the meeting. On November 16, the Central Organization Department issued the "Notice on the Speech by Hu Jintao and Comrade Zhang Quanjing at the National Rural Grassroots Organization Construction Work Symposium".

translated_text: On the 28th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee and the Party School of the CPC Central Committee jointly held a special seminar on the spiritual civilization construction of provincial and ministerial cadres in Beijing. It carefully studied the "Resolution" of the Sixth Plenary Session and Comrade Jiang Zemin's important speech at the plenary session, and conducted in-depth research on the construction of socialist spiritual civilization, mainly ideological and moral and cultural construction, and focused on how to implement the various tasks determined by the Sixth Plenary Session. We must closely combine the study of the spirit of the Sixth Plenary Session with the study of Deng Xiaoping Theory, especially the thoughts on the construction of spiritual civilization, and integrate them to guide practice. Learning should be linked to reality, focusing on the importance, urgency, long-term nature, complexity and arduousness of spiritual civilization construction under the new situation, the relationship between spiritual civilization and material civilization, the development of socialist market economy and the implementation of opening up to the outside world, the guiding ideology and goal of spiritual civilization construction, and the key to building spiritual civilization lies in the party, so as to improve understanding and unify thinking. Only by unifying the thinking of the whole party, especially the leading cadres, with the spirit of the Sixth Plenary Session can we enhance the confidence and sense of responsibility in building spiritual civilization, enhance the consciousness and firmness of insisting on doing both things and making both hands strong, and better unite the broad masses of the people to implement the tasks determined by the Sixth Plenary Session. We should discuss and seek good solutions around the key issues that need to be carefully studied and solved in the construction of spiritual civilization under the new situation. We should unremittingly implement the requirements put forward in the "Resolution" and Comrade Jiang Zemin's important speech. We should fully realize the importance of implementation from the perspective of being politically conscious and maintaining consistency with the Party Central Committee, from the perspective of gaining the trust of the people, strengthening the relationship between the Party and the masses, and enhancing the cohesion of the Party, and from the perspective of realizing the grand blueprint across the century and bringing a vigorous China into the 21st century. With an extremely responsible spirit to the Party and the people, and an extremely serious attitude towards work, we should work hard, seek practical results, and promote the construction of spiritual civilization in a down-to-earth manner. Participants in this seminar include leaders from provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, leaders from relevant ministries and commissions of the Central Government and state organs, and relevant responsible comrades from the People's Liberation Army, the Armed Police, and the Workers, Youth, and Women's Federations. 《纪要》还指出,要坚持实事求是的原则,既要反映工作中的成
绩和经验,也要反映存在的问题。有价值的问题性信息,可以督促
解决某个方面的重要问题;提醒纠正某种不良现象;推动某项政策
的落实;对完善和制定有关政策起到重要的促进作用。但从目前来

translated_text: On the 1st, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on the Key Points of Comrade Zhang Quanjing's Talks on Information Work and the Minutes of the Symposium on Information Supervision Work of the Organization Departments of Provincial, Regional and Municipal Party Committees". The "Key Points" are divided into five aspects: fully recognize the importance of information work; clarify the focus of information work; further improve the quality of information; further broaden information channels; and strengthen the leadership of information work. The "Minutes" pointed out that in the future, the information work of the organization department should be guided by Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and the basic line of the party, closely focus on the overall situation of the party's work and the central tasks of the organization department, and focus on improving the quality of information. It is necessary to enhance political discernment and political acumen, seek truth from facts, and timely, comprehensively and accurately reflect new situations, new problems and new experiences in organizational work. It is necessary to establish and improve a criss-crossing and sensitive information network, improve the quality of information personnel, and strive to make the information channels of the organization department the most direct, fastest and most reliable channels for leading comrades to fully grasp the situation of party building, and give full play to the important role of information work in strengthening party building. The minutes also pointed out that we should adhere to the principle of seeking truth from facts, and reflect both the achievements and experience in work and the existing problems. Valuable problematic information can urge the resolution of important issues in a certain aspect; remind the correction of certain unhealthy phenomena; promote the implementation of certain policies; and play an important role in promoting the improvement and formulation of relevant policies. However, from the current point of view, the problem of reporting good news but not bad news is still relatively prominent. Some important situations with tendencies and signs, including sudden incidents, are not reported, and late reporting and missed reporting often occur. The meeting believes that the key to solving the problem of difficulty in reporting problematic information lies in raising the awareness of leaders of organizational departments at all levels, especially the main leaders.

设工作座谈会上的讲话的通知》。

设高素质的干部队伍的要求,继续抓好高校领导班子建设;(二)学

党支部建设,认真做好在大学生和青年教师中发展党员工作;
(四)组织部门要与党委宣传部门,教育工作部门,政府教育行政部
门密切配合,承担起高校党建思想政治工作的指导责任。
虞云耀指出,高校领导班子正面临跨世纪的交接,大批五、六
十年代毕业的同志将陆续退出领导岗位,大批年轻同志将逐步走

做好这项工作,首先在思想认识上要到位。培养选拔能够跨世
纪担当重任的高校领导人才,是一项刻不容缓的战略任务。要以高
度的政治责任心和历史使命感,加大工作力度,加快工作步伐,抓
紧抓实,抓出成效。二是目标规划要到位。去年召开的第五次全国
高校党建工作会议,提出了“力争通过本世纪最后5年的努力,使
高校领导班子年龄结构更加合理,逐步使50岁以下的领导成员占
到半数,其中应配有1-2名40岁左右年轻干部”的工作目标。大
家都认为,这个目标是可行的。现在刚执行一年,有效果,但不少学
校离这个目标差距还很大。要做艰苦细致的工作,制订切实可行的
具体计划,认真组织实施。三是培养措施要到位。要从教研室、系
(处)抓起,建立校、系(处)两级后备干部队伍。紧紧抓住理论学习、
实践锻炼、严格教育管理这三个基本环节,针对每个人的不同情
况,落实具体培养措施。挂职锻炼、校内外交流的力度要加大。四
是大胆启用要到位。在坚持干部队伍“四化”方针和德才兼备的用
人标准的前提下,进一步解放思想,克服论资排辈、求全责备等
旧观念的束缚,及时把那些政治素质好、政绩突出,群众公认的优
秀年轻干部充实到领导班子中去。讨论中大家谈到,高校领导班子
一要坚持德才兼备;二要有一个合理的结构,包括年龄的梯次配
备;三要从实际出发,不搞一刀切。
translated_text: On the 20th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on Comrade Yu Yunyao's Speech at the Symposium on Party Building in Colleges and Universities". Yu Yunyao, Deputy Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, made four points. (I) In accordance with the requirements of the Central Committee on building a high-quality cadre team, continue to strengthen the construction of the leadership team of colleges and universities; (II) Study and implement the spirit of the Sixth Plenary Session of the Central Committee and earnestly strengthen ideological and moral construction; (III) Earnestly strengthen the construction of party branches in colleges and universities, and do a good job in developing party members among college students and young teachers; (IV) The organization department should work closely with the propaganda department of the party committee, the education department, and the government education administrative department to assume the responsibility of guiding the ideological and political work of party building in colleges and universities. Yu Yunyao pointed out that the leadership team of colleges and universities is facing a cross-century handover. A large number of comrades who graduated in the 1950s and 1960s will gradually withdraw from leadership positions, and a large number of young comrades will gradually take up leadership positions. The task of training and selecting young cadres, especially party committee secretaries and principals, is very arduous and urgent. To do this work well, we must first have a good understanding of the ideology. Cultivating and selecting college leaders who can shoulder the heavy responsibility across the century is an urgent strategic task. With a high sense of political responsibility and historical mission, we must increase our efforts, speed up our work, grasp it firmly and achieve results. Second, the goal planning must be in place. The fifth national college party building work conference held last year proposed the work goal of "striving to make the age structure of college leadership more reasonable through efforts in the last five years of this century, gradually making the leadership members under 50 years old account for half, and 1-2 young cadres around 40 years old should be equipped among them." Everyone believes that this goal is feasible. Now it has just been implemented for a year and has achieved results, but many schools are still far from this goal. We must do hard and meticulous work, formulate practical and specific plans, and organize and implement them seriously. Third, the training measures must be in place. We must start from the teaching and research office and department (department) to establish a reserve cadre team at the school and department (department) levels. We must firmly grasp the three basic links of theoretical study, practical training, and strict education management, and implement specific training measures according to the different situations of each person. The efforts of on-the-job training and exchanges inside and outside the school should be strengthened. Fourth, bold appointments should be in place. Under the premise of adhering to the "four modernizations" policy of the cadre team and the standard of employing people with both moral integrity and ability, we should further emancipate our minds, overcome the constraints of old concepts such as seniority and perfectionism, and timely enrich the leadership team with those outstanding young cadres with good political qualities, outstanding political achievements, and recognized by the masses. During the discussion, everyone talked about the fact that the leadership team of colleges and universities should first adhere to both moral integrity and ability; second, have a reasonable structure, including age-based allocation; third, proceed from reality and not adopt a one-size-fits-all approach.

话。

届六中全会精神;二是关于1996年的经济形势和1997年的经济
工作;三是关于加强和改善党对两个文明建设的领导。他强调,各
级党委和领导干部要全面、正确、积极地贯彻邓小平建设有中国特
色社会主义理论和党的基本路线,深刻理解和正确把握全党全国
工作的大局,把思想和行动统一到中央的精神上来。要从整体上处
理好物质文明建设与精神文明建设的关系,改革、发展、稳定的关
系,两个文明建设与党的建设的关系,把握好它们的内在联系,使
之相互协调、相互促进。在工作中,要坚持以经济建设为中心,坚持
两手抓、两手都要硬,还要学会“弹钢琴”的工作方法,既要善于抓
住主要矛盾,解决好存在的突出问题,又要统筹兼顾,防止顾此失
彼,确保两个文明协调发展。各级领导干部要切实转变领导作风和
工作作风,深入群众,深入实际,了解真实情况,倾听群众意见,把
党的政策措施不折不扣地贯彻下去。
translated_text: On the 29th, Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, Secretary of the Secretariat, and President of the Central Party School, attended the graduation ceremony of the 21st provincial and ministerial cadres training class of the Central Party School and delivered a speech. In his speech, Hu Jintao talked about three issues: one is about thoroughly implementing the spirit of the Sixth Plenary Session of the 14th Central Committee; the second is about the economic situation in 1996 and the economic work in 1997; the third is about strengthening and improving the party's leadership over the construction of two civilizations. He emphasized that party committees and leading cadres at all levels must fully, correctly and actively implement Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and the party's basic line, deeply understand and correctly grasp the overall situation of the work of the whole party and the whole country, and unify their thoughts and actions with the spirit of the central government. It is necessary to handle the relationship between the construction of material civilization and the construction of spiritual civilization, the relationship between reform, development and stability, and the relationship between the construction of two civilizations and party building from a holistic perspective, grasp their internal connection, and make them coordinate and promote each other. In work, we must adhere to the focus on economic construction, adhere to the two-handed approach, and learn the working method of "playing the piano". We must be good at grasping the main contradictions and solving the outstanding problems, and we must make overall plans and balance them to prevent losing sight of one thing while focusing on the other, and ensure the coordinated development of the two civilizations. Leading cadres at all levels must truly change their leadership style and work style, go deep into the masses, go deep into reality, understand the real situation, listen to the opinions of the masses, and implement the party's policies and measures without compromise.
