events:
11日——13日 全国保密工作会议在北京召开。中共中央总
书记、国家主席江泽民,中共中央政治局常委、国务院总理李鹏,中
共中央政治局常委、书记处书记胡锦涛,中央军委副主席张万年会
见了出席会议的全体代表并与部分代表进行了座谈,江泽民在座
谈会上发表了重要讲话。
江泽民指出:要充分认识新形势下保密工作的重要性。保密工
作历来是党和国家的一项重要工作。革命战争年代,保密就是保生
存,保胜利。和平建设时期,保密就是保安全,保发展。在新的历史
时期,保密工作做得好不好,也直接影响着改革开放和现代化建设
的进展。全党同志特别是各级领导干部,必须从这样的政治高度充
分认识保密工作的重要性。在对外开放和发展社会主义市场经济
的条件下,对保密工作的复杂性和艰苦性要有足够的思想准备。必
须保持高度的政治敏锐性和警惕性,牢固树立“保守党的机密,慎
之又慎”的思想,“必须十分注意保守党的机密,九分半不行,九分
九也不行,非十分不可”,把保密工作作为保障改革开放,促进经济
发展､维护党和国家安全的一项重要工作抓紧抓好。
江泽民要求严肃保密纪律,加大执法力度。他指出,要在各级
领导机关,特别是要害部门大力加强保密法纪教育,提高广大干部
尤其是年轻干部的保密纪律观念,增强他们遵守保密纪律的自觉
性。这是一个党性和政治原则问题,必须做到。
江泽民要求各级党委和政府切实加强对保密工作的领导,要
进一步给保密部门创造必要的条件,保证他们能真正履行职责。要
进一步发挥保密委员会的作用。要努力建设一支高素质的保密工
作队伍。
中共中央书记处书记、中央保密委员会主任任建新作了工作
报告。国务委员兼国务院秘书长、中央保密委员会副主任罗干会
议结束时作了总结讲话。他要求各级保密委员会要认真履行职责,
统一抓好这次会议的贯彻落实。各有关业务部门要通过学习贯彻
这次会议精神,统一思想认识,把日常业务工作和保密工作有机地
结合好,确保国家秘密万无一失。
translated_text: From the 11th to the 13th, the National Confidentiality Work Conference was held in Beijing. Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee and President of the State, Li Peng, Member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Premier of the State Council, Hu Jintao, Member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, and Zhang Wannian, Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission, met with all the representatives attending the meeting and held discussions with some of the representatives. Jiang Zemin delivered an important speech at the symposium. Jiang Zemin pointed out: We must fully recognize the importance of confidentiality work under the new situation. Confidentiality work has always been an important task of the Party and the country. In the revolutionary war era, confidentiality was to ensure survival and victory. In the period of peaceful construction, confidentiality is to ensure safety and development. In the new historical period, whether confidentiality work is done well or not also directly affects the progress of reform and opening up and modernization. All comrades of the Party, especially leading cadres at all levels, must fully recognize the importance of confidentiality work from such a political height. Under the conditions of opening up to the outside world and developing a socialist market economy, we must be mentally prepared for the complexity and difficulty of confidentiality work. We must maintain a high degree of political sensitivity and vigilance, firmly establish the idea of "keeping the secrets of the Party with extreme caution", "we must pay great attention to keeping the secrets of the Party, 9.5% is not enough, 9.9% is not enough, we must pay full attention to keeping the secrets of the Party", and take the confidentiality work as an important task to ensure reform and opening up, promote economic development, and safeguard the security of the Party and the country. Jiang Zemin demanded strict confidentiality discipline and increased law enforcement. He pointed out that it is necessary to vigorously strengthen confidentiality law and discipline education at all levels of leading organs, especially key departments, to improve the confidentiality discipline awareness of the majority of cadres, especially young cadres, and enhance their consciousness of abiding by confidentiality discipline. This is a question of party spirit and political principles, and it must be done. Jiang Zemin asked the Party committees and governments at all levels to effectively strengthen the leadership of confidentiality work, to further create the necessary conditions for confidentiality departments, and to ensure that they can truly perform their duties. The role of the confidentiality committee should be further played. We should strive to build a high-quality confidentiality work team. Ren Jianxin, Secretary of the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee and Director of the Central Confidentiality Committee, made a work report. Luo Gan, State Councilor and Secretary-General of the State Council and Deputy Director of the Central Confidentiality Committee, made a summary speech at the end of the meeting. He asked the secrecy committees at all levels to conscientiously perform their duties and implement the meeting in a unified manner. All relevant business departments should study and implement the spirit of this meeting, unify their thoughts and understanding, organically combine daily business work with secrecy work, and ensure that state secrets are safe.

方针、政策在企业人事工作中贯彻落实,严格执行有关企业领导人
员选拔任用的法规,坚持任人唯贤,反对任人唯亲。要用足够的精
力做好对企业领导人员的发现、培养、教育、考核和监督,任何一个
方面的工作都不能失职。企业行政领导人员和党务工作者,都是党
的干部,都要给予关心、爱护、帮助、支持。对工作认真负责,确有实
绩､群众拥护的,要表彰、奖励;发现有缺点和问题,要及时指出,及
时解决。群众反映强烈,问题突出的,要抓紧弄清情况,该充实的要
抓紧充实,该调整的要尽快调整,绝不能因领导班子问题贻误战
机。
中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理吴邦国出席会议并发表
讲话。吴邦国指出,要完成国有企业改革艰巨的任务,只有在党的
领导下,坚持正确方向,才能顺利进行。充分发挥企业党组织的政
治核心作用,既是改革的客观要求,也是国有企业特殊优势。
吴邦国指出,根据企业改革的实践,发挥企业党组织作用,主
要有五点:一是保证、监督党和国家方针政策在本企业的贯彻执
行;二是参与企业重大问题的决策,支持厂长依法行使职权,协调
企业内部各方面的关系;三是坚持党管干部的原则,同行政领导一
起,培养队伍,造就人才;四是领导思想政治工作,抓好企业精神文
明建设;五是加强党的自身建设,领导和支持工会、共青团独立开
展工作,维护职工合法权益,增强企业凝聚力。
吴邦国说,当前国有企业困难很多,建设一个坚强有力的领导
班子尤为重要。企业办得好坏,领导班子素质高低关系很大。大量
企业兴衰的事实说明,一个好的领导班子可以使一个亏损大户变
成盈利大户,一个不好的班子可以搞垮一个优秀企业。目前,国有
企业领导班子总的状况是好的。但是,也有一部分企业领导班子.
不适应发展社会主义市场经济的需要。有的是班子观念陈旧,有的
是班子素质不高,有的是班子团结不好,少数甚至贪污腐化,肆意
挥霍侵吞国家财产。这些问题必须引起我们高度重视,采取措施加
以解决。他提出,一是要下大决心,用大气力,对国有企业领导班子
进行一次普遍的认真的考核,对不适应改革和发展形势要求的领
导班子要调整充实,真正实行优胜劣汰;二是要切实抓好对企业领
导干部的培训工作,提高企业领导班子的思想政治素质和理论水
平;三是要加强对企业领导班子的监督,特别是要加强企业职工代
表大会对领导班子的民主评议和监督。
translated_text: From the 11th to the 14th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Policy Research Office of the CPC Central Committee, the State Economic and Trade Commission, the State Commission for Restructuring the Economic System, and the All-China Federation of Trade Unions jointly held a national state-owned enterprise party building work conference in Beijing. The main task of the conference is to thoroughly implement the spirit of the Fourth, Fifth, and Sixth Plenary Sessions of the 14th CPC Central Committee and the recent Central Economic Work Conference, further unify thoughts, clarify tasks, exchange experiences, study measures, and promote the strengthening of party building in state-owned enterprises and the improvement of party building work to ensure the smooth realization of various tasks of enterprise reform and development, and promote the sustained, rapid, and healthy development of the entire national economy and the overall progress of society. Attending the conference were more than 200 people, including the heads of the organization departments of the party committees of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the central government, and the responsible comrades of the Economic and Trade Commission and the Federation of Trade Unions, and the heads of the party and political work of relevant central departments and some large and medium-sized enterprises. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, attended the meeting and delivered an important speech. In his speech, Hu Jintao pointed out that according to the general goal of strengthening party building in the new era, combined with the characteristics of state-owned enterprises and the practical experience of these years, the work of strengthening party building in state-owned enterprises should strive to achieve "four haves", namely: a leadership team that resolutely implements the party's line, principles and policies, understands business, management, unity and coordination, is honest and fair, pioneering and enterprising, and is supported by the workers and the masses, especially a leader with strong political, professional and good work style; a team of party members who can withstand the test of difficulties and risks in enterprise reform and development and play a pioneering and exemplary role in the construction of two civilizations; a working mechanism that adapts to the requirements of enterprise reform and development, closely combines with production and operation, and ensures that the party organization of the enterprise plays a role; a set of work systems that strengthen party member education and management, can promptly resolve the contradictions and problems existing in itself, and continuously enhance cohesion and combat effectiveness. Hu Jintao pointed out that the fundamental way to solve the problems existing in state-owned enterprises is to promote reform in a down-to-earth manner, strengthen management, and actively change the growth model. To do these things well, the key is that the enterprise must have a good leadership team. Party and government leaders at all levels must make great efforts to strengthen the construction of enterprise leadership teams while vigorously promoting enterprise reform and development. We must focus on education and strive to ensure that members of the leadership teams of state-owned enterprises, especially the main leaders, have the following basic qualities: (1) have firm and correct ideals and beliefs, and can resolutely implement the party's line, principles, policies and national laws and regulations; (2) have a relatively rich knowledge of the socialist market economy, necessary scientific and technological knowledge and management capabilities required by job responsibilities; (3) firmly rely on the party organization and the majority of employees to run enterprises, be good at taking the mass line, and consciously accept supervision from all sides; (4) be diligent and dedicated, courageous in dedication, honest and upright, work hard, forge ahead, and work hard; (5) be modest and prudent, study hard, and be good at cooperating with members of the leadership team. Hu Jintao pointed out that in state-owned enterprises and state-controlled enterprises, the principle of party management of cadres must be upheld and management methods must be improved. These two musts are the guarantee for building a good enterprise leadership team and management team. We must ensure and supervise the implementation of the Party’s cadre line, principles and policies in the personnel work of enterprises, strictly implement the laws and regulations on the selection and appointment of enterprise leaders, adhere to the principle of appointing people on their merits and oppose nepotism. We must devote sufficient energy to the discovery, training, education, assessment and supervision of enterprise leaders, and no work in any aspect should be neglected. Enterprise administrative leaders and party workers are all Party cadres, and they should be cared for, loved, helped and supported. Those who are conscientious and responsible in their work, have real achievements and are supported by the masses should be commended and rewarded; if shortcomings and problems are found, they should be pointed out and solved in time. If the masses have strong reactions and prominent problems, we must hurry to clarify the situation, and those who need to be strengthened should be strengthened as soon as possible, and those who need to be adjusted should be adjusted as soon as possible. We must not miss the opportunity due to leadership problems. Wu Bangguo, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, attended the meeting and delivered a speech. Wu Bangguo pointed out that to complete the arduous task of state-owned enterprise reform, only under the leadership of the Party and adhering to the correct direction can it proceed smoothly. Giving full play to the political core role of the enterprise party organization is both an objective requirement of reform and a special advantage of state-owned enterprises. Wu Bangguo pointed out that according to the practice of enterprise reform, there are five main points to give full play to the role of the enterprise party organization: first, to ensure and supervise the implementation of the party and state policies in the enterprise; second, to participate in the decision-making of major issues of the enterprise, support the factory director to exercise his powers according to law, and coordinate the relationship between various aspects within the enterprise; third, to adhere to the principle of party management of cadres, and work with administrative leaders to cultivate teams and talents; fourth, to lead ideological and political work and do a good job in the construction of enterprise spiritual civilization; fifth, to strengthen the party's own construction, lead and support trade unions and the Communist Youth League to carry out work independently, safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of employees, and enhance the cohesion of enterprises. Wu Bangguo said that state-owned enterprises are facing many difficulties at present, and it is particularly important to build a strong and powerful leadership team. The quality of the leadership team has a great relationship with the success of an enterprise. The facts of the rise and fall of a large number of enterprises show that a good leadership team can turn a loss-making enterprise into a profitable one, and a bad team can ruin an excellent enterprise. At present, the overall situation of the leadership of state-owned enterprises is good. However, there are also some enterprise leadership teams that are not adapted to the needs of developing a socialist market economy. Some have outdated concepts, some have low quality, some have poor unity, and a few are even corrupt and wantonly squander and embezzle state property. These problems must be taken seriously by us and measures must be taken to solve them. He proposed that, first, we must make great determination and use great efforts to conduct a general and serious assessment of the leadership of state-owned enterprises, and adjust and enrich the leadership that does not meet the requirements of the reform and development situation, and truly implement the survival of the fittest; second, we must earnestly do a good job in training enterprise leaders and improve the ideological and political quality and theoretical level of enterprise leadership teams; third, we must strengthen supervision over enterprise leadership teams, especially strengthen the democratic evaluation and supervision of leadership teams by enterprise employee representative conferences.

translated_text: On the 15th and 16th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China held a national meeting of provincial, regional and municipal party committee organization ministers in Beijing. The main purpose of this meeting was to study and implement the spirit of the Sixth Plenary Session of the 14th CPC Central Committee and the Central Economic Work Conference, review and summarize the organizational work in 1996, and study and deploy the work tasks for 1997. In his speech at the meeting, Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, asked party committees and organization departments at all levels to continue to promote the ideological and political construction of leading groups above the county level, increase the efforts to select outstanding young cadres, conscientiously implement the "Interim Regulations on the Selection and Appointment of Party and Government Leading Cadres" and the "Regulations on the Work of Local Committees of the Communist Party of China (Trial)", further strengthen the construction of grassroots organizations with a focus on party building in rural areas and state-owned enterprises, strive to build a high-quality cadre team, continuously improve the quality of the party member team, and welcome the convening of the 15th National Congress of the Communist Party of China with outstanding achievements. Zhang Quanjing pointed out that we must further emancipate our minds, broaden our horizons, and strive to achieve new breakthroughs in the selection and appointment of outstanding young cadres, so that a group of relatively mature reserve candidates can enter the party and government leadership teams above the county level. In accordance with the requirements of the Central Committee, we should promptly solve the problem of the small number of young cadres and unreasonable structure in some leadership teams; we should strengthen practical training, insist on selecting leadership talents from cadres with grassroots practical experience and work experience in key positions, maintain the quality and vitality of the reserve cadre team, and meet the needs of the long-term construction of leadership teams at all levels. We should continue to do a good job in training and selecting female cadres, ethnic minority cadres and non-party cadres, and do a good job in building a high-quality scientific and technological cadre team and enterprise management cadre team. Zhang Quanjing stressed that it is necessary to strictly implement the "Interim Regulations on the Selection and Appointment of Party and Government Leading Cadres", deepen the reform of the cadre and personnel system, and resolutely prevent and correct the unhealthy trends in employment. It is necessary to strictly enforce the discipline of cadre and personnel work, resolutely investigate and punish behaviors and relevant responsible persons that violate the provisions of the "Regulations", and strive to make new progress in preventing and correcting unhealthy trends in employment. Zhang Quanjing pointed out that it is necessary to conscientiously implement the "Regulations on the Work of Local Committees of the Communist Party of China (Trial)" and improve the consciousness and work level of the leadership teams at all levels in implementing democratic centralism. All local Party and government leaders at all levels should fully recognize the important position and role of the Regulations in the construction of the Party system and in improving the leadership level of local Party committees, make efforts to study the Regulations, and consciously abide by and implement them in actual work. We should solve the outstanding problems existing in the process of the leadership team implementing democratic centralism in a targeted manner, improve the Party committee's democratic decision-making system, improve the level of governance and leadership, improve leadership methods, and adhere to and improve the system of combining collective leadership with individual division of labor and responsibility. We should strengthen the inspection and supervision of the implementation of the Regulations, regularly analyze typical cases, summarize experience, find out deficiencies, and make improvements. Zhang Quanjing pointed out that we should further strengthen the construction of the Party's grassroots organizations. In 1997, we should first focus on the Party building work at the grassroots level in rural areas and state-owned enterprises, and at the same time further strengthen the Party building of institutions and strengthen supervision over Party member leading cadres; conscientiously summarize experience and promote street Party building work; adhere to standards, ensure quality, and do a good job in developing Party members. Zhang Quanjing finally pointed out that the most important thing for the self-construction of the organization department is ideological and political construction and professional ethics construction. In the process of continuing to thoroughly study and implement Comrade Jiang Zemin’s “July 1st” important speech and the resolution of the Sixth Plenary Session of the Central Committee, we must earnestly sum up experience and lessons, correct our thinking, improve our work style, focus on improving the ideological and political quality of organizational cadres, and strive to build the organization department into a department with “firm politics, upright work style, proficient business, and outstanding work”, shouldering the historical responsibility of organizational work in the new era. Nearly 200 people attended the meeting, including the heads of the organization departments of the party committees of 30 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the central government, responsible comrades of the party committees or organization departments of 16 sub-provincial cities, and the heads of the personnel departments (bureaus) of various ministries and commissions of the central and state organs.

translated_text:
On the 1st, the CPC Central Committee issued the "Main Points of the Work of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee in 1997". The "Main Points" emphasized that 1997 is an important year in the historical development of our country. We will resume the exercise of sovereignty over Hong Kong and take an important step towards the peaceful reunification of the motherland; we will convene the 15th National Congress of the Party to comprehensively advance the great cause of building socialism with Chinese characteristics into the new century. We must correctly understand and grasp the situation, strive to seize opportunities, adhere to the Party's basic theory, basic line and basic policies, conscientiously implement the 14th National Congress of the Party and a series of strategic deployments since the 14th National Congress, correctly handle the relationship between reform, development and stability, pay special attention to maintaining a stable political, economic and social environment, continue to promote reform and opening up, promote economic development and social progress, and consolidate and develop the good situation won by the whole party and the people of all ethnic groups in the country with great efforts. To do a good job in all aspects of work in 1997, all party comrades, especially leading cadres at all levels, must firmly grasp the overall situation, make persistent efforts, work together, and forge ahead. The "Key Points" pointed out that in order to do a good job in all aspects of work in 1997, all party comrades, especially leading cadres at all levels, must firmly grasp the overall situation, make persistent efforts, work together and forge ahead.
The "Key Points" proposed that we should continue to implement the overall deployment of strengthening party building, adhere to the general goal of party building in the new era, grasp the fundamental of arming the whole party with basic theory, highlight the focus of building a high-quality cadre team, and comprehensively promote the great project of party building. We should focus on ideological construction and strengthen the construction of leading groups at all levels. We should vigorously carry out party spirit and style education for leading cadres at or above the county level with the main content of learning, politics and integrity, and earnestly solve the outstanding problems in ideals, beliefs and ideological style. We should continue to carry out activities to study theory and the Party Constitution. We should effectively strengthen the construction of democratic centralism in leading groups at all levels, improve decision-making level, enhance internal unity, and strictly enforce political discipline. We should speed up the implementation of the five-year plan for cadre training and strive to improve the quality of cadres at all levels. We should increase the work of cultivating and selecting outstanding young cadres.
Deepen the reform of the cadre personnel system, increase the exchange of cadres, expand democracy in cadre work, and promote the promotion and demotion of cadres. Strictly implement the selection and appointment system for party and government leading cadres, and prevent and correct unhealthy practices in the employment of personnel. We must do a good job in the construction of grassroots party organizations, solidly promote the construction of village-level organizations with party branches as the core, and ensure the completion of the three-year rectification and construction tasks of the backward village party branches. Vigorously strengthen the construction of party organizations in state-owned enterprises, and seriously study the work of party building in new economic organizations. Improve the level of construction of party organizations at the grassroots level in government agencies, schools, streets and other grassroots organizations. We must strengthen the construction of party style and clean government. Carry out in-depth education on the Marxist mass viewpoint and the party's mass line throughout the party, vigorously promote the fine style of linking theory with practice, closely connecting with the masses, criticism and self-criticism, and the fine tradition of hard work, resolutely oppose all kinds of decadent ideas and bad practices such as extravagance and waste, and promote the improvement of social atmosphere with the improvement of party style. Increase the work efforts to promote the integrity and self-discipline of leading cadres, investigate and deal with cases of violations of laws and disciplines, and correct unhealthy practices in departments and industries. Establish and implement the code of conduct for Party members and leading cadres, improve the internal supervision mechanism of the Party, and strictly manage the daily education of leading cadres.

深入,从而使我们的马克思主义水平从总体上有一个较大的提高。
translated_text: From January 6 to 24, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the United Front Work Department of the CPC Central Committee, and the Party School of the CPC Central Committee jointly held a special seminar on the united front and multi-party cooperation for provincial and ministerial cadres in Beijing. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, attended the seminar and delivered an important speech. Hu Jintao emphasized that strengthening the construction of the leadership team and the backbone team of leaders is a key link in the self-construction of the democratic parties and the Federation of Industry and Commerce, and is also an important part of consolidating and developing the multi-party cooperation led by the Communist Party of China. Strengthening the construction of the leadership team of democratic parties is fundamentally about continuously improving the ideological and political quality of the backbone leaders at all levels. On January 24, Li Ruihuan, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, also delivered an important speech at the end of the seminar. He pointed out that since the reform and opening up, the scientific and cultural level of cadres at all levels has greatly improved. This is a major achievement in the construction of the cadre team and an important guarantee for the continuous development of various undertakings. However, there is a phenomenon that should be noted, that is, some leading cadres have rich knowledge of natural sciences, but lack comprehensive social knowledge. Some comrades even lack some basic common sense in the field of social sciences and some basic theories of Marxism. There is no doubt that learning natural sciences and mastering various natural science professional knowledge is very important, and we must always vigorously promote it. However, for our leading cadres, especially senior cadres, if they lack Marxist theoretical literacy and social science knowledge, it is difficult to form a correct way of thinking, and they cannot observe and grasp the development of the world from a general perspective, so as to correctly solve various complex problems. The older generation of leaders of our party and various democratic parties attach great importance to social sciences, and many people have never been separated from the study and research of social sciences throughout their lives. It can be said that without their research and development in the field of social sciences, it would be difficult to imagine the victory of the Chinese revolution. Today, it can also be said that without the research and development of the vast number of cadres, especially leading cadres, in the field of social sciences, it is also difficult to imagine the victory of the cause of socialism with Chinese characteristics. The collective leadership of the CPC Central Committee with Comrade Jiang Zemin as the core attaches great importance to social sciences. It not only advocates them vigorously throughout the Party, but also sets an example by studying and researching them. It is hoped that our leading cadres, including those of the democratic parties, will attach importance to studying social sciences, persist in it for a long time, and continue to deepen their study, so that our overall level of Marxism will be greatly improved.

The "Key Points" put forward the main tasks for 1997: (i) Focus on strengthening ideological and political construction, continue to promote the construction of leadership teams, and strive to build a high-quality cadre team; (ii) In accordance with the requirements of the Central Committee, do a good job in the relevant preparatory work for the convening of the 15th National Congress and the preparations for the replacement of local leadership teams; (iii) Vigorously promote the training and selection of outstanding young cadres; (iv) Strictly implement the "Interim Regulations on the Selection and Appointment of Party and Government Leading Cadres", deepen the reform of the cadre and personnel system, and resolutely prevent and correct unhealthy trends in the use of personnel; (v) Conscientiously implement the "Regulations on the Work of Local Committees of the Communist Party of China (Trial)", and effectively improve the leadership of leaders at all levels (6) Strengthen the construction of high-quality enterprise cadres and scientific and technological talents; (7) Vigorously strengthen the construction of grassroots party organizations with a focus on rural areas and state-owned enterprises, and comprehensively improve the combat effectiveness of grassroots party organizations; (8) Deepen the "double learning" activities, strengthen the construction of party members, and further maintain the purity and advancement of the party members; (9) Further strengthen the work of veteran cadres, continue to earnestly implement the political and living benefits of veteran cadres, and give full play to the important role of veteran cadres in the construction of two civilizations; (10) Further strengthen the construction of the organization department itself and comprehensively improve the quality of organization cadres.

translated_text: From the 8th to the 10th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee held a national symposium on veteran cadres in Beijing. 11日 中共中央印发《关于进一步做好文艺工作的若干意
见》。
《意见》指出,社会主义文艺是我们党领导的革命和建设事业
的重要组成部分,是精神文明建设的一条重要战线。社会主义文艺
以自己的独特形式和魅力,反映改革开放和社会主义现代化建设
的现实生活,讴歌人民群众创造历史的奋发精神,塑造生动感人的
艺术形象,对振奋民族精神,陶冶道德情操,提高审美情趣,丰富文
化生活,引导人们追求真善美,有着不可替代的作用。文艺担负着
培育有理想、有道德、有文化、有纪律的社会主义公民,激励人民群
众积极投身建设有中国特色社会主义事业的光荣使命。文艺必须
坚持为人民服务、为社会主义服务的方向;坚持百花齐放,百家争
鸣的方针。
《意见》指出,繁荣发展社会主义文艺,必须加强和改善党对文
艺工作的领导。要正确制定文艺方针政策,积极倡导文艺工作者学
习马克思列宁主义、毛泽东思想,特别是邓小平建设有中国特色社
会主义理论,充分发挥广大文艺工作者的积极性,保证文艺发展的
正确方向。各级党委及其宣传文化主管部门要尊重文艺发展的规
律,尊重作家、艺术家的创造性劳动,既要注意防止横加干预,又不
能听之任之,真正做到团结鼓励、尊重信任、热情帮助,正确引导。
《意见》还指出,切实加强文艺界党组织的思想建设、组织建设
和作风建设,增强党组织的凝聚力和战斗力。按照干部队伍“四
化”方针和德才兼备的原则,配备好文艺部门和单位的领导班子,
特别要注意培养和选拔坚持党的路线方针政策、实绩突出,群众信
任的年轻干部。各级领导班子成员要加强理论学习,牢固树立政治
意识、大局意识、责任意识,充分发扬民主,广泛听取意见,自觉接
受群众监督。党员文艺工作者首先是共产党员,必须遵守党章,按
照党员标准严格要求自己,在群众中作出表率。
《意见》最后指出,党的领导干部和各级宣传文化工作部门要
密切同广大文艺工作者的联系,广交深交朋友。建立文艺通气会制
度,定期通报中央有关精神和文艺工作情况。经常与作家、艺术家
谈心,沟通思想,交换意见,帮助解决工作和生活中的实际问题。重
视发挥工会、共青团、妇联在组织文化活动、活跃群众文化生活方
面的重要作用。
translated_text: On the 11th, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Opinions on Further Improving Literature and Art Work". The "Opinions" pointed out that socialist literature and art are an important part of the revolution and construction led by our party and an important front in the construction of spiritual civilization. Socialist literature and art, with their own unique form and charm, reflect the real life of reform and opening up and socialist modernization, eulogize the people's spirit of creating history, and create vivid and touching artistic images. They play an irreplaceable role in inspiring the national spirit, cultivating moral sentiments, improving aesthetic tastes, enriching cultural life, and guiding people to pursue truth, goodness and beauty. Literature and art are responsible for cultivating socialist citizens with ideals, morality, culture and discipline, and encouraging the masses to actively participate in the construction of socialism with Chinese characteristics. Literature and art must adhere to the direction of serving the people and socialism; adhere to the principle of letting a hundred flowers bloom and a hundred schools of thought contend. The "Opinions" pointed out that in order to prosper and develop socialist literature and art, it is necessary to strengthen and improve the party's leadership over literature and art work. We must correctly formulate literary and artistic policies and actively encourage literary and artistic workers to study Marxism-Leninism, Mao Zedong Thought, and especially Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, give full play to the enthusiasm of the majority of literary and artistic workers, and ensure the correct direction of literary and artistic development. Party committees at all levels and their propaganda and cultural departments must respect the laws of literary and artistic development and the creative work of writers and artists. They must pay attention to preventing arbitrary interference, but they must not let it go, and truly achieve unity and encouragement, respect and trust, enthusiastic help, and correct guidance. The "Opinions" also pointed out that it is necessary to strengthen the ideological construction, organizational construction, and style construction of party organizations in the literary and artistic circles, and enhance the cohesion and combat effectiveness of party organizations. In accordance with the "four modernizations" policy of the cadre team and the principle of both moral integrity and ability, we must equip the leadership teams of literary and artistic departments and units, and pay special attention to cultivating and selecting young cadres who adhere to the party's line, principles, and policies, have outstanding achievements, and are trusted by the masses. Members of the leadership teams at all levels must strengthen theoretical learning, firmly establish political awareness, awareness of the overall situation, and sense of responsibility, fully promote democracy, listen to opinions widely, and consciously accept supervision from the masses. Party members and literary and artistic workers are first and foremost members of the Communist Party. They must abide by the Party Constitution, strictly demand themselves according to the standards of Party members, and set an example among the masses. The Opinion finally points out that the leading cadres of the Party and the propaganda and cultural work departments at all levels should maintain close contact with the broad masses of literary and artistic workers and make extensive and deep friends. Establish a literary and artistic briefing system to regularly report the relevant spirit of the Central Committee and the situation of literary and artistic work. Frequently talk with writers and artists, communicate ideas, exchange opinions, and help solve practical problems in work and life. Emphasize the important role of trade unions, the Communist Youth League, and the Women's Federation in organizing cultural activities and enlivening the cultural life of the masses.

须配套地抓。几年来的实践证明,抓好这三项建设,一般号召不行,
必须组织大批干部深入到村具体帮助。现在,每个县都有二、三十
名县级领导干部,每人抓一、两个村,县直七、八十个部门,每个部
门再帮助…,两个村,切实抓出成效,全县就有上百个村可以改变
面貌。各地都应当坚持不懈地这样抓,连续抓下去,使农村状况有
一个大的变化。
江泽民还指出,现在,农村改革和发展的目标、方针、政策都已
经明确了。目标能不能实现,政策能不能落实,在很大程度上取决
于我们各级干部思想作风如何。总的看,我们大多数干部廉洁奉
公、勤奋工作的,但也存在不少不容忽视的问题。有的干部为人民
服务的观念淡薄,不是尽职尽责地为群众办事,而是利用职权谋取
私利,不给好处不办事,给了好处乱办事。有的干部作风飘浮,说得
多,做得少,不深入群众,不解决实际问题。有的浮夸虚报,摆花架
子,搞形式主义。有的地方报喜藏忧,甚至对农民围攻县乡政府的
严重事件也不向上级报告。我们的干部是人民的公仆,应该满腔热
情地为群众服务,决不能高居于群众之上,更不能侵犯群众的利
益。现在,有些贫困地区的群众连吃饱饭都困难,而我们有些干部
却在那里讲排场、比阔气,奢侈之风屡禁不止。各级领导同志一定
要从自身做起,严格要求自己。每个领导干部都要联系几个不同类
型的村,交一些农民朋友,切实听到真话,了解实情,使自己的工作
符合实际情况,符合群众的意愿。党政机关每年都要组织大批干部
深入到村,特别是后进村和贫困村,落实党在农村的各项政策,帮
助农民开辟致富门路,解决群众关心的热点问题。这不仅是加强农
村工作的需要,也是培养锻炼干部、改进思想作风的需要,要长期
坚持下去。
translated_text: On the 13th, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee and President of the State, stressed in his speech at the Central Rural Work Conference that we must adhere to the two-pronged approach to rural work. The key to adhering to the two-pronged approach is to strengthen the construction of grassroots organizations in rural areas. The main thing is to ensure that there are people in charge, money to do things, and children to manage things. To solve the problem of "someone in charge", we must work hard to build village-level organizations with the party branch as the core, especially to select and assign village party branch secretaries. To solve the problem of "money to do things", we must do everything possible to develop and strengthen the strength of village-level collective economy. All localities should proceed from the actual situation and adopt various forms to actively develop collective economy. It should be noted here that we should not collect money and goods from farmers when we talk about developing collective economy, but open up new production channels. To solve the problem of "rules to manage things", we must strengthen the construction of village-level systems with democratic management as the content. We must adhere to the implementation of the system of villagers' deliberation and village affairs disclosure, and formulate village rules and folk agreements. Villagers are in charge of major village affairs, and matters that villagers are concerned about must be disclosed to the villagers. These three constructions are a unified whole with internal connections. If any one of them is taken care of in isolation, it will be difficult to achieve results. They must be taken care of in a coordinated manner. The practice in the past few years has proved that it is not enough to make general calls to do a good job in these three constructions. A large number of cadres must be organized to go deep into the villages to provide specific assistance. Now, each county has 20 to 30 county-level leading cadres, each of whom is responsible for one or two villages. There are 70 to 80 departments directly under the county, and each department will help... If two villages are effectively grasped, hundreds of villages in the county can change their appearance. All localities should persist in doing so and continue to do so to make a big change in the rural situation. Jiang Zemin also pointed out that now, the goals, principles and policies of rural reform and development have been clarified. Whether the goals can be achieved and the policies can be implemented depends to a large extent on the ideological style of our cadres at all levels. Generally speaking, most of our cadres are honest and dedicated to their work and work hard, but there are also many problems that cannot be ignored. Some cadres have a weak sense of serving the people. Instead of serving the masses with due diligence, they use their power to seek personal gain. They do not serve without benefits, and do things randomly after receiving benefits. Some cadres have a floating style, talk a lot but do little, do not go deep into the masses, and do not solve practical problems. Some are exaggerated and false, put on airs, and engage in formalism. In some places, they report good news but hide worries, and even do not report to their superiors the serious incidents of farmers besieging county and township governments. Our cadres are the servants of the people and should serve the masses with enthusiasm. They must not be above the masses, let alone infringe on the interests of the masses. Now, the masses in some poor areas have difficulty even getting enough food, but some of our cadres are there showing off and competing for extravagance, and the extravagant style has been repeatedly banned. Leaders at all levels must start with themselves and strictly demand themselves. Every leading cadre must contact several different types of villages, make some friends with farmers, and really hear the truth and understand the facts, so that their work conforms to the actual situation and the wishes of the masses. Every year, the Party and government organs organize a large number of cadres to go deep into the villages, especially the backward and poor villages, to implement the Party’s various policies in the countryside, help farmers open up ways to get rich, and solve the hot issues that the masses are concerned about. This is not only necessary to strengthen rural work, but also necessary to train and exercise cadres and improve their thinking and work style. It must be persisted in for a long time.

党员领导干部民主生活会质量的意见》。
《意见》指出,1990年中央下发《关于县以上党和国家机关党
员领导干部民主生活会的若干规定》以来,各地普遍建立了民主生
活会制度,多数单位能按期召开,对于活跃党内民主生活,加强领
导班子的思想政治建设,发挥了积极作用。但总的看,民主生活会
的质量有待进一步提高。存在的突出问题是,会议的政治性、思想
性、原则性不够强,汇报工作多,思想交锋少,批评和自我批评开展
得不认真甚至根本没有开展起来。
《意见》对提高党员领导干部民主生活会的质量提出了六条要
求:(一)进一步提高对开好领导干部民主生活会重要性的认识;
(二)明确民主生活会的目的要求,充分做好会前的准备工作;
(三)严肃认真地开展批评与自我批评;(四)党委(党组)主要负责
同志要切实负起开好民主生活会的责任;(五)抓好整改措施的制
定和落实;(六)加大对民主生活会指导和监督的力度。
translated_text: On the 14th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Opinions on Improving the Quality of Democratic Life Meetings of Party Members and Leading Cadres of Party and State Organs at or Above the County Level". The "Opinions" pointed out that since the Central Committee issued the "Several Provisions on Democratic Life Meetings of Party Members and Leading Cadres of Party and State Organs at or Above the County Level" in 1990, all localities have generally established a democratic life meeting system, and most units can hold it on schedule, which has played a positive role in invigorating democratic life within the party and strengthening the ideological and political construction of the leadership team. But in general, the quality of democratic life meetings needs to be further improved. The outstanding problems are that the political, ideological and principled nature of the meetings is not strong enough, there are more reports on work and fewer ideological confrontations, and criticism and self-criticism are not carried out seriously or even not at all. The Opinion puts forward six requirements for improving the quality of democratic life meetings for party members and leading cadres: (i) further improve the understanding of the importance of holding democratic life meetings for leading cadres; (ii) clarify the purpose and requirements of democratic life meetings and make full preparations before the meetings; (iii) conduct criticism and self-criticism seriously; (iv) the main responsible comrades of the Party Committee (Party Group) must take the responsibility of holding democratic life meetings well; (v) formulate and implement rectification measures; (vi) increase the intensity of guidance and supervision of democratic life meetings.

translated_text: On the 16th, the Organization Department and the Ministry of Personnel of the CPC Central Committee jointly issued the "Opinions on Further Improving the Work of Selecting Cadres to Go to the Countryside for Poverty Alleviation". The "Opinions" pointed out that selecting cadres to go to the countryside for poverty alleviation is an important measure to strengthen grassroots organizations and political power construction in poor areas and accelerate the progress of poverty alleviation work. It is of great significance to further strengthen the connection between the party and the government and the people and train and cultivate cadres. Party committees, governments and organizational personnel departments at all levels should consciously and actively do a good job in this work. The Opinions pointed out that the main tasks of cadres at all levels going to the countryside to help the poor are: under the unified leadership of the local party committee and government, help poor areas to strengthen the rectification and construction of rural grassroots organizations in accordance with the "five good" goals, pay special attention to cultivating and selecting leaders who can lead the masses out of poverty and become rich; conduct serious investigations and studies, help poor areas to adapt to local conditions, choose the right way to develop the economy, formulate effective plans and measures, and help implement them; focus on poverty alleviation and development, strengthen infrastructure construction, do practical and good things for poor areas; help poor areas to do a good job in the construction of rural socialist spiritual civilization, help cadres and the masses to cheer up, update their concepts, and improve their ability to get rid of poverty and become rich; help poor areas put forward opinions and suggestions for improving poverty alleviation and development, etc. The above tasks can be focused on by local governments and departments according to actual conditions, and further specified.

The "Points" pointed out that in the new year, the work of party building should be carried out in accordance with the overall deployment of the Central Committee, guided by Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and the basic line of the Party, and thoroughly implement the spirit of the Fourth, Fifth and Sixth Plenary Sessions of the 14th CPC Central Committee and the Central Economic Work Conference. Adhere to the general goal of party building in the new era, focus on economic construction, firmly grasp the overall situation of the work of the whole party and the whole country, closely combine the practice of reform, development and stability, grasp the fundamental of arming the whole party with basic theory, highlight the focus of building a high-quality cadre team, do not relax the work of laying the foundation at the grassroots level, comprehensively promote the great project of party building, and provide a strong political and organizational guarantee for achieving the goals of reform and development in 1997. The "Points" include the following contents: (a) Do a more solid and effective job in arming the whole party with Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics. (b) Strengthen the construction of the leadership team and strive to build a high-quality cadre team. (3) Effectively promote the construction of democratic centralism, invigorate the life within the party, and enhance the unity and solidarity of the party. (4) Further strengthen the construction of the party's grassroots organizations and improve the combat effectiveness of grassroots party organizations. (5) Further strengthen the relationship between the party and the masses, increase the efforts of party style construction and clean government construction, and promote the continued in-depth development of the anti-corruption struggle. (6) Strengthen and improve the leadership of the party committee over party building work and further improve the level of party building work.

translated_text: On the 21st, the Party Work Conference of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China was held in Beijing. Zeng Qinghong, Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China’s Directly Affiliated Institutions Working Committee, delivered an important speech at the conference. Zeng Qinghong pointed out that the general requirements for the work of the central government agencies in 1997 are to take Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics as the guide, fully implement the party's basic line and basic policies, further implement the 14th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and a series of strategic deployments since the 14th National Congress, continue to focus on the party's ideological and political construction and grassroots organization construction, and carry out in-depth "double learning" and "three lectures" education activities; further strengthen and improve the party's grassroots organization construction, strive to improve the cohesion and combat effectiveness of the party organization, unremittingly grasp the party style and clean government construction, and carry out in-depth anti-corruption struggles; strengthen ideological and moral construction, and carry out the creation of civilized agencies activities: to comprehensively improve the level of party organization construction in agencies and promote the development of two civilizations. Zeng Qinghong finally pointed out that in the new year, we must seize the current favorable opportunity to strengthen party building under the leadership of the Party Central Committee with Comrade Jiang Zemin as the core, make persistent efforts, and work together to welcome the convening of the 15th National Congress of the Communist Party of China with practical actions based on our duties and solid work and outstanding achievements in promoting the coordinated development of two civilizations. The meeting was chaired by Gu Yunfei, executive deputy secretary of the Central Working Committee, and attended by the party secretary and full-time deputy secretary of the Central Organs.

24日 中共中央发出《关于进一步加强和改进国有企业党的
建设工作的通知》。
《通知》指出,坚持党对国有企业的政治领导,是一个重大原则
问题,任何时候都不能动摇。党对国有企业的政治领导,主要体现
在:坚持国有企业的社会主义方向,保证党的路线、方针、政策和国
家法律、法规在企业贯彻执行:坚持党管干部的原则,按照管理权
限,依法选派,推荐国有资产产权代表和企业经营管理负责人,并
对他们实施教育、培养、考核、监督;坚持发挥企业党组织的政治核
心作用和党员的先锋模范作用。强调坚持党对国有企业的政治领
导,但不能以党代政,以党代企。
《通知》指出,新形势下的企业党建工作,要坚持以马列主义、
毛泽东思想特别是邓小平建设有中国特色社会主义理论为指导,
坚持党的“一个中心,两个基本点”的基本路线,紧紧围绕企业改革
和生产经营来进行,坚持党要管党、从严治党的方针,从政治、思
想、组织和作风上全面加强党的建设,充分发挥党组织的政治核心
作用,促进企业的物质文明和精神文明建设。
《通知》要求,各级地方党委和有关部门党组要高度重视国有
企业党建工作,列入重要日程,常抓不懈。党委主要领导同志要亲
自抓,组织部门要会同有关部门切实负起具体指导责任。各有关经
济部门党组在抓好企业改革、发展的同时,也要重视企业党建和思
想政治工作。在部署,检查工作时,要统筹兼顾,做到两项工作一起
抓,两个责任一起负,使经济工作和党的建设相互促进。在党委统
·领导下,把党政有关部门和企业等各方面的力量组织起来,按照
中央精神统一思想,协调行动,各司其职,各负其责。
《通知》还要求,对国有企业党建工作的领导,重在督促检查,
认真解决存在的问题。对软弱涣散、问题较多的企业领导班子,上
级党组织要派得力干部深入企业帮助整顿、调整。对企业党组织和
工作机构的设置,党务工作者的选配,党组织的领导关系等问题.
上级党组织要及时提出指导性意见,发现问题,及时解决。
translated_text: On the 24th, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on Further Strengthening and Improving the Party Building Work in State-owned Enterprises". The "Notice" pointed out that adhering to the party's political leadership over state-owned enterprises is a major principle issue that cannot be shaken at any time. The party's political leadership over state-owned enterprises is mainly reflected in: adhering to the socialist direction of state-owned enterprises, ensuring the implementation of the party's line, principles, policies and national laws and regulations in enterprises; adhering to the principle of party management of cadres, selecting and recommending representatives of state-owned assets and persons in charge of enterprise management in accordance with management authority and in accordance with the law, and educating, training, assessing and supervising them; adhering to the political core role of enterprise party organizations and the vanguard and exemplary role of party members. Emphasize the adherence to the party's political leadership over state-owned enterprises, but the party cannot replace the government or the enterprise. The Notice points out that the party building work of enterprises under the new situation should be guided by Marxism-Leninism, Mao Zedong Thought, especially Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, adhere to the party's basic line of "one center, two basic points", closely focus on enterprise reform and production and operation, adhere to the principle of the party's control and strict governance, comprehensively strengthen party building in terms of politics, ideology, organization and style, give full play to the political core role of party organizations, and promote the material and spiritual civilization of enterprises. The Notice requires that local party committees at all levels and party groups of relevant departments should attach great importance to the party building work of state-owned enterprises, put it on the important agenda, and always work hard. The main leading comrades of the party committee should personally take charge of it, and the organization department should work with relevant departments to effectively assume the specific guidance responsibility. While doing a good job in enterprise reform and development, the party groups of relevant economic departments should also pay attention to enterprise party building and ideological and political work. When deploying and inspecting work, we must take a comprehensive approach, do both work together, and bear both responsibilities together, so that economic work and party building can promote each other. Under the unified leadership of the Party Committee, the forces of the relevant party and government departments and enterprises should be organized to unify thoughts and coordinate actions in accordance with the spirit of the Central Committee, and each should perform its duties and bear its responsibilities. The "Notice" also requires that the leadership of the party building work of state-owned enterprises should focus on supervision and inspection, and earnestly solve existing problems. For weak and lax enterprise leadership teams with many problems, the higher-level party organizations should send capable cadres to go deep into the enterprises to help rectify and adjust. Regarding the establishment of enterprise party organizations and work institutions, the selection of party workers, and the leadership relationship of party organizations, the higher-level party organizations should promptly put forward guiding opinions, discover problems, and solve them in a timely manner.

列宁主义、毛泽东思想和邓小平建设有中国特色社会主义理论,紧

translated_text: On the 29th, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee and President of the State, delivered an important speech entitled "Vigorously Carry Forward the Spirit of Hard Struggle" at the 8th Plenary Session of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection. He first affirmed the achievements made in the fight against corruption and the building of a clean and honest Party style in 1996. At the same time, he pointed out the long-term and arduous nature of the fight against corruption and the building of a clean and honest Party style in the process of reform, opening up and modernization. He required Party committees and governments at all levels to deepen their understanding of the seriousness and urgency of fighting corruption and promoting integrity from a strategic and overall perspective, to enhance their awareness of the principle of "grasping both sides and making both sides strong", to effectively strengthen the leadership of the fight against corruption and the building of a clean and honest Party style, and to never take it lightly, to never stop in the face of difficulties, and to never slacken their fighting spirit. All localities and departments should combine the promotion of reform, opening up and modernization with greater determination, greater efforts and more solid work to actively promote the integrity and self-discipline of leading cadres, investigate and deal with cases of violations of laws and disciplines, and correct unhealthy practices in departments and industries. Jiang Zemin pointed out that we must form a good atmosphere of hard work and struggle throughout the country. First of all, the party should promote the spirit of hard work, simplicity, diligence and thrift. Strictly control the construction of new office buildings at all levels of party and government agencies, and vigorously streamline meetings. No meetings that can be held or not should be held, and the cost of meetings should be greatly reduced. The numerous commemorative meetings, seminars, and press conferences should be strictly controlled and reduced to the minimum. Gifts and so-called souvenirs should be prohibited at all meetings. In short, in all aspects, we must pay attention to careful budgeting and practice strict economy. Jiang Zemin pointed out that for Communist Party members and leading cadres at all levels, maintaining and carrying forward the spirit of hard struggle is, in the final analysis, to firmly establish and adhere to the Marxist world outlook and outlook on life. Only by fundamentally solving the world outlook and outlook on life and firmly establishing the mass viewpoint can the party's good tradition of hard struggle truly take root in their own thoughts and work style. This requires the majority of party members and leading cadres at all levels to study Marxism-Leninism, Mao Zedong Thought and Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics diligently, closely combine with the developing social practice, and constantly and seriously transform the subjective world so that they can truly have a noble spiritual realm. Some cadres do not study theory seriously, which is by no means a qualified cadre. It is difficult to achieve good results if we learn theory in conjunction with practice and do not pay attention to solving problems in world outlook and outlook on life. Our cadres at all levels must bear in mind that they are the people's servants, all work is for the masses, and they must rely on the masses to do a good job. We must respectfully learn from the masses, learn the good qualities and good work style of the masses, and learn the fine traditions of the Chinese nation and the fine traditions of the party. One of the great strengths and advantages of our Party is that it organically combines the establishment of a Marxist world outlook and outlook on life with the adherence to and development of the fine traditions of the Chinese nation, and emphasizes the ideological and moral cultivation of individual Communist Party members. Comrade Liu Shaoqi wrote a book entitled "On the Cultivation of Communist Party Members" specifically on this issue. In the revolutionary war years, Party members and cadres had to emphasize personal cultivation; now that the Party is in power and is carrying out reform and opening up and modernization, Party members and cadres must also emphasize personal cultivation. I think it is necessary to reiterate and emphasize this issue now. Jiang Zemin finally pointed out that for Communist Party members and cadres at all levels, maintaining and carrying forward the spirit of hard work is also a test of political stance, political views, and political discernment. Party organizations at all levels must strictly manage their inner-Party life and actively carry out criticism and self-criticism. In the issue of employing people, we must adhere to principles and pay great attention to whether there is a spirit and morality of hard work and conscious dedication. Cadres who are afraid of hardship, pursue enjoyment, and are extravagant and wasteful should not be reused. Leading cadres must not only manage themselves well, but also manage their spouses, children, and staff around them. The central government has made regulations on this issue in the past, requiring discipline inspection and supervision agencies to strengthen supervision and inspection and resolutely correct any problems found.

translated_text:
On the 4th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee forwarded the "Implementation Measures of the CPC Central Commission for Discipline Inspection on Reaffirming and Establishing the Five Inner-Party Supervision Systems"). The "Measures" pointed out that in order to further improve and strengthen the inner-party supervision mechanism, give full play to the supervisory role of the Party's Discipline Inspection Commission on party and government leading cadres, especially provincial (ministerial) level leading cadres, in accordance with the spirit of strict requirements, strict management and strict supervision of cadres, on the premise of adhering to the current leadership system of the Party's Discipline Inspection Commission, reaffirm and establish the five inner-party supervision systems, and formulate the following implementation measures accordingly. (I) In accordance with the relevant spirit of the "Decision of the CPC Central Committee on Strengthening the Party's Ties with the People" adopted by the Sixth Plenary Session of the 13th CPC Central Committee, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection selects provincial (ministerial) level cadres to inspect localities and departments according to work needs. Their task is to understand the implementation of the party's line, principles, policies and clean governance by the leading bodies and members of provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities directly under the Central Government and central and state organs and ministries, and report the relevant situation directly to the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, which will report to the Party Central Committee in a timely manner. (2) If the local and departmental Party Commissions (Discipline Inspection Groups) discover that the Party committees (Party groups) at the same level or their members have violated the Party discipline, they have the right to conduct preliminary verification and report directly to the higher-level Disciplinary Inspection Committee. No organization or individual may interfere or obstruct. If a case needs to be filed for inspection, it shall be reported for approval in accordance with the Party Constitution and relevant regulations. If the Commissions (Discipline Inspection Groups) encounter such problems and fail to report them, they will be derelict of duty and will be held accountable in serious cases.
(3) If the local and departmental Party Commissions (Discipline Inspection Groups) receive reports and accusations against members of the Party committees (Party groups) at the next level, they must report them to the higher-level Disciplinary Inspection Committee. No one has the right to withhold them. Anyone who violates the rules must be held accountable and dealt with seriously.
(4) For the promotion and appointment of major leading cadres at the local and departmental levels, the Party Organization Department shall seek the opinions of the Commissions (Discipline Inspection Groups) at the same level before submitting them to the Party committees (Party groups) for discussion and decision. (V) The nomination, appointment, removal, part-time job and transfer of leading cadres of discipline inspection and supervision organs at all levels must be approved by the higher-level discipline inspection and supervision organs in advance by the organization and personnel departments at all levels.

events: 中国共产党中央委员会、中华人民共和国全国人民代表大会常务委员会、中华人民共和国国务院、中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会、中国共产党和中华人民共和国中央军事委员会,极其悲痛地向全党全军全国各族人民通告:我们敬爱的邓小平同志患帕金森病晚期,并发肺部感染,因呼吸循环功能衰竭,抢救无效,于1997年2月19日21时零8分在北京逝世,享年93岁邓小平是全党全军全国各族人民公认的享有崇高威望的卓越领导人,伟大的马克思主义者,伟大的无产阶级革命家、政治家、军事家、外交家,久经考验的共产主义战士,中国社会主义改革开放和现代化建设的总设计师,建设有中国特色社会主义理论的创立者。邓小平的一生,是光辉的战斗的一生。在70多年波澜壮阔的革命生涯中,他为中国新民主主义革命的胜利和新中国的成立,为中国社会主义的创建、巩固和发展,建立了永不磨灭的功勋。
translated_text: On the 15th, Comrade Liu Jingji, Vice Chairman of the 8th National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, Honorary Vice Chairman of the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce, Vice Chairman of the 8th Shanghai CPPCC, Chairman of the Shanghai Federation of Industry and Commerce, and Advisor to the Central Committee of the China Democratic National Construction Association, died of illness in Shanghai at the age of 95. The Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress of the People's Republic of China, the State Council of the People's Republic of China, the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, the Communist Party of China and the Central Military Commission of the People's Republic of China, with great sorrow, inform the whole Party, the whole army and the people of all ethnic groups in the country that our beloved Comrade Deng Xiaoping died in Beijing at 21:08 on February 19, 1997 at the age of 93 due to respiratory and circulatory failure and ineffective rescue. Deng Xiaoping was an outstanding leader with high prestige recognized by the whole Party, the whole army and the people of all ethnic groups in the country, a great Marxist, a great proletarian revolutionary, politician, military strategist, diplomat, a time-tested communist fighter, the chief architect of China's socialist reform and opening up and modernization, and the founder of the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics. Deng Xiaoping's life was a glorious and fighting life. In his magnificent revolutionary career of more than 70 years, he made indelible contributions to the victory of China's new democratic revolution and the founding of New China, and to the creation, consolidation and development of Chinese socialism.

26日 全国党建研究会、中共中央组织部党建研究所《党建
研究》杂志社在京举行座谈会,缅怀邓小平对党建理论的巨大贡
献。中纪委、中央政策研究室、中央宣传部、中央统战部、中央党校、
中央文献研究室等有关方面负责同志吕枫、李力安、李正亭、郑科
扬、傅杰、刘延东、戴舟、冷溶、蔡长水、彭清华等先后在座谈会上发
言。
与会者指出.邓小平同志给中国人民留下的最宝贵的财富,是
他所创立的建设有中国特色社会主义理论。在这一理论体系中,关
于新时期执政党建设的理论占有重要地位。邓小平把马克思主义
建党学说的基本原理同当代中国实际和时代特征相结合,科学总
结中国共产党建设的历史经验并借鉴世界社会主义运动的经验教
训,对在改革开放和社会主义现代化建设中执政党的建设进行了
大量的探索,作出了高度的理论概括,极大地丰富了马克思主义建
党学说理论宝库。
座谈会由中央组织部副部长虞云耀主持。
translated_text:
On the 26th, the National Party Building Research Association and the Party Building Research Institute of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee held a symposium in Beijing to commemorate Deng Xiaoping's great contribution to the theory of party building. Responsible comrades from the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, the Central Policy Research Office, the Central Propaganda Department, the Central United Front Work Department, the Central Party School, the Central Document Research Office, such as Lv Feng, Li Lian, Li Zhengting, Zheng Keyang, Fu Jie, Liu Yandong, Dai Zhou, Leng Rong, Cai Changshui, Peng Qinghua, etc. spoke at the symposium. Participants pointed out that the most valuable asset Comrade Deng Xiaoping left to the Chinese people was the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics he founded. In this theoretical system, the theory of building the ruling party in the new era occupies an important position. Deng Xiaoping combined the basic principles of Marxist party building theory with the reality of contemporary China and the characteristics of the times, scientifically summarized the historical experience of the construction of the Communist Party of China and drew lessons from the experience and lessons of the world socialist movement, conducted a lot of exploration on the construction of the ruling party in reform and opening up and socialist modernization, made a high degree of theoretical summary, and greatly enriched the theoretical treasure house of Marxist party building theory.
The symposium was chaired by Yu Yunyao, Deputy Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee.

translated_text: On the 28th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on the Summary of the Rotational Training of Organization Department Cadres Nationwide". In particular, we must attach great importance to the outstanding problems and solve them seriously to ensure that the policies and guidelines of the party's organization cadre work are fully and correctly implemented. The objects of this rotation training have been expanded from cadres in the organization system to organizational personnel cadres in various business systems and grassroots enterprises and institutions. According to statistics from 30 provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities, by the end of 1996, 248,000 people had been trained, accounting for 94.7% of the 262,000 people who should be trained; the vast majority of central state organs and ministries have completed the rotation training tasks. The Central Organization Department has completed the task of training 477 people, including the heads and deputy heads of the Organization Departments of the Party Committees of provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities, and the heads and deputy heads of the cadres (personnel) departments and bureaus of the central state organs and commissions. The Organization Departments of the Party Committees of 30 provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities and most of the central state organs and commissions have completed the task of organizing the classes they are directly responsible for. The vast majority of prefectures (cities) and counties have completed the training plan. In addition, due to the late start of training in some provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities and the change of terms of township party committees, the training of personnel cadres of some directly affiliated units, enterprises and institutions in some counties and cities will be completed in the first half of 1997.

translated_text: On the 3rd, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the State Economic and Trade Commission, the Ministry of Personnel, and the All-China Federation of Trade Unions jointly issued the "Notice on Doing a Good Job in the Assessment and Construction of State-owned Enterprise Leadership Teams". The "Notice" pointed out that the guiding ideology of the assessment and construction of state-owned enterprise leadership teams is to follow the guidance of Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and the basic line of the Party, implement the spirit of a series of important speeches by Comrade Jiang Zemin on the reform, development and construction of enterprise leadership teams of state-owned enterprises, and follow the requirements put forward by the 1996 Central Economic Work Conference and the National State-owned Enterprise Party Building Work Conference. On the basis of a general and serious assessment of the leadership teams of state-owned enterprises, effective measures should be taken to address existing problems, optimize the team structure, improve the political quality of enterprise leaders and their management capabilities under the conditions of a socialist market economy, and provide organizational guarantees for deepening the reform of state-owned enterprises and promoting enterprise development. The "Notice" pointed out that the focus of this assessment and construction work is to do a good job in the leadership teams of large and medium-sized state-owned enterprises, first of all, enterprises with serious operating losses, where employees have more complaints, and where there are more internal contradictions and problems. Through assessment and construction work, we strive to achieve the following goals: First, build a leadership team that resolutely implements the principles and policies of the Party and the State, is politically strong, united and coordinated, especially with a good factory director (manager), party committee secretary, and chairman; second, further change concepts, enhance reform awareness, improve management level and the ability to drive enterprises to the market and win in competition; third, establish a set of practical and relatively standardized leadership team work system, form a clear division of power and responsibility within the enterprise, and mobilize the enthusiasm of all parties; fourth, be strict with oneself, be honest and upright, safeguard the rights and interests of the state and other owners, and safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of employees. The "Notice" also puts forward specific requirements for the objects, content and methods of assessment, measures to strengthen leadership team construction, and strengthen the organizational leadership of assessment and construction of state-owned enterprise leadership teams.

国家机关干部监督工作座谈会上讲话的通知》。
中央组织部副部长武连元在讲话中指出,加强干部监督工作
十分必要。腐败现象的存在,对我党有着极大的危害,这一点我们
必须有清醒的认识,不能掉以轻心,放任自流,任其发展。腐败分子
人数虽少,但影响坏,危害极大,发展下去就会使我们脱离群众。群
众不拥护我们,事业还能成功吗?国家还能长治久安吗?如果对那
些腐败,不廉洁的现象不制止,不处理,就会像病毒似的蔓延下去,
腐蚀我们党的肌体,甚至使国家的大好形势付之东流,把先辈们流
血牺牲换来的社会主义中国断送掉,就有亡党亡国的危险,这决不
是危言耸听。要努力加强对干部的监督,对腐败问题发现一个,处
理一个,并努力把它消除在萌芽状态,使其危害越来越小,这样我
们党和国家才会兴旺发达。
武连元指出,干部监督工作的目的主要有两个:一是为适应改
革开放、建设有中国特色社会主义的需要,不断提高干部队伍的素
质;二是出于关心、爱护干部,使每个干部不犯错误或少犯错误,能
够健康地成长。对干部的监督管理,要以预防为主,不能等干部犯
了错误,甚至犯罪进了监狱再去教育,那就晚了。我们搞干部监督
与纪检部门抓监督,目标是一致的,但也有区别。我们主要是宏观
管理,寓监督于经常性的培养、教育、考察和任免工作过程中。监督
的主要内容是:(一)政治立场、观点方面的监督。看干部是否能用
邓小平建设有中国特色社会主义理论的立场、观点、方法分析、处
理问题,是否有坚定的共产主义信念和无产阶级的世界观、人生
观。工作上是否能考虑大局,以国家的利益为重,能否坚持党的基
本路线不动摇,坚定地在政治上与江泽民同志为核心的党中央
保持一致。(二)组织纪律性方面的监督。看干部能否在思想、工作、
生活、作风等一切方面,用党章来规范、约束自己的言行,无论在大
事、小事、公事和私事上,都用党的纪律严格要求自己。党要求做
的,坚决去做,不让做的,就坚决不做,绝不搞上有政策,下有对策。
(三)思想作风和意识方面的监督。说起对意识方面的监督,似乎抽
象,但通过日积月累,长期的观察就可以了解到,看他工作踏不踏
实,对组织是不是忠诚老实,搞虚报浮夸的就是不老实,干部之所
以犯错误,不老实也是一个重要原因。有些人总想当官,跑官要官,
还有的搞关系,走后门,拉帮结派,居功自傲,打击别人,抬高自己,

translated_text: On the 13th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on Comrade Wu Lian's Speech at the Symposium on the Supervision of Cadres in Some Central and State Organs". Wu Lianyuan, deputy director of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, pointed out in his speech that it is very necessary to strengthen the supervision of cadres. The existence of corruption is extremely harmful to our party. We must have a clear understanding of this and cannot take it lightly, let it go, and let it develop. Although the number of corrupt elements is small, their influence is bad and the harm is great. If they continue to develop, they will make us separate from the masses. If the masses do not support us, can our cause succeed? Can the country still maintain long-term stability? If those corrupt and dishonest phenomena are not stopped and dealt with, they will spread like a virus, corrode the body of our party, and even make the good situation of the country go to waste, and ruin the socialist China that our ancestors shed blood and sacrificed. There is a danger of the destruction of the party and the country. This is by no means alarmist. We must strive to strengthen the supervision of cadres, find and deal with corruption problems, and strive to eliminate them in the bud, so that their harm is getting smaller and smaller, so that our party and country will prosper. Wu Lianyuan pointed out that there are two main purposes of cadre supervision: one is to meet the needs of reform and opening up and building socialism with Chinese characteristics, and constantly improve the quality of the cadre team; the other is to care for and love cadres, so that each cadre will not make mistakes or make fewer mistakes and can grow up healthily. Supervision and management of cadres should be based on prevention. We cannot wait until cadres make mistakes or even commit crimes and go to prison to educate them, because that will be too late. Our cadre supervision and the discipline inspection department's supervision have the same goals, but there are also differences. We mainly focus on macro management, and incorporate supervision into the regular training, education, inspection and appointment and removal process. The main content of supervision is: (a) Supervision of political stance and viewpoints. See whether cadres can use the stance, viewpoints and methods of Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics to analyze and deal with problems, and whether they have firm communist beliefs and the proletarian world outlook and outlook on life. Whether they can consider the overall situation and put the interests of the country first in their work, whether they can adhere to the basic line of the Party and remain politically consistent with the Party Central Committee with Comrade Jiang Zemin as the core. (II) Supervision of organizational discipline. See whether cadres can use the Party Constitution to regulate and restrain their words and deeds in all aspects such as thought, work, life, and style, and strictly demand themselves with the Party's discipline in major and minor matters, public and private matters. Do what the Party requires, and do not do what the Party does not allow. Never have a policy above and a countermeasure below. (III) Supervision of thought, style and consciousness. Speaking of supervision of consciousness, it seems abstract, but through accumulation and long-term observation, we can understand whether he works steadily and is loyal and honest to the organization. Those who make false reports and exaggerations are dishonest. Dishonesty is also an important reason why cadres make mistakes. Some people always want to be officials, run for office and seek official positions, and some have connections, use backdoors, form cliques, take credit for themselves, attack others and elevate themselves. Such people will fall sooner or later. (IV) Supervision in the implementation of democratic centralism. Adhering to democratic centralism is the essence of our party building. Whether the party organization is strong and powerful depends on whether democratic centralism is implemented seriously and can prevent individual dictatorship. This is effective management and supervision of cadres. But this is easier said than done. Some leading cadres are unwilling to act according to the principles of democratic centralism and like to have the final say. It must be seen that if our party does not implement democratic centralism seriously and seriously, it will also be in danger of the party and the country being destroyed. (V) Supervision in the mass viewpoint and implementation of the mass line. Past lessons tell us that if a cadre is separated from the masses, it is impossible to seek benefits for the masses and unite and lead the masses to work. Therefore, in supervising cadres, we must pay attention to whether the cadres can think about the masses, keep the masses in mind, and care about the sufferings of the masses. Ultimately, it depends on whether the cadres always adhere to the purpose of serving the people wholeheartedly.
