In order to implement this requirement put forward by the Central Committee, with the approval of the central leaders, the Office of the Central Financial and Economic Leading Group compiled the "Outline of Deng Xiaoping's Economic Theory". Comrade Jiang Zemin wrote a preface for this book entitled "Persist in Deepening the Study of Deng Xiaoping's Theory of Building Socialism with Chinese Characteristics". This "Outline" reflects the scientific system of Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and its main content and basic viewpoints in a relatively comprehensive and accurate manner. It is an important auxiliary material for county-level and above leaders to deeply study the "Selected Works of Deng Xiaoping" and the theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics. It can also be read by the majority of party members and the masses. Party committees at all levels should continue to organize cadres and party members to study Comrade Xiaoping's original works in depth, incorporate the study of the Outline of Deng Xiaoping's Economic Theory into the study plan of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, pay attention to comprehensively and accurately learning and mastering the spiritual essence of Deng Xiaoping's economic theory, and consciously use it to guide and promote the practice of reform and opening up and socialist modernization.

translated_text: On the 21st, the National Coordination Group for Strengthening the Construction of State-owned Enterprise Leadership Teams held a symposium on the assessment and construction of state-owned enterprise leadership teams in Beijing. Responsible comrades from some units of the central state organs attended the meeting. Zhang Quanjing, head of the National Coordination Group for Strengthening the Construction of State-owned Enterprise Leadership Teams and Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, spoke at the meeting. He asked leaders from all regions and departments to take the lead in learning and understanding the "Notice on Further Strengthening and Improving the Party Building Work in State-owned Enterprises" recently issued by the CPC Central Committee and the "Notice on Doing a Good Job in the Assessment and Construction of State-owned Enterprise Leadership Teams" jointly issued by the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and other four departments, and to fully realize that running state-owned enterprises well is not only a major economic issue, but also a major political issue. He said that the key to running state-owned enterprises well is to have a good leadership team. Zhang Quanjing pointed out that all localities and departments should follow the spirit of the two "Notices" and vigorously strengthen the party work in enterprises, earnestly grasp the assessment and construction of state-owned enterprise leadership teams, grasp them effectively, strengthen investigation and research, and find out the basic situation of enterprise leadership teams; focus on the leadership teams of large and medium-sized state-owned enterprises, first of all, those with serious operating losses, employees with more complaints, and more internal contradictions and problems. On the basis of assessing the leadership teams of state-owned enterprises, the overall quality of the leadership teams of state-owned enterprises should be improved through ideological education and rectification, organizational adjustments, strengthening training, and improving systems. For leadership teams that need organizational adjustments, they should be adjusted decisively. For members of the leadership team, those who are found to be incompetent and unqualified after assessment should be demoted or removed from their posts and cannot be "relocated"; those who are inferior should be appropriately adjusted; those who make decisions erroneously and cause major losses due to arbitrary behavior should be severely dealt with; those who abuse power, use power for personal gain, squander and embezzle state funds should be resolutely investigated and punished, and no leniency should be shown. Zhang Quanjing stressed that all localities and departments should strengthen the organizational leadership of the assessment and construction of state-owned enterprise leadership teams, put this work on the important agenda, and the main responsible comrades should personally take charge. Attention should be paid to summarizing and promoting good experiences, promoting work on the surface, and ensuring that the assessment and construction tasks of state-owned enterprise leadership teams are completed on time and with high quality through effective work. Leaders of the Ministry of Railways, the Ministry of Metallurgy, China Ordnance Industry Corporation, China National Petroleum Corporation, the Civil Aviation Administration of China, the Ministry of Electric Power, the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications and other units successively made key speeches at the meeting and exchanged views on the assessment and construction of state-owned enterprise leadership teams.

张全景在讲话中指出,选拔年轻干部,要坚持德才兼备的原
则,要看干部的本质,看干部的主流。干部工作难做,难在什么地

统一的原则,统一的政策,关键在于具体情况具体分析。要从实际
出发,划清用人上的是非界限。在选拔年轻干部上,要特别注重干
部的政治表现和道德品质。有的人沉湎于酒楼舞厅、迷恋于吃喝玩
乐,有的人跑官要官,有的人私欲严重,有这些毛病没有改正的人,
不能提拔重用。要从讲政治的高度看待这些问题,这些人在政治上
是不可靠的。
张全景指出,从目前选拔任用干部的情况来看,绝大多数的地
方和部门能按照《条例》办事,绝大多数干部也能够正确对待自己。
但是,我们也应当看到,用人上的不正之风和腐败现象仍然是很严
重的。今后,对跑官要官的,组织部门要记录在案,在他没有改正错
误之前,不得提拔。有一些人很会替自己打算,善于包装自己,千方
百计谋取个人的升迁。对这样的人,我们应该向他大喝一声,甚至
要猛击一掌,促使他翻然悔悟,迷途知返,不要再跑官要官。我们
用干部.首先是把政治思想素质放在第一位。有的人也可能有一定
能力,或者做出了一些成绩,但对于一个共产党员来说,这是应该
的,不能作为跑官要官的资本,跑官要官本身就说明其思想意识是
不健康的,要严肃地批评教育。还有的行賄受賄,买官卖官,有的骗
官。对此,要依法从严惩处。对以不正当手段谋取到官职的,要坚
决撤下来,并严肃处理有关人员。组织人事工作干部,要“讲学习、
讲政治､讲正气”,要有政治警惕性、政治敏锐性。有些骗子能够得
逞,和我们一些同志丧失政治警惕性或者工作上的马虎有关。只要
提高警惕,严谨细致,就不难识别出来。黑龙江省委组织部在办理
一个“干部”调入过程中,看到档案袋的密封不符合规定,任免呈报
表也有疑问,经审核原来是个骗子。但是,也有些人一听来头大,就
失去了警惕性,结果出了问题。现在还有一种情况值得注意,有个
别人为了当官,为了把有竞争力的对手搞下去,可以采取无所不用
其极的手段,散布流言蜚语,造谣诽谤,甚至和黑社会势力勾结起
来,“图官害命”。这也看出有的干部道德沦丧,根本就不具备干部
条件,也不具备党员条件。对于这类人,要发现一个严肃处理一个。
坚决同用人上的不正之风作斗争,是组织人事部门所担负的一项

度来看待这个问题,要弘扬组织工作的优良传统,毫不调和、毫不

们组织部门一个非常重要的任务。

translated_text: From the 15th to the 24th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China held a training course on the implementation of the "Interim Regulations on the Selection and Appointment of Party and Government Leading Cadres". More than 60 people, including the heads of the cadre review departments of the Organization Departments of the Party Committees of 31 provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities directly under the Central Government and 15 sub-provincial cities, and relevant responsible comrades from the cadre personnel departments (bureaus) of 15 ministries and commissions of the central state organs, participated in the training. During the training, the trainees carefully studied Comrade Jiang Zemin's remarks on "studying, politics, and integrity" and strengthening the management and supervision of cadres, exchanged the implementation of the "Regulations" in the past two years and the experience of implementing inspection and supervision work, analyzed some typical cases in the selection and appointment of personnel, and focused on discussing and studying measures to correct unhealthy trends in the appointment of cadres. Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, attended the meeting and gave a speech. Zhang Quanjing mainly talked about five aspects. (i) Increase the efforts to publicize and study the Regulations, and implement them; (ii) In accordance with the requirements of the Regulations, increase the efforts to train and select young cadres, and continuously strengthen the construction of the leadership team; (iii) Increase the efforts of inspection and supervision, and resolutely prevent and correct the unhealthy trends in the use of personnel; (iv) Increase the efforts of education and management, and strive to build a high-quality cadre team; (v) Study new problems, summarize new experiences, and continuously improve the level of implementation of the Regulations. Zhang Quanjing pointed out in his speech that in selecting young cadres, we must adhere to the principle of both moral integrity and ability, and look at the essence of cadres and the mainstream of cadres. The difficulty of cadre work lies in how to identify cadres. In selecting and using cadres, our party has unified standards, unified principles, and unified policies. The key lies in specific analysis of specific situations. We must proceed from reality and draw a clear line between right and wrong in the use of personnel. In selecting young cadres, we must pay special attention to the political performance and moral qualities of cadres. Some people indulge in restaurants and dance halls, and are obsessed with eating, drinking and having fun. Some people run for office and seek official positions. Some people have serious selfish desires. People who have these problems and have not corrected them cannot be promoted. We should look at these problems from a political perspective. These people are politically unreliable. Zhang Quanjing pointed out that from the current situation of selecting and appointing cadres, the vast majority of localities and departments can act in accordance with the "Regulations", and the vast majority of cadres can treat themselves correctly. However, we should also see that the unhealthy trends and corruption in the use of personnel are still very serious. In the future, the organization department will record those who run for office and seek official positions, and they shall not be promoted until they correct their mistakes. Some people are very good at planning for themselves, good at packaging themselves, and do everything possible to seek personal promotion. For such people, we should shout at them, or even slap them hard, to prompt them to repent, return to the right path, and stop running for office. When we use cadres, we first put political and ideological qualities in the first place. Some people may have certain abilities or have made some achievements, but for a Communist Party member, this is what they should do and cannot be used as capital for seeking official positions. Seeking official positions itself shows that their ideology is unhealthy and they should be seriously criticized and educated. Some people take bribes, buy and sell official positions, and some cheat officials. In this regard, they should be severely punished according to law. Those who obtain official positions by improper means should be resolutely removed and the relevant personnel should be severely dealt with. Organization and personnel cadres should "stress learning, politics, and integrity" and have political vigilance and political acumen. Some scammers can succeed because some of our comrades have lost their political vigilance or are careless in their work. As long as we are vigilant and rigorous and meticulous, it is not difficult to identify them. When handling the transfer of a "cadre", the Organization Department of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee found that the sealing of the file bag did not meet the regulations and the appointment and removal report form was also questionable. After review, it turned out that he was a scammer. However, some people lose their vigilance when they hear that he is a big shot, and problems arise as a result. There is another situation that deserves attention. Some people, in order to become officials and to get rid of their competitive opponents, can resort to all means, such as spreading rumors, slandering, and even colluding with underworld forces to "attempt to gain office and kill people". This also shows that some cadres have lost their morals and do not meet the requirements of cadres or party members. For such people, we must deal with them seriously. Resolutely fighting against unhealthy practices in the use of personnel is a glorious and important responsibility undertaken by the organization and personnel departments. We must have the courage to fight against unhealthy practices, recognize our responsibilities and missions from the perspective of the future and destiny of the party and the country, and conscientiously perform our duties. We must have a fearless spirit, not care about personal honor and disgrace, not be afraid of personal losses, be more firm, not be afraid of offending people, and not be afraid of wolves in front and tigers behind. In the final analysis, it is about whether we dare to take responsibility for the party's cause. As long as there is no personal selfishness, I don't have to be afraid of anything. We must maintain political clarity, look at this issue from a political perspective, carry forward the fine traditions of organizational work, and fight unhealthy practices in employment without compromise, compromise, or retreat. This is a very important task for our organization department. Wang Xudong, deputy director of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, gave a speech at the beginning of the semester. He reviewed the overall implementation of the Regulations over the past two years and called for further improvement of the understanding of the importance of implementing the Regulations, and made efforts to study in depth and accurately grasp the basic spirit of the Regulations. On May 23, the Organization Department of the Central Committee issued "Speech by Comrade Zhang Quanjing and Wang Xudong at the Training Course for Directors of the Thousand Audit Offices of the Organization Department".

同日中共中央组织部发出《关于在农村基层组织建设中切
实做好减轻农民负担工作的通知》。
《通知》要求: (一)各级党委要把减轻农民负担,作为农村基层
组织整顿和建设的一项重要内容,切切实实地把这项工作抓好。
(二)在乡镇党委整顿和建设中,应把减轻农民负担作为一项重要
内容。(三)各级机关派驻农村的基层组织建设工作队和部门驻点
工作组,在农村基层组织整顿和建设中,都要把减轻农民负担作为
自己的一项重要工作任务。(四)对虽已经过整顿但未解决好农民
负担问题的村以及列入整顿计划的村,可由省(区、市),地(市、州)
委派出地、县机关干部进村,结合了解农村基层组织建设情况,同
乡镇党委一起,就减轻农民负担工作进行一次全面的督促检查。
(五)各县(市)、乡(镇)党委有关部门,要坚决落实党中央、国务院
《决定》提出的“五个严禁”,即:严禁一切要农民出钱出物出工的达
标升级活动;严禁在农村搞法律规定外的任何形式的集资活动;严
禁对农民的一切乱收费、乱涨价、乱罚款;严禁各种摊派行为;严禁
动用专政工具和手段向农民收取钱物。这“五个严禁”,要全面地不
折不扣地贯彻执行。(六)为了从根本上减轻农民负担,在加强农村
基层组织和乡镇党委建设中,要千方百计地发展壮大村级集体经
济和乡镇企业,切实解决“有钱办事”的问题。
translated_text: On the same day, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on Effectively Reducing the Burden on Farmers in the Construction of Rural Grassroots Organizations". The "Notice" requires: (1) Party committees at all levels should regard reducing the burden on farmers as an important part of the rectification and construction of rural grassroots organizations, and do this work well. (2) In the rectification and construction of township party committees, reducing the burden on farmers should be regarded as an important part. (3) Grassroots organization construction teams and departmental on-site work teams stationed in rural areas at all levels should regard reducing the burden on farmers as an important task in the rectification and construction of rural grassroots organizations. (4) For villages that have been rectified but have not solved the problem of farmers' burdens and villages included in the rectification plan, the provincial (district, city) and prefectural (city, prefecture) committees can send cadres from prefectural and county organs to the villages to understand the construction of rural grassroots organizations and work with township party committees to conduct a comprehensive supervision and inspection on reducing the burden on farmers. (5) The relevant departments of the county (city) and township (town) party committees must resolutely implement the "five strict prohibitions" put forward in the "Decision" of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, namely: strictly prohibit all activities that require farmers to pay money, materials, and labor to meet standards and upgrade; strictly prohibit any form of fundraising activities in rural areas outside the provisions of the law; strictly prohibit all random charges, price increases, and fines on farmers; strictly prohibit all kinds of levies; strictly prohibit the use of dictatorship tools and means to collect money and materials from farmers. These "five strict prohibitions" must be fully and unswervingly implemented. (6) In order to fundamentally reduce the burden on farmers, in strengthening the construction of rural grassroots organizations and township party committees, we must do everything possible to develop and strengthen village-level collective economy and township enterprises, and effectively solve the problem of "having money to do things."

translated_text: From the 25th to the 27th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee held a national symposium on party building in Beijing. The meeting was chaired by Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee. Luo Gan, Zeng Qinghong, Lv Feng, Hou Zongbin, Chen Zuolin, E Weicheng, Wang Jialiu, Chen Fujin, Zhou Zi, Zheng Keyang, Liu Yunshan and other leading comrades as well as responsible comrades from relevant ministries and commissions of the central and state organs attended the meeting. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, emphasized at the meeting that learning, politics and integrity are the needs of comprehensively promoting the cause of building socialism with Chinese characteristics into the new century, the needs of strengthening and improving party building and political power building, and the requirements of the times and the people for party cadres. Party committees at all levels should raise their awareness, enhance their sense of responsibility and urgency, and take the implementation of the "three talks" education as a prominent task to strengthen the construction of organs, and effectively achieve results. Leading organs and leading cadres should do better and truly set an example. Hu Jintao pointed out that to be a role model in learning, we must work hard to master the scientific system and spiritual essence of Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and to use theory to solve practical problems. We must make learning Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics a top priority and work hard on it unremittingly. We must never ignore it, we must not slack off, and we must not engage in formalism. To be a role model in politics, we must work hard to fully, correctly and actively implement the party's basic line and various principles and policies, and effectively improve the quality and efficiency of our work. Compliance with democratic centralism is a necessary condition for our party to maintain complete political and organizational consolidation, high unity of action, and continuous improvement of combat effectiveness. We must strengthen education on democratic centralism and party discipline, strengthen supervision and inspection of the implementation of various party regulations, and resolutely correct the phenomenon of not following the rules and not investigating violations of discipline, so as to better mobilize the enthusiasm and creativity of the majority of party members and cadres and make the whole party more closely united around the Party Central Committee with Comrade Jiang Zemin as the core. To set an example of speaking the right way requires leading organs and leading cadres to speak the Party spirit and principles, be impartial and selfless, be upright and incorruptible, be consistent in words and deeds, and work hard to eliminate evil. Party committees at all levels should strengthen their leadership in the "Three Talks" education. The main responsible comrades should first attach importance to ideology, work well, be willing to use real efforts, and strive for practical results. In accordance with the requirements of the Central Committee, in the process of in-depth study of theory and the Party Constitution, a relatively concentrated period of time should be carried out in the spirit of rectification, so that the ideological and theoretical level of cadres in organs will be significantly improved, and there will be obvious progress in strengthening ideals and beliefs and ensuring the implementation of the Party's lines, principles and policies, and there will be obvious changes in the mental outlook, and a new situation will be created in the construction and work of organs. Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, also spoke at the meeting. He stressed that local party committees at all levels and party groups of all departments should regard strengthening the party building work of government agencies as an unshirkable political responsibility, and further strengthen the leadership and guidance of the party building work of government agencies in accordance with the requirements of "studying, being politically conscious and upright" and the overall deployment of the central party building work, conscientiously implement various tasks to strengthen the party building work of government agencies under the new situation, and raise the party work of government agencies to a new level. On May 15, the Central Organization Department issued the "Notice on the Speech of Comrade Hu Jintao and Comrade Zhang Quanjing at the National Forum on Party Building Work in Government Agencies".

translated_text: On the 29th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China held a "Report Meeting on Learning from Kong Fansen and Strengthening the Ideological and Work Style Construction of the Leading Group" in Beijing. Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, emphasized at the meeting: We must carry out the activities of learning from Kong Fansen more deeply, and in accordance with Comrade Jiang Zemin's requirements of "studying, politics, and integrity" and striving to build a high-quality cadre team, we must effectively strengthen the construction of leading groups at all levels. Responsible comrades from some departments of the central and state organs and relevant leaders of some provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities attended the meeting. Zhang Quanjing said that the practice of more than two years has fully proved that the activities of learning from Comrade Kong Fansen have played a huge role in strengthening the construction of leadership teams at all levels, promoting the leadership teams and leading cadres at all levels to further change their work style, strengthening the relationship between the Party, the masses, the cadres and the masses, improving the quality of the cadre team, and promoting the development of various tasks. Zhang Quanjing said that we must study Kong Fansen in depth, promote the leadership teams and leading cadres at all levels to study Marxism-Leninism, Mao Zedong Thought, especially Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, strengthen their ideals and beliefs, and enhance their consciousness of implementing the party's basic line. 理专家队伍,打破“论资排辈”等陈旧观念和习惯作法,加快培养、
大胆启用优秀青年科技人才。
translated_text: 22nd The "Symposium to Commemorate the 20th Anniversary of Comrade Deng Xiaoping's Advocate of "Respecting Knowledge and Talents"" jointly organized by the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee, and the United Front Work Department of the CPC Central Committee was held in Beijing. Dozens of experts and scholars from all fronts talked about their experience and feelings of learning Comrade Deng Xiaoping's "Respecting Knowledge and Talents" and conducted in-depth discussions on how to further implement this thought under the current situation. Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, Xu Guangchun, Deputy Minister of the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee, and Liu Yandong, Deputy Minister of the United Front Work Department of the CPC Central Committee, spoke at the meeting. Wang Xudong, Deputy Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, presided over the symposium. Zhang Quanjing pointed out that over the past 20 years, under the guidance of Comrade Xiaoping's brilliant thought on "Respecting Knowledge and Talents", party committees and governments at all levels have attached more and more importance to knowledge and talents, done a lot of work, and made great progress. The Party Central Committee with Comrade Jiang Zemin as the core attaches great importance to the work of intellectuals and the construction of scientific and technological talent teams. At the symposium commemorating the 75th anniversary of the founding of the Party, Comrade Jiang Zemin clearly stated that the high-quality cadre team we want to build "should be a team including party and government cadres, enterprise management cadres, A large team of scientific and technological cadres and other front cadres". Zhang Quanjing said that the current situation of intellectual work is good, but there is still a big gap from Comrade Xiaoping's hope and the requirements of the Party Central Committee. To develop science and technology, we must first further promote the idea of "respecting knowledge and talents" throughout the party and society, especially among leading cadres at all levels. Leading cadres should take the lead in learning scientific and technological knowledge, keep close contact with intellectuals, understand their voices in a timely manner, listen to their opinions and suggestions, and pay close attention to the political progress of intellectuals and the improvement of their academic and professional levels, and create good conditions for their work, life and healthy growth. Party organizations at all levels should, from the perspective of politics, cultivate and create a team of scientists who can enter the forefront of world science and technology, a team of engineering and technical experts with technological innovation capabilities and constantly overcome various complex problems in economic construction and social development, and a team of scientific and technological management experts with academic expertise and outstanding leadership skills, break the old concepts and practices such as "seniority-based promotion", and accelerate the cultivation and bold use of outstanding young scientific and technological talents.

translated_text: On the 25th, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council forwarded the "Several Provisions on Party and Government Organs Practicing Strict Economy and Preventing Extravagance and Waste". The "Provisions" pointed out that adhering to and carrying forward the fine traditions and style of hard work, diligence and thrift are of great significance for strengthening the flesh-and-blood ties between the Party and the government and the people, promoting the construction of clean government in party and government organs, and promoting the smooth progress of my country's reform and opening up and socialist modernization. In recent years, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council have repeatedly emphasized that party and government organs at all levels must practice strict economy and oppose extravagance and waste, and have made a series of regulations in this regard. In general, the implementation of these regulations is good. However, extravagance and waste such as showing off, competing for wealth, and squandering public funds still exist, and in some regions, departments and units are still spreading. In order to establish a good atmosphere of hard work, diligence and thrift, and further stop extravagant and wasteful behavior, the Party Central Committee and the State Council decided to reiterate and formulate the following regulations: (i) strictly control the construction and decoration of office buildings; (ii) strictly control various meetings; (iii) strictly control various celebrations; (iv) strictly prohibit the use of public funds for extravagant eating and drinking, and waste; (v) strictly control the use of public funds to install residential telephones or purchase mobile phones; (vi) strictly control various inspections. Formalistic evaluation and standard-reaching activities are prohibited; (vii) strictly equip and replace cars in accordance with regulations; (viii) strictly manage public-funded overseas travel.

中国社会主义改革开放和现代化建设实际问题为中心,以我们正

义,把马克思主义同它在现实生活中的生动发展割裂开来,对立起

东思想;高举邓小平建设有中国特色社会主义理论的旗帜,就是真
正高举马克思列宁主义、毛泽东思想的旗帜。在谈到党的建设时,

讨论的风气,积极探索的风气,求真务实的风气。
大力加强各级领导班子建设,努力建设一支高素质的干部队
伍,是党的建设又一项重大任务。要以思想政治建设为重点,把各

维护大局,加强团结

的有中共中央政治局常委李鹏,刘华清。还有关根、田纪云、李岚

translated_text: On the 29th, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, emphasized in his speech at the graduation ceremony of the provincial and ministerial cadres training class of the Central Party School that in the new period of socialist reform and opening up and modernization, on the new journey across the century, we must hold high the great banner of Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and use this theory to guide our entire cause and various work. This is an unshakable conclusion drawn by the Party from history and reality. Jiang Zemin elaborated on four issues: On Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics; On the primary stage of socialism; On economic development and economic system reform; On party building. Jiang Zemin pointed out that the reason why Marxism is scientific is that it always strictly takes facts as its basis. Real life is always changing, and the intensity and depth of this change have reached a level that our predecessors could hardly imagine in the past 100 years. Therefore, Marxism must continue to develop with the development of real life and cannot remain unchanged. There is a problem of academic style here. Should we simply look for answers from a few words in Marxist books or truly adhere to the Marxist standpoint, viewpoint and method to study the actual problems of contemporary China and the world? Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought must not be lost. If they are lost, we will lose our foundation and go astray. At the same time, we must focus on the actual problems of contemporary China's socialist reform and opening up and modernization construction, on what we are doing, and focus on the application of Marxist theory, on improving theoretical thinking on practical problems, and on new practices and new developments. It is meaningless to talk about Marxism without considering the actual situation of our country and the development of the times. There is no way out if we study Marxism in isolation and static, and separate Marxism from its vivid development in real life and set them in opposition. Marxism-Leninism, Mao Zedong Thought and Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics are a unified scientific system. In contemporary China, adhering to Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics is to truly adhere to Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought; holding high the banner of Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics is to truly hold high the banner of Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought. When talking about party building, Jiang Zemin emphasized: Our party shoulders the historical task of leading the people of all ethnic groups in the country to comprehensively promote the cause of socialism with Chinese characteristics into the 21st century and build a prosperous, democratic, and civilized socialist modern country. Strengthening and improving the party's leadership and further building our party well is the fundamental guarantee for completing this great mission. The task of party building is still very heavy, and it is necessary to do a good job in many aspects. It is the primary task of party building to deeply, solidly and persistently arm the whole party with Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics. The party must strive to create a culture of serious study, democratic discussion, active exploration, and truth-seeking and pragmatic. Vigorously strengthening the construction of leadership teams at all levels and striving to build a high-quality cadre team is another major task of party building. Focusing on ideological and political construction, we must build leadership teams at all levels into strong leadership collectives that resolutely implement the party's basic theory and basic line, serve the people wholeheartedly, and have the ability to lead modernization. Our leading cadres must not only have the theoretical and policy level and professional ability to be competent for their work, but also have political firmness, good ideological style and moral qualities. Senior cadres must set a good example in this regard. Anti-corruption is a serious political struggle that concerns the life and death of the party and the country. We must further increase our efforts and carry it out unremittingly. We must establish the idea of protracted warfare and fight the staged battles one by one. We must adhere to both treating the symptoms and the root causes and take multiple measures. Whether leading cadres at all levels can set an example is crucial to strengthening the party's work style and clean government and promoting the in-depth development of the anti-corruption struggle. Party organizations at all levels must effectively strengthen the daily management and supervision of cadres. Finally, Jiang Zemin particularly emphasized the need to maintain and strengthen the unity of the party. He said: my country's reform and opening up and modernization construction are in an important period of inheriting the past and ushering in the future. The tasks are very heavy and arduous, and all party comrades need to strengthen unity. When we talk about unity, we mean unity based on Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and the party's basic line. When it comes to unity, we must pay attention to the overall situation. We must correctly handle the balance between overall and local interests, put the interests of the Party and the country first and take into full account the interests of all parties. Leading cadres at all levels, especially senior cadres, must take the lead in implementing the principle of democratic centralism, strictly observe discipline, safeguard the overall situation, and strengthen unity. The ceremony was presided over by Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and president of the Central Party School. Attending the ceremony were Li Peng, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, and Liu Huaqing. Also present at the ceremony were Guan Gen, Tian Jiyun, Li Lanqing, Li Tieying, Yang Baibing, Wu Bangguo, Zou Jiahua, Jiang Chun, Qian Qichen, Huang Ju, Wei Jianxing, Xie Fei, Wen Jiabao, Wang Hanbin, Zhang Zhen, Zhang Wannian, and Chi Haotian.

translated_text: On the 19th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on the Wulian County Party Committee's Resolute Prevention of the Practice of Seeking Official Positions". The "Notice" pointed out that seeking official positions is an unhealthy trend among the cadre team. It seriously affects the correct implementation of the party's cadre line and cadre policy. It dampens the enthusiasm of the majority of cadres, damages the image of the party and the government, and causes great interference in the construction of a high-quality cadre team. The practice of Wulian County, Shandong Province shows that to stop the trend of seeking official positions, the key is that party committees and leading cadres at all levels must have a clear understanding and a firm attitude, adhere to principles, and not talk about personal relationships. Those who seek official positions must not only be resolutely refused, but also be severely criticized and educated. At the same time, in the cadre work, we must conscientiously implement the principle of democratic centralism, strictly follow the cadre management authority and the prescribed cadre appointment procedures, and not let individuals or a few people have the final say; we must unremittingly strengthen the ideological and political construction of the cadre team, so that the majority of cadres can firmly establish the Marxist world outlook, outlook on life, and values, always adhere to the purpose of serving the people wholeheartedly, and enhance the consciousness and firmness of resisting unhealthy tendencies; we must deepen the reform of the cadre personnel system, vigorously promote the promotion and demotion of cadres, and form a good mechanism to ensure that outstanding talents stand out. It is hoped that all localities and departments will refer to the practices of Wulian County, strictly implement the "Interim Regulations on the Selection and Appointment of Party and Government Leading Cadres", further increase the efforts to prevent and correct unhealthy tendencies in the use of personnel, and implement the task of building a high-quality cadre team.

events: 6月20日 纪念中国共产党成立76周年座谈会在中南海怀仁堂举行。中共中央组织部部长张全景主持了会议。中共中央政治局常委、书记处书记胡锦涛作了题为“共产党员要站在时代前列,充分发挥先锋模范作用”的重要讲话。座谈会上,中共中央组织部授予王启民、李素丽、邱娥国、包起帆、吴金印、谭彦、赵雪芳、苏新添、朱彦夫、樊代明、朱德坤、胡忠诚、张伟基、邵玉镇、姜淑琴、刘昌建、陈德华、邹光18名同志“全国优秀共产党员”称号。胡锦涛为这些优秀共产党员颁发了奖牌和证书。优秀共产党员代表王启民,吴天祥、樊代明,老党员代表白治民､焦裕禄妻子徐俊雅先后在座谈会上发言。出席座谈会的有丁关根、吴邦国、尉健行、温家宝、罗干等领导同志以及中央和国家机关有关部门负责同志曾庆红、侯宗宾、王维澄、汪家謬、宋德福、陈福今、郑科扬、刘云山、李铁林、王旭东、虞云耀等。胡锦涛在讲话中回顾了我们党走过的76年的光辉历程,指出了新时期共产党员先锋模范作用应具有鲜明的时代特征,并结合当前实际,着重向广大党员提出了四条要求:第一,必须高举小平建设有中国特色社会主义理论的伟大旗帜,坚定不移地走有中国特色社会主义道路。第二,必须站在社会主义改革开放和现代化建设的前列,努力创造无愧于共产党员称号的业绩。共产党员要爱岗敬业,勤奋学习,开拓进取,埋头苦干,为周围的群众作出表率,努力创造出一流的工作业绩。第三,必须认真实践全心全意为人民服务的宗旨,密切联系群众。无论我们党所处的环境发生什么样的变化,党的全心全意为人民服务的宗旨决不能变,群众观点,群众路线决不能丢,相信和依靠群众;与群众同甘共苦的优良传统决不能忘。第四,必须自觉抵御剥削阶级腐朽思想的侵蚀,带头弘扬社会主义道德风尚。胡锦涛在讲话中要求各级党组织要按照工人阶级先锋队战士的标准,加强对党员的教育管理,为党员充分发挥先锋模范作用创造条件。他说,党的各级组织要把加强党员队伍的教育管理作为一项经常性、基础性工作,认真抓起来。坚持对党员严格要求,努力在全党造成珍视共产党员的光荣称号,努力为党旗增光添彩,作名副其实的先进分子的浓厚风气。

June 20 A symposium commemorating the 76th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China was held in the Huairen Hall of Zhongnanhai. Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, presided over the meeting. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, delivered an important speech entitled "Communist Party members should stand at the forefront of the times and give full play to their vanguard and exemplary role".
At the symposium, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee awarded the title of "National Outstanding Communist Party Members" to 18 comrades including Wang Qimin, Li Suli, Qiu Eguo, Bao Qifan, Wu Jinyin, Tan Yan, Zhao Xuefang, Su Xintian, Zhu Yanfu, Fan Daiming, Zhu Dekun, Hu Zhongcheng, Zhang Weiji, Shao Yuzhen, Jiang Shuqin, Liu Changjian, Chen Dehua and Zou Guang. Hu Jintao presented medals and certificates to these outstanding Communist Party members.
Representatives of outstanding Communist Party members Wang Qimin, Wu Tianxiang, Fan Daiming, and representatives of veteran party members Bai Zhimin and Jiao Yulu's wife Xu Junya spoke at the symposium.
Attending the symposium were leaders such as Ding Guangen, Wu Bangguo, Wei Jianxing, Wen Jiabao, Luo Gan, and responsible comrades from relevant departments of the central and state organs Zeng Qinghong, Hou Zongbin, Wang Weicheng, Wang Jiamu, Song Defu, Chen Fujin, Zheng Keyang, Liu Yunshan, Li Tielin, Wang Xudong, Yu Yunyao, etc. In his speech, Hu Jintao reviewed the glorious 76-year history of our party, pointed out that the vanguard and exemplary role of Communist Party members in the new era should have distinct characteristics of the times, and combined with the current reality, he put forward four requirements to the majority of party members: First, we must hold high the great banner of Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and unswervingly follow the path of socialism with Chinese characteristics. Second, we must stand in the forefront of socialist reform, opening up and modernization, and strive to create achievements worthy of the title of Communist Party members. Communist Party members must love their posts, study diligently, forge ahead, work hard, set an example for the people around them, and strive to create first-class work performance. Third, we must earnestly practice the purpose of serving the people wholeheartedly and keep close contact with the masses. No matter what changes occur in the environment in which our party is located, the party's purpose of serving the people wholeheartedly must not change, the mass viewpoint and the mass line must not be lost, and the fine tradition of trusting and relying on the masses and sharing weal and woe with the masses must not be forgotten. Fourth, we must consciously resist the erosion of the decadent ideas of the exploiting class and take the lead in promoting socialist moral values. In his speech, Hu Jintao required party organizations at all levels to strengthen the education and management of party members in accordance with the standards of vanguard fighters of the working class, and create conditions for party members to fully play their vanguard and exemplary roles. He said that party organizations at all levels should take strengthening the education and management of party members as a regular and basic task and take it seriously. Adhere to strict requirements for party members and strive to create a strong atmosphere in the whole party to cherish the glorious title of Communist Party members, strive to add luster to the party flag, and become truly advanced elements.

30日 《人民日报》发表了以《统一祖国,振兴中华的核心力
量》为题的“七一”社论,庆祝中国共产党76周年生日。
《社论》指出,7月1日,是中国共产党成立76周年纪念日,也
是香港回归祖国,一洗百年耻辱的大喜日子。一日双庆,在我国政
治生活中是一件难得的盛事。
《社论》通过回顾中国共产党在民族解放和国家统一中所起的
决定性作用,进一步阐明了国家的独立和统一,离不开中国共产党
的领导这一颠扑不破的真理。
《社论》指出,香港回归祖国,是100多年来无数志士仁人为之
奋斗、为之牺牲,却又壮志未酬的夙愿,只是在中国共产党的领导
下,百年梦想才一步步变成了现实。香港回归是一部百余年屈辱史
的终点,又是“一国两制”这一全新构想付诸实施的起点。继续按照
“一国两制”的方针,解决澳门问题和台湾问题,最终实现中华民族
的大团结,是摆在我们面前的新的历史课题。中国共产党是统一祖
国､振兴中华的核心力量。把我们的党建设得更加伟大、更加坚强,
是把统一祖国,振兴中华的伟大事业继续胜利推向前进的根本保
证。
《社论》指出,进一步加强党的建设,首要的一条就是要高举邓
小平建设有中国特色社会主义理论的伟大旗帜,坚持党在社会主
义初级阶段的基本路线不动摇。要进一步加强党的建设,关键是要
大力加强各级领导班子建设,建设一支高素质的干部队伍。我们要
继续落实党中央关于党的建设这个“伟大的工程”的战略部署,以
思想政治建设为重点,把各级领导班子建设成为坚决贯彻党的基
本理论、基本路线、基本方针,全心全意为人民服务,具有领导现代
化建设能力的坚强领导集体。
《社论》最后强调,我们的事业是伟大的,我们的旗帜是辉煌
的,我们的任务是艰巨的,我们的前程是灿烂的。1997年秋天,将
召开党的第十五次全国代表大会,这将是一次把建设有中国特色
社会主义的伟大事业包括祖国统一大业全面推向21世纪的历史
性盛会。团结就是力量,团结就是生命。让我们在以江泽民同志为
核心的党中央坚强领导下,在邓小平建设有中国特色社会主义理
论和党的基本路线指引下,进一步加强全党的团结,加强全国各族
人民的团结,加强海内外中华儿女的团结,抓住机遇,开拓进取,以

translated_text: On the 19th, the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on Doing a Good Job in the Renewal of Local Leadership Teams in the Next Two Years". The "Notice" pointed out that in the next two years, the National People's Congress, government, and CPPCC of 30 provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities directly under the Central Government, and 15 sub-provincial cities, the Party committee leadership teams of 16 provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities directly under the Central Government, and 7 sub-provincial cities will be replaced, and the leadership teams of most cities, prefectures, and counties will also be replaced. The guiding ideology of this election is to adhere to the guidance of Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, adhere to the "four modernizations" policy of the cadre team and the principle of both moral integrity and ability, focus on improving quality, improving structure, and enhancing vitality, further promote democracy, promote exchanges, vigorously select outstanding cadres with firm political convictions, outstanding political achievements, diligence and integrity, and recognized by the masses, and build local leadership teams at all levels into strong leadership collectives that adhere to the Party's basic theory and basic line, serve the people wholeheartedly, and have the ability to lead modernization construction, so as to provide a strong organizational guarantee for bringing a stable, vibrant and dynamic China into the 21st century. The Notice proposes that we should fully implement the "four modernizations" policy of the cadre team and the principle of both moral integrity and ability, and strive to improve the structure of the leadership team. When changing terms, more than 1/5 of the members of the provincial people's congress standing committee should be around 55 years old, among which the deputy director should be around 55 years old; the CPPCC standing committee team should also select some relatively young comrades. The chairman of the Standing Committee of the People's Congress can be concurrently held by the responsible comrade of the party committee, or by other suitable candidates. We should actively cultivate and select women cadres, non-party cadres and ethnic minority cadres. There should be at least one female cadre in the party committee and government leadership team, and strive to have one female cadre in each. The governments of provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities directly under the central government and sub-provincial cities should be equipped with one non-party deputy position. If there is no selection at the moment, a vacancy should be left and supplemented later. There should be an appropriate number of non-party cadres among the deputy directors of the provincial, autonomous region, municipality directly under the central government and sub-provincial cities people's congresses; the number of non-party cadres among the vice chairmen of the CPPCC should be more than the number of party cadres. We should vigorously select outstanding young cadres and actively promote cadre exchanges. During the term change, there should be 3 cadres under 50 years old in the provincial party committee leadership team and 2 cadres in the government leadership team. Among them, there should be at least 1 cadre in the party and government leadership team who is around 45 years old. Those who cannot be selected can be solved through exchanges. The focus of this term change exchange is on members of the party and government leadership team, and the main targets are: those who have served in the same position for 10 years; young and middle-aged cadres who need to be trained in multiple positions or different regions; and those who need to be exchanged for other reasons. The selection of exchange candidates should be considered comprehensively and the work should be done in detail. The exchanged cadres should be in place as early as possible to facilitate the election. Regarding the age limit for office. The principal position of the provincial party committee, government, and discipline inspection commission is 65 years old, and other members are generally not more than 60 years old. In principle, non-party cadres serving as deputy governors (vice chairmen, deputy mayors) are the same as party member deputy governors (vice chairmen, deputy mayors). The party member cadres in the principal positions of the provincial people's congress standing committee and the CPPCC are 70 years old; the party member cadres in the deputy positions are 65 years old. The president of the provincial high people's court and the chief procurator of the people's procuratorate shall be 65 years old. The age of appointment of members of the provincial people's congress standing committee and the CPPCC standing committee shall be determined by the provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the central government according to local actual conditions, but the maximum age for party members and cadres shall not exceed 65 years. The age of leadership members of the party committee, government, and discipline inspection committee of a sub-provincial city and the president of the court and the chief procurator of the procuratorate shall be 60 years old; the age of party members and cadres in the principal positions of the Standing Committee of the People's Congress and the CPPCC shall be 65 years old, and the age of party members and cadres in the deputy positions shall be 63 years old. The "Notice" points out that party committees at all levels should effectively strengthen the leadership of the term change work and fully promote democracy throughout the whole process of the term change work. Attention should be paid to timely grasp the dynamics and communicate the situation. When unorganized activities or illegal activities are found, the attitude should be clearly stated and resolutely stopped. For the adjusted cadres, ideological work should be done well and their strengths should be used. We should care about and respect the retired old comrades and take various forms to give full play to their role.

translated_text:
From the 28th to the 29th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China held an on-site meeting in Shijiazhuang City, Hebei Province to solve the problem of arrears of "two fees" for retired cadres, summarize and promote the experience of Hebei Province in solving the arrears of "two fees" for retired cadres, and specifically study how to grasp the methods and measures to solve the arrears of "two fees" for retired cadres. Li Tielin, deputy director of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, attended the meeting and delivered a speech entitled "Strengthen leadership, take effective measures, and make up our minds to solve the problem of arrears of "two fees" for retired cadres as soon as possible." Li Tielin pointed out that solving the arrears of "two fees" for retired cadres is not only an economic issue, but also a political issue. The retirement allowances issued to retired cadres in accordance with national regulations and the actual reimbursement of medical expenses in accordance with regulations are the basic living guarantees for retired cadres to spend their later years in peace. Organizations and leaders at all levels must solve the problem of arrears of "two fees" for retired cadres with a spirit of high responsibility for the cause of the Party and with deep feelings. We must never cause them to have difficulties in their later years because of our slackness or dereliction of duty at work. Li Tielin pointed out that there are 1.89 million retired cadres in the country. According to statistics, no more than 200,000 people are owed "two fees". Priority should be given to solving the "two fees" arrears of these retired cadres, so that others cannot compete. To solve their "two fees" arrears, we must follow the principle of special matters and special treatment, and we cannot wait or delay. New China has been established for 48 years. If we cannot provide basic living security for these nearly 200,000 retired cadres, how can we explain to the people! If the problem of retired cadres' "two fees" arrears is not solved, it will directly affect the image and prestige of the party and the government. Leaders at all levels must fully recognize the importance and urgency of solving the "two fees" arrears of retired cadres from the height of politics and from the height of maintaining the overall situation of reform, development and stability, and make up their minds to solve it well. In his speech, Li Tielin demanded that we should fully recognize the importance of solving the "two fees" arrears of retired cadres; strengthen leadership, take measures, and effectively grasp the results; the organization department and the old cadres work department should give full play to their functional role. We should take the implementation of the living allowances for retired cadres as an important task and do it well.
Responsible comrades from the Organization Departments and Veteran Cadre Bureaus of the Party Committees of 12 provinces, autonomous regions and the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps attended the meeting.
On July 30, the Central Organization Department issued "Comrade Li Tielin's Speech at the On-site Meeting on the Implementation of the "Two Fees" for Retired Cadres".

translated_text: From August 28 to August 6, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China held a special seminar on "How to be a good top leader" in Beijing. translated_text: On the 4th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the General Political Department of the People's Liberation Army issued the "Notice on Further Strengthening the Cross-training of Military and Local Leading Cadres". Two sessions will be held each year, and 10 local students will be selected for each session. The school system is two and a half months. The main subjects are Mao Zedong's military thought and Deng Xiaoping's thoughts on military construction in the new era, focusing on the development trend of the international strategic situation, the security environment around my country, and some major issues in China's national defense construction. Two sessions will be held each year. 10 military students are selected for each term, with a duration of four and a half months; some divisional and regimental leaders are selected to attend the training class for ethnic minority cadres at the Central Party School; some divisional and regimental leaders of provincial military regions (garrisons and security areas) are selected to attend the training class for leading cadres at the Party Schools of provincial, autonomous regional and municipal Party Committees (divisional leaders mainly attend the training class for prefectural and departmental level cadres, and regimental leaders mainly attend the training class for county and department level cadres), with two terms per year, and the duration of the school is arranged according to the corresponding classes of the Party Schools of provincial, autonomous regional and municipal Party Committees. translated_text: On the 6th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued a "Notice on Several Issues of Party Member Development in Violation of the Party Constitution". The "Notice" pointed out that since the 14th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, party organizations at all levels have conscientiously implemented the guiding ideology and policies of party member development in accordance with the party constitution and relevant regulations, actively carried out party member development work, and achieved great results. However, in a few local and unit party organizations, the problem of recruiting party members in violation of the party constitution has occurred from time to time. The main reason is that some party members and party organizations are irresponsible for the party's cause, careless, perfunctory, and do not conscientiously perform the prescribed procedures; a few party members and cadres, for personal gain, falsify procedures, use "party tickets" to give favors, and allow people who do not meet the conditions of party membership to join the party; individual grassroots party organization leaders have lost their party spirit and principles, and asked for "benefits" when recruiting party members, and even "recruited relatives and factions" to cultivate personal power. These behaviors directly undermine the party's advanced nature and purity, and have caused adverse effects within the party and society. In order to strictly govern the Party and strictly enforce discipline in recruiting Party members, five cases of recruiting Party members in violation of the Party Constitution (attached) are hereby reported. Party committees at all levels and their organization departments should learn lessons from them, improve their work, plug loopholes, and firmly control the "entrance gate" of the Party member team.

18日 中共中央组织部在北京召开地方领导班子换届工作
座谈会。会议的任务是贯彻落实中央《关于做好今明两年地方领导
班子换届工作的通知》精神,安排布署地方领导班子换届工作。中
共中央政治局常委、书记处书记胡锦涛到会讲话。
胡锦涛指出,这次换届,是在我国历史发展的重要时期推进地
方领导班子和干部队伍新老交替合作的一件大事。
胡锦涛说,换届工作头绪纷繁,涉及方方面面,概括起来,主要
是两件大事:一是要起草一个好的工作报告,一是要做好人事安排
工作。在做好人事安排工作上,他讲了六点意见:(一)坚持组织路
线服从服务于政治路线,按照保证党的基本路线贯彻执行的要求
配备领导班子。(二)全面正确地贯彻干部队伍“四化”方针和德才
兼备的原则。(三)配强主要领导干部,完善领导班子结构,增强整
体功能。(四)大力选拔优秀年轻干部,推进新老交替与合作,增强
地方各级领导层的活力。(五)选人用人要坚决贯彻“人民公认”的
原则,认真走群众路线。(六)以换届为契机,积极推进干部人事制
度改革。
胡锦涛强调,换届选举工作,政治性、政策性很强,而且随着政
治体制改革的深入,要求会越来越高。搞好这项工作,党的领导是
关键,发扬民主是基础,依法办事是保证。必须正确认识和处理这
三个方面的关系,使其有机结合,互相促进。
中央组织部部长张全景也在会上讲话。他指出,换届选举人
事安排工作要以提高素质、完善结构、增强活力为重点,全面加强
领导班子建设。第一,切实把“班长”配好配强。要进一步研究培养
选拔“班长”的规律和途径,把选配好“班长”作为班子建设的关键
环节来抓;第二,努力完善班子结构。要积极培养和选拔女干部、党
外干部和少数民族干部;第三,大力选拔优秀年轻干部。要严格执
行中央对各级领导班子中年轻干部人数的规定,对达不到要求的,
要通过交流解决;第四,积极推进干部交流;第五,坚持干部能上能
下,合理确定并坚决调整不胜任现职或相形见绌的干部。
张全景还强调,党委要切实加强对换届工作的领导。要通盘考
虑,统筹安排;要充分发扬民主,搞好换届考察,提出一个好的人事
安排方案;要重视代表选举和委员协商提名工作;要严格依法办
事,精心组织选举;要严明组织人事纪律,坚决防止和纠正选人用
人上的不正之风,严肃查处违法违纪行为;要做好干部的思想政治
工作。
9月21日,中共中央办公厅印发了胡锦涛的讲话。8月28日,
中共中央组织部印发了张全景的讲话。
translated_text: On the 18th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee held a symposium on the change of leadership of local leaders in Beijing. The task of the meeting was to implement the spirit of the Central Committee's "Notice on Doing a Good Job in the Change of Leadership of Local Leaders in the Next Two Years" and to arrange and deploy the change of leadership of local leaders. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, spoke at the meeting. Hu Jintao pointed out that this change of leadership is a major event in promoting the cooperation between the old and new local leadership teams and cadres in an important period of my country's historical development. Hu Jintao said that the change of leadership is complicated and involves all aspects. In summary, there are mainly two major things: one is to draft a good work report, and the other is to do a good job in personnel arrangements. In terms of doing a good job in personnel arrangements, he made six points: (a) Adhere to the organizational line to serve the political line, and equip the leadership team in accordance with the requirements of ensuring the implementation of the party's basic line. (b) Fully and correctly implement the "four modernizations" policy of the cadre team and the principle of both moral integrity and ability. (III) Strengthen the main leading cadres, improve the leadership team structure, and enhance the overall function. (IV) Vigorously select outstanding young cadres, promote the replacement and cooperation between the old and the new, and enhance the vitality of the leadership at all levels in local areas. (V) The principle of "people's recognition" must be firmly implemented in the selection and appointment of personnel, and the mass line must be taken seriously. (VI) Take the opportunity of the change of term to actively promote the reform of the cadre and personnel system. Hu Jintao emphasized that the election work is highly political and policy-oriented, and with the deepening of the political system reform, the requirements will become higher and higher. To do this work well, the leadership of the party is the key, the promotion of democracy is the foundation, and doing things according to the law is the guarantee. It is necessary to correctly understand and handle the relationship between these three aspects, so that they can be organically combined and promote each other. Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, also spoke at the meeting. He pointed out that the personnel arrangement work of the election should focus on improving quality, improving structure, and enhancing vitality, and comprehensively strengthen the construction of the leadership team. First, we must effectively match and strengthen the "class leaders". We should further study the rules and ways of training and selecting "squad leaders" and take the selection of "squad leaders" as the key link in team building; second, strive to improve the team structure. We should actively train and select female cadres, non-party cadres and ethnic minority cadres; third, vigorously select outstanding young cadres. We should strictly implement the central government's regulations on the number of young cadres in leadership teams at all levels, and those who fail to meet the requirements should be resolved through exchanges; fourth, actively promote cadre exchanges; fifth, insist on the promotion and demotion of cadres, reasonably determine and resolutely adjust cadres who are not competent for their current positions or are inferior to them. Zhang Quanjing also emphasized that the Party Committee should effectively strengthen its leadership over the change of leadership. We should consider the overall situation and make overall arrangements; we should fully promote democracy, do a good job in the inspection of the change of leadership, and put forward a good personnel arrangement plan; we should attach importance to the election of representatives and the consultation and nomination of members; we should strictly abide by the law and carefully organize elections; we should strictly enforce organizational and personnel discipline, resolutely prevent and correct unhealthy trends in the selection and appointment of personnel, and severely investigate and deal with illegal and disciplinary violations; we should do a good job in the ideological and political work of cadres. On September 21, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee issued Hu Jintao's speech. On August 28, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued Zhang Quanjing's speech.

translated_text: On the 1st, Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, Secretary of the Secretariat, and President of the Central Party School, pointed out at the autumn opening ceremony of the Central Party School that the key to holding high the great banner of Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics is to arm the majority of party members and cadres, especially the leading cadres, with this theory. We must insist on focusing on the practical problems of contemporary China's socialist reform and opening up and modernization construction, focusing on what we are doing, focusing on the application of Marxist theory, focusing on improving theoretical thinking on practical problems, and focusing on new practices and new developments. translated_text: On the 10th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on the Report on the Study Meeting of County Party Committee Secretaries Convened by the Guangdong Provincial Party Committee". The "Notice" pointed out that the county (city) is a level with a special and important position in the organizational structure of the party and the state, and the county (city) committee is the leadership core of the county (city). They directly face the grassroots and the masses, and are the specific organizers of the implementation of the party's line, principles, and policies. They are responsible for the construction of the party's grassroots organizations, the development of the local economy, the enrichment of the local people, the construction of local civilization, and the protection of local peace. Under the new situation of reform and opening up, vigorously strengthening the construction of the leadership team and striving to improve the quality of cadres is not only a long-term and arduous strategic task, but also an urgent task that cannot be delayed. In the process of implementing this task, the county (city) committee team is not only the educated, but also the organizer and implementer of the education task, and one of the important sources of high-quality middle and senior leading cadres. Doing a good job in the construction of the leadership team of the county (city) committee, especially training and educating a large number of county (city) committee secretaries with high quality, is not only necessary for doing a good job in county (city) work and leading the grassroots cadres, but also necessary for creating a large number of politicians who can govern the party and the country and outstanding senior leaders across the century. Therefore, vigorously strengthening the construction of the leadership team of the county (city) committee and doing a good job in the training and education of the team of county (city) committee secretaries should always be an important part of the work of the provincial, regional and municipal party committees. On this issue, it is necessary to ensure that the ideological understanding, organizational leadership and work measures are in place. The "Notice" pointed out that the leading ideas and understandings of the Guangdong Provincial Party Committee in grasping the construction of the leadership team of the county (city) committee, especially the ideological and political construction, have certain universal significance, and its approach is also good. It is hoped that the party organizations in various places will take the spirit of the 15th National Congress of the Party as a guide, learn from Guangdong's experience, combine with reality, conduct in-depth investigations and research, and earnestly grasp the construction of the county (city) leadership team, continuously improve its leadership level, and ensure the implementation of the party's basic line.

translated_text: On the same day, the Presidium of the 15th National Congress of the Communist Party of China held its first meeting in the Great Hall of the People. The meeting first approved the list of the Standing Committee of the Presidium, which consisted of 33 people including Comrade Jiang Zemin, by a show of hands, chaired by Hu Jintao, Secretary-General of the Congress. The meeting approved Ding Guangen, Wen Jiabao and Zeng Qinghong as Deputy Secretaries-General of the Congress by a show of hands. The meeting listened to the report on the qualification review of delegates by the Qualification Review Committee of the 15th National Congress of the Communist Party of China. The meeting approved the Election Methods (Draft) of the 15th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and submitted it to the delegations for deliberation. The meeting also approved matters concerning the attendance and guests of the Congress. The Central Committee decided to invite relevant responsible comrades within the Party and non-Party people to attend the Congress. Attending the conference were: members and alternate members of the 14th Central Committee and members of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection who were not delegates to the 15th National Congress, former members of the Central Advisory Committee who were not delegates to the 15th National Congress or special invited delegates, some veteran comrades in the party who were not delegates to the 15th National Congress or special invited delegates, and other relevant comrades, a total of 296 people. Also invited were the Vice President of the State, the Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, the Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, the leaders of the democratic parties, the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce, and non-party people, as well as non-party people in Beijing among the Standing Committee members of the National People's Congress and the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, a total of 140 people, to attend the opening and closing ceremonies of the conference as guests. The Presidium meeting also approved the schedule of the 15th National Congress. According to this schedule, the 15th National Congress will open on the morning of September 12 and close on the morning of September 18.

translated_text: From the 12th to the 19th, the 15th National Congress of the Communist Party of China was held in the Great Hall of the People in Beijing. Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, delivered a report to the Congress on behalf of the 14th Central Committee. The title of the report was "Hold high the great banner of Deng Xiaoping Theory and comprehensively promote the cause of building socialism with Chinese characteristics into the 21st century". The Congress was presided over by Li Peng, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Premier of the State Council. Li Peng announced that there were 2,048 delegates and 60 special guests at the 15th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, and a total of 2,074 delegates and special guests attended the meeting today. He also extended a warm welcome to non-party friends and responsible comrades from relevant departments who attended the Congress. Jiang Zemin emphasized that the soul of this Congress is to hold high the great banner of Deng Xiaoping Theory. The 15th National Congress will undoubtedly go down in history with this as a mark. No matter what difficulties and risks there are, they cannot shake our firm belief in Deng Xiaoping Theory, but will only make us more consciously use this theory to overcome difficulties, defeat risks, and move forward victoriously. Adhering to Deng Xiaoping Theory and continuing to enrich and creatively develop this theory in practice is the solemn historical responsibility of the Party Central Committee and all Party comrades. Jiang Zemin's report consists of ten parts: (I) Review and Prospect at the Turn of the Century; (II) Work in the Past Five Years; (III) Historical Status and Guiding Significance of Deng Xiaoping Theory; (IV) Basic Line and Program for the Primary Stage of Socialism; (V) Economic System Reform and Economic Development Strategy; (VI) Political System Reform and Democratic Legal System Construction; (VII) Cultural Construction of Socialism with Chinese Characteristics; (VIII) Promoting the Peaceful Reunification of the Motherland; (IX) International Situation and Foreign Policy; (X) The Communist Party of China Facing the New Century. In his report, Jiang Zemin made a profound exposition on the primary stage of socialism and how to build socialism in the primary stage. He pointed out that the primary stage is the underdeveloped stage. The level of development of China's productive forces determines that it must go through a fairly long primary stage under socialist conditions to achieve industrialization and the socialization, marketization and modernization of the economy. At this stage, we must give priority to concentrating on developing productivity; we must use reform as the driving force for promoting all work in building socialism with Chinese characteristics; and we must correctly handle the relationship between reform, development and stability. He said that at the historical moment of pushing our cause into the 21st century, the whole party must unswervingly adhere to the party's basic line in the primary stage of socialism, and unify the two basic points of focusing on economic construction with the four basic principles and reform and opening up in the great practice of building socialism with Chinese characteristics. This is the most valuable experience of our party in the past 20 years and the most reliable guarantee for the victorious progress of our cause. He also expounded on the basic goals and basic policies of the economy, politics and culture of building socialism with Chinese characteristics. He pointed out that these basic goals and basic policies are organically unified and inseparable, and constitute the party's basic program in the primary stage of socialism. This program is an important part of Deng Xiaoping Theory, the development of the party's basic line in the economic, political, cultural and other aspects, and a summary of the most important experience in recent years. Jiang Zemin pointed out that the key to achieving the tasks set by this congress and comprehensively advancing our cause into the 21st century lies in upholding, strengthening and improving the party's leadership and further building the party well. He stressed the need to strengthen the party's ideological construction, organizational construction, and work style construction, oppose corruption, and strictly govern the party. The party led the people to write a glorious chapter in the 20th century, and it will certainly be able to write a new glorious chapter in the 21st century. Jiang Zemin called on the whole party to hold high the great banner of Deng Xiaoping Theory, closely unite around the Party Central Committee, be of one mind, unyielding, and work hard to comprehensively promote the great cause of building socialism with Chinese characteristics into the 21st century. Invited to attend the conference were Vice President Rong Yiren, Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, leaders of the central committees of various democratic parties and the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce, and non-party personages Fei Xiaotong, Sun Qimeng, Lei Jieqiong, Pabala Gelingjie, Wang Guangying, Cheng Siyuan, Lu Jiaxi, Ngapo Ngawang Jigme, Zhao Puchu, Qian Weichang, Ding Guangxun, Sun Fuling, An Zijie, Huo Yingdong, Ma Wanqi, Wan Guoquan, He Luli, Ding Shisun, Cheng Siwei, Cai Zimin, Yang Jike, Xu Caidong, etc. They sat in the VIP seats on the rostrum. Relevant responsible comrades in the party also attended today's conference. On September 13, Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, emphasized at the discussion of the Tibet delegation of the 15th CPC National Congress that to hold high the great banner and advance the great cause, we must persist in arming the whole party, educating cadres and the people with Deng Xiaoping Theory, and the key is to arm leading cadres at all levels. We must regard arming the whole party with Deng Xiaoping Theory as a long-term strategic task and unremittingly grasp it. We must take Deng Xiaoping Theory as a guide and fully, correctly and actively implement the party's basic line in the primary stage of socialism. On September 14, the Presidium of the 15th National Congress of the Communist Party of China held its second meeting. The meeting passed the resolution (draft) on the report of the 14th Central Committee, the resolution (draft) on the work report of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, and the resolution (draft) on the "Amendment to the Constitution of the Communist Party of China", and decided to submit these three draft resolutions to the delegations for discussion. The meeting passed the election method of the conference and completed other agendas. On September 17, the Presidium of the 15th National Congress of the Communist Party of China held its third meeting. The meeting adopted the list of candidates for the members of the Central Committee, alternate members of the Central Committee, and members of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection after the differential election by a show of hands, and submitted it to the delegations for deliberation. On September 18, the 2,074 delegates attending the 15th National Congress of the Communist Party of China elected the 15th Central Committee, which consists of 193 members and 151 alternate members, by secret ballot. 115 members of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection were elected. The Congress passed the resolution on the report of the 14th Central Committee and approved the report made by Comrade Jiang Zemin on behalf of the 14th Central Committee; the Congress also passed the resolution on the "Amendment to the Constitution of the Communist Party of China" and the resolution on the work report of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection. Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, delivered an important speech. He said that this congress was of great historical significance. The report of the 14th Central Committee adopted by the Congress scientifically summarizes the past and plans for the future from the historical height of the turn of the century. It has made comprehensive arrangements for the cross-century development of my country's reform and opening up and socialist modernization, and put forward clear propositions, guiding principles and policies on several major international and domestic issues. This report is the crystallization of collective wisdom and is our party's political declaration and action program for the new century. The Congress unanimously agreed to establish Deng Xiaoping Theory, which is the inheritance and development of Mao Zedong Thought, as the guiding ideology of our party and clearly write it into the Party Constitution. This will surely play a huge guiding role in the long-term success of the whole party and the people of all ethnic groups in the country to successfully realize socialist modernization in reform and opening up. The new Central Committee elected by the Congress has made the central leadership of the Party take another step towards revolutionization, rejuvenation, knowledge and specialization. All this will greatly inspire and mobilize the whole party and the people of all ethnic groups in the country to hold high the great banner of Deng Xiaoping Theory and confidently push the great cause of building socialism with Chinese characteristics into the 21st century. On September 19, the First Plenary Session of the 15th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China elected members and alternate members of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee, members of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee, and the General Secretary of the Central Committee; approved the members of the Central Secretariat based on the nomination of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee; decided on the composition of the Central Military Commission; and approved the list of candidates for secretary, deputy secretary and standing committee members elected by the First Plenary Session of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection as follows: (omitted)
