五大精神上来,把全国各族人民的力量凝聚到实现十五大确定的
各项任务上来,是当前和今后一个时期的一项重要任务。各级党委
对此要高度重视,精心组织,切实抓好。
《通知》要求,各级党委要重点抓好江泽民同志报告的学习,学
习要紧密联系实际,要切实加强对学习的领导。
translated_text: On the 20th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee issued the "Notice on Earnestly Studying the Spirit of the 15th CPC National Congress". The "Notice" pointed out that the 15th CPC National Congress was a historic meeting held at an important period in which my country's reform and opening up and socialist modernization construction were carried forward and the cause of building socialism with Chinese characteristics was inherited and forged ahead. Comrade Jiang Zemin's report "Hold High the Great Banner of Deng Xiaoping Theory and Push Forward the Construction of Socialism with Chinese Characteristics into the 21st Century" at the meeting held high the great banner of Deng Xiaoping Theory and made new strategic arrangements for the construction of my country's economy, politics, culture and other aspects and the construction of the party's ideology, organization and style. It is our party's political declaration and action program to lead the people of all ethnic groups in the country into the new century. The partial revisions made by the conference to the "Constitution of the Communist Party of China" established the guiding position of Deng Xiaoping Theory in the whole party. Earnestly studying the documents of the 15th CPC National Congress, unifying the thoughts of the broad masses of cadres and the people with the spirit of the 15th CPC National Congress, and concentrating the strength of the people of all ethnic groups in the country to realize the various tasks determined by the 15th CPC National Congress are important tasks at present and in the future. Party committees at all levels should attach great importance to this, organize it carefully, and do a good job in it. The "Notice" requires that party committees at all levels should focus on studying Comrade Jiang Zemin's report, and the study should be closely linked to reality, and the leadership of the study should be strengthened.

events: 1997年9月12日至18日,中国共产党第十五次代表大会在北京举行。江泽民向大会作《高举邓小平理论伟大旗帜,把建设有中国特色社会主义事业全面推向21世纪》报告。报告强调,培养同现代化要求相适应的数以亿计高素质的劳动者和数以千万计的专门人才,发挥我国巨大人力资源的优势,关系21世纪社会主义事业的全局。要深化人事制度改革,引入竞争激励机制,完善公务员制度,建设一支高素质的专业化国家行政管理干部队伍。
translated_text: From September 12 to 18, 1997, the 15th National Congress of the Communist Party of China was held in Beijing. Jiang Zemin delivered a report to the Congress entitled "Hold High the Great Banner of Deng Xiaoping Theory and Promote the Construction of Socialism with Chinese Characteristics into the 21st Century". The report emphasized that cultivating hundreds of millions of high-quality workers and tens of millions of specialized talents that meet the requirements of modernization and giving full play to the advantages of my country's huge human resources are related to the overall situation of the socialist cause in the 21st century. We must deepen the reform of the personnel system, introduce a competitive incentive mechanism, improve the civil service system, and build a high-quality and professional national administrative management cadre team.

伟大旗帜,坚持党在社会主义初级阶段的基本路线和基本纲领,抓

利,把建设有中国特色社会主义事业全面推向21世纪。他说,贯彻
十五大精神,首先必须认认真真地学。要下功夫认真研读江泽民同
志的报告,全面准确地领会精神实质,牢牢把握这次大会的主题,明

门的实际,多做艰苦踏实的工作,认真解决当前经济和社会生活中
的突出矛盾和问题,切实把改革开放和现代化建设事业推向前进。
胡锦涛强调,要实现十五大确定的各项任务,坚定不移地高举
伟大旗帜,卓有成效地推进伟大事业,需要我们从各方面做好工
作,关键在于坚持,加强和改善党的领导,围绕新时期党的建设的
总目标,从思想上、组织上、作风上全面加强党的建设。最根本、最重
要的一条就是要高举邓小平理论的伟大旗帜,坚持不懈地用这一理
论武装全党,首先是武装领导干部,在思想上和工作中牢固确立邓

用理论武装头脑,统一思想,指导工作,提高解决实际问题的能力。

神提出了要求,
座谈会由中央组织部部长张全景主持。宋平、吕枫、高扬、李正
亭､袁木､汪家镠.以及中央机关有关部门负责同志,部分省、市组
织部门、党建所的负责同志和部分专家、学者等参加了座谈会。党
建研究所所长蒋振云在会上介绍了党建所成立10年来的工作简
况;李力安、白克明、郑科扬、冷溶、柯广坚先后在座谈会上发言。
translated_text: On the 23rd, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee held a symposium to study and implement the spirit of the 15th CPC National Congress and the 10th anniversary of the establishment of the Party Building Research Institute of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, attended the meeting and delivered a speech. Hu Jintao pointed out that to study and implement the spirit of the 15th CPC National Congress is to hold high the great banner of Deng Xiaoping Theory, adhere to the basic line and basic program of the Party in the primary stage of socialism, seize opportunities, forge ahead, win new victories in reform and opening up and socialist modernization, and comprehensively promote the cause of building socialism with Chinese characteristics into the 21st century. He said that to implement the spirit of the 15th CPC National Congress, we must first study it seriously. We must make efforts to study Comrade Jiang Zemin's report carefully, fully and accurately understand the essence of the spirit, firmly grasp the theme of this congress, clarify the struggle program, goals, tasks and policies proposed by this congress, and strengthen the firmness and consciousness of holding high the great banner of Deng Xiaoping Theory and adhering to the basic line of the Party. To study and implement the spirit of the 15th CPC National Congress, we must also do it in a down-to-earth manner. We should closely connect with the actual situation of our region and department, do more hard and down-to-earth work, earnestly solve the outstanding contradictions and problems in the current economic and social life, and effectively push forward the cause of reform, opening up and modernization. Hu Jintao stressed that to achieve the tasks determined by the 15th National Congress, unswervingly hold high the great banner, and effectively promote the great cause, we need to do a good job in all aspects. The key lies in upholding, strengthening and improving the leadership of the Party, and comprehensively strengthening the Party building in terms of ideology, organization and style around the general goal of Party building in the new era. The most fundamental and important one is to hold high the great banner of Deng Xiaoping Theory, unremittingly use this theory to arm the whole Party, first of all, to arm leading cadres, and firmly establish the guiding position of Deng Xiaoping Theory in ideology and work. Not only should we study and master the theory in depth, but more importantly, we should effectively use the theory to arm our minds, unify our thoughts, guide our work, and improve our ability to solve practical problems. Hu Jintao also put forward requirements for Party building theory workers to take the lead in learning, publicizing and implementing the spirit of the 15th National Congress. The symposium was hosted by Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee. Song Ping, Lü Feng, Gao Yang, Li Zhengting, Yuan Mu, Wang Jialiu, as well as responsible persons from relevant departments of the central government, responsible persons from some provincial and municipal organization departments, party building institutes, and some experts and scholars attended the symposium. Jiang Zhenyun, director of the Party Building Institute, introduced the work of the Party Building Institute over the past 10 years at the meeting; Li Lian, Bai Keming, Zheng Keyang, Leng Rong, and Ke Guangjian spoke at the symposium.

同日 中共中央组织部印发《关于吉林省委组织部原党费管
理人员王引贪污、挪用党费问题的通报》。
中组部在印发通报时指出,吉林省委组织部原助理调研员王
引,在负责管理党费期间,利用工作之便,贪污、挪用党费,用于个
人买卖股票,严重触犯了党纪国法,最近已被开除党籍和公职,并
被司法机关依法判刑。这是多年来全国发生的最大一起贪污、挪用
党费的犯罪案件。
《通知》指出,王引问题的发生,决不是偶然的,给人们的教训
是深刻的。这一案件的发生,说明在改革开放和建立社会主义市场
经济的新形势下,如果放松了世界观的改造,就会丧失共产党人的
理想信念,就会利欲熏心,见利忘义,甚至走上违法犯罪道路。同
时,也反映和暴露出一些单位党组织在党费管理工作中存在的问
题。对此,我们要引以为戒,从中认真吸取教训。切实加强对党费
管理工作人员的教育和管理,加强对党费管理工作的领导,建立健
全党费管理的各项规章制度,经常督促检查,堵塞漏洞,防患于未
然。
《通知》指出,关于党费的管理历来都有明确的规定。王引的违
法犯罪,正是由于违反了这些规定,组织上又疏于检查、监督所造
成的。必须重申,党费只能存入中国工商银行、中国农业银行、中国
银行、中国建设银行、交通银行。各地各部门接此通报后,要逐级传
达,组织有关人员认真学习,并对近年来党费账簿进行一次清理检
查。发现问题,及时予以纠正。问题严重的,必须严肃处理。
translated_text:
On the same day, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued a "Notice on the Issue of Wang Yin, the Former Party Dues Management Personnel of the Organization Department of the Jilin Provincial Party Committee, Embezzling and Misappropriating Party Dues".
When issuing the notice, the Organization Department of the Central Committee pointed out that Wang Yin, the former assistant researcher of the Organization Department of the Jilin Provincial Party Committee, took advantage of his job to embezzle and misappropriate party dues during his time in charge of managing party dues, and used them for personal stock trading, which seriously violated party discipline and national laws. He has recently been expelled from the party and public office, and has been sentenced by judicial organs in accordance with the law. This is the largest criminal case of embezzlement and misappropriation of party dues in the country in many years.
The "Notice" pointed out that the occurrence of Wang Yin's problem was by no means accidental, and the lesson it gave people was profound. The occurrence of this case shows that under the new situation of reform and opening up and the establishment of a socialist market economy, if the transformation of the world outlook is relaxed, the ideals and beliefs of the Communists will be lost, and they will be blinded by greed, forget about justice when they see profit, and even embark on the road of breaking the law and committing crimes. At the same time, it also reflects and exposes the problems existing in the party organizations of some units in the management of party dues. We should take this as a warning and learn lessons from it. We should strengthen the education and management of party dues management staff, strengthen the leadership of party dues management, establish and improve various rules and regulations for party dues management, regularly supervise and inspect, plug loopholes, and prevent problems before they happen. The "Notice" pointed out that there have always been clear regulations on the management of party dues. Wang Yin's illegal crimes were caused by violating these regulations and the organization's negligence in inspection and supervision. It must be reiterated that party dues can only be deposited in the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, the Agricultural Bank of China, the Bank of China, the China Construction Bank, and the Bank of Communications. After receiving this notice, all localities and departments should convey it step by step, organize relevant personnel to study it seriously, and conduct a cleanup and inspection of party dues accounts in recent years. If problems are found, they should be corrected in a timely manner. Serious problems must be dealt with seriously.

translated_text: On the 6th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued a "Notice on the Implementation and Adherence of the System of Leading Cadres Contacting Poor Households in Liaoyang City, Liaoning Province". The "Notice" pointed out that since September 1994, Liaoyang City, Liaoning Province has implemented a system of contacting poor households among leading cadres at or above the deputy county level in the city's party and government agencies and institutions. In the past three years, nearly 10,000 cadres in the city have formed assistance pairs with urban and rural poor people, sincerely helping poor households to get rid of poverty and become rich. Not only has the lives of most of the assisted people been significantly improved, and some have basically escaped poverty, but the leading cadres have also been educated, achieving two results: the poor have escaped poverty and become rich, and the leading cadres have improved their ideological and political qualities. The circular emphasizes that leading cadres contacting poor households is in line with the central government's spirit of poverty alleviation to households and responsibilities to individuals, is a good way to alleviate poverty and solve problems, and is also an important measure to implement the spirit of the 15th National Congress and change the work style of cadres; leading cadres contacting poor households helps to enhance the sense of responsibility and mission of leading cadres, and is a good form of strengthening party spirit and party style education; leading cadres contacting poor households, showing true feelings and doing practical things, showing the public servant sentiment of the Communists, and establishing the image of leading cadres for the people, which is conducive to forming a good social atmosphere and promoting social stability. Party committees at all levels should, like the Liaoyang Municipal Party Committee, proceed from reality, actively explore, find and find good ways and measures that are in line with local realities and go deep into the grassroots and the masses, and persist in doing so.

events:
29日 中共中央组织部召开全国农村基层组织建设电视电
话会议。中共中央政治局常委、书记处书记胡锦涛出席会议并发表
重要讲话。
胡锦涛在讲话中指出,农业是国民经济的基础。农村基层党组
织是党在农村全部工作和战斗力的基础。基础牢,事业兴;基层稳,
天下安。只有进一步把农村基层组织建设好,才能把农民群众紧紧
团结在党和政府的周围,保证党的路线方针政策在农村基层贯彻
落实,实现农村跨世纪发展的目标和社会的长期稳定。3年的集中
整顿告一段落,决不是农村基层组织建设的结束,而是新一阶段工
作的开始。各级党委务必要防止和克服有的地方出现的“搞了3
年,差不多了”的思想和松懈情绪。
胡锦涛强调,继续加强农村基层组织建设,必须把握好总的指
导思想,就是:遵循党的十五大精神,高举邓小平理论伟大旗帜,坚
持党在社会主义初级阶段的基本路线、基本纲领不动摇,继续认真
贯彻中央关于农村基层组织建设工作的指导方针,紧紧围绕深化
农村改革,确保农业和农村经济发展,确保农民收入增加来进行,
全面、深入、扎实,持久地推进农村基层组织建设,为十五大提出的
农村工作任务的落实提供坚强的组织保证。
在谈到要继续按照中央确定的村级党组织建设应达到“五个
好”的目标进行工作时,胡锦涛说,这“五个好”是新时期党的建设
总目标结合农村基层组织状况的具体化,是农村基层组织在新形
势下加强自己,凝聚农民群众为实现农村跨世纪发展目标而奋斗
的需要。“五个好”是一个相互联系,不可分割的完整目标体系,必
须全面坚持,缺一不可。“五个好”各有内涵和标准,每个好都不能
降低要求,即使是初步达到“五个好”要求的基层党组织,也要根据
形势任务的发展变化,不断丰富“五个好”的内容,提高“五个好”的
水平。
胡锦涛提出,当前要着重抓好六个方面的工作:(一)认真学习
贯彻十五大精神,坚持不懈地用邓小平理论武装农村基层干部和
党员。(二)继续加强以党支部为核心的村级组织建设,进一步解决
好“有人管事”问题。(三)推进农业和农村经济发展,搞好扶贫开
发,壮大村级集体经济实力,切实解决“有钱办事”问题。(四)积极
发展农村基层民主,加强民主管理和民主监督,努力解决好“有章
理事”问题。(五)继续把教育培训提高农村基层干部作为一项战略
任务来抓,努力建设具有较高素质的农村基层干部队伍。(六)认真
抓好乡镇党委建设。
胡锦涛最后要求各级党委进一步加强对农村基层组织建设的
领导。特别是主要领导同志和主管的负责同志,要带头做到思想不
松懈,工作不松劲,力度不减弱。继续坚持和完善党委管党的建设、
书记带头抓党的建设的责任制,逐级负责,做到有布置,有检查,有
督促,推动问题的解决,促进工作一步一步,实实在在地向前发展。
各有关部门和群团组织要密切配合,进一步形成抓农村基层组织
建设的整体合力。要解放思想,实事求是,用改革的精神研究新情
况,解决新问题,总结新经验,把农村基层组织建设不断提高到新
水平。
中央、国家机关有关方面的负责同志和部分省区市党委组织
部长出席了主会场会议。各省区市､地,县的负责同志出席了分会
场会议。会议由中央组织部部长张全景主持。
11月7日.中央组织部印发了《胡锦涛同志在全国农村基层
组织建设电视电话会议上的讲话和张全景同志在会议结束时的讲
话》。
translated_text: On the 29th, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee held a national teleconference on the construction of rural grassroots organizations. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, attended the meeting and delivered an important speech. In his speech, Hu Jintao pointed out that agriculture is the foundation of the national economy. Rural grassroots party organizations are the foundation of all the party's work and combat effectiveness in rural areas. A solid foundation will lead to a prosperous cause; a stable grassroots will lead to peace in the world. Only by further building rural grassroots organizations can we unite the peasants around the party and the government, ensure the implementation of the party's line, principles and policies at the grassroots level in rural areas, and achieve the goal of rural cross-century development and long-term social stability. The end of the three-year centralized rectification is by no means the end of the construction of rural grassroots organizations, but the beginning of a new stage of work. Party committees at all levels must prevent and overcome the "three years of work, almost done" thinking and slackness that have appeared in some places. Hu Jintao stressed that in order to continue to strengthen the construction of rural grassroots organizations, we must grasp the general guiding ideology, that is, follow the spirit of the 15th CPC National Congress, hold high the great banner of Deng Xiaoping Theory, adhere to the basic line and basic program of the Party in the primary stage of socialism, continue to conscientiously implement the central government's guidelines on the construction of rural grassroots organizations, and focus on deepening rural reforms, ensuring the development of agriculture and rural economy, and ensuring the increase of farmers' income. We must comprehensively, deeply, solidly and persistently promote the construction of rural grassroots organizations, and provide a strong organizational guarantee for the implementation of the rural work tasks proposed by the 15th CPC National Congress. When talking about continuing to work in accordance with the goal of "five good" for the construction of village-level party organizations determined by the central government, Hu Jintao said that these "five good" are the specific embodiment of the general goal of party building in the new period combined with the situation of rural grassroots organizations, and are the need for rural grassroots organizations to strengthen themselves under the new situation and unite the peasant masses to strive for the realization of the rural cross-century development goals. The "five good" is an interconnected and inseparable complete goal system that must be fully adhered to and none of them can be missing. The "five good" have their own connotations and standards, and each good cannot lower the requirements. Even the grassroots party organizations that have initially met the "five good" requirements must continue to enrich the content of the "five good" and improve the level of the "five good" according to the development and changes of the situation and tasks. Hu Jintao proposed that we should focus on six aspects of work at present: (a) conscientiously study and implement the spirit of the 15th National Congress, and unremittingly arm rural grassroots cadres and party members with Deng Xiaoping Theory. (b) Continue to strengthen the construction of village-level organizations with party branches as the core, and further solve the problem of "someone in charge". (c) Promote the development of agriculture and rural economy, do a good job in poverty alleviation and development, strengthen the strength of village-level collective economy, and effectively solve the problem of "having money to do things". (d) Actively develop rural grassroots democracy, strengthen democratic management and democratic supervision, and strive to solve the problem of "having rules to manage things". (e) Continue to take education and training to improve rural grassroots cadres as a strategic task, and strive to build a team of rural grassroots cadres with high quality. (six) Conscientiously do a good job in township party committee construction. Finally, Hu Jintao asked the Party committees at all levels to further strengthen their leadership over the construction of rural grassroots organizations. In particular, the main leaders and responsible comrades should take the lead in not slacking off in their thinking, not slacking off in their work, and not weakening their efforts. We should continue to adhere to and improve the responsibility system of the Party committees managing the construction of the Party and the Party secretaries taking the lead in grasping the construction of the Party, and be responsible at each level, so as to make arrangements, conduct inspections, and supervise, promote the resolution of problems, and promote the work to move forward step by step. All relevant departments and mass organizations should cooperate closely to further form an overall force to grasp the construction of rural grassroots organizations. We should emancipate our minds, seek truth from facts, study new situations, solve new problems, summarize new experiences with the spirit of reform, and continuously improve the construction of rural grassroots organizations to a new level. Responsible comrades from relevant departments of the Central and State organs and the heads of the organization departments of some provincial, autonomous and municipal Party committees attended the main venue meeting. Responsible comrades from provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities, prefectures, and counties attended the branch venue meetings. The meeting was chaired by Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee. On November 7, the Central Organization Department issued "Comrade Hu Jintao's speech at the national rural grassroots organization construction video and telephone conference and Comrade Zhang Quanjing's speech at the end of the conference."

起理论学习的新高潮,是一项具有重大现实意义和深远历史意义
的决策。抓住了这一条,就抓住了贯彻十五大精神,全面推进社会
主义现代化建设和党的建设的灵魂。中央国家机关的党员领导干
部要带头高举邓小平理论伟大旗帜,努力用这一理论武装头脑,逐
步成长起一批通晓邓小平理论并善于在实践中运用理论的同志,
我们党领导改革开放和现代化建设的整体水平就会大大提高,我
们的事业就能更好地向前推进。
胡锦涛要求机关党组织紧紧围绕党的中心任务,密切联系本
部门、本单位的实际,充分发挥党的组织优势,把全体党员和干部
发动起来,在各自岗位上争创一流的工作业绩。首先,要有奋力开
拓的精神状态。坚持解放思想、实事求是,以“三个有利于”为标准
大胆探索,勇于实践,不断总结经验,对的就坚持,不对的就改正。
第二,要有脚踏实地的务实作风。坚持一切从实际出发,以对党和

愿,按客观规律办事。第三,要有做好工作的过硬本领。当前,世界
科学技术正在迅猛发展,国际交流日益扩大和增多。新问题不断出
现,新知识不断产生。这都要求我们高度重视学习,善于学习,不仅

力。
中共中央政治局委员、书记处书记、国务委员、中共中央国家

中央国家机关各部门党组主要负责同志、机关党委书记、纪委书记
共 300 多人出席了会议。
translated_text: On the 14th, Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, pointed out at the 12th Party Work Conference of the Central State Organs that the status and role of the central state organs determine that they have a special and important responsibility in implementing the spirit of the 15th National Congress. The party organizations of various ministries and commissions, especially the leading cadres, should remain sober and firm in what flag to raise, what road to take, and what image to establish; they should perform their duties well in comprehensively promoting the construction of socialism with Chinese characteristics in the new century; and they should play a role model in further strengthening the party building of the organs. In his speech, Hu Jintao emphasized that the 15th National Congress of the Communist Party of China established Deng Xiaoping Theory as the guiding ideology of the party, solemnly wrote it into the party constitution, and called on the whole party to hold high the great banner of Deng Xiaoping Theory and set off a new high tide of theoretical learning. This is a decision with great practical significance and far-reaching historical significance. Grasping this point means grasping the soul of implementing the spirit of the 15th National Congress and comprehensively promoting socialist modernization and party building. Party members and leading cadres of central state organs should take the lead in holding high the great banner of Deng Xiaoping Theory, strive to arm their minds with this theory, and gradually grow a group of comrades who are familiar with Deng Xiaoping Theory and good at applying the theory in practice. The overall level of our party's leadership in reform, opening up and modernization will be greatly improved, and our cause will be able to move forward better. Hu Jintao requires party organizations in government agencies to closely focus on the party's central tasks, closely connect with the actual situation of their departments and units, give full play to the party's organizational advantages, mobilize all party members and cadres, and strive to create first-class work performance in their respective positions. First, there must be a spirit of striving for pioneering. Adhere to emancipating the mind, seeking truth from facts, and boldly explore, practice, and constantly sum up experience based on the "three benefits" as the standard. Adhere to what is right and correct what is wrong. Second, there must be a down-to-earth and pragmatic style. Adhere to everything from reality, with a spirit of high responsibility to the party and the people, understand the real situation, reflect problems truthfully, respect the wishes of the masses, and act in accordance with objective laws. Third, there must be a strong ability to do a good job. At present, the world's science and technology are developing rapidly, and international exchanges are expanding and increasing. New problems are constantly emerging and new knowledge is constantly being generated. This requires us to attach great importance to learning and be good at learning. We must not only improve our ideological and theoretical level and policy level, but also continuously improve our knowledge level and professional ability. Luo Gan, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, Secretary of the Secretariat, State Councilor, and Secretary of the CPC Central Committee's State Organs Working Committee, presided over the meeting. More than 300 people attended the meeting, including responsible comrades from the Central Organization Department and the Central Propaganda Department, and the main responsible comrades of the party groups of various departments of the central state organs, the secretaries of the party committees of the organs, and the secretaries of the discipline inspection committees.

events:
同日 中共中央组织部、中共江西省委在北京联合举办“吴成
生同志事迹报告会”。
吴成生同志生前任江西省吉安地区行署副专员,1997年2月
6日因病去世,被广大群众誉为“忘我工作、无私奉献的好专员”。
中央组织部部长张全景在报告会上指出,我们学习吴成生同
志,就是要学习他时刻把人民利益放在高于一切地位的公仆情怀。
各级领导干部,要像吴成生同志那样,时刻把群众的冷暖挂在心
上,把人民拥护不拥护,赞成不赞成、高兴不高兴,答应不答应作为
我们想问题,办事情,做工作的出发点和落脚点,切实为人民群众
办好事、办实事。
张全景说,宣传吴成生同志的先进事迹,弘扬吴成生同志的崇
高精神,对于在广大党员干部中继续开展以讲学习、讲政治、讲正
气为主要内容的党性党风教育,对于以思想政治建设为重点,进一
步加强各级领导班子和干部队伍建设,将产生积极的推动作用。各
级领导干部都要向吴成生同志学习。要讲学习、讲政治、讲正气,认
真学习马列主义、毛泽东思想,特别是邓小平理论,切实加强党性
锻炼和思想道德修养,自重、自省､自警、自励;自觉置身于人民群
众的监督之下,行得正,立得端。要坚持从自身做起,从每一件事做
起,严格按党章办事,按党的原则办事,自我约束,清正廉洁.无私
奉献,自觉抵制拜金主义、享乐主义和极端个人主义的侵蚀。只有
这样,才能够为人民掌好权、用好权,得到人民群众的拥护,永葆人
民公仆的本色。
translated_text:
On the same day, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the CPC Jiangxi Provincial Committee jointly held a "Comrade Wu Chengsheng's Deeds Report Conference" in Beijing.
Comrade Wu Chengsheng was the deputy commissioner of the Jiangxi Ji'an District Administrative Office. He died of illness on February 6, 1997. He was praised by the masses as a "good commissioner who worked selflessly and made selfless contributions."
Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, pointed out at the report meeting that we learn from Comrade Wu Chengsheng, that is, we must learn from his public servant sentiment of always putting the interests of the people above all else.
Leading cadres at all levels should, like Comrade Wu Chengsheng, always keep the people's well-being in mind, and take the people's support, approval, happiness, and agreement as the starting point and foothold for our thinking, handling, and work, and do good things and practical things for the people.
Zhang Quanjing said that publicizing the advanced deeds of Comrade Wu Chengsheng and carrying forward his lofty spirit will play a positive role in promoting the education of Party spirit and Party style among the broad masses of Party members and cadres, with the main contents of learning, politics and integrity, and in further strengthening the construction of leading groups and cadres at all levels with ideological and political construction as the focus. Leading cadres at all levels should learn from Comrade Wu Chengsheng. They should emphasize learning, politics and integrity, earnestly study Marxism-Leninism, Mao Zedong Thought, especially Deng Xiaoping Theory, earnestly strengthen Party spirit training and ideological and moral cultivation, respect themselves, reflect on themselves, warn themselves and encourage themselves; consciously place themselves under the supervision of the people, act uprightly and stand upright. They should insist on starting from themselves and from every matter, strictly follow the Party Constitution and the Party's principles, exercise self-discipline, be honest and upright, make selfless contributions, and consciously resist the erosion of materialism, hedonism and extreme individualism. Only in this way can we exercise power for the people and use it well, gain the support of the masses, and always maintain the true qualities of the people's servants.

events:
18日 中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅印发《关于禁止自行
制作和使用地方旗、徽的通知》。
《通知》指出,最近,个别城市自行设计制作市旗、市徽,并公开
悬挂。《中华人民共和国国旗法》和《中华人民共和国国徽法》规定,
国旗和国徽是我们国家的象征和标志。我国的国旗、国徽代表着国
家主权的统一和不可分割。自行制作和使用市旗、市徽,不符合我
国国情,是不妥当的。
《通知》要求,各地一律不得自行制作和使用地方旗、徽。各级
党政领导干部特别是高级干部一定要不断提高政治鉴别力和政治
敏锐性,深刻认识自行制作和使用地方旗、徽可能产生的消极影
响,确保本地区不发生自行制作和使用地方旗、徽的问题。今后,如
发现自行制作和使用地方旗、徽,要对所在地的党政主要领导进行
严肃处理。
translated_text: On the 18th, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council issued the "Notice on Prohibition of Self-production and Use of Local Flags and Emblems". The "Notice" pointed out that recently, some cities have designed and produced their own city flags and emblems and publicly hung them. The "National Flag Law of the People's Republic of China" and the "National Emblem Law of the People's Republic of China" stipulate that the national flag and national emblem are the symbols and signs of our country. Our national flag and national emblem represent the unity and indivisibility of national sovereignty. Self-production and use of city flags and city emblems are not in line with our national conditions and are inappropriate. The "Notice" requires that all localities must not self-produce and use local flags and emblems. Party and government leaders at all levels, especially senior cadres, must constantly improve their political discernment and political acumen, deeply understand the negative impact that self-production and use of local flags and emblems may have, and ensure that the problem of self-production and use of local flags and emblems does not occur in this region. In the future, if local flags and emblems are found to be self-produced and used, the main party and government leaders in the area will be severely dealt with.

translated_text: On the 28th, Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, Secretary of the Secretariat, and President of the Central Party School, delivered an important speech at the graduation ceremony of the 23rd Provincial and Ministerial Cadre Training Class of the Central Party School. Hu Jintao stressed that we must continue to earnestly study and implement the spirit of the 15th National Congress, insist on using the spirit of the 15th National Congress to unify thoughts and take charge of the overall situation, further consolidate the thoughts and actions of the whole party, and focus on implementing the various tasks proposed by the 15th National Congress and the various decisions and arrangements of the Central Committee on current work. All walks of life and all fronts must concentrate on solving the practical problems they face and push forward all undertakings in a down-to-earth manner. Hu Jintao pointed out that in order to thoroughly study and implement the spirit of the 15th National Congress, we must firmly grasp the theme of holding high the great banner of Deng Xiaoping Theory and comprehensively advancing the cause of building socialism with Chinese characteristics into the 21st century, deeply understand the historical status and guiding significance of Deng Xiaoping Theory; deeply understand the basic national conditions of my country's primary stage of socialism and the Party's basic line and basic program in the primary stage of socialism; deeply understand the series of major principles and policies proposed by the Central Committee to promote the cross-century development of my country's socialist modernization; deeply understand the major historical responsibilities shouldered by the Communist Party of China in the new century and the importance of further building the Party. Special attention should be paid to solving two problems: First, always focus on unifying the thoughts of leading groups and leading cadres at all levels, and leading cadres should take the lead in promoting the Marxist style of study that integrates theory with practice. Second, always adhere to the grassroots and the masses, and do a good job in mass work conscientiously and meticulously, so that the spirit of the 15th National Congress is truly mastered by the masses and becomes the conscious action of the masses. Responsible comrades from relevant central departments, including Han Zhubin, Zhang Quanjing, Liu Yunshan, Chen Fujin, and Zheng Keyang, as well as the Executive Vice President of the Central Party School, Wang Jiamiao, and Vice Presidents Liu Shengyu, Liu Haifan, and Yang Chungui, attended the graduation ceremony. translated_text: On the 3rd, the Organization Department and the Ministry of Personnel of the CPC Central Committee issued the "Opinions on Doing a Good Job in Implementing the National Civil Service System and Reference Work in Township Organs". The "Opinions" pointed out that township organs are at the forefront of rural reform and construction. Doing a good job in implementing the civil service system and reference management in township organs and building a high-quality cadre team of township organs is of great significance to strengthening the construction of grassroots party organizations and political power in rural areas and promoting the construction of rural civilizations and various undertakings. 地方各级党委政法委员会领导班子配备工作的通知》
《通知》要求,地方各级党委政法委员会书记应由同级党委常
委担任。为便于政法委员会书记集中精力领导、协调好政法工作,
政法委员会书记一律不得兼任同级政法各部门的领导职务,已经
兼任的应尽快安排其他人员接替。
《通知》还要求,各级政法委员会可配备一至二名专职副书记,
省级政法委员会可以设秘书长,协助书记开展工作。目前,有的政
法委员会设置专职副书记过多,甚至把政法委当作安排从原無量
岗位退下来干部的场所,这种现象必须改变。
translated_text: On the same day, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and the CPC Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission issued the "Notice on Doing a Good Job in the Staffing of the Leadership Teams of the Political and Legal Affairs Commissions of Local Party Committees at All Levels". The "Notice" requires that the secretaries of the Political and Legal Affairs Commissions of local party committees at all levels should be members of the standing committees of the party committees at the same level. In order to facilitate the secretaries of the Political and Legal Affairs Commissions to concentrate on leading and coordinating political and legal work, the secretaries of the Political and Legal Affairs Commissions shall not concurrently hold leadership positions in the political and legal departments at the same level. Those who have concurrently held such positions should be replaced by other personnel as soon as possible. The "Notice" also requires that the Political and Legal Affairs Commissions at all levels may be equipped with one or two full-time deputy secretaries, and the provincial-level Political and Legal Affairs Commissions may have a secretary-general to assist the secretary in carrying out his work. At present, some Political and Legal Affairs Commissions have too many full-time deputy secretaries, and even use the Political and Legal Affairs Commissions as a place to arrange cadres who have retired from their original positions. This phenomenon must be changed.

和强化科学管理相结合。这是搞好企业的基础性工作,也是巩固企
业改革成果的保证。实践证明,在一定意义上说企业的改革和发
展,关键在企业的领导班子,在企业的厂长、经理。一个好的领导班
子可以把一个濒临破产的企业搞活,一个素质不高的领导班子也
可以把一个好的企业搞垮。所以,要加强企业领导班子建设,提高
企业领导者的素质。要对企业经营管理者进行制度化的考核、评
价,提高他们在市场经济条件下的经营管理水平。对软弱无力和不
称职的班子,特别是那些长期亏损企业的班子,要坚决撤换和及时
调整,要把1997年已经开始的对企业领导班子的考评工作继续做
好,见到成效。
translated_text: On the 11th, Zhu Rongji, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, pointed out in his speech at the Central Economic Work Conference that enterprise reform should combine strengthening the construction of enterprise leadership teams with strengthening scientific management. This is the basic work for doing a good job in enterprises and the guarantee for consolidating the results of enterprise reform. Practice has proved that in a certain sense, the key to the reform and development of enterprises lies in the leadership teams of enterprises, in the factory directors and managers of enterprises. A good leadership team can revive an enterprise on the verge of bankruptcy, and a leadership team with low quality can also ruin a good enterprise. Therefore, it is necessary to strengthen the construction of enterprise leadership teams and improve the quality of enterprise leaders. It is necessary to conduct institutionalized assessment and evaluation of enterprise management and improve their management and operation level under market economy conditions. For weak and incompetent teams, especially those of long-term loss-making enterprises, they must be resolutely replaced and adjusted in a timely manner, and the assessment of enterprise leadership teams that has been started in 1997 must be continued to be done well and see results.

管理。各定点生产企业要确保产品质量,做好售后服务工作。
translated_text: On the 13th, the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Notice on Further Improving the Replacement and Allocation of the Party Flag and Party Emblem of the Communist Party of China". The "Notice" requires that the party flags and party emblems used by party organizations at all levels that have not been replaced should be replaced as soon as possible; those that do not meet the regulations shall not be used. Party organizations that have not yet equipped with party flags and party emblems should gradually equip them in accordance with the regulations: From now on, party organizations can order party flags and party emblems directly from designated enterprises by grassroots party committees or local party committee organization departments, and there is no need to report to the Central Organization Department; the prices of party flags and party emblems are determined by designated production enterprises in accordance with relevant national regulations; party organizations at all levels shall not purchase party flags and party emblems produced by non-designated enterprises. If it is found that non-designated enterprises produce and sell party flags and party emblems, they should take the initiative to contact the local industrial and commercial administrative departments and investigate and deal with them in a timely manner; the organization departments of the provincial (autonomous region, municipality directly under the central government) party committees should strengthen the inspection and supervision of the replacement and allocation of party flags and party emblems. The organization departments of the provincial and municipal party committees where the designated production enterprises are located should assist the Central Organization Department in strengthening the management of designated enterprises. All designated production enterprises must ensure product quality and provide good after-sales service.

events:
21日 《人民日报》发表评论员文章“领导干部要做表率”。
文章指出,领导干部首先要做学习的表率。十五大报告是我们
党带领全国各族人民迈向新世纪的政治宣言和行动纲领,是高举
邓小平理论伟大旗帜,把建设有中国特色社会主义事业全面推向
21 世纪的一本“百科全书”,是相当长一个时期最重要的学习内
容。各级领导干部首先要认真研读十五大报告,全面准确领会精神
实质,牢牢把握十五大的主题,明确十五大提出的纲领、任务和方
针政策｡要密切联系实际,根据十五大精神部署工作,解决问题。在
此基础上,要组织广大党员学习,向群众进行宣传。学习的任务很
重,很迫切。在日新月异的当代,谁也没“老本”可吃。谁不认真学
习,谁就要落后,就没资格当领导。除了要认真学习十五大报告,学
习邓小平理论以外,还要学习社会主义市场经济知识,学习法律知
识,学习现代科学技术知识和管理知识,学习历史文化知识,学习
做好工作必需的一切知识。
领导干部要做发扬优良作风的表率。作风问题,实质上是对人
民群众的态度问题。当干部,要牢记全心全意为人民服务的宗旨,
绝不能脱离群众。实现宏伟目标,必须依靠人民群众的支持和参
与,必须发挥人民群众的积极性和创造性。现在,推进改革和建设
需要解决的问题不少,好办法不会从天上掉下来,也不是我们头脑
里固有的,归根到底只能来自于人民群众的创造和改革开放的实
践。领导干部要走出高楼深院,走出“文山”、“会海”,带头深入实
际,深入基层,调查研究。听取群众的意见,不断改进工作,真抓实
干,坚决反对主观主义、官僚主义、形式主义。理论上政治上要清醒
坚定,作风上要扎实。
领导干部还要做贯彻民主集中制,增强团结的表率。我们党是
个讲民主的党,也是个讲集中的党,是个贯彻民主集中制的党。在
改革开放和发展社会主义市场经济的条件下,民主集中制不仅不
能削弱,而且必须完善和发展。团结是党的生命,团结是大局。在
领导班子内部,要健全集体领导和个人分工负责相结合的制度。不
能一人说了算,也不能没人说了算,领导之间,既要互相信任,互相
支持､互相谅解,又要开展批评与自我批评。要光明正大,表里如
一,中国共产党和人民政府的干部不能沾染资产阶级政客的恶习。
目标是同一个,宗旨是同一个,要同心协力。要互相“补台”,不能互
相“拆台”,既不允许“窝里斗”,也不能当“老好人”。
translated_text: On the 21st, the People's Daily published a commentary article entitled "Leaders should set an example". The article pointed out that leaders should first set an example in learning. The report of the 15th National Congress is the political declaration and action program of our party to lead the people of all ethnic groups in the country into the new century. It is an "encyclopedia" that holds high the great banner of Deng Xiaoping Theory and comprehensively promotes the cause of building socialism with Chinese characteristics into the 21st century. It is the most important learning content for a long period of time. Leading cadres at all levels must first carefully study the report of the 15th National Congress, fully and accurately understand the essence of the spirit, firmly grasp the theme of the 15th National Congress, and clarify the program, tasks, and policies proposed by the 15th National Congress. We must closely connect with reality, deploy work according to the spirit of the 15th National Congress, and solve problems. On this basis, we must organize the majority of party members to study and publicize to the masses. The task of learning is heavy and urgent. In the ever-changing contemporary world, no one can rely on "old capital". Whoever does not study seriously will fall behind and will not be qualified to be a leader. In addition to studying the report of the 15th National Congress and Deng Xiaoping Theory, we must also learn about the socialist market economy, legal knowledge, modern science and technology, management knowledge, historical and cultural knowledge, and all the knowledge necessary to do a good job. Leading cadres should set an example in promoting good work style. The problem of work style is essentially a problem of attitude towards the people. When being a cadre, we must keep in mind the purpose of serving the people wholeheartedly and must never be separated from the masses. To achieve grand goals, we must rely on the support and participation of the people and give full play to the enthusiasm and creativity of the people. Now, there are many problems that need to be solved in promoting reform and construction. Good solutions will not fall from the sky, nor are they inherent in our minds. In the final analysis, they can only come from the creativity of the people and the practice of reform and opening up. Leading cadres must walk out of high-rise buildings and deep courtyards, walk out of "mountains of documents" and "sea of meetings", take the lead in going deep into reality, going deep into the grassroots, and conducting investigations and research. Listen to the opinions of the masses, constantly improve work, work hard, and resolutely oppose subjectivism, bureaucracy, and formalism. Theoretically, we must be clear-headed and firm in politics, and we must be solid in work style. Leading cadres should also set an example in implementing democratic centralism and strengthening unity. Our party is a democratic party, a centralized party, and a party that implements democratic centralism. Under the conditions of reform and opening up and the development of a socialist market economy, democratic centralism must not only not be weakened, but must be improved and developed. Unity is the life of the party and the overall situation. Within the leadership team, a system combining collective leadership with individual division of labor and responsibility must be improved. It is not possible for one person to have the final say, nor can it be possible for no one to have the final say. Leaders should trust, support and understand each other, and carry out criticism and self-criticism. They should be open and aboveboard, and the cadres of the Communist Party of China and the people's government should not be tainted by the bad habits of bourgeois politicians. The goal is the same, the purpose is the same, and we must work together. We should "help each other" and not "undermine" each other. We should not allow "infighting" or be "good guys".

events:
21日——24日 中共中央召开全国组织工作会议。会议的任
务是:深入学习和贯彻党的十五大精神,实事求是地回顾十四大以
来党的建设和组织工作,认真总结经验,研究和部署面向新世纪的
组织工作。
中共中央政治局常委江泽民、李鹏、朱镕基、李瑞环、胡锦涛、
李岚清等领导同志出席了会议。参加会议的还有中央、国家机关主
管组织、人事工作的领导同志和解放军总政治部、武警部队政治部
的有关负责同志共600多人。
中共中央总书记、国家主席江泽民在会上作了重要讲话。他指
出,党的十四大以来,中央和各级党委为加强领导班子和干部队伍
建设作了很大努力,采取了一系列重大措施,做了大量工作,取得
的成绩是明显的。各级领导干部,尤其是高中级干部学习邓小平理
论逐步深入,思想理论水平有了新的提高;新老干部的交替与合作
顺利进行,大批优秀年轻干部成长起来,逐步走上领导岗位;以建
设高素质干部队伍为目标,县以上领导干部中讲学习、讲政治、讲
正气的风气逐步兴起,各级各类干部培训工作的力度加大;干部制
度改革迈出新步伐,干部交流进一步展开。总的说来,我们的干
部,以党的基本理论、基本路线为指导,在不断研究新情况,解决新
问题、迎接新挑战的奋斗中,开阔了眼界,得到了锻炼,提高了水
平,增长了才干,为推进伟大事业发挥了骨干作用。我们党领导的
各项事业所取得的成就,都是同我们有一支适应时代要求的干部
队伍分不开的。
江泽民在讲话中,向各级领导同志提出了殷切的希望。他首先
强调,领导干部要重视学习,加强学习,不断提高理论修养和知识
水平 作为共产党人,放松了学习,思想落后于形势,就会丧失先进
性,使精神世界陷于低级趣味,就难以抵挡利欲的诱惑。他说,在全
党兴起学习马列主义、毛泽东思想特别是邓小平理论的新高潮,高
中级干部要带好头。要系统地而不是零碎地,实际地而不是空洞地
掌握邓小平理论,并且善于运用这个理论解决改革开放和现代化
建设中的各种问题,在实践中不断丰富发展这个理论。当今的时代
是一个各种新事物、新知识、新经验层出不穷的时代,我们要学习
的东西多得很。不论是谁,只要停顿下来,不学习新东西,肯定是要
落伍的。
江泽民在谈到贯彻中央的重大决策和部署时说,中央的重大
决策,都是经过广泛调查研究,征求各方面意见,从全国大局考虑
作出的。各地方,各部门一定要认真贯彻落实。高级干部尤其要在
这方面作表率。要正确处理全局和局部的关系,自觉坚持在大局下
面行动。要完整､准确地领会中央决策的精神,正确地加以贯彻执
行。贯彻中央决策,一定要体现在扎扎实实地打开工作局面上,体
现在解决实际问题上。
在谈到认真贯彻民主集中制时,江泽民指出,增强领导班子的
凝聚力和战斗力,必须健全集体领导和个人分工负责相结合的制
度。主要领导同志要有魄力,尤其要有全局思想和民主作风,要懂
得尊重别人,善于集思广益,坚持重大问题集体讨论决定。每个领
导成员既要根据集体的决定和分工,切实履行自己的职责,又要关
心全局工作,积极参与集体领导,要把贯彻执行民主集中制与讲学
习、讲政治、讲正气结合起来,树立领导班子的良好形象。
江泽民在讲话中着重强调,各级领导干部必须诚心诚意为人
民群众谋利益,始终保持同人民群众的血肉联系。要注意时刻摆正
自己同人民群众的位置,时刻牢记为人民服务的宗旨,时刻警惕脱

translated_text: From the 21st to the 24th, the CPC Central Committee held a national organizational work conference. The task of the conference was to thoroughly study and implement the spirit of the 15th CPC National Congress, to realistically review the party building and organizational work since the 14th CPC National Congress, to seriously summarize the experience, and to study and deploy organizational work for the new century. The Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee Jiang Zemin, Li Peng, Zhu Rongji, Li Ruihuan, Hu Jintao, Li Lanqing and other leading comrades attended the meeting. Also attending the meeting were more than 600 leading comrades in charge of organization and personnel work in the central and state organs and relevant responsible comrades from the General Political Department of the People's Liberation Army and the Political Department of the Armed Police Force. Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee and President of the People's Republic of China, delivered an important speech at the meeting. He pointed out that since the 14th CPC National Congress, the Central Committee and party committees at all levels have made great efforts to strengthen the construction of leadership teams and cadres, adopted a series of major measures, and done a lot of work, and the achievements have been obvious. Leading cadres at all levels, especially middle-level cadres, have gradually deepened their study of Deng Xiaoping Theory and have made new progress in their ideological and theoretical level; the alternation and cooperation between old and new cadres have been carried out smoothly, and a large number of outstanding young cadres have grown up and gradually taken up leadership positions; with the goal of building a high-quality cadre team, the trend of learning, politics and integrity has gradually emerged among leading cadres at the county level and above, and the training of cadres at all levels and of all types has been strengthened; the reform of the cadre system has taken new steps and the exchange of cadres has been further carried out. In general, our cadres, guided by the basic theory and basic line of the Party, have broadened their horizons, been tempered, improved their level, and increased their talents in the struggle to continuously study new situations, solve new problems and meet new challenges, and have played a backbone role in promoting the great cause. The achievements made in various undertakings led by our Party are inseparable from the fact that we have a cadre team that adapts to the requirements of the times. In his speech, Jiang Zemin expressed his earnest hope to leading comrades at all levels. He first emphasized that leading cadres should attach importance to learning, strengthen learning, and constantly improve their theoretical cultivation and knowledge level. As a Communist, if you relax your learning and your thoughts lag behind the situation, you will lose your advanced nature, your spiritual world will fall into low-level interests, and it will be difficult to resist the temptation of greed. He said that in the new upsurge of learning Marxism-Leninism, Mao Zedong Thought, and especially Deng Xiaoping Theory in the whole party, senior and middle-level cadres should set a good example. We must master Deng Xiaoping Theory systematically rather than piecemeal, practically rather than empty, and be good at using this theory to solve various problems in reform and opening up and modernization construction, and constantly enrich and develop this theory in practice. Today's era is an era in which all kinds of new things, new knowledge, and new experiences emerge in an endless stream. We have a lot to learn. No matter who you are, as long as you stop and don't learn new things, you will definitely fall behind. When talking about the implementation of the major decisions and arrangements of the central government, Jiang Zemin said that the major decisions of the central government are made after extensive investigation and research, soliciting opinions from all sides, and considering the overall situation of the country. All localities and departments must conscientiously implement them. Senior cadres should set an example in this regard. We should correctly handle the relationship between the overall situation and the local situation, and consciously adhere to the overall situation. We should fully and accurately understand the spirit of the central decision-making and correctly implement it. The implementation of the central decision must be reflected in the solid opening of the work situation and the solution of practical problems. When talking about the conscientious implementation of democratic centralism, Jiang Zemin pointed out that in order to enhance the cohesion and combat effectiveness of the leadership team, it is necessary to improve the system of combining collective leadership with individual division of labor and responsibility. The main leading comrades should have courage, especially the overall thinking and democratic style, know how to respect others, be good at brainstorming, and insist on collective discussion and decision on major issues. Each leading member should not only fulfill his or her own duties according to the collective decision and division of labor, but also care about the overall work and actively participate in collective leadership. It is necessary to combine the implementation of democratic centralism with learning, politics, and integrity to establish a good image of the leadership team. In his speech, Jiang Zemin emphasized that leading cadres at all levels must sincerely seek benefits for the people and always maintain flesh-and-blood ties with the people. We should always pay attention to placing ourselves in the right position with the masses, always bear in mind the purpose of serving the people, and always be vigilant against the tendency of being divorced from the masses. As the ruling party, on the one hand, we must adhere to the fundamental working line of coming from the masses and going to the masses, adhere to the ideological line of emancipating the mind and seeking truth from facts, and ensure that there are no problems with the line, principles, policies and major decisions; on the other hand, we must ensure that cadres at all levels and tens of millions of party members, first of all, leading organs and leading cadres, do not separate themselves from the masses in terms of ideology, work style and work: Finally, Jiang Zemin emphasized that the image that leading cadres, especially senior cadres, establish among the masses plays an important guiding role. Our leading cadres should not only be strict with themselves, but also manage their spouses, children and staff around them, and at the same time manage their subordinates. We must be determined to further strengthen and improve various systems of internal party supervision, and high- and middle-level cadres should improve their consciousness of accepting supervision. In short, leading cadres at all levels should establish lofty ideals and firm beliefs, and be models of upholding and carrying forward the fine traditions and work style of the Party. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, also delivered an important speech. He realistically affirmed the achievements and progress of party building in the past five years, analyzed the new characteristics of party building work including organizational work, pointed out the current shortcomings and problems that are not adapted to the new situation and new tasks. He stressed that in the process of implementing the spirit of the 15th National Congress, we must seize the opportunity to do a good job in party building and organizational work for the new century, strive to make the whole party learn Deng Xiaoping Theory with greater results, improve the quality of party members and cadres, strengthen the construction of leadership teams at all levels, and make new breakthroughs in cadre system reform; continue to deepen grassroots organization construction and rectification work, and strengthen the cohesion and combat effectiveness of party organizations; earnestly correct various negative and corrupt phenomena that are out of touch with the masses within the party, and have a new atmosphere in the relationship between the party and the masses, and between cadres and the masses; and make new progress in cadre training, intellectual work, veteran cadre work, and the construction of the organization department itself. Hu Jintao pointed out that we must deeply understand and closely focus on the theme of the 15th National Congress, follow the general goal and overall deployment of party building in the new era proposed by the 15th National Congress, study new situations and solve new problems in the spirit of reform, and strive to create a new situation in organizational work. He demanded that we should focus on the following five aspects: (i) Focus on leading cadres to promote the whole party to firmly and vigorously rise to a new high tide of theoretical learning; (ii) Focus on ideological and political construction to comprehensively strengthen the construction of the leadership team; (iii) Focus on cultivating and selecting outstanding young cadres to vigorously build a high-quality cadre team; (iv) Focus on rural areas and enterprises to strengthen and improve the construction of grassroots party organizations; (v) Focus on improving quality and strengthening party spirit to vigorously build a team of party members. Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the Central Committee, made arrangements for organizational work in 1998 at the meeting. In his speech, he said that in 1998, the organization work should focus on six aspects: organize the majority of party members, cadres, especially leading cadres to study Deng Xiaoping Theory as the primary task of the organization work; comprehensively improve the quality of leading cadres and further strengthen the construction of the leadership team; strengthen training, boldly select, and strive to create a large number of young cadres who can shoulder important tasks across the century; focus on promoting the promotion and demotion of cadres and accelerate the pace of cadre system reform; vigorously strengthen and improve the construction of the party's grassroots organizations and party members, enhance the party's cohesion and combat effectiveness; and further strengthen the self-construction of the organization department. Zhang Quanjing required that party organizations at all levels should follow the general goal of the new great project of party building, focus on solving the two major issues of continuously improving the leadership and governance level and continuously enhancing the ability to resist corruption and prevent degeneration, focus on ideological and political construction, comprehensively improve the quality of leading cadres, and further strengthen the construction of the leadership team. We should focus on enhancing the awareness of leading cadres in fully implementing the Party's basic line; educate and guide leading cadres to adhere to the fundamental purpose of serving the people wholeheartedly; adhere to the principle of democratic centralism and enhance the unity and cohesion of the leadership team; strive to improve the ability of leading cadres to control reform, opening up and modernization; further emancipate the mind, remove obstacles, strive to create a good environment for young cadres to stand out, and boldly select young cadres to join the leadership team. Zhang Quanjing stressed that the pace of cadre system reform should be accelerated, especially in terms of cadres being able to move up and down. In deepening the reform of the cadre system, we must adhere to the principle of the Party managing cadres and improve the methods of the Party managing cadres. Through continuous exploration and practice, we will gradually establish a scientific classification management system that conforms to the different characteristics of party and government organs, enterprises and institutions, create an open, equal, competitive and merit-based employment environment, improve a dynamic employment mechanism in which cadres can move up and down, enter and exit, and improve a supervision system with strict management, complete systems and mass participation, and gradually form a cadre system with Chinese characteristics that is compatible with the socialist market economy system and democratic political construction.

translated_text: On the 29th, Jiang Zemin, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee and President of the State, delivered an important speech at the closing ceremony of the seminar for members and alternate members of the CPC Central Committee on Deng Xiaoping Theory and the spirit of the 15th CPC National Congress. Jiang Zemin stressed that the whole party should form a new upsurge in the study of Deng Xiaoping Theory and raise this study to the new level reached by the 15th CPC National Congress. Historical experience, current requirements and future developments all tell us that the members and alternate members of the CPC Central Committee and senior cadres of the Party should first strengthen theoretical study and arm themselves with Marxism-Leninism, Mao Zedong Thought, and especially Deng Xiaoping Theory. At the same time, they should broaden their horizons and pay attention to understanding various trends and trends that reflect new developments and changes in the world. He asked the comrades of the Central Committee to take the lead in forming a culture of serious study, to extend this culture to the whole party, and to raise the level of the whole party's study of Deng Xiaoping Theory and its creative application of Deng Xiaoping Theory in practice to guide various work to a new height. Jiang Zemin pointed out that nearly half of the members of the Central Committee elected at the 15th CPC National Congress were new. In 1998, a large number of new comrades will take up important leadership positions. New responsibilities require that our ideological realm and theoretical level should be improved. Reform is deepening, development and stability are facing many deep-seated problems, and the international situation has undergone various new changes. All these require us to raise the study of Deng Xiaoping Theory to a new level in order to adapt to the new situation, solve new problems, and create a new situation. Jiang Zemin emphasized that most of our members and alternate members of the Central Committee are in important leadership positions, and their work tasks are heavy, and their learning tasks are also heavy. Learning is multifaceted, including the study of professional knowledge, historical knowledge, legal knowledge, market economy knowledge, international knowledge, etc., which are all necessary and important. But these are not enough. The first thing is to strengthen theoretical study. We must carefully read the Selected Works of Deng Xiaoping and the documents of the various Party Congresses and Central Committee Plenary Sessions since the Third Plenary Session of the Eleventh Central Committee. We must also read several important works of Marx and Lenin, the Selected Works of Mao Zedong, and the works written after the founding of the People's Republic of China in the Selected Works of Mao Zedong. He hoped that every member and alternate member of the Central Committee would formulate a plan for learning theory according to their own situation, work hard, squeeze out time, and persevere. Hu Jintao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat, spoke at the opening ceremony of the seminar on December 4. In his speech, Hu Jintao fully elaborated on the importance of holding high the great banner of Deng Xiaoping Theory and arming the whole party with Deng Xiaoping Theory. He emphasized that leading cadres at all levels should follow the requirements of the 15th National Congress, focus on the fundamental issue of "what is socialism and how to build socialism", fully and accurately grasp the scientific system of Deng Xiaoping Theory, understand the basic viewpoints and basic spirit of the theory in general, and systematically study and understand the relevant content of the theory from the perspective of their respective work areas. Hu Jintao pointed out that the current in-depth study of Deng Xiaoping Theory should be combined with the study of the spirit of the 15th National Congress. We should use Deng Xiaoping Theory to guide the study of the report of the 15th National Congress, deeply understand that the series of ideas and viewpoints put forward in the report are the adherence to, application and development of Deng Xiaoping Theory, and fully realize the objective inevitability and correctness of the series of policies and major measures in the report on promoting my country's socialist modernization, so as to deeply understand and fully grasp the spirit of the 15th National Congress. Through studying the report of the 15th National Congress, we should deepen our understanding of Deng Xiaoping Theory and its historical status and guiding significance, and enhance our consciousness and determination to hold high the great banner unshakably. Wei Jianxing also spoke at the closing ceremony. Central leaders Ding Guangen, Zhang Wannian, Luo Gan, Zeng Qinghong and heads of relevant central departments Zhang Quanjing, Teng Wensheng, Wang Jiaxi and others also attended the closing ceremony.

translated_text: On the 30th, Zhang Quanjing, Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, spoke at the graduation ceremony of the second batch of advanced training courses for enterprise leaders at the Central Party School, pointing out that the reform of state-owned enterprises is currently in the critical stage, and it is also a period with many problems. The more critical the moment, the more difficult the time, the more we must play the role of the party organization as a fighting fortress and the vanguard and exemplary role of the Communist Party members. This is our political advantage. With the deepening of economic system reform and state-owned enterprise reform, enterprise party building work has encountered a large number of new situations and new topics. If the party organization of the enterprise wants to make a difference, it must constantly emancipate the mind, update concepts, boldly explore, and be brave to innovate on the premise of adhering to the great goal of party building. At present, we should seriously study the establishment, duties, responsibilities, working methods and leadership relations of party organizations in large enterprise groups that are cross-regional, cross-industry, cross-ownership and transnational; seriously study the ways and methods for enterprise party organizations to play the role of political core in the establishment of a modern enterprise system; seriously study how to establish party organizations and carry out party activities in a timely manner in enterprises that have been leased, contracted and sold to individuals and enterprises that have implemented shareholding reforms after the liberalization of small state-owned enterprises; seriously study how enterprises with "one factory, multiple systems" can define the status, role and function of party organizations of different natures in enterprises according to new circumstances. We encourage party organizations at all levels to boldly break through and try boldly according to the standards of "three benefits" and do not require uniformity. In the process of promoting the reform and development of state-owned enterprises, strengthening the party building work of state-owned enterprises and giving full play to the political core role of enterprise party organizations is fundamentally to carry out party work closely around enterprise reform and production and operation. Zhang Quanjing said that the construction of enterprise leadership teams is the key to enterprise party building. A large number of facts show that the key to running state-owned enterprises well is to have a good leadership team. To build a good leadership team of state-owned enterprises, the first thing is to strengthen ideological and political construction. Leaders of state-owned enterprises should earnestly study Deng Xiaoping Theory, strengthen their confidence in running state-owned enterprises, enhance their political sense of responsibility and mission in running state-owned enterprises, rely wholeheartedly on the working class to run enterprises, fight corruption and promote integrity, adhere to and carry forward the fine tradition of hard work, and oppose and resist ostentation and extravagance. Enterprise leaders should always bear in mind their responsibilities, correctly handle the relationship between power, responsibility and interests, establish a holistic concept, safeguard the overall interests of the country, respect themselves, reflect on themselves, warn themselves, encourage themselves, be strict with themselves, and consciously resist the erosion of various decadent ideas and lifestyles. Zhang Quanjing stressed that it is necessary to strengthen learning and training, and strive to improve the theoretical cultivation and knowledge level of enterprise leaders. Party committees at all levels and relevant departments should create conditions for the learning and improvement of enterprise leaders, and earnestly do a good job in the training of state-owned enterprise leaders. This advanced training course lasted 26 days, with nearly 100 leading cadres from key state-owned enterprises across the country participating. Zheng Bijian, vice president of the Central Party School, presided over the closing ceremony. Wang Zhongyu, director of the State Economic and Trade Commission, attended the closing ceremony.
